versets.arabe: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
versets.phonetique: Bismillahi r-rahmani r-rahim
versets.francais: Au nom d'Allah, le Tout Miséricordieux, le Très Miséricordieux
versets.anglais: In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful

versets.arabe: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Al-hamdu lillahi rabbi l-alamin
versets.francais: Louange à Allah, Seigneur des univers
versets.anglais: [All] praise is [due] to Allah, Lord of the worlds

versets.arabe: الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
versets.phonetique: Ar-rahmani r-rahim
versets.francais: Le Tout Miséricordieux, le Très Miséricordieux
versets.anglais: The Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful

versets.arabe: مَالِكِ يَوْمِ الدِّينِ
versets.phonetique: Maliki yawmi d-din
versets.francais: Maître du Jour de la Rétribution
versets.anglais: Sovereign of the Day of Recompense

versets.arabe: إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَإِيَّاكَ نَسْتَعِينُ
versets.phonetique: Iyyaka nabudu wa iyyaka nastain
versets.francais: C'est Toi [Seul] que nous adorons, et c'est Toi [Seul] dont nous implorons le secours
versets.anglais: It is You we worship and You we ask for help

versets.arabe: اهْدِنَا الصِّرَاطَ الْمُسْتَقِيمَ
versets.phonetique: Ihdina s-sirata l-mustaqim
versets.francais: Guide-nous dans le droit chemin
versets.anglais: Guide us to the straight path

versets.arabe: صِرَاطَ الَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ الْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا الضَّالِّينَ
versets.phonetique: Sirata l-ladhina anamta alayhim ghayri l-maghdubi alayhim wa la d-dallin
versets.francais: Le chemin de ceux que Tu as comblés de faveurs, non pas de ceux qui ont encouru Ta colère, ni des égarés
versets.anglais: The path of those upon whom You have bestowed favor, not of those who have evoked [Your] anger or of those who are astray

versets.arabe: الم
versets.phonetique: Alif-Lâm-Mîm
versets.francais: Alif, Lâm, Mîm.
versets.anglais: Alif, Lam, Meem

versets.arabe: ذَٰلِكَ الْكِتَابُ لَا رَيْبَ ۛ فِيهِ ۛ هُدًى لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
versets.phonetique: Dhâlikal-kitâbu lâ rayba fîhi hudal-lil-muttaqîn
versets.francais: C'est le Livre au sujet duquel il n'y a aucun doute, une guidée pour les pieux.
versets.anglais: This is the Book about which there is no doubt, a guidance for those conscious of Allah

versets.arabe: الَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْغَيْبِ وَيُقِيمُونَ الصَّلَاةَ وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَاهُمْ يُنفِقُونَ
versets.phonetique: Alladhîna yu'minûna bil-ghaybi wa yuqîmûnas-salâta wa mimmâ razaqnâhum yunfiqûn
versets.francais: qui croient à l'invisible, accomplissent la Salât et dépensent de ce que Nous leur avons accordé.
versets.anglais: Who believe in the unseen, establish prayer, and spend out of what We have provided for them

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ وَمَا أُنزِلَ مِن قَبْلِكَ وَبِالْآخِرَةِ هُمْ يُوقِنُونَ
versets.phonetique: Walladhîna yu'minûna bimâ unzila ilayka wa mâ unzila min qablika wa bil-âkhirati hum yûqinûn
versets.francais: et qui croient à ce qui t'a été révélé et à ce qui a été révélé avant toi et qui ont la certitude de l'au-delà.
versets.anglais: And who believe in what has been revealed to you, [O Muhammad], and what was revealed before you, and of the Hereafter they are certain [in faith]

versets.arabe: أُولَٰئِكَ عَلَىٰ هُدًى مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ ۖ وَأُولَٰئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ
versets.phonetique: Ulâ'ika 'alâ hudam min rabbihim wa ulâ'ika humul-muflihûn
versets.francais: Ceux-là sont sur le bon chemin de leur Seigneur et ce sont eux les bienheureux.
versets.anglais: Those are upon [right] guidance from their Lord, and it is those who are the successful

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا سَوَاءٌ عَلَيْهِمْ أَأَنذَرْتَهُمْ أَمْ لَمْ تُنذِرْهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
versets.phonetique: Innal-ladhîna kafarû sawâ'un 'alayhim a'andhartahum am lam tundhirhum lâ yu'minûn
versets.francais: Ceux qui ont mécru, il leur est égal que tu les avertisses ou non: ils ne croiront pas.
versets.anglais: Indeed, those who disbelieve - it is all the same for them whether you warn them or do not warn them - they will not believe

versets.arabe: خَتَمَ اللَّهُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ وَعَلَىٰ سَمْعِهِمْ ۖ وَعَلَىٰ أَبْصَارِهِمْ غِشَاوَةٌ ۖ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: KhatamaAllâhu 'alâ qulûbihim wa 'alâ sam'ihim wa 'alâ absârihim ghishâwatun wa lahum 'adhâbun 'azîm
versets.francais: Allah a scellé leurs cœurs et leurs oreilles; et sur leurs yeux il y a une cécité; ils auront un grand châtiment.
versets.anglais: Allah has set a seal upon their hearts and upon their hearing, and over their vision is a veil. And for them is a great punishment

versets.arabe: وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَن يَقُولُ آمَنَّا بِاللَّهِ وَبِالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ وَمَا هُم بِمُؤْمِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa minan-nâsi man yaqûlu âmannâ billâhi wa bil-yawmil-âkhiri wa mâ hum bimu'minîn
versets.francais: Parmi les gens, il en est qui disent: "Nous croyons en Allah et au Jour Dernier", alors qu'ils ne sont pas croyants.
versets.anglais: And of the people are some who say, "We believe in Allah and the Last Day," but they are not believers

versets.arabe: يُخَادِعُونَ اللَّهَ وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَمَا يَخْدَعُونَ إِلَّا أَنفُسَهُمْ وَمَا يَشْعُرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Yukhâdi'ûnAllâha walladhîna âmanû wa mâ yakhda'ûna illâ anfusahum wa mâ yash'urûn
versets.francais: Ils cherchent à tromper Allah et ceux qui ont cru; mais ils ne trompent qu'eux-mêmes et ils ne s'en rendent pas compte.
versets.anglais: They [think to] deceive Allah and those who believe, but they deceive not except themselves and perceive [it] not

versets.arabe: فِي قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ فَزَادَهُمُ اللَّهُ مَرَضًا ۖ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ بِمَا كَانُوا يَكْذِبُونَ
versets.phonetique: Fî qulûbihim maradhun fazâdahumullâhu maradhan wa lahum 'adhâbun alîmun bimâ kânû yakdhibûn
versets.francais: Leurs cœurs sont malades; Allah les a rendus plus malades encore. Ils auront un châtiment douloureux pour avoir menti.
versets.anglais: In their hearts is disease, so Allah has increased their disease; and for them is a painful punishment because they [habitually] used to lie

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ لَا تُفْسِدُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ قَالُوا إِنَّمَا نَحْنُ مُصْلِحُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa idhâ qîla lahum lâ tufsidû fil-ardi qâlû innamâ nahnu muslihûn
versets.francais: Et quand on leur dit: "Ne semez pas la corruption sur la terre", ils disent: "Nous ne sommes que des réformateurs!"
versets.anglais: And when it is said to them, "Do not cause corruption on the earth," they say, "We are but reformers

versets.arabe: أَلَا إِنَّهُمْ هُمُ الْمُفْسِدُونَ وَلَٰكِن لَّا يَشْعُرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Alâ innahum humul-mufsidûna wa lâkin lâ yash'urûn
versets.francais: Non, c'est bien eux les corrupteurs, mais ils ne s'en rendent pas compte.
versets.anglais: Unquestionably, it is they who are the corrupters, but they perceive [it] not

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ آمِنُوا كَمَا آمَنَ النَّاسُ قَالُوا أَنُؤْمِنُ كَمَا آمَنَ السُّفَهَاءُ ۗ أَلَا إِنَّهُمْ هُمُ السُّفَهَاءُ وَلَٰكِن لَّا يَعْلَمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa idhâ qîla lahum âminû kamâ âmanan-nâsu qâlû anu'minu kamâ âmanas-sufahâ'u, alâ innahum humus-sufahâ'u wa lâkin lâ ya'lamûn
versets.francais: Et quand on leur dit: "Croyez comme les gens ont cru", ils disent: "Croirions-nous comme ont cru les stupides?" Non, c'est bien eux les stupides, mais ils ne le savent pas.
versets.anglais: And when it is said to them, "Believe as the people have believed," they say, "Should we believe as the foolish have believed?" Unquestionably, it is they who are the foolish, but they know [it] not

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا لَقُوا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا قَالُوا آمَنَّا وَإِذَا خَلَوْا إِلَىٰ شَيَاطِينِهِمْ قَالُوا إِنَّا مَعَكُمْ إِنَّمَا نَحْنُ مُسْتَهْزِئُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa idhâ laqul-ladhîna âmanû qâlû âmannâ wa idhâ khalaw ilâ shayâtînihim qâlû innâ ma'akum innamâ nahnu mustahzi'ûn
versets.francais: Quand ils rencontrent les croyants, ils disent: "Nous croyons." Mais quand ils se retrouvent seuls avec leurs diables, ils disent: "Nous sommes avec vous; nous ne faisions que nous moquer."
versets.anglais: And when they meet those who believe, they say, "We believe"; but when they are alone with their evil ones, they say, "Indeed, we are with you; we were only mockers

versets.arabe: اللَّهُ يَسْتَهْزِئُ بِهِمْ وَيَمُدُّهُمْ فِي طُغْيَانِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
versets.phonetique: Allâhu yastahzi'u bihim wa yamuddhuhum fî tughyânihim ya'mahûn
versets.francais: C'est Allah qui Se moque d'eux et les laisse errer dans leur rébellion.
versets.anglais: [But] Allah mocks them and prolongs them in their transgression [while] they wander blindly

versets.arabe: أُولَٰئِكَ الَّذِينَ اشْتَرَوُا الضَّلَالَةَ بِالْهُدَىٰ فَمَا رَبِحَت تِّجَارَتُهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوا مُهْتَدِينَ
versets.phonetique: Ulâ'ikal-ladhînashtarawud-dalâlata bil-hudâ famâ rabihat tijâratuhum wa mâ kânû muhtadîn
versets.francais: Ceux-là ont échangé la guidée contre l'égarement. Leur commerce n'a pas été profitable et ils n'étaient pas sur la bonne voie.
versets.anglais: Those are the ones who have purchased error [in exchange] for guidance, so their transaction has brought no profit, nor were they guided

versets.arabe: مَثَلُهُمْ كَمَثَلِ الَّذِي اسْتَوْقَدَ نَارًا فَلَمَّا أَضَاءَتْ مَا حَوْلَهُ ذَهَبَ اللَّهُ بِنُورِهِمْ وَتَرَكَهُمْ فِي ظُلُمَاتٍ لَّا يُبْصِرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Mathaluhum kamathalil-ladhîstawqada nâran falammâ adhâ'at mâ hawlahu dhahabAllâhu binûrihim wa tarakahum fî zulumâtin lâ yubsirûn
versets.francais: Ils ressemblent à quelqu'un qui allume un feu; quand le feu éclaire tout autour de lui, Allah enlève leur lumière et les laisse dans des ténèbres où ils ne voient rien.
versets.anglais: Their example is that of one who kindled a fire, but when it illuminated what was around him, Allah took away their light and left them in darkness [so] they could not see

versets.arabe: صُمٌّ بُكْمٌ عُمْيٌ فَهُمْ لَا يَرْجِعُونَ
versets.phonetique: Summun bukmun 'umyun fahum lâ yarji'ûn
versets.francais: Sourds, muets et aveugles, ils ne peuvent revenir.
versets.anglais: Deaf, dumb and blind - so they will not return [to the right path]

versets.arabe: أَوْ كَصَيِّبٍ مِّنَ السَّمَاءِ فِيهِ ظُلُمَاتٌ وَرَعْدٌ وَبَرْقٌ يَجْعَلُونَ أَصَابِعَهُمْ فِي آذَانِهِم مِّنَ الصَّوَاعِقِ حَذَرَ الْمَوْتِ ۚ وَاللَّهُ مُحِيطٌ بِالْكَافِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Aw kasayyibin minas-samâ'i fîhi zulumâtun wa ra'dun wa barqun yaj'alûna asâbi'ahum fî âdhânihim minas-sawâ'iqi hadhral-mawt, wallâhu muhîtun bil-kâfirîn
versets.francais: Ou comme une nuée d'orage du ciel avec ténèbres, tonnerre et éclair; ils se mettent les doigts dans les oreilles contre les coups du tonnerre, par peur de la mort. Allah cerne les ingrats.
versets.anglais: Or [it is] like a rainstorm from the sky within which is darkness, thunder and lightning. They put their fingers in their ears against the thunderclaps in dread of death. But Allah is encompassing of the disbelievers

versets.arabe: يَكَادُ الْبَرْقُ يَخْطَفُ أَبْصَارَهُمْ ۖ كُلَّمَا أَضَاءَ لَهُم مَّشَوْا فِيهِ وَإِذَا أَظْلَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ قَامُوا ۚ وَلَوْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ لَذَهَبَ بِسَمْعِهِمْ وَأَبْصَارِهِمْ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
versets.phonetique: Yakâdul-barqu yakhтafu absârahum kullamâ adhâ'a lahum mashaw fîhi wa idhâ azlama 'alayhim qâmû, wa law shâ'Allâhu ladhahaba bisam'ihim wa absârihim, innAllâha 'alâ kulli shay'in qadîr
versets.francais: L'éclair est sur le point de leur ravir la vue; chaque fois qu'il les éclaire ils marchent; et quand l'obscurité vient sur eux, ils s'arrêtent. Si Allah voulait, Il leur ôterait l'ouïe et la vue. Allah est Omnipotent.
versets.anglais: The lightning almost snatches away their sight. Every time it lights [the way] for them, they walk therein; but when darkness comes over them, they stand [still]. And if Allah had willed, He could have taken away their hearing and their sight. Indeed, Allah is over all things competent

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اعْبُدُوا رَبَّكُمُ الَّذِي خَلَقَكُمْ وَالَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَّقُونَ
versets.phonetique: Yâ ayyuhan-nâsu'budû rabbakumul-ladhî khalaqakum walladhîna min qablikum la'allakum tattaqûn
versets.francais: Ô hommes! Adorez votre Seigneur qui vous a créés, vous et ceux qui vous ont précédés, afin que vous soyez pieux.
versets.anglais: O mankind, worship your Lord, who created you and those before you, that you may become righteous

versets.arabe: الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْأَرْضَ فِرَاشًا وَالسَّمَاءَ بِنَاءً وَأَنزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَأَخْرَجَ بِهِ مِنَ الثَّمَرَاتِ رِزْقًا لَّكُمْ ۖ فَلَا تَجْعَلُوا لِلَّهِ أَندَادًا وَأَنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Alladhî ja'ala lakumul-arda firâshan was-samâ'a binâ'an wa anzala minas-samâ'i mâ'an fa'akhraja bihi minas-thamarâti rizqan lakum, falâ taj'alû lillâhi andâdan wa antum ta'lamûn
versets.francais: Lui qui a fait pour vous la terre un lit, le ciel une toiture et qui a fait descendre du ciel de l'eau pour faire sortir par elle des fruits, comme subsistance pour vous. Ne donnez donc pas des égaux à Allah, alors que vous savez.
versets.anglais: [He] who made for you the earth a bed [spread out] and the sky a ceiling and sent down from the sky, rain and brought forth thereby fruits as provision for you. So do not attribute to Allah equals while you know [that there is nothing similar to Him]

versets.arabe: وَإِن كُنتُمْ فِي رَيْبٍ مِّمَّا نَزَّلْنَا عَلَىٰ عَبْدِنَا فَأْتُوا بِسُورَةٍ مِّن مِّثْلِهِ وَادْعُوا شُهَدَاءَكُم مِّن دُونِ اللَّهِ إِن كُنتُمْ صَادِقِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa in kuntum fî raybin mimmâ nazzalnâ 'alâ 'abdinâ fa'tû bisûratin min mithlihi wad'û shuhadâ'akum min dûnillâhi in kuntum sâdiqîn
versets.francais: Et si vous avez un doute sur ce que Nous avons révélé à Notre serviteur, apportez donc une sourate semblable et appelez vos témoins en dehors d'Allah, si vous êtes véridiques.
versets.anglais: And if you are in doubt about what We have sent down upon Our Servant [Muhammad], then produce a surah the like thereof and call upon your witnesses other than Allah, if you should be truthful

versets.arabe: فَإِن لَّمْ تَفْعَلُوا وَلَن تَفْعَلُوا فَاتَّقُوا النَّارَ الَّتِي وَقُودُهَا النَّاسُ وَالْحِجَارَةُ ۖ أُعِدَّتْ لِلْكَافِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Fa in lam taf'alû wa lan taf'alû fattaqun-nârallatî waqûduhan-nâsu wal-hijâratu, u'iddat lil-kâfirîn
versets.francais: Si vous ne le faites pas, et vous ne le ferez jamais, craignez le Feu dont le combustible est les hommes et les pierres, préparé pour les ingrats.
versets.anglais: But if you do not - and you will never be able to - then fear the Fire, whose fuel is men and stones, prepared for the disbelievers

versets.arabe: وَبَشِّرِ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ أَنَّ لَهُمْ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ
versets.phonetique: Wa bashsiril-ladhîna âmanû wa 'amiluss-sâlihâti anna lahum jannâtin tajrî min tahtihal-anhâr
versets.francais: Et annonce la bonne nouvelle à ceux qui croient et font de bonnes œuvres: ils auront des jardins sous lesquels coulent des ruisseaux.
versets.anglais: And give good tidings to those who believe and do righteous deeds that they will have gardens [in Paradise] beneath which rivers flow. Whenever they are provided with a provision of fruit therefrom, they will say, "This is what we were provided with before." And it is given to them in likeness. And they will have therein purified spouses, and they will abide therein eternally

versets.arabe: إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَسْتَحْيِي أَن يَضْرِبَ مَثَلًا مَّا بَعُوضَةً فَمَا فَوْقَهَا
versets.phonetique: InnAllâha lâ yastahyî an yadriba mathalammâ ba'ûdhatan famâ fawqahâ
versets.francais: Allah ne craint pas de donner en parabole un moustique ou quelque chose au-dessus.
versets.anglais: Indeed, Allah is not timid to present an example - that of a mosquito or what is smaller than it. And those who have believed know that it is the truth from their Lord. But as for those who disbelieve, they say, "What did Allah intend by this as an example?" He misleads many thereby and guides many thereby. And He misleads not except the defiantly disobedient

versets.arabe: الَّذِينَ يَنقُضُونَ عَهْدَ اللَّهِ مِن بَعْدِ مِيثَاقِهِ وَيَقْطَعُونَ مَا أَمَرَ اللَّهُ بِهِ أَن يُوصَلَ وَيُفْسِدُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ ۚ أُولَٰئِكَ هُمُ الْخَاسِرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Alladhîna yanqudûna 'ahdAllâhi min ba'di mîthâqihi wa yaqta'ûna mâ amarAllâhu bihi an yûsala wa yufsidûna fil-ardi, ulâ'ika humul-khâsirûn
versets.francais: Ceux qui rompent le pacte d'Allah après l'avoir contracté, coupent ce qu'Allah a ordonné de maintenir, et sèment la corruption sur la terre; ceux-là sont les perdants.
versets.anglais: Who break the covenant of Allah after contracting it and sever that which Allah has ordered to be joined and cause corruption on earth. It is those who are the losers

versets.arabe: كَيْفَ تَكْفُرُونَ بِاللَّهِ وَكُنتُمْ أَمْوَاتًا فَأَحْيَاكُمْ ۖ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمْ ثُمَّ يُحْيِيكُمْ ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
versets.phonetique: Kayfa takfurûna billâhi wa kuntum amwâtan fa'ahyâkum, thumma yumîtukum thumma yuhyîkum thumma ilayhi turja'ûn
versets.francais: Comment pouvez-vous nier Allah alors qu'Il vous a donné la vie quand vous étiez morts, puis Il vous fera mourir, puis vous fera revivre, et enfin vous retournerez à Lui.
versets.anglais: How can you disbelieve in Allah when you were lifeless and He brought you to life; then He will cause you to die, then He will bring you [back] to life, and then to Him you will be returned

versets.arabe: هُوَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ لَكُم مَّا فِي الْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ اسْتَوَىٰ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ فَسَوَّاهُنَّ سَبْعَ سَمَاوَاتٍ ۚ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Huwal-ladhî khalaqa lakum mâ fil-ardi jamî'an thummastawa ilas-samâ'i fasawwâhunna sab'a samâwât, wa huwa bikulli shay'in 'alîm
versets.francais: C'est Lui qui a créé pour vous tout ce qui est sur la terre; puis Il a orienté Sa volonté vers le ciel et en fit sept cieux. Il est Omniscient.
versets.anglais: It is He who created for you all of that which is on the earth. Then He directed Himself to the heaven, [His being above all creation], and made them seven heavens, and He is Knowing of all things

versets.arabe: وَإِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَائِكَةِ إِنِّي جَاعِلٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ خَلِيفَةً ۖ قَالُوا أَتَجْعَلُ فِيهَا مَن يُفْسِدُ فِيهَا وَيَسْفِكُ الدِّمَاءَ وَنَحْنُ نُسَبِّحُ بِحَمْدِكَ وَنُقَدِّسُ لَكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنِّي أَعْلَمُ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa idh qâla rabbuka lil-malâ'ikati innî jâ'ilun fil-ardi khalîfatan, qâlû ataj'alu fîhâ man yufsidu fîhâ wa yasfiku dimâ'a wa nahnu nusabbihu bihamdika wa nuqaddisu lak, qâla innî a'lamu mâ lâ ta'lamûn
versets.francais: Et quand ton Seigneur dit aux anges: "Je vais établir un vicaire sur la terre." Ils dirent: "Vas-Tu y placer quelqu'un qui y mettra le désordre et qui répandra le sang, tandis que nous, nous Te louons et Te sanctifions?" Il dit: "Je sais ce que vous ne savez pas."
versets.anglais: And [mention, O Muhammad], when your Lord said to the angels, "Indeed, I will make upon the earth a successive authority." They said, "Will You place upon it one who causes corruption therein and sheds blood, while we declare Your praise and sanctify You?" Allah said, "Indeed, I know that which you do not know

versets.arabe: وَعَلَّمَ آدَمَ الْأَسْمَاءَ كُلَّهَا ثُمَّ عَرَضَهُمْ عَلَى الْمَلَائِكَةِ فَقَالَ أَنبِئُونِي بِأَسْمَاءِ هَٰؤُلَاءِ إِن كُنتُمْ صَادِقِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa 'allama Âdamal-asmâ'a kullahâ thumma 'aradhahum 'alal-malâ'ikati faqâla anbi'ûnî bi'asmâ'i hâ'ulâ'i in kuntum sâdiqîn
versets.francais: Et Il apprit à Adam les noms de toutes choses; puis Il les présenta aux anges et dit: "Informez-Moi des noms de ceux-là, si vous êtes véridiques."
versets.anglais: And He taught Adam the names - all of them. Then He showed them to the angels and said, "Inform Me of the names of these, if you are truthful

versets.arabe: قَالُوا سُبْحَانَكَ لَا عِلْمَ لَنَا إِلَّا مَا عَلَّمْتَنَا ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْعَلِيمُ الْحَكِيمُ
versets.phonetique: Qâlû subhânaka lâ 'ilma lanâ illâ mâ 'allamtanâ, innaka antal-'alîmul-hakîm
versets.francais: Ils dirent: "Gloire à Toi! Nous n'avons de savoir que ce que Tu nous as appris. C'est Toi l'Omniscient, le Sage."
versets.anglais: They said, "Exalted are You; we have no knowledge except what You have taught us. Indeed, it is You who is the Knowing, the Wise

versets.arabe: قَالَ يَا آدَمُ أَنبِئْهُم بِأَسْمَائِهِمْ ۖ فَلَمَّا أَنبَأَهُم بِأَسْمَائِهِمْ قَالَ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكُمْ إِنِّي أَعْلَمُ غَيْبَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَأَعْلَمُ مَا تُبْدُونَ وَمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْتُمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qâla yâ Âdamu anbi'hum bi'asmâ'ihim, falammâ anba'ahum bi'asmâ'ihim qâla alam aqul lakum innî a'lamu ghaybus-samâwâti wal-ardi wa a'lamu mâ tubdûna wa mâ kuntum taktumûn
versets.francais: Il dit: "Ô Adam, informe-les de leurs noms." Quand il les eut informés de leurs noms, Il dit: "Ne vous ai-Je pas dit que Je connais les secrets des cieux et de la terre et que Je sais ce que vous montrez et ce que vous cachez?"
versets.anglais: He said, "O Adam, inform them of their names." And when he had informed them of their names, He said, "Did I not tell you that I know the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth? And I know what you reveal and what you have concealed

versets.arabe: وَإِذْ قُلْنَا لِلْمَلَائِكَةِ اسْجُدُوا لِآدَمَ فَسَجَدُوا إِلَّا إِبْلِيسَ أَبَىٰ وَاسْتَكْبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ الْكَافِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa idh qulnâ lil-malâ'ikati usjudû li'Âdama fasajadû illâ Iblîsa abâ wastakbara wa kâna minal-kâfirîn
versets.francais: Et quand Nous dîmes aux anges: "Prosternez-vous devant Adam", ils se prosternèrent, sauf Iblîs qui refusa, s'enorgueillit et fut du nombre des ingrats.
versets.anglais: And [mention] when We said to the angels, "Prostrate before Adam"; so they prostrated, except for Iblees. He refused and was arrogant and became of the disbelievers

versets.arabe: وَقُلْنَا يَا آدَمُ اسْكُنْ أَنتَ وَزَوْجُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَكُلَا مِنْهَا رَغَدًا حَيْثُ شِئْتُمَا وَلَا تَقْرَبَا هَٰذِهِ الشَّجَرَةَ فَتَكُونَا مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa qulnâ yâ Âdamu uskun anta wa zawjukal-jannata wa kulâ minhâ raghadanhaythu shi'tumâ wa lâ taqrabâ hâdhihish-shajarata fatakûnâ minaz-zâlimîn
versets.francais: Et Nous dîmes: "Ô Adam, habite le Paradis avec ton épouse et mangez-en tous deux à votre guise; mais n'approchez pas de cet arbre, car vous seriez du nombre des injustes."
versets.anglais: And We said, "O Adam, dwell, you and your wife, in Paradise and eat therefrom in [ease and] abundance from wherever you will. But do not approach this tree, lest you be among the wrongdoers

versets.arabe: فَأَزَلَّهُمَا الشَّيْطَانُ عَنْهَا فَأَخْرَجَهُمَا مِمَّا كَانَا فِيهِ ۖ وَقُلْنَا اهْبِطُوا بَعْضُكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّ ۖ وَلَكُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ مُسْتَقَرٌّ وَمَتَاعٌ إِلَىٰ حِينٍ
versets.phonetique: Fa'azallahumash-shaytânu 'anhâ fa'akhrajahumâ mimmâ kânâ fîhi wa qulnahbitû ba'dhukum liba'dhin 'aduwwun wa lakum fil-ardi mustaqarrun wa matâ'un ilâ hîn
versets.francais: Alors le diable les fit trébucher et les sortit de là où ils se trouvaient. Nous dîmes: "Descendez, ennemis les uns des autres. La terre vous servira de séjour et de jouissance pour un temps."
versets.anglais: But Satan caused them to slip out of it and removed them from that [condition] in which they had been. And We said, "Go down, [all of you], as enemies to one another, and you will have upon the earth a place of settlement and provision for a time

versets.arabe: فَتَلَقَّىٰ آدَمُ مِن رَّبِّهِ كَلِمَاتٍ فَتَابَ عَلَيْهِ ۚ إِنَّهُ هُوَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ
versets.phonetique: Fatalaqqâ Âdamu min rabbihi kalimâtin fatâba 'alayh, innahu huwat-tawwâbur-rahîm
versets.francais: Puis Adam reçut de son Seigneur des paroles et Il agréa son repentir. Il est certes le Repentant, le Miséricordieux.
versets.anglais: Then Adam received from his Lord [some] words, and He accepted his repentance. Indeed, it is He who is the Accepting of repentance, the Merciful

versets.arabe: قُلْنَا اهْبِطُوا مِنْهَا جَمِيعًا ۖ فَإِمَّا يَأْتِيَنَّكُم مِّنِّي هُدًى فَمَن تَبِعَ هُدَايَ فَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qulnahbitû minhâ jamî'an fa'immâ ya'tiyannakum minnî hudan faman tabi'a hudâya falâ khawfun 'alayhim wa lâ hum yahzanûn
versets.francais: Nous dîmes: "Descendez-en tous. Lorsque vous vient de Ma part une guidée, ceux qui suivent Ma guidée n'auront rien à craindre et ne seront point affligés."
versets.anglais: We said, "Go down from it, all of you. And when guidance comes to you from Me, whoever follows My guidance - there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَكَذَّبُوا بِآيَاتِنَا أُولَٰئِكَ أَصْحَابُ النَّارِ ۖ هُمْ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ
versets.phonetique: Walladhîna kafarû wa kadhdhabû bi'âyâtinâ ulâ'ika ashâbun-nâri hum fîhâ khâlidûn
versets.francais: Ceux qui ne croient pas et traitent Nos signes de mensonges seront les gens du Feu, où ils demeureront éternellement.
versets.anglais: And those who disbelieve and deny Our signs - those will be companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally

versets.arabe: يَا بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ اذْكُرُوا نِعْمَتِيَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَأَوْفُوا بِعَهْدِي أُوفِ بِعَهْدِكُمْ وَإِيَّايَ فَارْهَبُونِ
versets.phonetique: Yâ banî Isrâ'îladh kurû ni'matiyallatî an'amtu 'alaykum wa awfû bi'ahdî ûfi bi'ahdikum wa iyyâya farhabûn
versets.francais: Ô fils d'Israël, rappelez-vous Mon bienfait dont Je vous ai comblés. Respectez Mon pacte, Je respecterai votre pacte. Et ne craignez que Moi.
versets.anglais: O Children of Israel, remember My favor which I have bestowed upon you and fulfill My covenant [upon you] that I will fulfill your covenant [from Me], and be afraid of [only] Me

versets.arabe: وَآمِنُوا بِمَا أَنزَلْتُ مُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا مَعَكُمْ وَلَا تَكُونُوا أَوَّلَ كَافِرٍ بِهِ ۖ وَلَا تَشْتَرُوا بِآيَاتِي ثَمَنًا قَلِيلًا وَإِيَّايَ فَاتَّقُونِ
versets.phonetique: Wa âminû bimâ anzaltu musaddiqan limâ ma'akum wa lâ takûnû awwala kâfirin bihi wa lâ tashtarû bi'âyâtî thamanan qalîlan wa iyyâya fattaqûn
versets.francais: Croyez en ce que J'ai révélé, confirmatif de ce que vous avez. Ne soyez pas les premiers à en nier la véracité. Et n'échangez pas Mes signes contre un vil prix. Et ne craignez que Moi.
versets.anglais: And believe in what I have sent down confirming that which is [already] with you, and be not the first to disbelieve in it. And do not exchange My signs for a small price, and fear [only] Me

versets.arabe: وَلَا تَلْبِسُوا الْحَقَّ بِالْبَاطِلِ وَتَكْتُمُوا الْحَقَّ وَأَنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa lâ talbisul-haqqa bil-bâtili wa taktumul-haqqa wa antum ta'lamûn
versets.francais: Ne confondez pas le vrai et le faux et ne dissimulez pas sciemment la vérité.
versets.anglais: And do not mix the truth with falsehood or conceal the truth while you know [it]

versets.arabe: وَأَقِيمُوا الصَّلَاةَ وَآتُوا الزَّكَاةَ وَارْكَعُوا مَعَ الرَّاكِعِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa aqîmus-salâta wa âtuz-zakâta warka'û ma'ar-râki'în
versets.francais: Accomplissez la Salât, acquittez la Zakât et inclinez-vous avec ceux qui s'inclinent.
versets.anglais: And establish prayer and give zakah and bow with those who bow [in worship and obedience]

versets.arabe: أَتَأْمُرُونَ النَّاسَ بِالْبِرِّ وَتَنسَوْنَ أَنفُسَكُمْ وَأَنتُمْ تَتْلُونَ الْكِتَابَ ۚ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Ata'murûnan-nâsa bil-birri wa tansawna anfusakum wa antum tatlûnal-kitâba, afalâ ta'qilûn
versets.francais: Ordonnez-vous aux gens la piété, et vous oubliez votre propre personne, alors que vous récitez le Livre? Ne raisonnez-vous pas?
versets.anglais: Do you order righteousness of the people and forget yourselves while you recite the Scripture? Then will you not reason

versets.arabe: وَاسْتَعِينُوا بِالصَّبْرِ وَالصَّلَاةِ ۚ وَإِنَّهَا لَكَبِيرَةٌ إِلَّا عَلَى الْخَاشِعِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wasta'înû bis-sabri was-salâti wa innahâ lakabîratun illâ 'alal-khâshi'în
versets.francais: Cherchez secours dans la patience et la Salât; certes, c'est dur, sauf pour les humbles.
versets.anglais: And seek help through patience and prayer, and indeed, it is difficult except for the humbly submissive [to Allah]

versets.arabe: الَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَاقُو رَبِّهِمْ وَأَنَّهُمْ إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ
versets.phonetique: Alladhîna yazunnûna annahum mulâqû rabbihim wa annahum ilayhi râji'ûn
versets.francais: ceux qui pensent qu'ils rencontreront leur Seigneur et que c'est vers Lui qu'ils retourneront.
versets.anglais: Who are certain that they will meet their Lord and that they will return to Him

versets.arabe: يَا بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ اذْكُرُوا نِعْمَتِيَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَأَنِّي فَضَّلْتُكُمْ عَلَى الْعَالَمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Yâ banî Isrâ'îladh kurû ni'matiyallatî an'amtu 'alaykum wa annî faddaltukum 'alal-'âlamîn
versets.francais: Ô fils d'Israël, rappelez-vous Mon bienfait dont Je vous ai comblés et que Je vous ai préférés aux mondes.
versets.anglais: O Children of Israel, remember My favor that I have bestowed upon you and that I preferred you over the worlds

versets.arabe: وَاتَّقُوا يَوْمًا لَّا تَجْزِي نَفْسٌ عَن نَّفْسٍ شَيْئًا وَلَا يُقْبَلُ مِنْهَا شَفَاعَةٌ وَلَا يُؤْخَذُ مِنْهَا عَدْلٌ وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wattaqû yawman lâ tajzî nafsun 'an nafsin shay'an wa lâ yuqbalu minhâ shafâ'atun wa lâ yu'khadhu minhâ 'adlun wa lâ hum yunsarûn
versets.francais: Craignez le Jour où nul ne pourra tenir lieu d'un autre en quoi que ce soit, où nulle intercession ne sera acceptée de personne, où nulle rançon ne sera admise, et où ils ne seront pas secourus.
versets.anglais: And fear a Day when no soul will suffice for another soul at all, nor will intercession be accepted from it, nor will compensation be taken from it, nor will they be aided

versets.arabe: وَإِذْ نَجَّيْنَاكُم مِّنْ آلِ فِرْعَوْنَ يَسُومُونَكُمْ سُوءَ الْعَذَابِ يُذَبِّحُونَ أَبْنَاءَكُمْ وَيَسْتَحْيُونَ نِسَاءَكُمْ ۚ وَفِي ذَٰلِكُم بَلَاءٌ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ عَظِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa idh najjaynâkum min âli Fir'awna yasûmûnakum sû'al-'adhâbi yudhabibhûna abnâ'akum wa yastahyûna nisâ'akum, wa fî dhâlikum balâ'un min rabbikum 'azîm
versets.francais: Et lorsque Nous vous sauvâmes de la famille de Pharaon qui vous infligeait un sévère châtiment, égorgeant vos fils et laissant vivre vos femmes. C'était là une grande épreuve de votre Seigneur.
versets.anglais: And [recall] when We saved your forefathers from the people of Pharaoh, who afflicted you with the worst torment, slaughtering your [newborn] sons and keeping your females alive. And in that was a great trial from your Lord

versets.arabe: وَإِذْ فَرَقْنَا بِكُمُ الْبَحْرَ فَأَنجَيْنَاكُمْ وَأَغْرَقْنَا آلَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَأَنتُمْ تَنظُرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa idh faraqnâ bikumul-bahra fa'anjaynâkum wa aghraqnâ âla Fir'awna wa antum tanzurûn
versets.francais: Et quand Nous avons fendu la mer pour vous, Nous vous avons sauvés et noyé les gens de Pharaon sous vos yeux.
versets.anglais: And [recall] when We parted the sea for you and saved you and drowned the people of Pharaoh while you were looking on

versets.arabe: وَإِذْ وَاعَدْنَا مُوسَىٰ أَرْبَعِينَ لَيْلَةً ثُمَّ اتَّخَذْتُمُ الْعِجْلَ مِن بَعْدِهِ وَأَنتُمْ ظَالِمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa idh wâ'adnâ Mûsâ arba'îna laylatan thummattakhadhtumul-'ijla min ba'dihi wa antum zâlimûn
versets.francais: Et quand Nous assignâmes à Moïse quarante nuits, vous avez pris le veau après lui, et vous étiez injustes.
versets.anglais: And [recall] when We made an appointment with Moses for forty nights. Then you took [for worship] the calf after him, while you were wrongdoers

versets.arabe: ثُمَّ عَفَوْنَا عَنكُم مِّن بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Thumma 'afawnâ 'ankum min ba'di dhâlika la'allakum tashkurûn
versets.francais: Puis Nous vous avons pardonné après cela, afin que vous soyez reconnaissants.
versets.anglais: Then We forgave you after that so perhaps you would be grateful

versets.arabe: وَإِذْ آتَيْنَا مُوسَى الْكِتَابَ وَالْفُرْقَانَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa idh âtaynâ Mûsal-kitâba wal-furqâna la'allakum tahtadûn
versets.francais: Et quand Nous donnâmes à Moïse le Livre et la Distinction, afin que vous soyez guidés.
versets.anglais: And [recall] when We gave Moses the Scripture and criterion that perhaps you would be guided

versets.arabe: وَإِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِقَوْمِهِ يَا قَوْمِ إِنَّكُمْ ظَلَمْتُمْ أَنفُسَكُم بِاتِّخَاذِكُمُ الْعِجْلَ فَتُوبُوا إِلَىٰ بَارِئِكُمْ فَاقْتُلُوا أَنفُسَكُمْ ذَٰلِكُمْ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ عِندَ بَارِئِكُمْ فَتَابَ عَلَيْكُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُ هُوَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ
versets.phonetique: Wa idh qâla Mûsâ liqawmihi yâ qawmi innakum zalamtum anfusakum bittakhâdhikumul-'ijla fatûbû ilâ bâri'ikum faqtulû anfusakum dhâlikum khayrun lakum 'inda bâri'ikum fatâba 'alaykum, innahu huwat-tawwâbur-rahîm
versets.francais: Et quand Moïse dit à son peuple: "Ô mon peuple, vous vous êtes vraiment lésés en prenant le veau. Repentez-vous donc auprès de votre Créateur et tuez vos propres personnes. Cela est meilleur pour vous auprès de votre Créateur." Il a donc agréé votre repentir. C'est Lui le Repentant, le Miséricordieux.
versets.anglais: And [recall] when Moses said to his people, "O my people, indeed you have wronged yourselves by your taking of the calf [for worship]. So repent to your Creator and kill yourselves. That is best for [all of] you in the sight of your Creator." Then He accepted your repentance; indeed, He is the Accepting of repentance, the Merciful

versets.arabe: وَإِذْ قُلْتُمْ يَا مُوسَىٰ لَن نُّؤْمِنَ لَكَ حَتَّىٰ نَرَى اللَّهَ جَهْرَةً فَأَخَذَتْكُمُ الصَّاعِقَةُ وَأَنتُمْ تَنظُرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa idh qultum yâ Mûsâ lan nu'mina laka hattâ naraAllâha jahratan fa'akhadhtakumus-sâ'iqatu wa antum tanzurûn
versets.francais: Et quand vous dîtes: "Ô Moïse, nous ne te croirons que si nous voyons Allah ouvertement." Alors la foudre vous frappa pendant que vous regardiez.
versets.anglais: And [recall] when you said, "O Moses, we will never believe you until we see Allah outright"; so the thunderbolt took you while you were looking on

versets.arabe: ثُمَّ بَعَثْنَاكُم مِّن بَعْدِ مَوْتِكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Thumma ba'athnâkum min ba'di mawtikum la'allakum tashkurûn
versets.francais: Puis Nous vous avons ressuscités après votre mort afin que vous soyez reconnaissants.
versets.anglais: Then We revived you after your death that perhaps you would be grateful

versets.arabe: وَظَلَّلْنَا عَلَيْكُمُ الْغَمَامَ وَأَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكُمُ الْمَنَّ وَالسَّلْوَىٰ ۖ كُلُوا مِن طَيِّبَاتِ مَا رَزَقْنَاكُمْ ۖ وَمَا ظَلَمُونَا وَلَٰكِن كَانُوا أَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa zallalnâ 'alaykumul-ghamâma wa anzalnâ 'alaykumul-manna was-salwâ, kulû min tayyibâti mâ razaqnâkum, wa mâ zalamanâ wa lâkin kânû anfusahum yazlimûn
versets.francais: Et Nous vous avons fait de l'ombre avec des nuages, et avons fait descendre sur vous la manne et la caille en disant: "Mangez des bonnes choses que Nous vous avons accordées." Ils ne Nous ont pas lésés, mais c'est eux-mêmes qu'ils lésaient.
versets.anglais: And We shaded you with clouds and sent down to you manna and quails, [saying], "Eat from the good things with which We have provided you." And they wronged Us not - but they were [only] wronging themselves

versets.arabe: وَإِذْ قُلْنَا ادْخُلُوا هَٰذِهِ الْقَرْيَةَ فَكُلُوا مِنْهَا حَيْثُ شِئْتُمْ رَغَدًا وَادْخُلُوا الْبَابَ سُجَّدًا وَقُولُوا حِطَّةٌ نَّغْفِرْ لَكُمْ خَطَايَاكُمْ ۚ وَسَنَزِيدُ الْمُحْسِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa idh qulnadhkhulû hâdhihil-qaryata fakulû minhâ haythu shi'tum raghadanwadkhulul-bâba sujjadan wa qûlû hittatun naghfir lakum khatâyâkum wa sanazîdul-muhsinîn
versets.francais: Et quand Nous dîmes: "Entrez dans cette cité et mangez-en à votre guise. Franchissez la porte en vous prosternant et dites: 'Absolution!' Nous vous pardonnerons vos péchés et accorderons davantage aux bienfaisants."
versets.anglais: And [recall] when We said, "Enter this city and eat from it wherever you will in [ease and] abundance, and enter the gate bowing humbly and say, 'Relieve us of our burdens.' We will [then] forgive your sins for you, and We will increase the doers of good [in goodness and reward]

versets.arabe: فَبَدَّلَ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا قَوْلًا غَيْرَ الَّذِي قِيلَ لَهُمْ فَأَنزَلْنَا عَلَى الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا رِجْزًا مِّنَ السَّمَاءِ بِمَا كَانُوا يَفْسُقُونَ
versets.phonetique: Fabaddalal-ladhîna zalamû qawlan ghayral-ladhî qîla lahum fa'anzalnâ 'alal-ladhîna zalamû rijzan minas-samâ'i bimâ kânû yafsuqûn
versets.francais: Mais les injustes changèrent la parole en une autre que celle qui leur avait été dite. Alors Nous avons fait descendre du ciel un châtiment sur les injustes, parce qu'ils étaient pervers.
versets.anglais: But those who wronged changed [those words] to a statement other than that which had been said to them, so We sent down upon those who wronged a punishment from the sky because they were defiantly disobeying

versets.arabe: وَإِذِ اسْتَسْقَىٰ مُوسَىٰ لِقَوْمِهِ فَقُلْنَا اضْرِب بِّعَصَاكَ الْحَجَرَ ۖ فَانفَجَرَتْ مِنْهُ اثْنَتَا عَشْرَةَ عَيْنًا ۖ قَدْ عَلِمَ كُلُّ أُنَاسٍ مَّشْرَبَهُمْ ۖ كُلُوا وَاشْرَبُوا مِن رِّزْقِ اللَّهِ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا فِي الْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa idhistasqâ Mûsâ liqawmihi faqulnadhrib bi'asâkal-hajara fanfajarat minhu thnatâ 'ashrata 'aynan, qad 'alima kullu unâsin mashrabahum, kulû washrabû min rizqillâhi wa lâ ta'thaw fil-ardi mufsidîn
versets.francais: Et quand Moïse demanda de l'eau pour son peuple, Nous lui dîmes: "Frappe le rocher de ton bâton." Et il en jaillit douze sources. Chaque groupe connaissait son abreuvoir. "Mangez et buvez de la subsistance d'Allah et ne semez pas la corruption sur la terre."
versets.anglais: And [recall] when Moses prayed for water for his people, so We said, "Strike with your staff the stone." And there gushed forth from it twelve springs, and every people knew its watering place. "Eat and drink from the provision of Allah, and do not commit abuse on the earth, spreading corruption

versets.arabe: وَإِذْ قُلْتُمْ يَا مُوسَىٰ لَن نَّصْبِرَ عَلَىٰ طَعَامٍ وَاحِدٍ فَادْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ يُخْرِجْ لَنَا مِمَّا تُنبِتُ الْأَرْضُ مِن بَقْلِهَا وَقِثَّائِهَا وَفُومِهَا وَعَدَسِهَا وَبَصَلِهَا
versets.phonetique: Wa idh qultum yâ Mûsâ lan nasbira 'alâ ta'âmin wâhidin fad'u lanâ rabbaka yukhrij lanâ mimmâ tunbitul-ardu min baqli hâ wa qiththâ'ihâ wa fûmihâ wa 'adasihâ wa basalihâ
versets.francais: Et quand vous dîtes: "Ô Moïse, nous ne pouvons plus supporter une seule et même nourriture. Implore pour nous ton Seigneur pour qu'Il nous fasse sortir de ce que la terre produit: légumes, concombres, ails, lentilles et oignons."
versets.anglais: And [recall] when you said, "O Moses, we can never endure one [kind of] food. So call upon your Lord to bring forth for us from the earth its green herbs and its cucumbers and its garlic and its lentils and its onions." [Moses] said, "Would you exchange what is better for what is less? Go into [any] settlement and indeed, you will have what you have asked." And they were covered with humiliation and poverty and returned with anger from Allah [upon them]. That was because they [repeatedly] disbelieved in the signs of Allah and killed the prophets without right. That was because they disobeyed and were [habitually] transgressing

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَالَّذِينَ هَادُوا وَالنَّصَارَىٰ وَالصَّابِئِينَ مَنْ آمَنَ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَلَهُمْ أَجْرُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ وَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
versets.phonetique: Innal-ladhîna âmanû walladhîna hâdû wan-nasârâ was-sâbi'îna man âmana billâhi wal-yawmil-âkhiri wa 'amila sâlihan falahum ajruhum 'inda rabbihim wa lâ khawfun 'alayhim wa lâ hum yahzanûn
versets.francais: Ceux qui ont cru, les Juifs, les Chrétiens et les Sabéens — quiconque d'entre eux aura cru en Allah et au Jour Dernier et fait des bonnes œuvres — auront leur récompense auprès de leur Seigneur; ils n'auront rien à craindre et ne seront point affligés.
versets.anglais: Indeed, those who believed and those who were Jews or Christians or Sabeans [before Prophet Muhammad] - those [among them] who believed in Allah and the Last Day and did righteousness - will have their reward with their Lord, and no fear will there be concerning them, nor will they grieve

versets.arabe: وَإِذْ أَخَذْنَا مِيثَاقَكُمْ وَرَفَعْنَا فَوْقَكُمُ الطُّورَ خُذُوا مَا آتَيْنَاكُم بِقُوَّةٍ وَاذْكُرُوا مَا فِيهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَّقُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa idh akhadhnâ mîthâqakum wa rafa'nâ fawqakumut-tûra khudhû mâ âtaynâkum biquwwatin wadhkurû mâ fîhi la'allakum tattaqûn
versets.francais: Et quand Nous avons pris votre engagement et élevé au-dessus de vous le mont Tûr: "Tenez fermement ce que Nous vous avons apporté et rappelez-vous ce qui s'y trouve, afin que vous soyez pieux."
versets.anglais: And [recall] when We took your covenant, [O Children of Israel, to abide by the Torah] and We raised over you the mount, [saying], "Take what We have given you with determination and remember what is in it that perhaps you may become righteous

versets.arabe: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّيْتُم مِّن بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ فَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُ لَكُنتُم مِّنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Thumma tawallaytum min ba'di dhâlika falawlâ fadhlullâhi 'alaykum wa rahmatuhu lakuntum minal-khâsirîn
versets.francais: Puis vous vous êtes retournés après cela. Sans la grâce d'Allah et Sa miséricorde sur vous, vous auriez été du nombre des perdants.
versets.anglais: Then you turned away after that. And if not for the favor of Allah upon you and His mercy, you would have been among the losers

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْتُمُ الَّذِينَ اعْتَدَوْا مِنكُمْ فِي السَّبْتِ فَقُلْنَا لَهُمْ كُونُوا قِرَدَةً خَاسِئِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa laqad 'alimtumul-ladhîna'tadaw minkum fis-sabti faqulnâ lahum kûnû qiradatan khâsi'în
versets.francais: Vous connaissez ceux d'entre vous qui ont transgressé en ce qui concerne le Sabbat. Nous leur avons dit: "Soyez des singes vils et méprisés."
versets.anglais: And you had already known about those who transgressed among you concerning the sabbath, and We said to them, "Be apes, despised

versets.arabe: فَجَعَلْنَاهَا نَكَالًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهَا وَمَا خَلْفَهَا وَمَوْعِظَةً لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
versets.phonetique: Faja'alnâhâ nakâlan limâ bayna yadayhâ wa mâ khalfahâ wa maw'izatan lil-muttaqîn
versets.francais: Nous en fîmes une leçon exemplaire pour leurs contemporains et pour leurs successeurs, et un avertissement pour les pieux.
versets.anglais: And We made it a deterrent punishment for those who were present and those who succeeded [them] and a lesson for those who fear Allah

versets.arabe: وَإِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِقَوْمِهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَأْمُرُكُمْ أَن تَذْبَحُوا بَقَرَةً ۖ قَالُوا أَتَتَّخِذُنَا هُزُوًا ۖ قَالَ أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ أَنْ أَكُونَ مِنَ الْجَاهِلِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa idh qâla Mûsâ liqawmihi innAllâha ya'murukum an tadhbahû baqarah, qâlû atattakhidhunâ huzuwan, qâla a'ûdhu billâhi an akûna minal-jâhilîn
versets.francais: Et quand Moïse dit à son peuple: "Allah vous ordonne d'immoler une vache." Ils dirent: "Nous prends-tu en ridicule?" Il dit: "Je cherche la protection d'Allah de faire partie des ignorants."
versets.anglais: And [recall] when Moses said to his people, "Indeed, Allah commands you to slaughter a cow." They said, "Do you take us in ridicule?" He said, "I seek refuge in Allah from being among the ignorant

versets.arabe: قَالُوا ادْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ يُبَيِّن لَّنَا مَا هِيَ ۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُ يَقُولُ إِنَّهَا بَقَرَةٌ لَّا فَارِضٌ وَلَا بِكْرٌ عَوَانٌ بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ فَافْعَلُوا مَا تُؤْمَرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qâlûd'u lanâ rabbaka yubayyin lanâ mâ hiya, qâla innahu yaqûlu innahâ baqaratun lâ fâridhun wa lâ bikrun 'awânun bayna dhâlika, faf'alû mâ tu'marûn
versets.francais: Ils dirent: "Implore ton Seigneur de nous expliquer ce qu'elle est." Il dit: "Il dit que c'est une vache ni vieille ni jeune, d'un âge moyen. Faites donc ce qui vous est commandé."
versets.anglais: They said, "Call upon your Lord to make clear to us what it is." [Moses] said, "[Allah] says, 'It is a cow which is neither old nor virgin, but median between that,' so do what you are commanded

versets.arabe: قَالُوا ادْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ يُبَيِّن لَّنَا مَا لَوْنُهَا ۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُ يَقُولُ إِنَّهَا بَقَرَةٌ صَفْرَاءُ فَاقِعٌ لَّوْنُهَا تَسُرُّ النَّاظِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qâlûd'u lanâ rabbaka yubayyin lanâ mâ lawnuhâ, qâla innahu yaqûlu innahâ baqaratun safrâ'u fâqi'un lawnuhâ tasurrun-nâzirîn
versets.francais: Ils dirent: "Implore ton Seigneur de nous expliquer sa couleur." Il dit: "Il dit que c'est une vache jaune vif dont la couleur réjouit ceux qui la regardent."
versets.anglais: They said, "Call upon your Lord to show us what is her color." He said, "He says, 'It is a yellow cow, bright in color - pleasing to the observers

versets.arabe: قَالُوا ادْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ يُبَيِّن لَّنَا مَا هِيَ إِنَّ الْبَقَرَ تَشَابَهَ عَلَيْنَا وَإِنَّا إِن شَاءَ اللَّهُ لَمُهْتَدُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qâlûd'u lanâ rabbaka yubayyin lanâ mâ hiya innal-baqara tashâbaha 'alaynâ wa innâ inshâ'Allâhu lamuhtadûn
versets.francais: Ils dirent: "Implore ton Seigneur de nous expliquer ce qu'elle est vraiment, car les vaches se ressemblent pour nous. Si Allah veut, nous serons bien guidés."
versets.anglais: They said, "Call upon your Lord to make clear to us what it is. Indeed, [all] cows look alike to us. And indeed we, if Allah wills, will be guided

versets.arabe: قَالَ إِنَّهُ يَقُولُ إِنَّهَا بَقَرَةٌ لَّا ذَلُولٌ تُثِيرُ الْأَرْضَ وَلَا تَسْقِي الْحَرْثَ مُسَلَّمَةٌ لَّا شِيَةَ فِيهَا ۚ قَالُوا الْآنَ جِئْتَ بِالْحَقِّ ۚ فَذَبَحُوهَا وَمَا كَادُوا يَفْعَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qâla innahu yaqûlu innahâ baqaratun lâ dhalûlun tuthîrul-arda wa lâ tasqil-hartha musallamatun lâ shiyata fîhâ, qâlul-âna ji'ta bil-haqqi fadhbahûhâ wa mâ kâdû yaf'alûn
versets.francais: Il dit: "Il dit que c'est une vache qu'on n'a pas assujettie à labourer la terre ni à arroser les champs, saine, sans aucune tache." Ils dirent: "Maintenant tu apportes la vérité." Et ils l'immolèrent, mais peu s'en fallut qu'ils ne le fissent pas.
versets.anglais: He said, "He says, 'It is a cow neither trained to plow the earth nor to irrigate the field, one free from fault with no spot upon her.' " They said, "Now you have come with the truth." So they slaughtered her, but they could hardly do it

versets.arabe: وَإِذْ قَتَلْتُمْ نَفْسًا فَادَّارَأْتُمْ فِيهَا ۖ وَاللَّهُ مُخْرِجٌ مَّا كُنتُمْ تَكْتُمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa idh qataltum nafsan faddâra'tum fîhâ, wallâhu mukhrijun mâ kuntum taktumûn
versets.francais: Et quand vous aviez tué un homme et que vous en disputiez: Allah devait manifester ce que vous cachiez.
versets.anglais: And [recall] when you slew a man and disputed over it, but Allah was to bring out that which you were concealing

versets.arabe: فَقُلْنَا اضْرِبُوهُ بِبَعْضِهَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُحْيِي اللَّهُ الْمَوْتَىٰ وَيُرِيكُمْ آيَاتِهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Faqulnadhribûhu biba'dhihâ, kadhâlika yuhyillâhul-mawtâ wa yurîkum âyâtihi la'allakum ta'qilûn
versets.francais: Nous dîmes: "Frappez-le avec une partie d'elle." C'est ainsi qu'Allah redonne vie aux morts et vous montre Ses signes afin que vous raisonniez.
versets.anglais: So, We said, "Strike the slain man with part of it." Thus does Allah bring the dead to life, and He shows you His signs that you might reason

versets.arabe: ثُمَّ قَسَتْ قُلُوبُكُم مِّن بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ فَهِيَ كَالْحِجَارَةِ أَوْ أَشَدُّ قَسْوَةً
versets.phonetique: Thumma qasat qulûbukum min ba'di dhâlika fahiya kal-hijârati aw ashaddu qaswatan
versets.francais: Puis vos cœurs se sont endurcis après cela et sont devenus comme des pierres ou plus durs encore.
versets.anglais: Then your hearts became hardened after that, being like stones or even harder. For indeed, there are stones from which rivers burst forth, and there are some of them that split open and water comes out, and there are some of them that fall down for fear of Allah. And Allah is not unaware of what you do

versets.arabe: أَفَتَطْمَعُونَ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا لَكُمْ وَقَدْ كَانَ فَرِيقٌ مِّنْهُمْ يَسْمَعُونَ كَلَامَ اللَّهِ ثُمَّ يُحَرِّفُونَهُ مِن بَعْدِ مَا عَقَلُوهُ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Afatatma'ûna an yu'minû lakum wa qad kâna farîqun minhum yasma'ûna kalâmAllâhi thumma yuharrifûnahu min ba'di mâ 'aqalûhu wa hum ya'lamûn
versets.francais: Espérez-vous qu'ils vous croiront? Alors qu'un groupe d'entre eux entendait la parole d'Allah, puis la déformait après l'avoir comprise, en le sachant.
versets.anglais: Do you covet [the hope, O believers], that they would believe for you while a party of them used to hear the words of Allah and then distort the Torah after they had understood it while they were knowing

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا لَقُوا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا قَالُوا آمَنَّا وَإِذَا خَلَا بَعْضُهُمْ إِلَىٰ بَعْضٍ قَالُوا أَتُحَدِّثُونَهُم بِمَا فَتَحَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْكُمْ لِيُحَاجُّوكُم بِهِ عِندَ رَبِّكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Wa idhâ laqul-ladhîna âmanû qâlû âmannâ wa idhâ khalâ ba'dhuhum ilâ ba'dhin qâlû atuhadithûnahum bimâ fatahAllâhu 'alaykum liyuhâjjûkum bihi 'inda rabbikum
versets.francais: Et quand ils rencontrent les croyants, ils disent: "Nous croyons." Mais quand ils se retrouvent entre eux, ils disent: "Leur dites-vous ce qu'Allah vous a révélé pour qu'ils en discutent contre vous devant votre Seigneur?"
versets.anglais: And when they meet those who believe, they say, "We have believed"; but when they are alone with one another, they say, "Do you talk to them about what Allah has revealed to you so they can argue with you about it before your Lord?" Then will you not reason

versets.arabe: أَوَلَا يَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ
versets.phonetique: Awa lâ ya'lamûna annAllâha ya'lamu mâ yusirrûna wa mâ yu'linûn
versets.francais: Ne savent-ils pas qu'Allah sait ce qu'ils cachent et ce qu'ils divulguent?
versets.anglais: But do they not know that Allah knows what they conceal and what they declare

versets.arabe: وَمِنْهُمْ أُمِّيُّونَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ الْكِتَابَ إِلَّا أَمَانِيَّ وَإِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَظُنُّونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa minhum ummiyyûna lâ ya'lamûnal-kitâba illâ amâniyya wa in hum illâ yazunnûn
versets.francais: Parmi eux il en est d'illettrés qui ne connaissent du Livre que des espoirs fallacieux et ne font que conjecturer.
versets.anglais: And among them are unlettered ones who do not know the Scripture except in wishful thinking, but they are only assuming

versets.arabe: فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ يَكْتُبُونَ الْكِتَابَ بِأَيْدِيهِمْ ثُمَّ يَقُولُونَ هَٰذَا مِنْ عِندِ اللَّهِ لِيَشْتَرُوا بِهِ ثَمَنًا قَلِيلًا
versets.phonetique: Fawaylun lil-ladhîna yaktubûnal-kitâba bi'aydîhim thumma yaqûlûna hâdhâ min 'indillâhi liyashtarû bihi thamanan qalîlan
versets.francais: Malheur donc à ceux qui écrivent le Livre de leurs propres mains, puis disent: "Cela vient d'Allah" pour en tirer un vil prix!
versets.anglais: So woe to those who write the "scripture" with their own hands, then say, "This is from Allah," in order to exchange it for a small price. Woe to them for what their hands have written and woe to them for what they earn

versets.arabe: وَقَالُوا لَن تَمَسَّنَا النَّارُ إِلَّا أَيَّامًا مَّعْدُودَةً ۚ قُلْ أَتَّخَذْتُمْ عِندَ اللَّهِ عَهْدًا فَلَن يُخْلِفَ اللَّهُ عَهْدَهُ ۖ أَمْ تَقُولُونَ عَلَى اللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa qâlû lan tamassanan-nâru illâ ayyâman ma'dûdatan, qul attakhadhtum 'indAllâhi 'ahdan falan yukhlifulAllâhu 'ahdahu am taqûlûna 'alAllâhi mâ lâ ta'lamûn
versets.francais: Ils dirent: "Le Feu ne nous touchera que pour des jours comptés." Dis: "Avez-vous conclu un pacte auprès d'Allah? Allah ne manquera point à Son pacte. Ou dites-vous contre Allah ce que vous ne savez pas?"
versets.anglais: And they say, "Never will the Fire touch us, except for a few days." Say, "Have you taken a covenant with Allah? For Allah will never break His covenant. Or do you say about Allah that which you do not know

versets.arabe: بَلَىٰ مَن كَسَبَ سَيِّئَةً وَأَحَاطَتْ بِهِ خَطِيئَتُهُ فَأُولَٰئِكَ أَصْحَابُ النَّارِ ۖ هُمْ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ
versets.phonetique: Balâ man kasaba sayyi'atan wa ahâtat bihi khatî'atuhu fa'ulâ'ika ashâbun-nâri hum fîhâ khâlidûn
versets.francais: Mais si, quiconque aura commis le mal et sera cerné par ses péchés sera un habitant du Feu et y demeurera éternellement.
versets.anglais: Yes, whoever earns evil and his sin has encompassed him - those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ أُولَٰئِكَ أَصْحَابُ الْجَنَّةِ ۖ هُمْ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ
versets.phonetique: Walladhîna âmanû wa 'amiluss-sâlihâti ulâ'ika ashâbul-jannati hum fîhâ khâlidûn
versets.francais: Ceux qui auront cru et accompli des bonnes œuvres seront les habitants du Paradis et y demeureront éternellement.
versets.anglais: But they who believe and do righteous deeds - those are the companions of Paradise; they will abide therein eternally

versets.arabe: وَإِذْ أَخَذْنَا مِيثَاقَ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ لَا تَعْبُدُونَ إِلَّا اللَّهَ وَبِالْوَالِدَيْنِ إِحْسَانًا وَذِي الْقُرْبَىٰ وَالْيَتَامَىٰ وَالْمَسَاكِينِ وَقُولُوا لِلنَّاسِ حُسْنًا وَأَقِيمُوا الصَّلَاةَ وَآتُوا الزَّكَاةَ
versets.phonetique: Wa idh akhadhnâ mîthâqa banî Isrâ'îla lâ ta'budûna illAllâha wa bil-wâlidayni ihsânan wa dhil-qurbâ wal-yatâmâ wal-masâkîni wa qûlû lin-nâsi husnan wa aqîmus-salâta wa âtuz-zakâh
versets.francais: Et quand Nous avons pris l'engagement des fils d'Israël: "N'adorez qu'Allah; soyez bienfaisants envers les père et mère, les proches, les orphelins et les pauvres; parlez bien aux gens; accomplissez la Salât et acquittez la Zakât."
versets.anglais: And [recall] when We took the covenant from the Children of Israel, [enjoining upon them], "Do not worship except Allah; and to parents do good and to relatives, orphans, and the needy. And speak to people good [words] and establish prayer and give zakah." Then you turned away, except a few of you, and you were refusing

versets.arabe: وَإِذْ أَخَذْنَا مِيثَاقَكُمْ لَا تَسْفِكُونَ دِمَاءَكُمْ وَلَا تُخْرِجُونَ أَنفُسَكُم مِّن دِيَارِكُمْ ثُمَّ أَقْرَرْتُمْ وَأَنتُمْ تَشْهَدُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa idh akhadhnâ mîthâqakum lâ tasfikûna dimâ'akum wa lâ tukhrijûna anfusakum min diyârikum thumma aqrartum wa antum tashadûn
versets.francais: Et quand Nous avons pris votre engagement: "Vous ne répandrez pas votre sang et ne vous chasserez pas de vos demeures." Vous avez reconnu et vous en êtes témoins.
versets.anglais: And [recall] when We took your covenant, [saying], "Do not shed each other's blood or evict one another from your homes." Then you acknowledged [this] while you were witnessing

versets.arabe: ثُمَّ أَنتُمْ هَٰؤُلَاءِ تَقْتُلُونَ أَنفُسَكُمْ وَتُخْرِجُونَ فَرِيقًا مِّنكُم مِّن دِيَارِهِمْ تَظَاهَرُونَ عَلَيْهِم بِالْإِثْمِ وَالْعُدْوَانِ
versets.phonetique: Thumma antum hâ'ulâ'i taqtulûna anfusakum wa tukhrijûna farîqan minkum min diyârihim tazâharûna 'alayhim bil-ithmi wal-'udwân
versets.francais: Et puis vous voilà en train de vous entretuer et de chasser un groupe des vôtres de leurs demeures en vous liguant contre eux dans le péché et l'hostilité.
versets.anglais: Then, you are those [same ones who are] killing one another and evicting a party of your people from their homes, cooperating against them in sin and aggression. And if they come to you as captives, you ransom them, although their eviction was forbidden to you. So do you believe in part of the Scripture and disbelieve in part? Then what is the recompense for those who do that among you except disgrace in worldly life; and on the Day of Resurrection they will be sent back to the severest of punishment. And Allah is not unaware of what you do

versets.arabe: أُولَٰئِكَ الَّذِينَ اشْتَرَوُا الْحَيَاةَ الدُّنْيَا بِالْآخِرَةِ ۖ فَلَا يُخَفَّفُ عَنْهُمُ الْعَذَابُ وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Ulâ'ikal-ladhînashtarawul-hayâtad-dunyâ bil-âkhirati falâ yukhaffafu 'anhumul-'adhâbu wa lâ hum yunsarûn
versets.francais: Ceux-là ont échangé la vie de l'au-delà contre la vie présente. Le châtiment ne sera pas allégé pour eux et ils ne seront pas secourus.
versets.anglais: Those are the ones who have bought the life of this world [in exchange] for the Hereafter, so the punishment will not be lightened for them, nor will they be aided

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا مُوسَى الْكِتَابَ وَقَفَّيْنَا مِن بَعْدِهِ بِالرُّسُلِ ۖ وَآتَيْنَا عِيسَى ابْنَ مَرْيَمَ الْبَيِّنَاتِ وَأَيَّدْنَاهُ بِرُوحِ الْقُدُسِ
versets.phonetique: Wa laqad âtaynâ Mûsal-kitâba wa qaffaynâ min ba'dihi bir-rusuli wa âtaynâ 'Îsabna Maryamal-bayyinâti wa ayyadnâhu birûhil-qudus
versets.francais: Nous avons donné à Moïse le Livre; après lui Nous avons envoyé les messagers successivement; et Nous avons accordé à Jésus fils de Marie les preuves et l'avons fortifié par l'Esprit Saint.
versets.anglais: And We did certainly give Moses the Torah and followed up after him with messengers. And We gave Jesus, the son of Mary, clear proofs and supported him with the Pure Spirit. But is it [not] that every time a messenger came to you, [O Children of Israel], with what your souls did not desire, you were arrogant? And a party [of messengers] you denied and another party you killed

versets.arabe: وَقَالُوا قُلُوبُنَا غُلْفٌ ۚ بَل لَّعَنَهُمُ اللَّهُ بِكُفْرِهِمْ فَقَلِيلًا مَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa qâlû qulûbunâ ghulf, bal la'anahumulAllâhu bikufrihim faqalîlan mâ yu'minûn
versets.francais: Ils dirent: "Nos cœurs sont enveloppés." Bien plutôt, Allah les a maudits pour leur mécréance; ils ne croient que très peu.
versets.anglais: And they said, "Our hearts are wrapped." But, [in fact], Allah has cursed them for their disbelief, so little is it that they believe

versets.arabe: وَلَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ كِتَابٌ مِّنْ عِندِ اللَّهِ مُصَدِّقٌ لِّمَا مَعَهُمْ وَكَانُوا مِن قَبْلُ يَسْتَفْتِحُونَ عَلَى الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُم مَّا عَرَفُوا كَفَرُوا بِهِ
versets.phonetique: Wa lammâ jâ'ahum kitâbun min 'indillâhi musaddiqun limâ ma'ahum wa kânû min qablu yastafitihûna 'alal-ladhîna kafarû falammâ jâ'ahum mâ 'arafu kafarû bih
versets.francais: Quand leur est venu, de la part d'Allah, un Livre confirmant ce qu'ils avaient, alors qu'ils demandaient auparavant la victoire contre les mécréants, quand ce qu'ils avaient reconnu leur vint, ils le renièrent.
versets.anglais: And when there came to them a Book from Allah confirming that which was with them - although before they used to pray for victory against those who disbelieved - but [then] when there came to them that which they recognized, they disbelieved in it; so the curse of Allah will be upon the disbelievers

versets.arabe: بِئْسَمَا اشْتَرَوْا بِهِ أَنفُسَهُمْ أَن يَكْفُرُوا بِمَا أَنزَلَ اللَّهُ بَغْيًا أَن يُنَزِّلَ اللَّهُ مِن فَضْلِهِ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ
versets.phonetique: Bi'samash-taraw bihi anfusahum an yakfurû bimâ anzalAllâhu baghyan an yunazzilAllâhu min fadhlihi 'alâ man yashâ'u min 'ibâdih
versets.francais: Comme est mauvais ce pour quoi ils ont vendu leur âme: renier ce qu'Allah a révélé, par jalousie qu'Allah fasse descendre de Sa grâce à qui Il veut parmi Ses serviteurs!
versets.anglais: How wretched is that for which they sold themselves - that they would disbelieve in what Allah has revealed through [their] outrage that Allah would send down His favor upon whom He wills from among His servants. So they returned having [earned] wrath upon wrath. And for the disbelievers is a humiliating punishment

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ آمِنُوا بِمَا أَنزَلَ اللَّهُ قَالُوا نُؤْمِنُ بِمَا أُنزِلَ عَلَيْنَا وَيَكْفُرُونَ بِمَا وَرَاءَهُ وَهُوَ الْحَقُّ مُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا مَعَهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Wa idhâ qîla lahum âminû bimâ anzalAllâhu qâlû nu'minu bimâ unzila 'alaynâ wa yakfurûna bimâ warâ'ahu wa huwal-haqqu musaddiqan limâ ma'ahum
versets.francais: Et quand on leur dit: "Croyez en ce qu'Allah a révélé", ils disent: "Nous croyons en ce qui nous a été révélé à nous." Et ils nient ce qui est en dehors, alors que c'est la vérité confirmant ce qu'ils ont.
versets.anglais: And when it is said to them, "Believe in what Allah has revealed," they say, "We believe [only] in what was revealed to us." And they disbelieve in what came after it, while it is the truth confirming that which is with them. Say, "Then why did you kill the prophets of Allah before, if you are [indeed] believers

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ جَاءَكُم مُّوسَىٰ بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ ثُمَّ اتَّخَذْتُمُ الْعِجْلَ مِن بَعْدِهِ وَأَنتُمْ ظَالِمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa laqad jâ'akum Mûsâ bil-bayyinâti thummattakhadhtumul-'ijla min ba'dihi wa antum zâlimûn
versets.francais: Moïse vous a apporté les preuves; puis vous avez pris le veau après lui, et vous étiez des injustes.
versets.anglais: And Moses had certainly brought you clear proofs. Then you took the calf [in worship] after that, while you were wrongdoers

versets.arabe: وَإِذْ أَخَذْنَا مِيثَاقَكُمْ وَرَفَعْنَا فَوْقَكُمُ الطُّورَ خُذُوا مَا آتَيْنَاكُم بِقُوَّةٍ وَاسْمَعُوا ۖ قَالُوا سَمِعْنَا وَعَصَيْنَا
versets.phonetique: Wa idh akhadhnâ mîthâqakum wa rafa'nâ fawqakumut-tûra khudhû mâ âtaynâkum biquwwatin wasma'û, qâlû sami'nâ wa 'asaynâ
versets.francais: Et quand Nous avons pris votre engagement et élevé au-dessus de vous le mont Tûr: "Tenez fermement ce que Nous vous avons apporté et écoutez", ils dirent: "Nous avons entendu et nous désobéissons."
versets.anglais: And [recall] when We took your covenant and raised over you the mount, [saying], "Take what We have given you with determination and listen." They said [instead], "We hear and disobey." And their hearts absorbed [the worship of] the calf because of their disbelief. Say, "How wretched is that which your faith enjoins upon you, if you should be believers

versets.arabe: قُلْ إِن كَانَتْ لَكُمُ الدَّارُ الْآخِرَةُ عِندَ اللَّهِ خَالِصَةً مِّن دُونِ النَّاسِ فَتَمَنَّوُا الْمَوْتَ إِن كُنتُمْ صَادِقِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qul in kânat lakumud-dârul-âkhiratu 'indAllâhi khâlisatan min dûnan-nâsi fatamanna wul-mawta in kuntum sâdiqîn
versets.francais: Dis: "Si la demeure de l'au-delà auprès d'Allah est exclusivement pour vous à l'exclusion des autres hommes, désirez donc la mort, si vous êtes véridiques."
versets.anglais: Say, [O Muhammad], "If the home of the Hereafter with Allah is for you alone and not the [other] people, then wish for death, if you should be truthful

versets.arabe: وَلَن يَتَمَنَّوْهُ أَبَدًا بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ ۗ وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ بِالظَّالِمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa lan yatamannawhu abadan bimâ qaddamat aydîhim, wallâhu 'alîmun biz-zâlimîn
versets.francais: Jamais ils ne le désireront, à cause de ce que leurs mains ont accompli. Allah connaît les injustes.
versets.anglais: But they will never wish for it, ever, because of what their hands have put forth. And Allah is Knowing of the wrongdoers

versets.arabe: وَلَتَجِدَنَّهُمْ أَحْرَصَ النَّاسِ عَلَىٰ حَيَاةٍ وَمِنَ الَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوا ۚ يَوَدُّ أَحَدُهُمْ لَوْ يُعَمَّرُ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa latajidannahum ahrasun-nâsi 'alâ hayâtin wa minal-ladhîna ashrakû, yawaddu ahaduhum law yu'ammara alfa sanatin
versets.francais: Tu trouveras sûrement qu'ils sont les gens les plus avides de vie, et même plus que les associateurs. Chacun d'eux voudrait vivre mille ans.
versets.anglais: And you will surely find them the most greedy of people for life - [even] more than those who associate others with Allah. One of them wishes that he could be granted life a thousand years, but it would not remove him in the least from the [coming] punishment that he should be granted life. And Allah is Seeing of what they do

versets.arabe: قُلْ مَن كَانَ عَدُوًّا لِّجِبْرِيلَ فَإِنَّهُ نَزَّلَهُ عَلَىٰ قَلْبِكَ بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ مُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَهُدًى وَبُشْرَىٰ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qul man kâna 'aduwwan liJibrîla fa'innahu nazzalahu 'alâ qalbika bi'idhnillâhi musaddiqan limâ bayna yadayhi wa hudan wa bushrâ lil-mu'minîn
versets.francais: Dis: "Quiconque est ennemi de Gabriel... c'est lui qui l'a fait descendre sur ton cœur, avec la permission d'Allah, en confirmation de ce qui était avant lui, et comme guidée et bonne annonce aux croyants."
versets.anglais: Say, "Whoever is an enemy to Gabriel - it is [none but] he who has brought the Qur'an down upon your heart, [O Muhammad], by permission of Allah, confirming that which was before it and as guidance and good tidings for the believers

versets.arabe: مَن كَانَ عَدُوًّا لِّلَّهِ وَمَلَائِكَتِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ وَجِبْرِيلَ وَمِيكَالَ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ عَدُوٌّ لِّلْكَافِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Man kâna 'aduwwan lillâhi wa malâ'ikatihi wa rusulihi wa Jibrîla wa Mîkâla fa'innAllâha 'aduwwun lil-kâfirîn
versets.francais: Quiconque est ennemi d'Allah, de Ses anges, de Ses messagers, de Gabriel et de Michaël... Allah est ennemi des ingrats.
versets.anglais: Whoever is an enemy to Allah and His angels and His messengers and Gabriel and Michael - then indeed, Allah is an enemy to the disbelievers

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ أَنزَلْنَا إِلَيْكَ آيَاتٍ بَيِّنَاتٍ ۖ وَمَا يَكْفُرُ بِهَا إِلَّا الْفَاسِقُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa laqad anzalnâ ilayka âyâtin bayyinâtin wa mâ yakfuru bihâ illal-fâsiqûn
versets.francais: Nous t'avons fait descendre des signes évidents. Seuls les pervers les nient.
versets.anglais: And We have certainly revealed to you verses [which are] clear proofs, and no one would deny them except the defiantly disobedient

versets.arabe: أَوَكُلَّمَا عَاهَدُوا عَهْدًا نَّبَذَهُ فَرِيقٌ مِّنْهُم ۚ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
versets.phonetique: Awa kullamâ 'âhadû 'ahdan nabadahu farîqun minhum, bal aktharuhum lâ yu'minûn
versets.francais: Chaque fois qu'ils ont contracté un engagement, un groupe d'entre eux l'a rejeté. Bien plutôt, la plupart d'eux ne croient pas.
versets.anglais: Is it not [true] that every time they took a covenant a party of them threw it away? But, [in fact], most of them do not believe

versets.arabe: وَلَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ مِّنْ عِندِ اللَّهِ مُصَدِّقٌ لِّمَا مَعَهُمْ نَبَذَ فَرِيقٌ مِّنَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْكِتَابَ كِتَابَ اللَّهِ وَرَاءَ ظُهُورِهِمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa lammâ jâ'ahum rasûlun min 'indillâhi musaddiqun limâ ma'ahum nabadha farîqun minal-ladhîna ûtul-kitâba kitâballâhi warâ'a zuhûrihim ka'annahum lâ ya'lamûn
versets.francais: Et quand un messager d'Allah vint à eux confirmant ce qu'ils avaient, un groupe de ceux à qui le Livre avait été donné jetèrent le Livre d'Allah derrière leur dos, comme s'ils ne savaient pas.
versets.anglais: And when a messenger from Allah came to them confirming that which was with them, a party of those who had been given the Scripture threw the Scripture of Allah behind their backs as if they did not know [what it contained]

versets.arabe: وَاتَّبَعُوا مَا تَتْلُو الشَّيَاطِينُ عَلَىٰ مُلْكِ سُلَيْمَانَ ۖ وَمَا كَفَرَ سُلَيْمَانُ وَلَٰكِنَّ الشَّيَاطِينَ كَفَرُوا يُعَلِّمُونَ النَّاسَ السِّحْرَ
versets.phonetique: Wattaba'û mâ tatlushshayâtînu 'alâ mulki Sulaymân, wa mâ kafara Sulaymânu wa lâkinnash-shayâtîna kafarû yu'allimûnan-nâsas-sihr
versets.francais: Ils suivirent ce que les diables récitaient sur le règne de Salomon. Salomon ne fut pas incrédule, mais ce sont les diables qui furent incrédules en enseignant aux gens la magie.
versets.anglais: And they followed [instead] what the devils had recited during the reign of Solomon. It was not Solomon who disbelieved, but the devils disbelieved, teaching people magic and that which was revealed to the two angels at Babylon, Harut and Marut. But the two angels do not teach anyone unless they say, "We are a trial, so do not disbelieve [by practicing magic]." And [yet] they learn from them that by which they cause separation between a man and his wife. But they do not harm anyone through it except by permission of Allah. And the people learn what harms them and does not benefit them. But the Children of Israel certainly knew that whoever purchased the magic would not have in the Hereafter any share. And wretched is that for which they sold themselves, if they only knew

versets.arabe: وَلَوْ أَنَّهُمْ آمَنُوا وَاتَّقَوْا لَمَثُوبَةٌ مِّنْ عِندِ اللَّهِ خَيْرٌ ۖ لَّوْ كَانُوا يَعْلَمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa law annahum âmanû wattaqaw lamathabatun min 'indillâhi khayr, law kânû ya'lamûn
versets.francais: Si seulement ils avaient cru et été pieux, la récompense d'Allah aurait certes été meilleure. Si seulement ils savaient!
versets.anglais: And if they had believed and feared Allah, then the reward from Allah would have been [far] better, if they only knew

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تَقُولُوا رَاعِنَا وَقُولُوا انظُرْنَا وَاسْمَعُوا ۗ وَلِلْكَافِرِينَ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Yâ ayyuhal-ladhîna âmanû lâ taqûlû râ'inâ wa qûlûnzurnâ wasma'û, wa lil-kâfirîna 'adhâbun alîm
versets.francais: Ô croyants! Ne dites pas "Râ'inâ" (surveille-nous) mais dites "Unzurnâ" (regarde-nous) et écoutez. Les ingrats auront un châtiment douloureux.
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, say not [to Allah 's Messenger], "Ra'ina" but say, "Unthurna" and listen. And for the disbelievers is a painful punishment

versets.arabe: مَّا يَوَدُّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ وَلَا الْمُشْرِكِينَ أَن يُنَزَّلَ عَلَيْكُم مِّنْ خَيْرٍ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Mâ yawaddal-ladhîna kafarû min ahlil-kitâbi wa lal-mushrikîna an yunazzala 'alaykum min khayrin min rabbikum
versets.francais: Ni les mécréants parmi les gens du Livre ni les associateurs n'aiment qu'on vous fasse descendre un bien de la part de votre Seigneur.
versets.anglais: Neither those who disbelieve from the People of the Scripture nor the polytheists wish that any good should be sent down to you from your Lord. But Allah selects for His mercy whom He wills, and Allah is the possessor of great bounty

versets.arabe: مَا نَنسَخْ مِنْ آيَةٍ أَوْ نُنسِهَا نَأْتِ بِخَيْرٍ مِّنْهَا أَوْ مِثْلِهَا ۗ أَلَمْ تَعْلَمْ أَنَّ اللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
versets.phonetique: Mâ nansakh min âyatin aw nuns-ihâ na'ti bikhayrin minhâ aw mithlihâ, alam ta'lam annAllâha 'alâ kulli shay'in qadîr
versets.francais: Tout verset que Nous abrogeons ou que Nous faisons oublier, Nous en apportons un meilleur ou de semblable. Ne sais-tu pas qu'Allah est Omnipotent?
versets.anglais: We do not abrogate a verse or cause it to be forgotten except that We bring forth [one] better than it or similar to it. Do you not know that Allah is over all things competent

versets.arabe: أَلَمْ تَعْلَمْ أَنَّ اللَّهَ لَهُ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۗ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِ اللَّهِ مِن وَلِيٍّ وَلَا نَصِيرٍ
versets.phonetique: Alam ta'lam annAllâha lahu mulkus-samâwâti wal-ardi wa mâ lakum min dûnillâhi min waliyyin wa lâ nasîr
versets.francais: Ne sais-tu pas qu'à Allah appartient le royaume des cieux et de la terre? Vous n'avez en dehors d'Allah ni protecteur ni secoureur.
versets.anglais: Do you not know that to Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and [that] you have not besides Allah any protector or any helper

versets.arabe: أَمْ تُرِيدُونَ أَن تَسْأَلُوا رَسُولَكُمْ كَمَا سُئِلَ مُوسَىٰ مِن قَبْلُ
versets.phonetique: Am turîdûna an tas'alû rasûlakum kamâ su'ila Mûsâ min qabl
versets.francais: Voulez-vous interroger votre Messager comme Moïse fut interrogé avant lui?
versets.anglais: Or do you intend to ask your Messenger as Moses was asked before? And whoever exchanges faith for disbelief has certainly strayed from the soundness of the way

versets.arabe: وَدَّ كَثِيرٌ مِّنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ لَوْ يَرُدُّونَكُم مِّن بَعْدِ إِيمَانِكُمْ كُفَّارًا حَسَدًا مِّنْ عِندِ أَنفُسِهِم مِّن بَعْدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الْحَقُّ
versets.phonetique: Wadda kathîrun min ahlil-kitâbi law yaruddûnakum min ba'di îmânikum kuffâran hasadan min 'indi anfusihim min ba'di mâ tabayyana lahumul-haqq
versets.francais: Beaucoup de gens du Livre voudraient vous ramener, après votre foi, à la mécréance, par jalousie de leur part, après que la vérité leur soit apparue clairement.
versets.anglais: Many of the People of the Scripture wish they could turn you back to disbelief after you have believed, out of envy from themselves [even] after the truth has become clear to them. So pardon and overlook until Allah delivers His command. Indeed, Allah is over all things competent

versets.arabe: وَأَقِيمُوا الصَّلَاةَ وَآتُوا الزَّكَاةَ ۚ وَمَا تُقَدِّمُوا لِأَنفُسِكُم مِّنْ خَيْرٍ تَجِدُوهُ عِندَ اللَّهِ ۗ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa aqîmus-salâta wa âtuz-zakâta, wa mâ tuqaddimû li'anfusikum min khayrin tajidûhu 'indAllâh, innAllâha bimâ ta'malûna basîr
versets.francais: Accomplissez la Salât et acquittez la Zakât. Le bien que vous vous préparez, vous le trouverez auprès d'Allah. Allah est Clairvoyant sur ce que vous faites.
versets.anglais: And establish prayer and give zakah, and whatever good you put forward for yourselves - you will find it with Allah. Indeed, Allah of what you do, is Seeing

versets.arabe: وَقَالُوا لَن يَدْخُلَ الْجَنَّةَ إِلَّا مَن كَانَ هُودًا أَوْ نَصَارَىٰ ۗ تِلْكَ أَمَانِيُّهُمْ ۗ قُلْ هَاتُوا بُرْهَانَكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَادِقِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa qâlû lan yadkhutal-jannata illâ man kâna hûdan aw nasârâ, tilka amâniyyuhum, qul hâtû burhânakum in kuntum sâdiqîn
versets.francais: Ils ont dit: "Nul n'entrera au Paradis sinon celui qui est Juif ou Chrétien." Ce sont là leurs vœux. Dis: "Apportez votre preuve, si vous êtes véridiques."
versets.anglais: And they say, "None will enter Paradise except one who is a Jew or a Christian." That is [merely] their wishful thinking, Say, "Produce your proof, if you should be truthful

versets.arabe: بَلَىٰ مَنْ أَسْلَمَ وَجْهَهُ لِلَّهِ وَهُوَ مُحْسِنٌ فَلَهُ أَجْرُهُ عِندَ رَبِّهِ وَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
versets.phonetique: Balâ man aslama wajhahu lillâhi wa huwa muhsinun falahu ajruhu 'inda rabbihi wa lâ khawfun 'alayhim wa lâ hum yahzanûn
versets.francais: Mais si, quiconque soumet sa face à Allah tout en faisant le bien, aura sa récompense auprès de son Seigneur. Ils n'auront rien à craindre et ne seront point affligés.
versets.anglais: Yes [on the contrary], whoever submits his face in Islam to Allah while being a doer of good will have his reward with his Lord. And no fear will there be concerning them, nor will they grieve

versets.arabe: وَقَالَتِ الْيَهُودُ لَيْسَتِ النَّصَارَىٰ عَلَىٰ شَيْءٍ وَقَالَتِ النَّصَارَىٰ لَيْسَتِ الْيَهُودُ عَلَىٰ شَيْءٍ وَهُمْ يَتْلُونَ الْكِتَابَ
versets.phonetique: Wa qâlatil-yahûdu laisatin-nasârâ 'alâ shay'in wa qâlatun-nasârâ laisatil-yahûdu 'alâ shay'in wa hum yatlûnal-kitâb
versets.francais: Les Juifs dirent: "Les Chrétiens ne sont sur rien" et les Chrétiens dirent: "Les Juifs ne sont sur rien." Pourtant ils lisent tous le Livre.
versets.anglais: The Jews say "The Christians have nothing [true] to stand on," and the Christians say, "The Jews have nothing to stand on," although they [both] recite the Scripture. Thus the polytheists speak the same as their words. But Allah will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ

versets.arabe: وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّن مَّنَعَ مَسَاجِدَ اللَّهِ أَن يُذْكَرَ فِيهَا اسْمُهُ وَسَعَىٰ فِي خَرَابِهَا
versets.phonetique: Wa man azlamu mimman mana'a masâjidAllâhi an yudhkara fîhas-muhu wa sa'â fî kharâbihâ
versets.francais: Qui est plus injuste que celui qui empêche qu'on invoque le nom d'Allah dans Ses mosquées et s'efforce à les ruiner?
versets.anglais: And who are more unjust than those who prevent the name of Allah from being mentioned in His mosques and strive toward their destruction. It is not for them to enter them except in fear. For them in this world is disgrace, and they will have in the Hereafter a great punishment

versets.arabe: وَلِلَّهِ الْمَشْرِقُ وَالْمَغْرِبُ ۚ فَأَيْنَمَا تُوَلُّوا فَثَمَّ وَجْهُ اللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ وَاسِعٌ عَلِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa lillâhil-mashriqu wal-maghrib, fa'aynamatuwallû fathamma wajhullâh, innAllâha wâsi'un 'alîm
versets.francais: À Allah appartiennent l'Orient et l'Occident. Où que vous vous tourniez, la Face d'Allah est là. Allah est Immense, Omniscient.
versets.anglais: And to Allah belongs the east and the west. So wherever you [might] turn, there is the Face of Allah. Indeed, Allah is all-Encompassing and Knowing

versets.arabe: وَقَالُوا اتَّخَذَ اللَّهُ وَلَدًا ۗ سُبْحَانَهُ ۖ بَل لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۖ كُلٌّ لَّهُ قَانِتُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa qâlûttakhadhAllâhu waladan subhânahu bal lahu mâ fis-samâwâti wal-ardi kullun lahu qânitûn
versets.francais: Ils dirent: "Allah S'est donné un fils." Gloire à Lui! Bien plutôt, tout ce qui est dans les cieux et la terre Lui appartient et tout Lui obéit.
versets.anglais: They say, "Allah has taken a son." Exalted is He! Rather, to Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth. All are devoutly obedient to Him

versets.arabe: بَدِيعُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۖ وَإِذَا قَضَىٰ أَمْرًا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُ كُن فَيَكُونُ
versets.phonetique: Badî'us-samâwâti wal-ardi wa idhâ qadhâ amran fa'innamâ yaqûlu lahu kun fayakûn
versets.francais: Il est le Créateur des cieux et de la terre à partir de rien. Quand Il décide une chose, Il dit seulement: "Sois", et c'est.
versets.anglais: Originator of the heavens and the earth. When He decrees a matter, He only says to it, "Be," and it is

versets.arabe: وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ لَوْلَا يُكَلِّمُنَا اللَّهُ أَوْ تَأْتِينَا آيَةٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa qâlal-ladhîna lâ ya'lamûna lawlâ yukallimunAllâhu aw ta'tînâ âyah
versets.francais: Ceux qui ne savent pas ont dit: "Pourquoi Allah ne nous parle-t-Il pas, ou pourquoi ne nous vient-il pas un signe?"
versets.anglais: Those who do not know say, "Why does Allah not speak to us or there come to us a sign?" Thus spoke those before them like their words. Their hearts resemble each other. We have shown clearly the signs to a people who are certain [in faith]

versets.arabe: إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ بِالْحَقِّ بَشِيرًا وَنَذِيرًا ۖ وَلَا تُسْأَلُ عَنْ أَصْحَابِ الْجَحِيمِ
versets.phonetique: Innâ arsalnâka bil-haqqi bashîran wa nadhîran wa lâ tus'alu 'an ashâbil-jahîm
versets.francais: Nous t'avons envoyé avec la vérité, comme annonciateur et avertisseur. Tu n'auras pas à répondre des gens de l'Enfer.
versets.anglais: Indeed, We have sent you, [O Muhammad], with the truth as a bringer of good tidings and a warner, and you will not be asked about the companions of Hellfire

versets.arabe: وَلَن تَرْضَىٰ عَنكَ الْيَهُودُ وَلَا النَّصَارَىٰ حَتَّىٰ تَتَّبِعَ مِلَّتَهُمْ ۗ قُلْ إِنَّ هُدَى اللَّهِ هُوَ الْهُدَىٰ
versets.phonetique: Wa lan tardha 'ankal-yahûdu wa lan-nasârâ hattâ tattabi'a millatahum, qul inna hudAllâhi huwal-hudâ
versets.francais: Les Juifs et les Chrétiens ne seront jamais satisfaits de toi jusqu'à ce que tu suives leur religion. Dis: "La guidée d'Allah, c'est la vraie guidée."
versets.anglais: And never will the Jews or the Christians approve of you until you follow their religion. Say, "Indeed, the guidance of Allah is the [only] guidance." If you were to follow their desires after what has come to you of knowledge, you would have against Allah no protector or helper

versets.arabe: الَّذِينَ آتَيْنَاهُمُ الْكِتَابَ يَتْلُونَهُ حَقَّ تِلَاوَتِهِ أُولَٰئِكَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِ
versets.phonetique: Alladhîna âtaynâhumul-kitâba yatlûnahu haqqa tilâwatihi ulâ'ika yu'minûna bih
versets.francais: Ceux à qui Nous avons donné le Livre et qui le récitent comme il se doit, ceux-là y croient.
