versets.anglais: Those to whom We have given the Book recite it with its true recital. They [are the ones who] believe in it. And whoever disbelieves in it - it is they who are the losers

versets.arabe: يَا بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ اذْكُرُوا نِعْمَتِيَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَأَنِّي فَضَّلْتُكُمْ عَلَى الْعَالَمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Yâ banî Isrâ'îladh kurû ni'matiyallatî an'amtu 'alaykum wa annî faddaltukum 'alal-'âlamîn
versets.francais: Ô fils d'Israël, rappelez-vous Mon bienfait dont Je vous ai comblés et que Je vous ai préférés aux mondes.
versets.anglais: O Children of Israel, remember My favor which I have bestowed upon you and that I preferred you over the worlds

versets.arabe: وَاتَّقُوا يَوْمًا لَّا تَجْزِي نَفْسٌ عَن نَّفْسٍ شَيْئًا وَلَا يُقْبَلُ مِنْهَا عَدْلٌ وَلَا تَنفَعُهَا شَفَاعَةٌ وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wattaqû yawman lâ tajzî nafsun 'an nafsin shay'an wa lâ yuqbalu minhâ 'adlun wa lâ tanfa'uhâ shafâ'atun wa lâ hum yunsarûn
versets.francais: Craignez le Jour où nul ne tiendra lieu d'un autre en quoi que ce soit, où nulle rançon ne sera acceptée, où nulle intercession ne sera profitable et où ils ne seront pas secourus.
versets.anglais: And fear a Day when no soul will suffice for another soul at all, and no compensation will be accepted from it, nor will any intercession benefit it, nor will they be aided

versets.arabe: وَإِذِ ابْتَلَىٰ إِبْرَاهِيمَ رَبُّهُ بِكَلِمَاتٍ فَأَتَمَّهُنَّ ۖ قَالَ إِنِّي جَاعِلُكَ لِلنَّاسِ إِمَامًا
versets.phonetique: Wa idhiibtalâ Ibrâhîma rabbuhu bikalimâtin fa'atammahunna, qâla innî jâ'iluka lin-nâsi imâmâ
versets.francais: Et quand son Seigneur éprouva Abraham par certaines paroles, et qu'il les eut accomplies, Il dit: "Je vais faire de toi un guide pour les hommes."
versets.anglais: And [mention, O Muhammad], when Abraham was tried by his Lord with commands and he fulfilled them. [Allah] said, "Indeed, I will make you a leader for the people." [Abraham] said, "And of my descendants?" [Allah] said, "My covenant does not include the wrongdoers

versets.arabe: وَإِذْ جَعَلْنَا الْبَيْتَ مَثَابَةً لِّلنَّاسِ وَأَمْنًا وَاتَّخِذُوا مِن مَّقَامِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ مُصَلًّى
versets.phonetique: Wa idh ja'alnal-bayta mathâbatan lin-nâsi wa amnan wattakhidhû min maqâmi Ibrâhîma musallâ
versets.francais: Et quand Nous fîmes de la Maison (la Ka'ba) un lieu de rassemblement et un lieu sûr pour les gens: "Prenez la station d'Ibrahim comme lieu de prière."
versets.anglais: And [mention] when We made the House a place of return for the people and [a place of] security. And take, [O believers], from the standing place of Abraham a place of prayer. And We charged Abraham and Ishmael, [saying], "Purify My House for those who perform Tawaf and those who are staying [there] for worship and those who bow and prostrate [in prayer]

versets.arabe: وَإِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ رَبِّ اجْعَلْ هَٰذَا بَلَدًا آمِنًا وَارْزُقْ أَهْلَهُ مِنَ الثَّمَرَاتِ مَنْ آمَنَ مِنْهُم بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ
versets.phonetique: Wa idh qâla Ibrâhîmu rabbij'al hâdhâ baladan âminan warzuq ahlahu minas-thamarâti man âmana minhum billâhi wal-yawmil-âkhir
versets.francais: Et quand Abraham dit: "Seigneur, fais de cette cité un lieu sûr et nourris ses habitants de fruits, ceux d'entre eux qui auront cru en Allah et au Jour Dernier."
versets.anglais: And [mention] when Abraham said, "My Lord, make this a secure city and provide its people with fruits - whoever of them believes in Allah and the Last Day." [Allah] said. "And whoever disbelieves - I will grant him enjoyment for a little; then I will force him to the punishment of the Fire, and wretched is the destination

versets.arabe: وَإِذْ يَرْفَعُ إِبْرَاهِيمُ الْقَوَاعِدَ مِنَ الْبَيْتِ وَإِسْمَاعِيلُ رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّا ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
versets.phonetique: Wa idh yarfa'u Ibrâhîmul-qawâ'ida minal-bayti wa Ismâ'îlu, rabbanâ taqabbal minnâ, innaka antas-samî'ul-'alîm
versets.francais: Et quand Abraham et Ismaël élevaient les fondations de la Maison: "Seigneur, accepte de nous. Tu es certes l'Audient, l'Omniscient."
versets.anglais: And [mention] when Abraham was raising the foundations of the House and [with him] Ishmael, [saying], "Our Lord, accept [this] from us. Indeed You are the Hearing, the Knowing

versets.arabe: رَبَّنَا وَاجْعَلْنَا مُسْلِمَيْنِ لَكَ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِنَا أُمَّةً مُّسْلِمَةً لَّكَ وَأَرِنَا مَنَاسِكَنَا وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَا ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ
versets.phonetique: Rabbanâ waj'alnâ muslimayni laka wa min dhurriyyatinâ ummatam muslimatan laka wa arinâ manâsikanâ wa tub 'alaynâ, innaka antat-tawwâbur-rahîm
versets.francais: "Seigneur, fais de nous deux des soumis à Toi; et de notre descendance une communauté soumise à Toi. Montre-nous nos rites et accepte notre repentir. Tu es le Repentant, le Miséricordieux."
versets.anglais: Our Lord, and make us Muslims [in submission] to You and from our descendants a Muslim nation [in submission] to You. And show us our rites and accept our repentance. Indeed, You are the Accepting of repentance, the Merciful

versets.arabe: رَبَّنَا وَابْعَثْ فِيهِمْ رَسُولًا مِّنْهُمْ يَتْلُو عَلَيْهِمْ آيَاتِكَ وَيُعَلِّمُهُمُ الْكِتَابَ وَالْحِكْمَةَ وَيُزَكِّيهِمْ ۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ
versets.phonetique: Rabbanâ wab'ath fîhim rasûlan minhum yatlû 'alayhim âyâtika wa yu'allimuhumulkitâba wal-hikmata wa yuzakkîhim, innaka antal-'azîzul-hakîm
versets.francais: "Seigneur, envoie parmi eux un messager issu d'eux qui leur récitera Tes versets, leur enseignera le Livre et la Sagesse et les purifiera. Tu es certes le Puissant, le Sage."
versets.anglais: Our Lord, and send among them a messenger from themselves who will recite to them Your verses and teach them the Book and wisdom and purify them. Indeed, You are the Exalted in Might, the Wise

versets.arabe: وَمَن يَرْغَبُ عَن مِّلَّةِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِلَّا مَن سَفِهَ نَفْسَهُ
versets.phonetique: Wa man yarghabu 'an millati Ibrâhîma illâ man safiha nafsah
versets.francais: Qui donc, sinon celui qui s'avilit lui-même, répudierait la religion d'Abraham?
versets.anglais: And who would be averse to the religion of Abraham except one who makes a fool of himself. And We had chosen him in this world, and indeed he, in the Hereafter, will be among the righteous

versets.arabe: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُ رَبُّهُ أَسْلِمْ ۖ قَالَ أَسْلَمْتُ لِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Idh qâla lahu rabbuhu aslim, qâla aslamtu lirabbil-'âlamîn
versets.francais: Quand son Seigneur lui dit: "Soumets-toi", il dit: "Je me soumets au Seigneur des mondes."
versets.anglais: When his Lord said to him, "Submit", he said "I have submitted [in Islam] to the Lord of the worlds

versets.arabe: وَوَصَّىٰ بِهَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بَنِيهِ وَيَعْقُوبُ يَا بَنِيَّ إِنَّ اللَّهَ اصْطَفَىٰ لَكُمُ الدِّينَ فَلَا تَمُوتُنَّ إِلَّا وَأَنتُم مُّسْلِمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa wassâ bihâ Ibrâhîmu banîhi wa Ya'qûbu yâ baniyya innAllâhastafâ lakumud-dîna falâ tamûtunna illâ wa antum muslimûn
versets.francais: Abraham en fit le legs à ses fils, et Jacob aussi: "Ô mes fils, Allah vous a choisi cette religion; ne mourez donc qu'en soumis."
versets.anglais: And Abraham instructed his sons [to do the same] and [so did] Jacob, [saying], "O my sons, indeed Allah has chosen for you this religion, so do not die except while you are Muslims

versets.arabe: أَمْ كُنتُمْ شُهَدَاءَ إِذْ حَضَرَ يَعْقُوبَ الْمَوْتُ إِذْ قَالَ لِبَنِيهِ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن بَعْدِي قَالُوا نَعْبُدُ إِلَٰهَكَ وَإِلَٰهَ آبَائِكَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَإِسْمَاعِيلَ وَإِسْحَاقَ إِلَٰهًا وَاحِدًا
versets.phonetique: Am kuntum shuhadâ'a idh hadhara Ya'qûbal-mawtu idh qâla libanîhi mâ ta'budûna min ba'dî, qâlû na'budu ilâhaka wa ilâha âbâ'ika Ibrâhîma wa Ismâ'îla wa Ishâqa ilâhan wâhidâ
versets.francais: Étiez-vous témoins quand Jacob fut sur le point de mourir, quand il dit à ses fils: "Qu'adorerez-vous après moi?" Ils dirent: "Nous adorerons ton Dieu et le Dieu de tes pères, Abraham, Ismaël et Isaac, un Dieu unique."
versets.anglais: Or were you witnesses when death approached Jacob, when he said to his sons, "What will you worship after me?" They said, "We will worship your God and the God of your fathers, Abraham and Ishmael and Isaac - one God. And we are Muslims [in submission] to Him

versets.arabe: تِلْكَ أُمَّةٌ قَدْ خَلَتْ ۖ لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَلَكُم مَّا كَسَبْتُمْ ۖ وَلَا تُسْأَلُونَ عَمَّا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Tilka ummatun qad khalat lahâ mâ kasabat wa lakum mâ kasabtum wa lâ tus'alûna 'ammâ kânû ya'malûn
versets.francais: C'est une communauté qui s'en est allée. À elle ce qu'elle a acquis; à vous ce que vous avez acquis. Vous ne serez pas interrogés sur ce qu'ils faisaient.
versets.anglais: That was a nation which has passed on. It will have [the consequence of] what it earned, and you will have what you have earned. And you will not be asked about what they used to do

versets.arabe: وَقَالُوا كُونُوا هُودًا أَوْ نَصَارَىٰ تَهْتَدُوا ۗ قُلْ بَلْ مِلَّةَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَنِيفًا ۖ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa qâlû kûnû hûdan aw nasârâ tahtadû, qul bal millata Ibrâhîma hanîfan wa mâ kâna minal-mushrikîn
versets.francais: Ils dirent: "Soyez Juifs ou Chrétiens et vous serez bien guidés." Dis: "Bien plutôt la religion d'Abraham le Monothéiste, qui n'était pas du nombre des associateurs."
versets.anglais: They say, "Be Jews or Christians [so] you will be guided." Say, "Rather, [we follow] the religion of Abraham, inclining toward truth, and he was not of the polytheists

versets.arabe: قُولُوا آمَنَّا بِاللَّهِ وَمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْنَا وَمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَىٰ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَإِسْمَاعِيلَ وَإِسْحَاقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ وَالْأَسْبَاطِ وَمَا أُوتِيَ مُوسَىٰ وَعِيسَىٰ وَمَا أُوتِيَ النَّبِيُّونَ مِن رَّبِّهِمْ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِّنْهُمْ وَنَحْنُ لَهُ مُسْلِمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qûlû âmannâ billâhi wa mâ unzila ilaynâ wa mâ unzila ilâ Ibrâhîma wa Ismâ'îla wa Ishâqa wa Ya'qûba wal-asbâti wa mâ ûtiya Mûsâ wa 'Îsâ wa mâ ûtiyan-nabiyyûna min rabbihim, lâ nufarriqu bayna ahadin minhum wa nahnu lahu muslimûn
versets.francais: Dites: "Nous croyons en Allah et à ce qui nous a été révélé et à ce qui a été révélé à Abraham, Ismaël, Isaac, Jacob et les tribus, à ce qui a été donné à Moïse et à Jésus et à ce qui a été donné aux prophètes de leur Seigneur. Nous ne faisons aucune différence entre eux et nous Lui sommes soumis."
versets.anglais: Say, [O believers], "We have believed in Allah and what has been revealed to us and what has been revealed to Abraham and Ishmael and Isaac and Jacob and the Descendants and what was given to Moses and Jesus and what was given to the prophets from their Lord. We make no distinction between any of them, and we are Muslims [in submission] to Him

versets.arabe: فَإِنْ آمَنُوا بِمِثْلِ مَا آمَنتُم بِهِ فَقَدِ اهْتَدَوا ۖ وَّإِن تَوَلَّوْا فَإِنَّمَا هُمْ فِي شِقَاقٍ
versets.phonetique: Fa in âmanû bimithli mâ âmantum bihi faqadih-tadaw, wa in tawallaw fa'innamâ hum fî shiqâq
versets.francais: S'ils croient en ce en quoi vous avez cru, ils sont bien guidés; mais s'ils s'en détournent, ils sont dans le schisme.
versets.anglais: So if they believe in the same as you believe in, then they have been [rightly] guided; but if they turn away, they are only in dissension, and Allah will be sufficient for you against them. And He is the Hearing, the Knowing

versets.arabe: صِبْغَةَ اللَّهِ ۖ وَمَنْ أَحْسَنُ مِنَ اللَّهِ صِبْغَةً ۖ وَنَحْنُ لَهُ عَابِدُونَ
versets.phonetique: Sibghata llâhi wa man ahsanu minAllâhi sibghatan wa nahnu lahu 'âbidûn
versets.francais: Couleur d'Allah! Et qui est meilleur qu'Allah pour la couleur? Et nous L'adorons.
versets.anglais: [And say, "Ours is] the religion of Allah. And who is better than Allah in [ordaining] religion? And we are worshippers of Him

versets.arabe: قُلْ أَتُحَاجُّونَنَا فِي اللَّهِ وَهُوَ رَبُّنَا وَرَبُّكُمْ وَلَنَا أَعْمَالُنَا وَلَكُمْ أَعْمَالُكُمْ وَنَحْنُ لَهُ مُخْلِصُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qul atuhâjjûnanâ fillâhi wa huwa rabbunâ wa rabbukum wa lanâ a'mâlunâ wa lakum a'mâlukum wa nahnu lahu mukhlisûn
versets.francais: Dis: "Nous disputez-vous à propos d'Allah, alors qu'Il est notre Seigneur et votre Seigneur? À nous nos actions et à vous les vôtres. Nous Lui sommes sincèrement dévoués."
versets.anglais: Say, [O Muhammad], "Do you argue with us about Allah while He is our Lord and your Lord? For us are our deeds, and for you are your deeds. And we are sincere [in deed and intention] to Him

versets.arabe: أَمْ تَقُولُونَ إِنَّ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَإِسْمَاعِيلَ وَإِسْحَاقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ وَالْأَسْبَاطَ كَانُوا هُودًا أَوْ نَصَارَىٰ ۗ قُلْ أَأَنتُمْ أَعْلَمُ أَمِ اللَّهُ
versets.phonetique: Am taqûlûna inna Ibrâhîma wa Ismâ'îla wa Ishâqa wa Ya'qûba wal-asbâta kânû hûdan aw nasârâ, qul a'antum a'lamu amillâh
versets.francais: Dites-vous qu'Abraham, Ismaël, Isaac, Jacob et les tribus étaient Juifs ou Chrétiens? Dis: "Êtes-vous plus savants qu'Allah?"
versets.anglais: Or do you say that Abraham and Ishmael and Isaac and Jacob and the Descendants were Jews or Christians? Say, "Are you more knowing or is Allah?" And who is more unjust than one who conceals a testimony he has from Allah? And Allah is not unaware of what you do

versets.arabe: تِلْكَ أُمَّةٌ قَدْ خَلَتْ ۖ لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَلَكُم مَّا كَسَبْتُمْ
versets.phonetique: Tilka ummatun qad khalat lahâ mâ kasabat wa lakum mâ kasabtum
versets.francais: C'est une communauté qui s'en est allée. À elle ce qu'elle a acquis; à vous ce que vous avez acquis.
versets.anglais: That is a nation which has passed on. It will have [the consequence of] what it earned, and you will have what you have earned. And you will not be asked about what they used to do

versets.arabe: سَيَقُولُ السُّفَهَاءُ مِنَ النَّاسِ مَا وَلَّاهُمْ عَن قِبْلَتِهِمُ الَّتِي كَانُوا عَلَيْهَا ۚ قُل لِّلَّهِ الْمَشْرِقُ وَالْمَغْرِبُ
versets.phonetique: Sayaqûlus-sufahâ'u minan-nâsi mâ wallâhum 'an qiblatihumul-latî kânû 'alayhâ, qul lillâhil-mashriqu wal-maghrib
versets.francais: Les imbéciles d'entre les gens diront: "Qu'est-ce qui les a détournés de leur Qibla vers laquelle ils se tournaient?" Dis: "À Allah appartiennent l'Orient et l'Occident."
versets.anglais: The foolish among the people will say, "What has turned them away from their qiblah, which they used to face?" Say, "To Allah belongs the east and the west. He guides whom He wills to a straight path

versets.arabe: وَكَذَٰلِكَ جَعَلْنَاكُمْ أُمَّةً وَسَطًا لِّتَكُونُوا شُهَدَاءَ عَلَى النَّاسِ وَيَكُونَ الرَّسُولُ عَلَيْكُمْ شَهِيدًا
versets.phonetique: Wa kadhâlika ja'alnâkum ummatanwasatan litakûnû shuhadâ'a 'alan-nâsi wa yakûnar-rasûlu 'alaykum shahîdâ
versets.francais: C'est ainsi que Nous avons fait de vous une communauté du juste milieu, pour que vous soyez témoins sur les gens, et que le Messager soit témoin sur vous.
versets.anglais: And thus we have made you a just community that you will be witnesses over the people and the Messenger will be a witness over you. And We did not make the qiblah which you used to face except that We might make evident who would follow the Messenger from who would turn back on his heels. And indeed, it is difficult except for those whom Allah has guided. And never would Allah have caused you to lose your faith. Indeed Allah is, to the people, Kind and Merciful

versets.arabe: قَدْ نَرَىٰ تَقَلُّبَ وَجْهِكَ فِي السَّمَاءِ ۖ فَلَنُوَلِّيَنَّكَ قِبْلَةً تَرْضَاهَا ۚ فَوَلِّ وَجْهَكَ شَطْرَ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ
versets.phonetique: Qad narâ taqalluba wajhika fis-samâ'i falanuwalliyannaka qiblatan tardhâhâ, fawalli wajhaka shatral-masjidil-harâm
versets.francais: Nous voyons ton visage se tourner vers le ciel. Nous t'orienterons donc vers une Qibla qui te satisfasse: tourne alors ton visage vers la Mosquée Sacrée.
versets.anglais: We have certainly seen the turning of your face, [O Muhammad], toward the heaven, and We will surely turn you to a qiblah with which you will be pleased. So turn your face toward al-Masjid al-Haram. And wherever you [believers] are, turn your faces toward it [in prayer]. Indeed, those who have been given the Scripture well know that it is the truth from their Lord. And Allah is not unaware of what they do

versets.arabe: وَلَئِنْ أَتَيْتَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْكِتَابَ بِكُلِّ آيَةٍ مَّا تَبِعُوا قِبْلَتَكَ
versets.phonetique: Wa la'in ataytâl-ladhîna ûtul-kitâba bikulli âyatin mâ tabi'û qiblatak
versets.francais: Même si tu apportais aux gens du Livre toute preuve, ils ne suivraient pas ta Qibla.
versets.anglais: And if you brought to those who were given the Scripture every sign, they would not follow your qiblah. Nor will you be a follower of their qiblah. Nor would they be followers of one another's qiblah. So if you were to follow their desires after what has come to you of knowledge, indeed, you would then be among the wrongdoers

versets.arabe: الَّذِينَ آتَيْنَاهُمُ الْكِتَابَ يَعْرِفُونَهُ كَمَا يَعْرِفُونَ أَبْنَاءَهُمْ ۖ وَإِنَّ فَرِيقًا مِّنْهُمْ لَيَكْتُمُونَ الْحَقَّ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Alladhîna âtaynâhumul-kitâba ya'rifûnahu kamâ ya'rifûna abnâ'ahum wa inna farîqan minhum layaktumûnal-haqqa wa hum ya'lamûn
versets.francais: Ceux à qui Nous avons donné le Livre le reconnaissent comme ils reconnaissent leurs propres fils. Mais un groupe d'entre eux cache sciemment la vérité.
versets.anglais: Those to whom We gave the Scripture know him as they know their own sons. But indeed, a party of them conceal the truth while they know [it]

versets.arabe: الْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكَ ۖ فَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْمُمْتَرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Al-haqqu min rabbika falâ takûnanna minal-mumtarîn
versets.francais: La vérité vient de ton Seigneur. Ne sois pas du nombre des sceptiques.
versets.anglais: The truth is from your Lord, so never be among the doubters

versets.arabe: وَلِكُلٍّ وِجْهَةٌ هُوَ مُوَلِّيهَا ۖ فَاسْتَبِقُوا الْخَيْرَاتِ ۚ أَيْنَ مَا تَكُونُوا يَأْتِ بِكُمُ اللَّهُ جَمِيعًا
versets.phonetique: Wa likullin wijhatun huwa muwallîhâ fastabiqul-khayrât, ayna mâ takûnû ya'ti bikumulAllâhu jamî'â
versets.francais: À chacun il y a une direction vers laquelle il se tourne. Rivalisez donc en bonnes œuvres. Où que vous soyez, Allah vous rassemblera tous.
versets.anglais: For each [religious following] is a direction toward which it faces. So race to [all that is] good. Wherever you may be, Allah will bring you forth [for judgement] all together. Indeed, Allah is over all things competent

versets.arabe: وَمِنْ حَيْثُ خَرَجْتَ فَوَلِّ وَجْهَكَ شَطْرَ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ ۖ وَإِنَّهُ لَلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكَ
versets.phonetique: Wa min haythu kharajta fawalli wajhaka shatral-masjidil-harâmi wa innahu lal-haqqu min rabbik
versets.francais: De quelque endroit que tu partes, tourne ton visage vers la Mosquée Sacrée. C'est bien la vérité de ton Seigneur.
versets.anglais: So from wherever you go out [for prayer, O Muhammad] turn your face toward al- Masjid al-Haram, and indeed, it is the truth from your Lord. And Allah is not unaware of what you do

versets.arabe: وَمِنْ حَيْثُ خَرَجْتَ فَوَلِّ وَجْهَكَ شَطْرَ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ ۚ وَحَيْثُ مَا كُنتُمْ فَوَلُّوا وُجُوهَكُمْ شَطْرَهُ
versets.phonetique: Wa min haythu kharajta fawalli wajhaka shatral-masjidil-harâmi wa haythumâ kuntum fawallû wujûhakum shatarah
versets.francais: De quelque endroit que tu partes, tourne ton visage vers la Mosquée Sacrée. Et où que vous soyez, tournez vos visages vers Elle.
versets.anglais: And from wherever you go out [for prayer], turn your face toward al-Masjid al-Haram. And wherever you [believers] may be, turn your faces toward it in order that the people will not have any argument against you, except for those of them who commit wrong; so fear them not but fear Me. And [it is] so I may complete My favor upon you and that you may be guided

versets.arabe: كَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا فِيكُمْ رَسُولًا مِّنكُمْ يَتْلُو عَلَيْكُمْ آيَاتِنَا وَيُزَكِّيكُمْ وَيُعَلِّمُكُمُ الْكِتَابَ وَالْحِكْمَةَ
versets.phonetique: Kamâ arsalnâ fîkum rasûlan minkum yatlû 'alaykum âyâtinâ wa yuzakkîkum wa yu'allimukumul-kitâba wal-hikmata
versets.francais: De même que Nous vous avons envoyé un messager d'entre vous pour vous réciter Nos versets, vous purifier et vous enseigner le Livre et la Sagesse.
versets.anglais: Just as We have sent among you a messenger from yourselves reciting to you Our verses and purifying you and teaching you the Book and wisdom and teaching you that which you did not know

versets.arabe: فَاذْكُرُونِي أَذْكُرْكُمْ وَاشْكُرُوا لِي وَلَا تَكْفُرُونِ
versets.phonetique: Fadhkurûnî adhkurkum washkurû lî wa lâ takfurûn
versets.francais: Rappelez-vous de Moi donc, Je me souviendrai de vous. Et soyez-Moi reconnaissants et ne soyez pas ingrats.
versets.anglais: So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me and do not deny Me

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اسْتَعِينُوا بِالصَّبْرِ وَالصَّلَاةِ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ مَعَ الصَّابِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Yâ ayyuhal-ladhîna âmanûsta'înû bis-sabri was-salâti, innAllâha ma'as-sâbirîn
versets.francais: Ô croyants! Cherchez secours dans la patience et la Salât. Allah est avec les endurants.
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, seek help through patience and prayer. Indeed, Allah is with the patient

versets.arabe: وَلَا تَقُولُوا لِمَن يُقْتَلُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ أَمْوَاتٌ ۚ بَلْ أَحْيَاءٌ وَلَٰكِن لَّا تَشْعُرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa lâ taqûlû liman yuqtalu fî sabîlillâhi amwât, bal ahyâ'un wa lâkin lâ tash'urûn
versets.francais: Ne dites pas de ceux qui sont tués dans le sentier d'Allah qu'ils sont morts. Au contraire ils sont vivants, mais vous ne le percevez pas.
versets.anglais: And do not say about those who are killed in the way of Allah, "They are dead." Rather, they are alive, but you perceive [it] not

versets.arabe: وَلَنَبْلُوَنَّكُم بِشَيْءٍ مِّنَ الْخَوْفِ وَالْجُوعِ وَنَقْصٍ مِّنَ الْأَمْوَالِ وَالْأَنفُسِ وَالثَّمَرَاتِ ۗ وَبَشِّرِ الصَّابِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa lanabluwannakum bishay'in minal-khawfi wal-jû'i wa naqsin minal-amwâli wal-anfusi wath-thamarât, wa bashshiris-sâbirîn
versets.francais: Nous vous éprouverons par un peu de peur, de faim, de perte de biens, de personnes et de fruits. Et fais la bonne annonce aux endurants!
versets.anglais: And We will surely test you with something of fear and hunger and a loss of wealth and lives and fruits, but give good tidings to the patient

versets.arabe: الَّذِينَ إِذَا أَصَابَتْهُم مُّصِيبَةٌ قَالُوا إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ
versets.phonetique: Alladhîna idhâ asâbathum musîbatun qâlû innâ lillâhi wa innâ ilayhi râji'ûn
versets.francais: Ceux qui, frappés par un malheur, disent: "Nous sommes à Allah et c'est à Lui que nous retournons."
versets.anglais: Who, when disaster strikes them, say, "Indeed we belong to Allah, and indeed to Him we will return

versets.arabe: أُولَٰئِكَ عَلَيْهِمْ صَلَوَاتٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ وَرَحْمَةٌ ۖ وَأُولَٰئِكَ هُمُ الْمُهْتَدُونَ
versets.phonetique: Ulâ'ika 'alayhim salawâtun min rabbihim wa rahmah, wa ulâ'ika humul-muhtadûn
versets.francais: Ceux-là recevront des bénédictions de leur Seigneur ainsi que de la miséricorde. Ce sont eux les bien guidés.
versets.anglais: Those are the ones upon whom are blessings from their Lord and mercy. And it is those who are the [rightly] guided

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةَ مِن شَعَائِرِ اللَّهِ ۖ فَمَنْ حَجَّ الْبَيْتَ أَوِ اعْتَمَرَ فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْهِ أَن يَطَّوَّفَ بِهِمَا
versets.phonetique: Innas-safâ wal-marwata min sha'â'irillâhi faman hajjal-bayta awi'tamara falâ junâha 'alayhi an yattawwafa bihimâ
versets.francais: As-Safâ et Al-Marwah sont parmi les symboles d'Allah. Quiconque fait le pèlerinage à la Maison ou la 'Umra, ne commet pas de faute en faisant le va-et-vient entre eux deux.
versets.anglais: Indeed, as-Safa and al-Marwah are among the symbols of Allah. So whoever makes Hajj to the House or performs 'umrah - there is no blame upon him for walking between them. And whoever volunteers good - then indeed, Allah is appreciative and Knowing

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَكْتُمُونَ مَا أَنزَلْنَا مِنَ الْبَيِّنَاتِ وَالْهُدَىٰ مِن بَعْدِ مَا بَيَّنَّاهُ لِلنَّاسِ فِي الْكِتَابِ أُولَٰئِكَ يَلْعَنُهُمُ اللَّهُ
versets.phonetique: Innal-ladhîna yaktumûna mâ anzalnâ minal-bayyinâti wal-hudâ min ba'di mâ bayyannâhu lin-nâsi fil-kitâbi ulâ'ika yal'anuhumullâh
versets.francais: Ceux qui cachent ce que Nous avons fait descendre comme preuves et guidée, après que Nous l'avons clairement expliqué aux gens dans le Livre, ceux-là Allah les maudit.
versets.anglais: Indeed, those who conceal what We sent down of clear proofs and guidance after We made it clear for the people in the Scripture - those are cursed by Allah and cursed by those who curse

versets.arabe: إِلَّا الَّذِينَ تَابُوا وَأَصْلَحُوا وَبَيَّنُوا فَأُولَٰئِكَ أَتُوبُ عَلَيْهِمْ ۚ وَأَنَا التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ
versets.phonetique: Illal-ladhîna tâbû wa aslahû wa bayyanu fa'ulâ'ika atûbu 'alayhim wa anat-tawwâbur-rahîm
versets.francais: Sauf ceux qui se repentent, se réforment et expliquent; ceux-là, J'agrée leur repentir. Je suis le Repentant, le Miséricordieux.
versets.anglais: Except for those who repent and correct themselves and make evident [what they concealed]. Those - I will accept their repentance, and I am the Accepting of repentance, the Merciful

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَمَاتُوا وَهُمْ كُفَّارٌ أُولَٰئِكَ عَلَيْهِمْ لَعْنَةُ اللَّهِ وَالْمَلَائِكَةِ وَالنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ
versets.phonetique: Innal-ladhîna kafarû wa mâtû wa hum kuffârun ulâ'ika 'alayhim la'natullâhi wal-malâ'ikati wan-nâsi ajma'în
versets.francais: Ceux qui ont mécru et sont morts dans la mécréance auront sur eux la malédiction d'Allah, des anges et des hommes tous ensemble.
versets.anglais: Indeed, those who disbelieve and die while they are disbelievers - upon them will be the curse of Allah and of the angels and the people, all together

versets.arabe: خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا لَا يُخَفَّفُ عَنْهُمُ الْعَذَابُ وَلَا هُمْ يُنظَرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Khâlidîna fîhâ lâ yukhaffafu 'anhumul-'adhâbu wa lâ hum yunzarûn
versets.francais: Ils y demeureront éternellement; le châtiment ne leur sera pas allégé et ils n'auront point de répit.
versets.anglais: Abiding eternally therein. The punishment will not be lightened for them, nor will they be reprieved

versets.arabe: وَإِلَٰهُكُمْ إِلَٰهٌ وَاحِدٌ ۖ لَّا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الرَّحْمَٰنُ الرَّحِيمُ
versets.phonetique: Wa ilâhukum ilâhun wâhid, lâ ilâha illâ huwar-rahmânur-rahîm
versets.francais: Et votre Dieu est un Dieu unique: point de dieu à part Lui, le Tout Miséricordieux, le Très Miséricordieux.
versets.anglais: And your god is one God. There is no deity [worthy of worship] except Him, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful

versets.arabe: إِنَّ فِي خَلْقِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَاخْتِلَافِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ وَالْفُلْكِ الَّتِي تَجْرِي فِي الْبَحْرِ بِمَا يَنفَعُ النَّاسَ
versets.phonetique: Inna fî khalqis-samâwâti wal-ardi wakhtilâfil-layli wan-nahâri wal-fulkil-latî tajrî fil-bahri bimâ yanfa'un-nâs
versets.francais: Il y a certes dans la création des cieux et de la terre, dans l'alternance de la nuit et du jour, dans les navires qui voguent en mer chargés de ce qui profite aux gens... des signes pour ceux qui raisonnent.
versets.anglais: Indeed, in the creation of the heavens and earth, and the alternation of the night and the day, and the [great] ships which sail through the sea with that which benefits people, and what Allah has sent down from the heavens of rain, giving life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness and dispersing therein every [kind of] moving creature, and [His] directing of the winds and the clouds controlled between the heaven and the earth are signs for a people who use reason

versets.arabe: وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَن يَتَّخِذُ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ أَندَادًا يُحِبُّونَهُمْ كَحُبِّ اللَّهِ ۖ وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا أَشَدُّ حُبًّا لِّلَّهِ
versets.phonetique: Wa minan-nâsi man yattakhidhu min dûnillâhi andâdan yuhibbûnahum kahubillâhi, walladhîna âmanû ashaddu hubban lillâh
versets.francais: Parmi les hommes il en est qui prennent, en dehors d'Allah, des égaux qu'ils aiment autant qu'Allah. Mais ceux qui croient sont plus intenses en amour pour Allah.
versets.anglais: And [yet], among the people are those who take other than Allah as equals [to Him]. They love them as they [should] love Allah. But those who believe are stronger in love for Allah. And if only they who have wronged would consider [that] when they see the punishment, [they will be certain] that all power belongs to Allah and that Allah is severe in punishment

versets.arabe: إِذْ تَبَرَّأَ الَّذِينَ اتُّبِعُوا مِنَ الَّذِينَ اتَّبَعُوا وَرَأَوُا الْعَذَابَ وَتَقَطَّعَتْ بِهِمُ الْأَسْبَابُ
versets.phonetique: Idh tabarra'al-ladhînat-tubi'û minal-ladhînattaba'û wa ra'awul-'adhâba wa taqatta'at bihimul-asbâb
versets.francais: Quand ceux qu'on avait suivis désavoueront leurs suiveurs et verront le châtiment, quand les liens entre eux seront coupés.
versets.anglais: [And they should consider that] when those who have been followed disassociate themselves from those who followed [them], and they [all] see the punishment, and cut off from them are the ties [of relationship]

versets.arabe: وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ اتَّبَعُوا لَوْ أَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةً فَنَتَبَرَّأَ مِنْهُمْ كَمَا تَبَرَّءُوا مِنَّا
versets.phonetique: Wa qâlal-ladhînattaba'û law anna lanâ karratan fanatabarr'a minhum kamâ tabarr'û minnâ
versets.francais: Ceux qui auront suivi diront: "Si seulement nous avions une autre chance pour les désavouer comme ils nous ont désavoués!"
versets.anglais: Those who followed will say, "If only we had another turn [at worldly life] so we could disassociate ourselves from them as they have disassociated themselves from us." Thus will Allah show them their deeds as regrets upon them. And they are never to emerge from the Fire

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ كُلُوا مِمَّا فِي الْأَرْضِ حَلَالًا طَيِّبًا وَلَا تَتَّبِعُوا خُطُوَاتِ الشَّيْطَانِ ۚ إِنَّهُ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِينٌ
versets.phonetique: Yâ ayyuhan-nâsu kulû mimmâ fil-ardi halâlan tayyiban wa lâ tattabi'û khutuwâtish-shaytân, innahu lakum 'aduwwun mubîn
versets.francais: Ô hommes! Mangez de ce qui est sur la terre en ce qui est licite et bon. Et ne suivez pas les pas du diable; car il est pour vous un ennemi déclaré.
versets.anglais: O mankind, eat from whatever is on earth [that is] lawful and good and do not follow the footsteps of Satan. Indeed, he is to you a clear enemy

versets.arabe: إِنَّمَا يَأْمُرُكُم بِالسُّوءِ وَالْفَحْشَاءِ وَأَن تَقُولُوا عَلَى اللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Innamâ ya'murukum bis-sû'i wal-fahshâ'i wa an taqûlû 'alAllâhi mâ lâ ta'lamûn
versets.francais: Il ne vous ordonne que le mal et la turpitude et que vous disiez contre Allah ce que vous ne savez pas.
versets.anglais: He only orders you to evil and immorality and to say about Allah what you do not know

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ اتَّبِعُوا مَا أَنزَلَ اللَّهُ قَالُوا بَلْ نَتَّبِعُ مَا أَلْفَيْنَا عَلَيْهِ آبَاءَنَا
versets.phonetique: Wa idhâ qîla lahumuttabi'û mâ anzalAllâhu qâlû bal nattabi'u mâ alfaynâ 'alayhi âbâ'anâ
versets.francais: Et quand on leur dit: "Suivez ce qu'Allah a révélé", ils disent: "Non, nous suivons ce que nous avons trouvé chez nos ancêtres."
versets.anglais: And when it is said to them, "Follow what Allah has revealed," they say, "Rather, we will follow that which we found our fathers doing." Even though their fathers understood nothing, nor were they guided

versets.arabe: وَمَثَلُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا كَمَثَلِ الَّذِي يَنْعِقُ بِمَا لَا يَسْمَعُ إِلَّا دُعَاءً وَنِدَاءً ۚ صُمٌّ بُكْمٌ عُمْيٌ فَهُمْ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa mathalul-ladhîna kafarû kamathalil-ladhî yan'iqu bimâ lâ yasma'u illâ du'â'an wa nidâ'an, summun bukmun 'umyun fahum lâ ya'qilûn
versets.francais: Les mécréants ressemblent à quelqu'un qui crie à ce qui n'entend rien d'autre que des cris et des appels. Sourds, muets et aveugles, ils ne raisonnent pas.
versets.anglais: The example of those who disbelieve is like that of one who shouts at what hears nothing but calls and cries cattle or sheep - deaf, dumb and blind, so they do not understand

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا كُلُوا مِن طَيِّبَاتِ مَا رَزَقْنَاكُمْ وَاشْكُرُوا لِلَّهِ إِن كُنتُمْ إِيَّاهُ تَعْبُدُونَ
versets.phonetique: Yâ ayyuhal-ladhîna âmanû kulû min tayyibâti mâ razaqnâkum washkurû lillâhi in kuntum iyyâhu ta'budûn
versets.francais: Ô croyants! Mangez des bonnes choses dont Nous vous avons pourvus et remerciez Allah si c'est vraiment Lui que vous adorez.
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, eat from the good things which We have provided for you and be grateful to Allah if it is [indeed] Him that you worship

versets.arabe: إِنَّمَا حَرَّمَ عَلَيْكُمُ الْمَيْتَةَ وَالدَّمَ وَلَحْمَ الْخِنزِيرِ وَمَا أُهِلَّ بِهِ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهِ
versets.phonetique: Innamâ harrama 'alaykumul-maytata wad-dama wa lahmal-khinzîri wa mâ uhilla bihi lighairillâh
versets.francais: Il vous a seulement interdit la bête morte, le sang, la chair de porc et ce sur quoi on a invoqué un autre qu'Allah.
versets.anglais: He has only forbidden to you dead animals, blood, the flesh of swine, and that which has been dedicated to other than Allah. But whoever is forced [by necessity], neither desiring [it] nor transgressing [its limit], there is no sin upon him. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَكْتُمُونَ مَا أَنزَلَ اللَّهُ مِنَ الْكِتَابِ وَيَشْتَرُونَ بِهِ ثَمَنًا قَلِيلًا ۙ أُولَٰئِكَ مَا يَأْكُلُونَ فِي بُطُونِهِمْ إِلَّا النَّارَ
versets.phonetique: Innal-ladhîna yaktumûna mâ anzalAllâhu minal-kitâbi wa yashtarûna bihi thamanan qalîlan, ulâ'ika mâ ya'kulûna fî butûnihim illan-nâr
versets.francais: Ceux qui cachent ce qu'Allah a révélé dans le Livre et en tirent un vil prix, ceux-là n'avalent dans leurs ventres que du feu.
versets.anglais: Indeed, they who conceal what Allah has sent down of the Book and exchange it for a small price - those consume not into their bellies except the Fire. And Allah will not speak to them on the Day of Resurrection, nor will He purify them. And they will have a painful punishment

versets.arabe: أُولَٰئِكَ الَّذِينَ اشْتَرَوُا الضَّلَالَةَ بِالْهُدَىٰ وَالْعَذَابَ بِالْمَغْفِرَةِ ۚ فَمَا أَصْبَرَهُمْ عَلَى النَّارِ
versets.phonetique: Ulâ'ikal-ladhînashtarawud-dalâlata bil-hudâ wal-'adhâba bil-maghfira, famâ asbarahum 'alan-nâr
versets.francais: Ceux-là ont échangé la guidée contre l'égarement et le pardon contre le châtiment. Comme ils sont endurants pour supporter le Feu!
versets.anglais: Those are the ones who have exchanged guidance for error and forgiveness for punishment. How patient they are in pursuit of the Fire

versets.arabe: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ اللَّهَ نَزَّلَ الْكِتَابَ بِالْحَقِّ ۗ وَإِنَّ الَّذِينَ اخْتَلَفُوا فِي الْكِتَابِ لَفِي شِقَاقٍ بَعِيدٍ
versets.phonetique: Dhâlika bi'annAllâha nazzalal-kitâba bil-haqq, wa innal-ladhîna ikhtalafû fil-kitâbi lafî shiqâqin ba'îd
versets.francais: C'est parce qu'Allah a fait descendre le Livre avec la vérité. Et ceux qui se divisent à propos du Livre sont certes dans un schisme profond.
versets.anglais: That is [deserved by them] because Allah has sent down the Book in truth. And indeed, those who differ over the Book are in extreme dissension

versets.arabe: لَّيْسَ الْبِرَّ أَن تُوَلُّوا وُجُوهَكُمْ قِبَلَ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ وَلَٰكِنَّ الْبِرَّ مَنْ آمَنَ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ وَالْمَلَائِكَةِ وَالْكِتَابِ وَالنَّبِيِّينَ
versets.phonetique: Laysal-birra an tuwallû wujûhakum qibalal-mashriqi wal-maghribi wa lâkinnal-birra man âmana billâhi wal-yawmil-âkhiri wal-malâ'ikati wal-kitâbi wan-nabiyyîn
versets.francais: La piété ne consiste pas à tourner vos visages vers l'Orient ou l'Occident. Mais la piété est de croire en Allah, au Jour Dernier, aux anges, au Livre et aux prophètes.
versets.anglais: Righteousness is not that you turn your faces toward the east or the west, but [true] righteousness is [in] one who believes in Allah, the Last Day, the angels, the Book, and the prophets and gives wealth, in spite of love for it, to relatives, orphans, the needy, the traveler, those who ask [for help], and for freeing slaves; [and who] establishes prayer and gives zakah; [those who] fulfill their promise when they promise; and [those who] are patient in poverty and hardship and during battle. Those are the ones who have been true, and it is those who are the righteous

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا كُتِبَ عَلَيْكُمُ الْقِصَاصُ فِي الْقَتْلَى
versets.phonetique: Yâ ayyuhal-ladhîna âmanû kutiba 'alaykumul-qisâsu fil-qatlâ
versets.francais: Ô croyants! Le talion vous est prescrit au sujet des tués.
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, prescribed for you is legal retribution for those murdered - the free for the free, the slave for the slave, and the female for the female. But whoever overlooks from his brother anything, then there should be a suitable follow-up and payment to him with good conduct. This is an alleviation from your Lord and a mercy. But whoever transgresses after that will have a painful punishment

versets.arabe: وَلَكُمْ فِي الْقِصَاصِ حَيَاةٌ يَا أُولِي الْأَلْبَابِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَّقُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa lakum fil-qisâsi hayâtun yâ ulil-albâbi la'allakum tattaqûn
versets.francais: Il y a pour vous dans le talion une vie, ô doués d'intelligence, afin que vous soyez pieux.
versets.anglais: And there is for you in legal retribution [saving of] life, O you [people] of understanding, that you may become righteous

versets.arabe: كُتِبَ عَلَيْكُمْ إِذَا حَضَرَ أَحَدَكُمُ الْمَوْتُ إِن تَرَكَ خَيْرًا الْوَصِيَّةُ لِلْوَالِدَيْنِ وَالْأَقْرَبِينَ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ
versets.phonetique: Kutiba 'alaykum idhâ hadara ahadakumul-mawtu in taraka khayranil-wasiyyatu lil-wâlidayni wal-aqrabîna bil-ma'rûf
versets.francais: Il vous est prescrit, quand la mort se présente à l'un de vous et s'il laisse un bien, de faire des legs en faveur des père et mère et des proches de façon convenable.
versets.anglais: Prescribed for you when death approaches [any] one of you if he leaves wealth [is that he should make] a bequest for the parents and near relatives according to what is acceptable - a duty upon the righteous

versets.arabe: فَمَن بَدَّلَهُ بَعْدَمَا سَمِعَهُ فَإِنَّمَا إِثْمُهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ يُبَدِّلُونَهُ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Faman baddalahu ba'damâ sami'ahu fa'innamâ ithmuhu 'alal-ladhîna yubaddilûnah, innAllâha samî'un 'alîm
versets.francais: Quiconque le modifie après l'avoir entendu, la faute en est à ceux qui le modifient. Allah est Audient, Omniscient.
versets.anglais: Then whoever alters the bequest after he has heard it - the sin is only upon those who have altered it. Indeed, Allah is Hearing and Knowing

versets.arabe: فَمَنْ خَافَ مِن مُّوصٍ جَنَفًا أَوْ إِثْمًا فَأَصْلَحَ بَيْنَهُمْ فَلَا إِثْمَ عَلَيْهِ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Faman khâfa min mûsin janafan aw ithman fa'aslaha baynahum falâ ithma 'alayhi, innAllâha ghafûrun rahîm
versets.francais: Mais si quelqu'un craint de la part du testateur une erreur ou une faute et remet les choses en ordre entre eux, il ne commet pas de faute. Allah est Pardonneur, Miséricordieux.
versets.anglais: But if one fears from the bequeather [some] error or sin and corrects that which is between them, there is no sin upon him. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا كُتِبَ عَلَيْكُمُ الصِّيَامُ كَمَا كُتِبَ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَّقُونَ
versets.phonetique: Yâ ayyuhal-ladhîna âmanû kutiba 'alaykumus-siyâmu kamâ kutiba 'alal-ladhîna min qablikum la'allakum tattaqûn
versets.francais: Ô croyants! On vous a prescrit le jeûne comme on l'a prescrit à ceux d'avant vous, ainsi atteindrez-vous la piété.
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, decreed upon you is fasting as it was decreed upon those before you that you may become righteous

versets.arabe: أَيَّامًا مَّعْدُودَاتٍ ۚ فَمَن كَانَ مِنكُم مَّرِيضًا أَوْ عَلَىٰ سَفَرٍ فَعِدَّةٌ مِّنْ أَيَّامٍ أُخَرَ
versets.phonetique: Ayyâman ma'dûdât, faman kâna minkum marîdhan aw 'alâ safarin fa'iddatun min ayyâmin ukhar
versets.francais: C'est un nombre déterminé de jours. Celui d'entre vous qui est malade ou en voyage jeûnera le même nombre d'autres jours.
versets.anglais: [Fasting for] a limited number of days. So whoever among you is ill or on a journey [during them] - then an equal number of days [are to be made up]. And upon those who are able [to fast, but with hardship] - a ransom [as substitute] of feeding a poor person [each day]. And whoever volunteers excess - it is better for him. But to fast is best for you, if you only knew

versets.arabe: شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ الَّذِي أُنزِلَ فِيهِ الْقُرْآنُ هُدًى لِّلنَّاسِ وَبَيِّنَاتٍ مِّنَ الْهُدَىٰ وَالْفُرْقَانِ
versets.phonetique: Shahru ramadânal-ladhî unzila fihil-qur'ânu hudan lin-nâsi wa bayyinâtin minal-hudâ wal-furqân
versets.francais: Le mois de Ramadan est celui où le Coran a été révélé pour servir de guide à l'humanité et comme preuves claires de la guidée et du Critère.
versets.anglais: The month of Ramadhan [is that] in which was revealed the Qur'an, a guidance for the people and clear proofs of guidance and criterion. So whoever sights [the new moon of] the month, let him fast it; and whoever is ill or on a journey - then an equal number of other days. Allah intends for you ease and does not intend for you hardship and [wants] for you to complete the period and to glorify Allah for that [to] which He has guided you; and perhaps you will be grateful

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِي عَنِّي فَإِنِّي قَرِيبٌ ۖ أُجِيبُ دَعْوَةَ الدَّاعِ إِذَا دَعَانِ
versets.phonetique: Wa idhâ sa'alaka 'ibâdî 'annî fa'innî qarîbun, ujîbu da'watad-dâ'i idhâ da'ân
versets.francais: Et si Mes serviteurs t'interrogent sur Moi, Je suis tout proche. Je réponds à l'appel de celui qui Me prie quand il Me prie.
versets.anglais: And when My servants ask you, [O Muhammad], concerning Me - indeed I am near. I respond to the invocation of the supplicant when he calls upon Me. So let them respond to Me [by obedience] and believe in Me that they may be [rightly] guided

versets.arabe: أُحِلَّ لَكُمْ لَيْلَةَ الصِّيَامِ الرَّفَثُ إِلَىٰ نِسَائِكُمْ ۚ هُنَّ لِبَاسٌ لَّكُمْ وَأَنتُمْ لِبَاسٌ لَّهُنَّ
versets.phonetique: Uhilla lakum laylatas-siyâmir-rafathu ilâ nisâ'ikum, hunna libâsun lakum wa antum libâsun lahunna
versets.francais: Il vous est permis, la nuit du jeûne, d'avoir des rapports avec vos femmes. Elles sont un vêtement pour vous et vous êtes un vêtement pour elles.
versets.anglais: It has been made permissible for you the night preceding fasting to go to your wives [for sexual relations]. They are clothing for you and you are clothing for them. Allah knows that you used to deceive yourselves, so He accepted your repentance and forgave you. So now, have relations with them and seek that which Allah has decreed for you. And eat and drink until the white thread of dawn becomes distinct to you from the black thread [of night]. Then complete the fast until the sunset. And do not have relations with them as long as you are staying for worship in the mosques. These are the limits [set by] Allah, so do not approach them. Thus does Allah make clear His ordinances to the people that they may become righteous

versets.arabe: وَلَا تَأْكُلُوا أَمْوَالَكُم بَيْنَكُم بِالْبَاطِلِ وَتُدْلُوا بِهَا إِلَى الْحُكَّامِ لِتَأْكُلُوا فَرِيقًا مِّنْ أَمْوَالِ النَّاسِ بِالْإِثْمِ وَأَنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa lâ ta'kulû amwâlakum baynakum bil-bâtili wa tudlû bihâ ilal-hukkâmi lita'kulû farîqan min amwâlin-nâsi bil-ithmi wa antum ta'lamûn
versets.francais: Et ne mangez pas mutuellement vos biens illicitement; et n'en apportez pas aux juges pour manger, en violation de la loi, une partie des biens des gens, alors que vous savez.
versets.anglais: And do not consume one another's wealth unjustly or send it [in bribery] to the rulers in order that [they might aid] you [to] consume a portion of the wealth of the people in sin, while you know [it is unlawful]

versets.arabe: يَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ الْأَهِلَّةِ ۖ قُلْ هِيَ مَوَاقِيتُ لِلنَّاسِ وَالْحَجِّ
versets.phonetique: Yas'alûnaka 'anil-ahillati qul hiya mawâqîtu lin-nâsi wal-hajj
versets.francais: Ils t'interrogent sur les nouvelles lunes. Dis: "Ce sont des dates fixes pour les gens et pour le pèlerinage."
versets.anglais: They ask you, [O Muhammad], about the new moons. Say, "They are measurements of time for the people and for Hajj." And it is not righteousness to enter houses from the back, but righteousness is [in] one who fears Allah. And enter houses from their doors. And fear Allah that you may succeed

versets.arabe: وَقَاتِلُوا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ الَّذِينَ يُقَاتِلُونَكُمْ وَلَا تَعْتَدُوا ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ الْمُعْتَدِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa qâtilû fî sabîlillâhil-ladhîna yuqâtilûnakum wa lâ ta'tadû, innAllâha lâ yuhibbul-mu'tadîn
versets.francais: Et combattez dans le sentier d'Allah ceux qui vous combattent, et ne transgressez pas. Certes, Allah n'aime pas les transgresseurs.
versets.anglais: Fight in the way of Allah those who fight you but do not transgress. Indeed. Allah does not like transgressors

versets.arabe: وَاقْتُلُوهُمْ حَيْثُ ثَقِفْتُمُوهُمْ وَأَخْرِجُوهُم مِّنْ حَيْثُ أَخْرَجُوكُمْ ۚ وَالْفِتْنَةُ أَشَدُّ مِنَ الْقَتْلِ
versets.phonetique: Waqtulûhum haythu thaqiftumûhum wa akhrijûhum min haythu akhrajûkum, wal-fitnatu ashaddu minal-qatl
versets.francais: Tuez-les où que vous les trouviez et chassez-les d'où ils vous ont chassés: la persécution est plus grave que le meurtre.
versets.anglais: And kill them wherever you overtake them and expel them from wherever they have expelled you, and fitnah is worse than killing. And do not fight them at al-Masjid al- Haram until they fight you there. But if they fight you, then kill them. Such is the recompense of the disbelievers

versets.arabe: فَإِنِ انتَهَوْا فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Fa inintahaw fa'innAllâha ghafûrun rahîm
versets.francais: S'ils cessent, Allah est alors Pardonneur, Miséricordieux.
versets.anglais: And if they cease, then indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful

versets.arabe: وَقَاتِلُوهُمْ حَتَّىٰ لَا تَكُونَ فِتْنَةٌ وَيَكُونَ الدِّينُ لِلَّهِ ۖ فَإِنِ انتَهَوْا فَلَا عُدْوَانَ إِلَّا عَلَى الظَّالِمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa qâtilûhum hattâ lâ takûna fitnatun wa yakûnad-dînu lillâhi, fa inintahaw falâ 'udwâna illâ 'alaz-zâlimîn
versets.francais: Et combattez-les jusqu'à ce qu'il n'y ait plus de persécution et que la religion soit à Allah. S'ils cessent, alors pas d'hostilité sauf contre les injustes.
versets.anglais: Fight them until there is no [more] fitnah and [until] worship is [acknowledged to be] for Allah. But if they cease, then there is to be no aggression except against the oppressors

versets.arabe: الشَّهْرُ الْحَرَامُ بِالشَّهْرِ الْحَرَامِ وَالْحُرُمَاتُ قِصَاصٌ ۚ فَمَنِ اعْتَدَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَاعْتَدُوا عَلَيْهِ بِمِثْلِ مَا اعْتَدَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Ash-shahrul-harâmu bish-shahril-harâmi wal-hurumâtu qisâs, famanit'adâ 'alaykum f'a'tadû 'alayhi bimithli ma'tadâ 'alaykum
versets.francais: Le mois sacré pour le mois sacré; les choses sacrées tombent sous la loi du talion. Quiconque vous attaque, attaquez-le dans la mesure de son attaque.
versets.anglais: [Fighting in] the sacred month is for [aggression committed in] the sacred month, and for [all] violations is legal retribution. So whoever has assaulted you, then assault him in the same way that he has assaulted you. And fear Allah and know that Allah is with those who fear Him

versets.arabe: وَأَنفِقُوا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَلَا تُلْقُوا بِأَيْدِيكُمْ إِلَى التَّهْلُكَةِ ۛ وَأَحْسِنُوا ۛ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْمُحْسِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa anfiqû fî sabîlillâhi wa lâ tulqû bi'aydîkum ilat-tahlukati wa ahsinû, innAllâha yuhibbul-muhsinîn
versets.francais: Dépensez dans le sentier d'Allah et ne vous jetez pas par vos propres mains dans la perdition. Et faites le bien. Allah aime les bienfaisants.
versets.anglais: And spend in the way of Allah and do not throw [yourselves] with your [own] hands into destruction [by refraining]. And do good; indeed, Allah loves the doers of good

versets.arabe: وَأَتِمُّوا الْحَجَّ وَالْعُمْرَةَ لِلَّهِ ۚ فَإِنْ أُحْصِرْتُمْ فَمَا اسْتَيْسَرَ مِنَ الْهَدْيِ
versets.phonetique: Wa atimmul-hajja wal-'umrata lillâh, fa in uhsirtum famastaysara minal-hadyi
versets.francais: Accomplissez le Pèlerinage et la 'Umra pour Allah. Si vous en êtes empêchés, faites une offrande de ce qu'on peut se procurer facilement.
versets.anglais: And complete the Hajj and 'umrah for Allah. But if you are prevented, then [offer] what can be obtained with ease of sacrificial animals. And do not shave your heads until the sacrificial animal has reached its place of slaughter. And whoever among you is ill or has an ailment of the head [making shaving necessary must offer] a ransom of fasting [three days] or charity or sacrifice. And when you are secure, then whoever performs 'umrah [during the Hajj months] followed by Hajj [offers] what can be obtained with ease of sacrificial animals. And whoever cannot find [or afford such an animal] - then a fast of three days during Hajj and of seven when you have returned [home]. Those are ten complete [days]. This is for those whose family is not in the area of al-Masjid al-Haram. And fear Allah and know that Allah is severe in penalty

versets.arabe: الْحَجُّ أَشْهُرٌ مَّعْلُومَاتٌ ۚ فَمَن فَرَضَ فِيهِنَّ الْحَجَّ فَلَا رَفَثَ وَلَا فُسُوقَ وَلَا جِدَالَ فِي الْحَجِّ
versets.phonetique: Al-hajju ashurun ma'lûmât, faman faradha fîhinnal-hajja falâ rafatha wa lâ fusûqa wa lâ jidâla fil-hajj
versets.francais: Le Pèlerinage se fait dans des mois bien connus. Quiconque s'impose le Pèlerinage dans ces mois s'abstiendra de rapports sexuels, d'actes répréhensibles et de disputes pendant le Pèlerinage.
versets.anglais: Hajj is [during] well-known months, so whoever has made Hajj obligatory upon himself therein [by entering the state of ihram], there is [to be for him] no sexual relations and no disobedience and no disputing during Hajj. And whatever good you do - Allah knows it. And take provisions, but indeed, the best provision is fear of Allah. And fear Me, O you of understanding

versets.arabe: لَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ أَن تَبْتَغُوا فَضْلًا مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ ۚ فَإِذَا أَفَضْتُم مِّنْ عَرَفَاتٍ فَاذْكُرُوا اللَّهَ عِندَ الْمَشْعَرِ الْحَرَامِ
versets.phonetique: Laysa 'alaykum junâhun an tabtaghû fadhlam min rabbikum, fa idhâ afadhtum min 'arafâtin fadhkurullâha 'indal-mash'aril-harâm
versets.francais: Vous ne commettez aucun péché en cherchant la grâce de votre Seigneur. Quand vous déferlez d'Arafat, invoquez Allah près du monument sacré.
versets.anglais: There is no blame upon you for seeking bounty from your Lord [during Hajj]. But when you depart from 'Arafat, remember Allah at al- Mash'ar al-Haram. And remember Him, as He has guided you, for indeed, you were before that among those astray

versets.arabe: ثُمَّ أَفِيضُوا مِنْ حَيْثُ أَفَاضَ النَّاسُ وَاسْتَغْفِرُوا اللَّهَ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Thumma afîdhû min haythu afâdan-nâsu wastaghfirullâh, innAllâha ghafûrun rahîm
versets.francais: Puis déferlz d'où les gens déferlent et demandez pardon à Allah. Allah est Pardonneur, Miséricordieux.
versets.anglais: Then depart from the place from where [all] the people depart and ask forgiveness of Allah. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful

versets.arabe: فَإِذَا قَضَيْتُم مَّنَاسِكَكُمْ فَاذْكُرُوا اللَّهَ كَذِكْرِكُمْ آبَاءَكُمْ أَوْ أَشَدَّ ذِكْرًا
versets.phonetique: Fa idhâ qadhаytum manâsikakum fadhkurullâha kadhikrikum âbâ'akum aw ashadda dhikrâ
versets.francais: Quand vous avez accompli vos rites, invoquez Allah comme vous invoquez vos pères, ou même plus fort.
versets.anglais: And when you have completed your rites, remember Allah like your [previous] remembrance of your fathers or with [much] greater remembrance. And among the people is he who says, "Our Lord, give us in this world," and he will have in the Hereafter no share

versets.arabe: وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَقُولُ رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
versets.phonetique: Wa minhum man yaqûlu rabbanâ âtinâ fid-dunyâ hasanatan wa fil-âkhirati hasanatan wa qinâ 'adhâban-nâr
versets.francais: Parmi eux il en est qui dit: "Seigneur, accorde-nous une belle part en ce monde et une belle part dans l'au-delà, et préserve-nous du châtiment du Feu."
versets.anglais: But among them is he who says, "Our Lord, give us in this world [that which is] good and in the Hereafter [that which is] good and protect us from the punishment of the Fire

versets.arabe: أُولَٰئِكَ لَهُمْ نَصِيبٌ مِّمَّا كَسَبُوا ۚ وَاللَّهُ سَرِيعُ الْحِسَابِ
versets.phonetique: Ulâ'ika lahum nasîbun mimmâ kasabû, wallâhu sarî'ul-hisâb
versets.francais: Ceux-là auront une part pour ce qu'ils ont acquis. Allah est prompt dans le règlement des comptes.
versets.anglais: Those will have a share of what they have earned, and Allah is swift in account

versets.arabe: وَاذْكُرُوا اللَّهَ فِي أَيَّامٍ مَّعْدُودَاتٍ
versets.phonetique: Wadhkurullâha fî ayyâmin ma'dûdât
versets.francais: Et invoquez Allah pendant les jours comptés.
versets.anglais: And remember Allah during [specific] numbered days. Then whoever hastens [his departure] in two days - there is no sin upon him; and whoever delays [until the third] - there is no sin upon him - for him who fears Allah. And fear Allah and know that unto Him you will be gathered

versets.arabe: وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَن يُعْجِبُكَ قَوْلُهُ فِي الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا وَيُشْهِدُ اللَّهَ عَلَىٰ مَا فِي قَلْبِهِ وَهُوَ أَلَدُّ الْخِصَامِ
versets.phonetique: Wa minan-nâsi man yu'jibuka qawluhu fil-hayâtid-dunyâ wa yushhidullâha 'alâ mâ fî qalbihi wa huwa aladdulkhisâm
versets.francais: Parmi les hommes, il en est dont la parole sur la vie présente t'émerveille et qui prend Allah à témoin de ce qui est dans son cœur, alors qu'il est le plus acharné des adversaires.
versets.anglais: And of the people is he whose speech pleases you in worldly life, and he calls Allah to witness as to what is in his heart, yet he is the fiercest of opponents

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا تَوَلَّىٰ سَعَىٰ فِي الْأَرْضِ لِيُفْسِدَ فِيهَا وَيُهْلِكَ الْحَرْثَ وَالنَّسْلَ ۗ وَاللَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ الْفَسَادَ
versets.phonetique: Wa idhâ tawallâ sa'â fil-ardi liyufsida fîhâ wa yuhlikal-hartha wan-nasla, wallâhu lâ yuhibbul-fasâd
versets.francais: Dès qu'il tourne le dos, il s'en va semer la corruption sur la terre, détruisant cultures et troupeaux. Et Allah n'aime pas la corruption.
versets.anglais: And when he goes away, he strives throughout the land to cause corruption therein and destroy crops and animals. And Allah does not like corruption

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُ اتَّقِ اللَّهَ أَخَذَتْهُ الْعِزَّةُ بِالْإِثْمِ ۚ فَحَسْبُهُ جَهَنَّمُ ۚ وَلَبِئْسَ الْمِهَادُ
versets.phonetique: Wa idhâ qîla lahuttaqillâha akhadhat-hul-'izzatu bil-ithm, fahasbuhu jahannam, wa labi'sal-mihâd
versets.francais: Et si on lui dit: "Crains Allah", l'orgueil le saisit et le pousse au péché. L'Enfer lui suffit. Quelle mauvaise couche!
versets.anglais: And when it is said to him, "Fear Allah," pride in the sin takes hold of him. Sufficient for him is Hellfire, and how wretched is the resting place

versets.arabe: وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَن يَشْرِي نَفْسَهُ ابْتِغَاءَ مَرْضَاتِ اللَّهِ ۗ وَاللَّهُ رَءُوفٌ بِالْعِبَادِ
versets.phonetique: Wa minan-nâsi man yash-rî nafsahu ibtigha'a mardâtillâh, wallâhu ra'ûfun bil-'ibâd
versets.francais: Et parmi les hommes, il en est qui se sacrifie pour la recherche de l'agrément d'Allah. Allah est très compatissant envers Ses serviteurs.
versets.anglais: And of the people is he who sells himself, seeking means to the approval of Allah. And Allah is kind to [His] servants

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا ادْخُلُوا فِي السِّلْمِ كَافَّةً وَلَا تَتَّبِعُوا خُطُوَاتِ الشَّيْطَانِ
versets.phonetique: Yâ ayyuhal-ladhîna âmanûdhkhulû fis-silmi kâffatan wa lâ tattabi'û khutuẁâtish-shaytân
versets.francais: Ô croyants, entrez en plein dans la paix et ne suivez pas les pas du diable.
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, enter into Islam completely [and perfectly] and do not follow the footsteps of Satan. Indeed, he is to you a clear enemy

versets.arabe: فَإِن زَلَلْتُم مِّن بَعْدِ مَا جَاءَتْكُمُ الْبَيِّنَاتُ فَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّ اللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Fa in zalalтum min ba'di mâ jâ'atkumul-bayyinâtu fa'lamû annAllâha 'azîzun hakîm
versets.francais: Si vous bronchez après que les preuves vous sont venues, sachez qu'Allah est Puissant et Sage.
versets.anglais: But if you deviate after clear proofs have come to you, then know that Allah is Exalted in Might and Wise

versets.arabe: هَلْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا أَن يَأْتِيَهُمُ اللَّهُ فِي ظُلَلٍ مِّنَ الْغَمَامِ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ وَقُضِيَ الْأَمْرُ
versets.phonetique: Hal yanzurûna illâ an ya'tiyahumullâhu fî zulalim minal-ghamâmi wal-malâ'ikatu wa qudhiyal-amr
versets.francais: N'attendent-ils rien d'autre que l'arrivée d'Allah dans des ombres de nuées, et des anges? Et la chose aura été décidée.
versets.anglais: Do they await but that Allah should come to them in covers of clouds and the angels [as well] and the matter is [then] decided? And to Allah [all] matters are returned

versets.arabe: سَلْ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ كَمْ آتَيْنَاهُم مِّنْ آيَةٍ بَيِّنَةٍ
versets.phonetique: Sal banî isrâ'îla kam âtaynâhum min âyatim bayyinah
versets.francais: Demande aux fils d'Israël combien de signes évidents Nous leur avons donnés.
versets.anglais: Ask the Children of Israel how many a sign of evidence We have given them. And whoever exchanges the favor of Allah [for disbelief] after it has come to him - then indeed, Allah is severe in penalty

versets.arabe: زُيِّنَ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا الْحَيَاةُ الدُّنْيَا وَيَسْخَرُونَ مِنَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا
versets.phonetique: Zuyyina lillathîna kafarûl-hayâtud-dunyâ wa yaskharûna minallathîna âmanû
versets.francais: La vie du monde a été embellie pour ceux qui ont mécru. Ils se raillent de ceux qui ont cru.
versets.anglais: Beautified for those who disbelieve is the life of this world, and they ridicule those who believe. But those who fear Allah are above them on the Day of Resurrection. And Allah gives provision to whom He wills without account

versets.arabe: كَانَ النَّاسُ أُمَّةً وَاحِدَةً فَبَعَثَ اللَّهُ النَّبِيِّينَ مُبَشِّرِينَ وَمُنذِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Kânan-nâsu ummataw wâhidatan faba'athallâhun-nabiyyîna mubash-shirîna wa munthirîn
versets.francais: Les hommes formaient une seule communauté. Allah envoya alors des prophètes, annonciateurs et avertisseurs.
versets.anglais: Mankind was [of] one religion [before their deviation]; then Allah sent the prophets as bringers of good tidings and warners and sent down with them the Scripture in truth to judge between the people concerning that in which they differed. And none differed over the Scripture except those who were given it - after the clear proofs came to them - out of jealous animosity among themselves. And Allah guided those who believed to the truth concerning that over which they had differed, by His permission. And Allah guides whom He wills to a straight path

versets.arabe: أَمْ حَسِبْتُمْ أَن تَدْخُلُوا الْجَنَّةَ وَلَمَّا يَأْتِكُم مَّثَلُ الَّذِينَ خَلَوْا مِن قَبْلِكُم
versets.phonetique: Am hasibtum an tadkhulul-jannata wa lammâ ya'tikum mathalul-lathîna khalaw min qablikum
versets.francais: Pensez-vous entrer au Paradis sans qu'il vous soit arrivé ce qui est arrivé à ceux qui ont passé avant vous?
versets.anglais: Or do you think that you will enter Paradise while such [trial] has not yet come to you as came to those who passed on before you? They were touched by poverty and hardship and were shaken until [even their] messenger and those who believed with him said, "When is the help of Allah?" Unquestionably, the help of Allah is near

versets.arabe: يَسْأَلُونَكَ مَاذَا يُنفِقُونَ قُلْ مَا أَنفَقْتُم مِّنْ خَيْرٍ فَلِلْوَالِدَيْنِ
versets.phonetique: Yas'alûnaka mâthâ yunfiqûn, qul mâ anfaqtum min khayrin falil-wâlidayni
versets.francais: Ils te demandent ce qu'ils doivent dépenser. Dis: ce que vous dépensez en bien doit aller aux père et mère.
versets.anglais: They ask you, [O Muhammad], what they should spend. Say, "Whatever you spend of good is [to be] for parents and relatives and orphans and the needy and the traveler. And whatever you do of good - indeed, Allah is Knowing of it

versets.arabe: كُتِبَ عَلَيْكُمُ الْقِتَالُ وَهُوَ كُرْهٌ لَّكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Kutiba 'alaykumul-qitâlu wa huwa kurhul-lakum
versets.francais: Le combat vous est prescrit, même si vous le détestez.
versets.anglais: Fighting has been enjoined upon you while it is hateful to you. But perhaps you hate a thing and it is good for you; and perhaps you love a thing and it is bad for you. And Allah Knows, while you know not

versets.arabe: يَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ الشَّهْرِ الْحَرَامِ قِتَالٍ فِيهِ
versets.phonetique: Yas'alûnaka 'anish-shahril-harâmi qitâlin fîh
versets.francais: Ils t'interrogent sur le mois sacré - sur le fait de s'y battre.
versets.anglais: They ask you about the sacred month - about fighting therein. Say, "Fighting therein is great [sin], but averting [people] from the way of Allah and disbelief in Him and [preventing access to] al-Masjid al-Haram and the expulsion of its people therefrom are greater [evil] in the sight of Allah. And fitnah is greater than killing." And they will continue to fight you until they turn you back from your religion if they are able. And whoever of you reverts from his religion [to disbelief] and dies while he is a disbeliever - for those, their deeds have become worthless in this world and the Hereafter, and those are the companions of the Fire, they will abide therein eternally

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَالَّذِينَ هَاجَرُوا وَجَاهَدُوا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ
versets.phonetique: Innal-lathîna âmanû wallathîna hâjarû wa jâhadû fî sabîlillâh
versets.francais: Ceux qui ont cru, émigré et lutté dans le chemin d'Allah, espèrent la miséricorde d'Allah.
versets.anglais: Indeed, those who have believed and those who have emigrated and fought in the cause of Allah - those expect the mercy of Allah. And Allah is Forgiving and Merciful

versets.arabe: يَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ الْخَمْرِ وَالْمَيْسِرِ قُلْ فِيهِمَا إِثْمٌ كَبِيرٌ
versets.phonetique: Yas'alûnaka 'anil-khamri wal-maysir, qul fîhimâ ithmun kabîr
versets.francais: Ils t'interrogent sur le vin et le jeu de hasard. Dis: dans ces deux-là il y a un grand péché.
versets.anglais: They ask you about wine and gambling. Say, "In them is great sin and [yet, some] benefit for people. But their sin is greater than their benefit." And they ask you what they should spend. Say, "The excess [beyond needs]." Thus Allah makes clear to you the verses [of revelation] that you might give thought

versets.arabe: فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ وَيَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ الْيَتَامَىٰ
versets.phonetique: Fid-dunyâ wal-âkhirati, wa yas'alûnaka 'anal-yatâmâ
versets.francais: En ce monde et dans l'au-delà. Et ils t'interrogent sur les orphelins.
versets.anglais: To this world and the Hereafter. And they ask you about orphans. Say, "Improvement for them is best. And if you mix your affairs with theirs - they are your brothers. And Allah knows the corrupter from the amender. And if Allah had willed, He could have put you in difficulty. Indeed, Allah is Exalted in Might and Wise

versets.arabe: وَلَا تَنكِحُوا الْمُشْرِكَاتِ حَتَّىٰ يُؤْمِنَّ
versets.phonetique: Wa lâ tankihul-mushrikâti hattâ yu'minn
versets.francais: N'épousez pas les femmes polythéistes jusqu'à ce qu'elles croient.
versets.anglais: And do not marry polytheistic women until they believe. And a believing slave woman is better than a polytheist, even though she might please you. And do not marry polytheistic men [to your women] until they believe. And a believing slave is better than a polytheist, even though he might please you. Those invite [you] to the Fire, but Allah invites to Paradise and to forgiveness, by His permission. And He makes clear His verses to the people that perhaps they may remember

versets.arabe: وَيَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ الْمَحِيضِ قُلْ هُوَ أَذًى فَاعْتَزِلُوا النِّسَاءَ فِي الْمَحِيضِ
versets.phonetique: Wa yas'alûnaka 'anil-mahîdh, qul huwa athan fa'tazilun-nisâ'a fil-mahîdh
versets.francais: Ils t'interrogent sur les menstrues. Dis: c'est une souillure. Éloignez-vous des femmes pendant les menstrues.
versets.anglais: And they ask you about menstruation. Say, "It is harm, so keep away from wives during menstruation. And do not approach them until they are pure. And when they have purified themselves, then come to them from where Allah has ordained for you. Indeed, Allah loves those who are constantly repentant and loves those who purify themselves

versets.arabe: نِسَاؤُكُمْ حَرْثٌ لَّكُمْ فَأْتُوا حَرْثَكُمْ أَنَّىٰ شِئْتُمْ
versets.phonetique: Nisâ'ukum harthul-lakum fa'tû harthakum annâ shi'tum
versets.francais: Vos épouses sont un champ de labour pour vous; venez à votre champ comme vous le voulez.
versets.anglais: Your wives are a place of sowing of seed for you, so come to your place of cultivation however you wish and put forth [righteousness] for yourselves. And fear Allah and know that you will meet Him. And give good tidings to the believers

versets.arabe: وَلَا تَجْعَلُوا اللَّهَ عُرْضَةً لِّأَيْمَانِكُمْ أَن تَبَرُّوا وَتَتَّقُوا
versets.phonetique: Wa lâ taj'alullâha 'urdhathal-li'aymânikum an tabarrû wa tattaqû
versets.francais: Ne faites pas d'Allah le prétexte de vos serments pour vous abstenir d'agir avec bonté.
versets.anglais: And do not make [your oath by] Allah an excuse against being righteous and fearing Allah and making peace among people. And Allah is Hearing and Knowing

versets.arabe: لَّا يُؤَاخِذُكُمُ اللَّهُ بِاللَّغْوِ فِي أَيْمَانِكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Lâ yu'âkhithukumullâhu bil-laghwi fî aymânikum
versets.francais: Allah ne vous demande pas compte de vos serments inconsidérés.
versets.anglais: Allah does not impose blame upon you for what is unintentional in your oaths, but He imposes blame upon you for what your hearts have earned. And Allah is Forgiving and Forbearing

versets.arabe: لِّلَّذِينَ يُؤْلُونَ مِن نِّسَائِهِمْ تَرَبُّصُ أَرْبَعَةِ أَشْهُرٍ
versets.phonetique: Lillathîna yu'lûna min nisâ'ihim tarabbusu arba'ati ashhur
versets.francais: Ceux qui font le serment de s'abstenir de leurs femmes doivent attendre quatre mois.
versets.anglais: For those who swear not to have sexual relations with their wives is a waiting time of four months, but if they return [to normal relations] - then indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful

versets.arabe: وَإِنْ عَزَمُوا الطَّلَاقَ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa in 'azamuth-talâqa fa'innallâha samî'un 'alîm
versets.francais: Et s'ils décident le divorce, Allah est Audient et Omniscient.
versets.anglais: And if they decide on divorce - then indeed, Allah is Hearing and Knowing

versets.arabe: وَالْمُطَلَّقَاتُ يَتَرَبَّصْنَ بِأَنفُسِهِنَّ ثَلَاثَةَ قُرُوءٍ
versets.phonetique: Wal-mutallaqâtu yatarabbasna bi'anfusihinna thalâthata qurû'
versets.francais: Les femmes divorcées observent une période d'attente de trois menstruations.
versets.anglais: Divorced women remain in waiting for three periods, and it is not lawful for them to conceal what Allah has created in their wombs if they believe in Allah and the Last Day. And their husbands have more right to take them back in this [period] if they want reconciliation. And due to the wives is similar to what is expected of them, according to what is reasonable. But the men have a degree over them [in responsibility and authority]. And Allah is Exalted in Might and Wise

versets.arabe: الطَّلَاقُ مَرَّتَانِ فَإِمْسَاكٌ بِمَعْرُوفٍ أَوْ تَسْرِيحٌ بِإِحْسَانٍ
versets.phonetique: Ath-talâqu marratâni fa'imsâkum bima'rûfin aw tasrîhum bi'ihsân
versets.francais: Le divorce est permis deux fois; après chacun, c'est soit la reprise honorable soit la séparation bienveillante.
versets.anglais: Divorce is twice. Then, either keep [her] in an acceptable manner or release [her] with good treatment. And it is not lawful for you to take anything of what you have given them unless both fear that they will not be able to keep [within] the limits of Allah. But if you fear that they will not keep [within] the limits of Allah, then there is no blame upon either of them concerning that by which she ransoms herself. These are the limits of Allah, so do not transgress them. And whoever transgresses the limits of Allah - it is those who are the wrongdoers

versets.arabe: فَإِن طَلَّقَهَا فَلَا تَحِلُّ لَهُ مِن بَعْدُ حَتَّىٰ تَنكِحَ زَوْجًا غَيْرَهُ
versets.phonetique: Fa'in tallaqahâ falâ tahillu lahû mim ba'du hattâ tankiha zawjan ghayrahu
versets.francais: S'il la répudie une troisième fois, elle ne lui sera plus licite tant qu'elle n'aura pas épousé un autre homme.
versets.anglais: And if he has divorced her [for the third time], then she is not lawful to him afterward until [after] she marries a husband other than him. And if the latter husband divorces her [or dies], there is no blame upon the woman and her former husband for returning to each other if they think that they can keep [within] the limits of Allah. These are the limits of Allah, which He makes clear to a people who know

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا طَلَّقْتُمُ النِّسَاءَ فَبَلَغْنَ أَجَلَهُنَّ فَأَمْسِكُوهُنَّ بِمَعْرُوفٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa ithâ tallaqtumun-nisâ'a fabalaghna ajalahunna fa'amsikûhunna bima'rûf
versets.francais: Lorsque vous divorcez d'avec des femmes et qu'elles ont atteint leur terme, retenez-les dignement.
versets.anglais: And when you divorce women and they have [nearly] fulfilled their term, either retain them according to acceptable terms or release them according to acceptable terms, and do not keep them, intending harm, to transgress [against them]. And whoever does that has certainly wronged himself. And do not take the verses of Allah in jest. And remember the favor of Allah upon you and what has been revealed to you of the Book and wisdom by which He instructs you. And fear Allah and know that Allah is Knowing of all things

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا طَلَّقْتُمُ النِّسَاءَ فَبَلَغْنَ أَجَلَهُنَّ فَلَا تَعْضُلُوهُنَّ
versets.phonetique: Wa ithâ tallaqtumun-nisâ'a fabalaghna ajalahunna falâ ta'dhulûhunn
versets.francais: Lorsque vous divorcer d'avec des femmes et qu'elles ont atteint leur terme, ne les empêchez pas d'épouser leurs prétendants.
versets.anglais: And when you divorce women and they have fulfilled their term, do not prevent them from remarrying their [former] husbands if they agree among themselves on an acceptable basis. That is instructed to whoever of you believes in Allah and the Last Day. That is better for you and purer, and Allah knows and you know not

versets.arabe: وَالْوَالِدَاتُ يُرْضِعْنَ أَوْلَادَهُنَّ حَوْلَيْنِ كَامِلَيْنِ
versets.phonetique: Wal-wâlidâtu yurdhi'na awlâdahunna hawlayni kâmilayni
versets.francais: Les mères allaiteront leurs enfants deux années complètes, pour ceux qui veulent parachever l'allaitement.
versets.anglais: Mothers may breastfeed their children two complete years for whoever wishes to complete the nursing [period]. Upon the father is the mothers' provision and their clothing according to what is acceptable. No person is charged with more than his capacity. No mother should be harmed through her child, and no father through his child. And upon the [father's] heir is [a duty] like that [of the father]. And if they both desire weaning through mutual consent from both of them and consultation, there is no blame upon either of them. And if you wish to have your children nursed by a substitute, there is no blame upon you as long as you give payment according to what is acceptable. And fear Allah and know that Allah is Seeing of what you do

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ يُتَوَفَّوْنَ مِنكُمْ وَيَذَرُونَ أَزْوَاجًا يَتَرَبَّصْنَ بِأَنفُسِهِنَّ أَرْبَعَةَ أَشْهُرٍ وَعَشْرًا
versets.phonetique: Wallathîna yutawaffawna minkum wa yatharûna azwâjan yatarabbasna bi'anfusihinna arba'ata ashhuri wa 'ashrâ
versets.francais: Ceux d'entre vous qui décèdent en laissant des épouses, celles-ci observent une attente de quatre mois et dix jours.
versets.anglais: And those who are taken in death among you and leave wives behind - they, [the wives, shall] wait four months and ten [days]. And when they have fulfilled their term, then there is no blame upon you for what they do with themselves in an acceptable manner. And Allah is [fully] Acquainted with what you do

versets.arabe: وَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكُمْ فِيمَا عَرَّضْتُم بِهِ مِنْ خِطْبَةِ النِّسَاءِ
versets.phonetique: Wa lâ junâha 'alaykum fîmâ 'arradhtum bihî min khitbatin-nisâ'
versets.francais: Vous ne commettez pas de péché en faisant des allusions à des demandes en mariage à ces femmes.
versets.anglais: There is no blame upon you for that to which you [indirectly] allude concerning a proposal to women or for what you conceal within yourselves. Allah knows that you will have them in mind. But do not promise them secretly except for saying a proper saying. And do not determine to undertake a marriage contract until the decreed period reaches its end. And know that Allah knows what is within yourselves, so beware of Him. And know that Allah is Forgiving and Forbearing

versets.arabe: لَّا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكُمْ إِن طَلَّقْتُمُ النِّسَاءَ مَا لَمْ تَمَسُّوهُنَّ
versets.phonetique: Lâ junâha 'alaykum in tallaqtumun-nisâ'a mâ lam tamassûhunn
versets.francais: Vous ne commettez aucun péché si vous divorcez d'avec des femmes que vous n'avez pas encore touchées.
versets.anglais: There is no blame upon you if you divorce women you have not touched nor specified for them an obligation. But give them [a gift of] compensation - the wealthy according to his capability and the poor according to his capability - a provision according to what is acceptable, a duty upon the doers of good

versets.arabe: وَإِن طَلَّقْتُمُوهُنَّ مِن قَبْلِ أَن تَمَسُّوهُنَّ وَقَدْ فَرَضْتُمْ لَهُنَّ فَرِيضَةً
versets.phonetique: Wa in tallaqtumûhunna min qabli an tamassûhunna wa qad faradhtum lahunna farîdhah
versets.francais: Si vous les répudiez avant de les avoir touchées, alors que vous avez fixé une dot, donnez-leur la moitié.
versets.anglais: And if you divorce them before you have touched them and you have already specified for them an obligation, then [give] half of what you specified - unless they forego the right or the one in whose hand is the marriage contract foregoes it. And to forego it is nearer to righteousness. And do not forget graciousness between you. Indeed Allah, of whatever you do, is Seeing

versets.arabe: حَافِظُوا عَلَى الصَّلَوَاتِ وَالصَّلَاةِ الْوُسْطَىٰ وَقُومُوا لِلَّهِ قَانِتِينَ
versets.phonetique: Hâfidhû 'alash-shalawâti wash-shalâtil-wusthâ wa qûmû lillâhi qânitîn
versets.francais: Observez scrupuleusement les Salats - surtout la Salat du milieu - et tenez-vous debout avec dévotion devant Allah.
versets.anglais: Maintain with care the [obligatory] prayers and [in particular] the middle prayer and stand before Allah, devoutly obedient

versets.arabe: فَإِنْ خِفْتُمْ فَرِجَالًا أَوْ رُكْبَانًا
versets.phonetique: Fa'in khiftum farijâlan aw rukbânâ
versets.francais: Si vous craignez quelque danger, priez à pied ou à cheval.
versets.anglais: And if you fear [an enemy, then pray] on foot or riding. But when you are secure, then remember Allah [in prayer], as He has taught you that which you did not [previously] know

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ يُتَوَفَّوْنَ مِنكُمْ وَيَذَرُونَ أَزْوَاجًا وَصِيَّةً لِّأَزْوَاجِهِم مَّتَاعًا إِلَى الْحَوْلِ
versets.phonetique: Wallathîna yutawaffawna minkum wa yatharûna azwâjan wasiyyatan li'azwâjihim matâ'an ilal-hawl
versets.francais: Ceux d'entre vous qui vont mourir en laissant des épouses, doivent léguer à celles-ci la jouissance pendant un an.
versets.anglais: And those who are taken in death among you and leave wives behind - for their wives is a bequest: maintenance for one year without turning [them] out. But if they leave [of their own accord], then there is no blame upon you for what they do with themselves in an acceptable way. And Allah is Exalted in Might and Wise

versets.arabe: وَلِلْمُطَلَّقَاتِ مَتَاعٌ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ حَقًّا عَلَى الْمُتَّقِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa lil-mutallaqâti matâ'um bil-ma'rûfi haqqan 'alal-muttaqîn
versets.francais: Et les femmes divorcées ont droit à une jouissance raisonnable. C'est un devoir pour les pieux.
versets.anglais: And for divorced women is a provision according to what is acceptable - a duty upon the righteous

versets.arabe: كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ آيَاتِهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Kathâlika yubayyinullâhu lakum âyâtihî la'allakum ta'qilûn
versets.francais: C'est ainsi qu'Allah vous expose Ses versets afin que vous raisonniez.
versets.anglais: Thus does Allah make clear to you His verses that you might use reason

versets.arabe: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى الَّذِينَ خَرَجُوا مِن دِيَارِهِمْ وَهُمْ أُلُوفٌ حَذَرَ الْمَوْتِ
versets.phonetique: Alam tara ilal-lathîna kharajû min diyârihim wa hum ulûfun hatharal-mawt
versets.francais: N'as-tu pas vu ceux qui abandonnèrent leurs demeures par milliers, par crainte de la mort?
versets.anglais: Have you not considered those who left their homes in many thousands, fearing death? Allah said to them, "Die"; then He restored them to life. And Allah is full of bounty to the people, but most of the people do not show gratitude

versets.arabe: وَقَاتِلُوا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّ اللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa qâtilû fî sabîlillâhi wa'lamû annallâha samî'un 'alîm
versets.francais: Combattez dans le chemin d'Allah et sachez qu'Allah est Audient et Omniscient.
versets.anglais: And fight in the cause of Allah and know that Allah is Hearing and Knowing

versets.arabe: مَّن ذَا الَّذِي يُقْرِضُ اللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا فَيُضَاعِفَهُ لَهُ أَضْعَافًا كَثِيرَةً
versets.phonetique: Man thallathî yuqridhullâha qardhan hasanan fayudhâ'ifahu lahû adh'âfan kathîrah
versets.francais: Qui est celui qui fera à Allah un beau prêt, afin qu'Il le lui multiplie plusieurs fois?
versets.anglais: Who is it that would loan Allah a goodly loan so He may multiply it for him many times over? And it is Allah who withholds and grants abundance, and to Him you will be returned

versets.arabe: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى الْمَلَإِ مِن بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ مِن بَعْدِ مُوسَىٰ
versets.phonetique: Alam tara ilal-mala'i mim banî isrâ'îla mim ba'di mûsâ
versets.francais: N'as-tu pas vu les notables des fils d'Israël après Moïse?
versets.anglais: Have you not considered the assembly of the Children of Israel after [the time of] Moses when they said to a prophet of theirs, "Send to us a king, and we will fight in the way of Allah "? He said, "Would you perhaps refrain from fighting if fighting was prescribed for you?" They said, "And why should we not fight in the cause of Allah when we have been driven out from our homes and from our children?" But when fighting was prescribed for them, they turned away, except for a few of them. And Allah is Knowing of the wrongdoers

versets.arabe: وَقَالَ لَهُمْ نَبِيُّهُمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ بَعَثَ لَكُمْ طَالُوتَ مَلِكًا
versets.phonetique: Wa qâla lahum nabiyyuhum innallâha qad ba'atha lakum tâlûta malikâ
versets.francais: Leur prophète leur dit: Allah vous a désigné Saül pour roi.
versets.anglais: And their prophet said to them, "Indeed, Allah has sent to you Saul as a king."
