They said, "How can he have kingship over us while we are more worthy of kingship than him and he has not been given any measure of wealth?" He said, "Indeed, Allah has chosen him over you and has increased him abundantly in knowledge and stature. And Allah gives His sovereignty to whom He wills. And Allah is all-Encompassing [in favor] and Knowing

versets.arabe: وَقَالَ لَهُمْ نَبِيُّهُمْ إِنَّ آيَةَ مُلْكِهِ أَن يَأْتِيَكُمُ التَّابُوتُ
versets.phonetique: Wa qâla lahum nabiyyuhum inna âyata mulkihî an ya'tiyakumut-tâbût
versets.francais: Leur prophète leur dit: le signe de son règne, c'est que vous recevrez le Tabernacle.
versets.anglais: And their prophet said to them, "Indeed, a sign of his kingship is that the chest will come to you in which is assurance from your Lord and a remnant of what the family of Moses and the family of Aaron had left, carried by the angels. Indeed in that is a sign for you, if you are believers

versets.arabe: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِالْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍ
versets.phonetique: Falammâ fasala tâlûtu bil-junûdi qâla innallâha mubthalîkum binahar
versets.francais: Quand Saül fut sorti avec ses soldats, il dit: Allah va vous éprouver avec un cours d'eau.
versets.anglais: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allah will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allah said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allah. And Allah is with the patient

versets.arabe: وَلَمَّا بَرَزُوا لِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِ قَالُوا رَبَّنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا
versets.phonetique: Wa lammâ barazû lijâlûta wa junûdihî qâlû rabbanâ afrigh 'alaynâ sabran
versets.francais: Et quand ils se trouvèrent en face de Goliath et de ses soldats, ils dirent: Seigneur, donne-nous de l'endurance.
versets.anglais: And when they went forth to [face] Goliath and his soldiers, they said, "Our Lord, pour upon us patience and plant firmly our feet and give us victory over the disbelieving people

versets.arabe: فَهَزَمُوهُم بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ وَقَتَلَ دَاوُودُ جَالُوتَ
versets.phonetique: Fahazamûhum bi'ithnil-lâhi wa qatala dâwûdu jâlût
versets.francais: Et ils les défirent avec la permission d'Allah, et David tua Goliath.
versets.anglais: So they defeated them by permission of Allah, and David killed Goliath, and Allah gave him the kingship and prophethood and taught him from that which He willed. And if it were not for Allah checking [some] people by means of others, the earth would have been corrupted, but Allah is full of bounty to the worlds

versets.arabe: تِلْكَ آيَاتُ اللَّهِ نَتْلُوهَا عَلَيْكَ بِالْحَقِّ وَإِنَّكَ لَمِنَ الْمُرْسَلِينَ
versets.phonetique: Tilka âyâtullâhi natlûhâ 'alayka bil-haqqi wa innaka laminal-murssalîn
versets.francais: Ce sont là les versets d'Allah que Nous te récitions en toute vérité. Tu es certes du nombre des messagers.
versets.anglais: These are the verses of Allah which We recite to you, [O Muhammad], in truth. And indeed, you are from among the messengers

versets.arabe: تِلْكَ الرُّسُلُ فَضَّلْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ
versets.phonetique: Tilkar-rusulu fadhdhal-nâ ba'dhahum 'alâ ba'dh
versets.francais: Parmi ces messagers, Nous en avons favorisé certains sur d'autres.
versets.anglais: Those messengers - some of them We caused to exceed others. Among them were those to whom Allah spoke, and He raised some of them in degree. And We gave Jesus, the Son of Mary, clear proofs, and We supported him with the Pure Spirit. If Allah had willed, those [generations] succeeding them would not have fought each other after the clear proofs had come to them. But they differed, and some of them believed and some of them disbelieved. And if Allah had willed, they would not have fought each other, but Allah does what He intends

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا أَنفِقُوا مِمَّا رَزَقْنَاكُم مِّن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَ يَوْمٌ
versets.phonetique: Yâ ayyuhal-lathîna âmanû anfiqû mimmâ razaqnâkum min qabli an ya'tiya yawm
versets.francais: Ô croyants, dépensez de ce que Nous vous avons attribué, avant que vienne un jour.
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, spend from that which We have provided for you before there comes a Day in which there is no exchange and no friendship and no intercession. And the disbelievers - they are the wrongdoers

versets.arabe: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ
versets.phonetique: Allâhu lâ ilâha illâ huwal-hayyul-qayyûm
versets.francais: Allah! Point de divinité à part Lui, le Vivant, Celui qui subsiste par Lui-même.
versets.anglais: Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of [all] existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great

versets.arabe: لَا إِكْرَاهَ فِي الدِّينِ قَد تَّبَيَّنَ الرُّشْدُ مِنَ الْغَيِّ
versets.phonetique: Lâ ikrâha fid-dîni qad tabayyanar-rushdu minal-ghayy
versets.francais: Point de contrainte en religion: la bonne voie s'est distinguée de l'égarement.
versets.anglais: There shall be no compulsion in [acceptance of] the religion. The right course has become clear from the wrong. So whoever disbelieves in Taghut and believes in Allah has grasped the most trustworthy handhold with no break in it. And Allah is Hearing and Knowing

versets.arabe: اللَّهُ وَلِيُّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا يُخْرِجُهُم مِّنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النُّورِ
versets.phonetique: Allâhu waliyyul-lathîna âmanû yukhrijuhum minath-thulumâti ilan-nûr
versets.francais: Allah est le protecteur de ceux qui croient. Il les fait sortir des ténèbres vers la lumière.
versets.anglais: Allah is the ally of those who believe. He brings them out from darknesses into the light. And those who disbelieve - their allies are Taghut. They take them out of the light into darknesses. Those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide eternally therein

versets.arabe: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى الَّذِي حَاجَّ إِبْرَاهِيمَ فِي رَبِّهِ أَنْ آتَاهُ اللَّهُ الْمُلْكَ
versets.phonetique: Alam tara ilal-lathî hâjja ibrâhîma fî rabbihî an âtâhullâhul-mulk
versets.francais: N'as-tu pas vu celui qui disputa avec Abraham au sujet de son Seigneur, parce qu'Allah lui avait accordé la royauté?
versets.anglais: Have you not considered the one who argued with Abraham about his Lord [merely] because Allah had given him kingship? When Abraham said, "My Lord is the one who gives life and causes death," he said, "I give life and cause death." Abraham said, "Indeed, Allah brings up the sun from the east, so bring it up from the west." So the disbeliever was overwhelmed [by astonishment], and Allah does not guide the wrongdoing people

versets.arabe: أَوْ كَالَّذِي مَرَّ عَلَىٰ قَرْيَةٍ وَهِيَ خَاوِيَةٌ عَلَىٰ عُرُوشِهَا
versets.phonetique: Aw kallathî marra 'alâ qaryatin wa hiya khâwiyatun 'alâ 'urûshihâ
versets.francais: Ou comme celui qui passa par une cité dont les toits s'étaient effondrés.
versets.anglais: Or [consider such an example] as the one who passed by a township which had fallen into ruin. He said, "How will Allah bring this to life after its death?" So Allah caused him to die for a hundred years; then He revived him. He said, "How long have you remained?" The man said, "I have remained a day or part of a day." He said, "Rather, you have remained one hundred years. Look at your food and your drink; it has not changed with time. And look at your donkey; and We will make you a sign for the people. And look at the bones [of this donkey] - how We raise them and then We cover them with flesh." And when it became clear to him, he said, "I know that Allah is over all things competent

versets.arabe: وَإِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ رَبِّ أَرِنِي كَيْفَ تُحْيِي الْمَوْتَىٰ
versets.phonetique: Wa ith qâla ibrâhîmu rabbi arinî kayfa tuhyil-mawtâ
versets.francais: Et quand Abraham dit: Seigneur, montre-moi comment Tu redonnes vie aux morts.
versets.anglais: And [mention] when Abraham said, "My Lord, show me how You give life to the dead." [Allah] said, "Have you not believed?" He said, "Yes, but [I ask] only that my heart may be satisfied." [Allah] said, "Take four birds and commit them to yourself. Then [after slaughtering them] put on each hill a portion of them; then call them - they will come [flying] to you in haste. And know that Allah is Exalted in Might and Wise

versets.arabe: مَّثَلُ الَّذِينَ يُنفِقُونَ أَمْوَالَهُمْ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ كَمَثَلِ حَبَّةٍ أَنبَتَتْ سَبْعَ سَنَابِلَ
versets.phonetique: Mathalul-lathîna yunfiqûna amwâlahum fî sabîlillâhi kamathali habbatin anbatat sab'a sanâbil
versets.francais: Ceux qui dépensent leurs biens dans le chemin d'Allah ressemblent à un grain qui germe sept épis.
versets.anglais: The example of those who spend their wealth in the way of Allah is like a seed [of grain] which grows seven spikes; in each spike is a hundred grains. And Allah multiplies [His reward] for whom He wills. And Allah is all-Encompassing and Knowing

versets.arabe: الَّذِينَ يُنفِقُونَ أَمْوَالَهُمْ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ثُمَّ لَا يُتْبِعُونَ مَا أَنفَقُوا مَنًّا وَلَا أَذًى
versets.phonetique: Allathîna yunfiqûna amwâlahum fî sabîlillâhi thumma lâ yutbi'ûna mâ anfaqû mannan wa lâ athan
versets.francais: Ceux qui dépensent leurs biens dans le chemin d'Allah sans faire suivre leurs dons d'un reproche ou d'un tort.
versets.anglais: Those who spend their wealth in the way of Allah and then do not follow up what they have spent with reminders [of it] or [other] injury will have their reward with their Lord, and there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve

versets.arabe: قَوْلٌ مَّعْرُوفٌ وَمَغْفِرَةٌ خَيْرٌ مِّن صَدَقَةٍ يَتْبَعُهَا أَذًى
versets.phonetique: Qawlum ma'rûfun wa maghfiratun khayrum min sadaqatin yatba'uhâ athan
versets.francais: Une bonne parole et un pardon valent mieux qu'une aumône suivie d'un tort.
versets.anglais: Kind speech and forgiveness are better than charity followed by injury. And Allah is Free of need and Forbearing

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تُبْطِلُوا صَدَقَاتِكُم بِالْمَنِّ وَالْأَذَىٰ
versets.phonetique: Yâ ayyuhal-lathîna âmanû lâ tubtilû sadaqâtikum bil-manni wal-athâ
versets.francais: Ô croyants, n'annulez pas vos aumônes par un rappel ou un tort.
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, do not invalidate your charities with reminders or injury as does one who spends his wealth [only] to be seen by the people and does not believe in Allah and the Last Day. His example is like that of a [large] smooth stone upon which is dust and is hit by a downpour that leaves it bare. They are unable [to keep] anything of what they have earned. And Allah does not guide the disbelieving people

versets.arabe: وَمَثَلُ الَّذِينَ يُنفِقُونَ أَمْوَالَهُمُ ابْتِغَاءَ مَرْضَاتِ اللَّهِ
versets.phonetique: Wa mathalul-lathîna yunfiqûna amwâlahumubtigha'a mardhatillâhi
versets.francais: Et ceux qui dépensent leurs biens pour rechercher l'agrément d'Allah ressemblent à un jardin sur une hauteur.
versets.anglais: And the example of those who spend their wealth seeking means to the approval of Allah and assuring [reward for] themselves is like a garden on high ground which is hit by a downpour - so it yields its fruits in double. And [even] if it is not hit by a downpour, then a drizzle [is sufficient]. And Allah, of what you do, is Seeing

versets.arabe: أَيَوَدُّ أَحَدُكُمْ أَن تَكُونَ لَهُ جَنَّةٌ مِّن نَّخِيلٍ وَأَعْنَابٍ
versets.phonetique: Ayawaddu ahadukum an takûna lahû jannatun min nakhîlin wa a'nâb
versets.francais: L'un de vous voudrait-il avoir un jardin de palmiers et de vignes arrosé par des ruisseaux?
versets.anglais: Would one of you like to have a garden of palm trees and grapevines underneath which rivers flow in which he has from every fruit? But he is afflicted with old age and has weak offspring, and it is hit by a whirlwind containing fire and is burned. Thus does Allah make clear to you [His] verses that you might give thought

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا أَنفِقُوا مِن طَيِّبَاتِ مَا كَسَبْتُمْ
versets.phonetique: Yâ ayyuhal-lathîna âmanû anfiqû min tayyibâti mâ kasabtum
versets.francais: Ô croyants, dépensez en bonnes choses que vous avez gagnées.
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, spend from the good things which you have earned and from that which We have produced for you from the earth. And do not aim toward the defective therefrom, spending [from that] while you would not take it [yourself] except with closed eyes. And know that Allah is Free of need and Praiseworthy

versets.arabe: الشَّيْطَانُ يَعِدُكُمُ الْفَقْرَ وَيَأْمُرُكُم بِالْفَحْشَاءِ
versets.phonetique: Ash-shaytânu ya'idukumul-faqra wa ya'murukum bil-fahshâ'
versets.francais: Le Diable vous promet la pauvreté et vous ordonne la turpitude.
versets.anglais: Satan threatens you with poverty and orders you to immorality, while Allah promises you forgiveness from Him and bounty. And Allah is all-Encompassing and Knowing

versets.arabe: يُؤْتِي الْحِكْمَةَ مَن يَشَاءُ وَمَن يُؤْتَ الْحِكْمَةَ فَقَدْ أُوتِيَ خَيْرًا كَثِيرًا
versets.phonetique: Yu'til-hikmata man yashâ'u wa man yu'tal-hikmata faqad ûtiya khayran kathîrâ
versets.francais: Il donne la sagesse à qui Il veut, et à qui on donne la sagesse, on lui a vraiment donné un grand bien.
versets.anglais: He gives wisdom to whom He wills, and whoever has been given wisdom has certainly been given much good. And none will remember except those of understanding

versets.arabe: وَمَا أَنفَقْتُم مِّن نَّفَقَةٍ أَوْ نَذَرْتُم مِّن نَّذْرٍ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ يَعْلَمُهُ
versets.phonetique: Wa mâ anfaqtum min nafaqatin aw natharrtum min nathanin fa'innallâha ya'lamuh
versets.francais: Quelles que soient les dépenses que vous faites ou les vœux que vous formulez, Allah les sait.
versets.anglais: And whatever you spend of expenditures or make of vows - indeed, Allah knows of it. And for the wrongdoers there are no helpers

versets.arabe: إِن تُبْدُوا الصَّدَقَاتِ فَنِعِمَّا هِيَ وَإِن تُخْفُوهَا وَتُؤْتُوهَا الْفُقَرَاءَ فَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ
versets.phonetique: In tubdus-sadaqâti fani'immâ hiya wa in tukhfûhâ wa tu'tûhal-fuqarâ'a fahuwa khayrul-lakum
versets.francais: Si vous faites les aumônes ostensiblement, c'est bien; mais si vous les cachez en les donnant aux pauvres, c'est encore mieux.
versets.anglais: If you disclose your charitable expenditures, they are good; but if you conceal them and give them to the poor, it is better for you, and He will remove from you some of your misdeeds [thereby]. And Allah, with what you do, is [fully] Acquainted

versets.arabe: لَّيْسَ عَلَيْكَ هُدَاهُمْ وَلَٰكِنَّ اللَّهَ يَهْدِي مَن يَشَاءُ
versets.phonetique: Laysa 'alayka hudâhum wa lâkinnallâha yahdî man yashâ'
versets.francais: Ce n'est pas à toi de les guider, mais Allah guide qui Il veut.
versets.anglais: Not upon you, [O Muhammad], is [responsibility for] their guidance, but Allah guides whom He wills. And whatever good you [believers] spend is for yourselves, and you do not spend except seeking the countenance of Allah. And whatever you spend of good - it will be fully repaid to you, and you will not be wronged

versets.arabe: لِلْفُقَرَاءِ الَّذِينَ أُحْصِرُوا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ
versets.phonetique: Lil-fuqarâ'il-lathîna uhsirû fî sabîlillâh
versets.francais: Les aumônes sont destinées aux pauvres qui se sont consacrés dans le chemin d'Allah.
versets.anglais: [Charity is] for the poor who have been restricted for the cause of Allah, unable to move about in the land. An ignorant [person] would think them self-sufficient because of their restraint, but you will know them by their [characteristic] sign. They do not ask people persistently [or at all]. And whatever you spend of good - indeed, Allah is Knowing of it

versets.arabe: الَّذِينَ يُنفِقُونَ أَمْوَالَهُم بِاللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ سِرًّا وَعَلَانِيَةً
versets.phonetique: Allathîna yunfiqûna amwâlahum bil-layli wan-nahâri sirran wa 'alâniyatan
versets.francais: Ceux qui dépensent leurs biens de nuit et de jour, en secret et en public.
versets.anglais: Those who spend their wealth [in Allah 's way] by night and by day, secretly and publicly - they will have their reward with their Lord. And no fear will there be concerning them, nor will they grieve

versets.arabe: الَّذِينَ يَأْكُلُونَ الرِّبَا لَا يَقُومُونَ إِلَّا كَمَا يَقُومُ الَّذِي يَتَخَبَّطُهُ الشَّيْطَانُ مِنَ الْمَسِّ
versets.phonetique: Allathîna ya'kulûnar-ribâ lâ yaqûmûna illâ kamâ yaqûmul-lathî yatakhabbatuhu ash-shaytânu minal-mass
versets.francais: Ceux qui mangent de l'usure ne se lèveront que comme se lève celui que le Diable a démenti par son toucher.
versets.anglais: Those who consume interest cannot stand [on the Day of Resurrection] except as one stands who is being beaten by Satan into insanity. That is because they say, "Trade is [just] like interest." But Allah has permitted trade and has forbidden interest. So whoever has received an admonition from his Lord and desists may have what is past, and his affair rests with Allah. But whoever returns to [dealing in interest or usury] - those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide eternally therein

versets.arabe: يَمْحَقُ اللَّهُ الرِّبَا وَيُرْبِي الصَّدَقَاتِ وَاللَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ كَفَّارٍ أَثِيمٍ
versets.phonetique: Yamhaqullâhur-ribâ wa yurbis-sadaqât, wallâhu lâ yuhibbu kulla kaffârin athîm
versets.francais: Allah anéantit l'usure et fait fructifier les aumônes. Allah n'aime pas le mécréant pécheur.
versets.anglais: Allah destroys interest and gives increase for charities. And Allah does not like every sinning disbeliever

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَأَقَامُوا الصَّلَاةَ وَآتَوُا الزَّكَاةَ
versets.phonetique: Innal-lathîna âmanû wa 'amilûs-sâlihâti wa aqâmush-shalâta wa âtawuz-zakât
versets.francais: Ceux qui ont cru, fait de bonnes oeuvres, accompli la Salat et acquitté la Zakat.
versets.anglais: Indeed, those who believe and do righteous deeds and establish prayer and give zakah will have their reward with their Lord, and there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَذَرُوا مَا بَقِيَ مِنَ الرِّبَا
versets.phonetique: Yâ ayyuhal-lathîna âmanû attaqullâha wa tharû mâ baqiya minar-ribâ
versets.francais: Ô croyants! Craignez Allah et renoncez aux restes de l'usure si vous êtes croyants.
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, fear Allah and give up what remains [due to you] of interest, if you should be believers

versets.arabe: فَإِن لَّمْ تَفْعَلُوا فَأْذَنُوا بِحَرْبٍ مِّنَ اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ
versets.phonetique: Fa'in lam taf'alû fa'thanû biharbin minallâhi wa rasûlih
versets.francais: Si vous ne le faites pas, attendez-vous à la guerre de la part d'Allah et de Son messager.
versets.anglais: And if you do not, then be informed of a war [against you] from Allah and His Messenger. But if you repent, you may have your principal - [thus] you do no wrong, nor are you wronged

versets.arabe: وَإِن كَانَ ذُو عُسْرَةٍ فَنَظِرَةٌ إِلَىٰ مَيْسَرَةٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa in kâna thû 'usratin fanazira ilâ maysarah
versets.francais: Si le débiteur est dans la gêne, qu'on lui accorde un délai jusqu'au retour à l'aisance.
versets.anglais: And if someone is in hardship, then [let there be] postponement until [a time of] ease. But if you give [from your right as] charity, then it is better for you, if you only knew

versets.arabe: وَاتَّقُوا يَوْمًا تُرْجَعُونَ فِيهِ إِلَى اللَّهِ ثُمَّ تُوَفَّىٰ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّا كَسَبَتْ
versets.phonetique: Wattaqû yawman turja'ûna fîhi ilallâhi thumma tuwaffâ kullu nafsin mâ kasabat
versets.francais: Craignez un jour où vous retournerez vers Allah. Alors chaque âme sera rétribuée selon ce qu'elle aura acquis.
versets.anglais: And fear a Day when you will be returned to Allah. Then every soul will be compensated for what it earned, and they will not be treated unjustly

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِذَا تَدَايَنتُم بِدَيْنٍ إِلَىٰ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى فَاكْتُبُوهُ
versets.phonetique: Yâ ayyuhal-lathîna âmanû ithâ tadâyantum bidaynin ilâ ajalim musamman faktubûh
versets.francais: Ô croyants! Quand vous contractez une dette à terme fixé, écrivez-la.
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, when you contract a debt for a specified term, write it down. And let a scribe write [it] between you in justice. Let no scribe refuse to write as Allah has taught him. So let him write and let the one who has the obligation dictate. And let him fear Allah, his Lord, and not leave anything out of it. But if the one who has the obligation is of limited understanding or weak or unable to dictate himself, then let his guardian dictate in justice. And bring to witness two witnesses from among your men. And if there are not two men [available], then a man and two women from those whom you accept as witnesses - so that if one of the women errs, then the other can remind her. And let not the witnesses refuse when they are called upon. And do not be [too] weary to write it, whether it is small or large, for its [specified] term. That is more just in the sight of Allah and stronger as evidence and more likely to prevent doubt between you, except when it is an immediate transaction which you conduct among yourselves. For [then] there is no blame upon you if you do not write it. And take witnesses when you conclude a contract. Let no scribe be harmed or any witness. For if you do so, indeed, it is [grave] disobedience in you. And fear Allah. And Allah teaches you. And Allah is Knowing of all things

versets.arabe: وَإِن كُنتُمْ عَلَىٰ سَفَرٍ وَلَمْ تَجِدُوا كَاتِبًا فَرِهَانٌ مَّقْبُوضَةٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa in kuntum 'alâ safarin wa lam tajidû kâtiban farihânun maqbûdhah
versets.francais: Si vous êtes en voyage et ne trouvez pas de scribe, un gage suffit.
versets.anglais: And if you are on a journey and cannot find a scribe, then a security deposit [should be] taken. And if one of you entrusts another, then let him who is entrusted discharge his trust [faithfully] and let him fear Allah, his Lord. And do not conceal testimony, for whoever conceals it - his heart is indeed sinful, and Allah is Knowing of what you do

versets.arabe: لِّلَّهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَإِن تُبْدُوا مَا فِي أَنفُسِكُمْ أَوْ تُخْفُوهُ
versets.phonetique: Lillâhi mâ fis-samâwâti wa mâ fil-ardhi wa in tubdû mâ fî anfusikum aw tukhfûh
versets.francais: À Allah appartient ce qui est dans les cieux et sur la terre. Que vous manifestiez ce qui est en vous ou que vous le cachiez.
versets.anglais: To Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth. Whether you show what is within yourselves or conceal it, Allah will bring you to account for it. Then He will forgive whom He wills and punish whom He wills, and Allah is over all things competent

versets.arabe: آمَنَ الرَّسُولُ بِمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِن رَّبِّهِ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ
versets.phonetique: Âmanar-rasûlu bimâ unzila ilayhi mir-rabbihî wal-mu'minûn
versets.francais: Le Messager croit en ce qu'on a fait descendre vers lui venant de son Seigneur, et les croyants aussi.
versets.anglais: The Messenger has believed in what was revealed to him from his Lord, and [so have] the believers. All of them have believed in Allah and His angels and His books and His messengers, [saying], "We make no distinction between any of His messengers." And they say, "We hear and we obey. [We seek] Your forgiveness, our Lord, and to You is the [final] destination

versets.arabe: لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا اكْتَسَبَتْ
versets.phonetique: Lâ yukallifullâhu nafsan illâ wus'ahâ, lahâ mâ kasabat wa 'alayhâ maktasabat
versets.francais: Allah n'impose à aucune âme une charge supérieure à sa capacité. Elle sera récompensée pour le bien qu'elle aura fait.
versets.anglais: Allah does not charge a soul except [with that within] its capacity. It will have [the consequence of] what [good] it has gained, and it will bear [the consequence of] what [evil] it has earned. "Our Lord, do not impose blame upon us if we have forgotten or erred. Our Lord, and lay not upon us a burden like that which You laid upon those before us. Our Lord, and burden us not with that which we have no ability to bear. And pardon us; and forgive us; and have mercy upon us. You are our protector, so give us victory over the disbelieving people

versets.arabe: الم
versets.phonetique: Alif Lam Mim
versets.francais: Alif, Lam, Mim.
versets.anglais: Alif, Lam, Meem

versets.arabe: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ
versets.phonetique: Allahu la ilaha illa huwal-hayyul-qayyum
versets.francais: Allah - point de divinité à part Lui, le Vivant, Celui qui subsiste par Lui-même.
versets.anglais: Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence

versets.arabe: نَزَّلَ عَلَيْكَ الْكِتَابَ بِالْحَقِّ مُصَدِّقًا لِمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَأَنزَلَ التَّوْرَاةَ وَالْإِنجِيلَ
versets.phonetique: Nazzala 'alayk al-kitaba bil-haqqi musaddiqan lima bayna yadayhi wa-anzalat-tawrata wal-injil
versets.francais: Il a fait descendre sur toi le Livre avec la vérité, confirmant ce qui était avant lui; et Il a fait descendre la Torah et l'Evangile.
versets.anglais: He has sent down upon you, [O Muhammad], the Book in truth, confirming what was before it. And He revealed the Torah and the Gospel

versets.arabe: مِن قَبْلُ هُدًى لِلنَّاسِ وَأَنزَلَ الْفُرْقَانَ
versets.phonetique: Min qablu hudan lin-nasi wa-anzalal-furqan
versets.francais: Avant cela, comme guide pour les gens. Et Il a fait descendre le Coran.
versets.anglais: Before, as guidance for the people. And He revealed the Qur'an. Indeed, those who disbelieve in the verses of Allah will have a severe punishment, and Allah is exalted in Might, the Owner of Retribution

versets.arabe: إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَخْفَىٰ عَلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ
versets.phonetique: Inna Allaha la yakhfa 'alayhi shay'un fil-ardi wa la fis-sama'
versets.francais: Rien n'échappe à Allah sur la terre ni dans le ciel.
versets.anglais: Indeed, from Allah nothing is hidden in the earth nor in the heaven

versets.arabe: هُوَ الَّذِي يُصَوِّرُكُمْ فِي الْأَرْحَامِ كَيْفَ يَشَاءُ
versets.phonetique: Huwa alladhi yusawwirukum fil-arhami kayfa yasha'
versets.francais: C'est Lui qui vous forme dans les matrices comme Il veut.
versets.anglais: It is He who forms you in the wombs however He wills. There is no deity except Him, the Exalted in Might, the Wise

versets.arabe: هُوَ الَّذِي أَنزَلَ عَلَيْكَ الْكِتَابَ مِنْهُ آيَاتٌ مُحْكَمَاتٌ
versets.phonetique: Huwa alladhi anzala 'alayk al-kitaba minhu ayatun muhkamat
versets.francais: C'est Lui qui a fait descendre sur toi le Livre: il s'y trouve des versets aux sens précis.
versets.anglais: It is He who has sent down to you, [O Muhammad], the Book; in it are verses [that are] precise - they are the foundation of the Book - and others unspecific. As for those in whose hearts is deviation [from truth], they will follow that of it which is unspecific, seeking discord and seeking an interpretation [suitable to them]. And no one knows its [true] interpretation except Allah. But those firm in knowledge say, "We believe in it. All [of it] is from our Lord." And no one will be reminded except those of understanding

versets.arabe: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا
versets.phonetique: Rabbana la tuzigh qulubana ba'da idh hadaytana
versets.francais: Seigneur! Ne laisse pas nos cœurs dévier après que Tu nous as guidés.
versets.anglais: [Who say], "Our Lord, let not our hearts deviate after You have guided us and grant us from Yourself mercy. Indeed, You are the Bestower

versets.arabe: رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ جَامِعُ النَّاسِ لِيَوْمٍ لَّا رَيْبَ فِيهِ
versets.phonetique: Rabbana innaka jami'un-nasi li-yawmin la rayba fih
versets.francais: Notre Seigneur, Tu vas certes rassembler les gens pour un Jour sur lequel il n'y a pas de doute.
versets.anglais: Our Lord, surely You will gather the people for a Day about which there is no doubt. Indeed, Allah does not fail in His promise

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَن تُغْنِيَ عَنْهُمْ أَمْوَالُهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Inna alladhina kafaru lan tughniya 'anhum amwaluhum
versets.francais: Ceux qui ont mécru, ni leurs biens ni leurs enfants ne leur seront d'aucune utilité contre Allah.
versets.anglais: Indeed, those who disbelieve - never will their wealth or their children avail them against Allah at all. And it is they who are fuel for the Fire

versets.arabe: كَدَأْبِ آلِ فِرْعَوْنَ وَالَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ
versets.phonetique: Kada'bi ali fir'awna walladhina min qablihim
versets.francais: Comme cela fut le cas pour les gens de Pharaon et ceux qui vécurent avant eux.
versets.anglais: [Theirs is] like the custom of the people of Pharaoh and those before them. They denied Our signs, so Allah seized them for their sins. And Allah is severe in penalty

versets.arabe: قُل لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا سَتُغْلَبُونَ وَتُحْشَرُونَ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ
versets.phonetique: Qul lil-ladhina kafaru satuglabuna wa-tuhsharuna ila jahannam
versets.francais: Dis à ceux qui ont mécru: "Vous serez vaincus et rassemblés vers l'Enfer."
versets.anglais: Say to those who disbelieve, "You will be overcome and gathered together to Hell, and wretched is the resting place

versets.arabe: قَدْ كَانَ لَكُمْ آيَةٌ فِي فِئَتَيْنِ الْتَقَتَا
versets.phonetique: Qad kana lakum ayatun fi fi'atayni iltaqata
versets.francais: Il y a eu pour vous un signe dans les deux groupes qui s'affrontèrent.
versets.anglais: Already there has been for you a sign in the two armies which met - one fighting in the cause of Allah and another of disbelievers. They saw them [to be] twice their [own] number by [their] eyesight. But Allah supports with His victory whom He wills. Indeed in that is a lesson for those of vision

versets.arabe: زُيِّنَ لِلنَّاسِ حُبُّ الشَّهَوَاتِ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ وَالْبَنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Zuyyina lin-nasi hubbu ash-shahawati minan-nisa'i wal-banin
versets.francais: Il a été enjolivé aux hommes l'amour des plaisirs: les femmes, les enfants.
versets.anglais: Beautified for people is the love of that which they desire - of women and sons, heaped-up sums of gold and silver, fine branded horses, and cattle and tilled land. That is the enjoyment of worldly life, but Allah has with Him the best return

versets.arabe: قُلْ أَؤُنَبِّئُكُم بِخَيْرٍ مِّن ذَٰلِكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Qul a'unabpi'ukum bikhayrin min dhalikum
versets.francais: Dis: "Voulez-vous que je vous annonce quelque chose de meilleur que cela?"
versets.anglais: Say, "Shall I inform you of [something] better than that? For those who fear Allah will be gardens in the presence of their Lord beneath which rivers flow, wherein they abide eternally, and purified spouses and approval from Allah. And Allah is Seeing of [His] servants

versets.arabe: الَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا إِنَّنَا آمَنَّا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا
versets.phonetique: Alladhina yaquluna rabbana innana amanna faghfir lana dhunubana
versets.francais: Ceux qui disent: "Seigneur! Nous avons cru. Pardonne-nous nos péchés."
versets.anglais: Those who say, "Our Lord, indeed we have believed, so forgive us our sins and protect us from the punishment of the Fire

versets.arabe: الصَّابِرِينَ وَالصَّادِقِينَ وَالْقَانِتِينَ وَالْمُنفِقِينَ
versets.phonetique: As-sabirina was-sadiqina wal-qanitina wal-munfiqin
versets.francais: Les endurants, les véridiques, les obéissants, les dépensiers.
versets.anglais: The patient, the true, the obedient, those who spend [in the way of Allah], and those who seek forgiveness before dawn

versets.arabe: شَهِدَ اللَّهُ أَنَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ
versets.phonetique: Shahida Allahu annahu la ilaha illa huwa wal-mala'ika
versets.francais: Allah atteste qu'il n'y a point de divinité à part Lui, ainsi que les anges.
versets.anglais: Allah witnesses that there is no deity except Him, and [so do] the angels and those of knowledge - [that He is] maintaining [creation] in justice. There is no deity except Him, the Exalted in Might, the Wise

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الدِّينَ عِندَ اللَّهِ الْإِسْلَامُ
versets.phonetique: Inna ad-dina 'inda Allahi al-Islam
versets.francais: La religion auprès d'Allah, c'est l'Islam.
versets.anglais: Indeed, the religion in the sight of Allah is Islam. And those who were given the Scripture did not differ except after knowledge had come to them - out of jealous animosity between themselves. And whoever disbelieves in the verses of Allah, then indeed, Allah is swift in [taking] account

versets.arabe: فَإِنْ حَاجُّوكَ فَقُلْ أَسْلَمْتُ وَجْهِيَ لِلَّهِ
versets.phonetique: Fa-in hajjuka faqul aslamtu wajhiya lillah
versets.francais: Si donc ils te discutent, dis: "J'ai soumis mon visage à Allah."
versets.anglais: So if they argue with you, say, "I have submitted myself to Allah [in Islam], and [so have] those who follow me." And say to those who were given the Scripture and [to] the unlearned, "Have you submitted yourselves?" And if they submit [in Islam], they are rightly guided; but if they turn away - then upon you is only the [duty of] notification. And Allah is Seeing of [His] servants

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَكْفُرُونَ بِآيَاتِ اللَّهِ وَيَقْتُلُونَ النَّبِيِّينَ
versets.phonetique: Inna alladhina yakfuruna bi-ayati Allahi wa-yaqtuluna an-nabiyyin
versets.francais: Ceux qui refusent de croire aux versets d'Allah et tuent injustement les prophètes.
versets.anglais: Those who disbelieve in the signs of Allah and kill the prophets without right and kill those who order justice from among the people - give them tidings of a painful punishment

versets.arabe: أُولَٰئِكَ الَّذِينَ حَبِطَتْ أَعْمَالُهُمْ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ
versets.phonetique: Ula'ika alladhina habitat a'maluhum fid-dunya wal-akhira
versets.francais: Ceux-là, leurs œuvres sont perdues en ce monde et dans l'au-delà.
versets.anglais: They are the ones whose deeds have become worthless in this world and the Hereafter, and for them there will be no helpers

versets.arabe: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا نَصِيبًا مِنَ الْكِتَابِ
versets.phonetique: Alam tara ila alladhina utu nasiban minal-kitab
versets.francais: N'as-tu pas vu ceux à qui une part du Livre a été donnée?
versets.anglais: Do you not consider, [O Muhammad], those who were given a portion of the Scripture? They are invited to the Scripture of Allah that it should arbitrate between them; then a party of them turns away, and they are refusing

versets.arabe: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَالُوا لَن تَمَسَّنَا النَّارُ إِلَّا أَيَّامًا مَّعْدُودَاتٍ
versets.phonetique: Dhalika bi-annahum qalu lan tamassana an-naru illa ayyaman ma'dudat
versets.francais: C'est parce qu'ils ont dit: "Le feu ne nous touchera que des jours comptés."
versets.anglais: That is because they say, "Never will the Fire touch us except for [a few] numbered days," and [because] they were deluded in their religion by what they were inventing

versets.arabe: فَكَيْفَ إِذَا جَمَعْنَاهُمْ لِيَوْمٍ لَّا رَيْبَ فِيهِ
versets.phonetique: Fakayfa idha jama'nahum li-yawmin la rayba fih
versets.francais: Comment sera leur sort, quand Nous les rassemblerons pour le Jour sur lequel il n'y a pas de doute?
versets.anglais: So how will it be when We assemble them for a Day about which there is no doubt? And each soul will be compensated [in full for] what it earned, and they will not be wronged

versets.arabe: قُلِ اللَّهُمَّ مَالِكَ الْمُلْكِ تُؤْتِي الْمُلْكَ مَن تَشَاءُ
versets.phonetique: Qulil-lahumma malika al-mulki tu'ti al-mulka man tasha'
versets.francais: Dis: "O Allah! Maître du Royaume, Tu donnes le royaume à qui Tu veux."
versets.anglais: Say, "O Allah, Owner of Sovereignty, You give sovereignty to whom You will and You take sovereignty away from whom You will. You honor whom You will and You humble whom You will. In Your hand is [all] good. Indeed, You are over all things competent

versets.arabe: تُولِجُ اللَّيْلَ فِي النَّهَارِ وَتُولِجُ النَّهَارَ فِي اللَّيْلِ
versets.phonetique: Tuliju al-layla fin-nahari wa tuliju an-nahara fil-layl
versets.francais: Tu fais entrer la nuit dans le jour, et Tu fais entrer le jour dans la nuit.
versets.anglais: You cause the night to enter the day, and You cause the day to enter the night; and You bring the living out of the dead, and You bring the dead out of the living. And You give provision to whom You will without account

versets.arabe: لَّا يَتَّخِذِ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ الْكَافِرِينَ أَوْلِيَاءَ مِن دُونِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: La yattakhidhi al-mu'minuna al-kafirana awliya'a min dun al-mu'minin
versets.francais: Que les croyants ne prennent pas pour alliés des mécréants, en dehors des croyants.
versets.anglais: Let not believers take disbelievers as allies rather than believers. And whoever [of you] does that has nothing with Allah, except when taking precaution against them in prudence. And Allah warns you of Himself, and to Allah is the [final] destination

versets.arabe: قُلْ إِن تُخْفُوا مَا فِي صُدُورِكُمْ أَوْ تُبْدُوهُ يَعْلَمْهُ اللَّهُ
versets.phonetique: Qul in tukhfu ma fi sudurikum aw tubduhu ya'lamhu Allah
versets.francais: Dis: "Que vous cachiez ce qui est dans vos poitrines ou que vous le divulguiez, Allah le sait."
versets.anglais: Say, "Whether you conceal what is in your breasts or reveal it, Allah knows it. And He knows that which is in the heavens and that which is on the earth. And Allah is over all things competent

versets.arabe: يَوْمَ تَجِدُ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّا عَمِلَتْ مِنْ خَيْرٍ مُحْضَرًا
versets.phonetique: Yawma tajidu kullu nafsin ma 'amilat min khayrin muhdaran
versets.francais: Le jour où chaque âme trouvera présent devant elle ce qu'elle aura fait de bien.
versets.anglais: The Day every soul will find what it has done of good present [before it] and what it has done of evil, it will wish that between itself and that [evil] was a great distance. And Allah warns you of Himself, and Allah is Kind to [His] servants

versets.arabe: قُلْ إِن كُنتُمْ تُحِبُّونَ اللَّهَ فَاتَّبِعُونِي يُحْبِبْكُمُ اللَّهُ
versets.phonetique: Qul in kuntum tuhibbuna Allaha fattabi'uni yuhbibkumu Allah
versets.francais: Dis: "Si vous aimez Allah, suivez-moi, Allah vous aimera."
versets.anglais: Say, [O Muhammad], "If you should love Allah, then follow me, [so] Allah will love you and forgive you your sins. And Allah is Forgiving and Merciful

versets.arabe: قُلْ أَطِيعُوا اللَّهَ وَالرَّسُولَ
versets.phonetique: Qul ati'u Allaha war-rasul
versets.francais: Dis: "Obéissez à Allah et au Messager."
versets.anglais: Say, "Obey Allah and the Messenger." But if they turn away - then indeed, Allah does not like the disbelievers

versets.arabe: إِنَّ اللَّهَ اصْطَفَىٰ آدَمَ وَنُوحًا وَآلَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَآلَ عِمْرَانَ
versets.phonetique: Inna Allaha astafa adama wa-nuhan wa-ala ibrahima wa-ala 'imran
versets.francais: Allah a choisi Adam, Noé, la famille d'Abraham et la famille d'Imran sur les mondes.
versets.anglais: Indeed, Allah chose Adam and Noah and the family of Abraham and the family of 'Imran over the worlds

versets.arabe: ذُرِّيَّةً بَعْضُهَا مِن بَعْضٍ وَاللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Dhurriyyatan ba'duha min ba'din wallahu sami'un 'alim
versets.francais: Descendants les uns des autres. Allah est Audient et Omniscient.
versets.anglais: Descendants, some of them from others. And Allah is Hearing and Knowing

versets.arabe: إِذْ قَالَتِ امْرَأَتُ عِمْرَانَ رَبِّ إِنِّي نَذَرْتُ لَكَ مَا فِي بَطْنِي
versets.phonetique: Idh qalati imra'atu 'imrana rabbi inni nadhartu laka ma fi batni
versets.francais: Quand la femme d'Imran dit: "Seigneur! Je T'ai voué ce qui est dans mon ventre."
versets.anglais: [Mention, O Muhammad], when the wife of 'Imran said, "My Lord, indeed I have pledged to You what is in my womb, consecrated [for Your service], so accept this from me. Indeed, You are the Hearing, the Knowing

versets.arabe: فَلَمَّا وَضَعَتْهَا قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّي وَضَعْتُهَا أُنثَىٰ
versets.phonetique: Falamma wada'atha qalat rabbi inni wada'tuha untha
versets.francais: Quand elle en accoucha, elle dit: "Seigneur! J'ai accouché d'une fille."
versets.anglais: But when she delivered her, she said, "My Lord, I have delivered a female." And Allah was most knowing of what she delivered, "And the male is not like the female. And I have named her Mary, and I seek refuge for her in You and [for] her descendants from Satan, the expelled [from the mercy of Allah]

versets.arabe: فَتَقَبَّلَهَا رَبُّهَا بِقَبُولٍ حَسَنٍ وَأَنبَتَهَا نَبَاتًا حَسَنًا
versets.phonetique: Fataqabbalaha rabbuha biqabulin hasanin wa-anbataha nabatan hasana
versets.francais: Son Seigneur l'agréa d'un bel agrément et la fit croître d'une belle croissance.
versets.anglais: So her Lord accepted her with good acceptance and caused her to grow in a good manner and put her in the care of Zechariah. Every time Zechariah entered upon her in the prayer chamber, he found with her provision. He said, "O Mary, from where is this [coming] to you?" She said, "It is from Allah. Indeed, Allah provides for whom He wills without account

versets.arabe: هُنَالِكَ دَعَا زَكَرِيَّا رَبَّهُ
versets.phonetique: Hunalika da'a zakariyya rabbah
versets.francais: C'est là que Zacharie invoqua son Seigneur.
versets.anglais: At that, Zechariah called upon his Lord, saying, "My Lord, grant me from Yourself a good offspring. Indeed, You are the Hearer of supplication

versets.arabe: فَنَادَتْهُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ وَهُوَ قَائِمٌ يُصَلِّي فِي الْمِحْرَابِ
versets.phonetique: Fanadat-hu al-mala'ikatu wa-huwa qa'imun yusalli fil-mihrab
versets.francais: Les anges l'appelèrent alors qu'il était debout en prière dans le sanctuaire.
versets.anglais: So the angels called him while he was standing in prayer in the chamber, "Indeed, Allah gives you good tidings of John, confirming a word from Allah and [who will be] honorable, abstaining [from women], and a prophet from among the righteous

versets.arabe: قَالَ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِي غُلَامٌ وَقَدْ بَلَغَنِيَ الْكِبَرُ
versets.phonetique: Qala rabbi anna yakunu li ghulamun waqad balaghaniya al-kibaru
versets.francais: Il dit: "Seigneur, comment aurais-je un fils alors que la vieillesse m'a atteint?"
versets.anglais: He said, "My Lord, how will I have a boy when I have reached old age and my wife is barren?" The angel said, "Such is Allah; He does what He wills

versets.arabe: قَالَ رَبِّ اجْعَل لِّي آيَةً
versets.phonetique: Qala rabbi ij'al li ayah
versets.francais: Il dit: "Seigneur, donne-moi un signe."
versets.anglais: He said, "My Lord, make for me a sign." He Said, "Your sign is that you will not [be able to] speak to the people for three days except by gesture. And remember your Lord much and exalt [Him with praise] in the evening and the morning

versets.arabe: وَإِذْ قَالَتِ الْمَلَائِكَةُ يَا مَرْيَمُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ اصْطَفَاكِ
versets.phonetique: Wa-idh qalati al-mala'ikatu ya Maryamu inna Allaha astafaki
versets.francais: Et quand les anges dirent: "O Marie! Allah t'a choisie."
versets.anglais: And [mention] when the angels said, "O Mary, indeed Allah has chosen you and purified you and chosen you above the women of the worlds

versets.arabe: يَا مَرْيَمُ اقْنُتِي لِرَبِّكِ وَاسْجُدِي وَارْكَعِي مَعَ الرَّاكِعِينَ
versets.phonetique: Ya Maryamu aqnuti li-rabbiki wasjudi warka'i ma'a ar-raki'in
versets.francais: O Marie! Sois obéissante à ton Seigneur, prosterne-toi et incline-toi avec ceux qui s'inclinent.
versets.anglais: O Mary, be devoutly obedient to your Lord and prostrate and bow with those who bow [in prayer]

versets.arabe: ذَٰلِكَ مِنْ أَنبَاءِ الْغَيْبِ نُوحِيهِ إِلَيْكَ
versets.phonetique: Dhalika min anba'i al-ghaybi nuhihi ilayk
versets.francais: Cela fait partie des nouvelles de l'Invisible que Nous te révélons.
versets.anglais: That is from the news of the unseen which We reveal to you, [O Muhammad]. And you were not with them when they cast their pens as to which of them should be responsible for Mary. Nor were you with them when they disputed

versets.arabe: إِذْ قَالَتِ الْمَلَائِكَةُ يَا مَرْيَمُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُبَشِّرُكِ بِكَلِمَةٍ مِّنْهُ
versets.phonetique: Idh qalati al-mala'ikatu ya Maryamu inna Allaha yubashshiruki bikalimatin minh
versets.francais: Les anges dirent: "O Marie! Allah t'annonce la bonne nouvelle d'un Verbe venant de Lui."
versets.anglais: [And mention] when the angels said, "O Mary, indeed Allah gives you good tidings of a word from Him, whose name will be the Messiah, Jesus, the son of Mary - distinguished in this world and the Hereafter and among those brought near [to Allah]

versets.arabe: وَيُكَلِّمُ النَّاسَ فِي الْمَهْدِ وَكَهْلًا وَمِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa-yukallimun-nasa fil-mahdi wa-kahlan wa-minas-salihin
versets.francais: Il parlera aux gens, au berceau et adulte, et sera parmi les biens.
versets.anglais: He will speak to the people in the cradle and in maturity and will be of the righteous

versets.arabe: قَالَتْ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِي وَلَدٌ وَلَمْ يَمْسَسْنِي بَشَرٌ
versets.phonetique: Qalat rabbi anna yakunu li waladun walam yamsasni basharun
versets.francais: Elle dit: "Seigneur, comment aurais-je un enfant, alors qu'aucun homme ne m'a touchée?"
versets.anglais: She said, "My Lord, how will I have a child when no man has touched me?" [The angel] said, "Such is Allah; He creates what He wills. When He decrees a matter, He only says to it, 'Be,' and it is

versets.arabe: وَيُعَلِّمُهُ الْكِتَابَ وَالْحِكْمَةَ وَالتَّوْرَاةَ وَالْإِنجِيلَ
versets.phonetique: Wa-yu'allimuhu al-kitaba wal-hikmata wat-tawrata wal-injil
versets.francais: Il lui enseignera le Livre, la Sagesse, la Torah et l'Evangile.
versets.anglais: And He will teach him writing and wisdom and the Torah and the Gospel

versets.arabe: وَرَسُولًا إِلَىٰ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ
versets.phonetique: Wa-rasulan ila bani isra'il
versets.francais: Et en envoyé aux fils d'Israël.
versets.anglais: And [make him] a messenger to the Children of Israel, [who will say], 'Indeed I have come to you with a sign from your Lord in that I design for you from clay [that which is] like the form of a bird, then I breathe into it and it becomes a bird by permission of Allah. And I cure the blind and the leper, and I give life to the dead - by permission of Allah. And I inform you of what you eat and what you store in your houses. Indeed in that is a sign for you, if you are believers

versets.arabe: وَمُصَدِّقًا لِمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيَّ مِنَ التَّوْرَاةِ
versets.phonetique: Wa-musaddiqan lima bayna yadayya minat-tawrah
versets.francais: Et confirmant ce qu'il y avait avant moi de la Torah.
versets.anglais: And [I have come] confirming what was before me of the Torah and to make lawful for you some of what was forbidden to you. And I have come to you with a sign from your Lord, so fear Allah and obey me

versets.arabe: إِنَّ اللَّهَ رَبِّي وَرَبُّكُمْ فَاعْبُدُوهُ
versets.phonetique: Inna Allaha rabbi wa-rabbukum fa'buduhu
versets.francais: Allah est mon Seigneur et votre Seigneur; adorez-Le.
versets.anglais: Indeed, Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. That is the straight path

versets.arabe: فَلَمَّا أَحَسَّ عِيسَىٰ مِنْهُمُ الْكُفْرَ قَالَ مَنْ أَنصَارِي إِلَى اللَّهِ
versets.phonetique: Falamma ahassa 'isa minhumu al-kufra qala man ansari ila Allah
versets.francais: Quand Jésus sentit leur mécréance, il dit: "Qui sont mes auxiliaires en Allah?"
versets.anglais: But when Jesus felt [persistence in] disbelief from them, he said, "Who are my supporters for [the cause of] Allah?" The disciples said, "We are supporters for Allah. We have believed in Allah and testify that we are Muslims [submitting to Him]

versets.arabe: رَبَّنَا آمَنَّا بِمَا أَنزَلْتَ وَاتَّبَعْنَا الرَّسُولَ
versets.phonetique: Rabbana amanna bima anzalta wattaba'na ar-rasul
versets.francais: Seigneur! Nous croyons à ce que Tu as révélé et nous suivons le Messager.
versets.anglais: Our Lord, we have believed in what You revealed and have followed the messenger Jesus, so register us among the witnesses [to truth]

versets.arabe: وَمَكَرُوا وَمَكَرَ اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ خَيْرُ الْمَاكِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa-makaru wa-makara Allah wallahu khayrul-makirin
versets.francais: Ils tramèrent une ruse, et Allah tramer aussi. Allah est le meilleur des stratèges.
versets.anglais: And the disbelievers planned, but Allah planned. And Allah is the best of planners

versets.arabe: إِذْ قَالَ اللَّهُ يَا عِيسَىٰ إِنِّي مُتَوَفِّيكَ وَرَافِعُكَ إِلَيَّ
versets.phonetique: Idh qala Allahu ya 'isa inni mutawaffika wa-rafi'uka ilayy
versets.francais: Allah dit: "O Jésus! Je vais te rappeler à Moi, t'élever vers Moi."
versets.anglais: [Mention] when Allah said, "O Jesus, indeed I will take you and raise you to Myself and purify you from those who disbelieve and make those who follow you [in submission to Allah alone] superior to those who disbelieve until the Day of Resurrection. Then to Me is your return, and I will judge between you concerning that in which you used to differ

versets.arabe: فَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا فَأُعَذِّبُهُمْ عَذَابًا شَدِيدًا
versets.phonetique: Fa-amma alladhina kafaru fa-u'adhdhibuhum 'adhaban shadida
versets.francais: Quant à ceux qui ont mécru, Je les châtierai d'un châtiment sévère.
versets.anglais: And as for those who disbelieved, I will punish them with a severe punishment in this world and the Hereafter, and they will have no helpers

versets.arabe: وَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ فَيُوَفِّيهِمْ أُجُورَهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Wa-amma alladhina amanu wa-'amilus-salihati fa-yuwaffihim ujurahum
versets.francais: Quant à ceux qui ont cru et fait de bonnes œuvres, Il leur paiera intégralement leurs récompenses.
versets.anglais: But as for those who believed and did righteous deeds, He will give them in full their rewards, and Allah does not like the wrongdoers

versets.arabe: ذَٰلِكَ نَتْلُوهُ عَلَيْكَ مِنَ الْآيَاتِ وَالذِّكْرِ الْحَكِيمِ
versets.phonetique: Dhalika natluh 'alayka minal-ayati wadh-dhikril-hakim
versets.francais: Voilà ce que Nous te récitons comme versets et Rappel Sage.
versets.anglais: This is what We recite to you, [O Muhammad], of [Our] verses and the precise [and wise] message

versets.arabe: إِنَّ مَثَلَ عِيسَىٰ عِندَ اللَّهِ كَمَثَلِ آدَمَ
versets.phonetique: Inna mathala 'isa 'inda Allahi kamathali adam
versets.francais: La similitude de Jésus pour Allah est comme celle d'Adam.
versets.anglais: Indeed, the example of Jesus to Allah is like that of Adam. He created Him from dust; then He said to him, "Be," and he was

versets.arabe: الْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكَ فَلَا تَكُن مِّنَ الْمُمْتَرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Al-haqqu min rabbika fala takun minal-mumtarin
versets.francais: La vérité vient de ton Seigneur; ne sois donc pas du nombre des douteurs.
versets.anglais: The truth is from your Lord, so do not be among the doubters

versets.arabe: فَمَنْ حَاجَّكَ فِيهِ مِن بَعْدِ مَا جَاءَكَ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ
versets.phonetique: Faman hajjaka fihi min ba'di ma ja'aka minal-'ilm
versets.francais: Si quelqu'un te conteste à ce sujet, après le savoir qui t'est venu, dis...
versets.anglais: Then whoever argues with you about it after [this] knowledge has come to you - say, "Come, let us call our sons and your sons, our women and your women, ourselves and yourselves, then supplicate earnestly [together] and invoke the curse of Allah upon the liars [among us]

versets.arabe: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ الْقَصَصُ الْحَقُّ
versets.phonetique: Inna hadha lahuwa al-qasasul-haqq
versets.francais: Cela est le récit véridique.
versets.anglais: Indeed, this is the true narration. And there is no deity except Allah. And indeed, Allah is the Exalted in Might, the Wise

versets.arabe: فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ بِالْمُفْسِدِينَ
versets.phonetique: Fa-in tawallaw fa-inna Allaha 'alimun bil-mufsidina
versets.francais: S'ils se détournent... Allah connaît bien les corrupteurs.
versets.anglais: But if they turn away, then indeed - Allah is Knowing of the corrupters

versets.arabe: قُلْ يَا أَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ تَعَالَوْا إِلَىٰ كَلِمَةٍ سَوَاءٍ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Qul ya ahla al-kitabi ta'alaw ila kalimatin sawa'in baynana wa-baynakum
versets.francais: Dis: "O gens du Livre! Venez à une parole commune entre nous et vous."
versets.anglais: Say, "O People of the Scripture, come to a word that is equitable between us and you - that we will not worship except Allah and not associate anything with Him and not take one another as lords instead of Allah." But if they turn away, then say, "Bear witness that we are Muslims [submitting to Him]

versets.arabe: يَا أَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ لِمَ تُحَاجُّونَ فِي إِبْرَاهِيمَ
versets.phonetique: Ya ahla al-kitabi lima tuhajjuna fi ibrahim
versets.francais: O gens du Livre! Pourquoi disputez-vous à propos d'Abraham?
versets.anglais: O People of the Scripture, why do you argue about Abraham while the Torah and the Gospel were not revealed until after him? Then will you not reason

versets.arabe: هَا أَنتُمْ هَٰؤُلَاءِ حَاجَجْتُمْ فِيمَا لَكُم بِهِ عِلْمٌ
versets.phonetique: Ha antum ha'ula'i hajjajtum fima lakum bihi 'ilm
versets.francais: Vous voilà: vous avez disputé sur ce dont vous aviez connaissance.
versets.anglais: Here you are - those who have argued about that of which you have [some] knowledge, but why do you argue about that of which you have no knowledge? And Allah knows, while you know not

versets.arabe: مَا كَانَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ يَهُودِيًّا وَلَا نَصْرَانِيًّا
versets.phonetique: Ma kana ibrahimu yahudiyyan wa-la nasraniyyan
versets.francais: Abraham n'était ni juif ni chrétien.
versets.anglais: Abraham was neither a Jew nor a Christian, but he was one inclining toward truth, a Muslim [submitting to Allah]. And he was not of the polytheists

versets.arabe: إِنَّ أَوْلَى النَّاسِ بِإِبْرَاهِيمَ لَلَّذِينَ اتَّبَعُوهُ
versets.phonetique: Inna awlan-nasi bi-ibrahima lalladhina attaba'uh
versets.francais: Certes, les gens les plus proches d'Abraham sont ceux qui l'ont suivi.
versets.anglais: Indeed, the most worthy of Abraham among the people are those who followed him [in submission to Allah] and this prophet, and those who believe [in his message]. And Allah is the ally of the believers

versets.arabe: وَدَّت طَّائِفَةٌ مِّنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ لَوْ يُضِلُّونَكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Waddat ta'ifatun min ahli al-kitabi law yudillunakum
versets.francais: Une partie des gens du Livre aurait voulu vous égarer.
versets.anglais: A faction of the people of the Scripture wish they could mislead you. But they do not mislead except themselves, and they perceive [it] not

versets.arabe: يَا أَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ لِمَ تَكْفُرُونَ بِآيَاتِ اللَّهِ وَأَنتُمْ تَشْهَدُونَ
versets.phonetique: Ya ahla al-kitabi lima takfuruna bi-ayati Allahi wa-antum tashhadun
versets.francais: O gens du Livre! Pourquoi reniez-vous les versets d'Allah alors que vous en êtes témoins?
versets.anglais: O People of the Scripture, why do you disbelieve in the verses of Allah while you witness [to their truth]

versets.arabe: يَا أَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ لِمَ تَلْبِسُونَ الْحَقَّ بِالْبَاطِلِ
versets.phonetique: Ya ahla al-kitabi lima talbisuna al-haqqa bil-batil
versets.francais: O gens du Livre! Pourquoi confondez-vous le vrai et le faux?
versets.anglais: O People of the Scripture, why do you confuse the truth with falsehood and conceal the truth while you know [it]

versets.arabe: وَقَالَت طَّائِفَةٌ مِّنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ آمِنُوا بِالَّذِي أُنزِلَ
versets.phonetique: Wa-qalat ta'ifatun min ahli al-kitabi aminu bil-ladhi unzila
versets.francais: Une partie des gens du Livre dit: "Croyez à ce qui a été révélé..."
versets.anglais: And a faction of the People of the Scripture say [to each other], "Believe in that which was revealed to the believers at the beginning of the day and reject it at its end that perhaps they will abandon their religion

versets.arabe: وَلَا تُؤْمِنُوا إِلَّا لِمَن تَبِعَ دِينَكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Wa-la tu'minu illa liman tabi'a dinakum
versets.francais: Et ne croyez qu'à ceux qui suivent votre religion.
versets.anglais: And do not trust except those who follow your religion." Say, "Indeed, the [true] guidance is the guidance of Allah. [Do you fear] lest someone be given [knowledge] like you were given or that they would [thereby] argue with you before your Lord?" Say, "Indeed, [all] bounty is in the hand of Allah - He grants it to whom He wills. And Allah is all-Encompassing and Wise

versets.arabe: يَخْتَصُّ بِرَحْمَتِهِ مَن يَشَاءُ وَاللَّهُ ذُو الْفَضْلِ الْعَظِيمِ
versets.phonetique: Yakhtassu birahmatih man yasha'u wallahu dhul-fadlil-'azim
versets.francais: Il accorde Sa miséricorde à qui Il veut. Allah est le Détenteur de la grâce immense.
versets.anglais: He selects for His mercy whom He wills. And Allah is the possessor of great bounty

versets.arabe: وَمِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ مَنْ إِن تَأْمَنْهُ بِقِنطَارٍ يُؤَدِّهِ إِلَيْكَ
versets.phonetique: Wa-min ahli al-kitabi man in ta'manhu biqintarin yu'addihi ilayk
versets.francais: Parmi les gens du Livre, il en est à qui si tu confies un qintar, il te le rend.
versets.anglais: And among the People of the Scripture is he who, if you entrust him with a great amount [of wealth], he will return it to you. And among them is he who, if you entrust him with a [single] silver coin, he will not return it to you unless you are constantly standing over him [demanding it]. That is because they say, "There is no blame upon us concerning the unlearned." And they speak untruth about Allah while they know [it]

versets.arabe: بَلَىٰ مَنْ أَوْفَىٰ بِعَهْدِهِ وَاتَّقَىٰ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْمُتَّقِينَ
versets.phonetique: Bala man awfa bi-'ahdihi wattaqa fa-inna Allaha yuhibbul-muttaqin
versets.francais: Mais si, ceux qui respectent leur engagement et craignent Allah, Allah aime les pieux.
versets.anglais: But yes, whoever fulfills his commitment and fears Allah - then indeed, Allah loves those who fear Him

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَشْتَرُونَ بِعَهْدِ اللَّهِ وَأَيْمَانِهِمْ ثَمَنًا قَلِيلًا
versets.phonetique: Inna alladhina yashtaruna bi-'ahdi Allahi wa-aymanihim thamanan qalila
versets.francais: Ceux qui vendent le pacte d'Allah et leurs serments pour un vil prix.
versets.anglais: Indeed, those who exchange the covenant of Allah and their [own] oaths for a small price will have no share in the Hereafter, and Allah will not speak to them or look at them on the Day of Resurrection, nor will He purify them; and they will have a painful punishment

versets.arabe: وَإِنَّ مِنْهُمْ لَفَرِيقًا يَلْوُونَ أَلْسِنَتَهُم بِالْكِتَابِ
versets.phonetique: Wa-inna minhum lafariqan yalwuna alsinatahum bil-kitab
versets.francais: Il y a parmi eux un groupe qui tord sa langue en récitant le Livre.
versets.anglais: And indeed, there is among them a party who alter the Scripture with their tongues so you may think it is from the Scripture, but it is not from the Scripture. And they say, "This is from Allah," but it is not from Allah. And they speak untruth about Allah while they know

versets.arabe: مَا كَانَ لِبَشَرٍ أَن يُؤْتِيَهُ اللَّهُ الْكِتَابَ
versets.phonetique: Ma kana libasharin an yu'tiyahu Allahu al-kitab
versets.francais: Il n'appartient pas à un être humain qu'Allah lui donne le Livre.
versets.anglais: It is not for a human [prophet] that Allah should give him the Scripture and authority and prophethood and then he would say to the people, "Be servants to me rather than Allah," but [instead, he would say], "Be pious scholars of the Lord because of what you have taught of the Scripture and because of what you have studied

versets.arabe: وَلَا يَأْمُرَكُمْ أَن تَتَّخِذُوا الْمَلَائِكَةَ وَالنَّبِيِّينَ أَرْبَابًا
versets.phonetique: Wa-la ya'murakum an tattakhidhu al-mala'ikata wan-nabiyyina arbaban
versets.francais: Et il ne vous ordonnerait pas de prendre les anges et les prophètes pour seigneurs.
versets.anglais: Nor could he order you to take the angels and prophets as lords. Would he order you to disbelief after you had been Muslims

versets.arabe: وَإِذْ أَخَذَ اللَّهُ مِيثَاقَ النَّبِيِّينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa-idh akhadha Allahu mithaqa an-nabiyyin
versets.francais: Et quand Allah prit l'engagement des prophètes.
versets.anglais: And [recall, O People of the Scripture], when Allah took the covenant of the prophets, [saying], "Whatever I give you of the Scripture and wisdom and then there comes to you a messenger confirming what is with you, you [must] believe in him and support him." [Allah] said, "Have you acknowledged and taken upon that My commitment?" They said, "We have acknowledged it." He said, "Then bear witness, and I am with you among the witnesses

versets.arabe: فَمَن تَوَلَّىٰ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُولَٰئِكَ هُمُ الْفَاسِقُونَ
versets.phonetique: Faman tawalla ba'da dhalika fa-ula'ika humul-fasiqun
versets.francais: Et quiconque se détourne après cela, ceux-là sont les pervers.
versets.anglais: And whoever turned away after that - they were the defiantly disobedient

versets.arabe: أَفَغَيْرَ دِينِ اللَّهِ يَبْغُونَ
versets.phonetique: Afaghayra dini Allahi yabghun
versets.francais: Cherchent-ils donc autre chose que la religion d'Allah?
versets.anglais: So is it other than the religion of Allah they desire, while to Him have submitted [all] those within the heavens and earth, willingly or by compulsion, and to Him they will be returned

versets.arabe: قُلْ آمَنَّا بِاللَّهِ وَمَا أُنزِلَ عَلَيْنَا
versets.phonetique: Qul amanna billahi wa-ma unzila 'alayna
versets.francais: Dis: "Nous croyons en Allah et en ce qui nous a été révélé."
versets.anglais: Say, "We have believed in Allah and in what was revealed to us and what was revealed to Abraham, Ishmael, Isaac, Jacob, and the Descendants, and in what was given to Moses and Jesus and to the prophets from their Lord. We make no distinction between any of them, and we are Muslims [submitting] to Him

versets.arabe: وَمَن يَبْتَغِ غَيْرَ الْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا فَلَن يُقْبَلَ مِنْهُ
versets.phonetique: Wa-man yabtaghi ghayral-islami dinan falan yuqbala minh
versets.francais: Quiconque désire une autre religion que l'Islam, cela ne lui sera pas accepté.
versets.anglais: And whoever desires other than Islam as religion - never will it be accepted from him, and he, in the Hereafter, will be among the losers

versets.arabe: كَيْفَ يَهْدِي اللَّهُ قَوْمًا كَفَرُوا بَعْدَ إِيمَانِهِمْ
versets.phonetique: Kayfa yahdil-lahu qawman kafaru ba'da imanihim
versets.francais: Comment Allah guiderait-Il des gens qui ont mécru après avoir cru?
versets.anglais: How shall Allah guide a people who disbelieved after their belief and had witnessed that the Messenger is true and clear signs had come to them? And Allah does not guide the wrongdoing people

versets.arabe: أُولَٰئِكَ جَزَاؤُهُمْ أَنَّ عَلَيْهِمْ لَعْنَةَ اللَّهِ
versets.phonetique: Ula'ika jaza'uhum anna 'alayhim la'nata Allah
versets.francais: Ceux-là, leur rétribution est que sur eux repose la malédiction d'Allah.
versets.anglais: Those - their recompense will be that upon them is the curse of Allah and the angels and the people, all together

versets.arabe: خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا لَا يُخَفَّفُ عَنْهُمُ الْعَذَابُ
versets.phonetique: Khalidina fiha la yukhaffafu 'anhumul-'adhab
versets.francais: Ils y demeureront éternellement. Le châtiment ne leur sera pas allégé.
versets.anglais: Abiding eternally therein. The punishment will not be lightened for them, nor will they be reprieved

versets.arabe: إِلَّا الَّذِينَ تَابُوا مِن بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ وَأَصْلَحُوا
versets.phonetique: Illa alladhina tabu min ba'di dhalika wa-aslachu
versets.francais: Sauf ceux qui se repentent après cela et se réforment.
versets.anglais: Except for those who repent after that and correct themselves. For indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا بَعْدَ إِيمَانِهِمْ ثُمَّ ازْدَادُوا كُفْرًا
versets.phonetique: Inna alladhina kafaru ba'da imanihim thumma izdadu kufran
versets.francais: Ceux qui mécroient après avoir cru et augmentent encore en mécréance.
versets.anglais: Indeed, those who reject the message after their belief and then increase in disbelief - never will their [claimed] repentance be accepted, and they are the ones astray

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَمَاتُوا وَهُمْ كُفَّارٌ
versets.phonetique: Inna alladhina kafaru wa-matu wa-hum kuffarun
versets.francais: Ceux qui ont mécru et sont morts mécréants.
versets.anglais: Indeed, those who disbelieve and die while they are disbelievers - never would the [whole] capacity of the earth in gold be accepted from one of them if he would [seek to] ransom himself with it. For those there will be a painful punishment, and they will have no helpers

versets.arabe: لَن تَنَالُوا الْبِرَّ حَتَّىٰ تُنفِقُوا مِمَّا تُحِبُّونَ
versets.phonetique: Lan tanalu al-birra hatta tunfiqu mimma tuhibbun
versets.francais: Vous n'atteindrez la piété vraie que si vous dépensez de ce que vous aimez.
versets.anglais: Never will you attain the good [reward] until you spend [in the way of Allah] from that which you love. And whatever you spend - indeed, Allah is Knowing of it

versets.arabe: كُلُّ الطَّعَامِ كَانَ حِلًّا لِبَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ
versets.phonetique: Kullu at-ta'ami kana hillan li-bani isra'il
versets.francais: Toute nourriture était licite aux fils d'Israël.
versets.anglais: All food was lawful to the Children of Israel except what Israel had made unlawful to himself before the Torah was revealed. Say, [O Muhammad], "So bring the Torah and recite it, if you should be truthful

versets.arabe: فَمَنِ افْتَرَىٰ عَلَى اللَّهِ الْكَذِبَ مِن بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ
versets.phonetique: Faman iftara 'ala Allahi al-kadhiba min ba'di dhalik
versets.francais: Quiconque invente ensuite un mensonge contre Allah, ceux-là sont les injustes.
versets.anglais: And whoever invents about Allah untruth after that - then those are [truly] the wrongdoers

versets.arabe: قُلْ صَدَقَ اللَّهُ فَاتَّبِعُوا مِلَّةَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَنِيفًا
versets.phonetique: Qul sadaqa Allahu fattabi'u millata ibrahima hanifa
versets.francais: Dis: "Allah a dit vrai! Suivez donc la religion d'Abraham le Monothéiste."
versets.anglais: Say, "Allah has told the truth. So follow the religion of Abraham, inclining toward truth; and he was not of the polytheists

versets.arabe: إِنَّ أَوَّلَ بَيْتٍ وُضِعَ لِلنَّاسِ لَلَّذِي بِبَكَّةَ مُبَارَكًا
versets.phonetique: Inna awwala baytin wudi'a lin-nasi lallhadhi bi-bakkata mubarakan
versets.francais: La première Maison fondée pour les gens est bien celle de Bakka, bénie.
versets.anglais: Indeed, the first House [of worship] established for mankind was that at Makkah - blessed and a guidance for the worlds

versets.arabe: فِيهِ آيَاتٌ بَيِّنَاتٌ مَّقَامُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ
versets.phonetique: Fihi ayatun bayyinatun maqamu ibrahim
versets.francais: Il s'y trouve des signes évidents: la station d'Abraham.
versets.anglais: In it are clear signs [such as] the standing place of Abraham. And whoever enters it shall be safe. And [due] to Allah from the people is a pilgrimage to the House - for whoever is able to find thereto a way. But whoever disbelieves - then indeed, Allah is free from need of the worlds

versets.arabe: قُلْ يَا أَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ لِمَ تَكْفُرُونَ بِآيَاتِ اللَّهِ
versets.phonetique: Qul ya ahla al-kitabi lima takfuruna bi-ayati Allah
versets.francais: Dis: "O gens du Livre! Pourquoi reniez-vous les versets d'Allah?"
versets.anglais: Say, "O People of the Scripture, why do you disbelieve in the verses of Allah while Allah is Witness over what you do

versets.arabe: قُلْ يَا أَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ لِمَ تَصُدُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ
versets.phonetique: Qul ya ahla al-kitabi lima tasudduna 'an sabili Allah
versets.francais: Dis: "O gens du Livre! Pourquoi détournez-vous de la voie d'Allah?"
versets.anglais: Say, "O People of the Scripture, why do you avert from the way of Allah those who believe, seeking to make it [seem] deviant, while you are witnesses [to the truth]? And Allah is not unaware of what you do

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِن تُطِيعُوا فَرِيقًا مِّنَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْكِتَابَ
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuha alladhina amanu in tuti'u fariqan minalladhina utu al-kitab
versets.francais: O croyants! Si vous obéissez à certains de ceux qui ont reçu le Livre, ils vous ramèneront à la mécréance.
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, if you obey a party of those who were given the Scripture, they would turn you back, after your belief, [to being] unbelievers

versets.arabe: وَكَيْفَ تَكْفُرُونَ وَأَنتُمْ تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ آيَاتُ اللَّهِ
versets.phonetique: Wa-kayfa takfuruna wa-antum tutla 'alaykum ayatu Allah
versets.francais: Et comment mécroyez-vous alors que les versets d'Allah vous sont récités?
versets.anglais: And how could you disbelieve while to you are being recited the verses of Allah and among you is His Messenger? And whoever holds firmly to Allah has [indeed] been guided to a straight path

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ حَقَّ تُقَاتِهِ
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuha alladhina amanu ittaqu Allaha haqqa tuqatih
versets.francais: O croyants! Craignez Allah comme Il doit être craint.
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, fear Allah as He should be feared and do not die except as Muslims [in submission to Him]

versets.arabe: وَاعْتَصِمُوا بِحَبْلِ اللَّهِ جَمِيعًا وَلَا تَفَرَّقُوا
versets.phonetique: Wa'tasimuu bihablil-lahi jami'an wa-la tafarraqu
versets.francais: Et cramponnez-vous tous ensemble au câble d'Allah, et ne vous divisez pas.
versets.anglais: And hold firmly to the rope of Allah all together and do not become divided. And remember the favor of Allah upon you - when you were enemies and He brought your hearts together and you became, by His favor, brothers. And you were on the edge of a pit of the Fire, and He saved you from it. Thus does Allah make clear to you His verses that you may be guided

versets.arabe: وَلْتَكُن مِّنكُمْ أُمَّةٌ يَدْعُونَ إِلَى الْخَيْرِ
versets.phonetique: Waltakun minkum ummatun yad'una ilal-khayr
versets.francais: Qu'il y ait parmi vous une communauté qui appelle au bien.
versets.anglais: And let there be [arising] from you a nation inviting to [all that is] good, enjoining what is right and forbidding what is wrong, and those will be the successful

versets.arabe: وَلَا تَكُونُوا كَالَّذِينَ تَفَرَّقُوا وَاخْتَلَفُوا
versets.phonetique: Wa-la takunu kalladhina tafarraqu wakhtalafu
versets.francais: Ne soyez pas comme ceux qui se sont divisés et disputés.
versets.anglais: And do not be like the ones who became divided and differed after the clear proofs had come to them. And those will have a great punishment

versets.arabe: يَوْمَ تَبْيَضُّ وُجُوهٌ وَتَسْوَدُّ وُجُوهٌ
versets.phonetique: Yawma tabyaddu wujuhun wa-taswaddu wujuh
versets.francais: Le Jour où des visages blanchiront et des visages noirciront.
versets.anglais: On the Day [some] faces will turn white and [some] faces will turn black. As for those whose faces turn black, [to them it will be said], "Did you disbelieve after your belief? Then taste the punishment for what you used to reject

versets.arabe: وَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ ابْيَضَّتْ وُجُوهُهُمْ فَفِي رَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ
versets.phonetique: Wa-amma alladhina ibyaddat wujuhuhum fafi rahmatil-lah
versets.francais: Quant à ceux dont les visages auront blanchi, ils seront dans la miséricorde d'Allah.
versets.anglais: But as for those whose faces will turn white, [they will be] within the mercy of Allah. They will abide therein eternally

versets.arabe: تِلْكَ آيَاتُ اللَّهِ نَتْلُوهَا عَلَيْكَ بِالْحَقِّ
versets.phonetique: Tilka ayatu Allahi natluhah 'alayka bil-haqq
versets.francais: Voilà les versets d'Allah que Nous te récitons en toute vérité.
versets.anglais: These are the verses of Allah. We recite them to you, [O Muhammad], in truth; and Allah wants no injustice to the worlds

versets.arabe: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ
versets.phonetique: Wa-lillahi ma fis-samawati wa-ma fil-ard
versets.francais: A Allah appartient ce qui est dans les cieux et sur la terre.
versets.anglais: To Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. And to Allah will [all] matters be returned

versets.arabe: كُنتُمْ خَيْرَ أُمَّةٍ أُخْرِجَتْ لِلنَّاسِ
versets.phonetique: Kuntum khayra ummatin ukhrijat lin-nas
versets.francais: Vous êtes la meilleure communauté qu'on ait fait surgir pour les hommes.
versets.anglais: You are the best nation produced [as an example] for mankind. You enjoin what is right and forbid what is wrong and believe in Allah. If only the People of the Scripture had believed, it would have been better for them. Among them are believers, but most of them are defiantly disobedient

versets.arabe: لَن يَضُرُّوكُمْ إِلَّا أَذًى
versets.phonetique: Lan yadurrukum illa adha
versets.francais: Ils ne pourront vous causer que du tort.
versets.anglais: They will not harm you except for [some] annoyance. And if they fight you, they will show you their backs; then they will not be aided

versets.arabe: ضُرِبَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ الذِّلَّةُ أَيْنَ مَا ثُقِفُوا
versets.phonetique: Duribat 'alayhimudh-dhillatu ayna ma thuqifu
versets.francais: L'avilissement leur a été infligé partout où ils se trouvent.
versets.anglais: They have been put under humiliation [by Allah] wherever they are overtaken, except for a covenant from Allah and a rope from the Muslims. And they have drawn upon themselves anger from Allah and have been put under destitution. That is because they disbelieved in the verses of Allah and killed the prophets without right. That is because they disobeyed and [habitually] transgressed

versets.arabe: لَيْسُوا سَوَاءً مِّنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ أُمَّةٌ قَائِمَةٌ
versets.phonetique: Laysu sawa'an min ahli al-kitabi ummatun qa'imah
versets.francais: Ils ne sont pas tous pareils: parmi les gens du Livre, il est une communauté droite.
versets.anglais: They are not [all] the same; among the People of the Scripture is a community standing [in obedience], reciting the verses of Allah during periods of the night and prostrating [in prayer]

versets.arabe: يُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ وَيَأْمُرُونَ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ
versets.phonetique: Yu'minuna billahi wal-yawmil-akhiri wa-ya'muruna bil-ma'ruf
versets.francais: Ils croient en Allah et au Jour dernier, ordonnent le convenable.
versets.anglais: They believe in Allah and the Last Day, and they enjoin what is right and forbid what is wrong and hasten to good deeds. And those are among the righteous

versets.arabe: وَمَا يَفْعَلُوا مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَلَن يُكْفَرُوهُ
versets.phonetique: Wa-ma yaf'alu min khayrin falan yukfaruh
versets.francais: Et le bien qu'ils font ne sera pas méconnu.
versets.anglais: And whatever good they do - never will it be removed from them. And Allah is Knowing of the righteous

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَن تُغْنِيَ عَنْهُمْ أَمْوَالُهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Inna alladhina kafaru lan tughniya 'anhum amwaluhum
versets.francais: Ceux qui mécroient, leurs biens et leurs enfants ne leur seront d'aucune utilité.
versets.anglais: Indeed, those who disbelieve - never will their wealth or their children avail them against Allah at all, and those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally

versets.arabe: مَثَلُ مَا يُنفِقُونَ فِي هَٰذِهِ الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا
versets.phonetique: Mathalu ma yunfiquna fi hadhihi al-hayatid-dunya
versets.francais: La comparaison de ce qu'ils dépensent dans cette vie présente.
versets.anglais: The example of what they spend in this worldly life is like that of a wind containing frost which strikes the harvest of a people who have wronged themselves and destroys it. And Allah has not wronged them, but they wrong themselves

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تَتَّخِذُوا بِطَانَةً مِّن دُونِكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuha alladhina amanu la tattakhidhu bitanatan min dunikum
versets.francais: O croyants! Ne prenez pas d'intimes en dehors de vous-mêmes.
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, do not take as intimates those other than yourselves, for they will not spare you [any] ruin. They wish you would have hardship. Hatred has already appeared from their mouths, and what their breasts conceal is greater. We have certainly made clear to you the signs, if you will use reason

versets.arabe: هَا أَنتُمْ أُولَاءِ تُحِبُّونَهُمْ وَلَا يُحِبُّونَكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Ha antum ula'i tuhibbunahum wa-la yuhibbunakum
versets.francais: Vous voilà: vous les aimez mais ils ne vous aiment pas.
versets.anglais: Here you are loving them but they are not loving you, while you believe in the Scripture - all of it. And when they meet you, they say, "We believe." But when they are alone, they bite their fingertips at you in rage. Say, "Die in your rage. Indeed, Allah is Knowing of that within the breasts

versets.arabe: إِن تَمْسَسْكُمْ حَسَنَةٌ تَسُؤْهُمْ
versets.phonetique: In tamsakum hasanatun tasu'hum
versets.francais: Si un bonheur vous touche, ils en sont affligés.
versets.anglais: If good touches you, it distresses them; but if harm strikes you, they rejoice at it. And if you are patient and fear Allah, their plot will not harm you at all. Indeed, Allah is encompassing of what they do

versets.arabe: وَإِذْ غَدَوْتَ مِنْ أَهْلِكَ تُبَوِّئُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ مَقَاعِدَ لِلْقِتَالِ
versets.phonetique: Wa-idh ghadawta min ahlika tubabbi'u al-mu'minina maqa'ida lil-qital
versets.francais: Quand tu partis tôt de chez toi pour établir les croyants à leurs postes de combat.
versets.anglais: And [remember] when you, [O Muhammad], left your family in the morning to post the believers at their stations for the battle [of Uhud] - and Allah is Hearing and Knowing

versets.arabe: إِذْ هَمَّت طَّائِفَتَانِ مِنكُمْ أَن تَفْشَلَا
versets.phonetique: Idh hammat ta'ifatani minkum an tafshala
versets.francais: Quand deux groupes parmi vous faillirent fléchir.
versets.anglais: When two parties among you were about to lose courage, but Allah was their ally; and upon Allah the believers should rely

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ نَصَرَكُمُ اللَّهُ بِبَدْرٍ وَأَنتُمْ أَذِلَّةٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa-laqad nasarakumu Allahu bibadrin wa-antum adhilla
versets.francais: Allah vous a certainement secourus à Badr alors que vous étiez faibles.
versets.anglais: And already had Allah given you victory at [the battle of] Badr while you were few in number. Then fear Allah; perhaps you will be grateful

versets.arabe: إِذْ تَقُولُ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ أَلَن يَكْفِيَكُمْ أَن يُمِدَّكُمْ رَبُّكُم
versets.phonetique: Idh taqulu lil-mu'minina alan yakfiyakum an yumiddakum rabbukum
versets.francais: Quand tu disais aux croyants: "Ne vous suffit-il pas que votre Seigneur vous secoure?"
versets.anglais: [Remember] when you said to the believers, "Is it not sufficient for you that your Lord should reinforce you with three thousand angels sent down

versets.arabe: بَلَىٰ إِن تَصْبِرُوا وَتَتَّقُوا وَيَأْتُوكُم مِّن فَوْرِهِمْ هَٰذَا
versets.phonetique: Bala in tasbiru wa-tattaqu wa-ya'tukum min fawrihim hadha
versets.francais: Oui! Si vous êtes patients et pieux et s'ils vous attaquent aussitôt.
