versets.anglais: Yes, if you remain patient and conscious of Allah and the enemy come upon you [attacking] in rage, your Lord will reinforce you with five thousand angels having marks [of distinction]

versets.arabe: وَمَا جَعَلَهُ اللَّهُ إِلَّا بُشْرَىٰ لَكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Wa-ma ja'alahu Allahu illa bushra lakum
versets.francais: Allah n'a fait cela que pour vous annoncer une bonne nouvelle.
versets.anglais: And Allah made it not except as [a sign of] good tidings for you and to reassure your hearts thereby. And victory is not except from Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Wise

versets.arabe: لِيَقْطَعَ طَرَفًا مِّنَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا
versets.phonetique: Liyaqta'a tarafan minal-ladhina kafaru
versets.francais: Pour exterminer un groupe de ceux qui ont mécru.
versets.anglais: That He might cut down a section of the disbelievers or suppress them so that they turn back disappointed

versets.arabe: لَيْسَ لَكَ مِنَ الْأَمْرِ شَيْءٌ أَوْ يَتُوبَ عَلَيْهِمْ
versets.phonetique: Laysa laka minal-amri shay'un aw yatuba 'alayhim
versets.francais: Tu n'as aucun pouvoir en la matière, ou bien Il Se retourne vers eux.
versets.anglais: Not for you, [O Muhammad, but for Allah], is the decision whether He should [cut them down] or forgive them or punish them, for indeed, they are wrongdoers

versets.arabe: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ
versets.phonetique: Wa-lillahi ma fis-samawati wa-ma fil-ard
versets.francais: A Allah appartient ce qui est dans les cieux et sur la terre.
versets.anglais: And to Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. He forgives whom He wills and punishes whom He wills. And Allah is Forgiving and Merciful

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تَأْكُلُوا الرِّبَا أَضْعَافًا مُضَاعَفَةً
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuha alladhina amanu la ta'kulu ar-riba ad'afan muda'afa
versets.francais: O croyants! Ne pratiquez pas l'usure en doublant et redoublant.
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, do not consume usury, doubled and multiplied, but fear Allah that you may be successful

versets.arabe: وَاتَّقُوا النَّارَ الَّتِي أُعِدَّتْ لِلْكَافِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa-ittaqu an-nara allati u'iddat lil-kafirin
versets.francais: Et craignez le feu qui a été préparé pour les mécréants.
versets.anglais: And fear the Fire, which has been prepared for the disbelievers

versets.arabe: وَأَطِيعُوا اللَّهَ وَالرَّسُولَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa-ati'u Allaha war-rasula la'allakum turhamun
versets.francais: Obéissez à Allah et au Messager, afin qu'il vous soit fait miséricorde.
versets.anglais: And obey Allah and the Messenger that you may obtain mercy

versets.arabe: وَسَارِعُوا إِلَىٰ مَغْفِرَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Wa-sari'u ila maghfiratin min rabbikum
versets.francais: Et hâtez-vous vers le pardon de votre Seigneur.
versets.anglais: And hasten to forgiveness from your Lord and a garden as wide as the heavens and earth, prepared for the righteous

versets.arabe: الَّذِينَ يُنفِقُونَ فِي السَّرَّاءِ وَالضَّرَّاءِ
versets.phonetique: Alladhina yunfiquna fis-sarra'i wad-darra'
versets.francais: Ceux qui dépensent dans l'aisance et dans l'adversité.
versets.anglais: Who spend [in the cause of Allah] during ease and hardship and who restrain anger and who pardon the people - and Allah loves the doers of good

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ إِذَا فَعَلُوا فَاحِشَةً أَوْ ظَلَمُوا أَنفُسَهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Walladhina idha fa'alu fahishatan aw zalamu anfusahum
versets.francais: Ceux qui, lorsqu'ils commettent une turpitude ou qu'ils se lèsent eux-mêmes.
versets.anglais: And those who, when they commit an immorality or wrong themselves [by transgression], remember Allah and seek forgiveness for their sins - and who can forgive sins except Allah? - and [who] do not persist in what they have done while they know

versets.arabe: أُولَٰئِكَ جَزَاؤُهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ
versets.phonetique: Ula'ika jaza'uhum maghfiratun min rabbihim
versets.francais: Ceux-là, leur récompense est le pardon de leur Seigneur.
versets.anglais: Those - their reward is forgiveness from their Lord and gardens beneath which rivers flow [in Paradise], wherein they will abide eternally; and excellent is the reward of the [righteous] workers

versets.arabe: قَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلِكُمْ سُنَنٌ فَسِيرُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ
versets.phonetique: Qad khalat min qablikum sunanun fasiru fil-ard
versets.francais: Des manières d'agir ont existé avant vous; parcourez donc la terre.
versets.anglais: Similar situations [as yours] have passed on before you, so proceed throughout the earth and observe how was the end of those who denied

versets.arabe: هَٰذَا بَيَانٌ لِلنَّاسِ وَهُدًى وَمَوْعِظَةٌ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
versets.phonetique: Hadha bayanun lin-nasi wa-hudan wa-maw'izatun lil-muttaqin
versets.francais: Ceci est un exposé pour les hommes, un guide et une exhortation pour les pieux.
versets.anglais: This [Qur'an] is a clear statement to [all] the people and a guidance and instruction for those conscious of Allah

versets.arabe: وَلَا تَهِنُوا وَلَا تَحْزَنُوا وَأَنتُمُ الْأَعْلَوْنَ
versets.phonetique: Wa-la tahinu wa-la tahzanu wa-antumul-a'lawn
versets.francais: Ne fléchissez pas et ne vous affligez pas, alors que vous aurez le dessus.
versets.anglais: So do not weaken and do not grieve, and you will be superior if you are [true] believers

versets.arabe: إِن يَمْسَسْكُمْ قَرْحٌ فَقَدْ مَسَّ الْقَوْمَ قَرْحٌ مِّثْلُهُ
versets.phonetique: In yamsakum qarhun faqad massa al-qawma qarhun mithluh
versets.francais: Si vous avez subi une blessure, pareille blessure a atteint ces gens.
versets.anglais: If a wound should touch you - there has already touched the [opposing] people a wound similar to it. And these days [of varying conditions] We alternate among the people so that Allah may make evident those who believe and [may] take to Himself from among you martyrs - and Allah does not like the wrongdoers

versets.arabe: وَلِيُمَحِّصَ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا
versets.phonetique: Wa-liyumahhisa Allahu alladhina amanu
versets.francais: Et pour qu'Allah purifie les croyants.
versets.anglais: And that Allah may purify the believers [through trials] and destroy the disbelievers

versets.arabe: أَمْ حَسِبْتُمْ أَن تَدْخُلُوا الْجَنَّةَ
versets.phonetique: Am hasibtum an tadkhulu al-janna
versets.francais: Pensiez-vous entrer au Paradis?
versets.anglais: Or do you think that you will enter Paradise while Allah has not yet made evident those of you who fight in His cause and made evident those who are steadfast

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ كُنتُمْ تَمَنَّوْنَ الْمَوْتَ مِن قَبْلِ أَن تَلْقَوْهُ
versets.phonetique: Wa-laqad kuntum tamannawna al-mawta min qabli an talqawh
versets.francais: Et vous souhaitiez la mort avant de la rencontrer.
versets.anglais: And you had certainly wished for martyrdom before you encountered it, and you have [now] seen it [before you] while you were looking on

versets.arabe: وَمَا مُحَمَّدٌ إِلَّا رَسُولٌ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلِهِ الرُّسُلُ
versets.phonetique: Wa-ma muhammadun illa rasulun qad khalat min qablihi ar-rusul
versets.francais: Muhammad n'est qu'un Messager. Des messagers sont passés avant lui.
versets.anglais: Muhammad is not but a messenger. [Other] messengers have passed on before him. So if he was to die or be killed, would you turn back on your heels [to unbelief]? And he who turns back on his heels will never harm Allah at all; but Allah will reward the grateful

versets.arabe: وَمَا كَانَ لِنَفْسٍ أَن تَمُوتَ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ
versets.phonetique: Wa-ma kana linafsin an tamutu illa bi-idhni Allah
versets.francais: Nulle âme ne peut mourir qu'avec la permission d'Allah.
versets.anglais: And it is not [possible] for one to die except by permission of Allah at a decree determined. And whoever desires the reward of this world - We will give him thereof; and whoever desires the reward of the Hereafter - We will give him thereof. And we will reward the grateful

versets.arabe: وَكَأَيِّن مِّن نَّبِيٍّ قَاتَلَ مَعَهُ رِبِّيُّونَ كَثِيرٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa-ka'ayyin min nabiyyin qatala ma'ahu ribbiyyuna kathir
versets.francais: Que de prophètes ont combattu avec de nombreux hommes de Dieu.
versets.anglais: And how many a prophet [fought and] with him fought many religious scholars. But they never lost assurance due to what afflicted them in the cause of Allah, nor did they weaken or submit. And Allah loves the steadfast

versets.arabe: وَمَا كَانَ قَوْلَهُمْ إِلَّا أَن قَالُوا رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا
versets.phonetique: Wa-ma kana qawlahum illa an qalu rabbana ghfir lana
versets.francais: Ils ne dirent rien d'autre que: "Seigneur, pardonne-nous nos péchés."
versets.anglais: And their words were not but that they said, "Our Lord, forgive us our sins and the excess [committed] in our affairs and plant firmly our feet and give us victory over the disbelieving people

versets.arabe: فَآتَاهُمُ اللَّهُ ثَوَابَ الدُّنْيَا وَحُسْنَ ثَوَابِ الْآخِرَةِ
versets.phonetique: Fa-atahumul-lahu thawabad-dunya wa-husna thawabil-akhira
versets.francais: Allah leur donna la récompense de ce bas monde et la belle récompense de l'au-delà.
versets.anglais: So Allah gave them the reward of this world and the good reward of the Hereafter. And Allah loves the doers of good

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِن تُطِيعُوا الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuha alladhina amanu in tuti'u alladhina kafaru
versets.francais: O croyants! Si vous obéissez aux mécréants, ils vous feront retourner sur vos pas.
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, if you obey those who disbelieve, they will turn you back on your heels, and you will [then] become losers

versets.arabe: بَلِ اللَّهُ مَوْلَاكُمْ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ النَّاصِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Bali Allahu mawlakum wa-huwa khayrun-nasirin
versets.francais: Mais Allah est votre Maître et Il est le meilleur des secoureurs.
versets.anglais: But Allah is your protector, and He is the best of helpers

versets.arabe: سَنُلْقِي فِي قُلُوبِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا الرُّعْبَ
versets.phonetique: Sanulqi fi qulubi alladhina kafaru ar-ru'b
versets.francais: Nous allons jeter l'effroi dans les cœurs des mécréants.
versets.anglais: We will cast terror into the hearts of those who disbelieve for what they have associated with Allah of which He had not sent down [any] authority. And their refuge will be the Fire, and wretched is the residence of the wrongdoers

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ صَدَقَكُمُ اللَّهُ وَعْدَهُ إِذْ تَحُسُّونَهُم بِإِذْنِهِ
versets.phonetique: Wa-laqad sadaqakumu Allahu wa'dahu idh tahussuna hum bi-idhnih
versets.francais: Allah a certes tenu Sa promesse envers vous quand, avec Sa permission, vous les abattiez.
versets.anglais: And Allah had certainly fulfilled His promise to you when you were killing the enemy by His permission until [the time] when you lost courage and fell to disputing about the order [given by the Prophet] and disobeyed after He had shown you that which you love. Among you are some who desire this world, and among you are some who desire the Hereafter. Then he turned you back from them [defeated] that He might test you. And He has already forgiven you, and Allah is the possessor of bounty for the believers

versets.arabe: إِذْ تُصْعِدُونَ وَلَا تَلْوُونَ عَلَىٰ أَحَدٍ
versets.phonetique: Idh tus'iduna wa-la talwuna 'ala ahad
versets.francais: Quand vous vous enfuyez sans vous retourner vers personne.
versets.anglais: [Remember] when you [fled and] climbed [the mountain] without looking aside at anyone while the Messenger was calling you from behind. So Allah repaid you with distress upon distress so you would not grieve for that which had escaped you [of victory and spoils of war] or [for] that which had befallen you [of injury and death]. And Allah is [fully] Acquainted with what you do

versets.arabe: ثُمَّ أَنزَلَ عَلَيْكُم مِّن بَعْدِ الْغَمِّ أَمَنَةً نُعَاسًا
versets.phonetique: Thumma anzala 'alaykum min ba'dil-ghami amanatan nu'asan
versets.francais: Ensuite, après l'affliction, Il fit descendre sur vous la sécurité sous forme d'assoupissement.
versets.anglais: Then after distress, He sent down upon you security [in the form of] drowsiness, overcoming a faction of you, while another faction worried about themselves, thinking of Allah other than the truth - the thought of ignorance, saying, "Is there anything for us [to have done] in this matter?" Say, "Indeed, the matter belongs completely to Allah." They conceal within themselves what they will not reveal to you. They say, "If there was anything we could have done in the matter, some of us would not have been killed right here." Say, "Even if you had been inside your houses, those decreed to be killed would have come out to their death beds." [It was] so that Allah might test what is in your breasts and purify what is in your hearts. And Allah is Knowing of that within the breasts

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ تَوَلَّوْا مِنكُمْ يَوْمَ الْتَقَى الْجَمْعَانِ
versets.phonetique: Inna alladhina tawallaw minkum yawma iltaqa al-jam'an
versets.francais: Ceux d'entre vous qui ont fui le jour où les deux troupes se rencontrèrent.
versets.anglais: Indeed, those of you who turned back on the day the two armies met, it was Satan who caused them to slip because of some [blame] they had earned. But Allah has already forgiven them. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Forbearing

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تَكُونُوا كَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuha alladhina amanu la takunu kalladhina kafaru
versets.francais: O croyants! Ne soyez pas comme les mécréants qui disent de leurs frères.
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, do not be like those who disbelieved and said about their brothers when they traveled through the land or went out to fight, "If they had been with us, they would not have died or have been killed," so Allah makes that [misconception] a regret within their hearts. And it is Allah who gives life and causes death, and Allah is Seeing of what you do

versets.arabe: وَلَئِن قُتِلْتُمْ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ أَوْ مُتُّمْ
versets.phonetique: Wa-la'in qutiltum fi sabili Allahi aw muttum
versets.francais: Si vous êtes tués dans le sentier d'Allah ou si vous mourez.
versets.anglais: And if you are killed in the cause of Allah or die - then forgiveness from Allah and mercy are better than whatever they accumulate [in this world]

versets.arabe: وَلَئِن مُّتُّمْ أَوْ قُتِلْتُمْ لَإِلَى اللَّهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa-la'in muttum aw qutiltum la-ila Allahi tuhsharun
versets.francais: Et que vous mouriez ou soyez tués, c'est vers Allah que vous serez rassemblés.
versets.anglais: And whether you die or are killed, unto Allah you will be gathered

versets.arabe: فَبِمَا رَحْمَةٍ مِّنَ اللَّهِ لِنتَ لَهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Fabima rahmatim minalLahi linta lahum
versets.francais: C'est par une miséricorde d'Allah que tu as été si doux envers eux.
versets.anglais: So by mercy from Allah, [O Muhammad], you were lenient with them. And if you had been rude [in speech] and harsh in heart, they would have disbanded from about you. So pardon them and ask forgiveness for them and consult them in the matter. And when you have decided, then rely upon Allah. Indeed, Allah loves those who rely [upon Him]

versets.arabe: إِن يَنصُرْكُمُ اللَّهُ فَلَا غَالِبَ لَكُمْ
versets.phonetique: In yansurukumu Allahu fala ghaliba lakum
versets.francais: Si Allah vous aide, nul ne peut vous vaincre.
versets.anglais: If Allah should aid you, no one can overcome you; but if He should forsake you, who is there that can aid you after Him? And upon Allah let the believers rely

versets.arabe: وَمَا كَانَ لِنَبِيٍّ أَن يَغُلَّ
versets.phonetique: Wa-ma kana linabiyyin an yaghull
versets.francais: Il n'appartient pas à un prophète de détourner des biens.
versets.anglais: It is not [attributable] to any prophet that he would act unfaithfully [in regard to war booty]. And whoever betrays, [taking unlawfully], will come with what he took on the Day of Resurrection. Then will every soul be [fully] compensated for what it earned, and they will not be wronged

versets.arabe: أَفَمَنِ اتَّبَعَ رِضْوَانَ اللَّهِ كَمَن بَاءَ بِسَخَطٍ مِّنَ اللَّهِ
versets.phonetique: Afamani attaba'a ridwana Allahi kaman ba'a bisakhatin minalLah
versets.francais: Celui qui recherche la satisfaction d'Allah est-il comparable à celui qui s'attire la colère d'Allah?
versets.anglais: So is one who pursues the pleasure of Allah like one who brings upon himself the anger of Allah and whose refuge is Hell? And wretched is the destination

versets.arabe: هُمْ دَرَجَاتٌ عِندَ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ بَصِيرٌ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Hum darajatun 'inda Allahi wallahu basirun bima ya'malun
versets.francais: Ils ont des degrés différents auprès d'Allah. Allah voit bien ce qu'ils font.
versets.anglais: They are [varying] degrees in the sight of Allah, and Allah is Seeing of whatever they do

versets.arabe: لَقَدْ مَنَّ اللَّهُ عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ إِذْ بَعَثَ فِيهِمْ رَسُولًا
versets.phonetique: Laqad manna Allahu 'ala al-mu'minina idh ba'atha fihim rasulan
versets.francais: Allah a vraiment accordé Sa grâce aux croyants en leur envoyant un Messager.
versets.anglais: Certainly did Allah confer [great] favor upon the believers when He sent among them a Messenger from themselves, reciting to them His verses and purifying them and teaching them the Book and wisdom, although they had been before in manifest error

versets.arabe: أَوَلَمَّا أَصَابَتْكُم مُّصِيبَةٌ قَدْ أَصَبْتُم مِّثْلَيْهَا
versets.phonetique: Awallamma asabatkum musibatun qad asabtum mithlayha
versets.francais: Quoi? Quand un malheur vous a atteint, vous en aviez pourtant infligé le double.
versets.anglais: Why [is it that] when a [single] disaster struck you [on the day of Uhud], although you had struck [the enemy in the battle of Badr] with one twice as great, you said, "From where is this?" Say, "It is from yourselves." Indeed, Allah is over all things competent

versets.arabe: وَمَا أَصَابَكُمْ يَوْمَ الْتَقَى الْجَمْعَانِ فَبِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ
versets.phonetique: Wa-ma asabakum yawma iltaqa al-jam'ani fabi-idhnillah
versets.francais: Et ce qui vous a atteint le jour de la rencontre des deux armées était par la permission d'Allah.
versets.anglais: And what struck you on the day the two armies met was by permission of Allah that He might make evident the [true] believers

versets.arabe: وَلِيَعْلَمَ الَّذِينَ نَافَقُوا
versets.phonetique: Wa-liya'lama alladhina nafaqu
versets.francais: Et pour qu'Il distingue les hypocrites.
versets.anglais: And that He might make evident those who are hypocrites. For it was said to them, "Come, fight in the way of Allah or [at least] defend." They said, "If we had known [there would be] fighting, we would have followed you." They were nearer to disbelief that day than to faith, saying with their mouths what was not in their hearts. And Allah is most Knowing of what they conceal

versets.arabe: الَّذِينَ قَالُوا لِإِخْوَانِهِمْ وَقَعَدُوا
versets.phonetique: Alladhina qalu li-ikhwanihim wa-qa'adu
versets.francais: Ceux qui ont dit de leurs frères en restant assis.
versets.anglais: Those who said about their brothers while sitting [at home], "If they had obeyed us, they would not have been killed." Say, "Then prevent death from yourselves, if you should be truthful

versets.arabe: وَلَا تَحْسَبَنَّ الَّذِينَ قُتِلُوا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ أَمْوَاتًا
versets.phonetique: Wa-la tahsabanna alladhina qutilu fi sabili Allahi amwata
versets.francais: Ne pense pas que ceux qui ont été tués dans le sentier d'Allah sont morts.
versets.anglais: And never think of those who have been killed in the cause of Allah as dead. Rather, they are alive with their Lord, receiving provision

versets.arabe: فَرِحِينَ بِمَا آتَاهُمُ اللَّهُ مِن فَضْلِهِ
versets.phonetique: Farihin bima atahumu Allahu min fadlih
versets.francais: Heureux de ce qu'Allah leur a accordé de Sa grâce.
versets.anglais: Rejoicing in what Allah has bestowed upon them of His bounty, and they receive good tidings about those [to be martyred] after them who have not yet joined them - that there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve

versets.arabe: يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ بِنِعْمَةٍ مِّنَ اللَّهِ وَفَضْلٍ
versets.phonetique: Yastabshiruna bini'matin minalLahi wa-fadl
versets.francais: Ils se réjouissent d'une grâce d'Allah et d'une faveur.
versets.anglais: They receive good tidings of favor from Allah and bounty and [of the fact] that Allah does not allow the reward of believers to be lost

versets.arabe: الَّذِينَ اسْتَجَابُوا لِلَّهِ وَالرَّسُولِ مِن بَعْدِ مَا أَصَابَهُمُ الْقَرْحُ
versets.phonetique: Alladhina istajablu lillahi war-rasuli min ba'di ma asabahum al-qarh
versets.francais: Ceux qui ont répondu à l'appel d'Allah et du Messager après avoir été blessés.
versets.anglais: Those [believers] who responded to Allah and the Messenger after injury had struck them. For those who did good among them and feared Allah is a great reward

versets.arabe: الَّذِينَ قَالَ لَهُمُ النَّاسُ إِنَّ النَّاسَ قَدْ جَمَعُوا لَكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Alladhina qala lahumu an-nasu inna an-nasa qad jama'u lakum
versets.francais: Ceux à qui des gens ont dit: "Des gens se sont rassemblés contre vous."
versets.anglais: Those to whom hypocrites said, "Indeed, the people have gathered against you, so fear them." But it [merely] increased them in faith, and they said, "Sufficient for us is Allah, and [He is] the best Disposer of affairs

versets.arabe: فَانقَلَبُوا بِنِعْمَةٍ مِّنَ اللَّهِ وَفَضْلٍ لَّمْ يَمْسَسْهُمْ سُوءٌ
versets.phonetique: Fanqalabu bini'matin minalLahi wa-fadlin lam yamsashum su'
versets.francais: Ils revinrent avec la grâce d'Allah et une faveur; aucun mal ne les avait touchés.
versets.anglais: So they returned with favor from Allah and bounty, no harm having touched them. And they pursued the pleasure of Allah, and Allah is the possessor of great bounty

versets.arabe: إِنَّمَا ذَٰلِكُمُ الشَّيْطَانُ يُخَوِّفُ أَوْلِيَاءَهُ
versets.phonetique: Innama dhalikumu ash-shaytanu yukhawwifu awliya'ah
versets.francais: C'est le Diable qui vous fait peur de ses alliés.
versets.anglais: That is only Satan who frightens [you] of his supporters. So fear them not, but fear Me, if you are [indeed] believers

versets.arabe: وَلَا يَحْزُنكَ الَّذِينَ يُسَارِعُونَ فِي الْكُفْرِ
versets.phonetique: Wa-la yahzunka alladhina yusari'una fil-kufr
versets.francais: Que ceux qui se précipitent vers la mécréance ne t'attristent pas.
versets.anglais: And do not be grieved, [O Muhammad], by those who hasten into disbelief. Indeed, they will never harm Allah at all. Allah intends that He should give them no share in the Hereafter, and for them is a great punishment

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ اشْتَرَوُا الْكُفْرَ بِالْإِيمَانِ لَن يَضُرُّوا اللَّهَ شَيْئًا
versets.phonetique: Inna alladhina ishtarawu al-kufra bil-imani lan yadurru Allaha shay'an
versets.francais: Ceux qui ont acheté la mécréance au prix de la foi ne nuiront nullement à Allah.
versets.anglais: Indeed, those who purchase disbelief [in exchange] for faith - never will they harm Allah at all, and for them is a painful punishment

versets.arabe: وَلَا يَحْسَبَنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا أَنَّمَا نُمْلِي لَهُمْ خَيْرٌ لِّأَنفُسِهِمْ
versets.phonetique: Wa-la yahsabanna alladhina kafaru annama numli lahum khayrun li-anfusihim
versets.francais: Que les mécréants ne pensent pas que le délai que Nous leur accordons est un bien pour eux.
versets.anglais: And let not those who disbelieve ever think that [because] We extend their time [of enjoyment] it is better for them. We only extend it for them so that they may increase in sin, and for them is a humiliating punishment

versets.arabe: مَّا كَانَ اللَّهُ لِيَذَرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَىٰ مَا أَنتُمْ عَلَيْهِ
versets.phonetique: Ma kana Allahu liyadhara al-mu'minina 'ala ma antum 'alayh
versets.francais: Allah ne laissera pas les croyants dans l'état où vous êtes, sans distinguer le mauvais du bon.
versets.anglais: Allah would not leave the believers in that [state] you are in [presently] until He separates the evil from the good. Nor would Allah reveal to you the unseen. But [instead], Allah chooses of His messengers whom He wills, so believe in Allah and His messengers. And if you believe and fear Him, then for you is a great reward

versets.arabe: وَلَا يَحْسَبَنَّ الَّذِينَ يَبْخَلُونَ بِمَا آتَاهُمُ اللَّهُ مِن فَضْلِهِ
versets.phonetique: Wa-la yahsabanna alladhina yabkhaluna bima atahumu Allahu min fadlih
versets.francais: Que ceux qui lésinent sur ce qu'Allah leur a accordé de Sa grâce ne pensent pas que c'est un bien pour eux.
versets.anglais: And let not those who [greedily] withhold what Allah has given them of His bounty ever think that it is better for them. Rather, it is worse for them. Their necks will be encircled by what they withheld on the Day of Resurrection. And to Allah belongs the heritage of the heavens and the earth. And Allah, with what you do, is [fully] Acquainted

versets.arabe: لَّقَدْ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ قَوْلَ الَّذِينَ قَالُوا إِنَّ اللَّهَ فَقِيرٌ وَنَحْنُ أَغْنِيَاءُ
versets.phonetique: Laqad sami'a Allahu qawla alladhina qalu inna Allaha faqirun wa-nahnu aghniya'
versets.francais: Allah a certainement entendu ceux qui ont dit: "Allah est pauvre et nous sommes riches."
versets.anglais: Allah has certainly heard the statement of those [Jews] who said, "Indeed, Allah is poor, while we are rich." We will record what they said and their killing of the prophets without right and will say, "Taste the punishment of the Burning Fire

versets.arabe: ذَٰلِكَ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ لَيْسَ بِظَلَّامٍ لِّلْعَبِيدِ
versets.phonetique: Dhalika bima qaddamat aydikum wa-anna Allaha laysa bidhallamin lil-'abid
versets.francais: C'est à cause de ce que vos mains ont accompli. Allah n'est point injuste envers les serviteurs.
versets.anglais: That is for what your hands have put forth and because Allah is not ever unjust to [His] servants

versets.arabe: الَّذِينَ قَالُوا إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَهِدَ إِلَيْنَا أَلَّا نُؤْمِنَ لِرَسُولٍ
versets.phonetique: Alladhina qalu inna Allaha 'ahida ilayna alla nu'mina lirasul
versets.francais: Ceux qui ont dit: "Allah nous a commandé de ne pas croire à un Messager."
versets.anglais: [They are] those who said, "Indeed, Allah has taken our promise not to believe any messenger until he brings us an offering which fire [from heaven] will consume." Say, "There have already come to you messengers before me with clear proofs and [even] that of which you speak. So why did you kill them, if you should be truthful

versets.arabe: فَإِن كَذَّبُوكَ فَقَدْ كُذِّبَ رُسُلٌ مِّن قَبْلِكَ
versets.phonetique: Fa-in kadhdhabuka faqad kudhdhiba rusulun min qablik
versets.francais: S'ils te traitent de menteur, des Messagers avant toi ont été traités de menteurs.
versets.anglais: Then if they deny you, [O Muhammad] - so were messengers denied before you, who brought clear proofs and written ordinances and the enlightening Scripture

versets.arabe: كُلُّ نَفْسٍ ذَائِقَةُ الْمَوْتِ
versets.phonetique: Kullu nafsin dha'iqatul-mawt
versets.francais: Toute âme goûtera la mort.
versets.anglais: Every soul will taste death, and you will only be given your [full] compensation on the Day of Resurrection. So he who is drawn away from the Fire and admitted to Paradise has attained [his desire]. And what is the life of this world except the enjoyment of delusion

versets.arabe: لَتُبْلَوُنَّ فِي أَمْوَالِكُمْ وَأَنفُسِكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Latublawunna fi amwalikum wa-anfusikum
versets.francais: Vous serez certes éprouvés dans vos biens et en vous-mêmes.
versets.anglais: You will surely be tested in your possessions and in yourselves. And you will surely hear from those who were given the Scripture before you and from those who associate others with Allah much abuse. But if you are patient and fear Allah - indeed, that is of the matters [worthy] of determination

versets.arabe: وَإِذْ أَخَذَ اللَّهُ مِيثَاقَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْكِتَابَ
versets.phonetique: Wa-idh akhadha Allahu mithaqa alladhina utu al-kitab
versets.francais: Quand Allah prit l'engagement de ceux à qui le Livre fut donné.
versets.anglais: And [mention, O Muhammad], when Allah took a covenant from those who were given the Scripture, [saying], "You must make it clear to the people and not conceal it." But they threw it away behind their backs and exchanged it for a small price. And wretched is that which they purchased

versets.arabe: لَا تَحْسَبَنَّ الَّذِينَ يَفْرَحُونَ بِمَا أَتَوا
versets.phonetique: La tahsabanna alladhina yafrahuna bima ataw
versets.francais: Ne pense pas que ceux qui se réjouissent de ce qu'ils ont accompli.
versets.anglais: And never think that those who rejoice in what they have perpetrated and like to be praised for what they did not do - never think them [to be] in safety from the punishment, and for them is a painful punishment

versets.arabe: وَلِلَّهِ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَاللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa-lillahi mulku as-samawati wal-ardi wallahu 'ala kulli shay'in qadir
versets.francais: A Allah appartient le royaume des cieux et de la terre. Allah est Omnipotent.
versets.anglais: And to Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth, and Allah is over all things competent

versets.arabe: إِنَّ فِي خَلْقِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَاخْتِلَافِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ لَآيَاتٍ
versets.phonetique: Inna fi khalqi as-samawati wal-ardi wa-ikhtilafi al-layli wan-nahari la-ayatin
versets.francais: Dans la création des cieux et de la terre et dans l'alternance de la nuit et du jour, il y a des signes.
versets.anglais: Indeed, in the creation of the heavens and the earth and the alternation of the night and the day are signs for those of understanding

versets.arabe: الَّذِينَ يَذْكُرُونَ اللَّهَ قِيَامًا وَقُعُودًا وَعَلَىٰ جُنُوبِهِمْ
versets.phonetique: Alladhina yadhkuruna Allaha qiyaman wa-qu'udan wa-'ala junubihim
versets.francais: Ceux qui invoquent Allah debout, assis et couchés sur leurs côtés.
versets.anglais: Who remember Allah while standing or sitting or [lying] on their sides and give thought to the creation of the heavens and the earth, [saying], "Our Lord, You did not create this aimlessly; exalted are You [above such a thing]; then protect us from the punishment of the Fire

versets.arabe: رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ مَن تُدْخِلِ النَّارَ فَقَدْ أَخْزَيْتَهُ
versets.phonetique: Rabbana innaka man tudkhili an-nara faqad akhzaytah
versets.francais: Seigneur! Celui que Tu feras entrer au Feu, Tu l'auras en vérité humilié.
versets.anglais: Our Lord, indeed whoever You admit to the Fire - You have disgraced him, and for the wrongdoers there are no helpers

versets.arabe: رَّبَّنَا إِنَّنَا سَمِعْنَا مُنَادِيًا يُنَادِي لِلْإِيمَانِ
versets.phonetique: Rabbana innana sami'na munadiyan yunadi lil-iman
versets.francais: Seigneur! Nous avons entendu un appelant qui appelait à la foi.
versets.anglais: Our Lord, indeed we have heard a caller calling to faith, [saying], 'Believe in your Lord,' and we have believed. Our Lord, so forgive us our sins and remove from us our misdeeds and cause us to die with the righteous

versets.arabe: رَبَّنَا وَآتِنَا مَا وَعَدتَّنَا عَلَىٰ رُسُلِكَ
versets.phonetique: Rabbana wa-atina ma wa'adtana 'ala rusulika
versets.francais: Seigneur! Donne-nous ce que Tu nous as promis par Tes messagers.
versets.anglais: Our Lord, and grant us what You promised us through Your messengers and do not disgrace us on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed, You do not fail in [Your] promise

versets.arabe: فَاسْتَجَابَ لَهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ أَنِّي لَا أُضِيعُ عَمَلَ عَامِلٍ مِّنكُم
versets.phonetique: Fastajaba lahum rabbuhum anni la udi'u 'amala 'amlin minkum
versets.francais: Leur Seigneur les exauça: "Je ne laisse pas perdre l'œuvre de celui qui œuvre."
versets.anglais: And their Lord responded to them, "Never will I allow to be lost the work of [any] worker among you, whether male or female; you are of one another. So those who emigrated or were evicted from their homes or were harmed in My cause or fought or were killed - I will surely remove from them their misdeeds, and I will surely admit them to gardens beneath which rivers flow as reward from Allah, and Allah has with Him the best reward

versets.arabe: لَا يَغُرَّنَّكَ تَقَلُّبُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا فِي الْبِلَادِ
versets.phonetique: La yagurrannaka taqallubu alladhina kafaru fil-bilad
versets.francais: Que ne t'abuse pas le va-et-vient des mécréants à travers le pays.
versets.anglais: Be not deceived by the [uninhibited] movement of the disbelievers throughout the land

versets.arabe: مَتَاعٌ قَلِيلٌ ثُمَّ مَأْوَاهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ وَبِئْسَ الْمِهَادُ
versets.phonetique: Mata'un qalilun thumma ma'wahum jahannamu wa-bi'sa al-mihad
versets.francais: C'est une jouissance passagère, puis leur refuge sera l'Enfer. Quelle mauvaise couche!
versets.anglais: [It is but] a small enjoyment; then their [final] refuge is Hell, and wretched is the resting place

versets.arabe: لَٰكِنِ الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا رَبَّهُمْ لَهُمْ جَنَّاتٌ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ
versets.phonetique: Lakini alladhina ittaqu rabbahum lahum jannatun tajri min tahtihal-anhar
versets.francais: Mais ceux qui ont craint leur Seigneur auront des jardins sous lesquels coulent les ruisseaux.
versets.anglais: But those who feared their Lord will have gardens beneath which rivers flow, abiding eternally therein, as accommodation from Allah. And that which is with Allah is best for the righteous

versets.arabe: وَإِنَّ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ لَمَن يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ
versets.phonetique: Wa-inna min ahli al-kitabi laman yu'minu billahi
versets.francais: Et parmi les gens du Livre, il en est qui croient en Allah.
versets.anglais: And indeed, among the People of the Scripture are those who believe in Allah and what was revealed to you and what was revealed to them, [being] humbly submissive to Allah. They do not exchange the verses of Allah for a small price. Those will have their reward with their Lord. Indeed, Allah is swift in account

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اصْبِرُوا وَصَابِرُوا وَرَابِطُوا وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuha alladhina amanu asbiru wa-sabiru wa-rabitu wa-ittaqu Allah
versets.francais: O croyants! Endurez, surpassez en endurance, soyez sur vos gardes et craignez Allah.
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, persevere and endure and remain stationed and fear Allah that you may be successful

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اتَّقُوا رَبَّكُمُ الَّذِي خَلَقَكُم مِّن نَّفْسٍ وَاحِدَةٍ وَخَلَقَ مِنْهَا زَوْجَهَا
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuha alnnasu ittaqoo rabbakumu allathee khalaqakum min nafsin wahidatin wakhalaqa minha zawjaha
versets.francais: Ô hommes! Craignez votre Seigneur qui vous a créés d'une seule personne, puis Il a créé de celle-ci son épouse.
versets.anglais: O mankind, fear your Lord, who created you from one soul and created from it its mate and dispersed from both of them many men and women. And fear Allah, through whom you ask one another, and the wombs. Indeed Allah is ever, over you, an Observer

versets.arabe: وَآتُوا الْيَتَامَىٰ أَمْوَالَهُمْ وَلَا تَتَبَدَّلُوا الْخَبِيثَ بِالطَّيِّبِ وَلَا تَأْكُلُوا أَمْوَالَهُمْ إِلَىٰ أَمْوَالِكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Waatoo alyatama amwalahum wala tatabaddaloo alkhabeetha biAlttayyibi wala ta'kuloo amwalahum ila amwalikum
versets.francais: Donnez aux orphelins leurs biens; n'échangez pas le mauvais contre le bon; ne dévorez pas leurs biens en les ajoutant aux vôtres.
versets.anglais: And give to the orphans their properties and do not substitute the defective [of your own] for the good [of theirs]. And do not consume their properties into your own. Indeed, that is ever a great sin

versets.arabe: وَإِنْ خِفْتُمْ أَلَّا تُقْسِطُوا فِي الْيَتَامَىٰ فَانكِحُوا مَا طَابَ لَكُم مِّنَ النِّسَاءِ مَثْنَىٰ وَثُلَاثَ وَرُبَاعَ
versets.phonetique: Wa-in khiftum alla tuqsitoo fee alyatama fankihoo ma taba lakum mina alnnisa'i mathna wathulatha warubaaAAa
versets.francais: Si vous craignez de n'être pas équitables envers les orphelins, épousez alors parmi les femmes celles qui vous plaisent, deux, trois ou quatre.
versets.anglais: And if you fear that you will not deal justly with the orphan girls, then marry those that please you of [other] women, two or three or four. But if you fear that you will not be just, then [marry only] one or those your right hand possesses. That is more suitable that you may not incline [to injustice]

versets.arabe: وَآتُوا النِّسَاءَ صَدُقَاتِهِنَّ نِحْلَةً فَإِن طِبْنَ لَكُمْ عَن شَيْءٍ مِّنْهُ نَفْسًا فَكُلُوهُ هَنِيئًا مَّرِيئًا
versets.phonetique: Waatoo alnnisaa saduqatihinna nihlatan fa-in tibna lakum AAan shay'in minhu nafsan fakuloohu haneean mariyya
versets.francais: Donnez aux femmes leur dot de bon gré. Et si elles vous en abandonnent une partie de bon gré, alors consommez-la utilement et agréablement.
versets.anglais: And give the women [upon marriage] their [bridal] gifts graciously. But if they give up willingly to you anything of it, then take it in satisfaction and ease

versets.arabe: وَلَا تُؤْتُوا السُّفَهَاءَ أَمْوَالَكُمُ الَّتِي جَعَلَ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ قِيَامًا وَارْزُقُوهُمْ فِيهَا وَاكْسُوهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Wala tu'too alssufaha'a amwalakumu allatee jaAAala Allahu lakum qiyaman warzuqoohum feeha waksoohum
versets.francais: Ne confiez pas aux incapables vos biens qu'Allah vous a attribués en soutien. Pourvoyez à leurs besoins et habillez-les à l'aide de ces biens.
versets.anglais: And do not give the weak-minded your property, which Allah has made a means of sustenance for you, but provide for them with it and clothe them and speak to them words of appropriate kindness

versets.arabe: وَابْتَلُوا الْيَتَامَىٰ حَتَّىٰ إِذَا بَلَغُوا النِّكَاحَ فَإِنْ آنَسْتُم مِّنْهُمْ رُشْدًا فَادْفَعُوا إِلَيْهِمْ أَمْوَالَهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Waibtalooa alyatama hatta itha balaghoo alnnikaha fa-in anastum minhum rushdan faidfaAAoo ilayhim amwalahum
versets.francais: Éprouvez les orphelins jusqu'à ce qu'ils atteignent l'âge du mariage. Si vous leur trouvez de la maturité, remettez-leur leurs biens.
versets.anglais: And test the orphans [in their abilities] until they reach marriageable age. Then if you perceive in them sound judgement, release their property to them. And do not consume it excessively and quickly, [anticipating] that they will grow up. And whoever, [when acting as guardian], is self-sufficient should refrain [from taking a fee]; and whoever is poor - let him take according to what is acceptable. Then when you release their property to them, bring witnesses upon them. And sufficient is Allah as Accountant

versets.arabe: لِّلرِّجَالِ نَصِيبٌ مِّمَّا تَرَكَ الْوَالِدَانِ وَالْأَقْرَبُونَ وَلِلنِّسَاءِ نَصِيبٌ مِّمَّا تَرَكَ الْوَالِدَانِ وَالْأَقْرَبُونَ
versets.phonetique: Lilrrijali naseebun mimma taraka alwalidani wal-aqraboona walilnnisa'i naseebun mimma taraka alwalidani wal-aqraboona
versets.francais: Aux hommes revient une part de ce que les parents et les proches ont laissé; et aux femmes une part de ce que les parents et les proches ont laissé.
versets.anglais: For men is a share of what the parents and close relatives leave, and for women is a share of what the parents and close relatives leave, be it little or much - an obligatory share

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا حَضَرَ الْقِسْمَةَ أُولُو الْقُرْبَىٰ وَالْيَتَامَىٰ وَالْمَسَاكِينُ فَارْزُقُوهُم مِّنْهُ
versets.phonetique: Wa-itha hadara alqismata oloo alqurba walyatama walmasakenu farzuqoohum minhu
versets.francais: Et quand des proches, des orphelins et des pauvres sont présents au partage, donnez-leur quelque chose là-dessus.
versets.anglais: And when [other] relatives and orphans and the needy are present at the [time of] division, then provide for them [something] out of the estate and speak to them words of appropriate kindness

versets.arabe: وَلْيَخْشَ الَّذِينَ لَوْ تَرَكُوا مِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ ذُرِّيَّةً ضِعَافًا خَافُوا عَلَيْهِمْ فَلْيَتَّقُوا اللَّهَ
versets.phonetique: Walyakhsha allatheena law tarakoo min khalfihim thurriyyatan diAAafan khafoo AAalayhim falyattaqoo Allah
versets.francais: Que ceux qui, s'ils laissaient derrière eux une progéniture faible, en auraient peur, craignent Allah et disent des paroles justes.
versets.anglais: And let those [executors and guardians] fear [injustice] as if they [themselves] had left weak offspring behind and feared for them. So let them fear Allah and speak words of appropriate justice

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَأْكُلُونَ أَمْوَالَ الْيَتَامَىٰ ظُلْمًا إِنَّمَا يَأْكُلُونَ فِي بُطُونِهِمْ نَارًا وَسَيَصْلَوْنَ سَعِيرًا
versets.phonetique: Inna allatheena ya'kuloona amwala alyatama thulman innama ya'kuloona fee butooonahum naran wasayaslawna saAAeera
versets.francais: Ceux qui consomment injustement les biens des orphelins ne font que manger du feu dans leurs ventres et ils brûleront dans une fournaise ardente.
versets.anglais: Indeed, those who devour the property of orphans unjustly are only consuming into their bellies fire. And they will be burned in a Blaze

versets.arabe: يُوصِيكُمُ اللَّهُ فِي أَوْلَادِكُمْ لِلذَّكَرِ مِثْلُ حَظِّ الْأُنثَيَيْنِ فَإِن كُنَّ نِسَاءً فَوْقَ اثْنَتَيْنِ فَلَهُنَّ ثُلُثَا مَا تَرَكَ
versets.phonetique: Yooseekumu Allahu fee awladikum lilththakari mithlu haththi al-unthayayni fa-in kunna nisa'an fawqa ithnatayni falahunna thuluthaama taraka
versets.francais: Allah vous ordonne, en ce qui concerne vos enfants, de donner au garçon autant qu'à deux filles. S'il n'y a que des filles et qu'elles soient plus de deux, à elles les deux tiers de l'héritage.
versets.anglais: Allah instructs you concerning your children: for the male, what is equal to the share of two females. But if there are [only] daughters, two or more, for them is two thirds of one's estate. And if there is only one, for her is half. And for one's parents, to each one of them is a sixth of his estate if he left children. But if he had no children and the parents [alone] inherit from him, then for his mother is one third. And if he had brothers [or sisters], for his mother is a sixth, after any bequest he [may have] made or debt. Your parents or your children - you know not which of them are nearest to you in benefit. [These shares are] an obligation [imposed] by Allah. Indeed, Allah is ever Knowing and Wise

versets.arabe: وَلَكُمْ نِصْفُ مَا تَرَكَ أَزْوَاجُكُمْ إِن لَّمْ يَكُن لَّهُنَّ وَلَدٌ فَإِن كَانَ لَهُنَّ وَلَدٌ فَلَكُمُ الرُّبُعُ مِمَّا تَرَكْنَ
versets.phonetique: Walakum nisfu ma taraka azwajukum in lam yakun lahunna waladun fa-in kana lahunna waladun falakumu alrrubuAAu mimma tarakna
versets.francais: Vous avez la moitié de ce que vos épouses laissent si elles n'ont pas d'enfant. Si elles ont un enfant, vous avez le quart de ce qu'elles laissent.
versets.anglais: And for you is half of what your wives leave if they have no child. But if they have a child, for you is one fourth of what they leave, after any bequest they [may have] made or debt. And for the wives is one fourth if you leave no child. But if you leave a child, then for them is an eighth of what you leave, after any bequest you [may have] made or debt. And if a man or woman leaves neither ascendants nor descendants but has a brother or a sister, then for each one of them is a sixth. But if they are more than two, they share a third, after any bequest which was made or debt, as long as there is no detriment [caused]. [This is] an ordinance from Allah, and Allah is Knowing and Forbearing

versets.arabe: تِلْكَ حُدُودُ اللَّهِ وَمَن يُطِعِ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ يُدْخِلْهُ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا
versets.phonetique: Tilka hudoodu Allahi waman ytiAAi Allaha warasoolahu yudkhilhu jannatin tajree min tahtiha al-anharu khalideena feeha
versets.francais: Telles sont les limites d'Allah. Quiconque obéit à Allah et à Son messager, Il le fera entrer dans des jardins sous lesquels coulent des ruisseaux.
versets.anglais: These are the limits [set by] Allah, and whoever obeys Allah and His Messenger will be admitted by Him to gardens [in Paradise] under which rivers flow, abiding eternally therein; and that is the great attainment

versets.arabe: وَمَن يَعْصِ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَيَتَعَدَّ حُدُودَهُ يُدْخِلْهُ نَارًا خَالِدًا فِيهَا وَلَهُ عَذَابٌ مُّهِينٌ
versets.phonetique: Waman yaAAsi Allaha warasoolahu wayataAAadda hudoodahu yudkhilhu naran khalidan feeha walahu AAathabun muheen
versets.francais: Et quiconque désobéit à Allah et à Son messager et transgresse Ses limites, Il le fera entrer dans le Feu pour y demeurer éternellement.
versets.anglais: And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger and transgresses His limits - He will put him into the Fire to abide eternally therein, and he will have a humiliating punishment

versets.arabe: وَاللَّاتِي يَأْتِينَ الْفَاحِشَةَ مِن نِّسَائِكُمْ فَاسْتَشْهِدُوا عَلَيْهِنَّ أَرْبَعَةً مِّنكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Wallatee ya'teena alfahishata min nisaaikum faistashhidoo AAalayhinna arbaAAatan minkum
versets.francais: Celles de vos femmes qui commettent une turpitude, faites témoigner contre elles quatre d'entre vous.
versets.anglais: Those who commit unlawful sexual intercourse of your women - bring against them four [witnesses] from among you. And if they testify, confine the guilty women to houses until death takes them or Allah ordains for them [another] way

versets.arabe: وَاللَّذَانِ يَأْتِيَانِهَا مِنكُمْ فَآذُوهُمَا فَإِن تَابَا وَأَصْلَحَا فَأَعْرِضُوا عَنْهُمَا إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ تَوَّابًا رَّحِيمًا
versets.phonetique: Wallathaani ya'tiyaneeha minkum faaathoohumaa fa-in taba waaslaha faaAAridoo AAanhumaa inna Allaha kana tawwaban raheema
versets.francais: Ceux de vous deux qui commettent cela, punissez-les tous deux. S'ils se repentent et s'amendent, laissez-les. Allah est Celui qui accepte le repentir et le Miséricordieux.
versets.anglais: And the two who commit it among you, dishonor them both. But if they repent and correct themselves, leave them alone. Indeed, Allah is ever Accepting of repentance and Merciful

versets.arabe: إِنَّمَا التَّوْبَةُ عَلَى اللَّهِ لِلَّذِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ السُّوءَ بِجَهَالَةٍ ثُمَّ يَتُوبُونَ مِن قَرِيبٍ
versets.phonetique: Innama alttawbatu AAala Allahi lillatheena yaAAmaLoona alssooa bijahAAlatin thumma yatooboona min qareebin
versets.francais: Allah accepte seulement le repentir de ceux qui font le mal par ignorance, puis se repentent promptement.
versets.anglais: The repentance accepted by Allah is only for those who do wrong in ignorance [or carelessness] and then repent soon after. It is those to whom Allah will turn in forgiveness, and Allah is ever Knowing and Wise

versets.arabe: وَلَيْسَتِ التَّوْبَةُ لِلَّذِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ السَّيِّئَاتِ حَتَّىٰ إِذَا حَضَرَ أَحَدَهُمُ الْمَوْتُ قَالَ إِنِّي تُبْتُ الْآنَ
versets.phonetique: Walaysati alttawbatu lillatheena yaAAmalona alssayyi'ati hatta itha hadara ahadahumu almawtu qala innee tubtu al-ana
versets.francais: Le repentir n'est pas accepté de ceux qui font le mal, jusqu'à ce que la mort se présente à l'un d'eux et qu'il dise: "Maintenant je me repens."
versets.anglais: But repentance is not [accepted] of those who [continue to] do evil deeds up until, when death comes to one of them, he says, "Indeed, I have repented now," or of those who die while they are disbelievers. For them We have prepared a painful punishment

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا يَحِلُّ لَكُمْ أَن تَرِثُوا النِّسَاءَ كَرْهًا وَلَا تَعْضُلُوهُنَّ لِتَذْهَبُوا بِبَعْضِ مَا آتَيْتُمُوهُنَّ
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la yahillu lakum an tarithooa alnnisaa karhan wala taAAduloohunna litathhaboo bibaAAdi ma ataytumoohunn
versets.francais: Ô vous qui croyez! Il ne vous est pas permis d'hériter les femmes contre leur gré, ni de les contraindre pour reprendre une partie de ce que vous leur avez donné.
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, it is not lawful for you to inherit women by compulsion. And do not make difficulties for them in order to take [back] part of what you gave them unless they commit a clear immorality. And live with them in kindness. For if you dislike them - perhaps you dislike a thing and Allah makes therein much good

versets.arabe: وَإِنْ أَرَدتُّمُ اسْتِبْدَالَ زَوْجٍ مَّكَانَ زَوْجٍ وَآتَيْتُمْ إِحْدَاهُنَّ قِنطَارًا فَلَا تَأْخُذُوا مِنْهُ شَيْئًا
versets.phonetique: Wa-in aradtumu istibdala zawjin makana zawjin waataytum ihdahunna qintaran fala ta'khuthooa minhu shay'an
versets.francais: Si vous voulez remplacer une épouse par une autre et que vous avez donné à l'une d'elles un quintal, n'en reprenez rien.
versets.anglais: But if you want to replace one wife with another and you have given one of them a great amount [in gifts], do not take [back] from it anything. Would you take it in injustice and manifest sin

versets.arabe: وَكَيْفَ تَأْخُذُونَهُ وَقَدْ أَفْضَىٰ بَعْضُكُمْ إِلَىٰ بَعْضٍ وَأَخَذْنَ مِنكُم مِّيثَاقًا غَلِيظًا
versets.phonetique: Wakayfa ta'khuthoonahu waqad afda baAAdukum ila baAAdin waakhathna minkum meethaqan ghaleethan
versets.francais: Comment le reprendriez-vous alors que vous avez cohabité l'un avec l'autre et qu'elles ont contracté avec vous un pacte solennel?
versets.anglais: And how could you take it while you have gone in unto each other and they have taken from you a solemn covenant

versets.arabe: وَلَا تَنكِحُوا مَا نَكَحَ آبَاؤُكُم مِّنَ النِّسَاءِ إِلَّا مَا قَدْ سَلَفَ إِنَّهُ كَانَ فَاحِشَةً وَمَقْتًا وَسَاءَ سَبِيلًا
versets.phonetique: Wala tankihoo ma nakaha abaokum mina alnnisa'i illa ma qad salafa innahu kana fahishatan wamaqtan wasaa sabeela
versets.francais: N'épousez pas les femmes que vos pères ont épousées, — sauf ce qui est déjà passé — car c'est une turpitude et une abomination.
versets.anglais: And do not marry those [women] whom your fathers married, except what has already occurred. Indeed, it was an immorality and hateful [to Allah] and was evil as a way

versets.arabe: حُرِّمَتْ عَلَيْكُمْ أُمَّهَاتُكُمْ وَبَنَاتُكُمْ وَأَخَوَاتُكُمْ وَعَمَّاتُكُمْ وَخَالَاتُكُمْ وَبَنَاتُ الْأَخِ وَبَنَاتُ الْأُخْتِ
versets.phonetique: Hurrimat AAalaykum ommahatukum wabanatukum wakhawatukum waAAammatukum wakhalaatukum wabanatu al-akhi wabanatu al-ukhti
versets.francais: Vous sont interdites: vos mères, vos filles, vos sœurs, vos tantes paternelles, vos tantes maternelles, les filles de votre frère et les filles de votre sœur.
versets.anglais: Prohibited to you [for marriage] are your mothers, your daughters, your sisters, your father's sisters, your mother's sisters, your brother's daughters, your sister's daughters, your [milk] mothers who nursed you, your sisters through nursing, your wives' mothers, and your step-daughters under your guardianship [born] of your wives unto whom you have gone in. But if you have not gone in unto them, there is no sin upon you. And [also prohibited are] the wives of your sons who are from your [own] loins, and that you take [in marriage] two sisters simultaneously, except for what has already occurred. Indeed, Allah is ever Forgiving and Merciful

versets.arabe: وَالْمُحْصَنَاتُ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ إِلَّا مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُكُمْ كِتَابَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَأُحِلَّ لَكُم مَّا وَرَاءَ ذَٰلِكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Walmuhsanatu mina alnnisa'i illa ma malakat aymanukum kitaba Allahi AAalaykum waohilla lakum ma waraa thalikum
versets.francais: Et les femmes déjà mariées sont aussi interdites, à l'exception de celles que vous possédez. C'est une obligation qu'Allah vous impose. Et il vous est permis, en dehors de tout cela...
versets.anglais: And [also prohibited to you are all] married women except those your right hands possess. [This is] the decree of Allah upon you. And lawful to you are [all others] beyond these, [provided] that you seek them [in marriage] with [gifts from] your property, desiring chastity, not unlawful sexual intercourse. So for whatever you enjoy [of marriage] from them, give them their due compensation as an obligation. And there is no blame upon you for what you mutually agree to beyond the obligation. Indeed, Allah is ever Knowing and Wise

versets.arabe: وَمَن لَّمْ يَسْتَطِعْ مِنكُمْ طَوْلًا أَن يَنكِحَ الْمُحْصَنَاتِ الْمُؤْمِنَاتِ فَمِن مَّا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُكُم مِّن فَتَيَاتِكُمُ الْمُؤْمِنَاتِ
versets.phonetique: Waman lam yastatiAA minkum tawlan an yankiha almuhsanati almu'minati famin ma malakat aymanukum min fatayatikumu almu'minat
versets.francais: Celui d'entre vous qui n'a pas les moyens d'épouser des femmes croyantes libres peut épouser l'une de vos esclaves croyantes.
versets.anglais: And whoever among you cannot [find] the means to marry free, believing women, then [he may marry] from those whom your right hands possess of believing slave girls. And Allah is most knowing about your faith. You [believers] are of one another. So marry them with the permission of their people and give them their due compensation according to what is acceptable. [They should be] chaste, neither [of] those who commit unlawful intercourse randomly nor those who take [secret] lovers. But once they are sheltered in marriage, if they should commit adultery, then for them is half the punishment for free [unmarried] women. This [allowance] is for him among you who fears sin, but to be patient is better for you. And Allah is Forgiving and Merciful

versets.arabe: يُرِيدُ اللَّهُ لِيُبَيِّنَ لَكُمْ وَيَهْدِيَكُمْ سُنَنَ الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِكُمْ وَيَتُوبَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Yureedu Allahu liyubayyina lakum wayahdiyakum sunana allatheena min qablikum wayatooba AAalaykum wallahu AAaleemun hakeem
versets.francais: Allah veut vous expliquer et vous guider vers les voies de ceux qui vous ont précédés et accueillir votre repentir. Allah est Omniscient et Sage.
versets.anglais: Allah wants to make clear to you [the lawful from the unlawful] and guide you to the [good] practices of those before you and to accept your repentance. And Allah is Knowing and Wise

versets.arabe: وَاللَّهُ يُرِيدُ أَن يَتُوبَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَيُرِيدُ الَّذِينَ يَتَّبِعُونَ الشَّهَوَاتِ أَن تَمِيلُوا مَيْلًا عَظِيمًا
versets.phonetique: Wallahu yureedu an yatooба AAalaykum wayureedu allatheena yattabiAAoona alshshahawati an tameeeloo maylan AAatheema
versets.francais: Allah veut accueillir votre repentir, tandis que ceux qui suivent les passions veulent que vous vous détourniez grandement du droit chemin.
versets.anglais: Allah wants to accept your repentance, but those who follow [their] passions want you to digress [into] a great deviation

versets.arabe: يُرِيدُ اللَّهُ أَن يُخَفِّفَ عَنكُمْ وَخُلِقَ الْإِنسَانُ ضَعِيفًا
versets.phonetique: Yureedu Allahu an yukhaffifa AAankum wakhuliqa al-insanu daAAeefa
versets.francais: Allah veut vous alléger votre fardeau, car l'homme a été créé faible.
versets.anglais: And Allah wants to lighten for you [your difficulties]; and mankind was created weak

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تَأْكُلُوا أَمْوَالَكُم بَيْنَكُم بِالْبَاطِلِ إِلَّا أَن تَكُونَ تِجَارَةً عَن تَرَاضٍ مِّنكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la ta'kulooa amwalakum baynakum bialbatili illa an takoona tijaratan AAan taradin minkum
versets.francais: Ô vous qui croyez! Ne mangez pas mutuellement vos biens injustement, à moins que ce soit par un commerce consenti entre vous.
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, do not consume one another's wealth unjustly but only [in lawful] business by mutual consent. And do not kill yourselves [or one another]. Indeed, Allah is to you ever Merciful

versets.arabe: وَمَن يَفْعَلْ ذَٰلِكَ عُدْوَانًا وَظُلْمًا فَسَوْفَ نُصْلِيهِ نَارًا وَكَانَ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى اللَّهِ يَسِيرًا
versets.phonetique: Waman yafAAal thalika AAudwanan wathulman fasawfa nusleehee naran wakana thalika AAala Allahi yaseera
versets.francais: Quiconque fait cela par animosité et injustice, Nous le ferons brûler dans un Feu. Et cela est facile pour Allah.
versets.anglais: And whoever does that in aggression and injustice - then We will drive him into a Fire. And that, for Allah, is [always] easy

versets.arabe: إِن تَجْتَنِبُوا كَبَائِرَ مَا تُنْهَوْنَ عَنْهُ نُكَفِّرْ عَنكُمْ سَيِّئَاتِكُمْ وَنُدْخِلْكُمْ مُّدْخَلًا كَرِيمًا
versets.phonetique: In tajtaniboo kaba'ira ma tunhawna AAanhu nukaffir AAankum sayyi'atikum wanudkhilkum mudkhalan kareema
versets.francais: Si vous évitez les grands péchés qui vous ont été interdits, Nous effacerons vos mauvaises actions et vous ferons entrer dans un lieu honorable.
versets.anglais: If you avoid the major sins which you are forbidden, We will remove from you your lesser sins and admit you to a noble entrance [into Paradise]

versets.arabe: وَلَا تَتَمَنَّوْا مَا فَضَّلَ اللَّهُ بِهِ بَعْضَكُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ لِّلرِّجَالِ نَصِيبٌ مِّمَّا اكْتَسَبُوا وَلِلنِّسَاءِ نَصِيبٌ مِّمَّا اكْتَسَبْنَ
versets.phonetique: Wala tatamannaw ma faddala Allahu bihi baAAdakum AAala baAAdin lilrrijali naseebun mimma iktasaboo walilnnisa'i naseebun mimma iktasabna
versets.francais: Ne convoitez pas ce qu'Allah a accordé à certains d'entre vous plus qu'à d'autres. Aux hommes revient la part de ce qu'ils ont acquis; aux femmes la part de ce qu'elles ont acquis.
versets.anglais: And do not wish for that by which Allah has made some of you exceed others. For men is a share of what they have earned, and for women is a share of what they have earned. And ask Allah of his bounty. Indeed Allah is ever, of all things, Knowing

versets.arabe: وَلِكُلٍّ جَعَلْنَا مَوَالِيَ مِمَّا تَرَكَ الْوَالِدَانِ وَالْأَقْرَبُونَ وَالَّذِينَ عَقَدَتْ أَيْمَانُكُمْ فَآتُوهُمْ نَصِيبَهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Walikullin jaAAalna mawalia mimma taraka alwalidani wal-aqraboona wallatheena AAaqadat aymanukum faatoohum naseebahum
versets.francais: À chacun Nous avons assigné des héritiers de ce que laissent les parents et les proches; et ceux avec qui vous avez fait un pacte, donnez-leur leur part.
versets.anglais: And for all, We have made heirs to what is left by parents and relatives. And to those whom your oaths have bound [to you] - give them their share. Indeed Allah is ever, over all things, a Witness

versets.arabe: الرِّجَالُ قَوَّامُونَ عَلَى النِّسَاءِ بِمَا فَضَّلَ اللَّهُ بَعْضَهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ وَبِمَا أَنفَقُوا مِنْ أَمْوَالِهِمْ
versets.phonetique: Alrrijalu qawwamoona AAala alnnisa'i bima faddala Allahu baAAdahum AAala baAAdin wabima anfaqoo min amwalihim
versets.francais: Les hommes ont autorité sur les femmes, en raison de ce par quoi Allah a favorisé certains sur d'autres et de ce qu'ils dépensent de leurs biens.
versets.anglais: Men are in charge of women by [right of] what Allah has given one over the other and what they spend [for maintenance] from their wealth. So righteous women are devoutly obedient, guarding in [the husband's] absence what Allah would have them guard. But those [wives] from whom you fear arrogance - [first] advise them; [then if they persist], forsake them in bed; and [finally], strike them. But if they obey you [once more], seek no means against them. Indeed, Allah is ever Exalted and Grand

versets.arabe: وَإِنْ خِفْتُمْ شِقَاقَ بَيْنِهِمَا فَابْعَثُوا حَكَمًا مِّنْ أَهْلِهِ وَحَكَمًا مِّنْ أَهْلِهَا إِن يُرِيدَا إِصْلَاحًا يُوَفِّقِ اللَّهُ بَيْنَهُمَا
versets.phonetique: Wa-in khiftum shiqaqa baynihima fabAAathoo hakaman min ahlihi wahakaman min ahliha in yureedaa islaahan yuwaffiq Allahu baynahuma
versets.francais: Si vous craignez le désaccord entre eux deux, envoyez un arbitre de la famille du mari et un arbitre de la famille de la femme. S'ils veulent la réconciliation, Allah rétablira l'entente entre eux.
versets.anglais: And if you fear dissension between the two, send an arbitrator from his people and an arbitrator from her people. If they both desire reconciliation, Allah will cause it between them. Indeed, Allah is ever Knowing and Acquainted [with all things]

versets.arabe: وَاعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ وَلَا تُشْرِكُوا بِهِ شَيْئًا وَبِالْوَالِدَيْنِ إِحْسَانًا وَبِذِي الْقُرْبَىٰ وَالْيَتَامَىٰ وَالْمَسَاكِينِ
versets.phonetique: WaoAAbudoo Allaha wala tushrikoo bihi shay'an wabilwalidayni ihsanan wathee alqurba walyatama walmasakeen
versets.francais: Adorez Allah et ne Lui associez rien. Soyez bons envers père et mère, envers les proches, les orphelins, les pauvres.
versets.anglais: Worship Allah and associate nothing with Him, and to parents do good, and to relatives, orphans, the needy, the near neighbor, the neighbor farther away, the companion at your side, the traveler, and those whom your right hands possess. Indeed, Allah does not like those who are self-deluding and boastful

versets.arabe: الَّذِينَ يَبْخَلُونَ وَيَأْمُرُونَ النَّاسَ بِالْبُخْلِ وَيَكْتُمُونَ مَا آتَاهُمُ اللَّهُ مِن فَضْلِهِ
versets.phonetique: Allatheena yabkhaloona waya'muroona alnnasa bilbukhli wayaktumoona ma ataahumu Allahu min fadlih
versets.francais: Ceux qui se montrent avares, ordonnent aux gens d'être avares et cachent ce qu'Allah leur a accordé de Sa grâce.
versets.anglais: Who are stingy and enjoin upon [other] people stinginess and conceal what Allah has given them of His bounty - and We have prepared for the disbelievers a humiliating punishment

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ يُنفِقُونَ أَمْوَالَهُمْ رِئَاءَ النَّاسِ وَلَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللَّهِ وَلَا بِالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ
versets.phonetique: Wallatheena yunfiqoona amwalahum ri'aa alnnasi wala yu'minoona billahi wala bilyawmi al-akhiri
versets.francais: Et ceux qui dépensent leurs biens pour être vus des gens et ne croient ni en Allah ni au Jour dernier.
versets.anglais: And [also] those who spend of their wealth to be seen by the people and believe not in Allah nor in the Last Day. And he to whom Satan is a companion - then evil is he as a companion

versets.arabe: وَمَاذَا عَلَيْهِمْ لَوْ آمَنُوا بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ وَأَنفَقُوا مِمَّا رَزَقَهُمُ اللَّهُ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ بِهِمْ عَلِيمًا
versets.phonetique: Wamatha AAalayhim law amanoo billahi walyawmi al-akhiri waanfaqoo mimma razaqahumu Allahu wakana Allahu bihim AAaleema
versets.francais: Qu'auraient-ils à perdre s'ils croyaient en Allah et au Jour dernier et dépensaient de ce qu'Allah leur a accordé? Allah les connaît bien.
versets.anglais: And what [harm would come] upon them if they believed in Allah and the Last Day and spent out of what Allah provided for them? And Allah is ever, about them, Knowing

versets.arabe: إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَظْلِمُ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ وَإِن تَكُ حَسَنَةً يُضَاعِفْهَا وَيُؤْتِ مِن لَّدُنْهُ أَجْرًا عَظِيمًا
versets.phonetique: Inna Allaha la yathlimu mithqala tharratin wa-in taku hasanatan yudaAAifha wayuAiti min ladunhu ajran AAatheema
versets.francais: Allah ne lèse personne du poids d'une atome. Et s'il y a une bonne action, Il la double et donne de Sa part une grande récompense.
versets.anglais: Indeed, Allah does not do injustice, [even] as much as an atom's weight; while if there is a good deed, He multiplies it and gives from Himself a great reward

versets.arabe: فَكَيْفَ إِذَا جِئْنَا مِن كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ بِشَهِيدٍ وَجِئْنَا بِكَ عَلَىٰ هَٰؤُلَاءِ شَهِيدًا
versets.phonetique: Fakayfa itha ji'na min kulli ummatin bisha-HeedinN waji'na bika AAala ha'ola'i shaheeda
versets.francais: Qu'en sera-t-il quand Nous amènerons un témoin de chaque communauté et que Nous t'amènerons comme témoin contre ceux-là?
versets.anglais: So how [will it be] when We bring from every nation a witness and we bring you, [O Muhammad] against these [people] as a witness

versets.arabe: يَوْمَئِذٍ يَوَدُّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَعَصَوُا الرَّسُولَ لَوْ تُسَوَّىٰ بِهِمُ الْأَرْضُ وَلَا يَكْتُمُونَ اللَّهَ حَدِيثًا
versets.phonetique: Yawma'ithin yawaddu allatheena kafaroo waAAasaw alrrasoola law tusawwa bihimu al-ardu wala yaktumona Allaha hadeethaa
versets.francais: Ce jour-là, ceux qui avaient mécru et désobéi au messager souhaiteraient que la terre se referme sur eux. Ils ne peuvent rien cacher à Allah.
versets.anglais: That Day, those who disbelieved and disobeyed the Messenger will wish they could be covered by the earth. And they will not conceal from Allah a [single] statement

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تَقْرَبُوا الصَّلَاةَ وَأَنتُمْ سُكَارَىٰ حَتَّىٰ تَعْلَمُوا مَا تَقُولُونَ
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la taqraboo alssalata waantum sukara hatta taAAlamoo ma taqooloon
versets.francais: Ô vous qui croyez! N'approchez pas de la Salat quand vous êtes en état d'ivresse, jusqu'à ce que vous sachiez ce que vous dites.
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, do not approach prayer while you are intoxicated until you know what you are saying or in a state of janabah, except those passing through [a place of prayer], until you have washed [your whole body]. And if you are ill or on a journey or one of you comes from the place of relieving himself or you have contacted women and find no water, then seek clean earth and wipe over your faces and your hands [with it]. Indeed, Allah is ever Pardoning and Forgiving

versets.arabe: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا نَصِيبًا مِّنَ الْكِتَابِ يَشْتَرُونَ الضَّلَالَةَ وَيُرِيدُونَ أَن تَضِلُّوا السَّبِيلَ
versets.phonetique: Alam tara ila allatheena ootoo naseeban mina alkitabi yashtaroona alddalAlata wayureedoona an tadilloo alssabeel
versets.francais: N'as-tu pas vu ceux à qui l'on a donné une part du Livre? Ils achètent l'égarement et veulent que vous vous égareriez du chemin.
versets.anglais: Have you not seen those who were given a portion of the Scripture, purchasing error [in exchange for it] and wishing you would lose the way

versets.arabe: وَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِأَعْدَائِكُمْ وَكَفَىٰ بِاللَّهِ وَلِيًّا وَكَفَىٰ بِاللَّهِ نَصِيرًا
versets.phonetique: Wallahu aAAlamu bi-aAAda'ikum wakafa billahi waliyyan wakafa billahi naseera
versets.francais: Allah connaît mieux vos ennemis. Allah suffit comme allié et Allah suffit comme secoureur.
versets.anglais: And Allah is most knowing of your enemies; and sufficient is Allah as an ally, and sufficient is Allah as a helper

versets.arabe: مِّنَ الَّذِينَ هَادُوا يُحَرِّفُونَ الْكَلِمَ عَن مَّوَاضِعِهِ وَيَقُولُونَ سَمِعْنَا وَعَصَيْنَا
versets.phonetique: Mina allatheena hadoo yuharrifoona alkalima AAan mawadiaAAihi wayaqooloona samiAAna waAAasayna
versets.francais: Parmi les Juifs, il en est qui altèrent les mots de leur place et qui disent: "Nous avons entendu et nous avons désobéi."
versets.anglais: Among the Jews are those who distort words from their [proper] usages and say, "We hear and disobey" and "Hear but be not heard" and "Ra'ina," twisting their tongues and defaming the religion. And if they had said [instead], "We hear and obey" and "Wait for us [to understand]," it would have been better for them and more suitable. But Allah has cursed them for their disbelief, so they believe not, except for a few

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْكِتَابَ آمِنُوا بِمَا نَزَّلْنَا مُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا مَعَكُم مِّن قَبْلِ أَن نَّطْمِسَ وُجُوهًا
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuha allatheena ootoo alkitaba aminoo bima nazzalna musaddiqan lima maAAakum min qabli an natmisa wujoohan
versets.francais: Ô vous qui avez reçu le Livre! Croyez à ce que Nous avons révélé confirmant ce que vous avez déjà, avant que Nous n'effacions des visages.
versets.anglais: O you who were given the Scripture, believe in what We have sent down [to Muhammad], confirming that which is with you, before We obliterate faces and turn them toward their backs or curse them as We cursed the sabbath-breakers. And ever is the decree of Allah accomplished

versets.arabe: إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَغْفِرُ أَن يُشْرَكَ بِهِ وَيَغْفِرُ مَا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَن يَشَاءُ وَمَن يُشْرِكْ بِاللَّهِ فَقَدِ افْتَرَىٰ إِثْمًا عَظِيمًا
versets.phonetique: Inna Allaha la yaghfiru an yushraka bihi wayaghfiru ma doona thalika liman yasha'o waman yushrik billahi faqad iftara ithman AAatheema
versets.francais: Allah ne pardonne pas qu'on Lui associe quelqu'un, mais Il pardonne tout autre péché à qui Il veut. Quiconque associe à Allah a commis un énorme péché.
versets.anglais: Indeed, Allah does not forgive association with Him, but He forgives what is less than that for whom He wills. And he who associates others with Allah has certainly fabricated a tremendous sin

versets.arabe: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى الَّذِينَ يُزَكُّونَ أَنفُسَهُم بَلِ اللَّهُ يُزَكِّي مَن يَشَاءُ وَلَا يُظْلَمُونَ فَتِيلًا
versets.phonetique: Alam tara ila allatheena yuzakkoona anfusahum bali Allahu yuzakkee man yasha'o wala yuthlamoona fateelan
versets.francais: N'as-tu pas vu ceux qui se glorifient eux-mêmes? Mais c'est Allah qui glorifie qui Il veut et ils ne seront pas lésés d'un brin de filasse.
versets.anglais: Have you not seen those who claim themselves to be pure? Rather, Allah purifies whom He wills, and injustice is not done to them, [even] as much as a thread [inside a date seed]

versets.arabe: انظُرْ كَيْفَ يَفْتَرُونَ عَلَى اللَّهِ الْكَذِبَ وَكَفَىٰ بِهِ إِثْمًا مُّبِينًا
versets.phonetique: Onthur kayfa yaftaroona AAala Allahi alkathiba wakafa bihi ithman mubeena
versets.francais: Regarde comme ils inventent le mensonge contre Allah. Cela suffit comme péché évident.
versets.anglais: Look how they invent about Allah untruth, and sufficient is that as a manifest sin

versets.arabe: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا نَصِيبًا مِّنَ الْكِتَابِ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْجِبْتِ وَالطَّاغُوتِ
versets.phonetique: Alam tara ila allatheena ootoo naseeban mina alkitabi yu'minoona biAljibti waalttaAGooti
versets.francais: N'as-tu pas vu ceux à qui l'on a donné une part du Livre? Ils croient au Jibt et au Tagut.
versets.anglais: Have you not seen those who were given a portion of the Scripture, who believe in superstition and false objects of worship and say about the disbelievers, "These are better guided than the believers as to the way

versets.arabe: أُولَٰئِكَ الَّذِينَ لَعَنَهُمُ اللَّهُ وَمَن يَلْعَنِ اللَّهُ فَلَن تَجِدَ لَهُ نَصِيرًا
versets.phonetique: Olaika allatheena laAAanahumu Allahu waman yalAAani Allahu falan tajida lahu naseera
versets.francais: Ceux-là sont ceux qu'Allah a maudits. Et quiconque est maudit d'Allah, tu ne trouveras pas pour lui de secoureur.
versets.anglais: Those are the ones whom Allah has cursed; and he whom Allah curses - never will you find for him a helper

versets.arabe: أَمْ لَهُمْ نَصِيبٌ مِّنَ الْمُلْكِ فَإِذًا لَّا يُؤْتُونَ النَّاسَ نَقِيرًا
versets.phonetique: Am lahum naseebun mina almulki fa'eethan la yu'toona alnnasa naqeera
versets.francais: Ont-ils une part de la royauté? Dans ce cas, ils ne donneraient aux gens pas même l'équivalent d'une creusure de noyau.
versets.anglais: Or have they a share of dominion? Then [if that were so], they would not give the people [even as much as] the speck on a date seed

versets.arabe: أَمْ يَحْسُدُونَ النَّاسَ عَلَىٰ مَا آتَاهُمُ اللَّهُ مِن فَضْلِهِ فَقَدْ آتَيْنَا آلَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْكِتَابَ وَالْحِكْمَةَ
versets.phonetique: Am yahsudoona alnnasa AAala ma ataahumu Allahu min fadlihi faqad atayna ala ibraheema alkitaba waalhikmata
versets.francais: Ou bien envient-ils les gens à cause de ce qu'Allah leur a accordé de Sa grâce? Nous avons donné à la famille d'Abraham le Livre et la Sagesse.
versets.anglais: Or do they envy people for what Allah has given them of His bounty? But we had already given the family of Abraham the Scripture and wisdom and conferred upon them a great kingdom

versets.arabe: فَمِنْهُم مَّنْ آمَنَ بِهِ وَمِنْهُم مَّن صَدَّ عَنْهُ وَكَفَىٰ بِجَهَنَّمَ سَعِيرًا
versets.phonetique: Faminhum man amana bihi waminhum man sadda AAanhu wakafa bijahannama saAAeera
versets.francais: Parmi eux il en est qui ont cru et parmi eux il en est qui s'en sont détournés. L'Enfer, ardent, suffit.
versets.anglais: And some among them believed in it, and some among them were averse to it. And sufficient is Hell as a blaze

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا بِآيَاتِنَا سَوْفَ نُصْلِيهِمْ نَارًا كُلَّمَا نَضِجَتْ جُلُودُهُم بَدَّلْنَاهُمْ جُلُودًا غَيْرَهَا
versets.phonetique: Inna allatheena kafaroo bi-ayatina sawfa nusleehim naran kullama nadijat julooduhum baddalnAhum julodan ghAyraha
versets.francais: Ceux qui ont mécru en Nos signes, Nous les brûlerons dans un Feu. Chaque fois que leur peau sera consumée, Nous leur en substituerons une autre.
versets.anglais: Indeed, those who disbelieve in Our verses - We will drive them into a Fire. Every time their skins are roasted through We will replace them with other skins so they may taste the punishment. Indeed, Allah is ever Exalted in Might and Wise

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ سَنُدْخِلُهُمْ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا أَبَدًا
versets.phonetique: Wallatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati sanudkhiluhum jannatin tajree min tahtiha al-anharu khalideena feeha abadan
versets.francais: Ceux qui ont cru et accompli les bonnes œuvres, Nous les ferons entrer dans des jardins sous lesquels coulent les ruisseaux, pour y demeurer éternellement.
versets.anglais: But those who believe and do righteous deeds - We will admit them to gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein they abide forever. For them therein are purified spouses, and We will admit them to deepening shade

versets.arabe: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَأْمُرُكُمْ أَن تُؤَدُّوا الْأَمَانَاتِ إِلَىٰ أَهْلِهَا وَإِذَا حَكَمْتُم بَيْنَ النَّاسِ أَن تَحْكُمُوا بِالْعَدْلِ
versets.phonetique: Inna Allaha ya'murukum an tua'ddoo al-amanati ila ahliha wa-itha hakamtum bayna alnnasi an tahkumoo biAAadl
versets.francais: Allah vous commande de remettre les dépôts à leurs propriétaires et, quand vous jugez entre les gens, de juger avec équité.
versets.anglais: Indeed, Allah commands you to render trusts to whom they are due and when you judge between people to judge with justice. Excellent is that which Allah instructs you. Indeed, Allah is ever Hearing and Seeing

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا أَطِيعُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُوا الرَّسُولَ وَأُولِي الْأَمْرِ مِنكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo atiAAoo Allaha waatiAAoo alrrasoola waolee al-amri minkum
versets.francais: Ô vous qui croyez! Obéissez à Allah, obéissez au messager et à ceux d'entre vous qui détiennent le commandement.
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, obey Allah and obey the Messenger and those in authority among you. And if you disagree over anything, refer it to Allah and the Messenger, if you should believe in Allah and the Last Day. That is the best [way] and best in result

versets.arabe: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى الَّذِينَ يَزْعُمُونَ أَنَّهُمْ آمَنُوا بِمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ وَمَا أُنزِلَ مِن قَبْلِكَ
versets.phonetique: Alam tara ila allatheena yazAAumoona annahum amanoo bima onzila ilayka wama onzila min qablika
versets.francais: N'as-tu pas vu ceux qui prétendent avoir cru à ce qu'on t'a révélé et à ce qui a été révélé avant toi?
versets.anglais: Have you not seen those who claim to have believed in what was revealed to you, [O Muhammad], and what was revealed before you? They wish to refer legislation to Taghut, while they were commanded to reject it; and Satan wishes to lead them far astray

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَعَالَوْا إِلَىٰ مَا أَنزَلَ اللَّهُ وَإِلَى الرَّسُولِ رَأَيْتَ الْمُنَافِقِينَ يَصُدُّونَ عَنكَ صُدُودًا
versets.phonetique: Wa-itha qeela lahum taAAalaw ila ma anzala Allahu wa-ila alrrasooli raayta almunafiqeena yasuddoona AAanka sudooda
versets.francais: Quand on leur dit: "Venez vers ce qu'Allah a révélé et vers le messager", tu vois les hypocrites se détourner de toi avec aversion.
versets.anglais: And when it is said to them, "Come to what Allah has revealed and to the Messenger," you see the hypocrites turning away from you in aversion

versets.arabe: فَكَيْفَ إِذَا أَصَابَتْهُم مُّصِيبَةٌ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ ثُمَّ جَاءُوكَ يَحْلِفُونَ بِاللَّهِ إِنْ أَرَدْنَا إِلَّا إِحْسَانًا وَتَوْفِيقًا
versets.phonetique: Fakayfa itha asabat-hum museebatun bima qaddamat aydeehim thumma jaooka yahlifoona billahi in aradna illa ihsanan watawfeeqa
versets.francais: Qu'en sera-t-il quand une calamité les touchera pour ce que leurs mains ont accompli? Ils viendront alors à toi en jurant par Allah: "Nous ne voulions que bien faire et concilier."
versets.anglais: So how [will it be] when disaster strikes them because of what their hands have put forth and then they come to you swearing by Allah, "We intended nothing but good conduct and accommodation

versets.arabe: أُولَٰئِكَ الَّذِينَ يَعْلَمُ اللَّهُ مَا فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ فَأَعْرِضْ عَنْهُمْ وَعِظْهُمْ وَقُل لَّهُمْ فِي أَنفُسِهِمْ قَوْلًا بَلِيغًا
versets.phonetique: Olaika allatheena yaAAlamu Allahu ma fee quloobihim faaAArid AAanhum waAAithhum waqul lahum fee anfusihim qawlan baleegha
versets.francais: Ceux-là, Allah sait ce qu'il y a dans leurs cœurs. Donc laisse-les, exhorte-les et parle-leur d'une façon pénétrante.
versets.anglais: Those are the ones of whom Allah knows what is in their hearts, so turn away from them but admonish them and speak to them a far-reaching word

versets.arabe: وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا مِن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا لِيُطَاعَ بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ وَلَوْ أَنَّهُمْ إِذ ظَّلَمُوا أَنفُسَهُمْ جَاءُوكَ
versets.phonetique: Wama arsalna min rasoolin illa liyutaAAa bi-ithni Allahi walaw annahum ith thalamoo anfusahum jaooka
versets.francais: Nous n'avons envoyé de messager que pour qu'on lui obéisse, par la permission d'Allah. S'ils venaient te trouver lorsqu'ils se sont lésés eux-mêmes.
versets.anglais: And We did not send any messenger except to be obeyed by permission of Allah. And if, when they wronged themselves, they had come to you, [O Muhammad], and asked forgiveness of Allah and the Messenger had asked forgiveness for them, they would have found Allah Accepting of repentance and Merciful

versets.arabe: فَلَا وَرَبِّكَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ حَتَّىٰ يُحَكِّمُوكَ فِيمَا شَجَرَ بَيْنَهُمْ ثُمَّ لَا يَجِدُوا فِي أَنفُسِهِمْ حَرَجًا مِّمَّا قَضَيْتَ
versets.phonetique: Fala warabbika la yu'minoona hatta yuhakkimooka feema shajara baynahum thumma la yajidoo fee anfusihim harajan mimma qadayta
versets.francais: Non! Par ton Seigneur! Ils ne croiront que lorsqu'ils t'auront pris comme juge dans leurs litiges, et ne ressentiront aucune gêne de ta décision.
versets.anglais: But no, by your Lord, they will not [truly] believe until they make you, [O Muhammad], judge concerning that over which they dispute among themselves and then find within themselves no discomfort from what you have judged and submit in [full, willing] submission

versets.arabe: وَلَوْ أَنَّا كَتَبْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ أَنِ اقْتُلُوا أَنفُسَكُمْ أَوِ اخْرُجُوا مِن دِيَارِكُم مَّا فَعَلُوهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلٌ مِّنْهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Walaw anna katAbna AAalayhim ani iqtuloo anfusakum awi ukhrujoo min diyarikum ma faAAaloohu illa qaleelun minhum
versets.francais: Si Nous leur avions prescrit: "Tuez-vous ou quittez vos demeures", bien peu d'entre eux l'auraient fait.
versets.anglais: And if We had decreed upon them, "Kill yourselves" or "Leave your homes," they would not have done it, except for a few of them. But if they had done what they were instructed, it would have been better for them and a firmer position [for them in faith]

versets.arabe: وَإِذًا لَّآتَيْنَاهُم مِّن لَّدُنَّا أَجْرًا عَظِيمًا
versets.phonetique: Wa-eethan laataynAhum min ladunna ajran AAatheema
versets.francais: Et dans ce cas, Nous leur aurions accordé de Notre part une immense récompense.
versets.anglais: And then We would have given them from Us a great reward

versets.arabe: وَلَهَدَيْنَاهُمْ صِرَاطًا مُّسْتَقِيمًا
versets.phonetique: Walahadaynathum siratan mustaqeema
versets.francais: Et certes, Nous les aurions guidés vers un droit chemin.
versets.anglais: And We would have guided them to a straight path

versets.arabe: وَمَن يُطِعِ اللَّهَ وَالرَّسُولَ فَأُولَٰئِكَ مَعَ الَّذِينَ أَنْعَمَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ النَّبِيِّينَ وَالصِّدِّيقِينَ وَالشُّهَدَاءِ وَالصَّالِحِينَ
