versets.phonetique: Waman ytuAAi Allaha waalrrasoola faola'ika maAAa allatheena anAAama Allahu AAalayhim mina alnnabiyyeena waAlssiddiqeena waAlshshuhadaa'i waAlssaliheen
versets.francais: Quiconque obéit à Allah et au messager, ceux-là seront avec ceux qu'Allah a comblés de Ses bienfaits: prophètes, véridiques, martyrs et gens de bien.
versets.anglais: And whoever obeys Allah and the Messenger - those will be with the ones upon whom Allah has bestowed favor of the prophets, the steadfast affirmers of truth, the martyrs and the righteous. And excellent are those as companions

versets.arabe: ذَٰلِكَ الْفَضْلُ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَكَفَىٰ بِاللَّهِ عَلِيمًا
versets.phonetique: Thalika alfadlu mina Allahi wakafa billahi AAaleema
versets.francais: C'est là la grâce d'Allah et Allah suffit comme Omniscient.
versets.anglais: That is the bounty from Allah, and sufficient is Allah as Knower

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا خُذُوا حِذْرَكُمْ فَانفِرُوا ثُبَاتٍ أَوِ انفِرُوا جَمِيعًا
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo khuthoo hithrakum fanfiroo thubaatin awi infiroo jameeAAa
versets.francais: Ô vous qui croyez! Prenez vos précautions et élancez-vous en groupes ou élancez-vous tous ensemble.
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, take your precaution and [either] go forth in companies or go forth all together

versets.arabe: وَإِنَّ مِنكُمْ لَمَن لَّيُبَطِّئَنَّ فَإِنْ أَصَابَتْكُم مُّصِيبَةٌ قَالَ قَدْ أَنْعَمَ اللَّهُ عَلَيَّ إِذْ لَمْ أَكُن مَّعَهُمْ شَهِيدًا
versets.phonetique: Wa-inna minkum laman layubattianna fa-in asabatkum museebatun qala qad anAAama Allahu AAalayya ith lam akun maAAahum shaheeda
versets.francais: Il y a parmi vous quelqu'un qui traîne sûrement. Si une calamité vous touche, il dit: "Allah m'a favorisé en n'étant pas avec eux quand cela est arrivé."
versets.anglais: And indeed, there is among you he who lingers behind; and if disaster strikes you, he says, "Allah has favored me in that I was not present with them

versets.arabe: وَلَئِنْ أَصَابَكُمْ فَضْلٌ مِّنَ اللَّهِ لَيَقُولَنَّ كَأَن لَّمْ تَكُن بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَهُ مَوَدَّةٌ يَا لَيْتَنِي كُنتُ مَعَهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Wala'in asabakum fadlun mina Allahi layaqoolanna kaAN lam takun baynakum wabaynahu mawaddatun ya laytanee kuntu maAAahum
versets.francais: Mais si une grâce vous vient d'Allah, il dira comme s'il n'y avait pas d'amour entre vous et lui: "Si seulement j'avais été avec eux."
versets.anglais: But if bounty comes to you from Allah, he will surely say, as if there had never been between you and him any affection. "Oh, I wish I had been with them so I could have attained a great attainment

versets.arabe: فَلْيُقَاتِلْ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ الَّذِينَ يَشْرُونَ الْحَيَاةَ الدُّنْيَا بِالْآخِرَةِ وَمَن يُقَاتِلْ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَيُقْتَلْ أَوْ يَغْلِبْ فَسَوْفَ نُؤْتِيهِ أَجْرًا عَظِيمًا
versets.phonetique: Falyuqatil fee sabeeli Allahi allatheena yashroona alhayata alddunya bil-akhirati waman yuqatil fee sabeeli Allahi fayuqtal aw yaghlib fasawfa nu'teehi ajran AAatheema
versets.francais: Que ceux qui troquent la vie d'ici-bas pour l'au-delà combattent dans le sentier d'Allah. Quiconque combat dans le sentier d'Allah est tué ou sort vainqueur, Nous lui accordons une immense récompense.
versets.anglais: So let those fight in the cause of Allah who sell the life of this world for the Hereafter. And he who fights in the cause of Allah and is killed or achieves victory - We will bestow upon him a great reward

versets.arabe: وَمَا لَكُمْ لَا تُقَاتِلُونَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَالْمُسْتَضْعَفِينَ مِنَ الرِّجَالِ وَالنِّسَاءِ وَالْوِلْدَانِ
versets.phonetique: Wama lakum la tuqatilona fee sabeeli Allahi waalmustadAAafeena mina alrrijali waalnnnisa'i waAlwildan
versets.francais: Qu'avez-vous à ne pas combattre dans le sentier d'Allah, et pour les faibles d'entre les hommes, les femmes et les enfants?
versets.anglais: And what is [the matter] with you that you fight not in the cause of Allah and [for] the oppressed among men, women, and children who say, "Our Lord, take us out of this city of oppressive people and appoint for us from Yourself a protector and appoint for us from Yourself a helper

versets.arabe: الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا يُقَاتِلُونَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا يُقَاتِلُونَ فِي سَبِيلِ الطَّاغُوتِ
versets.phonetique: Allatheena amanoo yuqatilona fee sabeeli Allahi wallatheena kafaroo yuqatilona fee sabeeli alttaghooti
versets.francais: Ceux qui croient combattent dans le sentier d'Allah, et ceux qui mécroient combattent dans le sentier du Tagut.
versets.anglais: Those who believe fight in the cause of Allah, and those who disbelieve fight in the cause of Taghut. So fight against the allies of Satan. Indeed, the plot of Satan has ever been weak

versets.arabe: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى الَّذِينَ قِيلَ لَهُمْ كُفُّوا أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَقِيمُوا الصَّلَاةَ وَآتُوا الزَّكَاةَ
versets.phonetique: Alam tara ila allatheena qeela lahum kuffoo aydiyakum waaqeemoo alssalata waatoo alzzakata
versets.francais: N'as-tu pas vu ceux à qui on disait: "Retenez vos mains, accomplissez la Salat et acquittez la Zakat"?
versets.anglais: Have you not seen those who were told, "Restrain your hands [from fighting] and establish prayer and give zakah"? But then when fighting was ordained for them, at once a party of them feared men as they fear Allah or with [even] greater fear. They said, "Our Lord, why have You decreed upon us fighting? If only You had postponed [it for] us for a short time." Say, The enjoyment of this world is little, and the Hereafter is better for he who fears Allah. And injustice will not be done to you, [even] as much as a thread [inside a date seed]

versets.arabe: أَيْنَمَا تَكُونُوا يُدْرِككُّمُ الْمَوْتُ وَلَوْ كُنتُمْ فِي بُرُوجٍ مُّشَيَّدَةٍ وَإِن تُصِبْهُمْ حَسَنَةٌ يَقُولُوا هَٰذِهِ مِنْ عِندِ اللَّهِ
versets.phonetique: Aynamaa takoonoo yudrik-kumoo almawtu walaw kuntum fee buroomin mushayyadatin wa-in tusibhum hasanatun yaqooloo hathihi min AAindi Allah
versets.francais: Où que vous soyez, la mort vous atteindra, même dans des tours très élevées. Et s'il leur arrive un bien, ils disent: "C'est de la part d'Allah."
versets.anglais: Wherever you may be, death will overtake you, even if you should be within towers of lofty construction. But if good comes to them, they say, "This is from Allah "; and if evil befalls them, they say, "This is from you." Say, "All [things] are from Allah." So what is [the matter] with those people that they can hardly understand any statement

versets.arabe: مَّا أَصَابَكَ مِنْ حَسَنَةٍ فَمِنَ اللَّهِ وَمَا أَصَابَكَ مِن سَيِّئَةٍ فَمِن نَّفْسِكَ
versets.phonetique: Ma asabaka min hasanatin famina Allahi wama asabaka min sayyi'atin famin nafsika
versets.francais: Ce qui t'arrive comme bien vient d'Allah; ce qui t'arrive comme mal vient de toi-même.
versets.anglais: What comes to you of good is from Allah, but what comes to you of evil, [O man], is from yourself. And We have sent you, [O Muhammad], to the people as a messenger, and sufficient is Allah as Witness

versets.arabe: مَّن يُطِعِ الرَّسُولَ فَقَدْ أَطَاعَ اللَّهَ وَمَن تَوَلَّىٰ فَمَا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ عَلَيْهِمْ حَفِيظًا
versets.phonetique: Man ytiAAi alrrasoola faqad ataAAa Allaha waman tawalla fama arsalnaka AAalayhim hafeethaa
versets.francais: Quiconque obéit au messager a certes obéi à Allah; quant à ceux qui se détournent, Nous ne t'avons pas envoyé comme gardien sur eux.
versets.anglais: He who obeys the Messenger has obeyed Allah; but those who turn away - We have not sent you over them as a guardian

versets.arabe: وَيَقُولُونَ طَاعَةٌ فَإِذَا بَرَزُوا مِنْ عِندِكَ بَيَّتَ طَائِفَةٌ مِّنْهُمْ غَيْرَ الَّذِي تَقُولُ
versets.phonetique: Wayaqooloona taAAatun fa-itha barazoo min AAindika bayyata ta'ifatun minhum ghayra allathee taqool
versets.francais: Ils disent: "Obéissance!" Mais quand ils s'éloignent de toi, un groupe d'entre eux décide la nuit d'autre chose que ce qu'ils disent.
versets.anglais: And they say, "[We pledge] obedience." But when they leave you, a group of them spend the night determining to do other than what you say. But Allah records what they plan by night. So leave them alone and rely upon Allah. And sufficient is Allah as Disposer of affairs

versets.arabe: أَفَلَا يَتَدَبَّرُونَ الْقُرْآنَ وَلَوْ كَانَ مِنْ عِندِ غَيْرِ اللَّهِ لَوَجَدُوا فِيهِ اخْتِلَافًا كَثِيرًا
versets.phonetique: Afala yatadabbaroona alqur'ana walaw kana min AAindi ghayri Allahi lawajadoo feehi ikhtilaafan katheera
versets.francais: Ne méditent-ils pas sur le Coran? S'il provenait d'un autre qu'Allah, ils y trouveraient certes de nombreuses contradictions.
versets.anglais: Then do they not reflect upon the Qur'an? If it had been from [any] other than Allah, they would have found within it much contradiction

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا جَاءَهُمْ أَمْرٌ مِّنَ الْأَمْنِ أَوِ الْخَوْفِ أَذَاعُوا بِهِ وَلَوْ رَدُّوهُ إِلَى الرَّسُولِ وَإِلَىٰ أُولِي الْأَمْرِ مِنْهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Wa-itha jaahum amrun mina al-amni awi alkhawfi atha'oo bihi walaw raddoohu ila alrrasooli wa-ila olee al-amri minhum
versets.francais: Quand une information de sécurité ou de crainte leur parvient, ils la divulguent. Si seulement ils la référaient au messager et à ceux qui commandent parmi eux...
versets.anglais: And when there comes to them information about [public] security or fear, they spread it around. But if they had referred it back to the Messenger or to those of authority among them, then the ones who [can] draw correct conclusions from it would have known about it. And if not for the favor of Allah upon you and His mercy, you would have followed Satan, except for a few

versets.arabe: فَقَاتِلْ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ لَا تُكَلَّفُ إِلَّا نَفْسَكَ وَحَرِّضِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Faqatil fee sabeeli Allahi la tukallafu illa nafsaka wahharrid almu'mineen
versets.francais: Bats-toi dans le sentier d'Allah: tu n'es responsable que de toi-même. Et encourage les croyants.
versets.anglais: So fight, [O Muhammad], in the cause of Allah; you are not held responsible except for yourself. And encourage the believers [to join you] that perhaps Allah will restrain the [military] might of those who disbelieve. And Allah is greater in might and stronger in [exemplary] punishment

versets.arabe: مَّن يَشْفَعْ شَفَاعَةً حَسَنَةً يَكُن لَّهُ نَصِيبٌ مِّنْهَا وَمَن يَشْفَعْ شَفَاعَةً سَيِّئَةً يَكُن لَّهُ كِفْلٌ مِّنْهَا
versets.phonetique: Man yashfaAA shafaAAatan hasanatan yakun lahu naseebun minha waman yashfaAA shafaAAatan sayyi'atan yakun lahu kiflun minha
versets.francais: Quiconque intercède d'une bonne intercession en aura une part; et quiconque intercède d'une mauvaise intercession en supportera la charge.
versets.anglais: Whoever intercedes for a good cause will have a reward therefrom; and whoever intercedes for an evil cause will have a burden therefrom. And ever is Allah, over all things, a Keeper

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا حُيِّيتُم بِتَحِيَّةٍ فَحَيُّوا بِأَحْسَنَ مِنْهَا أَوْ رُدُّوهَا إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ حَسِيبًا
versets.phonetique: Wa-itha huyyeetum bitahiyyatin fahayyoo biahsana minha aw ruddooha inna Allaha kana AAala kulli shay'in haseeba
versets.francais: Quand on vous adresse une salutation, répondez par une meilleure ou rendez-la. Allah tient compte de toute chose.
versets.anglais: And when you are greeted with a greeting, greet [in return] with one better than it or [at least] return it [in a like manner]. Indeed, Allah is ever, over all things, an Accountant

versets.arabe: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ لَيَجْمَعَنَّكُمْ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ وَمَنْ أَصْدَقُ مِنَ اللَّهِ حَدِيثًا
versets.phonetique: Allahu la ilaha illa huwa layajmaAAannakum ila yawmi alqiyamati la rayba feehi waman asdaqu mina Allahi hadeethaa
versets.francais: Allah! Pas de divinité à part Lui. Il vous rassemblera certainement au Jour de la Résurrection qui ne fait aucun doute. Qui est plus véridique qu'Allah dans ses paroles?
versets.anglais: Allah - there is no deity except Him. He will surely assemble you for [account on] the Day of Resurrection, about which there is no doubt. And who is more truthful than Allah in statement

versets.arabe: فَمَا لَكُمْ فِي الْمُنَافِقِينَ فِئَتَيْنِ وَاللَّهُ أَرْكَسَهُم بِمَا كَسَبُوا
versets.phonetique: Fama lakum fee almunafiqeena fi'atayni wallahu arkasahum bima kasaboo
versets.francais: Pourquoi êtes-vous en deux groupes à propos des hypocrites? Allah les a retournés pour ce qu'ils ont acquis.
versets.anglais: What is [the matter] with you [that you are] two groups concerning the hypocrites, while Allah has made them fall back [into error and disbelief] for what they earned. Do you wish to guide those whom Allah has sent astray? And he whom Allah sends astray - never will you find for him a way [of guidance]

versets.arabe: وَدُّوا لَوْ تَكْفُرُونَ كَمَا كَفَرُوا فَتَكُونُونَ سَوَاءً فَلَا تَتَّخِذُوا مِنْهُمْ أَوْلِيَاءَ حَتَّىٰ يُهَاجِرُوا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ
versets.phonetique: Waddoo law takfuroona kama kafaroo fatakoonoona sawaan fala tattakhithoo minhum awliya'a hatta yuhaajiroo fee sabeeli Allah
versets.francais: Ils auraient aimé que vous mécrussiez comme ils ont mécru, afin que vous soyez tous pareils. Ne prenez donc pas d'alliés parmi eux jusqu'à ce qu'ils émigrent dans le sentier d'Allah.
versets.anglais: They wish you would disbelieve as they disbelieved so you would be alike. So do not take from among them allies until they emigrate for the cause of Allah. But if they turn away, then seize them and kill them wherever you find them and take not from among them any ally or helper

versets.arabe: إِلَّا الَّذِينَ يَصِلُونَ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَهُم مِّيثَاقٌ أَوْ جَاءُوكُمْ حَصِرَتْ صُدُورُهُمْ أَن يُقَاتِلُوكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Illa allatheena yasiloona ila qawmin baynakum wabaynahum meethaqun aw jaookuM hasirat sudoohrum an yuqatilookum
versets.francais: Sauf ceux qui rejoignent un peuple avec lequel vous avez un pacte, ou qui viennent à vous la poitrine contractée à l'idée de vous combattre.
versets.anglais: Except for those who take refuge with a people between yourselves and whom is a treaty or those who come to you, their hearts strained at [the prospect of] fighting you or fighting their own people. And if Allah had willed, He could have given them power over you, and they would have fought you. So if they remove themselves from you and do not fight you and offer you peace, then Allah has not made for you a cause [for fighting] against them

versets.arabe: سَتَجِدُونَ آخَرِينَ يُرِيدُونَ أَن يَأْمَنُوكُمْ وَيَأْمَنُوا قَوْمَهُمْ كُلَّمَا رُدُّوا إِلَى الْفِتْنَةِ أُرْكِسُوا فِيهَا
versets.phonetique: Satajidoona akhareen yureedoona an ya'manookum waya'manoo qawmahum kullama ruddoo ila alfitnati orkisoo feeha
versets.francais: Vous trouverez d'autres qui veulent être en sécurité vis-à-vis de vous et en sécurité vis-à-vis de leur peuple. Chaque fois qu'ils sont ramenés à la tentation, ils y sont replongés.
versets.anglais: You will find others who wish to obtain security from you and [to] obtain security from their people. Every time they are returned to [the influence of] disbelief, they fall back into it. So if they do not withdraw from you or offer you peace or restrain their hands, then seize them and kill them wherever you overtake them. And those - We have made for you against them a clear authorization

versets.arabe: وَمَا كَانَ لِمُؤْمِنٍ أَن يَقْتُلَ مُؤْمِنًا إِلَّا خَطَأً وَمَن قَتَلَ مُؤْمِنًا خَطَأً فَتَحْرِيرُ رَقَبَةٍ مُّؤْمِنَةٍ
versets.phonetique: Wama kana limu'minin an yaqtula mu'minan illa khata'an waman qatala mu'minan khata'an fatahreeru raqabatin mu'minatin
versets.francais: Il n'appartient pas à un croyant de tuer un autre croyant, sauf par erreur. Quiconque tue un croyant par erreur devra libérer un esclave croyant.
versets.anglais: And never is it for a believer to kill a believer except by mistake. And whoever kills a believer by mistake - then the freeing of a believing slave and a compensation payment presented to the deceased's family [is required] unless they give [up their right as] charity. But if the deceased was from a people at war with you and he was a believer - then [only] the freeing of a believing slave; and if he was from a people with whom you have a treaty - then a compensation payment presented to his family and the freeing of a believing slave. And whoever does not find [one or cannot afford to buy one] - then [instead], a fast for two months consecutively, [seeking] acceptance of repentance from Allah. And Allah is ever Knowing and Wise

versets.arabe: وَمَن يَقْتُلْ مُؤْمِنًا مُّتَعَمِّدًا فَجَزَاؤُهُ جَهَنَّمُ خَالِدًا فِيهَا وَغَضِبَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَلَعَنَهُ
versets.phonetique: Waman yaqtul mu'minan mutaAAammidan fajazaouhu jahannamu khalidan feeha waghadiba Allahu AAalayhi walaAAanahu
versets.francais: Quiconque tue intentionnellement un croyant, sa sanction sera l'Enfer où il demeurera éternellement. Allah sera courroucé contre lui et le maudira.
versets.anglais: But whoever kills a believer intentionally - his recompense is Hell, wherein he will abide eternally, and Allah has become angry with him and has cursed him and has prepared for him a great punishment

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِذَا ضَرَبْتُمْ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَتَبَيَّنُوا وَلَا تَقُولُوا لِمَنْ أَلْقَىٰ إِلَيْكُمُ السَّلَامَ لَسْتَ مُؤْمِنًا
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo itha darabtum fee sabeeli Allahi fatabayyannoo wala taqooloo liman alqa ilaykumu alssalama lasta mu'mina
versets.francais: Ô vous qui croyez! Quand vous vous déplacez dans le sentier d'Allah, soyez bien avisés; ne dites pas à quelqu'un qui vous adresse la paix: "Tu n'es pas croyant."
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, when you go forth [to fight] in the cause of Allah, investigate; and do not say to one who gives you [a greeting of] peace "You are not a believer," aspiring for the goods of worldly life; for with Allah are many acquisitions. You [yourselves] were like that before; then Allah conferred His favor upon you, so investigate. Indeed Allah is ever, with what you do, Acquainted

versets.arabe: لَّا يَسْتَوِي الْقَاعِدُونَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ غَيْرُ أُولِي الضَّرَرِ وَالْمُجَاهِدُونَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ بِأَمْوَالِهِمْ وَأَنفُسِهِمْ
versets.phonetique: La yastawi alqa'idoona mina almu'mineena ghayru olee alddArari walmujahidoona fee sabeeli Allahi bi-amwalihim waanfusihim
versets.francais: Parmi les croyants, ceux qui restent chez eux sans raison valable ne sont pas égaux à ceux qui luttent dans le sentier d'Allah de leurs biens et de leurs personnes.
versets.anglais: Not equal are those believers remaining [at home] - other than the disabled - and the mujahideen, [who strive and fight] in the cause of Allah with their wealth and their lives. Allah has preferred the mujahideen through their wealth and their lives over those who remain [behind], by degrees. And to both Allah has promised the best [reward]. But Allah has preferred the mujahideen over those who remain [behind] with a great reward

versets.arabe: دَرَجَاتٍ مِّنْهُ وَمَغْفِرَةً وَرَحْمَةً وَكَانَ اللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا
versets.phonetique: Darajatin minhu wamaghfiratan warahmatan wakana Allahu ghafoooran raheema
versets.francais: Des degrés venant de Lui, un pardon et une miséricorde. Allah est Pardonneur et Miséricordieux.
versets.anglais: Degrees [of high position] from Him and forgiveness and mercy. And Allah is ever Forgiving and Merciful

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ تَوَفَّاهُمُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ ظَالِمِي أَنفُسِهِمْ قَالُوا فِيمَ كُنتُمْ قَالُوا كُنَّا مُسْتَضْعَفِينَ فِي الْأَرْضِ
versets.phonetique: Inna allatheena tawaffAhumu almala'ikatu thalimee anfusihim qaloo feema kuntum qaloo kunna mustadAAafeena fee al-ardi
versets.francais: Quant à ceux que les anges rappellent alors qu'ils se sont lésés eux-mêmes, ils disent: "En quoi étiez-vous?" Ils répondent: "Nous étions opprimés sur la terre."
versets.anglais: Indeed, those whom the angels take [in death] while wronging themselves - [the angels] will say, "In what [condition] were you?" They will say, "We were oppressed in the land." The angels will say, "Was not the earth of Allah spacious [enough] for you to emigrate therein?" For those, their refuge is Hell - and evil it is as a destination

versets.arabe: إِلَّا الْمُسْتَضْعَفِينَ مِنَ الرِّجَالِ وَالنِّسَاءِ وَالْوِلْدَانِ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ حِيلَةً وَلَا يَهْتَدُونَ سَبِيلًا
versets.phonetique: Illa almustadAAafeena mina alrrijali waAlnnisa'i waAlwildani la yastatiAAoona heelatan wala yahtadoona sabeela
versets.francais: Sauf les vraiment opprimés parmi les hommes, les femmes et les enfants qui n'ont aucun moyen et ne peuvent trouver de chemin.
versets.anglais: Except for the oppressed among men, women and children who cannot devise a plan nor are they directed to a way

versets.arabe: فَأُولَٰئِكَ عَسَى اللَّهُ أَن يَعْفُوَ عَنْهُمْ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ عَفُوًّا غَفُورًا
versets.phonetique: Faola'ika AAasa Allahu an yaAAfooa AAanhum wakana Allahu AAafuwwan ghafoora
versets.francais: Ceux-là, Allah leur accordera peut-être Son pardon. Allah est Indulgent et Pardonneur.
versets.anglais: For those it is expected that Allah will pardon them, and Allah is ever Pardoning and Forgiving

versets.arabe: وَمَن يُهَاجِرْ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ يَجِدْ فِي الْأَرْضِ مُرَاغَمًا كَثِيرًا وَسَعَةً وَمَن يَخْرُجْ مِن بَيْتِهِ مُهَاجِرًا إِلَى اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ
versets.phonetique: Waman yuhajir fee sabeeli Allahi yajid fee al-ardi muraghaman katheeran wasaAAatan waman yakhruj min baytihi muhajiran ila Allahi warasoolih
versets.francais: Quiconque émigre dans le sentier d'Allah trouvera sur la terre maints refuges et abondance. Quiconque quitte sa demeure en émigrant vers Allah et Son messager...
versets.anglais: And whoever emigrates for the cause of Allah will find on the earth many [alternative] locations and abundance. And whoever leaves his home as an emigrant to Allah and His Messenger and then death overtakes him - his reward has already become incumbent upon Allah. And Allah is ever Forgiving and Merciful

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا ضَرَبْتُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ أَن تَقْصُرُوا مِنَ الصَّلَاةِ إِنْ خِفْتُمْ أَن يَفْتِنَكُمُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا
versets.phonetique: Wa-itha darabtum fee al-ardi falaysa AAalaykum junahun an taqsuroo mina alssalati in khiftum an yaftinakumu allatheena kafaroo
versets.francais: Quand vous vous déplacez sur la terre, ce n'est pas un péché de raccourcir la Salat si vous craignez d'être éprouvés par les mécréants.
versets.anglais: And when you travel throughout the land, there is no blame upon you for shortening the prayer, [especially] if you fear that those who disbelieve may disrupt [or attack] you. Indeed, the disbelievers are ever to you a clear enemy

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا كُنتَ فِيهِمْ فَأَقَمْتَ لَهُمُ الصَّلَاةَ فَلْتَقُمْ طَائِفَةٌ مِّنْهُم مَّعَكَ وَلْيَأْخُذُوا أَسْلِحَتَهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Wa-itha kunta feehim faaqamta lahumu alssalata faltaqum ta'ifatun minhum maAAaka walyakhuthoo aslihatahum
versets.francais: Quand tu es parmi eux et que tu diriges la Salat, qu'un groupe d'entre eux se mette debout avec toi en prenant leurs armes.
versets.anglais: And when you are among them and lead them in prayer, let a group of them stand [in prayer] with you and let them carry their arms. And when they have prostrated, let them be [in position] behind you and have the other group come forward which has not [yet] prayed and let them pray with you, taking precaution and carrying their arms. Those who disbelieve wish that you would neglect your weapons and your baggage so they could come down upon you in one [single] attack. But there is no blame upon you, if you are troubled by rain or are ill, for putting down your arms, but take precaution. Indeed, Allah has prepared for the disbelievers a humiliating punishment

versets.arabe: فَإِذَا قَضَيْتُمُ الصَّلَاةَ فَاذْكُرُوا اللَّهَ قِيَامًا وَقُعُودًا وَعَلَىٰ جُنُوبِكُمْ فَإِذَا اطْمَأْنَنتُمْ فَأَقِيمُوا الصَّلَاةَ
versets.phonetique: Fa-itha qadaytumu alssalata faithkuroo Allaha qiyaman waquAAoodan waAAala junoobikum fa-itha itmanaantum faaqeemoo alssalata
versets.francais: Quand vous avez accompli la Salat, évoquez Allah, debout, assis ou couché sur vos côtés. Dès que vous vous sentez en sécurité, accomplissez la Salat.
versets.anglais: And when you have completed the prayer, remember Allah standing, sitting, or [lying] on your sides. But when you become secure, re-establish [regular] prayer. Indeed, prayer has been decreed upon the believers a decree of specified times

versets.arabe: وَلَا تَهِنُوا فِي ابْتِغَاءِ الْقَوْمِ إِن تَكُونُوا تَأْلَمُونَ فَإِنَّهُمْ يَأْلَمُونَ كَمَا تَأْلَمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wala tahinoo fee ibtighaa'i alqawmi in takoonoo ta'lamoon fainnahum ya'lamoona kama ta'lamoona
versets.francais: Ne faiblissez pas dans la poursuite de ces gens. Si vous souffrez, eux aussi souffrent comme vous souffrez.
versets.anglais: And do not weaken in pursuit of the enemy. If you should be suffering - so are they suffering as you are suffering, but you expect from Allah that which they expect not. And Allah is ever Knowing and Wise

versets.arabe: إِنَّا أَنزَلْنَا إِلَيْكَ الْكِتَابَ بِالْحَقِّ لِتَحْكُمَ بَيْنَ النَّاسِ بِمَا أَرَاكَ اللَّهُ
versets.phonetique: Inna anzalna ilayka alkitaba biAlhaqqi litahkuma bayna alnnasi bima araka Allah
versets.francais: Certes, Nous t'avons fait descendre le Livre en toute vérité, pour que tu juges entre les gens selon ce qu'Allah t'a montré.
versets.anglais: Indeed, We have revealed to you, [O Muhammad], the Book in truth so you may judge between the people by that which Allah has shown you. And do not be for the deceitful an advocate

versets.arabe: وَاسْتَغْفِرِ اللَّهَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا
versets.phonetique: Waistaghfiri Allaha inna Allaha kana ghafoooran raheema
versets.francais: Et implore le pardon d'Allah; car Allah est Pardonneur et Miséricordieux.
versets.anglais: And seek forgiveness of Allah. Indeed, Allah is ever Forgiving and Merciful

versets.arabe: وَلَا تُجَادِلْ عَنِ الَّذِينَ يَخْتَانُونَ أَنفُسَهُمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ مَن كَانَ خَوَّانًا أَثِيمًا
versets.phonetique: Wala tujadil AAani allatheena yakhtanoona anfusahum inna Allaha la yuhibbu man kana khawwanan atheema
versets.francais: Ne plaide pas en faveur de ceux qui se trahissent eux-mêmes. Allah n'aime pas le traître et le pécheur.
versets.anglais: And do not argue on behalf of those who deceive themselves. Indeed, Allah loves not one who is a habitually sinful deceiver

versets.arabe: يَسْتَخْفُونَ مِنَ النَّاسِ وَلَا يَسْتَخْفُونَ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَهُوَ مَعَهُمْ إِذْ يُبَيِّتُونَ مَا لَا يَرْضَىٰ مِنَ الْقَوْلِ
versets.phonetique: Yastakhfoona mina alnnasi wala yastakhfoona mina Allahi wahuwa maAAahum ith yubayyitoona ma la yarda mina alqawl
versets.francais: Ils se cachent des gens mais ne se cachent pas d'Allah, alors qu'Il est avec eux quand ils trament la nuit des paroles qui ne Lui agréent pas.
versets.anglais: They conceal [their evil intentions and deeds] from the people, but they cannot conceal [them] from Allah, and He is with them [in His knowledge] when they spend the night in such as He does not accept of speech. And ever is Allah, of what they do, encompassing

versets.arabe: هَا أَنتُمْ هَٰؤُلَاءِ جَادَلْتُمْ عَنْهُمْ فِي الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا فَمَن يُجَادِلُ اللَّهَ عَنْهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ
versets.phonetique: Ha antum haola'i jadaltum AAanhum fee alhayati alddunya faman yujadilu Allaha AAanhum yawma alqiyamati
versets.francais: Vous voilà à avoir plaidé pour eux dans la vie d'ici-bas. Mais qui plaidera pour eux auprès d'Allah le Jour de la Résurrection?
versets.anglais: Here you are - those who argue on their behalf in [this] worldly life - but who will argue with Allah for them on the Day of Resurrection, or who will [then] be their representative

versets.arabe: وَمَن يَعْمَلْ سُوءًا أَوْ يَظْلِمْ نَفْسَهُ ثُمَّ يَسْتَغْفِرِ اللَّهَ يَجِدِ اللَّهَ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا
versets.phonetique: Waman yaAAmal soo'an aw yathLim nafsahu thumma yastaghfiri Allaha yajid Allaha ghafoooran raheema
versets.francais: Quiconque fait le mal ou se lèse lui-même, puis implore le pardon d'Allah, trouvera Allah Pardonneur et Miséricordieux.
versets.anglais: And whoever does a wrong or wrongs himself but then seeks forgiveness of Allah will find Allah Forgiving and Merciful

versets.arabe: وَمَن يَكْسِبْ إِثْمًا فَإِنَّمَا يَكْسِبُهُ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا
versets.phonetique: Waman yaksib ithman fa-innama yaksibuhu AAala nafsihi wakana Allahu AAaleeman hakeema
versets.francais: Quiconque acquiert un péché ne l'acquiert que contre lui-même. Allah est Omniscient et Sage.
versets.anglais: And whoever commits a sin only earns it against himself. And Allah is ever Knowing and Wise

versets.arabe: وَمَن يَكْسِبْ خَطِيئَةً أَوْ إِثْمًا ثُمَّ يَرْمِ بِهِ بَرِيئًا فَقَدِ احْتَمَلَ بُهْتَانًا وَإِثْمًا مُّبِينًا
versets.phonetique: Waman yaksib khatiatan aw ithman thumma yarmi bihi bariyan faqadi ihtamala buhtan an waithman mubeena
versets.francais: Quiconque commet une faute ou un péché et en accuse un innocent, endosse certes une calomnie et un péché évident.
versets.anglais: But whoever earns an offense or a sin and then blames it on an innocent [person] has taken upon himself a slander and manifest sin

versets.arabe: وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكَ وَرَحْمَتُهُ لَهَمَّت طَّائِفَةٌ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُضِلُّوكَ وَمَا يُضِلُّونَ إِلَّا أَنفُسَهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Walawla fadlu Allahi AAalayka warahmatuhu lahAmmat ta'ifatun minhum an yudillooka wama yudilloona illa anfusahum
versets.francais: N'était la grâce d'Allah envers toi et Sa miséricorde, une partie d'entre eux avait résolu de t'égarer. Mais ils n'égarent qu'eux-mêmes.
versets.anglais: And if it was not for the favor of Allah upon you, [O Muhammad], and His mercy, a group of them would have determined to mislead you. But they do not mislead except themselves, and they will not harm you at all. And Allah has revealed to you the Book and wisdom and has taught you that which you did not know. And ever has the favor of Allah upon you been great

versets.arabe: لَّا خَيْرَ فِي كَثِيرٍ مِّن نَّجْوَاهُمْ إِلَّا مَنْ أَمَرَ بِصَدَقَةٍ أَوْ مَعْرُوفٍ أَوْ إِصْلَاحٍ بَيْنَ النَّاسِ
versets.phonetique: La khayra fee katheerin min najwahum illa man amara bisadaqatin aw maAAroofin aw islAhin bayna alnnasi
versets.francais: Il n'y a rien de bon dans beaucoup de leurs conciliabules, sauf celui qui recommande une aumône, un bien convenable ou une réconciliation entre les gens.
versets.anglais: No good is there in much of their private conversation, except for those who enjoin charity or that which is right or conciliation between people. And whoever does that seeking means to the approval of Allah - then We are going to give him a great reward

versets.arabe: وَمَن يُشَاقِقِ الرَّسُولَ مِن بَعْدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُ الْهُدَىٰ وَيَتَّبِعْ غَيْرَ سَبِيلِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ نُوَلِّهِ مَا تَوَلَّىٰ
versets.phonetique: Waman yushaqiqi alrrasoola min baAAdi ma tabayyana lahu alhuda wayattabiAA ghayra sabeeli almu'mineena nuwallihi ma tawalla
versets.francais: Quiconque rompt avec le messager après que la bonne voie lui a été clairement expliquée et suit une voie autre que celle des croyants, Nous lui ferons subir ce qu'il s'est choisi.
versets.anglais: And whoever opposes the Messenger after guidance has become clear to him and follows other than the way of the believers - We will give him what he has taken and drive him into Hell, and evil it is as a destination

versets.arabe: إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَغْفِرُ أَن يُشْرَكَ بِهِ وَيَغْفِرُ مَا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَن يَشَاءُ وَمَن يُشْرِكْ بِاللَّهِ فَقَدْ ضَلَّ ضَلَالًا بَعِيدًا
versets.phonetique: Inna Allaha la yaghfiru an yushraka bihi wayaghfiru ma doona thalika liman yasha'o waman yushrik billahi faqad dalla dalAlan baeeda
versets.francais: Allah ne pardonne pas qu'on Lui associe quelqu'un, mais Il pardonne tout autre péché à qui Il veut. Quiconque associe à Allah s'est égaré d'un égarement profond.
versets.anglais: Indeed, Allah does not forgive association with Him, but He forgives what is less than that for whom He wills. And he who associates others with Allah has certainly gone far astray

versets.arabe: إِن يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِ إِلَّا إِنَاثًا وَإِن يَدْعُونَ إِلَّا شَيْطَانًا مَّرِيدًا
versets.phonetique: In yadAAoona min doonihi illa inathan wa-in yadAAoona illa shaytanan mAreeda
versets.francais: Ils n'invoquent en dehors de Lui que des femelles, et ils n'invoquent que le diable rebelle.
versets.anglais: They call upon instead of Him none but female [deities], and they [actually] call upon none but a rebellious Satan

versets.arabe: لَّعَنَهُ اللَّهُ وَقَالَ لَأَتَّخِذَنَّ مِنْ عِبَادِكَ نَصِيبًا مَّفْرُوضًا
versets.phonetique: LaAAanahu Allahu waqala laAttakhithanna min AAibadika naseeban mafrootha
versets.francais: Allah l'a maudit et il dit: "Je prendrai certainement parmi Tes serviteurs une part déterminée."
versets.anglais: Whom Allah has cursed. For he had said, "I will surely take from among Your servants a specific portion

versets.arabe: وَلَأُضِلَّنَّهُمْ وَلَأُمَنِّيَنَّهُمْ وَلَآمُرَنَّهُمْ فَلَيُبَتِّكُنَّ آذَانَ الْأَنْعَامِ
versets.phonetique: Walaodallannahum walaomanniyAnnahum walaamurannahum falayubattikunna athana al-anAAami
versets.francais: "Et je les égarerais, je les bercerai de vaines espérances, je leur ordonnerai et ils fendront les oreilles des bestiaux."
versets.anglais: And I will mislead them, and I will arouse in them [sinful] desires, and I will command them so they will slit the ears of cattle, and I will command them so they will change the creation of Allah." And whoever takes Satan as an ally instead of Allah has certainly sustained a clear loss

versets.arabe: يَعِدُهُمْ وَيُمَنِّيهِمْ وَمَا يَعِدُهُمُ الشَّيْطَانُ إِلَّا غُرُورًا
versets.phonetique: YaAAiduhum wayumanneehim wama yaAAiduhumu alshshaytanu illa ghuroora
versets.francais: Il leur fait des promesses et il les berce de vaines espérances. Le diable ne fait que des promesses trompeuses.
versets.anglais: Satan promises them and arouses desire in them. But Satan does not promise them except delusion

versets.arabe: أُولَٰئِكَ مَأْوَاهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ وَلَا يَجِدُونَ عَنْهَا مَحِيصًا
versets.phonetique: Olaika ma'wahum jahannamu wala yajidoona AAanha maheetha
versets.francais: Ceux-là auront l'Enfer pour demeure et ne trouveront pas d'échappatoire.
versets.anglais: The refuge of those will be Hell, and they will not find from it an escape

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ سَنُدْخِلُهُمْ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا أَبَدًا
versets.phonetique: Wallatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati sanudkhiluhum jannatin tajree min tahtiha al-anharu khalideena feeha abadan
versets.francais: Ceux qui croient et accomplissent les bonnes œuvres, Nous les ferons entrer dans des jardins sous lesquels coulent les ruisseaux, pour y demeurer éternellement.
versets.anglais: But the ones who believe and do righteous deeds - We will admit them to gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever. [It is] the promise of Allah, [which is] truth, and who is more truthful than Allah in statement

versets.arabe: لَّيْسَ بِأَمَانِيِّكُمْ وَلَا أَمَانِيِّ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ مَن يَعْمَلْ سُوءًا يُجْزَ بِهِ
versets.phonetique: Laysa biamAniyyikum wala amAniyyi ahli alkitabi man yaAamal sooan yujza bih
versets.francais: Cela ne dépend ni de vos vœux ni des vœux des gens du Livre. Quiconque fait le mal en sera rétribué.
versets.anglais: Paradise is not [obtained] by your wishful thinking nor by that of the People of the Scripture. Whoever does a wrong will be recompensed for it, and he will not find besides Allah a protector or a helper

versets.arabe: وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِنَ الصَّالِحَاتِ مِن ذَكَرٍ أَوْ أُنثَىٰ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَأُولَٰئِكَ يَدْخُلُونَ الْجَنَّةَ
versets.phonetique: Waman yaAAmal mina alssalihati min thakarin aw ontha wahuwa mu'minun faola'ika yadkhuloona aljannata
versets.francais: Quiconque accomplit de bonnes œuvres, homme ou femme, tout en étant croyant, ceux-là entreront au Paradis.
versets.anglais: And whoever does righteous deeds, whether male or female, while being a believer - those will enter Paradise and will not be wronged, [even as much as] the speck on a date seed

versets.arabe: وَمَنْ أَحْسَنُ دِينًا مِّمَّنْ أَسْلَمَ وَجْهَهُ لِلَّهِ وَهُوَ مُحْسِنٌ وَاتَّبَعَ مِلَّةَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَنِيفًا
versets.phonetique: Waman ahsanu deenan mimman aslama wajhahu lillahi wahuwa muhsinun wattabaAAa millata ibraheema haneefa
versets.francais: Qui a une meilleure religion que celui qui soumet sa personne à Allah, qui fait le bien et suit la religion d'Abraham le pur monothéiste?
versets.anglais: And who is better in religion than one who submits himself to Allah while being a doer of good and follows the religion of Abraham, inclining toward truth? And Allah took Abraham as an intimate friend

versets.arabe: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ مُّحِيطًا
versets.phonetique: Walillahi ma fee alssamawati wama fee al-ardi wakana Allahu bikulli shay'in muheeta
versets.francais: À Allah appartient ce qui est dans les cieux et sur la terre. Allah embrasse tout.
versets.anglais: And to Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. And ever is Allah, of all things, encompassing

versets.arabe: وَيَسْتَفْتُونَكَ فِي النِّسَاءِ قُلِ اللَّهُ يُفْتِيكُمْ فِيهِنَّ وَمَا يُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فِي الْكِتَابِ فِي يَتَامَى النِّسَاءِ
versets.phonetique: Wayastaftoonaka fee alnnisa'i quli Allahu yufteekum feehinna wama yutla AAalaykum fee alkitabi fee yatama alnnisa'i
versets.francais: On te consulte au sujet des femmes. Dis: "Allah vous donne une décision à leur sujet, ainsi que ce qui vous est récité dans le Livre au sujet des orphelines femmes."
versets.anglais: And they request from you, [O Muhammad], a [legal] ruling concerning women. Say, "Allah gives you a ruling about them and [about] what has been recited to you in the Book concerning the orphan girls to whom you do not give what is decreed for them - and [yet] you desire to marry them - and concerning the oppressed among children and that you maintain for orphans [their rights] in justice." And whatever you do of good - indeed, Allah is ever Knowing of it

versets.arabe: وَإِنِ امْرَأَةٌ خَافَتْ مِن بَعْلِهَا نُشُوزًا أَوْ إِعْرَاضًا فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْهِمَا أَن يُصْلِحَا بَيْنَهُمَا صُلْحًا وَالصُّلْحُ خَيْرٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa-ini imra'atun khafat min baAAliha nooshouzan aw iAAraadan fala junaha AAalayhima an yusliha baynahuma sulhan waalssulhu khayr
versets.francais: Si une femme craint de son mari arrogance ou indifférence, ce n'est pas un péché pour eux deux de se réconcilier à l'amiable, car la réconciliation est meilleure.
versets.anglais: And if a woman fears from her husband contempt or evasion, there is no sin upon them if they make terms of settlement between them - and settlement is best. And present in [human] souls is stinginess. But if you do good and fear Allah - then indeed Allah is ever, with what you do, Acquainted

versets.arabe: وَلَن تَسْتَطِيعُوا أَن تَعْدِلُوا بَيْنَ النِّسَاءِ وَلَوْ حَرَصْتُمْ فَلَا تَمِيلُوا كُلَّ الْمَيْلِ فَتَذَرُوهَا كَالْمُعَلَّقَةِ
versets.phonetique: Walan tastatiAAoo an taAAdiloo bayna alnnisa'i walaw harAstum fala tameeloo kulla almayli fatATharoooha kAlmuAAallaqa
versets.francais: Vous ne pourrez jamais être équitables entre femmes, même si vous le souhaitez ardemment. Ne vous penchez donc pas entièrement d'un côté au point de laisser l'autre comme en suspens.
versets.anglais: And you will never be able to be equal [in feeling] between wives, even if you should strive [to do so]. So do not incline completely [toward one] and leave another hanging. And if you amend [your affairs] and fear Allah - then indeed, Allah is ever Forgiving and Merciful

versets.arabe: وَإِن يَتَفَرَّقَا يُغْنِ اللَّهُ كُلًّا مِّن سَعَتِهِ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ وَاسِعًا حَكِيمًا
versets.phonetique: Wa-in yatafarraqa yughni Allahu kullan min saAAatihi wakana Allahu wasiAAan hakeema
versets.francais: S'ils se séparent, Allah rendra chacun d'eux indépendant de par Son abondance. Allah est Plein d'abondance et Sage.
versets.anglais: But if they separate [by divorce], Allah will enrich each [of them] from His abundance. And ever is Allah Encompassing and Wise

versets.arabe: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَقَدْ وَصَّيْنَا الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْكِتَابَ مِن قَبْلِكُمْ وَإِيَّاكُمْ أَنِ اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ
versets.phonetique: Walillahi ma fee alssamawati wama fee al-ardi walaqad wassayna allatheena ootoo alkitaba min qablikum wa-iyyakum ani ittaqoo Allah
versets.francais: À Allah appartient ce qui est dans les cieux et sur la terre. Nous avons recommandé à ceux qui ont reçu le Livre avant vous et à vous de craindre Allah.
versets.anglais: And to Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. And We have instructed those who were given the Scripture before you and yourselves to fear Allah. But if you disbelieve - then to Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. And ever is Allah Free of need and Praiseworthy

versets.arabe: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَكَفَىٰ بِاللَّهِ وَكِيلًا
versets.phonetique: Walillahi ma fee alssamawati wama fee al-ardi wakafa billahi wakeela
versets.francais: À Allah appartient ce qui est dans les cieux et sur la terre. Allah suffit comme Garant.
versets.anglais: And to Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. And sufficient is Allah as Disposer of affairs

versets.arabe: إِن يَشَأْ يُذْهِبْكُمْ أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ وَيَأْتِ بِآخَرِينَ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكَ قَدِيرًا
versets.phonetique: In yasha yuthhib-kum ayyuha alnnasu waya'ti biakhaReena wakana Allahu AAala thalika qadeera
versets.francais: S'Il veut, Il vous fera disparaître, ô hommes, et amènera d'autres. Allah en est capable.
versets.anglais: If He wills, He can do away with you, O people, and bring others [in your place]. And ever is Allah competent to do that

versets.arabe: مَّن كَانَ يُرِيدُ ثَوَابَ الدُّنْيَا فَعِندَ اللَّهِ ثَوَابُ الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ سَمِيعًا بَصِيرًا
versets.phonetique: Man kana yureedu thawaba alddunya faAAinda Allahi thawabu alddunya wal-akhirati wakana Allahu sameeAAan baseera
versets.francais: Quiconque désire la récompense ici-bas, auprès d'Allah se trouve la récompense d'ici-bas et de l'au-delà. Allah est Audient et Clairvoyant.
versets.anglais: Whoever desires the reward of this world - then with Allah is the reward of this world and the Hereafter. And ever is Allah Hearing and Seeing

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا كُونُوا قَوَّامِينَ بِالْقِسْطِ شُهَدَاءَ لِلَّهِ وَلَوْ عَلَىٰ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَوِ الْوَالِدَيْنِ وَالْأَقْرَبِينَ
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo koonoo qawwameena bilqisti shuhadaa'a lillahi walaw AAala anfusikum awi alwalidayni wal-aqrabeena
versets.francais: Ô vous qui croyez! Soyez stricts en équité et soyez témoins pour Allah, même si c'est contre vous-mêmes, contre vos père et mère ou vos proches.
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, be persistently standing firm in justice, witnesses for Allah, even if it be against yourselves or parents and relatives. Whether one is rich or poor, Allah is more worthy of both. So follow not [personal] inclination, lest you not be just. And if you distort [your testimony] or refuse [to give it], then indeed Allah is ever, with what you do, Acquainted

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا آمِنُوا بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَالْكِتَابِ الَّذِي نَزَّلَ عَلَىٰ رَسُولِهِ وَالْكِتَابِ الَّذِي أَنزَلَ مِن قَبْلُ
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo aminoo billahi warasoolihi walkitabi allathee nazzala AAala rasoolihi walkitabi allathee anzala min qablu
versets.francais: Ô vous qui croyez! Croyez en Allah et en Son messager et au Livre qu'Il a révélé à Son messager et au Livre qu'Il a révélé avant.
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, believe in Allah and His Messenger and the Book that He sent down upon His Messenger and the Scripture which He sent down before. And whoever disbelieves in Allah, His angels, His books, His messengers, and the Last Day has certainly gone far astray

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا ثُمَّ كَفَرُوا ثُمَّ آمَنُوا ثُمَّ كَفَرُوا ثُمَّ ازْدَادُوا كُفْرًا لَّمْ يَكُنِ اللَّهُ لِيَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Inna allatheena amanoo thumma kafaroo thumma amanoo thumma kafaroo thumma izdadoo kufran lam yakuni Allahu liyaghfira lahum
versets.francais: Ceux qui ont cru puis mécru, puis ont cru, puis mécru, puis ont accru leur mécréance, Allah ne leur pardonnera pas.
versets.anglais: Indeed, those who have believed then disbelieved, then believed, then disbelieved, and then increased in disbelief - never will Allah forgive them, nor will He guide them to a way

versets.arabe: بَشِّرِ الْمُنَافِقِينَ بِأَنَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا
versets.phonetique: Bashshiri almunafiqeena bi-anna lahum AAathaban aleema
versets.francais: Annonce aux hypocrites qu'ils auront un châtiment douloureux.
versets.anglais: Give tidings to the hypocrites that there is for them a painful punishment

versets.arabe: الَّذِينَ يَتَّخِذُونَ الْكَافِرِينَ أَوْلِيَاءَ مِن دُونِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ أَيَبْتَغُونَ عِندَهُمُ الْعِزَّةَ فَإِنَّ الْعِزَّةَ لِلَّهِ جَمِيعًا
versets.phonetique: Allatheena yattakhithooNa alkafireena awliyaa min dooni almu'mineena ayabtaghoona AAindahumu alAAizzata fainna alAAizzata lillahi jameeAAa
versets.francais: Ceux qui prennent les mécréants pour alliés au détriment des croyants cherchent-ils auprès d'eux la puissance? La puissance appartient entièrement à Allah.
versets.anglais: Those who take disbelievers as allies instead of the believers. Do they seek with them honor [through power]? But indeed, honor belongs to Allah entirely

versets.arabe: وَقَدْ نَزَّلَ عَلَيْكُمْ فِي الْكِتَابِ أَنْ إِذَا سَمِعْتُمْ آيَاتِ اللَّهِ يُكْفَرُ بِهَا وَيُسْتَهْزَأُ بِهَا فَلَا تَقْعُدُوا مَعَهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Waqad nazzala AAalaykum fee alkitabi an itha samiAAtum ayati Allahi yukfaru biha wayustahzao biha fala taqAAudoo maAAahum
versets.francais: Il vous a déjà révélé dans le Livre que si vous entendez qu'on médit des versets d'Allah et qu'on s'en moque, ne vous asseyez pas avec eux.
versets.anglais: And it has already come down to you in the Book that when you hear the verses of Allah [recited], they are denied [by them] and ridiculed; so do not sit with them until they enter into another conversation. Indeed, you would then be like them. Indeed Allah will gather the hypocrites and disbelievers in Hell all together

versets.arabe: الَّذِينَ يَتَرَبَّصُونَ بِكُمْ فَإِن كَانَ لَكُمْ فَتْحٌ مِّنَ اللَّهِ قَالُوا أَلَمْ نَكُن مَّعَكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Allatheena yatarabbasoona bikum fa-in kana lakum fathun mina Allahi qaloo alam nakun maAAakum
versets.francais: Ceux qui épient votre situation: si la victoire vous vient de la part d'Allah, ils disent: "N'étions-nous pas avec vous?"
versets.anglais: Those who wait [and watch] you. Then if you gain a victory from Allah, they say, "Were we not with you?" But if the disbelievers have a success, they say [to them], "Did we not gain the advantage over you, but we protected you from the believers?" Allah will judge between [all of] you on the Day of Resurrection, and never will Allah give the disbelievers over the believers a way [to overcome them]

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الْمُنَافِقِينَ يُخَادِعُونَ اللَّهَ وَهُوَ خَادِعُهُمْ وَإِذَا قَامُوا إِلَى الصَّلَاةِ قَامُوا كُسَالَىٰ
versets.phonetique: Inna almunafiqeena yukhadiAAoona Allaha wahuwa khadiAAuhum wa-itha qamoo ila alssalati qamoo kusala
versets.francais: Les hypocrites cherchent à tromper Allah alors qu'Il les dupe. Quand ils se lèvent pour la Salat, ils se lèvent avec paresse.
versets.anglais: Indeed, the hypocrites [think to] deceive Allah, but He is deceiving them. And when they stand for prayer, they stand lazily, showing [themselves to] the people and not remembering Allah except a little

versets.arabe: مُّذَبْذَبِينَ بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ لَا إِلَىٰ هَٰؤُلَاءِ وَلَا إِلَىٰ هَٰؤُلَاءِ
versets.phonetique: Muthabthabeena bayna thalika la ila ha'ola'i wala ila ha'ola'i
versets.francais: Balancés entre les deux, n'appartenant ni à ceux-ci ni à ceux-là.
versets.anglais: Wavering between them, [belonging] neither to the believers nor to the disbelievers. And whoever Allah leaves astray - never will you find for him a way

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تَتَّخِذُوا الْكَافِرِينَ أَوْلِيَاءَ مِن دُونِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la tattakhithoo alkafireena awliyaa min dooni almu'mineena
versets.francais: Ô vous qui croyez! Ne prenez pas les mécréants pour alliés au détriment des croyants.
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, do not take the disbelievers as allies instead of the believers. Do you wish to give Allah against yourselves a clear case

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الْمُنَافِقِينَ فِي الدَّرْكِ الْأَسْفَلِ مِنَ النَّارِ وَلَن تَجِدَ لَهُمْ نَصِيرًا
versets.phonetique: Inna almunafiqeena fee alddarki al-asfali mina alnnari walan tajida lahum naseera
versets.francais: Les hypocrites seront au niveau le plus bas du Feu et tu ne trouveras pas pour eux de secoureur.
versets.anglais: Indeed, the hypocrites will be in the lowest depths of the Fire - and never will you find for them a helper

versets.arabe: إِلَّا الَّذِينَ تَابُوا وَأَصْلَحُوا وَاعْتَصَمُوا بِاللَّهِ وَأَخْلَصُوا دِينَهُمْ لِلَّهِ فَأُولَٰئِكَ مَعَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Illa allatheena taboo waaslahoo waAAatasamoo billahi waaakhlasooa deenahum lillahi faola'ika maAAa almu'mineen
versets.francais: Sauf ceux qui se repentent, s'amendent, s'attachent à Allah et pratiquent sincèrement leur religion pour Allah. Ceux-là seront avec les croyants.
versets.anglais: Except for those who repent, correct themselves, hold fast to Allah, and are sincere in their religion for Allah, for those will be with the believers. And Allah is going to give the believers a great reward

versets.arabe: مَّا يَفْعَلُ اللَّهُ بِعَذَابِكُمْ إِن شَكَرْتُمْ وَآمَنتُمْ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ شَاكِرًا عَلِيمًا
versets.phonetique: Ma yafAAalu Allahu biAAathabikum in shakartum waamantum wakana Allahu shakiran AAaleema
versets.francais: Qu'Allah ferait-Il de votre châtiment si vous rendez grâce et si vous croyez? Allah est Reconnaissant et Omniscient.
versets.anglais: What would Allah do with your punishment if you are grateful and believe? And ever is Allah Appreciative and Knowing

versets.arabe: لَّا يُحِبُّ اللَّهُ الْجَهْرَ بِالسُّوءِ مِنَ الْقَوْلِ إِلَّا مَن ظُلِمَ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ سَمِيعًا عَلِيمًا
versets.phonetique: La yuhibbu Allahu aljahra bialssoo'i mina alqawli illa man thulima wakana Allahu sameeAAan AAaleema
versets.francais: Allah n'aime pas qu'on profère de mauvaises paroles, sauf si l'on a été lésé. Allah est Audient et Omniscient.
versets.anglais: Allah does not like the public mention of evil except by one who has been wronged. And ever is Allah Hearing and Knowing

versets.arabe: إِن تُبْدُوا خَيْرًا أَوْ تُخْفُوهُ أَوْ تَعْفُوا عَن سُوءٍ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ عَفُوًّا قَدِيرًا
versets.phonetique: In tubdoo khayran aw tukhfoohu aw taAAfoo AAan soo'in fainna Allaha kana AAafuwwan qadeera
versets.francais: Que vous divulguiez un bien ou le cachiez ou que vous pardonniez un mal, Allah est certes Indulgent et Omnipotent.
versets.anglais: If [instead] you show [some] good or conceal it or pardon an offense - indeed, Allah is ever Pardoning and Competent

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَكْفُرُونَ بِاللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِ وَيُرِيدُونَ أَن يُفَرِّقُوا بَيْنَ اللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِ
versets.phonetique: Inna allatheena yakfuroona billahi warusulihi wayureedoona an yufarriqoo bayna Allahi warusulihi
versets.francais: Ceux qui mécroient en Allah et en Ses messagers et qui veulent séparer Allah de Ses messagers...
versets.anglais: Indeed, those who disbelieve in Allah and His messengers and wish to discriminate between Allah and His messengers and say, "We believe in some and disbelieve in others," and wish to adopt a way in between

versets.arabe: أُولَٰئِكَ هُمُ الْكَافِرُونَ حَقًّا وَأَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَافِرِينَ عَذَابًا مُّهِينًا
versets.phonetique: Olaika humu alkafiroona haqqan waaAAtadna lilkafireena AAathaban muheena
versets.francais: Ceux-là sont les vrais mécréants. Et Nous avons préparé pour les mécréants un châtiment avilissant.
versets.anglais: Those are the disbelievers, truly. And We have prepared for the disbelievers a humiliating punishment

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا بِاللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِ وَلَمْ يُفَرِّقُوا بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِّنْهُمْ أُولَٰئِكَ سَوْفَ يُؤْتِيهِمْ أُجُورَهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Wallatheena amanoo billahi warusulihi walam yufarriqoo bayna ahadin minhum olaika sawfa yu'teehim ojoorahum
versets.francais: Ceux qui croient en Allah et en Ses messagers et ne font pas de distinction entre eux, Allah leur donnera leurs récompenses.
versets.anglais: But they who believe in Allah and His messengers and do not discriminate between any of them - to those He is going to give their rewards. And ever is Allah Forgiving and Merciful

versets.arabe: يَسْأَلُكَ أَهْلُ الْكِتَابِ أَن تُنَزِّلَ عَلَيْهِمْ كِتَابًا مِّنَ السَّمَاءِ فَقَدْ سَأَلُوا مُوسَىٰ أَكْبَرَ مِن ذَٰلِكَ
versets.phonetique: Yas'aluka ahlu alkitabi an tunazzila AAalayhim kitaban mina alssama'i faqad saAloo moosa akbara min thalika
versets.francais: Les gens du Livre te demandent de faire descendre sur eux un livre du ciel. Ils avaient demandé à Moïse plus que cela.
versets.anglais: The People of the Scripture ask you to bring down to them a book from the heaven. But they had asked of Moses [even] greater than that and said, "Show us Allah outright," so the thunderbolt struck them for their wrongdoing. Then they took the calf [for worship] after clear evidences had come to them, and We pardoned that. And We gave Moses a clear authority

versets.arabe: وَرَفَعْنَا فَوْقَهُمُ الطُّورَ بِمِيثَاقِهِمْ وَقُلْنَا لَهُمُ ادْخُلُوا الْبَابَ سُجَّدًا
versets.phonetique: WarafaAAna fawqahumu alttora bimeethaqihim waqulna lahumu odkhuloo albaba sujjadan
versets.francais: Et Nous avons élevé au-dessus d'eux le Mont Sinaï pour leur pacte et leur avons dit: "Entrez en vous prosternant."
versets.anglais: And We raised over them the mount for [refusal of] their covenant; and We said to them, "Enter the gate bowing humbly", and We said to them, "Do not transgress on the sabbath", and We took from them a solemn covenant

versets.arabe: فَبِمَا نَقْضِهِم مِّيثَاقَهُمْ وَكُفْرِهِم بِآيَاتِ اللَّهِ وَقَتْلِهِمُ الْأَنبِيَاءَ بِغَيْرِ حَقٍّ
versets.phonetique: Fabima naqdihim meethaqahum wakufrihim bi-ayati Allahi waqatlihimu al-anbiyaa bighayri haqq
versets.francais: Mais à cause de leur violation de leur pacte, leur mécréance envers les signes d'Allah et le meurtre injuste des prophètes...
versets.anglais: And [We cursed them] for their breaking of the covenant and their disbelief in the signs of Allah and their killing of the prophets without right and their saying, "Our hearts are wrapped". Rather, Allah has sealed them because of their disbelief, so they believe not, except for a few

versets.arabe: وَبِكُفْرِهِمْ وَقَوْلِهِمْ عَلَىٰ مَرْيَمَ بُهْتَانًا عَظِيمًا
versets.phonetique: Wabikufrihim waqawlihim AAala maryama buhtanan AAatheema
versets.francais: Et à cause de leur mécréance et de leur calomnie énorme contre Marie.
versets.anglais: And [We cursed them] for their disbelief and their saying against Mary a great slander

versets.arabe: وَقَوْلِهِمْ إِنَّا قَتَلْنَا الْمَسِيحَ عِيسَى ابْنَ مَرْيَمَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَمَا قَتَلُوهُ وَمَا صَلَبُوهُ وَلَٰكِن شُبِّهَ لَهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Waqawlihim inna qatalna almaseeha AAeesa ibna maryama rasoola Allahi wama qataloohu wama salabooohu walakin shubbiha lahum
versets.francais: Et à cause de leur dit: "Nous avons tué le Messie, Jésus fils de Marie, messager d'Allah." Or ils ne l'ont ni tué ni crucifié, mais c'était une similitude.
versets.anglais: And [for] their saying, "Indeed, we have killed the Messiah, Jesus, the son of Mary, the messenger of Allah." And they did not kill him, nor did they crucify him; but [another] was made to resemble him to them. And indeed, those who differ over it are in doubt about it. They have no knowledge of it except the following of assumption. And they did not kill him, for certain

versets.arabe: بَل رَّفَعَهُ اللَّهُ إِلَيْهِ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ عَزِيزًا حَكِيمًا
versets.phonetique: Bal rafaAAahu Allahu ilayhi wakana Allahu AAazezan hakeema
versets.francais: Mais Allah l'a élevé vers Lui. Allah est Puissant et Sage.
versets.anglais: Rather, Allah raised him to Himself. And ever is Allah Exalted in Might and Wise

versets.arabe: وَإِن مِّنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ إِلَّا لَيُؤْمِنَنَّ بِهِ قَبْلَ مَوْتِهِ وَيَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ يَكُونُ عَلَيْهِمْ شَهِيدًا
versets.phonetique: Wa-in min ahli alkitabi illa layu'minanna bihi qabla mawtihi wayawma alqiyamati yakoonu AAalayhim shaheeda
versets.francais: Il n'est personne parmi les gens du Livre qui ne croira en lui avant sa mort. Et le Jour de la Résurrection, il sera témoin contre eux.
versets.anglais: And there is none from the People of the Scripture but that he will surely believe in Jesus before his death. And on the Day of Resurrection he will be against them a witness

versets.arabe: فَبِظُلْمٍ مِّنَ الَّذِينَ هَادُوا حَرَّمْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ طَيِّبَاتٍ أُحِلَّتْ لَهُمْ
versets.phonetique: FabithuLmin mina allatheena hadoo harramna AAalayhim tayyibatin ohillat lahum
versets.francais: À cause de l'injustice de ceux qui étaient Juifs, Nous leur avons interdit de bonnes choses qui leur étaient permises.
versets.anglais: For wrongdoing on the part of the Jews, We made unlawful for them [certain] good foods which had been lawful to them, and for their averting from the way of Allah many [people]

versets.arabe: وَأَخْذِهِمُ الرِّبَا وَقَدْ نُهُوا عَنْهُ وَأَكْلِهِمْ أَمْوَالَ النَّاسِ بِالْبَاطِلِ
versets.phonetique: Waakhlihimu alrriba waqad nuhoo AAanhu waakLihim amwala alnnasi bilbatili
versets.francais: Et parce qu'ils pratiquaient l'usure qui leur avait été interdite, et parce qu'ils dévoraient les biens des gens injustement.
versets.anglais: And [for] their taking of usury while they had been forbidden from it, and their consuming of the people's wealth unjustly. And we have prepared for the disbelievers among them a painful punishment

versets.arabe: لَّٰكِنِ الرَّاسِخُونَ فِي الْعِلْمِ مِنْهُمْ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ وَمَا أُنزِلَ مِن قَبْلِكَ
versets.phonetique: Lakini alrrasikhoona fee alAAilmi minhum walmu'minoona yu'minoona bima onzila ilayka wama onzila min qablika
versets.francais: Mais ceux d'entre eux qui sont bien enracinés dans la science et les croyants croient en ce qu'on t'a révélé et en ce qui a été révélé avant toi.
versets.anglais: But those firm in knowledge among them and the believers believe in what has been revealed to you, [O Muhammad], and what was revealed before you. And the establishers of prayer [especially] and the givers of zakah and the believers in Allah and the Last Day - those We will give a great reward

versets.arabe: إِنَّا أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ كَمَا أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَىٰ نُوحٍ وَالنَّبِيِّينَ مِن بَعْدِهِ وَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَىٰ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَإِسْمَاعِيلَ
versets.phonetique: Inna awhayna ilayka kama awhayna ila noohin waAlnnabiyyeena min baAAdihi waawhayna ila ibraheema wa-ismaAAeela
versets.francais: Nous t'avons fait une révélation comme Nous avions fait une révélation à Noé et aux prophètes après lui; et Nous avons fait des révélations à Abraham et Ismaël.
versets.anglais: Indeed, We have revealed to you, [O Muhammad], as We revealed to Noah and the prophets after him. And we revealed to Abraham, Ishmael, Isaac, Jacob, the Descendants, Jesus, Job, Jonah, Aaron, and Solomon, and to David We gave the book [of Psalms]

versets.arabe: وَرُسُلًا قَدْ قَصَصْنَاهُمْ عَلَيْكَ مِن قَبْلُ وَرُسُلًا لَّمْ نَقْصُصْهُمْ عَلَيْكَ وَكَلَّمَ اللَّهُ مُوسَىٰ تَكْلِيمًا
versets.phonetique: Warusulan qad qasasnahum AAalayka min qablu warusulan lam naqsushum AAalayka wakallama Allahu moosa takleema
versets.francais: Des messagers que Nous t'avons déjà racontés auparavant et des messagers que Nous ne t'avons pas racontés. Allah a parlé à Moïse directement.
versets.anglais: And [We sent] messengers about whom We have related [their stories] to you before and messengers about whom We have not related to you. And Allah spoke to Moses with [direct] speech

versets.arabe: رُّسُلًا مُّبَشِّرِينَ وَمُنذِرِينَ لِئَلَّا يَكُونَ لِلنَّاسِ عَلَى اللَّهِ حُجَّةٌ بَعْدَ الرُّسُلِ
versets.phonetique: Rusulan mubashshireena wamunthireena li'alla yakoona lilnnasi AAala Allahi hujjatun baAAda alrrusul
versets.francais: Des messagers annonciateurs et avertisseurs, afin que les hommes n'aient plus d'argument à opposer à Allah après les messagers.
versets.anglais: [We sent] messengers as bringers of good tidings and warners so that mankind will have no argument against Allah after the messengers. And ever is Allah Exalted in Might and Wise

versets.arabe: لَّٰكِنِ اللَّهُ يَشْهَدُ بِمَا أَنزَلَ إِلَيْكَ أَنزَلَهُ بِعِلْمِهِ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ يَشْهَدُونَ وَكَفَىٰ بِاللَّهِ شَهِيدًا
versets.phonetique: Lakini Allahu yashhadu bima anzala ilayka anzalahu biAAilmihi walmalaaYikatu yashhAdoona wakafa billahi shaheeda
versets.francais: Mais Allah témoigne de ce qu'Il t'a révélé. Il l'a révélé en Sa science. Les anges en témoignent aussi. Allah suffit comme témoin.
versets.anglais: But Allah bears witness to that which He has revealed to you. He has sent it down with His knowledge, and the angels bear witness [as well]. And sufficient is Allah as Witness

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَصَدُّوا عَن سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ قَدْ ضَلُّوا ضَلَالًا بَعِيدًا
versets.phonetique: Inna allatheena kafaroo wasaddoo AAan sabeeli Allahi qad dalloo dalalan baAAeeda
versets.francais: Ceux qui ont mécru et ont fait obstacle au sentier d'Allah se sont égarés d'un égarement profond.
versets.anglais: Indeed, those who disbelieve and avert [people] from the way of Allah have certainly gone far astray

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَظَلَمُوا لَمْ يَكُنِ اللَّهُ لِيَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ وَلَا لِيَهْدِيَهُمْ طَرِيقًا
versets.phonetique: Inna allatheena kafaroo wathalamoo lam yakuni Allahu liyaghfira lahum wala liyahdiyahum tareeqa
versets.francais: Ceux qui ont mécru et commis des injustices, Allah ne les pardonnera pas et ne les guidera pas vers une voie.
versets.anglais: Indeed, those who disbelieve and commit wrong [or injustice] - never will Allah forgive them, nor will He guide them to a path

versets.arabe: إِلَّا طَرِيقَ جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا أَبَدًا وَكَانَ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى اللَّهِ يَسِيرًا
versets.phonetique: Illa tareeqa jahannama khalideena feeha abadan wakana thalika AAala Allahi yaseera
versets.francais: Sauf le chemin de l'Enfer où ils demeureront éternellement. Cela est facile pour Allah.
versets.anglais: Except the path of Hell; they will abide therein forever. And that, for Allah, is [always] easy

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ قَدْ جَاءَكُمُ الرَّسُولُ بِالْحَقِّ مِن رَّبِّكُمْ فَآمِنُوا خَيْرًا لَّكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuha alnnasu qad jaakumu alrrasoolu biAlhaqqi min rabbikum faaminoo khayran lakum
versets.francais: Ô hommes! Le messager vous est venu avec la vérité de la part de votre Seigneur. Croyez donc, c'est mieux pour vous.
versets.anglais: O Mankind, the Messenger has come to you with the truth from your Lord, so believe; it is better for you. But if you disbelieve - then indeed, to Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and earth. And ever is Allah Knowing and Wise

versets.arabe: يَا أَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ لَا تَغْلُوا فِي دِينِكُمْ وَلَا تَقُولُوا عَلَى اللَّهِ إِلَّا الْحَقَّ إِنَّمَا الْمَسِيحُ عِيسَى ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ
versets.phonetique: Ya ahla alkitabi la taghloo fee deenikum wala taqooloo AAala Allahi illa alhaqqa innnama almaseehu AAeesa ibnu maryama rasoolu Allah
versets.francais: Ô gens du Livre! N'exagérez pas dans votre religion et ne dites d'Allah que la vérité. Le Messie, Jésus fils de Marie, n'est qu'un messager d'Allah.
versets.anglais: O People of the Scripture, do not commit excess in your religion or say about Allah except the truth. The Messiah, Jesus, the son of Mary, was but a messenger of Allah and His word which He directed to Mary and a soul [created at a command] from Him. So believe in Allah and His messengers. And do not say, "Three"; desist - it is better for you. Indeed, Allah is but one God. Exalted is He above having a son. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. And sufficient is Allah as Disposer of affairs

versets.arabe: لَّن يَسْتَنكِفَ الْمَسِيحُ أَن يَكُونَ عَبْدًا لِّلَّهِ وَلَا الْمَلَائِكَةُ الْمُقَرَّبُونَ
versets.phonetique: Lan yastankifa almaseehu an yakoona AAabdan lillahi wala almala'ikatu almuqarraboona
versets.francais: Le Messie ne dédaignera jamais d'être serviteur d'Allah, ni les anges proches.
versets.anglais: Never would the Messiah disdain to be a servant of Allah, nor would the angels near [to Him]. And whoever disdains His worship and is arrogant - He will gather them to Himself all together

versets.arabe: فَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ فَيُوَفِّيهِمْ أُجُورَهُمْ وَيَزِيدُهُم مِّن فَضْلِهِ
versets.phonetique: Faamma allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati fayuwaffeeHim ojoorahum wayazeeduhum min fadlihi
versets.francais: Quant à ceux qui ont cru et accompli les bonnes œuvres, Il leur paiera intégralement leurs récompenses et leur accordera davantage de Sa grâce.
versets.anglais: And as for those who believed and did righteous deeds, He will give them in full their rewards and grant them extra from His bounty. But as for those who disdained and were arrogant, He will punish them with a painful punishment, and they will not find for themselves besides Allah any protector or helper

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ قَدْ جَاءَكُم بُرْهَانٌ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ وَأَنزَلْنَا إِلَيْكُمْ نُورًا مُّبِينًا
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuha alnnasu qad jaakum burhanun min rabbikum waanzalna ilaykum noooooran mubeena
versets.francais: Ô hommes! Une preuve vous est venue de la part de votre Seigneur et Nous avons fait descendre vers vous une lumière évidente.
versets.anglais: O mankind, there has come to you a conclusive proof from your Lord, and We have sent down to you a clear light

versets.arabe: فَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا بِاللَّهِ وَاعْتَصَمُوا بِهِ فَسَيُدْخِلُهُمْ فِي رَحْمَةٍ مِّنْهُ وَفَضْلٍ وَيَهْدِيهِمْ إِلَيْهِ صِرَاطًا مُّسْتَقِيمًا
versets.phonetique: Faamma allatheena amanoo billahi waAAatasamoo bihi fasayudkhiluhum fee rahmatin minhu wafadlin wayahdeehim ilayhi siratan mustaqeema
versets.francais: Quant à ceux qui ont cru en Allah et se sont attachés à Lui, Il les fera entrer dans une miséricorde venue de Lui et une grâce; Il les guidera vers Lui sur un droit chemin.
versets.anglais: So those who believe in Allah and hold fast to Him - He will admit them to mercy from Himself and bounty and guide them to Himself on a straight path

versets.arabe: يَسْتَفْتُونَكَ قُلِ اللَّهُ يُفْتِيكُمْ فِي الْكَلَالَةِ إِنِ امْرُؤٌ هَلَكَ لَيْسَ لَهُ وَلَدٌ وَلَهُ أُخْتٌ فَلَهَا نِصْفُ مَا تَرَكَ
versets.phonetique: Yastaftoonaka quli Allahu yufteekum fee alKalAlati ini imruon halaka laysa lahu waladun walahu okhtun falaha nisfu ma taraka
versets.francais: On te consulte. Dis: "Allah vous donne une décision au sujet de la parenté par les côtés. Si un homme meurt sans enfant mais a une sœur, elle a la moitié de ce qu'il laisse."
versets.anglais: They request from you a [legal] ruling. Say, "Allah gives you a ruling concerning one having neither descendants nor ascendants [as heirs]." If a man dies, leaving no child but [only] a sister, she will have half of what he left. And he inherits from her if she [dies and] has no child. But if there are two sisters [or more], they will have two-thirds of what he left. If there are both brothers and sisters, the male will have the share of two females. Allah makes clear to you [His law], lest you go astray. And Allah is Knowing of all things

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا أَوْفُوا بِالْعُقُودِ ۚ أُحِلَّتْ لَكُم بَهِيمَةُ الْأَنْعَامِ إِلَّا مَا يُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ غَيْرَ مُحِلِّي الصَّيْدِ وَأَنتُمْ حُرُمٌ ۗ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَحْكُمُ مَا يُرِيدُ
versets.phonetique: Yā ayyuhā lladhīna āmanū awfū bil-'uqūdi uḥillat lakum bahīmatu l-an'āmi illā mā yutlā 'alaykum ghayra muḥillī ṣ-ṣaydi wa'antum ḥurum inna llāha yaḥkumu mā yurīd
versets.francais: Ô vous qui croyez! Remplissez vos engagements. Il vous est permis de manger les bêtes du bétail, sauf ce qui vous est récité [comme prohibé]. Et ne vous permettez pas la chasse quand vous êtes en état d'ihrâm. Certes Allah décrète ce qu'Il veut.
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, fulfill [all] contracts. Lawful for you are the animals of grazing livestock except for that which is recited to you [in this Qur'an] - hunting not being permitted while you are in the state of ihram. Indeed, Allah ordains what He intends

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تُحِلُّوا شَعَائِرَ اللَّهِ وَلَا الشَّهْرَ الْحَرَامَ وَلَا الْهَدْيَ وَلَا الْقَلَائِدَ وَلَا آمِّينَ الْبَيْتَ الْحَرَامَ يَبْتَغُونَ فَضْلًا مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ وَرِضْوَانًا ۚ وَإِذَا حَلَلْتُمْ فَاصْطَادُوا ۚ وَلَا يَجْرِمَنَّكُمْ شَنَآنُ قَوْمٍ أَن صَدُّوكُمْ عَنِ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ أَن تَعْتَدُوا ۘ وَتَعَاوَنُوا عَلَى الْبِرِّ وَالتَّقْوَىٰ ۖ وَلَا تَعَاوَنُوا عَلَى الْإِثْمِ وَالْعُدْوَانِ ۚ وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ ۖ إِنَّ اللَّهَ شَدِيدُ الْعِقَابِ
versets.phonetique: Yā ayyuhā lladhīna āmanū lā tuḥillū sha'ā'ira llāhi walā sh-shahra l-ḥarāma walā l-hadya walā l-qalā'ida walā āmmīna l-bayta l-ḥarāma yabtaghūna faḍlan min rabbihim wariḍwānan wa'idhā ḥalaltum faṣṭādū walā yajrimannakum shana'ānu qawmin an ṣaddūkum 'ani l-masjidi l-ḥarāmi an ta'tadū wata'āwanū 'alā l-birri wat-taqwā walā ta'āwanū 'alā l-ithmi wal-'udwāni wattaqū llāha inna llāha shadīdu l-'iqāb
versets.francais: Ô vous qui croyez! Ne profanez pas les rites d'Allah, ni le mois sacré, ni les offrandes, ni les colliers [de ces offrandes], ni ceux qui se rendent à la Maison Sacrée, cherchant la grâce de leur Seigneur et Son agrément. Mais quand vous avez quitté l'état d'ihrâm, vous pouvez chasser. Et que la haine de gens qui vous ont obstrué l'accès à la Mosquée Sacrée ne vous incite pas à transgresser. Entraidez-vous dans l'accomplissement des bonnes œuvres et de la piété et ne vous entraidez pas dans le péché et la transgression. Et craignez Allah, car Allah est sévère en punition.
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, do not violate the rites of Allah or [the sanctity of] the sacred month or [neglect the marking of] the sacrificial animals and garlanding [them] or [violate the safety of] those coming to the Sacred House seeking bounty from their Lord and [His] approval. But when you come out of ihram, then [you may] hunt. And do not let the hatred of a people for having obstructed you from al-Masjid al-Haram lead you to transgress. And cooperate in righteousness and piety, but do not cooperate in sin and aggression. And fear Allah; indeed, Allah is severe in penalty

versets.arabe: حُرِّمَتْ عَلَيْكُمُ الْمَيْتَةُ وَالدَّمُ وَلَحْمُ الْخِنزِيرِ وَمَا أُهِلَّ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهِ بِهِ وَالْمُنْخَنِقَةُ وَالْمَوْقُوذَةُ وَالْمُتَرَدِّيَةُ وَالنَّطِيحَةُ وَمَا أَكَلَ السَّبُعُ إِلَّا مَا ذَكَّيْتُمْ وَمَا ذُبِحَ عَلَى النُّصُبِ وَأَن تَسْتَقْسِمُوا بِالْأَزْلَامِ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ فِسْقٌ ۗ الْيَوْمَ يَئِسَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِن دِينِكُمْ فَلَا تَخْشَوْهُمْ وَاخْشَوْنِ ۚ الْيَوْمَ أَكْمَلْتُ لَكُمْ دِينَكُمْ وَأَتْمَمْتُ عَلَيْكُمْ نِعْمَتِي وَرَضِيتُ لَكُمُ الْإِسْلَامَ دِينًا ۚ فَمَنِ اضْطُرَّ فِي مَخْمَصَةٍ غَيْرَ مُتَجَانِفٍ لِّإِثْمٍ ۙ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Ḥurrimat 'alaykumu l-maytatu wad-damu walaḥmu l-khinzīri wamā uhilla lighayri llāhi bihi wal-munkhaniqatu wal-mawqūdhatu wal-mutaraddiyatu wan-naṭīḥatu wamā akala s-sabu'u illā mā dhakkaytum wamā dhubiḥa 'alā n-nuṣubi wa'an tastaqsimū bil-azlāmi dhālikum fisqun al-yawma ya'isa lladhīna kafarū min dīnikum falā takhshawahum wakhshawni al-yawma akmaltu lakum dīnakum wa'atmamtu 'alaykum ni'matī waraḍītu lakumu l-islāma dīnan famani ḍṭurra fī makhmaṣatin ghayra mutajānifin li'ithmin fa'inna llāha ghafūrun raḥīm
versets.francais: Vous sont interdits: la bête morte, le sang, la viande de porc, ce sur quoi on a invoqué un autre nom qu'Allah, la bête étouffée, la bête assommée, la bête morte d'une chute, la bête morte d'un coup de corne, et celle qu'une bête féroce a dévorée — sauf celle que vous égorgez [avant sa mort] — et ce qui a été abattu sur les pierres dressées; et [il vous est interdit] de tirer au sort au moyen des flèches. Tout cela est perversité. Aujourd'hui les mécréants désespèrent de vous faire abandonner votre religion. Ne les craignez pas et craignez-Moi. Aujourd'hui J'ai parachevé pour vous votre religion, et accompli Sur vous Mon bienfait. Et J'agrée l'Islam comme religion pour vous. Quiconque est contraint par la faim, sans inclination vers le péché, … Allah est certes Pardonneur et Miséricordieux.
versets.anglais: Prohibited to you are dead animals, blood, the flesh of swine, and that which has been dedicated to other than Allah, and [those animals] killed by strangling or by a violent blow or by a head-long fall or by the goring of horns, and those from which a wild animal has eaten, except what you [are able to] slaughter [before its death], and those which are sacrificed on stone altars, and [prohibited is] that you seek decision through divining arrows. That is grave disobedience. This day those who disbelieve have despaired of [defeating] your religion; so fear them not, but fear Me. This day I have perfected for you your religion and completed My favor upon you and have approved for you Islam as religion. But whoever is forced by severe hunger with no inclination to sin - then indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful

versets.arabe: يَسْأَلُونَكَ مَاذَا أُحِلَّ لَهُمْ ۖ قُلْ أُحِلَّ لَكُمُ الطَّيِّبَاتُ ۙ وَمَا عَلَّمْتُم مِّنَ الْجَوَارِحِ مُكَلِّبِينَ تُعَلِّمُونَهُنَّ مِمَّا عَلَّمَكُمُ اللَّهُ ۖ فَكُلُوا مِمَّا أَمْسَكْنَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَاذْكُرُوا اسْمَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ۖ وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَرِيعُ الْحِسَابِ
versets.phonetique: Yas'alūnaka mādhā uḥilla lahum qul uḥilla lakumu ṭ-ṭayyibātu wamā 'allamtum mina l-jawāriḥi mukalibīna tu'allimūnahunna mimmā 'allamakumu llāhu fakulū mimmā amsákna 'alaykum wadhkurū sma llāhi 'alayhi wattaqū llāha inna llāha sarī'u l-ḥisāb
versets.francais: Ils te demandent ce qui leur est permis. Dis: «Vous sont permises les bonnes choses, ainsi que ce que vous avez appris aux bêtes de chasse, en leur apprenant ce qu'Allah vous a appris. Mangez donc ce qu'elles ont attrapé pour vous, et prononcez le nom d'Allah dessus. Et craignez Allah. Allah est certes rapide dans le compte.»
versets.anglais: They ask you, [O Muhammad], what has been made lawful for them. Say, "Lawful for you are [all] good foods and [game caught by] what you have trained of hunting animals which you train as Allah has taught you. So eat of what they catch for you, and mention the name of Allah upon it, and fear Allah." Indeed, Allah is swift in account

versets.arabe: الْيَوْمَ أُحِلَّ لَكُمُ الطَّيِّبَاتُ ۖ وَطَعَامُ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْكِتَابَ حِلٌّ لَّكُمْ وَطَعَامُكُمْ حِلٌّ لَّهُمْ ۖ وَالْمُحْصَنَاتُ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنَاتِ وَالْمُحْصَنَاتُ مِنَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْكِتَابَ مِن قَبْلِكُمْ إِذَا آتَيْتُمُوهُنَّ أُجُورَهُنَّ مُحْصِنِينَ غَيْرَ مُسَافِحِينَ وَلَا مُتَّخِذِي أَخْدَانٍ ۗ وَمَن يَكْفُرْ بِالْإِيمَانِ فَقَدْ حَبِطَ عَمَلُهُ وَهُوَ فِي الْآخِرَةِ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Al-yawma uḥilla lakumu ṭ-ṭayyibātu waṭa'āmu lladhīna ūtū l-kitāba ḥillun lakum waṭa'āmukum ḥillun lahum wal-muḥṣanātu mina l-mu'mināti wal-muḥṣanātu mina lladhīna ūtū l-kitāba min qablikum idhā ātaytumūhunna ujūrahunna muḥṣinīna ghayra musāfiḥīna walā muttakhidhī akhdānin waman yakfur bil-īmāni faqad ḥabiṭa 'amaluhu wahuwa fī l-ākhirati mina l-khāsirīn
versets.francais: Aujourd'hui vous sont permises les bonnes choses. La nourriture de ceux à qui le Livre a été donné vous est licite, et votre nourriture leur est licite. Et [vous sont permises] les femmes chastes d'entre les croyantes, et les femmes chastes d'entre ceux à qui le Livre a été donné avant vous, si vous leur donnez leurs dots, en prenant des épouses légitimes et non en fornicateurs, ni en preneurs d'amantes. Quiconque abjure la foi, ses oeuvres seront vaines et, dans l'au-delà, il sera parmi les perdants.
versets.anglais: This day [all] good foods have been made lawful, and the food of those who were given the Scripture is lawful for you and your food is lawful for them. And [lawful in marriage are] chaste women from among the believers and chaste women from among those who were given the Scripture before you, when you have given them their due compensation, desiring chastity, not unlawful sexual intercourse or taking [secret] lovers. And whoever denies the faith - his work has become worthless, and he, in the Hereafter, will be among the losers

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِذَا قُمْتُمْ إِلَى الصَّلَاةِ فَاغْسِلُوا وُجُوهَكُمْ وَأَيْدِيَكُمْ إِلَى الْمَرَافِقِ وَامْسَحُوا بِرُءُوسِكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُمْ إِلَى الْكَعْبَيْنِ ۚ وَإِن كُنتُمْ جُنُبًا فَاطَّهَّرُوا ۚ وَإِن كُنتُم مَّرْضَىٰ أَوْ عَلَىٰ سَفَرٍ أَوْ جَاءَ أَحَدٌ مِّنكُم مِّنَ الْغَائِطِ أَوْ لَامَسْتُمُ النِّسَاءَ فَلَمْ تَجِدُوا مَاءً فَتَيَمَّمُوا صَعِيدًا طَيِّبًا فَامْسَحُوا بِوُجُوهِكُمْ وَأَيْدِيكُم مِّنْهُ ۚ مَا يُرِيدُ اللَّهُ لِيَجْعَلَ عَلَيْكُم مِّنْ حَرَجٍ وَلَٰكِن يُرِيدُ لِيُطَهِّرَكُمْ وَلِيُتِمَّ نِعْمَتَهُ عَلَيْكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Yā ayyuhā lladhīna āmanū idhā qumtum ilā ṣ-ṣalāti faghsilū wujūhakum wa'aydiyakum ilā l-marāfiqi wamsaḥū biru'ūsikum wa'arjulakum ilā l-ka'bayni wa'in kuntum junuban faṭṭahharū wa'in kuntum marḍā aw 'alā safarin aw jā'a aḥadun minkum mina l-ghā'iṭi aw lāmastumu n-nisā'a falam tajidū mā'an fatayyammamū ṣa'īdan ṭayyiban famsaḥū biwujūhikum wa'aydīkum minhu mā yurīdu llāhu liyaj'ala 'alaykum min ḥarajin walākin yurīdu liyuṭahhirakum waliyutimma ni'matahu 'alaykum la'allakum tashkurūn
versets.francais: Ô vous qui croyez! Quand vous vous levez pour accomplir la prière, lavez vos visages et vos mains jusqu'aux coudes; passez les mains mouillées sur vos têtes, et [lavez] vos pieds jusqu'aux chevilles. Et si vous êtes en état de grande impureté rituelle, purifiez-vous. Et si vous êtes malades, ou en voyage, ou si l'un de vous revient des lieux d'aisance, ou si vous avez touché des femmes et que vous ne trouviez pas d'eau, tayammamez avec du sable pur; frottez-en vos visages et vos mains. Allah ne veut pas vous imposer de gêne, mais Il veut vous purifier et parfaire sur vous Ses bienfaits, afin que vous soyez reconnaissants.
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, when you rise to [perform] prayer, wash your faces and your forearms to the elbows and wipe over your heads and wash your feet to the ankles. And if you are in a state of janabah, then purify yourselves. But if you are ill or on a journey or one of you comes from the place of relieving himself or you have contacted women and do not find water, then seek clean earth and wipe over your faces and hands with it. Allah does not intend to make difficulty for you, but He intends to purify you and complete His favor upon you that you may be grateful
