versets.arabe: وَاذْكُرُوا نِعْمَةَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَمِيثَاقَهُ الَّذِي وَاثَقَكُم بِهِ إِذْ قُلْتُمْ سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا ۖ وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ
versets.phonetique: Wadhkurū ni'mata llāhi 'alaykum wamīthāqahu lladhī wāthaqakum bihi idh qultum sami'nā wa'aṭa'nā wattaqū llāha inna llāha 'alīmun bidhāti ṣ-ṣudūr
versets.francais: Et rappelez-vous le bienfait d'Allah sur vous, et Son pacte par lequel Il vous a liés, quand vous avez dit: «Nous avons entendu et obéi.» Craignez Allah. Certes Allah connaît le contenu des poitrines.
versets.anglais: And remember the favor of Allah upon you and His covenant with which He bound you when you said, "We hear and we obey"; and fear Allah. Indeed, Allah is Knowing of that within the breasts

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا كُونُوا قَوَّامِينَ لِلَّهِ شُهَدَاءَ بِالْقِسْطِ ۖ وَلَا يَجْرِمَنَّكُمْ شَنَآنُ قَوْمٍ عَلَىٰ أَلَّا تَعْدِلُوا ۚ اعْدِلُوا هُوَ أَقْرَبُ لِلتَّقْوَىٰ ۖ وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ خَبِيرٌ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Yā ayyuhā lladhīna āmanū kūnū qawwāmīna lillāhi shuhadā'a bil-qisṭi walā yajrimannakum shana'ānu qawmin 'alā allā ta'dilū i'dilū huwa aqrabu lit-taqwā wattaqū llāha inna llāha khabīrun bimā ta'malūn
versets.francais: Ô vous qui croyez! Soyez stricts dans vos devoirs envers Allah et témoignez avec équité. Et que la haine de tout un peuple ne vous incite pas à être inéquitables. Soyez équitables; cela est plus proche de la piété. Et craignez Allah. Certes Allah est Parfaitement Connaisseur de ce que vous faites.
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, be persistently standing firm for Allah, witnesses in justice, and do not let the hatred of a people prevent you from being just. Be just; that is nearer to righteousness. And fear Allah; indeed, Allah is Acquainted with what you do

versets.arabe: وَعَدَ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ ۙ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَأَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa'ada llāhu lladhīna āmanū wa'amilū ṣ-ṣāliḥāti lahum maghfiratun wa'ajrun 'aẓīm
versets.francais: Allah a promis à ceux qui croient et accomplissent les bonnes œuvres: pardon et énorme récompense.
versets.anglais: Allah has promised those who believe and do righteous deeds [that] for them there is forgiveness and great reward

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَكَذَّبُوا بِآيَاتِنَا أُولَٰئِكَ أَصْحَابُ الْجَحِيمِ
versets.phonetique: Walladhīna kafarū wakadhdhabū bi'āyātinā ulā'ika aṣḥābu l-jaḥīm
versets.francais: Et ceux qui ne croient pas et traitent Nos signes de mensonge, voilà les gens de l'Enfer.
versets.anglais: But those who disbelieve and deny Our signs - those are the companions of Hellfire

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اذْكُرُوا نِعْمَتَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ إِذْ هَمَّ قَوْمٌ أَن يَبْسُطُوا إِلَيْكُمْ أَيْدِيَهُمْ فَكَفَّ أَيْدِيَهُمْ عَنكُمْ ۖ وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ ۚ وَعَلَى اللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ
versets.phonetique: Yā ayyuhā lladhīna āmanū dhkurū ni'mata llāhi 'alaykum idh hamma qawmun an yabsuṭū ilaykum aydiyahum fakaffa aydiyahum 'ankum wattaqū llāha wa'alā llāhi falyatawakkali l-mu'minūn
versets.francais: Ô vous qui croyez! Rappelez-vous le bienfait d'Allah sur vous, quand des gens ont voulu étendre leurs mains sur vous et qu'Il a retenu leurs mains loin de vous. Et craignez Allah. C'est en Allah que les croyants doivent se confier.
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, remember the favor of Allah upon you when a people determined to extend their hands [in aggression] against you, but He withheld their hands from you; and fear Allah. And upon Allah let the believers rely

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ أَخَذَ اللَّهُ مِيثَاقَ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ وَبَعَثْنَا مِنهُمُ اثْنَيْ عَشَرَ نَقِيبًا ۖ وَقَالَ اللَّهُ إِنِّي مَعَكُمْ ۖ لَئِنْ أَقَمْتُمُ الصَّلَاةَ وَآتَيْتُمُ الزَّكَاةَ وَآمَنتُم بِرُسُلِي وَعَزَّرْتُمُوهُمْ وَأَقْرَضْتُمُ اللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا لَّأُكَفِّرَنَّ عَنكُمْ سَيِّئَاتِكُمْ وَلَأُدْخِلَنَّكُمْ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ
versets.phonetique: Walaqad akhadha llāhu mīthāqa banī isrā'īla waba'athnā minhumu thnayn 'ashara naqīban waqāla llāhu innī ma'akum la'in aqamtumu ṣ-ṣalāta wa'ātaytumu z-zakāta wa'āmantum birusulī wa'azzartumūhum wa'aqraḍtumu llāha qarḍan ḥasanan la'ukaffiranna 'ankum sayyi'ātikum wala'udkhilannakum jannātin tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru
versets.francais: Et certes, Allah avait pris le pacte des fils d'Israël, et Nous avions désigné parmi eux douze chefs. Allah dit: «Je suis avec vous, si vous accomplissez la Salât, acquittez la Zakât, croyez en Mes messagers, leur portez secours, et accordez à Allah un prêt sincère, J'effacerai vos méfaits et vous ferai entrer dans des jardins sous lesquels coulent les ruisseaux.»
versets.anglais: And Allah had already taken a covenant from the Children of Israel, and We delegated from among them twelve leaders. And Allah said, "I am with you. If you establish prayer and give zakah and believe in My messengers and support them and loan Allah a goodly loan, I will surely remove from you your misdeeds and admit you to gardens beneath which rivers flow. But whoever of you disbelieves after that has certainly strayed from the soundness of the way

versets.arabe: فَبِمَا نَقْضِهِم مِّيثَاقَهُمْ لَعَنَّاهُمْ وَجَعَلْنَا قُلُوبَهُمْ قَاسِيَةً ۖ يُحَرِّفُونَ الْكَلِمَ عَن مَّوَاضِعِهِ ۙ وَنَسُوا حَظًّا مِّمَّا ذُكِّرُوا بِهِ ۚ وَلَا تَزَالُ تَطَّلِعُ عَلَىٰ خَائِنَةٍ مِّنْهُمْ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا مِّنْهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Fabimā naqḍihim mīthāqahum la'annāhum waja'alnā qulūbahum qāsiyatan yuḥarrifūna l-kalima 'an mawāḍi'ihi wanasū ḥaẓẓan mimmā dhukkiru bihi walā tazālu taṭṭali'u 'alā khā'inatin minhum illā qalīlan minhum
versets.francais: Mais à cause de la violation de leur pacte, Nous les avons maudits et endurci leurs cœurs. Ils détournent les paroles de leur sens, et ont oublié une partie de ce qui leur avait été rappelé. Tu ne cesseras de découvrir leur trahison, sauf chez un petit nombre d'entre eux.
versets.anglais: So for their breaking of the covenant We cursed them and made their hearts hard. They distort words from their [proper] usages and have forgotten a portion of that of which they were reminded. And you will still observe deceit among them, except a few of them. But pardon them and overlook [their misdeeds]. Indeed, Allah loves the doers of good

versets.arabe: وَمِنَ الَّذِينَ قَالُوا إِنَّا نَصَارَىٰ أَخَذْنَا مِيثَاقَهُمْ فَنَسُوا حَظًّا مِّمَّا ذُكِّرُوا بِهِ فَأَغْرَيْنَا بَيْنَهُمُ الْعَدَاوَةَ وَالْبَغْضَاءَ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ ۚ وَسَوْفَ يُنَبِّئُهُمُ اللَّهُ بِمَا كَانُوا يَصْنَعُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wamina lladhīna qālū innā naṣārā akhadhnā mīthāqahum fanasū ḥaẓẓan mimmā dhukkiru bihi fa'aghraynā baynahumu l-'adāwata wal-baghḍā'a ilā yawmi l-qiyāmati wasawfa yunabbi'uhumu llāhu bimā kānū yaṣna'ūn
versets.francais: Et Nous avons aussi pris le pacte de ceux qui disent: «Nous sommes Chrétiens.» Mais ils ont oublié une partie de ce qui leur avait été rappelé. Nous avons alors attisé entre eux l'inimitié et la haine jusqu'au Jour de la Résurrection. Allah les informera de ce qu'ils faisaient.
versets.anglais: And from those who say, "We are Christians" We took their covenant; but they forgot a portion of that of which they were reminded. So We caused among them animosity and hatred until the Day of Resurrection. And Allah is going to inform them about what they used to do

versets.arabe: يَا أَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ قَدْ جَاءَكُمْ رَسُولُنَا يُبَيِّنُ لَكُمْ كَثِيرًا مِّمَّا كُنتُمْ تُخْفُونَ مِنَ الْكِتَابِ وَيَعْفُو عَن كَثِيرٍ ۚ قَدْ جَاءَكُم مِّنَ اللَّهِ نُورٌ وَكِتَابٌ مُّبِينٌ
versets.phonetique: Yā ahla l-kitābi qad jā'akum rasūlunā yubayyinu lakum kathīran mimmā kuntum tukhfūna mina l-kitābi waya'fū 'an kathīrin qad jā'akum mina llāhi nūrun wakitābun mubīn
versets.francais: Ô gens du Livre! Notre Messager vous est venu vous exposant beaucoup de ce que vous cachiez du Livre, et effaçant beaucoup de choses. Il vous est certes venu d'Allah une lumière et un Livre explicite.
versets.anglais: O People of the Scripture, there has come to you Our Messenger making clear to you much of what you used to conceal of the Scripture and overlooking much. There has come to you from Allah a light and a clear Book

versets.arabe: يَهْدِي بِهِ اللَّهُ مَنِ اتَّبَعَ رِضْوَانَهُ سُبُلَ السَّلَامِ وَيُخْرِجُهُم مِّنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النُّورِ بِإِذْنِهِ وَيَهْدِيهِمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
versets.phonetique: Yahdī bihi llāhu mani ttaba'a riḍwānahu subula s-salāmi wayukhrijuhum mina ẓ-ẓulumāti ilā n-nūri bi'idhnihi wayahdīhim ilā ṣirāṭin mustaqīm
versets.francais: Par ce Livre, Allah guide vers les voies de la paix quiconque cherche Son agrément, et Il les fait sortir, par Sa permission, des ténèbres vers la lumière, et Il les guide vers un droit chemin.
versets.anglais: By which Allah guides those who pursue His pleasure to the ways of peace and brings them out from darknesses into the light, by His permission, and guides them to a straight path

versets.arabe: لَّقَدْ كَفَرَ الَّذِينَ قَالُوا إِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْمَسِيحُ ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ ۚ قُلْ فَمَن يَمْلِكُ مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا إِنْ أَرَادَ أَن يُهْلِكَ الْمَسِيحَ ابْنَ مَرْيَمَ وَأُمَّهُ وَمَن فِي الْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا ۗ وَلِلَّهِ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ۚ يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَاءُ ۚ وَاللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
versets.phonetique: Laqad kafara lladhīna qālū inna llāha huwa l-masīḥu bnu maryama qul faman yamliku mina llāhi shay'an in arāda an yuhliká l-masīḥa bna maryama wa'ummahu waman fī l-arḍi jamī'an walillāhi mulku s-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā yakhluqu mā yashā'u wallāhu 'alā kulli shay'in qadīr
versets.francais: Certes, ils ont mécru, ceux qui ont dit: «Allah est le Messie, fils de Marie.» Dis: «Qui donc peut quelque chose contre Allah, s'Il voulait faire périr le Messie, fils de Marie, sa mère et tous ceux qui sont sur la terre?» A Allah appartient la royauté des cieux, de la terre et de tout ce qui est entre eux. Il crée ce qu'Il veut. Et Allah est Omnipotent.
versets.anglais: They have certainly disbelieved who say that Allah is Christ, the son of Mary. Say, "Then who could prevent Allah at all if He had intended to destroy Christ, the son of Mary, or his mother or everyone on the earth?" And to Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them. He creates what He wills, and Allah is over all things competent

versets.arabe: وَقَالَتِ الْيَهُودُ وَالنَّصَارَىٰ نَحْنُ أَبْنَاءُ اللَّهِ وَأَحِبَّاؤُهُ ۚ قُلْ فَلِمَ يُعَذِّبُكُم بِذُنُوبِكُم ۖ بَلْ أَنتُم بَشَرٌ مِّمَّنْ خَلَقَ ۚ يَغْفِرُ لِمَن يَشَاءُ وَيُعَذِّبُ مَن يَشَاءُ ۚ وَلِلَّهِ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ۖ وَإِلَيْهِ الْمَصِيرُ
versets.phonetique: Waqālati l-yahūdu wan-naṣārā naḥnu abnā'u llāhi wa'aḥibbā'uhu qul falima yu'adhdhibukum bidhunūbikum bal antum basharun mimman khalaqa yaghfiru liman yashā'u wayu'adhdhibu man yashā'u walillāhi mulku s-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā wa'ilayhi l-maṣīr
versets.francais: Les Juifs et les Chrétiens ont dit: «Nous sommes les fils d'Allah et Ses bien-aimés.» Dis: «Pourquoi donc vous châtie-t-Il pour vos péchés?» Mais non, vous êtes des humains parmi ceux qu'Il a créés. Il pardonne à qui Il veut et châtie qui Il veut. Et c'est à Allah qu'appartient la royauté des cieux et de la terre et de tout ce qui est entre eux, et c'est à Lui que sera le retour final.
versets.anglais: But the Jews and the Christians say, "We are the children of Allah and His beloved." Say, "Then why does He punish you for your sins?" Rather, you are human beings from among those He has created. He forgives whom He wills, and He punishes whom He wills. And to Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, and to Him is the [final] destination

versets.arabe: يَا أَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ قَدْ جَاءَكُمْ رَسُولُنَا يُبَيِّنُ لَكُمْ عَلَىٰ فَتْرَةٍ مِّنَ الرُّسُلِ أَن تَقُولُوا مَا جَاءَنَا مِن بَشِيرٍ وَلَا نَذِيرٍ ۖ فَقَدْ جَاءَكُم بَشِيرٌ وَنَذِيرٌ ۗ وَاللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
versets.phonetique: Yā ahla l-kitābi qad jā'akum rasūlunā yubayyinu lakum 'alā fatratim mina r-rusuli an taqūlū mā jā'anā min bashīrin walā nadhīrin faqad jā'akum bashīrun wanadhīrun wallāhu 'alā kulli shay'in qadīr
versets.francais: Ô gens du Livre! Notre Messager vous est venu après une interruption dans la série des messagers, pour vous exposer les choses de peur que vous ne disiez: «Il ne nous est pas venu d'annonciateur et d'avertisseur.» Et voilà qu'un annonciateur et un avertisseur vous est venu. Et Allah est Omnipotent.
versets.anglais: O People of the Scripture, there has come to you Our Messenger to make clear to you [the religion] after a period [of suspension] of messengers, lest you say, "There came not to us any bringer of good tidings or a warner." But there has come to you a bringer of good tidings and a warner. And Allah is over all things competent

versets.arabe: وَإِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِقَوْمِهِ يَا قَوْمِ اذْكُرُوا نِعْمَةَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ إِذْ جَعَلَ فِيكُمْ أَنبِيَاءَ وَجَعَلَكُم مُّلُوكًا وَآتَاكُم مَّا لَمْ يُؤْتِ أَحَدًا مِّنَ الْعَالَمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa'idh qāla mūsā liqawmihi yā qawmi dhkurū ni'mata llāhi 'alaykum idh ja'ala fīkum anbiyā'a waja'alakum mulūkan wa'ātākum mā lam yu'ti aḥadan mina l-'ālamīn
versets.francais: Et [rappelle-leur] quand Moïse dit à son peuple: «Ô mon peuple! Rappelez-vous le bienfait d'Allah sur vous quand Il a placé parmi vous des prophètes, et fait de vous des rois, et vous a accordé ce qu'Il n'a accordé à personne d'autre dans l'univers.»
versets.anglais: And [mention, O Muhammad], when Moses said to his people, "O my people, remember the favor of Allah upon you when He appointed among you prophets and made you possessors and gave you that which He had not given anyone among the worlds

versets.arabe: يَا قَوْمِ ادْخُلُوا الْأَرْضَ الْمُقَدَّسَةَ الَّتِي كَتَبَ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ وَلَا تَرْتَدُّوا عَلَىٰ أَدْبَارِكُمْ فَتَنقَلِبُوا خَاسِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Yā qawmi dkhulū l-arḍa l-muqaddasata llatī kataba llāhu lakum walā tartaddū 'alā adbārikum fatanqalibū khāsirīn
versets.francais: «Ô mon peuple! Entrez dans la Terre Sainte qu'Allah vous a destinée, et ne rebroussez pas chemin, sinon vous vous retrouverez perdants.»
versets.anglais: O my people, enter the Holy Land which Allah has assigned to you and do not turn back [from fighting in Allah 's cause] and [thus] become losers

versets.arabe: قَالُوا يَا مُوسَىٰ إِنَّ فِيهَا قَوْمًا جَبَّارِينَ وَإِنَّا لَن نَّدْخُلَهَا حَتَّىٰ يَخْرُجُوا مِنْهَا فَإِن يَخْرُجُوا مِنْهَا فَإِنَّا دَاخِلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qālū yā mūsā inna fīhā qawman jabbārīna wa'innā lan nadkhulahā ḥattā yakhrujū minhā fa'in yakhrujū minhā fa'innā dākhilūn
versets.francais: Ils dirent: «Ô Moïse! Il y a là des gens très puissants, et nous n'y entrerons pas tant qu'ils n'en sont pas sortis. S'ils en sortent, alors nous y entrerons.»
versets.anglais: They said, "O Moses, indeed within it is a people of tyrannical strength, and indeed, we will never enter it until they leave it; but if they leave it, then we will enter

versets.arabe: قَالَ رَجُلَانِ مِنَ الَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ أَنْعَمَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمَا ادْخُلُوا عَلَيْهِمُ الْبَابَ فَإِذَا دَخَلْتُمُوهُ فَإِنَّكُمْ غَالِبُونَ ۚ وَعَلَى اللَّهِ فَتَوَكَّلُوا إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qāla rajulāni mina lladhīna yakhāfūna an'ama llāhu 'alayhimā dkhulū 'alayhimu l-bāba fa'idhā dakhaltumūhu fa'innakum ghālibūna wa'alā llāhi fatawakkalū in kuntum mu'minīn
versets.francais: Deux hommes parmi ceux qui craignaient Allah et sur lesquels Allah avait accordé Ses bienfaits dirent: «Entrez par la porte sur eux; dès que vous y serez entrés vous serez victorieux. Et en Allah fiez-vous, si vous êtes croyants.»
versets.anglais: Said two men from those who feared [to disobey] upon whom Allah had bestowed favor, "Enter upon them through the gate, for when you have entered it, you will be predominant. And upon Allah rely, if you should be believers

versets.arabe: قَالُوا يَا مُوسَىٰ إِنَّا لَن نَّدْخُلَهَا أَبَدًا مَّا دَامُوا فِيهَا ۖ فَاذْهَبْ أَنتَ وَرَبُّكَ فَقَاتِلَا إِنَّا هَاهُنَا قَاعِدُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qālū yā mūsā innā lan nadkhulahā abadan mā dāmū fīhā fadhab anta wa'rabbuka faqātilā innā hāhunā qā'idūn
versets.francais: Ils dirent: «Ô Moïse! Nous n'y entrerons jamais, tant qu'ils y seront. Va donc toi et ton Seigneur faire la guerre; nous restons ici assis.»
versets.anglais: They said, "O Moses, indeed we will not enter it, ever, as long as they are within it; so go, you and your Lord, and fight. Indeed, we are remaining right here

versets.arabe: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّي لَا أَمْلِكُ إِلَّا نَفْسِي وَأَخِي ۖ فَافْرُقْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ الْقَوْمِ الْفَاسِقِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qāla rabbi innī lā amliku illā nafsī wa'akhī fafruq baynanā wabayna l-qawmi l-fāsiqīn
versets.francais: Il dit: «Seigneur, je ne dispose que de moi-même et de mon frère. Sépare-nous donc de ce peuple pervers.»
versets.anglais: [Moses] said, "My Lord, indeed I do not possess except myself and my brother, so part us from the defiantly disobedient people

versets.arabe: قَالَ فَإِنَّهَا مُحَرَّمَةٌ عَلَيْهِمْ ۛ أَرْبَعِينَ سَنَةً ۛ يَتِيهُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ ۚ فَلَا تَأْسَ عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْفَاسِقِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qāla fa'innahā muḥarramatun 'alayhim arba'īna sanatan yatīhūna fī l-arḍi falā ta'sa 'alā l-qawmi l-fāsiqīn
versets.francais: Il dit: «Elle leur sera donc interdite quarante ans. Ils erreront sur la terre. Ne te chagrine donc pas à cause du peuple pervers.»
versets.anglais: [Allah] said, "Then indeed, it is forbidden to them for forty years [in which] they will wander throughout the land. So do not grieve over the defiantly disobedient people

versets.arabe: وَاتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ ابْنَيْ آدَمَ بِالْحَقِّ إِذْ قَرَّبَا قُرْبَانًا فَتُقُبِّلَ مِنْ أَحَدِهِمَا وَلَمْ يُتَقَبَّلْ مِنَ الْآخَرِ قَالَ لَأَقْتُلَنَّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَتَقَبَّلُ اللَّهُ مِنَ الْمُتَّقِينَ
versets.phonetique: Watlū 'alayhim naba'a bnay ādam bil-ḥaqqi idh qarrabā qurbānan fataqubbila min aḥadihimā walam yutaqabbal mina l-ākhara qāla la'aqtulannaka qāla innamā yataqabbalu llāhu mina l-muttaqīn
versets.francais: Et récite-leur en toute vérité la nouvelle des deux fils d'Adam: ils firent tous deux une offrande; elle fut acceptée de l'un et non de l'autre. Celui-ci dit: «Je te tuerai certainement.» L'autre dit: «Allah n'accepte que de la part des pieux.»
versets.anglais: And recite to them the story of Adam's two sons, in truth, when they both offered a sacrifice [to Allah], and it was accepted from one of them but was not accepted from the other. Said [the latter], "I will surely kill you." Said [the former], "Indeed, Allah only accepts from the righteous [who fear Him]

versets.arabe: لَئِن بَسَطتَ إِلَيَّ يَدَكَ لِتَقْتُلَنِي مَا أَنَا بِبَاسِطٍ يَدِيَ إِلَيْكَ لِأَقْتُلَكَ ۖ إِنِّي أَخَافُ اللَّهَ رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ
versets.phonetique: La'in basaṭta ilayya yadaka litaqtulanī mā ana bibāsiṭin yadiya ilayka li'aqtulaka innī akhāfu llāha rabba l-'ālamīn
versets.francais: «Si tu étends ta main vers moi pour me tuer, moi je n'étendrai pas ma main vers toi pour te tuer, car je crains Allah, le Seigneur de l'univers.»
versets.anglais: If you should raise your hand against me to kill me - I shall not raise my hand against you to kill you. Indeed, I fear Allah, Lord of the worlds

versets.arabe: إِنِّي أُرِيدُ أَن تَبُوءَ بِإِثْمِي وَإِثْمِكَ فَتَكُونَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّارِ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ جَزَاءُ الظَّالِمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Innī urīdu an tabū'a bi'ithmī wa'ithmika fatakunā min aṣḥābi n-nāri wadhālika jazā'u ẓ-ẓālimīn
versets.francais: «Je veux que tu te charges de mon péché et du tien, pour que tu deviennes de la gent du Feu. Telle est la rétribution des injustes.»
versets.anglais: Indeed I want you to obtain [thereby] my sin and your sin so you will be among the companions of the Fire. And that is the recompense of wrongdoers

versets.arabe: فَطَوَّعَتْ لَهُ نَفْسُهُ قَتْلَ أَخِيهِ فَقَتَلَهُ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Faṭawwa'at lahū nafsuhu qatla akhīhi faqatalahu fa'aṣbaḥa mina l-khāsirīn
versets.francais: Alors son âme l'incita à tuer son frère, il le tua donc, et il devint ainsi de ceux qui perdent.
versets.anglais: And his soul permitted to him the murder of his brother, so he killed him and became among the losers

versets.arabe: فَبَعَثَ اللَّهُ غُرَابًا يَبْحَثُ فِي الْأَرْضِ لِيُرِيَهُ كَيْفَ يُوَارِي سَوْءَةَ أَخِيهِ ۚ قَالَ يَا وَيْلَتَا أَعَجَزْتُ أَنْ أَكُونَ مِثْلَ هَٰذَا الْغُرَابِ فَأُوَارِيَ سَوْءَةَ أَخِي ۖ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ النَّادِمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Faba'atha llāhu ghurāban yabḥathu fī l-arḍi liyuriyahu kayfa yuwārī saw'ata akhīhi qāla yā waylatā a'ajaztu an akūna mithla hādhā l-ghurābi fa'uwāriya saw'ata akhī fa'aṣbaḥa mina n-nādimīn
versets.francais: Allah envoya alors un corbeau qui grattait la terre pour lui montrer comment ensevelir le cadavre de son frère. Il dit: «Malheur à moi! Suis-je incapable d'être comme ce corbeau et d'ensevelir le cadavre de mon frère?» Il devint alors plein de regrets.
versets.anglais: Then Allah sent a crow searching in the ground to show him how to hide the disgrace of his brother. He said, "O woe to me! Have I failed to be like this crow and hide the body of my brother?" And he became of the regretful

versets.arabe: مِنْ أَجْلِ ذَٰلِكَ كَتَبْنَا عَلَىٰ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ أَنَّهُ مَن قَتَلَ نَفْسًا بِغَيْرِ نَفْسٍ أَوْ فَسَادٍ فِي الْأَرْضِ فَكَأَنَّمَا قَتَلَ النَّاسَ جَمِيعًا وَمَنْ أَحْيَاهَا فَكَأَنَّمَا أَحْيَا النَّاسَ جَمِيعًا
versets.phonetique: Min ajli dhālika katabnā 'alā banī isrā'īla annahu man qatala nafsan bighayri nafsin aw fasādin fī l-arḍi faka'annamā qatala n-nāsa jamī'an waman aḥyāhā faka'annamā aḥyā n-nāsa jamī'ā
versets.francais: C'est pourquoi Nous avons prescrit pour les fils d'Israël que quiconque tuerait une personne non coupable d'un meurtre ou d'une corruption sur la terre, c'est comme s'il avait tué tous les hommes. Et quiconque lui fait don de la vie, c'est comme s'il faisait don de la vie à tous les hommes.
versets.anglais: Because of that, We decreed upon the Children of Israel that whoever kills a soul unless for a soul or for corruption [done] in the land - it is as if he had slain mankind entirely. And whoever saves one - it is as if he had saved mankind entirely. And our messengers had certainly come to them with clear proofs. Then indeed many of them, [even] after that, throughout the land, were transgressors

versets.arabe: إِنَّمَا جَزَاءُ الَّذِينَ يُحَارِبُونَ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَيَسْعَوْنَ فِي الْأَرْضِ فَسَادًا أَن يُقَتَّلُوا أَوْ يُصَلَّبُوا أَوْ تُقَطَّعَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَأَرْجُلُهُم مِّنْ خِلَافٍ أَوْ يُنفَوْا مِنَ الْأَرْضِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ لَهُمْ خِزْيٌ فِي الدُّنْيَا ۖ وَلَهُمْ فِي الْآخِرَةِ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Innamā jazā'u lladhīna yuḥāribūna llāha warasūlahu waysa'awna fī l-arḍi fasādan an yuqattalū aw yuṣallabū aw tuqaṭṭa'a aydīhim wa'arjuluhum min khilāfin aw yunfaw mina l-arḍi dhālika lahum khizyun fī d-dunyā walahum fī l-ākhirati 'adhābun 'aẓīm
versets.francais: Ceux qui font la guerre à Allah et à Son messager et qui s'efforcent de semer la corruption sur la terre: leur rétribution sera qu'ils soient tués ou crucifiés, qu'on leur coupe la main et le pied opposés, ou qu'ils soient expulsés du pays. Ce sera pour eux un déshonneur ici-bas, et dans l'au-delà ils auront un énorme châtiment,
versets.anglais: Indeed, the penalty for those who wage war against Allah and His Messenger and strive upon earth [to cause] corruption is none but that they be killed or crucified or that their hands and feet be cut off from opposite sides or that they be exiled from the land. That is for them a disgrace in this world; and for them in the Hereafter is a great punishment

versets.arabe: إِلَّا الَّذِينَ تَابُوا مِن قَبْلِ أَن تَقْدِرُوا عَلَيْهِمْ ۖ فَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Illā lladhīna tābū min qabli an taqdirū 'alayhim fa'lamū anna llāha ghafūrun raḥīm
versets.francais: sauf ceux qui se repentent avant que vous ayez le pouvoir sur eux: sache qu'Allah est Pardonneur et Miséricordieux.
versets.anglais: Except for those who return [repenting] before you apprehend them. And know that Allah is Forgiving and Merciful

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَابْتَغُوا إِلَيْهِ الْوَسِيلَةَ وَجَاهِدُوا فِي سَبِيلِهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
versets.phonetique: Yā ayyuhā lladhīna āmanū ttaqū llāha wabtaghū ilayhi l-wasīlata wajāhidū fī sabīlihi la'allakum tufliḥūn
versets.francais: Ô vous qui croyez! Craignez Allah; cherchez le moyen de vous rapprocher de Lui et luttez dans Son chemin afin que vous réussissiez.
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, fear Allah and seek the means [of nearness] to Him and strive in His cause that you may succeed

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَوْ أَنَّ لَهُم مَّا فِي الْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا وَمِثْلَهُ مَعَهُ لِيَفْتَدُوا بِهِ مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ مَا تُقُبِّلَ مِنْهُمْ ۖ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Inna lladhīna kafarū law anna lahum mā fī l-arḍi jamī'an wamithlahu ma'ahu layaftadū bihi min 'adhābi yawmi l-qiyāmati mā tuqubbila minhum walahum 'adhābun alīm
versets.francais: Quant à ceux qui ne croient pas, quand bien même ils disposeraient de tout ce qui est sur la terre, et de tout autant encore, pour se racheter du châtiment du Jour de la Résurrection, rien ne leur sera accepté, et ils auront un châtiment douloureux.
versets.anglais: Indeed, those who disbelieve - if they should have all that is in the earth and the like of it with it by which to ransom themselves from the punishment of the Day of Resurrection, it will not be accepted from them, and for them is a painful punishment

versets.arabe: يُرِيدُونَ أَن يَخْرُجُوا مِنَ النَّارِ وَمَا هُم بِخَارِجِينَ مِنْهَا ۖ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مُّقِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Yurīdūna an yakhrujū mina n-nāri wamā hum bikhārijīna minhā walahum 'adhābun muqīm
versets.francais: Ils voudront sortir du Feu; mais ils n'en sortiront pas. Et ils auront un châtiment permanent.
versets.anglais: They will wish to get out of the Fire, but never are they to emerge therefrom, and for them is an enduring punishment

versets.arabe: وَالسَّارِقُ وَالسَّارِقَةُ فَاقْطَعُوا أَيْدِيَهُمَا جَزَاءً بِمَا كَسَبَا نَكَالًا مِّنَ اللَّهِ ۗ وَاللَّهُ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Wass-sāriqu was-sāriqatu faqṭa'ū aydiyahumā jazā'an bimā kasabā nakālan mina llāhi wallāhu 'azīzun ḥakīm
versets.francais: Au voleur et à la voleuse, coupez les mains, en rétribution de ce qu'ils ont commis, et comme punition exemplaire de la part d'Allah. Allah est Puissant et Sage.
versets.anglais: [As for] the thief, the male and the female, amputate their hands in recompense for what they committed as a deterrent [punishment] from Allah. And Allah is Exalted in Might and Wise

versets.arabe: فَمَن تَابَ مِن بَعْدِ ظُلْمِهِ وَأَصْلَحَ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ يَتُوبُ عَلَيْهِ ۗ إِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Faman tāba min ba'di ẓulmihi wa'aṣlaḥa fa'inna llāha yatūbu 'alayhi inna llāha ghafūrun raḥīm
versets.francais: Quiconque se repent après son injustice et se réforme, Allah accepte son repentir. Certes Allah est Pardonneur et Miséricordieux.
versets.anglais: But whoever repents after his wrongdoing and reforms, indeed, Allah will turn to him in forgiveness. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful

versets.arabe: أَلَمْ تَعْلَمْ أَنَّ اللَّهَ لَهُ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ يُعَذِّبُ مَن يَشَاءُ وَيَغْفِرُ لِمَن يَشَاءُ ۗ وَاللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
versets.phonetique: Alam ta'lam anna llāha lahū mulku s-samāwāti wal-arḍi yu'adhdhibu man yashā'u wayaghfiru liman yashā'u wallāhu 'alā kulli shay'in qadīr
versets.francais: Ne sais-tu pas qu'à Allah appartient la royauté des cieux et de la terre? Il châtie qui Il veut et pardonne à qui Il veut. Et Allah est Omnipotent.
versets.anglais: Do you not know that to Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth? He punishes whom He wills and forgives whom He wills, and Allah is over all things competent

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الرَّسُولُ لَا يَحْزُنكَ الَّذِينَ يُسَارِعُونَ فِي الْكُفْرِ مِنَ الَّذِينَ قَالُوا آمَنَّا بِأَفْوَاهِهِمْ وَلَمْ تُؤْمِن قُلُوبُهُمْ ۛ وَمِنَ الَّذِينَ هَادُوا ۛ سَمَّاعُونَ لِلْكَذِبِ سَمَّاعُونَ لِقَوْمٍ آخَرِينَ لَمْ يَأْتُوكَ
versets.phonetique: Yā ayyuhā r-rasūlu lā yaḥzunka lladhīna yusāri'ūna fī l-kufri mina lladhīna qālū āmannā bi'afwāhihim walam tu'min qulūbuhum wamina lladhīna hādū sammā'ūna lil-kadhib sammā'ūna liqawmin ākharīna lam ya'tūk
versets.francais: Ô Messager! Que ne t'attristent pas ceux qui s'empressent dans l'incroyance, parmi ceux qui disent «nous avons cru» de leurs bouches, alors que leurs cœurs ne croient pas, et parmi les Juifs: ils écoutent le mensonge, ils prêtent l'oreille à d'autres gens qui ne sont pas venus à toi.
versets.anglais: O Messenger, let them not grieve you who hasten into disbelief of those who say, "We believe" with their mouths, but their hearts believe not, and from among the Jews. [They are] avid listeners to falsehood, listening to another people who have not come to you. They distort words beyond their [proper] usages, saying "If you are given this, take it; but if you are not given it, then beware." But he for whom Allah intends fitnah - never will you possess [power to do] for him a thing against Allah. Those are the ones for whom Allah does not intend to purify their hearts. For them in this world is disgrace, and for them in the Hereafter is a great punishment

versets.arabe: سَمَّاعُونَ لِلْكَذِبِ أَكَّالُونَ لِلسُّحْتِ ۚ فَإِن جَاءُوكَ فَاحْكُم بَيْنَهُمْ أَوْ أَعْرِضْ عَنْهُمْ ۖ وَإِن تُعْرِضْ عَنْهُمْ فَلَن يَضُرُّوكَ شَيْئًا ۖ وَإِنْ حَكَمْتَ فَاحْكُم بَيْنَهُم بِالْقِسْطِ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْمُقْسِطِينَ
versets.phonetique: Sammā'ūna lil-kadhib akkālūna lis-suḥt fa'in jā'ūka faḥkum baynahum aw a'riḍ 'anhum wa'in tu'riḍ 'anhum falan yaḍurrūka shay'an wa'in ḥakamta faḥkum baynahum bil-qisṭi inna llāha yuḥibbu l-muqsiṭīn
versets.francais: Ils écoutent le mensonge et dévorent les gains illicites. S'ils viennent à toi, juge entre eux ou bien détourne-toi d'eux. Si tu te détournes d'eux, ils ne te causeront aucun préjudice. Mais si tu juges, juge entre eux avec équité. Certes Allah aime les équitables.
versets.anglais: [They are] avid listeners to falsehood, devourers of [what is] unlawful. So if they come to you, [O Muhammad], judge between them or turn away from them. And if you turn away from them - never will they harm you at all. And if you judge, judge between them with justice. Indeed, Allah loves those who act justly

versets.arabe: وَكَيْفَ يُحَكِّمُونَكَ وَعِندَهُمُ التَّوْرَاةُ فِيهَا حُكْمُ اللَّهِ ثُمَّ يَتَوَلَّوْنَ مِن بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ ۚ وَمَا أُولَٰئِكَ بِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wakayfa yuḥakkimūnaka wa'indahumu t-tawrātu fīhā ḥukmu llāhi thumma yatawallawna min ba'di dhālik wamā ulā'ika bil-mu'minīn
versets.francais: Et comment te demandent-ils de juger, alors qu'ils ont la Torah contenant le jugement d'Allah? Malgré cela, ils se détournent [de toi]. Ceux-là ne sont pas des croyants.
versets.anglais: But how is it that they come to you for judgement while they have the Torah, in which is the judgement of Allah? Then they turn away, [even] after that; but those are not [in fact] believers

versets.arabe: إِنَّا أَنزَلْنَا التَّوْرَاةَ فِيهَا هُدًى وَنُورٌ ۚ يَحْكُمُ بِهَا النَّبِيُّونَ الَّذِينَ أَسْلَمُوا لِلَّذِينَ هَادُوا وَالرَّبَّانِيُّونَ وَالْأَحْبَارُ بِمَا اسْتُحْفِظُوا مِن كِتَابِ اللَّهِ وَكَانُوا عَلَيْهِ شُهَدَاءَ
versets.phonetique: Innā anzalnā t-tawrāta fīhā hudan wanūrun yaḥkumu bihā n-nabiyyūna lladhīna aslamū lil-ladhīna hādū war-rabbāniyyūna wal-aḥbāru bimā stuḥfiẓū min kitābi llāhi wakānū 'alayhi shuhadā'
versets.francais: Certes Nous avons fait descendre la Torah, dans laquelle il y a guide et lumière. C'est d'après cela que les prophètes soumis [à Allah] jugeaient les Juifs, de même que les rabbins et les docteurs, selon ce qui leur a été confié du Livre d'Allah, dont ils étaient les gardiens.
versets.anglais: Indeed, We sent down the Torah, in which was guidance and light. The prophets who submitted [to Allah] judged by it for the Jews, as did the rabbis and scholars by that with which they were entrusted of the Scripture of Allah, and they were witnesses thereto. So do not fear the people but fear Me, and do not exchange My verses for a small price. And whoever does not judge by what Allah has revealed - then it is those who are the disbelievers

versets.arabe: وَكَتَبْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ فِيهَا أَنَّ النَّفْسَ بِالنَّفْسِ وَالْعَيْنَ بِالْعَيْنِ وَالْأَنفَ بِالْأَنفِ وَالْأُذُنَ بِالْأُذُنِ وَالسِّنَّ بِالسِّنِّ وَالْجُرُوحَ قِصَاصٌ ۚ فَمَن تَصَدَّقَ بِهِ فَهُوَ كَفَّارَةٌ لَّهُ ۚ وَمَن لَّمْ يَحْكُم بِمَا أَنزَلَ اللَّهُ فَأُولَٰئِكَ هُمُ الظَّالِمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wakatabnā 'alayhim fīhā anna n-nafsa bin-nafsi wal-'ayna bil-'ayni wal-anfa bil-anfi wal-udhuna bil-udhuni was-sinna bis-sinni wal-jurūḥa qiṣāṣun faman taṣaddaqa bihi fahuwa kaffāratun lahu waman lam yaḥkum bimā anzala llāhu fa'ulā'ika humu ẓ-ẓālimūn
versets.francais: Et Nous y avons prescrit pour eux: vie pour vie, œil pour œil, nez pour nez, oreille pour oreille, dent pour dent, et pour les blessures, représailles. Mais si quelqu'un y renonce par charité, cela lui vaut expiation. Et ceux qui ne jugent pas d'après ce qu'Allah a fait descendre, ce sont eux les injustes.
versets.anglais: And We ordained for them therein a life for a life, an eye for an eye, a nose for a nose, an ear for an ear, a tooth for a tooth, and for wounds is legal retribution. But whoever gives [up his right as] charity, it is an expiation for him. And whoever does not judge by what Allah has revealed - then it is those who are the wrongdoers

versets.arabe: وَقَفَّيْنَا عَلَىٰ آثَارِهِم بِعِيسَى ابْنِ مَرْيَمَ مُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ مِنَ التَّوْرَاةِ ۖ وَآتَيْنَاهُ الْإِنجِيلَ فِيهِ هُدًى وَنُورٌ وَمُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ مِنَ التَّوْرَاةِ وَهُدًى وَمَوْعِظَةً لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
versets.phonetique: Waqaffaynā 'alā āthārihim bi'īsā bni maryama muṣaddiqan limā bayna yadayhi mina t-tawrāti wa'ātaynāhu l-injīla fīhi hudan wanūrun wamuṣaddiqan limā bayna yadayhi mina t-tawrāti wahudanw wamaw'iẓatan lil-muttaqīn
versets.francais: Et Nous avons envoyé à leur suite Jésus, fils de Marie, pour confirmer ce qu'il y avait avant lui dans la Torah; et Nous lui avons donné l'Evangile dans lequel il y a guide et lumière, pour confirmer ce qu'il y avait avant lui dans la Torah, et comme guide et exhortation pour les pieux.
versets.anglais: And We sent, following in their footsteps, Jesus, the son of Mary, confirming that which came before him in the Torah; and We gave him the Gospel, in which was guidance and light and confirming that which preceded it of the Torah as guidance and instruction for the righteous

versets.arabe: وَلْيَحْكُمْ أَهْلُ الْإِنجِيلِ بِمَا أَنزَلَ اللَّهُ فِيهِ ۚ وَمَن لَّمْ يَحْكُم بِمَا أَنزَلَ اللَّهُ فَأُولَٰئِكَ هُمُ الْفَاسِقُونَ
versets.phonetique: Walyaḥkum ahlu l-injīli bimā anzala llāhu fīhi waman lam yaḥkum bimā anzala llāhu fa'ulā'ika humu l-fāsiqūn
versets.francais: Et que les gens de l'Evangile jugent d'après ce qu'Allah y a fait descendre. Et ceux qui ne jugent pas d'après ce qu'Allah a révélé, ce sont eux les pervers.
versets.anglais: And let the People of the Gospel judge by what Allah has revealed therein. And whoever does not judge by what Allah has revealed - then it is those who are the defiantly disobedient

versets.arabe: وَأَنزَلْنَا إِلَيْكَ الْكِتَابَ بِالْحَقِّ مُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ مِنَ الْكِتَابِ وَمُهَيْمِنًا عَلَيْهِ ۖ فَاحْكُم بَيْنَهُم بِمَا أَنزَلَ اللَّهُ ۖ وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ أَهْوَاءَهُمْ عَمَّا جَاءَكَ مِنَ الْحَقِّ
versets.phonetique: Wa'anzalnā ilayka l-kitāba bil-ḥaqqi muṣaddiqan limā bayna yadayhi mina l-kitābi wamuhaymanan 'alayhi faḥkum baynahum bimā anzala llāhu walā tattabi' ahwā'ahum 'ammā jā'aka mina l-ḥaqq
versets.francais: Et Nous avons fait descendre sur toi le Livre avec la vérité, pour confirmer le Livre qui était avant lui et pour veiller sur lui. Juge donc parmi eux d'après ce qu'Allah a fait descendre. Et ne suis pas leurs passions, loin de la vérité qui t'est venue.
versets.anglais: And We have revealed to you, [O Muhammad], the Book in truth, confirming that which preceded it of the Scripture and as a criterion over it. So judge between them by what Allah has revealed and do not follow their inclinations away from what has come to you of the truth. To each of you We prescribed a law and a method. Had Allah willed, He would have made you one nation [united in religion], but [He intended] to test you in what He has given you; so race to [all that is] good. To Allah is your return all together, and He will [then] inform you concerning that over which you used to differ

versets.arabe: وَأَنِ احْكُم بَيْنَهُم بِمَا أَنزَلَ اللَّهُ وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ أَهْوَاءَهُمْ وَاحْذَرْهُمْ أَن يَفْتِنُوكَ عَن بَعْضِ مَا أَنزَلَ اللَّهُ إِلَيْكَ
versets.phonetique: Wa'ani ḥkum baynahum bimā anzala llāhu walā tattabi' ahwā'ahum waḥdharhum an yaftinūka 'an ba'ḍi mā anzala llāhu ilayk
versets.francais: Et juge entre eux d'après ce qu'Allah a révélé, ne suis pas leurs passions et prends garde à eux de peur qu'ils ne t'écartent d'une partie de ce qu'Allah t'a révélé.
versets.anglais: And judge, [O Muhammad], between them by what Allah has revealed and do not follow their inclinations and beware of them, lest they tempt you away from some of what Allah has revealed to you. And if they turn away - then know that Allah only intends to afflict them with some of their [own] sins. And indeed, many among the people are defiantly disobedient

versets.arabe: أَفَحُكْمَ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ يَبْغُونَ ۚ وَمَنْ أَحْسَنُ مِنَ اللَّهِ حُكْمًا لِّقَوْمٍ يُوقِنُونَ
versets.phonetique: Afaḥukma l-jāhiliyyati yabghūna waman aḥsanu mina llāhi ḥukman liqawmin yūqinūn
versets.francais: Est-ce le jugement du temps de l'Ignorance qu'ils cherchent? Mais qui donc est meilleur qu'Allah comme juge pour des gens qui ont la certitude de la foi?
versets.anglais: Then is it the judgement of [the time of] ignorance they desire? But who is better than Allah in judgement for a people who are certain [in faith]

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تَتَّخِذُوا الْيَهُودَ وَالنَّصَارَىٰ أَوْلِيَاءَ ۘ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلِيَاءُ بَعْضٍ ۚ وَمَن يَتَوَلَّهُم مِّنكُمْ فَإِنَّهُ مِنْهُمْ ۗ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ الظَّالِمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Yā ayyuhā lladhīna āmanū lā tattakhidhū l-yahūda wan-naṣārā awliyā'a ba'ḍuhum awliyā'u ba'ḍin waman yatawallahum minkum fa'innahu minhum inna llāha lā yahdī l-qawma ẓ-ẓālimīn
versets.francais: Ô vous qui croyez! Ne prenez pas les Juifs et les Chrétiens comme alliés: ils sont alliés les uns des autres. Et celui d'entre vous qui les prend pour alliés est des leurs. Allah ne guide certes pas les gens injustes.
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, do not take the Jews and the Christians as allies. They are [in fact] allies of one another. And whoever is an ally to them among you - then indeed, he is [one] of them. Indeed, Allah guides not the wrongdoing people

versets.arabe: فَتَرَى الَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ يُسَارِعُونَ فِيهِمْ يَقُولُونَ نَخْشَىٰ أَن تُصِيبَنَا دَائِرَةٌ ۚ فَعَسَى اللَّهُ أَن يَأْتِيَ بِالْفَتْحِ أَوْ أَمْرٍ مِّنْ عِندِهِ فَيُصْبِحُوا عَلَىٰ مَا أَسَرُّوا فِي أَنفُسِهِمْ نَادِمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Fatarā lladhīna fī qulūbihim maraḍun yusāri'ūna fīhim yaqūlūna nakhshā an tuṣībanā dā'iratun fa'asā llāhu an ya'tiya bil-fatḥi aw amrin min 'indihi fayuṣbiḥū 'alā mā asarrū fī anfusihim nādimīn
versets.francais: Tu vois ceux dont les cœurs sont malades se précipiter vers eux, disant: «Nous craignons qu'un revers de fortune nous atteigne.» Peut-être Allah accordera-t-Il la victoire ou un ordre émanant de Lui, et ils regretteront alors ce qu'ils cachaient en eux-mêmes.
versets.anglais: So you see those in whose hearts is disease hastening into [association with] them, saying, "We are afraid a misfortune may strike us." But perhaps Allah will bring conquest or a decision from Him, and they will become, over what they have been concealing within themselves, regretful

versets.arabe: وَيَقُولُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا أَهَٰؤُلَاءِ الَّذِينَ أَقْسَمُوا بِاللَّهِ جَهْدَ أَيْمَانِهِمْ ۙ إِنَّهُمْ لَمَعَكُمْ ۚ حَبِطَتْ أَعْمَالُهُمْ فَأَصْبَحُوا خَاسِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wayaqūlu lladhīna āmanū ahā'ulā'i lladhīna aqsamū billāhi jahda aymānihim innahum lama'akum ḥabiṭat a'māluhum fa'aṣbaḥū khāsirīn
versets.francais: Et les croyants diront: «Seraient-ce là ceux qui juraient par Allah avec leur plus ferme serment qu'ils étaient vraiment avec vous?» Leurs oeuvres sont vaines, et ils se retrouvent perdants.
versets.anglais: And those who believe will say, "Are these the ones who swore by Allah their strongest oaths that indeed they were with you?" Their deeds have become worthless, and they have become losers

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا مَن يَرْتَدَّ مِنكُمْ عَن دِينِهِ فَسَوْفَ يَأْتِي اللَّهُ بِقَوْمٍ يُحِبُّهُمْ وَيُحِبُّونَهُ أَذِلَّةٍ عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ أَعِزَّةٍ عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ يُجَاهِدُونَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَلَا يَخَافُونَ لَوْمَةَ لَائِمٍ
versets.phonetique: Yā ayyuhā lladhīna āmanū man yartadda minkum 'an dīnihi fasawfa ya'tī llāhu biqawmin yuḥibbuhum wayuḥibbūnahu adhillatin 'alā l-mu'minīna a'izzatin 'alā l-kāfirīna yujāhidūna fī sabīli llāhi walā yakhāfūna lawmata lā'im
versets.francais: Ô vous qui croyez! Quiconque parmi vous apostasie Sa religion... Allah fera venir des gens qu'Il aime et qui L'aiment, humbles envers les croyants, fiers envers les mécréants, qui luttent dans le chemin d'Allah, et qui ne craignent pas le blâme du blâmeur.
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, whoever of you should revert from his religion - Allah will bring forth [in place of them] a people He will love and who will love Him [who are] humble toward the believers, powerful against the disbelievers; they strive in the cause of Allah and do not fear the blame of a critic. That is the favor of Allah; He bestows it upon whom He wills. And Allah is all-Encompassing and Knowing

versets.arabe: إِنَّمَا وَلِيُّكُمُ اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا الَّذِينَ يُقِيمُونَ الصَّلَاةَ وَيُؤْتُونَ الزَّكَاةَ وَهُمْ رَاكِعُونَ
versets.phonetique: Innamā waliyyukumu llāhu warasūluhu walladhīna āmanū lladhīna yuqīmūna ṣ-ṣalāta wayu'tūna z-zakāta wahum rāki'ūn
versets.francais: Votre allié n'est qu'Allah, Son messager, et les croyants qui accomplissent la Salât, acquittent la Zakât et s'inclinent [devant Allah].
versets.anglais: Your ally is none but Allah and [therefore] His Messenger and those who have believed - those who establish prayer and give zakah, and they bow [in worship]

versets.arabe: وَمَن يَتَوَلَّ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا فَإِنَّ حِزْبَ اللَّهِ هُمُ الْغَالِبُونَ
versets.phonetique: Waman yatawalla llāha warasūlahu walladhīna āmanū fa'inna ḥizba llāhi humu l-ghālibūn
versets.francais: Et quiconque prend pour alliés Allah, Son messager et les croyants... c'est le parti d'Allah qui sera victorieux.
versets.anglais: And whoever is an ally of Allah and His Messenger and those who have believed - indeed, the party of Allah - they will be the predominant

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تَتَّخِذُوا الَّذِينَ اتَّخَذُوا دِينَكُمْ هُزُوًا وَلَعِبًا مِّنَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْكِتَابَ مِن قَبْلِكُمْ وَالْكُفَّارَ أَوْلِيَاءَ ۚ وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Yā ayyuhā lladhīna āmanū lā tattakhidhū lladhīna ttakhadhū dīnakum huzuwan wala'iban mina lladhīna ūtū l-kitāba min qablikum wal-kuffāra awliyā'a wattaqū llāha in kuntum mu'minīn
versets.francais: Ô vous qui croyez! Ne prenez pas pour alliés ceux qui prennent votre religion en dérision et en jeu, parmi ceux qui ont reçu le Livre avant vous, et les mécréants. Et craignez Allah si vous êtes croyants.
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, take not those who have taken your religion in ridicule and amusement among the ones who were given the Scripture before you nor the disbelievers as allies. And fear Allah, if you should [truly] be believers

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا نَادَيْتُمْ إِلَى الصَّلَاةِ اتَّخَذُوهَا هُزُوًا وَلَعِبًا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَوْمٌ لَّا يَعْقِلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa'idhā nādaytum ilā ṣ-ṣalāti ttakhadhūhā huzuwan wala'iban dhālika bi'annahum qawmun lā ya'qilūn
versets.francais: Et quand vous appelez à la Salât, ils la prennent en moquerie et en jeu. C'est parce qu'ils sont des gens qui ne raisonnent pas.
versets.anglais: And when you call to prayer, they take it in ridicule and amusement. That is because they are a people who do not use reason

versets.arabe: قُلْ يَا أَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ هَلْ تَنقِمُونَ مِنَّا إِلَّا أَنْ آمَنَّا بِاللَّهِ وَمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْنَا وَمَا أُنزِلَ مِن قَبْلُ وَأَنَّ أَكْثَرَكُمْ فَاسِقُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qul yā ahla l-kitābi hal tanqimūna minnā illā an āmannā billāhi wamā unzila ilaynā wamā unzila min qablu wa'anna aktharakum fāsiqūn
versets.francais: Dis: «Ô gens du Livre! Nous reprochez-vous autre chose, sinon que nous croyons en Allah, en ce qu'Il a révélé pour nous et en ce qu'Il a révélé avant? Et la plupart d'entre vous sont des pervers.»
versets.anglais: Say, "O People of the Scripture, do you resent us except [for the fact] that we have believed in Allah and what was revealed to us and what was revealed before and because most of you are defiantly disobedient

versets.arabe: قُلْ هَلْ أُنَبِّئُكُم بِشَرٍّ مِّن ذَٰلِكَ مَثُوبَةً عِندَ اللَّهِ ۚ مَن لَّعَنَهُ اللَّهُ وَغَضِبَ عَلَيْهِ وَجَعَلَ مِنْهُمُ الْقِرَدَةَ وَالْخَنَازِيرَ وَعَبَدَ الطَّاغُوتَ ۚ أُولَٰئِكَ شَرٌّ مَّكَانًا وَأَضَلُّ عَن سَوَاءِ السَّبِيلِ
versets.phonetique: Qul hal unabbi'ukum bisharrin min dhālika mathūbatan 'inda llāhi man la'anahu llāhu waghaḍiba 'alayhi waja'ala minhu l-qiradata wal-khanāzīra wa'abada ṭ-ṭāghūta ulā'ika sharrun makānan wa'aḍallu 'an sawā'i s-sabīl
versets.francais: Dis: «Vous informerai-je de ce qu'il y a de pire que cela comme rétribution auprès d'Allah? Celui qu'Allah a maudit, sur qui Il s'est mis en colère, dont Il a fait des singes et des pourceaux, et qui ont adoré le Tagout. Voilà ceux dont la situation est la plus mauvaise et qui sont les plus égarés du droit chemin.»
versets.anglais: Say, "Shall I inform you of [what is] worse than that as penalty from Allah? [It is that of] those whom Allah has cursed and with whom He became angry and made of them apes and pigs and slaves of Taghut. Those are worse in position and further astray from the sound way

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا جَاءُوكُمْ قَالُوا آمَنَّا وَقَد دَّخَلُوا بِالْكُفْرِ وَهُمْ قَدْ خَرَجُوا بِهِ ۚ وَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا كَانُوا يَكْتُمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa'idhā jā'ūkum qālū āmannā waqad dakhalū bil-kufri wahum qad kharajū bihi wallāhu a'lamu bimā kānū yaktumūn
versets.francais: Et quand ils viennent à vous, ils disent: «Nous avons cru», alors qu'ils sont entrés avec l'incroyance et sortis avec elle. Et Allah sait mieux ce qu'ils cachent.
versets.anglais: And when they come to you, they say, "We believe." But they have entered with disbelief [in their hearts], and they have certainly left with it. And Allah is most knowing of what they were concealing

versets.arabe: وَتَرَىٰ كَثِيرًا مِّنْهُمْ يُسَارِعُونَ فِي الْإِثْمِ وَالْعُدْوَانِ وَأَكْلِهِمُ السُّحْتَ ۚ لَبِئْسَ مَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Watarā kathīran minhum yusāri'ūna fī l-ithmi wal-'udwāni wa'aklihimu s-suḥta labi'sa mā kānū ya'malūn
versets.francais: Tu en vois beaucoup se précipiter vers le péché, l'hostilité et leur consommation de ce qui est illicite. Comme est mauvais ce qu'ils faisaient!
versets.anglais: And you see many of them hastening into sin and aggression and the devouring of [what is] unlawful. How wretched is what they have been doing

versets.arabe: لَوْلَا يَنْهَاهُمُ الرَّبَّانِيُّونَ وَالْأَحْبَارُ عَن قَوْلِهِمُ الْإِثْمَ وَأَكْلِهِمُ السُّحْتَ ۚ لَبِئْسَ مَا كَانُوا يَصْنَعُونَ
versets.phonetique: Lawlā yanhāhumu r-rabbāniyyūna wal-aḥbāru 'an qawlihimu l-ithma wa'aklihimu s-suḥta labi'sa mā kānū yaṣna'ūn
versets.francais: Pourquoi les rabbins et les docteurs ne leur interdisent-ils pas de tenir des propos pécheurs et de manger des gains illicites? Comme est mauvais ce qu'ils accomplissaient!
versets.anglais: Why do the rabbis and religious scholars not forbid them from saying what is sinful and devouring what is unlawful? How wretched is what they have been practicing

versets.arabe: وَقَالَتِ الْيَهُودُ يَدُ اللَّهِ مَغْلُولَةٌ ۚ غُلَّتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَلُعِنُوا بِمَا قَالُوا ۘ بَلْ يَدَاهُ مَبْسُوطَتَانِ يُنفِقُ كَيْفَ يَشَاءُ
versets.phonetique: Waqālati l-yahūdu yadu llāhi maghūlatun ghullat aydīhim walu'inū bimā qālū bal yadāhu mabsūṭatāni yunfiqu kayfa yashā'
versets.francais: Et les Juifs ont dit: «La main d'Allah est enchaînée.» Ce sont leurs mains à eux qui sont enchaînées et ils sont maudits pour ce qu'ils ont dit. Bien au contraire, Ses deux mains sont largement étendues; Il dépense comme Il veut.
versets.anglais: And the Jews say, "The hand of Allah is chained." Chained are their hands, and cursed are they for what they say. Rather, both His hands are extended; He spends however He wills. And that which has been revealed to you from your Lord will surely increase many of them in transgression and disbelief. And We have cast among them animosity and hatred until the Day of Resurrection. Every time they kindled the fire of war [against you], Allah extinguished it. And they strive throughout the land [causing] corruption, and Allah does not like corrupters

versets.arabe: وَلَوْ أَنَّ أَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ آمَنُوا وَاتَّقَوْا لَكَفَّرْنَا عَنْهُمْ سَيِّئَاتِهِمْ وَلَأَدْخَلْنَاهُمْ جَنَّاتِ النَّعِيمِ
versets.phonetique: Walaw anna ahla l-kitābi āmanū wattaqaw lakaffarnā 'anhum sayyi'ātihim wala'adkhalnāhum jannāti n-na'īm
versets.francais: Si les gens du Livre croyaient et se gardaient [du mal], Nous leur effacerions leurs méfaits et les ferions entrer aux jardins des délices.
versets.anglais: And if only the People of the Scripture had believed and feared Allah, We would have removed from them their misdeeds and admitted them to Gardens of Pleasure

versets.arabe: وَلَوْ أَنَّهُمْ أَقَامُوا التَّوْرَاةَ وَالْإِنجِيلَ وَمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِم مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ لَأَكَلُوا مِن فَوْقِهِمْ وَمِن تَحْتِ أَرْجُلِهِم
versets.phonetique: Walaw annahum aqāmū t-tawrāta wal-injīla wamā unzila ilayhim min rabbihim la'akalū min fawqihim wamin taḥti arjulihim
versets.francais: Et s'ils avaient observé la Torah, l'Evangile et ce qui leur a été révélé par leur Seigneur, ils auraient certes joui de [bienfaits venant] de dessus eux et de dessous leurs pieds.
versets.anglais: And if only they upheld [the law of] the Torah, the Gospel, and what has been revealed to them from their Lord, they would have consumed [provision] from above them and from beneath their feet. Among them are a moderate community, but many of them - evil is that which they do

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الرَّسُولُ بَلِّغْ مَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ ۖ وَإِن لَّمْ تَفْعَلْ فَمَا بَلَّغْتَ رِسَالَتَهُ ۚ وَاللَّهُ يَعْصِمُكَ مِنَ النَّاسِ ۗ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ الْكَافِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Yā ayyuhā r-rasūlu balligh mā unzila ilayka min rabbika wa'in lam taf'al famā ballaghta risālatahu wallāhu ya'ṣimuka mina n-nāsi inna llāha lā yahdī l-qawma l-kāfirīn
versets.francais: Ô Messager! Transmets ce qui t'a été descendu de la part de ton Seigneur. Si tu ne le faisais pas, tu n'aurais pas transmis Son message. Et Allah te protègera des gens. Certes Allah ne guide pas les gens mécréants.
versets.anglais: O Messenger, announce that which has been revealed to you from your Lord, and if you do not, then you have not conveyed His message. And Allah will protect you from the people. Indeed, Allah does not guide the disbelieving people

versets.arabe: قُلْ يَا أَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ لَسْتُمْ عَلَىٰ شَيْءٍ حَتَّىٰ تُقِيمُوا التَّوْرَاةَ وَالْإِنجِيلَ وَمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكُم مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Qul yā ahla l-kitābi lastum 'alā shay'in ḥattā tuqīmū t-tawrāta wal-injīla wamā unzila ilaykum min rabbikum
versets.francais: Dis: «Ô gens du Livre! Vous n'êtes fondés sur rien, tant que vous n'observez pas la Torah, l'Evangile et ce qui vous a été descendu de votre Seigneur.»
versets.anglais: Say, "O People of the Scripture, you are [standing] on nothing until you uphold [the law of] the Torah, the Gospel, and what has been revealed to you from your Lord." And that which has been revealed to you from your Lord will surely increase many of them in transgression and disbelief. So do not grieve over the disbelieving people

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَالَّذِينَ هَادُوا وَالصَّابِئُونَ وَالنَّصَارَىٰ مَنْ آمَنَ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
versets.phonetique: Inna lladhīna āmanū walladhīna hādū waṣ-ṣābi'ūna wan-naṣārā man āmana billāhi wal-yawmi l-ākhiri wa'amila ṣāliḥan falā khawfun 'alayhim walā hum yaḥzanūn
versets.francais: Certes, ceux qui ont cru, ceux qui sont Juifs, les Sabéens, les Chrétiens, quiconque a cru en Allah et au Jour dernier et a fait le bien — pas de crainte pour eux et ils ne seront pas attristés.
versets.anglais: Indeed, those who have believed [in Prophet Muhammad] and those [before Him] who were Jews or Sabeans or Christians - those [among them] who believed in Allah and the Last Day and did righteousness - no fear will there be concerning them, nor will they grieve

versets.arabe: لَقَدْ أَخَذْنَا مِيثَاقَ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ وَأَرْسَلْنَا إِلَيْهِمْ رُسُلًا ۖ كُلَّمَا جَاءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ بِمَا لَا تَهْوَىٰ أَنفُسُهُمْ فَرِيقًا كَذَّبُوا وَفَرِيقًا يَقْتُلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Laqad akhadhnā mīthāqa banī isrā'īla wa'arsalnā ilayhim rusulan kullamā jā'ahum rasūlun bimā lā tahwā anfusuhum farīqan kadhdhabū wafarīqan yaqtulūn
versets.francais: Certes Nous avons pris le pacte des fils d'Israël et leur avons envoyé des messagers. Chaque fois qu'un messager leur apportait ce que leurs âmes n'aimaient pas, ils en traitaient un groupe de menteurs, et ils en tuaient un autre.
versets.anglais: We had already taken the covenant of the Children of Israel and had sent to them messengers. Whenever there came to them a messenger with what their souls did not desire, a party [of messengers] they denied, and another party they killed

versets.arabe: وَحَسِبُوا أَلَّا تَكُونَ فِتْنَةٌ فَعَمُوا وَصَمُّوا ثُمَّ تَابَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ ثُمَّ عَمُوا وَصَمُّوا كَثِيرٌ مِّنْهُمْ ۚ وَاللَّهُ بَصِيرٌ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Waḥasibū allā takūna fitnatun fa'amū waṣammū thumma tāba llāhu 'alayhim thumma 'amū waṣammū kathīrun minhum wallāhu baṣīrun bimā ya'malūn
versets.francais: Ils pensaient qu'il n'y aurait pas d'épreuve; ils sont devenus aveugles et sourds. Ensuite Allah a agréé leur repentir. Puis encore beaucoup d'entre eux sont devenus aveugles et sourds. Allah voit bien ce qu'ils font.
versets.anglais: And they thought there would be no [resulting] punishment, so they became blind and deaf. Then Allah turned to them in forgiveness; then [again] many of them became blind and deaf. And Allah is Seeing of what they do

versets.arabe: لَقَدْ كَفَرَ الَّذِينَ قَالُوا إِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْمَسِيحُ ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ ۖ وَقَالَ الْمَسِيحُ يَا بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ اعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ رَبِّي وَرَبَّكُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُ مَن يُشْرِكْ بِاللَّهِ فَقَدْ حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ الْجَنَّةَ وَمَأْوَاهُ النَّارُ ۖ وَمَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ مِنْ أَنصَارٍ
versets.phonetique: Laqad kafara lladhīna qālū inna llāha huwa l-masīḥu bnu maryama waqāla l-masīḥu yā banī isrā'īla 'budū llāha rabbī wa'rabbakum innahu man yushrik billāhi faqad ḥarrama llāhu 'alayhi l-jannata wama'wāhu n-nāru wamā liẓ-ẓālimīna min anṣār
versets.francais: Certes, ils ont mécru, ceux qui disent: «Allah est le Messie, fils de Marie», alors que le Messie a dit: «Ô fils d'Israël, adorez Allah, mon Seigneur et votre Seigneur.» Quiconque associe à Allah [des partenaires], Allah lui interdit le Paradis, et sa demeure sera le Feu. Et pour les injustes, pas de secours.
versets.anglais: They have certainly disbelieved who say, "Allah is the Messiah, the son of Mary" while the Messiah has said, "O Children of Israel, worship Allah, my Lord and your Lord." Indeed, he who associates others with Allah - Allah has forbidden him Paradise, and his refuge is the Fire. And there are not for the wrongdoers any helpers

versets.arabe: لَّقَدْ كَفَرَ الَّذِينَ قَالُوا إِنَّ اللَّهَ ثَالِثُ ثَلَاثَةٍ ۘ وَمَا مِنْ إِلَٰهٍ إِلَّا إِلَٰهٌ وَاحِدٌ ۚ وَإِن لَّمْ يَنتَهُوا عَمَّا يَقُولُونَ لَيَمَسَّنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِنْهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Laqad kafara lladhīna qālū inna llāha thālithu thalāthatin wamā min ilāhin illā ilāhun wāḥidun wa'in lam yantahū 'ammā yaqūlūna layamassanna lladhīna kafarū minhum 'adhābun alīm
versets.francais: Certes, ils ont mécru, ceux qui disent: «Allah est le troisième de trois.» Il n'y a de divinité qu'une divinité unique. Et s'ils ne cessent pas ce qu'ils disent, un châtiment douloureux touchera certes ceux d'entre eux qui ne croient pas.
versets.anglais: They have certainly disbelieved who say, "Allah is the third of three." And there is no god except one God. And if they do not desist from what they are saying, there will surely afflict the disbelievers among them a painful punishment

versets.arabe: أَفَلَا يَتُوبُونَ إِلَى اللَّهِ وَيَسْتَغْفِرُونَهُ ۚ وَاللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Afalā yatūbūna ilā llāhi wayastaghfirūnahu wallāhu ghafūrun raḥīm
versets.francais: Ne se repentent-ils pas donc à Allah et ne Lui demandent-ils pas pardon? Et Allah est Pardonneur et Miséricordieux.
versets.anglais: So will they not repent to Allah and seek His forgiveness? And Allah is Forgiving and Merciful

versets.arabe: مَّا الْمَسِيحُ ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ إِلَّا رَسُولٌ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلِهِ الرُّسُلُ وَأُمُّهُ صِدِّيقَةٌ ۖ كَانَا يَأْكُلَانِ الطَّعَامَ ۗ انظُرْ كَيْفَ نُبَيِّنُ لَهُمُ الْآيَاتِ ثُمَّ انظُرْ أَنَّىٰ يُؤْفَكُونَ
versets.phonetique: Mā l-masīḥu bnu maryama illā rasūlun qad khalat min qablihi r-rusulu wa'ummuhu ṣiddīqatun kānā ya'kulāni ṭ-ṭa'āma unẓur kayfa nubayyinu lahumu l-āyāti thumma unẓur annā yu'fakūn
versets.francais: Le Messie, fils de Marie, n'est qu'un messager. Des messagers sont passés avant lui. Et sa mère était une véridique. Et ils mangeaient tous deux la nourriture. Vois comment Nous leur exposons les signes; vois ensuite comment ils s'en détournent.
versets.anglais: The Messiah, son of Mary, was not but a messenger; [other] messengers have passed on before him. And his mother was a supporter of truth. They both used to eat food. Look how We make clear to them the signs; then look how they are deluded

versets.arabe: قُلْ أَتَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ مَا لَا يَمْلِكُ لَكُمْ ضَرًّا وَلَا نَفْعًا ۚ وَاللَّهُ هُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
versets.phonetique: Qul ata'budūna min dūni llāhi mā lā yamliku lakum ḍarran walā naf'an wallāhu huwa s-samī'u l-'alīm
versets.francais: Dis: «Adorez-vous, en dehors d'Allah, ce qui ne peut vous causer ni tort ni profit?» Mais Allah c'est Lui l'Audient et l'Omniscient.
versets.anglais: Say, "Do you worship besides Allah that which holds for you no [power of] harm or benefit while it is Allah who is the Hearing, the Knowing

versets.arabe: قُلْ يَا أَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ لَا تَغْلُوا فِي دِينِكُمْ غَيْرَ الْحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعُوا أَهْوَاءَ قَوْمٍ قَدْ ضَلُّوا مِن قَبْلُ وَأَضَلُّوا كَثِيرًا وَضَلُّوا عَن سَوَاءِ السَّبِيلِ
versets.phonetique: Qul yā ahla l-kitābi lā taghlū fī dīnikum ghayra l-ḥaqqi walā tattabi'ū ahwā'a qawmin qad ḍallū min qablu wa'aḍallū kathīran waḍallū 'an sawā'i s-sabīl
versets.francais: Dis: «Ô gens du Livre! N'exagérez pas sans raison dans votre religion. Et ne suivez pas les passions de gens qui s'étaient égarés auparavant, qui ont égaré beaucoup d'autres, et qui se sont écartés du droit chemin.»
versets.anglais: Say, "O People of the Scripture, do not exceed limits in your religion beyond the truth and do not follow the inclinations of a people who had gone astray before and misled many and have strayed from the soundness of the way

versets.arabe: لُعِنَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِن بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ عَلَىٰ لِسَانِ دَاوُودَ وَعِيسَى ابْنِ مَرْيَمَ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ بِمَا عَصَوا وَّكَانُوا يَعْتَدُونَ
versets.phonetique: Lu'ina lladhīna kafarū min banī isrā'īla 'alā lisāni dāwūda wa'īsā bni maryama dhālika bimā 'aṣaw wakānū ya'tadūn
versets.francais: Ceux des fils d'Israël qui n'ont pas cru ont été maudits par la bouche de David et de Jésus, fils de Marie. Cela parce qu'ils ont désobéi et transgressaient.
versets.anglais: Cursed were those who disbelieved among the Children of Israel by the tongue of David and of Jesus, the son of Mary. That was because they disobeyed and [habitually] transgressed

versets.arabe: كَانُوا لَا يَتَنَاهَوْنَ عَن مُّنكَرٍ فَعَلُوهُ ۚ لَبِئْسَ مَا كَانُوا يَفْعَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Kānū lā yatanāhawna 'an munkarin fa'alūhu labi'sa mā kānū yaf'alūn
versets.francais: Ils ne s'interdisaient pas mutuellement les actes répréhensibles qu'ils faisaient. Comme est mauvais ce qu'ils faisaient!
versets.anglais: They used not to prevent one another from wrongdoing that they did. How wretched was that which they were doing

versets.arabe: تَرَىٰ كَثِيرًا مِّنْهُمْ يَتَوَلَّوْنَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا ۚ لَبِئْسَ مَا قَدَّمَتْ لَهُمْ أَنفُسُهُمْ أَن سَخِطَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَفِي الْعَذَابِ هُمْ خَالِدُونَ
versets.phonetique: Tarā kathīran minhum yatawallawna lladhīna kafarū labi'sa mā qaddamat lahum anfusuhum an sakhaṭa llāhu 'alayhim wafī l-'adhābi hum khālidūn
versets.francais: Tu en vois beaucoup prendre pour alliés les mécréants. Comme est mauvais ce que leurs âmes leur ont préparé: la colère d'Allah sur eux. Et ils demeureront éternellement dans le châtiment.
versets.anglais: You see many of them becoming allies of those who disbelieved. How wretched is that which they have put forth for themselves in that Allah has become angry with them, and in the punishment they will abide eternally

versets.arabe: وَلَوْ كَانُوا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللَّهِ وَالنَّبِيِّ وَمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مَا اتَّخَذُوهُمْ أَوْلِيَاءَ وَلَٰكِنَّ كَثِيرًا مِّنْهُمْ فَاسِقُونَ
versets.phonetique: Walaw kānū yu'minūna billāhi wan-nabiyyi wamā unzila ilayhi mā ttakhadhūhum awliyā'a walākin kathīran minhum fāsiqūn
versets.francais: S'ils croyaient en Allah, au Prophète et à ce qui lui a été révélé, ils ne prendraient pas les mécréants pour alliés. Mais beaucoup d'entre eux sont des pervers.
versets.anglais: And if they had believed in Allah and the Prophet and in what was revealed to him, they would not have taken them as allies; but many of them are defiantly disobedient

versets.arabe: لَتَجِدَنَّ أَشَدَّ النَّاسِ عَدَاوَةً لِّلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا الْيَهُودَ وَالَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوا ۖ وَلَتَجِدَنَّ أَقْرَبَهُم مَّوَدَّةً لِّلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا الَّذِينَ قَالُوا إِنَّا نَصَارَىٰ
versets.phonetique: Latajidanna ashadda n-nāsi 'adāwatan lilladhīna āmanū l-yahūda walladhīna ashrakū walatajidanna aqrabahum mawaddatan lilladhīna āmanū lladhīna qālū innā naṣārā
versets.francais: Tu trouveras certes que les gens les plus hostiles aux croyants sont les Juifs et les polythéistes. Et tu trouveras certes que les plus proches en affection pour les croyants, sont ceux qui disent: «Nous sommes Chrétiens.»
versets.anglais: You will surely find the most intense of the people in animosity toward the believers [to be] the Jews and those who associate others with Allah; and you will find the nearest of them in affection to the believers those who say, "We are Christians." That is because among them are priests and monks and because they are not arrogant

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا سَمِعُوا مَا أُنزِلَ إِلَى الرَّسُولِ تَرَىٰ أَعْيُنَهُمْ تَفِيضُ مِنَ الدَّمْعِ مِمَّا عَرَفُوا مِنَ الْحَقِّ ۖ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا آمَنَّا فَاكْتُبْنَا مَعَ الشَّاهِدِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa'idhā sami'ū mā unzila ilā r-rasūli tarā a'yunahum tafīḍu mina d-dam'i mimmā 'arafū mina l-ḥaqqi yaqūlūna rabbanā āmannā faktubunā ma'a sh-shāhidīn
versets.francais: Et quand ils entendent ce qui a été révélé au Messager, tu vois leurs yeux déborder de larmes, à cause de ce qu'ils ont reconnu de la vérité. Ils disent: «Seigneur, nous croyons, inscris-nous donc parmi les témoins.»
versets.anglais: And when they hear what has been revealed to the Messenger, you see their eyes overflowing with tears because of what they have recognized of the truth. They say, "Our Lord, we have believed, so register us among the witnesses

versets.arabe: وَمَا لَنَا لَا نُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَمَا جَاءَنَا مِنَ الْحَقِّ وَنَطْمَعُ أَن يُدْخِلَنَا رَبُّنَا مَعَ الْقَوْمِ الصَّالِحِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wamā lanā lā nu'minu billāhi wamā jā'anā mina l-ḥaqqi wanaṭma'u an yudkhilanā rabbunā ma'a l-qawmi ṣ-ṣāliḥīn
versets.francais: «Et pourquoi ne croirions-nous pas en Allah et en ce qui nous est venu de la vérité, alors que nous aspirons que notre Seigneur nous fasse entrer avec les gens vertueux?»
versets.anglais: And why should we not believe in Allah and what has come to us of the truth? And we aspire that our Lord will admit us [to Paradise] with the righteous people

versets.arabe: فَأَثَابَهُمُ اللَّهُ بِمَا قَالُوا جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ جَزَاءُ الْمُحْسِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Fa'athābahumu llāhu bimā qālū jannātin tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru khālidīna fīhā wadhālika jazā'u l-muḥsinīn
versets.francais: Allah les a récompensés pour ce qu'ils ont dit: des jardins sous lesquels coulent les ruisseaux, où ils demeureront éternellement. Telle est la récompense des bienfaisants.
versets.anglais: So Allah rewarded them for what they said with gardens [in Paradise] beneath which rivers flow, wherein they abide eternally. And that is the reward of doers of good

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَكَذَّبُوا بِآيَاتِنَا أُولَٰئِكَ أَصْحَابُ الْجَحِيمِ
versets.phonetique: Walladhīna kafarū wakadhdhabū bi'āyātinā ulā'ika aṣḥābu l-jaḥīm
versets.francais: Ceux qui ne croient pas et traitent Nos signes de mensonge, ce sont eux les gens de la fournaise.
versets.anglais: But those who disbelieved and denied Our signs - they are the companions of Hellfire

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تُحَرِّمُوا طَيِّبَاتِ مَا أَحَلَّ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ وَلَا تَعْتَدُوا ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ الْمُعْتَدِينَ
versets.phonetique: Yā ayyuhā lladhīna āmanū lā tuḥarrimū ṭayyibāti mā aḥalla llāhu lakum walā ta'tadū inna llāha lā yuḥibbu l-mu'tadīn
versets.francais: Ô vous qui croyez! Ne défendez pas les bonnes choses qu'Allah vous a rendues licites, et ne transgressez pas. Car Allah n'aime pas les transgresseurs.
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, do not prohibit the good things which Allah has made lawful to you and do not transgress. Indeed, Allah does not like transgressors

versets.arabe: وَكُلُوا مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ اللَّهُ حَلَالًا طَيِّبًا ۚ وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ الَّذِي أَنتُم بِهِ مُؤْمِنُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wakulū mimmā razaqakumu llāhu ḥalālan ṭayyiban wattaqū llāha lladhī antum bihi mu'minūn
versets.francais: Et mangez de ce qu'Allah vous a accordé comme nourriture licite et bonne. Et craignez Allah en qui vous croyez.
versets.anglais: And eat of what Allah has provided for you [which is] lawful and good. And fear Allah, in whom you are believers

versets.arabe: لَا يُؤَاخِذُكُمُ اللَّهُ بِاللَّغْوِ فِي أَيْمَانِكُمْ وَلَٰكِن يُؤَاخِذُكُم بِمَا عَقَّدتُّمُ الْأَيْمَانَ ۖ فَكَفَّارَتُهُ إِطْعَامُ عَشَرَةِ مَسَاكِينَ مِنْ أَوْسَطِ مَا تُطْعِمُونَ أَهْلِيكُمْ أَوْ كِسْوَتُهُمْ أَوْ تَحْرِيرُ رَقَبَةٍ ۖ فَمَن لَّمْ يَجِدْ فَصِيَامُ ثَلَاثَةِ أَيَّامٍ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ كَفَّارَةُ أَيْمَانِكُمْ إِذَا حَلَفْتُمْ
versets.phonetique: Lā yu'ākhidhukumu llāhu bil-laghwi fī aymānikum walākin yu'ākhidhukum bimā 'aqqadtumu l-aymāna fakaffāratuhu iṭ'āmu 'ashrati masākīna min awsaṭi mā tuṭ'imūna ahlīkum aw kiswatuhum aw taḥrīru raqabatin faman lam yajid faṣiyāmu thalāthati ayyāmin dhālika kaffāratu aymānikum idhā ḥalaftum
versets.francais: Allah ne vous prend pas à tâche pour vos serments inconsidérés; mais Il vous prend à tâche pour vos serments délibérés. L'expiation en est: nourrir dix pauvres, de ce dont vous nourrissez en moyenne vos familles, ou les habiller, ou libérer un esclave. Celui qui n'en a pas les moyens devra jeûner trois jours. Voilà l'expiation de vos serments quand vous avez juré.
versets.anglais: Allah will not impose blame upon you for what is meaningless in your oaths, but He will impose blame upon you for [breaking] what you intended of oaths. So its expiation is the feeding of ten needy people from the average of that which you feed your [own] families or clothing them or the freeing of a slave. But whoever cannot find [or afford it] - then a fast of three days [is required]. That is the expiation for oaths when you have sworn. But guard your oaths. Thus does Allah make clear to you His verses that you may be grateful

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِنَّمَا الْخَمْرُ وَالْمَيْسِرُ وَالْأَنصَابُ وَالْأَزْلَامُ رِجْسٌ مِّنْ عَمَلِ الشَّيْطَانِ فَاجْتَنِبُوهُ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
versets.phonetique: Yā ayyuhā lladhīna āmanū innamā l-khamru wal-maysiru wal-anṣābu wal-azlāmu rijsun min 'amali sh-shayṭāni fajtanibūhu la'allakum tufliḥūn
versets.francais: Ô vous qui croyez! Le vin, le jeu de hasard, les pierres dressées, les flèches de divination sont une abomination et une œuvre du Diable. Écartez-vous en, afin que vous réussissiez.
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, indeed, intoxicants, gambling, [sacrificing on] stone alters [to other than Allah], and divining arrows are but defilement from the work of Satan, so avoid it that you may be successful

versets.arabe: إِنَّمَا يُرِيدُ الشَّيْطَانُ أَن يُوقِعَ بَيْنَكُمُ الْعَدَاوَةَ وَالْبَغْضَاءَ فِي الْخَمْرِ وَالْمَيْسِرِ وَيَصُدَّكُمْ عَن ذِكْرِ اللَّهِ وَعَنِ الصَّلَاةِ ۖ فَهَلْ أَنتُم مُّنتَهُونَ
versets.phonetique: Innamā yurīdu sh-shayṭānu an yūqi'a baynakumu l-'adāwata wal-baghḍā'a fī l-khamri wal-maysiri wayaṣuddakum 'an dhikri llāhi wa'ani ṣ-ṣalāti fahel antum muntahūn
versets.francais: Le Diable ne veut que semer parmi vous l'inimitié et la haine par le vin et le jeu de hasard, et vous écarter du souvenir d'Allah et de la Salât. Allez-vous donc y mettre fin?
versets.anglais: Satan only wants to cause between you animosity and hatred through intoxicants and gambling and to avert you from the remembrance of Allah and from prayer. So will you not desist

versets.arabe: وَأَطِيعُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُوا الرَّسُولَ وَاحْذَرُوا ۚ فَإِن تَوَلَّيْتُمْ فَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّمَا عَلَىٰ رَسُولِنَا الْبَلَاغُ الْمُبِينُ
versets.phonetique: Wa'aṭī'ū llāha wa'aṭī'ū r-rasūla waḥdharu fa'in tawallaytum fa'lamū annamā 'alā rasūlinā l-balāghu l-mubīn
versets.francais: Et obéissez à Allah, obéissez au Messager et prenez garde! Mais si vous vous détournez, sachez que la seule obligation de Notre messager est la transmission claire du message.
versets.anglais: And obey Allah and obey the Messenger and beware. And if you turn away - then know that upon Our Messenger is only [the responsibility for] clear notification

versets.arabe: لَيْسَ عَلَى الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ جُنَاحٌ فِيمَا طَعِمُوا إِذَا مَا اتَّقَوا وَّآمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ ثُمَّ اتَّقَوا وَّآمَنُوا ثُمَّ اتَّقَوا وَّأَحْسَنُوا
versets.phonetique: Laysa 'alā lladhīna āmanū wa'amilū ṣ-ṣāliḥāti junāḥun fīmā ṭa'imū idhā mā ttaqaw wa'āmanū wa'amilū ṣ-ṣāliḥāti thumma ttaqaw wa'āmanū thumma ttaqaw wa'aḥsanū
versets.francais: Il n'y a pas de péché pour ceux qui croient et font le bien, à l'égard de ce qu'ils auront consommé pourvu qu'ils craignent Allah, qu'ils croient et fassent le bien, puis encore craignent Allah et croient, ensuite craignent Allah et fassent le bien.
versets.anglais: There is not upon those who believe and do righteousness [any] blame concerning what they have eaten [in the past] if they [now] fear Allah and believe and do righteous deeds, and then fear Allah and believe, and then fear Allah and do good; and Allah loves the doers of good

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَيَبْلُوَنَّكُمُ اللَّهُ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنَ الصَّيْدِ تَنَالُهُ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَرِمَاحُكُمْ لِيَعْلَمَ اللَّهُ مَن يَخَافُهُ بِالْغَيْبِ ۚ فَمَنِ اعْتَدَىٰ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ فَلَهُ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Yā ayyuhā lladhīna āmanū layabluwannakumu llāhu bishay'in mina ṣ-ṣaydi tanālahu aydīkum warrimāḥukum liya'lama llāhu man yakhāfuhu bil-ghaybi faman i'tadā ba'da dhālika falahu 'adhābun alīm
versets.francais: Ô vous qui croyez! Allah vous éprouvera certes par quelque chose du gibier que peuvent atteindre vos mains et vos lances, afin qu'Allah distingue ceux qui Le craignent dans l'invisible. Quiconque transgresse après cela aura un châtiment douloureux.
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, Allah will surely test you through something of the game that your hands and spears [can] reach, that Allah may make evident those who fear Him unseen. And whoever transgresses after that - for him is a painful punishment

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تَقْتُلُوا الصَّيْدَ وَأَنتُمْ حُرُمٌ ۚ وَمَن قَتَلَهُ مِنكُم مُّتَعَمِّدًا فَجَزَاءٌ مِّثْلُ مَا قَتَلَ مِنَ النَّعَمِ يَحْكُمُ بِهِ ذَوَا عَدْلٍ مِّنكُمْ هَدْيًا بَالِغَ الْكَعْبَةِ أَوْ كَفَّارَةٌ طَعَامُ مَسَاكِينَ أَوْ عَدْلُ ذَٰلِكَ صِيَامًا
versets.phonetique: Yā ayyuhā lladhīna āmanū lā taqtulū ṣ-ṣayda wa'antum ḥurum waman qatalahu minkum muta'ammidan fajazā'un mithlu mā qatala mina n-na'ami yaḥkumu bihi dhawā 'adlin minkum hadyan bāligha l-ka'bati aw kaffāratun ṭa'āmu masākīna aw 'adlu dhālika ṣiyāmā
versets.francais: Ô vous qui croyez! Ne tuez pas le gibier quand vous êtes en état d'ihrâm. Quiconque d'entre vous le tue intentionnellement devra une compensation équivalente à ce qu'il a tué, en bétail, jugée par deux hommes équitables parmi vous, à titre d'offrande parvenant à la Ka'ba, ou en expiation nourrir des pauvres, ou jeûner l'équivalent.
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, do not kill game while you are in the state of ihram. And whoever of you kills it intentionally - the penalty is an equivalent from sacrificial animals to what he killed, as judged by two just men among you as an offering [to Allah] delivered to the Ka'bah, or an expiation: the feeding of needy people or the equivalent of that in fasting, that he may taste the consequence of his deed. Allah has pardoned what is past; but whoever returns [to violation], then Allah will take retribution from him. And Allah is Exalted in Might and Owner of Retribution

versets.arabe: أُحِلَّ لَكُمْ صَيْدُ الْبَحْرِ وَطَعَامُهُ مَتَاعًا لَّكُمْ وَلِلسَّيَّارَةِ ۖ وَحُرِّمَ عَلَيْكُمْ صَيْدُ الْبَرِّ مَا دُمْتُمْ حُرُمًا ۗ وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ الَّذِي إِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Uḥilla lakum ṣaydu l-baḥri waṭa'āmuhu matā'an lakum walil-sayyārati waḥurrima 'alaykum ṣaydu l-barri mā dumtum ḥuruman wattaqū llāha lladhī ilayhi tuḥsharūn
versets.francais: La chasse maritime et sa consommation vous sont permises pour votre jouissance et pour le bénéfice des voyageurs. Et la chasse terrestre vous est interdite tant que vous êtes en état d'ihrâm. Et craignez Allah vers qui vous serez rassemblés.
versets.anglais: Lawful to you is game from the sea and its food as provision for you and the travelers, but forbidden to you is game from the land as long as you are in the state of ihram. And fear Allah to whom you will be gathered

versets.arabe: جَعَلَ اللَّهُ الْكَعْبَةَ الْبَيْتَ الْحَرَامَ قِيَامًا لِّلنَّاسِ وَالشَّهْرَ الْحَرَامَ وَالْهَدْيَ وَالْقَلَائِدَ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِتَعْلَمُوا أَنَّ اللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Ja'ala llāhu l-ka'bata l-bayta l-ḥarāma qiyāman lin-nāsi wash-shahra l-ḥarāma wal-hadya wal-qalā'ida dhālika lita'lamū anna llāha ya'lamu mā fī s-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi wa'anna llāha bikulli shay'in 'alīm
versets.francais: Allah a fait de la Kaaba, la Maison Sacrée, un lieu de rassemblement pour les gens, ainsi que le mois sacré, les offrandes et leurs guirlandes. Cela, afin que vous sachiez qu'Allah connaît ce qui est dans les cieux et ce qui est sur la terre, et qu'Allah est Omniscient.
versets.anglais: Allah has made the Ka'bah, the Sacred House, standing for the people and [has sanctified] the sacred months and the sacrificial animals and the garlands [by which they are identified]. That is so you may know that Allah knows what is in the heavens and what is in the earth and that Allah is Knowing of all things

versets.arabe: اعْلَمُوا أَنَّ اللَّهَ شَدِيدُ الْعِقَابِ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: I'lamū anna llāha shadīdu l-'iqābi wa'anna llāha ghafūrun raḥīm
versets.francais: Sachez qu'Allah est sévère en punition et qu'Allah est Pardonneur et Miséricordieux.
versets.anglais: Know that Allah is severe in penalty and that Allah is Forgiving and Merciful

versets.arabe: مَّا عَلَى الرَّسُولِ إِلَّا الْبَلَاغُ ۗ وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تُبْدُونَ وَمَا تَكْتُمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Mā 'alā r-rasūli illā l-balāghu wallāhu ya'lamu mā tubdūna wamā taktumūn
versets.francais: La mission du Messager n'est que de transmettre le message. Et Allah sait ce que vous divulguez et ce que vous cachez.
versets.anglais: Not upon the Messenger is [responsibility] except [for] notification. And Allah knows whatever you reveal and whatever you conceal

versets.arabe: قُل لَّا يَسْتَوِي الْخَبِيثُ وَالطَّيِّبُ وَلَوْ أَعْجَبَكَ كَثْرَةُ الْخَبِيثِ ۚ فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ يَا أُولِي الْأَلْبَابِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qul lā yastawī l-khabīthu waṭ-ṭayyibu walaw a'jabaka kathratu l-khabīth fattaqū llāha yā ulī l-albābi la'allakum tufliḥūn
versets.francais: Dis: «Le mauvais et le bon ne sont pas égaux, même si l'abondance du mauvais t'émerveille.» Craignez donc Allah, ô gens doués de raison, afin que vous réussissiez.
versets.anglais: Say, "Not equal are the evil and the good, although the abundance of evil might impress you." So fear Allah, O you of understanding, that you may be successful

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تَسْأَلُوا عَنْ أَشْيَاءَ إِن تُبْدَ لَكُمْ تَسُؤْكُمْ وَإِن تَسْأَلُوا عَنْهَا حِينَ يُنَزَّلُ الْقُرْآنُ تُبْدَ لَكُمْ عَفَا اللَّهُ عَنْهَا ۗ وَاللَّهُ غَفُورٌ حَلِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Yā ayyuhā lladhīna āmanū lā tas'alū 'an ashyā'a in tubda lakum tasu'kum wa'in tas'alū 'anhā ḥīna yunazzalu l-qur'ānu tubda lakum 'afā llāhu 'anhā wallāhu ghafūrun ḥalīm
versets.francais: Ô vous qui croyez! Ne posez pas de questions sur des choses qui, si elles vous étaient révélées, vous affligeraient. Si vous posez des questions sur elles au moment où le Coran est révélé, elles vous seront révélées. Allah en a passé l'éponge. Et Allah est Pardonneur et Indulgent.
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, do not ask about things which, if they are shown to you, will distress you. But if you ask about them while the Qur'an is being revealed, they will be shown to you. Allah has pardoned that which is past; and Allah is Forgiving and Forbearing

versets.arabe: قَدْ سَأَلَهَا قَوْمٌ مِّن قَبْلِكُمْ ثُمَّ أَصْبَحُوا بِهَا كَافِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qad sa'alahā qawmun min qablikum thumma aṣbaḥū bihā kāfirīn
versets.francais: Des gens avant vous ont posé de telles questions, et ils sont ensuite devenus incrédules.
versets.anglais: A people asked such [questions] before you; then they became thereby disbelievers

versets.arabe: مَا جَعَلَ اللَّهُ مِن بَحِيرَةٍ وَلَا سَائِبَةٍ وَلَا وَصِيلَةٍ وَلَا حَامٍ ۙ وَلَٰكِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا يَفْتَرُونَ عَلَى اللَّهِ الْكَذِبَ ۖ وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Mā ja'ala llāhu min baḥīratin walā sā'ibatin walā waṣīlatin walā ḥāmin walākin lladhīna kafarū yaftarūna 'alā llāhi l-kadhiba wa'aktharuhum lā ya'qilūn
