versets.francais: Allah n'a pas institué de Bahira, ni de Saïba, ni de Wasila, ni de Ham. Mais ceux qui ne croient pas inventent des mensonges contre Allah, et la plupart d'entre eux ne raisonnent pas.
versets.anglais: Allah has not appointed [such innovations as] bahirah or sa'ibah or wasilah or ham. But those who disbelieve invent falsehood about Allah, and most of them do not reason

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَعَالَوْا إِلَىٰ مَا أَنزَلَ اللَّهُ وَإِلَى الرَّسُولِ قَالُوا حَسْبُنَا مَا وَجَدْنَا عَلَيْهِ آبَاءَنَا ۚ أَوَلَوْ كَانَ آبَاؤُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ شَيْئًا وَلَا يَهْتَدُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa'idhā qīla lahum ta'ālaw ilā mā anzala llāhu wa'ilā r-rasūli qālū ḥasbunā mā wajadnā 'alayhi ābā'anā awalaw kāna ābā'uhum lā ya'lamūna shay'an walā yahtadūn
versets.francais: Et quand on leur dit: «Venez à ce qu'Allah a fait descendre et vers le Messager», ils disent: «Ce que nous avons trouvé en pratique chez nos ancêtres nous suffit.» Et cela même si leurs ancêtres ne savaient rien et ne se guidaient pas?
versets.anglais: And when it is said to them, "Come to what Allah has revealed and to the Messenger," they say, "Sufficient for us is that upon which we found our fathers." Even though their fathers knew nothing, nor were they guided

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا عَلَيْكُمْ أَنفُسَكُمْ ۖ لَا يَضُرُّكُم مَّن ضَلَّ إِذَا اهْتَدَيْتُمْ ۚ إِلَى اللَّهِ مَرْجِعُكُمْ جَمِيعًا فَيُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Yā ayyuhā lladhīna āmanū 'alaykum anfusakum lā yaḍurrukum man ḍalla idhā htadaytum ilā llāhi marji'ukum jamī'an fayunabbi'ukum bimā kuntum ta'malūn
versets.francais: Ô vous qui croyez! Vous êtes responsables de vous-mêmes. Celui qui s'égare ne peut vous nuire si vous êtes bien guidés. C'est vers Allah que vous retournerez tous; alors Il vous informera de ce que vous faisiez.
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, upon you is [responsibility for] yourselves. Those who have gone astray will not harm you when you have been guided. To Allah is you return all together; then He will inform you of what you used to do

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا شَهَادَةُ بَيْنِكُمْ إِذَا حَضَرَ أَحَدَكُمُ الْمَوْتُ حِينَ الْوَصِيَّةِ اثْنَانِ ذَوَا عَدْلٍ مِّنكُمْ أَوْ آخَرَانِ مِنْ غَيْرِكُمْ إِنْ أَنتُمْ ضَرَبْتُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ فَأَصَابَتْكُم مُّصِيبَةُ الْمَوْتِ
versets.phonetique: Yā ayyuhā lladhīna āmanū shahādatu baynikum idhā ḥaḍara aḥadakumu l-mawtu ḥīna l-waṣiyyati thānāni dhawā 'adlin minkum aw ākharāni min ghayrikum in antum ḍarabtum fī l-arḍi fa'aṣābatkum muṣībatu l-mawt
versets.francais: Ô vous qui croyez! Quand la mort se présente à l'un de vous, au moment du testament, le témoignage doit être fait par deux hommes intègres parmi vous, ou deux autres que vous, si vous êtes en voyage et que la mort vous frappe.
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, testimony [should be taken] among you when death approaches one of you at the time of bequest - [that of] two just men from among you or two others from outside if you are traveling through the land and the disaster of death should strike you. Detain them after the prayer and let them both swear by Allah if you doubt [their testimony, saying], "We will not exchange our oath for a price, even if he should be a near relative, and we will not withhold the testimony of Allah. Indeed, we would then be of the sinful

versets.arabe: فَإِنْ عُثِرَ عَلَىٰ أَنَّهُمَا اسْتَحَقَّا إِثْمًا فَآخَرَانِ يَقُومَانِ مَقَامَهُمَا مِنَ الَّذِينَ اسْتَحَقَّ عَلَيْهِمُ الْأَوْلَيَانِ فَيُقْسِمَانِ بِاللَّهِ لَشَهَادَتُنَا أَحَقُّ مِن شَهَادَتِهِمَا وَمَا اعْتَدَيْنَا إِنَّا إِذًا لَّمِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Fa'in 'uthira 'alā annahumā staḥaqqā ithman fa'ākharāni yaqūmāni maqāmahumā mina lladhīna staḥaqqa 'alayhimu l-awlayāni fayuqsimāni billāhi lashahadatunā aḥaqqu min shahādatihimā wamā i'tadaynā innā idhan lamine ẓ-ẓālimīn
versets.francais: Si on découvre que ces deux-là ont commis un parjure, que deux autres [témoins] des héritiers les plus proches prennent leur place, et qu'ils jurent par Allah: «Notre témoignage est plus véridique que le leur et nous n'avons pas transgressé, car nous serions alors du nombre des injustes.»
versets.anglais: But if it is found that those two were guilty of perjury, let two others stand in their place [who are] foremost [in claim] from those who have a lawful right. And let them swear by Allah, "Our testimony is truer than their testimony, and we have not transgressed. Indeed, we would then be of the wrongdoers

versets.arabe: ذَٰلِكَ أَدْنَىٰ أَن يَأْتُوا بِالشَّهَادَةِ عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهَا أَوْ يَخَافُوا أَن تُرَدَّ أَيْمَانٌ بَعْدَ أَيْمَانِهِمْ ۗ وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَاسْمَعُوا ۗ وَاللَّهُ لَا يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ الْفَاسِقِينَ
versets.phonetique: Dhālika adnā an ya'tū bish-shahādati 'alā wajhihā aw yakhāfū an turadda aymānun ba'da aymānihim wattaqū llāha wasma'ū wallāhu lā yahdī l-qawma l-fāsiqīn
versets.francais: Cela permettra mieux d'obtenir un témoignage correct, ou de craindre qu'un autre serment soit rejeté après leurs serments. Et craignez Allah et écoutez. Allah ne guide pas les gens pervers.
versets.anglais: That is more likely that they will give testimony according to its [true] objective, or [at least] they would fear that [other] oaths might be taken after their oaths. And fear Allah and listen; and Allah does not guide the defiantly disobedient people

versets.arabe: يَوْمَ يَجْمَعُ اللَّهُ الرُّسُلَ فَيَقُولُ مَاذَا أُجِبْتُمْ ۖ قَالُوا لَا عِلْمَ لَنَا ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ عَلَّامُ الْغُيُوبِ
versets.phonetique: Yawma yajma'u llāhu r-rusula fayaqūlu mādhā ujibtum qālū lā 'ilma lanā innaka anta 'allāmu l-ghuyūb
versets.francais: Le jour où Allah réunira les messagers et leur dira: «Quelle réponse vous a-t-on faite?» Ils diront: «Nous n'en savons rien. C'est Toi le Connaisseur parfait des invisibles.»
versets.anglais: [Be warned of] the Day when Allah will assemble the messengers and say, "What was the response you received?" They will say, "We have no knowledge. Indeed, it is You who is Knower of the unseen

versets.arabe: إِذْ قَالَ اللَّهُ يَا عِيسَى ابْنَ مَرْيَمَ اذْكُرْ نِعْمَتِي عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَىٰ وَالِدَتِكَ إِذْ أَيَّدتُّكَ بِرُوحِ الْقُدُسِ تُكَلِّمُ النَّاسَ فِي الْمَهْدِ وَكَهْلًا ۖ وَإِذْ عَلَّمْتُكَ الْكِتَابَ وَالْحِكْمَةَ وَالتَّوْرَاةَ وَالْإِنجِيلَ
versets.phonetique: Idh qāla llāhu yā 'īsā bna maryama dhkur ni'matī 'alayka wa'alā wālidatika idh ayyadtuka birūḥi l-qudusi tukallimu n-nāsa fī l-mahdi wakahlan wa'idh 'allamtuka l-kitāba wal-ḥikmata wat-tawrāta wal-injīl
versets.francais: Allah dira: «Ô Jésus, fils de Marie! Rappelle-toi Mon bienfait sur toi et sur ta mère, quand Je t'ai soutenu du Saint-Esprit: tu parlais aux gens au berceau et en tant qu'adulte; et quand Je t'ai enseigné le Livre, la Sagesse, la Torah et l'Evangile.»
versets.anglais: [The Day] when Allah will say, "O Jesus, Son of Mary, remember My favor upon you and upon your mother when I supported you with the Pure Spirit and you spoke to the people in the cradle and in maturity; and [remember] when I taught you writing and wisdom and the Torah and the Gospel; and when you designed from clay [what was] like the form of a bird with My permission, then you breathed into it, and it became a bird with My permission; and you healed the blind and the leper with My permission; and when you brought forth the dead with My permission; and when I restrained the Children of Israel from [killing] you when you came to them with clear proofs and those who disbelieved among them said, "This is not but obvious magic

versets.arabe: وَإِذْ أَوْحَيْتُ إِلَى الْحَوَارِيِّينَ أَنْ آمِنُوا بِي وَبِرَسُولِي قَالُوا آمَنَّا وَاشْهَدْ بِأَنَّنَا مُسْلِمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa'idh awḥaytu ilā l-ḥawāriyyīna an āminū bī birasūlī qālū āmannā washhad bi'annanā muslimūn
versets.francais: Et quand J'ai inspiré aux Apôtres: «Croyez en Moi et en Mon messager», ils dirent: «Nous croyons. Et sois témoin que nous sommes soumis.»
versets.anglais: And [remember] when I inspired to the disciples, "Believe in Me and in My messenger Jesus." They said, "We have believed, so bear witness that indeed we are Muslims [in submission to Allah]

versets.arabe: إِذْ قَالَ الْحَوَارِيُّونَ يَا عِيسَى ابْنَ مَرْيَمَ هَلْ يَسْتَطِيعُ رَبُّكَ أَن يُنَزِّلَ عَلَيْنَا مَائِدَةً مِّنَ السَّمَاءِ ۖ قَالَ اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Idh qāla l-ḥawāriyyūna yā 'īsā bna maryama hal yastaṭī'u rabbuka an yunazzila 'alaynā mā'idatan mina s-samā'i qāla ttaqū llāha in kuntum mu'minīn
versets.francais: Quand les Apôtres dirent: «Ô Jésus, fils de Marie, ton Seigneur peut-Il faire descendre pour nous une table servie du ciel?» Il dit: «Craignez Allah si vous êtes croyants.»
versets.anglais: [And remember] when the disciples said, "O Jesus, Son of Mary, can your Lord send down to us a table [spread with food] from the heaven? [Jesus] said," Fear Allah, if you should be believers

versets.arabe: قَالُوا نُرِيدُ أَن نَّأْكُلَ مِنْهَا وَتَطْمَئِنَّ قُلُوبُنَا وَنَعْلَمَ أَن قَدْ صَدَقْتَنَا وَنَكُونَ عَلَيْهَا مِنَ الشَّاهِدِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qālū nurīdu an na'kula minhā waṭaṭma'inna qulūbunā wana'lama an qad ṣadaqtanā wanakūna 'alayhā mina sh-shāhidīn
versets.francais: Ils dirent: «Nous voulons manger de cette table, pour que nos cœurs se rassurent, que nous sachions que tu nous as dit la vérité, et pour en être témoins.»
versets.anglais: They said, "We wish to eat from it and let our hearts be reassured and know that you have been truthful to us and be among its witnesses

versets.arabe: قَالَ عِيسَى ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا أَنزِلْ عَلَيْنَا مَائِدَةً مِّنَ السَّمَاءِ تَكُونُ لَنَا عِيدًا لِّأَوَّلِنَا وَآخِرِنَا وَآيَةً مِّنكَ ۖ وَارْزُقْنَا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الرَّازِقِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qāla 'īsā bnu maryama llāhumma rabbanā anzil 'alaynā mā'idatan mina s-samā'i takūnu lanā 'īdan li'awwalinā wa'ākhirinā wa'āyatan minka warzuqnā wa'anta khayru r-rāziqīn
versets.francais: Jésus, fils de Marie, dit: «Ô Allah, notre Seigneur! Fais descendre sur nous une table du ciel qui sera pour nous une fête, pour le premier et le dernier d'entre nous, et un signe de Ta part. Et pourvois-nous en nourriture. Tu es le meilleur des pourvoyeurs.»
versets.anglais: Said Jesus, the son of Mary, "O Allah, our Lord, send down to us a table [spread with food] from the heaven to be for us a festival for the first of us and the last of us and a sign from You. And provide for us, and You are the best of providers

versets.arabe: قَالَ اللَّهُ إِنِّي مُنَزِّلُهَا عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ فَمَن يَكْفُرْ بَعْدُ مِنكُمْ فَإِنِّي أُعَذِّبُهُ عَذَابًا لَّا أُعَذِّبُهُ أَحَدًا مِّنَ الْعَالَمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qāla llāhu innī munazziluhā 'alaykum faman yakfur ba'du minkum fa'innī u'adhdhibuhu 'adhāban lā u'adhdhibuhu aḥadan mina l-'ālamīn
versets.francais: Allah dit: «Je vais la faire descendre sur vous. Mais quiconque parmi vous se montrera ingrat après cela, Je le châtierai d'un châtiment dont Je n'aurai châtié personne dans l'univers.»
versets.anglais: Allah said, "Indeed, I will sent it down to you, but whoever disbelieves afterwards from among you - then indeed will I punish him with a punishment by which I have not punished anyone among the worlds

versets.arabe: وَإِذْ قَالَ اللَّهُ يَا عِيسَى ابْنَ مَرْيَمَ أَأَنتَ قُلْتَ لِلنَّاسِ اتَّخِذُونِي وَأُمِّيَ إِلَٰهَيْنِ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ ۖ قَالَ سُبْحَانَكَ مَا يَكُونُ لِي أَنْ أَقُولَ مَا لَيْسَ لِي بِحَقٍّ
versets.phonetique: Wa'idh qāla llāhu yā 'īsā bna maryama a'anta qulta lin-nāsi ttakhidhūnī wa'ummiya ilāhayni min dūni llāhi qāla subḥānaka mā yakūnu lī an aqūla mā laysa lī biḥaqq
versets.francais: Et quand Allah dit: «Ô Jésus, fils de Marie, est-ce toi qui as dit aux gens: Prenez-moi, moi et ma mère, pour deux divinités en dehors d'Allah?» Il dit: «Gloire à Toi! Il ne m'appartient pas de dire ce à quoi je n'ai pas droit.»
versets.anglais: And [beware the Day] when Allah will say, "O Jesus, Son of Mary, did you say to the people, 'Take me and my mother as deities besides Allah?'" He will say, "Exalted are You! It was not for me to say that to which I have no right. If I had said it, You would have known it. You know what is within myself, and I do not know what is within Yourself. Indeed, it is You who is Knower of the unseen

versets.arabe: مَا قُلْتُ لَهُمْ إِلَّا مَا أَمَرْتَنِي بِهِ أَنِ اعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ رَبِّي وَرَبَّكُمْ ۚ وَكُنتُ عَلَيْهِمْ شَهِيدًا مَّا دُمْتُ فِيهِمْ ۖ فَلَمَّا تَوَفَّيْتَنِي كُنتَ أَنتَ الرَّقِيبَ عَلَيْهِمْ ۚ وَأَنتَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ شَهِيدٌ
versets.phonetique: Mā qultu lahum illā mā amartanī bihi ani 'budū llāha rabbī warabbakum wakuntu 'alayhim shahīdan mā dumtu fīhim falammā tawaffaytanī kunta anta r-raqība 'alayhim wa'anta 'alā kulli shay'in shahīd
versets.francais: «Je ne leur ai dit que ce que Tu m'avais commandé: «Adorez Allah, mon Seigneur et votre Seigneur.» J'étais témoin sur eux, tant que j'étais parmi eux. Mais quand Tu m'as rappelé à Toi, c'est Toi qui étais le Surveillant sur eux. Et Tu es Témoin de toute chose.»
versets.anglais: I said not to them except what You commanded me - to worship Allah, my Lord and your Lord. And I was a witness over them as long as I was among them; but when You took me up, You were the Observer over them, and You are, over all things, Witness

versets.arabe: إِن تُعَذِّبْهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ عِبَادُكَ ۖ وَإِن تَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ فَإِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ
versets.phonetique: In tu'adhdhibhum fa'innahum 'ibāduka wa'in taghfir lahum fa'innaka anta l-'azīzu l-ḥakīm
versets.francais: «Si Tu les châties, ils sont Tes serviteurs; et si Tu leur pardonnes, Tu es le Puissant, le Sage.»
versets.anglais: If You should punish them - indeed they are Your servants; but if You forgive them - indeed it is You who is the Exalted in Might, the Wise

versets.arabe: قَالَ اللَّهُ هَٰذَا يَوْمُ يَنفَعُ الصَّادِقِينَ صِدْقُهُمْ ۚ لَهُمْ جَنَّاتٌ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا أَبَدًا ۚ رَّضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ وَرَضُوا عَنْهُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ
versets.phonetique: Qāla llāhu hādhā yawmu yanfa'u ṣ-ṣādiqīna ṣidquhum lahum jannātun tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru khālidīna fīhā abadan raḍiya llāhu 'anhum waraḍū 'anhu dhālika l-fawzu l-'aẓīm
versets.francais: Allah dit: «Voici le jour où la véracité des véridiques leur sera profitable. Ils auront des jardins sous lesquels coulent les ruisseaux, où ils demeureront éternellement. Allah est satisfait d'eux et ils sont satisfaits de Lui. C'est là l'immense succès.»
versets.anglais: Allah will say, "This is the Day when the truthful will benefit from their truthfulness." For them are gardens [in Paradise] beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever, Allah being pleased with them, and they with Him. That is the great attainment

versets.arabe: لِلَّهِ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا فِيهِنَّ ۚ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
versets.phonetique: Lillāhi mulku s-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā fīhinna wahuwa 'alā kulli shay'in qadīr
versets.francais: A Allah appartient la royauté des cieux et de la terre et de tout ce qu'ils contiennent. Et Il est Omnipotent.
versets.anglais: To Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatever is within them. And He is over all things competent

versets.arabe: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَجَعَلَ الظُّلُمَاتِ وَالنُّورَ
versets.phonetique: Alhamdu lillahi allathee khalaqa alssamawati wal-arda wajaAAala alththulumati waalnnoora
versets.francais: Louange à Allah qui a créé les cieux et la terre et a établi les ténèbres et la lumière.
versets.anglais: [All] praise is [due] to Allah, who created the heavens and the earth and made the darkness and the light. Then those who disbelieve equate [others] with their Lord

versets.arabe: هُوَ الَّذِي خَلَقَكُم مِّن طِينٍ ثُمَّ قَضَىٰ أَجَلًا وَأَجَلٌ مُّسَمًّى عِندَهُ
versets.phonetique: Huwa allathee khalaqakum min teenin thumma qada ajalan waajulun musamman AAindahu
versets.francais: C'est Lui qui vous a créés d'argile, puis Il a fixé un terme, et un terme précis est auprès de Lui.
versets.anglais: It is He who created you from clay and then decreed a term and a specified time [known] to Him; then [still] you are in dispute

versets.arabe: وَهُوَ اللَّهُ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَفِي الْأَرْضِ يَعْلَمُ سِرَّكُمْ وَجَهْرَكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Wahuwa Allahu fee alssamawati wafee al-ardi yaAAlamu sirrakum wajaHrakum
versets.francais: Et c'est Lui Allah dans les cieux et sur la terre. Il connaît votre secret et ce que vous divulguez.
versets.anglais: And He is Allah, [the only deity] in the heavens and the earth. He knows your secret and what you make public, and He knows that which you earn

versets.arabe: وَمَا تَأْتِيهِم مِّنْ آيَةٍ مِّنْ آيَاتِ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَّا كَانُوا عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wama ta'teehim min ayatin min ayati rabbihim illa kanoo AAanha muAArideen
versets.francais: Nulle part il ne leur vient un signe parmi les signes de leur Seigneur sans qu'ils s'en détournent.
versets.anglais: And no sign comes to them from the signs of their Lord except that they turn away therefrom

versets.arabe: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوا بِالْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ فَسَوْفَ يَأْتِيهِمْ أَنبَاءُ مَا كَانُوا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِئُونَ
versets.phonetique: Faqad kaththaboo bialhaqqi lamma jaahum fasawfa ya'teehim anbao ma kanoo bihi yastahzi'oon
versets.francais: Ils ont nié la vérité quand elle leur est venue. Or viendront bientôt à eux les nouvelles de ce dont ils se moquaient.
versets.anglais: For they had denied the truth when it came to them, but there is going to reach them the news of what they used to ridicule

versets.arabe: أَلَمْ يَرَوْا كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن قَرْنٍ مَّكَّنَّاهُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ مَا لَمْ نُمَكِّن لَّكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Alam yaraw kam ahlakna min qablihim min qarnin makkannahum fee al-ardi ma lam numakkin lakum
versets.francais: N'ont-ils pas vu combien de générations Nous avons anéanties avant eux, à qui Nous avions accordé une stabilité sur terre que Nous ne vous avons pas accordée?
versets.anglais: Have they not seen how many generations We destroyed before them which We had established upon the earth as We have not established you? And We sent [rain from] the sky upon them in showers and made rivers flow beneath them; then We destroyed them for their sins and brought forth after them a generation of others

versets.arabe: وَلَوْ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ كِتَابًا فِي قِرْطَاسٍ فَلَمَسُوهُ بِأَيْدِيهِمْ لَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا إِنْ هَٰذَا إِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ
versets.phonetique: Walaw nazzalna AAalayka kitaban fee qirtasin falamasoohu bi-aydeehim laqala allatheena kafaroo in hatha illa sihrun mubeen
versets.francais: Et si Nous avions fait descendre sur toi un livre écrit sur du papier et qu'ils l'eussent touché de leurs mains, ceux qui ont mécru auraient dit: "Ce n'est là qu'une magie évidente."
versets.anglais: And even if We had sent down to you, [O Muhammad], a written scripture on a page and they touched it with their hands, the disbelievers would say, "This is not but obvious magic

versets.arabe: وَقَالُوا لَوْلَا أُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ مَلَكٌ وَلَوْ أَنزَلْنَا مَلَكًا لَّقُضِيَ الْأَمْرُ ثُمَّ لَا يُنظَرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Waqaloo lawla onzila AAalayhi malakun walaw anzalna malakan laqudiya al-amru thumma la yuntharoon
versets.francais: Ils ont dit: "Que n'a-t-on fait descendre sur lui un ange!" Si Nous avions fait descendre un ange, l'affaire eût été réglée et ils n'auraient plus eu de délai.
versets.anglais: And they say, "Why was there not sent down to him an angel?" But if We had sent down an angel, the matter would have been decided; then they would not be reprieved

versets.arabe: وَلَوْ جَعَلْنَاهُ مَلَكًا لَّجَعَلْنَاهُ رَجُلًا وَلَلَبَسْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّا يَلْبِسُونَ
versets.phonetique: Walaw jaAAalnahu malakan lajaAAalnahu rajulan walalabasna AAalayhim ma yalbasoon
versets.francais: Et si Nous en avions fait un ange, c'est sous forme d'un homme que Nous l'aurions fait, et Nous les aurions couverts de la même confusion dont ils se couvrent.
versets.anglais: And if We had made him an angel, We would have made him [appear as] a man, and We would have covered them with that in which they cover themselves

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدِ اسْتُهْزِئَ بِرُسُلٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ فَحَاقَ بِالَّذِينَ سَخِرُوا مِنْهُمْ مَّا كَانُوا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِئُونَ
versets.phonetique: Walaqadi istuhzi'a birusulin min qablika fahaaqa biAllatheena sakhiroo minhum ma kanoo bihi yastahzi'oon
versets.francais: Des messagers avant toi ont été raillés. Mais ceux qui se moquaient d'eux furent enveloppés par ce dont ils se moquaient.
versets.anglais: And already were messengers ridiculed before you, but those who mocked them were enveloped by that which they used to ridicule

versets.arabe: قُلْ سِيرُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ ثُمَّ انظُرُوا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُكَذِّبِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qul seeroo fee al-ardi thumma onthuroo kayfa kana AAaqibatu almukaththibeen
versets.francais: Dis: "Parcourez la terre, puis regardez ce qu'il en est advenu de ceux qui ont nié."
versets.anglais: Say, "Travel through the land; then observe how was the end of the deniers

versets.arabe: قُل لِّمَن مَّا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ قُل لِّلَّهِ كَتَبَ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِ الرَّحْمَةَ
versets.phonetique: Qul liman ma fee alssamawati wal-ardi qul lillahi kataba AAala nafsihi alrrahmata
versets.francais: Dis: "À qui appartient ce qui est dans les cieux et sur la terre?" Dis: "À Allah." Il S'est prescrit la miséricorde.
versets.anglais: Say, "To whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and earth?" Say, "To Allah." He has decreed upon Himself mercy. He will surely assemble you for the Day of Resurrection, about which there is no doubt. Those who will lose themselves [that Day] do not believe

versets.arabe: وَلَهُ مَا سَكَنَ فِي اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
versets.phonetique: Walahu ma sakana fee allayli waalnnnahari wahuwa alssamiAAu alAAaleem
versets.francais: À Lui appartient tout ce qui habite la nuit et le jour. Et Il est l'Audient, l'Omniscient.
versets.anglais: And to Him belongs that which reposes by night and by day, and He is the Hearing, the Knowing

versets.arabe: قُلْ أَغَيْرَ اللَّهِ أَتَّخِذُ وَلِيًّا فَاطِرِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ
versets.phonetique: Qul aghaYra Allahi attakhithu waliyyan fatiri alssamawati wal-ardi
versets.francais: Dis: "Prendrais-je un autre allié qu'Allah, le Créateur des cieux et de la terre?"
versets.anglais: Say, "Is it other than Allah I should take as a protector, Creator of the heavens and the earth, while it is He who feeds and is not fed?" Say, [O Muhammad], "Indeed, I have been commanded to be the first [among you] who submit [to Allah] and [was commanded], 'Do not ever be of the polytheists

versets.arabe: قُلْ إِنِّي أَخَافُ إِنْ عَصَيْتُ رَبِّي عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
versets.phonetique: Qul innee akhafu in AAasaytu rabbee AAathaba yawmin AAatheem
versets.francais: Dis: "Je crains, si je désobéis à mon Seigneur, le châtiment d'un jour terrible."
versets.anglais: Say, "Indeed I fear, if I should disobey my Lord, the punishment of a tremendous Day

versets.arabe: مَّن يُصْرَفْ عَنْهُ يَوْمَئِذٍ فَقَدْ رَحِمَهُ وَذَٰلِكَ الْفَوْزُ الْمُبِينُ
versets.phonetique: Man yusraf AAanhu yawma'ithin faqad rahimahu wathalika alfawzu almubeen
versets.francais: Celui à qui on l'aura écarté ce jour-là, Allah lui aura fait miséricorde. Et c'est le succès évident.
versets.anglais: He from whom it is averted that Day - [Allah] has granted him mercy. And that is the clear attainment

versets.arabe: وَإِن يَمْسَسْكَ اللَّهُ بِضُرٍّ فَلَا كَاشِفَ لَهُ إِلَّا هُوَ وَإِن يَمْسَسْكَ بِخَيْرٍ فَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa-in yamsaska Allahu bidurrin fala kashifa lahu illa huwa wa-in yamsaska bikhayrin fahuwa AAala kulli shay'in qadeer
versets.francais: Si Allah te touche d'une affliction, nul ne peut l'enlever en dehors de Lui. Et s'Il te touche d'un bien, c'est qu'Il est Omnipotent.
versets.anglais: And if Allah should touch you with adversity, there is no remover of it except Him. And if He touches you with good - then He is over all things competent

versets.arabe: وَهُوَ الْقَاهِرُ فَوْقَ عِبَادِهِ وَهُوَ الْحَكِيمُ الْخَبِيرُ
versets.phonetique: Wahuwa alqahiru fawqa AAibadihi wahuwa alhakeemu alkhabeer
versets.francais: Il est le Dominateur suprême de Ses serviteurs. Il est le Sage, le Bien Informé.
versets.anglais: And He is the subjugator over His servants. And He is the Wise, the Acquainted [with all]

versets.arabe: قُلْ أَيُّ شَيْءٍ أَكْبَرُ شَهَادَةً قُلِ اللَّهُ شَهِيدٌ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Qul ayyu shay'in akbaru shahAdatan quli Allahu shaheedun baynee wabaynakum
versets.francais: Dis: "Quelle chose est la plus grande en témoignage?" Dis: "Allah est témoin entre moi et vous."
versets.anglais: Say, "What thing is greatest in testimony?" Say, "Allah is witness between me and you. And this Qur'an was revealed to me that I may warn you thereby and whomever it reaches. Do you [truly] testify that with Allah there are other deities?" Say, "I will not testify [with you]." Say, "Indeed, He is but one God, and indeed, I am free of what you associate [with Him]

versets.arabe: الَّذِينَ آتَيْنَاهُمُ الْكِتَابَ يَعْرِفُونَهُ كَمَا يَعْرِفُونَ أَبْنَاءَهُمُ الَّذِينَ خَسِرُوا أَنفُسَهُمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
versets.phonetique: Allatheena ataynahumu alkitaba yaAArifoonahu kama yaAArifoona abnaahum allatheena khasiroo anfusahum fahum la yu'minoon
versets.francais: Ceux à qui Nous avons donné le Livre le reconnaissent comme ils reconnaissent leurs propres enfants. Ceux qui ont perdu leurs âmes ne croient pas.
versets.anglais: Those to whom We have given the Scripture recognize it as they recognize their [own] sons. Those who will lose themselves [in the Hereafter] do not believe

versets.arabe: وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ افْتَرَىٰ عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا أَوْ كَذَّبَ بِآيَاتِهِ
versets.phonetique: Waman athlamu mimmani iftara AAala Allahi kathiban aw kaththaba bi-ayatihi
versets.francais: Qui est plus injuste que celui qui invente un mensonge contre Allah ou qui dément Ses signes?
versets.anglais: And who is more unjust than one who invents about Allah a lie or denies His verses? Indeed, the wrongdoers will not succeed

versets.arabe: وَيَوْمَ نَحْشُرُهُمْ جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ نَقُولُ لِلَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوا أَيْنَ شُرَكَاؤُكُمُ الَّذِينَ كُنتُمْ تَزْعُمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wayawma nahshuruhum jameeAAan thumma naqoolu lillatheena ashrakoo ayna shurakakumu allatheena kuntum tazAAumoon
versets.francais: Le jour où Nous les rassemblerons tous, Nous dirons à ceux qui ont associé: "Où sont vos associés dont vous prétendiez qu'ils l'étaient?"
versets.anglais: And [mention, O Muhammad], the Day We will gather them all together; then We will say to those who associated others with Allah, "Where are your 'partners' that you used to claim [with Him]

versets.arabe: ثُمَّ لَمْ تَكُن فِتْنَتُهُمْ إِلَّا أَن قَالُوا وَاللَّهِ رَبِّنَا مَا كُنَّا مُشْرِكِينَ
versets.phonetique: Thumma lam takun fitnatuhum illa an qaloo wallahi rabbina ma kunna mushrikeen
versets.francais: Leur seule excuse sera de dire: "Par Allah notre Seigneur! Nous n'étions pas des associateurs."
versets.anglais: Then there will be no [excuse upon] examination except they will say, "By Allah, our Lord, we were not those who associated

versets.arabe: انظُرْ كَيْفَ كَذَبُوا عَلَىٰ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَضَلَّ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا يَفْتَرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Onthur kayfa kathaboo AAala anfusihim wadalla AAanhum ma kanoo yaftaroon
versets.francais: Regarde comment ils mentent contre eux-mêmes, et comment s'est égaré d'eux ce qu'ils inventaient.
versets.anglais: See how they will lie about themselves. And lost from them will be what they used to invent

versets.arabe: وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَسْتَمِعُ إِلَيْكَ وَجَعَلْنَا عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ أَكِنَّةً أَن يَفْقَهُوهُ وَفِي آذَانِهِمْ وَقْرًا
versets.phonetique: Waminhum man yastamiAAu ilayka wajaAAalna AAala quloobihim akinnatan an yafqahoohu wafee athanihim waqra
versets.francais: Parmi eux il en est qui t'écoutent; mais Nous avons mis des voiles sur leurs cœurs qui les empêchent de comprendre, et une surdité dans leurs oreilles.
versets.anglais: And among them are those who listen to you, but We have placed over their hearts coverings, lest they understand it, and in their ears deafness. And if they should see every sign, they will not believe in it. Even when they come to you arguing with you, those who disbelieve say, "This is not but legends of the former peoples

versets.arabe: وَهُمْ يَنْهَوْنَ عَنْهُ وَيَنْأَوْنَ عَنْهُ وَإِن يُهْلِكُونَ إِلَّا أَنفُسَهُمْ وَمَا يَشْعُرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wahum yanhawna AAanhu wayan'awna AAanhu wa-in yuhlikoona illa anfusahum wama yashAAuroon
versets.francais: Ils en éloignent les autres et s'en éloignent eux-mêmes. Ils ne se perdent qu'eux-mêmes sans le percevoir.
versets.anglais: And they prevent [others] from him and are [themselves] remote from him. And they do not destroy except themselves, but they perceive [it] not

versets.arabe: وَلَوْ تَرَىٰ إِذْ وُقِفُوا عَلَى النَّارِ فَقَالُوا يَا لَيْتَنَا نُرَدُّ وَلَا نُكَذِّبَ بِآيَاتِ رَبِّنَا
versets.phonetique: Walaw tara ith wuqifoo AAala alnnari faqaloo ya laytana nuraddu wala nukaththiba bi-ayati rabbina
versets.francais: Si tu les voyais quand ils seront arrêtés devant le Feu et qu'ils diront: "Si seulement nous pouvions être retournés! Nous ne démentirons plus les signes de notre Seigneur."
versets.anglais: If you could but see when they are made to stand before the Fire and will say, "Oh, would that we could be returned [to life on earth] and not deny the signs of our Lord and be among the believers

versets.arabe: بَلْ بَدَا لَهُم مَّا كَانُوا يُخْفُونَ مِن قَبْلُ وَلَوْ رُدُّوا لَعَادُوا لِمَا نُهُوا عَنْهُ
versets.phonetique: Bal bada lahum ma kanoo yukhfoona min qablu walaw ruddoo laAAadoo lima nuhoo AAanh
versets.francais: Bien au contraire, ce qu'ils cachaient auparavant leur est apparu. Et si on les retournait, ils reviendraient à ce qui leur a été interdit.
versets.anglais: But what they concealed before has [now] appeared to them. And even if they were returned, they would return to that which they were forbidden; and indeed, they are liars

versets.arabe: وَقَالُوا إِنْ هِيَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا الدُّنْيَا وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَبْعُوثِينَ
versets.phonetique: Waqaloo in hiya illa hayatuna alddunya wama nahnu bimaAAbooTheen
versets.francais: Ils disent: "Il n'y a que notre vie présente et nous ne serons pas ressuscités."
versets.anglais: And they say, "There is none but our worldly life, and we will not be resurrected

versets.arabe: وَلَوْ تَرَىٰ إِذْ وُقِفُوا عَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ قَالَ أَلَيْسَ هَٰذَا بِالْحَقِّ قَالُوا بَلَىٰ وَرَبِّنَا
versets.phonetique: Walaw tara ith wuqifoo AAala rabbihim qala alaysa hatha bialhaqqi qaloo bala warabbina
versets.francais: Si tu les voyais quand ils seront arrêtés devant leur Seigneur. Il dira: "N'est-ce pas la vérité?" Ils diront: "Mais si, par notre Seigneur!"
versets.anglais: If you could but see when they will be made to stand before their Lord. He will say, "Is this not the truth?" They will say, "Yes, by our Lord." He will [then] say, "So taste the punishment because you used to disbelieve

versets.arabe: قَدْ خَسِرَ الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا بِلِقَاءِ اللَّهِ حَتَّىٰ إِذَا جَاءَتْهُمُ السَّاعَةُ بَغْتَةً
versets.phonetique: Qad khasira allatheena kaththaboo biliqai Allahi hatta itha jaathumu alssaAAatu baghtatan
versets.francais: Ceux qui ont nié la rencontre d'Allah ont perdu, jusqu'à ce que l'Heure leur vienne à l'improviste.
versets.anglais: Those will have lost who deny the meeting with Allah, until when the Hour [of resurrection] comes upon them unexpectedly, they will say, "Oh, [how great is] our regret over what we neglected concerning it," while they bear their burdens on their backs. Unquestionably, evil is that which they bear

versets.arabe: وَمَا الْحَيَاةُ الدُّنْيَا إِلَّا لَعِبٌ وَلَهْوٌ وَلَلدَّارُ الْآخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ لِّلَّذِينَ يَتَّقُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wama alhayatu alddunya illa laAAibun walahwun walaldaru al-akhiratu khayrun lillatheena yattaqoon
versets.francais: La vie d'ici-bas n'est que jeu et divertissement. La demeure de l'au-delà est certes meilleure pour ceux qui ont la piété.
versets.anglais: And the worldly life is not but amusement and diversion; but the home of the Hereafter is best for those who fear Allah, so will you not reason

versets.arabe: قَدْ نَعْلَمُ إِنَّهُ لَيَحْزُنُكَ الَّذِي يَقُولُونَ فَإِنَّهُمْ لَا يُكَذِّبُونَكَ وَلَٰكِنَّ الظَّالِمِينَ بِآيَاتِ اللَّهِ يَجْحَدُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qad naAAlamu innahu layahzunuka allathee yaqooloona fa-innahum la yukaththiboonaka walakinna alththalimeena bi-ayati Allahi yajhadoon
versets.francais: Nous savons bien que ce qu'ils disent te chagrine. Ce n'est pas toi qu'ils traitent de menteur, mais c'est les versets d'Allah que les injustes rejettent.
versets.anglais: We know that you, [O Muhammad], are saddened by what they say. And indeed, they do not call you untruthful, but it is the verses of Allah that the wrongdoers reject

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ كُذِّبَتْ رُسُلٌ مِّن قَبْلِكَ فَصَبَرُوا عَلَىٰ مَا كُذِّبُوا وَأُوذُوا حَتَّىٰ أَتَاهُمْ نَصْرُنَا
versets.phonetique: Walaqad kuththibat rusulun min qablika fasabaroo AAala ma kuththiboo waoothoo hatta atahum nasruna
versets.francais: Des messagers avant toi ont été traités de menteurs; ils ont enduré d'être niés et d'être maltraités jusqu'à ce que Notre secours leur vînt.
versets.anglais: And certainly were messengers denied before you, but they were patient over [the effects of] denial, and they were harmed until Our victory came to them. And none can alter the words of Allah. And there has certainly come to you some information about the [previous] messengers

versets.arabe: وَإِن كَانَ كَبُرَ عَلَيْكَ إِعْرَاضُهُمْ فَإِنِ اسْتَطَعْتَ أَن تَبْتَغِيَ نَفَقًا فِي الْأَرْضِ أَوْ سُلَّمًا فِي السَّمَاءِ
versets.phonetique: Wa-in kana kabura AAalayka iAAraduhum fa-ini istataAAta an tabtaghiya nafaqan fee al-ardi aw sullaman fee alssama
versets.francais: Si leur aversion t'est pénible et si tu peux chercher un tunnel dans la terre ou une échelle vers le ciel pour leur apporter un signe...
versets.anglais: And if their evasion is difficult for you, then if you are able to seek a tunnel into the earth or a stairway into the sky to bring them a sign, [then do so]. But if Allah had willed, He would have united them upon guidance. So never be of the ignorant

versets.arabe: إِنَّمَا يَسْتَجِيبُ الَّذِينَ يَسْمَعُونَ وَالْمَوْتَىٰ يَبْعَثُهُمُ اللَّهُ ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ يُرْجَعُونَ
versets.phonetique: Innama yastajeebu allatheena yasmaAAoona waalmawta yabAAathuhumu Allahu thumma ilayhi yurjaAAoon
versets.francais: Seuls répondent ceux qui entendent; quant aux morts, Allah les ressuscitera, puis c'est vers Lui qu'ils seront ramenés.
versets.anglais: Only those who hear will respond. But the dead - Allah will resurrect them; then to Him they will be returned

versets.arabe: وَقَالُوا لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ آيَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِ قُلْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَادِرٌ عَلَىٰ أَن يُنَزِّلَ آيَةً
versets.phonetique: Waqaloo lawla nuzzila AAalayhi ayatun min rabbihi qul inna Allaha qadirun AAala an yunazzila ayatan
versets.francais: Ils disent: "Que n'a-t-on fait descendre sur lui un signe de son Seigneur!" Dis: "Allah est certes capable de faire descendre un signe."
versets.anglais: And they say, "Why has a sign not been sent down to him from his Lord?" Say, "Indeed, Allah is Able to send down a sign, but most of them do not know

versets.arabe: وَمَا مِن دَابَّةٍ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا طَائِرٍ يَطِيرُ بِجَنَاحَيْهِ إِلَّا أُمَمٌ أَمْثَالُكُم
versets.phonetique: Wama min dabbatin fee al-ardi wala ta'irin yateeru bijanahayhi illa umumun amthalukum
versets.francais: Il n'y a pas d'animal sur terre, ni d'oiseau volant de ses ailes qui ne soient des communautés semblables à vous.
versets.anglais: And there is no creature on [or within] the earth or bird that flies with its wings except [that they are] communities like you. We have not neglected in the Register a thing. Then unto their Lord they will be gathered

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا بِآيَاتِنَا صُمٌّ وَبُكْمٌ فِي الظُّلُمَاتِ مَن يَشَأِ اللَّهُ يُضْلِلْهُ
versets.phonetique: Wallatheena kaththaboo bi-ayatina summun wabumkun fee alththulumati man yasha Allahu yudlilhu
versets.francais: Ceux qui ont démenti Nos signes sont sourds et muets dans les ténèbres. Allah égare qui Il veut.
versets.anglais: But those who deny Our verses are deaf and dumb within darknesses. Whomever Allah wills - He leaves astray; and whomever He wills - He puts him on a straight path

versets.arabe: قُلْ أَرَأَيْتَكُمْ إِنْ أَتَاكُمْ عَذَابُ اللَّهِ أَوْ أَتَتْكُمُ السَّاعَةُ أَغَيْرَ اللَّهِ تَدْعُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qul araaytakum in atakum AAathabu Allahi aw atatakumu alssaAAatu aghaYra Allahi tadAAoon
versets.francais: Dis: "Que pensez-vous? Si le châtiment d'Allah vous vient ou si l'Heure vous vient, invoquez-vous autre qu'Allah?"
versets.anglais: Say, "Have you considered: if there came to you the punishment of Allah or there came to you the Hour - is it other than Allah you would invoke, if you should be truthful

versets.arabe: بَلْ إِيَّاهُ تَدْعُونَ فَيَكْشِفُ مَا تَدْعُونَ إِلَيْهِ إِن شَاءَ وَتَنسَوْنَ مَا تُشْرِكُونَ
versets.phonetique: Bal iyyahu tadAAoona fakashifu ma tadAAoona ilayhi in shaa watansawna ma tushrikoon
versets.francais: C'est plutôt Lui que vous invoquez. Il écarte alors ce pour quoi vous L'invoquez, si Il veut, et vous oubliez ce que vous Lui associez.
versets.anglais: No, it is Him [alone] you would invoke, and He would remove that for which you invoked Him if He willed, and you would forget what you associate [with Him]

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا إِلَىٰ أُمَمٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ فَأَخَذْنَاهُم بِالْبَأْسَاءِ وَالضَّرَّاءِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَضَرَّعُونَ
versets.phonetique: Walaqad arsalna ila umamin min qablika faakhathnahum bial-ba'sai waalddarraa laAAallahum yatadarraAAoon
versets.francais: Nous avons envoyé des messagers à des communautés avant toi, et Nous les avons affligés de misère et d'adversité afin qu'ils implorent.
versets.anglais: And We have already sent [messengers] to nations before you, [O Muhammad]; then We seized them with poverty and hardship that perhaps they might humble themselves [to Us]

versets.arabe: فَلَوْلَا إِذْ جَاءَهُم بَأْسُنَا تَضَرَّعُوا وَلَٰكِن قَسَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الشَّيْطَانُ مَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Falawla ith jaahum ba'suna tadarraAAoo walakin qasat quloobuhum wazayyana lahumu alshshaytanu ma kanoo yaAAmaloon
versets.francais: Pourquoi n'ont-ils pas imploré quand Notre rigueur les a atteints? Mais leurs cœurs s'étaient endurcis et le Diable leur a embelli ce qu'ils faisaient.
versets.anglais: Then why, when Our punishment came to them, did they not humble themselves? But their hearts became hardened, and Satan made attractive to them that which they were doing

versets.arabe: فَلَمَّا نَسُوا مَا ذُكِّرُوا بِهِ فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ أَبْوَابَ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ حَتَّىٰ إِذَا فَرِحُوا بِمَا أُوتُوا أَخَذْنَاهُم بَغْتَةً
versets.phonetique: Falamma nasoo ma thukkiro bihi fatahna AAalayhim abwaba kulli shay'in hatta itha farihoo bima ootoo akhathhnahum baghtatan
versets.francais: Quand ils eurent oublié ce qui leur avait été rappelé, Nous leur ouvrîmes les portes de toute chose. Puis quand ils se réjouirent de ce qu'ils avaient reçu, Nous les saisîmes à l'improviste.
versets.anglais: So when they forgot that by which they had been reminded, We opened to them the doors of every [good] thing until, when they rejoiced in that which they were given, We seized them suddenly, and they were [then] in despair

versets.arabe: فَقُطِعَ دَابِرُ الْقَوْمِ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
versets.phonetique: FaqutiAAa dabiru alqawmi allatheena thalamoo walhamdu lillahi rabbi alAAalameen
versets.francais: Et fut extirpée la dernière trace du peuple qui fut injuste. Et louange à Allah, Seigneur de l'univers.
versets.anglais: So the people that committed wrong were eliminated. And praise to Allah, Lord of the worlds

versets.arabe: قُلْ أَرَأَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَخَذَ اللَّهُ سَمْعَكُمْ وَأَبْصَارَكُمْ وَخَتَمَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِكُم مَّنْ إِلَٰهٌ غَيْرُ اللَّهِ يَأْتِيكُم بِهِ
versets.phonetique: Qul araaytum in akhattha Allahu samAAakum waabsarakum wakhatama AAala quloobikum man ilahun ghayru Allahi ya'teekum bih
versets.francais: Dis: "Que pensez-vous? Si Allah vous prenait votre ouïe et vos yeux et scellait vos cœurs, quelle divinité autre qu'Allah vous les rendrait?"
versets.anglais: Say, "Have you considered: if Allah should take away your hearing and your sight and set a seal upon your hearts, which deity other than Allah could bring them [back] to you?" Look how we diversify the verses; then they [still] turn away

versets.arabe: قُلْ أَرَأَيْتَكُمْ إِنْ أَتَاكُمْ عَذَابُ اللَّهِ بَغْتَةً أَوْ جَهْرَةً هَلْ يُهْلَكُ إِلَّا الْقَوْمُ الظَّالِمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qul araaytakum in atakum AAathabu Allahi baghTatan aw jahratan hal yuhlaku illa alqawmu alththalimoon
versets.francais: Dis: "Que pensez-vous? Si le châtiment d'Allah vous vient à l'improviste ou ouvertement, est-ce que seul le peuple injuste sera anéanti?"
versets.anglais: Say, "Have you considered: if the punishment of Allah should come to you unexpectedly or manifestly, will any be destroyed but the wrongdoing people

versets.arabe: وَمَا نُرْسِلُ الْمُرْسَلِينَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرِينَ وَمُنذِرِينَ فَمَنْ آمَنَ وَأَصْلَحَ فَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wama nursilu almursaleena illa mubashshireena wamunthireena faman amana waaslaha fala khawfun AAalayhim wala hum yahzanoon
versets.francais: Nous n'envoyons les messagers qu'en annonciateurs et avertisseurs. Celui qui croit et s'améliore, pas de crainte pour eux et ils ne seront pas attristés.
versets.anglais: And We send not the messengers except as bringers of good tidings and warners. So whoever believes and reforms - there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا بِآيَاتِنَا يَمَسُّهُمُ الْعَذَابُ بِمَا كَانُوا يَفْسُقُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wallatheena kaththaboo bi-ayatina yamassuhumu alAAathabu bima kanoo yafsuqoon
versets.francais: Ceux qui ont démenti Nos signes, le châtiment les touchera pour leur perversité.
versets.anglais: But those who deny Our verses - the punishment will touch them for their defiant disobedience

versets.arabe: قُل لَّا أَقُولُ لَكُمْ عِندِي خَزَائِنُ اللَّهِ وَلَا أَعْلَمُ الْغَيْبَ وَلَا أَقُولُ لَكُمْ إِنِّي مَلَكٌ
versets.phonetique: Qul la aqoolu lakum AAindee khaza'inu Allahi wala aAAlamu alghayba wala aqoolu lakum innee malakun
versets.francais: Dis: "Je ne vous dis pas: 'J'ai les trésors d'Allah'; je ne connais pas l'invisible non plus, et je ne vous dis pas: 'Je suis un ange.'"
versets.anglais: Say, [O Muhammad], "I do not tell you that I have the depositories [containing the provision] of Allah or that I know the unseen, nor do I tell you that I am an angel. I only follow what is revealed to me." Say, "Is the blind equivalent to the seeing? Then will you not give thought

versets.arabe: وَأَنذِرْ بِهِ الَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ أَن يُحْشَرُوا إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ لَيْسَ لَهُم مِّن دُونِهِ وَلِيٌّ وَلَا شَفِيعٌ
versets.phonetique: Waanthir bihi allatheena yakhafuona an yuhsharoo ila rabbihim laysa lahum min doonihi waliyyun wala shafeeAAun
versets.francais: Et avertis par lui ceux qui craignent d'être rassemblés vers leur Seigneur, n'ayant en dehors de Lui ni allié ni intercesseur.
versets.anglais: And warn by the Qur'an those who fear that they will be gathered before their Lord - for them besides Him will be no protector and no intercessor - that they might become righteous

versets.arabe: وَلَا تَطْرُدِ الَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ رَبَّهُم بِالْغَدَاةِ وَالْعَشِيِّ يُرِيدُونَ وَجْهَهُ
versets.phonetique: Wala tatrud allatheena yadAAoona rabbahum bialghAdaAti waalAAashiyyi yureedoona wajhahu
versets.francais: Ne repousse pas ceux qui invoquent leur Seigneur matin et soir, désirant Sa Face.
versets.anglais: And do not send away those who call upon their Lord morning and afternoon, seeking His countenance. Not upon you is anything of their account and not upon them is anything of your account. So were you to send them away, you would [then] be of the wrongdoers

versets.arabe: وَكَذَٰلِكَ فَتَنَّا بَعْضَهُم بِبَعْضٍ لِّيَقُولُوا أَهَٰؤُلَاءِ مَنَّ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِم مِّن بَيْنِنَا
versets.phonetique: Wakathalika fatanna baAAdahum bibaAAdin liyaqooloo aHa'ola'i manna Allahu AAalayhim min baynina
versets.francais: C'est ainsi que Nous avons éprouvé les uns par les autres pour qu'ils disent: "Est-ce là ceux qu'Allah a favorisés parmi nous?"
versets.anglais: And thus We have tried some of them through others that the disbelievers might say, "Is it these whom Allah has favored among us?" Is not Allah most knowing of those who are grateful

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا جَاءَكَ الَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِآيَاتِنَا فَقُلْ سَلَامٌ عَلَيْكُمْ كَتَبَ رَبُّكُمْ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِ الرَّحْمَةَ
versets.phonetique: Wa-itha jaaka allatheena yu'minoona bi-ayatina faqul salamun AAalaykum kataba rabbukum AAala nafsihi alrrahmata
versets.francais: Quand ceux qui croient en Nos signes viennent à toi, dis: "Paix sur vous! Votre Seigneur S'est prescrit la miséricorde."
versets.anglais: And when those come to you who believe in Our verses, say, "Peace be upon you. Your Lord has decreed upon Himself mercy: that any of you who does wrong out of ignorance and then repents after that and corrects himself - indeed, He is Forgiving and Merciful

versets.arabe: وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُفَصِّلُ الْآيَاتِ وَلِتَسْتَبِينَ سَبِيلُ الْمُجْرِمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wakathalika nufassilu al-ayati walitastabina sabeelu almujrimeen
versets.francais: C'est ainsi que Nous exposons en détail les signes, afin que se manifeste clairement le chemin des criminels.
versets.anglais: And thus do We detail the verses, and [thus] the way of the criminals will become evident

versets.arabe: قُلْ إِنِّي نُهِيتُ أَنْ أَعْبُدَ الَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ قُل لَّا أَتَّبِعُ أَهْوَاءَكُمْ قَدْ ضَلَلْتُ إِذًا وَمَا أَنَا مِنَ الْمُهْتَدِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qul innee nuheetu an aAAbuda allatheena tadAAoona min dooni Allahi qul la attabiAAu ahwaakum qad dalaltu ithan wama ana mina almuhtadeen
versets.francais: Dis: "Il m'est interdit d'adorer ceux que vous invoquez en dehors d'Allah." Dis: "Je ne suis pas vos passions. Sinon je me serais égaré et ne serais pas des gens bien guidés."
versets.anglais: Say, "Indeed, I have been forbidden to worship those you invoke besides Allah." Say, "I will not follow your desires, for I would then have gone astray, and I would not be of the [rightly] guided

versets.arabe: قُلْ إِنِّي عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّي وَكَذَّبْتُم بِهِ مَا عِندِي مَا تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ بِهِ إِنِ الْحُكْمُ إِلَّا لِلَّهِ
versets.phonetique: Qul innee AAala bayyinatin min rabbee wakaththabtum bihi ma AAindee ma tastaAAjiloona bihi ini alhukmu illa lillahi
versets.francais: Dis: "Je suis sur une preuve de mon Seigneur, que vous avez niée. Je n'ai pas ce que vous voulez hâter. Le jugement n'appartient qu'à Allah."
versets.anglais: Say, "Indeed, I am on clear evidence from my Lord, and you have denied it. I do not have that for which you are impatient. The decision is only for Allah. He relates the truth, and He is the best of deciders

versets.arabe: قُل لَّوْ أَنَّ عِندِي مَا تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ بِهِ لَقُضِيَ الْأَمْرُ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكُمْ وَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِالظَّالِمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qul law anna AAindee ma tastaAAjiloona bihi laqudiya al-amru baynee wabaynakum wallahu aAAlamu biAlththalimeen
versets.francais: Dis: "Si j'avais ce que vous voulez hâter, l'affaire serait réglée entre vous et moi. Allah connaît mieux les injustes."
versets.anglais: Say, "If I had that for which you are impatient, the matter would have been decided between me and you, but Allah is most knowing of the wrongdoers

versets.arabe: وَعِندَهُ مَفَاتِحُ الْغَيْبِ لَا يَعْلَمُهَا إِلَّا هُوَ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا فِي الْبَرِّ وَالْبَحْرِ
versets.phonetique: WaAAindahu mafatihu alghaybi la yaAAlamuka illa huwa wayaAAlamu ma fee albarri waalbahri
versets.francais: Auprès de Lui sont les clefs de l'invisible; nul ne les connaît en dehors de Lui. Il sait ce qui est sur terre et dans la mer.
versets.anglais: And with Him are the keys of the unseen; none knows them except Him. And He knows what is on the land and in the sea. Not a leaf falls but that He knows it. And no grain is there within the darknesses of the earth and no moist or dry [thing] but that it is [written] in a clear record

versets.arabe: وَهُوَ الَّذِي يَتَوَفَّاكُم بِاللَّيْلِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا جَرَحْتُم بِالنَّهَارِ ثُمَّ يَبْعَثُكُمْ فِيهِ
versets.phonetique: Wahuwa allathee yatawaffakum biallayli wayaAAlamu ma jarahtum biAlnnnahari thumma yabAAathukum feeh
versets.francais: C'est Lui qui vous rappelle la nuit et qui sait ce que vous faites le jour. Il vous ressuscite alors pendant le jour.
versets.anglais: And it is He who takes your souls by night and knows what you have committed by day. Then He revives you therein that a specified term may be fulfilled. Then to Him will be your return; then He will inform you about what you used to do

versets.arabe: وَهُوَ الْقَاهِرُ فَوْقَ عِبَادِهِ وَيُرْسِلُ عَلَيْكُمْ حَفَظَةً حَتَّىٰ إِذَا جَاءَ أَحَدَكُمُ الْمَوْتُ تَوَفَّتْهُ رُسُلُنَا
versets.phonetique: Wahuwa alqahiru fawqa AAibadihi wayursilu AAalaykum hafadhatan hatta itha jaa ahadakumu almawtu tawaffathu rusuluna
versets.francais: Il est le Dominateur suprême de Ses serviteurs. Il envoie sur vous des gardiens. Quand la mort vient à l'un de vous, Nos messagers le rappellent.
versets.anglais: And He is the subjugator over His servants, and He sends over you guardian-angels until, when death comes to one of you, Our messengers take him, and they do not fail [in their duties]

versets.arabe: ثُمَّ رُدُّوا إِلَى اللَّهِ مَوْلَاهُمُ الْحَقِّ أَلَا لَهُ الْحُكْمُ وَهُوَ أَسْرَعُ الْحَاسِبِينَ
versets.phonetique: Thumma ruddoo ila Allahi mawlahumu alhaqqi ala lahu alhukmu wahuwa asraAAu alhasibeen
versets.francais: Puis ils seront ramenés à Allah, leur vrai Maître. À Lui appartient le jugement en vérité. Il est le plus rapide à compter.
versets.anglais: Then they His servants are returned to Allah, their true Lord. Unquestionably, His is the judgement, and He is the swiftest of accountants

versets.arabe: قُلْ مَن يُنَجِّيكُم مِّن ظُلُمَاتِ الْبَرِّ وَالْبَحْرِ تَدْعُونَهُ تَضَرُّعًا وَخُفْيَةً
versets.phonetique: Qul man yunajjeekum min thulumaati albarri waalbahri tadAAoonahu tadarruAAan wakhufyatan
versets.francais: Dis: "Qui vous délivre des ténèbres de la terre et de la mer? Vous L'invoquez humblement et en secret."
versets.anglais: Say, "Who rescues you from the darknesses of the land and sea [when] you call upon Him imploring [aloud] and privately, 'If He should save us from this [crisis], we will surely be among the thankful

versets.arabe: قُلِ اللَّهُ يُنَجِّيكُم مِّنْهَا وَمِن كُلِّ كَرْبٍ ثُمَّ أَنتُمْ تُشْرِكُونَ
versets.phonetique: Quli Allahu yunajjeekum minha wamin kulli karbin thumma antum tushrikoon
versets.francais: Dis: "C'est Allah qui vous en délivre et de toute détresse, puis vous Lui associez."
versets.anglais: Say, "It is Allah who saves you from it and from every distress; then you [still] associate others with Him

versets.arabe: قُلْ هُوَ الْقَادِرُ عَلَىٰ أَن يَبْعَثَ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابًا مِّن فَوْقِكُمْ أَوْ مِن تَحْتِ أَرْجُلِكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Qul huwa alqadiru AAala an yabAAatha AAalaykum AAathaban min fawqikum aw min tahti arjulikum
versets.francais: Dis: "Il est Capable d'envoyer contre vous un châtiment de dessus vous ou de dessous vos pieds."
versets.anglais: Say, "He is the [one] Able to send upon you affliction from above you or from beneath your feet or to confuse you [so you become] sects and make you taste the violence of one another." Look how We diversify the signs that they might understand

versets.arabe: وَكَذَّبَ بِهِ قَوْمُكَ وَهُوَ الْحَقُّ قُل لَّسْتُ عَلَيْكُم بِوَكِيلٍ
versets.phonetique: Wakaththaba bihi qawmuka wahuwa alhaqqu qul lastu AAalaykum biwakeel
versets.francais: Et ton peuple le nie alors que c'est la vérité. Dis: "Je ne suis pas chargé de vous."
versets.anglais: But your people have denied it while it is the truth. Say, "I am not over you a manager

versets.arabe: لِّكُلِّ نَبَإٍ مُّسْتَقَرٌّ وَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Likulli naba'in mustaqarrun wasawfa taAAlamoon
versets.francais: À toute nouvelle son terme fixé; vous saurez bientôt.
versets.anglais: For every happening is a finality; and you are going to know

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ الَّذِينَ يَخُوضُونَ فِي آيَاتِنَا فَأَعْرِضْ عَنْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يَخُوضُوا فِي حَدِيثٍ غَيْرِهِ
versets.phonetique: Wa-itha raayta allatheena yakhoodona fee ayatina faaAArid AAanhum hatta yakhoodoo fee hadeethin ghayrih
versets.francais: Quand tu vois ceux qui s'engagent en vain dans la discussion de Nos versets, éloigne-toi d'eux jusqu'à ce qu'ils s'engagent dans un autre sujet.
versets.anglais: And when you see those who engage in [offensive] discourse concerning Our verses, then turn away from them until they enter into another conversation. And if Satan should cause you to forget, then do not remain after the reminder with the wrongdoing people

versets.arabe: وَمَا عَلَى الَّذِينَ يَتَّقُونَ مِنْ حِسَابِهِم مِّن شَيْءٍ وَلَٰكِن ذِكْرَىٰ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wama AAala allatheena yattaqoona min hisabihim min shay'in walakin thikra laAAAllahum yattaqoon
versets.francais: Les pieux n'ont rien à répondre de leur compte. Mais c'est un rappel, peut-être se garderont-ils.
versets.anglais: And those who fear Allah are not held accountable for the disbelievers at all, but [only for] a reminder - that perhaps they will fear Him

versets.arabe: وَذَرِ الَّذِينَ اتَّخَذُوا دِينَهُمْ لَعِبًا وَلَهْوًا وَغَرَّتْهُمُ الْحَيَاةُ الدُّنْيَا
versets.phonetique: Wathari allatheena ittakhathoo deenahum laAAiban walahwan wagharrat-humu alhayatu alddunya
versets.francais: Laisse ceux qui ont pris leur religion pour jeu et amusement et que la vie d'ici-bas a trompés.
versets.anglais: And leave those who take their religion as amusement and diversion and whom the worldly life has deluded. But remind with the Qur'an, lest a soul be given up to destruction for what it earned; it will have other than Allah no protector and no intercessor. And if it should offer every compensation, it would not be taken from it. Those are the ones who are given to destruction for what they have earned. For them will be a drink of scalding water and a painful punishment because they used to disbelieve

versets.arabe: قُلْ أَنَدْعُو مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُنَا وَلَا يَضُرُّنَا وَنُرَدُّ عَلَىٰ أَعْقَابِنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَانَا اللَّهُ
versets.phonetique: Qul anadAAoo min dooni Allahi ma la yanfaAAuna wala yadurruna wanuraddu AAala aAAqabina baAAda ith hadana Allah
versets.francais: Dis: "Invoquerions-nous en dehors d'Allah ce qui ne nous profite ni ne nous nuit, et reviendrions-nous sur nos pas après qu'Allah nous a guidés?"
versets.anglais: Say, "Shall we invoke instead of Allah that which neither benefits us nor harms us and be turned back on our heels after Allah has guided us? [We would then be] like one whom the devils enticed [to wander] upon the earth confused, [while] he has companions inviting him to guidance, [calling], 'Come to us.' " Say, "Indeed, the guidance of Allah is the [only] guidance; and we have been commanded to submit to the Lord of the worlds

versets.arabe: وَأَنْ أَقِيمُوا الصَّلَاةَ وَاتَّقُوهُ وَهُوَ الَّذِي إِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Waan aqeemoo alssalata waittaqoohu wahuwa allathee ilayhi tuhsharoon
versets.francais: Et d'accomplir la Salat et de Le craindre. C'est Lui vers qui vous serez rassemblés.
versets.anglais: And to establish prayer and fear Him." And it is He to whom you will be gathered

versets.arabe: وَهُوَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ بِالْحَقِّ وَيَوْمَ يَقُولُ كُن فَيَكُونُ قَوْلُهُ الْحَقُّ
versets.phonetique: Wahuwa allathee khalaqa alssamawati wal-arda bialhaqqi wayawma yaqoolu kun fayakoonu qawluhu alhaqqu
versets.francais: C'est Lui qui a créé les cieux et la terre en toute vérité. Le jour où Il dit: "Sois!" cela est. Sa parole est la vérité.
versets.anglais: And it is He who created the heavens and earth in truth. And the day He says, "Be," and it is, His word is the truth. And His is the dominion [on] the Day the Horn is blown. [He is] Knower of the unseen and the witnessed; and He is the Wise, the Acquainted

versets.arabe: وَإِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ لِأَبِيهِ آزَرَ أَتَتَّخِذُ أَصْنَامًا آلِهَةً إِنِّي أَرَاكَ وَقَوْمَكَ فِي ضَلَالٍ مُّبِينٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa-ith qala ibraheemu li-abeehi azara atattakhithu asnaman alihatan innee araka waqawmaka fee dalalin mubeen
versets.francais: Abraham dit à son père Azar: "Prends-tu des idoles pour divinités? Je te vois, toi et ton peuple, dans un égarement évident."
versets.anglais: And [mention, O Muhammad], when Abraham said to his father Azar, "Do you take idols as deities? Indeed, I see you and your people to be in manifest error

versets.arabe: وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُرِي إِبْرَاهِيمَ مَلَكُوتَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَلِيَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُوقِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wakathalika nuree ibraheema malakooTa alssamawati wal-ardi waliyakoona mina almuqineen
versets.francais: C'est ainsi que Nous faisions voir à Abraham le Royaume des cieux et de la terre afin qu'il soit parmi ceux qui ont la certitude.
versets.anglais: And thus did We show Abraham the realm of the heavens and the earth that he would be among the certain [in faith]

versets.arabe: فَلَمَّا جَنَّ عَلَيْهِ اللَّيْلُ رَأَىٰ كَوْكَبًا قَالَ هَٰذَا رَبِّي فَلَمَّا أَفَلَ قَالَ لَا أُحِبُّ الْآفِلِينَ
versets.phonetique: Falamma janna AAalayhi allaYlu raa kawkaban qala hatha rabbee falamma afala qala la ohibbu al-afileen
versets.francais: Quand la nuit l'enveloppa, il vit une étoile. Il dit: "Voilà mon Seigneur!" Puis quand elle disparut, il dit: "Je n'aime pas ceux qui disparaissent."
versets.anglais: So when the night covered him [with darkness], he saw a star. He said, "This is my lord." But when it set, he said, "I like not those that disappear

versets.arabe: فَلَمَّا رَأَى الْقَمَرَ بَازِغًا قَالَ هَٰذَا رَبِّي فَلَمَّا أَفَلَ قَالَ لَئِن لَّمْ يَهْدِنِي رَبِّي لَأَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الضَّالِّينَ
versets.phonetique: Falamma raa alqamara bazighan qala hatha rabbee falamma afala qala la'in lam yahdinee rabbee laakoonanna mina alqawmi alddalleen
versets.francais: Puis quand il vit la lune se lever, il dit: "Voilà mon Seigneur!" Quand elle disparut, il dit: "Si mon Seigneur ne me guide pas, je serai certes parmi les gens égarés."
versets.anglais: And when he saw the moon rising, he said, "This is my lord." But when it set, he said, "Unless my Lord guides me, I will surely be among the people gone astray

versets.arabe: فَلَمَّا رَأَى الشَّمْسَ بَازِغَةً قَالَ هَٰذَا رَبِّي هَٰذَا أَكْبَرُ فَلَمَّا أَفَلَتْ قَالَ يَا قَوْمِ إِنِّي بَرِيءٌ مِّمَّا تُشْرِكُونَ
versets.phonetique: Falamma raa alshshamsa bazighatan qala hatha rabbee hatha akbaru falamma afalat qala ya qawmi innee bari'un mimma tushrikoon
versets.francais: Puis quand il vit le soleil se lever, il dit: "Voilà mon Seigneur, il est plus grand!" Mais quand il disparut, il dit: "Ô mon peuple, je suis innocent de ce que vous associez."
versets.anglais: And when he saw the sun rising, he said, "This is my lord; this is greater." But when it set, he said, "O my people, indeed I am free from what you associate with Allah

versets.arabe: إِنِّي وَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِيَ لِلَّذِي فَطَرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ حَنِيفًا وَمَا أَنَا مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ
versets.phonetique: Innee wajjahtu wajhiya lillathee fatara alssamawati wal-arda haneefan wama ana mina almushrikeen
versets.francais: "J'oriente mon visage exclusivement vers Celui qui a créé les cieux et la terre, en pur monothéiste; je ne suis pas des associateurs."
versets.anglais: Indeed, I have turned my face toward He who created the heavens and the earth, inclining toward truth, and I am not of those who associate others with Allah

versets.arabe: وَحَاجَّهُ قَوْمُهُ قَالَ أَتُحَاجُّونِّي فِي اللَّهِ وَقَدْ هَدَانِ وَلَا أَخَافُ مَا تُشْرِكُونَ بِهِ
versets.phonetique: Wahajjahu qawmuhu qala atuhajjoonanee fee Allahi waqad hadani wala akhafu ma tushrikoona bih
versets.francais: Son peuple le discuta. Il dit: "Me disputez-vous au sujet d'Allah alors qu'Il m'a guidé? Je ne crains pas ce que vous Lui associez."
versets.anglais: And his people argued with him. He said, "Do you argue with me concerning Allah while He has guided me? And I fear not what you associate with Him [and will not be harmed] unless my Lord should will something. My Lord encompasses all things in knowledge; then will you not remember

versets.arabe: وَكَيْفَ أَخَافُ مَا أَشْرَكْتُمْ وَلَا تَخَافُونَ أَنَّكُمْ أَشْرَكْتُم بِاللَّهِ مَا لَمْ يُنَزِّلْ بِهِ عَلَيْكُمْ سُلْطَانًا
versets.phonetique: Wakayfa akhafu ma ashraktum wala takhafoonaanna innakum ashraktum billahi ma lam yunazzil bihi AAalaykum sultana
versets.francais: "Comment craindrai-je ce que vous Lui associez, alors que vous ne craignez pas d'avoir associé à Allah ce pour quoi Il n'a fait descendre sur vous aucune preuve?"
versets.anglais: And how should I fear what you associate while you do not fear that you have associated with Allah that for which He has not sent down to you any authority? So which of the two parties has more right to security, if you should know

versets.arabe: الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَلَمْ يَلْبِسُوا إِيمَانَهُم بِظُلْمٍ أُولَٰئِكَ لَهُمُ الْأَمْنُ وَهُم مُّهْتَدُونَ
versets.phonetique: Allatheena amanoo walam yalbisoo eemanahum bithulmin olaika lahumu al-amnu wahum muhtadoon
versets.francais: Ceux qui ont cru et n'ont pas entaché leur foi d'injustice, ceux-là auront la sécurité et ce sont eux les bien guidés.
versets.anglais: They who believe and do not mix their belief with injustice - those will have security, and they are [rightly] guided

versets.arabe: وَتِلْكَ حُجَّتُنَا آتَيْنَاهَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِ نَرْفَعُ دَرَجَاتٍ مَّن نَّشَاءُ
versets.phonetique: Watilka hujjatuna ataynaha ibraheema AAala qawmihi narfaAAu darajatin man nasha'o
versets.francais: Telle est Notre preuve que Nous avons donnée à Abraham contre son peuple. Nous élevons en degrés qui Nous voulons.
versets.anglais: And that was Our [conclusive] argument which We gave Abraham against his people. We raise by degrees whom We will. Indeed, your Lord is Wise and Knowing

versets.arabe: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُ إِسْحَاقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ كُلًّا هَدَيْنَا وَنُوحًا هَدَيْنَا مِن قَبْلُ
versets.phonetique: Wawahabna lahu ishaqa wayaAAqooba kullan hadayna wanoohan hadayna min qablu
versets.francais: Et Nous lui avons accordé Isaac et Jacob. Nous avons guidé chacun d'eux. Avant lui, Nous avions guidé Noé.
versets.anglais: And We gave to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob - all [of them] We guided. And Noah, We guided before; and among his descendants, David and Solomon and Job and Joseph and Moses and Aaron. Thus do We reward the doers of good

versets.arabe: وَزَكَرِيَّا وَيَحْيَىٰ وَعِيسَىٰ وَإِلْيَاسَ كُلٌّ مِّنَ الصَّالِحِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wazakariyya wayahya waAAeesa wa-ilyasa kullun mina alssaliheen
versets.francais: Et Zacharie, Jean, Jésus et Élie — tous parmi les vertueux.
versets.anglais: And Zechariah and John and Jesus and Elias - and all were of the righteous

versets.arabe: وَإِسْمَاعِيلَ وَالْيَسَعَ وَيُونُسَ وَلُوطًا وَكُلًّا فَضَّلْنَا عَلَى الْعَالَمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa-ismaAAeela walyasaAAa wayoonusa walootan wakullan faddalna AAala alAAalameen
versets.francais: Et Ismaël, Élisée, Jonas et Loth — Nous les avons tous préférés à tous les mondes.
versets.anglais: And Ishmael and Elisha and Jonah and Lot - and all [of them] We preferred over the worlds

versets.arabe: وَمِنْ آبَائِهِمْ وَذُرِّيَّاتِهِمْ وَإِخْوَانِهِمْ وَاجْتَبَيْنَاهُمْ وَهَدَيْنَاهُمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
versets.phonetique: Wamin aba'ihim wathurriyyatihim wa-ikhwanihim waistaBaynahum wahadaYnahum ila siratin mustaqeem
versets.francais: Ainsi que certains de leurs pères, descendants et frères. Nous les avons élus et guidés vers un droit chemin.
versets.anglais: And [some] among their fathers and their descendants and their brothers - and We chose them and We guided them to a straight path

versets.arabe: ذَٰلِكَ هُدَى اللَّهِ يَهْدِي بِهِ مَن يَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ وَلَوْ أَشْرَكُوا لَحَبِطَ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Thalika huda Allahi yahdee bihi man yashao min AAibadihi walaw ashrakoo lahabita AAanhum ma kanoo yaAAmaloon
versets.francais: Telle est la guidée d'Allah. Il guide par elle qui Il veut parmi Ses serviteurs. S'ils avaient associé, ce qu'ils faisaient aurait été anéanti.
versets.anglais: That is the guidance of Allah by which He guides whomever He wills of His servants. But if they had associated others with Allah, then worthless for them would be whatever they were doing

versets.arabe: أُولَٰئِكَ الَّذِينَ آتَيْنَاهُمُ الْكِتَابَ وَالْحُكْمَ وَالنُّبُوَّةَ فَإِن يَكْفُرْ بِهَا هَٰؤُلَاءِ
versets.phonetique: Olaika allatheena ataynahumu alkitaba waalhukma waalnnubuwwata fa-in yakfur biha ha'ola
versets.francais: Ce sont eux à qui Nous avons donné le Livre, le jugement et la prophétie. Si ceux-là y mécroyaient,
versets.anglais: Those are the ones to whom We gave the Scripture and authority and prophethood. But if the disbelievers deny it, then We have entrusted it to a people who are not therein disbelievers

versets.arabe: أُولَٰئِكَ الَّذِينَ هَدَى اللَّهُ فَبِهُدَاهُمُ اقْتَدِهْ قُل لَّا أَسْأَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ أَجْرًا
versets.phonetique: Olaika allatheena hada Allahu fabihudahumu iqtadih qul la as'alukum AAalayhi ajran
versets.francais: Ce sont eux qu'Allah a guidés. Suis donc leur guidée. Dis: "Je ne vous en demande pas de salaire."
versets.anglais: Those are the ones whom Allah has guided, so from their guidance take an example. Say, "I ask of you for this message no payment. It is not but a reminder for the worlds

versets.arabe: وَمَا قَدَرُوا اللَّهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهِ إِذْ قَالُوا مَا أَنزَلَ اللَّهُ عَلَىٰ بَشَرٍ مِّن شَيْءٍ
versets.phonetique: Wama qadaroo Allaha haqqa qadrihi ith qaloo ma anzala Allahu AAala basharin min shay'in
versets.francais: Ils n'ont pas estimé Allah à Sa juste valeur quand ils ont dit: "Allah n'a rien fait descendre à un être humain."
versets.anglais: And they did not appraise Allah with true appraisal when they said, "Allah did not reveal to a human being anything." Say, "Who revealed the Scripture that Moses brought as light and guidance to the people? You [Jews] make it into pages, disclosing [some of] it and concealing much. And you were taught that which you knew not - neither you nor your fathers." Say, "Allah [revealed it]." Then leave them in their [empty] discourse, amusing themselves

versets.arabe: وَهَٰذَا كِتَابٌ أَنزَلْنَاهُ مُبَارَكٌ مُّصَدِّقُ الَّذِي بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَلِتُنذِرَ أُمَّ الْقُرَىٰ وَمَنْ حَوْلَهَا
versets.phonetique: Wahatha kitabun anzalnahu mubarakun musaddiqu allathee bayna yadayhi walitunthira umma alqura waman hawlaha
versets.francais: Voilà un Livre béni que Nous avons fait descendre, confirmant ce qui le précédait, pour que tu avertisses la mère des cités et ceux qui l'entourent.
versets.anglais: And this is a Book which We have sent down, blessed and confirming what was before it, that you may warn the Mother of Cities and those around it. Those who believe in the Hereafter believe in it, and they are maintaining their prayers

versets.arabe: وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ افْتَرَىٰ عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا أَوْ قَالَ أُوحِيَ إِلَيَّ وَلَمْ يُوحَ إِلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ
versets.phonetique: Waman athlamu mimmani iftara AAala Allahi kathiban aw qala oohiya ilayya walam yooha ilayhi shay'on
versets.francais: Qui est plus injuste que celui qui invente un mensonge contre Allah ou qui dit: "Il m'a été révélé", alors que rien ne lui a été révélé?
versets.anglais: And who is more unjust than one who invents a lie about Allah or says, "It has been inspired to me," while nothing has been inspired to him, and one who says, "I will reveal [something] like what Allah revealed." And if you could but see when the wrongdoers are in the overwhelming pangs of death while the angels extend their hands, [saying], "Discharge your souls! Today you will be awarded the punishment of [extreme] humiliation for what you used to say against Allah other than the truth and [that] you were, toward His verses, being arrogant

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ جِئْتُمُونَا فُرَادَىٰ كَمَا خَلَقْنَاكُمْ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ وَتَرَكْتُم مَّا خَوَّلْنَاكُمْ وَرَاءَ ظُهُورِكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Walaqad ji'tumoona furada kama khalaqnakum awwala marratin wataraktum ma khawwalnakum wara'a thuhoorikum
versets.francais: Vous voilà venus à Nous seuls, comme Nous vous avons créés la première fois, laissant derrière vos dos ce que Nous vous avions accordé.
versets.anglais: [It will be said to them], "And you have certainly come to Us alone as We created you the first time, and you have left whatever We bestowed upon you behind you. And We do not see with you your 'intercessors' which you claimed that they were among you associates [of Allah]. It has [all] been severed between you, and lost from you is what you used to claim

versets.arabe: إِنَّ اللَّهَ فَالِقُ الْحَبِّ وَالنَّوَىٰ يُخْرِجُ الْحَيَّ مِنَ الْمَيِّتِ وَمُخْرِجُ الْمَيِّتِ مِنَ الْحَيِّ
versets.phonetique: Inna Allaha faliqu alhaggi waalnnawa yukhriju alhayya mina almayyiti wamukhriju almayyiti mina alhayyi
versets.francais: Allah est Celui qui fait fendre le grain et le noyau. Il fait sortir le vivant du mort et le mort du vivant.
versets.anglais: Indeed, Allah is the cleaver of grain and date seeds. He brings the living out of the dead and brings the dead out of the living. That is Allah; so how are you deluded

versets.arabe: فَالِقُ الْإِصْبَاحِ وَجَعَلَ اللَّيْلَ سَكَنًا وَالشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ حُسْبَانًا ذَٰلِكَ تَقْدِيرُ الْعَزِيزِ الْعَلِيمِ
versets.phonetique: Faliqu al-isbahi wajaAAala allayla sakanan waalshshamsa waalqamara husabanan thalika taqdeeru alAAazeezi alAAaleem
versets.francais: Il fend l'aurore, et Il a fait de la nuit un repos, et du soleil et de la lune une computation. Telle est la mesure du Puissant, du Savant.
versets.anglais: [He is] the cleaver of daybreak and has made the night for rest and the sun and moon for calculation. That is the determination of the Exalted in Might, the Knowing

versets.arabe: وَهُوَ الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ النُّجُومَ لِتَهْتَدُوا بِهَا فِي ظُلُمَاتِ الْبَرِّ وَالْبَحْرِ
versets.phonetique: Wahuwa allathee jaAAala lakumu alnnujooma litahtadoo biha fee thulumaati albarri waalbahri
versets.francais: C'est Lui qui a fait pour vous les étoiles afin que vous vous guidiez par elles dans les ténèbres de la terre et de la mer.
versets.anglais: And it is He who placed for you the stars that you may be guided by them through the darknesses of the land and sea. We have detailed the signs for a people who know

versets.arabe: وَهُوَ الَّذِي أَنشَأَكُم مِّن نَّفْسٍ وَاحِدَةٍ فَمُسْتَقَرٌّ وَمُسْتَوْدَعٌ
versets.phonetique: Wahuwa allathee ansha'akum min nafsin wahidatin famustaqarrun wamustawdaAAun
versets.francais: C'est Lui qui vous a créés d'une seule personne, et il y a un gîte et un dépôt.
versets.anglais: And it is He who produced you from one soul and [gave you] a place of dwelling and of storage. We have detailed the signs for a people who understand

versets.arabe: وَهُوَ الَّذِي أَنزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَأَخْرَجْنَا بِهِ نَبَاتَ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ فَأَخْرَجْنَا مِنْهُ خَضِرًا
versets.phonetique: Wahuwa allathee anzala mina alssama'i maan faakhrajana bihi nabata kulli shay'in faakhrajna minhu khadiran
versets.francais: C'est Lui qui a fait descendre du ciel de l'eau. Nous en avons fait sortir des germes de toute chose; nous en avons fait sortir une verdure.
versets.anglais: And it is He who sends down rain from the sky, and We produce thereby the growth of all things. We produce from it greenery from which We produce grains arranged in layers. And from the palm trees - of its emerging fruit are clusters hanging low. And [We produce] gardens of grapevines and olives and pomegranates, similar yet varied. Look at [each of] its fruit when it yields and [at] its ripening. Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe

versets.arabe: وَجَعَلُوا لِلَّهِ شُرَكَاءَ الْجِنَّ وَخَلَقَهُمْ وَخَرَقُوا لَهُ بَنِينَ وَبَنَاتٍ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ
versets.phonetique: WajaAAaloo lillahi shurakaa aljinna wakhalaqahum wakharaqoo lahu baneena wabanatin bighayri AAilm
versets.francais: Ils attribuent à Allah des associés: les djinns alors que c'est Lui qui les a créés; et ils Lui prêtent, sans savoir, des fils et des filles.
versets.anglais: But they have attributed to Allah partners - the jinn, while He has created them - and have fabricated for Him sons and daughters. Exalted is He and high above what they describe

versets.arabe: بَدِيعُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لَهُ وَلَدٌ وَلَمْ تَكُن لَّهُ صَاحِبَةٌ
versets.phonetique: BadeeAAu alssamawati wal-ardi anna yakoonu lahu waladun walam takun lahu sahibatun
versets.francais: Créateur des cieux et de la terre, comment aurait-Il un enfant alors qu'Il n'a pas d'épouse?
versets.anglais: [He is] Originator of the heavens and the earth. How could He have a son when He does not have a companion and He created all things? And He is, of all things, Knowing

versets.arabe: ذَٰلِكُمُ اللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ خَالِقُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ فَاعْبُدُوهُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَكِيلٌ
versets.phonetique: Thalikumu Allahu rabbukum la ilaha illa huwa khaliqu kulli shay'in faoAAbudoohu wahuwa AAala kulli shay'in wakeel
versets.francais: Tel est Allah, votre Seigneur. Pas de divinité à part Lui, le Créateur de toute chose. Adorez-Le donc. Il est le Garant de toute chose.
versets.anglais: That is Allah, your Lord; there is no deity except Him, the Creator of all things, so worship Him. And He is Disposer of all things

versets.arabe: لَّا تُدْرِكُهُ الْأَبْصَارُ وَهُوَ يُدْرِكُ الْأَبْصَارَ وَهُوَ اللَّطِيفُ الْخَبِيرُ
versets.phonetique: La tudrikuhu al-absaru wahuwa yudriku al-absara wahuwa allateefu alkhabeer
versets.francais: Les visions ne L'atteignent pas, alors qu'Il atteint toutes les visions. Et Il est le Subtil, le Tout Connaisseur.
versets.anglais: Vision perceives Him not, but He perceives [all] vision; and He is the Subtle, the Acquainted

versets.arabe: قَدْ جَاءَكُم بَصَائِرُ مِن رَّبِّكُمْ فَمَنْ أَبْصَرَ فَلِنَفْسِهِ وَمَنْ عَمِيَ فَعَلَيْهَا
versets.phonetique: Qad jaakum basa'iru min rabbikum faman absara falinafsihi waman AAamiya faAAalayha
versets.francais: Des lumières vous sont venues de la part de votre Seigneur. Celui qui voit, c'est pour son propre avantage; et celui qui est aveugle, c'est à ses dépens.
versets.anglais: There has come to you enlightenment from your Lord. So whoever will see does so for [the benefit of] his soul, and whoever is blind [does harm] against it. And [say], "I am not a guardian over you

versets.arabe: وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُصَرِّفُ الْآيَاتِ وَلِيَقُولُوا دَرَسْتَ وَلِنُبَيِّنَهُ لِقَوْمٍ يَعْلَمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wakathalika nusarrifu al-ayati waliyaqooloo darasta walinubayyinahu liqawmin yaAAlamoon
versets.francais: C'est ainsi que Nous varions les signes pour qu'ils disent: "Tu as étudié", et afin que Nous l'expliquions à des gens qui savent.
versets.anglais: And thus do We diversify the verses so the disbelievers will say, "You have studied," and so We may make the Qur'an clear for a people who know

versets.arabe: اتَّبِعْ مَا أُوحِيَ إِلَيْكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ الْمُشْرِكِينَ
versets.phonetique: IttabiAAU ma oohiya ilayka min rabbika la ilaha illa huwa waAArid AAani almushrikeen
versets.francais: Suis ce qui t'a été révélé de la part de ton Seigneur. Pas de divinité à part Lui. Et écarte-toi des associateurs.
versets.anglais: Follow, [O Muhammad], what has been revealed to you from your Lord - there is no deity except Him - and turn away from those who associate others with Allah

versets.arabe: وَلَوْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ مَا أَشْرَكُوا وَمَا جَعَلْنَاكَ عَلَيْهِمْ حَفِيظًا وَمَا أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِوَكِيلٍ
versets.phonetique: Walaw shaa Allahu ma ashrakoo wama jaAAalnaka AAalayhim hafeethan wama anta AAalayhim biwakeel
versets.francais: Si Allah avait voulu, ils n'auraient pas associé. Nous ne t'avons pas établi gardien sur eux et tu n'es pas leur garant.
versets.anglais: But if Allah had willed, they would not have associated. And We have not appointed you over them as a guardian, nor are you a manager over them

versets.arabe: وَلَا تَسُبُّوا الَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ فَيَسُبُّوا اللَّهَ عَدْوًا بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ
versets.phonetique: Wala tasubboo allatheena yadAAoona min dooni Allahi fayasubboo Allaha AAadwan bighayri AAilm
versets.francais: N'insultez pas ceux qu'ils invoquent en dehors d'Allah, sinon ceux-ci insulteraient Allah par hostilité et sans savoir.
versets.anglais: And do not insult those they invoke other than Allah, lest they insult Allah in enmity without knowledge. Thus We have made pleasing to every community their deeds. Then to their Lord is their return, and He will inform them about what they used to do

versets.arabe: وَأَقْسَمُوا بِاللَّهِ جَهْدَ أَيْمَانِهِمْ لَئِن جَاءَتْهُمْ آيَةٌ لَّيُؤْمِنُنَّ بِهَا
versets.phonetique: Waaqsamoo billahi jahda aymanihim la'in jaathum ayatun layu'minunna biha
versets.francais: Ils ont juré par Allah le plus fort de leurs serments que s'il leur venait un signe, ils y croiraient certainement.
versets.anglais: And they swear by Allah their strongest oaths that if a sign came to them, they would surely believe in it. Say, "The signs are only with Allah." And what will make you perceive that even if a sign came, they would not believe

versets.arabe: وَنُقَلِّبُ أَفْئِدَتَهُمْ وَأَبْصَارَهُمْ كَمَا لَمْ يُؤْمِنُوا بِهِ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ
versets.phonetique: Wanuqallibu af'idatahum waabsarahum kama lam yu'minoo bihi awwala marratin
versets.francais: Et Nous retournerons leurs cœurs et leurs regards comme ils n'y avaient pas cru la première fois.
versets.anglais: And We will turn away their hearts and their eyes just as they refused to believe in it the first time. And We will leave them in their transgression, wandering blindly

versets.arabe: وَلَوْ أَنَّنَا نَزَّلْنَا إِلَيْهِمُ الْمَلَائِكَةَ وَكَلَّمَهُمُ الْمَوْتَىٰ وَحَشَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ قُبُلًا مَّا كَانُوا لِيُؤْمِنُوا
versets.phonetique: Walaw annana nazzalna ilayhimu almala'ikata wakallamahumu almawta wahasharna AAalayhim kulla shay'in qubulaan ma kanoo liyu'minoo
versets.francais: Même si Nous avions fait descendre vers eux des anges et que les morts leur avaient parlé et que Nous avions rassemblé devant eux toute chose, ils n'auraient pas cru.
versets.anglais: And even if We had sent down to them the angels [with the message] and the dead spoke to them [of it] and We gathered together every [created] thing in front of them, they would not believe unless Allah should will. But most of them, [of that], are ignorant

versets.arabe: وَكَذَٰلِكَ جَعَلْنَا لِكُلِّ نَبِيٍّ عَدُوًّا شَيَاطِينَ الْإِنسِ وَالْجِنِّ يُوحِي بَعْضُهُمْ إِلَىٰ بَعْضٍ زُخْرُفَ الْقَوْلِ غُرُورًا
versets.phonetique: Wakathalika jaAAalna likulli nabiyyin AAaduwwan shayateena al-insi waaljinni yoohee baAAduhum ila baAAdin zukhruf-l-qawli ghurooran
versets.francais: Ainsi avons-Nous assigné à chaque prophète des ennemis, des diables d'entre les hommes et les djinns qui s'inspirent les uns les autres des paroles trompeuses et dorées pour séduire.
