versets.anglais: And thus We have made for every prophet an enemy - devils from mankind and jinn, inspiring to one another decorative speech in delusion. But if your Lord had willed, they would not have done it, so leave them and that which they invent

versets.arabe: وَلِتَصْغَىٰ إِلَيْهِ أَفْئِدَةُ الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْآخِرَةِ وَلِيَرْضَوْهُ وَلِيَقْتَرِفُوا مَا هُم مُّقْتَرِفُونَ
versets.phonetique: Walitasagha ilayhi af'idatu allatheena la yu'minoona bil-akhirati waliyardawhu waliyaqtarifoo ma hum muqtarifoon
versets.francais: Et pour que les cœurs de ceux qui ne croient pas en l'au-delà s'y inclinent et l'approuvent et commettent ce qu'ils commettent.
versets.anglais: And [it is] so the hearts of those who disbelieve in the Hereafter will incline toward it and that they will be satisfied with it and that they will commit that which they are committing

versets.arabe: أَفَغَيْرَ اللَّهِ أَبْتَغِي حَكَمًا وَهُوَ الَّذِي أَنزَلَ إِلَيْكُمُ الْكِتَابَ مُفَصَّلًا
versets.phonetique: Afaghayra Allahi abtaghee hakaman wahuwa allathee anzala ilaykumu alkitaba mufassalaan
versets.francais: Chercherais-je un autre juge qu'Allah, alors que c'est Lui qui vous a fait descendre le Livre exposé en détail?
versets.anglais: [Say], "Then is it other than Allah I should seek as judge while it is He who has revealed to you the Book explained in detail?" And those to whom We [previously] gave the Scripture know that it is sent down from your Lord in truth, so never be among the doubters

versets.arabe: وَتَمَّتْ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ صِدْقًا وَعَدْلًا لَّا مُبَدِّلَ لِكَلِمَاتِهِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
versets.phonetique: Watammat kalimatu rabbika sidqan waAAadlan la mubaddila likalimatihi wahuwa alssameeAAu alAAaleem
versets.francais: La parole de ton Seigneur est accomplie en vérité et en équité. Nul ne peut modifier Ses paroles. Il est l'Audient, l'Omniscient.
versets.anglais: And the word of your Lord has been fulfilled in truth and in justice. None can alter His words, and He is the Hearing, the Knowing

versets.arabe: وَإِن تُطِعْ أَكْثَرَ مَن فِي الْأَرْضِ يُضِلُّوكَ عَن سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا الظَّنَّ وَإِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَخْرُصُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa-in tutiAA akthara man fee al-ardi yudillooka AAan sabeeli Allahi in yattabiAAoona illa althThanna wa-in hum illa yakhrusoon
versets.francais: Si tu obéis à la majorité de ceux qui sont sur terre, ils t'égareraient du sentier d'Allah. Ils ne suivent que la conjecture et ne font que mentir.
versets.anglais: And if you obey most of those upon the earth, they will mislead you from the way of Allah. They follow not except assumption, and they are not but falsifying

versets.arabe: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ مَن يَضِلُّ عَن سَبِيلِهِ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِالْمُهْتَدِينَ
versets.phonetique: Inna rabbaka huwa aAAlamu man yadillu AAan sabeelihi wahuwa aAAlamu bilmuhtadeen
versets.francais: Ton Seigneur sait mieux qui s'égare de Son sentier et Il connaît mieux les bien guidés.
versets.anglais: Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who strays from His way, and He is most knowing of the [rightly] guided

versets.arabe: فَكُلُوا مِمَّا ذُكِرَ اسْمُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ إِن كُنتُم بِآيَاتِهِ مُؤْمِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Fakuloo mimma thukira ismu Allahi AAalayhi in kuntum bi-ayatihi mu'mineen
versets.francais: Mangez donc de ce sur quoi le nom d'Allah a été prononcé, si vous croyez en Ses signes.
versets.anglais: So eat of that [meat] upon which the name of Allah has been mentioned, if you are believers in His verses

versets.arabe: وَمَا لَكُمْ أَلَّا تَأْكُلُوا مِمَّا ذُكِرَ اسْمُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ وَقَدْ فَصَّلَ لَكُم مَّا حَرَّمَ عَلَيْكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Wama lakum alla ta'kuloo mimma thukira ismu Allahi AAalayhi waqad fassala lakum ma harrama AAalaykum
versets.francais: Qu'avez-vous à ne pas manger de ce sur quoi le nom d'Allah a été prononcé, alors qu'Il vous a exposé en détail ce qu'Il vous a interdit?
versets.anglais: And why should you not eat of that upon which the name of Allah has been mentioned while He has explained in detail to you what He has forbidden you, excepting that to which you are compelled. And indeed do many lead [others] astray through their [own] inclinations without knowledge. Indeed, your Lord - He is most knowing of the transgressors

versets.arabe: وَذَرُوا ظَاهِرَ الْإِثْمِ وَبَاطِنَهُ إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَكْسِبُونَ الْإِثْمَ سَيُجْزَوْنَ بِمَا كَانُوا يَقْتَرِفُونَ
versets.phonetique: Watharoo thahira al-ithmi wabatinahu inna allatheena yaksibona al-ithma sayujzawna bima kanoo yaqtarifoon
versets.francais: Et abandonnez ce qui est péché, publiquement ou en secret. Ceux qui commettent des péchés seront rétribués de ce qu'ils commettaient.
versets.anglais: And leave what is apparent of sin and what is concealed thereof. Indeed, those who earn [blame for] sin will be recompensed for that which they used to commit

versets.arabe: وَلَا تَأْكُلُوا مِمَّا لَمْ يُذْكَرِ اسْمُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ وَإِنَّهُ لَفِسْقٌ
versets.phonetique: Wala ta'kuloo mimma lam yuthkari ismu Allahi AAalayhi wa-innahu lafisqun
versets.francais: Ne mangez pas de ce sur quoi le nom d'Allah n'a pas été prononcé, car c'est une perversité.
versets.anglais: And do not eat of that upon which the name of Allah has not been mentioned, for indeed, it is grave disobedience. And indeed do the devils inspire their allies [among men] to dispute with you. And if you were to obey them, indeed, you would be associators [of others with Him]

versets.arabe: أَوَمَن كَانَ مَيْتًا فَأَحْيَيْنَاهُ وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُ نُورًا يَمْشِي بِهِ فِي النَّاسِ كَمَن مَّثَلُهُ فِي الظُّلُمَاتِ
versets.phonetique: Awaman kana maytan faahyaynahu wajaAAalna lahu noorun yamshee bihi fee alnnasi kaman mathaluhu fee alththulumat
versets.francais: Celui qui était mort et que Nous avons ramené à la vie et à qui Nous avons accordé une lumière pour marcher parmi les gens, est-il semblable à celui qui est dans les ténèbres?
versets.anglais: And is one who was dead and We gave him life and made for him light by which to walk among the people like one who is in darkness, never to emerge therefrom? Thus it has been made pleasing to the disbelievers that which they were doing

versets.arabe: وَكَذَٰلِكَ جَعَلْنَا فِي كُلِّ قَرْيَةٍ أَكَابِرَ مُجْرِمِيهَا لِيَمْكُرُوا فِيهَا وَمَا يَمْكُرُونَ إِلَّا بِأَنفُسِهِمْ
versets.phonetique: Wakathalika jaAAalna fee kulli qaryatin akabira mujrimeeha liyamkuroo feeha wama yamkuroona illa bi-anfusihim
versets.francais: C'est ainsi que dans chaque cité Nous avons placé les grands criminels pour qu'ils y complotent. Ils ne complotent que contre eux-mêmes.
versets.anglais: And thus We have placed within every city the greatest of its criminals to conspire therein. But they conspire not except against themselves, and they perceive [it] not

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا جَاءَتْهُمْ آيَةٌ قَالُوا لَن نُّؤْمِنَ حَتَّىٰ نُؤْتَىٰ مِثْلَ مَا أُوتِيَ رُسُلُ اللَّهِ
versets.phonetique: Wa-itha jaa'thum ayatun qaloo lan nu'mina hatta nu'ta mithla ma ootiya rusulu Allah
versets.francais: Quand un signe leur vient, ils disent: "Nous ne croirons pas jusqu'à ce qu'on nous donne pareil à ce qui a été donné aux messagers d'Allah."
versets.anglais: And when a sign comes to them, they say, "Never will we believe until we are given like that which was given to the messengers of Allah." Allah is most knowing of where He places His message. There will afflict those who committed crimes debasement before Allah and severe punishment for what they used to conspire

versets.arabe: فَمَن يُرِدِ اللَّهُ أَن يَهْدِيَهُ يَشْرَحْ صَدْرَهُ لِلْإِسْلَامِ وَمَن يُرِدْ أَن يُضِلَّهُ يَجْعَلْ صَدْرَهُ ضَيِّقًا حَرَجًا
versets.phonetique: Faman yurid Allahu an yahdiyahu yashrah sadrahoo lil-islami waman yurid an yudillahu yajAAal sadrahoo dayyiqan harajan
versets.francais: Celui qu'Allah veut guider, Il lui ouvre la poitrine à l'Islam. Celui qu'Il veut égarer, Il rend sa poitrine étroite et oppressée.
versets.anglais: So whoever Allah wants to guide - He expands his breast to [contain] Islam; and whoever He wants to misguide - He makes his breast tight and constricted as though he were climbing into the sky. Thus does Allah place defilement upon those who do not believe

versets.arabe: وَهَٰذَا صِرَاطُ رَبِّكَ مُسْتَقِيمًا قَدْ فَصَّلْنَا الْآيَاتِ لِقَوْمٍ يَذَّكَّرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wahatha siratu rabbika mustaqeeman qad fassalna al-ayati liqawmin yaththakkaroon
versets.francais: Tel est le droit chemin de ton Seigneur. Nous avons exposé en détail les signes pour des gens qui se rappellent.
versets.anglais: And this is the path of your Lord, [leading] straight. We have detailed the verses for a people who remember

versets.arabe: لَهُمْ دَارُ السَّلَامِ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ وَهُوَ وَلِيُّهُم بِمَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Lahum daru alssalami AAinda rabbihim wahuwa waliyyuhum bima kanoo yaAAmaloon
versets.francais: Pour eux la Demeure de la paix auprès de leur Seigneur. Il sera leur allié pour ce qu'ils faisaient.
versets.anglais: For them will be the Home of Peace with their Lord. And He will be their protecting friend because of what they used to do

versets.arabe: وَيَوْمَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ جَمِيعًا يَا مَعْشَرَ الْجِنِّ قَدِ اسْتَكْثَرْتُم مِّنَ الْإِنسِ
versets.phonetique: Wayawma yahshuruhum jameeAAan ya maAhshara aljinni qadi istakthartum mina al-insi
versets.francais: Le jour où Il les rassemblera tous: "Ô assemblée des djinns, vous avez abusé des humains."
versets.anglais: And [mention, O Muhammad], the Day when He will gather them together [and say], "O company of jinn, you have [misled] many of mankind." And their allies among mankind will say, "Our Lord, some of us made use of others, and we have [now] reached our term, which you appointed for us." He will say, "The Fire is your residence, wherein you will abide eternally, except for what Allah wills. Indeed, your Lord is Wise and Knowing

versets.arabe: وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُوَلِّي بَعْضَ الظَّالِمِينَ بَعْضًا بِمَا كَانُوا يَكْسِبُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wakathalika nuwallee baAAda alththalimeena baAAdan bima kanoo yaksiboon
versets.francais: C'est ainsi que Nous mettons certains injustes comme alliés d'autres, à cause de ce qu'ils acquéraient.
versets.anglais: And thus will We make some of the wrongdoers allies of others for what they used to earn

versets.arabe: يَا مَعْشَرَ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنسِ أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ رُسُلٌ مِّنكُمْ يَقُصُّونَ عَلَيْكُمْ آيَاتِي
versets.phonetique: Ya maAhshara aljinni wal-insi alam ya'tikum rusulun minkum yaqussona AAalaykum ayatee
versets.francais: "Ô assemblée de djinns et d'humains! Ne vous sont-ils pas venus des messagers parmi vous qui vous racontaient Mes signes?"
versets.anglais: O company of jinn and mankind, did there not come to you messengers from among you, relating to you My verses and warning you of the meeting of this Day of yours?" They will say, "We bear witness against ourselves"; and the worldly life had deluded them, and they will bear witness against themselves that they were disbelievers

versets.arabe: ذَٰلِكَ أَن لَّمْ يَكُن رَّبُّكَ مُهْلِكَ الْقُرَىٰ بِظُلْمٍ وَأَهْلُهَا غَافِلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Thalika an lam yakun rabbuka muhliKa alqura bithulmin waahluha ghafiloon
versets.francais: C'est que ton Seigneur ne détruit pas les cités injustement pendant que leurs habitants sont dans l'ignorance.
versets.anglais: That is because your Lord would not destroy the cities for wrongdoing while their people were unaware

versets.arabe: وَلِكُلٍّ دَرَجَاتٌ مِّمَّا عَمِلُوا وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِغَافِلٍ عَمَّا يَعْمَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Walikullin darajatun mimma AAamiloo wama rabbuka bighafilin AAamma yaAAmaloon
versets.francais: À chacun des degrés selon ce qu'il a fait. Et ton Seigneur n'est pas inattentif à ce qu'ils font.
versets.anglais: And for all are degrees from what they have done. And your Lord is not unaware of what they do

versets.arabe: وَرَبُّكَ الْغَنِيُّ ذُو الرَّحْمَةِ إِن يَشَأْ يُذْهِبْكُمْ وَيَسْتَخْلِفْ مِن بَعْدِكُم مَّا يَشَاءُ
versets.phonetique: Warabbuka alghaniyyu thoo alrrahmati in yasha yuthhib-kum wayastakhlif min baAAadikum ma yasha
versets.francais: Ton Seigneur est le Riche Absolu, le Miséricordieux. S'Il voulait, Il vous ferait disparaître et ferait venir après vous ce qu'Il voudrait.
versets.anglais: And your Lord is the Free of need, the possessor of mercy. If He wills, he can do away with you and give succession after you to whomever He wills, just as He produced you from the descendants of another people

versets.arabe: إِنَّ مَا تُوعَدُونَ لَآتٍ وَمَا أَنتُم بِمُعْجِزِينَ
versets.phonetique: Inna ma tooAAadoona laatin wama antum bimuAAjizeen
versets.francais: Ce qui vous est promis viendra certainement, et vous ne pouvez pas le réduire à l'impuissance.
versets.anglais: Indeed, what you are promised is coming, and you will not cause failure [to Allah]

versets.arabe: قُلْ يَا قَوْمِ اعْمَلُوا عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِكُمْ إِنِّي عَامِلٌ فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ مَن تَكُونُ لَهُ عَاقِبَةُ الدَّارِ
versets.phonetique: Qul ya qawmi iAAmaloo AAala makanatikum innee AAamilun fasawfa taAAlamoona man takoonu lahu AAaqibatu alddari
versets.francais: Dis: "Ô mon peuple, agissez selon votre position; moi j'agis. Vous saurez bientôt à qui appartiendra la bonne fin de la demeure."
versets.anglais: Say, "O my people, work according to your position; [for] indeed, I am working. And you are going to know who will have succession in the home. Indeed, the wrongdoers will not succeed

versets.arabe: وَجَعَلُوا لِلَّهِ مِمَّا ذَرَأَ مِنَ الْحَرْثِ وَالْأَنْعَامِ نَصِيبًا فَقَالُوا هَٰذَا لِلَّهِ بِزَعْمِهِمْ وَهَٰذَا لِشُرَكَائِنَا
versets.phonetique: WajaAAaloo lillahi mimma thara'a mina alharti wal-anAAami naseeban faqaloo hatha lillahi bizaAAamihim wahatha lishuraka'ina
versets.francais: De ce qu'Il a créé comme récoltes et bestiaux, ils assignent une part à Allah en disant selon leur prétendu: "Ceci est à Allah et ceci est à nos associés."
versets.anglais: And the polytheists assign to Allah from that which He created of crops and livestock a share and say, "This is for Allah," by their claim, "and this is for our partners [associated with Him]." But what is for their "partners" does not reach Allah, while what is for Allah - this reaches their "partners." Evil is that which they rule

versets.arabe: وَكَذَٰلِكَ زَيَّنَ لِكَثِيرٍ مِّنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ قَتْلَ أَوْلَادِهِمْ شُرَكَاؤُهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Wakathalika zayyana likathirin mina almushrikeena qatla awladihim shuraka'ouhum
versets.francais: C'est ainsi que leurs associés ont embelli à beaucoup d'associateurs le meurtre de leurs enfants.
versets.anglais: And likewise, to many of the polytheists their partners have made [to seem] pleasing the killing of their children in order to bring about their destruction and to cover them with confusion in their religion. And if Allah had willed, they would not have done so. So leave them and that which they invent

versets.arabe: وَقَالُوا هَٰذِهِ أَنْعَامٌ وَحَرْثٌ حِجْرٌ لَّا يَطْعَمُهَا إِلَّا مَن نَّشَاءُ بِزَعْمِهِمْ
versets.phonetique: Waqaloo hathihi anAAamun waharthun hijrun la yatAAamuha illa man nasha'o bizaAAamihim
versets.francais: Ils disent: "Ces bestiaux et ces récoltes sont réservés et nul n'en mange sauf qui nous voulons, selon leur prétendu."
versets.anglais: And they say, "These animals and crops are forbidden; no one may eat from them except whom we will," by their claim. And there are those [camels] whose backs are forbidden [by them] and those upon which the name of Allah is not mentioned - [all of this] an invention of untruth about Him. He will punish them for what they were inventing

versets.arabe: وَقَالُوا مَا فِي بُطُونِ هَٰذِهِ الْأَنْعَامِ خَالِصَةٌ لِّذُكُورِنَا وَمُحَرَّمٌ عَلَىٰ أَزْوَاجِنَا
versets.phonetique: Waqaloo ma fee butooni hathihi al-anAAami khalisatun lithukoorina wamuharramun AAala azwajina
versets.francais: Ils disent: "Ce qui est dans les ventres de ces bestiaux est exclusivement pour nos mâles et interdit à nos épouses."
versets.anglais: And they say, "What is in the bellies of these animals is exclusively for our males and forbidden to our females. But if it is [born] dead, then all of them have shares therein." He will punish them for their description. Indeed, He is Wise and Knowing

versets.arabe: قَدْ خَسِرَ الَّذِينَ قَتَلُوا أَوْلَادَهُمْ سَفَهًا بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ وَحَرَّمُوا مَا رَزَقَهُمُ اللَّهُ
versets.phonetique: Qad khasira allatheena qataloo awladahum safahaan bighayri AAilmin waharramoo ma razaqahumu Allah
versets.francais: Ont certes perdu ceux qui ont tué leurs enfants par sottise et sans savoir, et ont déclaré illicite ce qu'Allah leur avait accordé.
versets.anglais: Those will have lost who killed their children in foolishness without knowledge and prohibited what Allah had provided for them, inventing untruth about Allah. They have gone astray and were not [rightly] guided

versets.arabe: وَهُوَ الَّذِي أَنشَأَ جَنَّاتٍ مَّعْرُوشَاتٍ وَغَيْرَ مَعْرُوشَاتٍ وَالنَّخْلَ وَالزَّرْعَ مُخْتَلِفًا أُكُلُهُ
versets.phonetique: Wahuwa allathee ansha'a jannatin maAArooshatin waghaYra maAArooshatin waalnakhla walzzarAAa mukhtalifan okuluhu
versets.francais: C'est Lui qui a créé des jardins en treillage et sans treillage, les palmiers et les cultures aux fruits variés.
versets.anglais: And He it is who causes gardens to grow, [both] trellised and untrellised, and palm trees and crops of different [kinds of] food and olives and pomegranates, similar and dissimilar. Eat of [each of] its fruit when it yields and give its due [zakah] on the day of its harvest. And be not excessive. Indeed, He does not like those who commit excess

versets.arabe: وَمِنَ الْأَنْعَامِ حَمُولَةً وَفَرْشًا كُلُوا مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ اللَّهُ وَلَا تَتَّبِعُوا خُطُوَاتِ الشَّيْطَانِ
versets.phonetique: Wamina al-anAAami hamoolatan wafarshan kuloo mimma razaqakumu Allahu wala tattabiAAoo khutuwati alshshaytan
versets.francais: Et parmi les bestiaux, des bêtes de somme et des bêtes de boucherie. Mangez de ce qu'Allah vous a accordé et ne suivez pas les pas du Diable.
versets.anglais: And of the grazing livestock are carriers [of burdens] and those [too] small. Eat of what Allah has provided for you and do not follow the footsteps of Satan. Indeed, he is to you a clear enemy

versets.arabe: ثَمَانِيَةَ أَزْوَاجٍ مِّنَ الضَّأْنِ اثْنَيْنِ وَمِنَ الْمَعْزِ اثْنَيْنِ قُلْ آلذَّكَرَيْنِ حَرَّمَ أَمِ الْأُنثَيَيْنِ
versets.phonetique: Thamaniyata azwajin mina aldda'ni ithnaYni wamina almaAAzi ithnaYni qul althakarayni harrama ami al-unthayayni
versets.francais: Huit couples: deux brebis et deux chèvres. Dis: "Est-ce les deux mâles qu'Il a interdits, ou les deux femelles?"
versets.anglais: [They are] eight mates - of the sheep, two and of the goats, two. Say, "Is it the two males He has forbidden or the two females or that which the wombs of the two females contain? Inform me with knowledge, if you should be truthful

versets.arabe: وَمِنَ الْإِبِلِ اثْنَيْنِ وَمِنَ الْبَقَرِ اثْنَيْنِ قُلْ آلذَّكَرَيْنِ حَرَّمَ أَمِ الْأُنثَيَيْنِ أَمَّا اشْتَمَلَتْ عَلَيْهِ أَرْحَامُ الْأُنثَيَيْنِ
versets.phonetique: Wamina al-ibili ithnaYni wamina albaqari ithnaYni qul althakarayni harrama ami al-unthayayni amma ishtamalat AAalayhi arhamu al-unthayayni
versets.francais: Et deux chameaux et deux bœufs. Dis: "Est-ce les deux mâles qu'Il a interdits, ou les deux femelles, ou ce que les ventres des deux femelles contiennent?"
versets.anglais: And of the camels, two and of the cattle, two. Say, "Is it the two males He has forbidden or the two females or that which the wombs of the two females contain? Or were you witnesses when Allah charged you with this? Then who is more unjust than one who invents a lie about Allah to mislead the people by [something] other than knowledge? Indeed, Allah does not guide the wrongdoing people

versets.arabe: قُل لَّا أَجِدُ فِي مَا أُوحِيَ إِلَيَّ مُحَرَّمًا عَلَىٰ طَاعِمٍ يَطْعَمُهُ إِلَّا أَن يَكُونَ مَيْتَةً أَوْ دَمًا مَّسْفُوحًا
versets.phonetique: Qul la ajidu fee ma oohiya ilayya muharraman AAala taAAimin yatAAamuhu illa an yakoona maytatan aw daman masfouhan
versets.francais: Dis: "Dans ce qui m'a été révélé, je ne trouve aucun aliment interdit à un mangeur qui en mange, sauf si c'est une bête morte, du sang répandu,"
versets.anglais: Say, "I do not find within that which was revealed to me [anything] forbidden to one who would eat it unless it be a dead animal or blood spilled out or the flesh of swine - for indeed, it is impure - or it be [that slaughtered in] disobedience, dedicated to other than Allah. But whoever is forced [by necessity], neither desiring [it] nor transgressing [its limit], then indeed, your Lord is Forgiving and Merciful

versets.arabe: وَعَلَى الَّذِينَ هَادُوا حَرَّمْنَا كُلَّ ذِي ظُفُرٍ وَمِنَ الْبَقَرِ وَالْغَنَمِ حَرَّمْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ شُحُومَهُمَا
versets.phonetique: WaAAala allatheena hadoo harramna kulla thee thufurin wamina albaqari waalghAnami harramna AAalayhim shuhoomahuma
versets.francais: Aux Juifs Nous avons interdit tout animal à sabots entiers; des bœufs et des moutons Nous leur avons interdit les graisses.
versets.anglais: And to those who are Jews We prohibited every animal of uncloven hoof; and of the cattle and the sheep We prohibited to them their fat, except what adheres to their backs or the entrails or what is joined with bone. [By] that We repaid them for their injustice. And indeed, We are truthful

versets.arabe: فَإِن كَذَّبُوكَ فَقُل رَّبُّكُمْ ذُو رَحْمَةٍ وَاسِعَةٍ وَلَا يُرَدُّ بَأْسُهُ عَنِ الْقَوْمِ الْمُجْرِمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Fa-in kaththabooka faqul rabbukum thoo rahmatin wasiAAatin wala yuraddu ba'suhu AAani alqawmi almujrimeen
versets.francais: S'ils te traitent de menteur, dis: "Votre Seigneur est Possesseur d'une vaste miséricorde; mais Sa rigueur ne sera pas écartée des gens criminels."
versets.anglais: So if they deny you, [O Muhammad], say, "Your Lord is the possessor of vast mercy; but His punishment cannot be repelled from the people who are criminals

versets.arabe: سَيَقُولُ الَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوا لَوْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ مَا أَشْرَكْنَا وَلَا آبَاؤُنَا وَلَا حَرَّمْنَا مِن شَيْءٍ
versets.phonetique: Sayaqoolu allatheena ashrakoo law shaa Allahu ma ashrakna wala aba'ona wala harramna min shay'in
versets.francais: Ceux qui associent diront: "Si Allah avait voulu, nous n'aurions pas associé, ni nos pères, et nous n'aurions rien interdit."
versets.anglais: Those who associated with Allah will say, "If Allah had willed, we would not have associated [anything] and neither would our fathers, nor would we have prohibited anything." Likewise did those before deny until they tasted Our punishment. Say, "Do you have any knowledge that you can produce for us? You follow not except assumption, and you are not but falsifying

versets.arabe: قُلْ فَلِلَّهِ الْحُجَّةُ الْبَالِغَةُ فَلَوْ شَاءَ لَهَدَاكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qul falillahi alhujjatu albalighaatu falaw shaa lahadakum ajmaAAeen
versets.francais: Dis: "À Allah appartient la preuve souveraine. S'Il avait voulu, Il vous aurait guidés tous."
versets.anglais: Say, "With Allah is the far-reaching argument. If He had willed, He would have guided you all

versets.arabe: قُلْ هَلُمَّ شُهَدَاءَكُمُ الَّذِينَ يَشْهَدُونَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ حَرَّمَ هَٰذَا
versets.phonetique: Qul halumma shuhadaakumu allatheena yashadoona anna Allaha harrama hatha
versets.francais: Dis: "Amenez vos témoins qui attestent qu'Allah a interdit cela."
versets.anglais: Say, [O Muhammad], "Bring forward your witnesses who will testify that Allah has prohibited this." And if they testify, do not testify with them. And do not follow the desires of those who deny Our verses and those who do not believe in the Hereafter, while they equate [others] with their Lord

versets.arabe: قُلْ تَعَالَوْا أَتْلُ مَا حَرَّمَ رَبُّكُمْ عَلَيْكُمْ أَلَّا تُشْرِكُوا بِهِ شَيْئًا وَبِالْوَالِدَيْنِ إِحْسَانًا
versets.phonetique: Qul taAAalaw atlu ma harrama rabbukum AAalaykum alla tushrikoo bihi shay'an wabialwalidayni ihsana
versets.francais: Dis: "Venez, je vais réciter ce que votre Seigneur vous a interdit: de ne Lui rien associer; d'être bons envers vos père et mère."
versets.anglais: Say, "Come, I will recite what your Lord has prohibited to you. [He commands] that you not associate anything with Him, and to parents, good treatment, and do not kill your children out of poverty; We will provide for you and them. And do not approach immoralities - what is apparent of them and what is concealed. And do not kill the soul which Allah has forbidden [to be killed] except by [legal] right. This has He instructed you that you may use reason

versets.arabe: وَلَا تَقْرَبُوا مَالَ الْيَتِيمِ إِلَّا بِالَّتِي هِيَ أَحْسَنُ حَتَّىٰ يَبْلُغَ أَشُدَّهُ وَأَوْفُوا الْكَيْلَ وَالْمِيزَانَ بِالْقِسْطِ
versets.phonetique: Wala taqraboo mala alyateemi illa biallatee hiya ahsanu hatta yablugha ashuddahu waawfoo alkayyla waalmeezana bilqist
versets.francais: N'approchez pas les biens de l'orphelin que de la meilleure façon, jusqu'à ce qu'il atteigne sa majorité; et accomplissez la mesure et le pesage équitablement.
versets.anglais: And do not approach the orphan's property except in a way that is best until he reaches maturity. And give full measure and weight in justice. We do not charge any soul except [with that within] its capacity. And when you testify, be just, even if [it concerns] a near relative. And the covenant of Allah fulfill. This has He instructed you that you may remember

versets.arabe: وَأَنَّ هَٰذَا صِرَاطِي مُسْتَقِيمًا فَاتَّبِعُوهُ وَلَا تَتَّبِعُوا السُّبُلَ فَتَفَرَّقَ بِكُمْ عَن سَبِيلِهِ
versets.phonetique: Waanna hatha siratee mustaqeeman fattabiAAoohu wala tattabiAAoo alssibula fatafaarraqa bikum AAan sabeelihi
versets.francais: "Et que voilà Mon droit chemin. Suivez-le donc. Ne suivez pas les sentiers qui vous éloigneraient de Son sentier."
versets.anglais: And, [moreover], this is My path, which is straight, so follow it; and do not follow [other] ways, for you will be separated from His way. This has He instructed you that you may become righteous

versets.arabe: ثُمَّ آتَيْنَا مُوسَى الْكِتَابَ تَمَامًا عَلَى الَّذِي أَحْسَنَ وَتَفْصِيلًا لِّكُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةً
versets.phonetique: Thumma atayna moosa alkitaba tamaman AAala allathee ahsana watafseelaan likulli shay'in wahudan warahmatan
versets.francais: Puis Nous avons donné à Moïse le Livre, comme parfait accomplissement pour celui qui fait le bien, et explication détaillée de toute chose, et guidée et miséricorde.
versets.anglais: Then We gave Moses the Scripture, making complete [Our favor] upon the one who did good and as a detailed explanation of all things and as guidance and mercy that perhaps in [the matter of] the meeting with their Lord they would believe

versets.arabe: وَهَٰذَا كِتَابٌ أَنزَلْنَاهُ مُبَارَكٌ فَاتَّبِعُوهُ وَاتَّقُوا لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wahatha kitabun anzalnahu mubarakun fattabiAAoohu wattaqoo laAAallakum turhamoon
versets.francais: Et voilà un Livre béni que Nous avons fait descendre. Suivez-le donc et soyez pieux, afin qu'on vous fasse miséricorde.
versets.anglais: And this [Qur'an] is a Book We have revealed [which is] blessed, so follow it and fear Allah that you may receive mercy

versets.arabe: أَن تَقُولُوا إِنَّمَا أُنزِلَ الْكِتَابُ عَلَىٰ طَائِفَتَيْنِ مِن قَبْلِنَا وَإِن كُنَّا عَن دِرَاسَتِهِمْ لَغَافِلِينَ
versets.phonetique: An taqooloo innama onzila alkitabu AAala ta'ifataYni min qablina wa-in kunna AAan dirasatihim laghafileen
versets.francais: Pour que vous ne disiez pas: "Le Livre n'a été révélé qu'à deux groupes avant nous et nous n'avions pas connaissance de leur enseignement."
versets.anglais: [We revealed it] lest you say, "The Scripture was only sent down to two groups before us, but we were of their study unaware

versets.arabe: أَوْ تَقُولُوا لَوْ أَنَّا أُنزِلَ عَلَيْنَا الْكِتَابُ لَكُنَّا أَهْدَىٰ مِنْهُمْ فَقَدْ جَاءَكُم بَيِّنَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةٌ
versets.phonetique: Aw taqooloo law anna onzila AAalayna alkitabu lakunna ahda minhum faqad jaakum bayyinatun min rabbikum wahudan warahmatun
versets.francais: Ou que vous disiez: "Si seulement le Livre nous avait été révélé, nous aurions été mieux guidés qu'eux." Il vous est maintenant venu une preuve de votre Seigneur, une guidée et une miséricorde.
versets.anglais: Or lest you say, "If only the Scripture had been revealed to us, we would have been better guided than they." So there has [now] come to you a clear evidence from your Lord and a guidance and mercy. Then who is more unjust than one who denies the verses of Allah and turns away from them? We will recompense those who turn away from Our verses with the worst of punishment for their having turned away

versets.arabe: هَلْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا أَن تَأْتِيَهُمُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ أَوْ يَأْتِيَ رَبُّكَ أَوْ يَأْتِيَ بَعْضُ آيَاتِ رَبِّكَ
versets.phonetique: Hal yanthuroona illa an ta'tiyahumu almala'ikatu aw ya'tiya rabbuka aw ya'tiya baAAdu ayati rabbika
versets.francais: N'attendent-ils que la venue des anges ou la venue de ton Seigneur, ou encore la venue de quelques signes de ton Seigneur?
versets.anglais: Do they [then] wait for anything except that the angels should come to them or your Lord should come or that there come some of the signs of your Lord? The Day that some of the signs of your Lord will come no soul will benefit from its faith as long as it had not believed before or had earned through its faith some good. Say, "Wait. Indeed, we [also] are waiting

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ فَرَّقُوا دِينَهُمْ وَكَانُوا شِيَعًا لَّسْتَ مِنْهُمْ فِي شَيْءٍ
versets.phonetique: Inna allatheena farraqoo deenahum wakanoo shiyaAAan lasta minhum fee shay'in
versets.francais: Ceux qui ont divisé leur religion et qui se sont organisés en sectes, tu n'as rien à faire avec eux.
versets.anglais: Indeed, those who have divided their religion and become sects - you, [O Muhammad], are not [associated] with them in anything. Their affair is only [left] to Allah; then He will inform them about what they used to do

versets.arabe: مَن جَاءَ بِالْحَسَنَةِ فَلَهُ عَشْرُ أَمْثَالِهَا وَمَن جَاءَ بِالسَّيِّئَةِ فَلَا يُجْزَىٰ إِلَّا مِثْلَهَا وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Man jaa bilhasanati falahu AAashru amthaliha waman jaa bilsayyi'ati fala yujza illa mithlaha wahum la yuthlamoon
versets.francais: Celui qui vient avec une bonne action aura dix fois pareille. Celui qui vient avec une mauvaise action ne sera rétribué que pareillement. Et ils ne seront pas lésés.
versets.anglais: Whoever comes [on the Day of Judgement] with a good deed will have ten times the like thereof [to his credit], and whoever comes with an evil deed will not be recompensed except the like thereof; and they will not be wronged

versets.arabe: قُلْ إِنَّنِي هَدَانِي رَبِّي إِلَىٰ صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ دِينًا قِيَمًا مِّلَّةَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَنِيفًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qul innanee hadanee rabbee ila siratin mustaqeemin deenan qiyaman millata ibraheema haneefan wama kana mina almushrikeen
versets.francais: Dis: "Mon Seigneur m'a guidé vers un droit chemin, une religion droite, la religion d'Abraham le pur monothéiste, qui n'était pas parmi les associateurs."
versets.anglais: Say, "Indeed, my Lord has guided me to a straight path - a correct religion - the way of Abraham, inclining toward truth. And he was not among those who associated others with Allah

versets.arabe: قُلْ إِنَّ صَلَاتِي وَنُسُكِي وَمَحْيَايَ وَمَمَاتِي لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qul inna salateee wanusukee wamahyaya wamamatee lillahi rabbi alAAalameen
versets.francais: Dis: "Ma Salat, mes actes de dévotion, ma vie et ma mort appartiennent à Allah, Seigneur de l'univers."
versets.anglais: Say, "Indeed, my prayer, my rites of sacrifice, my living and my dying are for Allah, Lord of the worlds

versets.arabe: لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَبِذَٰلِكَ أُمِرْتُ وَأَنَا أَوَّلُ الْمُسْلِمِينَ
versets.phonetique: La shareeka lahu wabizalika omirtu waana awwalu almuslimeen
versets.francais: "Il n'a pas d'associé. Tel est l'ordre que j'ai reçu et je suis le premier des Musulmans."
versets.anglais: No partner has He. And this I have been commanded, and I am the first [among you] of the Muslims

versets.arabe: قُلْ أَغَيْرَ اللَّهِ أَبْغِي رَبًّا وَهُوَ رَبُّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَلَا تَكْسِبُ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ إِلَّا عَلَيْهَا
versets.phonetique: Qul aghaYra Allahi abghee rabban wahuwa rabbu kulli shay'in wala taksibu kullu nafsin illa AAalayha
versets.francais: Dis: "Chercherais-je un autre seigneur qu'Allah, alors qu'Il est le Seigneur de toute chose? Chaque âme n'acquiert que pour elle-même."
versets.anglais: Say, "Is it other than Allah I should desire as a lord while He is the Lord of all things? And every soul earns not [blame] except against itself, and no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another. Then to your Lord is your return, and He will inform you concerning that over which you used to differ

versets.arabe: وَهُوَ الَّذِي جَعَلَكُمْ خَلَائِفَ الْأَرْضِ وَرَفَعَ بَعْضَكُمْ فَوْقَ بَعْضٍ دَرَجَاتٍ لِّيَبْلُوَكُمْ فِي مَا آتَاكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Wahuwa allathee jaAAalakum khala'ifa al-ardi warafaAAa baAAdakum fawqa baAAdin darajatin liyabluwakum fee ma atakum
versets.francais: C'est Lui qui vous a établis khalifes sur la terre et a élevé certains d'entre vous en rangs sur d'autres afin de vous éprouver en ce qu'Il vous a donné.
versets.anglais: And it is He who has made you successors upon the earth and has raised some of you above others in degrees [of rank] that He may try you through what He has given you. Indeed, your Lord is swift in penalty; but indeed, He is Forgiving and Merciful

versets.arabe: المص
versets.phonetique: Alif Lam Mim Sad
versets.francais: Alif, Lam, Mim, Sad.
versets.anglais: Alif, Lam, Meem, Sad

versets.arabe: كِتَابٌ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ فَلَا يَكُن فِي صَدْرِكَ حَرَجٌ مِّنْهُ
versets.phonetique: Kitabun unzila ilayka fala yakun fi sadrika harajun minh
versets.francais: Un Livre t'a été révélé. Qu'il n'y ait donc aucune gêne dans ton cœur à ce sujet.
versets.anglais: [This is] a Book revealed to you, [O Muhammad] - so let there not be in your breast distress therefrom - that you may warn thereby and as a reminder to the believers

versets.arabe: اتَّبِعُوا مَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكُم مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Ittabi'u ma unzila ilaykum min rabbikum
versets.francais: Suivez ce qui vous a été descendu de la part de votre Seigneur.
versets.anglais: Follow, [O mankind], what has been revealed to you from your Lord and do not follow other than Him any allies. Little do you remember

versets.arabe: وَكَم مِّن قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَاهَا
versets.phonetique: Wa-kam min qaryatin ahlaknaha
versets.francais: Combien de cités avons-Nous détruites!
versets.anglais: And how many cities have We destroyed, and Our punishment came to them at night or while they were sleeping at noon

versets.arabe: فَمَا كَانَ دَعْوَاهُمْ إِذْ جَاءَهُم بَأْسُنَا إِلَّا أَن قَالُوا إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَالِمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Fama kana da'wahum idh ja'ahum ba'suna illa an qalu inna kunna zalimin
versets.francais: Quand Notre châtiment les frappa, leur seule supplication fut: "Nous étions injustes."
versets.anglais: And their declaration when Our punishment came to them was only that they said, "Indeed, we were wrongdoers

versets.arabe: فَلَنَسْأَلَنَّ الَّذِينَ أُرْسِلَ إِلَيْهِمْ وَلَنَسْأَلَنَّ الْمُرْسَلِينَ
versets.phonetique: Falanas'alanna alladhina ursila ilayhim wa-lanas'alannal-mursalin
versets.francais: Nous interrogerons certes ceux à qui des messagers ont été envoyés, et Nous interrogerons les messagers.
versets.anglais: Then We will surely question those to whom [a message] was sent, and We will surely question the messengers

versets.arabe: فَلَنَقُصَّنَّ عَلَيْهِم بِعِلْمٍ وَمَا كُنَّا غَائِبِينَ
versets.phonetique: Falanaqqussanna 'alayhim bi'ilmin wa-ma kunna gha'ibin
versets.francais: Nous leur ferons certes récit en pleine connaissance. Nous n'étions pas absents.
versets.anglais: Then We will surely relate [their deeds] to them with knowledge, and We were not [at all] absent

versets.arabe: وَالْوَزْنُ يَوْمَئِذٍ الْحَقُّ
versets.phonetique: Wal-waznu yawma'idhin al-haqq
versets.francais: La pesée ce Jour-là est la vérité.
versets.anglais: And the weighing [of deeds] that Day will be the truth. So those whose scales are heavy - it is they who will be the successful

versets.arabe: وَمَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَازِينُهُ فَأُولَٰئِكَ الَّذِينَ خَسِرُوا أَنفُسَهُم
versets.phonetique: Wa-man khaffat mawaziynuhu fa-ula'ika alladhina khasiru anfusahum
versets.francais: Ceux dont la balance est légère, ce sont eux qui se sont perdus eux-mêmes.
versets.anglais: And those whose scales are light - they are the ones who will lose themselves for what injustice they were doing toward Our verses

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ مَكَّنَّاكُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَجَعَلْنَا لَكُمْ فِيهَا مَعَايِشَ
versets.phonetique: Wa-laqad makkannakum fil-ardi wa-ja'alna lakum fiha ma'ayish
versets.francais: Nous vous avons établis sur la terre et Nous y avons disposé pour vous des moyens de subsistance.
versets.anglais: And We have certainly established you upon the earth and made for you therein ways of livelihood. Little are you grateful

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَاكُمْ ثُمَّ صَوَّرْنَاكُمْ ثُمَّ قُلْنَا لِلْمَلَائِكَةِ اسْجُدُوا لِآدَمَ
versets.phonetique: Wa-laqad khalaqnakum thumma sawwarnakum thumma qulna lil-mala'ikati osjudu li-adam
versets.francais: Nous vous avons créés, puis façonnés, puis Nous avons dit aux anges: "Prosternez-vous devant Adam."
versets.anglais: And We have certainly created you, [O Mankind], and given you [human] form. Then We said to the angels, "Prostrate to Adam"; so they prostrated, except for Iblees. He was not of those who prostrated

versets.arabe: قَالَ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَلَّا تَسْجُدَ إِذْ أَمَرْتُكَ
versets.phonetique: Qala ma mana'aka alla tasjuda idh amartuk
versets.francais: Il dit: "Qu'est-ce qui t'a empêché de te prosterner quand Je te l'ai commandé?"
versets.anglais: [Allah] said, "What prevented you from prostrating when I commanded you?" [Satan] said, "I am better than him. You created me from fire and created him from clay

versets.arabe: قَالَ فَاهْبِطْ مِنْهَا فَمَا يَكُونُ لَكَ أَن تَتَكَبَّرَ فِيهَا
versets.phonetique: Qala fahbit minha fama yakunu laka an tatakabbara fiha
versets.francais: Il dit: "Descends-en! Tu n'as pas à t'y enorgueillir."
versets.anglais: [Allah] said, "Descend from Paradise, for it is not for you to be arrogant therein. So get out; indeed, you are of the debased

versets.arabe: قَالَ أَنظِرْنِي إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qala andhirni ila yawmi yub'athun
versets.francais: Il dit: "Accorde-moi un délai jusqu'au Jour où ils seront ressuscités."
versets.anglais: [Satan] said, "Reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected

versets.arabe: قَالَ إِنَّكَ مِنَ الْمُنظَرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qala innaka minal-mundharin
versets.francais: Il dit: "Tu es de ceux à qui le délai est accordé."
versets.anglais: [Allah] said, "Indeed, you are of those reprieved

versets.arabe: قَالَ فَبِمَا أَغْوَيْتَنِي لَأَقْعُدَنَّ لَهُمْ صِرَاطَكَ الْمُسْتَقِيمَ
versets.phonetique: Qala fabima aghwaytani la-aq'udanna lahum sirataka al-mustaqim
versets.francais: Il dit: "Puisque Tu m'as égaré, je me posterai certes sur Ton droit chemin."
versets.anglais: [Satan] said, "Because You have put me in error, I will surely sit in wait for them on Your straight path

versets.arabe: ثُمَّ لَآتِيَنَّهُم مِّن بَيْنِ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ
versets.phonetique: Thumma la-atiyannahum min bayni aydihim wa-min khalfihim
versets.francais: Puis je les assaillirai de devant et de derrière, de droite et de gauche.
versets.anglais: Then I will come to them from before them and from behind them and on their right and on their left, and You will not find most of them grateful [to You]

versets.arabe: قَالَ اخْرُجْ مِنْهَا مَذْءُومًا مَّدْحُورًا
versets.phonetique: Qala ukhruj minha madh'uman madhura
versets.francais: Il dit: "Sors-en, méprisé et banni."
versets.anglais: [Allah] said, "Get out of Paradise, reproached and expelled. Whoever follows you among them - I will surely fill Hell with you, all together

versets.arabe: وَيَا آدَمُ اسْكُنْ أَنتَ وَزَوْجُكَ الْجَنَّةَ
versets.phonetique: Wa-ya adamu oskun anta wa-zawjuka al-janna
versets.francais: Et toi, Adam, habite le Paradis, toi et ton épouse.
versets.anglais: And "O Adam, dwell, you and your wife, in Paradise and eat from wherever you will but do not approach this tree, lest you be among the wrongdoers

versets.arabe: فَوَسْوَسَ لَهُمَا الشَّيْطَانُ لِيُبْدِيَ لَهُمَا مَا وُورِيَ عَنْهُمَا مِن سَوْآتِهِمَا
versets.phonetique: Fawaswasa lahuma ash-shaytanu liyubdiya lahuma ma wuriya 'anhuma min saw'atihima
versets.francais: Le Diable leur fit des suggestions pour leur dévoiler leurs nudités qui leur étaient cachées.
versets.anglais: But Satan whispered to them to make apparent to them that which was concealed from them of their private parts. He said, "Your Lord did not forbid you this tree except that you become angels or become of the immortal

versets.arabe: وَقَاسَمَهُمَا إِنِّي لَكُمَا لَمِنَ النَّاصِحِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa-qasamahuma inni lakuma lamina an-nasihin
versets.francais: Et il leur jura: "Je suis pour vous deux un conseiller sincère."
versets.anglais: And he swore [by Allah] to them, "Indeed, I am to you from among the sincere advisors

versets.arabe: فَدَلَّاهُمَا بِغُرُورٍ
versets.phonetique: Fadallahuma bighurur
versets.francais: Il les fit ainsi tomber par tromperie.
versets.anglais: So he made them fall, through deception. And when they tasted of the tree, their private parts became apparent to them, and they began to fasten together over themselves from the leaves of Paradise. And their Lord called to them, "Did I not forbid you from that tree and tell you that Satan is to you a clear enemy

versets.arabe: قَالَا رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا
versets.phonetique: Qala rabbana zalamna anfusana wa-in lam taghfir lana wa-tarhamna
versets.francais: Ils dirent: "Seigneur! Nous nous sommes lésés nous-mêmes. Si Tu ne nous pardonnes pas et ne nous fais pas miséricorde."
versets.anglais: They said, "Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers

versets.arabe: قَالَ اهْبِطُوا بَعْضُكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّ
versets.phonetique: Qala ihbitu ba'dukum liba'din 'aduw
versets.francais: Il dit: "Descendez, ennemis les uns des autres."
versets.anglais: [Allah] said, "Descend, being to one another enemies. And for you on the earth is a place of settlement and enjoyment for a time

versets.arabe: قَالَ فِيهَا تَحْيَوْنَ وَفِيهَا تَمُوتُونَ وَمِنْهَا تُخْرَجُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qala fiha tahyawna wa-fiha tamutuna wa-minha tukhrajun
versets.francais: Il dit: "C'est là que vous vivrez, là que vous mourrez, et de là vous serez tirés."
versets.anglais: He said, "Therein you will live, and therein you will die, and from it you will be brought forth

versets.arabe: يَا بَنِي آدَمَ قَدْ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكُمْ لِبَاسًا يُوَارِي سَوْآتِكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Ya bani adama qad anzalna 'alaykum libasan yuwari saw'atikum
versets.francais: O enfants d'Adam! Nous avons fait descendre sur vous un vêtement pour couvrir vos nudités.
versets.anglais: O children of Adam, We have bestowed upon you clothing to conceal your private parts and as adornment. But the clothing of righteousness - that is best. That is from the signs of Allah that perhaps they will remember

versets.arabe: يَا بَنِي آدَمَ لَا يَفْتِنَنَّكُمُ الشَّيْطَانُ
versets.phonetique: Ya bani adama la yaftinannakumu ash-shaytan
versets.francais: O enfants d'Adam! Que le Diable ne vous tente pas.
versets.anglais: O children of Adam, let not Satan tempt you as he removed your parents from Paradise, stripping them of their clothing to show them their private parts. Indeed, he sees you, he and his tribe, from where you do not see them. Indeed, We have made the devils allies to those who do not believe

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا فَعَلُوا فَاحِشَةً قَالُوا وَجَدْنَا عَلَيْهَا آبَاءَنَا
versets.phonetique: Wa-idha fa'alu fahishatan qalu wajadna 'alayha aba'ana
versets.francais: Et quand ils commettent une turpitude, ils disent: "Nous avons trouvé nos ancêtres en train de la pratiquer."
versets.anglais: And when they commit an immorality, they say, "We found our fathers doing it, and Allah has ordered us to do it." Say, "Indeed, Allah does not order immorality. Do you say about Allah that which you do not know

versets.arabe: قُلْ أَمَرَ رَبِّي بِالْقِسْطِ
versets.phonetique: Qul amara rabbi bil-qist
versets.francais: Dis: "Mon Seigneur a ordonné l'équité."
versets.anglais: Say, [O Muhammad], "My Lord has ordered justice and that you maintain yourselves [in worship of Him] at every place [or time] of prostration, and invoke Him, sincere to Him in religion." Just as He originated you, you will return [to life]

versets.arabe: فَرِيقًا هَدَىٰ وَفَرِيقًا حَقَّ عَلَيْهِمُ الضَّلَالَةُ
versets.phonetique: Fariqan hada wa-fariqan haqqa 'alayhim ad-dalalah
versets.francais: Un groupe a été guidé, et un autre groupe, l'égarement leur était dû.
versets.anglais: A group [of you] He guided, and a group deserved [to be in] error. Indeed, they had taken the devils as allies instead of Allah while they thought that they were guided

versets.arabe: يَا بَنِي آدَمَ خُذُوا زِينَتَكُمْ عِندَ كُلِّ مَسْجِدٍ
versets.phonetique: Ya bani adama khudu zinatakum 'inda kulli masjid
versets.francais: O enfants d'Adam! Portez votre parure à chaque lieu de prière.
versets.anglais: O children of Adam, take your adornment at every masjid, and eat and drink, but be not excessive. Indeed, He likes not those who commit excess

versets.arabe: قُلْ مَنْ حَرَّمَ زِينَةَ اللَّهِ الَّتِي أَخْرَجَ لِعِبَادِهِ
versets.phonetique: Qul man harrama zinata Allahi allati akhraja li'ibadih
versets.francais: Dis: "Qui a interdit la parure d'Allah qu'Il a sortie pour Ses serviteurs?"
versets.anglais: Say, "Who has forbidden the adornment of Allah which He has produced for His servants and the good [lawful] things of provision?" Say, "They are for those who believe during the worldly life [but] exclusively for them on the Day of Resurrection." Thus do We detail the verses for a people who know

versets.arabe: قُلْ إِنَّمَا حَرَّمَ رَبِّيَ الْفَوَاحِشَ مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا وَمَا بَطَنَ
versets.phonetique: Qul innama harrama rabbiya al-fawahisha ma zahara minha wa-ma batan
versets.francais: Dis: "Mon Seigneur n'a interdit que les turpitudes, apparentes ou cachées."
versets.anglais: Say, "My Lord has only forbidden immoralities - what is apparent of them and what is concealed - and sin, and oppression without right, and that you associate with Allah that for which He has not sent down authority, and that you say about Allah that which you do not know

versets.arabe: وَلِكُلِّ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلٌ فَإِذَا جَاءَ أَجَلُهُمْ لَا يَسْتَأْخِرُونَ سَاعَةً
versets.phonetique: Wa-likulli ummatin ajalun fa-idha ja'a ajaluhum la yasta'khiruna sa'ah
versets.francais: A chaque communauté est fixé un terme. Quand leur terme arrive, ils ne peuvent le retarder d'une heure.
versets.anglais: And for every nation is a [specified] term. So when their time has come, they will not remain behind an hour, nor will they precede [it]

versets.arabe: يَا بَنِي آدَمَ إِمَّا يَأْتِيَنَّكُمْ رُسُلٌ مِّنكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Ya bani adama imma ya'tiyannakum rusulun minkum
versets.francais: O enfants d'Adam! Si des messagers, issus de vous, viennent vous exposer Mes révélations.
versets.anglais: O children of Adam, if there come to you messengers from among you relating to you My verses, then whoever fears Allah and reforms - there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا بِآيَاتِنَا وَاسْتَكْبَرُوا عَنْهَا
versets.phonetique: Walladhina kadhdhabu bi-ayatina was-takbaru 'anha
versets.francais: Ceux qui traitent Nos versets de mensonges et s'en enorgueillissent.
versets.anglais: But the ones who deny Our verses and are arrogant toward them - those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally

versets.arabe: فَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ افْتَرَىٰ عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا
versets.phonetique: Faman azlamu mimmani iftara 'ala Allahi kadhiba
versets.francais: Qui est plus injuste que celui qui forge un mensonge contre Allah?
versets.anglais: And who is more unjust than one who invents about Allah a lie or denies His verses? Those will attain their portion of the decree until when Our messengers come to them to take them in death, they will say, "Where are those you used to invoke besides Allah?" They will say, "They have departed from us," and will bear witness against themselves that they were disbelievers

versets.arabe: قَالَ ادْخُلُوا فِي أُمَمٍ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلِكُم
versets.phonetique: Qala odkhulufi umamin qad khalat min qablikum
versets.francais: Il dira: "Entrez parmi les communautés qui sont passées avant vous."
versets.anglais: [Allah] will say, "Enter among nations which had passed on before you of jinn and mankind into the Fire." Every time a nation enters, it will curse its sister until, when they have all overtaken one another therein, the last of them will say about the first of them "Our Lord, these had misled us, so give them a double punishment of the Fire. He will say, "For each is double, but you do not know

versets.arabe: وَقَالَتْ أُولَاهُمْ لِأُخْرَاهُمْ فَمَا كَانَ لَكُمْ عَلَيْنَا مِن فَضْلٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa-qalat ulahum li-ukhrahum fama kana lakum 'alayna min fadl
versets.francais: Et les premiers diront aux derniers: "Vous n'avez aucun avantage sur nous."
versets.anglais: And the first of them will say to the last of them, "Then you had not any favor over us, so taste the punishment for what you used to earn

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا بِآيَاتِنَا وَاسْتَكْبَرُوا عَنْهَا لَا تُفَتَّحُ لَهُمْ أَبْوَابُ السَّمَاءِ
versets.phonetique: Inna alladhina kadhdhabu bi-ayatina was-takbaru 'anha la tufattahu lahum abwabu as-sama'
versets.francais: Ceux qui traitent Nos signes de mensonges et s'en enorgueillissent, les portes du ciel ne leur seront pas ouvertes.
versets.anglais: Indeed, those who deny Our verses and are arrogant toward them - the gates of Heaven will not be opened for them, nor will they enter Paradise until a camel enters into the eye of a needle. And thus do We recompense the criminals

versets.arabe: لَهُم مِّن جَهَنَّمَ مِهَادٌ وَمِن فَوْقِهِمْ غَوَاشٍ
versets.phonetique: Lahum min jahannama mihadun wa-min fawqihim ghawash
versets.francais: Pour eux, l'Enfer sera leur couche et par-dessus eux des couvertures.
versets.anglais: They will have from Hell a bed and over them coverings [of fire]. And thus do We recompense the wrongdoers

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَا نُكَلِّفُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا
versets.phonetique: Walladhina amanu wa-'amilus-salihati la nukallifu nafsan illa wus'aha
versets.francais: Ceux qui croient et font de bonnes œuvres - Nous n'imposons à chaque âme que ce qu'elle peut supporter.
versets.anglais: But those who believed and did righteous deeds - We charge no soul except [within] its capacity. Those are the companions of Paradise; they will abide therein eternally

versets.arabe: وَنَزَعْنَا مَا فِي صُدُورِهِم مِّنْ غِلٍّ
versets.phonetique: Wa-naza'na ma fi sudurihin min ghillin
versets.francais: Nous enlèverons la rancune de leurs poitrines.
versets.anglais: And We will have removed whatever is within their breasts of resentment, [while] flowing beneath them are rivers. And they will say, "Praise to Allah, who has guided us to this; and we would never have been guided if Allah had not guided us. Certainly the messengers of our Lord had come with the truth." And they will be called, "This is Paradise, which you have been made to inherit for what you used to do

versets.arabe: وَنَادَىٰ أَصْحَابُ الْجَنَّةِ أَصْحَابَ النَّارِ
versets.phonetique: Wa-nada ashabu al-jannati ashaba an-nar
versets.francais: Les gens du Paradis appelleront les gens du Feu.
versets.anglais: And the companions of Paradise will call out to the companions of the Fire, "We have already found what our Lord promised us to be true. Have you found what your Lord promised to be true?" They will say, "Yes." Then an announcer will announce among them, "The curse of Allah shall be upon the wrongdoers

versets.arabe: الَّذِينَ يَصُدُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَيَبْغُونَهَا عِوَجًا
versets.phonetique: Alladhina yasudduna 'an sabili Allahi wa-yabghunaha 'iwajan
versets.francais: Ceux qui détournent du sentier d'Allah et cherchent à le rendre tortueux.
versets.anglais: Who averted [people] from the way of Allah and sought to make it [seem] deviant while they were, concerning the Hereafter, disbelievers

versets.arabe: وَبَيْنَهُمَا حِجَابٌ وَعَلَى الْأَعْرَافِ رِجَالٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa-baynahuma hijabun wa-'ala al-a'rafi rija
versets.francais: Entre les deux se dresse une cloison. Et sur les hauteurs se trouvent des hommes.
versets.anglais: And between them will be a partition, and on [its] elevations are men who recognize all by their mark. And they call out to the companions of Paradise, "Peace be upon you." They have not [yet] entered it, but they long intensely

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا صُرِفَتْ أَبْصَارُهُمْ تِلْقَاءَ أَصْحَابِ النَّارِ
versets.phonetique: Wa-idha surifat absaruhum tilqa'a ashabi an-nar
versets.francais: Et quand leur regard se tourne vers les gens du Feu.
versets.anglais: And when their eyes are turned toward the companions of the Fire, they say, "Our Lord, do not place us with the wrongdoing people

versets.arabe: وَنَادَىٰ أَصْحَابُ الْأَعْرَافِ رِجَالًا يَعْرِفُونَهُم بِسِيمَاهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Wa-nada ashabu al-a'rafi rijalan ya'rifunahum bisimahum
versets.francais: Les gens des hauteurs appelleront des hommes qu'ils reconnaîtront à leurs traits.
versets.anglais: And the companions of the Elevations will call to men [within Hell] whom they recognize by their mark, saying, "Of no avail to you was your gathering and [the fact] that you were arrogant

versets.arabe: أَهَٰؤُلَاءِ الَّذِينَ أَقْسَمْتُمْ لَا يَنَالُهُمُ اللَّهُ بِرَحْمَةٍ
versets.phonetique: Aha'ula'i alladhina aqsamtum la yanalahumu Allahu birahma
versets.francais: Est-ce là ceux au sujet desquels vous juriez qu'Allah ne leur accorderait pas Sa miséricorde?
versets.anglais: [Allah will say], "Are these the ones whom you [inhabitants of Hell] swore that Allah would never offer them mercy? Enter Paradise, [O People of the Elevations]. No fear will there be concerning you, nor will you grieve

versets.arabe: وَنَادَىٰ أَصْحَابُ النَّارِ أَصْحَابَ الْجَنَّةِ أَنْ أَفِيضُوا عَلَيْنَا مِنَ الْمَاءِ
versets.phonetique: Wa-nada ashabu an-nari ashaba al-jannati an afidu 'alayna minal-ma'
versets.francais: Les gens du Feu appelleront les gens du Paradis: "Répandez sur nous un peu d'eau."
versets.anglais: And the companions of the Fire will call to the companions of Paradise, "Pour upon us some water or from whatever Allah has provided you." They will say, "Indeed, Allah has forbidden them both to the disbelievers

versets.arabe: الَّذِينَ اتَّخَذُوا دِينَهُمْ لَهْوًا وَلَعِبًا وَغَرَّتْهُمُ الْحَيَاةُ الدُّنْيَا
versets.phonetique: Alladhina ittakhadhu dinahum lahwan wa-la'iban wa-gharrathumu al-hayatu ad-dunya
versets.francais: Ceux qui ont pris leur religion comme jeu et divertissement et que la vie présente a trompés.
versets.anglais: Who took their religion as distraction and amusement and whom the worldly life deluded." So today We will forget them just as they forgot the meeting of this Day of theirs and for having rejected Our verses

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ جِئْنَاهُم بِكِتَابٍ فَصَّلْنَاهُ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa-laqad ji'nahum bikitabin fassalnahu 'ala 'ilm
versets.francais: Nous leur avons certes apporté un Livre que Nous avons explicité avec science.
versets.anglais: And We had certainly brought them a Book which We detailed by knowledge - as guidance and mercy to a people who believe

versets.arabe: هَلْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا تَأْوِيلَهُ
versets.phonetique: Hal yanzuruna illa ta'wilah
versets.francais: N'attendent-ils qu'à son accomplissement?
versets.anglais: Do they await except its result? The Day its result comes those who had ignored it before will say, "The messengers of our Lord had come with the truth, so are there [now] any intercessors to intercede for us or could we be sent back to do other than we used to do?" They will have lost themselves, and lost from them is what they used to invent

versets.arabe: إِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ اللَّهُ الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ
versets.phonetique: Inna rabbakumu Allahu alladhi khalaqa as-samawati wal-arda fi sittati ayyam
versets.francais: Votre Seigneur, c'est Allah qui a créé les cieux et la terre en six jours.
versets.anglais: Indeed, your Lord is Allah, who created the heavens and earth in six days and then established Himself above the Throne. He covers the night with the day, [another night] chasing it rapidly; and [He created] the sun, the moon, and the stars, subjected by His command. Unquestionably, His is the creation and the command; blessed is Allah, Lord of the worlds

versets.arabe: ادْعُوا رَبَّكُمْ تَضَرُّعًا وَخُفْيَةً
versets.phonetique: Ud'u rabbakum tadharru'an wa-khufya
versets.francais: Invoquez votre Seigneur avec humilité et en secret.
versets.anglais: Call upon your Lord in humility and privately; indeed, He does not like transgressors

versets.arabe: وَلَا تُفْسِدُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ بَعْدَ إِصْلَاحِهَا
versets.phonetique: Wa-la tufsidu fil-ardi ba'da islahiha
versets.francais: Et ne semez pas la corruption sur la terre après sa mise en ordre.
versets.anglais: And cause not corruption upon the earth after its reformation. And invoke Him in fear and aspiration. Indeed, the mercy of Allah is near to the doers of good

versets.arabe: وَهُوَ الَّذِي يُرْسِلُ الرِّيَاحَ بُشْرًا بَيْنَ يَدَيْ رَحْمَتِهِ
versets.phonetique: Wa-huwa alladhi yursilu ar-riyaha bushran bayna yaday rahmatih
versets.francais: C'est Lui qui envoie les vents comme une bonne annonce précédant Sa miséricorde.
versets.anglais: And it is He who sends the winds as good tidings before His mercy until, when they have carried heavy rainclouds, We drive them to a dead land and We send down rain therein and bring forth thereby [some] of all the fruits. Thus will We bring forth the dead; perhaps you may be reminded

versets.arabe: وَالْبَلَدُ الطَّيِّبُ يَخْرُجُ نَبَاتُهُ بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِ
versets.phonetique: Wal-baladu at-tayyibu yakhruju nabatuhu bi-idhni rabbih
versets.francais: Le bon pays: sa végétation pousse avec la permission de son Seigneur.
versets.anglais: And the good land - its vegetation emerges by permission of its Lord; but that which is bad - nothing emerges except sparsely, with difficulty. Thus do We diversify the signs for a people who are grateful

versets.arabe: لَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِ
versets.phonetique: Laqad arsalna nuhan ila qawmih
versets.francais: Nous avons envoyé Noé à son peuple.
versets.anglais: We had certainly sent Noah to his people, and he said, "O my people, worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him. Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a tremendous Day

versets.arabe: قَالَ الْمَلَأُ مِن قَوْمِهِ إِنَّا لَنَرَاكَ فِي ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ
versets.phonetique: Qala al-mala'u min qawmihi inna lanaraka fi dalalin mubin
versets.francais: Les notables de son peuple dirent: "Nous te voyons dans un égarement évident."
versets.anglais: Said the eminent among his people, "Indeed, we see you in clear error

versets.arabe: قَالَ يَا قَوْمِ لَيْسَ بِي ضَلَالَةٌ
versets.phonetique: Qala ya qawmi laysa bi dalalah
versets.francais: Il dit: "O mon peuple! Il n'y a aucun égarement en moi."
versets.anglais: [Noah] said, "O my people, there is not error in me, but I am a messenger from the Lord of the worlds

versets.arabe: أُبَلِّغُكُمْ رِسَالَاتِ رَبِّي وَأَنصَحُ لَكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Uballigukum risalati rabbi wa-ansahu lakum
versets.francais: Je vous transmets les messages de mon Seigneur et je vous conseille sincèrement.
versets.anglais: I convey to you the messages of my Lord and advise you; and I know from Allah what you do not know

versets.arabe: أَوَعَجِبْتُمْ أَن جَاءَكُمْ ذِكْرٌ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٍ مِّنكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Awa 'ajibtum an ja'akum dhikrun min rabbikum 'ala rajulin minkum
versets.francais: Vous étonnez-vous qu'un rappel de votre Seigneur vous soit venu par l'intermédiaire d'un homme d'entre vous?
versets.anglais: Then do you wonder that there has come to you a reminder from your Lord through a man from among you, that he may warn you and that you may fear Allah so you might receive mercy

versets.arabe: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَنجَيْنَاهُ وَالَّذِينَ مَعَهُ فِي الْفُلْكِ
versets.phonetique: Fakadhdhabuhu fa-anjaynahu walladhina ma'ahu fil-fulk
versets.francais: Ils le traitèrent de menteur. Nous le sauvâmes, lui et ceux qui étaient avec lui dans l'arche.
versets.anglais: But they denied him, so We saved him and those who were with him in the ship. And We drowned those who denied Our signs. Indeed, they were a blind people

versets.arabe: وَإِلَىٰ عَادٍ أَخَاهُمْ هُودًا
versets.phonetique: Wa-ila 'adin akhahum huda
versets.francais: Et aux 'Aad, leur frère Hud.
versets.anglais: And to the 'Aad [We sent] their brother Hud. He said, "O my people, worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him. Then will you not fear Him

versets.arabe: قَالَ الْمَلَأُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِن قَوْمِهِ إِنَّا لَنَرَاكَ فِي سَفَاهَةٍ
versets.phonetique: Qala al-mala'u alladhina kafaru min qawmihi inna lanaraka fi safahah
versets.francais: Les notables mécréants de son peuple dirent: "Nous te voyons dans la sottise."
versets.anglais: Said the eminent ones who disbelieved among his people, "Indeed, we see you in foolishness, and indeed, we think you are of the liars

versets.arabe: قَالَ يَا قَوْمِ لَيْسَ بِي سَفَاهَةٌ وَلَٰكِنِّي رَسُولٌ مِّن رَّبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qala ya qawmi laysa bi safahatun walakinniy rasulun min rabb al-'alamin
versets.francais: Il dit: "O mon peuple! Il n'y a aucune sottise en moi. Je suis un messager du Seigneur des mondes."
versets.anglais: [Hud] said, "O my people, there is not foolishness in me, but I am a messenger from the Lord of the worlds

versets.arabe: أُبَلِّغُكُمْ رِسَالَاتِ رَبِّي وَأَنَا لَكُمْ نَاصِحٌ أَمِينٌ
versets.phonetique: Uballigukum risalati rabbi wa-ana lakum nasihun amin
versets.francais: Je vous transmets les messages de mon Seigneur et je suis pour vous un conseiller loyal.
versets.anglais: I convey to you the messages of my Lord, and I am to you a trustworthy adviser

versets.arabe: أَوَعَجِبْتُمْ أَن جَاءَكُمْ ذِكْرٌ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٍ مِّنكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Awa 'ajibtum an ja'akum dhikrun min rabbikum 'ala rajulin minkum
versets.francais: Vous étonnez-vous qu'un rappel de votre Seigneur vous soit venu par l'intermédiaire d'un homme d'entre vous?
versets.anglais: Then do you wonder that there has come to you a reminder from your Lord through a man from among you, that he may warn you? And remember when He made you successors after the people of Noah and increased you in stature extensively. So remember the favors of Allah that you might succeed

versets.arabe: قَالُوا أَجِئْتَنَا لِنَعْبُدَ اللَّهَ وَحْدَهُ وَنَذَرَ مَا كَانَ يَعْبُدُ آبَاؤُنَا
versets.phonetique: Qalu aji'tana lina'buda Allaha wahdahu wa-nadhara ma kana ya'budu aba'una
versets.francais: Ils dirent: "Es-tu venu pour que nous adorions Allah seul et que nous abandonnions ce qu'adoraient nos ancêtres?"
versets.anglais: They said, "Have you come to us that we should worship Allah alone and leave what our fathers have worshipped? Then bring us what you promise us, if you should be of the truthful

versets.arabe: قَالَ قَدْ وَقَعَ عَلَيْكُم مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ رِجْسٌ وَغَضَبٌ
versets.phonetique: Qala qad waqa'a 'alaykum min rabbikum rijsun wa-ghadab
versets.francais: Il dit: "La souillure et la colère de votre Seigneur sont sur vous."
versets.anglais: [Hud] said, "Already have defilement and anger fallen upon you from your Lord. Do you dispute with me concerning [mere] names you have named them, you and your fathers, for which Allah has not sent down any authority? Then wait; indeed, I am with you among those who wait

versets.arabe: فَأَنجَيْنَاهُ وَالَّذِينَ مَعَهُ بِرَحْمَةٍ مِّنَّا
versets.phonetique: Fa-anjaynahu walladhina ma'ahu birahmatim minna
versets.francais: Nous le sauvâmes, lui et ceux qui étaient avec lui, par une miséricorde de Notre part.
versets.anglais: So We saved him and those with him by mercy from Us. And We eliminated those who denied Our signs, and they were not [at all] believers

versets.arabe: وَإِلَىٰ ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَالِحًا
versets.phonetique: Wa-ila thamuda akhahum salihan
versets.francais: Et aux Thamoud, leur frère Salih.
versets.anglais: And to the Thamud [We sent] their brother Salih. He said, "O my people, worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him. There has come to you clear evidence from your Lord. This is the she-camel of Allah [sent] to you as a sign. So leave her to eat within Allah 's land and do not touch her with harm, lest there seize you a painful punishment

versets.arabe: وَاذْكُرُوا إِذْ جَعَلَكُمْ خُلَفَاءَ مِن بَعْدِ عَادٍ
versets.phonetique: Wadhkuru idh ja'alakum khulafa'a min ba'di 'ad
versets.francais: Et rappelez-vous quand Il vous a faits successeurs des 'Aad.
versets.anglais: And remember when He made you successors after the 'Aad and settled you in the land, [and] you take for yourselves palaces from its plains and carve from the mountains, homes. Then remember the favors of Allah and do not commit abuse on the earth, spreading corruption

versets.arabe: قَالَ الْمَلَأُ الَّذِينَ اسْتَكْبَرُوا مِن قَوْمِهِ لِلَّذِينَ اسْتُضْعِفُوا
versets.phonetique: Qala al-mala'u alladhina astakbaru min qawmihi lilladhina ustud'ifu
versets.francais: Les notables arrogants de son peuple dirent à ceux qui étaient méprisés.
versets.anglais: Said the eminent ones who were arrogant among his people to those who were oppressed - to those who believed among them, "Do you [actually] know that Salih is sent from his Lord?" They said, "Indeed we, in that with which he was sent, are believers

versets.arabe: قَالَ الَّذِينَ اسْتَكْبَرُوا إِنَّا بِالَّذِي آمَنتُم بِهِ كَافِرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qala alladhina astakbaru inna bil-ladhi amantum bihi kafirun
versets.francais: Ceux qui s'enorgueillissaient dirent: "Nous rejetons ce en quoi vous croyez."
versets.anglais: Said those who were arrogant, "Indeed we, in that which you have believed, are disbelievers

versets.arabe: فَعَقَرُوا النَّاقَةَ وَعَتَوْا عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ
versets.phonetique: Fa'aqaru an-naqata wa-'ataw 'an amri rabbihim
versets.francais: Ils égorgèrent la chamelle et défièrent l'ordre de leur Seigneur.
versets.anglais: So they hamstrung the she-camel and were insolent toward the command of their Lord and said, "O Salih, bring us what you promise us, if you should be of the messengers

versets.arabe: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ الرَّجْفَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا فِي دَارِهِمْ جَاثِمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Fa-akhadhathumur-rajfatu fa-asbahu fi darihim jathimin
versets.francais: Le séisme les saisit et ils se retrouvèrent dans leurs demeures, gisant face contre terre.
versets.anglais: So the earthquake seized them, and they became within their home [corpses] fallen prone

versets.arabe: فَتَوَلَّىٰ عَنْهُمْ وَقَالَ يَا قَوْمِ لَقَدْ أَبْلَغْتُكُمْ رِسَالَةَ رَبِّي
versets.phonetique: Fatawalla 'anhum wa-qala ya qawmi laqad ablaghtukum risalata rabbi
versets.francais: Il s'en détourna et dit: "O mon peuple! Je vous ai bien transmis le message de mon Seigneur."
versets.anglais: And he turned away from them and said, "O my people, I had certainly conveyed to you the message of my Lord and advised you, but you do not like advisors

versets.arabe: وَلُوطًا إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِ أَتَأْتُونَ الْفَاحِشَةَ مَا سَبَقَكُم بِهَا مِنْ أَحَدٍ مِّنَ الْعَالَمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa-lutan idh qala liqawmihi ata'tuna al-fahishata ma sabaqakum biha min ahadin minal-'alamin
versets.francais: Et Loth, quand il dit à son peuple: "Commettez-vous cette turpitude que nul peuple avant vous n'a commise?"
versets.anglais: And [We had sent] Lot when he said to his people, "Do you commit such immorality as no one has preceded you with from among the worlds

versets.arabe: إِنَّكُمْ لَتَأْتُونَ الرِّجَالَ شَهْوَةً مِّن دُونِ النِّسَاءِ
versets.phonetique: Innakum lata'tuna ar-rijala shahwatan min dun an-nisa'
versets.francais: Vous vous approchez des hommes avec désir au lieu des femmes.
versets.anglais: Indeed, you approach men with desire, instead of women. Rather, you are a transgressing people

versets.arabe: وَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوْمِهِ إِلَّا أَن قَالُوا أَخْرِجُوهُم مِّن قَرْيَتِكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Wa-ma kana jawaba qawmihi illa an qalu akhrijuhum min qaryatikum
versets.francais: La seule réponse de son peuple fut: "Expulsez-les de votre cité."
versets.anglais: But the answer of his people was only that they said, "Evict them from your city! Indeed, they are men who keep themselves pure

versets.arabe: فَأَنجَيْنَاهُ وَأَهْلَهُ إِلَّا امْرَأَتَهُ كَانَتْ مِنَ الْغَابِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Fa-anjaynahu wa-ahlahu illa imra'atahu kanat minal-ghajirin
versets.francais: Nous le sauvâmes, lui et les siens, sauf sa femme qui était parmi ceux qui restèrent.
versets.anglais: So We saved him and his family, except for his wife; she was of those who remained [with the evildoers]

versets.arabe: وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّطَرًا
versets.phonetique: Wa-amtarna 'alayhim mataran
versets.francais: Nous fîmes pleuvoir sur eux une pluie.
versets.anglais: And We rained upon them a rain [of stones]. Then see how was the end of the criminals

versets.arabe: وَإِلَىٰ مَدْيَنَ أَخَاهُمْ شُعَيْبًا
versets.phonetique: Wa-ila madyana akhahum shu'ayba
versets.francais: Et aux Madyan, leur frère Chou'ayb.
versets.anglais: And to [the people of] Madyan [We sent] their brother Shu'ayb. He said, "O my people, worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him. There has come to you clear evidence from your Lord. So fulfill the measure and weight and do not deprive people of their due and cause not corruption upon the earth after its reformation. That is better for you, if you should be believers

versets.arabe: وَلَا تَقْعُدُوا بِكُلِّ صِرَاطٍ تُوعِدُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa-la taq'udu bikulli siratin tu'idun
versets.francais: Ne vous asseyez pas sur chaque chemin pour menacer.
versets.anglais: And do not sit on every path, threatening and averting from the way of Allah those who believe in Him, seeking to make it [seem] deviant. And remember when you were few and He increased you. And see how was the end of the corrupters

versets.arabe: وَإِن كَانَ طَائِفَةٌ مِّنكُمْ آمَنُوا بِالَّذِي أُرْسِلْتُ بِهِ
versets.phonetique: Wa-in kana ta'ifatun minkum amanu bil-ladhi ursiltu bih
versets.francais: S'il y a un groupe parmi vous qui croit en ce avec quoi j'ai été envoyé.
versets.anglais: And if there should be a group among you who has believed in that with which I have been sent and a group that has not believed, then be patient until Allah judges between us. And He is the best of judges

versets.arabe: قَالَ الْمَلَأُ الَّذِينَ اسْتَكْبَرُوا مِن قَوْمِهِ لَنُخْرِجَنَّكَ يَا شُعَيْبُ
versets.phonetique: Qala al-mala'u alladhina astakbaru min qawmihi lanukhrijannaka ya shu'ayb
versets.francais: Les notables arrogants de son peuple dirent: "Nous t'expulserons sûrement de notre cité, ô Chou'ayb."
versets.anglais: Said the eminent ones who were arrogant among his people, "We will surely evict you, O Shu'ayb, and those who have believed with you from our city, or you must return to our religion." He said, "Even if we were unwilling

versets.arabe: قَدِ افْتَرَيْنَا عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا إِنْ عُدْنَا فِي مِلَّتِكُم
versets.phonetique: Qadif tarayna 'ala Allahi kadhiban in 'udna fi millatikum
versets.francais: Nous aurions forgé un mensonge contre Allah si nous retournions à votre religion.
versets.anglais: We would have invented against Allah a lie if we returned to your religion after Allah had saved us from it. And it is not for us to return to it except that Allah, our Lord, should will. Our Lord has encompassed all things in knowledge. Upon Allah we have relied. Our Lord, decide between us and our people in truth, and You are the best of those who give decision

versets.arabe: وَقَالَ الْمَلَأُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِن قَوْمِهِ لَئِنِ اتَّبَعْتُمْ شُعَيْبًا
versets.phonetique: Wa-qala al-mala'u alladhina kafaru min qawmihi la'ini attaba'tum shu'ayban
versets.francais: Les notables mécréants de son peuple dirent: "Si vous suivez Chou'ayb, vous serez perdants."
versets.anglais: Said the eminent ones who disbelieved among his people, "If you should follow Shu'ayb, indeed, you would then be losers

versets.arabe: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ الرَّجْفَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا فِي دَارِهِمْ جَاثِمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Fa-akhadhathumur-rajfatu fa-asbahu fi darihim jathimin
versets.francais: Le séisme les saisit et ils gisaient face contre terre dans leurs demeures.
versets.anglais: So the earthquake seized them, and they became within their home [corpses] fallen prone

versets.arabe: الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا شُعَيْبًا كَأَن لَّمْ يَغْنَوْا فِيهَا
versets.phonetique: Alladhina kadhdhabu shu'ayban ka'an lam yaghnaw fiha
versets.francais: Ceux qui avaient traité Chou'ayb de menteur, comme s'ils n'avaient jamais prospéré là.
versets.anglais: Those who denied Shu'ayb - it was as though they had never resided there. Those who denied Shu'ayb - it was they who were the losers

versets.arabe: فَتَوَلَّىٰ عَنْهُمْ وَقَالَ يَا قَوْمِ لَقَدْ أَبْلَغْتُكُمْ رِسَالَاتِ رَبِّي
versets.phonetique: Fatawalla 'anhum wa-qala ya qawmi laqad ablaghtukum risalati rabbi
versets.francais: Il s'en détourna et dit: "O mon peuple! Je vous ai transmis les messages de mon Seigneur."
versets.anglais: And he turned away from them and said, "O my people, I had certainly conveyed to you the messages of my Lord and advised you, so how could I grieve for a disbelieving people

versets.arabe: وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا فِي قَرْيَةٍ مِّن نَّبِيٍّ إِلَّا أَخَذْنَا أَهْلَهَا بِالْبَأْسَاءِ
versets.phonetique: Wa-ma arsalna fi qaryatin min nabiyyin illa akhadna ahlaha bil-ba'sa'i
versets.francais: Nous n'avons envoyé dans une cité aucun prophète sans que Nous n'en saisissions les habitants par la détresse.
versets.anglais: And We sent to no city a prophet [who was denied] except that We seized its people with poverty and hardship that they might humble themselves [to Allah]

versets.arabe: ثُمَّ بَدَّلْنَا مَكَانَ السَّيِّئَةِ الْحَسَنَةَ
versets.phonetique: Thumma baddalna makana as-sayyi'ati al-hasanah
versets.francais: Ensuite Nous avons remplacé le malheur par le bonheur.
versets.anglais: Then We exchanged in place of the bad [condition], good, until they increased [and prospered] and said, "Our fathers [also] were touched with hardship and ease." So We seized them suddenly while they did not perceive

versets.arabe: وَلَوْ أَنَّ أَهْلَ الْقُرَىٰ آمَنُوا وَاتَّقَوْا
versets.phonetique: Wa-law anna ahla al-qura amanu wattaqaw
versets.francais: Si les habitants des cités avaient cru et étaient pieux.
versets.anglais: And if only the people of the cities had believed and feared Allah, We would have opened upon them blessings from the heaven and the earth; but they denied [the messengers], so We seized them for what they were earning

versets.arabe: أَفَأَمِنَ أَهْلُ الْقُرَىٰ أَن يَأْتِيَهُم بَأْسُنَا بَيَاتًا
versets.phonetique: Afa'amina ahlu al-qura an ya'tiyahum ba'suna bayatan
versets.francais: Les habitants des cités se croyaient-ils à l'abri de Notre châtiment venant la nuit?
versets.anglais: Then, did the people of the cities feel secure from Our punishment coming to them at night while they were asleep

versets.arabe: أَوَأَمِنَ أَهْلُ الْقُرَىٰ أَن يَأْتِيَهُم بَأْسُنَا ضُحًى
versets.phonetique: Awa amina ahlu al-qura an ya'tiyahum ba'suna duhan
versets.francais: Les habitants des cités se croyaient-ils à l'abri que Notre châtiment les atteigne en plein midi?
versets.anglais: Or did the people of the cities feel secure from Our punishment coming to them in the morning while they were at play

versets.arabe: أَفَأَمِنُوا مَكْرَ اللَّهِ فَلَا يَأْمَنُ مَكْرَ اللَّهِ إِلَّا الْقَوْمُ الْخَاسِرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Afa'aminu makra Allahi fala ya'manu makra Allahi illa al-qawmu al-khasirun
versets.francais: Se croyaient-ils à l'abri de la ruse d'Allah? Seuls les perdants se croient à l'abri de la ruse d'Allah.
versets.anglais: Then did they feel secure from the plan of Allah? But no one feels secure from the plan of Allah except the losing people

versets.arabe: أَوَلَمْ يَهْدِ لِلَّذِينَ يَرِثُونَ الْأَرْضَ مِن بَعْدِ أَهْلِهَا
versets.phonetique: Awa lam yahdi lilladhina yarisuna al-arda min ba'di ahliha
versets.francais: N'est-il pas apparu clairement à ceux qui héritent la terre après ses habitants?
versets.anglais: Has it not become clear to those who inherited the earth after its [previous] people that if We willed, We could afflict them for their sins? But We seal over their hearts so they do not hear

versets.arabe: تِلْكَ الْقُرَىٰ نَقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ أَنبَائِهَا
versets.phonetique: Tilka al-qura naqussu 'alayka min anba'iha
versets.francais: Ces cités, Nous te racontons de leurs nouvelles.
versets.anglais: Those cities - We relate to you, [O Muhammad], some of their news. And certainly did their messengers come to them with clear proofs, but they were not to believe in that which they had denied before. Thus does Allah seal over the hearts of the disbelievers

versets.arabe: وَمَا وَجَدْنَا لِأَكْثَرِهِم مِّنْ عَهْدٍ وَإِن وَجَدْنَا أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَفَاسِقِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa-ma wajadna li-aktharihim min 'ahdin wa-in wajadna aktharahum lafasiqin
versets.francais: Nous n'avons pas trouvé chez la plupart d'entre eux fidélité à l'engagement; Nous les avons trouvés pervers.
versets.anglais: And We did not find for most of them any covenant; but indeed, We found most of them defiantly disobedient

versets.arabe: ثُمَّ بَعَثْنَا مِن بَعْدِهِم مُّوسَىٰ بِآيَاتِنَا إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَئِهِ
versets.phonetique: Thumma ba'athna min ba'dihim musa bi-ayatina ila fir'awna wa-mala'ih
versets.francais: Puis, après eux, Nous envoyâmes Moïse avec Nos signes vers Pharaon et ses notables.
versets.anglais: Then We sent after them Moses with Our signs to Pharaoh and his establishment, but they were unjust toward them. So see how was the end of the corrupters

versets.arabe: وَقَالَ مُوسَىٰ يَا فِرْعَوْنُ إِنِّي رَسُولٌ مِّن رَّبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa-qala musa ya fir'awnu inni rasulun min rabb al-'alamin
versets.francais: Moïse dit: "O Pharaon! Je suis un messager du Seigneur des mondes."
versets.anglais: And Moses said, "O Pharaoh, I am a messenger from the Lord of the worlds

versets.arabe: حَقِيقٌ عَلَىٰ أَن لَّا أَقُولَ عَلَى اللَّهِ إِلَّا الْحَقَّ
versets.phonetique: Haqiqun 'ala an la aqula 'ala Allahi illa al-haqq
versets.francais: Je dois ne dire sur Allah que la vérité.
versets.anglais: [Who is] obligated not to say about Allah except the truth. I have come to you with clear evidence from your Lord, so send with me the Children of Israel

versets.arabe: قَالَ إِن كُنتَ جِئْتَ بِآيَةٍ فَأْتِ بِهَا إِن كُنتَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qala in kunta ji'ta bi-ayatin fa'ti biha in kunta minas-sadiqin
versets.francais: Il dit: "Si tu as apporté un signe, présente-le si tu es parmi les véridiques."
versets.anglais: [Pharaoh] said, "If you have come with a sign, then bring it forth, if you should be of the truthful
