versets.arabe: فَأَلْقَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ ثُعْبَانٌ مُبِينٌ
versets.phonetique: Fa-alqa 'asahu fa-idha hiya thu'banun mubin
versets.francais: Il jeta son bâton et voilà qu'il devint un serpent évident.
versets.anglais: So Moses threw his staff, and suddenly it was a serpent, manifest

versets.arabe: وَنَزَعَ يَدَهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ بَيْضَاءُ لِلنَّاظِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa-naza'a yadahu fa-idha hiya bayda'u lin-nazhirin
versets.francais: Et il retira sa main et voilà qu'elle était blanche pour les regardeurs.
versets.anglais: And he drew out his hand; thereupon it was white [with radiance] for the observers

versets.arabe: قَالَ الْمَلَأُ مِن قَوْمِ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَسَاحِرٌ عَلِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Qala al-mala'u min qawmi fir'awna inna hadha lasahirun 'alim
versets.francais: Les notables du peuple de Pharaon dirent: "C'est là un magicien savant."
versets.anglais: Said the eminent among the people of Pharaoh, "Indeed, this is a learned magician

versets.arabe: يُرِيدُ أَن يُخْرِجَكُم مِّنْ أَرْضِكُمْ فَمَاذَا تَأْمُرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Yuridu an yukhrijkum min ardikum famadha ta'murun
versets.francais: Il veut vous expulser de votre pays. Que décidez-vous?
versets.anglais: Who wants to expel you from your land [through magic], so what do you instruct

versets.arabe: قَالُوا أَرْجِهْ وَأَخَاهُ وَأَرْسِلْ فِي الْمَدَائِنِ حَاشِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qalu arjih wa-akhahu wa-arsil fil-mada'ini hashirin
versets.francais: Ils dirent: "Reporte son affaire et celle de son frère, et envoie dans les villes des rassembleurs."
versets.anglais: They said, "Postpone [the matter of] him and his brother and send among the cities gatherers

versets.arabe: يَأْتُوكَ بِكُلِّ سَاحِرٍ عَلِيمٍ
versets.phonetique: Ya'tuka bikulli sahirin 'alim
versets.francais: Ils t'amèneront tout magicien compétent.
versets.anglais: Who will bring you every learned magician

versets.arabe: وَجَاءَ السَّحَرَةُ فِرْعَوْنَ قَالُوا إِنَّ لَنَا لَأَجْرًا إِن كُنَّا نَحْنُ الْغَالِبِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa-ja'a as-saharatu fir'awna qalu inna lana la-ajran in kunna nahnu al-ghalibina
versets.francais: Les magiciens vinrent trouver Pharaon et dirent: "Aurons-nous une récompense si nous sommes les vainqueurs?"
versets.anglais: And the magicians came to Pharaoh. They said, "Indeed for us is a reward if we are the predominant

versets.arabe: قَالَ نَعَمْ وَإِنَّكُمْ لَمِنَ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qala na'am wa-innakum laminal-muqarrabin
versets.francais: Il dit: "Oui, et vous serez du groupe des proches."
versets.anglais: He said, "Yes, and, [moreover], you will be among those made near [to me]

versets.arabe: قَالُوا يَا مُوسَىٰ إِمَّا أَن تُلْقِيَ وَإِمَّا أَن نَّكُونَ نَحْنُ الْمُلْقِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qalu ya musa imma an tulqiya wa-imma an nakuna nahnu al-mulqin
versets.francais: Ils dirent: "O Moïse! Soit tu jettes, soit nous sommes les premiers à jeter."
versets.anglais: They said, "O Moses, either you throw [your staff], or we will be the ones to throw [first]

versets.arabe: قَالَ أَلْقُوا فَلَمَّا أَلْقَوْا سَحَرُوا أَعْيُنَ النَّاسِ
versets.phonetique: Qala alqu falaamma alqaw saharu a'yuna an-nas
versets.francais: Il dit: "Jetez!" Quand ils jetèrent, ils ensorcelèrent les yeux des gens.
versets.anglais: He said, "Throw," and when they threw, they bewitched the eyes of the people and struck terror into them, and they presented a great [feat of] magic

versets.arabe: وَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ أَنْ أَلْقِ عَصَاكَ
versets.phonetique: Wa-awhayna ila musa an alqi 'asak
versets.francais: Nous révélâmes à Moïse: "Jette ton bâton."
versets.anglais: And We inspired to Moses, "Throw your staff," and at once it devoured what they were falsifying

versets.arabe: فَوَقَعَ الْحَقُّ وَبَطَلَ مَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Fawaqa'a al-haqqu wa-batala ma kanu ya'malun
versets.francais: Alors la vérité s'imposa et ce qu'ils faisaient devint nul.
versets.anglais: So the truth was established, and abolished was what they were doing

versets.arabe: فَغُلِبُوا هُنَالِكَ وَانقَلَبُوا صَاغِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Fagulibu hunalika wanqalabu saghirin
versets.francais: Ils furent vaincus là et se retrouvèrent humiliés.
versets.anglais: And Pharaoh and his people were overcome right there and became debased

versets.arabe: وَأُلْقِيَ السَّحَرَةُ سَاجِدِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa-ulqiya as-saharatu sajidina
versets.francais: Les magiciens se prosternèrent.
versets.anglais: And the magicians fell down in prostration [to Allah]

versets.arabe: قَالُوا آمَنَّا بِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qalu amanna biRabbi al-'alamin
versets.francais: Ils dirent: "Nous croyons au Seigneur des mondes."
versets.anglais: They said, "We have believed in the Lord of the worlds

versets.arabe: رَبِّ مُوسَىٰ وَهَارُونَ
versets.phonetique: Rabbi musa wa-harun
versets.francais: Le Seigneur de Moïse et d'Aaron.
versets.anglais: The Lord of Moses and Aaron

versets.arabe: قَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ آمَنتُم بِهِ قَبْلَ أَن آذَنَ لَكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Qala fir'awnu amantum bihi qabla an adhana lakum
versets.francais: Pharaon dit: "Vous avez cru en lui avant que je vous en donne la permission."
versets.anglais: Said Pharaoh, "You believed in him before I gave you permission. Indeed, this is a conspiracy which you conspired in the city to expel therefrom its people. But you are going to know

versets.arabe: لَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُم مِّنْ خِلَافٍ
versets.phonetique: La-uqatti'anna aydiyakum wa-arjulakum min khilaf
versets.francais: Je vais vous couper les mains et les pieds en sens contraires.
versets.anglais: I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides; then I will surely crucify you all

versets.arabe: قَالُوا إِنَّا إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا مُنقَلِبُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qalu inna ila rabbina munqalibun
versets.francais: Ils dirent: "Nous retournerons à notre Seigneur."
versets.anglais: They said, "Indeed, to our Lord we will return

versets.arabe: وَمَا تَنقِمُ مِنَّا إِلَّا أَنْ آمَنَّا بِآيَاتِ رَبِّنَا
versets.phonetique: Wa-ma tanqimu minna illa an amanna bi-ayati rabbina
versets.francais: Tu ne nous reproches rien d'autre que d'avoir cru aux signes de notre Seigneur.
versets.anglais: And you do not resent us except because we believed in the signs of our Lord when they came to us. Our Lord, pour upon us patience and let us die as Muslims [in submission to You]

versets.arabe: وَقَالَ الْمَلَأُ مِن قَوْمِ فِرْعَوْنَ أَتَذَرُ مُوسَىٰ وَقَوْمَهُ
versets.phonetique: Wa-qala al-mala'u min qawmi fir'awna atadaru musa wa-qawmah
versets.francais: Les notables du peuple de Pharaon dirent: "Vas-tu laisser Moïse et son peuple?"
versets.anglais: And the eminent among the people of Pharaoh said," Will you leave Moses and his people to cause corruption in the land and abandon you and your gods?" [Pharaoh] said, "We will kill their sons and keep their women alive; and indeed, we are subjugators over them

versets.arabe: قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِقَوْمِهِ اسْتَعِينُوا بِاللَّهِ وَاصْبِرُوا
versets.phonetique: Qala musa liqawmihi asta'inu billahi wasbiru
versets.francais: Moïse dit à son peuple: "Cherchez le secours d'Allah et soyez patients."
versets.anglais: Said Moses to his people, "Seek help through Allah and be patient. Indeed, the earth belongs to Allah. He causes to inherit it whom He wills of His servants. And the [best] outcome is for the righteous

versets.arabe: قَالُوا أُوذِينَا مِن قَبْلِ أَن تَأْتِيَنَا وَمِن بَعْدِ مَا جِئْتَنَا
versets.phonetique: Qalu udhina min qabli an ta'tiyanaAndroidException wa-min ba'di ma ji'tana
versets.francais: Ils dirent: "Nous avons été maltraités avant que tu ne viennes à nous et depuis que tu es venu."
versets.anglais: They said, "We have been harmed before you came to us and after you have come to us." He said, "Perhaps your Lord will destroy your enemy and grant you succession in the land and see how you will do

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ أَخَذْنَا آلَ فِرْعَوْنَ بِالسِّنِينَ وَنَقْصٍ مِّنَ الثَّمَرَاتِ
versets.phonetique: Wa-laqad akhadna ala fir'awna bis-sinina wa-naqsin minas-thamarat
versets.francais: Nous avons éprouvé les gens de Pharaon par des années de disette et une diminution de fruits.
versets.anglais: And We certainly seized the people of Pharaoh with years of famine and a deficiency in fruits that perhaps they would be reminded

versets.arabe: فَإِذَا جَاءَتْهُمُ الْحَسَنَةُ قَالُوا لَنَا هَٰذِهِ
versets.phonetique: Fa-idha ja'athumu al-hasanatu qalu lana hadhihi
versets.francais: Quand un bonheur leur arrivait, ils disaient: "Ceci nous revient de droit."
versets.anglais: But when good came to them, they said, "This is ours [by right]." And if a bad [condition] struck them, they saw an evil omen in Moses and those with him. Unquestionably, their fortune is with Allah, but most of them do not know

versets.arabe: وَقَالُوا مَهْمَا تَأْتِنَا بِهِ مِنْ آيَةٍ لِتَسْحَرَنَا بِهَا
versets.phonetique: Wa-qalu mahma ta'tina bihi min ayatin litasharana biha
versets.francais: Et ils dirent: "Quel que soit le signe que tu nous apportes pour nous ensorceler avec."
versets.anglais: And they said, "No matter what sign you bring us with which to bewitch us, we will not be believers in you

versets.arabe: فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ الطُّوفَانَ وَالْجَرَادَ وَالْقُمَّلَ وَالضَّفَادِعَ وَالدَّمَ
versets.phonetique: Fa-arsalna 'alayhimut-tufana wal-jarada wal-qummala wad-dafadi'a wad-dam
versets.francais: Nous envoyâmes sur eux le déluge, les criquets, les vermine, les grenouilles et le sang.
versets.anglais: So We sent upon them the flood and locusts and lice and frogs and blood as distinct signs, but they were arrogant and were a criminal people

versets.arabe: وَلَمَّا وَقَعَ عَلَيْهِمُ الرِّجْزُ قَالُوا يَا مُوسَى ادْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ
versets.phonetique: Wa-lamma waqa'a 'alayhimur-rijzu qalu ya musa ud'u lana rabbak
versets.francais: Quand le châtiment s'abattit sur eux, ils dirent: "O Moïse! Invoque ton Seigneur pour nous."
versets.anglais: And when the punishment descended upon them, they said, "O Moses, invoke for us your Lord by what He has promised you. If you [can] remove the punishment from us, we will surely believe you, and we will send with you the Children of Israel

versets.arabe: فَلَمَّا كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُمُ الرِّجْزَ إِلَىٰ أَجَلٍ هُم بَالِغُوهُ إِذَا هُمْ يَنكُثُونَ
versets.phonetique: Falamma kashafna 'anhumur-rijza ila ajalin hum balighuh idha hum yankuthun
versets.francais: Mais quand Nous écartâmes d'eux le châtiment jusqu'à un terme qu'ils atteindraient, voilà qu'ils manquaient à leur promesse.
versets.anglais: But when We removed the punishment from them until a term which they were to reach, then at once they broke their word

versets.arabe: فَانتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ فَأَغْرَقْنَاهُمْ فِي الْيَمِّ
versets.phonetique: Fantaqamna minhum fa-aghraqnahum fil-yamm
versets.francais: Nous nous vengeâmes d'eux et les noyâmes dans la mer.
versets.anglais: So We took retribution from them, and We drowned them in the sea because they denied Our signs and were heedless of them

versets.arabe: وَأَوْرَثْنَا الْقَوْمَ الَّذِينَ كَانُوا يُسْتَضْعَفُونَ مَشَارِقَ الْأَرْضِ وَمَغَارِبَهَا
versets.phonetique: Wa-awrathna al-qawma alladhina kanu yustada'afuna masharika al-ardi wa-maghariba
versets.francais: Nous fîmes hériter au peuple qu'on avait opprimé les parties orientales et occidentales de la terre.
versets.anglais: And We caused the people who had been oppressed to inherit the eastern regions of the land and the western ones, which We had blessed. And the good word of your Lord was fulfilled for the Children of Israel because of what they had patiently endured. And We destroyed [all] that Pharaoh and his people were producing and what they had been building

versets.arabe: وَجَاوَزْنَا بِبَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ الْبَحْرَ
versets.phonetique: Wa-jawazna bibani isra'ila al-bahr
versets.francais: Nous fîmes traverser la mer aux fils d'Israël.
versets.anglais: And We took the Children of Israel across the sea; then they came upon a people intent in devotion to [some] idols of theirs. They said, "O Moses, make for us a god just as they have gods." He said, "Indeed, you are a people behaving ignorantly

versets.arabe: إِنَّ هَٰؤُلَاءِ مُتَبَّرٌ مَّا هُمْ فِيهِ
versets.phonetique: Inna ha'ula'i mutabbarun ma hum fih
versets.francais: Ce en quoi ceux-ci s'occupent sera certes anéanti.
versets.anglais: Indeed, those [worshippers] - destroyed is that in which they are [engaged], and worthless is whatever they were doing

versets.arabe: قَالَ أَغَيْرَ اللَّهِ أَبْغِيكُمْ إِلَٰهًا
versets.phonetique: Qala aghayra Allahi abghikum ilahan
versets.francais: Il dit: "Voulez-vous que je vous cherche un dieu autre qu'Allah?"
versets.anglais: He said, "Is it other than Allah I should desire for you as a god while He has preferred you over the worlds

versets.arabe: وَإِذْ أَنجَيْنَاكُم مِّنْ آلِ فِرْعَوْنَ يَسُومُونَكُمْ سُوءَ الْعَذَابِ
versets.phonetique: Wa-idh anjaynakum min ali fir'awna yasumunakum su'a al-'adhab
versets.francais: Et quand Nous vous sauvâmes des gens de Pharaon qui vous infligeaient un affreux châtiment.
versets.anglais: And [recall, O Children of Israel], when We saved you from the people of Pharaoh, [who were] afflicting you with the worst torment - killing your sons and keeping your women alive. And in that was a great trial from your Lord

versets.arabe: وَوَاعَدْنَا مُوسَىٰ ثَلَاثِينَ لَيْلَةً وَأَتْمَمْنَاهَا بِعَشْرٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa-wa'adna musa thalathina laylatan wa-atmamnaha bi'ashr
versets.francais: Nous assignâmes à Moïse trente nuits auxquelles Nous en ajoutâmes dix.
versets.anglais: And We made an appointment with Moses for thirty nights and perfected them by [the addition of] ten; so the term of his Lord was completed as forty nights. And Moses said to his brother Aaron, "Take my place among my people, do right [by them], and do not follow the way of the corrupters

versets.arabe: وَلَمَّا جَاءَ مُوسَىٰ لِمِيقَاتِنَا وَكَلَّمَهُ رَبُّهُ
versets.phonetique: Wa-lamma ja'a musa limiqatina wa-kallamahu rabbuh
versets.francais: Quand Moïse vint à Notre rendez-vous et que son Seigneur lui parla.
versets.anglais: And when Moses arrived at Our appointed time and his Lord spoke to him, he said, "My Lord, show me [Yourself] that I may look at You." [Allah] said, "You will not see Me, but look at the mountain; if it should remain in place, then you will see Me." But when his Lord appeared to the mountain, He rendered it level, and Moses fell unconscious. And when he awoke, he said, "Exalted are You! I have repented to You, and I am the first of the believers

versets.arabe: قَالَ يَا مُوسَىٰ إِنِّي اصْطَفَيْتُكَ عَلَى النَّاسِ بِرِسَالَاتِي وَبِكَلَامِي
versets.phonetique: Qala ya musa inni astafaytuka 'ala an-nasi birisalati wa-bikalami
versets.francais: Il dit: "O Moïse! Je t'ai choisi parmi les gens pour Mes messages et Ma parole."
versets.anglais: [Allah] said, "O Moses, I have chosen you over the people with My messages and My words [to you]. So take what I have given you and be among the grateful

versets.arabe: وَكَتَبْنَا لَهُ فِي الْأَلْوَاحِ مِن كُلِّ شَيْءٍ مَّوْعِظَةً وَتَفْصِيلًا لِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa-katabna lahu fil-alwahi min kulli shay'in maw'izatan wa-tafsilal likulli shay'
versets.francais: Nous écrivîmes pour lui sur des Tables une exhortation sur toutes choses et un détail sur toutes choses.
versets.anglais: And We wrote for him on the tablets [something] of all things - instruction and explanation for all things, [saying], "Take them with determination and order your people to take the best of it. I will show you the home of the defiantly disobedient

versets.arabe: سَأَصْرِفُ عَنْ آيَاتِيَ الَّذِينَ يَتَكَبَّرُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ الْحَقِّ
versets.phonetique: Sa-asrifu 'an ayatiya alladhina yatakabbaruna fil-ardi bighayri al-haqq
versets.francais: Je détournerai de Mes signes ceux qui s'enorgueillissent sur la terre sans droit.
versets.anglais: I will turn away from My signs those who are arrogant upon the earth without right; and if they should see every sign, they will not believe in it. And if they see the way of consciousness, they will not adopt it as a way; but if they see the way of error, they will adopt it as a way. That is because they have denied Our signs and they were heedless of them

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا بِآيَاتِنَا وَلِقَاءِ الْآخِرَةِ حَبِطَتْ أَعْمَالُهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Walladhina kadhdhabu bi-ayatina wa-liqa'i al-akhirati habitat a'maluhum
versets.francais: Ceux qui traitent de mensonges Nos versets et la rencontre de l'au-delà, leurs œuvres sont vaines.
versets.anglais: Those who denied Our signs and the meeting of the Hereafter - their deeds have become worthless. Are they recompensed except for what they used to do

versets.arabe: وَاتَّخَذَ قَوْمُ مُوسَىٰ مِن بَعْدِهِ مِنْ حُلِيِّهِمْ عِجْلًا جَسَدًا لَّهُ خُوَارٌ
versets.phonetique: Wattakhadha qawmu musa min ba'dihi min huliyyihim 'ijlan jasadan lahu khuwar
versets.francais: Après le départ de Moïse, son peuple prit un veau fait de leurs bijoux, un corps qui mugissait.
versets.anglais: And the people of Moses made, after [his departure], from their ornaments a calf - an image having a lowing sound. Did they not see that it could neither speak to them nor guide them to a way? They took it [for worship], and they were wrongdoers

versets.arabe: وَلَمَّا سُقِطَ فِي أَيْدِيهِمْ وَرَأَوْا أَنَّهُمْ قَدْ ضَلُّوا
versets.phonetique: Wa-lamma suqita fi aydihim wa-ra'aw annahum qad dallu
versets.francais: Quand ils se mordirent les mains et virent qu'ils s'étaient égarés.
versets.anglais: And when regret overcame them and they saw that they had gone astray, they said, "If our Lord does not have mercy upon us and forgive us, we will surely be among the losers

versets.arabe: وَلَمَّا رَجَعَ مُوسَىٰ إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِ غَضْبَانَ أَسِفًا
versets.phonetique: Wa-lamma raja'a musa ila qawmihi ghadbana asifa
versets.francais: Quand Moïse retourna vers son peuple, irrité et affligé.
versets.anglais: And when Moses returned to his people, angry and grieved, he said, "How wretched is that by which you have replaced me after [my departure]. Were you impatient over the matter of your Lord?" And he threw down the tablets and seized his brother by [the hair of] his head, pulling him toward him. [Aaron] said, "O son of my mother, indeed the people oppressed me and were about to kill me, so let not the enemies rejoice over me and do not place me among the wrongdoing people

versets.arabe: قَالَ رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِأَخِي وَأَدْخِلْنَا فِي رَحْمَتِكَ
versets.phonetique: Qala rabbi ighfir li wa-li-akhi wa-adkhilna fi rahmatik
versets.francais: Il dit: "Seigneur! Pardonne-moi et pardonne à mon frère, et fais-nous entrer dans Ta miséricorde."
versets.anglais: [Moses] said, "My Lord, forgive me and my brother and admit us into Your mercy, for You are the most merciful of the merciful

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ اتَّخَذُوا الْعِجْلَ سَيَنَالُهُمْ غَضَبٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ
versets.phonetique: Inna alladhina ittakhadhu al-'ijla sayanaluhum ghadabun min rabbihim
versets.francais: Ceux qui ont pris le veau recevront la colère de leur Seigneur.
versets.anglais: Indeed, those who took the calf [for worship] will obtain anger from their Lord and humiliation in the life of this world, and thus do We recompense the inventors [of falsehood]

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ عَمِلُوا السَّيِّئَاتِ ثُمَّ تَابُوا مِن بَعْدِهَا وَآمَنُوا
versets.phonetique: Walladhina 'amilus-sayyi'ati thumma tabu min ba'diha wa-amanu
versets.francais: Ceux qui ont commis de mauvaises actions, puis se sont repentis et ont cru.
versets.anglais: But those who committed misdeeds and then repented after them and believed - indeed your Lord, thereafter, is Forgiving and Merciful

versets.arabe: وَلَمَّا سَكَتَ عَن مُّوسَى الْغَضَبُ أَخَذَ الْأَلْوَاحَ
versets.phonetique: Wa-lamma sakata 'an musa al-ghadabu akhadha al-alwah
versets.francais: Quand la colère se fut dissipée chez Moïse, il prit les Tables.
versets.anglais: And when the anger subsided in Moses, he took up the tablets; and in their inscription was guidance and mercy for those who are fearful of their Lord

versets.arabe: وَاخْتَارَ مُوسَىٰ قَوْمَهُ سَبْعِينَ رَجُلًا لِمِيقَاتِنَا
versets.phonetique: Wakhtara musa qawmahu sab'ina rajulan limiqatina
versets.francais: Moïse choisit soixante-dix hommes de son peuple pour Notre rendez-vous.
versets.anglais: And Moses chose from his people seventy men for Our appointment. And when the earthquake seized them, he said, "My Lord, if You had willed, You could have destroyed them before and me [as well]. Would You destroy us for what the foolish among us have done? This is not but Your trial by which You send astray whom You will and guide whom You will. You are our Protector, so forgive us and have mercy upon us; and You are the best of forgivers

versets.arabe: وَاكْتُبْ لَنَا فِي هَٰذِهِ الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ
versets.phonetique: Waktub lana fi hadhihi ad-dunya hasanatan wa-fil-akhira
versets.francais: Inscris-nous pour cette vie le bien et dans l'au-delà.
versets.anglais: And decree for us in this world [that which is] good and [also] in the Hereafter; indeed, we have turned back to You." [Allah] said, "My punishment - I afflict with it whom I will, but My mercy encompasses all things." So I will decree it [especially] for those who fear Me and give zakah and those who believe in Our verses

versets.arabe: الَّذِينَ يَتَّبِعُونَ الرَّسُولَ النَّبِيَّ الْأُمِّيَّ
versets.phonetique: Alladhina yattabi'una ar-rasula an-nabiyya al-ummiyya
versets.francais: Ceux qui suivent le Messager, le Prophète illettré.
versets.anglais: Those who follow the Messenger, the unlettered prophet, whom they find written in what they have of the Torah and the Gospel, who enjoins upon them what is right and forbids them what is wrong and makes lawful for them the good things and prohibits for them the evil and relieves them of their burden and the shackles which were upon them. So they who have believed in him, honored him, supported him and followed the light which was sent down with him - it is those who will be the successful

versets.arabe: قُلْ يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِنِّي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ إِلَيْكُمْ جَمِيعًا
versets.phonetique: Qul ya ayyuhan-nasu inni rasulu Allahi ilaykum jami'an
versets.francais: Dis: "O hommes! Je suis le Messager d'Allah vers vous tous."
versets.anglais: Say, [O Muhammad], "O mankind, indeed I am the Messenger of Allah to you all, [from Him] to whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. There is no deity except Him; He gives life and causes death." So believe in Allah and His Messenger, the unlettered prophet, who believes in Allah and His words, and follow him that you may be guided

versets.arabe: وَمِن قَوْمِ مُوسَىٰ أُمَّةٌ يَهْدُونَ بِالْحَقِّ
versets.phonetique: Wa-min qawmi musa ummatun yahduna bil-haqq
versets.francais: Et parmi le peuple de Moïse, il y a une communauté qui guide par la vérité.
versets.anglais: And among the people of Moses is a community which guides by truth and by it establishes justice

versets.arabe: وَقَطَّعْنَاهُمُ اثْنَتَيْ عَشْرَةَ أَسْبَاطًا أُمَمًا
versets.phonetique: Wa-qatta'nahumu ithnatay 'ashrata asbatan umaman
versets.francais: Nous les divisâmes en douze tribus, des nations.
versets.anglais: And We divided them into twelve descendant tribes [as distinct] nations. And We inspired to Moses when his people implored him for water, "Strike with your staff the stone," and there gushed forth from it twelve springs. Every people knew its watering place. And We shaded them with clouds and sent down upon them manna and quails, [saying], "Eat from the good things with which We have provided you." And they wronged Us not, but they were [only] wronging themselves

versets.arabe: وَإِذْ قِيلَ لَهُمُ اسْكُنُوا هَٰذِهِ الْقَرْيَةَ وَكُلُوا مِنْهَا
versets.phonetique: Wa-idh qila lahumu uskunu hadhihi al-qaryata wa-kulu minha
versets.francais: Et quand on leur dit: "Habitez cette cité et mangez-y."
versets.anglais: And [mention, O Muhammad], when it was said to them, "Dwell in this city and eat from it wherever you will and say, 'Relieve us of our burdens,' and enter the gate bowing humbly; We will [then] forgive you your sins. We will increase the doers of good [in goodness and reward]

versets.arabe: فَبَدَّلَ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا مِنْهُمْ قَوْلًا غَيْرَ الَّذِي قِيلَ لَهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Fabaddala alladhina zalamu minhum qawlan ghayra alladhi qila lahum
versets.francais: Mais les injustes parmi eux changèrent la parole par une autre.
versets.anglais: But those who wronged among them changed [the words] to a statement other than that which had been said to them. So We sent upon them a punishment from the sky for the wrong that they were doing

versets.arabe: وَاسْأَلْهُمْ عَنِ الْقَرْيَةِ الَّتِي كَانَتْ حَاضِرَةَ الْبَحْرِ
versets.phonetique: Wa-sa'alhum 'an al-qaryati allati kanat hadirata al-bahr
versets.francais: Interroge-les au sujet de la cité qui était au bord de la mer.
versets.anglais: And ask them about the town that was by the sea - when they transgressed in [the matter of] the sabbath - when their fish came to them openly on their sabbath day, and the day they had no sabbath they did not come to them. Thus did We give them trial because they were defiantly disobedient

versets.arabe: وَإِذْ قَالَتْ أُمَّةٌ مِّنْهُمْ لِمَ تَعِظُونَ قَوْمًا
versets.phonetique: Wa-idh qalat ummatun minhum lima ta'izhuna qawman
versets.francais: Et quand une communauté d'entre eux dit: "Pourquoi exhortez-vous un peuple?"
versets.anglais: And when a community among them said, "Why do you advise [or warn] a people whom Allah is [about] to destroy or to punish with a severe punishment?" they [the advisors] said, "To be absolved before your Lord and perhaps they may fear Him

versets.arabe: فَلَمَّا نَسُوا مَا ذُكِّرُوا بِهِ أَنجَيْنَا الَّذِينَ يَنْهَوْنَ عَنِ السُّوءِ
versets.phonetique: Falamma nasu ma dhukkiru bihi anjayna alladhina yanhawna 'anis-su'
versets.francais: Quand ils eurent oublié ce qu'on leur avait rappelé, Nous sauvâmes ceux qui interdisaient le mal.
versets.anglais: And when they forgot that by which they had been reminded, We saved those who had forbidden evil and seized those who wronged, with a wretched punishment, because they were defiantly disobeying

versets.arabe: فَلَمَّا عَتَوْا عَن مَّا نُهُوا عَنْهُ قُلْنَا لَهُمْ كُونُوا قِرَدَةً خَاسِئِينَ
versets.phonetique: Falamma 'ataw 'an ma nuhu 'anhu qulna lahum kunu qiradatan khasipin
versets.francais: Quand ils se rebellèrent contre ce qu'on leur avait interdit, Nous leur dîmes: "Soyez des singes chassés."
versets.anglais: So when they were insolent about that which they had been forbidden, We said to them, "Be apes, despised

versets.arabe: وَإِذْ تَأَذَّنَ رَبُّكَ لَيَبْعَثَنَّ عَلَيْهِمْ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ
versets.phonetique: Wa-idh ta'adhdhana rabbuka layab'athanna 'alayhim ila yawmi al-qiyamah
versets.francais: Et quand ton Seigneur proclama qu'Il enverrait contre eux jusqu'au Jour du Jugement.
versets.anglais: And [mention] when your Lord declared that He would surely [continue to] send upon them until the Day of Resurrection those who would afflict them with the worst torment. Indeed, your Lord is swift in penalty; but indeed, He is Forgiving and Merciful

versets.arabe: وَقَطَّعْنَاهُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ أُمَمًا
versets.phonetique: Wa-qatta'nahum fil-ardi umaman
versets.francais: Nous les avons dispersés en groupes à travers la terre.
versets.anglais: And We divided them throughout the earth into nations. Of them some were righteous, and of them some were otherwise. And We tested them with good [times] and bad that perhaps they would return [to obedience]

versets.arabe: فَخَلَفَ مِن بَعْدِهِمْ خَلْفٌ وَرِثُوا الْكِتَابَ
versets.phonetique: Fakhalafa min ba'dihim khalfun waritu al-kitab
versets.francais: Leur succéda une descendance qui hérita le Livre.
versets.anglais: And there followed them successors who inherited the Scripture [while] taking the commodities of this lower life and saying, "It will be forgiven for us." And if an offer like it comes to them, they will [again] take it. Was not the covenant of the Scripture taken from them that they would not say about Allah except the truth, and they studied what was in it? And the home of the Hereafter is better for those who fear Allah, so will you not use reason

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ يُمَسِّكُونَ بِالْكِتَابِ وَأَقَامُوا الصَّلَاةَ
versets.phonetique: Walladhina yumasikuna bil-kitabi wa-aqamu as-salah
versets.francais: Ceux qui s'attachent au Livre et accomplissent la Salat.
versets.anglais: But those who hold fast to the Book and establish prayer - indeed, We will not allow to be lost the reward of the reformers

versets.arabe: وَإِذْ نَتَقْنَا الْجَبَلَ فَوْقَهُمْ كَأَنَّهُ ظُلَّةٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa-idh nataqna al-jabala fawqahum ka'annahu zullah
versets.francais: Et quand Nous soulevâmes la montagne au-dessus d'eux comme un auvent.
versets.anglais: And [mention] when We raised the mountain above them as if it was a dark cloud and they were certain that it would fall upon them, [and Allah said], "Take what We have given you with determination and remember what is in it that you might fear Allah

versets.arabe: وَإِذْ أَخَذَ رَبُّكَ مِن بَنِي آدَمَ مِن ظُهُورِهِمْ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Wa-idh akhadha rabbuka min bani adama min zhuhurihim dhurriyyatahum
versets.francais: Et quand ton Seigneur tira de la descendance des fils d'Adam.
versets.anglais: And [mention] when your Lord took from the children of Adam - from their loins - their descendants and made them testify of themselves, [saying to them], "Am I not your Lord?" They said, "Yes, we have testified." [This] - lest you should say on the day of Resurrection, "Indeed, we were of this unaware

versets.arabe: أَوْ تَقُولُوا إِنَّمَا أَشْرَكَ آبَاؤُنَا مِن قَبْلُ
versets.phonetique: Aw taqulu innama ashraka aba'una min qabl
versets.francais: Ou que vous ne disiez: "Ce sont nos ancêtres qui ont pratiqué l'association."
versets.anglais: Or [lest] you say, "It was only that our fathers associated [others in worship] with Allah before, and we were but descendants after them. Then would You destroy us for what the falsifiers have done

versets.arabe: وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُفَصِّلُ الْآيَاتِ وَلَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa-kadhalika nufassilu al-ayati wa-la'allahum yarji'un
versets.francais: Ainsi Nous exposons en détail les signes, afin qu'ils reviennent.
versets.anglais: And thus do We [explain in] detail the verses, and perhaps they will return

versets.arabe: وَاتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ الَّذِي آتَيْنَاهُ آيَاتِنَا فَانسَلَخَ مِنْهَا
versets.phonetique: Watlu 'alayhim naba'a alladhi ataynahuayatina fa-insalakha minha
versets.francais: Et récite-leur la nouvelle de celui à qui Nous avions donné Nos signes, mais qui s'en détacha.
versets.anglais: And recite to them, [O Muhammad], the news of him to whom we gave [knowledge of] Our signs, but he detached himself from them; so Satan pursued him, and he became of the deviators

versets.arabe: وَلَوْ شِئْنَا لَرَفَعْنَاهُ بِهَا وَلَٰكِنَّهُ أَخْلَدَ إِلَى الْأَرْضِ
versets.phonetique: Wa-law shi'na lara-fa'nahu biha walakinnahu akhlada ilal-ard
versets.francais: Si Nous avions voulu, Nous l'aurions élevé grâce à ces signes. Mais il s'attacha à la terre.
versets.anglais: And if We had willed, we could have elevated him thereby, but he adhered [instead] to the earth and followed his own desire. So his example is like that of the dog: if you chase him, he pants, or if you leave him, he [still] pants. That is the example of the people who denied Our signs. So relate the stories that perhaps they will give thought

versets.arabe: سَاءَ مَثَلًا الْقَوْمُ الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا بِآيَاتِنَا وَأَنفُسَهُمْ كَانُوا يَظْلِمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Sa'a mathalan al-qawmu alladhina kadhdhabu bi-ayatina wa-anfusahum kanu yazlimuna
versets.francais: Quelle mauvaise exemple que le peuple qui traite Nos signes de mensonges et se lèse lui-même.
versets.anglais: How evil an example [is that of] the people who denied Our signs and used to wrong themselves

versets.arabe: مَن يَهْدِ اللَّهُ فَهُوَ الْمُهْتَدِي وَمَن يُضْلِلْ فَأُولَٰئِكَ هُمُ الْخَاسِرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Man yahdi Allahu fahuwa al-muhtadi wa-man yudlil fa-ula'ika humul-khasirun
versets.francais: Celui qu'Allah guide, c'est lui le guidé. Ceux qu'Il égare, ceux-là sont les perdants.
versets.anglais: Whoever Allah guides - he is the [rightly] guided; and whoever He sends astray - it is those who are the losers

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ ذَرَأْنَا لِجَهَنَّمَ كَثِيرًا مِّنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنسِ
versets.phonetique: Wa-laqad dhara'na lijahannama kathiran minal-jinni wal-ins
versets.francais: Nous avons certes créé pour l'Enfer beaucoup de djinns et d'hommes.
versets.anglais: And We have certainly created for Hell many of the jinn and mankind. They have hearts with which they do not understand, they have eyes with which they do not see, and they have ears with which they do not hear. Those are like livestock; rather, they are more astray. It is they who are the heedless

versets.arabe: وَلِلَّهِ الْأَسْمَاءُ الْحُسْنَىٰ فَادْعُوهُ بِهَا
versets.phonetique: Wa-lillahi al-asma'u al-husna fad'uhu biha
versets.francais: A Allah appartiennent les plus beaux noms; appelez-Le par eux.
versets.anglais: And to Allah belong the best names, so invoke Him by them. And leave [the company of] those who practice deviation concerning His names. They will be recompensed for what they have been doing

versets.arabe: وَمِمَّنْ خَلَقْنَا أُمَّةٌ يَهْدُونَ بِالْحَقِّ وَبِهِ يَعْدِلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa-mimman khalaqna ummatun yahduna bil-haqqi wa-bihi ya'dilun
versets.francais: Et parmi ceux que Nous avons créés, il est une communauté qui guide par la vérité.
versets.anglais: And among those We created is a community which guides by truth and thereby establishes justice

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا بِآيَاتِنَا سَنَسْتَدْرِجُهُم مِّنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Walladhina kadhdhabu bi-ayatina sanastadrijuhum min haythu la ya'lamun
versets.francais: Ceux qui traitent Nos signes de mensonges, Nous les conduirons à leur perte, d'une façon qu'ils ne savent pas.
versets.anglais: But those who deny Our signs - We will progressively lead them [to destruction] from where they do not know

versets.arabe: وَأُمْلِي لَهُمْ إِنَّ كَيْدِي مَتِينٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa-umli lahum inna kaydi matin
versets.francais: Je leur accorde du délai. Mon stratagème est solide.
versets.anglais: And I will give them time. Indeed, my plan is firm

versets.arabe: أَوَلَمْ يَتَفَكَّرُوا مَا بِصَاحِبِهِم مِّن جِنَّةٍ
versets.phonetique: Awa lam yatafakkaru ma bisahib him min jinnah
versets.francais: N'ont-ils pas réfléchi? Il n'y a aucune folie chez leur compagnon.
versets.anglais: Then do they not give thought? There is in their companion [Muhammad] no madness. He is not but a clear warner

versets.arabe: أَوَلَمْ يَنظُرُوا فِي مَلَكُوتِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ
versets.phonetique: Awa lam yanzuru fi malakuti as-samawati wal-ard
versets.francais: N'ont-ils pas regardé dans le Royaume des cieux et de la terre?
versets.anglais: Do they not look into the realm of the heavens and the earth and everything that Allah has created and [think] that perhaps their appointed time has come near? So in what statement hereafter will they believe

versets.arabe: مَن يُضْلِلِ اللَّهُ فَلَا هَادِيَ لَهُ
versets.phonetique: Man yudlili Allahu fala hadiya lah
versets.francais: Celui qu'Allah égare n'a pas de guide.
versets.anglais: Whoever Allah sends astray - there is no guide for him. And He leaves them in their transgression, wandering blindly

versets.arabe: يَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ السَّاعَةِ أَيَّانَ مُرْسَاهَا
versets.phonetique: Yas'alunaka 'anis-sa'ati ayyanna mursaha
versets.francais: Ils t'interrogent sur l'Heure: "Quand aura lieu son ancrage?"
versets.anglais: They ask you, [O Muhammad], about the Hour: when is its arrival? Say, "Its knowledge is only with my Lord. None will reveal its time except Him. It lays heavily upon the heavens and the earth. It will not come upon you except unexpectedly." They ask you as if you are familiar with it. Say, "Its knowledge is only with Allah, but most of the people do not know

versets.arabe: قُل لَّا أَمْلِكُ لِنَفْسِي نَفْعًا وَلَا ضَرًّا إِلَّا مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ
versets.phonetique: Qul la amliku linafsi naf'an wa-la darran illa ma sha'a Allah
versets.francais: Dis: "Je n'ai pas le pouvoir de me faire du bien ou du mal, sauf ce qu'Allah veut."
versets.anglais: Say, "I hold not for myself [the power of] benefit or harm, except what Allah has willed. And if I knew the unseen, I could have acquired much wealth, and no harm would have touched me. I am not except a warner and a bringer of good tidings to a people who believe

versets.arabe: هُوَ الَّذِي خَلَقَكُم مِّن نَّفْسٍ وَاحِدَةٍ
versets.phonetique: Huwa alladhi khalaqakum min nafsin wahidah
versets.francais: C'est Lui qui vous a créés d'une seule âme.
versets.anglais: It is He who created you from one soul and created from it its mate that he might dwell in security with her. And when he covers her, she carries a light burden and continues therein. And when it becomes heavy, they both invoke Allah, their Lord, "If You should give us a good [child], we will surely be among the grateful

versets.arabe: فَلَمَّا آتَاهُمَا صَالِحًا جَعَلَا لَهُ شُرَكَاءَ فِيمَا آتَاهُمَا
versets.phonetique: Falamma ataahuma salihan ja'ala lahu shurak'a fima ataahuma
versets.francais: Quand Il leur donna un enfant sain, ils lui associèrent des partenaires.
versets.anglais: But when He gives them a good [child], they ascribe partners to Him concerning that which He has given them. Exalted is Allah above what they associate with Him

versets.arabe: أَيُشْرِكُونَ مَا لَا يَخْلُقُ شَيْئًا وَهُمْ يُخْلَقُونَ
versets.phonetique: Ayushrikuna ma la yakhluqu shay'an wa-hum yukhlaqun
versets.francais: Associent-ils ce qui ne crée rien alors qu'ils sont créés?
versets.anglais: Do they associate with Him those who create nothing and they are [themselves] created

versets.arabe: وَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ لَهُمْ نَصْرًا وَلَا أَنفُسَهُمْ يَنصُرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa-la yastatri'una lahum nasran wa-la anfusahum yansuruna
versets.francais: Ils ne peuvent les secourir, ni se secourir eux-mêmes.
versets.anglais: And the false deities are unable to [give] them help, nor can they help themselves

versets.arabe: وَإِن تَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَى الْهُدَىٰ لَا يَتَّبِعُوكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Wa-in tad'uhum ilal-huda la yattabi'ukum
versets.francais: Si vous les appelez à la bonne voie, ils ne vous suivent pas.
versets.anglais: And if you [believers] invite them to guidance, they will not follow you. It is all the same for you whether you invite them or you are silent

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ عِبَادٌ أَمْثَالُكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Inna alladhina tad'una min duni Allahi 'ibadun amthalukum
versets.francais: Ceux que vous invoquez en dehors d'Allah sont des serviteurs comme vous.
versets.anglais: Indeed, those you [polytheists] call upon besides Allah are servants like you. So call upon them and let them respond to you, if you should be truthful

versets.arabe: أَلَهُمْ أَرْجُلٌ يَمْشُونَ بِهَا
versets.phonetique: Alahumul arjulun yamshuna biha
versets.francais: Ont-ils des pieds pour marcher?
versets.anglais: Do they have feet by which they walk? Or do they have hands by which they strike? Or do they have eyes by which they see? Or do they have ears by which they hear? Say, [O Muhammad], "Call your 'partners' and then conspire against me and give me no respite

versets.arabe: إِنَّ وَلِيِّيَ اللَّهُ الَّذِي نَزَّلَ الْكِتَابَ وَهُوَ يَتَوَلَّى الصَّالِحِينَ
versets.phonetique: Inna waliyyiya Allahu alladhi nazzala al-kitaba wa-huwa yatawalla as-salihin
versets.francais: Mon allié c'est Allah qui a fait descendre le Livre et Il protège les vertueux.
versets.anglais: Indeed, my protector is Allah, who has sent down the Book; and He is an ally to the righteous

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Walladhina tad'una min dunihi la yastatri'una nasrakum
versets.francais: Ceux que vous invoquez en dehors de Lui ne peuvent vous secourir.
versets.anglais: And those you call upon besides Him are unable to help you, nor can they help themselves

versets.arabe: وَإِن تَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَى الْهُدَىٰ لَا يَسْمَعُوا
versets.phonetique: Wa-in tad'uhum ilal-huda la yasma'u
versets.francais: Et si vous les appelez à la direction, ils n'entendent pas.
versets.anglais: And if you invite them to guidance, they do not hear; and you see them looking at you while they do not see

versets.arabe: خُذِ الْعَفْوَ وَأْمُرْ بِالْعُرْفِ وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ الْجَاهِلِينَ
versets.phonetique: Khudhi al-'afwa wa-'mur bil-'urfi wa-a'rid 'anil-jahilin
versets.francais: Fais preuve d'indulgence, ordonne le bien et éloigne-toi des ignorants.
versets.anglais: Take what is given freely, enjoin what is good, and turn away from the ignorant

versets.arabe: وَإِمَّا يَنزَغَنَّكَ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ نَزْغٌ فَاسْتَعِذْ بِاللَّهِ
versets.phonetique: Wa-imma yanzaghannaka minas-shaytani nazghun fasta'idh billah
versets.francais: Si une tentation du Diable te pique, cherche refuge auprès d'Allah.
versets.anglais: And if an evil suggestion comes to you from Satan, then seek refuge in Allah. Indeed, He is Hearing and Knowing

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا إِذَا مَسَّهُمْ طَائِفٌ مِّنَ الشَّيْطَانِ
versets.phonetique: Inna alladhina ittaqaw idha massahum ta'ifun minas-shaytan
versets.francais: Ceux qui sont pieux, quand une inspiration du Diable les touche.
versets.anglais: Indeed, those who fear Allah - when an impulse touches them from Satan, they remember [Him] and at once they have insight

versets.arabe: وَإِخْوَانُهُمْ يَمُدُّونَهُمْ فِي الْغَيِّ ثُمَّ لَا يُقْصِرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa-ikhwanuhum yamudduna hum fil-ghayyi thumma la yuqsirun
versets.francais: Quant à leurs frères (les Diables), ils les plongent dans l'égarement sans jamais s'arrêter.
versets.anglais: But their brothers - the devils increase them in error; then they do not stop short

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا لَمْ تَأْتِهِم بِآيَةٍ قَالُوا لَوْلَا اجْتَبَيْتَهَا
versets.phonetique: Wa-idha lam ta'tihim bi-ayatin qalu lawla ijtabaytaha
versets.francais: Quand tu ne leur apportes pas un signe, ils disent: "Pourquoi ne l'as-tu pas cherché?"
versets.anglais: And when you, [O Muhammad], do not bring them a sign, they say, "Why have you not contrived it?" Say, "I only follow what is revealed to me from my Lord. This [Qur'an] is enlightenment from your Lord and guidance and mercy for a people who believe

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا قُرِئَ الْقُرْآنُ فَاسْتَمِعُوا لَهُ وَأَنصِتُوا
versets.phonetique: Wa-idha quri'a al-qur'anu fastami'u lahu wa-ansitu
versets.francais: Quand le Coran est récité, écoutez-le et taisez-vous.
versets.anglais: So when the Qur'an is recited, then listen to it and pay attention that you may receive mercy

versets.arabe: وَاذْكُر رَّبَّكَ فِي نَفْسِكَ تَضَرُّعًا وَخِيفَةً
versets.phonetique: Wadhkur rabbaka fi nafsika tadharru'an wa-khifah
versets.francais: Invoque ton Seigneur en toi-même, avec humilité et crainte.
versets.anglais: And remember your Lord within yourself in humility and in fear without being apparent in speech - in the mornings and the evenings. And do not be among the heedless

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ عِندَ رَبِّكَ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ عَنْ عِبَادَتِهِ
versets.phonetique: Inna alladhina 'inda rabbika la yastakbiruna 'an 'ibadatih
versets.francais: Ceux qui sont auprès de ton Seigneur ne s'enorgueillissent pas de L'adorer.
versets.anglais: Indeed, those who are near your Lord are not prevented by arrogance from His worship, and they exalt Him, and to Him they prostrate

versets.arabe: يَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ الْأَنفَالِ ۖ قُلِ الْأَنفَالُ لِلَّهِ وَالرَّسُولِ ۖ فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَصْلِحُوا ذَاتَ بَيْنِكُمْ ۖ وَأَطِيعُوا اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Yas'alunaka 'anil-anfal qulil-anfalu lillahi war-rasul fattaqullaha wa aslahu dhata baynikum wa ati'ullaha wa rasulahu in kuntum mu'minin
versets.francais: Ils t'interrogent sur les butins. Dis : "Les butins appartiennent à Allah et au Messager." Craignez Allah, réglez vos différends et obéissez à Allah et à Son messager si vous êtes croyants.
versets.anglais: They ask you, [O Muhammad], about the bounties [of war]. Say, "The [decision concerning] bounties is for Allah and the Messenger." So fear Allah and amend that which is between you and obey Allah and His Messenger, if you should be believers

versets.arabe: إِنَّمَا الْمُؤْمِنُونَ الَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِرَ اللَّهُ وَجِلَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ وَإِذَا تُلِيَتْ عَلَيْهِمْ آيَاتُهُ زَادَتْهُمْ إِيمَانًا وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Innamal-mu'minunal-ladhina idha dhukir-allahu wajilat qulubuhum wa idha tuliyat 'alayhim ayatuhu zadathum imananaw wa 'ala rabbihim yatawakkalun
versets.francais: Les vrais croyants sont ceux dont les cœurs frémissent quand on mentionne Allah, et dont la foi s'accroît quand on leur récite Ses versets, et qui font confiance à leur Seigneur.
versets.anglais: The believers are only those who, when Allah is mentioned, their hearts become fearful, and when His verses are recited to them, it increases them in faith; and upon their Lord they rely

versets.arabe: الَّذِينَ يُقِيمُونَ الصَّلَاةَ وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَاهُمْ يُنفِقُونَ
versets.phonetique: Alladhina yuqimunas-salata wa mimma razaqnahum yunfiqun
versets.francais: Ceux qui accomplissent la prière et qui dépensent de ce que Nous leur avons attribué.
versets.anglais: The ones who establish prayer, and from what We have provided them, they spend

versets.arabe: أُولَٰئِكَ هُمُ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ حَقًّا ۚ لَّهُمْ دَرَجَاتٌ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ وَمَغْفِرَةٌ وَرِزْقٌ كَرِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Ula'ika humul-mu'minuna haqqan lahum darajatun 'inda rabbihim wa maghfiratuw wa rizqun karim
versets.francais: Ceux-là sont les vrais croyants. Ils ont des degrés élevés auprès de leur Seigneur, ainsi que pardon et généreuse attribution.
versets.anglais: Those are the believers, truly. For them are degrees [of high position] with their Lord and forgiveness and noble provision

versets.arabe: كَمَا أَخْرَجَكَ رَبُّكَ مِن بَيْتِكَ بِالْحَقِّ وَإِنَّ فَرِيقًا مِّنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ لَكَارِهُونَ
versets.phonetique: Kama akhrajaka rabbuka mim baytika bil-haqqi wa inna fariqam minal-mu'minina lakarihun
versets.francais: De même que ton Seigneur t'a fait sortir de ta demeure en toute vérité, bien qu'une partie des croyants ne l'aimait pas.
versets.anglais: [It is] just as when your Lord brought you out of your home [for the battle of Badr] in truth, while indeed, a party among the believers were unwilling

versets.arabe: يُجَادِلُونَكَ فِي الْحَقِّ بَعْدَمَا تَبَيَّنَ كَأَنَّمَا يُسَاقُونَ إِلَى الْمَوْتِ وَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Yujadilunaka fil-haqqi ba'dama tabayyana ka'annama yusaquna ilal-mawti wa hum yandhturun
versets.francais: Ils discutent avec toi sur la vérité après qu'elle est devenue manifeste, comme si on les conduisait à la mort les yeux ouverts.
versets.anglais: Arguing with you concerning the truth after it had become clear, as if they were being driven toward death while they were looking on

versets.arabe: وَإِذْ يَعِدُكُمُ اللَّهُ إِحْدَى الطَّائِفَتَيْنِ أَنَّهَا لَكُمْ وَتَوَدُّونَ أَنَّ غَيْرَ ذَاتِ الشَّوْكَةِ تَكُونُ لَكُمْ وَيُرِيدُ اللَّهُ أَن يُحِقَّ الْحَقَّ بِكَلِمَاتِهِ وَيَقْطَعَ دَابِرَ الْكَافِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa idh ya'idukumullahu ihdat-ta'ifatayni annahalakum wa tawadduna anna ghayra dhatish-shawkati takunu lakum wa yuridullahu ay-yuhiqqal-haqqa bikalimatihi wa yaqta'a dabiral-kafirin
versets.francais: Allah vous avait promis l'une des deux troupes, et vous souhaitiez que ce fût la moins armée qui vous échût. Mais Allah voulait établir la vérité par Ses paroles et anéantir les mécréants jusqu'au dernier.
versets.anglais: [Remember, O believers], when Allah promised you one of the two groups - that it would be yours - and you wished that the unarmed one would be yours. But Allah intended to establish the truth by His words and to eliminate the disbelievers

versets.arabe: لِيُحِقَّ الْحَقَّ وَيُبْطِلَ الْبَاطِلَ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الْمُجْرِمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Liyuhiqqal-haqqa wa yubtilal-batila wa law karihal-mujrimun
versets.francais: Pour établir la vérité et abolir le faux, même si les criminels ne l'aiment pas.
versets.anglais: That He should establish the truth and abolish falsehood, even if the criminals disliked it

versets.arabe: إِذْ تَسْتَغِيثُونَ رَبَّكُمْ فَاسْتَجَابَ لَكُمْ أَنِّي مُمِدُّكُم بِأَلْفٍ مِّنَ الْمَلَائِكَةِ مُرْدِفِينَ
versets.phonetique: Idh tastaghi-thuna rabbakum fastajaba lakum anni mumiddukum bi'alfim minal-mala'ikati murdifin
versets.francais: Quand vous appeliez à l'aide votre Seigneur, Il vous répondit : "Je vais vous soutenir de mille anges se succédant."
versets.anglais: [Remember] when you asked help of your Lord, and He answered you, "Indeed, I will reinforce you with a thousand from the angels, following one another

versets.arabe: وَمَا جَعَلَهُ اللَّهُ إِلَّا بُشْرَىٰ وَلِتَطْمَئِنَّ بِهِ قُلُوبُكُمْ ۚ وَمَا النَّصْرُ إِلَّا مِنْ عِندِ اللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa ma ja'alahullahu illa bushra wa litathma'inna bihi qulubukum wa man-nasru illa min 'indillah innallaha 'azizun hakim
versets.francais: Allah ne l'a fait que comme une bonne nouvelle et pour que vos cœurs en soient rassurés. La victoire ne vient que d'Allah. Allah est Puissant et Sage.
versets.anglais: And Allah made it not but good tidings and so that your hearts would be assured thereby. And victory is not but from Allah. Indeed, Allah is Exalted in Might and Wise

versets.arabe: إِذْ يُغَشِّيكُمُ النُّعَاسَ أَمَنَةً مِّنْهُ وَيُنَزِّلُ عَلَيْكُم مِّنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً لِّيُطَهِّرَكُم بِهِ وَيُذْهِبَ عَنكُمْ رِجْزَ الشَّيْطَانِ وَلِيَرْبِطَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِكُمْ وَيُثَبِّتَ بِهِ الْأَقْدَامَ
versets.phonetique: Idh yughash-shikumun-nu'asa amanatan minhu wa yunazzilu 'alaykum minas-sama'i ma'al liyutahhirakum bihi wa yudhhiba 'ankum rijzash-shaytani wa liyarbita 'ala qulubikum wa yuthabbita bihil-aqdam
versets.francais: Quand Il vous enveloppait de somnolence comme sécurité de Sa part et faisait descendre sur vous du ciel de l'eau pour vous en purifier, éloigner de vous la souillure du Diable, lier vos cœurs et affermir vos pas.
versets.anglais: [Remember] when He overwhelmed you with drowsiness [giving] security from Him and sent down upon you from the sky, rain by which to purify you and remove from you the evil [suggestions] of Satan and to make steadfast your hearts and plant firmly thereby your feet

versets.arabe: إِذْ يُوحِي رَبُّكَ إِلَى الْمَلَائِكَةِ أَنِّي مَعَكُمْ فَثَبِّتُوا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا ۚ سَأُلْقِي فِي قُلُوبِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا الرُّعْبَ فَاضْرِبُوا فَوْقَ الْأَعْنَاقِ وَاضْرِبُوا مِنْهُمْ كُلَّ بَنَانٍ
versets.phonetique: Idh yuhi rabbuka ilal-mala'ikati anni ma'akum fathabbitulladhina amanu sa'ulqi fi qulubildhina kafaru-r-ru'ba fadribu fawqal-a'naqi wadribu minhum kulla banan
versets.francais: Quand ton Seigneur révélait aux anges : "Je suis avec vous, affermissez ceux qui croient. Je vais jeter l'effroi dans les cœurs des mécréants. Frappez au-dessus des cous et frappez-leur toutes les phalanges."
versets.anglais: [Remember] when your Lord inspired to the angels, "I am with you, so strengthen those who have believed. I will cast terror into the hearts of those who disbelieved, so strike [them] upon the necks and strike from them every fingertip

versets.arabe: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ شَاقُّوا اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ ۚ وَمَن يُشَاقِقِ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ شَدِيدُ الْعِقَابِ
versets.phonetique: Dhalika bi'annahum shaqqullaha wa rasulahu wa may yushaqiqillaha wa rasulahu fa'innallaha shadidur-'iqab
versets.francais: Cela parce qu'ils ont défié Allah et Son messager. Quiconque défie Allah et Son messager, Allah est sévère dans le châtiment.
versets.anglais: That is because they opposed Allah and His Messenger. And whoever opposes Allah and His Messenger - indeed, Allah is severe in penalty

versets.arabe: ذَٰلِكُمْ فَذُوقُوهُ وَأَنَّ لِلْكَافِرِينَ عَذَابَ النَّارِ
versets.phonetique: Dhalikum fadhhuquhu wa anna lil-kafirna 'adhaaban-nar
versets.francais: Voilà, goûtez-le ! Les mécréants auront le châtiment du Feu.
versets.anglais: That [is yours], so taste it." And indeed for the disbelievers is the punishment of the Fire

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِذَا لَقِيتُمُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا زَحْفًا فَلَا تُوَلُّوهُمُ الْأَدْبَارَ
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuhal-ladhina amanu idha laqitumulladhina kafaru zahfan fala tuwalluhumu-l-adbar
versets.francais: Ô les croyants ! Quand vous rencontrez les mécréants en marche, ne leur tournez pas le dos.
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, when you meet those who disbelieve advancing [for battle], do not turn to them your backs [in flight]

versets.arabe: وَمَن يُوَلِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ دُبُرَهُ إِلَّا مُتَحَرِّفًا لِّقِتَالٍ أَوْ مُتَحَيِّزًا إِلَىٰ فِئَةٍ فَقَدْ بَاءَ بِغَضَبٍ مِّنَ اللَّهِ وَمَأْوَاهُ جَهَنَّمُ ۖ وَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيرُ
versets.phonetique: Wa may-yuwallihim yawma'idhin duburahu illa mutaharrifal liqitalin aw mutahayyizan ila fi'atin faqad ba'a bighadabim minallahi wa ma'wahu jahannamu wa bi'sal-masir
versets.francais: Quiconque leur tourne le dos ce jour-là - à moins de manœuvrer pour combattre ou pour rejoindre un groupe - encourt la colère d'Allah et sa demeure sera l'Enfer. Quelle mauvaise destination !
versets.anglais: And whoever turns his back to them on such a day, unless swerving [as a strategy] for war or joining [another] company, has certainly returned with anger [upon him] from Allah, and his refuge is Hell - and wretched is the destination

versets.arabe: فَلَمْ تَقْتُلُوهُمْ وَلَٰكِنَّ اللَّهَ قَتَلَهُمْ ۚ وَمَا رَمَيْتَ إِذْ رَمَيْتَ وَلَٰكِنَّ اللَّهَ رَمَىٰ ۚ وَلِيُبْلِيَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ مِنْهُ بَلَاءً حَسَنًا ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Falam taqtuluhum wa lakinnallaha qatalahum wa ma ramayta idh ramayta wa lakinnallaha rama wa liyubliyal-mu'minina minhu bala'an hasana innallaha sami'un 'alim
versets.francais: Ce n'est pas vous qui les avez tués, mais c'est Allah qui les a tués. Et tu n'as pas lancé quand tu as lancé mais c'est Allah qui a lancé, pour éprouver agréablement les croyants de Sa part. Allah est Audient et Omniscient.
versets.anglais: And you did not kill them, but it was Allah who killed them. And you threw not, [O Muhammad], when you threw, but it was Allah who threw that He might test the believers with a good test. Indeed, Allah is Hearing and Knowing

versets.arabe: ذَٰلِكُمْ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ مُوهِنُ كَيْدِ الْكَافِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Dhalikum wa annallaha muhinu kaydil-kafirin
versets.francais: Voilà, et Allah affaiblit la ruse des mécréants.
versets.anglais: That [is so], and [also] that Allah will weaken the plot of the disbelievers

versets.arabe: إِن تَسْتَفْتِحُوا فَقَدْ جَاءَكُمُ الْفَتْحُ ۖ وَإِن تَنتَهُوا فَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ ۖ وَإِن تَعُودُوا نَعُدْ وَلَن تُغْنِيَ عَنكُمْ فِئَتُكُمْ شَيْئًا وَلَوْ كَثُرَتْ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ مَعَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: In tastaftihu faqad ja'akumul-fathu wa in tantahu fahuwa khayrul lakum wa in ta'udu na'ud wa lan tughniya 'ankum fi'atukum shay'aw wa law kathurat wa annallaha ma'al-mu'minin
versets.francais: Si vous demandiez une décision, la décision vous est venue. Si vous cessez, ce sera mieux pour vous. Si vous recommencez, Nous recommencerons. Votre groupe ne vous sera d'aucune utilité, si nombreux soit-il. Allah est avec les croyants.
versets.anglais: If you [disbelievers] seek the victory - the defeat has come to you. And if you desist [from hostilities], it is best for you; but if you return [to war], We will return, and never will you be availed by your [large] company at all, even if it should increase; and [that is] because Allah is with the believers

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا أَطِيعُوا اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَلَا تَوَلَّوْا عَنْهُ وَأَنتُمْ تَسْمَعُونَ
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuhal-ladhina amanu ati'ullaha wa rasulahu wa la tawallaww 'anhu wa antum tasma'un
versets.francais: Ô les croyants ! Obéissez à Allah et à Son messager et ne vous détournez pas de lui alors que vous entendez.
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, obey Allah and His Messenger and do not turn from him while you hear [his order]

versets.arabe: وَلَا تَكُونُوا كَالَّذِينَ قَالُوا سَمِعْنَا وَهُمْ لَا يَسْمَعُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa la takunu kalladhina qalu sami'na wa hum la yasma'un
versets.francais: Et ne soyez pas comme ceux qui ont dit : "Nous avons entendu" alors qu'ils n'entendent pas.
versets.anglais: And do not be like those who say, "We have heard," while they do not hear

versets.arabe: إِنَّ شَرَّ الدَّوَابِّ عِندَ اللَّهِ الصُّمُّ الْبُكْمُ الَّذِينَ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Inna sharrad-dawabbbi 'indallahis-summul-bukmulladhina la ya'qilun
versets.francais: Les pires des créatures auprès d'Allah sont les sourds-muets qui ne raisonnent pas.
versets.anglais: Indeed, the worst of living creatures in the sight of Allah are the deaf and dumb who do not use reason

versets.arabe: وَلَوْ عَلِمَ اللَّهُ فِيهِمْ خَيْرًا لَّأَسْمَعَهُمْ ۖ وَلَوْ أَسْمَعَهُمْ لَتَوَلَّوا وَّهُم مُّعْرِضُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa law 'alimallahu fihim khayral la'asma'ahum wa law asma'ahum latawallaw wahum mu'ridun
versets.francais: Si Allah avait connu quelque bien en eux, Il leur aurait fait entendre. Et s'Il leur avait fait entendre, ils se seraient détournés en s'écartant.
versets.anglais: Had Allah known any good in them, He would have made them hear. And if He had made them hear, they would [still] have turned away, while they were refusing

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اسْتَجِيبُوا لِلَّهِ وَلِلرَّسُولِ إِذَا دَعَاكُمْ لِمَا يُحْيِيكُمْ ۖ وَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّ اللَّهَ يَحُولُ بَيْنَ الْمَرْءِ وَقَلْبِهِ وَأَنَّهُ إِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuhal-ladhina amanu-staghibu lillahi wa lir-rasuli idha da'akum lima yuhyikum wa'lamu annallaha yahulu baynal-mar'i wa qalbihi wa annahu ilayhi tuhsharun
versets.francais: Ô les croyants ! Répondez à Allah et au Messager lorsqu'il vous appelle à ce qui vous donne vie. Sachez qu'Allah s'interpose entre l'homme et son cœur et que c'est vers Lui que vous serez rassemblés.
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, respond to Allah and to the Messenger when he calls you to that which gives you life. And know that Allah intervenes between a man and his heart and that to Him you will be gathered

versets.arabe: وَاتَّقُوا فِتْنَةً لَّا تُصِيبَنَّ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا مِنكُمْ خَاصَّةً ۖ وَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّ اللَّهَ شَدِيدُ الْعِقَابِ
versets.phonetique: Wattaqu fitnatan la tusibanna-l-ladhina dhalamu minkum khassataw wa'lamu annallaha shadidur-'iqab
versets.francais: Craignez la discorde qui ne frappera pas seulement ceux d'entre vous qui ont été injustes. Sachez qu'Allah est sévère dans le châtiment.
versets.anglais: And fear a trial which will not strike those who have wronged among you exclusively, and know that Allah is severe in penalty

versets.arabe: وَاذْكُرُوا إِذْ أَنتُمْ قَلِيلٌ مُّسْتَضْعَفُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ تَخَافُونَ أَن يَتَخَطَّفَكُمُ النَّاسُ فَآوَاكُمْ وَأَيَّدَكُم بِنَصْرِهِ وَرَزَقَكُم مِّنَ الطَّيِّبَاتِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wadhkuru idh antum qalilum musta'dafuna fil-ardi takhafuna ay yatakhattafakumun-nasu fa'awakum wa ayyadakum binasrihi wa razaqakum minat-tayyibati la'allakum tashkurun
versets.francais: Rappelez-vous quand vous étiez peu nombreux et opprimés sur la terre, craignant que les gens vous enlèvent. Il vous donna refuge, vous fortifia de Son secours et vous pourvut de bonnes choses afin que vous soyez reconnaissants.
versets.anglais: And remember when you were few and oppressed in the land, fearing that people might abduct you, but He sheltered you, supported you with His victory, and provided you with good things - that you might be grateful

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تَخُونُوا اللَّهَ وَالرَّسُولَ وَتَخُونُوا أَمَانَاتِكُمْ وَأَنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuhal-ladhina amanu la takhunullaha war-rasula wa takhunu amanatikum wa antum ta'lamun
versets.francais: Ô les croyants ! Ne trahissez pas Allah et le Messager, et ne trahissez pas sciemment vos dépôts de confiance.
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, do not betray Allah and the Messenger or betray your trusts while you know [the consequence]

versets.arabe: وَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّمَا أَمْوَالُكُمْ وَأَوْلَادُكُمْ فِتْنَةٌ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ عِندَهُ أَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa'lamu annama amwalukum wa awladukum fitnatuw wa annallaha 'indahu ajrun 'azim
versets.francais: Sachez que vos biens et vos enfants ne sont qu'une tentation et qu'auprès d'Allah il y a une énorme récompense.
versets.anglais: And know that your properties and your children are but a trial and that Allah has with Him a great reward

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِن تَتَّقُوا اللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّكُمْ فُرْقَانًا وَيُكَفِّرْ عَنكُمْ سَيِّئَاتِكُمْ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ۗ وَاللَّهُ ذُو الْفَضْلِ الْعَظِيمِ
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuhal-ladhina amanu in tattaqullaha yaj'al lakum furqanaw wa yukaffir 'ankum sayyi'atikum wa yaghfir lakum wallahu dhul-fadlil-'azim
versets.francais: Ô les croyants ! Si vous craignez Allah, Il vous accordera un discernement, effacera vos mauvaises actions et vous pardonnera. Allah est le Détenteur de l'immense grâce.
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, if you fear Allah, He will grant you a criterion and will remove from you your misdeeds and forgive you. And Allah is the possessor of great bounty

versets.arabe: وَإِذْ يَمْكُرُ بِكَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لِيُثْبِتُوكَ أَوْ يَقْتُلُوكَ أَوْ يُخْرِجُوكَ ۚ وَيَمْكُرُونَ وَيَمْكُرُ اللَّهُ ۖ وَاللَّهُ خَيْرُ الْمَاكِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa idh yamkuru bikal-ladhina kafaru liyuthbituka aw yaqtuluka aw yukhrijuk wa yamkuruna wa yamkurullahu wallahu khayrul-makirin
versets.francais: Quand les mécréants complotaient contre toi pour t'emprisonner, te tuer ou t'expulser. Ils complotaient et Allah complotait. Allah est le meilleur des comploteurs.
versets.anglais: And [remember, O Muhammad], when those who disbelieved plotted against you to restrain you or kill you or evict you [from Makkah]. But they plan, and Allah plans. And Allah is the best of planners

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ آيَاتُنَا قَالُوا قَدْ سَمِعْنَا لَوْ نَشَاءُ لَقُلْنَا مِثْلَ هَٰذَا ۙ إِنْ هَٰذَا إِلَّا أَسَاطِيرُ الْأَوَّلِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa idha tutla 'alayhim ayatuna qalu qad sami'na law nasha'u laqulna mithla hadha in hadha illa asatirul-awwalin
versets.francais: Quand Nos versets leur sont récités, ils disent : "Nous avons entendu. Si nous voulions, nous dirions pareil. Ce ne sont que des contes des Anciens."
versets.anglais: And when Our verses are recited to them, they say, "We have heard. If we willed, we could say [something] like this. This is not but legends of the former peoples

versets.arabe: وَإِذْ قَالُوا اللَّهُمَّ إِن كَانَ هَٰذَا هُوَ الْحَقَّ مِنْ عِندِكَ فَأَمْطِرْ عَلَيْنَا حِجَارَةً مِّنَ السَّمَاءِ أَوِ ائْتِنَا بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa idh qalullahumma in kana hadha huwal-haqqa min 'indika fa'amtir 'alayna hijaratam minas-sama'i awit-ina bi'adhabin alim
versets.francais: Quand ils dirent : "Ô Allah, si c'est là la vérité venant de Toi, fais donc pleuvoir sur nous des pierres venant du ciel, ou apporte-nous un châtiment douloureux."
versets.anglais: And [remember] when they said, "O Allah, if this should be the truth from You, then rain down upon us stones from the sky or bring us a painful punishment

versets.arabe: وَمَا كَانَ اللَّهُ لِيُعَذِّبَهُمْ وَأَنتَ فِيهِمْ ۚ وَمَا كَانَ اللَّهُ مُعَذِّبَهُمْ وَهُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa ma kanallahu liyu'adhdhibahum wa anta fihim wa ma kanallahu mu'adhdhibahum wa hum yastagfhirun
versets.francais: Mais Allah ne les châtierait pas tant que tu es parmi eux. Et Allah ne les châtierait pas non plus tant qu'ils imploreront le pardon.
versets.anglais: But Allah would not punish them while you, [O Muhammad], are among them, and Allah would not punish them while they seek forgiveness

versets.arabe: وَمَا لَهُمْ أَلَّا يُعَذِّبَهُمُ اللَّهُ وَهُمْ يَصُدُّونَ عَنِ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ وَمَا كَانُوا أَوْلِيَاءَهُ ۚ إِنْ أَوْلِيَاؤُهُ إِلَّا الْمُتَّقُونَ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa ma lahum alla yu'adhdhibahumullahu wa hum yasudduna 'anil-masjidil-harami wa ma kanu awliya'ah in awliya'uhu illal-muttaquna wa lakinna aktharahum la ya'lamun
versets.francais: Pourquoi Allah ne les châtierait-Il pas alors qu'ils obstruent l'accès à la Mosquée sacrée et qu'ils n'en sont pas les gardiens légitimes ? Ses vrais gardiens ne sont que les pieux, mais la plupart d'entre eux ne savent pas.
versets.anglais: But why should Allah not punish them while they obstruct [people] from al-Masjid al- Haram and they were not [fit to be] its guardians? Its [true] guardians are not but the righteous, but most of them do not know

versets.arabe: وَمَا كَانَ صَلَاتُهُمْ عِندَ الْبَيْتِ إِلَّا مُكَاءً وَتَصْدِيَةً ۚ فَذُوقُوا الْعَذَابَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa ma kana salatuhum 'indal-bayti illa muka'aw wa tasdiyatan fadhhuqul-'adhaba bima kuntum takfurun
versets.francais: Leur prière auprès de la Maison n'était que sifflements et battements de mains. Goûtez donc le châtiment pour avoir mécru.
versets.anglais: And their prayer at the House was not except whistling and handclapping. So taste the punishment for what you disbelieved

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا يُنفِقُونَ أَمْوَالَهُمْ لِيَصُدُّوا عَن سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ۚ فَسَيُنفِقُونَهَا ثُمَّ تَكُونُ عَلَيْهِمْ حَسْرَةً ثُمَّ يُغْلَبُونَ ۗ وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ يُحْشَرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Innal-ladhina kafaru yunfiquna amwalahum liyasudduu 'an sabilillahi fasayunfiqunaha thumma takunu 'alayhim hasratan thumma yughalbun walladhina kafaru ila jahannama yuhsharun
versets.francais: Les mécréants dépensent leurs biens pour obstruer le chemin d'Allah. Ils vont les dépenser, puis cela deviendra pour eux un regret, ensuite ils seront vaincus. Et les mécréants seront rassemblés vers l'Enfer.
versets.anglais: Indeed, those who disbelieve spend their wealth to avert [people] from the way of Allah. So they will spend it; then it will be for them a [source of] regret; then they will be overcome. And those who have disbelieved - unto Hell they will be gathered

versets.arabe: لِيَمِيزَ اللَّهُ الْخَبِيثَ مِنَ الطَّيِّبِ وَيَجْعَلَ الْخَبِيثَ بَعْضَهُ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ فَيَرْكُمَهُ جَمِيعًا فَيَجْعَلَهُ فِي جَهَنَّمَ ۚ أُولَٰئِكَ هُمُ الْخَاسِرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Liyamizallahul-khabitha minat-tayyibi wa yaj'alal-khabitha ba'dahu 'ala ba'din fayarkumahu jami'an fayaj'alahu fi jahannama ula'ika humul-khasirun
versets.francais: Afin qu'Allah sépare le mauvais du bon et qu'Il entasse les uns sur les autres tous les mauvais pour les mettre dans l'Enfer. Ceux-là sont les perdants.
versets.anglais: [This is] so that Allah may distinguish the wicked from the good and place the wicked some of them upon others and heap them all together and put them into Hell. It is those who are the losers

versets.arabe: قُل لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا إِن يَنتَهُوا يُغْفَرْ لَهُم مَّا قَدْ سَلَفَ وَإِن يَعُودُوا فَقَدْ مَضَتْ سُنَّتُ الْأَوَّلِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qul lilladhina kafaru iy yantahu yughfar lahum ma qad salafa wa iy ya'udu faqad madat sunnatul-awwalin
versets.francais: Dis à ceux qui ont mécru : "S'ils cessent, ce qui est passé leur sera pardonné. S'ils recommencent, l'exemple des anciens s'est déjà produit."
versets.anglais: Say to those who have disbelieved [that] if they cease, what has previously occurred will be forgiven for them. But if they return [to hostility] - then the precedent of the former [rebellious] peoples has already taken place

versets.arabe: وَقَاتِلُوهُمْ حَتَّىٰ لَا تَكُونَ فِتْنَةٌ وَيَكُونَ الدِّينُ كُلُّهُ لِلَّهِ ۚ فَإِنِ انتَهَوْا فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa qatiluhum hatta la takuna fitnatuw wa yakunad-dinu kulluhu lillahi fa'ini-ntahaw fa'innallaha bima ya'maluna basir
versets.francais: Combattez-les jusqu'à ce qu'il n'y ait plus de persécution et que la religion soit entièrement à Allah. S'ils cessent, Allah voit bien ce qu'ils font.
versets.anglais: And fight them until there is no fitnah and [until] the religion, all of it, is for Allah. And if they cease - then indeed, Allah is Seeing of what they do

versets.arabe: وَإِن تَوَلَّوْا فَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّ اللَّهَ مَوْلَاكُمْ ۚ نِعْمَ الْمَوْلَىٰ وَنِعْمَ النَّصِيرُ
versets.phonetique: Wa in tawallaw fa'lamu annallaha mawlakum ni'mal-mawla wa ni'man-nasir
versets.francais: S'ils se détournent, sachez qu'Allah est votre Maître. Quel bon Maître et quel bon Soutien !
versets.anglais: But if they turn away - then know that Allah is your protector. Excellent is the protector, and Excellent is the helper

versets.arabe: وَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّمَا غَنِمْتُم مِّن شَيْءٍ فَأَنَّ لِلَّهِ خُمُسَهُ وَلِلرَّسُولِ وَلِذِي الْقُرْبَىٰ وَالْيَتَامَىٰ وَالْمَسَاكِينِ وَابْنِ السَّبِيلِ إِن كُنتُمْ آمَنتُم بِاللَّهِ وَمَا أَنزَلْنَا عَلَىٰ عَبْدِنَا يَوْمَ الْفُرْقَانِ يَوْمَ الْتَقَى الْجَمْعَانِ ۗ وَاللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa'lamu annama ghanimtum min shay'in fa'anna lillahi khumusahu wa lir-rasuli wa lidhil-qurba wal-yatama wal-masakini wabnis-sabili in kuntum amantum billahi wa ma anzalna 'ala 'abdina yawmal-furqani yawmal-taqal-jam'an wallahu 'ala kulli shay'in qadir
versets.francais: Sachez que tout butin que vous avez pris, le cinquième en appartient à Allah, au Messager, aux proches parents, aux orphelins, aux pauvres et au voyageur en détresse, si vous croyez en Allah et en ce que Nous avons révélé à Notre serviteur le jour du discernement, le jour où les deux troupes s'affrontèrent. Allah est Omnipotent.
versets.anglais: And know that anything you obtain of war booty - then indeed, for Allah is one fifth of it and for the Messenger and for [his] near relatives and the orphans, the needy, and the [stranded] traveler, if you have believed in Allah and in that which We sent down to Our Servant on the day of criterion - the day when the two armies met. And Allah, over all things, is competent

versets.arabe: إِذْ أَنتُم بِالْعُدْوَةِ الدُّنْيَا وَهُم بِالْعُدْوَةِ الْقُصْوَىٰ وَالرَّكْبُ أَسْفَلَ مِنكُمْ ۚ وَلَوْ تَوَاعَدتُّمْ لَاخْتَلَفْتُمْ فِي الْمِيعَادِ ۙ وَلَٰكِن لِّيَقْضِيَ اللَّهُ أَمْرًا كَانَ مَفْعُولًا
versets.phonetique: Idh antum bil-'udwatid-dunya wa hum bil-'udwatil-quswa war-rakbu asfala minkum wa law tawa'adttum lakhtalafattum fil-mi'aadi wa lakin liyaqdiyallahu amran kana maf'ula
versets.francais: Quand vous étiez sur la rive proche et eux sur la rive éloignée, et la caravane en bas de vous. Si vous vous étiez donné rendez-vous, vous n'auriez pas pu vous mettre d'accord sur le lieu. Mais Allah voulait accomplir une chose déjà décidée.
versets.anglais: [Remember] when you were on the near side of the valley, and they were on the farther side, and the caravan was lower [in position] than you. If you had made an appointment [to meet], you would have missed the appointment. But [it was] so that Allah might accomplish a matter already destined - that those who perished [through disbelief] would perish upon evidence and those who lived [in faith] would live upon evidence; and indeed, Allah is Hearing and Knowing

versets.arabe: إِذْ يُرِيكَهُمُ اللَّهُ فِي مَنَامِكَ قَلِيلًا ۖ وَلَوْ أَرَاكَهُمْ كَثِيرًا لَّفَشِلْتُمْ وَلَتَنَازَعْتُمْ فِي الْأَمْرِ وَلَٰكِنَّ اللَّهَ سَلَّمَ ۗ إِنَّهُ عَلِيمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ
versets.phonetique: Idh yurikahumulahu fi manamika qalila wa law arakahum kathiranl-fashiltum wa latanaza'tum fil-amri wa lakinnallaha sallama innahu 'alimum bidhatis-sudur
versets.francais: Quand Allah te les montrait dans ton rêve en petit nombre. S'Il te les avait montrés nombreux, vous auriez faibli et vous vous seriez disputés au sujet de la décision à prendre. Mais Allah vous a préservés. Il connaît bien le fond des cœurs.
versets.anglais: [Remember, O Muhammad], when Allah showed them to you in your dream as few; and if He had shown them to you as many, you [believers] would have lost courage and would have disputed in the matter [of whether to fight], but Allah saved [you from that]. Indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts

versets.arabe: وَإِذْ يُرِيكُمُوهُمْ إِذِ الْتَقَيْتُمْ فِي أَعْيُنِكُمْ قَلِيلًا وَيُقَلِّلُكُمْ فِي أَعْيُنِهِمْ لِيَقْضِيَ اللَّهُ أَمْرًا كَانَ مَفْعُولًا ۗ وَإِلَى اللَّهِ تُرْجَعُ الْأُمُورُ
versets.phonetique: Wa idh yurikumuwhum idhil-taqaytum fi a'yunikum qaliluw wa yuqallilukum fi a'yunihim liyaqdiyallahu amran kana maf'ulaa wa ilallahi turja'ul-umur
versets.francais: Et quand, lors de votre rencontre, Il vous les montrait peu nombreux à vos yeux et vous diminuait à leurs yeux, pour qu'Allah accomplisse une chose déjà décidée. C'est vers Allah que les affaires retournent.
versets.anglais: And [remember] when He showed them to you, when you met, as few in your eyes, and He made you [appear] as few in their eyes so that Allah might accomplish a matter already destined. And to Allah are [all] matters returned

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِذَا لَقِيتُمْ فِئَةً فَاثْبُتُوا وَاذْكُرُوا اللَّهَ كَثِيرًا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuhal-ladhina amanu idha laqitum fi'atan fathabitu wadhkurullaha kathiral la'allakum tuflihun
versets.francais: Ô les croyants ! Quand vous rencontrez une troupe, tenez ferme et invoquez beaucoup Allah afin que vous réussissiez.
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, when you encounter a company [from the enemy forces], stand firm and remember Allah much that you may be successful

versets.arabe: وَأَطِيعُوا اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَلَا تَنَازَعُوا فَتَفْشَلُوا وَتَذْهَبَ رِيحُكُمْ ۖ وَاصْبِرُوا ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ مَعَ الصَّابِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa ati'ullaha wa rasulahu wa la tanaza'u fatafshalu wa tadhhaba rihukum wasbiru innallaha ma'as-sabirin
versets.francais: Obéissez à Allah et à Son messager et ne vous disputez pas, sinon vous fléchirez et perdrez votre force. Soyez endurants. Allah est avec les endurants.
versets.anglais: And obey Allah and His Messenger, and do not dispute and [thus] lose courage and [then] your strength would depart; and be patient. Indeed, Allah is with the patient

versets.arabe: وَلَا تَكُونُوا كَالَّذِينَ خَرَجُوا مِن دِيَارِهِم بَطَرًا وَرِئَاءَ النَّاسِ وَيَصُدُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ۚ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ مُحِيطٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa la takunu kalladhina kharaju min diyarihim bataran wa ri'a'an-nasi wa yasudduna 'an sabilillah wallahu bima ya'maluna muhit
versets.francais: Ne soyez pas comme ceux qui sont sortis de leurs demeures avec arrogance et ostentation, obstruant le chemin d'Allah. Allah cerne ce qu'ils font.
versets.anglais: And do not be like those who came forth from their homes insolently and to be seen by people and avert [them] from the way of Allah. And Allah is encompassing of what they do

versets.arabe: وَإِذْ زَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الشَّيْطَانُ أَعْمَالَهُمْ وَقَالَ لَا غَالِبَ لَكُمُ الْيَوْمَ مِنَ النَّاسِ وَإِنِّي جَارٌ لَّكُمْ ۖ فَلَمَّا تَرَاءَتِ الْفِئَتَانِ نَكَصَ عَلَىٰ عَقِبَيْهِ وَقَالَ إِنِّي بَرِيءٌ مِّنكُمْ إِنِّي أَرَىٰ مَا لَا تَرَوْنَ إِنِّي أَخَافُ اللَّهَ ۚ وَاللَّهُ شَدِيدُ الْعِقَابِ
versets.phonetique: Wa idh zayyana lahumush-shaytanu a'malahum wa qala la ghaliba lakumul-yawma minan-nasi wa inni jarun lakum falamma tara'atil-fi'atani nakasa 'ala 'aqibayhi wa qala inni bari'um minkum inni ara ma la tarawna inni akhafullaha wallahu shadidur-'iqab
versets.francais: Quand le Diable leur enjoliva leurs actes en disant : "Nul parmi les gens ne peut vous vaincre aujourd'hui, et je suis votre protecteur." Mais quand les deux troupes se trouvèrent face à face, il tourna les talons en disant : "Je me dissocie de vous. Je vois ce que vous ne voyez pas. Je crains Allah." Allah est sévère dans le châtiment.
versets.anglais: And [remember] when Satan made their deeds pleasing to them and said, "No one can overcome you today from among the people, and indeed, I am your protector." But when the two armies sighted each other, he turned on his heels and said, "Indeed, I am disassociated from you. Indeed, I see what you do not see; indeed I fear Allah. And Allah is severe in penalty

versets.arabe: إِذْ يَقُولُ الْمُنَافِقُونَ وَالَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ غَرَّ هَٰؤُلَاءِ دِينُهُمْ ۗ وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Idh yaqulul-munafiquna walladhina fi qulubihim maradun gharra ha'ula'i dinuhum wa may-yatawakkal 'alallahi fa'innallaha 'azizun hakim
versets.francais: Quand les hypocrites et ceux dont les cœurs sont malades disaient : "Leur religion les a trompés." Mais quiconque s'en remet à Allah... Allah est vraiment Puissant et Sage.
versets.anglais: [Remember] when the hypocrites and those in whose hearts was disease said, "Their religion has deluded those [Muslims]." But whoever relies upon Allah - then indeed, Allah is Exalted in Might and Wise

versets.arabe: وَلَوْ تَرَىٰ إِذْ يَتَوَفَّى الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا ۙ الْمَلَائِكَةُ يَضْرِبُونَ وُجُوهَهُمْ وَأَدْبَارَهُمْ وَذُوقُوا عَذَابَ الْحَرِيقِ
versets.phonetique: Wa law tara idh yatawaffall-ladhina kafarulmalaa'ikatu yadribuna wujuhahum wa adbarahum wa dhuqu 'adhabal-hariq
versets.francais: Si tu voyais quand les anges rappellent les mécréants, ils les frappent au visage et dans le dos : "Goûtez le châtiment du feu brûlant."
versets.anglais: And if you could but see when the angels take the souls of those who disbelieved... They are striking their faces and their backs and [saying], "Taste the punishment of the Burning Fire

versets.arabe: ذَٰلِكَ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ لَيْسَ بِظَلَّامٍ لِّلْعَبِيدِ
versets.phonetique: Dhalika bima qaddamat aydikum wa annallaha laysa bidhallamin lil-'abid
versets.francais: Cela pour ce que vos mains ont accompli, et parce qu'Allah n'est pas injuste envers Ses serviteurs.
versets.anglais: That is for what your hands have put forth [of evil] and because Allah is not ever unjust to His servants

versets.arabe: كَدَأْبِ آلِ فِرْعَوْنَ ۙ وَالَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ كَفَرُوا بِآيَاتِ اللَّهِ فَأَخَذَهُمُ اللَّهُ بِذُنُوبِهِمْ ۗ إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَوِيٌّ شَدِيدُ الْعِقَابِ
versets.phonetique: Kada'bi ali fir'awna walladhina min qablihim kafaru bi'ayatillahi fa'akhadhahumullahu bidhunubihim innallaha qawiyyun shadidur-'iqab
versets.francais: Comme la coutume de la famille de Pharaon et de ceux qui vivaient avant eux : ils avaient mécru en les versets d'Allah et Allah les a saisis à cause de leurs péchés. Allah est Fort, sévère dans le châtiment.
versets.anglais: [Theirs is] like the custom of the people of Pharaoh and of those before them. They disbelieved in the signs of Allah, so Allah seized them for their sins. Indeed, Allah is Powerful and severe in penalty

versets.arabe: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ اللَّهَ لَمْ يَكُ مُغَيِّرًا نِّعْمَةً أَنْعَمَهَا عَلَىٰ قَوْمٍ حَتَّىٰ يُغَيِّرُوا مَا بِأَنفُسِهِمْ ۙ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Dhalika bi'annallaha lam yaku mughayyiran ni'matan an'amaha 'ala qawmin hatta yughayyiru ma bi'anfusihim wa annallaha sami'un 'alim
versets.francais: Cela parce qu'Allah ne modifie pas un bienfait qu'Il a accordé à un peuple tant que celui-ci ne change pas ce qui est en lui-même. Allah est Audient et Omniscient.
