versets.anglais: That is because Allah would not change a favor which He had bestowed upon a people until they change what is within themselves. And indeed, Allah is Hearing and Knowing

versets.arabe: كَدَأْبِ آلِ فِرْعَوْنَ ۙ وَالَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ كَذَّبُوا بِآيَاتِ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَهْلَكْنَاهُم بِذُنُوبِهِمْ وَأَغْرَقْنَا آلَ فِرْعَوْنَ ۚ وَكُلٌّ كَانُوا ظَالِمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Kada'bi ali fir'awna walladhina min qablihim kadhdhabu bi'ayati rabbihim fa'ahlaknahum bidhunubihim wa aghraqna ala fir'awn wa kullun kanu dhalimin
versets.francais: Comme la coutume de la famille de Pharaon et de ceux qui vivaient avant eux : ils traitèrent de mensonges les versets de leur Seigneur et Nous les avons détruits à cause de leurs péchés et Nous avons noyé la famille de Pharaon. Ils étaient tous injustes.
versets.anglais: [Theirs is] like the custom of the people of Pharaoh and of those before them. They denied the signs of their Lord, so We destroyed them for their sins, and We drowned the people of Pharaoh. And all [of them] were wrongdoers

versets.arabe: إِنَّ شَرَّ الدَّوَابِّ عِندَ اللَّهِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا فَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
versets.phonetique: Inna sharrad-dawaabbi 'indallahil-ladhina kafaru fahum la yu'minun
versets.francais: Les pires des créatures auprès d'Allah sont ceux qui ont mécru et ne croiront pas.
versets.anglais: Indeed, the worst of living creatures in the sight of Allah are those who have disbelieved, and they will not [ever] believe

versets.arabe: الَّذِينَ عَاهَدتَّ مِنْهُمْ ثُمَّ يَنقُضُونَ عَهْدَهُمْ فِي كُلِّ مَرَّةٍ وَهُمْ لَا يَتَّقُونَ
versets.phonetique: Alladhina 'ahatta minhum thumma yanquduna 'ahdahum fi kulli marratiw wa hum la yattaqun
versets.francais: Ceux avec qui tu as conclu une alliance et qui violent leur alliance à chaque fois sans avoir la crainte.
versets.anglais: The ones with whom you made a treaty but then they break their pledge every time, and they do not fear Allah

versets.arabe: فَإِمَّا تَثْقَفَنَّهُمْ فِي الْحَرْبِ فَشَرِّدْ بِهِم مَّنْ خَلْفَهُمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَذَّكَّرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Fa'imma tathqafannahum fil-harbi fasharrid bihim man khalfahum la'allahum yadhdhakkarun
versets.francais: Si tu les surprends en pleine guerre, disperse par leur sort ceux qui sont derrière eux afin qu'ils se souviennent.
versets.anglais: So if you, [O Muhammad], gain dominance over them in war, disperse by [means of] them those behind them that perhaps they will be reminded

versets.arabe: وَإِمَّا تَخَافَنَّ مِن قَوْمٍ خِيَانَةً فَانبِذْ إِلَيْهِمْ عَلَىٰ سَوَاءٍ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ الْخَائِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa imma takhafanna min qawmin khiyanatan fanbidh ilayhim 'ala sawa'in innallaha la yuhibbul-kha'inin
versets.francais: Si tu crains vraiment la trahison d'un peuple, dénonce l'alliance en lui rendant la pareille. Allah n'aime pas les traîtres.
versets.anglais: If you [have reason to] fear from a people betrayal, throw [their treaty] back to them, [putting you] on equal terms. Indeed, Allah does not like traitors

versets.arabe: وَلَا يَحْسَبَنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا سَبَقُوا ۚ إِنَّهُمْ لَا يُعْجِزُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa la yahsabannal-ladhina kafaru sabaqu innahum la yu'jizun
versets.francais: Que les mécréants ne croient pas avoir pris de l'avance. Ils ne sont pas en mesure de Nous réduire à l'impuissance.
versets.anglais: And let not those who disbelieve think they will escape. Indeed, they will not cause failure [to Allah]

versets.arabe: وَأَعِدُّوا لَهُم مَّا اسْتَطَعْتُم مِّن قُوَّةٍ وَمِن رِّبَاطِ الْخَيْلِ تُرْهِبُونَ بِهِ عَدُوَّ اللَّهِ وَعَدُوَّكُمْ وَآخَرِينَ مِن دُونِهِمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَهُمُ اللَّهُ يَعْلَمُهُمْ ۚ وَمَا تُنفِقُوا مِن شَيْءٍ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ يُوَفَّ إِلَيْكُمْ وَأَنتُمْ لَا تُظْلَمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa a'iddu lahum mas-tata'tum min quwwatiw wa mir-ribatil-khayli turhibuna bihi 'aduwwallahi wa 'aduwwakum wa akharina min dunihim la ta'lamuhumullahu ya'lamuhum wa ma tunfiqu min shay'in fi sabilillahi yuwaffa ilaykum wa antum la tudhlamun
versets.francais: Préparez contre eux tout ce que vous pouvez comme force et comme cavalerie en alerte pour terroriser l'ennemi d'Allah et votre ennemi, et d'autres en dehors d'eux que vous ne connaissez pas mais qu'Allah connaît. Tout ce que vous dépensez dans le chemin d'Allah vous sera pleinement restitué et vous ne serez pas lésés.
versets.anglais: And prepare against them whatever you are able of power and of steeds of war by which you may terrify the enemy of Allah and your enemy and others besides them whom you do not know [but] whom Allah knows. And whatever you spend in the cause of Allah will be fully repaid to you, and you will not be wronged

versets.arabe: وَإِن جَنَحُوا لِلسَّلْمِ فَاجْنَحْ لَهَا وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّهُ هُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
versets.phonetique: Wa in janahluu lis-salmi fajnah laha wa tawakkal 'alallahi innahu huwas-sami'ul-'alim
versets.francais: S'ils inclinent à la paix, inclines-y toi aussi et fais confiance à Allah. C'est Lui l'Audient, l'Omniscient.
versets.anglais: And if they incline to peace, then incline to it [also] and rely upon Allah. Indeed, it is He who is the Hearing, the Knowing

versets.arabe: وَإِن يُرِيدُوا أَن يَخْدَعُوكَ فَإِنَّ حَسْبَكَ اللَّهُ ۚ هُوَ الَّذِي أَيَّدَكَ بِنَصْرِهِ وَبِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa iy yuriidu ay yakhda'uka fa'inna hasbakallahu huwal-ladhee ayyadaka binasrihi wa bil-mu'minin
versets.francais: S'ils veulent te tromper, Allah te suffit. C'est Lui qui t'a soutenu de Son aide et des croyants.
versets.anglais: But if they intend to deceive you - then sufficient for you is Allah. It is He who supported you with His help and with the believers

versets.arabe: وَأَلَّفَ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِهِمْ ۚ لَوْ أَنفَقْتَ مَا فِي الْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا مَّا أَلَّفْتَ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِهِمْ وَلَٰكِنَّ اللَّهَ أَلَّفَ بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa allafa bayna qulubihim law anfaqta ma fil-ardi jami'am ma allafta bayna qulubihim wa lakinnallaha allafa baynahum innahu 'azizun hakim
versets.francais: Et Il a uni leurs cœurs. Si tu avais dépensé tout ce qui est sur la terre, tu n'aurais pas uni leurs cœurs, mais Allah les a unis. Il est Puissant et Sage.
versets.anglais: And brought together their hearts. If you had spent all that is in the earth, you could not have brought their hearts together; but Allah brought them together. Indeed, He is Exalted in Might and Wise

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ حَسْبُكَ اللَّهُ وَمَنِ اتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuhan-nabiyyu hasbukallahu wa manit-taba'aka minal-mu'minin
versets.francais: Ô Prophète, Allah te suffit, ainsi qu'aux croyants qui te suivent.
versets.anglais: O Prophet, sufficient for you is Allah and for whoever follows you of the believers

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ حَرِّضِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَى الْقِتَالِ ۚ إِن يَكُن مِّنكُمْ عِشْرُونَ صَابِرُونَ يَغْلِبُوا مِائَتَيْنِ ۚ وَإِن يَكُن مِّنكُم مِّائَةٌ يَغْلِبُوا أَلْفًا مِّنَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا بِأَنَّهُمْ قَوْمٌ لَّا يَفْقَهُونَ
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuhan-nabiyyu harridhil-mu'minina 'alal-qital iy yakum minkum 'ishruuna sabirun yaghlibuu mi'atayn wa iy yakum minkum mi'atun yaghlibuu alfam minal-ladhina kafaru bi'annahum qawmul la yafqahun
versets.francais: Ô Prophète, incite les croyants au combat. S'il se trouve parmi vous vingt endurants, ils en vaincront deux cents. S'il s'en trouve cent, ils vaincront mille mécréants, parce que ce sont des gens qui ne comprennent pas.
versets.anglais: O Prophet, urge the believers to battle. If there are among you twenty [who are] steadfast, they will overcome two hundred. And if there are among you one hundred [who are] steadfast, they will overcome a thousand of those who have disbelieved because they are a people who do not understand

versets.arabe: الْآنَ خَفَّفَ اللَّهُ عَنكُمْ وَعَلِمَ أَنَّ فِيكُمْ ضَعْفًا ۚ فَإِن يَكُن مِّنكُم مِّائَةٌ صَابِرَةٌ يَغْلِبُوا مِائَتَيْنِ ۚ وَإِن يَكُن مِّنكُمْ أَلْفٌ يَغْلِبُوا أَلْفَيْنِ بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ ۗ وَاللَّهُ مَعَ الصَّابِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Al-ana khaffafallahu 'ankum wa 'alima anna fikum da'fan fa'iy yakum minkum mi'atun sabiratun yaghlibuu mi'atayn wa iy yakum minkum alfun yaghlibuu alfayni bi'idhnillah wallahu ma'as-sabirin
versets.francais: Maintenant Allah vous a allégé le fardeau sachant qu'il y a en vous de la faiblesse. S'il se trouve cent endurants parmi vous, ils en vaincront deux cents, et s'il s'en trouve mille, ils en vaincront deux mille avec la permission d'Allah. Allah est avec les endurants.
versets.anglais: Now, Allah has lightened [the hardship] for you, and He knows that among you is weakness. So if there are from you one hundred [who are] steadfast, they will overcome two hundred. And if there are among you a thousand, they will overcome two thousand by permission of Allah. And Allah is with the steadfast

versets.arabe: مَا كَانَ لِنَبِيٍّ أَن يَكُونَ لَهُ أَسْرَىٰ حَتَّىٰ يُثْخِنَ فِي الْأَرْضِ ۚ تُرِيدُونَ عَرَضَ الدُّنْيَا وَاللَّهُ يُرِيدُ الْآخِرَةَ ۗ وَاللَّهُ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Ma kana linabiyyin ay yakuna lahu asra hatta yuthkhina fil-ardi turiduna 'aradad-dunya wallahu yuridul-akhirah wallahu 'azizun hakim
versets.francais: Il ne convient pas à un prophète d'avoir des captifs avant d'avoir suffisamment dominé dans le pays. Vous voulez les biens d'ici-bas alors qu'Allah veut l'au-delà. Allah est Puissant et Sage.
versets.anglais: It is not for a prophet to have captives [of war] until he inflicts a massacre [upon Allah 's enemies] in the land. Some Muslims desire the commodities of this world, but Allah desires [for you] the Hereafter. And Allah is Exalted in Might and Wise

versets.arabe: لَّوْلَا كِتَابٌ مِّنَ اللَّهِ سَبَقَ لَمَسَّكُمْ فِيمَا أَخَذْتُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Lawla kitabum minallahi sabaqa lamassakum fima akhadhtum 'adhabun 'azim
versets.francais: S'il n'y avait pas un décret antérieur d'Allah, un énorme châtiment vous aurait atteint pour ce que vous avez pris.
versets.anglais: If not for a decree from Allah that preceded, you would have been touched for what you took by a great punishment

versets.arabe: فَكُلُوا مِمَّا غَنِمْتُمْ حَلَالًا طَيِّبًا ۚ وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Fakulu mimma ghanimtum halalan tayyibaw wattaqullaha innallaha ghafururr-rahim
versets.francais: Mangez donc de ce que vous avez pris comme butin, ce qui est licite et bon, et craignez Allah. Allah est Pardonneur et Miséricordieux.
versets.anglais: So consume what you have taken of war booty [as being] lawful and good, and fear Allah. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ قُل لِّمَن فِي أَيْدِيكُم مِّنَ الْأَسْرَىٰ إِن يَعْلَمِ اللَّهُ فِي قُلُوبِكُمْ خَيْرًا يُؤْتِكُمْ خَيْرًا مِّمَّا أُخِذَ مِنكُمْ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ۗ وَاللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuhan-nabiyyu qul liman fi aydikum minal-asra iy ya'lamillahu fi qulubikum khayray yu'tikum khayram mimma ukhdha minkum wa yaghfir lakum wallahu ghafururr-rahim
versets.francais: Ô Prophète, dis aux captifs qui sont entre vos mains : "Si Allah connaît quelque bien dans vos cœurs, Il vous donnera mieux que ce qu'on vous a pris et vous pardonnera." Allah est Pardonneur et Miséricordieux.
versets.anglais: O Prophet, say to whoever is in your hands of the captives, "If Allah knows [any] good in your hearts, He will give you [something] better than what was taken from you, and He will forgive you; and Allah is Forgiving and Merciful

versets.arabe: وَإِن يُرِيدُوا خِيَانَتَكَ فَقَدْ خَانُوا اللَّهَ مِن قَبْلُ فَأَمْكَنَ مِنْهُمْ ۗ وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa iy yuriidu khiyanataka faqad khanu-llaha min qablu fa'amkana minhum wallahu 'alimun hakim
versets.francais: S'ils veulent te trahir, ils ont déjà trahi Allah auparavant et Il a eu prise sur eux. Allah est Omniscient et Sage.
versets.anglais: But if they intend to betray you - then they have already betrayed Allah before, and He empowered [you] over them. And Allah is Knowing and Wise

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَهَاجَرُوا وَجَاهَدُوا بِأَمْوَالِهِمْ وَأَنفُسِهِمْ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَالَّذِينَ آوَوا وَّنَصَرُوا أُولَٰئِكَ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلِيَاءُ بَعْضٍ
versets.phonetique: Innal-ladhina amanu wa hajaru wa jahadu bi'amwalihim wa anfusihim fi sabilillahi walladhina awaw wa nasaru ula'ika ba'duhum awliya'u ba'd
versets.francais: Ceux qui ont cru, émigré et combattu de leurs biens et de leurs personnes dans le chemin d'Allah, et ceux qui ont donné asile et porté secours, ceux-là sont alliés les uns des autres.
versets.anglais: Indeed, those who have believed and emigrated and fought with their wealth and lives in the cause of Allah and those who gave shelter and aided - they are allies of one another. But those who believed and did not emigrate - for you there is no guardianship of them until they emigrate. And if they seek help of you for the religion, then you must help, except against a people between yourselves and whom is a treaty. And Allah is Seeing of what you do

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَلَمْ يُهَاجِرُوا مَا لَكُم مِّن وَلَايَتِهِم مِّن شَيْءٍ حَتَّىٰ يُهَاجِرُوا ۚ وَإِنِ اسْتَنصَرُوكُمْ فِي الدِّينِ فَعَلَيْكُمُ النَّصْرُ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ قَوْمٍ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَهُم مِّيثَاقٌ ۗ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
versets.phonetique: Walladhina amanu wa lam yuhajiru ma lakum min walayatihim min shay'in hatta yuhajiru wa inis-tansarukum fid-dini fa'alaykumun-nasru illa 'ala qawmin baynakum wa baynahum mithaq wallahu bima ta'maluna basir
versets.francais: Et ceux qui ont cru sans avoir émigré, vous n'êtes en aucune façon leurs alliés tant qu'ils n'auront pas émigré. S'ils vous demandent secours pour la religion, à vous de les secourir, sauf contre un peuple avec lequel vous avez un traité. Allah voit bien ce que vous faites.
versets.anglais: And those who disbelieved are allies of one another. If you do not do so, there will be fitnah on earth and great corruption

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلِيَاءُ بَعْضٍ ۚ إِلَّا تَفْعَلُوهُ تَكُن فِتْنَةٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَفَسَادٌ كَبِيرٌ
versets.phonetique: Walladhina kafaru ba'duhum awliya'u ba'din illa taf'aluhu takun fitnatun fil-ardi wa fasadun kabir
versets.francais: Les mécréants sont alliés les uns des autres. Si vous ne faites pas cela, il y aura discorde sur la terre et grande corruption.
versets.anglais: But those who have believed and emigrated and fought in the cause of Allah and those who gave shelter and aided - it is they who are the believers, truly. For them is forgiveness and noble provision

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَهَاجَرُوا وَجَاهَدُوا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَالَّذِينَ آوَوا وَّنَصَرُوا أُولَٰئِكَ هُمُ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ حَقًّا ۚ لَّهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَرِزْقٌ كَرِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Walladhina amanu wa hajaru wa jahadu fi sabilillahi walladhina awaw wa nasaru ula'ika humul-mu'minuna haqqan lahum maghfiratuw wa rizqun karim
versets.francais: Ceux qui ont cru, émigré et combattu dans le chemin d'Allah, et ceux qui ont donné asile et porté secours, ceux-là sont les vrais croyants. Il y a pour eux pardon et généreuse attribution.
versets.anglais: And those who believed after [the initial emigration] and emigrated and fought with you - they are of you. But those of [blood] relationship are more entitled [to inheritance] in the decree of Allah. Indeed, Allah is Knowing of all things

versets.arabe: بَرَاءَةٌ مِّنَ اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ إِلَى الَّذِينَ عَاهَدتُّم مِّنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ
versets.phonetique: Baraa'atun mina Allahi wa rasoolihi ila allatheena AAahadtum mina almushrikeen
versets.francais: Désaveu de la part d'Allah et de Son messager à l'égard des associateurs avec qui vous avez conclu un pacte.
versets.anglais: [This is a declaration of] disassociation, from Allah and His Messenger, to those with whom you had made a treaty among the polytheists

versets.arabe: فَسِيحُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ أَرْبَعَةَ أَشْهُرٍ وَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّكُمْ غَيْرُ مُعْجِزِي اللَّهِ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ مُخْزِي الْكَافِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Faseeho fee al-ardi arbaAAata ashhurin waiAAlamoo annakum ghayru muAAjizee Allahi waanna Allaha mukhzee alkafireem
versets.francais: Parcourez donc librement le pays pendant quatre mois, et sachez que vous ne pouvez point réduire Allah à l'impuissance, et qu'Allah couvre de honte les infidèles.
versets.anglais: So travel freely, [O disbelievers], throughout the land [during] four months but know that you cannot cause failure to Allah and that Allah will disgrace the disbelievers

versets.arabe: وَأَذَانٌ مِّنَ اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ إِلَى النَّاسِ يَوْمَ الْحَجِّ الْأَكْبَرِ أَنَّ اللَّهَ بَرِيءٌ مِّنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ وَرَسُولُهُ
versets.phonetique: Waathanun mina Allahi warasoolihi ila alnnasi yawma alhajji al-akbari anna Allaha bareeon mina almushrikeena warasooluh
versets.francais: Et proclamation de la part d'Allah et de Son messager aux gens au grand jour du pèlerinage qu'Allah est quitte envers les associateurs, ainsi que Son messager.
versets.anglais: And [it is] an announcement from Allah and His Messenger to the people on the day of the greater pilgrimage that Allah is disassociated from the disbelievers, and [so is] His Messenger. So if you repent, that is best for you; but if you turn away - then know that you will not cause failure to Allah. And give tidings to those who disbelieve of a painful punishment

versets.arabe: إِلَّا الَّذِينَ عَاهَدتُّم مِّنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَنقُصُوكُمْ شَيْئًا وَلَمْ يُظَاهِرُوا عَلَيْكُمْ أَحَدًا فَأَتِمُّوا إِلَيْهِمْ عَهْدَهُمْ إِلَىٰ مُدَّتِهِمْ
versets.phonetique: Illa allatheena AAahadtum mina almushrikeena thumma lam yanqusookum shay'an walam yuthaahiroo AAalaykum ahadan faatimmoo ilayhim AAahdahum ila muddatihim
versets.francais: Sauf les associateurs avec qui vous avez conclu un pacte, qui ne vous ont rien manqué et n'ont soutenu personne contre vous. Respectez donc pour eux leur pacte jusqu'à leur terme.
versets.anglais: Excepted are those with whom you made a treaty among the polytheists and then they have not been deficient toward you in anything or supported anyone against you; so complete for them their treaty until their term [has ended]. Indeed, Allah loves the righteous [who fear Him]

versets.arabe: فَإِذَا انسَلَخَ الْأَشْهُرُ الْحُرُمُ فَاقْتُلُوا الْمُشْرِكِينَ حَيْثُ وَجَدتُّمُوهُمْ وَخُذُوهُمْ وَاحْصُرُوهُمْ وَاقْعُدُوا لَهُمْ كُلَّ مَرْصَدٍ
versets.phonetique: Fa-itha insalakha al-ashhuru alhurumu faqtuloo almushrikeena haythu wajadtumoohum wakhuthoohum wahsuroohum waqAAudoo lahum kulla marsad
versets.francais: Quand les mois sacrés expirent, tuez les associateurs où que vous les trouviez. Capturez-les, assiégez-les et guettez-les dans toute embuscade.
versets.anglais: And when the sacred months have passed, then kill the polytheists wherever you find them and capture them and besiege them and sit in wait for them at every place of ambush. But if they should repent, establish prayer, and give zakah, let them [go] on their way. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful

versets.arabe: وَإِنْ أَحَدٌ مِّنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ اسْتَجَارَكَ فَأَجِرْهُ حَتَّىٰ يَسْمَعَ كَلَامَ اللَّهِ ثُمَّ أَبْلِغْهُ مَأْمَنَهُ
versets.phonetique: Wa-in ahadun mina almushrikeena istajaraka faajirhu hatta yasmaAAa kalama Allahi thumma ablighhu ma'manah
versets.francais: Et si l'un des associateurs te demande asile, accorde-lui, jusqu'à ce qu'il entende la parole d'Allah, puis fais-le parvenir à son lieu de sécurité.
versets.anglais: And if any one of the polytheists seeks your protection, then grant him protection so that he may hear the words of Allah. Then deliver him to his place of safety. That is because they are a people who do not know

versets.arabe: كَيْفَ يَكُونُ لِلْمُشْرِكِينَ عَهْدٌ عِندَ اللَّهِ وَعِندَ رَسُولِهِ إِلَّا الَّذِينَ عَاهَدتُّمْ عِندَ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ
versets.phonetique: Kayfa yakoonu lilmushrikeena AAahdun AAinda Allahi waAAinda rasoolihi illa allatheena AAahadtum AAinda almasjidi alharam
versets.francais: Comment les associateurs auraient-ils un pacte auprès d'Allah et auprès de Son messager? Sauf ceux avec qui vous avez conclu un pacte près de la Mosquée sacrée.
versets.anglais: How can there be for the polytheists a treaty in the sight of Allah and with His Messenger, except for those with whom you made a treaty at al-Masjid al-Haram? So as long as they are upright toward you, be upright toward them. Indeed, Allah loves the righteous [who fear Him]

versets.arabe: كَيْفَ وَإِن يَظْهَرُوا عَلَيْكُمْ لَا يَرْقُبُوا فِيكُمْ إِلًّا وَلَا ذِمَّةً
versets.phonetique: Kayfa wa-in yathharoo AAalaykum la yarquboo feekum illan wala thimmah
versets.francais: Comment en serait-il autrement? Car s'ils avaient le dessus sur vous, ils n'observeraient à votre égard ni parenté ni pacte.
versets.anglais: How [can there be a treaty] while, if they gain dominance over you, they do not observe concerning you any pact of kinship or covenant of protection? They satisfy you with their mouths, but their hearts refuse [compliance], and most of them are defiantly disobedient

versets.arabe: اشْتَرَوْا بِآيَاتِ اللَّهِ ثَمَنًا قَلِيلًا فَصَدُّوا عَن سَبِيلِهِ إِنَّهُمْ سَاءَ مَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Ishtaraw bi-ayati Allahi thamanan qaleelan fasaddoo AAan sabeelihi innahum saa ma kanoo yaAAmaloon
versets.francais: Ils ont troqué les versets d'Allah contre un faible prix, et ils ont fait obstacle à Son sentier. Certes, ce qu'ils font est mauvais.
versets.anglais: They have exchanged the signs of Allah for a small price and averted [people] from His way. Indeed, it was evil that they were doing

versets.arabe: لَا يَرْقُبُونَ فِي مُؤْمِنٍ إِلًّا وَلَا ذِمَّةً وَأُولَٰئِكَ هُمُ الْمُعْتَدُونَ
versets.phonetique: La yarquboona fee mu'minin illan wala thimmatan waolaika humu almuAAtadoon
versets.francais: Ils n'observent, envers un croyant, ni parenté ni pacte; et ceux-là sont les transgresseurs.
versets.anglais: They do not observe toward a believer any pact of kinship or covenant of protection. And it is they who are the transgressors

versets.arabe: فَإِن تَابُوا وَأَقَامُوا الصَّلَاةَ وَآتَوُا الزَّكَاةَ فَإِخْوَانُكُمْ فِي الدِّينِ
versets.phonetique: Fa-in taboo waaqamoo alssalata waatawoo alzzakata fa-ikhwanukum fee alddeen
versets.francais: S'ils se repentent, accomplissent la Salat et acquittent la Zakat, ils sont vos frères en religion.
versets.anglais: But if they repent, establish prayer, and give zakah, then they are your brothers in religion; and We detail the verses for a people who know

versets.arabe: وَإِن نَّكَثُوا أَيْمَانَهُم مِّن بَعْدِ عَهْدِهِمْ وَطَعَنُوا فِي دِينِكُمْ فَقَاتِلُوا أَئِمَّةَ الْكُفْرِ
versets.phonetique: Wa-in nakathoo aymanahum min baAAdi AAahdihim wataAAanoo fee deenikum faqatiloo a'immata alkufr
versets.francais: S'ils violent leurs serments après leur engagement et attaquent votre religion, combattez les chefs des mécréants.
versets.anglais: And if they break their oaths after their treaty and defame your religion, then fight the leaders of disbelief, for indeed, there are no oaths [sacred] to them; [fight them that] they might cease

versets.arabe: أَلَا تُقَاتِلُونَ قَوْمًا نَّكَثُوا أَيْمَانَهُمْ وَهَمُّوا بِإِخْرَاجِ الرَّسُولِ وَهُم بَدَءُوكُمْ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ
versets.phonetique: Ala tuqatilona qawman nakathoo aymanahum wahammoo bi-ikhraji alrrasooli wahum badaookum awwala marrah
versets.francais: Ne combattrez-vous pas des gens qui ont violé leurs serments, qui ont voulu expulser le Messager et qui les premiers vous ont attaqués?
versets.anglais: Would you not fight a people who broke their oaths and determined to expel the Messenger, and they had begun [the attack upon] you the first time? Do you fear them? But Allah has more right that you should fear Him, if you are [truly] believers

versets.arabe: قَاتِلُوهُمْ يُعَذِّبْهُمُ اللَّهُ بِأَيْدِيكُمْ وَيُخْزِهِمْ وَيَنصُرْكُمْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَيَشْفِ صُدُورَ قَوْمٍ مُّؤْمِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qatilohum yuAAaththibhumu Allahu bi-aydeekum wayukhzihim wayansurkum AAalayhim wayashfi sudoora qawmin mu'mineen
versets.francais: Combattez-les! Allah les châtiera par vos mains, les couvrira de honte, vous donnera la victoire sur eux et guérira les cœurs de gens croyants.
versets.anglais: Fight them; Allah will punish them by your hands and will disgrace them and give you victory over them and satisfy the breasts of a believing people

versets.arabe: وَيُذْهِبْ غَيْظَ قُلُوبِهِمْ وَيَتُوبُ اللَّهُ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَاءُ وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Wayuthhib ghaytha quloobihim wayatoobu Allahu AAala man yashao wallahu AAaleemun hakeem
versets.francais: Et Il fera partir la rage de leurs cœurs. Allah accorde Son pardon à qui Il veut. Allah est Omniscient et Sage.
versets.anglais: And remove the fury in the believers' hearts. And Allah turns in forgiveness to whom He wills; and Allah is Knowing and Wise

versets.arabe: أَمْ حَسِبْتُمْ أَن تُتْرَكُوا وَلَمَّا يَعْلَمِ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ جَاهَدُوا مِنكُمْ وَلَمْ يَتَّخِذُوا مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ وَلَا رَسُولِهِ وَلَا الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَلِيجَةً
versets.phonetique: Am hasibtum an tutrakou walamma yaAAlami Allahu allatheena jahadoo minkum walam yattakhithoo min dooni Allahi wala rasoolihi wala almu'mineena waleejah
versets.francais: Pensez-vous qu'on vous laissera ainsi, sans qu'Allah ne distingue ceux parmi vous qui luttent et qui ne prennent pas d'alliés en dehors d'Allah, de Son messager et des croyants?
versets.anglais: Do you think that you will be left [as you are] while Allah has not yet made evident those among you who strive [for His cause] and do not take other than Allah, His Messenger and the believers as intimates? And Allah is Acquainted with what you do

versets.arabe: مَا كَانَ لِلْمُشْرِكِينَ أَن يَعْمُرُوا مَسَاجِدَ اللَّهِ شَاهِدِينَ عَلَىٰ أَنفُسِهِم بِالْكُفْرِ
versets.phonetique: Ma kana lilmushrikeena an yaAAmuroo masajida Allahi shahideena AAala anfusihim bilkufr
versets.francais: Il n'appartient pas aux associateurs d'entretenir les mosquées d'Allah, tout en témoignant eux-mêmes de leur propre mécréance.
versets.anglais: It is not for the polytheists to maintain the mosques of Allah [while] witnessing against themselves with disbelief. [For] those, their deeds have become worthless, and in the Fire they will abide eternally

versets.arabe: إِنَّمَا يَعْمُرُ مَسَاجِدَ اللَّهِ مَنْ آمَنَ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ وَأَقَامَ الصَّلَاةَ وَآتَى الزَّكَاةَ وَلَمْ يَخْشَ إِلَّا اللَّهَ
versets.phonetique: Innama yaAAmuru masajida Allahi man amana billahi walyawmi al-akhiri waaqama alssalata waataa alzzakata walam yakhsha illa Allah
versets.francais: Seuls entretiennent les mosquées d'Allah ceux qui croient en Allah et au Jour dernier, accomplissent la Salat, acquittent la Zakat et ne craignent qu'Allah.
versets.anglais: The mosques of Allah are only to be maintained by those who believe in Allah and the Last Day and establish prayer and give zakah and do not fear except Allah, for it is expected that those will be of the [rightly] guided

versets.arabe: أَجَعَلْتُمْ سِقَايَةَ الْحَاجِّ وَعِمَارَةَ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ كَمَنْ آمَنَ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ وَجَاهَدَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ
versets.phonetique: AjaAAaltum siqayata alhajji waAAimarata almasjidi alharami kaman amana billahi walyawmi al-akhiri wajahada fee sabeeli Allah
versets.francais: Avez-vous assimilé le fait d'abreuver les pèlerins et d'entretenir la Mosquée sacrée à celui qui a cru en Allah et au Jour dernier et qui lutte dans le sentier d'Allah?
versets.anglais: Have you made the providing of water for the pilgrim and the maintenance of al-Masjid al-Haram equal to [the deeds of] one who believes in Allah and the Last Day and strives in the cause of Allah? They are not equal in the sight of Allah. And Allah does not guide the wrongdoing people

versets.arabe: الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَهَاجَرُوا وَجَاهَدُوا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ بِأَمْوَالِهِمْ وَأَنفُسِهِمْ أَعْظَمُ دَرَجَةً عِندَ اللَّهِ
versets.phonetique: Allatheena amanoo wahajaroo wajahadoo fee sabeeli Allahi bi-amwalihim waanfusihim aAAthamu darajatan AAinda Allah
versets.francais: Ceux qui ont cru, émigré et lutté dans le sentier d'Allah avec leurs biens et leurs personnes ont le plus haut rang auprès d'Allah.
versets.anglais: The ones who have believed, emigrated and striven in the cause of Allah with their wealth and their lives are greater in rank in the sight of Allah. And it is those who are the attainers [of success]

versets.arabe: يُبَشِّرُهُمْ رَبُّهُم بِرَحْمَةٍ مِّنْهُ وَرِضْوَانٍ وَجَنَّاتٍ لَّهُمْ فِيهَا نَعِيمٌ مُّقِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Yubashshiruhum rabbuhum birahmatun minhu waridwanin wajannatin lahum feeha naAAeemun muqeem
versets.francais: Leur Seigneur leur annonce une miséricorde venant de Lui, un agrément et des jardins où il y aura pour eux un bonheur permanent.
versets.anglais: Their Lord gives them good tidings of mercy from Him and approval and of gardens for them wherein is enduring pleasure

versets.arabe: خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا أَبَدًا إِنَّ اللَّهَ عِندَهُ أَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Khalideena feeha abadan inna Allaha AAindahu ajrun AAatheem
versets.francais: Ils y demeureront éternellement. Certes, Allah détient une récompense immense.
versets.anglais: [They will be] abiding therein forever. Indeed, Allah has with Him a great reward

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تَتَّخِذُوا آبَاءَكُمْ وَإِخْوَانَكُمْ أَوْلِيَاءَ إِنِ اسْتَحَبُّوا الْكُفْرَ عَلَى الْإِيمَانِ
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la tattakhithoo abaakum wa-ikhwanakum awliyaa ini istahabboo alkufra AAala al-eeman
versets.francais: Ô vous qui croyez! Ne prenez pas vos pères et vos frères pour alliés s'ils préfèrent la mécréance à la foi.
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, do not take your fathers or your brothers as allies if they have preferred disbelief over belief. And whoever does so among you - then it is those who are the wrongdoers

versets.arabe: قُلْ إِن كَانَ آبَاؤُكُمْ وَأَبْنَاؤُكُمْ وَإِخْوَانُكُمْ وَأَزْوَاجُكُمْ وَعَشِيرَتُكُمْ وَأَمْوَالٌ اقْتَرَفْتُمُوهَا وَتِجَارَةٌ تَخْشَوْنَ كَسَادَهَا أَحَبَّ إِلَيْكُم مِّنَ اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَجِهَادٍ فِي سَبِيلِهِ فَتَرَبَّصُوا
versets.phonetique: Qul in kana abaokum waabnaokum wa-ikhwanukum waazwajukum waAAasheeratukum waamwalun iqtaraftumoha watijaratun takhshawna kasadaha ahabba ilaykum mina Allahi warasoolihi wajihadin fee sabeelihi fatarabbasoo
versets.francais: Dis: Si vos pères, vos fils, vos frères, vos épouses, votre famille, les biens que vous avez acquis, le commerce dont vous craignez le déclin, les demeures qui vous plaisent, vous sont plus chers qu'Allah, Son messager et la lutte dans Son sentier, alors attendez.
versets.anglais: Say, [O Muhammad], "If your fathers, your sons, your brothers, your wives, your relatives, wealth which you have obtained, commerce wherein you fear decline, and dwellings with which you are pleased are more beloved to you than Allah and His Messenger and jihad in His cause, then wait until Allah executes His command. And Allah does not guide the defiantly disobedient people

versets.arabe: لَقَدْ نَصَرَكُمُ اللَّهُ فِي مَوَاطِنَ كَثِيرَةٍ وَيَوْمَ حُنَيْنٍ إِذْ أَعْجَبَتْكُمْ كَثْرَتُكُمْ فَلَمْ تُغْنِ عَنكُمْ شَيْئًا
versets.phonetique: Laqad nasarakumu Allahu fee mawatina katheeratin wayawma hunaynin ith aAAjabatkum kathratukum falam tughnii AAankum shay'a
versets.francais: Allah vous a secourus en maints endroits, notamment le jour de Hunayn, quand votre grand nombre vous enorgueillissait mais ne vous servit à rien.
versets.anglais: Allah has already given you victory in many regions and [even] on the day of Hunayn, when your great number pleased you, but it did not avail you at all, and the earth was confining for you with its vastness; then you turned back, fleeing

versets.arabe: ثُمَّ أَنزَلَ اللَّهُ سَكِينَتَهُ عَلَىٰ رَسُولِهِ وَعَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَأَنزَلَ جُنُودًا لَّمْ تَرَوْهَا
versets.phonetique: Thumma anzala Allahu sakeenatahu AAala rasoolihi waAAala almu'mineena waanzala junoodan lam tarawha
versets.francais: Puis Allah fit descendre Sa sérénité sur Son messager et sur les croyants, et fit descendre des armées que vous ne voyiez pas.
versets.anglais: Then Allah sent down His tranquillity upon His Messenger and upon the believers and sent down soldiers angels whom you did not see and punished those who disbelieved. And that is the recompense of the disbelievers

versets.arabe: ثُمَّ يَتُوبُ اللَّهُ مِن بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَاءُ وَاللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Thumma yatoobu Allahu min baAAdi thalika AAala man yashao wallahu ghafoorun raheem
versets.francais: Ensuite Allah accepte le repentir de qui Il veut, et Allah est Pardonneur et Miséricordieux.
versets.anglais: Then Allah will accept repentance after that for whom He wills; and Allah is Forgiving and Merciful

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِنَّمَا الْمُشْرِكُونَ نَجَسٌ فَلَا يَقْرَبُوا الْمَسْجِدَ الْحَرَامَ بَعْدَ عَامِهِمْ هَٰذَا
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo innama almushrikoona najasun fala yaqraboo almasjida alharama baAAda AAamihim hatha
versets.francais: Ô vous qui croyez! Les associateurs ne sont qu'impureté. Qu'ils n'approchent donc plus de la Mosquée sacrée après cette année.
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, indeed the polytheists are unclean, so let them not approach al-Masjid al-Haram after this, their [final] year. And if you fear privation, Allah will enrich you from His bounty if He wills. Indeed, Allah is Knowing and Wise

versets.arabe: قَاتِلُوا الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللَّهِ وَلَا بِالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ وَلَا يُحَرِّمُونَ مَا حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ وَلَا يَدِينُونَ دِينَ الْحَقِّ مِنَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْكِتَابَ
versets.phonetique: Qatiloo allatheena la yu'minoona billahi wala bilyawmi al-akhiri wala yuharrimoona ma harrama Allahu warasooluhu wala yadeenoona deena alhaqqi mina allatheena ootoo alkitab
versets.francais: Combattez ceux qui ne croient pas en Allah ni au Jour dernier, n'interdisent pas ce qu'Allah et Son messager ont interdit, et ne pratiquent pas la religion de la vérité, parmi ceux qui ont reçu le Livre.
versets.anglais: Fight those who do not believe in Allah or in the Last Day and who do not consider unlawful what Allah and His Messenger have made unlawful and who do not adopt the religion of truth from those who were given the Scripture - [fight] until they give the jizyah willingly while they are humbled

versets.arabe: وَقَالَتِ الْيَهُودُ عُزَيْرٌ ابْنُ اللَّهِ وَقَالَتِ النَّصَارَىٰ الْمَسِيحُ ابْنُ اللَّهِ
versets.phonetique: Waqalati alyahoodu AAuzayrun ibnu Allahi waqalati alnnasara almaseehu ibnu Allah
versets.francais: Les Juifs disent: "Uzayr est le fils d'Allah." Et les Chrétiens disent: "Le Messie est le fils d'Allah."
versets.anglais: The Jews say, "Ezra is the son of Allah "; and the Christians say, "The Messiah is the son of Allah." That is their statement from their mouths; they imitate the saying of those who disbelieved [before them]. May Allah destroy them; how are they deluded

versets.arabe: اتَّخَذُوا أَحْبَارَهُمْ وَرُهْبَانَهُمْ أَرْبَابًا مِّن دُونِ اللَّهِ وَالْمَسِيحَ ابْنَ مَرْيَمَ
versets.phonetique: Ittakhathoo ahbarahum waruhbanahum arbaban min dooni Allahi waalmaseeha ibna maryam
versets.francais: Ils ont pris leurs rabbins et leurs moines comme seigneurs en dehors d'Allah, ainsi que le Messie, fils de Marie.
versets.anglais: They have taken their scholars and monks as lords besides Allah, and [also] the Messiah, the son of Mary. And they were not commanded except to worship one God; there is no deity except Him. Exalted is He above whatever they associate with Him

versets.arabe: يُرِيدُونَ أَن يُطْفِئُوا نُورَ اللَّهِ بِأَفْوَاهِهِمْ وَيَأْبَى اللَّهُ إِلَّا أَن يُتِمَّ نُورَهُ
versets.phonetique: Yureedoona an yutfi'oo noora Allahi bi-afwahihim waya'ba Allahu illa an yutimma noorahou
versets.francais: Ils veulent éteindre la lumière d'Allah de leurs bouches, mais Allah ne veut qu'une chose: parachever Sa lumière.
versets.anglais: They want to extinguish the light of Allah with their mouths, but Allah refuses except to perfect His light, although the disbelievers dislike it

versets.arabe: هُوَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلَ رَسُولَهُ بِالْهُدَىٰ وَدِينِ الْحَقِّ لِيُظْهِرَهُ عَلَى الدِّينِ كُلِّهِ
versets.phonetique: Huwa allathee arsala rasoolahu bilhuda wadeeni alhaqqi liyuthhirahu AAala alddeeni kullih
versets.francais: C'est Lui qui a envoyé Son messager avec la guidée et la religion de la vérité pour la faire prévaloir sur toute autre religion.
versets.anglais: It is He who has sent His Messenger with guidance and the religion of truth to manifest it over all religion, although they who associate others with Allah dislike it

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِنَّ كَثِيرًا مِّنَ الْأَحْبَارِ وَالرُّهْبَانِ لَيَأْكُلُونَ أَمْوَالَ النَّاسِ بِالْبَاطِلِ وَيَصُدُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo inna katheeran mina al-ahbari walruhbani laya'kuloona amwala alnnasi bilbatili wayasuddoona AAan sabeeli Allah
versets.francais: Ô vous qui croyez! Beaucoup de rabbins et de moines dévorent les biens des gens illégitimement et détournent du sentier d'Allah.
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, indeed many of the scholars and the monks devour the wealth of people unjustly and avert [them] from the way of Allah. And those who hoard gold and silver and spend it not in the way of Allah - give them tidings of a painful punishment

versets.arabe: يَوْمَ يُحْمَىٰ عَلَيْهَا فِي نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ فَتُكْوَىٰ بِهَا جِبَاهُهُمْ وَجُنُوبُهُمْ وَظُهُورُهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Yawma yuhma AAalayha fee nari jahannama fatukwa biha jibahhuhum wajunoobuhum wathuhooruhum
versets.francais: Le jour où ces richesses seront chauffées dans le feu de l'Enfer et où leurs fronts, leurs flancs et leurs dos en seront marqués au fer.
versets.anglais: The Day when it will be heated in the fire of Hell and seared therewith will be their foreheads, their flanks, and their backs, [it will be said], "This is what you hoarded for yourselves, so taste what you used to hoard

versets.arabe: إِنَّ عِدَّةَ الشُّهُورِ عِندَ اللَّهِ اثْنَا عَشَرَ شَهْرًا فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ يَوْمَ خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ
versets.phonetique: Inna AAiddata alshshuhoori AAinda Allahi ithna AAashara shahran fee kitabi Allahi yawma khalaqa alssamawati wal-ard
versets.francais: Le nombre des mois, auprès d'Allah, est de douze mois dans le livre d'Allah depuis le jour où Il a créé les cieux et la terre.
versets.anglais: Indeed, the number of months with Allah is twelve [lunar] months in the register of Allah [from] the day He created the heavens and the earth; of these, four are sacred. That is the correct religion, so do not wrong yourselves during them. And fight against the disbelievers collectively as they fight against you collectively. And know that Allah is with the righteous [who fear Him]

versets.arabe: إِنَّمَا النَّسِيءُ زِيَادَةٌ فِي الْكُفْرِ يُضَلُّ بِهِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا يُحِلُّونَهُ عَامًا وَيُحَرِّمُونَهُ عَامًا
versets.phonetique: Innama alnnasi'o ziyadatun fee alkufri yudallu bihi allatheena kafaroo yuhilloonahu AAaman wayuharrimoonahu AAama
versets.francais: Le report du mois sacré n'est qu'un surcroît de mécréance, qui égare ceux qui ont mécru. Ils le rendent licite une année et l'interdisent l'autre.
versets.anglais: Indeed, the postponing [of restriction within sacred months] is an increase in disbelief by which those who have disbelieved are led [further] astray. They make it lawful one year and unlawful another year to correspond to the number made unlawful by Allah and [thus] make lawful what Allah has made unlawful. Made pleasing to them is the evil of their deeds; and Allah does not guide the disbelieving people

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا مَا لَكُمْ إِذَا قِيلَ لَكُمُ انفِرُوا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ اثَّاقَلْتُمْ إِلَى الْأَرْضِ
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo ma lakum itha qeela lakumu infiroo fee sabeeli Allahi iththaqaltum ila al-ard
versets.francais: Ô vous qui croyez! Qu'avez-vous? Quand on vous a dit: "Élancez-vous dans le sentier d'Allah", vous vous êtes appesantis sur la terre.
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, what is [the matter] with you that, when you are told to go forth in the cause of Allah, you adhere heavily to the earth? Are you satisfied with the life of this world rather than the Hereafter? But what is the enjoyment of worldly life compared to the Hereafter except a [very] little

versets.arabe: إِلَّا تَنفِرُوا يُعَذِّبْكُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا وَيَسْتَبْدِلْ قَوْمًا غَيْرَكُمْ وَلَا تَضُرُّوهُ شَيْئًا
versets.phonetique: Illa tanfiroo yuAAaththibkum AAathaban aleeman wayastabdil qawman ghayrakum wala tadurrohu shay'a
versets.francais: Si vous ne vous élancez pas, Il vous châtiera d'un châtiment douloureux et vous remplacera par un autre peuple, et vous ne Lui nuirez en rien.
versets.anglais: If you do not go forth, He will punish you with a painful punishment and will replace you with another people, and you will not harm Him at all. And Allah is over all things competent

versets.arabe: إِلَّا تَنصُرُوهُ فَقَدْ نَصَرَهُ اللَّهُ إِذْ أَخْرَجَهُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا ثَانِيَ اثْنَيْنِ إِذْ هُمَا فِي الْغَارِ
versets.phonetique: Illa tansuroohu faqad nasarahu Allahu ith akhrajahu allatheena kafaroo thanya ithnayni ith huma fee alghaar
versets.francais: Si vous ne lui prêtez pas secours, Allah lui a déjà accordé Son secours quand ceux qui avaient mécru l'expulsèrent, le deuxième de deux, quand ils étaient tous les deux dans la grotte.
versets.anglais: If you do not aid the Prophet - Allah has already aided him when those who disbelieved had driven him out [of Makkah] as one of two, when they were in the cave and he said to his companion, "Do not grieve; indeed Allah is with us." And Allah sent down his tranquillity upon him and supported him with angels you did not see and made the word of those who disbelieved the lowest, while the word of Allah - that is the highest. And Allah is Exalted in Might and Wise

versets.arabe: انفِرُوا خِفَافًا وَثِقَالًا وَجَاهِدُوا بِأَمْوَالِكُمْ وَأَنفُسِكُمْ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ذَٰلِكُمْ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Infiroo khifafan wathiqalan wajahadoo bi-amwalikum waanfusikum fee sabeeli Allahi thalikum khayrun lakum in kuntum taAAlamoon
versets.francais: Élancez-vous, légèrement ou lourdement chargés, et luttez de vos biens et de vos personnes dans le sentier d'Allah. C'est un bien pour vous, si vous saviez.
versets.anglais: Go forth, whether light or heavy, and strive with your wealth and your lives in the cause of Allah. That is better for you, if you only knew

versets.arabe: لَوْ كَانَ عَرَضًا قَرِيبًا وَسَفَرًا قَاصِدًا لَّاتَّبَعُوكَ وَلَٰكِن بَعُدَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ الشُّقَّةُ
versets.phonetique: Law kana AAaradan qareeban wasafaran qasidan lattabaAAooka walakin baAAudat AAalayhimu alshshuqqah
versets.francais: Si c'était un gain proche et un voyage facile, ils t'auraient suivi; mais le trajet leur a paru trop long.
versets.anglais: Had it been an easy gain and a moderate trip, the hypocrites would have followed you, but distant to them was the journey. And they will swear by Allah, "If we were able, we would have gone forth with you," destroying themselves [through false oaths], and Allah knows that indeed they are liars

versets.arabe: عَفَا اللَّهُ عَنكَ لِمَ أَذِنتَ لَهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يَتَبَيَّنَ لَكَ الَّذِينَ صَدَقُوا وَتَعْلَمَ الْكَاذِبِينَ
versets.phonetique: AAafa Allahu AAanka lima athinta lahum hatta yatabayyana laka allatheena sadaqoo wataAAlama alkathibeen
versets.francais: Allah t'a pardonné. Pourquoi leur as-tu accordé la permission avant qu'il te soit apparu clairement ceux qui disaient vrai et que tu aies connu les menteurs?
versets.anglais: May Allah pardon you, [O Muhammad]; why did you give them permission [to remain behind]? [You should not have] until it was evident to you who were truthful and you knew [who were] the liars

versets.arabe: لَا يَسْتَأْذِنُكَ الَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ أَن يُجَاهِدُوا بِأَمْوَالِهِمْ وَأَنفُسِهِمْ
versets.phonetique: La yasta'thinuka allatheena yu'minoona billahi walyawmi al-akhiri an yujahedoo bi-amwalihim waanfusihim
versets.francais: Ceux qui croient en Allah et au Jour dernier ne te demandent pas la permission de lutter de leurs biens et de leurs personnes.
versets.anglais: Those who believe in Allah and the Last Day would not ask permission of you to be excused from striving with their wealth and their lives. And Allah is Knowing of those who fear Him

versets.arabe: إِنَّمَا يَسْتَأْذِنُكَ الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ وَارْتَابَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ فَهُمْ فِي رَيْبِهِمْ يَتَرَدَّدُونَ
versets.phonetique: Innama yasta'thinuka allatheena la yu'minoona billahi walyawmi al-akhiri wartabat quloobuhum fahum fee raybihim yataraddadoon
versets.francais: Ceux qui te demandent la permission ne croient pas en Allah ni au Jour dernier; leurs cœurs sont dans le doute et ils balancent dans leur doute.
versets.anglais: Only those would ask permission of you who do not believe in Allah and the Last Day and whose hearts have doubted, and they, in their doubt, are hesitating

versets.arabe: وَلَوْ أَرَادُوا الْخُرُوجَ لَأَعَدُّوا لَهُ عُدَّةً وَلَٰكِن كَرِهَ اللَّهُ انبِعَاثَهُمْ فَثَبَّطَهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Walaw aradoo alkhurooja laaAAaddoo lahu AAuddatan walakin kariha Allahu inbiAAathahum fathabbtahum
versets.francais: S'ils avaient voulu sortir, ils y auraient préparé un équipement. Mais Allah a jugé déplorable leur départ et les a retenus.
versets.anglais: And if they had intended to go forth, they would have prepared for it [some] preparation. But Allah disliked their being sent, so He kept them back, and they were told, "Remain [behind] with those who remain

versets.arabe: لَوْ خَرَجُوا فِيكُم مَّا زَادُوكُمْ إِلَّا خَبَالًا وَلَأَوْضَعُوا خِلَالَكُمْ يَبْغُونَكُمُ الْفِتْنَةَ
versets.phonetique: Law kharajoo feekum ma zadookum illa khabalan walawdaAAoo khilalakum yabghoonakumu alfitnah
versets.francais: S'ils étaient sortis avec vous, ils n'auraient fait qu'accroître votre désordre et se seraient empressés à semer la discorde parmi vous.
versets.anglais: Had they gone forth with you, they would not have increased you except in confusion, and they would have been active among you, seeking [to cause] you fitnah. And among you are avid listeners to them. And Allah is Knowing of the wrongdoers

versets.arabe: لَقَدِ ابْتَغَوُا الْفِتْنَةَ مِن قَبْلُ وَقَلَّبُوا لَكَ الْأُمُورَ حَتَّىٰ جَاءَ الْحَقُّ وَظَهَرَ أَمْرُ اللَّهِ
versets.phonetique: Laqadi ibtaghawoo alfitnata min qablu waqallaboo laka al-omoora hatta jaa alhaqqu wathhara amru Allah
versets.francais: Ils ont déjà cherché la discorde auparavant, et ont intrigué contre toi, jusqu'à ce que vînt la vérité et que le commandement d'Allah triomphât.
versets.anglais: They had already desired dissension before and had upset matters for you until the truth came and the ordinance of Allah appeared, while they were averse

versets.arabe: وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَقُولُ ائْذَن لِّي وَلَا تَفْتِنِّي أَلَا فِي الْفِتْنَةِ سَقَطُوا
versets.phonetique: Waminhum man yaqoolu i'than lee wala tafitannee ala fee alfitnati saqatoo
versets.francais: Il en est parmi eux qui dit: "Permets-moi et ne me tente pas." Certes, c'est dans la tentation qu'ils sont tombés.
versets.anglais: And among them is he who says, "Permit me [to remain at home] and do not put me to trial." Unquestionably, into trial they have fallen. And indeed, Hell will encompass the disbelievers

versets.arabe: إِن تُصِبْكَ حَسَنَةٌ تَسُؤْهُمْ وَإِن تُصِبْكَ مُصِيبَةٌ يَقُولُوا قَدْ أَخَذْنَا أَمْرَنَا مِن قَبْلُ
versets.phonetique: In tusibka hasanatun tasu'hum wa-in tusibka museebatun yaqooloo qad akhathnaa amrana min qabl
versets.francais: Si un bien t'atteint, cela les contrarie; et si une calamité t'atteint, ils disent: "Nous avions pris nos précautions."
versets.anglais: If good befalls you, it distresses them; but if disaster strikes you, they say, "We took our matter [in hand] before," and turn away while they are rejoicing

versets.arabe: قُل لَّن يُصِيبَنَا إِلَّا مَا كَتَبَ اللَّهُ لَنَا هُوَ مَوْلَانَا وَعَلَى اللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qul lan yuseebana illa ma kataba Allahu lana huwa mawlana waAAala Allahi falyatawakkali almu'minoon
versets.francais: Dis: "Il ne nous atteindra que ce qu'Allah a prescrit pour nous. Il est notre Maître. Et c'est en Allah que les croyants doivent se confier."
versets.anglais: Say, "Never will we be struck except by what Allah has decreed for us; He is our protector." And upon Allah let the believers rely

versets.arabe: قُلْ هَلْ تَرَبَّصُونَ بِنَا إِلَّا إِحْدَى الْحُسْنَيَيْنِ وَنَحْنُ نَتَرَبَّصُ بِكُمْ أَن يُصِيبَكُمُ اللَّهُ بِعَذَابٍ
versets.phonetique: Qul hal tarabbasoona bina illa ihda alhusnayyni wanahnu natarabbabu bikum an yuseebakumu Allahu biAAathab
versets.francais: Dis: "Attendez-vous pour nous autre chose que l'une des deux bonnes fins? Alors que nous attendons pour vous qu'Allah vous frappe d'un châtiment?"
versets.anglais: Say, "Do you await for us except one of the two best things while we await for you that Allah will afflict you with punishment from Himself or at our hands? So wait; indeed we, along with you, are waiting

versets.arabe: قُلْ أَنفِقُوا طَوْعًا أَوْ كَرْهًا لَّن يُتَقَبَّلَ مِنكُمْ إِنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ قَوْمًا فَاسِقِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qul anfiqoo tawAAan aw karhan lan yutaqabbala minkum innakum kuntum qawman fasiqeen
versets.francais: Dis: "Dépensez de gré ou de force, cela ne vous sera jamais accepté: vous êtes des gens pervers."
versets.anglais: Say, "Spend willingly or unwillingly; never will it be accepted from you. Indeed, you have been a defiantly disobedient people

versets.arabe: وَمَا مَنَعَهُمْ أَن تُقْبَلَ مِنْهُمْ نَفَقَاتُهُمْ إِلَّا أَنَّهُمْ كَفَرُوا بِاللَّهِ وَبِرَسُولِهِ
versets.phonetique: Wama manaAAahum an tuqbala minhum nafaqatuhum illa annahum kafaroo billahi wabirasoolih
versets.francais: Ce qui empêche que leurs dépenses soient acceptées d'eux, c'est qu'ils ont mécru en Allah et en Son messager.
versets.anglais: And what prevents their expenditures from being accepted from them but that they have disbelieved in Allah and in His Messenger and that they come not to prayer except while they are lazy and that they do not spend except while they are unwilling

versets.arabe: فَلَا تُعْجِبْكَ أَمْوَالُهُمْ وَلَا أَوْلَادُهُمْ إِنَّمَا يُرِيدُ اللَّهُ لِيُعَذِّبَهُم بِهَا فِي الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا
versets.phonetique: Fala tuAAjibka amwaluhum wala awladuhum innama yureedu Allahu liyuAAaththibahum biha fee alhayati alddunya
versets.francais: Que leurs biens et leurs enfants ne t'émerveillent donc pas. Allah veut seulement les châtier par cela dans la vie présente.
versets.anglais: So let not their wealth or their children impress you. Allah only intends to punish them through them in worldly life and that their souls should depart [at death] while they are disbelievers

versets.arabe: وَيَحْلِفُونَ بِاللَّهِ إِنَّهُمْ لَمِنكُمْ وَمَا هُم مِّنكُمْ وَلَٰكِنَّهُمْ قَوْمٌ يَفْرَقُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wayahlifoona billahi innahum laminkum wama hum minkum walakinnahum qawmun yafiraqoon
versets.francais: Ils jurent par Allah qu'ils sont des vôtres, alors qu'ils ne sont pas des vôtres; ce sont plutôt des gens qui ont peur.
versets.anglais: And they swear by Allah that they are from among you while they are not from among you; but they are a people who are afraid

versets.arabe: لَوْ يَجِدُونَ مَلْجَأً أَوْ مَغَارَاتٍ أَوْ مُدَّخَلًا لَّوَلَّوْا إِلَيْهِ وَهُمْ يَجْمَحُونَ
versets.phonetique: Law yajidoona malja'an aw magharatun aw muddakhalan lawwallaw ilayhi wahum yajmahoon
versets.francais: S'ils trouvaient un refuge ou des cavernes ou un endroit où pénétrer, ils s'y rendraient précipitamment.
versets.anglais: If they could find a refuge or some caves or any place to enter [and hide], they would turn to it while they run heedlessly

versets.arabe: وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَلْمِزُكَ فِي الصَّدَقَاتِ فَإِنْ أُعْطُوا مِنْهَا رَضُوا وَإِن لَّمْ يُعْطَوْا مِنهَا إِذَا هُمْ يَسْخَطُونَ
versets.phonetique: Waminhum man yalmizuka fee alssadaqati fa-in ootoo minha radoo wa-in lam yuAAtaw minha itha hum yaskhatoon
versets.francais: Parmi eux, il en est qui te critiquent au sujet des aumônes: si on leur en donne, ils sont satisfaits; si on ne leur en donne pas, ils s'indignent.
versets.anglais: And among them are some who criticize you concerning the [distribution of] charities. If they are given from them, they approve; but if they are not given from them, at once they become angry

versets.arabe: وَلَوْ أَنَّهُمْ رَضُوا مَا آتَاهُمُ اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ وَقَالُوا حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ سَيُؤْتِينَا اللَّهُ مِن فَضْلِهِ
versets.phonetique: Walaw annahum radaw ma atahumu Allahu warasoolohu waqaloo hasbuna Allahu sayu'teena Allahu min fadlih
versets.francais: Que ne se sont-ils contentés de ce qu'Allah et Son messager leur ont donné, en disant: "Allah nous suffit; Allah nous donnera de Sa grâce."
versets.anglais: If only they had been satisfied with what Allah and His Messenger gave them and said, "Sufficient for us is Allah; Allah will give us of His bounty, and [so will] His Messenger; indeed, we are desirous toward Allah," [it would have been better for them]

versets.arabe: إِنَّمَا الصَّدَقَاتُ لِلْفُقَرَاءِ وَالْمَسَاكِينِ وَالْعَامِلِينَ عَلَيْهَا وَالْمُؤَلَّفَةِ قُلُوبُهُمْ وَفِي الرِّقَابِ وَالْغَارِمِينَ وَفِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَابْنِ السَّبِيلِ
versets.phonetique: Innama alssadaqatu lilfuqara'i walmasakini walAAamileena AAalayha walmu'allafati quloobuhum wafee alrriqabi waalghareemena wafee sabeeli Allahi waibni alssabeel
versets.francais: Les aumônes ne sont destinées qu'aux pauvres, aux indigents, à ceux qui y travaillent, à ceux dont les cœurs sont à gagner, à l'affranchissement des esclaves, à ceux qui sont lourdement endettés, dans le sentier d'Allah et au voyageur.
versets.anglais: Zakah expenditures are only for the poor and for the needy and for those employed to collect [zakah] and for bringing hearts together [for Islam] and for freeing captives [or slaves] and for those in debt and for the cause of Allah and for the [stranded] traveler - an obligation [imposed] by Allah. And Allah is Knowing and Wise

versets.arabe: وَمِنْهُمُ الَّذِينَ يُؤْذُونَ النَّبِيَّ وَيَقُولُونَ هُوَ أُذُنٌ قُلْ أُذُنُ خَيْرٍ لَّكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Waminhumu allatheena yu'thoona alnnabiyya wayaqooloona huwa uthunun qul uthunu khayrin lakum
versets.francais: Parmi eux, il en est qui maltraitent le Prophète et disent: "Il est une oreille!" Dis: "Une oreille bienveillante pour vous."
versets.anglais: And among them are those who abuse the Prophet and say, "He is an ear." Say, "[It is] an ear of goodness for you that believes in Allah and believes the believers and [is] a mercy to those who believe among you." And those who abuse the Messenger of Allah - for them is a painful punishment

versets.arabe: يَحْلِفُونَ بِاللَّهِ لَكُمْ لِيُرْضُوكُمْ وَاللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَحَقُّ أَن يُرْضُوهُ إِن كَانُوا مُؤْمِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Yahlifoona billahi lakum liyurdookum wallahu warasoolohu ahaqqu an yurdoohu in kanoo mu'mineen
versets.francais: Ils vous jurent par Allah pour vous contenter. Or Allah et Son messager méritent davantage qu'ils les contentent, s'ils sont vraiment croyants.
versets.anglais: They swear by Allah to you [Muslims] to satisfy you. But Allah and His Messenger are more worthy for them to satisfy, if they should be believers

versets.arabe: أَلَمْ يَعْلَمُوا أَنَّهُ مَن يُحَادِدِ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ فَأَنَّ لَهُ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدًا فِيهَا
versets.phonetique: Alam yaAAlamoo annahu man yuhadidi Allaha warasoolahu fa-anna lahu nara jahannama khalidan feeha
versets.francais: Ne savent-ils pas que quiconque s'oppose à Allah et à Son messager aura le feu de l'Enfer pour toujours?
versets.anglais: Do they not know that whoever opposes Allah and His Messenger - that for him is the fire of Hell, wherein he will abide eternally? That is the great disgrace

versets.arabe: يَحْذَرُ الْمُنَافِقُونَ أَن تُنَزَّلَ عَلَيْهِمْ سُورَةٌ تُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ
versets.phonetique: Yahtharu almunafiqoona an tunazzala AAalayhim sooratun tunabbiohum bima fee quloobihim
versets.francais: Les hypocrites craignent qu'on ne fasse descendre sur eux une sourate qui les informe de ce qui est dans leurs cœurs.
versets.anglais: They hypocrites are apprehensive lest a surah be revealed about them, informing them of what is in their hearts. Say, "Mock [as you wish]; indeed, Allah will expose that which you fear

versets.arabe: وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُمْ لَيَقُولُنَّ إِنَّمَا كُنَّا نَخُوضُ وَنَلْعَبُ قُلْ أَبِاللَّهِ وَآيَاتِهِ وَرَسُولِهِ كُنتُمْ تَسْتَهْزِئُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wala'in sa'altahum layaqoolunna innama kunna nakhoodu wanalAAabu qul abillahi waayatihi warasoolihi kuntum tastahzi'oon
versets.francais: Si tu les interrogeais, ils diraient sûrement: "Nous ne faisions que nous amuser et plaisanter." Dis: "Est-ce d'Allah, de Ses versets et de Son messager que vous vous moquiez?"
versets.anglais: And if you ask them, they will surely say, "We were only conversing and playing." Say, "Is it Allah and His verses and His Messenger that you were mocking

versets.arabe: لَا تَعْتَذِرُوا قَدْ كَفَرْتُم بَعْدَ إِيمَانِكُمْ إِن نَّعْفُ عَن طَائِفَةٍ مِّنكُمْ نُعَذِّبْ طَائِفَةً
versets.phonetique: La taAAtatiroo qad kafartum baAAda eemanikum in naAAfu AAan ta'ifatin minkum nuAAaththib ta'ifah
versets.francais: N'alléguez pas d'excuse: vous avez mécru après votre foi. Si Nous pardonnons à une partie d'entre vous, Nous en châtierons une autre.
versets.anglais: Make no excuse; you have disbelieved after your belief. If We pardon one faction of you - We will punish another faction because they were criminals

versets.arabe: الْمُنَافِقُونَ وَالْمُنَافِقَاتُ بَعْضُهُم مِّن بَعْضٍ يَأْمُرُونَ بِالْمُنكَرِ وَيَنْهَوْنَ عَنِ الْمَعْرُوفِ وَيَقْبِضُونَ أَيْدِيَهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Almunafiqoona waalmunafiqatu baAAduhum min baAAdin ya'muroona bilmunkari wayanhawna AAani almaAArofi wayaqbidoona aydiyahum
versets.francais: Les hypocrites, hommes et femmes, se ressemblent: ils commandent le blâmable, interdisent le convenable et retirent leurs mains.
versets.anglais: The hypocrite men and hypocrite women are of one another. They enjoin what is wrong and forbid what is right and close their hands. They have forgotten Allah, so He has forgotten them [accordingly]. Indeed, the hypocrites - it is they who are the defiantly disobedient

versets.arabe: وَعَدَ اللَّهُ الْمُنَافِقِينَ وَالْمُنَافِقَاتِ وَالْكُفَّارَ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا
versets.phonetique: WaAAada Allahu almunafiqeena waalmunafiqati walkuffara nara jahannama khalideena feeha
versets.francais: Allah a promis aux hypocrites, hommes et femmes, ainsi qu'aux mécréants, le feu de l'Enfer, pour y demeurer éternellement.
versets.anglais: Allah has promised the hypocrite men and hypocrite women and the disbelievers the fire of Hell, wherein they will abide eternally. It is sufficient for them. And Allah has cursed them, and for them is an enduring punishment

versets.arabe: كَالَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِكُمْ كَانُوا أَشَدَّ مِنكُمْ قُوَّةً وَأَكْثَرَ أَمْوَالًا وَأَوْلَادًا فَاسْتَمْتَعُوا بِخَلَاقِهِمْ
versets.phonetique: Kaallatheena min qablikum kanoo ashadda minkum quwwatan waakthara amwalan waawladan faistamtaAAoo bikhalaqihim
versets.francais: Comme ceux qui vous ont précédés: ils étaient plus forts que vous et possédaient plus de biens et d'enfants; ils ont joui de leur part.
versets.anglais: [You disbelievers are] like those before you; they were stronger than you in power and more abundant in wealth and children. They enjoyed their portion [of worldly enjoyment], and you have enjoyed your portion as those before you enjoyed their portion, and you have engaged [in vanities] like that in which they engaged. [It is] those whose deeds have become worthless in this world and in the Hereafter, and it is they who are the losers

versets.arabe: أَلَمْ يَأْتِهِمْ نَبَأُ الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ قَوْمِ نُوحٍ وَعَادٍ وَثَمُودَ وَقَوْمِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَأَصْحَابِ مَدْيَنَ وَالْمُؤْتَفِكَاتِ
versets.phonetique: Alam ya'tihim nabao allatheena min qablihim qawmi noohin waAAadin wathamooda waqawmi ibraheema waas-habi madyana walmu'tafikaat
versets.francais: Ne leur est-il pas venu les nouvelles de ceux qui les ont précédés: le peuple de Noé, de 'Aad, de Thamoud, du peuple d'Abraham, des habitants de Madyan et des cités renversées?
versets.anglais: Has there not reached them the news of those before them - the people of Noah and [the tribes of] 'Aad and Thamud and the people of Abraham and the companions of Madyan and the towns overturned? Their messengers came to them with clear proofs. And Allah would never have wronged them, but they were wronging themselves

versets.arabe: وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتُ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلِيَاءُ بَعْضٍ يَأْمُرُونَ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَيَنْهَوْنَ عَنِ الْمُنكَرِ
versets.phonetique: Walmu'minoona walmu'minatu baAAduhum awliyao baAAdin ya'muroona bilmaAAroofi wayanhawna AAani almunkar
versets.francais: Les croyants et les croyantes sont alliés les uns des autres: ils commandent le convenable, interdisent le blâmable.
versets.anglais: The believing men and believing women are allies of one another. They enjoin what is right and forbid what is wrong and establish prayer and give zakah and obey Allah and His Messenger. Those - Allah will have mercy upon them. Indeed, Allah is Exalted in Might and Wise

versets.arabe: وَعَدَ اللَّهُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا
versets.phonetique: WaAAada Allahu almu'mineena walmu'minati jannatin tajree min tahtiha al-anharu khalideena feeha
versets.francais: Allah a promis aux croyants et aux croyantes des jardins sous lesquels coulent les ruisseaux, pour y demeurer éternellement.
versets.anglais: Allah has promised the believing men and believing women gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein they abide eternally, and pleasant dwellings in gardens of perpetual residence; but approval from Allah is greater. It is that which is the great attainment

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ جَاهِدِ الْكُفَّارَ وَالْمُنَافِقِينَ وَاغْلُظْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَمَأْوَاهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ وَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيرُ
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuha alnnabiyyu jahidi alkuffara waalmunafiqeena waghluth AAalayhim wama'wahum jahannamu wabi'sa almaseer
versets.francais: Ô Prophète! Lutte contre les mécréants et les hypocrites et sois dur à leur égard. Leur demeure sera l'Enfer, et quelle mauvaise destination!
versets.anglais: O Prophet, fight against the disbelievers and the hypocrites and be harsh upon them. And their refuge is Hell, and wretched is the destination

versets.arabe: يَحْلِفُونَ بِاللَّهِ مَا قَالُوا وَلَقَدْ قَالُوا كَلِمَةَ الْكُفْرِ وَكَفَرُوا بَعْدَ إِسْلَامِهِمْ
versets.phonetique: Yahlifoona billahi ma qaloo walaqad qaloo kalimata alkufri wakafaroo baAAda islamihim
versets.francais: Ils jurent par Allah qu'ils n'ont rien dit, alors qu'ils ont certainement prononcé la parole de mécréance et ont mécru après leur islamisation.
versets.anglais: They swear by Allah that they did not say [anything against the Prophet] while they had said the word of disbelief and disbelieved after their [pretense of] Islam and planned that which they were not to attain. And they were not resentful except [for the fact] that Allah and His Messenger had enriched them of His bounty. So if they repent, it is better for them; but if they turn away, Allah will punish them with a painful punishment in this world and the Hereafter. And there will not be for them on earth any protector or helper

versets.arabe: وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ عَاهَدَ اللَّهَ لَئِنْ آتَانَا مِن فَضْلِهِ لَنَصَّدَّقَنَّ وَلَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ
versets.phonetique: Waminhum man AAahada Allaha la'in atana min fadlihi lanassaddaqanna walanakooonanna mina alssaliheen
versets.francais: Parmi eux, il en est qui ont conclu un pacte avec Allah: "Si Tu nous accordes de Ta grâce, nous ferons l'aumône et serons de gens de bien."
versets.anglais: And among them are those who made a covenant with Allah, [saying], "If He should give us from His bounty, we will surely spend in charity, and we will surely be among the righteous

versets.arabe: فَلَمَّا آتَاهُم مِّن فَضْلِهِ بَخِلُوا بِهِ وَتَوَلَّوا وَّهُم مُّعْرِضُونَ
versets.phonetique: Falamma atahum min fadlihi bakhiloo bihi watawullaw wahum muAAridoon
versets.francais: Puis quand Il leur eut accordé de Sa grâce, ils furent avares avec elle et se détournèrent en faisant la sourde oreille.
versets.anglais: But when he gave them from His bounty, they were stingy with it and turned away while they refused

versets.arabe: فَأَعْقَبَهُمْ نِفَاقًا فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يَلْقَوْنَهُ بِمَا أَخْلَفُوا اللَّهَ مَا وَعَدُوهُ
versets.phonetique: FaaAAqabahum nifaqan fee quloobihim ila yawmi yalqawnahu bima akhlafoo Allaha ma waAAadoohu
versets.francais: Il a mis en conséquence l'hypocrisie dans leurs cœurs jusqu'au jour où ils Le rencontreront, pour avoir manqué à Allah ce qu'ils Lui avaient promis.
versets.anglais: So He penalized them with hypocrisy in their hearts until the Day they will meet Him - because they failed Allah in what they promised Him and because they [habitually] used to lie

versets.arabe: أَلَمْ يَعْلَمُوا أَنَّ اللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ سِرَّهُمْ وَنَجْوَاهُمْ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ عَلَّامُ الْغُيُوبِ
versets.phonetique: Alam yaAAlamoo anna Allaha yaAAlamu sirrahum wanajwahum waanna Allaha AAallamu alghuyoob
versets.francais: Ne savent-ils pas qu'Allah connaît leur secret et leurs conciliabules et qu'Allah est le grand Connaisseur des choses cachées?
versets.anglais: Did they not know that Allah knows their secrets and their private conversations and that Allah is the Knower of the unseen

versets.arabe: الَّذِينَ يَلْمِزُونَ الْمُطَّوِّعِينَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ فِي الصَّدَقَاتِ وَالَّذِينَ لَا يَجِدُونَ إِلَّا جُهْدَهُمْ فَيَسْخَرُونَ مِنْهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Allatheena yalmizooona almuttawwiAAeena mina almu'mineena fee alssadaqati wallatheena la yajidoona illa juhdahum fayaskhaoona minhum
versets.francais: Ceux qui critiquent les croyants volontaires pour leurs aumônes et ceux qui ne trouvent à donner que leur effort, puis se moquent d'eux.
versets.anglais: Those who criticize the contributors among the believers concerning [their] charities and [criticize] the ones who find nothing [to spend] except their effort, so they ridicule them - Allah will ridicule them, and they will have a painful punishment

versets.arabe: اسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ أَوْ لَا تَسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ إِن تَسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ سَبْعِينَ مَرَّةً فَلَن يَغْفِرَ اللَّهُ لَهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Istaghfir lahum aw la tastaghfir lahum in tastaghfir lahum sabAAeena marratan falan yaghfira Allahu lahum
versets.francais: Que tu implores leur pardon ou non — même si tu implores leur pardon soixante-dix fois — Allah ne leur pardonnera jamais.
versets.anglais: Ask forgiveness for them, [O Muhammad], or do not ask forgiveness for them. If you should ask forgiveness for them seventy times - never will Allah forgive them. That is because they disbelieved in Allah and His Messenger, and Allah does not guide the defiantly disobedient people

versets.arabe: فَرِحَ الْمُخَلَّفُونَ بِمَقْعَدِهِمْ خِلَافَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ وَكَرِهُوا أَن يُجَاهِدُوا بِأَمْوَالِهِمْ وَأَنفُسِهِمْ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ
versets.phonetique: Fariha almukhallafoona bimaqAAadihim khilafa rasooli Allahi wakarihoo an yujahedoo bi-amwalihim waanfusihim fee sabeeli Allah
versets.francais: Ceux qui sont restés en arrière se sont réjouis de rester derrière le messager d'Allah et ont détesté lutter de leurs biens et de leurs personnes dans le sentier d'Allah.
versets.anglais: Those who remained behind rejoiced in their staying [at home] after [the departure of] the Messenger of Allah and disliked to strive with their wealth and their lives in the cause of Allah and said, "Do not go forth in the heat." Say, "The fire of Hell is more intensive in heat" - if they would but understand

versets.arabe: فَلْيَضْحَكُوا قَلِيلًا وَلْيَبْكُوا كَثِيرًا جَزَاءً بِمَا كَانُوا يَكْسِبُونَ
versets.phonetique: Falyadhakoo qaleelan walyabkoo katheeran jazaan bima kanoo yaksiboon
versets.francais: Qu'ils rient peu et pleurent beaucoup, en rétribution de ce qu'ils acquéraient.
versets.anglais: So let them laugh a little and [then] weep much as recompense for what they used to earn

versets.arabe: فَإِن رَّجَعَكَ اللَّهُ إِلَىٰ طَائِفَةٍ مِّنْهُمْ فَاسْتَأْذَنُوكَ لِلْخُرُوجِ فَقُل لَّن تَخْرُجُوا مَعِيَ أَبَدًا
versets.phonetique: Fa-in rajaAAaka Allahu ila ta'ifatin minhum fasta'thanooka lilkhurooji faqul lan takhrujoo maAAiya abadan
versets.francais: Si Allah te ramène vers un groupe d'entre eux et qu'ils te demandent la permission de sortir, dis: "Vous ne sortirez jamais avec moi."
versets.anglais: If Allah should return you to a faction of them [after the expedition] and then they ask your permission to go out [to battle], say, "You will not go out with me, ever, and you will never fight with me an enemy. Indeed, you were satisfied with sitting [at home] the first time, so sit [now] with those who stay behind

versets.arabe: وَلَا تُصَلِّ عَلَىٰ أَحَدٍ مِّنْهُم مَّاتَ أَبَدًا وَلَا تَقُمْ عَلَىٰ قَبْرِهِ
versets.phonetique: Wala tusalli AAala ahadin minhum mata abadan wala taqum AAala qabrihi
versets.francais: Ne prie jamais sur aucun d'entre eux qui vient à mourir, et ne te tiens pas sur sa tombe.
versets.anglais: And do not pray [the funeral prayer, O Muhammad], over any of them who has died - ever - or stand at his grave. Indeed, they disbelieved in Allah and His Messenger and died while they were defiantly disobedient

versets.arabe: وَلَا تُعْجِبْكَ أَمْوَالُهُمْ وَأَوْلَادُهُمْ إِنَّمَا يُرِيدُ اللَّهُ أَن يُعَذِّبَهُم بِهَا فِي الدُّنْيَا وَتَزْهَقَ أَنفُسُهُمْ وَهُمْ كَافِرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wala tuAAjibka amwaluhum waawladuhum innama yureedu Allahu an yuAAaththibahum biha fee alddunya watazhaqa anfusuhum wahum kafiroon
versets.francais: Que leurs biens et leurs enfants ne t'émerveillent pas. Allah veut seulement les châtier par cela dans la vie d'ici-bas, et que leurs âmes s'en aillent alors qu'ils sont mécréants.
versets.anglais: And let not their wealth and their children impress you. Allah only intends to punish them through them in this world and that their souls should depart [at death] while they are disbelievers

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا أُنزِلَتْ سُورَةٌ أَنْ آمِنُوا بِاللَّهِ وَجَاهِدُوا مَعَ رَسُولِهِ اسْتَأْذَنَكَ أُولُو الطَّوْلِ مِنْهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Wa-itha onzilat sooratun an aminoo billahi wajahedoo maAAa rasoolihi ista'thanaka oloo alttawli minhum
versets.francais: Et quand on fait descendre une sourate: "Croyez en Allah et luttez avec Son messager", ceux d'entre eux qui ont des ressources te demandent permission.
versets.anglais: And when a surah was revealed [enjoining them] to believe in Allah and to fight with His Messenger, those of wealth among them asked your permission [to stay back] and said, "Leave us to be with them who sit [at home]

versets.arabe: رَضُوا بِأَن يَكُونُوا مَعَ الْخَوَالِفِ وَطُبِعَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ فَهُمْ لَا يَفْقَهُونَ
versets.phonetique: Radoo bian yakoonoo maAAa alkhawwalifi watubiAAa AAala quloobihim fahum la yafqahoon
versets.francais: Ils se sont contentés d'être avec ceux qui restent derrière; un sceau a été mis sur leurs cœurs: ils ne comprennent pas.
versets.anglais: They were satisfied to be with those who stay behind, and their hearts were sealed over, so they do not understand

versets.arabe: لَٰكِنِ الرَّسُولُ وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا مَعَهُ جَاهَدُوا بِأَمْوَالِهِمْ وَأَنفُسِهِمْ وَأُولَٰئِكَ لَهُمُ الْخَيْرَاتُ
versets.phonetique: Lakini alrrasoolu wallatheena amanoo maAAahu jahadoo bi-amwalihim waanfusihim waolaika lahumu alkhayraat
versets.francais: Mais le messager et ceux qui ont cru avec lui ont lutté de leurs biens et de leurs personnes. Ceux-là auront toutes les bonnes choses.
versets.anglais: But the Messenger and those who believed with him fought with their wealth and their lives. Those will have [all that is] good, and it is those who are the successful

versets.arabe: أَعَدَّ اللَّهُ لَهُمْ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا ذَٰلِكَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ
versets.phonetique: AAAadda Allahu lahum jannatin tajree min tahtiha al-anharu khalideena feeha thalika alfawzu alAAatheem
versets.francais: Allah leur a préparé des jardins sous lesquels coulent les ruisseaux, pour y demeurer éternellement. C'est là le grand succès.
versets.anglais: Allah has prepared for them gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide eternally. That is the great attainment

versets.arabe: وَجَاءَ الْمُعَذِّرُونَ مِنَ الْأَعْرَابِ لِيُؤْذَنَ لَهُمْ وَقَعَدَ الَّذِينَ كَذَبُوا اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ
versets.phonetique: Wajaa almuAAaththiroona mina al-aAAarabi liyu'thana lahum waqaAAada allatheena kathaboo Allaha warasoolah
versets.francais: Les Bédouins qui alléguaient des excuses vinrent pour qu'on leur accorde la permission; et ceux qui avaient menti à Allah et à Son messager restèrent assis.
versets.anglais: And those with excuses among the bedouins came to be permitted [to remain], and they who had lied to Allah and His Messenger sat [at home]. There will strike those who disbelieved among them a painful punishment

versets.arabe: لَّيْسَ عَلَى الضُّعَفَاءِ وَلَا عَلَى الْمَرْضَىٰ وَلَا عَلَى الَّذِينَ لَا يَجِدُونَ مَا يُنفِقُونَ حَرَجٌ
versets.phonetique: Laysa AAala aldduAAafai wala AAala almarda wala AAala allatheena la yajidoona ma yunfiqoona harajun
versets.francais: Il n'y a pas de reproche contre les faibles, ni contre les malades, ni contre ceux qui ne trouvent pas de quoi dépenser.
versets.anglais: There is not upon the weak or upon the ill or upon those who do not find anything to spend any discomfort when they are sincere to Allah and His Messenger. There is not upon the doers of good any cause [for blame]. And Allah is Forgiving and Merciful

versets.arabe: وَلَا عَلَى الَّذِينَ إِذَا مَا أَتَوْكَ لِتَحْمِلَهُمْ قُلْتَ لَا أَجِدُ مَا أَحْمِلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ تَوَلَّوا وَّأَعْيُنُهُمْ تَفِيضُ مِنَ الدَّمْعِ
versets.phonetique: Wala AAala allatheena itha ma atawka litahmilaahum qulta la ajidu ma ahmilukum AAalayhi tawallaw waaAAyunuhum tafeedu mina alddamAAi
versets.francais: Ni contre ceux qui, lorsqu'ils sont venus te trouver pour que tu les transportes, tu as dit: "Je ne trouve pas de quoi vous transporter", et ils s'en retournèrent les yeux débordant de larmes.
versets.anglais: Nor [is there blame] upon those who, when they came to you that you might give them mounts, you said, "I can find nothing for you to ride upon." They turned back while their eyes overflowed with tears out of grief that they could not find something to spend [for the cause of Allah]

versets.arabe: إِنَّمَا السَّبِيلُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ يَسْتَأْذِنُونَكَ وَهُمْ أَغْنِيَاءُ رَضُوا بِأَن يَكُونُوا مَعَ الْخَوَالِفِ
versets.phonetique: Innama alssabeelu AAala allatheena yasta'thinoounaka wahum aghniyao radoo bian yakoonoo maAAa alkhawwalif
versets.francais: Le reproche n'incombe qu'à ceux qui te demandent la permission alors qu'ils sont riches; ils se sont contentés d'être avec ceux qui restent derrière.
versets.anglais: The cause [for blame] is only upon those who ask permission of you while they are rich. They are satisfied to be with those who stay behind, and Allah has sealed over their hearts, so they do not know

versets.arabe: يَعْتَذِرُونَ إِلَيْكُمْ إِذَا رَجَعْتُمْ إِلَيْهِمْ قُل لَّا تَعْتَذِرُوا لَن نُّؤْمِنَ لَكُمْ
versets.phonetique: YaAAtatirona ilaykum itha rajaAAatum ilayhim qul la taAAtatiroo lan nu'mina lakum
versets.francais: Ils vous présenteront des excuses quand vous retournerez vers eux. Dis: "N'alléguez pas d'excuses, nous ne vous croirons pas."
versets.anglais: They will make excuses to you when you have returned to them. Say, "Make no excuse - never will we believe you. Allah has already informed us of your news. And Allah will observe your deeds, and [so will] His Messenger; then you will be taken back to the Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, and He will inform you of what you used to do

versets.arabe: سَيَحْلِفُونَ بِاللَّهِ لَكُمْ إِذَا انقَلَبْتُمْ إِلَيْهِمْ لِتُعْرِضُوا عَنْهُمْ فَأَعْرِضُوا عَنْهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Sayahlifoona billahi lakum itha inqalabtum ilayhim lituAAridoo AAanhum faaAAridoo AAanhum
versets.francais: Ils vous jureront par Allah, quand vous reviendrez vers eux, pour que vous les laissiez. Laissez-les donc.
versets.anglais: They will swear by Allah to you when you return to them that you would leave them alone. So leave them alone; indeed they are evil; and their refuge is Hell as recompense for what they had been earning

versets.arabe: يَحْلِفُونَ لَكُمْ لِتَرْضَوْا عَنْهُمْ فَإِن تَرْضَوْا عَنْهُمْ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَرْضَىٰ عَنِ الْقَوْمِ الْفَاسِقِينَ
versets.phonetique: Yahlifoona lakum litardaw AAanhum fa-in tardaw AAanhum fainna Allaha la yarda AAani alqawmi alfasiqeen
versets.francais: Ils vous jureront afin que vous soyez satisfaits d'eux. Mais si vous êtes satisfaits d'eux, Allah ne sera pas satisfait des gens pervers.
versets.anglais: They swear to you so that you might be satisfied with them. But if you should be satisfied with them - indeed, Allah is not satisfied with a defiantly disobedient people

versets.arabe: الْأَعْرَابُ أَشَدُّ كُفْرًا وَنِفَاقًا وَأَجْدَرُ أَلَّا يَعْلَمُوا حُدُودَ مَا أَنزَلَ اللَّهُ عَلَىٰ رَسُولِهِ
versets.phonetique: Al-aAArabu ashaddu kufran wanifaqan waajdaru alla yaAAlamoo hudooda ma anzala Allahu AAala rasoolih
versets.francais: Les Bédouins sont plus endurcis dans la mécréance et l'hypocrisie, et plus enclins à ne pas connaître les limites de ce qu'Allah a révélé à Son messager.
versets.anglais: The bedouins are stronger in disbelief and hypocrisy and more likely not to know the limits of what [laws] Allah has revealed to His Messenger. And Allah is Knowing and Wise

versets.arabe: وَمِنَ الْأَعْرَابِ مَن يَتَّخِذُ مَا يُنفِقُ مَغْرَمًا وَيَتَرَبَّصُ بِكُمُ الدَّوَائِرَ
versets.phonetique: Wamina al-aAArabi man yattakhithu ma yunfiqu maghramaan wayatarabbabu bikumu alddawa'ir
versets.francais: Parmi les Bédouins, il en est qui considèrent ce qu'ils dépensent comme une perte et guettent les revers de fortune qui vous frapperont.
versets.anglais: And among the bedouins are some who consider what they spend as a loss and await for you turns of misfortune. Upon them will be a misfortune of evil. And Allah is Hearing and Knowing

versets.arabe: وَمِنَ الْأَعْرَابِ مَن يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ وَيَتَّخِذُ مَا يُنفِقُ قُرُبَاتٍ عِندَ اللَّهِ
versets.phonetique: Wamina al-aAArabi man yu'minu billahi walyawmi al-akhiri wayattakhithu ma yunfiqu qurubatin AAinda Allahi
versets.francais: Parmi les Bédouins, il en est qui croit en Allah et au Jour dernier et qui considère ce qu'il dépense comme une façon de se rapprocher d'Allah.
versets.anglais: But among the bedouins are some who believe in Allah and the Last Day and consider what they spend as means of nearness to Allah and of [obtaining] invocations of the Messenger. Unquestionably, it is a means of nearness for them. Allah will admit them to His mercy. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful

versets.arabe: وَالسَّابِقُونَ الْأَوَّلُونَ مِنَ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ وَالْأَنصَارِ وَالَّذِينَ اتَّبَعُوهُم بِإِحْسَانٍ رَّضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ وَرَضُوا عَنْهُ
versets.phonetique: Waalsabiqoona al-awwaloona mina almuhajireena waal-ansari wallatheena ittabaAAoohum bi-ihsanin radiya Allahu AAanhum waradoo AAanhu
