versets.francais: Les tout premiers à avoir émigré et à avoir aidé, et ceux qui les ont suivis avec bienfaisance, Allah les agrée et ils L'agréent.
versets.anglais: And the first forerunners [in the faith] among the Muhajireen and the Ansar and those who followed them with good conduct - Allah is pleased with them and they are pleased with Him, and He has prepared for them gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever. That is the great attainment

versets.arabe: وَمِمَّنْ حَوْلَكُم مِّنَ الْأَعْرَابِ مُنَافِقُونَ وَمِنْ أَهْلِ الْمَدِينَةِ مَرَدُوا عَلَى النِّفَاقِ
versets.phonetique: Wamimman hawlakum mina al-aAArabi munafiqoona wamin ahli almadeenati maradoo AAala alnnifaq
versets.francais: Parmi les Bédouins qui vous entourent, il y a des hypocrites, et parmi les habitants de Médine, il y en a qui s'obstinent dans l'hypocrisie.
versets.anglais: And among those around you of the bedouins are hypocrites, and [also] from the people of Madinah. They have become accustomed to hypocrisy. You, [O Muhammad], do not know them, [but] We know them. We will punish them twice [in this world]; then they will be returned to a great punishment

versets.arabe: وَآخَرُونَ اعْتَرَفُوا بِذُنُوبِهِمْ خَلَطُوا عَمَلًا صَالِحًا وَآخَرَ سَيِّئًا عَسَى اللَّهُ أَن يَتُوبَ عَلَيْهِمْ
versets.phonetique: Waakharoona iAAatarafoo bithunoobihim khalatoo AAamalan salihan waakhara sayyi'an AAasa Allahu an yatooба AAalayhim
versets.francais: D'autres ont avoué leurs péchés: ils ont mêlé des bonnes actions à d'autres mauvaises. Peut-être Allah leur accordera-t-Il Son pardon.
versets.anglais: And [there are] others who have acknowledged their sins. They had mixed a righteous deed with another that was bad. Perhaps Allah will turn to them in forgiveness. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful

versets.arabe: خُذْ مِنْ أَمْوَالِهِمْ صَدَقَةً تُطَهِّرُهُمْ وَتُزَكِّيهِم بِهَا وَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِمْ إِنَّ صَلَاتَكَ سَكَنٌ لَّهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Khuth min amwalihim sadaqatan tutahhiruhum watuzakkeehim biha wasalli AAalayhim inna salataka sakanun lahum
versets.francais: Prélève de leurs biens une aumône par laquelle tu les purifies et les bénis, et prie pour eux; car ta prière est une quiétude pour eux.
versets.anglais: Take, [O, Muhammad], from their wealth a charity by which you purify them and cause them increase, and invoke [Allah 's blessings] upon them. Indeed, your invocations are reassurance for them. And Allah is Hearing and Knowing

versets.arabe: أَلَمْ يَعْلَمُوا أَنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ يَقْبَلُ التَّوْبَةَ عَنْ عِبَادِهِ وَيَأْخُذُ الصَّدَقَاتِ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ
versets.phonetique: Alam yaAAlamoo anna Allaha huwa yaqbalu alttawbata AAan AAibadihi waya'khuthu alssadaqati waanna Allaha huwa alttawwabu alraheem
versets.francais: Ne savent-ils pas qu'Allah accueille le repentir de Ses serviteurs et accepte les aumônes, et qu'Allah est Celui qui accepte le repentir, le Miséricordieux?
versets.anglais: Do they not know that it is Allah who accepts repentance from His servants and receives charities and that it is Allah who is the Accepting of repentance, the Merciful

versets.arabe: وَقُلِ اعْمَلُوا فَسَيَرَى اللَّهُ عَمَلَكُمْ وَرَسُولُهُ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ وَسَتُرَدُّونَ إِلَىٰ عَالِمِ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ
versets.phonetique: Waquli iAAmaloo fasayara Allahu AAamalakum warasoolohu walmu'minoona wasaturaddoona ila AAalimi alghaybi waalshshahadati
versets.francais: Et dis: "Agissez! Allah verra vos actions, ainsi que Son messager et les croyants. Et vous serez ramenés vers Celui qui connaît l'invisible et le visible."
versets.anglais: And say, "Do [as you will], for Allah will see your deeds, and [so, will] His Messenger and the believers. And you will be returned to the Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, and He will inform you of what you used to do

versets.arabe: وَآخَرُونَ مُرْجَوْنَ لِأَمْرِ اللَّهِ إِمَّا يُعَذِّبُهُمْ وَإِمَّا يَتُوبُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Waakharoona murjawna li-amri Allahi imma yuAAaththibuhum wa-imma yatoobu AAalayhim wallahu AAaleemun hakeem
versets.francais: D'autres sont en suspens jusqu'à ce qu'Allah prononce Son ordre: soit Il les châtiera, soit Il leur accordera Son pardon. Allah est Omniscient et Sage.
versets.anglais: And [there are] others deferred until the command of Allah - whether He will punish them or whether He will forgive them. And Allah is Knowing and Wise

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ اتَّخَذُوا مَسْجِدًا ضِرَارًا وَكُفْرًا وَتَفْرِيقًا بَيْنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَإِرْصَادًا لِّمَنْ حَارَبَ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ
versets.phonetique: Wallatheena ittakhathoo masjidan diraran wakufran watafreeqan bayna almu'mineena wairsadan liman haraba Allaha warasoolah
versets.francais: Quant à ceux qui ont pris une mosquée pour nuire, par mécréance, pour semer la division parmi les croyants et pour servir de guet-apens à celui qui a fait la guerre à Allah et à Son messager.
versets.anglais: And [there are] those [hypocrites] who took for themselves a mosque for causing harm and disbelief and division among the believers and as a station for whoever had warred against Allah and His Messenger before. And they will surely swear, "We intended only the best." And Allah testifies that indeed they are liars

versets.arabe: لَا تَقُمْ فِيهِ أَبَدًا لَّمَسْجِدٌ أُسِّسَ عَلَى التَّقْوَىٰ مِنْ أَوَّلِ يَوْمٍ أَحَقُّ أَن تَقُومَ فِيهِ
versets.phonetique: La taqum feehi abadan lamasjidun ossisa AAala alttaqwa min awwali yawmin ahaqqu an taqooma feeh
versets.francais: N'y célèbre jamais la prière! Une mosquée fondée dès le premier jour sur la piété mérite mieux que tu y célèbres la prière.
versets.anglais: Do not stand [for prayer] within it - ever. A mosque founded on righteousness from the first day is more worthy for you to stand in. Within it are men who love to purify themselves; and Allah loves those who purify themselves

versets.arabe: أَفَمَنْ أَسَّسَ بُنْيَانَهُ عَلَىٰ تَقْوَىٰ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَرِضْوَانٍ خَيْرٌ أَم مَّنْ أَسَّسَ بُنْيَانَهُ عَلَىٰ شَفَا جُرُفٍ هَارٍ
versets.phonetique: Afaman assasa bunyanahu AAala taqwa mina Allahi waridwanin khayrun am man assasa bunyanahu AAala shafa jurifin harin
versets.francais: Celui qui a fondé son édifice sur la crainte d'Allah et Son agrément vaut-il mieux que celui qui a fondé son édifice au bord d'un ravin qui s'effondre?
versets.anglais: Then is one who laid the foundation of his building on righteousness [with fear] from Allah and [seeking] His approval better or one who laid the foundation of his building on the edge of a bank about to collapse, so it collapsed with him into the fire of Hell? And Allah does not guide the wrongdoing people

versets.arabe: لَا يَزَالُ بُنْيَانُهُمُ الَّذِي بَنَوْا رِيبَةً فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ إِلَّا أَن تَقَطَّعَ قُلُوبُهُمْ وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: La yazalu bunyanuhumu allathee banaw reebatan fee quloobihim illa an taqattaAAa quloobuhum wallahu AAaleemun hakeem
versets.francais: L'édifice qu'ils ont construit ne cessera d'être un sujet de doute dans leurs cœurs, à moins que leurs cœurs ne soient brisés. Allah est Omniscient et Sage.
versets.anglais: Their building which they built will not cease to be a [cause of] skepticism in their hearts until their hearts are stopped. And Allah is Knowing and Wise

versets.arabe: إِنَّ اللَّهَ اشْتَرَىٰ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَأَمْوَالَهُم بِأَنَّ لَهُمُ الْجَنَّةَ
versets.phonetique: Inna Allaha ishtara mina almu'mineena anfusahum waAmwalahum bi-anna lahumu aljannata
versets.francais: Certes Allah a acheté des croyants leurs personnes et leurs biens en échange du Paradis.
versets.anglais: Indeed, Allah has purchased from the believers their lives and their properties [in exchange] for that they will have Paradise. They fight in the cause of Allah, so they kill and are killed. [It is] a true promise [binding] upon Him in the Torah and the Gospel and the Qur'an. And who is truer to his covenant than Allah? So rejoice in your transaction which you have contracted. And it is that which is the great attainment

versets.arabe: التَّائِبُونَ الْعَابِدُونَ الْحَامِدُونَ السَّائِحُونَ الرَّاكِعُونَ السَّاجِدُونَ الْآمِرُونَ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَالنَّاهُونَ عَنِ الْمُنكَرِ
versets.phonetique: Altta'iboona alAAabidoona alhamidoona alssa'ihoona alrraki'oona alssajidoona al-amiroona bilmaAArofi walnahona AAani almunkar
versets.francais: Les repentants, les adorateurs, les louangeurs, les jeûneurs, les inclinés, les prosternés, ceux qui commandent le convenable et interdisent le blâmable.
versets.anglais: [Such believers are] the repentant, the worshippers, the praisers [of Allah], the travelers [for His cause], those who bow and prostrate [in prayer], those who enjoin what is right and forbid what is wrong, and those who observe the limits [set by] Allah. And give good tidings to the believers

versets.arabe: مَا كَانَ لِلنَّبِيِّ وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا أَن يَسْتَغْفِرُوا لِلْمُشْرِكِينَ وَلَوْ كَانُوا أُولِي قُرْبَىٰ
versets.phonetique: Ma kana lilnnabiyyi wallatheena amanoo an yastaghfiroo lilmushrikeena walaw kanoo olee qurba
versets.francais: Il n'appartient pas au Prophète et à ceux qui ont cru d'implorer le pardon pour les associateurs, même s'ils sont des proches parents.
versets.anglais: It is not for the Prophet and those who have believed to ask forgiveness for the polytheists, even if they were relatives, after it has become clear to them that they are companions of Hellfire

versets.arabe: وَمَا كَانَ اسْتِغْفَارُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ لِأَبِيهِ إِلَّا عَن مَّوْعِدَةٍ وَعَدَهَا إِيَّاهُ فَلَمَّا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُ أَنَّهُ عَدُوٌّ لِّلَّهِ تَبَرَّأَ مِنْهُ
versets.phonetique: Wama kana istighfaru ibraheema li-abeehi illa AAan mawAAidatin waAAadaha iyyahu falamma tabayyana lahu annahu AAaduwwun lillahi tabarra'a minh
versets.francais: La demande de pardon d'Abraham pour son père n'était due qu'à une promesse qu'il lui avait faite. Puis quand il lui fut apparu clairement qu'il était ennemi d'Allah, il se désolidarisa de lui.
versets.anglais: And the request of forgiveness of Abraham for his father was only because of a promise he had made to him. But when it became apparent to Abraham that his father was an enemy to Allah, he disassociated himself from him. Indeed was Abraham compassionate and patient

versets.arabe: وَمَا كَانَ اللَّهُ لِيُضِلَّ قَوْمًا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَاهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يُبَيِّنَ لَهُم مَّا يَتَّقُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wama kana Allahu liyudilla qawman baAAda ith hadahum hatta yubayyina lahum ma yattaqoon
versets.francais: Allah n'est pas à égarer un peuple après l'avoir guidé, jusqu'à ce qu'Il lui explique ce qu'il doit craindre.
versets.anglais: And Allah would not let a people stray after He has guided them until He makes clear to them what they should avoid. Indeed, Allah is Knowing of all things

versets.arabe: إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَهُ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِ اللَّهِ مِن وَلِيٍّ وَلَا نَصِيرٍ
versets.phonetique: Inna Allaha lahu mulku alssamawati wal-ardi yuhyee wayumeetu wama lakum min dooni Allahi min waliyyin wala naseer
versets.francais: Certes, Allah possède le royaume des cieux et de la terre. Il donne la vie et donne la mort. Vous n'avez, en dehors d'Allah, ni allié ni secoureur.
versets.anglais: Indeed, to Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth; He gives life and causes death. And you have not besides Allah any protector or any helper

versets.arabe: لَّقَد تَّابَ اللَّهُ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ وَالْمُهَاجِرِينَ وَالْأَنصَارِ الَّذِينَ اتَّبَعُوهُ فِي سَاعَةِ الْعُسْرَةِ
versets.phonetique: Laqad taba Allahu AAala alnnabiyyi waalmuhajireena waal-ansari allatheena ittabaAAoohu fee saAAati alAAusrah
versets.francais: Allah a certainement accordé Son pardon au Prophète, aux émigrés et aux Ansars qui l'ont suivi dans l'heure de la détresse.
versets.anglais: Allah has already forgiven the Prophet and the Muhajireen and the Ansar who followed him in the hour of difficulty after the hearts of a party of them had almost inclined [to doubt], and then He forgave them. Indeed, He was to them Kind and Merciful

versets.arabe: وَعَلَى الثَّلَاثَةِ الَّذِينَ خُلِّفُوا حَتَّىٰ إِذَا ضَاقَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ الْأَرْضُ بِمَا رَحُبَتْ
versets.phonetique: WaAAala alththalathati allatheena khullifoo hatta itha daqat AAalayhimu al-ardu bima rahubat
versets.francais: Et aux trois qui avaient été laissés en arrière: la terre leur parut immense malgré son étendue.
versets.anglais: And [He also forgave] the three who were left behind [and regretted their error] to the point that the earth closed in on them in spite of its vastness and their souls confined them and they were certain that there is no refuge from Allah except in Him. Then He turned to them so they could repent. Indeed, Allah is the Accepting of repentance, the Merciful

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَكُونُوا مَعَ الصَّادِقِينَ
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo ittaqoo Allaha wakoonoo maAAa alssadiqeen
versets.francais: Ô vous qui croyez! Craignez Allah et soyez avec les véridiques.
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, fear Allah and be with those who are true

versets.arabe: مَا كَانَ لِأَهْلِ الْمَدِينَةِ وَمَنْ حَوْلَهُم مِّنَ الْأَعْرَابِ أَن يَتَخَلَّفُوا عَن رَّسُولِ اللَّهِ
versets.phonetique: Ma kana li-ahli almadeenati waman hawlahum mina al-aAArabi an yatakhallafoo AAan rasooli Allah
versets.francais: Il n'appartient pas aux habitants de Médine et aux Bédouins qui les entourent de rester derrière le messager d'Allah.
versets.anglais: It was not [proper] for the people of Madinah and those surrounding them of the bedouins that they remain behind after [the departure of] the Messenger of Allah or that they prefer themselves over his self. That is because they are not afflicted by thirst or fatigue or hunger in the cause of Allah, nor do they tread on any ground that enrages the disbelievers, nor do they inflict upon an enemy any infliction but that is registered for them as a righteous deed. Indeed, Allah does not allow to be lost the reward of the doers of good

versets.arabe: وَلَا يُنفِقُونَ نَفَقَةً صَغِيرَةً وَلَا كَبِيرَةً وَلَا يَقْطَعُونَ وَادِيًا إِلَّا كُتِبَ لَهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Wala yunfiqoona nafaqatan sagheeratan wala kabeeratan wala yaqtaAAoona wadiyan illa kutiba lahum
versets.francais: Ils ne font aucune dépense, petite ou grande, et ne traversent aucune vallée sans que cela ne leur soit inscrit.
versets.anglais: Nor do they spend an expenditure, small or large, or cross a valley but that it is registered for them that Allah may reward them for the best of what they were doing

versets.arabe: وَمَا كَانَ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ لِيَنفِرُوا كَافَّةً فَلَوْلَا نَفَرَ مِن كُلِّ فِرْقَةٍ مِّنْهُمْ طَائِفَةٌ لِّيَتَفَقَّهُوا فِي الدِّينِ
versets.phonetique: Wama kana almu'minoona liyanfiroo kaffatan falawla nafara min kulli firqatin minhum ta'ifatun liyatafaqqahoo fee alddeeni
versets.francais: Les croyants ne doivent pas partir tous en expédition. Pourquoi de chaque groupe d'entre eux une partie ne se consacrerait-elle pas à l'approfondissement de la religion?
versets.anglais: And it is not for the believers to go forth [to battle] all at once. For there should separate from every division of them a group [remaining] to obtain understanding in the religion and warn their people when they return to them that they might be cautious

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا قَاتِلُوا الَّذِينَ يَلُونَكُم مِّنَ الْكُفَّارِ وَلْيَجِدُوا فِيكُمْ غِلْظَةً
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo qatiloo allatheena yaloonakum mina alkuffari walyajidoo feekum ghilthah
versets.francais: Ô vous qui croyez! Combattez les mécréants qui vous avoisinent, et qu'ils trouvent en vous de la fermeté.
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, fight those adjacent to you of the disbelievers and let them find in you harshness. And know that Allah is with the righteous

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا مَا أُنزِلَتْ سُورَةٌ فَمِنْهُم مَّن يَقُولُ أَيُّكُمْ زَادَتْهُ هَٰذِهِ إِيمَانًا
versets.phonetique: Wa-itha ma onzilat sooratun faminhum man yaqoolu ayyukum zadat-hu hathihi eemanan
versets.francais: Quand une sourate est révélée, certains d'entre eux disent: "Lequel d'entre vous cette sourate a-t-elle accru en foi?"
versets.anglais: And whenever a surah is revealed, there are among the hypocrites those who say, "Which of you has this increased faith?" As for those who believed, it has increased them in faith, while they are rejoicing

versets.arabe: وَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ فَزَادَتْهُمْ رِجْسًا إِلَىٰ رِجْسِهِمْ وَمَاتُوا وَهُمْ كَافِرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Waamma allatheena fee quloobihim maradun fazadathum rijsan ila rijsihim wamatoo wahum kafiroon
versets.francais: Quant à ceux qui ont une maladie dans leurs cœurs, elle leur a accru leur souillure à leur souillure et ils sont morts en étant mécréants.
versets.anglais: But as for those in whose hearts is disease, it has [only] increased them in evil [in addition] to their evil. And they will have died while they are disbelievers

versets.arabe: أَوَلَا يَرَوْنَ أَنَّهُمْ يُفْتَنُونَ فِي كُلِّ عَامٍ مَّرَّةً أَوْ مَرَّتَيْنِ ثُمَّ لَا يَتُوبُونَ وَلَا هُمْ يَذَّكَّرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Awala yarawna annahum yuftanoona fee kulli AAamin marratan aw marratayni thumma la yatooboona wala hum yaththakkaroon
versets.francais: Ne voient-ils pas qu'ils sont éprouvés une ou deux fois chaque année? Puis ils ne se repentent pas et ne se souviennent pas.
versets.anglais: Do they not see that they are tried every year once or twice but then they do not repent nor do they remember

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا مَا أُنزِلَتْ سُورَةٌ نَّظَرَ بَعْضُهُمْ إِلَىٰ بَعْضٍ هَلْ يَرَاكُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ ثُمَّ انصَرَفُوا
versets.phonetique: Wa-itha ma onzilat sooratun nadhara baAAduhum ila baAAdin hal yarakum min ahadin thumma insarafoo
versets.francais: Quand une sourate est révélée, ils se regardent les uns les autres: "Y a-t-il quelqu'un qui vous voit?" Puis ils s'en vont.
versets.anglais: And whenever a surah is revealed, they look at each other, [saying], "Does anyone see you?" and then they dismiss themselves. Allah has dismissed their hearts because they are a people who do not understand

versets.arabe: لَقَدْ جَاءَكُمْ رَسُولٌ مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ عَزِيزٌ عَلَيْهِ مَا عَنِتُّمْ حَرِيصٌ عَلَيْكُم بِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ رَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Laqad jaakum rasoolun min anfusikum AAazeezun AAalayhi ma AAanittum hareesun AAalaykum bilmu'mineena raoofun raheem
versets.francais: Il vous est venu un messager pris parmi vous; il souffre de ce que vous souffrez et s'intéresse à vous. Il est compatissant et miséricordieux envers les croyants.
versets.anglais: There has certainly come to you a Messenger from among yourselves. Grievous to him is what you suffer; [he is] concerned over you and to the believers is kind and merciful

versets.arabe: فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا فَقُلْ حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
versets.phonetique: Fa-in tawallaw faqul hasbiya Allahu la ilaha illa huwa AAalayhi tawakkaltu wahuwa rabbu alAAarshi alAAatheem
versets.francais: S'ils se détournent, dis: "Allah me suffit. Il n'y a pas de divinité à part Lui. Je me confie en Lui. Il est le Seigneur du Trône immense."
versets.anglais: But if they turn away, [O Muhammad], say, "Sufficient for me is Allah; there is no deity except Him. On Him I have relied, and He is the Lord of the Great Throne

versets.arabe: الر تِلْكَ آيَاتُ الْكِتَابِ الْحَكِيمِ
versets.phonetique: Alif-Lâm-Râ. Tilka âyâtul-kitâbil-hakîm
versets.francais: Alif, Lam, Ra. Voici les versets du Livre sage.
versets.anglais: Alif, Lam, Ra. These are the verses of the wise Book

versets.arabe: أَكَانَ لِلنَّاسِ عَجَبًا أَنْ أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَىٰ رَجُلٍ مِّنْهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Akâna lin-nâsi 'ajaban an awhaynâ ilâ rajulim minhum
versets.francais: Est-il étonnant pour les gens que Nous ayons révélé à un homme parmi eux?
versets.anglais: Have the people been amazed that We revealed [revelation] to a man from among them, [saying], "Warn mankind and give good tidings to those who believe that they will have a [firm] precedence of honor with their Lord"? [But] the disbelievers say, "Indeed, this is an obvious magician

versets.arabe: إِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ اللَّهُ الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ
versets.phonetique: Inna rabbakumullâhul-lathî khalaqas-samâwâti wal-ardha fî sittati ayyâm
versets.francais: Votre Seigneur est Allah qui a créé les cieux et la terre en six jours.
versets.anglais: Indeed, your Lord is Allah, who created the heavens and the earth in six days and then established Himself above the Throne, arranging the matter [of His creation]. There is no intercessor except after His permission. That is Allah, your Lord, so worship Him. Then will you not remember

versets.arabe: إِلَيْهِ مَرْجِعُكُمْ جَمِيعًا وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقًّا
versets.phonetique: Ilayhi marji'ukum jamî'an wa'dallâhi haqqâ
versets.francais: C'est vers Lui que vous retournerez tous. C'est la promesse d'Allah en vérité.
versets.anglais: To Him is your return all together. [It is] the promise of Allah [which is] truth. Indeed, He begins the [process of] creation and then repeats it that He may reward those who have believed and done righteous deeds, in justice. But those who disbelieved will have a drink of scalding water and a painful punishment for what they used to deny

versets.arabe: هُوَ الَّذِي جَعَلَ الشَّمْسَ ضِيَاءً وَالْقَمَرَ نُورًا
versets.phonetique: Huwal-lathî ja'alash-shamsa dhiyâ'an wal-qamara nûrâ
versets.francais: C'est Lui qui a fait du soleil une clarté et de la lune une lumière.
versets.anglais: It is He who made the sun a shining light and the moon a derived light and determined for it phases - that you may know the number of years and account [of time]. Allah has not created this except in truth. He details the signs for a people who know

versets.arabe: إِنَّ فِي اخْتِلَافِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ وَمَا خَلَقَ اللَّهُ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ
versets.phonetique: Inna fîkhtilâfil-layli wan-nahâri wa mâ khalaqallâhu fis-samâwâti wal-ardh
versets.francais: Dans l'alternance de la nuit et du jour et ce qu'Allah a créé dans les cieux et la terre, il y a des signes.
versets.anglais: Indeed, in the alternation of the night and the day and [in] what Allah has created in the heavens and the earth are signs for a people who fear Allah

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ لَا يَرْجُونَ لِقَاءَنَا وَرَضُوا بِالْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا
versets.phonetique: Innal-lathîna lâ yarjûna liqâ'anâ wa radhû bil-hayâtid-dunyâ
versets.francais: Ceux qui n'espèrent pas Notre rencontre et se satisfont de la vie présente.
versets.anglais: Indeed, those who do not expect the meeting with Us and are satisfied with the life of this world and feel secure therein and those who are heedless of Our signs

versets.arabe: أُولَٰئِكَ مَأْوَاهُمُ النَّارُ بِمَا كَانُوا يَكْسِبُونَ
versets.phonetique: Ulâ'ika ma'wâhumun-nâru bimâ kânû yaksibûn
versets.francais: Ceux-là, leur demeure sera le Feu à cause de ce qu'ils ont acquis.
versets.anglais: For those their refuge will be the Fire because of what they used to earn

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ يَهْدِيهِمْ رَبُّهُم بِإِيمَانِهِمْ
versets.phonetique: Innal-lathîna âmanû wa 'amilûs-sâlihâti yahdîhim rabbuhum bi'îmânihim
versets.francais: Ceux qui ont cru et accompli les bonnes œuvres, leur Seigneur les guidera grâce à leur foi.
versets.anglais: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - their Lord will guide them because of their faith. Beneath them rivers will flow in the Gardens of Pleasure

versets.arabe: دَعْوَاهُمْ فِيهَا سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَتَحِيَّتُهُمْ فِيهَا سَلَامٌ
versets.phonetique: Da'wâhum fîhâ subhânakallâhumma wa tahiyyatuhum fîhâ salâm
versets.francais: Leur invocation là-dedans sera: Gloire à Toi, ô Allah! Et leur salutation: Paix!
versets.anglais: Their call therein will be, "Exalted are You, O Allah," and their greeting therein will be, "Peace." And the last of their call will be, "Praise to Allah, Lord of the worlds

versets.arabe: وَلَوْ يُعَجِّلُ اللَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ الشَّرَّ اسْتِعْجَالَهُم بِالْخَيْرِ
versets.phonetique: Wa law yu'ajjilullâhu lin-nâsish-sharra isti'jâlahum bil-khayr
versets.francais: Si Allah précipitait pour les hommes le mal comme ils veulent précipiter le bien.
versets.anglais: And if Allah was to hasten for the people the evil [they invoke] as He hastens for them the good, their term would have been ended for them. But We leave the ones who do not expect the meeting with Us, in their transgression, wandering blindly

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا مَسَّ الْإِنسَانَ الضُّرُّ دَعَانَا لِجَنبِهِ أَوْ قَاعِدًا أَوْ قَائِمًا
versets.phonetique: Wa ithâ massal-insânadh-dhurru da'ânâ lijambihî aw qâ'idan aw qâ'imâ
versets.francais: Quand le malheur touche l'homme, il Nous invoque couché sur le côté, assis ou debout.
versets.anglais: And when affliction touches man, he calls upon Us, whether lying on his side or sitting or standing; but when We remove from him his affliction, he continues [in disobedience] as if he had never called upon Us to [remove] an affliction that touched him. Thus is made pleasing to the transgressors that which they have been doing

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَا الْقُرُونَ مِن قَبْلِكُمْ لَمَّا ظَلَمُوا
versets.phonetique: Wa laqad ahlaknâl-qurûna min qablikum lammâ dhalamû
versets.francais: Nous avons anéanti des générations avant vous lorsqu'elles furent injustes.
versets.anglais: And We had already destroyed generations before you when they wronged, and their messengers had come to them with clear proofs, but they were not to believe. Thus do We recompense the criminal people

versets.arabe: ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَاكُمْ خَلَائِفَ فِي الْأَرْضِ مِن بَعْدِهِمْ
versets.phonetique: Thumma ja'alnâkum khalâ'ifa fil-ardhi mim ba'dihim
versets.francais: Ensuite Nous vous avons établis comme successeurs sur la terre après eux.
versets.anglais: Then We made you successors in the land after them so that We may observe how you will do

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ آيَاتُنَا بَيِّنَاتٍ قَالَ الَّذِينَ لَا يَرْجُونَ لِقَاءَنَا
versets.phonetique: Wa ithâ tutlâ 'alayhim âyâtunâ bayyinâtin qâlal-lathîna lâ yarjûna liqâ'anâ
versets.francais: Quand Nos versets leur sont récités clairement, ceux qui n'espèrent pas Notre rencontre disent.
versets.anglais: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, those who do not expect the meeting with Us say, "Bring us a Qur'an other than this or change it." Say, [O Muhammad], "It is not for me to change it on my own accord. I only follow what is revealed to me. Indeed I fear, if I should disobey my Lord, the punishment of a tremendous Day

versets.arabe: قُل لَّوْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ مَا تَلَوْتُهُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَلَا أَدْرَاكُم بِهِ
versets.phonetique: Qul law shâ'allâhu mâ talawtuhu 'alaykum wa lâ adrâkum bih
versets.francais: Dis: si Allah l'avait voulu, je ne vous l'aurais pas récité et Il ne vous l'aurait pas fait connaître.
versets.anglais: Say, "If Allah had willed, I would not have recited it to you, nor would He have made it known to you, for I had remained among you a lifetime before it. Then will you not reason

versets.arabe: فَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ افْتَرَىٰ عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا أَوْ كَذَّبَ بِآيَاتِهِ
versets.phonetique: Faman adhlamu mimmanifte-râ 'alallâhi kathiban aw kaththaba bi'âyâtih
versets.francais: Qui est plus injuste que celui qui invente un mensonge contre Allah ou qui traite Ses versets de mensonges?
versets.anglais: So who is more unjust than he who invents a lie about Allah or denies His signs? Indeed, the criminals will not succeed

versets.arabe: وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ مَا لَا يَضُرُّهُمْ وَلَا يَنفَعُهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Wa ya'budûna min dûnillâhi mâ lâ yadhurruhum wa lâ yanfa'uhum
versets.francais: Ils adorent en dehors d'Allah ce qui ne leur nuit ni ne leur profite.
versets.anglais: And they worship other than Allah that which neither harms them nor benefits them, and they say, "These are our intercessors with Allah " Say, "Do you inform Allah of something He does not know in the heavens or on the earth?" Exalted is He and high above what they associate with Him

versets.arabe: وَمَا كَانَ النَّاسُ إِلَّا أُمَّةً وَاحِدَةً فَاخْتَلَفُوا
versets.phonetique: Wa mâ kânan-nâsu illâ ummataw wâhidatan fakhtalafu
versets.francais: Les hommes ne formaient qu'une seule communauté, puis ils divergèrent.
versets.anglais: And mankind was not but one community [united in religion], but [then] they differed. And if not for a word that preceded from your Lord, it would have been judged between them [immediately] concerning that over which they differ

versets.arabe: وَيَقُولُونَ لَوْلَا أُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ آيَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِ
versets.phonetique: Wa yaqûlûna lawlâ unzila 'alayhi âyatun mir-rabbih
versets.francais: Ils disent: pourquoi n'a-t-on pas fait descendre sur lui un signe de son Seigneur?
versets.anglais: And they say, "Why is a sign not sent down to him from his Lord?" So say, "The unseen is only for Allah [to administer], so wait; indeed, I am with you among those who wait

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا أَذَقْنَا النَّاسَ رَحْمَةً مِّن بَعْدِ ضَرَّاءَ مَسَّتْهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Wa ithâ athaqnan-nâsa rahmatam mim ba'di dharrâ'a massat-hum
versets.francais: Quand Nous faisons goûter aux hommes une miséricorde après une adversité qui les avait touchés.
versets.anglais: And when We give the people a taste of mercy after adversity has touched them, at once they conspire against Our verses. Say, "Allah is swifter in strategy." Indeed, Our messengers record that which you conspire

versets.arabe: هُوَ الَّذِي يُسَيِّرُكُمْ فِي الْبَرِّ وَالْبَحْرِ
versets.phonetique: Huwal-lathî yusayyirukum fil-barri wal-bahr
versets.francais: C'est Lui qui vous fait voyager sur terre et sur mer.
versets.anglais: It is He who enables you to travel on land and sea until, when you are in ships and they sail with them by a good wind and they rejoice therein, there comes a storm wind and the waves come upon them from everywhere and they assume that they are surrounded, supplicating Allah, sincere to Him in religion, "If You should save us from this, we will surely be among the thankful

versets.arabe: فَلَمَّا أَنجَاهُمْ إِذَا هُمْ يَبْغُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ الْحَقِّ
versets.phonetique: Falammâ anjâhum ithâ hum yabghûna fil-ardhi bighayril-haqq
versets.francais: Mais quand Il les sauve, les voilà qui commettent des injustices sur la terre sans droit.
versets.anglais: But when He saves them, at once they commit injustice upon the earth without right. O mankind, your injustice is only against yourselves, [being merely] the enjoyment of worldly life. Then to Us is your return, and We will inform you of what you used to do

versets.arabe: إِنَّمَا مَثَلُ الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا كَمَاءٍ أَنزَلْنَاهُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ
versets.phonetique: Innamâ mathalul-hayâtid-dunyâ kamâ'in anzalnâhu minas-samâ'
versets.francais: La vie du monde est comparable à une eau que Nous faisons descendre du ciel.
versets.anglais: The example of [this] worldly life is but like rain which We have sent down from the sky that the plants of the earth absorb - [those] from which men and livestock eat - until, when the earth has taken on its adornment and is beautified and its people suppose that they have capability over it, there comes to it Our command by night or by day, and We make it as a harvest, as if it had not flourished yesterday. Thus do We explain in detail the signs for a people who give thought

versets.arabe: وَاللَّهُ يَدْعُو إِلَىٰ دَارِ السَّلَامِ وَيَهْدِي مَن يَشَاءُ إِلَىٰ صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
versets.phonetique: Wallâhu yad'û ilâ dâris-salâmi wa yahdî man yashâ'u ilâ sirâtim mustaqîm
versets.francais: Allah appelle à la Demeure de la paix et guide qui Il veut vers un chemin droit.
versets.anglais: And Allah invites to the Home of Peace and guides whom He wills to a straight path

versets.arabe: لِّلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا الْحُسْنَىٰ وَزِيَادَةٌ
versets.phonetique: Lillathîna ahsanul-husnâ wa ziyâdah
versets.francais: Ceux qui ont fait le bien auront la meilleure récompense et davantage.
versets.anglais: For them who have done good is the best [reward] and extra. No darkness will cover their faces, nor humiliation. Those are companions of Paradise; they will abide therein eternally

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ كَسَبُوا السَّيِّئَاتِ جَزَاءُ سَيِّئَةٍ بِمِثْلِهَا
versets.phonetique: Wallathîna kasabus-sayyi'âti jazâ'u sayyi'atim bimithlihâ
versets.francais: Ceux qui ont accompli les mauvaises actions seront récompensés d'un mal égal au mal.
versets.anglais: But they who have earned [blame for] evil doings - the recompense of an evil deed is its equivalent, and humiliation will cover them. They will have from Allah no protector. It will be as if their faces are covered with pieces of the night - so dark [are they]. Those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally

versets.arabe: وَيَوْمَ نَحْشُرُهُمْ جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ نَقُولُ لِلَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوا مَكَانَكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Wa yawma nahshuruhum jamî'an thumma naqûlu lillathîna ashrakû makânakum
versets.francais: Le jour où Nous les rassemblerons tous, puis Nous dirons à ceux qui ont associé: restez à vos places.
versets.anglais: And [mention, O Muhammad], the Day We will gather them all together - then We will say to those who associated others with Allah, "[Remain in] your place, you and your 'partners.' " Then We will separate them, and their "partners" will say, "You did not used to worship us

versets.arabe: فَكَفَىٰ بِاللَّهِ شَهِيدًا بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Fakafâ billâhi shahîdan baynanâ wa baynakum
versets.francais: Allah suffit comme témoin entre nous et vous.
versets.anglais: And sufficient is Allah as a witness between us and you that we were of your worship unaware

versets.arabe: هُنَالِكَ تَبْلُو كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّا أَسْلَفَتْ
versets.phonetique: Hunâlika tablû kullu nafsin mâ aslafat
versets.francais: Là, chaque âme éprouvera ce qu'elle aura envoyé en avant.
versets.anglais: There, [on that Day], every soul will be put to trial for what it did previously, and they will be returned to Allah, their master, the Truth, and lost from them is whatever they used to invent

versets.arabe: قُلْ مَن يَرْزُقُكُم مِّنَ السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ
versets.phonetique: Qul man yarzuqukum minas-samâ'i wal-ardh
versets.francais: Dis: qui vous accorde votre subsistance depuis le ciel et la terre?
versets.anglais: Say, "Who provides for you from the heaven and the earth? Or who controls hearing and sight and who brings the living out of the dead and brings the dead out of the living and who arranges [every] matter?" They will say, "Allah," so say, "Then will you not fear Him

versets.arabe: فَذَٰلِكُمُ اللَّهُ رَبُّكُمُ الْحَقُّ فَمَاذَا بَعْدَ الْحَقِّ إِلَّا الضَّلَالُ
versets.phonetique: Fathâlikumullâhu rabbukumul-haqqu famâthâ ba'dal-haqqi illad-dhalâl
versets.francais: Voilà Allah, votre vrai Seigneur. Qu'y a-t-il après la vérité, sinon l'égarement?
versets.anglais: For that is Allah, your Lord, the Truth. And what can be beyond truth except error? So how are you averted

versets.arabe: كَذَٰلِكَ حَقَّتْ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ عَلَى الَّذِينَ فَسَقُوا
versets.phonetique: Kathâlika haqqat kalimatu rabbika 'alal-lathîna fasaqû
versets.francais: Ainsi s'est réalisée la parole de ton Seigneur contre ceux qui ont transgressé.
versets.anglais: Thus the word of your Lord has come into effect upon those who defiantly disobeyed - that they will not believe

versets.arabe: قُلْ هَلْ مِن شُرَكَائِكُم مَّن يَبْدَأُ الْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُ
versets.phonetique: Qul hal min shurakâ'ikum man yabda'ul-khalqa thumma yu'îduh
versets.francais: Dis: y a-t-il parmi vos associés quelqu'un qui crée d'abord puis renouvelle?
versets.anglais: Say, "Are there of your 'partners' any who begins creation and then repeats it?" Say, "Allah begins creation and then repeats it, so how are you deluded

versets.arabe: قُلْ هَلْ مِن شُرَكَائِكُم مَّن يَهْدِي إِلَى الْحَقِّ
versets.phonetique: Qul hal min shurakâ'ikum man yahdî ilal-haqq
versets.francais: Dis: y a-t-il parmi vos associés quelqu'un qui guide vers la vérité?
versets.anglais: Say, "Are there of your 'partners' any who guides to the truth?" Say, "Allah guides to the truth. So is He who guides to the truth more worthy to be followed or he who guides not unless he is guided? Then what is [wrong] with you - how do you judge

versets.arabe: وَمَا يَتَّبِعُ أَكْثَرُهُمْ إِلَّا ظَنًّا إِنَّ الظَّنَّ لَا يُغْنِي مِنَ الْحَقِّ شَيْئًا
versets.phonetique: Wa mâ yattabi'u aktharuhum illâ zhannan innadh-dhanna lâ yughnî minal-haqqi shay'â
versets.francais: La plupart d'entre eux ne suivent que la conjecture. La conjecture ne sert à rien contre la vérité.
versets.anglais: And most of them follow not except assumption. Indeed, assumption avails not against the truth at all. Indeed, Allah is Knowing of what they do

versets.arabe: وَمَا كَانَ هَٰذَا الْقُرْآنُ أَن يُفْتَرَىٰ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ
versets.phonetique: Wa mâ kâna hâthal-qur'ânu an yuftarâ min dûnillâh
versets.francais: Ce Coran ne peut être inventé en dehors d'Allah.
versets.anglais: And it was not [possible] for this Qur'an to be produced by other than Allah, but [it is] a confirmation of what was before it and a detailed explanation of the [former] Scripture, about which there is no doubt, from the Lord of the worlds

versets.arabe: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ افْتَرَاهُ قُلْ فَأْتُوا بِسُورَةٍ مِّثْلِهِ
versets.phonetique: Am yaqûlûnaftarâh, qul fa'tû bisûratim mithlih
versets.francais: Ou disent-ils qu'il l'a inventé? Dis: apportez une sourate pareille à lui.
versets.anglais: Or do they say [about the Prophet], "He invented it?" Say, "Then bring forth a surah like it and call upon [for assistance] whomever you can besides Allah, if you should be truthful

versets.arabe: بَلْ كَذَّبُوا بِمَا لَمْ يُحِيطُوا بِعِلْمِهِ
versets.phonetique: Bal kaththabû bimâ lam yuhîtû bi'ilmih
versets.francais: Mais ils ont traité de mensonge ce dont ils n'ont pas embrassé la connaissance.
versets.anglais: Rather, they have denied that which they encompass not in knowledge and whose interpretation has not yet come to them. Thus did those before them deny. Then observe how was the end of the wrongdoers

versets.arabe: وَمِنْهُم مَّن يُؤْمِنُ بِهِ وَمِنْهُم مَّن لَّا يُؤْمِنُ بِهِ
versets.phonetique: Wa minhum man yu'minu bihî wa minhum man lâ yu'minu bih
versets.francais: Parmi eux, il y en a qui croient en lui et il y en a qui n'y croient pas.
versets.anglais: And of them are those who believe in it, and of them are those who do not believe in it. And your Lord is most knowing of the corrupters

versets.arabe: وَإِن كَذَّبُوكَ فَقُل لِّي عَمَلِي وَلَكُمْ عَمَلُكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Wa in kaththabûka faqul lî 'amalî wa lakum 'amalukum
versets.francais: S'ils te traitent de menteur, dis: à moi mon oeuvre et à vous votre oeuvre.
versets.anglais: And if they deny you, [O Muhammad], then say, "For me are my deeds, and for you are your deeds. You are disassociated from what I do, and I am disassociated from what you do

versets.arabe: وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَسْتَمِعُونَ إِلَيْكَ أَفَأَنتَ تُسْمِعُ الصُّمَّ
versets.phonetique: Wa minhum man yastami'ûna ilayk, afa'anta tusmi'ush-summ
versets.francais: Parmi eux il y en a qui t'écoutent. Mais peux-tu faire entendre les sourds?
versets.anglais: And among them are those who listen to you. But can you cause the deaf to hear, although they will not use reason

versets.arabe: وَمِنهُم مَّن يَنظُرُ إِلَيْكَ أَفَأَنتَ تَهْدِي الْعُمْيَ
versets.phonetique: Wa minhum man yandh-uru ilayk, afa'anta tahdil-'umya
versets.francais: Parmi eux il y en a qui te regardent. Mais peux-tu guider les aveugles?
versets.anglais: And among them are those who look at you. But can you guide the blind although they will not [attempt to] see

versets.arabe: إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَظْلِمُ النَّاسَ شَيْئًا وَلَٰكِنَّ النَّاسَ أَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Innallâha lâ yadhlimun-nâsa shay'an wa lâkinnan-nâsa anfusahum yadhlimûn
versets.francais: Allah n'est pas injuste envers les hommes, mais les hommes sont injustes envers eux-mêmes.
versets.anglais: Indeed, Allah does not wrong the people at all, but it is the people who are wronging themselves

versets.arabe: وَيَوْمَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ كَأَن لَّمْ يَلْبَثُوا إِلَّا سَاعَةً مِّنَ النَّهَارِ
versets.phonetique: Wa yawma yahshuruhum ka'an lam yalbathû illâ sâ'atam minan-nahâr
versets.francais: Le jour où Il les rassemblera, comme s'ils n'avaient demeuré qu'une heure du jour.
versets.anglais: And on the Day when He will gather them, [it will be] as if they had not remained [in the world] but an hour of the day, [and] they will know each other. Those will have lost who denied the meeting with Allah and were not guided

versets.arabe: وَإِمَّا نُرِيَنَّكَ بَعْضَ الَّذِي نَعِدُهُمْ أَوْ نَتَوَفَّيَنَّكَ
versets.phonetique: Wa immâ nuriyannaka ba'dhal-lathî na'iduhum aw natawaffayannaka
versets.francais: Que Nous te fassions voir quelque chose de ce que Nous leur promettons, ou que Nous te rappelions.
versets.anglais: And whether We show you some of what We promise them, [O Muhammad], or We take you in death, to Us is their return; then, [either way], Allah is a witness concerning what they are doing

versets.arabe: وَلِكُلِّ أُمَّةٍ رَّسُولٌ فَإِذَا جَاءَ رَسُولُهُمْ قُضِيَ بَيْنَهُم بِالْقِسْطِ
versets.phonetique: Wa likulli ummatin rasûlun fa'ithâ jâ'a rasûluhum qudhiya baynahum bil-qist
versets.francais: À chaque communauté son messager. Quand leur messager vient, on juge entre eux en toute équité.
versets.anglais: And for every nation is a messenger. So when their messenger comes, it will be judged between them in justice, and they will not be wronged

versets.arabe: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا الْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَادِقِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa yaqûlûna matâ hâthal-wa'du in kuntum sâdiqîn
versets.francais: Ils disent: quand se réalisera cette promesse, si vous dites vrai?
versets.anglais: And they say, "When is [the fulfillment of] this promise, if you should be truthful

versets.arabe: قُل لَّا أَمْلِكُ لِنَفْسِي ضَرًّا وَلَا نَفْعًا إِلَّا مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ
versets.phonetique: Qul lâ amliku linafsî dharran wa lâ naf'an illâ mâ shâ'allâh
versets.francais: Dis: je ne dispose pour moi-même, ni de tort ni de profit, sauf ce qu'Allah veut.
versets.anglais: Say, "I possess not for myself any harm or benefit except what Allah should will. For every nation is a [specified] term. When their time has come, then they will not remain behind an hour, nor will they precede [it]

versets.arabe: قُلْ أَرَأَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَتَاكُمْ عَذَابُهُ بَيَاتًا أَوْ نَهَارًا
versets.phonetique: Qul ara'aytum in atâkum 'athâbuhû bayâtan aw nahârâ
versets.francais: Dis: avez-vous réfléchi? Si Son châtiment vous venait de nuit ou de jour.
versets.anglais: Say, "Have you considered: if His punishment should come to you by night or by day - for which [aspect] of it would the criminals be impatient

versets.arabe: أَثُمَّ إِذَا مَا وَقَعَ آمَنتُم بِهِ آلْآنَ وَقَدْ كُنتُم بِهِ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Athumma ithâ mâ waqa'a âmantum bih, âl'âna wa qad kuntum bihî tasta'jilûn
versets.francais: Est-ce qu'alors, quand il sera arrivé, vous y croirez? Maintenant? Alors que vous le pressiez?
versets.anglais: Then is it that when it has [actually] occurred you will believe in it? Now? And you were [once] for it impatient

versets.arabe: ثُمَّ قِيلَ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا ذُوقُوا عَذَابَ الْخُلْدِ
versets.phonetique: Thumma qîla lillathîna dhalamû thûqû 'athâbal-khuld
versets.francais: Puis il sera dit à ceux qui furent injustes: goûtez au châtiment éternel.
versets.anglais: Then it will be said to those who had wronged, "Taste the punishment of eternity; are you being recompensed except for what you used to earn

versets.arabe: وَيَسْتَنبِئُونَكَ أَحَقٌّ هُوَ قُلْ إِي وَرَبِّي إِنَّهُ لَحَقٌّ
versets.phonetique: Wa yastanbi'ûnaka ahaqqun huwa, qul î'wa rabbî innahû lahaqq
versets.francais: Ils te demandent si c'est vrai. Dis: oui, par mon Seigneur, c'est la vérité.
versets.anglais: And they ask information of you, [O Muhammad], "Is it true?" Say, "Yes, by my Lord. Indeed, it is truth; and you will not cause failure [to Allah]

versets.arabe: وَلَوْ أَنَّ لِكُلِّ نَفْسٍ ظَلَمَتْ مَا فِي الْأَرْضِ لَافْتَدَتْ بِهِ
versets.phonetique: Wa law anna likulli nafsin dhalamat mâ fil-ardhi laftadat bih
versets.francais: Si chaque âme injuste possédait tout ce qui est sur la terre, elle en offrirait le prix de sa rançon.
versets.anglais: And if each soul that wronged had everything on earth, it would offer it in ransom. And they will confide regret when they see the punishment; and they will be judged in justice, and they will not be wronged

versets.arabe: أَلَا إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ
versets.phonetique: Alâ inna lillâhi mâ fis-samâwâti wal-ardh
versets.francais: Sache qu'à Allah appartient ce qui est dans les cieux et sur la terre.
versets.anglais: Unquestionably, to Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth. Unquestionably, the promise of Allah is truth, but most of them do not know

versets.arabe: هُوَ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
versets.phonetique: Huwa yuhyî wa yumîtu wa ilayhi turja'ûn
versets.francais: C'est Lui qui donne la vie et qui fait mourir, et c'est vers Lui que vous retournerez.
versets.anglais: He gives life and causes death, and to Him you will be returned

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ قَدْ جَاءَتْكُم مَّوْعِظَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Yâ ayyuhan-nâsu qad jâ'atkum maw'izhatun mir-rabbikum
versets.francais: Ô hommes, une exhortation vous est venue de votre Seigneur.
versets.anglais: O mankind, there has to come to you instruction from your Lord and healing for what is in the breasts and guidance and mercy for the believers

versets.arabe: قُلْ بِفَضْلِ اللَّهِ وَبِرَحْمَتِهِ فَبِذَٰلِكَ فَلْيَفْرَحُوا
versets.phonetique: Qul bifadhlillâhi wa birahmatihi fabithâlika falyafrahû
versets.francais: Dis: que ce soit par la grâce d'Allah et par Sa miséricorde qu'ils se réjouissent.
versets.anglais: Say, "In the bounty of Allah and in His mercy - in that let them rejoice; it is better than what they accumulate

versets.arabe: قُلْ أَرَأَيْتُم مَّا أَنزَلَ اللَّهُ لَكُم مِّن رِّزْقٍ فَجَعَلْتُم مِّنْهُ حَرَامًا وَحَلَالًا
versets.phonetique: Qul ara'aytum mâ anzalallâhu lakum min rizqin faja'altum minhu harâman wa halâlâ
versets.francais: Dis: avez-vous vu ce qu'Allah a fait descendre pour vous comme subsistance, dont vous avez rendu illicite une partie et licite une autre?
versets.anglais: Say, "Have you seen what Allah has sent down to you of provision of which you have made [some] lawful and [some] unlawful?" Say, "Has Allah permitted you [to do so], or do you invent [something] about Allah

versets.arabe: وَمَا ظَنُّ الَّذِينَ يَفْتَرُونَ عَلَى اللَّهِ الْكَذِبَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ
versets.phonetique: Wa mâ dhannu llathîna yaftarûna 'alallâhil-kathibа yawmal-qiyâmah
versets.francais: Quelle est l'opinion de ceux qui inventent le mensonge contre Allah au Jour de la Résurrection?
versets.anglais: And what will be the supposition of those who invent falsehood about Allah on the Day of Resurrection? Indeed, Allah is full of bounty to the people, but most of them are not grateful

versets.arabe: وَمَا تَكُونُ فِي شَأْنٍ وَمَا تَتْلُو مِنْهُ مِن قُرْآنٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa mâ takûnu fî sha'nin wa mâ tatlû minhu min qur'ân
versets.francais: En quelque situation que tu te trouves, quelle que soit la partie du Coran que tu récites.
versets.anglais: And, [O Muhammad], you are not [engaged] in any matter or recite any of the Qur'an and you [people] do not do any deed except that We are witness over you when you are involved in it. And not absent from your Lord is any [part] of an atom's weight within the earth or within the heaven or [anything] smaller than that or greater but that it is in a clear register

versets.arabe: أَلَا إِنَّ أَوْلِيَاءَ اللَّهِ لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
versets.phonetique: Alâ inna awliyâ'allâhi lâ khawfun 'alayhim wa lâ hum yahzanûn
versets.francais: Certes, les proches d'Allah n'éprouvent aucune crainte et ne sont pas affligés.
versets.anglais: Unquestionably, [for] the allies of Allah there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve

versets.arabe: الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَكَانُوا يَتَّقُونَ
versets.phonetique: Allathîna âmanû wa kânû yattaqûn
versets.francais: Ceux qui ont cru et qui craignaient Allah.
versets.anglais: Those who believed and were fearing Allah

versets.arabe: لَهُمُ الْبُشْرَىٰ فِي الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ
versets.phonetique: Lahumul-bushrâ fil-hayâtid-dunyâ wa fil-âkhirah
versets.francais: À eux la bonne nouvelle dans la vie du monde et dans l'au-delà.
versets.anglais: For them are good tidings in the worldly life and in the Hereafter. No change is there in the words of Allah. That is what is the great attainment

versets.arabe: وَلَا يَحْزُنكَ قَوْلُهُمْ إِنَّ الْعِزَّةَ لِلَّهِ جَمِيعًا
versets.phonetique: Wa lâ yahzunka qawluhum innal-'izzata lillâhi jamî'â
versets.francais: Que leurs paroles ne t'attristent pas. La puissance appartient entièrement à Allah.
versets.anglais: And let not their speech grieve you. Indeed, honor [due to power] belongs to Allah entirely. He is the Hearing, the Knowing

versets.arabe: أَلَا إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَن فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَن فِي الْأَرْضِ
versets.phonetique: Alâ inna lillâhi man fis-samâwâti wa man fil-ardh
versets.francais: Sache qu'à Allah appartient quiconque est dans les cieux et sur la terre.
versets.anglais: Unquestionably, to Allah belongs whoever is in the heavens and whoever is on the earth. And those who invoke other than Allah do not [actually] follow [His] "partners." They follow not except assumption, and they are not but falsifying

versets.arabe: هُوَ الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ اللَّيْلَ لِتَسْكُنُوا فِيهِ وَالنَّهَارَ مُبْصِرًا
versets.phonetique: Huwal-lathî ja'ala lakumul-layla litaskunû fîhi wan-nahâra mubsirâ
versets.francais: C'est Lui qui a fait pour vous la nuit afin que vous vous y reposiez et le jour pour voir.
versets.anglais: It is He who made for you the night to rest therein and the day, giving sight. Indeed in that are signs for a people who listen

versets.arabe: قَالُوا اتَّخَذَ اللَّهُ وَلَدًا سُبْحَانَهُ هُوَ الْغَنِيُّ
versets.phonetique: Qâlûttakhadhallâhu waladâ, subhânahu huwal-ghaniyy
versets.francais: Ils ont dit: Allah S'est attribué un enfant. Gloire à Lui! Il est le Riche.
versets.anglais: They have said, "Allah has taken a son." Exalted is He; He is the [one] Free of need. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth. You have no authority for this [claim]. Do you say about Allah that which you do not know

versets.arabe: قُلْ إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَفْتَرُونَ عَلَى اللَّهِ الْكَذِبَ لَا يُفْلِحُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qul innal-lathîna yaftarûna 'alallâhil-kathibа lâ yuflihûn
versets.francais: Dis: ceux qui inventent le mensonge contre Allah ne réussiront pas.
versets.anglais: Say, "Indeed, those who invent falsehood about Allah will not succeed

versets.arabe: مَتَاعٌ فِي الدُّنْيَا ثُمَّ إِلَيْنَا مَرْجِعُهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Matâ'un fid-dunyâ thumma ilaynâ marji'uhum
versets.francais: Jouissance éphémère en ce monde, puis leur retour sera vers Nous.
versets.anglais: [For them is brief] enjoyment in this world; then to Us is their return; then We will make them taste the severe punishment because they used to disbelieve

versets.arabe: وَاتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ نُوحٍ إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِ يَا قَوْمِ
versets.phonetique: Watlu 'alayhim naba'a nûhin ith qâla liqawmihî yâ qawm
versets.francais: Et récite-leur la nouvelle de Noé, quand il dit à son peuple: Ô mon peuple!
versets.anglais: And recite to them the news of Noah, when he said to his people, "O my people, if my residence and my reminding of the signs of Allah has become burdensome upon you - then I have relied upon Allah. So resolve upon your plan and [call upon] your associates. Then let not your plan be obscure to you. Then carry it out upon me and do not give me respite

versets.arabe: فَإِن تَوَلَّيْتُمْ فَمَا سَأَلْتُكُم مِّنْ أَجْرٍ إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَى اللَّهِ
versets.phonetique: Fa'in tawallaytum famâ sa'altukum min ajrin in ajriya illâ 'alallâh
versets.francais: Si vous vous détournez, je ne vous ai demandé aucune rétribution. Ma récompense n'incombe qu'à Allah.
versets.anglais: And if you turn away [from my advice] then no payment have I asked of you. My reward is only from Allah, and I have been commanded to be of the Muslims

versets.arabe: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَنَجَّيْنَاهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُ فِي الْفُلْكِ
versets.phonetique: Fakaththabûhu fanajjaynâhu wa man ma'ahu fil-fulk
versets.francais: Ils le traitèrent de menteur. Nous le sauvâmes ainsi que ceux qui étaient avec lui dans l'arche.
versets.anglais: And they denied him, so We saved him and those with him in the ship and made them successors, and We drowned those who denied Our signs. Then see how was the end of those who were warned

versets.arabe: ثُمَّ بَعَثْنَا مِن بَعْدِهِ رُسُلًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِمْ
versets.phonetique: Thumma ba'athnâ mim ba'dihî rusulan ilâ qawmihim
versets.francais: Puis Nous envoyâmes après lui des messagers à leurs peuples.
versets.anglais: Then We sent after him messengers to their peoples, and they came to them with clear proofs. But they were not to believe in that which they had denied before. Thus We seal over the hearts of the transgressors

versets.arabe: ثُمَّ بَعَثْنَا مِن بَعْدِهِم مُّوسَىٰ وَهَارُونَ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَئِهِ
versets.phonetique: Thumma ba'athnâ mim ba'dihim mûsâ wa hârûna ilâ fir'awna wa mala'ih
versets.francais: Puis Nous envoyâmes après eux Moïse et Aaron vers Pharaon et ses notables.
versets.anglais: Then We sent after them Moses and Aaron to Pharaoh and his establishment with Our signs, but they behaved arrogantly and were a criminal people

versets.arabe: فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُمُ الْحَقُّ مِنْ عِندِنَا قَالُوا إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَسِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ
versets.phonetique: Falammâ jâ'ahumul-haqqu min 'indinâ qâlû inna hâthâ lasihrum mubîn
versets.francais: Quand la vérité leur vint de Notre part, ils dirent: c'est là de la magie évidente.
versets.anglais: So when there came to them the truth from Us, they said, "Indeed, this is obvious magic

versets.arabe: قَالَ مُوسَىٰ أَتَقُولُونَ لِلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَاءَكُمْ أَسِحْرٌ هَٰذَا
versets.phonetique: Qâla mûsâ ataqûlûna lil-haqqi lammâ jâ'akum asihrun hâthâ
versets.francais: Moïse dit: dites-vous à la vérité quand elle vous est venue: est-ce là de la magie?
versets.anglais: Moses said, "Do you say [thus] about the truth when it has come to you? Is this magic? But magicians will not succeed

versets.arabe: قَالُوا أَجِئْتَنَا لِتَلْفِتَنَا عَمَّا وَجَدْنَا عَلَيْهِ آبَاءَنَا
versets.phonetique: Qâlû aji'tanâ littalfitanâ 'ammâ wajadnâ 'alayhi âbâ'anâ
versets.francais: Ils dirent: es-tu venu pour nous détourner de ce sur quoi nous avons trouvé nos pères?
versets.anglais: They said, "Have you come to us to turn us away from that upon which we found our fathers and so that you two may have grandeur in the land? And we are not believers in you

versets.arabe: وَقَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ ائْتُونِي بِكُلِّ سَاحِرٍ عَلِيمٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa qâla fir'awnu'itûnî bikulli sâhirin 'alîm
versets.francais: Pharaon dit: amenez-moi tout magicien savant.
versets.anglais: And Pharaoh said, "Bring to me every learned magician

versets.arabe: فَلَمَّا جَاءَ السَّحَرَةُ قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰ أَلْقُوا مَا أَنتُم مُّلْقُونَ
versets.phonetique: Falammâ jâ'as-saharatu qâla lahum mûsâ alqû mâ antum mulqûn
versets.francais: Quand les magiciens vinrent, Moïse leur dit: jetez ce que vous avez à jeter.
versets.anglais: So when the magicians came, Moses said to them, "Throw down whatever you will throw

versets.arabe: فَلَمَّا أَلْقَوْا قَالَ مُوسَىٰ مَا جِئْتُم بِهِ السِّحْرُ
versets.phonetique: Falammâ alqaw qâla mûsâ mâ ji'tum bihis-sihr
versets.francais: Quand ils eurent jeté, Moïse dit: ce que vous apportez là, c'est de la magie.
versets.anglais: And when they had thrown, Moses said, "What you have brought is [only] magic. Indeed, Allah will expose its worthlessness. Indeed, Allah does not amend the work of corrupters

versets.arabe: وَيُحِقُّ اللَّهُ الْحَقَّ بِكَلِمَاتِهِ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الْمُجْرِمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa yuhiqqullâhul-haqqa bikalimâtihî wa law karihal-mujrimûn
versets.francais: Allah confirme la vérité par Ses paroles, même si les criminels le détestent.
versets.anglais: And Allah will establish the truth by His words, even if the criminals dislike it

versets.arabe: فَمَا آمَنَ لِمُوسَىٰ إِلَّا ذُرِّيَّةٌ مِّن قَوْمِهِ
versets.phonetique: Famâ âmana limûsâ illâ thurriyyatun min qawmih
versets.francais: Parmi le peuple de Moïse, seule une jeunesse crut en lui.
versets.anglais: But no one believed Moses, except [some] youths among his people, for fear of Pharaoh and his establishment that they would persecute them. And indeed, Pharaoh was haughty within the land, and indeed, he was of the transgressors

versets.arabe: وَقَالَ مُوسَىٰ يَا قَوْمِ إِن كُنتُمْ آمَنتُم بِاللَّهِ فَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلُوا
versets.phonetique: Wa qâla mûsâ yâ qawmi in kuntum âmantum billâhi fa'alayhi tawakkalû
versets.francais: Moïse dit: Ô mon peuple, si vous croyez en Allah, fiez-vous à Lui.
versets.anglais: And Moses said, "O my people, if you have believed in Allah, then rely upon Him, if you should be Muslims

versets.arabe: فَقَالُوا عَلَى اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِّلْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Faqâlû 'alallâhi tawakkalnâ rabbanâ lâ taj'alnâ fitnatallil-qawmidh-dhâlimîn
versets.francais: Ils dirent: nous nous en remettons à Allah. Notre Seigneur, ne fais pas de nous une épreuve pour le peuple injuste.
versets.anglais: So they said, "Upon Allah do we rely. Our Lord, make us not [objects of] trial for the wrongdoing people

versets.arabe: وَنَجِّنَا بِرَحْمَتِكَ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa najjinâ birahmatika minal-qawmil-kâfirîn
versets.francais: Et sauve-nous par Ta miséricorde du peuple mécréant.
versets.anglais: And save us by Your mercy from the disbelieving people

versets.arabe: وَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَأَخِيهِ أَن تَبَوَّآ لِقَوْمِكُمَا بِمِصْرَ بُيُوتًا
versets.phonetique: Wa awhaynâ ilâ mûsâ wa akhîhi an tabawwa'â liqawmikumâ bimisra buyûtâ
versets.francais: Nous avons révélé à Moïse et à son frère: établissez des maisons pour votre peuple en Égypte.
versets.anglais: And We inspired to Moses and his brother, "Settle your people in Egypt in houses and make your houses [facing the] qiblah and establish prayer and give good tidings to the believers

versets.arabe: وَقَالَ مُوسَىٰ رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ آتَيْتَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَأَهُ زِينَةً وَأَمْوَالًا فِي الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا
versets.phonetique: Wa qâla mûsâ rabbanâ innaka âtayta fir'awna wa mala'ahu zînataw wa amwâlan fil-hayâtid-dunyâ
versets.francais: Moïse dit: Notre Seigneur, Tu as donné à Pharaon et à ses notables une parure et des richesses dans la vie présente.
versets.anglais: And Moses said, "Our Lord, indeed You have given Pharaoh and his establishment splendor and wealth in the worldly life, our Lord, that they may lead [men] astray from Your way. Our Lord, obliterate their wealth and harden their hearts so that they will not believe until they see the painful punishment

versets.arabe: قَالَ قَدْ أُجِيبَت دَّعْوَتُكُمَا فَاسْتَقِيمَا
versets.phonetique: Qâla qad ujîbat da'watukumâ fastaqîmâ
versets.francais: Il dit: votre invocation a été exaucée. Restez tous deux dans le droit chemin.
versets.anglais: [Allah] said, "Your supplication has been answered." So remain on a right course and follow not the way of those who do not know

versets.arabe: وَجَاوَزْنَا بِبَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ الْبَحْرَ فَأَتْبَعَهُمْ فِرْعَوْنُ وَجُنُودُهُ
versets.phonetique: Wa jâwazna bibanî isrâ'îlal-bahra fa'atba'ahum fir'awnu wa junûduh
versets.francais: Nous avons fait traverser la mer aux fils d'Israël. Pharaon et ses soldats les poursuivirent.
versets.anglais: And We took the Children of Israel across the sea, and Pharaoh and his soldiers pursued them in tyranny and enmity until, when drowning overtook him, he said, "I believe that there is no deity except that in whom the Children of Israel believe, and I am of the Muslims

versets.arabe: آلْآنَ وَقَدْ عَصَيْتَ قَبْلُ وَكُنتَ مِنَ الْمُفْسِدِينَ
versets.phonetique: Âl'âna wa qad 'asayta qablu wa kunta minal-mufsidîn
versets.francais: Maintenant? Alors que tu avais été rebelle auparavant et faisais partie des semeurs de corruption!
versets.anglais: Now? And you had disobeyed [Him] before and were of the corrupters

versets.arabe: فَالْيَوْمَ نُنَجِّيكَ بِبَدَنِكَ لِتَكُونَ لِمَنْ خَلْفَكَ آيَةً
versets.phonetique: Fal-yawma nunajjîka bibadanika litakûna liman khalfaka âyah
versets.francais: Aujourd'hui Nous te sauvons avec ton corps pour que tu sois un signe pour ceux qui viennent après toi.
versets.anglais: So today We will save you in body that you may be to those who succeed you a sign. And indeed, many among the people, of Our signs, are heedless

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ بَوَّأْنَا بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ مُبَوَّأَ صِدْقٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa laqad bawwa'nâ banî isrâ'îla mubawwa'a sidq
versets.francais: Nous avons établi les fils d'Israël dans une demeure sincère.
versets.anglais: And We had certainty settled the Children of Israel in an agreeable settlement and provided them with good things. And they did not differ until [after] knowledge had come to them. Indeed, your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ

versets.arabe: فَإِن كُنتَ فِي شَكٍّ مِّمَّا أَنزَلْنَا إِلَيْكَ فَاسْأَلِ الَّذِينَ يَقْرَءُونَ الْكِتَابَ
versets.phonetique: Fa'in kunta fî shakkim mimmâ anzalnâ ilayka fas'alil-lathîna yaqra'ûnal-kitâb
versets.francais: Si tu es dans le doute au sujet de ce que Nous t'avons révélé, interroge ceux qui lisent le Livre.
versets.anglais: So if you are in doubt, [O Muhammad], about that which We have revealed to you, then ask those who have been reading the Scripture before you. The truth has certainly come to you from your Lord, so never be among the doubters

versets.arabe: وَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا بِآيَاتِ اللَّهِ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa lâ takûnanna minal-lathîna kaththabû bi'âyâtillâhi fatakûna minal-khâsirîn
versets.francais: Et ne sois pas de ceux qui traitent de mensonges les signes d'Allah, tu serais alors parmi les perdants.
versets.anglais: And never be of those who deny the signs of Allah and [thus] be among the losers

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ حَقَّتْ عَلَيْهِمْ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
versets.phonetique: Innal-lathîna haqqat 'alayhim kalimatu rabbika lâ yu'minûn
versets.francais: Ceux contre qui la parole de ton Seigneur s'est réalisée ne croiront pas.
versets.anglais: Indeed, those upon whom the word of your Lord has come into effect will not believe

versets.arabe: وَلَوْ جَاءَتْهُمْ كُلُّ آيَةٍ حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُا الْعَذَابَ الْأَلِيمَ
versets.phonetique: Wa law jâ'athum kullu âyatin hattâ yarawul-'athâbal-alîm
versets.francais: Même si tous les signes leur venaient, jusqu'à ce qu'ils voient le châtiment douloureux.
versets.anglais: Even if every sign should come to them, until they see the painful punishment

versets.arabe: فَلَوْلَا كَانَتْ قَرْيَةٌ آمَنَتْ فَنَفَعَهَا إِيمَانُهَا إِلَّا قَوْمَ يُونُسَ
versets.phonetique: Falawlâ kânat qaryatun âmanat fanafa'ahâ îmânuhâ illâ qawma yûnus
versets.francais: Pourquoi n'y eut-il pas de cité qui crût et à qui sa foi profitât, sauf le peuple de Jonas?
versets.anglais: Then has there not been a [single] city that believed so its faith benefited it except the people of Jonah? When they believed, We removed from them the punishment of disgrace in worldly life and gave them enjoyment for a time

versets.arabe: وَلَوْ شَاءَ رَبُّكَ لَآمَنَ مَن فِي الْأَرْضِ كُلُّهُمْ جَمِيعًا
versets.phonetique: Wa law shâ'a rabbuka la'âmana man fil-ardhi kulluhum jamî'â
versets.francais: Si ton Seigneur l'avait voulu, tous ceux qui sont sur la terre auraient cru.
versets.anglais: And had your Lord willed, those on earth would have believed - all of them entirely. Then, [O Muhammad], would you compel the people in order that they become believers

versets.arabe: وَمَا كَانَ لِنَفْسٍ أَن تُؤْمِنَ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ
versets.phonetique: Wa mâ kâna linafsín an tu'mina illâ bi'ithnil-lâh
versets.francais: Il n'appartient à aucune âme de croire, sauf par la permission d'Allah.
versets.anglais: And it is not for a soul to believe except by permission of Allah, and He will place defilement upon those who will not use reason

versets.arabe: قُلِ انظُرُوا مَاذَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ
versets.phonetique: Qulindh-urû mâthâ fis-samâwâti wal-ardh
versets.francais: Dis: regardez ce qu'il y a dans les cieux et sur la terre.
versets.anglais: Say, "Observe what is in the heavens and earth." But of no avail will be signs or warners to a people who do not believe

versets.arabe: فَهَلْ يَنتَظِرُونَ إِلَّا مِثْلَ أَيَّامِ الَّذِينَ خَلَوْا مِن قَبْلِهِمْ
versets.phonetique: Fahal yantadhirûna illâ mithla ayyâmil-lathîna khalaw min qablihim
versets.francais: N'attendent-ils donc que les jours pareils à ceux des gens qui sont passés avant eux?
versets.anglais: So do they wait except for like [what occurred in] the days of those who passed on before them? Say, "Then wait; indeed, I am with you among those who wait

versets.arabe: ثُمَّ نُنَجِّي رُسُلَنَا وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا كَذَٰلِكَ
versets.phonetique: Thumma nunajjî rusulanâ wallathîna âmanû kathâlik
versets.francais: Ensuite Nous sauvons Nos messagers et ceux qui ont cru. Ainsi en est-il.
versets.anglais: Then We will save our messengers and those who have believed. Thus, it is an obligation upon Us that We save the believers

versets.arabe: قُلْ يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِن كُنتُمْ فِي شَكٍّ مِّن دِينِي
versets.phonetique: Qul yâ ayyuhan-nâsu in kuntum fî shakkim min dînî
versets.francais: Dis: Ô hommes, si vous êtes dans le doute quant à ma religion.
versets.anglais: Say, [O Muhammad], "O people, if you are in doubt as to my religion - then I do not worship those which you worship besides Allah; but I worship Allah, who causes your death. And I have been commanded to be of the believers

versets.arabe: وَأَنْ أَقِمْ وَجْهَكَ لِلدِّينِ حَنِيفًا وَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa an aqim wajhaka lid-dîni hanîfan wa lâ takûnanna minal-mushrikîn
versets.francais: Et dirige ton visage vers la religion en vrai croyant et ne sois jamais du nombre des polythéistes.
versets.anglais: And [commanded], 'Direct your face toward the religion, inclining to truth, and never be of those who associate others with Allah

versets.arabe: وَلَا تَدْعُ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُكَ وَلَا يَضُرُّكَ
versets.phonetique: Wa lâ tad'u min dûnillâhi mâ lâ yanfa'uka wa lâ yadhurruk
versets.francais: N'invoque pas en dehors d'Allah ce qui ne peut te profiter ni te nuire.
versets.anglais: And do not invoke besides Allah that which neither benefits you nor harms you, for if you did, then indeed you would be of the wrongdoers

versets.arabe: وَإِن يَمْسَسْكَ اللَّهُ بِضُرٍّ فَلَا كَاشِفَ لَهُ إِلَّا هُوَ
versets.phonetique: Wa in yamsaska llâhu bidhurrin falâ kâshifa lahû illâ huw
versets.francais: Si Allah t'afflige d'un mal, nul ne peut l'enlever en dehors de Lui.
versets.anglais: And if Allah should touch you with adversity, there is no remover of it except Him; and if He intends for you good, then there is no repeller of His bounty. He causes it to reach whom He wills of His servants. And He is the Forgiving, the Merciful

versets.arabe: قُلْ يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ قَدْ جَاءَكُمُ الْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Qul yâ ayyuhan-nâsu qad jâ'akumul-haqqu mir-rabbikum
versets.francais: Dis: Ô hommes, la vérité vous est venue de votre Seigneur.
versets.anglais: Say, "O mankind, the truth has come to you from your Lord, so whoever is guided is only guided for [the benefit of] his soul, and whoever goes astray only goes astray [in violation] against it. And I am not over you a manager

versets.arabe: وَاتَّبِعْ مَا يُوحَىٰ إِلَيْكَ وَاصْبِرْ حَتَّىٰ يَحْكُمَ اللَّهُ
versets.phonetique: Wattabi' mâ yûhâ ilayka wasbir hattâ yahkumallâh
versets.francais: Suis ce qui t'est révélé et sois patient jusqu'à ce qu'Allah juge.
versets.anglais: And follow what is revealed to you, [O Muhammad], and be patient until Allah will judge. And He is the best of judges

versets.arabe: الر ۚ كِتَابٌ أُحْكِمَتْ آيَاتُهُ ثُمَّ فُصِّلَتْ مِن لَّدُنْ حَكِيمٍ خَبِيرٍ
versets.phonetique: Alif lām rā kitābun uḥkimat āyātuhu thumma fuṣṣilat min ladun ḥakīmin khabīr
versets.francais: Alif, Lam, Ra. C'est un Livre dont les versets sont parfaitement établis, puis exposés en détail, de la part d'un Sage, Parfaitement Connaisseur.
versets.anglais: Alif, Lam, Ra. [This is] a Book whose verses are perfected and then presented in detail from [one who is] Wise and Acquainted

versets.arabe: أَلَّا تَعْبُدُوا إِلَّا اللَّهَ ۚ إِنَّنِي لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌ وَبَشِيرٌ
versets.phonetique: Allā ta'budū illā llāha innanī lakum minhu nadhīrun wabashīr
versets.francais: «N'adorez qu'Allah. Je suis de Sa part pour vous un avertisseur et un annonciateur.»
versets.anglais: [Through a messenger, saying], "Do not worship except Allah. Indeed, I am to you from Him a warner and a bringer of good tidings

versets.arabe: وَأَنِ اسْتَغْفِرُوا رَبَّكُمْ ثُمَّ تُوبُوا إِلَيْهِ يُمَتِّعْكُم مَّتَاعًا حَسَنًا إِلَىٰ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى وَيُؤْتِ كُلَّ ذِي فَضْلٍ فَضْلَهُ ۖ وَإِن تَوَلَّوْا فَإِنِّي أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ كَبِيرٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa'ani staghfirū rabbakum thumma tūbū ilayhi yumattiˋkum matā'an ḥasanan ilā ajalin musamman wayu'ti kulla dhī faḍlin faḍlahu wa'in tawallū fa'innī akhāfu 'alaykum 'adhāba yawmin kabīr
versets.francais: «Et implorez le pardon de votre Seigneur, puis revenez à Lui. Il vous accordera un bon bien-être jusqu'à un terme fixé, et accordera à tout homme méritant sa récompense. Mais si vous vous détournez, je crains pour vous le châtiment d'un jour terrible.»
versets.anglais: And [saying], "Seek forgiveness of your Lord and repent to Him, [and] He will let you enjoy a good provision for a specified term and give every doer of favor his favor. But if you turn away, then indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a great Day

versets.arabe: إِلَى اللَّهِ مَرْجِعُكُمْ ۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
versets.phonetique: Ilā llāhi marji'ukum wahuwa 'alā kulli shay'in qadīr
versets.francais: Vers Allah est votre retour. Et Il est Omnipotent.
versets.anglais: To Allah is your return, and He is over all things competent

versets.arabe: أَلَا إِنَّهُمْ يَثْنُونَ صُدُورَهُمْ لِيَسْتَخْفُوا مِنْهُ ۚ أَلَا حِينَ يَسْتَغْشُونَ ثِيَابَهُمْ يَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ ۚ إِنَّهُ عَلِيمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ
versets.phonetique: Alā innahum yathnūna ṣudūrahum liyastakhfū minhu alā ḥīna yastaghshūna thiyābahum ya'lamu mā yusirrūna wamā yu'linūna innahu 'alīmun bidhāti ṣ-ṣudūr
versets.francais: Certes, ils replient leurs poitrines pour se cacher de Lui. Mais quand ils se couvrent de leurs vêtements, Il sait ce qu'ils cachent et ce qu'ils divulguent. Il connaît, certes, le contenu des poitrines.
versets.anglais: Unquestionably, they the disbelievers turn away their breasts to hide themselves from Him. Unquestionably, [even] when they cover themselves in their clothing, Allah knows what they conceal and what they declare. Indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts

versets.arabe: وَمَا مِن دَابَّةٍ فِي الْأَرْضِ إِلَّا عَلَى اللَّهِ رِزْقُهَا وَيَعْلَمُ مُسْتَقَرَّهَا وَمُسْتَوْدَعَهَا ۚ كُلٌّ فِي كِتَابٍ مُّبِينٍ
versets.phonetique: Wamā min dābbatin fī l-arḍi illā 'alā llāhi rizquhā waya'lamu mustaqarrahā wamustaw da'ahā kullun fī kitābin mubīn
versets.francais: Il n'existe pas une bête sur la terre dont Allah n'assure pas la subsistance. Il connaît son gîte et son dépôt. Tout est dans un Livre explicite.
versets.anglais: And there is no creature on earth but that upon Allah is its provision, and He knows its place of dwelling and place of storage. All is in a clear register

versets.arabe: وَهُوَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ وَكَانَ عَرْشُهُ عَلَى الْمَاءِ لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ أَيُّكُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًا
versets.phonetique: Wahuwa lladhī khalaqa s-samāwāti wal-arḍa fī sittati ayyāmin wakāna 'arshuhu 'alā l-mā'i liyabluwakum ayyukum aḥsanu 'amalā
versets.francais: C'est Lui qui a créé les cieux et la terre en six jours alors que Son Trône était sur l'eau, afin de vous éprouver [pour voir] qui d'entre vous agit le mieux.
versets.anglais: And it is He who created the heavens and the earth in six days - and His Throne had been upon water - that He might test you as to which of you is best in deed. But if you say, "Indeed, you are resurrected after death," those who disbelieve will surely say, "This is not but obvious magic

versets.arabe: وَلَئِن أَخَّرْنَا عَنْهُمُ الْعَذَابَ إِلَىٰ أُمَّةٍ مَّعْدُودَةٍ لَّيَقُولُنَّ مَا يَحْبِسُهُ ۗ أَلَا يَوْمَ يَأْتِيهِمْ لَيْسَ مَصْرُوفًا عَنْهُمْ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُوا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِئُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wala'in akhkharnā 'anhumu l-'adhāba ilā ummatin ma'dūdatin layaqūlunna mā yaḥbisuhu alā yawma ya'tīhim laysa maṣrūfan 'anhum waḥāqa bihim mā kānū bihi yastahzi'ūn
versets.francais: Et si Nous différons le châtiment pour eux jusqu'à un délai compté, ils diront sûrement: «Qu'est-ce qui le retient?» Mais le jour où il leur viendra, il ne sera pas détourné d'eux, et ce dont ils se moquaient les cernera.
versets.anglais: And if We hold back from them the punishment for a limited time, they will surely say, "What detains it?" Unquestionably, on the Day it comes to them, it will not be averted from them, and they will be enveloped by what they used to ridicule

versets.arabe: وَلَئِنْ أَذَقْنَا الْإِنسَانَ مِنَّا رَحْمَةً ثُمَّ نَزَعْنَاهَا مِنْهُ إِنَّهُ لَيَئُوسٌ كَفُورٌ
versets.phonetique: Wala'in adhaqnā l-insāna minnā raḥmatan thumma naza'nāhā minhu innahu laYa'ūsun kafūr
versets.francais: Et si Nous faisons goûter à l'homme une miséricorde de Notre part, puis Nous la lui retirons, il sera certainement désespéré et ingrat.
versets.anglais: And if We give man a taste of mercy from Us and then We withdraw it from him, indeed, he is despairing and ungrateful

versets.arabe: وَلَئِنْ أَذَقْنَاهُ نَعْمَاءَ بَعْدَ ضَرَّاءَ مَسَّتْهُ لَيَقُولَنَّ ذَهَبَ السَّيِّئَاتُ عَنِّي ۚ إِنَّهُ لَفَرِحٌ فَخُورٌ
versets.phonetique: Wala'in adhaqnāhu na'māˊa ba'da ḍarrā'a massathu layaqūlanna dhahaba s-sayyi'ātu 'annī innahu lafariḥun fakhūr
versets.francais: Et si Nous lui faisons goûter des bienfaits après les maux qui l'ont touché, il dira sûrement: «Les maux m'ont quitté.» Il sera alors content et bouffi d'orgueil.
versets.anglais: But if We give him a taste of favor after hardship has touched him, he will surely say, "Bad times have left me." Indeed, he is exultant and boastful

versets.arabe: إِلَّا الَّذِينَ صَبَرُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ أُولَٰئِكَ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَأَجْرٌ كَبِيرٌ
versets.phonetique: Illā lladhīna ṣabarū wa'amilū ṣ-ṣāliḥāti ulā'ika lahum maghfiratun wa'ajrun kabīr
versets.francais: Sauf ceux qui ont enduré et fait le bien. Ceux-là auront un pardon et une grande récompense.
versets.anglais: Except for those who are patient and do righteous deeds; those will have forgiveness and great reward

versets.arabe: فَلَعَلَّكَ تَارِكٌ بَعْضَ مَا يُوحَىٰ إِلَيْكَ وَضَائِقٌ بِهِ صَدْرُكَ أَن يَقُولُوا لَوْلَا أُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ كَنزٌ أَوْ جَاءَ مَعَهُ مَلَكٌ ۚ إِنَّمَا أَنتَ نَذِيرٌ ۚ وَاللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَكِيلٌ
versets.phonetique: Fala'allaka tārikun ba'ḍa mā yūḥā ilayka waḍā'iqun bihi ṣadruka an yaqūlū lawlā unzila 'alayhi kanzun aw jā'a ma'ahu malakun innamā anta nadhīrun wallāhu 'alā kulli shay'in wakīl
versets.francais: Peut-être tu vas omettre une partie de ce qui t'est révélé, et tu te sens à l'étroit parce qu'ils disent: «Pourquoi n'a-t-il pas eu un trésor descendu sur lui, ou pourquoi un ange ne l'a-t-il pas accompagné?» Tu n'es qu'un avertisseur. Et Allah prend soin de toute chose.
versets.anglais: Then would you possibly leave [out] some of what is revealed to you, or is your breast constrained by it because they say, "Why has there not been sent down to him a treasure or come with him an angel?" But you are only a warner. And Allah is Disposer of all things

versets.arabe: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ افْتَرَاهُ ۖ قُلْ فَأْتُوا بِعَشْرِ سُوَرٍ مِّثْلِهِ مُفْتَرَيَاتٍ وَادْعُوا مَنِ اسْتَطَعْتُم مِّن دُونِ اللَّهِ إِن كُنتُمْ صَادِقِينَ
versets.phonetique: Am yaqūlūna ftarāhu qul fa'tū bi'ashri suwarim mithlihi muftarayātin wad'ū mani staṭa'tum min dūni llāhi in kuntum ṣādiqīn
versets.francais: Disent-ils: «Il l'a inventé?» Dis: «Apportez donc dix sourates semblables à celui-ci, inventées, et invoquez qui vous pouvez en dehors d'Allah, si vous êtes véridiques.»
versets.anglais: Or do they say, "He invented it"? Say, "Then bring ten surahs like it that have been invented and call upon [for assistance] whomever you can besides Allah, if you should be truthful

versets.arabe: فَإِلَّمْ يَسْتَجِيبُوا لَكُمْ فَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّمَا أُنزِلَ بِعِلْمِ اللَّهِ وَأَن لَّا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ فَهَلْ أَنتُم مُّسْلِمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Fa'illam yastajībū lakum fa'lamū annamā unzila bi'ilmi llāhi wa'an lā ilāha illā huwa fahel antum muslimūn
versets.francais: S'ils ne vous répondent pas, sachez qu'il a été révélé avec la science d'Allah, et qu'il n'y a de divinité qu'Allah. Êtes-vous alors soumis [à Lui]?
versets.anglais: And if they do not respond to you - then know that the Qur'an was revealed with the knowledge of Allah and that there is no deity except Him. Then, would you [not] be Muslims

versets.arabe: مَن كَانَ يُرِيدُ الْحَيَاةَ الدُّنْيَا وَزِينَتَهَا نُوَفِّ إِلَيْهِمْ أَعْمَالَهُمْ فِيهَا وَهُمْ فِيهَا لَا يُبْخَسُونَ
versets.phonetique: Man kāna yurīdu l-ḥayāta d-dunyā wazīnatahā nuwaffi ilayhim a'mālahum fīhā wahum fīhā lā yubkhasūn
versets.francais: Quiconque ne désire que la vie présente avec ses attraits, Nous lui payons ici-bas ses actes en entier, sans qu'il y soit lésé.
versets.anglais: Whoever desires the life of this world and its adornments - We fully repay them for their deeds therein, and they therein will not be deprived

versets.arabe: أُولَٰئِكَ الَّذِينَ لَيْسَ لَهُمْ فِي الْآخِرَةِ إِلَّا النَّارُ ۖ وَحَبِطَ مَا صَنَعُوا فِيهَا وَبَاطِلٌ مَّا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Ulā'ika lladhīna laysa lahum fī l-ākhirati illā n-nāru waḥabiṭa mā ṣana'ū fīhā wabāṭilun mā kānū ya'malūn
versets.francais: Voilà ceux qui n'auront dans l'au-delà que le Feu; et ce qu'ils auront fait dans la vie présente sera anéanti, et vains seront leurs actes.
versets.anglais: Those are the ones for whom there is not in the Hereafter but the Fire. And lost is what they did therein, and worthless is what they used to do

versets.arabe: أَفَمَن كَانَ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّهِ وَيَتْلُوهُ شَاهِدٌ مِّنْهُ وَمِن قَبْلِهِ كِتَابُ مُوسَىٰ إِمَامًا وَرَحْمَةً
versets.phonetique: Afaman kāna 'alā bayyinatin min rabbihi wayatlūhu shāhidun minhu wamin qablihi kitābu mūsā imāman waraḥmatan
versets.francais: Quoi! Celui qui se fonde sur une preuve de son Seigneur — qu'un témoin de Sa part le suit, et qu'avant lui il y avait le Livre de Moïse, un guide et une miséricorde —
versets.anglais: So is one who [stands] upon a clear evidence from his Lord [like the aforementioned]? And a witness from Him follows it, and before it was the Scripture of Moses to lead and as mercy. Those [believers in the former revelations] believe in the Qur'an.
