But whoever disbelieves in it from the [various] factions - the Fire is his promised destination. So be not in doubt about it. Indeed, it is the truth from your Lord, but most of the people do not believe

versets.arabe: وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ افْتَرَىٰ عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا ۚ أُولَٰئِكَ يُعْرَضُونَ عَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ وَيَقُولُ الْأَشْهَادُ هَٰؤُلَاءِ الَّذِينَ كَذَبُوا عَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ ۚ أَلَا لَعْنَةُ اللَّهِ عَلَى الظَّالِمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Waman aẓlamu mimmani ftarā 'alā llāhi kadhiban ulā'ika yu'raḍūna 'alā rabbihim wayaqūlu l-ashhādu hā'ulā'i lladhīna kadhabū 'alā rabbihim alā la'natu llāhi 'alā ẓ-ẓālimīn
versets.francais: Et qui est plus injuste que celui qui invente un mensonge contre Allah? Ceux-là seront présentés devant leur Seigneur, et les témoins diront: «Ce sont eux qui ont menti contre leur Seigneur.» Certes, la malédiction d'Allah est sur les injustes,
versets.anglais: And who is more unjust than he who invents a lie about Allah? Those will be presented before their Lord, and the witnesses will say, "These are the ones who lied against their Lord." Unquestionably, the curse of Allah is upon the wrongdoers

versets.arabe: الَّذِينَ يَصُدُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَيَبْغُونَهَا عِوَجًا وَهُم بِالْآخِرَةِ هُمْ كَافِرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Alladhīna yaṣuddūna 'an sabīli llāhi wayabghūnahā 'iwajan wahum bil-ākhirati hum kāfirūn
versets.francais: ceux qui obstruent le chemin d'Allah et cherchent à le rendre tortueux, et qui ne croient pas en l'au-delà.
versets.anglais: Who averted [people] from the way of Allah and sought to make it [seem] deviant while they, concerning the Hereafter, were disbelievers

versets.arabe: أُولَٰئِكَ لَمْ يَكُونُوا مُعْجِزِينَ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَمَا كَانَ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ اللَّهِ مِنْ أَوْلِيَاءَ ۘ يُضَاعَفُ لَهُمُ الْعَذَابُ ۚ مَا كَانُوا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ السَّمْعَ وَمَا كَانُوا يُبْصِرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Ulā'ika lam yakūnū mu'jizīna fī l-arḍi wamā kāna lahum min dūni llāhi min awliyā'a yuḍā'afu lahumu l-'adhābu mā kānū yastaṭī'ūna s-sam'a wamā kānū yubṣirūn
versets.francais: Ceux-là ne pouvaient pas réduire Allah à l'impuissance sur la terre, et ils n'avaient point d'autres protecteurs en dehors d'Allah. Le châtiment leur sera doublé. Ils n'avaient pas pu entendre, et ils ne voyaient pas.
versets.anglais: Those were not causing failure [to Allah] on earth, nor did they have besides Allah any protectors. For them the punishment will be multiplied. They were not able to hear, nor did they see

versets.arabe: أُولَٰئِكَ الَّذِينَ خَسِرُوا أَنفُسَهُمْ وَضَلَّ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا يَفْتَرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Ulā'ika lladhīna khasirū anfusahum waḍalla 'anhum mā kānū yaftarūn
versets.francais: Ceux-là ont perdu leurs âmes, et ce qu'ils inventaient les a abandonnés.
versets.anglais: Those are the ones who will have lost themselves, and lost from them is what they used to invent

versets.arabe: لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّهُمْ فِي الْآخِرَةِ هُمُ الْأَخْسَرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Lā jarama annahum fī l-ākhirati humu l-akhsarūn
versets.francais: Nul doute que dans l'au-delà, ce sont eux les plus grands perdants.
versets.anglais: Assuredly, it is they in the Hereafter who will be the greatest losers

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَأَخْبَتُوا إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ أُولَٰئِكَ أَصْحَابُ الْجَنَّةِ ۖ هُمْ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ
versets.phonetique: Inna lladhīna āmanū wa'amilū ṣ-ṣāliḥāti wa'akhbatū ilā rabbihim ulā'ika aṣḥābu l-jannati hum fīhā khālidūn
versets.francais: Certes, ceux qui croient, font le bien et s'humilient devant leur Seigneur, voilà les gens du Paradis; ils y demeureront éternellement.
versets.anglais: Indeed, they who have believed and done righteous deeds and humbled themselves to their Lord - those are the companions of Paradise; they will abide eternally therein

versets.arabe: مَثَلُ الْفَرِيقَيْنِ كَالْأَعْمَىٰ وَالْأَصَمِّ وَالْبَصِيرِ وَالسَّمِيعِ ۚ هَلْ يَسْتَوِيَانِ مَثَلًا ۚ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Mathalu l-farīqayni kal-a'mā wal-aṣammi wal-baṣīri was-samī'i hal yastawiyāni mathalan afalā tadhakkarūn
versets.francais: Les deux groupes sont comparables à l'aveugle et sourd d'un côté, et au voyant et à l'entendant de l'autre. Sont-ils égaux en comparaison? Ne vous rappelez-vous pas?
versets.anglais: The example of the two parties is like the blind and deaf, and the seeing and hearing. Are they equal in comparison? Then, will you not remember

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِ إِنِّي لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
versets.phonetique: Walaqad arsalnā nūḥan ilā qawmihi innī lakum nadhīrun mubīn
versets.francais: Et certes, Nous avons envoyé Noé à son peuple: «Je suis pour vous un avertisseur explicite.»
versets.anglais: And We had certainly sent Noah to his people, [saying], "Indeed, I am to you a clear warner

versets.arabe: أَن لَّا تَعْبُدُوا إِلَّا اللَّهَ ۖ إِنِّي أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ أَلِيمٍ
versets.phonetique: An lā ta'budū illā llāha innī akhāfu 'alaykum 'adhāba yawmin alīm
versets.francais: «N'adorez qu'Allah! Je crains pour vous le châtiment d'un jour douloureux.»
versets.anglais: That you not worship except Allah. Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a painful day

versets.arabe: فَقَالَ الْمَلَأُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِن قَوْمِهِ مَا نَرَاكَ إِلَّا بَشَرًا مِّثْلَنَا وَمَا نَرَاكَ اتَّبَعَكَ إِلَّا الَّذِينَ هُمْ أَرَاذِلُنَا بَادِيَ الرَّأْيِ وَمَا نَرَىٰ لَكُمْ عَلَيْنَا مِن فَضْلٍ بَلْ نَظُنُّكُمْ كَاذِبِينَ
versets.phonetique: Faqāla l-mala'u lladhīna kafarū min qawmihi mā narāka illā basharan mithlunā wamā narāka ttaba'aka illā lladhīna hum arādhilunā bādiya r-ra'yi wamā narā lakum 'alaynā min faḍlin bal naẓunnukum kādhibīn
versets.francais: Les notables de son peuple qui ne croyaient pas dirent: «Nous ne te voyons qu'un être humain comme nous. Et nous ne voyons que ce sont les gens les plus vils parmi nous qui t'ont suivi, à première vue. Et nous ne vous voyons pas supérieurs à nous. Bien au contraire, nous vous croyons menteurs.»
versets.anglais: So the eminent among those who disbelieved from his people said, "We do not see you but as a man like ourselves, and we do not see you followed except by those who are the lowest of us [and] at first suggestion. And we do not see in you over us any merit; rather, we think you are liars

versets.arabe: قَالَ يَا قَوْمِ أَرَأَيْتُمْ إِن كُنتُ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّي وَآتَانِي رَحْمَةً مِّنْ عِندِهِ فَعُمِّيَتْ عَلَيْكُمْ أَنُلْزِمُكُمُوهَا وَأَنتُمْ لَهَا كَارِهُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qāla yā qawmi ara'aytum in kuntu 'alā bayyinatin min rabbī wa'ātānī raḥmatan min 'indihi fa'ummiyat 'alaykum anulzimukumūhā wa'antum lahā kārihūn
versets.francais: Il dit: «Ô mon peuple! Que pensez-vous? Si je me fonde sur une preuve de mon Seigneur, et qu'Il m'a accordé une miséricorde de Sa part et qu'elle vous a été cachée, vous forcerons-nous à l'accepter malgré votre aversion?»
versets.anglais: He said, "O my people have you considered: if I should be upon clear evidence from my Lord while He has given me mercy from Himself but it has been made unapparent to you, should we force it upon you while you are averse to it

versets.arabe: وَيَا قَوْمِ لَا أَسْأَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مَالًا ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَى اللَّهِ ۚ وَمَا أَنَا بِطَارِدِ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا ۚ إِنَّهُم مُّلَاقُو رَبِّهِمْ وَلَٰكِنِّي أَرَاكُمْ قَوْمًا تَجْهَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wayā qawmi lā as'alukum 'alayhi mālan in ajriya illā 'alā llāhi wamā ana biṭāridi lladhīna āmanū innahum mulāqū rabbihim walākinnnī arākum qawman tajhalūn
versets.francais: «Ô mon peuple! Je ne vous demande pas de richesse pour cela. Ma récompense n'incombe qu'à Allah. Et je ne vais pas chasser ceux qui ont cru car ils vont rencontrer leur Seigneur. Mais je vous vois un peuple ignorant.»
versets.anglais: And O my people, I ask not of you for it any wealth. My reward is not but from Allah. And I am not one to drive away those who have believed. Indeed, they will meet their Lord, but I see that you are a people behaving ignorantly

versets.arabe: وَيَا قَوْمِ مَن يَنصُرُنِي مِنَ اللَّهِ إِن طَرَدتُّهُمْ ۚ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wayā qawmi man yanṣurunī mina llāhi in ṭaradttuhum afalā tadhakkarūn
versets.francais: «Ô mon peuple! Qui me protégera d'Allah si je les chasse? Ne vous rappelez-vous donc pas?»
versets.anglais: And O my people, who would protect me from Allah if I drove them away? Then will you not be reminded

versets.arabe: وَلَا أَقُولُ لَكُمْ عِندِي خَزَائِنُ اللَّهِ وَلَا أَعْلَمُ الْغَيْبَ وَلَا أَقُولُ إِنِّي مَلَكٌ وَلَا أَقُولُ لِلَّذِينَ تَزْدَرِي أَعْيُنُكُمْ لَن يُؤْتِيَهُمُ اللَّهُ خَيْرًا
versets.phonetique: Walā aqūlu lakum 'indī khazā'inu llāhi walā a'lamu l-ghayba walā aqūlu innī malakun walā aqūlu lilladhīna tazdari a'yunukum lan yu'tiyahumu llāhu khayran
versets.francais: «Je ne vous dis pas que je possède les trésors d'Allah, ni que je connais l'invisible, ni que je suis un ange, ni que je dis de ceux que vos yeux méprisent qu'Allah ne leur accordera jamais de bien.»
versets.anglais: And I do not tell you that I have the depositories [containing the provision] of Allah or that I know the unseen, nor do I tell you that I am an angel, nor do I say of those upon whom your eyes look down that Allah will never grant them any good. Allah is most knowing of what is within their souls. Indeed, I would then be among the wrongdoers

versets.arabe: قَالُوا يَا نُوحُ قَدْ جَادَلْتَنَا فَأَكْثَرْتَ جِدَالَنَا فَأْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَا إِن كُنتَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qālū yā nūḥu qad jādaltanā fa'katharta jidālanā fa'tinā bimā ta'idunā in kunta mina ṣ-ṣādiqīn
versets.francais: Ils dirent: «Ô Noé! Tu nous as disputé et tu as beaucoup prolongé notre dispute. Apporte-nous donc ce dont tu nous menaces si tu es du nombre des véridiques.»
versets.anglais: They said, "O Noah, you have disputed us and been frequent in dispute of us. So bring us what you threaten us, if you should be of the truthful

versets.arabe: قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَأْتِيكُم بِهِ اللَّهُ إِن شَاءَ وَمَا أَنتُم بِمُعْجِزِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qāla innamā ya'tīkum bihi llāhu in shā'a wamā antum bimu'jizīn
versets.francais: Il dit: «C'est Allah seul qui vous l'apportera, s'Il veut, et vous ne pouvez pas Le réduire à l'impuissance.»
versets.anglais: He said, "Allah will only bring it to you if He wills, and you will not cause [Him] failure

versets.arabe: وَلَا يَنفَعُكُمْ نُصْحِي إِنْ أَرَدتُّ أَنْ أَنصَحَ لَكُمْ إِن كَانَ اللَّهُ يُرِيدُ أَن يُغْوِيَكُمْ ۚ هُوَ رَبُّكُمْ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
versets.phonetique: Walā yanfa'ukum nuṣḥī in aradttu an anṣaḥa lakum in kāna llāhu yurīdu an yughwiyakum huwa rabbukum wa'ilayhi turja'ūn
versets.francais: «Et mon conseil ne vous profite pas, si j'ai voulu vous conseiller, quand Allah veut vous égarer. Il est votre Seigneur et vers Lui vous serez ramenés.»
versets.anglais: And my advice will not benefit you - although I wished to advise you - If Allah should intend to put you in error. He is your Lord, and to Him you will be returned

versets.arabe: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ افْتَرَاهُ ۖ قُلْ إِنِ افْتَرَيْتُهُ فَعَلَيَّ إِجْرَامِي وَأَنَا بَرِيءٌ مِّمَّا تُجْرِمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Am yaqūlūna ftarāhu qul in iftaraytuhu fa'alayya ijrāmī wa'anā barī'un mimmā tujrimūn
versets.francais: Disent-ils qu'il l'a inventé? Dis: «Si je l'ai inventé, c'est sur moi que tombe mon péché. Et je suis innocent de ce dont vous vous rendez coupables.»
versets.anglais: Or do they say [about Prophet Muhammad], "He invented it"? Say, "If I have invented it, then upon me is [the consequence of] my crime; but I am innocent of what [crimes] you commit

versets.arabe: وَأُوحِيَ إِلَىٰ نُوحٍ أَنَّهُ لَن يُؤْمِنَ مِن قَوْمِكَ إِلَّا مَن قَدْ آمَنَ فَلَا تَبْتَئِسْ بِمَا كَانُوا يَفْعَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa'ūḥiya ilā nūḥin annahu lan yu'mina min qawmika illā man qad āmana falā tabt'is bimā kānū yaf'alūn
versets.francais: Et il fut révélé à Noé: «Personne de ton peuple ne croira sauf ceux qui ont déjà cru. Ne te désole donc pas de ce qu'ils font.»
versets.anglais: And it was revealed to Noah that, "No one will believe from your people except those who have already believed, so do not be distressed by what they have been doing

versets.arabe: وَاصْنَعِ الْفُلْكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا وَوَحْيِنَا وَلَا تُخَاطِبْنِي فِي الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا ۚ إِنَّهُم مُّغْرَقُونَ
versets.phonetique: Waṣna'i l-fulka bi'a'yuninā wawaḥyinā walā tukhāṭibnī fī lladhīna ẓalamū innahum mughraqūn
versets.francais: «Et construis l'arche sous Nos yeux et selon Notre révélation. Et ne M'implore pas en faveur des injustes. Ils seront noyés.»
versets.anglais: And construct the ship under Our observation and Our inspiration and do not address Me concerning those who have wronged; indeed, they are [to be] drowned

versets.arabe: وَيَصْنَعُ الْفُلْكَ وَكُلَّمَا مَرَّ عَلَيْهِ مَلَأٌ مِّن قَوْمِهِ سَخِرُوا مِنْهُ ۚ قَالَ إِن تَسْخَرُوا مِنَّا فَإِنَّا نَسْخَرُ مِنكُمْ كَمَا تَسْخَرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wayaṣna'u l-fulka wakulla mā marra 'alayhi mala'un min qawmihi sakhirū minhu qāla in taskhurū minnā fa'innā naskharu minkum kamā taskharūn
versets.francais: Et il construisait l'arche. Chaque fois que des notables de son peuple passaient devant lui, ils se moquaient de lui. Il dit: «Si vous vous moquez de nous, nous nous moquerons de vous, tout comme vous vous moquez.»
versets.anglais: And he constructed the ship, and whenever an assembly of the eminent of his people passed by him, they ridiculed him. He said, "If you ridicule us, then we will ridicule you just as you ridicule

versets.arabe: فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ مَن يَأْتِيهِ عَذَابٌ يُخْزِيهِ وَيَحِلُّ عَلَيْهِ عَذَابٌ مُّقِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Fasawfa ta'lamūna man ya'tīhi 'adhābun yukhzīhi wayaḥillu 'alayhi 'adhābun muqīm
versets.francais: «Vous saurez bientôt sur qui viendra un châtiment le couvrant d'ignominie, et sur qui s'abattra un châtiment permanent.»
versets.anglais: And you are going to know who will get a punishment that will disgrace him [on earth] and upon whom will descend an enduring punishment [in the Hereafter]

versets.arabe: حَتَّىٰ إِذَا جَاءَ أَمْرُنَا وَفَارَ التَّنُّورُ قُلْنَا احْمِلْ فِيهَا مِن كُلٍّ زَوْجَيْنِ اثْنَيْنِ وَأَهْلَكَ إِلَّا مَن سَبَقَ عَلَيْهِ الْقَوْلُ وَمَنْ آمَنَ ۚ وَمَا آمَنَ مَعَهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلٌ
versets.phonetique: Ḥattā idhā jā'a amrunā wafāra t-tannūru qulnā ḥmil fīhā min kullin zawjayni thnayny wa'ahlaka illā man sabaqa 'alayhi l-qawlu waman āmana wamā āmana ma'ahu illā qalīl
versets.francais: Jusqu'au moment où vint Notre ordre et que le four se mit à bouillonner. Nous dîmes: «Embarque dedans un couple de chaque espèce, ainsi que ta famille — sauf ceux dont la sentence a déjà été prononcée — et ceux qui ont cru.» Mais ceux qui avaient cru avec lui n'étaient qu'un petit nombre.
versets.anglais: [So it was], until when Our command came and the oven overflowed, We said, "Load upon the ship of each [creature] two mates and your family, except those about whom the word has preceded, and [include] whoever has believed." But none had believed with him, except a few

versets.arabe: وَقَالَ ارْكَبُوا فِيهَا بِسْمِ اللَّهِ مَجْرَاهَا وَمُرْسَاهَا ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّي لَغَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Waqāla rkabū fīhā bismi llāhi majrāhā wamursāhā inna rabbī laghafūrun raḥīm
versets.francais: Et il dit: «Embarquez! Au nom d'Allah sera sa marche et son ancrage. Mon Seigneur est Pardonneur et Miséricordieux.»
versets.anglais: And [Noah] said, "Embark therein; in the name of Allah is its course and its anchorage. Indeed, my Lord is Forgiving and Merciful

versets.arabe: وَهِيَ تَجْرِي بِهِمْ فِي مَوْجٍ كَالْجِبَالِ وَنَادَىٰ نُوحٌ ابْنَهُ وَكَانَ فِي مَعْزِلٍ يَا بُنَيَّ ارْكَب مَّعَنَا وَلَا تَكُن مَّعَ الْكَافِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wahiya tajrī bihim fī mawjin kal-jibāli wanādā nūḥun bnahū wakāna fī ma'zilin yā bunayya rkab ma'anā walā takun ma'a l-kāfirīn
versets.francais: L'arche voguait avec eux à travers des vagues comme des montagnes. Et Noé appela son fils qui se tenait à l'écart: «Ô mon fils! Embarque avec nous et ne reste pas avec les mécréants.»
versets.anglais: And it sailed with them through waves like mountains, and Noah called to his son who was apart [from them], "O my son, come aboard with us and be not with the disbelievers

versets.arabe: قَالَ سَآوِي إِلَىٰ جَبَلٍ يَعْصِمُنِي مِنَ الْمَاءِ ۚ قَالَ لَا عَاصِمَ الْيَوْمَ مِنْ أَمْرِ اللَّهِ إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ ۚ وَحَالَ بَيْنَهُمَا الْمَوْجُ فَكَانَ مِنَ الْمُغْرَقِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qāla sa'āwī ilā jabalin ya'ṣimunī mina l-mā'i qāla lā 'āṣima l-yawma min amri llāhi illā man raḥima waḥāla baynahumā l-mawju fakāna mina l-mughraqīn
versets.francais: Il dit: «Je vais me réfugier à une montagne qui me protégera de l'eau.» Noé dit: «Aujourd'hui rien ne protège de l'ordre d'Allah, sauf celui auquel Il fait miséricorde.» Et une vague s'interposa entre eux, et il fut de ceux qui furent noyés.
versets.anglais: [But] he said, "I will take refuge on a mountain to protect me from the water." [Noah] said, "There is no protector today from the decree of Allah, except for whom He gives mercy." And the waves came between them, and he was among the drowned

versets.arabe: وَقِيلَ يَا أَرْضُ ابْلَعِي مَاءَكِ وَيَا سَمَاءُ أَقْلِعِي وَغِيضَ الْمَاءُ وَقُضِيَ الْأَمْرُ وَاسْتَوَتْ عَلَى الْجُودِيِّ ۖ وَقِيلَ بُعْدًا لِّلْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Waqīla yā arḍu bla'ī mā'aki wayā samā'u aqli'ī wagīḍa l-mā'u waquḍiya l-amru wastawat 'alā l-jūdiyyi waqīla bu'dan lil-qawmi ẓ-ẓālimīn
versets.francais: Et il fut dit: «Ô terre, absorbe ton eau! Et toi, ô ciel, retiens [ta pluie]!» L'eau diminua, et l'ordre fut exécuté. L'arche s'arrêta sur le mont Judi. Et il fut dit: «Loin [de la miséricorde d'Allah] les gens injustes!»
versets.anglais: And it was said, "O earth, swallow your water, and O sky, withhold [your rain]." And the water subsided, and the matter was accomplished, and the ship came to rest on the [mountain of] Judiyy. And it was said, "Away with the wrongdoing people

versets.arabe: وَنَادَىٰ نُوحٌ رَّبَّهُ فَقَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ ابْنِي مِنْ أَهْلِي وَإِنَّ وَعْدَكَ الْحَقُّ وَأَنتَ أَحْكَمُ الْحَاكِمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wanādā nūḥun rabbahu faqāla rabbi inna bnī min ahlī wa'inna wa'daka l-ḥaqqu wa'anta aḥkamu l-ḥākimīn
versets.francais: Noé appela son Seigneur: «Seigneur, mon fils est de ma famille. Ta promesse est certes vraie, et Tu es le Plus Juste des juges.»
versets.anglais: And Noah called to his Lord and said, "My Lord, indeed my son is of my family; and indeed, Your promise is true; and You are the most just of judges

versets.arabe: قَالَ يَا نُوحُ إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ مِنْ أَهْلِكَ ۖ إِنَّهُ عَمَلٌ غَيْرُ صَالِحٍ ۖ فَلَا تَسْأَلْنِ مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِ عِلْمٌ ۖ إِنِّي أَعِظُكَ أَن تَكُونَ مِنَ الْجَاهِلِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qāla yā nūḥu innahu laysa min ahlika innahu 'amalun ghayru ṣāliḥin falā tas'alni mā laysa laka bihi 'ilmun innī a'iẓuka an takūna mina l-jāhilīn
versets.francais: Il dit: «Ô Noé! Il n'est pas de ta famille; c'est un homme aux actes mauvais. Ne me demande pas ce dont tu n'as pas de savoir. Je te conseille de ne pas être du nombre des ignorants.»
versets.anglais: He said, "O Noah, indeed he is not of your family; indeed, he is [one whose] work was other than righteous, so ask Me not for that about which you have no knowledge. Indeed, I advise you, lest you be among the ignorant

versets.arabe: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَسْأَلَكَ مَا لَيْسَ لِي بِهِ عِلْمٌ ۖ وَإِلَّا تَغْفِرْ لِي وَتَرْحَمْنِي أَكُن مِّنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qāla rabbi innī a'ūdhu bika an as'alaka mā laysa lī bihi 'ilmun wa'illā taghfir lī watarḥamnī akun mina l-khāsirīn
versets.francais: Il dit: «Seigneur, je cherche Ta protection contre le fait de Te demander ce dont je n'ai pas de connaissance. Si Tu ne me pardonnes pas et ne me fais pas miséricorde, je serai du nombre des perdants.»
versets.anglais: [Noah] said, "My Lord, I seek refuge in You from asking that of which I have no knowledge. And unless You forgive me and have mercy upon me, I will be among the losers

versets.arabe: قِيلَ يَا نُوحُ اهْبِطْ بِسَلَامٍ مِّنَّا وَبَرَكَاتٍ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَىٰ أُمَمٍ مِّمَّن مَّعَكَ ۚ وَأُمَمٌ سَنُمَتِّعُهُمْ ثُمَّ يَمَسُّهُم مِّنَّا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Qīla yā nūḥu hbiṭ bisalāmin minnā wabarakātin 'alayka wa'alā umaamin mimman ma'aka wa'umamun sanumattiˋuhum thumma yamassuhum minnā 'adhābun alīm
versets.francais: Il lui fut dit: «Ô Noé! Descends avec une paix venant de Nous et des bénédictions sur toi et sur les communautés [issues] de ceux qui sont avec toi. Et il y a des communautés à qui Nous accorderons des jouissances, puis que touchera un châtiment douloureux venant de Nous.»
versets.anglais: It was said, "O Noah, disembark in security from Us and blessings upon you and upon nations [descending] from those with you. But other nations [of them] We will grant enjoyment; then there will touch them from Us a painful punishment

versets.arabe: تِلْكَ مِنْ أَنبَاءِ الْغَيْبِ نُوحِيهَا إِلَيْكَ ۖ مَا كُنتَ تَعْلَمُهَا أَنتَ وَلَا قَوْمُكَ مِن قَبْلِ هَٰذَا ۖ فَاصْبِرْ ۖ إِنَّ الْعَاقِبَةَ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
versets.phonetique: Tilka min anbā'i l-ghaybi nūḥīhā ilayka mā kunta ta'lamuhā anta walā qawmuka min qabli hādhā faṣbir inna l-'āqibata lil-muttaqīn
versets.francais: Voilà des nouvelles de l'invisible que Nous te révélons. Tu ne les connaissais pas, toi ni ton peuple avant ceci. Endure donc. La fin heureuse est pour les pieux.
versets.anglais: That is from the news of the unseen which We reveal to you, [O Muhammad]. You knew it not, neither you nor your people, before this. So be patient; indeed, the [best] outcome is for the righteous

versets.arabe: وَإِلَىٰ عَادٍ أَخَاهُمْ هُودًا ۚ قَالَ يَا قَوْمِ اعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَٰهٍ غَيْرُهُ ۖ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا مُفْتَرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa'ilā 'ādin akhāhum hūdan qāla yā qawmi 'budū llāha mā lakum min ilāhin ghayruhu in antum illā muftarūn
versets.francais: Et aux Aad, leur frère Hûd. Il dit: «Ô mon peuple! Adorez Allah, vous n'avez pas de divinité autre que Lui. Vous n'êtes que des inventeurs de mensonges.»
versets.anglais: And to 'Aad [We sent] their brother Hud. He said, "O my people, worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him. You are not but inventors [of falsehood]

versets.arabe: يَا قَوْمِ لَا أَسْأَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ أَجْرًا ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَى الَّذِي فَطَرَنِي ۚ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Yā qawmi lā as'alukum 'alayhi ajran in ajriya illā 'alā lladhī faṭaranī afalā ta'qilūn
versets.francais: «Ô mon peuple! Je ne vous demande pas de salaire pour cela. Ma récompense n'incombe qu'à Celui qui m'a créé. Ne raisonnez-vous donc pas?»
versets.anglais: O my people, I do not ask you for it any reward. My reward is only from the one who created me. Then will you not reason

versets.arabe: وَيَا قَوْمِ اسْتَغْفِرُوا رَبَّكُمْ ثُمَّ تُوبُوا إِلَيْهِ يُرْسِلِ السَّمَاءَ عَلَيْكُم مِّدْرَارًا وَيَزِدْكُمْ قُوَّةً إِلَىٰ قُوَّتِكُمْ وَلَا تَتَوَلَّوْا مُجْرِمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wayā qawmi staghfirū rabbakum thumma tūbū ilayhi yursili s-samā'a 'alaykum midrāran wayazdkum quwwatan ilā quwwatikum walā tatawallaw mujrimīn
versets.francais: «Ô mon peuple! Demandez pardon à votre Seigneur, puis revenez à Lui. Il vous enverra du ciel d'abondantes pluies, et Il ajoutera force à votre force. Et ne vous détournez pas comme des criminels.»
versets.anglais: And O my people, ask forgiveness of your Lord and then repent to Him. He will send [rain from] the sky upon you in showers and increase you in strength [added] to your strength. And do not turn away, [being] criminals

versets.arabe: قَالُوا يَا هُودُ مَا جِئْتَنَا بِبَيِّنَةٍ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِتَارِكِي آلِهَتِنَا عَن قَوْلِكَ وَمَا نَحْنُ لَكَ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qālū yā hūdu mā ji'tanā bibayyinatin wamā naḥnu bitārikī ālihatinā 'an qawlika wamā naḥnu laka bimu'minīn
versets.francais: Ils dirent: «Ô Hûd! Tu ne nous as pas apporté une preuve évidente, et nous n'allons pas abandonner nos divinités sur ta parole, et nous ne croyons pas en toi.»
versets.anglais: They said, "O Hud, you have not brought us clear evidence, and we are not ones to leave our gods on your say-so. Nor are we believers in you

versets.arabe: إِن نَّقُولُ إِلَّا اعْتَرَاكَ بَعْضُ آلِهَتِنَا بِسُوءٍ ۗ قَالَ إِنِّي أُشْهِدُ اللَّهَ وَاشْهَدُوا أَنِّي بَرِيءٌ مِّمَّا تُشْرِكُونَ
versets.phonetique: In naqūlu illā 'tarāka ba'ḍu ālihatinā bisū'in qāla innī ushhidu llāha washhadu annī barī'un mimmā tushrikūn
versets.francais: «Nous disons seulement que l'une de nos divinités t'a frappé de quelque mal.» Il dit: «Je prends Allah à témoin, et vous aussi soyez témoins, que je me dissocie de ce à quoi vous associez,»
versets.anglais: We only say that some of our gods have possessed you with evil." He said, "Indeed, I call Allah to witness, and witness [yourselves] that I am free from whatever you associate with Allah

versets.arabe: مِن دُونِهِ ۖ فَكِيدُونِي جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ لَا تُنظِرُونِ
versets.phonetique: Min dūnihi fakīdūnī jamī'an thumma lā tunẓirūn
versets.francais: «en dehors de Lui. Combinez donc [vos ruses] contre moi tous ensemble, sans m'accorder de délai.»
versets.anglais: Other than Him. So plot against me all together; then do not give me respite

versets.arabe: إِنِّي تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ رَبِّي وَرَبِّكُم ۚ مَّا مِن دَابَّةٍ إِلَّا هُوَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهَا ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّي عَلَىٰ صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
versets.phonetique: Innī tawakkaltu 'alā llāhi rabbī warabbikum mā min dābbatin illā huwa ākhidhun bināṣiyatihā inna rabbī 'alā ṣirāṭin mustaqīm
versets.francais: «Je me confie à Allah, mon Seigneur et votre Seigneur. Il n'est pas une bête qu'Il ne tienne par la tête. Certes mon Seigneur est sur un droit chemin.»
versets.anglais: Indeed, I have relied upon Allah, my Lord and your Lord. There is no creature but that He holds its forelock. Indeed, my Lord is on a path [that is] straight

versets.arabe: فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا فَقَدْ أَبْلَغْتُكُم مَّا أُرْسِلْتُ بِهِ إِلَيْكُمْ ۚ وَيَسْتَخْلِفُ رَبِّي قَوْمًا غَيْرَكُمْ وَلَا تَضُرُّونَهُ شَيْئًا ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّي عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ حَفِيظٌ
versets.phonetique: Fa'in tawallū faqad ablaghtukum mā ursiltu bihi ilaykum wayastakhlifu rabbī qawman ghayrakum walā taḍurrūnahu shay'an inna rabbī 'alā kulli shay'in ḥafiẓ
versets.francais: «Si vous vous détournez, je vous ai certes transmis ce avec quoi j'ai été envoyé vers vous. Mon Seigneur fera venir d'autres gens pour vous succéder. Vous ne pouvez nullement Lui causer de préjudice. Mon Seigneur veille sur toute chose.»
versets.anglais: But if they turn away, [say], "I have already conveyed that with which I was sent to you. My Lord will give succession to a people other than you, and you will not harm Him at all. Indeed my Lord is, over all things, Guardian

versets.arabe: وَلَمَّا جَاءَ أَمْرُنَا نَجَّيْنَا هُودًا وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا مَعَهُ بِرَحْمَةٍ مِّنَّا وَنَجَّيْنَاهُم مِّنْ عَذَابٍ غَلِيظٍ
versets.phonetique: Walammā jā'a amrunā najjaynā hūdan walladhīna āmanū ma'ahu biraḥmatin minnā wanajjaynāhum min 'adhābin ghalīẓ
versets.francais: Et quand Notre ordre vint, Nous sauvâmes Hûd et ceux qui avaient cru avec lui par une miséricorde de Notre part, et Nous les sauvâmes d'un dur châtiment.
versets.anglais: And when Our command came, We saved Hud and those who believed with him, by mercy from Us; and We saved them from a harsh punishment

versets.arabe: وَتِلْكَ عَادٌ ۖ جَحَدُوا بِآيَاتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَعَصَوْا رُسُلَهُ وَاتَّبَعُوا أَمْرَ كُلِّ جَبَّارٍ عَنِيدٍ
versets.phonetique: Watilka 'ādun jaḥadū bi'āyāti rabbihim wa'aṣaw rusulahu wattaba'ū amra kulli jabbārin 'anīd
versets.francais: Et voilà les Aad: ils ont rejeté les signes de leur Seigneur, désobéi à Ses messagers, et suivi l'ordre de tout tyran obstiné.
versets.anglais: And that was 'Aad, who rejected the signs of their Lord and disobeyed His messengers and followed the order of every obstinate tyrant

versets.arabe: وَأُتْبِعُوا فِي هَٰذِهِ الدُّنْيَا لَعْنَةً وَيَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ۗ أَلَا إِنَّ عَادًا كَفَرُوا رَبَّهُمْ ۗ أَلَا بُعْدًا لِّعَادٍ قَوْمِ هُودٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa'utbi'ū fī hādhihi d-dunyā la'natan wayawma l-qiyāmati alā inna 'ādan kafarū rabbahum alā bu'dan li'ādin qawmi hūd
versets.francais: Et ils furent poursuivis dans la vie présente par une malédiction, ainsi qu'au Jour de la Résurrection. Certes, les Aad ont renié leur Seigneur. Et loin [de la miséricorde divine] les Aad, le peuple de Hûd!
versets.anglais: And they were [therefore] followed in this world with a curse and [as well] on the Day of Resurrection. Unquestionably, 'Aad denied their Lord; then away with 'Aad, the people of Hud

versets.arabe: وَإِلَىٰ ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَالِحًا ۚ قَالَ يَا قَوْمِ اعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَٰهٍ غَيْرُهُ ۖ هُوَ أَنشَأَكُم مِّنَ الْأَرْضِ وَاسْتَعْمَرَكُمْ فِيهَا فَاسْتَغْفِرُوهُ ثُمَّ تُوبُوا إِلَيْهِ ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّي قَرِيبٌ مُّجِيبٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa'ilā thamūda akhāhum ṣāliḥan qāla yā qawmi 'budū llāha mā lakum min ilāhin ghayruhu huwa ansha'akum mina l-arḍi wasta'marakum fīhā fastaghfirūhu thumma tūbū ilayhi inna rabbī qarībun mujīb
versets.francais: Et aux Thamoud, leur frère Ṣâliḥ. Il dit: «Ô mon peuple! Adorez Allah. Vous n'avez pas d'autre divinité que Lui. C'est Lui qui vous a produits de la terre et vous y a établis. Demandez-Lui pardon, et revenez à Lui. Mon Seigneur est Proche et Il répond.»
versets.anglais: And to Thamud [We sent] their brother Salih. He said, "O my people, worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him. He has produced you from the earth and settled you in it, so ask forgiveness of Him and then repent to Him. Indeed, my Lord is near and responsive

versets.arabe: قَالُوا يَا صَالِحُ قَدْ كُنتَ فِينَا مَرْجُوًّا قَبْلَ هَٰذَا أَتَنْهَانَا أَن نَّعْبُدَ مَا يَعْبُدُ آبَاؤُنَا وَإِنَّنَا لَفِي شَكٍّ مِّمَّا تَدْعُونَا إِلَيْهِ مُرِيبٍ
versets.phonetique: Qālū yā ṣāliḥu qad kunta fīnā marjuwwan qabla hādhā atanhānā an na'buda mā ya'budu ābā'unā wa'innanā lafī shakkin mimmā tad'ūnā ilayhi murīb
versets.francais: Ils dirent: «Ô Ṣâliḥ! Tu étais parmi nous un homme en qui on mettait de grands espoirs avant ceci. Nous interdis-tu d'adorer ce qu'adoraient nos ancêtres? Nous sommes dans un doute troublant à l'égard de ce à quoi tu nous invites.»
versets.anglais: They said, "O Salih, you were among us a man of promise before this. Do you forbid us to worship what our fathers worshipped? And indeed we are, about that to which you invite us, in disquieting doubt

versets.arabe: قَالَ يَا قَوْمِ أَرَأَيْتُمْ إِن كُنتُ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّي وَآتَانِي مِنْهُ رَحْمَةً فَمَن يَنصُرُنِي مِنَ اللَّهِ إِنْ عَصَيْتُهُ ۖ فَمَا تَزِيدُونَنِي غَيْرَ تَخْسِيرٍ
versets.phonetique: Qāla yā qawmi ara'aytum in kuntu 'alā bayyinatin min rabbī wa'ātānī minhu raḥmatan faman yanṣurunī mina llāhi in 'aṣaytuhu famā tazīdūnanī ghayra takhsīr
versets.francais: Il dit: «Ô mon peuple! Que pensez-vous? Si je me fonde sur une preuve de mon Seigneur, et qu'Il m'a accordé une miséricorde de Sa part, qui me protégera d'Allah si je Lui désobéis? Vous ne faites que me faire perdre davantage.»
versets.anglais: He said, "O my people, have you considered: if I should be upon clear evidence from my Lord and He has given me mercy from Himself, who would protect me from Allah if I disobeyed Him? So you would not increase me except in loss

versets.arabe: وَيَا قَوْمِ هَٰذِهِ نَاقَةُ اللَّهِ لَكُمْ آيَةً فَذَرُوهَا تَأْكُلْ فِي أَرْضِ اللَّهِ وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوءٍ فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابٌ قَرِيبٌ
versets.phonetique: Wayā qawmi hādhihi nāqatu llāhi lakum āyatan fadhharūhā ta'kul fī arḍi llāhi walā tamassūhā bisū'in faya'khudhakum 'adhābun qarīb
versets.francais: «Ô mon peuple! Voilà la chamelle d'Allah comme signe pour vous. Laissez-la paître sur la terre d'Allah et ne lui faites aucun mal, sinon un châtiment proche vous saisira.»
versets.anglais: And O my people, this is the she-camel of Allah - [she is] to you a sign. So let her feed upon Allah 's earth and do not touch her with harm, or you will be taken by an impending punishment

versets.arabe: فَعَقَرُوهَا فَقَالَ تَمَتَّعُوا فِي دَارِكُمْ ثَلَاثَةَ أَيَّامٍ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ وَعْدٌ غَيْرُ مَكْذُوبٍ
versets.phonetique: Fa'aqarūhā faqāla tamatta'ū fī dārikum thalāthata ayyāmin dhālika wa'dun ghayru makdhūb
versets.francais: Ils lui coupèrent les jarrets. Il dit: «Profitez [de la vie] dans vos demeures trois jours. C'est une promesse qui ne sera pas démentie.»
versets.anglais: But they hamstrung her, so he said, "Enjoy yourselves in your homes for three days. That is a promise not to be denied

versets.arabe: فَلَمَّا جَاءَ أَمْرُنَا نَجَّيْنَا صَالِحًا وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا مَعَهُ بِرَحْمَةٍ مِّنَّا وَمِنْ خِزْيِ يَوْمِئِذٍ ۗ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ الْقَوِيُّ الْعَزِيزُ
versets.phonetique: Falammā jā'a amrunā najjaynā ṣāliḥan walladhīna āmanū ma'ahu biraḥmatin minnā wamin khizyi yawmi'idhin inna rabbaka huwa l-qawiyyu l-'azīz
versets.francais: Quand Notre ordre vint, Nous sauvâmes Ṣâliḥ et ceux qui avaient cru avec lui par une miséricorde de Notre part, et de la honte de ce jour. Certes ton Seigneur est le Fort, le Puissant.
versets.anglais: So when Our command came, We saved Salih and those who believed with him, by mercy from Us, and [saved them] from the disgrace of that day. Indeed, it is your Lord who is the Powerful, the Exalted in Might

versets.arabe: وَأَخَذَ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا الصَّيْحَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا فِي دِيَارِهِمْ جَاثِمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa'akhadha lladhīna ẓalamū ṣ-ṣayḥatu fa'aṣbaḥū fī diyārihim jāthimīn
versets.francais: Et le Cri saisit les injustes, et ils s'écroulèrent dans leurs demeures,
versets.anglais: And the shriek seized those who had wronged, and they became within their homes [corpses] fallen prone

versets.arabe: كَأَن لَّمْ يَغْنَوْا فِيهَا ۗ أَلَا إِنَّ ثَمُودَ كَفَرُوا رَبَّهُمْ ۗ أَلَا بُعْدًا لِّثَمُودَ
versets.phonetique: Ka'an lam yaghnaw fīhā alā inna thamūda kafarū rabbahum alā bu'dan lithhamūd
versets.francais: comme s'ils n'y avaient jamais prospéré. Certes, les Thamoud ont renié leur Seigneur. Loin [de la miséricorde divine] les Thamoud!
versets.anglais: As if they had never prospered therein. Unquestionably, Thamud denied their Lord; then, away with Thamud

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ جَاءَتْ رُسُلُنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ بِالْبُشْرَىٰ قَالُوا سَلَامًا ۖ قَالَ سَلَامٌ ۖ فَمَا لَبِثَ أَن جَاءَ بِعِجْلٍ حَنِيذٍ
versets.phonetique: Walaqad jā'at rusulunā ibrāhīma bil-bushrā qālū salāman qāla salāmun famā labitha an jā'a bi'ijlin ḥanīdh
versets.francais: Et certes Nos messagers sont venus à Abraham avec la bonne nouvelle. Ils dirent: «Salut.» Il dit: «Salut.» Et il ne tarda pas à apporter un veau rôti.
versets.anglais: And certainly did Our messengers come to Abraham with good tidings; they said, "Peace." He said, "Peace," and did not delay in bringing [them] a roasted calf

versets.arabe: فَلَمَّا رَأَىٰ أَيْدِيَهُمْ لَا تَصِلُ إِلَيْهِ نَكِرَهُمْ وَأَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةً ۚ قَالُوا لَا تَخَفْ إِنَّا أُرْسِلْنَا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِ لُوطٍ
versets.phonetique: Falammā ra'ā aydiyahum lā taṣilu ilayhi nakirahum wa'awjasa minhum khīfatan qālū lā takhaf innā ursilnā ilā qawmi lūṭ
versets.francais: Mais quand il vit que leurs mains ne se tendaient pas vers [la nourriture], il leur trouva un air étrange et ressentit de la peur envers eux. Ils dirent: «N'aie pas peur. Nous avons été envoyés vers le peuple de Loth.»
versets.anglais: But when he saw their hands not reaching for it, he distrusted them and felt from them apprehension. They said, "Fear not. We have been sent to the people of Lot

versets.arabe: وَامْرَأَتُهُ قَائِمَةٌ فَضَحِكَتْ فَبَشَّرْنَاهَا بِإِسْحَاقَ وَمِن وَرَاءِ إِسْحَاقَ يَعْقُوبَ
versets.phonetique: Wamra'atuhu qā'imatun faḍaḥikat fabashsarnāhā bi'isḥāqa wamin warā'i isḥāqa ya'qūb
versets.francais: Et sa femme était debout; elle sourit. Alors Nous lui annonçâmes la bonne nouvelle d'Isaac, et après Isaac, Jacob.
versets.anglais: And his Wife was standing, and she smiled. Then We gave her good tidings of Isaac and after Isaac, Jacob

versets.arabe: قَالَتْ يَا وَيْلَتَىٰ أَأَلِدُ وَأَنَا عَجُوزٌ وَهَٰذَا بَعْلِي شَيْخًا ۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَيْءٌ عَجِيبٌ
versets.phonetique: Qālat yā waylatā a'alidu wa'anā 'ajūzun wahādhā ba'lī shaykhana inna hādhā lashay'un 'ajīb
versets.francais: Elle dit: «Malheur à moi! Vais-je accoucher alors que je suis une vieille femme, et que mon mari est un vieillard? Vraiment, c'est une chose étrange!»
versets.anglais: She said, "Woe to me! Shall I give birth while I am an old woman and this, my husband, is an old man? Indeed, this is an amazing thing

versets.arabe: قَالُوا أَتَعْجَبِينَ مِنْ أَمْرِ اللَّهِ ۖ رَحْمَتُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ ۚ إِنَّهُ حَمِيدٌ مَّجِيدٌ
versets.phonetique: Qālū ata'jabīna min amri llāhi raḥmatu llāhi wabarakātuhu 'alaykum ahla l-bayti innahu ḥamīdun majīd
versets.francais: Ils dirent: «T'étonne-tu de l'ordre d'Allah? Que la miséricorde d'Allah et Ses bénédictions soient sur vous, gens de la maison. Il est certes Digne de louange et Plein de gloire.»
versets.anglais: They said, "Are you amazed at the decree of Allah? May the mercy of Allah and His blessings be upon you, people of the house. Indeed, He is Praiseworthy and Honorable

versets.arabe: فَلَمَّا ذَهَبَ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الرَّوْعُ وَجَاءَتْهُ الْبُشْرَىٰ يُجَادِلُنَا فِي قَوْمِ لُوطٍ
versets.phonetique: Falammā dhahaba 'an ibrāhīma r-raw'u wajā'at-hu l-bushrā yujādilunā fī qawmi lūṭ
versets.francais: Quand la crainte se fut dissipée de Abraham et que la bonne nouvelle lui fut venue, il entreprit de discuter avec Nous au sujet du peuple de Loth.
versets.anglais: And when the fright had left Abraham and the good tidings had reached him, he began to argue with Us concerning the people of Lot

versets.arabe: إِنَّ إِبْرَاهِيمَ لَحَلِيمٌ أَوَّاهٌ مُّنِيبٌ
versets.phonetique: Inna ibrāhīma laḥalīmun awwāhun munīb
versets.francais: Certes, Abraham était fort indulgent, compatissant et repentant.
versets.anglais: Indeed, Abraham was forbearing, grieving and [frequently] returning [to Allah]

versets.arabe: يَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ أَعْرِضْ عَنْ هَٰذَا ۖ إِنَّهُ قَدْ جَاءَ أَمْرُ رَبِّكَ ۖ وَإِنَّهُمْ آتِيهِمْ عَذَابٌ غَيْرُ مَرْدُودٍ
versets.phonetique: Yā ibrāhīmu a'riḍ 'an hādhā innahu qad jā'a amru rabbika wa'innahum ātīhim 'adhābun ghayru mardūd
versets.francais: «Ô Abraham! Cesse de discuter là-dessus: l'ordre de ton Seigneur est venu, et sur eux viendra un châtiment irrévocable.»
versets.anglais: [The angels said], "O Abraham, give up this [plea]. Indeed, the command of your Lord has come, and indeed, there will reach them a punishment that cannot be repelled

versets.arabe: وَلَمَّا جَاءَتْ رُسُلُنَا لُوطًا سِيءَ بِهِمْ وَضَاقَ بِهِمْ ذَرْعًا وَقَالَ هَٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَصِيبٌ
versets.phonetique: Walammā jā'at rusulunā lūṭan sī'a bihim waḍāqa bihim dhar'an waqāla hādhā yawmun 'aṣīb
versets.francais: Et quand Nos messagers vinrent à Loth, il fut affligé à cause d'eux et se sentit incapable de les protéger. Il dit: «C'est un jour terrible.»
versets.anglais: And when Our messengers, [the angels], came to Lot, he was anguished for them and felt for them great discomfort and said, "This is a trying day

versets.arabe: وَجَاءَهُ قَوْمُهُ يُهْرَعُونَ إِلَيْهِ وَمِن قَبْلُ كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ السَّيِّئَاتِ ۚ قَالَ يَا قَوْمِ هَٰؤُلَاءِ بَنَاتِي هُنَّ أَطْهَرُ لَكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Wajā'ahu qawmuhu yuhra'ūna ilayhi wamin qablu kānū ya'malūna s-sayyi'āti qāla yā qawmi hā'ulā'i banātī hunna aṭharu lakum
versets.francais: Et son peuple vint à lui en se précipitant vers lui. Avant cela, ils commettaient déjà des actes répréhensibles. Il dit: «Ô mon peuple! Voici mes filles: elles sont plus pures pour vous.»
versets.anglais: And his people came hastening to him, and before [this] they had been doing evil deeds. He said, "O my people, these are my daughters; they are purer for you. So fear Allah and do not disgrace me concerning my guests. Is there not among you a man of reason

versets.arabe: قَالُوا لَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ مَا لَنَا فِي بَنَاتِكَ مِنْ حَقٍّ وَإِنَّكَ لَتَعْلَمُ مَا نُرِيدُ
versets.phonetique: Qālū laqad 'alimta mā lanā fī banātika min ḥaqqin wa'innaka lata'lamu mā nurīd
versets.francais: Ils dirent: «Tu sais bien que nous n'avons aucun désir pour tes filles. Et tu sais bien ce que nous voulons.»
versets.anglais: They said, "You have already known that we have not concerning your daughters any claim, and indeed, you know what we want

versets.arabe: قَالَ لَوْ أَنَّ لِي بِكُمْ قُوَّةً أَوْ آوِي إِلَىٰ رُكْنٍ شَدِيدٍ
versets.phonetique: Qāla law anna lī bikum quwwatan aw āwī ilā ruknin shadīd
versets.francais: Il dit: «Ah! Si seulement j'avais la force [de vous combattre] ou si je pouvais me réfugier dans un puissant soutien.»
versets.anglais: He said, "If only I had against you some power or could take refuge in a strong support

versets.arabe: قَالُوا يَا لُوطُ إِنَّا رُسُلُ رَبِّكَ لَن يَصِلُوا إِلَيْكَ ۖ فَأَسْرِ بِأَهْلِكَ بِقِطْعٍ مِّنَ اللَّيْلِ وَلَا يَلْتَفِتْ مِنكُمْ أَحَدٌ إِلَّا امْرَأَتَكَ ۖ إِنَّهُ مُصِيبُهَا مَا أَصَابَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّ مَوْعِدَهُمُ الصُّبْحُ
versets.phonetique: Qālū yā lūṭu innā rusulu rabbika lan yaṣilū ilayka fa'asri bi'ahlika biqiṭ'in mina l-layli walā yaltafit minkum aḥadun illā mra'ataka innahu muṣībuha mā aṣābahum inna maw'idahumu ṣ-ṣubḥ
versets.francais: Ils dirent: «Ô Loth! Nous sommes les messagers de ton Seigneur. Ils ne pourront pas t'atteindre. Pars avec ta famille durant la nuit, et qu'aucun de vous ne se retourne, sauf ta femme: ce qui les touchera la touchera. Leur rendez-vous est à l'aube.»
versets.anglais: The angels said, "O Lot, indeed we are messengers of your Lord; [therefore], they will never reach you. So set out with your family during a portion of the night and let not any among you look back - except your wife; indeed, she will be struck by that which strikes them. Indeed, their appointment is [for] the morning. Is not the morning near

versets.arabe: فَلَمَّا جَاءَ أَمْرُنَا جَعَلْنَا عَالِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهَا حِجَارَةً مِّن سِجِّيلٍ مَّنضُودٍ
versets.phonetique: Falammā jā'a amrunā ja'alnā 'āliyahā sāfilahā wa'amṭarnā 'alayhā ḥijāratan min sijjīlin manḍūd
versets.francais: Quand Notre ordre vint, Nous retournâmes la ville sens dessus dessous, et Nous fîmes pleuvoir sur elle des pierres de terre cuite, en couches successives,
versets.anglais: So when Our command came, We made the highest part [of the city] its lowest and rained upon them stones of layered hard clay, [which were]

versets.arabe: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ ۖ وَمَا هِيَ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ بِبَعِيدٍ
versets.phonetique: Musawwamatan 'inda rabbika wamā hiya mina ẓ-ẓālimīna biba'īd
versets.francais: marquées chez ton Seigneur. Et elles ne sont jamais loin des injustes.
versets.anglais: Marked from your Lord. And Allah 's punishment is not from the wrongdoers [very] far

versets.arabe: وَإِلَىٰ مَدْيَنَ أَخَاهُمْ شُعَيْبًا ۚ قَالَ يَا قَوْمِ اعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَٰهٍ غَيْرُهُ ۖ وَلَا تَنقُصُوا الْمِكْيَالَ وَالْمِيزَانَ ۚ إِنِّي أَرَاكُم بِخَيْرٍ وَإِنِّي أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ مُّحِيطٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa'ilā madyana akhāhum shu'ayban qāla yā qawmi 'budū llāha mā lakum min ilāhin ghayruhu walā tanquṣū l-mikyāla wal-mīzāna innī arākum bikhayin wa'innī akhāfu 'alaykum 'adhāba yawmin muḥīṭ
versets.francais: Et aux Madyan, leur frère Chuayb. Il dit: «Ô mon peuple! Adorez Allah. Vous n'avez pas de divinité autre que Lui. Et ne rognez pas la mesure et le poids. Je vous vois dans l'aisance et je crains pour vous le châtiment d'un jour qui vous enveloppera.»
versets.anglais: And to Madyan [We sent] their brother Shu'ayb. He said, "O my people, worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him. And do not decrease from the measure and the scale. Indeed, I see you in prosperity, but indeed, I fear for you the punishment of an all-encompassing Day

versets.arabe: وَيَا قَوْمِ أَوْفُوا الْمِكْيَالَ وَالْمِيزَانَ بِالْقِسْطِ ۖ وَلَا تَبْخَسُوا النَّاسَ أَشْيَاءَهُمْ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا فِي الْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wayā qawmi awfū l-mikyāla wal-mīzāna bil-qisṭi walā tabkhasū n-nāsa ashyā'ahum walā ta'thaw fī l-arḍi mufsidīn
versets.francais: «Ô mon peuple! Donnez la juste mesure et le juste poids, ne frustrez pas les gens de leurs biens, et ne semez pas la corruption sur la terre.»
versets.anglais: And O my people, give full measure and weight in justice and do not deprive the people of their due and do not commit abuse on the earth, spreading corruption

versets.arabe: بَقِيَّتُ اللَّهِ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ ۚ وَمَا أَنَا عَلَيْكُم بِحَفِيظٍ
versets.phonetique: Baqiyyatu llāhi khayrun lakum in kuntum mu'minīna wamā ana 'alaykum biḥafiẓ
versets.francais: «Ce qu'Allah laisse pour vous est meilleur pour vous, si vous êtes croyants. Et je ne suis pas un gardien sur vous.»
versets.anglais: What remains [lawful] from Allah is best for you, if you would be believers. But I am not a guardian over you

versets.arabe: قَالُوا يَا شُعَيْبُ أَصَلَاتُكَ تَأْمُرُكَ أَن نَّتْرُكَ مَا يَعْبُدُ آبَاؤُنَا أَوْ أَن نَّفْعَلَ فِي أَمْوَالِنَا مَا نَشَاءُ ۖ إِنَّكَ لَأَنتَ الْحَلِيمُ الرَّشِيدُ
versets.phonetique: Qālū yā shu'aybu aṣalātuka ta'muruka an natruka mā ya'budu ābā'unā aw an naf'ala fī amwālinā mā nashā'u innaka la'anta l-ḥalīmu r-rashīd
versets.francais: Ils dirent: «Ô Chuayb! Est-ce ta Salât qui t'ordonne que nous abandonnions ce qu'adoraient nos ancêtres, ou que nous ne fassions pas ce que nous voulons de nos biens? Tu es certes l'indulgent, le raisonnable.»
versets.anglais: They said, "O Shu'ayb, does your prayer command you that we should leave what our fathers worship or not do with our wealth what we please? Indeed, you are the forbearing, the discerning

versets.arabe: قَالَ يَا قَوْمِ أَرَأَيْتُمْ إِن كُنتُ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّي وَرَزَقَنِي مِنْهُ رِزْقًا حَسَنًا ۚ وَمَا أُرِيدُ أَنْ أُخَالِفَكُمْ إِلَىٰ مَا أَنْهَاكُمْ عَنْهُ ۚ إِنْ أُرِيدُ إِلَّا الْإِصْلَاحَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ
versets.phonetique: Qāla yā qawmi ara'aytum in kuntu 'alā bayyinatin min rabbī warazaqanī minhu rizqan ḥasanan wamā urīdu an ukhālifakum ilā mā anhākum 'anhu in urīdu illā l-iṣlāḥa mā staṭa'tu
versets.francais: Il dit: «Ô mon peuple! Que pensez-vous? Si je me fonde sur une preuve de mon Seigneur et qu'Il m'a accordé une bonne subsistance... Je ne veux pas vous contredire en faisant ce que je vous interdis. Je ne veux que la réforme dans la mesure du possible.»
versets.anglais: He said, "O my people, have you considered: if I am upon clear evidence from my Lord and He has provided me with a good provision from Him...? And I do not intend to differ from you in that which I have forbidden you; I only intend reform as much as I am able. And my success is not but through Allah. Upon him I have relied, and to Him I return

versets.arabe: وَيَا قَوْمِ لَا يَجْرِمَنَّكُمْ شِقَاقِي أَن يُصِيبَكُم مِّثْلُ مَا أَصَابَ قَوْمَ نُوحٍ أَوْ قَوْمَ هُودٍ أَوْ قَوْمَ صَالِحٍ ۚ وَمَا قَوْمُ لُوطٍ مِّنكُم بِبَعِيدٍ
versets.phonetique: Wayā qawmi lā yajrimannakum shiqāqī an yuṣībakum mithlu mā aṣāba qawma nūḥin aw qawma hūdin aw qawma ṣāliḥin wamā qawmu lūṭin minkum biba'īd
versets.francais: «Ô mon peuple! Que ma contradiction ne vous expose pas à ce qui a touché le peuple de Noé, ou le peuple de Hûd, ou le peuple de Ṣâliḥ. Et le peuple de Loth ne vous est pas loin.»
versets.anglais: And O my people, let not [your] dissension from me cause you to be struck by that similar to what struck the people of Noah or the people of Hud or the people of Salih. And the people of Lot are not from you far away

versets.arabe: وَاسْتَغْفِرُوا رَبَّكُمْ ثُمَّ تُوبُوا إِلَيْهِ ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّي رَحِيمٌ وَدُودٌ
versets.phonetique: Wastaghfirū rabbakum thumma tūbū ilayhi inna rabbī raḥīmun wadūd
versets.francais: «Et demandez pardon à votre Seigneur, puis revenez à Lui. Mon Seigneur est Miséricordieux et Affectueux.»
versets.anglais: And ask forgiveness of your Lord and then repent to Him. Indeed, my Lord is Merciful and Affectionate

versets.arabe: قَالُوا يَا شُعَيْبُ مَا نَفْقَهُ كَثِيرًا مِّمَّا تَقُولُ وَإِنَّا لَنَرَاكَ فِينَا ضَعِيفًا ۖ وَلَوْلَا رَهْطُكَ لَرَجَمْنَاكَ ۖ وَمَا أَنتَ عَلَيْنَا بِعَزِيزٍ
versets.phonetique: Qālū yā shu'aybu mā nafqahu kathīran mimmā taqūlu wa'innā lanarāka fīnā ḍa'īfan walawlā rahṭuka larajamnāka wamā anta 'alaynā bi'azīz
versets.francais: Ils dirent: «Ô Chuayb! Nous ne comprenons pas grand chose à ce que tu dis, et nous te trouvons parmi nous bien faible. Si ce n'était ton clan, nous t'aurions lapidé. Tu n'as aucune influence sur nous.»
versets.anglais: They said, "O Shu'ayb, we do not understand much of what you say, and indeed, we consider you among us as weak. And if not for your family, we would have stoned you [to death]; and you are not to us one respected

versets.arabe: قَالَ يَا قَوْمِ أَرَهْطِي أَعَزُّ عَلَيْكُم مِّنَ اللَّهِ وَاتَّخَذْتُمُوهُ وَرَاءَكُمْ ظِهْرِيًّا ۖ إِنَّ رَبِّي بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ مُحِيطٌ
versets.phonetique: Qāla yā qawmi a-rahṭī a'azzu 'alaykum mina llāhi wattakhadhtumūhu warā'akum ẓihriyyan inna rabbī bimā ta'malūna muḥīṭ
versets.francais: Il dit: «Ô mon peuple! Mon clan est-il plus puissant chez vous qu'Allah? Et vous L'avez mis derrière vous, oublié! Mon Seigneur certes cerne ce que vous faites.»
versets.anglais: He said, "O my people, is my family more respected for power by you than Allah? But you put Him behind your backs [in neglect]. Indeed, my Lord is encompassing of what you do

versets.arabe: وَيَا قَوْمِ اعْمَلُوا عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِكُمْ إِنِّي عَامِلٌ ۖ سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ مَن يَأْتِيهِ عَذَابٌ يُخْزِيهِ وَمَنْ هُوَ كَاذِبٌ ۖ وَارْتَقِبُوا إِنِّي مَعَكُمْ رَقِيبٌ
versets.phonetique: Wayā qawmi 'malū 'alā makānatikum innī 'āmilun sawfa ta'lamūna man ya'tīhi 'adhābun yukhzīhi waman huwa kādhibun wartaqibū innī ma'akum raqīb
versets.francais: «Ô mon peuple! Agissez selon votre état; moi, j'agirai. Vous saurez bientôt sur qui viendra un châtiment le couvrant d'ignominie et qui est le menteur. Attendez! Je suis avec vous parmi ceux qui attendent.»
versets.anglais: And O my people, work according to your position; indeed, I am working. You are going to know to whom will come a punishment that will disgrace him and who is a liar. So watch; indeed, I am with you a watcher, [awaiting the outcome]

versets.arabe: وَلَمَّا جَاءَ أَمْرُنَا نَجَّيْنَا شُعَيْبًا وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا مَعَهُ بِرَحْمَةٍ مِّنَّا وَأَخَذَتِ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا الصَّيْحَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا فِي دِيَارِهِمْ جَاثِمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Walammā jā'a amrunā najjaynā shu'ayban walladhīna āmanū ma'ahu biraḥmatin minnā wa'akhadhati lladhīna ẓalamū ṣ-ṣayḥatu fa'aṣbaḥū fī diyārihim jāthimīn
versets.francais: Quand Notre ordre vint, Nous sauvâmes Chuayb et ceux qui avaient cru avec lui par une miséricorde de Notre part. Et le Cri saisit les injustes et ils s'écroulèrent dans leurs demeures,
versets.anglais: And when Our command came, We saved Shu'ayb and those who believed with him, by mercy from Us. And the shriek seized those who had wronged, and they became within their homes [corpses] fallen prone

versets.arabe: كَأَن لَّمْ يَغْنَوْا فِيهَا ۗ أَلَا بُعْدًا لِّمَدْيَنَ كَمَا بَعِدَتْ ثَمُودُ
versets.phonetique: Ka'an lam yaghnaw fīhā alā bu'dan limadyana kamā ba'idat thamūd
versets.francais: comme s'ils n'y avaient jamais prospéré. Loin [de la miséricorde divine] Madyan, comme furent éloignés les Thamoud!
versets.anglais: As if they had never prospered therein. Then, away with Madyan as Thamud was taken away

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ بِآيَاتِنَا وَسُلْطَانٍ مُّبِينٍ
versets.phonetique: Walaqad arsalnā mūsā bi'āyātinā wasulṭānin mubīn
versets.francais: Et certes, Nous avons envoyé Moïse avec Nos signes et une autorité évidente
versets.anglais: And We did certainly send Moses with Our signs and a clear authority

versets.arabe: إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَئِهِ فَاتَّبَعُوا أَمْرَ فِرْعَوْنَ ۖ وَمَا أَمْرُ فِرْعَوْنَ بِرَشِيدٍ
versets.phonetique: Ilā fir'awna wamala'ihi fattaba'ū amra fir'awna wamā amru fir'awna birashīd
versets.francais: vers Pharaon et ses notables. Et ils suivirent l'ordre de Pharaon. Mais l'ordre de Pharaon n'était pas raisonnable.
versets.anglais: To Pharaoh and his establishment, but they followed the command of Pharaoh, and the command of Pharaoh was not [at all] discerning

versets.arabe: يَقْدُمُ قَوْمَهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فَأَوْرَدَهُمُ النَّارَ ۖ وَبِئْسَ الْوِرْدُ الْمَوْرُودُ
versets.phonetique: Yaqdumu qawmahu yawma l-qiyāmati fa'awradahumu n-nāra wabi'sa l-wirdu l-mawrūd
versets.francais: Il précédera son peuple au Jour de la Résurrection et les mènera au Feu. Et quelle mauvaise direction que d'être conduit là!
versets.anglais: He will precede his people on the Day of Resurrection and lead them into the Fire; and wretched is the place to which they are led

versets.arabe: وَأُتْبِعُوا فِي هَٰذِهِ لَعْنَةً وَيَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ۚ بِئْسَ الرِّفْدُ الْمَرْفُودُ
versets.phonetique: Wa'utbi'ū fī hādhihi la'natan wayawma l-qiyāmati bi'sa r-rifdu l-marfūd
versets.francais: Et ils furent poursuivis dans cette vie par une malédiction, ainsi qu'au Jour de la Résurrection. Quelle mauvaise assistance!
versets.anglais: And they were followed in this [world] with a curse and on the Day of Resurrection. And wretched is the gift which is given

versets.arabe: ذَٰلِكَ مِنْ أَنبَاءِ الْقُرَىٰ نَقُصُّهُ عَلَيْكَ ۖ مِنْهَا قَائِمٌ وَحَصِيدٌ
versets.phonetique: Dhālika min anbā'i l-qurā naquṣṣuhu 'alayk minhā qā'imun waḥaṣīd
versets.francais: Voilà des nouvelles des cités que Nous te narrons. Il en est parmi elles encore debout, et il en est des fauchées.
versets.anglais: That is from the news of the cities, which We relate to you; of them, some are [still] standing and some are [as] a harvest [mowed down]

versets.arabe: وَمَا ظَلَمْنَاهُمْ وَلَٰكِن ظَلَمُوا أَنفُسَهُمْ ۖ فَمَا أَغْنَتْ عَنْهُمْ آلِهَتُهُمُ الَّتِي يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ مِن شَيْءٍ لَّمَّا جَاءَ أَمْرُ رَبِّكَ
versets.phonetique: Wamā ẓalamnāhum walākin ẓalamū anfusahum famā aghnat 'anhum ālihatuhumu llatī yad'ūna min dūni llāhi min shay'in lammā jā'a amru rabbik
versets.francais: Nous ne leur avons pas fait de tort, mais ce sont eux qui se sont fait tort à eux-mêmes. Leurs divinités qu'ils invoquaient en dehors d'Allah ne leur ont servi à rien quand l'ordre de ton Seigneur est venu.
versets.anglais: And We did not wrong them, but they wronged themselves. And they were not availed at all by their gods which they invoked other than Allah when there came the command of your Lord. And they did not increase them in other than ruin

versets.arabe: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَخْذُ رَبِّكَ إِذَا أَخَذَ الْقُرَىٰ وَهِيَ ظَالِمَةٌ ۚ إِنَّ أَخْذَهُ أَلِيمٌ شَدِيدٌ
versets.phonetique: Wakadhalika akhdhu rabbika idhā akhadha l-qurā wahiya ẓālimatun inna akhdhahu alīmun shadīd
versets.francais: Telle est la prise de ton Seigneur, quand Il saisit les cités qui sont injustes. Sa prise est certes douloureuse et sévère.
versets.anglais: And thus is the seizure of your Lord when He seizes the cities while they are committing wrong. Indeed, His seizure is painful and severe

versets.arabe: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً لِّمَنْ خَافَ عَذَابَ الْآخِرَةِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمٌ مَّجْمُوعٌ لَّهُ النَّاسُ وَذَٰلِكَ يَوْمٌ مَّشْهُودٌ
versets.phonetique: Inna fī dhālika la'āyatan liman khāfa 'adhāba l-ākhirati dhālika yawmun majmū'un lahū n-nāsu wadhālika yawmun mashhūd
versets.francais: Il y a là certes un signe pour celui qui craint le châtiment de l'au-delà. C'est un jour pour lequel les gens seront tous rassemblés. Et c'est un jour dont on sera témoin.
versets.anglais: Indeed in that is a sign for those who fear the punishment of the Hereafter. That is a Day for which the people will be collected, and that is a Day [which will be] witnessed

versets.arabe: وَمَا نُؤَخِّرُهُ إِلَّا لِأَجَلٍ مَّعْدُودٍ
versets.phonetique: Wamā nu'akhkhiruhu illā li'ajalin ma'dūd
versets.francais: Et Nous ne le différons que pour un terme compté.
versets.anglais: And We do not delay it except for a limited term

versets.arabe: يَوْمَ يَأْتِ لَا تَكَلَّمُ نَفْسٌ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ ۚ فَمِنْهُمْ شَقِيٌّ وَسَعِيدٌ
versets.phonetique: Yawma ya'ti lā takallamu nafsun illā bi'idhnihi famin-hum shaqiyyun wasa'īd
versets.francais: Le jour où il arrivera, personne ne parlera sauf avec Sa permission. Parmi eux, il y en aura de malheureux et d'heureux.
versets.anglais: The Day it comes no soul will speak except by His permission. And among them will be the wretched and the prosperous

versets.arabe: فَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ شَقُوا فَفِي النَّارِ لَهُمْ فِيهَا زَفِيرٌ وَشَهِيقٌ
versets.phonetique: Fa'ammā lladhīna shaqū fafī n-nāri lahum fīhā zafīrun washahīq
versets.francais: Quant aux malheureux, ils seront dans le Feu; là, ils pousseront des soupirs et des râles,
versets.anglais: As for those who were [destined to be] wretched, they will be in the Fire. For them therein is [violent] exhaling and inhaling

versets.arabe: خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا مَا دَامَتِ السَّمَاوَاتُ وَالْأَرْضُ إِلَّا مَا شَاءَ رَبُّكَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ فَعَّالٌ لِّمَا يُرِيدُ
versets.phonetique: Khālidīna fīhā mā dāmati s-samāwātu wal-arḍu illā mā shā'a rabbuka inna rabbaka fa''ālun limā yurīd
versets.francais: y demeurant éternellement aussi longtemps que dureront les cieux et la terre, sauf ce que ton Seigneur voudra. Certes ton Seigneur accomplit ce qu'Il veut.
versets.anglais: [They will be] abiding therein as long as the heavens and the earth endure, except what your Lord should will. Indeed, your Lord is an effecter of what He intends

versets.arabe: وَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ سُعِدُوا فَفِي الْجَنَّةِ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا مَا دَامَتِ السَّمَاوَاتُ وَالْأَرْضُ إِلَّا مَا شَاءَ رَبُّكَ ۖ عَطَاءً غَيْرَ مَجْذُوذٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa'ammā lladhīna su'idū fafī l-jannati khālidīna fīhā mā dāmati s-samāwātu wal-arḍu illā mā shā'a rabbuka 'aṭā'an ghayra majdhūdh
versets.francais: Et quant aux heureux, ils seront dans le Paradis, y demeurant éternellement aussi longtemps que dureront les cieux et la terre, sauf ce que ton Seigneur voudra, une attribution sans fin.
versets.anglais: And as for those who were [destined to be] prosperous, they will be in Paradise, abiding therein as long as the heavens and the earth endure, except what your Lord should will - a bestowal uninterrupted

versets.arabe: فَلَا تَكُ فِي مِرْيَةٍ مِّمَّا يَعْبُدُ هَٰؤُلَاءِ ۚ مَا يَعْبُدُونَ إِلَّا كَمَا يَعْبُدُ آبَاؤُهُم مِّن قَبْلُ ۚ وَإِنَّا لَمُوَفُّوهُمْ نَصِيبَهُمْ غَيْرَ مَنقُوصٍ
versets.phonetique: Falā taku fī miryatin mimmā ya'budu hā'ulā'i mā ya'budūna illā kamā ya'budu ābā'uhum min qablu wa'innā lamuwafffūhum naṣībahum ghayra manqūṣ
versets.francais: Ne sois donc pas en doute à l'égard de ce qu'adorent ces gens. Ils n'adorent que comme adoraient leurs ancêtres avant eux. Et Nous leur payerons certes leur dû intégralement.
versets.anglais: So do not be in doubt, [O Muhammad], as to what these [polytheists] are worshipping. They worship not except as their fathers worshipped before. And indeed, We will give them their share undiminished

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا مُوسَى الْكِتَابَ فَاخْتُلِفَ فِيهِ ۚ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِن رَّبِّكَ لَقُضِيَ بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَفِي شَكٍّ مِّنْهُ مُرِيبٍ
versets.phonetique: Walaqad ātaynā mūsā l-kitāba fakhtulifu fīhi walawlā kalimatun sabaqat min rabbika laquḍiya baynahum wa'innahum lafī shakkin minhu murīb
versets.francais: Et certes, Nous avons donné le Livre à Moïse et on a différé là-dessus. Et si la parole n'avait pas précédé de la part de ton Seigneur, il aurait été tranché entre eux. Ils sont certes dans un doute troublant à son sujet.
versets.anglais: And We had certainly given Moses the Scripture, but it came under disagreement. And if not for a word that preceded from your Lord, it would have been judged between them. And indeed they are, concerning the Qur'an, in disquieting doubt

versets.arabe: وَإِنَّ كُلًّا لَّمَّا لَيُوَفِّيَنَّهُمْ رَبُّكَ أَعْمَالَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa'inna kullan lammā layuwaffiyyannahum rabbuka a'mālahum innahu bimā ya'malūna khabīr
versets.francais: Et certes, ton Seigneur leur rétribuera leurs œuvres à tous. Il est Parfaitement Connaisseur de ce qu'ils font.
versets.anglais: And indeed, each [of the believers and disbelievers] - your Lord will fully compensate them for their deeds. Indeed, He is Acquainted with what they do

versets.arabe: فَاسْتَقِمْ كَمَا أُمِرْتَ وَمَن تَابَ مَعَكَ وَلَا تَطْغَوْا ۚ إِنَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
versets.phonetique: Fastaqim kamā umirta waman tāba ma'aka walā taṭghaw innahu bimā ta'malūna baṣīr
versets.francais: Tiens-toi donc droit, comme il t'a été commandé, toi et quiconque est revenu [à Allah] avec toi, et ne transgressez pas. Il voit bien ce que vous faites.
versets.anglais: So remain on a right course as you have been commanded, [you] and those who have turned back with you [to Allah], and do not transgress. Indeed, He is Seeing of what you do

versets.arabe: وَلَا تَرْكَنُوا إِلَى الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا فَتَمَسَّكُمُ النَّارُ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِ اللَّهِ مِنْ أَوْلِيَاءَ ثُمَّ لَا تُنصَرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Walā tarkanū ilā lladhīna ẓalamū fatamassukumu n-nāru wamā lakum min dūni llāhi min awliyā'a thumma lā tunṣarūn
versets.francais: Et ne vous inclinez pas vers les injustes, sinon le Feu vous toucherait. Et vous n'auriez pas d'autres alliés qu'Allah, et vous ne seriez pas secourus.
versets.anglais: And do not incline toward those who do wrong, lest you be touched by the Fire, and you would not have other than Allah any protectors; then you would not be helped

versets.arabe: وَأَقِمِ الصَّلَاةَ طَرَفَيِ النَّهَارِ وَزُلَفًا مِّنَ اللَّيْلِ ۚ إِنَّ الْحَسَنَاتِ يُذْهِبْنَ السَّيِّئَاتِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ذِكْرَىٰ لِلذَّاكِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa'aqimi ṣ-ṣalāta ṭarafayi n-nahāri wazulafan mina l-layli inna l-ḥasanāti yudhhibna s-sayyi'āti dhālika dhikrā lidhdhākirīn
versets.francais: Et accomplis la Salât aux deux extrémités du jour et à certaines heures de la nuit. Les bonnes œuvres effacent les mauvaises. C'est là un rappel pour ceux qui réfléchissent.
versets.anglais: And establish prayer at the two ends of the day and at the approach of the night. Indeed, good deeds do away with misdeeds. That is a reminder for those who remember

versets.arabe: وَاصْبِرْ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُضِيعُ أَجْرَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Waṣbir fa'inna llāha lā yuḍī'u ajra l-muḥsinīn
versets.francais: Et sois patient car Allah ne laisse pas perdre la récompense des bienfaisants.
versets.anglais: And be patient, for indeed, Allah does not allow to be lost the reward of those who do good

versets.arabe: فَلَوْلَا كَانَ مِنَ الْقُرُونِ مِن قَبْلِكُمْ أُولُو بَقِيَّةٍ يَنْهَوْنَ عَنِ الْفَسَادِ فِي الْأَرْضِ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا مِّمَّنْ أَنجَيْنَا مِنْهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Falawlā kāna mina l-qurūni min qablikum ulū baqiyyatin yanhawna 'ani l-fasādi fī l-arḍi illā qalīlan mimman anjaynā minhum
versets.francais: Que n'y avait-il donc pas dans les générations avant vous, des hommes sensés qui s'interdisaient de semer la corruption sur la terre? Sauf un petit nombre de ceux que Nous avons sauvés.
versets.anglais: So why were there not among the generations before you those of enduring discrimination forbidding corruption on earth - except a few of those We saved from among them? But those who wronged pursued what luxury they were given therein, and they were criminals

versets.arabe: وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ لِيُهْلِكَ الْقُرَىٰ بِظُلْمٍ وَأَهْلُهَا مُصْلِحُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wamā kāna rabbuka liyuhlikā l-qurā biẓulmin wa'ahluhā muṣliḥūn
versets.francais: Ton Seigneur n'est pas tel qu'il détruise injustement des cités dont les habitants seraient réformateurs.
versets.anglais: And your Lord would not have destroyed the cities unjustly while their people were reformers

versets.arabe: وَلَوْ شَاءَ رَبُّكَ لَجَعَلَ النَّاسَ أُمَّةً وَاحِدَةً ۖ وَلَا يَزَالُونَ مُخْتَلِفِينَ
versets.phonetique: Walaw shā'a rabbuka laja'ala n-nāsa ummatan wāḥidatan walā yazālūna mukhtalifīn
versets.francais: Et si ton Seigneur l'avait voulu, Il aurait fait des gens une seule communauté. Mais ils ne cessent pas de différer,
versets.anglais: And if your Lord had willed, He could have made mankind one community; but they will not cease to differ

versets.arabe: إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ رَبُّكَ ۚ وَلِذَٰلِكَ خَلَقَهُمْ ۗ وَتَمَّتْ كَلِمَةُ رَبِّكَ لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ
versets.phonetique: Illā man raḥima rabbuka walildhālika khalaqahum watammat kalimatu rabbika la'amla'anna jahannama mina l-jinnati wan-nāsi ajma'īn
versets.francais: sauf ceux à qui ton Seigneur fait miséricorde. Et c'est pour cela qu'Il les a créés. Et la parole de ton Seigneur s'est accomplie: «Je remplirai certes l'Enfer de djinns et d'humains, tous ensemble.»
versets.anglais: Except whom your Lord has given mercy, and for that He created them. But the word of your Lord is to be fulfilled that, "I will surely fill Hell with jinn and men all together

versets.arabe: وَكُلًّا نَّقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ أَنبَاءِ الرُّسُلِ مَا نُثَبِّتُ بِهِ فُؤَادَكَ ۚ وَجَاءَكَ فِي هَٰذِهِ الْحَقُّ وَمَوْعِظَةٌ وَذِكْرَىٰ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wakullan naquṣṣu 'alayka min anbā'i r-rusuli mā nuthabbitu bihi fu'ādaka wajā'aka fī hādhihi l-ḥaqqu wamaw'iẓatun wadhikrā lil-mu'minīn
versets.francais: Et tout ce que Nous te narrons des nouvelles des messagers est ce par quoi Nous fortifions ton cœur. Il t'est venu en ceci la vérité, une exhortation et un rappel pour les croyants.
versets.anglais: And each [story] We relate to you from the news of the messengers is that by which We make firm your heart. And there has come to you, in this, the truth and an instruction and a reminder for the believers

versets.arabe: وَقُل لِّلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ اعْمَلُوا عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِكُمْ إِنَّا عَامِلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Waqul lilladhīna lā yu'minūna 'malū 'alā makānatikum innā 'āmilūn
versets.francais: Et dis à ceux qui ne croient pas: «Agissez selon votre état; nous, nous agirons.»
versets.anglais: And say to those who do not believe, "Work according to your position; indeed, we are working

versets.arabe: وَانتَظِرُوا إِنَّا مُنتَظِرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wantaẓirū innā muntaẓirūn
versets.francais: «Et attendez; nous aussi, nous attendons.»
versets.anglais: And wait, indeed, we are waiting

versets.arabe: وَلِلَّهِ غَيْبُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ يُرْجَعُ الْأَمْرُ كُلُّهُ فَاعْبُدْهُ وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَيْهِ ۚ وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِغَافِلٍ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Walillāhi ghaybu s-samāwāti wal-arḍi wa'ilayhi yurja'u l-amru kulluhu fa'budhu watawakkal 'alayhi wamā rabbuka bighāfilin 'ammā ta'malūn
versets.francais: A Allah appartient l'invisible des cieux et de la terre. Vers Lui est ramené tout ordre. Adore-Le et mets ta confiance en Lui. Ton Seigneur n'est pas inattentif à ce que vous faites.
versets.anglais: And to Allah belong the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth and to Him will be returned the matter, all of it, so worship Him and rely upon Him. And your Lord is not unaware of that which you do

versets.arabe: الر تِلْكَ آيَاتُ الْكِتَابِ الْمُبِينِ
versets.phonetique: Alif-Lâm-Râ. Tilka âyâtul-kitâbil-mubîn
versets.francais: Alif, Lam, Ra. Ce sont les versets du Livre explicite.
versets.anglais: Alif, Lam, Ra. These are the verses of the clear Book

versets.arabe: إِنَّا أَنزَلْنَاهُ قُرْآنًا عَرَبِيًّا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Innâ anzalnâhu qur'ânan 'arabiyyan la'allakum ta'qilûn
versets.francais: Nous l'avons révélé en Coran arabe afin que vous raisonniez.
versets.anglais: Indeed, We have sent it down as an Arabic Qur'an that you might understand

versets.arabe: نَحْنُ نَقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ أَحْسَنَ الْقَصَصِ
versets.phonetique: Nahnu naqussu 'alayka ahsanal-qasas
versets.francais: Nous te racontons le plus beau des récits.
versets.anglais: We relate to you, [O Muhammad], the best of stories in what We have revealed to you of this Qur'an although you were, before it, among the unaware

versets.arabe: إِذْ قَالَ يُوسُفُ لِأَبِيهِ يَا أَبَتِ إِنِّي رَأَيْتُ أَحَدَ عَشَرَ كَوْكَبًا
versets.phonetique: Ith qâla yûsufu li'abîhi yâ abati innî ra'aytu ahada 'ashara kawkabâ
versets.francais: Quand Joseph dit à son père: Ô mon père, j'ai vu onze étoiles.
versets.anglais: [Of these stories mention] when Joseph said to his father, "O my father, indeed I have seen [in a dream] eleven stars and the sun and the moon; I saw them prostrating to me

versets.arabe: قَالَ يَا بُنَيَّ لَا تَقْصُصْ رُؤْيَاكَ عَلَىٰ إِخْوَتِكَ
versets.phonetique: Qâla yâ bunayya lâ taqsus ru'yâka 'alâ ikhwatik
versets.francais: Il dit: Ô mon fils, ne raconte pas ta vision à tes frères.
versets.anglais: He said, "O my son, do not relate your vision to your brothers or they will contrive against you a plan. Indeed Satan, to man, is a manifest enemy

versets.arabe: وَكَذَٰلِكَ يَجْتَبِيكَ رَبُّكَ وَيُعَلِّمُكَ مِن تَأْوِيلِ الْأَحَادِيثِ
versets.phonetique: Wa kathâlika yajtabîka rabbuka wa yu'allimuka min ta'wîlil-ahâdîth
versets.francais: C'est ainsi que ton Seigneur t'élira et t'apprendra l'interprétation des songes.
versets.anglais: And thus will your Lord choose you and teach you the interpretation of narratives and complete His favor upon you and upon the family of Jacob, as He completed it upon your fathers before, Abraham and Isaac. Indeed, your Lord is Knowing and Wise

versets.arabe: لَّقَدْ كَانَ فِي يُوسُفَ وَإِخْوَتِهِ آيَاتٌ لِّلسَّائِلِينَ
versets.phonetique: Laqad kâna fî yûsufa wa ikhwatihî âyâtun lis-sâ'ilîn
versets.francais: En Joseph et ses frères, il y avait des signes pour ceux qui demandent.
versets.anglais: Certainly were there in Joseph and his brothers signs for those who ask

versets.arabe: إِذْ قَالُوا لَيُوسُفُ وَأَخُوهُ أَحَبُّ إِلَىٰ أَبِينَا مِنَّا
versets.phonetique: Ith qâlû layûsufu wa akhûhu ahabbu ilâ abînâ minnâ
versets.francais: Quand ils dirent: Joseph et son frère sont plus aimés de notre père que nous.
versets.anglais: When they said, "Joseph and his brother are more beloved to our father than we, while we are a clan. Indeed, our father is in clear error

versets.arabe: اقْتُلُوا يُوسُفَ أَوِ اطْرَحُوهُ أَرْضًا يَخْلُ لَكُمْ وَجْهُ أَبِيكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Uqtulû yûsufa awi't-rahûhu ardhan yakhlû lakum wajhu abîkum
versets.francais: Tuez Joseph ou expulsez-le dans un pays, le visage de votre père vous sera alors libre.
versets.anglais: Kill Joseph or cast him out to [another] land; the countenance of your father will [then] be only for you, and you will be after that a righteous people

versets.arabe: قَالَ قَائِلٌ مِّنْهُمْ لَا تَقْتُلُوا يُوسُفَ وَأَلْقُوهُ فِي غَيَابَتِ الْجُبِّ
versets.phonetique: Qâla qâ'ilum minhum lâ taqtulû yûsufa wa alqûhu fî ghayâbatil-jubb
versets.francais: L'un d'eux dit: ne tuez pas Joseph, mais jetez-le au fond du puits.
versets.anglais: Said a speaker among them, "Do not kill Joseph but throw him into the bottom of the well; some travelers will pick him up - if you would do [something]

versets.arabe: قَالُوا يَا أَبَانَا مَا لَكَ لَا تَأْمَنَّا عَلَىٰ يُوسُفَ
versets.phonetique: Qâlû yâ abânâ mâ laka lâ ta'mannâ 'alâ yûsuf
versets.francais: Ils dirent: Ô notre père, pourquoi ne nous fais-tu pas confiance au sujet de Joseph?
versets.anglais: They said, "O our father, why do you not entrust us with Joseph while indeed, we are to him sincere counselors

versets.arabe: أَرْسِلْهُ مَعَنَا غَدًا يَرْتَعْ وَيَلْعَبْ وَإِنَّا لَهُ لَحَافِظُونَ
versets.phonetique: Arsilhu ma'anâ ghadan yarta'a wa yal'ab wa innâ lahû lahâfidhûn
versets.francais: Envoie-le demain avec nous pour qu'il se divertisse et joue, et nous le garderons bien.
versets.anglais: Send him with us tomorrow that he may eat well and play. And indeed, we will be his guardians

versets.arabe: قَالَ إِنِّي لَيَحْزُنُنِي أَن تَذْهَبُوا بِهِ
versets.phonetique: Qâla innî layahzununî an tathabû bih
versets.francais: Il dit: cela m'attriste vraiment que vous l'emmeniez.
versets.anglais: [Jacob] said, "Indeed, it saddens me that you should take him, and I fear that a wolf would eat him while you are of him unaware

versets.arabe: قَالُوا لَئِنْ أَكَلَهُ الذِّئْبُ وَنَحْنُ عُصْبَةٌ إِنَّا إِذًا لَّخَاسِرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qâlû la'in akalahuth-thi'bu wa nahnu 'usbatun innâ ithân lakhâsirûn
versets.francais: Ils dirent: si le loup le dévore pendant que nous sommes un groupe, nous serions alors perdants.
versets.anglais: They said, "If a wolf should eat him while we are a [strong] clan, indeed, we would then be losers

versets.arabe: فَلَمَّا ذَهَبُوا بِهِ وَأَجْمَعُوا أَن يَجْعَلُوهُ فِي غَيَابَتِ الْجُبِّ
versets.phonetique: Falammâ thahabû bihî wa ajma'û an yaj'alûhu fî ghayâbatil-jubb
versets.francais: Quand ils l'emmenèrent et décidèrent de le jeter au fond du puits.
versets.anglais: So when they took him [out] and agreed to put him into the bottom of the well... But We inspired to him, "You will surely inform them [someday] about this affair of theirs while they do not perceive [your identity]

versets.arabe: وَجَاءُوا أَبَاهُمْ عِشَاءً يَبْكُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa jâ'û abâhum 'ishâ'an yabkûn
versets.francais: Le soir ils vinrent en pleurant auprès de leur père.
versets.anglais: And they came to their father at night, weeping

versets.arabe: قَالُوا يَا أَبَانَا إِنَّا ذَهَبْنَا نَسْتَبِقُ وَتَرَكْنَا يُوسُفَ عِندَ مَتَاعِنَا
versets.phonetique: Qâlû yâ abânâ innâ thahabnâ nastabiru wa taraknâ yûsufa 'inda matâ'inâ
versets.francais: Ils dirent: Ô notre père, nous sommes partis faire la course et avons laissé Joseph près de nos affaires.
versets.anglais: They said, "O our father, indeed we went racing each other and left Joseph with our possessions, and a wolf ate him. But you would not believe us, even if we were truthful

versets.arabe: وَجَاءُوا عَلَىٰ قَمِيصِهِ بِدَمٍ كَذِبٍ قَالَ بَلْ سَوَّلَتْ لَكُمْ أَنفُسُكُمْ أَمْرًا
versets.phonetique: Wa jâ'û 'alâ qamîsihî bidamin kathibin, qâla bal sawwalat lakum anfusukum amrâ
versets.francais: Et ils apportèrent sa chemise avec un faux sang. Il dit: non, vos âmes vous ont suggéré quelque chose.
versets.anglais: And they brought upon his shirt false blood. [Jacob] said, "Rather, your souls have enticed you to something, so patience is most fitting. And Allah is the one sought for help against that which you describe

versets.arabe: وَجَاءَتْ سَيَّارَةٌ فَأَرْسَلُوا وَارِدَهُمْ فَأَدْلَىٰ دَلْوَهُ
versets.phonetique: Wa jâ'at sayyâratun fa'arsalû wâridahum fa'adlâ dalwahu
versets.francais: Une caravane arriva. Ils envoyèrent leur puisatier qui laissa descendre son seau.
versets.anglais: And there came a company of travelers; then they sent their water drawer, and he let down his bucket. He said, "Good news! Here is a boy." And they concealed him, [taking him] as merchandise; and Allah was knowing of what they did

versets.arabe: وَشَرَوْهُ بِثَمَنٍ بَخْسٍ دَرَاهِمَ مَعْدُودَةٍ وَكَانُوا فِيهِ مِنَ الزَّاهِدِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa sharawhu bithamanin bakhsin darâhima ma'dûdatin wa kânû fîhi minadh-dhâhidîn
versets.francais: Et ils le vendirent à bas prix, pour quelques dirhams comptés. Ils le méprisaient.
versets.anglais: And they sold him for a reduced price - a few dirhams - and they were, concerning him, of those content with little

versets.arabe: وَقَالَ الَّذِي اشْتَرَاهُ مِن مِّصْرَ لِامْرَأَتِهِ أَكْرِمِي مَثْوَاهُ
versets.phonetique: Wa qâlal-lathîshtarâhu min misra limra'atihi akrimî mathwâh
versets.francais: Celui qui l'acheta en Égypte dit à sa femme: traite-le honorablement.
versets.anglais: And the one from Egypt who bought him said to his wife, "Make his residence comfortable. Perhaps he will benefit us, or we will adopt him as a son." And thus, We established Joseph in the land that We might teach him the interpretation of events. And Allah is predominant over His affair, but most of the people do not know

versets.arabe: وَلَمَّا بَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُ آتَيْنَاهُ حُكْمًا وَعِلْمًا
versets.phonetique: Wa lammâ balagha ashuddahu âtaynâhu hukman wa 'ilmâ
versets.francais: Quand il atteignit sa maturité, Nous lui accordâmes sagesse et science.
versets.anglais: And when Joseph reached maturity, We gave him judgment and knowledge. And thus We reward the doers of good

versets.arabe: وَرَاوَدَتْهُ الَّتِي هُوَ فِي بَيْتِهَا عَن نَّفْسِهِ
versets.phonetique: Wa râwadat-hul-latî huwa fî baytihâ 'an nafsih
versets.francais: Celle dans la maison de qui il se trouvait voulut le séduire.
versets.anglais: And she, in whose house he was, sought to seduce him. She closed the doors and said, "Come, you." He said, "[I seek] the refuge of Allah. Indeed, he is my master, who has made good my residence. Indeed, wrongdoers will not succeed

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ هَمَّتْ بِهِ وَهَمَّ بِهَا لَوْلَا أَن رَّأَىٰ بُرْهَانَ رَبِّهِ
versets.phonetique: Wa laqad hammat bihî wa hamma bihâ lawlâ an ra'â burhâna rabbih
versets.francais: Elle désirait sa possession et il l'aurait désirée s'il n'avait pas vu la preuve de son Seigneur.
versets.anglais: And she certainly determined [to seduce] him, and he would have inclined to her had he not seen the proof of his Lord. And thus [it was] that We should avert from him evil and immorality. Indeed, he was of Our chosen servants

versets.arabe: وَاسْتَبَقَا الْبَابَ وَقَدَّتْ قَمِيصَهُ مِن دُبُرٍ
versets.phonetique: Wastabaqâl-bâba wa qaddat qamîsahu min dubur
versets.francais: Ils se précipitèrent vers la porte et elle déchira sa chemise par derrière.
versets.anglais: And they both raced to the door, and she tore his shirt from the back, and they found her husband at the door. She said, "What is the recompense of one who intended evil for your wife but that he be imprisoned or a painful punishment

versets.arabe: قَالَ هِيَ رَاوَدَتْنِي عَن نَّفْسِي
versets.phonetique: Qâla hiya râwadatnî 'an nafsî
versets.francais: Il dit: c'est elle qui a voulu me séduire.
versets.anglais: [Joseph] said, "It was she who sought to seduce me." And a witness from her family testified. "If his shirt is torn from the front, then she has told the truth, and he is of the liars

versets.arabe: وَإِن كَانَ قَمِيصُهُ قُدَّ مِن دُبُرٍ فَكَذَبَتْ وَهُوَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa in kâna qamîsuhu qudda min duburin fakathabat wa huwa minas-sâdiqîn
versets.francais: Si sa chemise est déchirée par derrière, elle a menti et il est véridique.
versets.anglais: But if his shirt is torn from the back, then she has lied, and he is of the truthful

versets.arabe: فَلَمَّا رَأَىٰ قَمِيصَهُ قُدَّ مِن دُبُرٍ قَالَ إِنَّهُ مِن كَيْدِكُنَّ
versets.phonetique: Falammâ ra'â qamîsahu qudda min duburin qâla innahû min kaydikunn
versets.francais: Quand il vit que sa chemise était déchirée par derrière, il dit: c'est là de votre ruse.
versets.anglais: So when her husband saw his shirt torn from the back, he said, "Indeed, it is of the women's plan. Indeed, your plan is great

versets.arabe: يُوسُفُ أَعْرِضْ عَنْ هَٰذَا وَاسْتَغْفِرِي لِذَنبِكِ
versets.phonetique: Yûsufu a'ridh 'an hâthâ wastaghfirî lithambik
versets.francais: Joseph, détourne-toi de cela! Et toi, demande pardon pour ton péché.
versets.anglais: Joseph, ignore this. And, [my wife], ask forgiveness for your sin. Indeed, you were of the sinful

versets.arabe: وَقَالَ نِسْوَةٌ فِي الْمَدِينَةِ امْرَأَتُ الْعَزِيزِ تُرَاوِدُ فَتَاهَا عَن نَّفْسِهِ
versets.phonetique: Wa qâla niswatun fil-madînatim-ra'atul-'azîzi turâwidu fatâhâ 'an nafsih
versets.francais: Des femmes dans la ville dirent: la femme du dignitaire veut séduire son serviteur.
versets.anglais: And women in the city said, "The wife of al-'Azeez is seeking to seduce her slave boy; he has impassioned her with love. Indeed, we see her [to be] in clear error

versets.arabe: فَلَمَّا سَمِعَتْ بِمَكْرِهِنَّ أَرْسَلَتْ إِلَيْهِنَّ
versets.phonetique: Falammâ sami'at bimakrihinna arsalat ilayhinn
versets.francais: Quand elle entendit leur complot, elle les invita.
versets.anglais: So when she heard of their scheming, she sent for them and prepared for them a banquet and gave each one of them a knife and said [to Joseph], "Come out before them."
