And when they saw him, they greatly admired him and cut their hands and said, "Perfect is Allah! This is not a man; this is none but a noble angel

versets.arabe: قَالَتْ فَذَٰلِكُنَّ الَّذِي لُمْتُنَّنِي فِيهِ
versets.phonetique: Qâlat fathâlikunnal-lathî lumtunnanî fîh
versets.francais: Elle dit: voilà celui pour lequel vous m'avez blâmée.
versets.anglais: She said, "That is the one about whom you blamed me. And I certainly sought to seduce him, but he firmly refused; and if he will not do what I order him, he will surely be imprisoned and will be of those debased

versets.arabe: قَالَ رَبِّ السِّجْنُ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِمَّا يَدْعُونَنِي إِلَيْهِ
versets.phonetique: Qâla rabbis-sijnu ahabbu ilayya mimmâ yad'ûnanî ilayh
versets.francais: Il dit: Seigneur, la prison m'est plus chère que ce à quoi elles m'invitent.
versets.anglais: He said, "My Lord, prison is more to my liking than that to which they invite me. And if You do not avert from me their plan, I might incline toward them and [thus] be of the ignorant

versets.arabe: فَاسْتَجَابَ لَهُ رَبُّهُ فَصَرَفَ عَنْهُ كَيْدَهُنَّ
versets.phonetique: Fastajâba lahû rabbuhû fasarafa 'anhu kaydahunna
versets.francais: Son Seigneur l'exauça et détourna de lui leur ruse.
versets.anglais: So his Lord responded to him and averted from him their plan. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing

versets.arabe: ثُمَّ بَدَا لَهُم مِّن بَعْدِ مَا رَأَوُا الْآيَاتِ لَيَسْجُنُنَّهُ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
versets.phonetique: Thumma badâ lahum mim ba'di mâ ra'awul-âyâti layasjununnahû hattâ hîn
versets.francais: Puis il leur parut bon, après avoir vu les preuves, de l'emprisonner pour un temps.
versets.anglais: Then it appeared to them after they had seen the signs that al-'Azeez should surely imprison him for a time

versets.arabe: وَدَخَلَ مَعَهُ السِّجْنَ فَتَيَانِ
versets.phonetique: Wa dakhala ma'ahus-sijna fatayân
versets.francais: Deux jeunes gens entrèrent en prison avec lui.
versets.anglais: And there entered the prison with him two young men. One of them said, "Indeed, I have seen myself [in a dream] pressing wine." The other said, "Indeed, I have seen myself carrying upon my head [some] bread, from which the birds were eating. Inform us of its interpretation; indeed, we see you to be of those who do good

versets.arabe: قَالَ لَا يَأْتِيكُمَا طَعَامٌ تُرْزَقَانِهِ إِلَّا نَبَّأْتُكُمَا بِتَأْوِيلِهِ
versets.phonetique: Qâla lâ ya'tiyakumâ ta'âmun turzaqânihî illâ nabba'tukumâ bita'wîlih
versets.francais: Il dit: avant qu'on vous apporte votre repas, je vous en indiquerai l'interprétation.
versets.anglais: He said, "You will not receive food that is provided to you except that I will inform you of its interpretation before it comes to you. That is from what my Lord has taught me. Indeed, I have left the religion of a people who do not believe in Allah, and they, in the Hereafter, are disbelievers

versets.arabe: وَاتَّبَعْتُ مِلَّةَ آبَائِي إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَإِسْحَاقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ
versets.phonetique: Wattaba'tu millata âbâ'î ibrâhîma wa ishâqa wa ya'qûb
versets.francais: J'ai suivi la religion de mes pères: Abraham, Isaac et Jacob.
versets.anglais: And I have followed the religion of my fathers, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob. And it was not for us to associate anything with Allah. That is from the favor of Allah upon us and upon the people, but most of the people are not grateful

versets.arabe: يَا صَاحِبَيِ السِّجْنِ أَأَرْبَابٌ مُّتَفَرِّقُونَ خَيْرٌ أَمِ اللَّهُ الْوَاحِدُ الْقَهَّارُ
versets.phonetique: Yâ sâhibayis-sijni a'arbâbun mutafarriqûna khayrun amillâhul-wâhidul-qahhâr
versets.francais: Ô mes compagnons de prison, des seigneurs multiples valent-ils mieux qu'Allah, l'Unique, le Dominateur?
versets.anglais: O [my] two companions of prison, are separate lords better or Allah, the One, the Prevailing

versets.arabe: مَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِهِ إِلَّا أَسْمَاءً سَمَّيْتُمُوهَا أَنتُمْ وَآبَاؤُكُم
versets.phonetique: Mâ ta'budûna min dûnihî illâ asmâ'an sammaytumûhâ antum wa âbâ'ukum
versets.francais: Vous n'adorez en dehors de Lui que des noms que vous et vos pères avez inventés.
versets.anglais: You worship not besides Him except [mere] names you have named them, you and your fathers, for which Allah has sent down no authority. Legislation is not but for Allah. He has commanded that you worship not except Him. That is the correct religion, but most of the people do not know

versets.arabe: يَا صَاحِبَيِ السِّجْنِ أَمَّا أَحَدُكُمَا فَيَسْقِي رَبَّهُ خَمْرًا
versets.phonetique: Yâ sâhibayis-sijni ammâ ahadukumâ fayasqî rabbahu khamrâ
versets.francais: Ô mes compagnons de prison, l'un de vous deux servira du vin à son maître.
versets.anglais: O two companions of prison, as for one of you, he will give drink to his master of wine; but as for the other, he will be crucified, and the birds will eat from his head. The matter has been decreed about which you both inquire

versets.arabe: وَقَالَ لِلَّذِي ظَنَّ أَنَّهُ نَاجٍ مِّنْهُمَا اذْكُرْنِي عِندَ رَبِّكَ
versets.phonetique: Wa qâla lillathî dhanna annahu nâjim minhumadhkurnî 'inda rabbik
versets.francais: Il dit à celui qu'il croyait être sauvé: parle de moi à ton maître.
versets.anglais: And he said to the one whom he knew would go free, "Mention me before your master." But Satan made him forget the mention [to] his master, and Joseph remained in prison several years

versets.arabe: وَقَالَ الْمَلِكُ إِنِّي أَرَىٰ سَبْعَ بَقَرَاتٍ سِمَانٍ يَأْكُلُهُنَّ سَبْعٌ عِجَافٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa qâlal-maliku innî arâ sab'a baqarâtin simânin ya'kuluhunna sab'un 'ijâf
versets.francais: Le roi dit: je vois sept vaches grasses dévorées par sept maigres.
versets.anglais: And [subsequently] the king said, "Indeed, I have seen [in a dream] seven fat cows being eaten by seven [that were] lean, and seven green spikes [of grain] and others [that were] dry. O eminent ones, explain to me my vision, if you should interpret visions

versets.arabe: قَالُوا أَضْغَاثُ أَحْلَامٍ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِتَأْوِيلِ الْأَحْلَامِ بِعَالِمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qâlû adghâthu ahlâmin wa mâ nahnu bita'wîlil-ahlâmi bi'âlimîn
versets.francais: Ils dirent: ce sont des rêves confus et nous ne connaissons pas l'interprétation des rêves.
versets.anglais: They said, "[It is but] a mixture of false dreams, and we are not learned in the interpretation of dreams

versets.arabe: وَقَالَ الَّذِي نَجَا مِنْهُمَا وَادَّكَرَ بَعْدَ أُمَّةٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa qâlal-lathî najâ minhumâ waddakara ba'da ummah
versets.francais: Celui qui avait été sauvé des deux dit, se souvenant après un certain temps.
versets.anglais: But the one who was freed and remembered after a time said, "I will inform you of its interpretation, so send me forth

versets.arabe: يُوسُفُ أَيُّهَا الصِّدِّيقُ أَفْتِنَا فِي سَبْعِ بَقَرَاتٍ سِمَانٍ
versets.phonetique: Yûsufu ayyuhas-siddîqu aftinâ fî sab'i baqarâtin simânin
versets.francais: Joseph, Ô véridique, instruis-nous au sujet de sept vaches grasses.
versets.anglais: [He said], "Joseph, O man of truth, explain to us about seven fat cows eaten by seven [that were] lean, and seven green spikes [of grain] and others [that were] dry - that I may return to the people; perhaps they will know [about you]

versets.arabe: قَالَ تَزْرَعُونَ سَبْعَ سِنِينَ دَأَبًا فَمَا حَصَدتُّمْ فَذَرُوهُ فِي سُنبُلِهِ
versets.phonetique: Qâla tazra'ûna sab'a sinîna da'aban famâ hasadtum fatharûhu fî sunbulihi
versets.francais: Il dit: vous cultiverez sept années de suite; laissez ce que vous moissonnez en épi.
versets.anglais: [Joseph] said, "You will plant for seven years consecutively; and what you harvest leave in its spikes, except a little from which you will eat

versets.arabe: ثُمَّ يَأْتِي مِن بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ سَبْعٌ شِدَادٌ يَأْكُلْنَ مَا قَدَّمْتُمْ لَهُنَّ
versets.phonetique: Thumma ya'tî mim ba'di thâlika sab'un shidâdun ya'kulna mâ qaddamtum lahunna
versets.francais: Puis viendront après cela sept années difficiles qui consumeront ce que vous aurez mis en réserve.
versets.anglais: Then will come after that seven difficult [years] which will consume what you saved for them, except a little from which you will store

versets.arabe: ثُمَّ يَأْتِي مِن بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ عَامٌ فِيهِ يُغَاثُ النَّاسُ وَفِيهِ يَعْصِرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Thumma ya'tî mim ba'di thâlika 'âmun fîhi yughâthun-nâsu wa fîhi ya'sirûn
versets.francais: Puis viendra après cela une année où les gens seront secourus et où ils pressureront.
versets.anglais: Then will come after that a year in which the people will be given rain and in which they will press [olives and grapes]

versets.arabe: وَقَالَ الْمَلِكُ ائْتُونِي بِهِ فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُ الرَّسُولُ قَالَ ارْجِعْ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ
versets.phonetique: Wa qâlal-maliku'itûnî bih, falammâ jâ'ahur-rasûlu qâlarji' ilâ rabbik
versets.francais: Le roi dit: amenez-le moi. Quand le messager vint le voir, il dit: retourne vers ton maître.
versets.anglais: And the king said, "Bring him to me." But when the messenger came to him, [Joseph] said, "Return to your master and ask him what is the case of the women who cut their hands. Indeed, my Lord is Knowing of their plan

versets.arabe: قَالَ مَا خَطْبُكُنَّ إِذْ رَاوَدتُّنَّ يُوسُفَ عَن نَّفْسِهِ
versets.phonetique: Qâla mâ khatbukunna ith râwadtunna yûsufa 'an nafsih
versets.francais: Il dit: qu'en était-il quand vous avez voulu séduire Joseph?
versets.anglais: Said [the king to the women], "What was your condition when you sought to seduce Joseph?" They said, "Perfect is Allah! We know about him no evil." The wife of al-'Azeez said, "Now the truth has become evident. It was I who sought to seduce him, and indeed, he is of the truthful

versets.arabe: ذَٰلِكَ لِيَعْلَمَ أَنِّي لَمْ أَخُنْهُ بِالْغَيْبِ
versets.phonetique: Thâlika liya'lama annî lam akhunhu bil-ghayb
versets.francais: C'est pour qu'il sache que je ne l'ai pas trahi en son absence.
versets.anglais: That is so al-'Azeez will know that I did not betray him in [his] absence and that Allah does not guide the plan of betrayers

versets.arabe: وَمَا أُبَرِّئُ نَفْسِي إِنَّ النَّفْسَ لَأَمَّارَةٌ بِالسُّوءِ
versets.phonetique: Wa mâ ubarri'u nafsî innan-nafsa la'ammâratun bis-sû'
versets.francais: Je ne m'absous pas moi-même: l'âme est très portée à faire le mal.
versets.anglais: And I do not acquit myself. Indeed, the soul is a persistent enjoiner of evil, except those upon which my Lord has mercy. Indeed, my Lord is Forgiving and Merciful

versets.arabe: وَقَالَ الْمَلِكُ ائْتُونِي بِهِ أَسْتَخْلِصْهُ لِنَفْسِي
versets.phonetique: Wa qâlal-maliku'itûnî bihi astakhliṣhu linafsî
versets.francais: Le roi dit: amenez-le moi que je me l'attache exclusivement.
versets.anglais: And the king said, "Bring him to me; I will appoint him exclusively for myself." And when he spoke to him, he said, "Indeed, you are today established [in position] and trusted

versets.arabe: قَالَ اجْعَلْنِي عَلَىٰ خَزَائِنِ الْأَرْضِ إِنِّي حَفِيظٌ عَلِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Qâlaj'alnî 'alâ khazâ'inil-ardhi innî hafîdhun 'alîm
versets.francais: Il dit: établis-moi sur les greniers du pays, je suis bon gardien et savant.
versets.anglais: [Joseph] said, "Appoint me over the storehouses of the land. Indeed, I will be a knowing guardian

versets.arabe: وَكَذَٰلِكَ مَكَّنَّا لِيُوسُفَ فِي الْأَرْضِ يَتَبَوَّأُ مِنْهَا حَيْثُ يَشَاءُ
versets.phonetique: Wa kathâlika makkannâ liyûsufa fil-ardhi yatabawwa'u minhâ haythu yashâ'
versets.francais: C'est ainsi que Nous avons établi Joseph dans le pays pour s'y installer où il voulait.
versets.anglais: And thus We established Joseph in the land to settle therein wherever he willed. We touch with Our mercy whom We will, and We do not allow to be lost the reward of those who do good

versets.arabe: وَلَأَجْرُ الْآخِرَةِ خَيْرٌ لِّلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَكَانُوا يَتَّقُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa la'ajrul-âkhirati khayrul-lillathîna âmanû wa kânû yattaqûn
versets.francais: La récompense de l'au-delà est meilleure pour ceux qui ont cru et qui craignaient Allah.
versets.anglais: And the reward of the Hereafter is better for those who believed and were fearing Allah

versets.arabe: وَجَاءَ إِخْوَةُ يُوسُفَ فَدَخَلُوا عَلَيْهِ فَعَرَفَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُ مُنكِرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa jâ'a ikhwatu yûsufa fadakhalû 'alayhi fa'arafahum wa hum lahû munkirûn
versets.francais: Les frères de Joseph vinrent et entrèrent auprès de lui. Il les reconnut mais ils ne le reconnurent pas.
versets.anglais: And the brothers of Joseph came [seeking food], and they entered upon him; and he recognized them, but he was to them unknown

versets.arabe: وَلَمَّا جَهَّزَهُم بِجَهَازِهِمْ قَالَ ائْتُونِي بِأَخٍ لَّكُم مِّنْ أَبِيكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Wa lammâ jahhazahum bijahâzihim qâla'itûnî bi'akhin lakum min abîkum
versets.francais: Quand il les eut pourvus de leur provision, il dit: amenez-moi le frère que vous avez de votre père.
versets.anglais: And when he had furnished them with their supplies, he said, "Bring me a brother of yours from your father. Do not you see that I give full measure and that I am the best of accommodators

versets.arabe: فَإِن لَّمْ تَأْتُونِي بِهِ فَلَا كَيْلَ لَكُمْ عِندِي وَلَا تَقْرَبُونِ
versets.phonetique: Fa'in lam ta'tûnî bihî falâ kayla lakum 'indî wa lâ taqrabûn
versets.francais: Si vous ne me l'amenez pas, vous n'aurez plus de mesure auprès de moi et ne m'approchez plus.
versets.anglais: But if you do not bring him to me, no measure will there be [hereafter] for you from me, nor will you approach me

versets.arabe: قَالُوا سَنُرَاوِدُ عَنْهُ أَبَاهُ وَإِنَّا لَفَاعِلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qâlû sanurâwidu 'anhu abâhu wa innâ lafâ'ilûn
versets.francais: Ils dirent: nous allons essayer d'obtenir son consentement auprès de son père, et nous le ferons.
versets.anglais: They said, "We will attempt to dissuade his father from [keeping] him, and indeed, we will do [it]

versets.arabe: وَقَالَ لِفِتْيَانِهِ اجْعَلُوا بِضَاعَتَهُمْ فِي رِحَالِهِمْ
versets.phonetique: Wa qâla lifityânihij'alû bidhâ'atahum fî rihâlihim
versets.francais: Il dit à ses serviteurs: remettez leur marchandise dans leurs bagages.
versets.anglais: And [Joseph] said to his servants, "Put their merchandise into their saddlebags so they might recognize it when they have gone back to their people that perhaps they will [again] return

versets.arabe: فَلَمَّا رَجَعُوا إِلَىٰ أَبِيهِمْ قَالُوا يَا أَبَانَا مُنِعَ مِنَّا الْكَيْلُ
versets.phonetique: Falammâ raja'û ilâ abîhim qâlû yâ abânâ muni'a minnal-kayl
versets.francais: Quand ils retournèrent auprès de leur père, ils dirent: Ô notre père, la mesure nous a été refusée.
versets.anglais: So when they returned to their father, they said, "O our father, [further] measure has been denied to us, so send with us our brother [that] we will be given measure. And indeed, we will be his guardians

versets.arabe: قَالَ هَلْ آمَنُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا كَمَا أَمِنتُكُمْ عَلَىٰ أَخِيهِ مِن قَبْلُ
versets.phonetique: Qâla hal âmanukum 'alayhi illâ kamâ amintukum 'alâ akhîhi min qabl
versets.francais: Il dit: vous inspirez-vous confiance pour lui comme vous m'avez inspiré confiance pour son frère auparavant?
versets.anglais: He said, "Should I entrust you with him except [under coercion] as I entrusted you with his brother before? But Allah is the best guardian, and He is the most merciful of the merciful

versets.arabe: وَلَمَّا فَتَحُوا مَتَاعَهُمْ وَجَدُوا بِضَاعَتَهُمْ رُدَّتْ إِلَيْهِمْ
versets.phonetique: Wa lammâ fatahû matâ'ahum wajadû bidhâ'atahum ruddat ilayhim
versets.francais: Quand ils ouvrirent leurs bagages, ils trouvèrent que leur marchandise leur avait été rendue.
versets.anglais: And when they opened their baggage, they found their merchandise returned to them. They said, "O our father, what [more] could we desire? This is our merchandise returned to us. And we will obtain supplies for our family and protect our brother and obtain an increase of a camel's load; that is an easy measurement

versets.arabe: قَالَ لَنْ أُرْسِلَهُ مَعَكُمْ حَتَّىٰ تُؤْتُونِ مَوْثِقًا مِّنَ اللَّهِ
versets.phonetique: Qâla lan ursilahu ma'akum hattâ tu'tûni mawthiqam minallâh
versets.francais: Il dit: je ne l'enverrai pas avec vous tant que vous ne me donnerez pas une garantie de la part d'Allah.
versets.anglais: [Jacob] said, "Never will I send him with you until you give me a promise by Allah that you will bring him [back] to me, unless you should be surrounded by enemies." And when they had given their promise, he said, "Allah, over what we say, is Witness

versets.arabe: وَقَالَ يَا بَنِيَّ لَا تَدْخُلُوا مِن بَابٍ وَاحِدٍ وَادْخُلُوا مِنْ أَبْوَابٍ مُّتَفَرِّقَةٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa qâla yâ baniyya lâ tadkhulû min bâbin wâhidin wadkhulû min abwâbim mutafarriqah
versets.francais: Il dit: Ô mes fils, n'entrez pas par une seule porte, mais entrez par des portes différentes.
versets.anglais: And he said, "O my sons, do not enter from one gate but enter from different gates; and I cannot avail you against [the decree of] Allah at all. The decision is only for Allah; upon Him I have relied, and upon Him let those who would rely [indeed] rely

versets.arabe: وَلَمَّا دَخَلُوا مِنْ حَيْثُ أَمَرَهُمْ أَبُوهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Wa lammâ dakhalû min haythu amarahum abûhum
versets.francais: Quand ils entrèrent par où leur père le leur avait ordonné.
versets.anglais: And when they entered from where their father had ordered them, it did not avail them against Allah at all except [it was] a need within the soul of Jacob, which he satisfied. And indeed, he was a possessor of knowledge because of what We had taught him, but most of the people do not know

versets.arabe: وَلَمَّا دَخَلُوا عَلَىٰ يُوسُفَ آوَىٰ إِلَيْهِ أَخَاهُ
versets.phonetique: Wa lammâ dakhalû 'alâ yûsufa âwâ ilayhi akhâh
versets.francais: Quand ils se présentèrent à Joseph, il accueillit auprès de lui son frère.
versets.anglais: And when they entered upon Joseph, he took his brother to himself; he said, "Indeed, I am your brother, so do not despair over what they used to do [to me]

versets.arabe: فَلَمَّا جَهَّزَهُم بِجَهَازِهِمْ جَعَلَ السِّقَايَةَ فِي رَحْلِ أَخِيهِ
versets.phonetique: Falammâ jahhazahum bijahâzihim ja'alas-siqâyata fî rahli akhîh
versets.francais: Quand il les eut pourvus de leurs provisions, il plaça la coupe dans le bagage de son frère.
versets.anglais: So when he had furnished them with their supplies, he put the [gold measuring] bowl into the bag of his brother. Then an announcer called out, "O caravan, indeed you are thieves

versets.arabe: قَالُوا وَأَقْبَلُوا عَلَيْهِم مَّاذَا تَفْقِدُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qâlû wa aqbalû 'alayhim mâthâ tafqidûn
versets.francais: Ils dirent en se retournant vers eux: que cherchez-vous?
versets.anglais: They said while approaching them, "What is it you are missing

versets.arabe: قَالُوا نَفْقِدُ صُوَاعَ الْمَلِكِ وَلِمَن جَاءَ بِهِ حِمْلُ بَعِيرٍ
versets.phonetique: Qâlû nafqidu suwâ'al-maliki wa liman jâ'a bihî himlu ba'îr
versets.francais: Ils dirent: nous cherchons la coupe du roi. Celui qui la rapportera aura une charge de chameau.
versets.anglais: They said, "We are missing the measure of the king. And for he who produces it is [the reward of] a camel's load, and I am responsible for it

versets.arabe: قَالُوا تَاللَّهِ لَقَدْ عَلِمْتُمْ مَّا جِئْنَا لِنُفْسِدَ فِي الْأَرْضِ
versets.phonetique: Qâlû tallâhi laqad 'alimtum mâ ji'nâ linufsida fil-ardh
versets.francais: Ils dirent: par Allah, vous savez que nous ne sommes pas venus pour semer la corruption dans le pays.
versets.anglais: They said, "By Allah, you have certainly known that we did not come to cause corruption in the land, and we have not been thieves

versets.arabe: قَالُوا فَمَا جَزَاؤُهُ إِن كُنتُمْ كَاذِبِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qâlû famâ jazâ'uhu in kuntum kâthibîn
versets.francais: Ils dirent: quelle sera sa punition si vous mentez?
versets.anglais: The accusers said, "Then what would be its recompense if you should be liars

versets.arabe: قَالُوا جَزَاؤُهُ مَن وُجِدَ فِي رَحْلِهِ فَهُوَ جَزَاؤُهُ
versets.phonetique: Qâlû jazâ'uhu man wujida fî rahlihî fahuwa jazâ'uh
versets.francais: Ils dirent: sa punition? Celui dans le bagage de qui on le trouvera sera retenu comme punition.
versets.anglais: [The brothers] said, "Its recompense is that he in whose bag it is found - he [himself] will be its recompense. Thus do we recompense the wrongdoers

versets.arabe: فَبَدَأَ بِأَوْعِيَتِهِمْ قَبْلَ وِعَاءِ أَخِيهِ ثُمَّ اسْتَخْرَجَهَا مِن وِعَاءِ أَخِيهِ
versets.phonetique: Fabada'a bi'aw'iyatihim qabla wi'â'i akhîhi thummastaakhrajahâ min wi'â'i akhîh
versets.francais: Il commença par leurs sacs avant le sac de son frère, puis il l'extirpa du sac de son frère.
versets.anglais: So he began [the search] with their bags before the bag of his brother; then he extracted it from the bag of his brother. Thus did We plan for Joseph. He could not have taken his brother within the religion of the king except that Allah willed. We raise in degrees whom We will, but over every possessor of knowledge is one [more] knowing

versets.arabe: قَالُوا إِن يَسْرِقْ فَقَدْ سَرَقَ أَخٌ لَّهُ مِن قَبْلُ
versets.phonetique: Qâlû in yasriq faqad saraqa akhun lahû min qabl
versets.francais: Ils dirent: s'il a volé, un de ses frères avait aussi volé avant lui.
versets.anglais: They said, "If he steals - a brother of his has stolen before." But Joseph kept it within himself and did not reveal it to them. He said, "You are worse in position, and Allah is most knowing of what you describe

versets.arabe: قَالُوا يَا أَيُّهَا الْعَزِيزُ إِنَّ لَهُ أَبًا شَيْخًا كَبِيرًا
versets.phonetique: Qâlû yâ ayyuhal-'azîzu inna lahû aban shaykhân kabîrâ
versets.francais: Ils dirent: Ô dignitaire, il a un vieux père âgé.
versets.anglais: They said, "O 'Azeez, indeed he has a father [who is] an old man, so take one of us in place of him. Indeed, we see you as a doer of good

versets.arabe: قَالَ مَعَاذَ اللَّهِ أَن نَّأْخُذَ إِلَّا مَن وَجَدْنَا مَتَاعَنَا عِندَهُ
versets.phonetique: Qâla ma'âthallâhi an na'khutha illâ man wajadnâ matâ'anâ 'indahu
versets.francais: Il dit: qu'Allah nous préserve de prendre quelqu'un d'autre que celui chez qui nous avons trouvé notre bien.
versets.anglais: He said, "[I seek] the refuge of Allah [to prevent] that we take except him with whom we found our possession. Indeed, we would then be unjust

versets.arabe: فَلَمَّا اسْتَيْأَسُوا مِنْهُ خَلَصَ نَجِيًّا قَالَ كَبِيرُهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Falammastay'asû minhu khalasa najiyyân, qâla kabîruhum
versets.francais: Quand ils désespérèrent de lui, ils se retirèrent à l'écart pour délibérer. L'aîné d'eux dit.
versets.anglais: So when they had despaired of him, they secluded themselves in private consultation. The eldest of them said, "Do you not know that your father has taken upon you an oath by Allah and [that] before you failed in [your duty to] Joseph? So I will never leave [this] land until my father permits me or Allah decides for me, and He is the best of judges

versets.arabe: ارْجِعُوا إِلَىٰ أَبِيكُمْ فَقُولُوا يَا أَبَانَا إِنَّ ابْنَكَ سَرَقَ
versets.phonetique: Irji'û ilâ abîkum faqûlû yâ abânâ innabnakas-saraq
versets.francais: Retournez auprès de votre père et dites: Ô notre père, ton fils a volé.
versets.anglais: Return to your father and say, "O our father, indeed your son has stolen, and we did not testify except to what we knew. And we were not witnesses of the unseen

versets.arabe: وَاسْأَلِ الْقَرْيَةَ الَّتِي كُنَّا فِيهَا وَالْعِيرَ الَّتِي أَقْبَلْنَا فِيهَا
versets.phonetique: Was'alil-qaryatal-latî kunnâ fîhâ wal-'îrallati aqbalnâ fîhâ
versets.francais: Interroge la ville dans laquelle nous étions et la caravane avec laquelle nous sommes venus.
versets.anglais: And ask the city in which we were and the caravan in which we came - and indeed, we are truthful

versets.arabe: قَالَ بَلْ سَوَّلَتْ لَكُمْ أَنفُسُكُمْ أَمْرًا فَصَبْرٌ جَمِيلٌ
versets.phonetique: Qâla bal sawwalat lakum anfusukum amrân fasabrun jamîl
versets.francais: Il dit: non, vos âmes vous ont suggéré quelque chose. La patience est belle.
versets.anglais: [Jacob] said, "Rather, your souls have enticed you to something, so patience is most fitting. Perhaps Allah will bring them to me all together. Indeed it is He who is the Knowing, the Wise

versets.arabe: وَتَوَلَّىٰ عَنْهُمْ وَقَالَ يَا أَسَفَىٰ عَلَىٰ يُوسُفَ
versets.phonetique: Wa tawallâ 'anhum wa qâla yâ asafâ 'alâ yûsuf
versets.francais: Il se détourna d'eux et dit: quel chagrin pour Joseph!
versets.anglais: And he turned away from them and said, "Oh, my sorrow over Joseph," and his eyes became white from grief, for he was [of that] a suppressor

versets.arabe: قَالُوا تَاللَّهِ تَفْتَأُ تَذْكُرُ يُوسُفَ حَتَّىٰ تَكُونَ حَرَضًا
versets.phonetique: Qâlû tallâhi tafta'u tathkuru yûsufa hattâ takûna haradhan
versets.francais: Ils dirent: par Allah, tu ne cesseras de mentionner Joseph jusqu'à en dépérir.
versets.anglais: They said, "By Allah, you will not cease remembering Joseph until you become fatally ill or become of those who perish

versets.arabe: قَالَ إِنَّمَا أَشْكُو بَثِّي وَحُزْنِي إِلَى اللَّهِ
versets.phonetique: Qâla innamâ ashkû baththî wa huznî ilallâh
versets.francais: Il dit: je ne me plains de ma détresse et de mon chagrin qu'à Allah.
versets.anglais: He said, "I only complain of my suffering and my grief to Allah, and I know from Allah that which you do not know

versets.arabe: يَا بَنِيَّ اذْهَبُوا فَتَحَسَّسُوا مِن يُوسُفَ وَأَخِيهِ
versets.phonetique: Yâ baniyyathabû fatahasssasû min yûsufa wa akhîh
versets.francais: Ô mes fils, allez et recherchez des nouvelles de Joseph et de son frère.
versets.anglais: O my sons, go and find out about Joseph and his brother and despair not of relief from Allah. Indeed, no one despairs of relief from Allah except the disbelieving people

versets.arabe: فَلَمَّا دَخَلُوا عَلَيْهِ قَالُوا يَا أَيُّهَا الْعَزِيزُ مَسَّنَا وَأَهْلَنَا الضُّرُّ
versets.phonetique: Falammâ dakhalû 'alayhi qâlû yâ ayyuhal-'azîzu massanâ wa ahlanadh-dhurr
versets.francais: Quand ils se présentèrent à lui, ils dirent: Ô dignitaire, le malheur nous a touchés, nous et nos familles.
versets.anglais: So when they entered upon Joseph, they said, "O 'Azeez, adversity has touched us and our family, and we have come with goods poor in quality, but give us full measure and be charitable to us. Indeed, Allah rewards the charitable

versets.arabe: قَالَ هَلْ عَلِمْتُم مَّا فَعَلْتُم بِيُوسُفَ وَأَخِيهِ
versets.phonetique: Qâla hal 'alimtum mâ fa'altum biyûsufa wa akhîh
versets.francais: Il dit: savez-vous ce que vous avez fait à Joseph et à son frère?
versets.anglais: He said, "Do you know what you did with Joseph and his brother when you were ignorant

versets.arabe: قَالُوا أَإِنَّكَ لَأَنتَ يُوسُفُ قَالَ أَنَا يُوسُفُ وَهَٰذَا أَخِي
versets.phonetique: Qâlû a'innaka la'anta yûsuf, qâla ana yûsufu wa hâthâ akhî
versets.francais: Ils dirent: es-tu vraiment Joseph? Il dit: je suis Joseph, et voici mon frère.
versets.anglais: They said, "Are you indeed Joseph?" He said "I am Joseph, and this is my brother. Allah has certainly favored us. Indeed, he who fears Allah and is patient, then indeed, Allah does not allow to be lost the reward of those who do good

versets.arabe: قَالُوا تَاللَّهِ لَقَدْ آثَرَكَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا
versets.phonetique: Qâlû tallâhi laqad âtharakallâhu 'alaynâ
versets.francais: Ils dirent: par Allah, Allah t'a vraiment préféré à nous.
versets.anglais: They said, "By Allah, certainly has Allah preferred you over us, and indeed, we have been sinners

versets.arabe: قَالَ لَا تَثْرِيبَ عَلَيْكُمُ الْيَوْمَ يَغْفِرُ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Qâla lâ tathrîba 'alaykumul-yawma yaghfirullâhu lakum
versets.francais: Il dit: aucun reproche contre vous aujourd'hui. Qu'Allah vous pardonne.
versets.anglais: He said, "No blame will there be upon you today. Allah will forgive you; and He is the most merciful of the merciful

versets.arabe: اذْهَبُوا بِقَمِيصِي هَٰذَا فَأَلْقُوهُ عَلَىٰ وَجْهِ أَبِي يَأْتِ بَصِيرًا
versets.phonetique: Ithhabû biqamîsî hâthâ fa'alqûhu 'alâ wajhi abî ya'ti basîrâ
versets.francais: Prenez cette chemise et jetez-la sur le visage de mon père, il recouvrira la vue.
versets.anglais: Take this, my shirt, and cast it over the face of my father; he will become seeing. And bring me your family, all together

versets.arabe: وَلَمَّا فَصَلَتِ الْعِيرُ قَالَ أَبُوهُمْ إِنِّي لَأَجِدُ رِيحَ يُوسُفَ
versets.phonetique: Wa lammâ fasalatil-'îru qâla abûhum innî la'ajidu rîha yûsuf
versets.francais: Quand la caravane fut partie, leur père dit: je sens vraiment l'odeur de Joseph.
versets.anglais: And when the caravan departed [from Egypt], their father said, "Indeed, I find the smell of Joseph [and would say that he was alive] if you did not think me weakened in mind

versets.arabe: قَالُوا تَاللَّهِ إِنَّكَ لَفِي ضَلَالِكَ الْقَدِيمِ
versets.phonetique: Qâlû tallâhi innaka lafî dhalâlikal-qadîm
versets.francais: Ils dirent: par Allah, tu es encore dans ton ancien égarement.
versets.anglais: They said, "By Allah, indeed you are in your [same] old error

versets.arabe: فَلَمَّا أَن جَاءَ الْبَشِيرُ أَلْقَاهُ عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِ فَارْتَدَّ بَصِيرًا
versets.phonetique: Falammâ an jâ'al-bashîru alqâhu 'alâ wajhihî fartadda basîrâ
versets.francais: Quand le porteur de bonnes nouvelles arriva, il la jeta sur son visage et il recouvra la vue.
versets.anglais: And when the bearer of good tidings arrived, he cast it over his face, and he returned [once again] seeing. He said, "Did I not tell you that I know from Allah that which you do not know

versets.arabe: قَالُوا يَا أَبَانَا اسْتَغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا إِنَّا كُنَّا خَاطِئِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qâlû yâ abânastaghhfir lanâ thunûbanâ innâ kunnâ khâti'în
versets.francais: Ils dirent: Ô notre père, demande pardon pour nos péchés. Nous étions vraiment fautifs.
versets.anglais: They said, "O our father, ask for us forgiveness of our sins; indeed, we have been sinners

versets.arabe: قَالَ سَوْفَ أَسْتَغْفِرُ لَكُمْ رَبِّي إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
versets.phonetique: Qâla sawfa astaghfiru lakum rabbî innahû huwal-ghafûrur-rahîm
versets.francais: Il dit: je demanderai bientôt pardon pour vous à mon Seigneur. C'est Lui le Pardonneur le Très Miséricordieux.
versets.anglais: He said, "I will ask forgiveness for you from my Lord. Indeed, it is He who is the Forgiving, the Merciful

versets.arabe: فَلَمَّا دَخَلُوا عَلَىٰ يُوسُفَ آوَىٰ إِلَيْهِ أَبَوَيْهِ
versets.phonetique: Falammâ dakhalû 'alâ yûsufa âwâ ilayhi abawayh
versets.francais: Quand ils se présentèrent à Joseph, il accueillit ses parents auprès de lui.
versets.anglais: And when they entered upon Joseph, he took his parents to himself and said, "Enter Egypt, Allah willing, safe [and secure]

versets.arabe: وَرَفَعَ أَبَوَيْهِ عَلَى الْعَرْشِ وَخَرُّوا لَهُ سُجَّدًا
versets.phonetique: Wa rafa'a abawayhi 'alal-'arshi wa kharrû lahû sujjadâ
versets.francais: Il fit monter ses parents sur le trône et ils se prosternèrent devant lui.
versets.anglais: And he raised his parents upon the throne, and they bowed to him in prostration. And he said, "O my father, this is the explanation of my vision of before. My Lord has made it reality. And He was certainly good to me when He took me out of prison and brought you [here] from bedouin life after Satan had induced [estrangement] between me and my brothers. Indeed, my Lord is Subtle in what He wills. Indeed, it is He who is the Knowing, the Wise

versets.arabe: رَبِّ قَدْ آتَيْتَنِي مِنَ الْمُلْكِ وَعَلَّمْتَنِي مِن تَأْوِيلِ الْأَحَادِيثِ
versets.phonetique: Rabbi qad âtaytanî minal-mulki wa 'allamtanî min ta'wîlil-ahâdîth
versets.francais: Seigneur, Tu m'as donné part du royaume et m'as appris l'interprétation des songes.
versets.anglais: My Lord, You have given me [something] of sovereignty and taught me of the interpretation of dreams. Creator of the heavens and earth, You are my protector in this world and in the Hereafter. Cause me to die a Muslim and join me with the righteous

versets.arabe: ذَٰلِكَ مِنْ أَنبَاءِ الْغَيْبِ نُوحِيهِ إِلَيْكَ
versets.phonetique: Thâlika min anbâ'il-ghaybi nûhîhi ilayk
versets.francais: Ceci fait partie des nouvelles de l'Invisible que Nous te révélons.
versets.anglais: That is from the news of the unseen which We reveal, [O Muhammad], to you. And you were not with them when they put together their plan while they conspired

versets.arabe: وَمَا أَكْثَرُ النَّاسِ وَلَوْ حَرَصْتَ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa mâ aktharan-nâsi wa law harassta bimu'minîn
versets.francais: La plupart des gens ne croiront pas, même si tu y tiens beaucoup.
versets.anglais: And most of the people, although you strive [for it], are not believers

versets.arabe: وَمَا تَسْأَلُهُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَالَمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa mâ tas'aluhum 'alayhi min ajrin in huwa illâ thikrul-lil'âlamîn
versets.francais: Tu ne leur demandes aucune récompense pour cela. Ce n'est qu'un rappel pour les mondes.
versets.anglais: And you do not ask of them for it any payment. It is not except a reminder to the worlds

versets.arabe: وَكَأَيِّن مِّنْ آيَةٍ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ يَمُرُّونَ عَلَيْهَا
versets.phonetique: Wa ka'ayyin min âyatin fis-samâwâti wal-ardhi yamurrûna 'alayhâ
versets.francais: Combien de signes dans les cieux et sur la terre devant lesquels ils passent.
versets.anglais: And how many a sign within the heavens and earth do they pass over while they, therefrom, are turning away

versets.arabe: وَمَا يُؤْمِنُ أَكْثَرُهُم بِاللَّهِ إِلَّا وَهُم مُّشْرِكُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa mâ yu'minu aktharuhum billâhi illâ wa hum mushrikûn
versets.francais: La plupart d'entre eux ne croient en Allah qu'en Lui associant des partenaires.
versets.anglais: And most of them believe not in Allah except while they associate others with Him

versets.arabe: أَفَأَمِنُوا أَن تَأْتِيَهُمْ غَاشِيَةٌ مِّنْ عَذَابِ اللَّهِ
versets.phonetique: Afa'aminû an ta'tiyahum ghâshiyatun min 'athâbillâh
versets.francais: Se croient-ils donc à l'abri d'une enveloppe du châtiment d'Allah?
versets.anglais: Then do they feel secure that there will not come to them an overwhelming [aspect] of the punishment of Allah or that the Hour will not come upon them suddenly while they do not perceive

versets.arabe: قُلْ هَٰذِهِ سَبِيلِي أَدْعُو إِلَى اللَّهِ عَلَىٰ بَصِيرَةٍ
versets.phonetique: Qul hâthihi sabîlî ad'û ilallâhi 'alâ basîrah
versets.francais: Dis: voici mon chemin. J'invite à Allah avec clairvoyance.
versets.anglais: Say, "This is my way; I invite to Allah with insight, I and those who follow me. And exalted is Allah; and I am not of those who associate others with Him

versets.arabe: وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ إِلَّا رِجَالًا نُّوحِي إِلَيْهِم مِّنْ أَهْلِ الْقُرَىٰ
versets.phonetique: Wa mâ arsalnâ min qablika illâ rijâlan nûhî ilayhim min ahlil-qurâ
versets.francais: Nous n'avons envoyé avant toi que des hommes que Nous inspirions, choisis parmi les gens des cités.
versets.anglais: And We sent not before you [as messengers] except men to whom We revealed from among the people of cities. So have they not traveled through the earth and observed how was the end of those before them? And the home of the Hereafter is best for those who fear Allah; then will you not reason

versets.arabe: حَتَّىٰ إِذَا اسْتَيْأَسَ الرُّسُلُ وَظَنُّوا أَنَّهُمْ قَدْ كُذِبُوا
versets.phonetique: Hattâ ithastay'asar-rusulu wa dhannû annahum qad kuthibû
versets.francais: Jusqu'à ce que les messagers désespèrent et pensent qu'ils avaient été traités de menteurs.
versets.anglais: [They continued] until, when the messengers despaired and were certain that they had been denied, there came to them Our victory, and whoever We willed was saved. And Our punishment cannot be repelled from the people who are criminals

versets.arabe: لَقَدْ كَانَ فِي قَصَصِهِمْ عِبْرَةٌ لِّأُولِي الْأَلْبَابِ
versets.phonetique: Laqad kâna fî qasasihim 'ibratun li'ulil-albâb
versets.francais: Dans leurs récits il y a certes une leçon pour les gens doués d'intelligence.
versets.anglais: There was certainly in their stories a lesson for those of understanding. Never was the Qur'an a narration invented, but a confirmation of what was before it and a detailed explanation of all things and guidance and mercy for a people who believe

versets.arabe: الم ۚ تِلْكَ آيَاتُ الْكِتَابِ ۗ وَالَّذِي أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ الْحَقُّ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
versets.phonetique: Alif-Lam-Mim, Tilka ayat al-kitab wa-alladhia unzila ilayka min rabbik al-haqqu wa lakinnas akthar an-nasi la yu'minun
versets.francais: Alif. Lam. Mim. Ce sont les versets du Livre. Ce qui t'a été révélé par ton Seigneur est la vérité; mais la plupart des gens ne croient pas.
versets.anglais: Alif, Lam, Meem, Ra. These are the verses of the Book; and what has been revealed to you from your Lord is the truth, but most of the people do not believe

versets.arabe: اللَّهُ الَّذِي رَفَعَ السَّمَاوَاتِ بِغَيْرِ عَمَدٍ تَرَوْنَهَا ۖ ثُمَّ اسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى الْعَرْشِ ۖ وَسَخَّرَ الشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ ۖ كُلٌّ يَجْرِي لِأَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۚ يُدَبِّرُ الْأَمْرَ يُفَصِّلُ الْآيَاتِ لَعَلَّكُمْ بِلِقَاءِ رَبِّكُمْ تُوقِنُونَ
versets.phonetique: Allahu alladhi rafa'a as-samawati bighayri 'amadin tarawnahaa, thumma istawa ala al-'arsh wa sakhkhara ash-shams wa al-qamar, kullun yajri li-ajal musamma, yudabbir al-amr yufassil al-ayat la'allakum bi-liqa'i rabbikum tuqinun
versets.francais: C'est Allah qui a élevé les cieux sans piliers que vous puissiez voir, puis S'est établi sur le Trône. Il a soumis le soleil et la lune, chacun poursuivant sa course pour un terme fixé. Il administre l'ordre, et Il expose en détail les signes afin que vous croyiez ferme à la rencontre de votre Seigneur.
versets.anglais: It is Allah who erected the heavens without pillars that you [can] see; then He established Himself above the Throne and made subject the sun and the moon, each running [its course] for a specified term. He arranges [each] matter; He details the signs that you may, of the meeting with your Lord, be certain

versets.arabe: وَهُوَ الَّذِي مَدَّ الْأَرْضَ وَجَعَلَ فِيهَا رَوَاسِيَ وَأَنْهَارًا ۖ وَمِن كُلِّ الثَّمَرَاتِ جَعَلَ فِيهَا زَوْجَيْنِ اثْنَيْنِ ۖ يُغْشِي اللَّيْلَ النَّهَارَ ۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَاتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa huwa alladhi madda al-arda wa ja'ala fiha rawasi wa anhara, wa min kulli ath-thamarati ja'ala fiha zawjayn ithnayn, yughshi al-layl an-nahar, inna fi dhalika la-ayat li-qawmin yatafakkrun
versets.francais: C'est Lui qui a étendu la terre et y a placé des montagnes fermes et des fleuves. De chaque fruit Il y a créé deux espèces. Il fait couvrir la nuit le jour. Il y a en cela des signes pour des gens qui réfléchissent.
versets.anglais: And it is He who spread the earth and placed therein firmly set mountains and rivers; and from all of the fruits He made therein two mates; He causes the night to cover the day. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought

versets.arabe: وَفِي الْأَرْضِ قِطَعٌ مُّتَجَاوِرَةٌ وَجَنَّاتٌ مِّن أَعْنَابٍ وَزَرْعٌ وَنَخِيلٌ صِنْوَانٌ وَغَيْرُ صِنْوَانٍ يُسْقَىٰ بِمَاءٍ وَاحِدٍ وَنُفَضِّلُ بَعْضَهَا عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ فِي الْأُكُلِ ۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَاتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa fi al-ardi qita'un mutajawira wa jannat min a'nab wa zar'u wa nakhil sinwan wa ghayru sinwan yusqa bi-ma'in wahid wa nufaddil ba'dahaa ala ba'din fi al-ukul, inna fi dhalika la-ayat li-qawmin ya'qilun
versets.francais: Et sur la terre il y a des parcelles contiguës, des jardins de vignes, des champs, des palmiers - quelques-uns pourvus de tiges jumelles, d'autres non. Tous sont arrosés d'une même eau, et Nous excellons les uns sur les autres quant aux fruits. Il y a en cela des signes pour des gens qui comprennent.
versets.anglais: And within the land are neighboring plots and gardens of grapevines and crops and palm trees, [growing] several from a root or otherwise, watered with one water; but We make some of them exceed others in [quality of] fruit. Indeed in that are signs for a people who reason

versets.arabe: وَإِن تَعْجَبْ فَعَجَبٌ قَوْلُهُمْ أَإِذَا كُنَّا تُرَابًا أَإِنَّا لَفِي خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ ۚ أُولَٰئِكَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا بِرَبِّهِمْ ۖ وَأُولَٰئِكَ الْأَغْلَالُ فِي أَعْنَاقِهِمْ ۖ وَأُولَٰئِكَ أَصْحَابُ النَّارِ هُمْ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa in ta'jab fa-'ajabun qawluhum a-idha kunna turab a-inna la-fi khalq jadid, ula'ik alladhina kafarou bi-rabbihim wa ula'ik al-aghlal fi a'naqihim wa ula'ik ashab an-nar hum fiha khalidun
versets.francais: Et si tu t'étonnes, l'étonnement est dans leur parole: "Quand nous serons devenus poussière, serons-nous, vraiment, dans une nouvelle création?" Ceux-là sont ceux qui ont mécru envers leur Seigneur, et ils porteront des colliers, et ce sont les gens du feu, où ils demeureront éternellement.
versets.anglais: And if you are astonished, [O Muhammad] - then astonishing is their saying, "When we are dust, will we indeed be [brought] into a new creation?" Those are the ones who have disbelieved in their Lord, and those will have shackles upon their necks, and those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally

versets.arabe: وَيَسْتَعْجِلُونَكَ بِالسَّيِّئَةِ قَبْلَ الْحَسَنَةِ وَقَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلِهِمُ الْمَثُلَاتُ ۚ وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَذُو مَغْفِرَةٍ لِّلنَّاسِ عَلَىٰ ظُلْمِهِمْ ۖ وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَشَدِيدُ الْعِقَابِ
versets.phonetique: Wa yasta'jilunaka bi-as-sayyiah qabla al-hasana wa qad khalat min qablihim al-mathulat, wa inna rabbaka la-dhu maghfirah li-n-nasi ala zulmin wa inna rabbaka la-shadid al-'iqab
versets.francais: Et ils te pressent d'avoir le châtiment avant le bien, tandis que les châtiments avant eux déjà se sont écoulés. Et certes, ton Seigneur est riche en pardon pour les gens malgré leur injustice. Et certes, ton Seigneur est terrible en punition.
versets.anglais: They impatiently urge you to bring about evil before good, while there has already occurred before them similar punishments [to what they demand]. And indeed, your Lord is full of forgiveness for the people despite their wrongdoing, and indeed, your Lord is severe in penalty

versets.arabe: وَيَقُولُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَوْلَا أُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ آيَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِ ۚ إِنَّمَا أَنتَ مُنذِرٌ ۚ وَلِكُلِّ قَوْمٍ هَادٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa yaqul alladhina kafarou law la unzila alayhi ayah min rabbihi, innama anta mundhir wa li-kulli qawmin had
versets.francais: Et les mécréants disent: "Pourquoi aucun signe ne lui a-t-il été révélé de la part de son Seigneur?" Tu es seulement un avertisseur. Et pour chaque peuple, il y a un guide.
versets.anglais: And those who disbelieved say, "Why has a sign not been sent down to him from his Lord?" You are only a warner, and for every people is a guide

versets.arabe: اللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تَحْمِلُ كُلُّ أُنثَىٰ وَمَا تَغِيضُ الْأَرْحَامُ وَمَا تَزْدَادُ ۖ وَكُلُّ شَيْءٍ عِندَهُ بِمِقْدَارٍ
versets.phonetique: Allahu ya'lam ma tahmal kullu untha wa ma taghidh al-arhamu wa ma tazdad wa kull shay'in indahu bi-miqdari
versets.francais: Allah sait ce que porte chaque femelle, et de combien se réduisent les matrices et de combien s'accroissent. Et chaque chose, auprès de Lui, est estimée avec certitude.
versets.anglais: Allah knows what every female carries and what the wombs lose [prematurely] or exceed. And everything with Him is by due measure

versets.arabe: عَالِمُ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ الْكَبِيرُ الْمُتَعَالِ
versets.phonetique: Alim al-ghayb wa ash-shahadah al-kabir al-muta'al
versets.francais: Connaisseur du monde invisible et du monde visible, le Grand, le Très Élevé.
versets.anglais: [He is] Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Grand, the Exalted

versets.arabe: سَوَاءٌ مِّنكُم مَّن أَسَرَّ الْقَوْلَ وَمَن جَهَرَ بِهِ وَمَن هُوَ مُسْتَخْفٍ بِاللَّيْلِ وَسَارِبٌ بِالنَّهَارِ
versets.phonetique: Sawau min-kum man asarra al-qawl wa man jahara bihi wa man huwa mustakhfi bi-al-layl wa sarib bi-an-nahar
versets.francais: Vous êtes tous égaux - celui qui cache la parole et celui qui la divulgue, celui qui se cache pendant la nuit et celui qui se montre au jour.
versets.anglais: It is the same [to Him] concerning you whether one conceals [his] speech or one publicizes it and whether one is hidden by night or conspicuous [among others] by day

versets.arabe: لَهُ مُعَقِّبَاتٌ مِّن بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِ يَحْفَظُونَهُ مِنْ أَمْرِ اللَّهِ ۗ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُغَيِّرُ مَا بِقَوْمٍ حَتَّىٰ يُغَيِّرُوا مَا بِأَنفُسِهِمْ ۗ وَإِذَا أَرَادَ اللَّهُ بِقَوْمٍ سُوءًا فَلَا مَرَدَّ لَهُ ۚ وَمَا لَهُم مِّن دُونِهِ مِن وَالٍ
versets.phonetique: Lahu mu'aqqibat min bayn yaday-hi wa min khalfihi yahfazunahum min amr-illah, inna-llaha la yughayyir ma bi-qawm hatta yughayyru ma bi-anfusihim wa idha arad-illahu bi-qawm suu'an fa-la maradda lahu wa ma lahum min dunhi min wal
versets.francais: Il y a des anges qui se succèdent, devant lui et derrière lui, qui le protègent par le commandement d'Allah. En vérité, Allah ne change l'état d'un peuple que s'il change lui-même. Et quand Allah veut un mal à un peuple, nul ne peut le repousser, et en dehors de Lui ils n'ont point de protecteur.
versets.anglais: For each one are successive [angels] before and behind him who protect him by the decree of Allah. Indeed, Allah will not change the condition of a people until they change what is in themselves. And when Allah intends for a people ill, there is no repelling it. And there is not for them besides Him any patron

versets.arabe: هُوَ الَّذِي يُرِيكُمُ الْبَرْقَ خَوْفًا وَطَمَعًا وَيُنشِئُ السَّحَابَ الثِّقَالَ
versets.phonetique: Huwa alladhi yurîkum al-barq khawfan wa tama'an wa yunshi' as-sahab ath-thiqal
versets.francais: C'est Lui qui vous montre l'éclair, source de crainte et d'espoir, et qui crée les nuages lourds.
versets.anglais: It is He who shows you lightening, [causing] fear and aspiration, and generates the heavy clouds

versets.arabe: وَيُسَبِّحُ الرَّعْدُ بِحَمْدِهِ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ مِنْ خِيفَتِهِ وَيُرْسِلُ الصَّوَاعِقَ فَيُصِيبُ بِهَا مَن يَشَاءُ وَهُمْ يُجَادِلُونَ فِي اللَّهِ وَهُوَ شَدِيدُ الْمِحَالِ
versets.phonetique: Wa yusabbih ar-ra'd bi-hamdihi wa al-malaikah min khifatih wa yursil as-sawai'q fa-yusib biha man yasha' wa hum yujadilun fi-llah wa huwa shadid al-mihal
versets.francais: Le tonnerre célèbre Ses louanges, et les anges aussi, de crainte de Lui. Il lance les foudres et en frappe qui Il veut, tandis qu'ils disputent sur Allah, alors qu'Il est redoutable en puissance.
versets.anglais: And the thunder exalts [Allah] with praise of Him - and the angels [as well] from fear of Him - and He sends thunderbolts and strikes therewith whom He wills while they dispute about Allah; and He is severe in assault

versets.arabe: لَهُ دُعَاءُ الْحَقِّ ۖ وَالَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِ لَا يَسْتَجِيبُونَ لَهُم بِشَيْءٍ إِلَّا كَبَاسِطِ كَفَّيْهِ إِلَى الْمَاءِ لِيَبْلُغَ فَاهُ وَمَا هُوَ بِبَالِغِهِ ۚ وَمَا دُعَاءُ الْكَافِرِينَ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَالٍ
versets.phonetique: Lahu du'a' al-haqq wa-alladhina yad'un min dunihi la yastajibun lahum bi-shay'in illa kasit kafayhi ila al-ma'i li-yablugh fauh wa ma huwa bibalihi wa ma du'a' al-kafirin illa fi dalal
versets.francais: C'est à Allah seul qu'est due une invocation légitime. Tandis que ceux qu'on invoque en dehors de Lui ne répondent à rien; similaires à celui qui étend les deux mains vers l'eau pour qu'elle atteigne sa bouche, alors qu'elle ne peut l'atteindre. Et l'invocation des mécréants n'est que dans l'égarement.
versets.anglais: To Him [alone] is the supplication of truth. And those they call upon besides Him do not respond to them with a thing, except as one who stretches his hands toward water [from afar, calling it] to reach his mouth, but it will not reach it [thus]. And the supplication of the disbelievers is not but in error [i.e. futility]

versets.arabe: وَلِلَّهِ يَسْجُدُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ طَوْعًا وَكَرْهًا وَظِلَالُهُم بِالْغُدُوِّ وَالْآصَالِ
versets.phonetique: Wa li-llahi yasjud ma fi as-samawat wa ma fi al-ard taw'an wa karhan wa zhilaluhum bi-al-ghuduww wa al-asal
versets.francais: Et c'est à Allah que se prosternent tous ceux qui sont dans les cieux et sur la terre, volontairement ou par contrainte, et leurs ombres matin et soir.
versets.anglais: And to Allah prostrates whoever is within the heavens and the earth, willingly or by compulsion, and their shadows [as well] in the mornings and the afternoons

versets.arabe: قُلْ مَن رَّبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ قُلِ اللَّهُ ۚ قُلْ أَفَاتَّخَذْتُم مِّن دُونِهِ أَوْلِيَاءَ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ لِأَنفُسِهِمْ نَفْعًا وَلَا ضَرًّا ۚ قُلْ هَلْ يَسْتَوِي الْأَعْمَىٰ وَالْبَصِيرُ أَمْ هَلْ تَسْتَوِي الظُّلُمَاتُ وَالنُّورُ ۗ أَمْ جَعَلُوا لِلَّهِ شُرَكَاءَ خَلَقُوا كَخَلْقِهِ فَتَشَابَهَ الْخَلْقُ عَلَيْهِمْ ۚ قُلِ اللَّهُ خَالِقُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَهُوَ الْوَاحِدُ الْقَهَّارُ
versets.phonetique: Qul man rabb as-samawat wa al-ard qul-illah qul afa-ttakhadhtum min dunihi awliya' la yamlukun li-anfusihim naf'an wa la darra, qul hal yastawi al-a'ma wa al-basir am hal tastawi az-zhulumat wa an-nur, am ja'alu li-llahi shuraka' khalqu ka-khalqih fa-tashabah al-khalqu alayhim qul-illahu khaliq kulli shay'in wa huwa al-wahid al-qahhar
versets.francais: Dis: "Qui est le Seigneur des cieux et de la terre?" Dis: "C'est Allah." Dis: "Avez-vous pris auprès de Lui des protecteurs qui ne possèdent pour eux-mêmes ni profit ni préjudice?" Dis: "L'aveugle et celui qui voit sont-ils égaux? Les ténèbres et la lumière sont-elles égales?" Ou ont-ils assigné à Allah des associés qui créent comme sa création, en sorte que la création leur paraît similaire? Dis: "Allah est le Créateur de toute chose, et c'est Lui l'Unique, le Tout-Puissant."
versets.anglais: Say, "Who is Lord of the heavens and earth?" Say, "Allah." Say, "Have you then taken besides Him allies not possessing [even] for themselves any benefit or any harm?" Say, "Is the blind equivalent to the seeing? Or is darkness equivalent to light? Or have they attributed to Allah partners who created like His creation so that the creation [of each] seemed similar to them?" Say, "Allah is the Creator of all things, and He is the One, the Prevailing

versets.arabe: أَنزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَسَالَتْ أَوْدِيَةٌ بِقَدَرِهَا فَاحْتَمَلَ السَّيْلُ زَبَدًا رَّابِيًا ۚ وَمِمَّا يُوقِدُونَ عَلَيْهِ فِي النَّارِ ابْتِغَاءَ حِلْيَةٍ أَوْ مَتَاعٍ زَبَدٌ مِّثْلُهُ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يَضْرِبُ اللَّهُ الْحَقَّ وَالْبَاطِلَ ۚ فَأَمَّا الزَّبَدُ فَيَذْهَبُ جُفَاءً ۖ وَأَمَّا مَا يَنفَعُ النَّاسَ فَيَمْكُثُ فِي الْأَرْضِ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يَضْرِبُ اللَّهُ الْأَمْثَالَ
versets.phonetique: Anzala min as-sama' ma' fa-salat awdiyah bi-qadariha fa-ihtamal as-sayl zabadan rabyan wa mimma yuwqidun alayh fi an-nar ibtigh'a' hilya aw mata'in zabadun mithluh, kadhalk yadrib-illahu al-haqq wa al-batil fa-amma az-zabadu fa-yadhhab jufau wa amma ma yanfa'u an-nas fa-yumkuth fi al-ard kadhalk yadrib-illahu al-amthal
versets.francais: Il a fait descendre du ciel de l'eau dont les vallées se sont remplies chacune selon leur capacité, et le flot charria une écume. Et de ce qu'on fait fondre au feu pour fabriquer des bijoux ou des ustensiles sort une écume semblable. C'est ainsi qu'Allah propose le vrai et le faux. L'écume s'en va en vain tandis que ce qui profite aux gens demeure dans la terre. Ainsi Allah propose des paraboles.
versets.anglais: He sends down from the sky, rain, and valleys flow according to their capacity, and the torrent carries a rising foam. And from that [ore] which they heat in the fire, desiring adornments and utensils, is a foam like it. Thus Allah presents [the example of] truth and falsehood. As for the foam, it vanishes, [being] cast off; but as for that which benefits the people, it remains on the earth. Thus does Allah present examples

versets.arabe: لِلَّذِينَ اسْتَجَابُوا لِرَبِّهِمُ الْحُسْنَىٰ ۚ وَالَّذِينَ لَمْ يَسْتَجِيبُوا لَهُ لَوْ أَنَّ لَهُمْ مَا فِي الْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا وَمِثْلَهُ مَعَهُ لَافْتَدَوْا بِهِ ۚ أُولَٰئِكَ لَهُمْ سُوءُ الْحِسَابِ وَمَأْوَاهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ ۖ وَبِئْسَ الْمِهَادُ
versets.phonetique: Li-lladhina istajabu li-rabbihim al-husna wa-alladhina lam yastajbu lahu law anna lahum ma fi al-ard jami'an wa mithluhu ma'ahu la-ftadaw bihi ula'ik lahum su'u al-hisab wa mawa'ahum jahannam wa bi's al-mihad
versets.francais: Pour ceux qui ont répondu à l'appel de leur Seigneur: la récompense la plus belle. Et pour ceux qui n'y ont pas répondu: s'ils avaient possédé tout ce qui est sur la terre et autant avec, ils auraient cherché à s'en racheter. Ceux-là auront un mauvais compte, et leur refuge sera l'Enfer. Quel mauvais refuge!
versets.anglais: For those who have responded to their Lord is the best [reward], but those who did not respond to Him - if they had all that is in the earth entirely and the like of it with it, they would [attempt to] ransom themselves thereby. Those will have the worst account, and their refuge is Hell, and wretched is the resting place

versets.arabe: أَفَمَن يَعْلَمُ أَنَّمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ الْحَقُّ كَمَنْ هُوَ أَعْمَىٰ ۚ إِنَّمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ أُولُو الْأَلْبَابِ
versets.phonetique: Afa-man ya'lam annam anzila ilayk min rabbik al-haqq kaman huwa a'ma innama yatadhdhhakkar ulu al-albab
versets.francais: Celui qui sait que ce qu'on t'a révélé venant de ton Seigneur est la vérité est-il égal à celui qui est aveugle? Seuls les doués d'intelligence méditeront.
versets.anglais: Then is he who knows that what has been revealed to you from your Lord is the truth like one who is blind? They will only be reminded who are people of understanding

versets.arabe: الَّذِينَ يُوفُونَ بِعَهْدِ اللَّهِ وَلَا يَنقُضُونَ الْمِيثَاقَ
versets.phonetique: Alladhina yufun bi-ahd-illahi wa la yanqudun al-mithaq
versets.francais: Ceux qui remplissent les promesses faites à Allah et ne violent pas l'alliance.
versets.anglais: Those who fulfill the covenant of Allah and do not break the contract

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ يَصِلُونَ مَا أَمَرَ اللَّهُ بِهِ أَن يُوصَلَ وَيَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ وَيَخَافُونَ سُوءَ الْحِسَابِ
versets.phonetique: Wa-alladhina yassilun ma amara-llahu bihi an yusal wa yakhshawn rabbahum wa yakhafun su'u al-hisab
versets.francais: Et ceux qui maintiennent les liens que Allah a ordonné de maintenir, craignent leur Seigneur et redoutent un mauvais compte.
versets.anglais: And those who join that which Allah has ordered to be joined and fear their Lord and are afraid of the evil of [their] account

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ صَبَرُوا ابْتِغَاءَ وَجْهِ رَبِّهِمْ وَأَقَامُوا الصَّلَاةَ وَأَنفَقُوا مِمَّا رَزَقْنَاهُمْ سِرًّا وَعَلَانِيَةً وَيَدْرَءُونَ بِالْحَسَنَةِ السَّيِّئَةَ ۚ أُولَٰئِكَ لَهُمْ عُقْبَى الدَّارِ
versets.phonetique: Wa-alladhina sabaru ibtigha' wajh rabbihim wa aqamu as-salah wa anfaqu mimma razaqnahum sirran wa alaniyan wa yadrau'un bi-al-hasanah as-sayyiah ula'ik lahum uqba ad-dar
versets.francais: Et ceux qui endurent avec constance, cherchant la face de leur Seigneur, s'acquittent de la Salat, dépensent de ce que Nous leur avons attribué, en secret et ouvertement, et repoussent le mal par le bien: ceux-là auront la Demeure dernière.
versets.anglais: And those who are patient, seeking the countenance of their Lord, and establish prayer and spend from what We have provided for them secretly and publicly and prevent evil with good - those will have the good consequence of [this] home

versets.arabe: جَنَّاتُ عَدْنٍ يَدْخُلُونَهَا وَمَن صَلَحَ مِنْ آبَائِهِمْ وَأَزْوَاجِهِمْ وَذُرِّيَّاتِهِمْ ۖ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ يَدْخُلُونَ عَلَيْهِم مِّن كُلِّ بَابٍ
versets.phonetique: Jannat adnin yadkhulunaha wa man salah min aba'ihim wa azwajihim wa dhurriyyatihim wa al-malaikah yadkhulun alayihim min kulli bab
versets.francais: Les Jardins d'Éden que les justes d'entre leurs pères, leurs épouses et leurs descendants entreront. Et les Anges entreront auprès d'eux par chaque porte.
versets.anglais: Gardens of perpetual residence; they will enter them with whoever were righteous among their fathers, their spouses and their descendants. And the angels will enter upon them from every gate, [saying]

versets.arabe: سَلَامٌ عَلَيْكُمْ بِمَا صَبَرْتُمْ فَنِعْمَ عُقْبَى الدَّارِ
versets.phonetique: Salamun alayakum bima sabartum fa-ni'm uqba ad-dar
versets.francais: Paix soit sur vous, pour avoir enduré avec constance! Excellent est le séjour dernier!
versets.anglais: Peace be upon you for what you patiently endured. And excellent is the final home

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ يَنقُضُونَ عَهْدَ اللَّهِ مِن بَعْدِ مِيثَاقِهِ وَيَقْطَعُونَ مَا أَمَرَ اللَّهُ بِهِ أَن يُوصَلَ وَيُفْسِدُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ ۚ أُولَٰئِكَ لَهُمُ اللَّعْنَةُ وَلَهُمْ سُوءُ الدَّارِ
versets.phonetique: Wa-alladhina yanqudun ahd-illahi min ba'di mithaqih wa yaqta'un ma amara-llahu bihi an yusal wa yufsidun fi al-ard ula'ik lahum al-la'nah wa lahum su'u ad-dar
versets.francais: Et ceux qui violent l'alliance d'Allah après l'avoir conclue, qui rompent les liens que Allah a ordonné de maintenir, et qui sèment la corruption sur la terre: ceux-là auront la malédiction et auront une mauvaise demeure.
versets.anglais: But those who break the covenant of Allah after contracting it and sever that which Allah has ordered to be joined and spread corruption on earth - for them is the curse, and they will have the worst home

versets.arabe: اللَّهُ يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَاءُ وَيَقْدِرُ ۚ وَفَرِحُوا بِالْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا وَالْحَيَاةُ الدُّنْيَا فِي الْآخِرَةِ إِلَّا مَتَاعٌ
versets.phonetique: Allahu yabsut ar-rizq li-man yasha' wa yaqdur wa farihu bi-al-hayah ad-duniya wa al-hayah ad-duniya fi al-akhirah illa mata'
versets.francais: Allah élargit la subsistance à qui Il veut et la mesure. Ils se sont réjouis de la vie présente, tandis que la vie présente, comparée à l'au-delà, n'est qu'un objet d'jouissance temporelle.
versets.anglais: Allah extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it]. And they rejoice in the worldly life, while the worldly life is not, compared to the Hereafter, except [brief] enjoyment

versets.arabe: وَيَقُولُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَوْلَا أُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ آيَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِ ۖ قُلْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُضِلُّ مَن يَشَاءُ وَيَهْدِي إِلَيْهِ مَن أَنَابَ
versets.phonetique: Wa yaqul alladhina kafarou law la unzila alayhi ayah min rabbihi qul inna-llaha yudill man yasha' wa yahdi ilayh man anab
versets.francais: Et les mécréants disent: "Pourquoi un signe ne lui a-t-il pas été révélé de la part de son Seigneur?" Dis: "Allah égare qui Il veut et guide vers Lui celui qui se repent."
versets.anglais: And those who disbelieved say, "Why has a sign not been sent down to him from his Lord?" Say, [O Muhammad], "Indeed, Allah leaves astray whom He wills and guides to Himself whoever turns back [to Him]

versets.arabe: الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَتَطْمَئِنُّ قُلُوبُهُم بِذِكْرِ اللَّهِ ۗ أَلَا بِذِكْرِ اللَّهِ تَطْمَئِنُّ الْقُلُوبُ
versets.phonetique: Alladhina amanu wa tatma'inn qulubuhum bi-dhikr-illahi ala bi-dhikr-illahi tatma'inn al-qulub
versets.francais: Ceux qui ont cru et dont les cœurs se tranquillisent à l'évocation d'Allah. N'est-ce pas à l'évocation d'Allah que se tranquillisent les cœurs?
versets.anglais: Those who have believed and whose hearts are assured by the remembrance of Allah. Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah hearts are assured

versets.arabe: الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ طُوبَىٰ لَهُمْ وَحُسْنُ مَآبٍ
versets.phonetique: Alladhina amanu wa amilu as-salihati tuba lahum wa husn mab
versets.francais: Ceux qui ont cru et accompli les bonnes oeuvres: bonheur est à eux et excellent séjour.
versets.anglais: Those who have believed and done righteous deeds - a good state is theirs and a good return

versets.arabe: كَذَٰلِكَ أَرْسَلْنَاكَ فِي أُمَّةٍ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلِهَا أُمَمٌ لِّتَتْلُوَ عَلَيْهِمُ الَّذِي أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ وَهُمْ يَكْفُرُونَ بِالرَّحْمَٰنِ ۚ قُلْ هُوَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَإِلَيْهِ مَتَابِ
versets.phonetique: Kadhalk arsalnaka fi ummah qad khalat min qablih umam li-tatlu alayihim alladhi awhayna ilayk wa hum yakfurun bi-ar-rahman qul huwa rabbi la ilaha illa huwa alayh tawakkalt wa ilayh matab
versets.francais: Ainsi, Nous t'avons envoyé vers une nation devant qui d'autres nations ont passé, afin que tu leur récites ce que Nous t'avons révélé. Et ils mécroient au Miséricordieux! Dis: "Il est mon Seigneur! Il n'y a de divinité que Lui. C'est sur Lui que je compte et c'est vers Lui que revient le repentir."
versets.anglais: Thus have We sent you to a community before which [other] communities have passed on so you might recite to them that which We revealed to you, while they disbelieve in the Most Merciful. Say, "He is my Lord; there is no deity except Him. Upon Him I rely, and to Him is my return

versets.arabe: وَلَوْ أَنَّ قُرْآنًا سُيِّرَتْ بِهِ الْجِبَالُ أَوْ قُطِّعَتْ بِهِ الْأَرْضُ أَوْ كُلِّمَ بِهِ الْمَوْتَىٰ ۗ بَل لِّلَّهِ الْأَمْرُ جَمِيعًا ۗ أَفَلَمْ يَيْأَسِ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا أَن لَّوْ يَشَاءُ اللَّهُ لَهَدَى النَّاسَ جَمِيعًا ۗ وَلَا يَزَالُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا تُصِيبُهُمْ بِمَا صَنَعُوا قَارِعَةٌ أَوْ تَحِلُّ قَرِيبًا مِّن دَارِهِمْ حَتَّىٰ يَأْتِيَ وَعْدُ اللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ
versets.phonetique: Wa law anna qur'anan suyyirat bihi al-jibal aw qutta'at bihi al-ard aw kullim bihi al-mawta bal li-llahi al-amr jami'an afa-lam yai'as alladhina amanu an law yasha'-llahu la-hada an-nas jami'an wa la yazal alladhina kafarou tusibuhum bima sana'u qari'ah aw tahil qariban min darihim hatta ya'ti wa'd-illah inna-llaha la yukhilf al-mi'ad
versets.francais: Et si y avait un Coran par lequel on déplacerait les montagnes, ou par lequel on déchirerait la terre, ou par lequel on parlerait aux morts... (Mais non!). C'est plutôt à Allah que revient tout l'ordre. Ne savent pas ceux qui croient qu'Allah aurait pu diriger tous les gens s'Il l'avait voulu? Et quant à ceux qui ont mécru, les catastrophes ne cesseront pas de s'abattre sur eux pour avoir agi, ou se fixeront à proximité de leur demeure, jusqu'à ce que la promesse d'Allah se réalise. Allah ne manque jamais à Sa promesse.
versets.anglais: And if there was any qur'an by which the mountains would be removed or the earth would be broken apart or the dead would be made to speak, [it would be this Qur'an], but to Allah belongs the affair entirely. Then have those who believed not accepted that had Allah willed, He would have guided the people, all of them? And those who disbelieve do not cease to be struck, for what they have done, by calamity - or it will descend near their home - until there comes the promise of Allah. Indeed, Allah does not fail in [His] promise

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدِ اسْتُهْزِئَ بِرُسُلٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ فَأَمْلَيْتُ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا ثُمَّ أَخَذْتُهُمْ ۖ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عِقَابِ
versets.phonetique: Wa laqad istuhziyah bi-rusul min qablika fa-amlayt li-lladhina kafarou thumma akhdhthum fa-kayf kan iqabi
versets.francais: Et en vérité, des Messagers avant toi ont été moqués. Mais J'ai accordé un délai aux mécréants, puis Je les ai châtiés. Comment fut donc Mon châtiment?
versets.anglais: And already were [other] messengers ridiculed before you, and I extended the time of those who disbelieved; then I seized them, and how [terrible] was My penalty

versets.arabe: أَفَمَن هُوَ قَائِمٌ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ نَفْسٍ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ ۗ وَجَعَلُوا لِلَّهِ شُرَكَاءَ قُلْ سَمُّوهُمْ ۚ أَمْ تُنَبِّئُونَهُ بِمَا لَا يَعْلَمُ فِي الْأَرْضِ أَمْ بِظَاهِرٍ مِّنَ الْقَوْلِ ۗ بَلْ زُيِّنَ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مَكْرُهُمْ وَصُدُّوا عَن السَّبِيلِ ۚ وَمَن يُضْلِلِ اللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُ مِنْ هَادٍ
versets.phonetique: Afa-man huwa qa'im ala kulli nafs bima kasabat wa ja'alu li-llahi shuraka' qul sammuuhum am tunabbiwunahu bima la ya'lam fi al-ard am bi-zahir min al-qawl bal zuyyina li-lladhina kafarou makruhum wa suddu an as-sabîl wa man yudlil-illahu fa-ma lahu min had
versets.francais: Est-ce celui qui préside au destin de chaque âme selon ses actes, auquel cas associerait-on à Allah d'autres divinités? Dis: "Nommez-les. Ou annoncerez-vous à Allah ce qu'Il ne connaît pas sur terre? Ou est-ce vain paroles?" Mais l'intrigue des mécréants leur a plutôt semblé bonne, et ils ont été détournés du chemin. Et celui qu'Allah égare, n'a aucun guide.
versets.anglais: Then is He who is a maintainer of every soul, [knowing] what it has earned, [like any other]? But to Allah they have attributed partners. Say, "Name them. Or do you inform Him of that which He knows not upon the earth or of what is apparent of speech?" Rather, their [own] plan has been made attractive to those who disbelieve, and they have been averted from the way. And whomever Allah leaves astray - there will be for him no guide

versets.arabe: لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ فِي الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا وَلَعَذَابُ الْآخِرَةِ أَشَقُّ ۖ وَمَا لَهُم مِّنَ اللَّهِ مِن وَاقٍ
versets.phonetique: Lahum adhab fi al-hayah ad-duniya wa la-adhab al-akhirah ashaqq wa ma lahum min-illahi min waqin
versets.francais: Ils ont un châtiment dans la vie présente, et le châtiment de l'au-delà est certainement plus dur. Et ils n'ont aucun protecteur contre Allah.
versets.anglais: For them will be punishment in the life of [this] world, and the punishment of the Hereafter is more severe. And they will not have from Allah any protector

versets.arabe: مَثَلُ الْجَنَّةِ الَّتِي وُعِدَ الْمُتَّقُونَ ۖ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ ۖ أُكُلُهَا دَائِمٌ وَظِلُّهَا ۚ تِلْكَ عُقْبَى الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا وَّعُقْبَى الْكَافِرِينَ النَّارُ
versets.phonetique: Mathul al-jannh alladhia wu'ida al-muttaqun tajri min tahtiha al-anharu ukluha da'im wa zhilluha tilka uqba alladhina ittaqu wa uqba al-kafirin an-nar
versets.francais: Voici la description du Paradis qu'on a promis aux pieux: il y coule des fleuves; son fruit est perpétuel ainsi que son ombre. Tel est le sort de ceux qui craignent Allah, tandis que le sort des mécréants, c'est le Feu.
versets.anglais: The example of Paradise, which the righteous have been promised, is [that] beneath it rivers flow. Its fruit is lasting, and its shade. That is the consequence for the righteous, and the consequence for the disbelievers is the Fire

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ آتَيْنَاهُمُ الْكِتَابَ يَفْرَحُونَ بِمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ وَمِنَ الْأَحْزَابِ مَن يُنكِرُ بَعْضَهُ ۚ قُلْ إِنَّمَا أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَعْبُدَ اللَّهَ وَلَا أُشْرِكَ بِهِ ۗ إِلَيْهِ أَدْعُو وَإِلَيْهِ مَتَابِ
versets.phonetique: Wa-alladhina ataynahum al-kitab yafrahu bima unzila ilayk wa min al-ahzab man yankir ba'dah qul innama umirt an a'bud-illaha wa la ushrik bihi ilayh ad'u wa ilayh matab
versets.francais: Et ceux à qui Nous avons donné le Livre sont heureux de ce qui t'a été révélé. Et parmi les groupes, il en est qui nient une partie. Dis: "On m'a seulement ordonné d'adorer Allah et de ne rien Lui associer. C'est vers Lui que j'appelle et c'est vers Lui que revient ma destination."
versets.anglais: And [the believers among] those to whom We have given the [previous] Scripture rejoice at what has been revealed to you, [O Muhammad], but among the [opposing] factions are those who deny part of it. Say, "I have only been commanded to worship Allah and not associate [anything] with Him. To Him I invite, and to Him is my return

versets.arabe: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَنزَلْنَاهُ حُكْمًا عَرَبِيًّا ۚ وَلَئِنِ اتَّبَعْتَ أَهْوَاءَهُم بَعْدَ مَا جَاءَكَ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ مَا لَكَ مِنَ اللَّهِ مِن وَلِيٍّ وَلَا وَاقٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa kadhalk anzalnah hukman arabiyyan wa la-in ittaba'ta ahwa'ahum ba'da ma ja'aka min al-ilm ma laka min-illahi min waliyy wa la waqin
versets.francais: Ainsi, Nous l'avons révélé, jugement en langue arabe. Et si tu suis leurs désirs, malgré le savoir que tu as reçu, tu n'aurais alors contre Allah aucun allié ni aucun protecteur.
versets.anglais: And thus We have revealed it as an Arabic legislation. And if you should follow their inclinations after what has come to you of knowledge, you would not have against Allah any ally or any protector

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلًا مِّن قَبْلِكَ وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُمْ أَزْوَاجًا وَذُرِّيَّةً ۚ وَمَا كَانَ لِرَسُولٍ أَن يَأْتِيَ بِآيَةٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ ۗ لِكُلِّ أَجَلٍ كِتَابٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa laqad arsalna rusul min qablika wa ja'alna lahum azwaj wa dhurriyyah wa ma kan li-rasul an ya'ti bi-ayah illa bi-idhn-illahi li-kulli ajal kitab
versets.francais: Et en vérité, avant toi, Nous avons envoyé des Messagers et Nous leur avons donné des épouses et une descendance. Or, il n'est d'autre Messager de Lui apporter un miracle qu'avec la permission d'Allah. Chaque terme a son ordre écrit.
versets.anglais: And We have already sent messengers before you and assigned to them wives and descendants. And it was not for a messenger to come with a sign except by permission of Allah. For every term is a decree

versets.arabe: يَمْحُو اللَّهُ مَا يَشَاءُ وَيُثْبِتُ ۖ وَعِندَهُ أُمُّ الْكِتَابِ
versets.phonetique: Yamhu-llahu ma yasha' wa yuthbit wa indahu umm al-kitab
versets.francais: Allah efface ce qu'Il veut et confirme ce qu'Il veut. Et près de Lui est la Mère du Livre.
versets.anglais: Allah eliminates what He wills or confirms, and with Him is the Mother of the Book

versets.arabe: وَإِمَّا نُرِيَنَّكَ بَعْضَ الَّذِي نَعِدُهُمْ أَوْ نَتَوَفَّيَنَّكَ فَإِلَيْنَا مَرْجِعُهُمْ ثُمَّ اللَّهُ شَهِيدٌ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفْعَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa imma nuriyannaka ba'da alladhi na'iduhum aw natawaffayyannaka fa-ilayna marji'uhum thumma-llahu shahid ala ma yaf'alun
versets.francais: Que ce soit le cas que Nous te montrions une partie de ce que Nous leur promettons ou que Nous te rappelions à Nous, ils retourneront vers Nous, et puis Allah est témoin de ce qu'ils font.
versets.anglais: And whether We show you part of what We promise them or take you in death, upon you is only the [duty of] notification, and upon Us is the account

versets.arabe: وَلِكُلِّ أُمَّةٍ رَّسُولٌ ۖ فَإِذَا جَاءَ رَسُولُهُمْ قُضِيَ بَيْنَهُم بِالْقِسْطِ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa li-kulli ummah rasul fa-idha ja'a rasuluhum qudiya baynahum bi-al-qist wa hum la yuzhlmun
versets.francais: À chaque communauté un Messager. Puis quand arrive son Messager, le jugement se prononce entre eux en toute justice, et ils ne sont point lésés.
versets.anglais: Have they not seen that We set upon the land, reducing it from its borders? And Allah decides; there is no adjuster of His decision. And He is swift in account

versets.arabe: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا الْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَادِقِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa yaqulun mata hadha al-wa'd in kuntum sadiqin
versets.francais: Et ils disent: "Quand donc se réalisera cette promesse, si vous dites vrai?"
versets.anglais: And those before them had plotted, but to Allah belongs the plan entirely. He knows what every soul earns, and the disbelievers will know for whom is the final home

versets.arabe: قُلْ لَا أَعْلَمُ أَنِ السَّاعَةَ تَأْتِي قَرِيبًا ۖ إِنْ أَتَّبِعُ إِلَّا مَا يُوحَىٰ إِلَيَّ وَمَا أَنَا إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
versets.phonetique: Qul la a'lam an as-saa'ah ta'ti qariban in attabi'u illa ma yujha ilayya wa ma ana illa nadhir mubin
versets.francais: Dis: "Je ne sais pas si l'Heure est proche. Je ne fais que suivre ce qui m'est révélé, et je ne suis qu'un avertisseur évident."
versets.anglais: And those who have disbelieved say, "You are not a messenger." Say, [O Muhammad], "Sufficient is Allah as Witness between me and you, and [the witness of] whoever has knowledge of the Scripture

versets.arabe: الر كِتَابٌ أَنْزَلْنَاهُ إِلَيْكَ لِتُخْرِجَ النَّاسَ مِنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النُّورِ
versets.phonetique: Alif lām rā kitābun anzalnāhu ilayka litukhrija-an-nāsa min-az-zulumāti ilā-an-nūr
versets.francais: Alif, Lām, Rā. C'est un Livre que Nous avons fait descendre sur toi, pour que tu fasses sortir les hommes des ténèbres à la lumière.
versets.anglais: Alif, Lam, Ra. [This is] a Book which We have revealed to you, [O Muhammad], that you might bring mankind out of darknesses into the light by permission of their Lord - to the path of the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy

versets.arabe: بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَاطِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَمِيدِ
versets.phonetique: Bi-idhni rabbihim ilā sirāti-al-'azīzi-al-hamīd
versets.francais: Par la permission de leur Seigneur vers le droit chemin du Puissant, de celui qui est digne de louange.
versets.anglais: Allah, to whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. And woe to the disbelievers from a severe punishment

versets.arabe: اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ
versets.phonetique: Allāhi-alladhī lahu mā fi-as-samāwāti wa-mā fi-al-ardi
versets.francais: Allah à qui appartient tout ce qui est dans les cieux et sur la terre.
versets.anglais: The ones who prefer the worldly life over the Hereafter and avert [people] from the way of Allah, seeking to make it (seem) deviant. Those are in extreme error

versets.arabe: وَوَيْلٌ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِنْ عَذَابٍ شَدِيدٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa-waylu li-alladhīn kafarū min 'adhābin shadīd
versets.francais: Et malheur aux mécréants, pour un châtiment terrible!
versets.anglais: And We did not send any messenger except [speaking] in the language of his people to state clearly for them, and Allah sends astray [thereby] whom He wills and guides whom He wills. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise

versets.arabe: الَّذِينَ يَسْتَحِبُّونَ الْحَيَاةَ الدُّنْيَا عَلَى الْآخِرَةِ
versets.phonetique: Alladhīn yastahabbun-al-hayāta-ad-dunyā 'alā-al-ākhirah
versets.francais: Ceux qui préfèrent la vie de ce monde à celle de l'au-delà.
versets.anglais: And We certainly sent Moses with Our signs, [saying], "Bring out your people from darknesses into the light and remind them of the days of Allah." Indeed in that are signs for everyone patient and grateful

versets.arabe: وَيَصِدُّونَ عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَيَبْغُونَهَا عِوَجًا
versets.phonetique: Wa-yasidd ūn 'an sabīl-Allāh wa-yabghūnaha 'iwaja
versets.francais: Et se détournent du sentier d'Allah en le cherchant tortueux.
versets.anglais: And [recall, O Children of Israel], when Moses said to His people, "Remember the favor of Allah upon you when He saved you from the people of Pharaoh, who were afflicting you with the worst torment and were slaughtering your [newborn] sons and keeping your females alive. And in that was a great trial from your Lord

versets.arabe: وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا مِنْ رَسُولٍ إِلَّا بِلِسَانِ قَوْمِهِ لِيُبَيِّنَ لَهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Wa-mā arsalnā min rasūlin illā bilisān qawmihi liyubayyina lahum
versets.francais: Nous n'avons envoyé aucun Messager, sinon dans la langue de son peuple, afin de lui exposer les choses clairement.
versets.anglais: And [remember] when your Lord proclaimed, 'If you are grateful, I will surely increase you [in favor]; but if you deny, indeed, My punishment is severe

versets.arabe: فَيُضِلُّ اللَّهُ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَيَهْدِي مَنْ يَشَاءُ
versets.phonetique: Fa-yudillu-Allāhu man yashā'u wa-yahdi man yashā'u
versets.francais: Allah égare qui Il veut et guide qui Il veut.
versets.anglais: And Moses said, "If you should disbelieve, you and whoever is on the earth entirely - indeed, Allah is Free of need and Praiseworthy

versets.arabe: وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ
versets.phonetique: Wa-huwa-al-'azīzu-al-hakīm
versets.francais: Et c'est Lui le Puissant, le Sage.
versets.anglais: Has there not reached you the news of those before you - the people of Noah and 'Aad and Thamud and those after them? No one knows them but Allah. Their messengers brought them clear proofs, but they returned their hands to their mouths and said, "Indeed, we disbelieve in that with which you have been sent, and indeed we are, about that to which you invite us, in disquieting doubt

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ بِآيَاتِنَا أَنْ أَخْرِجْ قَوْمَكَ مِنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النُّورِ
versets.phonetique: Wa-laqad arsalnā mūsā bi-āyātinā an akhri j qawmaka min-az-zulumāti ilā-an-nūr
versets.francais: Et certes, Nous avons envoyé Moïse avec Nos signes (disant): Fais sortir ton peuple des ténèbres à la lumière.
versets.anglais: Their messengers said, "Can there be doubt about Allah, Creator of the heavens and earth? He invites you that He may forgive you of your sins, and He delays your death for a specified term." They said, "You are not but men like us who wish to avert us from what our fathers were worshipping. So bring us a clear authority

versets.arabe: وَذَكِّرْهُمْ بِأَيَّامِ اللَّهِ
versets.phonetique: Wa-dhakkir-hum bi-ayyāmi-Allāh
versets.francais: Et rappelle-lui les jours d'Allah.
versets.anglais: Their messengers said to them, "We are only men like you, but Allah confers favor upon whom He wills of His servants. It has never been for us to bring you evidence except by permission of Allah. And upon Allah let the believers rely

versets.arabe: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَاتٍ لِكُلِّ صَبَّارٍ شَكُورٍ
versets.phonetique: Inna fi dhālik la-āyātin likulli sabbārin shakūr
versets.francais: Il y a là des signes pour quiconque est endurant et reconnaissant.
versets.anglais: And why should we not rely upon Allah while He has guided us to our [good] ways. And we will surely be patient against whatever harm you should cause us. And upon Allah let those who would rely [indeed] rely

versets.arabe: وَإِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِقَوْمِهِ اذْكُرُوا نِعْمَةَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ إِذْ أَنْجَاكُمْ مِنْ آلِ فِرْعَوْنَ
versets.phonetique: Wa-idh qāla mūsā liqawmihi-idhkurū ni'mata-Allāh 'alaykum idh anjākum min āli fi'awn
versets.francais: Et (rappelle-toi) quand Moïse dit à son peuple: Souvenez-vous du bienfait d'Allah envers vous, quand Il vous a sauvés des gens de Pharaon.
versets.anglais: And those who disbelieved said to their messengers, "We will surely drive you out of our land, or you must return to our religion." So their Lord inspired to them, "We will surely destroy the wrongdoers

versets.arabe: يَسُومُونَكُمْ سُوءَ الْعَذَابِ وَيُذَبِّحُونَ أَبْنَاءَكُمْ وَيَسْتَحْيُونَ نِسَاءَكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Yasūmūnakum sū'a-al-'adhāb wa-yudhabbihūn abnā'akum wa-yastahyūn nisā'akum
versets.francais: Ils vous infligeaient le pire châtiment et égorgaient vos fils, laissant vivre vos femmes.
versets.anglais: And We will surely cause you to dwell in the land after them. That is for he who fears My position and fears My threat

versets.arabe: وَفِي ذَٰلِكُمْ بَلَاءٌ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ عَظِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa-fi dhālikum balā'un min rabbikum 'azīm
versets.francais: Et en cela il y avait une grande épreuve de la part de votre Seigneur.
versets.anglais: And they requested victory from Allah, and disappointed, [therefore], was every obstinate tyrant

versets.arabe: وَإِذْ تَأَذَّنَ رَبُّكُمْ لَئِنْ شَكَرْتُمْ لَأَزِيدَنَّكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Wa-idh ta-addhana rabbukum la-in shakartu lā-aziданnakum
versets.francais: Et (rappelle-toi) quand votre Seigneur proclama: "Si vous êtes reconnaissants, Je vous augmenterai;"
versets.anglais: Before him is Hell, and he will be given a drink of purulent water

versets.arabe: وَلَئِنْ كَفَرْتُمْ إِنَّ عَذَابِي لَشَدِيدٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa-la-in kafartu mْ inna 'adhābi lashadīd
versets.francais: et si vous êtes ingrats, certes, Mon châtiment est terrible."
versets.anglais: He will gulp it but will hardly [be able to] swallow it. And death will come to him from everywhere, but he is not to die. And before him is a massive punishment

versets.arabe: وَقَالَ مُوسَىٰ إِنْ تَكْفُرُوا أَنْتُمْ وَمَنْ فِي الْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَغَنِيٌّ حَمِيدٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa-qāla mūsā in takfurū antum wa-man fi-al-ardi jamī'an fa-inna-Allāh laghanīyun hamīd
versets.francais: Et Moïse dit: "Si vous êtes ingrats, vous et tous ceux qui sont sur la terre, Allah est certes Riche et Digne de louange."
versets.anglais: The example of those who disbelieve in their Lord is [that] their deeds are like ashes which the wind blows forcefully on a stormy day; they are unable [to keep] from what they earned a [single] thing. That is what is extreme error

versets.arabe: أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ نَبَأُ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ قَوْمِ نُوحٍ وَعَادٍ وَثَمُودَ
