versets.phonetique: Yatawārā mina l-qawmi min sū'i mā bushshira bihi ayumsikuhu 'alā hūnin am yadussuhu fī t-turābi alā sā'a mā yaḥkumūn
versets.francais: Il se cache des gens à cause du malheur de l'annonce qu'il a reçue. Va-t-il garder l'enfant malgré la honte, ou l'enterrer dans la terre? C'est vraiment un mauvais jugement qu'ils font.
versets.anglais: He hides himself from the people because of the ill of which he has been informed. Should he keep it in humiliation or bury it in the ground? Unquestionably, evil is what they decide

versets.arabe: لِلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْآخِرَةِ مَثَلُ السَّوْءِ ۖ وَلِلَّهِ الْمَثَلُ الْأَعْلَىٰ ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ
versets.phonetique: Lilladhīna lā yu'minūna bil-ākhirati mathalu s-saw'i walillāhi l-mathalu l-a'lā wahuwa l-'azīzu l-ḥakīm
versets.francais: Ceux qui ne croient pas en l'au-delà méritent la mauvaise qualification. Et c'est à Allah que s'applique la qualification suprême. Il est le Puissant, le Sage.
versets.anglais: For those who do not believe in the Hereafter is the description of evil; and for Allah is the highest attribute. And He is Exalted in Might, the Wise

versets.arabe: وَلَوْ يُؤَاخِذُ اللَّهُ النَّاسَ بِظُلْمِهِم مَّا تَرَكَ عَلَيْهَا مِن دَابَّةٍ وَلَٰكِن يُؤَخِّرُهُمْ إِلَىٰ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۖ فَإِذَا جَاءَ أَجَلُهُمْ لَا يَسْتَأْخِرُونَ سَاعَةً ۖ وَلَا يَسْتَقْدِمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Walaw yu'ākhidhu llāhu n-nāsa biẓulmihim mā taraka 'alayhā min dābbatin walākin yu'akhkhiruhum ilā ajalin musamman fa'idhā jā'a ajaluhum lā yasta'khirūna sā'atan walā yastaqddimūn
versets.francais: Si Allah prenait les gens à tâche pour leur injustice, il ne laisserait sur terre aucune bête. Mais Il les reporte jusqu'à un terme fixé. Quand leur terme viendra, ils ne pourront pas le retarder d'une heure ni l'avancer.
versets.anglais: And if Allah were to impose blame on the people for their wrongdoing, He would not have left upon the earth any creature, but He defers them for a specified term. And when their term has come, they will not remain behind an hour, nor will they precede [it]

versets.arabe: وَيَجْعَلُونَ لِلَّهِ مَا يَكْرَهُونَ وَتَصِفُ أَلْسِنَتُهُمُ الْكَذِبَ أَنَّ لَهُمُ الْحُسْنَىٰ ۖ لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّ لَهُمُ النَّارَ وَأَنَّهُم مُّفْرَطُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wayaj'alūna lillāhi mā yakrahūna wataṣifu alsinatuhumu l-kadhiba anna lahumu l-ḥusnā lā jarama anna lahumu n-nāra wa'annahum mufraṭūn
versets.francais: Et ils attribuent à Allah ce qu'ils détestent. Et leurs langues énoncent le mensonge: qu'il y aura pour eux une belle récompense. Nul doute qu'il y aura pour eux le Feu et qu'ils y seront les premiers.
versets.anglais: And they attribute to Allah that which they dislike, and their tongues assert the lie that they will have the best [from Him]. Assuredly, they will have the Fire, and they will be [therein] neglected

versets.arabe: تَاللَّهِ لَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا إِلَىٰ أُمَمٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ فَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الشَّيْطَانُ أَعْمَالَهُمْ فَهُوَ وَلِيُّهُمُ الْيَوْمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Tallāhi laqad arsalnā ilā umaamin min qablika fazayyanna lahumu sh-shayṭānu a'mālahum fahuwa waliyyuhumu l-yawma walahum 'adhābun alīm
versets.francais: Par Allah! Nous avons certes envoyé [des messagers] à des communautés avant toi, et le Diable leur a embelli leurs actions. Il est donc leur allié aujourd'hui. Et ils auront un châtiment douloureux.
versets.anglais: By Allah, We did certainly send [messengers] to nations before you, but Satan made their deeds attractive to them. And he is the disbelievers' ally today [as well], and they will have a painful punishment

versets.arabe: وَمَا أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ الْكِتَابَ إِلَّا لِتُبَيِّنَ لَهُمُ الَّذِي اخْتَلَفُوا فِيهِ ۙ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wamā anzalnā 'alayka l-kitāba illā litubayyina lahumu lladhī khtalaFū fīhi wahudanw waraḥmatan liqawmin yu'minūn
versets.francais: Et Nous n'avons fait descendre sur toi le Livre que pour que tu leur expliques clairement ce sur quoi ils divergent, et en tant que guide et miséricorde pour les croyants.
versets.anglais: And We have not revealed to you the Book, [O Muhammad], except for you to make clear to them that wherein they have differed and as guidance and mercy for a people who believe

versets.arabe: وَاللَّهُ أَنزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَأَحْيَا بِهِ الْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا ۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَسْمَعُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wallāhu anzala mina s-samā'i mā'an fa'aḥyā bihi l-arḍa ba'da mawtihā inna fī dhālika la'āyatan liqawmin yasma'ūn
versets.francais: Allah a fait descendre du ciel de l'eau et a redonné vie à la terre après sa mort. Il y a là certes un signe pour des gens qui écoutent.
versets.anglais: And Allah has sent down rain from the sky and given life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who listen

versets.arabe: وَإِنَّ لَكُمْ فِي الْأَنْعَامِ لَعِبْرَةً ۖ نُّسْقِيكُم مِّمَّا فِي بُطُونِهِ مِن بَيْنِ فَرْثٍ وَدَمٍ لَّبَنًا خَالِصًا سَائِغًا لِّلشَّارِبِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa'inna lakum fī l-an'āmi la'ibratun nusqīkum mimmā fī buṭūnihi min bayni farthin wadamin labanan khāliṣan sā'ighan lil-shāribīn
versets.francais: Il y a certes pour vous une leçon dans les bestiaux. Nous vous abreuvons de ce qui est dans leurs ventres, entre les excréments et le sang: du lait pur et agréable à boire.
versets.anglais: And indeed, for you in grazing livestock is a lesson. We give you drink from what is in their bellies - between excretion and blood - pure milk, palatable to drinkers

versets.arabe: وَمِن ثَمَرَاتِ النَّخِيلِ وَالْأَعْنَابِ تَتَّخِذُونَ مِنْهُ سَكَرًا وَرِزْقًا حَسَنًا ۗ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wamin thamarāti n-nakhīli wal-a'nābi tattakhidhūna minhu sakaran warizqan ḥasanan inna fī dhālika la'āyatan liqawmin ya'qilūn
versets.francais: Et des fruits des palmiers et des vignes, vous tirez une boisson enivrante et une bonne nourriture. Il y a là certes un signe pour des gens qui raisonnent.
versets.anglais: And from the fruits of the palm trees and grapevines you take intoxicant and good provision. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who reason

versets.arabe: وَأَوْحَىٰ رَبُّكَ إِلَى النَّحْلِ أَنِ اتَّخِذِي مِنَ الْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا وَمِنَ الشَّجَرِ وَمِمَّا يَعْرِشُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa'awḥā rabbuka ilā n-naḥli ani ttakhidhī mina l-jibāli buyūtan wamina sh-shajari wamimmā ya'rishūn
versets.francais: Ton Seigneur a révélé aux abeilles: «Prenez des maisons dans les montagnes, dans les arbres et dans les constructions que font les hommes.»
versets.anglais: And your Lord inspired to the bee, "Take for yourself among the mountains, houses, and among the trees and [in] that which they construct

versets.arabe: ثُمَّ كُلِي مِن كُلِّ الثَّمَرَاتِ فَاسْلُكِي سُبُلَ رَبِّكِ ذُلُلًا ۚ يَخْرُجُ مِن بُطُونِهَا شَرَابٌ مُّخْتَلِفٌ أَلْوَانُهُ فِيهِ شِفَاءٌ لِّلنَّاسِ ۗ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Thumma kulī min kulli th-thamarāti faslukī subula rabbiki dhululan yakhruju min buṭūnihā sharābun mukhtalifun alwānuhu fīhi shifā'un lin-nāsi inna fī dhālika la'āyatan liqawmin yatafakkarūn
versets.francais: «Puis mange de toutes sortes de fruits et suis les sentiers de ton Seigneur en toute docilité.» De leurs ventres sort une boisson de couleurs variées, dans laquelle il y a une guérison pour les gens. Il y a là certes un signe pour des gens qui réfléchissent.
versets.anglais: Then eat from all the fruits and follow the ways of your Lord laid down [for you]." There emerges from their bellies a drink, varying in colors, in which there is healing for people. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who give thought

versets.arabe: وَاللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمْ ثُمَّ يَتَوَفَّاكُمْ ۚ وَمِنكُم مَّن يُرَدُّ إِلَىٰ أَرْذَلِ الْعُمُرِ لِكَيْ لَا يَعْلَمَ بَعْدَ عِلْمٍ شَيْئًا ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ قَدِيرٌ
versets.phonetique: Wallāhu khalaqakum thumma yatawaffākum waminkum man yuraddu ilā ardhali l-'umuri likay lā ya'lama ba'da 'ilmin shay'an inna llāha 'alīmun qadīr
versets.francais: Et Allah vous a créés. Puis Il vous fera mourir. Et parmi vous il y a celui qui est ramené à l'âge le plus décrépit, de sorte qu'il ne sache plus rien après avoir su. Allah est Omniscient et Omnipotent.
versets.anglais: And Allah created you; then He will take you in death. And among you is he who is reversed to the most decrepit [old] age so that he will not know, after [having had] knowledge, a thing. Indeed, Allah is Knowing and Competent

versets.arabe: وَاللَّهُ فَضَّلَ بَعْضَكُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ فِي الرِّزْقِ ۚ فَمَا الَّذِينَ فُضِّلُوا بِرَادِّي رِزْقِهِمْ عَلَىٰ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُهُمْ فَهُمْ فِيهِ سَوَاءٌ
versets.phonetique: Wallāhu faḍḍala ba'ḍakum 'alā ba'ḍin fī r-rizqi famā lladhīna fuḍḍilū birāddī rizqihim 'alā mā malakat aymānuhum fahum fīhi sawā'
versets.francais: Et Allah a favorisé certains d'entre vous par rapport à d'autres en matière de subsistance. Ceux qui ont été favorisés ne vont certes pas remettre leur subsistance à leurs esclaves pour être tous à égalité.
versets.anglais: And Allah has favored some of you over others in provision. But those who were favored would not hand over their provision to those whom their right hands possess so they would be equal to them therein. Then is it the favor of Allah they reject

versets.arabe: وَاللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَزْوَاجًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنْ أَزْوَاجِكُم بَنِينَ وَحَفَدَةً وَرَزَقَكُم مِّنَ الطَّيِّبَاتِ ۚ أَفَبِالْبَاطِلِ يُؤْمِنُونَ وَبِنِعْمَتِ اللَّهِ هُمْ يَكْفُرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wallāhu ja'ala lakum min anfusikum azwājan waja'ala lakum min azwājikum banīna waḥafadatan warazaqakum mina ṭ-ṭayyibāti afabil-bāṭili yu'minūna wabini'mati llāhi hum yakfurūn
versets.francais: Et Allah vous a donné des épouses tirées de vous-mêmes, et a fait pour vous, de vos épouses, des fils et des petits-fils, et vous a attribué de bonnes nourritures. Croient-ils donc au mensonge et rejettent-ils le bienfait d'Allah?
versets.anglais: And Allah has made for you from yourselves mates and has made for you from your mates sons and grandchildren and has provided for you from the good things. Then in falsehood do they believe and in the favor of Allah they disbelieve

versets.arabe: وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ مَا لَا يَمْلِكُ لَهُمْ رِزْقًا مِّنَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ شَيْئًا وَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ
versets.phonetique: Waya'budūna min dūni llāhi mā lā yamliku lahum rizqan mina s-samāwāti wal-arḍi shay'an walā yastaṭī'ūn
versets.francais: Et ils adorent en dehors d'Allah des choses qui n'ont aucun pouvoir de leur donner quelque subsistance que ce soit venant des cieux et de la terre, et qui n'en sont pas capables.
versets.anglais: And they worship besides Allah that which does not possess for them [the power of] provision from the heavens and the earth at all, and [in fact], they are unable

versets.arabe: فَلَا تَضْرِبُوا لِلَّهِ الْأَمْثَالَ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Falā taḍribū lillāhi l-amthāla inna llāha ya'lamu wa'antum lā ta'lamūn
versets.francais: Ne donnez donc pas d'équivalents à Allah. Certes Allah sait et vous ne savez pas.
versets.anglais: So do not assert similarities to Allah. Indeed, Allah knows and you do not know

versets.arabe: ضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلًا عَبْدًا مَّمْلُوكًا لَّا يَقْدِرُ عَلَىٰ شَيْءٍ وَمَن رَّزَقْنَاهُ مِنَّا رِزْقًا حَسَنًا فَهُوَ يُنفِقُ مِنْهُ سِرًّا وَجَهْرًا ۖ هَلْ يَسْتَوُونَ
versets.phonetique: Ḍaraba llāhu mathalan 'abdan mamlūkan lā yaqdiru 'alā shay'in waman razaqnāhu minnā rizqan ḥasanan fahuwa yunfiqu minhu sirran wajahran hal yastawūn
versets.francais: Allah propose la parabole d'un esclave appartenant à un maître, ne disposant de rien, et d'un homme à qui Nous avons accordé de Notre part une belle subsistance dont il dépense en secret et en public. Sont-ils égaux?
versets.anglais: Allah presents an example: a slave [who is] owned and unable to do a thing and he to whom We have provided from Us good provision, so he spends from it secretly and publicly. Can they be equal? Praise to Allah! But most of them do not know

versets.arabe: وَضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلًا رَّجُلَيْنِ أَحَدُهُمَا أَبْكَمُ لَا يَقْدِرُ عَلَىٰ شَيْءٍ وَهُوَ كَلٌّ عَلَىٰ مَوْلَاهُ أَيْنَمَا يُوَجِّههُّ لَا يَأْتِ بِخَيْرٍ ۖ هَلْ يَسْتَوِي هُوَ وَمَن يَأْمُرُ بِالْعَدْلِ ۙ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
versets.phonetique: Waḍaraba llāhu mathalan rajulayni aḥaduhumā abkamu lā yaqdiru 'alā shay'in wahuwa kallun 'alā mawlāhu aynamā yuwajjihhū lā ya'ti bikhayrin hal yastawī huwa waman ya'muru bil-'adli wahuwa 'alā ṣirāṭin mustaqīm
versets.francais: Et Allah propose la parabole de deux hommes dont l'un est muet, ne peut rien faire et est à la charge de son maître; partout où son maître l'envoie, il ne rapporte rien de bon. Est-il l'égal de celui qui ordonne la justice et qui est sur un droit chemin?
versets.anglais: And Allah presents an example of two men, one of them dumb and unable to do a thing, while he is a burden to his guardian. Wherever he directs him, he brings no good. Is he equal to one who commands justice, while he is on a straight path

versets.arabe: وَلِلَّهِ غَيْبُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۚ وَمَا أَمْرُ السَّاعَةِ إِلَّا كَلَمْحِ الْبَصَرِ أَوْ هُوَ أَقْرَبُ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
versets.phonetique: Walillāhi ghaybu s-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā amru s-sā'ati illā kalamḥi l-baṣari aw huwa aqrabu inna llāha 'alā kulli shay'in qadīr
versets.francais: Et à Allah appartient l'invisible des cieux et de la terre. Et l'ordre de l'Heure n'est que comme un clin d'œil ou encore plus rapide. Certes Allah est Omnipotent.
versets.anglais: And to Allah belongs the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth. And the command for the Hour is not but as a glance of the eye or even nearer. Indeed, Allah is over all things competent

versets.arabe: وَاللَّهُ أَخْرَجَكُم مِّن بُطُونِ أُمَّهَاتِكُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ شَيْئًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ السَّمْعَ وَالْأَبْصَارَ وَالْأَفْئِدَةَ ۙ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wallāhu akhrajakum min buṭūni ummahātikum lā ta'lamūna shay'an waja'ala lakumu s-sam'a wal-abṣāra wal-af'idata la'allakum tashkurūn
versets.francais: Et Allah vous a fait sortir du ventre de vos mères sans que vous ne sachiez rien. Et Il vous a donné l'ouïe, les yeux et les cœurs, afin que vous soyez reconnaissants.
versets.anglais: And Allah has extracted you from the wombs of your mothers not knowing a thing, and He made for you hearing and vision and intellect that perhaps you would be grateful

versets.arabe: أَلَمْ يَرَوْا إِلَى الطَّيْرِ مُسَخَّرَاتٍ فِي جَوِّ السَّمَاءِ مَا يُمْسِكُهُنَّ إِلَّا اللَّهُ ۗ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَاتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ
versets.phonetique: Alam yaraw ilā ṭ-ṭayri musakhkharātin fī jawwi s-samā'i mā yumsikuhunna illā llāhu inna fī dhālika la'āyātin liqawmin yu'minūn
versets.francais: N'ont-ils pas regardé les oiseaux assujettis dans les airs du ciel? Rien ne les retient sinon Allah. Il y a là certes des signes pour des gens qui croient.
versets.anglais: Do they not see the birds controlled in the atmosphere of the sky? None holds them up except Allah. Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe

versets.arabe: وَاللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّن بُيُوتِكُمْ سَكَنًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّن جُلُودِ الْأَنْعَامِ بُيُوتًا تَسْتَخِفُّونَهَا يَوْمَ ظَعْنِكُمْ وَيَوْمَ إِقَامَتِكُمْ ۙ وَمِنْ أَصْوَافِهَا وَأَوْبَارِهَا وَأَشْعَارِهَا أَثَاثًا وَمَتَاعًا إِلَىٰ حِينٍ
versets.phonetique: Wallāhu ja'ala lakum min buyūtikum sakanan waja'ala lakum min julūdi l-an'āmi buyūtan tastakhiffūnahā yawma ẓa'nikum wayawma iqāmatikum wamin aṣwāfihā wa'awbārihā wa'ash'ārihā athāthan wamata'an ilā ḥīn
versets.francais: Et Allah vous a donné vos maisons comme lieu de repos, et vous a donné des maisons [de tentes] en peaux de bétail que vous trouvez légères le jour de votre déplacement et le jour de votre séjour, et de leurs laines, poils et crins, des meubles et des biens pour un temps.
versets.anglais: And Allah has made for you from your homes a place of rest and made for you from the hides of the animals tents which you find light on your day of travel and your day of encampment; and from their wool, fur and hair is furnishing and enjoyment for a time

versets.arabe: وَاللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّمَّا خَلَقَ ظِلَالًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ الْجِبَالِ أَكْنَانًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمْ سَرَابِيلَ تَقِيكُمُ الْحَرَّ وَسَرَابِيلَ تَقِيكُم بَأْسَكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Wallāhu ja'ala lakum mimmā khalaqa ẓilālan waja'ala lakum mina l-jibāli aknānan waja'ala lakum sarābīla taqīkumu l-ḥarra wasarābīla taqīkum ba'sakum
versets.francais: Et Allah vous a donné des ombrages de ce qu'Il a créé. Il vous a donné des refuges dans les montagnes, et Il vous a donné des vêtements qui vous protègent de la chaleur, et des vêtements qui vous protègent de la violence de la guerre.
versets.anglais: And Allah has made for you, from that which He has created, shadows and has made for you from the mountains, shelters and has made for you garments which protect you from the heat and garments which protect you from your [enemy in] battle. Thus does He complete His favor upon you that you might submit [to Him]

versets.arabe: فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا فَإِنَّمَا عَلَيْكَ الْبَلَاغُ الْمُبِينُ
versets.phonetique: Fa'in tawallū fa'innamā 'alayka l-balāghu l-mubīn
versets.francais: Si alors ils se détournent, tu n'es chargé que de la transmission claire du message.
versets.anglais: But if they turn away, [O Muhammad] - then only upon you is [responsibility for] clear notification

versets.arabe: يَعْرِفُونَ نِعْمَتَ اللَّهِ ثُمَّ يُنكِرُونَهَا وَأَكْثَرُهُمُ الْكَافِرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Ya'rifūna ni'mata llāhi thumma yunkirūnahā wa'aktharuhumu l-kāfirūn
versets.francais: Ils reconnaissent le bienfait d'Allah et ils le nient. Et la plupart d'entre eux sont ingrats.
versets.anglais: They recognize the favor of Allah; then they deny it. And most of them are disbelievers

versets.arabe: وَيَوْمَ نَبْعَثُ مِن كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ شَهِيدًا ثُمَّ لَا يُؤْذَنُ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَلَا هُمْ يُسْتَعْتَبُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wayawma nab'athu min kulli ummatin shahīdan thumma lā yu'dhanu lilladhīna kafarū walā hum yusta'tabūn
versets.francais: Et le jour où Nous ressusciterons de chaque communauté un témoin, les mécréants n'auront pas la permission [de s'expliquer] et on ne leur demandera pas d'expiation.
versets.anglais: And [mention] the Day when We will resurrect from every nation a witness. Then it will not be permitted to the disbelievers [to apologize or make excuses], nor will they be asked to appease [Allah]

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا رَأَى الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا الْعَذَابَ فَلَا يُخَفَّفُ عَنْهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنظَرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa'idhā ra'ā lladhīna ẓalamū l-'adhāba falā yukhaffafu 'anhum walā hum yunẓarūn
versets.francais: Et quand les injustes verront le châtiment, il ne leur sera pas allégé et ils n'auront pas de délai.
versets.anglais: And when those who wronged see the punishment, it will not be lightened for them, nor will they be reprieved

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا رَأَى الَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوا شُرَكَاءَهُمْ قَالُوا رَبَّنَا هَٰؤُلَاءِ شُرَكَاؤُنَا الَّذِينَ كُنَّا نَدْعُو مِن دُونِكَ ۖ فَأَلْقَوْا إِلَيْهِمُ الْقَوْلَ إِنَّكُمْ لَكَاذِبُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa'idhā ra'ā lladhīna ashrakū shurakā'ahum qālū rabbanā hā'ulā'i shurakā'unā lladhīna kunnā nad'ū min dūnika fa'alqaw ilayhimu l-qawla innakum lakādhibūn
versets.francais: Et quand ceux qui ont associé verront leurs associés, ils diront: «Seigneur, voici nos associés que nous invoquions en dehors de Toi.» Et ceux-là leur lanceront la parole: «Vous êtes certes menteurs.»
versets.anglais: And when those who associated others with Allah see their "partners," they will say," Our Lord, these are our partners [to You] whom we used to invoke besides You." But they will throw at them the statement, "Indeed, you are liars

versets.arabe: وَأَلْقَوْا إِلَى اللَّهِ يَوْمَئِذٍ السَّلَمَ ۖ وَضَلَّ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا يَفْتَرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa'alqaw ilā llāhi yawma'idhin s-salama waḍalla 'anhum mā kānū yaftarūn
versets.francais: Et ce jour-là ils présenteront leur soumission à Allah, et ce qu'ils inventaient les abandonnera.
versets.anglais: And they will impart to Allah that Day [their] submission, and lost from them is what they used to invent

versets.arabe: الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَصَدُّوا عَن سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ زِدْنَاهُمْ عَذَابًا فَوْقَ الْعَذَابِ بِمَا كَانُوا يُفْسِدُونَ
versets.phonetique: Alladhīna kafarū waṣaddū 'an sabīli llāhi zidnāhum 'adhāban fawqa l-'adhābi bimā kānū yufsidūn
versets.francais: Ceux qui ont mécru et fait obstacle au sentier d'Allah, Nous leur ajouterons un châtiment par-dessus leur châtiment, parce qu'ils semaient la corruption.
versets.anglais: Those who disbelieved and averted [others] from the way of Allah - We will increase them in punishment over [their] punishment for what corruption they were causing

versets.arabe: وَيَوْمَ نَبْعَثُ فِي كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ شَهِيدًا عَلَيْهِم مِّنْ أَنفُسِهِمْ ۖ وَجِئْنَا بِكَ شَهِيدًا عَلَىٰ هَٰؤُلَاءِ ۚ وَنَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ الْكِتَابَ تِبْيَانًا لِّكُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةً وَبُشْرَىٰ لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wayawma nab'athu fī kulli ummatin shahīdan 'alayhim min anfusihim waji'nā bika shahīdan 'alā hā'ulā'i wanazzalnā 'alayka l-kitāba tibyānan likulli shay'in wahudanw waraḥmatan wabushrā lil-muslimīn
versets.francais: Et le jour où Nous ressusciterons dans chaque communauté un témoin contre eux tiré d'eux-mêmes, et que Nous t'amènerons comme témoin contre ceux-ci. Et Nous avons fait descendre sur toi le Livre, comme explication de toute chose, et comme guide, miséricorde et bonne annonce aux Musulmans.
versets.anglais: And [mention] the Day when We will resurrect among every nation a witness over them from themselves. And We will bring you, [O Muhammad], as a witness over your nation. And We have sent down to you the Book as clarification for all things and as guidance and mercy and good tidings for the Muslims

versets.arabe: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَأْمُرُ بِالْعَدْلِ وَالْإِحْسَانِ وَإِيتَاءِ ذِي الْقُرْبَىٰ وَيَنْهَىٰ عَنِ الْفَحْشَاءِ وَالْمُنكَرِ وَالْبَغْيِ ۚ يَعِظُكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Inna llāha ya'muru bil-'adli wal-iḥsāni wa'ītā'i dhī l-qurbā wayanhā 'ani l-faḥshā'i wal-munkari wal-baghyi ya'iẓukum la'allakum tadhakkarūn
versets.francais: Certes Allah commande l'équité, la bienfaisance et l'assistance aux proches. Et Il interdit la turpitude, le blâmable et l'injustice. Il vous exhorte afin que vous vous souveniez.
versets.anglais: Indeed, Allah orders justice and good conduct and giving to relatives and forbids immorality and bad conduct and oppression. He admonishes you that perhaps you will be reminded

versets.arabe: وَأَوْفُوا بِعَهْدِ اللَّهِ إِذَا عَاهَدتُّمْ وَلَا تَنقُضُوا الْأَيْمَانَ بَعْدَ تَوْكِيدِهَا وَقَدْ جَعَلْتُمُ اللَّهَ عَلَيْكُمْ كَفِيلًا ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa'awfū bi'ahdi llāhi idhā 'āhadttum walā tanquḍū l-aymāna ba'da tawkīdihā waqad ja'altumu llāha 'alaykum kafīlan inna llāha ya'lamu mā taf'alūn
versets.francais: Et remplissez votre engagement envers Allah quand vous vous êtes engagés, et ne violez pas les serments après les avoir confirmés, alors que vous avez pris Allah pour garant. Certes Allah sait ce que vous faites.
versets.anglais: And fulfill the covenant of Allah when you have taken it, [O believers], and do not break oaths after their confirmation while you have made Allah, over you, a witness. Indeed, Allah knows what you do

versets.arabe: وَلَا تَكُونُوا كَالَّتِي نَقَضَتْ غَزْلَهَا مِن بَعْدِ قُوَّةٍ أَنكَاثًا تَتَّخِذُونَ أَيْمَانَكُمْ دَخَلًا بَيْنَكُمْ أَن تَكُونَ أُمَّةٌ هِيَ أَرْبَىٰ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ
versets.phonetique: Walā takūnū kalllatī naqaḍat ghazlahā min ba'di quwwatin ankāthan tattakhidhūna aymānakum dakhalan baynakum an takūna ummatun hiya arbā min ummatin
versets.francais: Et ne soyez pas comme celle qui défaisait son fil après l'avoir fortement tissé, en prenant vos serments comme moyen de tromperie entre vous parce qu'une communauté est plus nombreuse qu'une autre.
versets.anglais: And do not be like she who untwisted her spun thread after it was strong [by] taking your oaths as [means of] deceit between you because one community is more plentiful [in number or wealth] than another community. Allah only tries you thereby. And He will surely make clear to you on the Day of Resurrection that over which you used to differ

versets.arabe: وَلَوْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ لَجَعَلَكُمْ أُمَّةً وَاحِدَةً وَلَٰكِن يُضِلُّ مَن يَشَاءُ وَيَهْدِي مَن يَشَاءُ ۚ وَلَتُسْأَلُنَّ عَمَّا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Walaw shā'a llāhu laja'alakum ummatan wāḥidatan walākin yuḍillu man yashā'u wayahdī man yashā'u walatus'alunna 'ammā kuntum ta'malūn
versets.francais: Et si Allah l'avait voulu, Il aurait fait de vous une seule communauté. Mais Il égare qui Il veut et guide qui Il veut. Et on vous demandera certes des comptes sur ce que vous faisiez.
versets.anglais: And if Allah had willed, He could have made you [of] one religion, but He causes to stray whom He wills and guides whom He wills. And you will surely be questioned about what you used to do

versets.arabe: وَلَا تَتَّخِذُوا أَيْمَانَكُمْ دَخَلًا بَيْنَكُمْ فَتَزِلَّ قَدَمٌ بَعْدَ ثُبُوتِهَا وَتَذُوقُوا السُّوءَ بِمَا صَدَدتُّمْ عَن سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ۖ وَلَكُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Walā tattakhidhū aymānakum dakhalan baynakum fatazilla qadamun ba'da thubūtihā watad hūqū s-sū'a bimā ṣadadttum 'an sabīli llāhi walakum 'adhābun 'aẓīm
versets.francais: Et ne prenez pas vos serments comme moyen de tromperie entre vous, sinon un pied glissera après avoir été ferme. Et vous goûterez au malheur pour avoir fait obstacle au sentier d'Allah. Et vous aurez un énorme châtiment.
versets.anglais: And do not take your oaths as [means of] deceit between you, lest a foot slip after it was [once] firm, and you would taste evil [in this world] for what [people] you diverted from the way of Allah, and you would have [in the Hereafter] a great punishment

versets.arabe: وَلَا تَشْتَرُوا بِعَهْدِ اللَّهِ ثَمَنًا قَلِيلًا ۚ إِنَّمَا عِندَ اللَّهِ هُوَ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Walā tashtarū bi'ahdi llāhi thamanan qalīlan innamā 'inda llāhi huwa khayrun lakum in kuntum ta'lamūn
versets.francais: Et ne vendez pas l'engagement d'Allah pour un prix dérisoire. Ce qu'il y a auprès d'Allah est meilleur pour vous si vous saviez.
versets.anglais: And do not exchange the covenant of Allah for a small price. Indeed, what is with Allah is best for you, if only you could know

versets.arabe: مَا عِندَكُمْ يَنفَدُ ۖ وَمَا عِندَ اللَّهِ بَاقٍ ۗ وَلَنَجْزِيَنَّ الَّذِينَ صَبَرُوا أَجْرَهُم بِأَحْسَنِ مَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Mā 'indakum yanfadu wamā 'inda llāhi bāqin walanajziyanana lladhīna ṣabarū ajrahum bi'aḥsani mā kānū ya'malūn
versets.francais: Ce que vous avez s'épuisera, mais ce qu'Allah a est permanent. Et Nous récompenserons certes ceux qui ont enduré, selon le meilleur de ce qu'ils faisaient.
versets.anglais: Whatever you have will end, but what Allah has is lasting. And We will surely give those who were patient their reward according to the best of what they used to do

versets.arabe: مَنْ عَمِلَ صَالِحًا مِّن ذَكَرٍ أَوْ أُنثَىٰ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَلَنُحْيِيَنَّهُ حَيَاةً طَيِّبَةً ۖ وَلَنَجْزِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْرَهُم بِأَحْسَنِ مَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Man 'amila ṣāliḥan min dhakarin aw unthā wahuwa mu'minun falanuhyiyannahu ḥayātan ṭayyibatan walanajziyannahum ajrahum bi'aḥsani mā kānū ya'malūn
versets.francais: Quiconque, mâle ou femelle, fait le bien tout en étant croyant, Nous lui ferons vivre une bonne vie. Et Nous leur accorderons certes leur récompense selon le meilleur de ce qu'ils faisaient.
versets.anglais: Whoever does righteousness, whether male or female, while he is a believer - We will surely cause him to live a good life, and We will surely give them their reward [in the Hereafter] according to the best of what they used to do

versets.arabe: فَإِذَا قَرَأْتَ الْقُرْآنَ فَاسْتَعِذْ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
versets.phonetique: Fa'idhā qara'ta l-qur'āna fasta'idh billāhi mina sh-shayṭāni r-rajīm
versets.francais: Quand tu lis le Coran, demande la protection d'Allah contre le Diable banni.
versets.anglais: So when you recite the Qur'an, [first] seek refuge in Allah from Satan, the expelled [from His mercy]

versets.arabe: إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ لَهُ سُلْطَانٌ عَلَى الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Innahu laysa lahu sulṭānun 'alā lladhīna āmanū wa'alā rabbihim yatawakkalūn
versets.francais: Il n'a aucun pouvoir sur ceux qui croient et qui font confiance à leur Seigneur.
versets.anglais: Indeed, there is for him no authority over those who have believed and rely upon their Lord

versets.arabe: إِنَّمَا سُلْطَانُهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ يَتَوَلَّوْنَهُ وَالَّذِينَ هُم بِهِ مُشْرِكُونَ
versets.phonetique: Innamā sulṭānuhu 'alā lladhīna yatawallawnahu walladhīna hum bihi mushrikūn
versets.francais: Son pouvoir n'est que sur ceux qui le prennent pour allié et qui lui attribuent des associés [à Allah].
versets.anglais: His authority is only over those who take him as an ally and those who through him associate others with Allah

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا بَدَّلْنَا آيَةً مَّكَانَ آيَةٍ ۙ وَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يُنَزِّلُ قَالُوا إِنَّمَا أَنتَ مُفْتَرٍ ۚ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa'idhā baddalnā āyatan makāna āyatin wallāhu a'lamu bimā yunazzilu qālū innamā anta muftarin bal aktharuhum lā ya'lamūn
versets.francais: Et quand Nous substituons un verset à un autre — et Allah sait mieux ce qu'Il révèle — ils disent: «Tu n'es qu'un inventeur.» Mais la plupart d'entre eux ne savent pas.
versets.anglais: And when We substitute a verse in place of a verse - and Allah is most knowing of what He sends down - they say, "You, [O Muhammad], are but an inventor [of lies]." But most of them do not know

versets.arabe: قُلْ نَزَّلَهُ رُوحُ الْقُدُسِ مِن رَّبِّكَ بِالْحَقِّ لِيُثَبِّتَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَهُدًى وَبُشْرَىٰ لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qul nazzalahu rūḥu l-qudusi min rabbika bil-ḥaqqi liyuthabbita lladhīna āmanū wahudanw wabushrā lil-muslimīn
versets.francais: Dis: «Le Saint-Esprit l'a apporté de ton Seigneur en toute vérité, pour affermir ceux qui croient, et comme guide et bonne annonce aux Musulmans.»
versets.anglais: Say, [O Muhammad], "The Pure Spirit has brought it down from your Lord in truth to make firm those who believe and as guidance and good tidings to the Muslims

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ نَعْلَمُ أَنَّهُمْ يَقُولُونَ إِنَّمَا يُعَلِّمُهُ بَشَرٌ ۗ لِّسَانُ الَّذِي يُلْحِدُونَ إِلَيْهِ أَعْجَمِيٌّ وَهَٰذَا لِسَانٌ عَرَبِيٌّ مُّبِينٌ
versets.phonetique: Walaqad na'lamu annahum yaqūlūna innamā yu'allimuhu basharun lisānu lladhī yulḥidūna ilayhi a'jamiyyun wahādhā lisānun 'arabiyyun mubīn
versets.francais: Certes Nous savons qu'ils disent: «C'est un être humain qui le lui enseigne.» La langue de celui auquel ils font allusion est étrangère, alors que ceci est une langue arabe claire.
versets.anglais: And We certainly know that they say, "It is only a human being who teaches the Prophet." The tongue of the one they refer to is foreign, and this Qur'an is [in] a clear Arabic language

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِآيَاتِ اللَّهِ لَا يَهْدِيهِمُ اللَّهُ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Inna lladhīna lā yu'minūna bi'āyāti llāhi lā yahdīhimu llāhu walahum 'adhābun alīm
versets.francais: Ceux qui ne croient pas aux versets d'Allah, Allah ne les guide pas. Et ils auront un châtiment douloureux.
versets.anglais: Indeed, those who do not believe in the verses of Allah - Allah will not guide them, and for them is a painful punishment

versets.arabe: إِنَّمَا يَفْتَرِي الْكَذِبَ الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِآيَاتِ اللَّهِ ۖ وَأُولَٰئِكَ هُمُ الْكَاذِبُونَ
versets.phonetique: Innamā yaftarī l-kadhiba lladhīna lā yu'minūna bi'āyāti llāhi wa'ulā'ika humu l-kādhibūn
versets.francais: Ce ne sont que ceux qui ne croient pas aux versets d'Allah qui inventent des mensonges. Et voilà les menteurs.
versets.anglais: They only invent falsehood who do not believe in the verses of Allah, and it is those who are the liars

versets.arabe: مَن كَفَرَ بِاللَّهِ مِن بَعْدِ إِيمَانِهِ إِلَّا مَنْ أُكْرِهَ وَقَلْبُهُ مُطْمَئِنٌّ بِالْإِيمَانِ وَلَٰكِن مَّن شَرَحَ بِالْكُفْرِ صَدْرًا فَعَلَيْهِمْ غَضَبٌ مِّنَ اللَّهِ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Man kafara billāhi min ba'di īmānihi illā man ukriha waqalbuhu muṭma'innun bil-īmāni walākin man sharaḥa bil-kufri ṣadran fa'alayhim ghaḍabun mina llāhi walahum 'adhābun 'aẓīm
versets.francais: Quiconque renie Allah après avoir cru — sauf celui qui y est contraint alors que son cœur demeure tranquille dans la foi — mais celui qui ouvre sa poitrine à la mécréance, ceux-là auront la colère d'Allah sur eux. Et ils auront un énorme châtiment.
versets.anglais: Whoever disbelieves in Allah after his belief... except for one who is forced [to renounce his religion] while his heart is secure in faith. But those who [willingly] open their breasts to disbelief, upon them is wrath from Allah, and for them is a great punishment

versets.arabe: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمُ اسْتَحَبُّوا الْحَيَاةَ الدُّنْيَا عَلَى الْآخِرَةِ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ الْكَافِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Dhālika bi'annahumu staḥabbū l-ḥayāta d-dunyā 'alā l-ākhirati wa'anna llāha lā yahdī l-qawma l-kāfirīn
versets.francais: Cela parce qu'ils ont préféré la vie présente à l'au-delà, et qu'Allah ne guide pas les gens mécréants.
versets.anglais: That is because they preferred the worldly life over the Hereafter and that Allah does not guide the disbelieving people

versets.arabe: أُولَٰئِكَ الَّذِينَ طَبَعَ اللَّهُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ وَسَمْعِهِمْ وَأَبْصَارِهِمْ ۖ وَأُولَٰئِكَ هُمُ الْغَافِلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Ulā'ika lladhīna ṭaba'a llāhu 'alā qulūbihim wasm'ihim wa'abṣārihim wa'ulā'ika humu l-ghāfilūn
versets.francais: Ceux-là sont ceux sur les cœurs, l'ouïe et la vue desquels Allah a mis un sceau. Et ceux-là, ce sont les insouciants.
versets.anglais: Those are the ones over whose hearts and hearing and vision Allah has sealed, and it is those who are the heedless

versets.arabe: لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّهُمْ فِي الْآخِرَةِ هُمُ الْخَاسِرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Lā jarama annahum fī l-ākhirati humu l-khāsirūn
versets.francais: Nul doute que dans l'au-delà ce sont eux les perdants.
versets.anglais: Assuredly, it is they, in the Hereafter, who will be the losers

versets.arabe: ثُمَّ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لِلَّذِينَ هَاجَرُوا مِن بَعْدِ مَا فُتِنُوا ثُمَّ جَاهَدُوا وَصَبَرُوا إِنَّ رَبَّكَ مِن بَعْدِهَا لَغَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Thumma inna rabbaka lilladhīna hājarū min ba'di mā futinū thumma jāhadū waṣabarū inna rabbaka min ba'dihā laghafūrun raḥīm
versets.francais: Puis ton Seigneur sera, envers ceux qui ont émigré après avoir été persécutés, puis ont lutté et enduré, certes après cela Pardonneur et Miséricordieux.
versets.anglais: Then, indeed your Lord, to those who emigrated after they had been compelled [to renounce their religion] and thereafter fought [for the cause of Allah] and were patient - indeed, your Lord, after that, is Forgiving and Merciful

versets.arabe: يَوْمَ تَأْتِي كُلُّ نَفْسٍ تُجَادِلُ عَن نَّفْسِهَا وَتُوَفَّىٰ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّا عَمِلَتْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Yawma ta'tī kullu nafsin tujādilu 'an nafsihā watuwaffā kullu nafsin mā 'amilat wahum lā yuẓlamūn
versets.francais: Le jour où chaque âme viendra plaider pour elle-même; et chaque âme sera pleinement rétribuée de ce qu'elle aura fait. Et ils ne seront pas lésés.
versets.anglais: On the Day when every soul will come disputing for itself, and every soul will be fully compensated for what it did, and they will not be wronged

versets.arabe: وَضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلًا قَرْيَةً كَانَتْ آمِنَةً مُّطْمَئِنَّةً يَأْتِيهَا رِزْقُهَا رَغَدًا مِّن كُلِّ مَكَانٍ فَكَفَرَتْ بِأَنْعُمِ اللَّهِ فَأَذَاقَهَا اللَّهُ لِبَاسَ الْجُوعِ وَالْخَوْفِ بِمَا كَانُوا يَصْنَعُونَ
versets.phonetique: Waḍaraba llāhu mathalan qaryatan kānat āminatan muṭma'innatann ya'tīhā rizquhā raghadan min kulli makānin fakafarat bi'an'umi llāhi fa'adhāqahā llāhu libāsa l-jū'i wal-khawfi bimā kānū yaṣna'ūn
versets.francais: Allah propose la parabole d'une cité qui était en sécurité et tranquillité, sa subsistance lui arrivant en abondance de partout. Mais elle a été ingrate envers les bienfaits d'Allah, et Allah lui a fait goûter le vêtement de la faim et de la peur à cause de ce qu'elle faisait.
versets.anglais: And Allah presents an example: a city which was safe and secure, its provision coming to it in abundance from every location, but it denied the favors of Allah. So Allah made it taste the envelopment of hunger and fear for what they had been doing

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ جَاءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ مِّنْهُمْ فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمُ الْعَذَابُ وَهُمْ ظَالِمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Walaqad jā'ahum rasūlun minhum fakadhdhabūhu fa'akhadhahumu l-'adhābu wahum ẓālimūn
versets.francais: Il leur est certes venu un messager tiré d'eux-mêmes; ils l'ont traité de menteur et le châtiment les a saisis alors qu'ils étaient injustes.
versets.anglais: And there had certainly come to them a Messenger from among themselves, but they denied him; so punishment overtook them while they were wrongdoers

versets.arabe: فَكُلُوا مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ اللَّهُ حَلَالًا طَيِّبًا وَاشْكُرُوا نِعْمَتَ اللَّهِ إِن كُنتُمْ إِيَّاهُ تَعْبُدُونَ
versets.phonetique: Fakulū mimmā razaqakumu llāhu ḥalālan ṭayyiban washkurū ni'mata llāhi in kuntum iyyāhu ta'budūn
versets.francais: Mangez donc de ce qu'Allah vous a accordé comme nourriture licite et bonne. Et soyez reconnaissants pour le bienfait d'Allah, si c'est Lui que vous adorez.
versets.anglais: Then eat of what Allah has provided for you [which is] lawful and good. And be grateful for the favor of Allah, if it is [indeed] Him that you worship

versets.arabe: إِنَّمَا حَرَّمَ عَلَيْكُمُ الْمَيْتَةَ وَالدَّمَ وَلَحْمَ الْخِنزِيرِ وَمَا أُهِلَّ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهِ بِهِ ۖ فَمَنِ اضْطُرَّ غَيْرَ بَاغٍ وَلَا عَادٍ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Innamā ḥarrama 'alaykumu l-maytata wad-dama walaḥma l-khinzīri wamā uhilla lighayri llāhi bihi famani ḍṭurra ghayra bāghin walā 'ādin fa'inna llāha ghafūrun raḥīm
versets.francais: Il vous a seulement interdit la bête morte, le sang, la viande de porc, et ce sur quoi on a invoqué un autre nom qu'Allah. Mais pour celui qui est contraint sans [désir] ni transgression, Allah est Pardonneur et Miséricordieux.
versets.anglais: He has only forbidden to you dead animals, blood, the flesh of swine, and that which has been dedicated to other than Allah. But whoever is forced [by necessity], neither desiring [it] nor transgressing [its limit] - then indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful

versets.arabe: وَلَا تَقُولُوا لِمَا تَصِفُ أَلْسِنَتُكُمُ الْكَذِبَ هَٰذَا حَلَالٌ وَهَٰذَا حَرَامٌ لِّتَفْتَرُوا عَلَى اللَّهِ الْكَذِبَ ۚ إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَفْتَرُونَ عَلَى اللَّهِ الْكَذِبَ لَا يُفْلِحُونَ
versets.phonetique: Walā taqūlū limā taṣifu alsinatukumu l-kadhiba hādhā ḥalālun wahādhā ḥarāmun litaftarū 'alā llāhi l-kadhiba inna lladhīna yaftarūna 'alā llāhi l-kadhiba lā yufliḥūn
versets.francais: Et ne dites pas, pour le mensonge que profèrent vos langues: «Ceci est licite et cela est illicite», inventant ainsi des mensonges contre Allah. Ceux qui inventent des mensonges contre Allah ne réussiront pas.
versets.anglais: And do not say about what your tongues assert of untruth, "This is lawful and this is unlawful," to invent falsehood about Allah. Indeed, those who invent falsehood about Allah will not succeed

versets.arabe: مَتَاعٌ قَلِيلٌ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Matā'un qalīlun walahum 'adhābun alīm
versets.francais: [Ce sera] une jouissance passagère. Et ils auront un châtiment douloureux.
versets.anglais: [It is but] a brief enjoyment, and they will have a painful punishment

versets.arabe: وَعَلَى الَّذِينَ هَادُوا حَرَّمْنَا مَا قَصَصْنَا عَلَيْكَ مِن قَبْلُ ۖ وَمَا ظَلَمْنَاهُمْ وَلَٰكِن كَانُوا أَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa'alā lladhīna hādū ḥarramnā mā qaṣaṣnā 'alayka min qablu wamā ẓalamnāhum walākin kānū anfusahum yaẓlimūn
versets.francais: Et pour les Juifs, Nous avons interdit ce que Nous t'avons relaté auparavant. Et Nous ne leur avons pas fait de tort, mais c'était eux qui se faisaient tort à eux-mêmes.
versets.anglais: And to those who are Jews We have prohibited that which We related to you before. And We did not wrong them [thereby], but they were wronging themselves

versets.arabe: ثُمَّ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لِلَّذِينَ عَمِلُوا السُّوءَ بِجَهَالَةٍ ثُمَّ تَابُوا مِن بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ وَأَصْلَحُوا إِنَّ رَبَّكَ مِن بَعْدِهَا لَغَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Thumma inna rabbaka lilladhīna 'amilū s-sū'a bijahālatin thumma tābū min ba'di dhālika wa'aṣlaḥū inna rabbaka min ba'dihā laghafūrun raḥīm
versets.francais: Puis ton Seigneur, envers ceux qui ont fait le mal par ignorance, puis se sont repentis après cela et se sont amendés, certes après cela ton Seigneur est Pardonneur et Miséricordieux.
versets.anglais: Then, indeed your Lord, to those who have done wrong out of ignorance and then repent after that and correct themselves - indeed, your Lord, thereafter, is Forgiving and Merciful

versets.arabe: إِنَّ إِبْرَاهِيمَ كَانَ أُمَّةً قَانِتًا لِّلَّهِ حَنِيفًا وَلَمْ يَكُ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ
versets.phonetique: Inna ibrāhīma kāna ummatan qānitan lillāhi ḥanīfan walam yaku mina l-mushrikīn
versets.francais: Abraham était certes une communauté à lui seul, entièrement soumis à Allah et de religion droite. Et il n'était pas du nombre des polythéistes.
versets.anglais: Indeed, Abraham was a [comprehensive] leader, devoutly obedient to Allah, inclining toward truth, and he was not of those who associate others with Allah

versets.arabe: شَاكِرًا لِّأَنْعُمِهِ ۚ اجْتَبَاهُ وَهَدَاهُ إِلَىٰ صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
versets.phonetique: Shākiran li'an'umihi ijtabāhu wahadāhu ilā ṣirāṭin mustaqīm
versets.francais: Reconnaissant pour Ses bienfaits, Allah l'a choisi et l'a guidé vers un droit chemin.
versets.anglais: [He was] grateful for His favors. Allah chose him and guided him to a straight path

versets.arabe: وَآتَيْنَاهُ فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً ۖ وَإِنَّهُ فِي الْآخِرَةِ لَمِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa'ātaynāhu fī d-dunyā ḥasanatan wa'innahu fī l-ākhirati lamina ṣ-ṣāliḥīn
versets.francais: Et Nous lui avons accordé une belle récompense dans ce monde. Et dans l'au-delà, il sera certes parmi les vertueux.
versets.anglais: And We gave him good in this world, and indeed, in the Hereafter he will be among the righteous

versets.arabe: ثُمَّ أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ أَنِ اتَّبِعْ مِلَّةَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَنِيفًا ۖ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ
versets.phonetique: Thumma awḥaynā ilayka ani ttabi' millata ibrāhīma ḥanīfan wamā kāna mina l-mushrikīn
versets.francais: Puis Nous t'avons révélé: «Suis la religion d'Abraham de religion droite. Et il n'était pas du nombre des polythéistes.»
versets.anglais: Then We revealed to you, [O Muhammad], to follow the religion of Abraham, inclining toward truth; and he was not of those who associate with Allah

versets.arabe: إِنَّمَا جُعِلَ السَّبْتُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ اخْتَلَفُوا فِيهِ ۚ وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَيَحْكُمُ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فِيمَا كَانُوا فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ
versets.phonetique: Innamā ju'ila s-sabtu 'alā lladhīna khtalaFū fīhi wa'inna rabbaka layaḥkumu baynahum yawma l-qiyāmati fīmā kānū fīhi yakhtalifūn
versets.francais: Le Sabbat a été imposé seulement à ceux qui ont divergé à son sujet. Et certes ton Seigneur décidera entre eux au Jour de la Résurrection sur ce sur quoi ils divergeaient.
versets.anglais: The sabbath was only appointed for those who differed over it. And indeed, your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ

versets.arabe: ادْعُ إِلَىٰ سَبِيلِ رَبِّكَ بِالْحِكْمَةِ وَالْمَوْعِظَةِ الْحَسَنَةِ ۖ وَجَادِلْهُم بِالَّتِي هِيَ أَحْسَنُ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِ ۖ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِالْمُهْتَدِينَ
versets.phonetique: Ud'u ilā sabīli rabbika bil-ḥikmati wal-maw'iẓati l-ḥasanati wajādilhum billati hiya aḥsanu inna rabbaka huwa a'lamu biman ḍalla 'an sabīlihi wahuwa a'lamu bil-muhtadīn
versets.francais: Appelle au sentier de ton Seigneur avec sagesse et belle exhortation, et discute avec eux de la meilleure façon. Certes ton Seigneur sait mieux qui s'est égaré de Son sentier, et Il sait mieux qui est bien guidé.
versets.anglais: Invite to the way of your Lord with wisdom and good instruction, and argue with them in a way that is best. Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who has strayed from His way, and He is most knowing of who is [rightly] guided

versets.arabe: وَإِنْ عَاقَبْتُمْ فَعَاقِبُوا بِمِثْلِ مَا عُوقِبْتُم بِهِ ۖ وَلَئِن صَبَرْتُمْ لَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لِّلصَّابِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa'in 'āqabtum fa'āqibū bimithli mā 'ūqibtum bihi wala'in ṣabartum lahuwa khayrun liṣ-ṣābirīn
versets.francais: Et si vous punissez, punissez d'une peine équivalente à celle qu'on vous a infligée. Mais si vous êtes patients, c'est vraiment meilleur pour ceux qui endurent.
versets.anglais: And if you punish [an enemy, O believers], punish with an equivalent of that with which you were harmed. But if you are patient - it is better for those who are patient

versets.arabe: وَاصْبِرْ وَمَا صَبْرُكَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ ۚ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا تَكُ فِي ضَيْقٍ مِّمَّا يَمْكُرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Waṣbir wamā ṣabruka illā billāhi walā taḥzan 'alayhim walā taku fī ḍayqin mimmā yamkurūn
versets.francais: Et sois patient: et ta patience ne peut venir que d'Allah. Ne t'attriste pas à cause d'eux et ne te sens pas à l'étroit à cause de leurs manigances.
versets.anglais: And be patient, [O Muhammad], and your patience is not but through Allah. And do not grieve over them and do not be in distress over what they conspire

versets.arabe: إِنَّ اللَّهَ مَعَ الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوا وَّالَّذِينَ هُم مُّحْسِنُونَ
versets.phonetique: Inna llāha ma'a lladhīna ttaqaw walladhīna hum muḥsinūn
versets.francais: Certes Allah est avec ceux qui ont la piété et ceux qui font le bien.
versets.anglais: Indeed, Allah is with those who fear Him and those who are doers of good

versets.arabe: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي أَسْرَىٰ بِعَبْدِهِ لَيْلًا مِّنَ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ إِلَى الْمَسْجِدِ الْأَقْصَى
versets.phonetique: Subhânal-lathî asrâ bi'abdihî laylam minal-masjidil-harâmi ilal-masjidil-aqsâ
versets.francais: Gloire à Celui qui a fait voyager Son serviteur de nuit du Masjid Al-Haram au Masjid Al-Aqsa.
versets.anglais: Exalted is He who took His Servant by night from al-Masjid al-Haram to al-Masjid al-Aqsa, whose surroundings We have blessed, to show him of Our signs. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Seeing

versets.arabe: وَآتَيْنَا مُوسَى الْكِتَابَ وَجَعَلْنَاهُ هُدًى لِّبَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ
versets.phonetique: Wa âtaynâ mûsal-kitâba wa ja'alnâhu hudal-libanî isrâ'îl
versets.francais: Nous avons donné à Moïse le Livre et en avons fait un guide pour les fils d'Israël.
versets.anglais: And We gave Moses the Scripture and made it a guidance for the Children of Israel that you not take other than Me as Disposer of affairs

versets.arabe: ذُرِّيَّةَ مَنْ حَمَلْنَا مَعَ نُوحٍ إِنَّهُ كَانَ عَبْدًا شَكُورًا
versets.phonetique: Thurriyyata man hamalnâ ma'a nûhin innahû kâna 'abdan shakûrâ
versets.francais: Descendants de ceux que Nous avons transportés avec Noé. Il était un serviteur très reconnaissant.
versets.anglais: O descendants of those We carried [in the ship] with Noah. Indeed, he was a grateful servant

versets.arabe: وَقَضَيْنَا إِلَىٰ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ فِي الْكِتَابِ لَتُفْسِدُنَّ فِي الْأَرْضِ مَرَّتَيْنِ
versets.phonetique: Wa qadhaynâ ilâ banî isrâ'îla fil-kitâbi latufsidunn fil-ardhi marratayn
versets.francais: Nous avons décrété pour les fils d'Israël dans le Livre: vous sèmerez la corruption sur terre deux fois.
versets.anglais: And We conveyed to the Children of Israel in the Scripture that, "You will surely cause corruption on the earth twice, and you will surely reach [a degree of] great haughtiness

versets.arabe: فَإِذَا جَاءَ وَعْدُ أُولَاهُمَا بَعَثْنَا عَلَيْكُمْ عِبَادًا لَّنَا أُولِي بَأْسٍ شَدِيدٍ
versets.phonetique: Fa'ithâ jâ'a wa'du ûlâhumâ ba'athnâ 'alaykum 'ibâdan lanâ ûlî ba'sin shadîd
versets.francais: Quand la première promesse est venue, Nous avons envoyé contre vous Nos serviteurs doués d'une grande vigueur.
versets.anglais: So when the [time of] promise came for the first of them, We sent against you servants of Ours - those of great military might, and they probed [even] into the homes, and it was a promise fulfilled

versets.arabe: ثُمَّ رَدَدْنَا لَكُمُ الْكَرَّةَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَأَمْدَدْنَاكُم بِأَمْوَالٍ وَبَنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Thumma radadnâ lakumul-karrata 'alayhim wa amdadnâkum bi'amwâlin wa banîn
versets.francais: Puis Nous vous avons rendu la victoire sur eux et vous avons renforcés de richesses et d'enfants.
versets.anglais: Then We gave back to you a return victory over them. And We reinforced you with wealth and sons and made you more numerous in manpower

versets.arabe: إِنْ أَحْسَنتُمْ أَحْسَنتُمْ لِأَنفُسِكُمْ وَإِنْ أَسَأْتُمْ فَلَهَا
versets.phonetique: In ahsantum ahsantum li'anfusikum wa in asa'tum falahâ
versets.francais: Si vous faites le bien, vous le faites pour vous-mêmes, et si vous faites le mal, c'est contre vous-mêmes.
versets.anglais: [And said], "If you do good, you do good for yourselves; and if you do evil, [you do it] to yourselves." Then when the final promise came, [We sent your enemies] to sadden your faces and to enter the temple in Jerusalem, as they entered it the first time, and to destroy what they had taken over with [total] destruction

versets.arabe: عَسَىٰ رَبُّكُمْ أَن يَرْحَمَكُمْ وَإِنْ عُدتُّمْ عُدْنَا
versets.phonetique: Asâ rabbukum an yarhamakum wa in 'udtum 'udnâ
versets.francais: Peut-être que votre Seigneur vous fera miséricorde. Mais si vous recommencez, Nous recommencerons.
versets.anglais: [Then Allah said], "It is expected, [if you repent], that your Lord will have mercy upon you. But if you return [to sin], We will return [to punishment]. And We have made Hell, for the disbelievers, a prison-bed

versets.arabe: إِنَّ هَٰذَا الْقُرْآنَ يَهْدِي لِلَّتِي هِيَ أَقْوَمُ
versets.phonetique: Inna hâthal-qur'âna yahdî lilllatî hiya aqwam
versets.francais: Ce Coran guide vers ce qui est le plus droit.
versets.anglais: Indeed, this Qur'an guides to that which is most suitable and gives good tidings to the believers who do righteous deeds that they will have a great reward

versets.arabe: وَأَنَّ الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْآخِرَةِ أَعْتَدْنَا لَهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا
versets.phonetique: Wa annal-lathîna lâ yu'minûna bil-âkhirati a'tadnâ lahum 'athâban alîmâ
versets.francais: Et que ceux qui ne croient pas à l'au-delà, Nous leur avons préparé un châtiment douloureux.
versets.anglais: And that those who do not believe in the Hereafter - We have prepared for them a painful punishment

versets.arabe: وَيَدْعُ الْإِنسَانُ بِالشَّرِّ دُعَاءَهُ بِالْخَيْرِ وَكَانَ الْإِنسَانُ عَجُولًا
versets.phonetique: Wa yad'ul-insânu bish-sharri du'â'ahu bil-khayri wa kânal-insânu 'ajûlâ
versets.francais: L'homme invoque le mal comme il invoque le bien. L'homme est très pressé.
versets.anglais: And man supplicates for evil as he supplicates for good, and man is ever hasty

versets.arabe: وَجَعَلْنَا اللَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ آيَتَيْنِ
versets.phonetique: Wa ja'alnal-layla wan-nahâra âyatayn
versets.francais: Nous avons fait de la nuit et du jour deux signes.
versets.anglais: And We have made the night and day two signs, and We erased the sign of the night and made the sign of the day visible that you may seek bounty from your Lord and may know the number of years and the account [of time]. And everything We have set out in detail

versets.arabe: وَكُلَّ إِنسَانٍ أَلْزَمْنَاهُ طَائِرَهُ فِي عُنُقِهِ
versets.phonetique: Wa kulla insânin alzamnâhu tâ'irahu fî 'unuqih
versets.francais: Nous avons attaché au cou de chaque homme son destin.
versets.anglais: And [for] every person We have imposed his fate upon his neck, and We will produce for him on the Day of Resurrection a record which he will encounter spread open

versets.arabe: اقْرَأْ كِتَابَكَ كَفَىٰ بِنَفْسِكَ الْيَوْمَ عَلَيْكَ حَسِيبًا
versets.phonetique: Iqra'kitâbaka kafâ binafsikalyawma 'alayka hasîbâ
versets.francais: Lis ton livre; tu suffis aujourd'hui comme témoin contre toi-même.
versets.anglais: [It will be said], "Read your record. Sufficient is yourself against you this Day as accountant

versets.arabe: مَّنِ اهْتَدَىٰ فَإِنَّمَا يَهْتَدِي لِنَفْسِهِ وَمَن ضَلَّ فَإِنَّمَا يَضِلُّ عَلَيْهَا
versets.phonetique: Manihhtadâ fa'innamâ yahtadî linafsihî wa man dhalla fa'innamâ yadhillu 'alayhâ
versets.francais: Quiconque suit le droit chemin, ne le suit que pour son propre bien. Quiconque s'égare, ne s'égare qu'à ses dépens.
versets.anglais: Whoever is guided is only guided for [the benefit of] his soul. And whoever errs only errs against it. And no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another. And never would We punish until We sent a messenger

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا أَرَدْنَا أَن نُّهْلِكَ قَرْيَةً أَمَرْنَا مُتْرَفِيهَا فَفَسَقُوا فِيهَا
versets.phonetique: Wa ithâ aradnâ an nuhlikaqaryatan amarnâ mutrafîhâ fafasaqû fîhâ
versets.francais: Quand Nous voulons détruire une cité, Nous commandons à ses aisés et ils s'y livrent à la débauche.
versets.anglais: And when We intend to destroy a city, We command its affluent but they defiantly disobey therein; so the word comes into effect upon it, and We destroy it with [complete] destruction

versets.arabe: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِنَ الْقُرُونِ مِن بَعْدِ نُوحٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa kam ahlaknâ minal-qurûni mim ba'di nûh
versets.francais: Combien de générations avons-Nous détruites après Noé!
versets.anglais: And how many have We destroyed from the generations after Noah. And sufficient is your Lord, concerning the sins of His servants, as Acquainted and Seeing

versets.arabe: مَّن كَانَ يُرِيدُ الْعَاجِلَةَ عَجَّلْنَا لَهُ فِيهَا مَا نَشَاءُ لِمَن نُّرِيدُ
versets.phonetique: Man kâna yurîdul-'âjilata 'ajjalnâ lahû fîhâ mâ nashâ'u liman nurîd
versets.francais: Quiconque désire la vie immédiate, Nous lui en accordons ce que Nous voulons à qui Nous voulons.
versets.anglais: Whoever should desire the immediate - We hasten for him from it what We will to whom We intend. Then We have made for him Hell, which he will [enter to] burn, censured and banished

versets.arabe: وَمَنْ أَرَادَ الْآخِرَةَ وَسَعَىٰ لَهَا سَعْيَهَا وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa man arâdal-âkhirata wa sa'â lahâ sa'yahâ wa huwa mu'min
versets.francais: Quiconque désire l'au-delà et s'y efforce comme il se doit, tout en étant croyant.
versets.anglais: But whoever desires the Hereafter and exerts the effort due to it while he is a believer - it is those whose effort is ever appreciated [by Allah]

versets.arabe: كُلًّا نُّمِدُّ هَٰؤُلَاءِ وَهَٰؤُلَاءِ مِنْ عَطَاءِ رَبِّكَ
versets.phonetique: Kullan numiddu hâ'ulâ'i wa hâ'ulâ'i min 'atâ'i rabbik
versets.francais: À tous, à ceux-ci et à ceux-là, Nous accordons largement les dons de ton Seigneur.
versets.anglais: To each [category] We extend - to these and to those - from the gift of your Lord. And never has the gift of your Lord been restricted

versets.arabe: انظُرْ كَيْفَ فَضَّلْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ
versets.phonetique: Undh-ur kayfa fadhdhal-nâ ba'dhahum 'alâ ba'dh
versets.francais: Regarde comment Nous avons favorisé certains sur d'autres.
versets.anglais: Look how We have favored [in provision] some of them over others. But the Hereafter is greater in degrees [of difference] and greater in distinction

versets.arabe: لَّا تَجْعَلْ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا آخَرَ فَتَقْعُدَ مَذْمُومًا مَّخْذُولًا
versets.phonetique: Lâ taj'al ma'allâhi ilâhan âkhara fataq'uda mathmûman makhthûlâ
versets.francais: N'associe pas à Allah une autre divinité, sinon tu te retrouverais blâmé et abandonné.
versets.anglais: Do not make [as equal] with Allah another deity and [thereby] become censured and forsaken

versets.arabe: وَقَضَىٰ رَبُّكَ أَلَّا تَعْبُدُوا إِلَّا إِيَّاهُ وَبِالْوَالِدَيْنِ إِحْسَانًا
versets.phonetique: Wa qadhâ rabbuka allâ ta'budû illâ iyyâhu wa bil-wâlidayni ihsânâ
versets.francais: Ton Seigneur a décrété que vous n'adoriez que Lui seul, et que vous traitiez les parents avec bonté.
versets.anglais: And your Lord has decreed that you not worship except Him, and to parents, good treatment. Whether one or both of them reach old age [while] with you, say not to them [so much as], "uff," and do not repel them but speak to them a noble word

versets.arabe: وَاخْفِضْ لَهُمَا جَنَاحَ الذُّلِّ مِنَ الرَّحْمَةِ وَقُل رَّبِّ ارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرًا
versets.phonetique: Wakhfidh lahumâ janâhadh-thulli minar-rahmati wa qur-rabbi irhamhumâ kamâ rabbayânî saghîrâ
versets.francais: Abaisse pour eux l'aile de l'humilité par miséricorde et dis: Seigneur, fais-leur miséricorde comme ils m'ont élevé petit.
versets.anglais: And lower to them the wing of humility out of mercy and say, "My Lord, have mercy upon them as they brought me up [when I was] small

versets.arabe: رَّبُّكُمْ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا فِي نُفُوسِكُمْ إِن تَكُونُوا صَالِحِينَ
versets.phonetique: Rabbukum a'lamu bimâ fî nufûsikum in takûnû sâlihîn
versets.francais: Votre Seigneur connaît mieux ce qui est dans vos âmes. Si vous êtes vertueux.
versets.anglais: Your Lord is most knowing of what is within yourselves. If you should be righteous [in intention] - then indeed He is ever, to the often returning [to Him], Forgiving

versets.arabe: وَآتِ ذَا الْقُرْبَىٰ حَقَّهُ وَالْمِسْكِينَ وَابْنَ السَّبِيلِ
versets.phonetique: Wa âti thal-qurbâ haqqahu wal-miskîna wabnas-sabîl
versets.francais: Donne au proche parent ce qui lui est dû, ainsi qu'au pauvre et au voyageur.
versets.anglais: And give the relative his right, and [also] the poor and the traveler, and do not spend wastefully

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الْمُبَذِّرِينَ كَانُوا إِخْوَانَ الشَّيَاطِينِ
versets.phonetique: Innal-mubathhirîna kânû ikhwânash-shayâtîn
versets.francais: Les prodigues sont les frères des diables.
versets.anglais: Indeed, the wasteful are brothers of the devils, and ever has Satan been to his Lord ungrateful

versets.arabe: وَإِمَّا تُعْرِضَنَّ عَنْهُمُ ابْتِغَاءَ رَحْمَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّكَ تَرْجُوهَا
versets.phonetique: Wa immâ tu'ridhannahum ubtighâ'a rahmatim mir-rabbika tarjûhâ
versets.francais: Si tu dois t'écarter d'eux en attendant la miséricorde de ton Seigneur que tu espères.
versets.anglais: And if you [must] turn away from the needy awaiting mercy from your Lord which you expect, then speak to them a gentle word

versets.arabe: وَلَا تَجْعَلْ يَدَكَ مَغْلُولَةً إِلَىٰ عُنُقِكَ وَلَا تَبْسُطْهَا كُلَّ الْبَسْطِ
versets.phonetique: Wa lâ taj'al yadaka maghlûlatan ilâ 'unuqika wa lâ tabsuthâ kullal-bast
versets.francais: Ne tiens pas ta main attachée à ton cou, et ne l'étends pas non plus complètement.
versets.anglais: And do not make your hand [as] chained to your neck or extend it completely and [thereby] become blamed and insolvent

versets.arabe: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَاءُ وَيَقْدِرُ
versets.phonetique: Inna rabbaka yabsuttur-rizqa liman yashâ'u wa yaqdir
versets.francais: Ton Seigneur étend la subsistance à qui Il veut et la restreint.
versets.anglais: Indeed, your Lord extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it]. Indeed He is ever, concerning His servants, Acquainted and Seeing

versets.arabe: وَلَا تَقْتُلُوا أَوْلَادَكُمْ خَشْيَةَ إِمْلَاقٍ نَّحْنُ نَرْزُقُهُمْ وَإِيَّاكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Wa lâ taqtulû awlâdakum khashyata imlâqin nahnu narzuquhum wa iyyâkum
versets.francais: Ne tuez pas vos enfants par crainte de pauvreté. C'est Nous qui pourvoyons à leurs besoins ainsi qu'aux vôtres.
versets.anglais: And do not kill your children for fear of poverty. We provide for them and for you. Indeed, their killing is ever a great sin

versets.arabe: وَلَا تَقْرَبُوا الزِّنَىٰ إِنَّهُ كَانَ فَاحِشَةً وَسَاءَ سَبِيلًا
versets.phonetique: Wa lâ taqrabuz-zinâ innahû kâna fâhishatan wa sâ'a sabîlâ
versets.francais: N'approchez pas de la fornication. C'est une turpitude et un mauvais chemin.
versets.anglais: And do not approach unlawful sexual intercourse. Indeed, it is ever an immorality and is evil as a way

versets.arabe: وَلَا تَقْتُلُوا النَّفْسَ الَّتِي حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ إِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ
versets.phonetique: Wa lâ taqtulun-nafsal-latî harramallâhu illâ bil-haqq
versets.francais: Ne tuez pas l'être humain qu'Allah a rendu sacré, sauf à bon droit.
versets.anglais: And do not kill the soul which Allah has forbidden, except by right. And whoever is killed unjustly - We have given his heir authority, but let him not exceed limits in [the matter of] taking life. Indeed, he has been supported [by the law]

versets.arabe: وَلَا تَقْرَبُوا مَالَ الْيَتِيمِ إِلَّا بِالَّتِي هِيَ أَحْسَنُ
versets.phonetique: Wa lâ taqrabû mâlal-yatîmi illâ billatî hiya ahsan
versets.francais: N'approchez pas des biens de l'orphelin, sauf de la meilleure façon.
versets.anglais: And do not approach the property of an orphan, except in the way that is best, until he reaches maturity. And fulfill [every] commitment. Indeed, the commitment is ever [that about which one will be] questioned

versets.arabe: وَأَوْفُوا الْكَيْلَ إِذَا كِلْتُمْ وَزِنُوا بِالْقِسْطَاسِ الْمُسْتَقِيمِ
versets.phonetique: Wa awful-kayla ithâ kiltum wa zinû bil-qistâsil-mustaqîm
versets.francais: Donnez pleine mesure quand vous mesurez et pesez avec une balance juste.
versets.anglais: And give full measure when you measure, and weigh with an even balance. That is the best [way] and best in result

versets.arabe: وَلَا تَقْفُ مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِ عِلْمٌ إِنَّ السَّمْعَ وَالْبَصَرَ وَالْفُؤَادَ
versets.phonetique: Wa lâ taqfu mâ laysa laka bihî 'ilmun innas-sam'a wal-basara wal-fu'âd
versets.francais: Ne poursuis pas ce dont tu n'as aucune connaissance. L'ouïe, la vue et le cœur en seront tous demandés.
versets.anglais: And do not pursue that of which you have no knowledge. Indeed, the hearing, the sight and the heart - about all those [one] will be questioned

versets.arabe: وَلَا تَمْشِ فِي الْأَرْضِ مَرَحًا إِنَّكَ لَن تَخْرِقَ الْأَرْضَ
versets.phonetique: Wa lâ tamshi fil-ardhi marahân innaka lan takhriqqal-ardh
versets.francais: Ne marche pas sur terre avec arrogance. Tu ne pourras jamais fendre la terre.
versets.anglais: And do not walk upon the earth exultantly. Indeed, you will never tear the earth [apart], and you will never reach the mountains in height

versets.arabe: كُلُّ ذَٰلِكَ كَانَ سَيِّئُهُ عِندَ رَبِّكَ مَكْرُوهًا
versets.phonetique: Kullu thâlika kâna sayyi'uhu 'inda rabbika makrûhâ
versets.francais: Tout cela, ce qui en est mauvais est détesté de ton Seigneur.
versets.anglais: All that - its evil is ever, in the sight of your Lord, detested

versets.arabe: ذَٰلِكَ مِمَّا أَوْحَىٰ إِلَيْكَ رَبُّكَ مِنَ الْحِكْمَةِ
versets.phonetique: Thâlika mimmâ awha ilayka rabbuka minal-hikmah
versets.francais: Voilà ce que ton Seigneur t'a révélé comme sagesse.
versets.anglais: That is from what your Lord has revealed to you, [O Muhammad], of wisdom. And, [O mankind], do not make [as equal] with Allah another deity, lest you be thrown into Hell, blamed and banished

versets.arabe: أَفَأَصْفَاكُمْ رَبُّكُم بِالْبَنِينَ وَاتَّخَذَ مِنَ الْمَلَائِكَةِ إِنَاثًا
versets.phonetique: Afa'asfâkum rabbukum bil-banîna wattakhathaminal-malâ'ikati inâthâ
versets.francais: Votre Seigneur vous a-t-il distingués avec des fils et a-t-il pris pour Lui des filles parmi les anges?
versets.anglais: Then, has your Lord chosen you for [having] sons and taken from among the angels daughters? Indeed, you say a grave saying

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ صَرَّفْنَا فِي هَٰذَا الْقُرْآنِ لِيَذَّكَّرُوا
versets.phonetique: Wa laqad sarrafnâ fî hâthal-qur'âni litathakarû
versets.francais: Nous avons exposé de diverses façons dans ce Coran afin qu'ils se souviennent.
versets.anglais: And We have certainly diversified [the contents] in this Qur'an that mankind may be reminded, but it does not increase the disbelievers except in aversion

versets.arabe: قُل لَّوْ كَانَ مَعَهُ آلِهَةٌ كَمَا يَقُولُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qul law kâna ma'ahu âlihatun kamâ yaqûlûn
versets.francais: Dis: s'il y avait avec Lui d'autres divinités comme ils le prétendent.
versets.anglais: Say, [O Muhammad], "If there had been with Him [other] gods, as they say, then they [each] would have sought to the Owner of the Throne a way

versets.arabe: سُبْحَانَهُ وَتَعَالَىٰ عَمَّا يَقُولُونَ عُلُوًّا كَبِيرًا
versets.phonetique: Subhânahu wa ta'âlâ 'ammâ yaqûlûna 'uluwwan kabîrâ
versets.francais: Gloire à Lui et Il est bien au-dessus de ce qu'ils disent, d'une élévation absolue.
versets.anglais: Exalted is He and high above what they say by great sublimity

versets.arabe: تُسَبِّحُ لَهُ السَّمَاوَاتُ السَّبْعُ وَالْأَرْضُ وَمَن فِيهِنَّ
versets.phonetique: Tusabbihu lahus-samâwâtus-sab'u wal-ardhu wa man fîhinn
versets.francais: Les sept cieux, la terre et ceux qui s'y trouvent Le glorifient.
versets.anglais: The seven heavens and the earth and whatever is in them exalt Him. And there is not a thing except that it exalts [Allah] by His praise, but you do not understand their [way of] exalting. Indeed, He is ever Forbearing and Forgiving

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا قَرَأْتَ الْقُرْآنَ جَعَلْنَا بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَ الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa ithâ qara'tal-qur'âna ja'alnâ baynaka wa baynal-lathîna lâ yu'minûn
versets.francais: Quand tu récites le Coran, Nous mettons entre toi et ceux qui ne croient pas un voile invisible.
versets.anglais: And when you recite the Qur'an, We put between you and those who do not believe in the Hereafter a concealed partition

versets.arabe: وَجَعَلْنَا عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ أَكِنَّةً أَن يَفْقَهُوهُ
versets.phonetique: Wa ja'alnâ 'alâ qulûbihim akinnatan an yafqahûh
versets.francais: Nous avons mis sur leurs cœurs des voiles pour qu'ils ne le comprennent pas.
versets.anglais: And We have placed over their hearts coverings, lest they understand it, and in their ears deafness. And when you mention your Lord alone in the Qur'an, they turn back in aversion

versets.arabe: نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَسْتَمِعُونَ بِهِ إِذْ يَسْتَمِعُونَ إِلَيْكَ
versets.phonetique: Nahnu a'lamu bimâ yastami'ûna bihî ith yastami'ûna ilayk
versets.francais: Nous savons mieux ce qu'ils écoutent quand ils t'écoutent.
versets.anglais: We are most knowing of how they listen to it when they listen to you and [of] when they are in private conversation, when the wrongdoers say, "You follow not but a man affected by magic

versets.arabe: انظُرْ كَيْفَ ضَرَبُوا لَكَ الْأَمْثَالَ فَضَلُّوا فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ سَبِيلًا
versets.phonetique: Undh-ur kayfa darabû lakal-amthâla fadballû falâ yastatî'ûna sabîlâ
versets.francais: Vois comment ils t'ont comparé. Ils se sont égarés et ne peuvent trouver de chemin.
versets.anglais: Look how they strike for you comparisons; but they have strayed, so they cannot [find] a way

versets.arabe: وَقَالُوا أَإِذَا كُنَّا عِظَامًا وَرُفَاتًا أَإِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa qâlû a'ithâ kunnâ 'idhâman wa rufâtan a'innâ lamab'ûthûn
versets.francais: Ils dirent: une fois que nous serons des os et de la poussière, serons-nous vraiment ressuscités?
versets.anglais: And they say, "When we are bones and crumbled particles, will we [truly] be resurrected as a new creation

versets.arabe: قُلْ كُونُوا حِجَارَةً أَوْ حَدِيدًا
versets.phonetique: Qul kûnû hijâratan aw hadîdâ
versets.francais: Dis: soyez des pierres ou du fer.
versets.anglais: Say, "Be you stones or iron

versets.arabe: أَوْ خَلْقًا مِّمَّا يَكْبُرُ فِي صُدُورِكُمْ فَسَيَقُولُونَ مَن يُعِيدُنَا
versets.phonetique: Aw khalqan mimmâ yakburu fî sudûrikum fasayaqûlûna man yu'îdunâ
versets.francais: Ou quelque chose d'encore plus grand selon votre conception. Ils diront: qui nous fera revivre?
versets.anglais: Or [any] creation of that which is great within your breasts." And they will say, "Who will restore us?" Say, "He who brought you forth the first time." Then they will nod their heads toward you and say, "When is that?" Say, "Perhaps it will be soon

versets.arabe: يَوْمَ يَدْعُوكُمْ فَتَسْتَجِيبُونَ بِحَمْدِهِ وَتَظُنُّونَ إِن لَّبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا
versets.phonetique: Yawma yad'ûkum fatastajîbûna bihamdihî wa tadhunnûna in labithtum illâ qalîlâ
versets.francais: Le jour où Il vous appellera et que vous répondrez en Le louant, et vous penserez n'être restés qu'un peu.
versets.anglais: On the Day He will call you and you will respond with praise of Him and think that you had not remained [in the world] except for a little

versets.arabe: وَقُل لِّعِبَادِي يَقُولُوا الَّتِي هِيَ أَحْسَنُ
versets.phonetique: Wa qul li'ibâdî yaqûlûlllatî hiya ahsan
versets.francais: Dis à Mes serviteurs de dire ce qui est le mieux.
versets.anglais: And tell My servants to say that which is best. Indeed, Satan induces [dissension] among them. Indeed Satan is ever, to mankind, a clear enemy

versets.arabe: رَّبُّكُمْ أَعْلَمُ بِكُمْ إِن يَشَأْ يَرْحَمْكُمْ أَوْ إِن يَشَأْ يُعَذِّبْكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Rabbukum a'lamu bikum in yasha' yarhamkum aw in yasha' yu'athibkum
versets.francais: Votre Seigneur vous connaît le mieux. S'Il veut, Il vous fera miséricorde; s'Il veut, Il vous châtiera.
versets.anglais: Your Lord is most knowing of you. If He wills, He will have mercy upon you; or if He wills, He will punish you. And We have not sent you, [O Muhammad], over them as a manager

versets.arabe: وَرَبُّكَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَلَقَدْ فَضَّلْنَا بَعْضَ النَّبِيِّينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa rabbuka a'lamu biman fis-samâwâti wal-ardhi wa laqad fadhdhal-nâ ba'dhan-nabiyyîn
versets.francais: Ton Seigneur connaît mieux tous ceux qui sont dans les cieux et sur la terre. Nous avons favorisé certains prophètes.
versets.anglais: And your Lord is most knowing of whoever is in the heavens and the earth. And We have made some of the prophets exceed others [in various ways], and to David We gave the book [of Psalms]

versets.arabe: قُلِ ادْعُوا الَّذِينَ زَعَمْتُم مِّن دُونِهِ فَلَا يَمْلِكُونَ كَشْفَ الضُّرِّ عَنكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Qulid'ûllathîna za'amtum min dûnihî falâ yamlikûna kashfadh-dhurri 'ankum
versets.francais: Dis: invoquez ceux que vous avez imaginés en dehors de Lui. Ils ne peuvent écarter de vous le mal.
versets.anglais: Say, "Invoke those you have claimed [as gods] besides Him, for they do not possess the [ability for] removal of adversity from you or [for its] transfer [to someone else]

versets.arabe: أُولَٰئِكَ الَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ يَبْتَغُونَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمُ الْوَسِيلَةَ
versets.phonetique: Ulâ'ikal-lathîna yad'ûna yabtaghûna ilâ rabbihimul-wasîlah
versets.francais: Ceux qu'ils invoquent cherchent eux-mêmes le moyen de se rapprocher de leur Seigneur.
versets.anglais: Those whom they invoke seek means of access to their Lord, [striving as to] which of them would be nearest, and they hope for His mercy and fear His punishment. Indeed, the punishment of your Lord is ever feared

versets.arabe: وَإِن مِّن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا نَحْنُ مُهْلِكُوهَا قَبْلَ يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ
versets.phonetique: Wa in min qaryatin illâ nahnu muhlikûhâ qabla yawmil-qiyâmah
versets.francais: Il n'est pas de cité que Nous ne détruisions ou que Nous ne châtiions sévèrement avant le Jour de la Résurrection.
versets.anglais: And there is no city but that We will destroy it before the Day of Resurrection or punish it with a severe punishment. That has ever been in the Register inscribed

versets.arabe: وَمَا مَنَعَنَا أَن نُّرْسِلَ بِالْآيَاتِ إِلَّا أَن كَذَّبَ بِهَا الْأَوَّلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa mâ mana'anâ an nursal bil-âyâti illâ an kaththaba bihal-awwalûn
versets.francais: Rien ne Nous empêche d'envoyer les signes, sinon que les anciens les ont traités de mensonges.
versets.anglais: And nothing has prevented Us from sending signs except that the former peoples denied them. And We gave Thamud the she-camel as a visible sign, but they wronged her. And We send not the signs except as a warning

versets.arabe: وَإِذْ قُلْنَا لَكَ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ أَحَاطَ بِالنَّاسِ
versets.phonetique: Wa ith qulnâ laka inna rabbaka ahâta bin-nâs
versets.francais: Quand Nous t'avons dit: ton Seigneur cerne les hommes de toutes parts.
versets.anglais: And [remember, O Muhammad], when We told you, "Indeed, your Lord has encompassed the people." And We did not make the sight which We showed you except as a trial for the people, as was the accursed tree [mentioned] in the Qur'an. And We threaten them, but it increases them not except in great transgression

versets.arabe: وَإِذْ قُلْنَا لِلْمَلَائِكَةِ اسْجُدُوا لِآدَمَ فَسَجَدُوا إِلَّا إِبْلِيسَ
versets.phonetique: Wa ith qulnâ lil-malâ'ikati usjudû li'âdama fasajadû illâ iblîs
versets.francais: Quand Nous avons dit aux anges: prosternez-vous devant Adam. Ils se prosternèrent sauf Iblis.
versets.anglais: And [mention] when We said to the angles, "Prostrate to Adam," and they prostrated, except for Iblees. He said, "Should I prostrate to one You created from clay

versets.arabe: قَالَ أَرَأَيْتَكَ هَٰذَا الَّذِي كَرَّمْتَ عَلَيَّ
versets.phonetique: Qâla ara'aytaka hâthal-lathî karramta 'alayya
versets.francais: Il dit: est-ce là celui que Tu as honoré au-dessus de moi?
versets.anglais: [Iblees] said, "Do You see this one whom You have honored above me? If You delay me until the Day of Resurrection, I will surely destroy his descendants, except for a few

versets.arabe: قَالَ اذْهَبْ فَمَن تَبِعَكَ مِنْهُمْ فَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ جَزَاؤُكُمْ جَزَاءً مَّوْفُورًا
versets.phonetique: Qâlath-hab faman tabi'aka minhum fa'inna jahannama jazâ'ukum jazâ'an mawfûrâ
versets.francais: Il dit: va-t'en! Ceux d'entre eux qui te suivront, la Géhenne sera votre rétribution, une rétribution complète.
versets.anglais: [Allah] said, "Go, for whoever of them follows you, indeed Hell will be the recompense of you - an ample recompense

versets.arabe: وَاسْتَفْزِزْ مَنِ اسْتَطَعْتَ مِنْهُم بِصَوْتِكَ
versets.phonetique: Wastafziz manistatata minhum bisawtik
versets.francais: Ébranle par ta voix ceux d'entre eux que tu peux.
versets.anglais: And incite [to senselessness] whoever you can among them with your voice and assault them with your horses and foot soldiers and become a partner in their wealth and their children and promise them." But Satan does not promise them except delusion

versets.arabe: إِنَّ عِبَادِي لَيْسَ لَكَ عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَانٌ وَكَفَىٰ بِرَبِّكَ وَكِيلًا
versets.phonetique: Inna 'ibâdî laysa laka 'alayhim sultânun wa kafâ birabbika wakîlâ
versets.francais: Certes, tu n'as aucun pouvoir sur Mes serviteurs. Ton Seigneur suffit comme Protecteur.
versets.anglais: Indeed, over My [believing] servants there is for you no authority. And sufficient is your Lord as Disposer of affairs

versets.arabe: رَّبُّكُمُ الَّذِي يُزْجِي لَكُمُ الْفُلْكَ فِي الْبَحْرِ لِتَبْتَغُوا مِن فَضْلِهِ
versets.phonetique: Rabbukumul-lathî yuzjî lakumul-fulka fil-bahri litabtaghû min fadhlih
versets.francais: Votre Seigneur est Celui qui vous fait naviguer sur mer afin que vous recherchiez de Sa grâce.
versets.anglais: It is your Lord who drives the ship for you through the sea that you may seek of His bounty. Indeed, He is ever, to you, Merciful

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا مَسَّكُمُ الضُّرُّ فِي الْبَحْرِ ضَلَّ مَن تَدْعُونَ إِلَّا إِيَّاهُ
versets.phonetique: Wa ithâ massakumudh-dhurru fil-bahri dhalla man tad'ûna illâ iyyâh
versets.francais: Quand vous êtes en détresse sur la mer, ceux que vous invoquez s'évanouissent sauf Lui.
versets.anglais: And when adversity touches you at sea, lost are [all] those you invoke except for Him. But when He delivers you to the land, you turn away [from Him]. And ever is man ungrateful

versets.arabe: أَفَأَمِنتُمْ أَن يَخْسِفَ بِكُمْ جَانِبَ الْبَرِّ أَوْ يُرْسِلَ عَلَيْكُمْ حَاصِبًا
versets.phonetique: Afa'amintum an yakhsifa bikum jânibul-barri aw yursila 'alaykum hâsibâ
versets.francais: Vous croyez-vous à l'abri qu'Il vous enfouisse dans la terre ferme ou qu'Il vous envoie une tempête de pierres?
versets.anglais: Then do you feel secure that [instead] He will not cause a part of the land to swallow you or send against you a storm of stones? Then you would not find for yourselves an advocate

versets.arabe: أَمْ أَمِنتُمْ أَن يُعِيدَكُمْ فِيهِ تَارَةً أُخْرَىٰ فَيُرْسِلَ عَلَيْكُمْ قَاصِفًا مِّنَ الرِّيحِ
versets.phonetique: Am amintum an yu'îdakum fîhi târatun ukhrâ fayursila 'alaykum qâsifam minar-rîh
versets.francais: Ou vous croyez-vous à l'abri qu'Il vous y ramène une autre fois et vous envoie un vent destructeur?
versets.anglais: Or do you feel secure that He will not send you back into the sea another time and send upon you a hurricane of wind and drown you for what you denied? Then you would not find for yourselves against Us an avenger

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ كَرَّمْنَا بَنِي آدَمَ وَحَمَلْنَاهُمْ فِي الْبَرِّ وَالْبَحْرِ
versets.phonetique: Wa laqad karamnâ banî âdama wa hamalnâhum fil-barri wal-bahr
versets.francais: Certes, Nous avons honoré les fils d'Adam. Nous les avons transportés sur terre et sur mer.
versets.anglais: And We have certainly honored the children of Adam and carried them on the land and sea and provided for them of the good things and preferred them over much of what We have created, with [definite] preference

versets.arabe: يَوْمَ نَدْعُو كُلَّ أُنَاسٍ بِإِمَامِهِمْ
versets.phonetique: Yawma nad'û kulla unâsin bi'imâmihim
versets.francais: Le jour où Nous appellerons chaque groupe avec son imam.
versets.anglais: [Mention, O Muhammad], the Day We will call forth every people with their record [of deeds]. Then whoever is given his record in his right hand - those will read their records, and injustice will not be done to them, [even] as much as a thread [inside the date seed]

versets.arabe: وَمَن كَانَ فِي هَٰذِهِ أَعْمَىٰ فَهُوَ فِي الْآخِرَةِ أَعْمَىٰ
versets.phonetique: Wa man kâna fî hâthihî a'mâ fahuwa fil-âkhirati a'mâ
versets.francais: Quiconque aura été aveugle ici-bas, sera aveugle dans l'au-delà.
versets.anglais: And whoever is blind in this [life] will be blind in the Hereafter and more astray in way

versets.arabe: وَإِن كَادُوا لَيَفْتِنُونَكَ عَنِ الَّذِي أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ
versets.phonetique: Wa in kâdû layaftinûnaka 'anillathî awhaynâ ilayk
versets.francais: Ils ont failli t'éloigner de ce que Nous t'avons révélé.
versets.anglais: And indeed, they were about to tempt you away from that which We revealed to you in order to [make] you invent about Us something else; and then they would have taken you as a friend

versets.arabe: وَلَوْلَا أَن ثَبَّتْنَاكَ لَقَدْ كِدتَّ تَرْكَنُ إِلَيْهِمْ شَيْئًا قَلِيلًا
versets.phonetique: Wa lawlâ an thabbatnâka laqad kidta tarkanu ilayhim shay'an qalîlâ
versets.francais: Si Nous ne t'avions pas affermi, tu aurais failli t'incliner un peu vers eux.
versets.anglais: And if We had not strengthened you, you would have almost inclined to them a little

versets.arabe: إِذًا لَّأَذَقْنَاكَ ضِعْفَ الْحَيَاةِ وَضِعْفَ الْمَمَاتِ
versets.phonetique: Ithan la'athaqnâka dhi'fal-hayâti wa dhi'fal-mamât
versets.francais: Nous t'aurions alors fait goûter le double en vie et le double à la mort.
versets.anglais: Then [if you had], We would have made you taste double [punishment in] life and double [after] death. Then you would not find for yourself against Us a helper

versets.arabe: وَإِن كَادُوا لَيَسْتَفِزُّونَكَ مِنَ الْأَرْضِ لِيُخْرِجُوكَ مِنْهَا
versets.phonetique: Wa in kâdû layastafizzûnaka minal-ardhi liyukhrijûka minhâ
versets.francais: Ils ont failli te faire peur pour t'expulser du pays.
