versets.anglais: And indeed, they were about to drive you from the land to evict you therefrom. And then [when they do], they will not remain [there] after you, except for a little

versets.arabe: سُنَّةَ مَن قَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ مِن رُّسُلِنَا
versets.phonetique: Sunnata man qad arsalnâ qablaka mir-rusulinâ
versets.francais: C'est la règle de ceux de Nos messagers que Nous avons envoyés avant toi.
versets.anglais: [That is Our] established way for those We had sent before you of Our messengers; and you will not find in Our way any alteration

versets.arabe: أَقِمِ الصَّلَاةَ لِدُلُوكِ الشَّمْسِ إِلَىٰ غَسَقِ اللَّيْلِ وَقُرْآنَ الْفَجْرِ
versets.phonetique: Aqimis-salâta liduluukish-shamsi ilâ ghasaqil-layli wa qur'ânal-fajr
versets.francais: Accomplis la Salat au déclin du soleil jusqu'à l'obscurité de la nuit, et la récitation de l'aube.
versets.anglais: Establish prayer at the decline of the sun [from its meridian] until the darkness of the night and [also] the Qur'an of dawn. Indeed, the recitation of dawn is ever witnessed

versets.arabe: وَمِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَتَهَجَّدْ بِهِ نَافِلَةً لَّكَ عَسَىٰ أَن يَبْعَثَكَ رَبُّكَ مَقَامًا مَّحْمُودًا
versets.phonetique: Wa minal-layli fatahajjad bihî nâfilatan laka 'asâ an yab'athaka rabbuka maqâman mahmûdâ
versets.francais: Et durant une partie de la nuit, veille à la Salat en plus: peut-être que ton Seigneur t'élèvera à une station louée.
versets.anglais: And from [part of] the night, pray with it as additional [worship] for you; it is expected that your Lord will resurrect you to a praised station

versets.arabe: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَدْخِلْنِي مُدْخَلَ صِدْقٍ وَأَخْرِجْنِي مُخْرَجَ صِدْقٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa qur-rabbi adkhilnî mudkhala sidqin wa akhrijnî mukhraja sidq
versets.francais: Et dis: Seigneur, fais-moi entrer d'une entrée sincère et sortir d'une sortie sincère.
versets.anglais: And say, "My Lord, cause me to enter a sound entrance and to exit a sound exit and grant me from Yourself a supporting authority

versets.arabe: وَقُلْ جَاءَ الْحَقُّ وَزَهَقَ الْبَاطِلُ إِنَّ الْبَاطِلَ كَانَ زَهُوقًا
versets.phonetique: Wa qul jâ'al-haqqu wa zahaqal-bâtil innal-bâtila kâna zahûqâ
versets.francais: Et dis: la vérité est venue et le faux s'est évanoui. Le faux est toujours évanescent.
versets.anglais: And say, "Truth has come, and falsehood has departed. Indeed is falsehood, [by nature], ever bound to depart

versets.arabe: وَنُنَزِّلُ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ مَا هُوَ شِفَاءٌ وَرَحْمَةٌ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa nunazzilu minal-qur'âni mâ huwa shifâ'un wa rahmatun lil-mu'minîn
versets.francais: Nous faisons descendre dans le Coran ce qui est une guérison et une miséricorde pour les croyants.
versets.anglais: And We send down of the Qur'an that which is healing and mercy for the believers, but it does not increase the wrongdoers except in loss

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَى الْإِنسَانِ أَعْرَضَ وَنَأَىٰ بِجَانِبِهِ
versets.phonetique: Wa ithâ an'amnâ 'alal-insâni a'radha wa na'â bijânibih
versets.francais: Quand Nous accordons des bienfaits à l'homme, il se détourne et s'éloigne.
versets.anglais: And when We bestow favor upon the disbeliever, he turns away and distances himself; and when evil touches him, he is ever despairing

versets.arabe: قُلْ كُلٌّ يَعْمَلُ عَلَىٰ شَاكِلَتِهِ فَرَبُّكُمْ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنْ هُوَ أَهْدَىٰ سَبِيلًا
versets.phonetique: Qul kullun ya'malu 'alâ shâkilatihî fa rabbukum a'lamu biman huwa ahdâ sabîlâ
versets.francais: Dis: chacun agit selon sa façon d'être. Votre Seigneur sait mieux qui est le mieux guidé.
versets.anglais: Say, "Each works according to his manner, but your Lord is most knowing of who is best guided in way

versets.arabe: وَيَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ الرُّوحِ قُلِ الرُّوحُ مِنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّي
versets.phonetique: Wa yas'alûnaka 'anir-rûhi qulir-rûhu min amri rabbî
versets.francais: Ils t'interrogent sur l'âme. Dis: l'âme relève de l'ordre de mon Seigneur.
versets.anglais: And they ask you, [O Muhammad], about the soul. Say, "The soul is of the affair of my Lord. And mankind have not been given of knowledge except a little

versets.arabe: وَلَئِن شِئْنَا لَنَذْهَبَنَّ بِالَّذِي أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ
versets.phonetique: Wa la'in shi'nâ lanathahabanna bilathî awhaynâ ilayk
versets.francais: Si Nous voulions, Nous ferions disparaître ce que Nous t'avons révélé.
versets.anglais: And if We willed, We could surely do away with that which We revealed to you. Then you would not find for yourself concerning it an advocate against Us

versets.arabe: إِلَّا رَحْمَةً مِّن رَّبِّكَ إِنَّ فَضْلَهُ كَانَ عَلَيْكَ كَبِيرًا
versets.phonetique: Illâ rahmatam mir-rabbika inna fadhlahu kâna 'alayka kabîrâ
versets.francais: Sauf par la miséricorde de ton Seigneur. Sa grâce envers toi est immense.
versets.anglais: Except [We have left it with you] as a mercy from your Lord. Indeed, His favor upon you has ever been great

versets.arabe: قُل لَّئِنِ اجْتَمَعَتِ الْإِنسُ وَالْجِنُّ عَلَىٰ أَن يَأْتُوا بِمِثْلِ هَٰذَا الْقُرْآنِ
versets.phonetique: Qul la'inijttama'atil-insu wal-jinnu 'alâ an ya'tû bimithli hâthal-qur'ân
versets.francais: Dis: si les hommes et les djinns s'unissaient pour produire quelque chose de semblable à ce Coran, ils n'y parviendraient pas.
versets.anglais: Say, "If mankind and the jinn gathered in order to produce the like of this Qur'an, they could not produce the like of it, even if they were to each other assistants

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ صَرَّفْنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِي هَٰذَا الْقُرْآنِ مِن كُلِّ مَثَلٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa laqad sarrafnâ lin-nâsi fî hâthal-qur'âni min kulli mathal
versets.francais: Nous avons certes, diversifié dans ce Coran pour les hommes toutes sortes d'exemples.
versets.anglais: And We have certainly diversified for the people in this Qur'an from every [kind] of example, but most of the people refused [anything] except disbelief

versets.arabe: وَقَالُوا لَن نُّؤْمِنَ لَكَ حَتَّىٰ تَفْجُرَ لَنَا مِنَ الْأَرْضِ يَنبُوعًا
versets.phonetique: Wa qâlû lan nu'mina laka hattâ tafjura lanâ minal-ardhi yanbû'â
versets.francais: Ils dirent: nous ne croirons en toi que si tu fais jaillir de la terre une source pour nous.
versets.anglais: And they say, "We will not believe you until you break open for us from the ground a spring

versets.arabe: أَوْ تَكُونَ لَكَ جَنَّةٌ مِّن نَّخِيلٍ وَعِنَبٍ فَتُفَجِّرَ الْأَنْهَارَ خِلَالَهَا تَفْجِيرًا
versets.phonetique: Aw takûna laka jannatun min nakhîlin wa 'inibin fatufajjiral-anhâra khilâlahâ tafjîrâ
versets.francais: Ou que tu aies un jardin de palmiers et de vignes et que tu y fasses couler des ruisseaux.
versets.anglais: Or [until] you have a garden of palm tress and grapes and make rivers gush forth within them in force [and abundance]

versets.arabe: أَوْ تُسْقِطَ السَّمَاءَ كَمَا زَعَمْتَ عَلَيْنَا كِسَفًا
versets.phonetique: Aw tusqitas-samâ'a kamâ za'amta 'alaynâ kisafâ
versets.francais: Ou que tu fasses tomber sur nous le ciel par morceaux comme tu le prétends.
versets.anglais: Or you make the heaven fall upon us in fragments as you have claimed or you bring Allah and the angels before [us]

versets.arabe: قُلْ سُبْحَانَ رَبِّي هَلْ كُنتُ إِلَّا بَشَرًا رَّسُولًا
versets.phonetique: Qul subhâna rabbî hal kuntu illâ basharan rasûlâ
versets.francais: Dis: Gloire à mon Seigneur! Ne suis-je qu'un être humain envoyé comme messager?
versets.anglais: Or you have a house of gold or you ascend into the sky. And [even then], we will not believe in your ascension until you bring down to us a book we may read." Say, "Exalted is my Lord! Was I ever but a human messenger

versets.arabe: وَمَا مَنَعَ النَّاسَ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا إِذْ جَاءَهُمُ الْهُدَىٰ
versets.phonetique: Wa mâ mana'an-nâsa an yu'minû ith jâ'ahumul-hudâ
versets.francais: Rien n'a empêché les hommes de croire quand la guidance leur est venue.
versets.anglais: And what prevented the people from believing when guidance came to them except that they said, "Has Allah sent a human messenger

versets.arabe: قُل لَّوْ كَانَ فِي الْأَرْضِ مَلَائِكَةٌ يَمْشُونَ مُطْمَئِنِّينَ
versets.phonetique: Qul law kâna fil-ardhi malâ'ikatun yamshûna mutma'innîn
versets.francais: Dis: s'il y avait sur la terre des anges marchant tranquillement, Nous aurions fait descendre pour eux un ange comme messager.
versets.anglais: Say, "If there were upon the earth angels walking securely, We would have sent down to them from the heaven an angel [as a] messenger

versets.arabe: قُلْ كَفَىٰ بِاللَّهِ شَهِيدًا بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Qul kafâ billâhi shahîdan baynî wa baynakum
versets.francais: Dis: Allah suffit comme témoin entre moi et vous.
versets.anglais: Say, "Sufficient is Allah as Witness between me and you. Indeed he is ever, concerning His servants, Acquainted and Seeing

versets.arabe: وَمَن يَهْدِ اللَّهُ فَهُوَ الْمُهْتَدِ وَمَن يُضْلِلْ فَلَن تَجِدَ لَهُمْ أَوْلِيَاءَ
versets.phonetique: Wa man yahdillâhu fahuwal-muhtadi wa man yudhlil falan tajida lahum awliyâ'
versets.francais: Celui qu'Allah guide est bien guidé. Et ceux qu'Il égare, tu ne trouveras pour eux aucun protecteur.
versets.anglais: And whoever Allah guides - he is the [rightly] guided; and whoever He sends astray - you will never find for them protectors besides Him, and We will gather them on the Day of Resurrection [fallen] on their faces - blind, dumb and deaf. Their refuge is Hell; every time it subsides We increase them in blazing fire

versets.arabe: وَنَحْشُرُهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ عُمْيًا وَبُكْمًا وَصُمًّا
versets.phonetique: Wa nahshuruhum yawmal-qiyâmati 'alâ wujûhihim 'umyan wa bukman wa summân
versets.francais: Nous les rassemblerons le Jour de la Résurrection sur leurs visages, aveugles, muets et sourds.
versets.anglais: That is their recompense because they disbelieved in Our verses and said, "When we are bones and crumbled particles, will we [truly] be resurrected [in] a new creation

versets.arabe: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا أَنَّ اللَّهَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ قَادِرٌ
versets.phonetique: Awa lam yaraw annallâhal-lathî khalaqas-samâwâti wal-ardha qâdir
versets.francais: Ne voient-ils pas qu'Allah qui a créé les cieux et la terre est capable de créer leurs semblables?
versets.anglais: Do they not see that Allah, who created the heavens and earth, is [the one] Able to create the likes of them? And He has appointed for them a term, about which there is no doubt. But the wrongdoers refuse [anything] except disbelief

versets.arabe: قُل لَّوْ أَنتُمْ تَمْلِكُونَ خَزَائِنَ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّي
versets.phonetique: Qul law antum tamlukûna khazâ'ina rahmati rabbî
versets.francais: Dis: si vous possédiez les trésors de la miséricorde de mon Seigneur, vous les retiendriez par crainte de les dépenser.
versets.anglais: Say [to them], "If you possessed the depositories of the mercy of my Lord, then you would withhold out of fear of spending." And ever has man been stingy

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ تِسْعَ آيَاتٍ بَيِّنَاتٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa laqad âtaynâ mûsâ tis'a âyâtin bayyinât
versets.francais: Nous avons donné à Moïse neuf signes évidents.
versets.anglais: And We had certainly given Moses nine evident signs, so ask the Children of Israel [about] when he came to them and Pharaoh said to him, "Indeed I think, O Moses, that you are affected by magic

versets.arabe: قَالَ لَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ مَا أَنزَلَ هَٰؤُلَاءِ إِلَّا رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ
versets.phonetique: Qâla laqad 'alimta mâ anzala hâ'ulâ'i illâ rabbus-samâwâti wal-ardh
versets.francais: Moïse dit: tu sais bien que personne n'a fait descendre ces signes sauf le Seigneur des cieux et de la terre.
versets.anglais: [Moses] said, "You have already known that none has sent down these [signs] except the Lord of the heavens and the earth as evidence, and indeed I think, O Pharaoh, that you are destroyed

versets.arabe: فَأَرَادَ أَن يَسْتَفِزَّهُم مِّنَ الْأَرْضِ فَأَغْرَقْنَاهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُ جَمِيعًا
versets.phonetique: Fa'arâda an yastafizzahum minal-ardhi fa'aghraqnâhu wa man ma'ahu jamî'â
versets.francais: Il voulut les chasser du pays, alors Nous le noyâmes lui et tous ceux qui étaient avec lui.
versets.anglais: So he intended to drive them from the land, but We drowned him and those with him all together

versets.arabe: وَقُلْنَا مِن بَعْدِهِ لِبَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ اسْكُنُوا الْأَرْضَ
versets.phonetique: Wa qulnâ mim ba'dihî libanî isrâ'îla uskûnul-ardh
versets.francais: Après lui, Nous dîmes aux fils d'Israël: habitez la terre.
versets.anglais: And We said after Pharaoh to the Children of Israel, "Dwell in the land, and when there comes the promise of the Hereafter, We will bring you forth in [one] gathering

versets.arabe: وَبِالْحَقِّ أَنزَلْنَاهُ وَبِالْحَقِّ نَزَلَ
versets.phonetique: Wa bil-haqqi anzalnâhu wa bil-haqqi nazal
versets.francais: Nous l'avons révélé en toute vérité et c'est en toute vérité qu'il est descendu.
versets.anglais: And with the truth We have sent the Qur'an down, and with the truth it has descended. And We have not sent you, [O Muhammad], except as a bringer of good tidings and a warner

versets.arabe: وَقُرْآنًا فَرَقْنَاهُ لِتَقْرَأَهُ عَلَى النَّاسِ عَلَىٰ مُكْثٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa qur'ânan faraqnâhu litaqra'ahu 'alan-nâsi 'alâ mukth
versets.francais: Nous avons divisé le Coran afin que tu le récites aux hommes à intervalles.
versets.anglais: And [it is] a Qur'an which We have separated [by intervals] that you might recite it to the people over a prolonged period. And We have sent it down progressively

versets.arabe: قُلْ آمِنُوا بِهِ أَوْ لَا تُؤْمِنُوا إِنَّ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهِ
versets.phonetique: Qul âminû bihî aw lâ tu'minû innal-lathîna ûtul-'ilma min qablih
versets.francais: Dis: croyez-y ou n'y croyez pas. Ceux à qui la science a été donnée avant lui, quand on le leur récite, se prosternent.
versets.anglais: Say, "Believe in it or do not believe. Indeed, those who were given knowledge before it - when it is recited to them, they fall upon their faces in prostration

versets.arabe: وَيَقُولُونَ سُبْحَانَ رَبِّنَا إِن كَانَ وَعْدُ رَبِّنَا لَمَفْعُولًا
versets.phonetique: Wa yaqûlûna subhâna rabbinâ in kâna wa'du rabbinâ lamaf'ûlâ
versets.francais: Et ils disent: Gloire à notre Seigneur. La promesse de notre Seigneur était certainement accomplie.
versets.anglais: And they say, "Exalted is our Lord! Indeed, the promise of our Lord has been fulfilled

versets.arabe: وَيَخِرُّونَ لِلْأَذْقَانِ يَبْكُونَ وَيَزِيدُهُمْ خُشُوعًا
versets.phonetique: Wa yakhirrûna lil-athqâni yabkûna wa yazîduhum khushû'â
versets.francais: Et ils tombent le visage en pleurant, et cela augmente leur humilité.
versets.anglais: And they fall upon their faces weeping, and the Qur'an increases them in humble submission

versets.arabe: قُلِ ادْعُوا اللَّهَ أَوِ ادْعُوا الرَّحْمَٰنَ أَيًّا مَّا تَدْعُوا فَلَهُ الْأَسْمَاءُ الْحُسْنَىٰ
versets.phonetique: Qulid'ûllâha aw id'ur-rahmâna ayyam mâ tad'û falahul-asmâ'ul-husnâ
versets.francais: Dis: invoquez Allah ou invoquez Ar-Rahman; quel que soit le nom que vous invoquez, Il a les plus beaux noms.
versets.anglais: Say, "Call upon Allah or call upon the Most Merciful. Whichever [name] you call - to Him belong the best names." And do not recite [too] loudly in your prayer or [too] quietly but seek between that an [intermediate] way

versets.arabe: وَقُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي لَمْ يَتَّخِذْ وَلَدًا
versets.phonetique: Wa qulil-hamdu lillâhil-lathî lam yattakhith waladâ
versets.francais: Et dis: louange à Allah qui n'a pas pris d'enfant.
versets.anglais: And say, "Praise to Allah, who has not taken a son and has had no partner in [His] dominion and has no [need of a] protector out of weakness; and glorify Him with [great] glorification

versets.arabe: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَنزَلَ عَلَىٰ عَبْدِهِ الْكِتَابَ وَلَمْ يَجْعَل لَّهُ عِوَجًا
versets.phonetique: Alhamdu lillahi lladhi anzala ala abdihi l-kitaba wa lam yaj-al lahu iwaja
versets.francais: Louange à Allah qui a fait descendre sur Son serviteur le Livre sans y mettre aucune déviation
versets.anglais: [All] praise is [due] to Allah, who has sent down upon His Servant the Book and has not made therein any deviance

versets.arabe: قَيِّمًا لِّيُنذِرَ بَأْسًا شَدِيدًا مِّن لَّدُنْهُ وَيُبَشِّرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ الَّذِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ الصَّالِحَاتِ أَنَّ لَهُمْ أَجْرًا حَسَنًا
versets.phonetique: Qayyiman liyundhira ba-san shadidan min ladunhu wa yubashshira l-mu-minina lladhina ya-maluna s-salihati anna lahum ajran hasana
versets.francais: Un Livre droit, pour avertir d-un châtiment sévère venant de Lui, et pour annoncer la bonne nouvelle aux croyants qui font de bonnes oeuvres qu-ils auront une belle récompense
versets.anglais: [He has made it] straight, to warn of severe punishment from Him and to give good tidings to the believers who do righteous deeds that they will have a good reward

versets.arabe: مَّاكِثِينَ فِيهِ أَبَدًا
versets.phonetique: Makithina fihi abada
versets.francais: Dans laquelle ils demeureront éternellement
versets.anglais: In which they will remain forever

versets.arabe: وَيُنذِرَ الَّذِينَ قَالُوا اتَّخَذَ اللَّهُ وَلَدًا
versets.phonetique: Wa yundhira lladhina qalu ttakhadha l-lahu walada
versets.francais: Et pour avertir ceux qui ont dit : Allah S-est donné un enfant
versets.anglais: And to warn those who say, "Allah has taken a son

versets.arabe: مَّا لَهُم بِهِ مِنْ عِلْمٍ وَلَا لِآبَائِهِمْ كَبُرَتْ كَلِمَةً تَخْرُجُ مِنْ أَفْوَاهِهِمْ إِن يَقُولُونَ إِلَّا كَذِبًا
versets.phonetique: Ma lahum bihi min ilmin wa la li-aba-ihim kaburat kalimatan takhruju min afwahihim in yaquluna illa kadhiba
versets.francais: Ni eux ni leurs pères n-en ont aucune connaissance. Quelle énorme parole qui sort de leurs bouches ! Ils ne disent que mensonge
versets.anglais: They have no knowledge of it, nor had their fathers. Grave is the word that comes out of their mouths; they speak not except a lie

versets.arabe: فَلَعَلَّكَ بَاخِعٌ نَّفْسَكَ عَلَىٰ آثَارِهِمْ إِن لَّمْ يُؤْمِنُوا بِهَٰذَا الْحَدِيثِ أَسَفًا
versets.phonetique: Fala-allaka bakhi-un nafsaka ala atharihim in lam yu-minu bihadha l-hadithi asafa
versets.francais: Tu vas peut-être te consumer de chagrin sur leurs traces s-ils ne croient pas en ce discours
versets.anglais: Then perhaps you would kill yourself through grief over them, [O Muhammad], if they do not believe in this message, [and] out of sorrow

versets.arabe: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَا مَا عَلَى الْأَرْضِ زِينَةً لَّهَا لِنَبْلُوَهُمْ أَيُّهُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًا
versets.phonetique: Inna ja-alna ma ala l-ardi zinatan laha linabluwahum ayyuhum ahsanu amala
versets.francais: Nous avons fait de ce qui est sur la terre un ornement pour elle, afin d-éprouver les hommes et de savoir lequel d-entre eux est le meilleur en oeuvres
versets.anglais: Indeed, We have made that which is on the earth adornment for it that We may test them [as to] which of them is best in deed

versets.arabe: وَإِنَّا لَجَاعِلُونَ مَا عَلَيْهَا صَعِيدًا جُرُزًا
versets.phonetique: Wa inna laja-iluna ma alayha sa-idan juroza
versets.francais: Et Nous allons réduire ce qui est sur elle en une terre desséchée
versets.anglais: And indeed, We will make that which is upon it [into] a barren ground

versets.arabe: أَمْ حَسِبْتَ أَنَّ أَصْحَابَ الْكَهْفِ وَالرَّقِيمِ كَانُوا مِنْ آيَاتِنَا عَجَبًا
versets.phonetique: Am hasibta anna ashaba l-kahfi wa r-raqimi kanu min ayatina ajaba
versets.francais: As-tu pensé que les gens de la Caverne et de la Table étaient parmi Nos prodiges étonnants
versets.anglais: Or have you thought that the companions of the cave and the inscription were, among Our signs, a wonder

versets.arabe: إِذْ أَوَى الْفِتْيَةُ إِلَى الْكَهْفِ فَقَالُوا رَبَّنَا آتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًا
versets.phonetique: Idh awa l-fityatu ila l-kahfi faqalu rabbana atina min ladunka rahmatan wa hayyi-lana min amrina rashada
versets.francais: Quand les jeunes gens se réfugièrent dans la Caverne et dirent : Notre Seigneur, accorde-nous une miséricorde de Ta part et prépare-nous une bonne conduite dans notre affaire
versets.anglais: [Mention] when the youths retreated to the cave and said, "Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance

versets.arabe: فَضَرَبْنَا عَلَىٰ آذَانِهِمْ فِي الْكَهْفِ سِنِينَ عَدَدًا
versets.phonetique: Fadharabna ala adhanihim fi l-kahfi sinina adada
versets.francais: Nous avons alors fermé leurs oreilles dans la Caverne pendant un nombre d-années
versets.anglais: So We cast [a cover of sleep] over their ears within the cave for a number of years

versets.arabe: ثُمَّ بَعَثْنَاهُمْ لِنَعْلَمَ أَيُّ الْحِزْبَيْنِ أَحْصَىٰ لِمَا لَبِثُوا أَمَدًا
versets.phonetique: Thumma ba-athnahum lina-lama ayyu l-hizbayni ahsa lima labithu amada
versets.francais: Puis Nous les avons réveillés pour savoir lequel des deux groupes avait mieux calculé la durée de leur séjour
versets.anglais: Then We awakened them that We might show which of the two factions was most precise in calculating what [extent] they had remained in time

versets.arabe: نَحْنُ نَقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ نَبَأَهُم بِالْحَقِّ إِنَّهُمْ فِتْيَةٌ آمَنُوا بِرَبِّهِمْ وَزِدْنَاهُمْ هُدًى
versets.phonetique: Nahnu naqussu alayka naba-ahum bil-haqqi innahum fityatun amanu birabbihim wa zidnahum huda
versets.francais: Nous te racontons leur histoire en toute vérité. Ce sont des jeunes gens qui ont cru en leur Seigneur, et Nous leur avons accordé davantage de guidée
versets.anglais: It is We who relate to you, [O Muhammad], their story in truth. Indeed, they were youths who believed in their Lord, and We increased them in guidance

versets.arabe: وَرَبَطْنَا عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ إِذْ قَامُوا فَقَالُوا رَبُّنَا رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ لَن نَّدْعُوَ مِن دُونِهِ إِلَٰهًا لَّقَدْ قُلْنَا إِذًا شَطَطًا
versets.phonetique: Wa rabatna ala qulubihim idh qamu faqalu rabbuna rabbu s-samawati wa l-ardi lan nad-uwa min dunihi ilahan laqad qulna idhan shatata
versets.francais: Et Nous avons fortifié leurs coeurs quand ils se levèrent et dirent : Notre Seigneur est le Seigneur des cieux et de la terre. Nous n-invoquerons jamais en dehors de Lui aucune divinité, sinon nous dirions une énormité
versets.anglais: And We made firm their hearts when they stood up and said, "Our Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth. Never will we invoke besides Him any deity. We would have certainly spoken, then, an excessive transgression

versets.arabe: هَٰؤُلَاءِ قَوْمُنَا اتَّخَذُوا مِن دُونِهِ آلِهَةً لَّوْلَا يَأْتُونَ عَلَيْهِم بِسُلْطَانٍ بَيِّنٍ فَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ افْتَرَىٰ عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا
versets.phonetique: Ha-ula-i qawmuna ttakhadhu min dunihi aligatan lawla ya-tuna alayhim bisultanin bayyinin faman azlamu mimman iftara ala l-lahi kadhiba
versets.francais: Voilà notre peuple qui a pris en dehors de Lui d-autres divinités. Que n-apportent-ils pas une preuve évidente à leur sujet ? Qui est plus injuste que celui qui invente un mensonge contre Allah
versets.anglais: These, our people, have taken besides Him deities. Why do they not bring for [worship of] them a clear authority? And who is more unjust than one who invents about Allah a lie

versets.arabe: وَإِذِ اعْتَزَلْتُمُوهُمْ وَمَا يَعْبُدُونَ إِلَّا اللَّهَ فَأْوُوا إِلَى الْكَهْفِ يَنشُرْ لَكُمْ رَبُّكُم مِّن رَّحْمَتِهِ وَيُهَيِّئْ لَكُم مِّنْ أَمْرِكُم مِّرْفَقًا
versets.phonetique: Wa idhi-tazaltumuhum wa ma ya-buduna illa l-laha fa-wu ila l-kahfi yanshur lakum rabbukum min rahmatihi wa yuhayyi-lakkum min amrikum mirfaqa
versets.francais: Puisque vous vous êtes séparés d-eux et de ce qu-ils adorent en dehors d-Allah, réfugiez-vous dans la Caverne : votre Seigneur étendra sur vous Sa miséricorde et vous préparera une issue favorable dans votre affaire
versets.anglais: [The youths said to one another], "And when you have withdrawn from them and that which they worship other than Allah, retreat to the cave. Your Lord will spread out for you of His mercy and will prepare for you from your affair facility

versets.arabe: وَتَرَى الشَّمْسَ إِذَا طَلَعَت تَّزَاوَرُ عَن كَهْفِهِمْ ذَاتَ الْيَمِينِ وَإِذَا غَرَبَت تَّقْرِضُهُمْ ذَاتَ الشِّمَالِ وَهُمْ فِي فَجْوَةٍ مِّنْهُ
versets.phonetique: Wa tara sh-shamsa idha tala-at tazawaru an kahfihim dhata l-yamini wa idha gharabat taqridhuhum dhata sh-shimali wa hum fi fajwatin minhu
versets.francais: Tu vois le soleil quand il se lève décliner vers la droite de leur Caverne et quand il se couche les éviter vers la gauche, tandis qu-ils sont dans l-espace intérieur de la Caverne
versets.anglais: And [had you been present], you would see the sun when it rose, inclining away from their cave on the right, and when it set, passing away from them on the left, while they were [laying] within an open space thereof. That was from the signs of Allah. He whom Allah guides is the [rightly] guided, but he whom He leaves astray - never will you find for him a protecting guide

versets.arabe: وَتَحْسَبُهُمْ أَيْقَاظًا وَهُمْ رُقُودٌ وَنُقَلِّبُهُمْ ذَاتَ الْيَمِينِ وَذَاتَ الشِّمَالِ وَكَلْبُهُم بَاسِطٌ ذِرَاعَيْهِ بِالْوَصِيدِ
versets.phonetique: Wa tahsabuhum ayqadan wa hum ruqudun wa nuqallibuhum dhata l-yamini wa dhata sh-shimali wa kalbuhum basitun dhira-ayhi bil-wasid
versets.francais: Tu les crois éveillés alors qu-ils dorment. Nous les retournons vers la droite et vers la gauche, tandis que leur chien étend ses pattes de devant sur le seuil
versets.anglais: And you would think them awake, while they were asleep. And We turned them to the right and to the left, while their dog stretched his forelegs at the entrance. If you had looked at them, you would have turned from them in flight and been filled by them with terror

versets.arabe: وَكَذَٰلِكَ بَعَثْنَاهُمْ لِيَتَسَاءَلُوا بَيْنَهُمْ قَالَ قَائِلٌ مِّنْهُمْ كَمْ لَبِثْتُمْ قَالُوا لَبِثْنَا يَوْمًا أَوْ بَعْضَ يَوْمٍ قَالُوا رَبُّكُمْ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا لَبِثْتُمْ
versets.phonetique: Wa kadhalika ba-athnahum liyatasa-alu baynahum qala qa-ilun minhum kam labithtum qalu labithna yawman aw ba-da yawmin qalu rabbukum a-lamu bima labithtum
versets.francais: C-est ainsi que Nous les avons réveillés pour qu-ils s-interrogent entre eux. L-un d-eux dit : Combien de temps avez-vous séjourné ici ? Ils dirent : Un jour ou partie d-un jour. Ils dirent : Votre Seigneur sait mieux combien de temps vous avez séjourné
versets.anglais: And similarly, We awakened them that they might question one another. Said a speaker from among them, "How long have you remained [here]?" They said, "We have remained a day or part of a day." They said, "Your Lord is most knowing of how long you remained. So send one of you with this silver coin of yours to the city and let him look to which is the best of food and bring you provision from it and let him be cautious. And let no one be aware of you

versets.arabe: إِنَّهُمْ إِن يَظْهَرُوا عَلَيْكُمْ يَرْجُمُوكُمْ أَوْ يُعِيدُوكُمْ فِي مِلَّتِهِمْ وَلَن تُفْلِحُوا إِذًا أَبَدًا
versets.phonetique: Innahum in yazhharu alaykum yarjumukum aw yu-idukum fi millatihim wa lan tuflihu idhan abada
versets.francais: Si jamais ils ont connaissance de votre affaire, ils vous lapideront ou vous feront retourner à leur religion, et vous ne prospérerez jamais
versets.anglais: Indeed, if they come to know of you, they will stone you or return you to their religion. And never would you succeed, then - ever

versets.arabe: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَعْثَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ لِيَعْلَمُوا أَنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّ وَأَنَّ السَّاعَةَ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهَا
versets.phonetique: Wa kadhalika a-tharna alayhim liya-lamu anna wa-da l-lahi haqqun wa anna s-sa-ata la rayba fiha
versets.francais: C-est ainsi que Nous avons permis aux gens de les découvrir pour qu-ils sachent que la promesse d-Allah est vraie et que l-Heure ne fait aucun doute
versets.anglais: And similarly, We caused them to be found that they [who found them] would know that the promise of Allah is truth and that of the Hour there is no doubt. [That was] when they disputed among themselves about their affair and [then] said, "Construct over them a structure. Their Lord is most knowing about them." Said those who prevailed in the matter, "We will surely take [for ourselves] over them a masjid

versets.arabe: سَيَقُولُونَ ثَلَاثَةٌ رَّابِعُهُمْ كَلْبُهُمْ وَيَقُولُونَ خَمْسَةٌ سَادِسُهُمْ كَلْبُهُمْ رَجْمًا بِالْغَيْبِ وَيَقُولُونَ سَبْعَةٌ وَثَامِنُهُمْ كَلْبُهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Sayaquluna thalathatun rabi-uhum kalbuhum wa yaquluna khamsatun sadisuhum kalbuhum rajman bil-ghaybi wa yaquluna sab-atun wa thaaminuhum kalbuhum
versets.francais: Ils diront : Ils étaient trois, leur chien était le quatrième. D-autres diront : Cinq, leur chien était le sixième, présumant de l-inconnu. D-autres encore diront : Sept, et leur chien était le huitième
versets.anglais: They will say there were three, the fourth of them being their dog; and they will say there were five, the sixth of them being their dog - guessing at the unseen; and they will say there were seven, and the eighth of them was their dog. Say, [O Muhammad], "My Lord is most knowing of their number. None knows them except a few. So do not argue about them except with an obvious argument and do not inquire about them among [the speculators] from anyone

versets.arabe: وَلَا تَقُولَنَّ لِشَيْءٍ إِنِّي فَاعِلٌ ذَٰلِكَ غَدًا
versets.phonetique: Wa la taqulanna lishay-in inni fa-ilun dhalika ghada
versets.francais: Ne dis jamais à propos d-une chose : Je ferai cela demain
versets.anglais: And never say of anything, "Indeed, I will do that tomorrow

versets.arabe: إِلَّا أَن يَشَاءَ اللَّهُ وَاذْكُر رَّبَّكَ إِذَا نَسِيتَ وَقُلْ عَسَىٰ أَن يَهْدِيَنِ رَبِّي لِأَقْرَبَ مِنْ هَٰذَا رَشَدًا
versets.phonetique: Illa an yasha-a l-lahu wa dhkur rabbaka idha nasita wa qul asa an yahdiyani rabbi li-aqraba min hadha rashada
versets.francais: Sans ajouter : sauf si Allah le veut. Et rappelle-toi de ton Seigneur quand tu oublies, et dis : Peut-être que mon Seigneur me guidera vers quelque chose de plus proche de la bonne direction
versets.anglais: Except [when adding], "If Allah wills." And remember your Lord when you forget [it] and say, "Perhaps my Lord will guide me to what is nearer than this to right conduct

versets.arabe: وَلَبِثُوا فِي كَهْفِهِمْ ثَلَاثَ مِائَةٍ سِنِينَ وَازْدَادُوا تِسْعًا
versets.phonetique: Wa labithu fi kahfihim thalatha mi-atin sinina wa zdadu tis-a
versets.francais: Ils demeurèrent dans leur Caverne trois cents ans et neuf de plus
versets.anglais: And they remained in their cave for three hundred years and exceeded by nine

versets.arabe: قُلِ اللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا لَبِثُوا لَهُ غَيْبُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ أَبْصِرْ بِهِ وَأَسْمِعْ مَا لَهُم مِّن دُونِهِ مِن وَلِيٍّ وَلَا يُشْرِكُ فِي حُكْمِهِ أَحَدًا
versets.phonetique: Quli l-lahu a-lamu bima labithu lahu ghaybu s-samawati wa l-ardi absir bihi wa asmi- ma lahum min dunihi min waliyyin wa la yushriku fi hukmihi ahada
versets.francais: Dis : Allah sait mieux combien de temps ils sont restés. À Lui appartient le secret des cieux et de la terre. Comme Il voit et entend bien ! Ils n-ont en dehors de Lui aucun protecteur, et Il n-associe personne à Son pouvoir
versets.anglais: Say, "Allah is most knowing of how long they remained. He has [knowledge of] the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth. How Seeing is He and how Hearing! They have not besides Him any protector, and He shares not His legislation with anyone

versets.arabe: وَاتْلُ مَا أُوحِيَ إِلَيْكَ مِن كِتَابِ رَبِّكَ لَا مُبَدِّلَ لِكَلِمَاتِهِ وَلَن تَجِدَ مِن دُونِهِ مُلْتَحَدًا
versets.phonetique: Wa tlu ma uhiya ilayka min kitabi rabbika la mubaddila likalimatihi wa lan tajida min dunihi multahada
versets.francais: Récite ce qui t-a été révélé du Livre de ton Seigneur. Rien ne peut modifier Ses paroles et tu ne trouveras aucun refuge en dehors de Lui
versets.anglais: And recite, [O Muhammad], what has been revealed to you of the Book of your Lord. There is no changer of His words, and never will you find in other than Him a refuge

versets.arabe: وَاصْبِرْ نَفْسَكَ مَعَ الَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ رَبَّهُم بِالْغَدَاةِ وَالْعَشِيِّ يُرِيدُونَ وَجْهَهُ وَلَا تَعْدُ عَيْنَاكَ عَنْهُمْ تُرِيدُ زِينَةَ الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا
versets.phonetique: Wa sbir nafsaka ma-a lladhina yad-una rabbahum bil-ghadati wa l-ashiyyi yuriduna wajhahu wa la ta-du aynak anhum turidu zinata l-hayati d-dunya
versets.francais: Retiens-toi avec ceux qui invoquent leur Seigneur matin et soir cherchant Sa Face. Et que tes yeux ne se détournent pas d-eux pour chercher les ornements de la vie présente
versets.anglais: And keep yourself patient [by being] with those who call upon their Lord in the morning and the evening, seeking His countenance. And let not your eyes pass beyond them, desiring adornments of the worldly life, and do not obey one whose heart We have made heedless of Our remembrance and who follows his desire and whose affair is ever [in] neglect

versets.arabe: وَقُلِ الْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكُمْ فَمَن شَاءَ فَلْيُؤْمِن وَمَن شَاءَ فَلْيَكْفُرْ
versets.phonetique: Wa quli l-haqqu min rabbikum faman sha-a falyu-min wa man sha-a falyakfur
versets.francais: Dis : La vérité vient de votre Seigneur. Que celui qui veut croie, et que celui qui veut mécroie
versets.anglais: And say, "The truth is from your Lord, so whoever wills - let him believe; and whoever wills - let him disbelieve." Indeed, We have prepared for the wrongdoers a fire whose walls will surround them. And if they call for relief, they will be relieved with water like murky oil, which scalds [their] faces. Wretched is the drink, and evil is the resting place

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ إِنَّا لَا نُضِيعُ أَجْرَ مَنْ أَحْسَنَ عَمَلًا
versets.phonetique: Inna lladhina amanu wa amilu s-salihati inna la nudi-u ajra man ahsana amala
versets.francais: Quant à ceux qui ont cru et accompli de bonnes oeuvres, Nous ne laissons pas perdre la récompense de ceux qui font le bien
versets.anglais: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - indeed, We will not allow to be lost the reward of any who did well in deeds

versets.arabe: أُولَٰئِكَ لَهُمْ جَنَّاتُ عَدْنٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهِمُ الْأَنْهَارُ يُحَلَّوْنَ فِيهَا مِنْ أَسَاوِرَ مِن ذَهَبٍ وَيَلْبَسُونَ ثِيَابًا خُضْرًا مِّن سُندُسٍ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٍ
versets.phonetique: Ula-ika lahum jannatu adnin tajri min tahtihimu l-anharu yuhallawna fiha min asawira min dhahabin wa yalbasuna thiyaban khudran min sundusin wa istabraqin
versets.francais: Ceux-là auront les jardins d-Eden où coulent les ruisseaux. Ils y seront ornés de bracelets d-or et vêtus de vêtements verts de soie fine et de brocart
versets.anglais: Those will have gardens of perpetual residence; beneath them rivers will flow. They will be adorned therein with bracelets of gold and will wear green garments of fine silk and brocade, reclining therein on adorned couches. Excellent is the reward, and good is the resting place

versets.arabe: وَاضْرِبْ لَهُم مَّثَلًا رَّجُلَيْنِ جَعَلْنَا لِأَحَدِهِمَا جَنَّتَيْنِ مِنْ أَعْنَابٍ وَحَفَفْنَاهُمَا بِنَخْلٍ وَجَعَلْنَا بَيْنَهُمَا زَرْعًا
versets.phonetique: Wa drib lahum mathalan rajulayni ja-alna li-ahadihima jannatayn min a-nabin wa hafafnahuma binakhlin wa ja-alna baynahuma zar-a
versets.francais: Propose-leur l-exemple de deux hommes : à l-un Nous avons donné deux jardins de vigne que Nous avons entourés de palmiers et entre lesquels Nous avons mis des champs cultivés
versets.anglais: And present to them an example of two men: We granted to one of them two gardens of grapevines, and We bordered them with palm trees and placed between them [fields of] crops

versets.arabe: كِلْتَا الْجَنَّتَيْنِ آتَتْ أُكُلَهَا وَلَمْ تَظْلِم مِّنْهُ شَيْئًا وَفَجَّرْنَا خِلَالَهُمَا نَهَرًا
versets.phonetique: Kilta l-jannatayn atat ukulaha wa lam tazlim minhu shay-an wa fajjarna khilalahuma nahara
versets.francais: Les deux jardins avaient donné leurs fruits sans rien manquer, et Nous avions fait jaillir entre eux un ruisseau
versets.anglais: Each of the two gardens produced its fruit and did not fall short thereof in anything. And We caused to gush forth within them a river

versets.arabe: وَكَانَ لَهُ ثَمَرٌ فَقَالَ لِصَاحِبِهِ وَهُوَ يُحَاوِرُهُ أَنَا أَكْثَرُ مِنكَ مَالًا وَأَعَزُّ نَفَرًا
versets.phonetique: Wa kana lahu thamarun faqala lisahibihi wa huwa yuhawirahu ana aktharu minka malan wa a-azzu nafara
versets.francais: Il avait des richesses et dit à son compagnon en le taquinant : Je suis plus riche que toi et plus puissant par mes hommes
versets.anglais: And he had fruit, so he said to his companion while he was conversing with him, "I am greater than you in wealth and mightier in [numbers of] men

versets.arabe: وَدَخَلَ جَنَّتَهُ وَهُوَ ظَالِمٌ لِّنَفْسِهِ قَالَ مَا أَظُنُّ أَن تَبِيدَ هَٰذِهِ أَبَدًا
versets.phonetique: Wa dakhala jannatahu wa huwa zalimun linafsihi qala ma azunnu an tabida hadhihi abada
versets.francais: Et il entra dans son jardin, faisant tort à lui-même : Il dit : Je ne pense pas que cela périsse jamais
versets.anglais: And he entered his garden while he was unjust to himself. He said, "I do not think that this will perish - ever

versets.arabe: وَمَا أَظُنُّ السَّاعَةَ قَائِمَةً وَلَئِن رُّدِدتُّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّي لَأَجِدَنَّ خَيْرًا مِّنْهَا مُنقَلَبًا
versets.phonetique: Wa ma azunnu s-sa-ata qa-imatan wa la-in rudidtu ila rabbi la-ajidanna khayran minha munqalaba
versets.francais: Et je ne pense pas que l-Heure arrive. Et même si je suis ramené vers mon Seigneur, je trouverai certes mieux en retournant vers Lui
versets.anglais: And I do not think the Hour will occur. And even if I should be brought back to my Lord, I will surely find better than this as a return

versets.arabe: قَالَ لَهُ صَاحِبُهُ وَهُوَ يُحَاوِرُهُ أَكَفَرْتَ بِالَّذِي خَلَقَكَ مِن تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ ثُمَّ سَوَّاكَ رَجُلًا
versets.phonetique: Qala lahu sahibuhu wa huwa yuhawirahu akafarta billadhi khalaqaka min turabin thumma min nutfatin thumma sawwaka rajula
versets.francais: Son compagnon lui dit en le taquinant : Mécroirais-tu en Celui qui t-a créé de terre, puis d-une goutte de sperme, et t-a façonné en homme
versets.anglais: His companion said to him while he was conversing with him, "Have you disbelieved in He who created you from dust and then from a sperm-drop and then proportioned you [as] a man

versets.arabe: لَّٰكِنَّا هُوَ اللَّهُ رَبِّي وَلَا أُشْرِكُ بِرَبِّي أَحَدًا
versets.phonetique: Lakinna huwa l-lahu rabbi wa la ushrika birrabi ahada
versets.francais: Mais moi, c-est Allah mon Seigneur, et je n-associe personne à mon Seigneur
versets.anglais: But as for me, He is Allah, my Lord, and I do not associate with my Lord anyone

versets.arabe: وَلَوْلَا إِذْ دَخَلْتَ جَنَّتَكَ قُلْتَ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ لَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
versets.phonetique: Wa lawla idh dakhalta jannataka qulta ma sha-a l-lahu la quwwata illa billahi
versets.francais: Que ne disais-tu en entrant dans ton jardin : C-est ce qu-Allah a voulu. Il n-y a de force qu-en Allah
versets.anglais: And why did you, when you entered your garden, not say, 'What Allah willed [has occurred]; there is no power except in Allah '? Although you see me less than you in wealth and children

versets.arabe: فَعَسَىٰ رَبِّي أَن يُؤْتِيَنِ خَيْرًا مِّن جَنَّتِكَ وَيُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهَا حُسْبَانًا مِّنَ السَّمَاءِ فَتُصْبِحَ صَعِيدًا زَلَقًا
versets.phonetique: Fa-asa rabbi an yu-tiyani khayran min jannatika wa yursila alayha husbanamin s-sama-i fatusbiha sa-idan zalaqa
versets.francais: Peut-être mon Seigneur me donnera-t-Il quelque chose de mieux que ton jardin et enverra-t-Il sur lui du ciel une foudre qui en fera une terre glissante
versets.anglais: It may be that my Lord will give me [something] better than your garden and will send upon it a calamity from the sky, and it will become a smooth, dusty ground

versets.arabe: أَوْ يُصْبِحَ مَاؤُهَا غَوْرًا فَلَن تَسْتَطِيعَ لَهُ طَلَبًا
versets.phonetique: Aw yusbiha ma-uha ghawran falan tastati-a lahu talaba
versets.francais: Ou son eau deviendra profondément enfouie et tu ne pourras pas la chercher
versets.anglais: Or its water will become sunken [into the earth], so you would never be able to seek it

versets.arabe: وَأُحِيطَ بِثَمَرِهِ فَأَصْبَحَ يُقَلِّبُ كَفَّيْهِ عَلَىٰ مَا أَنفَقَ فِيهَا وَهِيَ خَاوِيَةٌ عَلَىٰ عُرُوشِهَا
versets.phonetique: Wa uhita bithamarihi faasbaha yuqallibu kaffayhi ala ma anfaqa fiha wa hiya khawiyatun ala urushiha
versets.francais: Et ses fruits furent enveloppés. Il se mit à se tordre les mains à propos de ce qu-il y avait dépensé, tandis qu-elle était effondrée sur ses treilles
versets.anglais: And his fruits were encompassed [by ruin], so he began to turn his hands about [in dismay] over what he had spent on it, while it had collapsed upon its trellises, and said, "Oh, I wish I had not associated with my Lord anyone

versets.arabe: وَلَمْ تَكُن لَّهُ فِئَةٌ يَنصُرُونَهُ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ وَمَا كَانَ مُنتَصِرًا
versets.phonetique: Wa lam takun lahu fi-atun yansuruna min duni l-lahi wa ma kana muntasira
versets.francais: Et il n-avait pas de groupe pour le secourir en dehors d-Allah, et il ne put se secourir lui-même
versets.anglais: And there was for him no company to aid him other than Allah, nor could he defend himself

versets.arabe: هُنَالِكَ الْوَلَايَةُ لِلَّهِ الْحَقِّ هُوَ خَيْرٌ ثَوَابًا وَخَيْرٌ عُقْبًا
versets.phonetique: Hunalika l-walayatu lillahi l-haqqi huwa khayrun thawaban wa khayrun uqba
versets.francais: Là la protection appartient à Allah, le Vrai. C-est Lui le meilleur pour la récompense et le meilleur pour la rétribution
versets.anglais: There the authority is [completely] for Allah, the Truth. He is best in reward and best in outcome

versets.arabe: وَاضْرِبْ لَهُم مَّثَلَ الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا كَمَاءٍ أَنزَلْنَاهُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ فَاخْتَلَطَ بِهِ نَبَاتُ الْأَرْضِ فَأَصْبَحَ هَشِيمًا تَذْرُوهُ الرِّيَاحُ
versets.phonetique: Wa drib lahum mathala l-hayati d-dunya kama-in anzalnahu mina s-sama-i fakhtalatat bihi nabatu l-ardi faasbaha hashiman tadhruhu r-riyah
versets.francais: Propose-leur l-exemple de la vie présente : elle est comme une eau que Nous faisons descendre du ciel. La végétation de la terre se mélange à elle, puis elle devient du foin que les vents dispersent
versets.anglais: And present to them the example of the life of this world, [its being] like rain which We send down from the sky, and the vegetation of the earth mingles with it and [then] it becomes dry remnants, scattered by the winds. And Allah is ever, over all things, Perfect in Ability

versets.arabe: الْمَالُ وَالْبَنُونَ زِينَةُ الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا وَالْبَاقِيَاتُ الصَّالِحَاتُ خَيْرٌ عِندَ رَبِّكَ ثَوَابًا وَخَيْرٌ أَمَلًا
versets.phonetique: Al-malu wa l-banuna zinatu l-hayati d-dunya wa l-baqiyatu s-salihatu khayrun inda rabbika thawaban wa khayrun amala
versets.francais: Les biens et les enfants sont l-ornement de la vie présente. Mais les bonnes oeuvres durables sont meilleures auprès de ton Seigneur comme récompense et meilleures comme espérance
versets.anglais: Wealth and children are [but] adornment of the worldly life. But the enduring good deeds are better to your Lord for reward and better for [one's] hope

versets.arabe: وَيَوْمَ نُسَيِّرُ الْجِبَالَ وَتَرَى الْأَرْضَ بَارِزَةً وَحَشَرْنَاهُمْ فَلَمْ نُغَادِرْ مِنْهُمْ أَحَدًا
versets.phonetique: Wa yawma nusayyiru l-jibala wa tara l-arda barizatan wa hasharna-hum falam nughadir minhum ahada
versets.francais: Le jour où Nous ferons mouvoir les montagnes et où tu verras la terre mise à découvert, et où Nous les rassemblerons sans en laisser un seul
versets.anglais: And [warn of] the Day when We will remove the mountains and you will see the earth prominent, and We will gather them and not leave behind from them anyone

versets.arabe: وَعُرِضُوا عَلَىٰ رَبِّكَ صَفًّا لَّقَدْ جِئْتُمُونَا كَمَا خَلَقْنَاكُمْ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ بَلْ زَعَمْتُمْ أَلَّن نَّجْعَلَ لَكُم مَّوْعِدًا
versets.phonetique: Wa uridhu ala rabbika saffan laqad ji-tumuna kama khalaqnakum awwala marratin bal za-amtum allanN naj-ala lakum maw-ida
versets.francais: Ils seront présentés devant ton Seigneur en rangs. Vous voilà venus à Nous tels que Nous vous avons créés la première fois. Vous prétendiez que Nous ne vous accorderions jamais de rendez-vous
versets.anglais: And they will be presented before your Lord in rows, [and He will say], "You have certainly come to Us just as We created you the first time. But you claimed that We would never make for you an appointment

versets.arabe: وَوُضِعَ الْكِتَابُ فَتَرَى الْمُجْرِمِينَ مُشْفِقِينَ مِمَّا فِيهِ وَيَقُولُونَ يَا وَيْلَتَنَا مَالِ هَٰذَا الْكِتَابِ لَا يُغَادِرُ صَغِيرَةً وَلَا كَبِيرَةً إِلَّا أَحْصَاهَا
versets.phonetique: Wa wudi-a l-kitabu fatara l-mujrimina mushfiqina mimma fihi wa yaquluna ya waylatana mali hadha l-kitabi la yughadiru saghiratan wa la kabiratan illa ahsaha
versets.francais: Le Livre sera posé. Tu verras les coupables effrayés de ce qu-il contient. Ils diront : Malheur à nous ! Qu-a donc ce Livre à ne délaisser ni petite ni grande chose sans la recenser
versets.anglais: And the record [of deeds] will be placed [open], and you will see the criminals fearful of that within it, and they will say, "Oh, woe to us! What is this book that leaves nothing small or great except that it has enumerated it?" And they will find what they did present [before them]. And your Lord does injustice to no one

versets.arabe: وَإِذْ قُلْنَا لِلْمَلَائِكَةِ اسْجُدُوا لِآدَمَ فَسَجَدُوا إِلَّا إِبْلِيسَ كَانَ مِنَ الْجِنِّ فَفَسَقَ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِ
versets.phonetique: Wa idh qulna lil-mala-ikati sjudu li-adama fasajadu illa iblisa kana mina l-jinni ffasaqa an amri rabbih
versets.francais: Quand Nous dîmes aux anges : Prosternez-vous devant Adam, ils se prosternèrent, sauf Iblis qui était du genre des djinns et se révolta contre l-ordre de son Seigneur
versets.anglais: And [mention] when We said to the angels, "Prostrate to Adam," and they prostrated, except for Iblees. He was of the jinn and departed from the command of his Lord. Then will you take him and his descendants as allies other than Me while they are enemies to you? Wretched it is for the wrongdoers as an exchange

versets.arabe: مَا أَشْهَدتُّهُمْ خَلْقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَلَا خَلْقَ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَمَا كُنتُ مُتَّخِذَ الْمُضِلِّينَ عَضُدًا
versets.phonetique: Ma ashhattuhum khalqa s-samawati wa l-ardi wa la khalqa anfusihim wa ma kuntu muttakhidha l-mudillina aduda
versets.francais: Je ne les ai pas pris à témoin lors de la création des cieux et de la terre, ni lors de leur propre création. Je ne prends pas pour soutiens les égareurs
versets.anglais: I did not make them witness to the creation of the heavens and the earth or to the creation of themselves, and I would not have taken the misguiders as assistants

versets.arabe: وَيَوْمَ يَقُولُ نَادُوا شُرَكَائِيَ الَّذِينَ زَعَمْتُمْ فَدَعَوْهُمْ فَلَمْ يَسْتَجِيبُوا لَهُمْ وَجَعَلْنَا بَيْنَهُم مَّوْبِقًا
versets.phonetique: Wa yawma yaqulu nadu shuraka-iya lladhina za-amtum fada-awhum falam yastajibu lahum wa ja-alna baynahum mawbiqa
versets.francais: Le jour où Il dira : Appelez Mes associés que vous prétendiez avoir. Ils les appelleront mais ils ne leur répondront pas, et Nous aurons placé entre eux un gouffre
versets.anglais: And [warn of] the Day when He will say, "Call 'My partners' whom you claimed," and they will invoke them, but they will not respond to them. And We will put between them [a valley of] destruction

versets.arabe: وَرَأَى الْمُجْرِمُونَ النَّارَ فَظَنُّوا أَنَّهُم مُّوَاقِعُوهَا وَلَمْ يَجِدُوا عَنْهَا مَصْرِفًا
versets.phonetique: Wa ra-a l-mujrimuna n-nara fazannu annahum muwaqi-uha wa lam yajidu anha masrifa
versets.francais: Et les coupables verront le Feu et penseront qu-ils vont y tomber, et ils ne trouveront aucun moyen de l-éviter
versets.anglais: And the criminals will see the Fire and will be certain that they are to fall therein. And they will not find from it a way elsewhere

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ صَرَّفْنَا فِي هَٰذَا الْقُرْآنِ لِلنَّاسِ مِن كُلِّ مَثَلٍ وَكَانَ الْإِنسَانُ أَكْثَرَ شَيْءٍ جَدَلًا
versets.phonetique: Wa laqad sarrafna fi hadha l-qurani lin-nasi min kulli mathalin wa kana l-insanu akthara shay-in jadala
versets.francais: Nous avons certes varié dans ce Coran toutes sortes d-exemples pour les hommes. Mais l-être humain est, plus que toute chose, disputeur
versets.anglais: And We have certainly diversified in this Qur'an for the people from every [kind of] example; but man has ever been, most of anything, [prone to] dispute

versets.arabe: وَمَا مَنَعَ النَّاسَ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا إِذْ جَاءَهُمُ الْهُدَىٰ وَيَسْتَغْفِرُوا رَبَّهُمْ إِلَّا أَن تَأْتِيَهُمْ سُنَّةُ الْأَوَّلِينَ أَوْ يَأْتِيَهُمُ الْعَذَابُ قُبُلًا
versets.phonetique: Wa ma mana-a n-nasa an yu-minu idh ja-ahumu l-huda wa yastaghhfiru rabbahum illa an ta-tiyahum sunnatu l-awwalina aw ya-tiyahumu l-adhabu qubula
versets.francais: Rien n-empêche les gens de croire quand la guidée leur parvient, et de demander pardon à leur Seigneur, si ce n-est qu-il leur advienne le sort des Anciens ou que le châtiment leur arrive de face
versets.anglais: And nothing has prevented the people from believing when guidance came to them and from asking forgiveness of their Lord except that there [must] befall them the [accustomed] precedent of the former peoples or that the punishment should come [directly] before them

versets.arabe: وَمَا نُرْسِلُ الْمُرْسَلِينَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرِينَ وَمُنذِرِينَ وَيُجَادِلُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا بِالْبَاطِلِ لِيُدْحِضُوا بِهِ الْحَقَّ
versets.phonetique: Wa ma nursilu l-mursalina illa mubash-shirina wa mundhirina wa yujadilu lladhina kafaru bil-batili liyudhidu bihi l-haqqa
versets.francais: Nous n-envoyons les messagers que pour annoncer la bonne nouvelle et avertir. Les mécréants disputent avec le faux pour réfuter par là le vrai
versets.anglais: And We send not the messengers except as bringers of good tidings and warners. And those who disbelieve dispute by [using] falsehood to [attempt to] invalidate thereby the truth and have taken My verses, and that of which they are warned, in ridicule

versets.arabe: وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّن ذُكِّرَ بِآيَاتِ رَبِّهِ فَأَعْرَضَ عَنْهَا وَنَسِيَ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ إِنَّا جَعَلْنَا عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ أَكِنَّةً أَن يَفْقَهُوهُ وَفِي آذَانِهِمْ وَقْرًا
versets.phonetique: Wa man azlamu mimman dukkira bi-ayati rabbihi fa-a-rada anha wa nasiya ma qaddamat yadahu inna ja-alna ala qulubihim akinnatan an yafqahuhu wa fi adhanihim waqra
versets.francais: Qui est plus injuste que celui à qui on rappelle les signes de son Seigneur et qui s-en détourne, oubliant ce que ses mains ont commis ? Nous avons mis sur leurs coeurs des voiles, et dans leurs oreilles une surdité
versets.anglais: And who is more unjust than one who is reminded of the verses of his Lord but turns away from them and forgets what his hands have put forth? Indeed, We have placed over their hearts coverings, lest they understand it, and in their ears deafness. And if you invite them to guidance - they will never be guided, then - ever

versets.arabe: وَرَبُّكَ الْغَفُورُ ذُو الرَّحْمَةِ لَوْ يُؤَاخِذُهُم بِمَا كَسَبُوا لَعَجَّلَ لَهُمُ الْعَذَابَ بَل لَّهُم مَّوْعِدٌ لَّن يَجِدُوا مِن دُونِهِ مَوْئِلًا
versets.phonetique: Wa rabbuka l-ghafuru dhu r-rahmati law yu-akhidhuhum bima kasabu la-ajjala lahumu l-adhaba bal lahum maw-idun lan yajidu min dunihi maw-ila
versets.francais: Ton Seigneur est le Tout Pardonnant, plein de miséricorde. S-Il les punissait pour ce qu-ils ont acquis, Il leur hâterait le châtiment. Mais ils ont un rendez-vous auquel ils ne trouveront aucun refuge
versets.anglais: And your Lord is the Forgiving, full of mercy. If He were to impose blame upon them for what they earned, He would have hastened for them the punishment. Rather, for them is an appointment from which they will never find an escape

versets.arabe: وَتِلْكَ الْقُرَىٰ أَهْلَكْنَاهُمْ لَمَّا ظَلَمُوا وَجَعَلْنَا لِمَهْلِكِهِم مَّوْعِدًا
versets.phonetique: Wa tilka l-qura ahlaknnahum lamma zalamu wa ja-alna limahlakihim maw-ida
versets.francais: Ces cités, Nous les avons détruites quand elles ont été injustes, et Nous avons assigné un moment à leur destruction
versets.anglais: And those cities - We destroyed them when they wronged, and We made for their destruction an appointed time

versets.arabe: وَإِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِفَتَاهُ لَا أَبْرَحُ حَتَّىٰ أَبْلُغَ مَجْمَعَ الْبَحْرَيْنِ أَوْ أَمْضِيَ حُقُبًا
versets.phonetique: Wa idh qala musa lifatahu la abrahu hatta ablugha majma-a l-bahrayni aw amdhiya huquba
versets.francais: Et quand Moïse dit à son serviteur : Je ne m-arrêterai pas jusqu-à ce que j-atteigne la jonction des deux mers ou je marcherai longtemps
versets.anglais: And [mention] when Moses said to his servant, "I will not cease [traveling] until I reach the junction of the two seas or continue for a long period

versets.arabe: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَا مَجْمَعَ بَيْنِهِمَا نَسِيَا حُوتَهُمَا فَاتَّخَذَ سَبِيلَهُ فِي الْبَحْرِ سَرَبًا
versets.phonetique: Falamma balagha majma-a baynihima nasiya hutahuma fattakhadha sabilahu fi l-bahri saraba
versets.francais: Quand ils arrivèrent à leur jonction, ils oublièrent leur poisson qui prit son chemin dans la mer en creusant un tunnel
versets.anglais: But when they reached the junction between them, they forgot their fish, and it took its course into the sea, slipping away

versets.arabe: فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَا قَالَ لِفَتَاهُ آتِنَا غَدَاءَنَا لَقَدْ لَقِينَا مِن سَفَرِنَا هَٰذَا نَصَبًا
versets.phonetique: Falamma jawaza qala lifatahu atina ghada-ana laqad laqina min safarina hadha nasaba
versets.francais: Quand ils eurent dépassé l-endroit, il dit à son serviteur : Apporte-nous notre déjeuner ; nous avons certes éprouvé de la fatigue dans ce voyage
versets.anglais: So when they had passed beyond it, [Moses] said to his boy, "Bring us our morning meal. We have certainly suffered in this, our journey, [much] fatigue

versets.arabe: قَالَ أَرَأَيْتَ إِذْ أَوَيْنَا إِلَى الصَّخْرَةِ فَإِنِّي نَسِيتُ الْحُوتَ وَمَا أَنسَانِيهُ إِلَّا الشَّيْطَانُ أَن أَذْكُرَهُ وَاتَّخَذَ سَبِيلَهُ فِي الْبَحْرِ عَجَبًا
versets.phonetique: Qala ara-ayta idh awayna ila s-sakhrati fa-inni nasitu l-huta wa ma ansaniyhu illa sh-shaytanu an adhkurahu wattakhadha sabilahu fi l-bahri ajaba
versets.francais: Il dit : As-tu vu quand nous nous sommes reposés contre le rocher ? J-ai oublié le poisson. C-est le diable seul qui m-a fait oublier de t-en parler. Le poisson a pris son chemin dans la mer de façon étrange
versets.anglais: He said, "Did you see when we retired to the rock? Indeed, I forgot [there] the fish. And none made me forget it except Satan - that I should mention it. And it took its course into the sea amazingly

versets.arabe: قَالَ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنَّا نَبْغِ فَارْتَدَّا عَلَىٰ آثَارِهِمَا قَصَصًا
versets.phonetique: Qala dhalika ma kunna nabghi fartadda ala atharihima qasasa
versets.francais: Il dit : C-est bien cela que nous cherchions. Ils revinrent sur leurs pas en suivant leurs propres traces
versets.anglais: [Moses] said, "That is what we were seeking." So they returned, following their footprints

versets.arabe: فَوَجَدَا عَبْدًا مِّنْ عِبَادِنَا آتَيْنَاهُ رَحْمَةً مِّنْ عِندِنَا وَعَلَّمْنَاهُ مِن لَّدُنَّا عِلْمًا
versets.phonetique: Fawajada abdan min ibadina ataynahu rahmatan min indina wa allamnnahu min ladunna ilma
versets.francais: Ils trouvèrent l-un de Nos serviteurs à qui Nous avions accordé une miséricorde de Notre part et à qui Nous avions enseigné une science de Notre part
versets.anglais: And they found a servant from among Our servants to whom we had given mercy from us and had taught him from Us a [certain] knowledge

versets.arabe: قَالَ لَهُ مُوسَىٰ هَلْ أَتَّبِعُكَ عَلَىٰ أَن تُعَلِّمَنِ مِمَّا عُلِّمْتَ رُشْدًا
versets.phonetique: Qala lahu musa hal attabi-uka ala an tu-allimani mimma ullimta rushda
versets.francais: Moïse lui dit : Puis-je te suivre pour que tu m-apprennes, de ce qu-on t-a enseigné, une saine direction
versets.anglais: Moses said to him, "May I follow you on [the condition] that you teach me from what you have been taught of sound judgement

versets.arabe: قَالَ إِنَّكَ لَن تَسْتَطِيعَ مَعِيَ صَبْرًا
versets.phonetique: Qala innaka lan tastati-a ma-iya sabra
versets.francais: Il dit : Tu ne pourras certes pas être patient avec moi
versets.anglais: He said, "Indeed, with me you will never be able to have patience

versets.arabe: وَكَيْفَ تَصْبِرُ عَلَىٰ مَا لَمْ تُحِطْ بِهِ خُبْرًا
versets.phonetique: Wa kayfa tasbiru ala ma lam tuhit bihi khubra
versets.francais: Et comment serais-tu patient sur ce dont tu n-as pas une connaissance complète
versets.anglais: And how can you have patience for what you do not encompass in knowledge

versets.arabe: قَالَ سَتَجِدُنِي إِن شَاءَ اللَّهُ صَابِرًا وَلَا أَعْصِي لَكَ أَمْرًا
versets.phonetique: Qala satajiduni in sha-a l-lahu sabiran wa la a-si laka amra
versets.francais: Il dit : Tu me trouveras patient, si Allah le veut, et je ne te désobéirai en rien
versets.anglais: [Moses] said, "You will find me, if Allah wills, patient, and I will not disobey you in [any] order

versets.arabe: قَالَ فَإِنِ اتَّبَعْتَنِي فَلَا تَسْأَلْنِي عَن شَيْءٍ حَتَّىٰ أُحْدِثَ لَكَ مِنْهُ ذِكْرًا
versets.phonetique: Qala fa-in ittaba-tani fala tas-alni an shay-in hatta uhdithalaka minhu dhikra
versets.francais: Il dit : Si tu me suis, ne me pose de questions sur rien jusqu-à ce que je t-en parle moi-même
versets.anglais: He said, "Then if you follow me, do not ask me about anything until I make to you about it mention

versets.arabe: فَانطَلَقَا حَتَّىٰ إِذَا رَكِبَا فِي السَّفِينَةِ خَرَقَهَا قَالَ أَخَرَقْتَهَا لِتُغْرِقَ أَهْلَهَا لَقَدْ جِئْتَ شَيْئًا إِمْرًا
versets.phonetique: Fantalaqa hatta idha rakiba fi s-safinati kharaqaha qala akharaqtaha litughriqa ahlaha laqad ji-ta shay-an imra
versets.francais: Ils partirent. Quand ils montèrent dans la barque, il la perfora. Il dit : L-as-tu percée pour noyer ses passagers ? Tu as fait là quelque chose d-énorme
versets.anglais: So they set out, until when they had embarked on the ship, al-Khidh r tore it open. [Moses] said, "Have you torn it open to drown its people? You have certainly done a grave thing

versets.arabe: قَالَ أَلَمْ أَقُلْ إِنَّكَ لَن تَسْتَطِيعَ مَعِيَ صَبْرًا
versets.phonetique: Qala alam aqul innaka lan tastati-a ma-iya sabra
versets.francais: Il dit : Ne t-avais-je pas dit que tu ne pourrais pas être patient avec moi
versets.anglais: [Al-Khidh r] said, "Did I not say that with me you would never be able to have patience

versets.arabe: قَالَ لَا تُؤَاخِذْنِي بِمَا نَسِيتُ وَلَا تُرْهِقْنِي مِنْ أَمْرِي عُسْرًا
versets.phonetique: Qala la tu-akhidhni bima nasitu wa la turhiqni min amri usra
versets.francais: Il dit : Ne me blâme pas pour ce que j-ai oublié et ne m-impose pas de difficultés dans mes affaires
versets.anglais: [Moses] said, "Do not blame me for what I forgot and do not cover me in my matter with difficulty

versets.arabe: فَانطَلَقَا حَتَّىٰ إِذَا لَقِيَا غُلَامًا فَقَتَلَهُ قَالَ أَقَتَلْتَ نَفْسًا زَكِيَّةً بِغَيْرِ نَفْسٍ لَّقَدْ جِئْتَ شَيْئًا نُّكْرًا
versets.phonetique: Fantalaqa hatta idha laqiya ghulaman faqatalahu qala aqatalta nafsan zakiyyatan bighayri nafsin laqad ji-ta shay-an nukra
versets.francais: Ils partirent de nouveau. Quand ils rencontrèrent un jeune garçon et qu-il le tua, il dit : As-tu tué une âme innocente sans qu-elle ait tué quelqu-un ? Tu as fait là quelque chose de révoltant
versets.anglais: So they set out, until when they met a boy, al-Khidh r killed him. [Moses] said, "Have you killed a pure soul for other than [having killed] a soul? You have certainly done a deplorable thing

versets.arabe: قَالَ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكَ إِنَّكَ لَن تَسْتَطِيعَ مَعِيَ صَبْرًا
versets.phonetique: Qala alam aqul laka innaka lan tastati-a ma-iya sabra
versets.francais: Il dit : Ne t-avais-je pas dit que tu ne pourrais pas être patient avec moi
versets.anglais: [Al-Khidh r] said, "Did I not tell you that with me you would never be able to have patience

versets.arabe: قَالَ إِن سَأَلْتُكَ عَن شَيْءٍ بَعْدَهَا فَلَا تُصَاحِبْنِي قَدْ بَلَغْتَ مِن لَّدُنِّي عُذْرًا
versets.phonetique: Qala in sa-altuka an shay-in ba-daha fala tusahibni qad balaghta min ladunni udhra
versets.francais: Il dit : Si je te pose une question sur quelque chose après cela, ne me garde plus avec toi. Tu as eu de moi une excuse suffisante
versets.anglais: [Moses] said, "If I should ask you about anything after this, then do not keep me as a companion. You have obtained from me an excuse

versets.arabe: فَانطَلَقَا حَتَّىٰ إِذَا أَتَيَا أَهْلَ قَرْيَةٍ اسْتَطْعَمَا أَهْلَهَا فَأَبَوْا أَن يُضَيِّفُوهُمَا فَوَجَدَا فِيهَا جِدَارًا يُرِيدُ أَن يَنقَضَّ فَأَقَامَهُ
versets.phonetique: Fantalaqa hatta idha ataya ahla qaryatin ista-tama ahlaha fa-abaw an yudayyifuhuma fawajada fiha jidaran yuridu an yanqadda fa-aqamahu
versets.francais: Ils repartirent. Quand ils arrivèrent chez les habitants d-un village et leur demandèrent de la nourriture, ceux-ci refusèrent de les héberger. Ils trouvèrent dans ce village un mur qui menaçait de tomber, et il le redressa
versets.anglais: So they set out, until when they came to the people of a town, they asked its people for food, but they refused to offer them hospitality. And they found therein a wall about to collapse, so al-Khidh r restored it. [Moses] said, "If you wished, you could have taken for it a payment

versets.arabe: قَالَ هَٰذَا فِرَاقُ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنِكَ سَأُنَبِّئُكَ بِتَأْوِيلِ مَا لَمْ تَسْتَطِع عَّلَيْهِ صَبْرًا
versets.phonetique: Qala hadha firaqu bayni wa baynaka saunabhi-uka bita-wili ma lam tastati- alayhi sabra
versets.francais: Il dit : C-est ici la séparation entre toi et moi. Je vais t-informer de l-interprétation de ce avec quoi tu n-as pu être patient
versets.anglais: [Al-Khidh r] said, "This is parting between me and you. I will inform you of the interpretation of that about which you could not have patience

versets.arabe: أَمَّا السَّفِينَةُ فَكَانَتْ لِمَسَاكِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ فِي الْبَحْرِ فَأَرَدتُّ أَنْ أَعِيبَهَا وَكَانَ وَرَاءَهُم مَّلِكٌ يَأْخُذُ كُلَّ سَفِينَةٍ غَصْبًا
versets.phonetique: Amma s-safinatu fakanat limasakina ya-maluna fi l-bahri fa-aradu an a-ibaha wa kana wara-ahum malikun ya-khudhu kulla safinatin ghasba
versets.francais: La barque appartenait à des pauvres gens qui travaillaient sur la mer. J-ai voulu la rendre défectueuse, car derrière eux se trouvait un roi qui s-emparait de toute barque de force
versets.anglais: As for the ship, it belonged to poor people working at sea. So I intended to cause defect in it as there was after them a king who seized every [good] ship by force

versets.arabe: وَأَمَّا الْغُلَامُ فَكَانَ أَبَوَاهُ مُؤْمِنَيْنِ فَخَشِينَا أَن يُرْهِقَهُمَا طُغْيَانًا وَكُفْرًا
versets.phonetique: Wa amma l-ghulamu fakana abawahu mu-minayni fakhashina an yurhiqahuma tughyanawwa kufra
versets.francais: Quant au jeune garçon, ses parents étaient croyants, et nous avons craint qu-il ne les accable de transgression et d-incroyance
versets.anglais: And as for the boy, his parents were believers, and we feared that he would overburden them by transgression and disbelief

versets.arabe: فَأَرَدْنَا أَن يُبْدِلَهُمَا رَبُّهُمَا خَيْرًا مِّنْهُ زَكَاةً وَأَقْرَبَ رُحْمًا
versets.phonetique: Fa-aradna an yubdilahuma rabbuhuma khayran minhu zakatan wa aqraba ruhma
versets.francais: Et nous avons voulu que leur Seigneur leur donne en échange un enfant meilleur en pureté et plus proche de la tendresse
versets.anglais: So we intended that their Lord should substitute for them one better than him in purity and nearer to mercy

versets.arabe: وَأَمَّا الْجِدَارُ فَكَانَ لِغُلَامَيْنِ يَتِيمَيْنِ فِي الْمَدِينَةِ وَكَانَ تَحْتَهُ كَنزٌ لَّهُمَا وَكَانَ أَبُوهُمَا صَالِحًا فَأَرَادَ رَبُّكَ أَن يَبْلُغَا أَشُدَّهُمَا وَيَسْتَخْرِجَا كَنزَهُمَا رَحْمَةً مِّن رَّبِّكَ
versets.phonetique: Wa amma l-jidaru fakana lighulaminiyatimayni fi l-madinati wa kana tahtahu kanzun lahuma wa kana abuhuma salihan fa-arada rabbuka an yablugha ashuddahuma wa yastakhrija kanzahuma rahmatan min rabbika
versets.francais: Quant au mur, il appartenait à deux jeunes orphelins de la ville. Dessous se trouvait un trésor qui leur appartenait. Leur père était un homme vertueux. Ton Seigneur a voulu qu-ils atteignent leur maturité et retirent leur trésor, par miséricorde de ton Seigneur
versets.anglais: And as for the wall, it belonged to two orphan boys in the city, and there was beneath it a treasure for them, and their father had been righteous. So your Lord intended that they reach maturity and extract their treasure, as a mercy from your Lord. And I did it not of my own accord. That is the interpretation of that about which you could not have patience

versets.arabe: وَمَا فَعَلْتُهُ عَنْ أَمْرِي ذَٰلِكَ تَأْوِيلُ مَا لَمْ تَسْطِع عَّلَيْهِ صَبْرًا
versets.phonetique: Wa ma fa-altuhu an amri dhalika ta-wilu ma lam tastati- alayhi sabra
versets.francais: Je n-ai pas agi de ma propre initiative. Voilà l-interprétation de ce avec quoi tu n-as pu être patient
versets.anglais: And they ask you, [O Muhammad], about Dhul-Qarnayn. Say, "I will recite to you about him a report

versets.arabe: وَيَسْأَلُونَكَ عَن ذِي الْقَرْنَيْنِ قُلْ سَأَتْلُو عَلَيْكُم مِّنْهُ ذِكْرًا
versets.phonetique: Wa yas-alunaka an dhi l-qarnayni qul satlu alaykum minhu dhikra
versets.francais: Ils t-interrogent sur le Bicornu. Dis : Je vais vous en réciter quelque chose
versets.anglais: Indeed We established him upon the earth, and We gave him to everything a way

versets.arabe: إِنَّا مَكَّنَّا لَهُ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَآتَيْنَاهُ مِن كُلِّ شَيْءٍ سَبَبًا
versets.phonetique: Inna makkanna lahu fi l-ardi wa ataynahu min kulli shay-in sababa
versets.francais: Nous lui avons établi une puissance sur terre et Nous lui avons donné les moyens d-atteindre toute chose
versets.anglais: So he followed a way

versets.arabe: فَأَتْبَعَ سَبَبًا حَتَّىٰ إِذَا بَلَغَ مَغْرِبَ الشَّمْسِ وَجَدَهَا تَغْرُبُ فِي عَيْنٍ حَمِئَةٍ وَوَجَدَ عِندَهَا قَوْمًا
versets.phonetique: Fa-atba-a sababahatta idha balagha maghrib ash-shamsi wajadaha taghrubu fi aynin hami-atin wa wajada indaha qawma
versets.francais: Il suivit une voie jusqu-à ce qu-il atteignit le coucher du soleil. Il le trouva se couchant dans une source boueuse et il trouva auprès d-elle un peuple
versets.anglais: Until, when he reached the setting of the sun, he found it [as if] setting in a spring of dark mud, and he found near it a people. Allah said, "O Dhul-Qarnayn, either you punish [them] or else adopt among them [a way of] goodness

versets.arabe: قُلْنَا يَا ذَا الْقَرْنَيْنِ إِمَّا أَن تُعَذِّبَ وَإِمَّا أَن تَتَّخِذَ فِيهِمْ حُسْنًا
versets.phonetique: Qulna ya dha l-qarnayni imma an tu-adhdhibha wa imma an tattakhidha fihim husna
versets.francais: Nous dîmes : O Bicornu, soit tu les châties, soit tu agis bien envers eux
versets.anglais: He said, "As for one who wrongs, we will punish him. Then he will be returned to his Lord, and He will punish him with a terrible punishment

versets.arabe: قَالَ أَمَّا مَن ظَلَمَ فَسَوْفَ نُعَذِّبُهُ ثُمَّ يُرَدُّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِ فَيُعَذِّبُهُ عَذَابًا نُّكْرًا
versets.phonetique: Qala amma man zalama fasawfa nu-adhdhibuhu thumma yuraddu ila rabbihi fayu-adhdhibuhu adhaban nukra
versets.francais: Il dit : Quant à celui qui aura commis une injustice, nous le châtierons, puis il sera ramené vers son Seigneur qui le châtiera d-un châtiment sévère
versets.anglais: But as for one who believes and does righteousness, he will have a reward of Paradise, and we will speak to him from our command with ease

versets.arabe: وَأَمَّا مَنْ آمَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَلَهُ جَزَاءً الْحُسْنَىٰ وَسَنَقُولُ لَهُ مِنْ أَمْرِنَا يُسْرًا
versets.phonetique: Wa amma man amana wa amila salihan falahu jaza-an l-husna wa sanaqulu lahu min amrina yusra
versets.francais: Quant à celui qui aura cru et accompli de bonnes oeuvres, il aura la meilleure récompense, et nous lui dirons, dans notre commandement, quelque chose de facile
versets.anglais: Then he followed a way

versets.arabe: ثُمَّ أَتْبَعَ سَبَبًا حَتَّىٰ إِذَا بَلَغَ مَطْلِعَ الشَّمْسِ وَجَدَهَا تَطْلُعُ عَلَىٰ قَوْمٍ لَّمْ نَجْعَل لَّهُم مِّن دُونِهَا سِتْرًا
versets.phonetique: Thumma atba-a sababahatta idha balagha matli-a sh-shamsi wajadaha tatlu-u ala qawmin lam naj-al lahum min duniha sitra
versets.francais: Puis il suivit une autre voie jusqu-à ce qu-il atteignit le lever du soleil. Il le trouva se levant sur un peuple auquel Nous n-avions pas accordé d-abri contre lui
versets.anglais: Until, when he came to the rising of the sun, he found it rising on a people for whom We had not made against it any shield

versets.arabe: كَذَٰلِكَ وَقَدْ أَحَطْنَا بِمَا لَدَيْهِ خُبْرًا
versets.phonetique: Kadhalika wa qad ahatna bima ladayhi khubra
versets.francais: Il en était ainsi. Et Nous avions certes parfaitement connaissance de ce qu-il possédait
versets.anglais: Thus. And We had encompassed [all] that he had in knowledge

versets.arabe: ثُمَّ أَتْبَعَ سَبَبًا حَتَّىٰ إِذَا بَلَغَ بَيْنَ السَّدَّيْنِ وَجَدَ مِن دُونِهِمَا قَوْمًا لَّا يَكَادُونَ يَفْقَهُونَ قَوْلًا
versets.phonetique: Thumma atba-a sababahatta idha balagha bayna s-saddayni wajada min dunihima qawman la yakaduna yafqahuna qawla
versets.francais: Puis il suivit une voie jusqu-à ce qu-il atteignit l-endroit entre les deux barrières. Il y trouva un peuple qui ne comprenait presque aucune parole
versets.anglais: Then he followed a way

versets.arabe: قَالُوا يَا ذَا الْقَرْنَيْنِ إِنَّ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ مُفْسِدُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ فَهَلْ نَجْعَلُ لَكَ خَرْجًا عَلَىٰ أَن تَجْعَلَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُمْ سَدًّا
versets.phonetique: Qalu ya dha l-qarnayni inna ya-juja wa ma-juja mufsiduna fi l-ardi fahal naj-alu laka kharjan ala an taj-ala baynana wa baynahum sadda
versets.francais: Ils dirent : O Bicornu, Gog et Magog sèment la corruption sur la terre. Veux-tu que nous te payions une contribution pour que tu établisses entre nous et eux une barrière
versets.anglais: Until, when he reached [a pass] between two mountains, he found beside them a people who could hardly understand [his] speech

versets.arabe: قَالَ مَا مَكَّنِّي فِيهِ رَبِّي خَيْرٌ فَأَعِينُونِي بِقُوَّةٍ أَجْعَلْ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَهُمْ رَدْمًا
versets.phonetique: Qala ma makkanni fihi rabbi khayrun fa-a-inuni biquwwatin aj-al baynakum wa baynahum radma
versets.francais: Il dit : Ce en quoi mon Seigneur m-a établi vaut mieux. Aidez-moi donc de votre force, j-établirai entre vous et eux une digue
versets.anglais: They said, "O Dhul-Qarnayn, indeed Gog and Magog are [great] corrupters in the land. So may we assign for you an expenditure that you might make between us and them a barrier

versets.arabe: آتُونِي زُبَرَ الْحَدِيدِ حَتَّىٰ إِذَا سَاوَىٰ بَيْنَ الصَّدَفَيْنِ قَالَ انفُخُوا حَتَّىٰ إِذَا جَعَلَهُ نَارًا قَالَ آتُونِي أُفْرِغْ عَلَيْهِ قِطْرًا
versets.phonetique: Atuni zubara l-hadidi hatta idha sawa bayna s-sadafayni qala anfukhu hatta idha ja-alahu naran qala atuni ufrigh alayhi qitra
versets.francais: Apportez-moi des blocs de fer. Jusqu-à ce qu-il eut comblé l-espace entre les deux pentes, il dit : Soufflez. Puis quand il en eut fait du feu il dit : Apportez-moi du cuivre fondu que je déverse dessus
versets.anglais: He said, "That in which my Lord has established me is better [than what you offer], but assist me with strength; I will make between you and them a dam

versets.arabe: فَمَا اسْطَاعُوا أَن يَظْهَرُوهُ وَمَا اسْتَطَاعُوا لَهُ نَقْبًا
versets.phonetique: Fama stata-u an yazharuh wa ma stata-u lahu naqba
versets.francais: Ils ne purent donc pas l-escalader ni le percer
versets.anglais: Bring me sheets of iron" - until, when he had leveled [them] between the two mountain walls, he said, "Blow [with bellows]," until when he had made it [like] fire, he said, "Bring me, that I may pour over it molten copper

versets.arabe: قَالَ هَٰذَا رَحْمَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّي فَإِذَا جَاءَ وَعْدُ رَبِّي جَعَلَهُ دَكَّاءَ وَكَانَ وَعْدُ رَبِّي حَقًّا
versets.phonetique: Qala hadha rahmatun min rabbi fa-idha ja-a wa-du rabbi ja-alahu dakka-a wa kana wa-du rabbi haqqa
versets.francais: Il dit : C-est une miséricorde de mon Seigneur. Quand la promesse de mon Seigneur viendra, Il le réduira en poudre. La promesse de mon Seigneur est vraie
versets.anglais: So Gog and Magog were unable to pass over it, nor were they able [to effect] in it any penetration

versets.arabe: وَتَرَكْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَمُوجُ فِي بَعْضٍ وَنُفِخَ فِي الصُّورِ فَجَمَعْنَاهُمْ جَمْعًا
versets.phonetique: Wa tarakna ba-dahum yawma-idhin yamuju fi ba-din wa nufikha fi s-suri fajama-nahum jam-a
versets.francais: Et Nous les laisserons, ce jour-là, se mêler les uns aux autres. Et on soufflera dans la Trompe et Nous les rassemblerons tous
versets.anglais: [Dhul-Qarnayn] said, "This is a mercy from my Lord; but when the promise of my Lord comes, He will make it level, and ever is the promise of my Lord true

versets.arabe: وَعَرَضْنَا جَهَنَّمَ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْكَافِرِينَ عَرْضًا
versets.phonetique: Wa aradna jahannama yawma-idhin lil-kafiryna arda
versets.francais: Et Nous présenterons l-Enfer, ce jour-là, face aux mécréants
versets.anglais: And We will leave them that day surging over each other, and [then] the Horn will be blown, and We will assemble them in [one] assembly

versets.arabe: الَّذِينَ كَانَتْ أَعْيُنُهُمْ فِي غِطَاءٍ عَن ذِكْرِي وَكَانُوا لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ سَمْعًا
versets.phonetique: Alladhina kanat a-yunuhum fi ghita-in an dhikri wa kanu la yastati-una sam-a
versets.francais: Ceux dont les yeux étaient voilés à Mon Rappel et qui ne pouvaient pas entendre
versets.anglais: And We will present Hell that Day to the Disbelievers, on display

versets.arabe: أَفَحَسِبَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا أَن يَتَّخِذُوا عِبَادِي مِن دُونِي أَوْلِيَاءَ إِنَّا أَعْتَدْنَا جَهَنَّمَ لِلْكَافِرِينَ نُزُلًا
versets.phonetique: Afahasiba lladhina kafaru an yattakhidhu ibadi min duni awliya-a inna a-tadna jahannama lil-kafiryna nuzula
versets.francais: Les mécréants ont-ils pensé qu-ils pouvaient prendre Mes serviteurs pour protecteurs en dehors de Moi ? Nous avons préparé l-Enfer pour les mécréants en guise de demeure
versets.anglais: Those whose eyes had been within a cover [removed] from My remembrance, and they were not able to hear

versets.arabe: قُلْ هَلْ نُنَبِّئُكُم بِالْأَخْسَرِينَ أَعْمَالًا
versets.phonetique: Qul hal nunabi-ukum bil-akhsarina a-mala
versets.francais: Dis : Vous annoncerons-Nous ceux qui ont le plus perdu en oeuvres
versets.anglais: Then do those who disbelieve think that they can take My servants instead of Me as allies? Indeed, We have prepared Hell for the disbelievers as a lodging

versets.arabe: الَّذِينَ ضَلَّ سَعْيُهُمْ فِي الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا وَهُمْ يَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّهُمْ يُحْسِنُونَ صُنْعًا
versets.phonetique: Alladhina dalla sa-yuhum fi l-hayati d-dunya wa hum yahsabuna annahum yuhsinuna sun-a
versets.francais: Ceux dont l-effort s-est égaré dans la vie présente et qui pensent pourtant qu-ils font du bien
versets.anglais: Say, [O Muhammad], "Shall we [believers] inform you of the greatest losers as to [their] deeds

versets.arabe: أُولَٰئِكَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا بِآيَاتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَلِقَائِهِ فَحَبِطَتْ أَعْمَالُهُمْ فَلَا نُقِيمُ لَهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَزْنًا
versets.phonetique: Ula-ika lladhina kafaru bi-ayati rabbihim wa liqa-ihi fahabitat a-maluhum fala nuqimu lahum yawma l-qiyamati wazna
versets.francais: Ceux-là sont ceux qui ont mécru aux signes de leur Seigneur et à Sa rencontre. Leurs oeuvres sont devenues vaines. Nous ne leur accorderons aucun poids au Jour de la Résurrection
versets.anglais: [They are] those whose effort is lost in worldly life, while they think that they are doing well in work

versets.arabe: ذَٰلِكَ جَزَاؤُهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ بِمَا كَفَرُوا وَاتَّخَذُوا آيَاتِي وَرُسُلِي هُزُوًا
versets.phonetique: Dhalika jaza-uhum jahannamu bima kafaru wattakhadhu ayati wa rusuli huzu-a
versets.francais: Voilà leur rétribution : l-Enfer, pour avoir mécru et s-être moqués de Mes signes et de Mes messagers
versets.anglais: Those are the ones who disbelieve in the verses of their Lord and in [their] meeting Him, so their deeds have become worthless; and We will not assign to them on the Day of Resurrection any importance

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ كَانَتْ لَهُمْ جَنَّاتُ الْفِرْدَوْسِ نُزُلًا
versets.phonetique: Inna lladhina amanu wa amilu s-salihati kanat lahum jannatu l-firdawsi nuzula
versets.francais: Ceux qui ont cru et accompli de bonnes oeuvres auront les jardins du Firdaws en demeure
versets.anglais: That is their recompense - Hell - for what they denied and [because] they took My signs and My messengers in ridicule

versets.arabe: خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا لَا يَبْغُونَ عَنْهَا حِوَلًا
versets.phonetique: Khalidina fiha la yabghuna anha hiwala
versets.francais: Ils y demeureront éternellement, sans désirer s-en éloigner
versets.anglais: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - they will have the Gardens of Paradise as a lodging

versets.arabe: قُل لَّوْ كَانَ الْبَحْرُ مِدَادًا لِّكَلِمَاتِ رَبِّي لَنَفِدَ الْبَحْرُ قَبْلَ أَن تَنفَدَ كَلِمَاتُ رَبِّي وَلَوْ جِئْنَا بِمِثْلِهِ مَدَدًا
versets.phonetique: Qul law kana l-bahru midadan likalimati rabbi lanafida l-bahru qabla an tanfada kalimatu rabbi wa law ji-na bimithlihi madada
versets.francais: Dis : Si la mer était de l-encre pour écrire les paroles de mon Seigneur, la mer s-épuiserait avant que s-épuisent les paroles de mon Seigneur, même si Nous apportions autant en renfort
versets.anglais: Wherein they abide eternally. They will not desire from it any transfer

versets.arabe: قُلْ إِنَّمَا أَنَا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ يُوحَىٰ إِلَيَّ أَنَّمَا إِلَٰهُكُمْ إِلَٰهٌ وَاحِدٌ فَمَن كَانَ يَرْجُو لِقَاءَ رَبِّهِ فَلْيَعْمَلْ عَمَلًا صَالِحًا وَلَا يُشْرِكْ بِعِبَادَةِ رَبِّهِ أَحَدًا
versets.phonetique: Qul innama ana basharun mithlukum yuha ilayya annama ilahukum ilahun wahidun faman kana yarju liqa-a rabbihi falya-mal amalan salihan wa la yushrik bi-ibadati rabbihi ahada
versets.francais: Dis : Je ne suis qu-un être humain comme vous. Il m-est révélé que votre Dieu est un Dieu Unique. Que celui qui espère rencontrer son Seigneur accomplisse de bonnes oeuvres et n-associe personne dans le culte rendu à son Seigneur
versets.anglais: Say, "If the sea were ink for [writing] the words of my Lord, the sea would be exhausted before the words of my Lord were exhausted, even if We brought the like of it as a supplement

versets.arabe: وَلَا يُشْرِكُ بِعِبَادَةِ رَبِّهِ أَحَدًا
versets.phonetique: Wa la yushrik bi-ibadati rabbihi ahada
versets.francais: Et qu-il n-associe personne dans le culte rendu à son Seigneur
versets.anglais: Say, "I am only a man like you, to whom has been revealed that your god is one God. So whoever would hope for the meeting with his Lord - let him do righteous work and not associate in the worship of his Lord anyone

versets.arabe: كهيعص
versets.phonetique: Kaf-Ha-Ya-Ayn-Sad
versets.francais: Kaf, Ha, Ya, Ayn, Sad.
versets.anglais: Kaf, Ha, Ya, 'Ayn, Sad

versets.arabe: ذكر رحمة ربك عبده زكريا
versets.phonetique: Dhikr rahmatu rabbika abdah zakariya
versets.francais: Mention de la miséricorde de ton Seigneur envers Son serviteur Zacharie.
versets.anglais: [This is] a mention of the mercy of your Lord to His servant Zechariah

versets.arabe: إذ نادى ربه نداء خفيا
versets.phonetique: Idh nada rabbah nida' khafiyyah
versets.francais: Quand il invoqua son Seigneur d'une invocation secrète.
versets.anglais: When he called to his Lord a private supplication

versets.arabe: قال رب إني وهن العظم مني واشتعل الرأس شيبا ولم أكن بدعائك رب شقيا
versets.phonetique: Qala rabbi inni wahuna al-'adham minni wa-shtaa'la ar-ra's shay'an wa lam akun bi-du'a'ika rabbi shaqqiyya
versets.francais: Il dit: 'Seigneur, mes os se sont affaiblis et mes cheveux ont blanchi. Et je n'ai jamais été déçu dans ma prière envers Toi, ô Seigneur.
