versets.francais: Il dit: "Ô fils de ma mère, ne me prends pas par la barbe ni par la tête! J'ai craint que tu ne dises: 'Tu as semé la division parmi les fils d'Israël.'"
versets.anglais: [Aaron] said, "O son of my mother, do not seize [me] by my beard or by my head. Indeed, I feared that you would say, 'You caused division among the Children of Israel, and you did not observe [or await] my word

versets.arabe: قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكَ يَا سَامِرِيُّ
versets.phonetique: Qala fama khatbuka ya samiriyyu
versets.francais: Il dit: "Et toi, qu'as-tu à dire, ô Samaritain?"
versets.anglais: [Moses] said, "And what is your case, O Samiri

versets.arabe: قَالَ بَصُرْتُ بِمَا لَمْ يَبْصُرُوا بِهِ فَقَبَضْتُ قَبْضَةً مِّنْ أَثَرِ الرَّسُولِ فَنَبَذْتُهَا
versets.phonetique: Qala basurtu bima lam yabsuroo bihi faqabadtu qabdatan min athari alrrasooli fanabathuha
versets.francais: Il dit: "J'ai vu ce qu'ils n'ont pas vu. J'ai pris une poignée de la trace du messager et je l'ai lancée."
versets.anglais: He said, "I saw what they did not see, so I took a handful [of dust] from the track of the messenger and threw it, and thus did my soul entice me

versets.arabe: قَالَ فَاذْهَبْ فَإِنَّ لَكَ فِي الْحَيَاةِ أَن تَقُولَ لَا مِسَاسَ
versets.phonetique: Qala fathhab fa-inna laka fee alhayati an taqoola la misasa
versets.francais: Il dit: "Va donc! Ta punition dans cette vie sera de dire: 'Point de contact!'"
versets.anglais: [Moses] said, "Then go. And indeed, it is [decreed] for you in [this] life to say, 'No contact.' And indeed, you have an appointment [in the Hereafter] you will not fail to keep. And look at your 'god' to which you remained devoted. We will surely burn it and blow it into the sea with a blast

versets.arabe: إِنَّمَا إِلَٰهُكُمُ اللَّهُ الَّذِي لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ وَسِعَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ عِلْمًا
versets.phonetique: Innama ilahukumu Allahu allathee la ilaha illa huwa wasiAAa kulla shay'in AAilma
versets.francais: Votre divinité n'est qu'Allah, hormis qui il n'y a pas de divinité. Sa science embrasse toute chose.
versets.anglais: Your god is only Allah, except for whom there is no deity. He has encompassed all things in knowledge

versets.arabe: كَذَٰلِكَ نَقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ أَنبَاءِ مَا قَدْ سَبَقَ وَقَدْ آتَيْنَاكَ مِن لَّدُنَّا ذِكْرًا
versets.phonetique: Kathalika naqussu AAalayka min anbai ma qad sabaqa waqad ataynaka min ladunna thikran
versets.francais: Ainsi te racontons-Nous des nouvelles de ce qui a précédé. Nous t'avons accordé de Notre part un Rappel.
versets.anglais: Thus, [O Muhammad], We relate to you from the news of what has preceded. And We have certainly given you from Us the Qur'an

versets.arabe: مَّنْ أَعْرَضَ عَنْهُ فَإِنَّهُ يَحْمِلُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وِزْرًا
versets.phonetique: Man aAArada AAanhu fa-innahu yahmilu yawma alqiyamati wizra
versets.francais: Celui qui s'en détourne portera le Jour de la Résurrection un lourd fardeau.
versets.anglais: Whoever turns away from it - then indeed, he will bear on the Day of Resurrection a burden

versets.arabe: خَالِدِينَ فِيهِ وَسَاءَ لَهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ حِمْلًا
versets.phonetique: Khalideena feehi wasaa lahum yawma alqiyamati himla
versets.francais: Ils y demeureront éternellement; et quel mauvais fardeau le Jour de la Résurrection!
versets.anglais: [Abiding] eternally therein, and evil it is for them on the Day of Resurrection as a load

versets.arabe: يَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِي الصُّورِ وَنَحْشُرُ الْمُجْرِمِينَ يَوْمَئِذٍ زُرْقًا
versets.phonetique: Yawma yunfakhu fee alssori wanahshuru almujrimeena yawma'ithin zurqa
versets.francais: Le jour où l'on soufflera dans la Trompe et où Nous rassemblerons les criminels, ce jour-là, les yeux blêmes.
versets.anglais: The Day the Horn will be blown. And We will gather the criminals, that Day, blue-eyed

versets.arabe: يَتَخَافَتُونَ بَيْنَهُمْ إِن لَّبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا عَشْرًا
versets.phonetique: Yatakhafatoona baynahum in labithtum illa AAashran
versets.francais: Ils se chuchotent entre eux: "Vous n'avez séjourné que dix jours."
versets.anglais: They will murmur among themselves, "You remained not but ten [days in the world]

versets.arabe: نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ إِذْ يَقُولُ أَمْثَلُهُمْ طَرِيقَةً إِن لَّبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا يَوْمًا
versets.phonetique: Nahnu aAAlamu bima yaqooloona ith yaqoolu amthaluhum tareeqatan in labithtum illa yawma
versets.francais: Nous savons mieux ce qu'ils diront, quand le meilleur d'entre eux dira: "Vous n'avez séjourné qu'un jour."
versets.anglais: We are most knowing of what they say when the best of them in manner will say, "You remained not but one day

versets.arabe: وَيَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ الْجِبَالِ فَقُلْ يَنسِفُهَا رَبِّي نَسْفًا
versets.phonetique: Wayas'aloonaka AAani aljibali faqul yansifuha rabbee nasfa
versets.francais: Ils t'interrogent sur les montagnes. Dis: "Mon Seigneur les dispersera complètement."
versets.anglais: And they ask you about the mountains, so say, "My Lord will blow them away with a blast

versets.arabe: فَيَذَرُهَا قَاعًا صَفْصَفًا
versets.phonetique: Fayatharuha qaAAan safsafa
versets.francais: Il les laissera une plaine rase,
versets.anglais: And He will leave the earth a level plain

versets.arabe: لَّا تَرَىٰ فِيهَا عِوَجًا وَلَا أَمْتًا
versets.phonetique: La tara feeha AAiwajan wala amta
versets.francais: où tu ne verras ni creux ni bosse.
versets.anglais: You will not see therein a depression or an elevation

versets.arabe: يَوْمَئِذٍ يَتَّبِعُونَ الدَّاعِيَ لَا عِوَجَ لَهُ وَخَشَعَتِ الْأَصْوَاتُ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ
versets.phonetique: Yawma'ithin yattabiAAoona alddaAAiya la AAiwaja lahu wakhashaAAati al-aswatu lilrrahman
versets.francais: Ce jour-là, ils suivront le Convocateur sans pouvoir dévier. Les voix s'abaisseront devant le Tout Miséricordieux.
versets.anglais: That Day, everyone will follow [the call of] the Caller [with] no deviation therefrom, and [all] voices will be stilled before the Most Merciful, so you will not hear except a whisper [of footsteps]

versets.arabe: يَوْمَئِذٍ لَّا تَنفَعُ الشَّفَاعَةُ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ الرَّحْمَٰنُ وَرَضِيَ لَهُ قَوْلًا
versets.phonetique: Yawma'ithin la tanfaAAu alshshafaAAatu illa man athina lahu alrrahmanu waradiya lahu qawla
versets.francais: Ce jour-là, l'intercession ne sera d'aucun profit, sauf de la part de celui à qui le Tout Miséricordieux aura accordé permission et dont Il agrée la parole.
versets.anglais: That Day, no intercession will benefit except [that of] one to whom the Most Merciful has given permission and has accepted his word

versets.arabe: يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِهِ عِلْمًا
versets.phonetique: YaAAlamu ma bayna aydeehim wama khalfahum wala yuheetoona bihi AAilma
versets.francais: Il sait ce qui est devant eux et ce qui est derrière eux, alors qu'ils ne L'appréhendent pas par la connaissance.
versets.anglais: Allah knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, but they do not encompass it in knowledge

versets.arabe: وَعَنَتِ الْوُجُوهُ لِلْحَيِّ الْقَيُّومِ وَقَدْ خَابَ مَنْ حَمَلَ ظُلْمًا
versets.phonetique: WaAAanati alwujoohu lilhayyi alqayyoomi waqad khaba man hamala thulma
versets.francais: Les visages s'humilieront devant le Vivant, l'Immuable. Et sera déçu quiconque porte une injustice.
versets.anglais: And [all] faces will be humbled before the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence. And he will have failed who carries injustice

versets.arabe: وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِنَ الصَّالِحَاتِ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَلَا يَخَافُ ظُلْمًا وَلَا هَضْمًا
versets.phonetique: Waman yaAAmal mina alssalihati wahuwa mu'minun fala yakhafu thulman wala hadma
versets.francais: Quiconque fait des bonnes œuvres en étant croyant ne craindra ni injustice ni lésion.
versets.anglais: But he who does of righteous deeds while he is a believer - he will neither fear injustice nor deprivation

versets.arabe: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَنزَلْنَاهُ قُرْآنًا عَرَبِيًّا وَصَرَّفْنَا فِيهِ مِنَ الْوَعِيدِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ أَوْ يُحْدِثُ لَهُمْ ذِكْرًا
versets.phonetique: Wakathalika anzalnaahu qur'anan AAarabiyyan wasarrafna feehi mina alwaAAeedi laAAallahum yattaqoona aw yuhdithu lahum thikra
versets.francais: Ainsi avons-Nous fait descendre un Coran en langue arabe, et y avons varié les avertissements afin qu'ils acquièrent la piété ou qu'ils tirent leçon.
versets.anglais: And thus We have sent it down as an Arabic Qur'an and have diversified therein the warnings that perhaps they will avoid [sin] or it would cause them remembrance

versets.arabe: فَتَعَالَى اللَّهُ الْمَلِكُ الْحَقُّ وَلَا تَعْجَلْ بِالْقُرْآنِ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يُقْضَىٰ إِلَيْكَ وَحْيُهُ وَقُل رَّبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا
versets.phonetique: FataAAala Allahu almaliku alhaqqu wala taAAjal bialqur'ani min qabli an yuqda ilayka wahyuhu waqul rabbi zidnee AAilma
versets.francais: Qu'Allah soit exalté, le Roi, la Vérité! Ne te hâte pas de réciter le Coran avant que sa révélation ne te soit parachevée. Et dis: "Seigneur, augmente mes connaissances."
versets.anglais: So high [above all] is Allah, the Sovereign, the Truth. And, [O Muhammad], do not hasten with [recitation of] the Qur'an before its revelation is completed to you, and say, "My Lord, increase me in knowledge

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ عَهِدْنَا إِلَىٰ آدَمَ مِن قَبْلُ فَنَسِيَ وَلَمْ نَجِدْ لَهُ عَزْمًا
versets.phonetique: Walaqad AAahidna ila adama min qablu fanasiya walam najid lahu AAazma
versets.francais: Certes, Nous avions commandé auparavant à Adam, mais il oublia et Nous ne lui avons pas trouvé de ferme résolution.
versets.anglais: And We had already taken a promise from Adam before, but he forgot; and We found not in him determination

versets.arabe: وَإِذْ قُلْنَا لِلْمَلَائِكَةِ اسْجُدُوا لِآدَمَ فَسَجَدُوا إِلَّا إِبْلِيسَ أَبَىٰ
versets.phonetique: Wa-ith qulna lilmala'ikati osjudoo li-adama fasajadoo illa ibleesa aba
versets.francais: Et quand Nous dîmes aux anges: "Prosternez-vous devant Adam", ils se prosternèrent, sauf Iblis qui refusa.
versets.anglais: And [mention] when We said to the angels, "Prostrate to Adam," and they prostrated, except Iblees; he refused

versets.arabe: فَقُلْنَا يَا آدَمُ إِنَّ هَٰذَا عَدُوٌّ لَّكَ وَلِزَوْجِكَ فَلَا يُخْرِجَنَّكُمَا مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ فَتَشْقَىٰ
versets.phonetique: Faqulna ya adamu inna hatha AAaduwwun laka walilzawjika fala yukhrijannakuma mina aljannati fatashqa
versets.francais: Nous dîmes: "Ô Adam, celui-ci est un ennemi pour toi et pour ta femme. Qu'il ne vous fasse donc pas sortir du Jardin, sinon tu seras dans la peine."
versets.anglais: So We said, "O Adam, indeed this is an enemy to you and to your wife. Then let him not remove you from Paradise so you would suffer

versets.arabe: إِنَّ لَكَ أَلَّا تَجُوعَ فِيهَا وَلَا تَعْرَىٰ
versets.phonetique: Inna laka alla tajoAAa feeha wala taAAra
versets.francais: "Tu ne souffriras de faim là-dedans ni de nudité,"
versets.anglais: Indeed, it is [promised] for you not to be hungry therein or be unclothed

versets.arabe: وَأَنَّكَ لَا تَظْمَأُ فِيهَا وَلَا تَضْحَىٰ
versets.phonetique: Waannaka la tatma'o feeha wala tadha
versets.francais: "et tu n'y auras ni soif ni accablement de chaleur."
versets.anglais: And indeed, you will not be thirsty therein or be hot from the sun

versets.arabe: فَوَسْوَسَ إِلَيْهِ الشَّيْطَانُ قَالَ يَا آدَمُ هَلْ أَدُلُّكَ عَلَىٰ شَجَرَةِ الْخُلْدِ وَمُلْكٍ لَّا يَبْلَىٰ
versets.phonetique: Fawaswasa ilayhi alshshaytanu qala ya adamu hal adulluka AAala shajrati alkhuldi wamulikin la yabla
versets.francais: Puis le Diable lui chuchota: "Ô Adam, t'indiquerai-je l'arbre de l'éternité et une royauté impérissable?"
versets.anglais: Then Satan whispered to him; he said, "O Adam, shall I direct you to the tree of eternity and possession that will not deteriorate

versets.arabe: فَأَكَلَا مِنْهَا فَبَدَتْ لَهُمَا سَوْآتُهُمَا وَطَفِقَا يَخْصِفَانِ عَلَيْهِمَا مِن وَرَقِ الْجَنَّةِ
versets.phonetique: Fakala minha fabadtat lahuma saw'atuhuma watafiqaaa yakhsifani AAalayhima min waraqi aljannati
versets.francais: Ils en mangèrent tous les deux. Leurs parties honteuses leur apparurent et ils se mirent à se couvrir avec des feuilles du Jardin.
versets.anglais: And Adam and his wife ate of it, and their private parts became apparent to them, and they began to fasten over themselves from the leaves of Paradise. And Adam disobeyed his Lord and erred

versets.arabe: ثُمَّ اجْتَبَاهُ رَبُّهُ فَتَابَ عَلَيْهِ وَهَدَىٰ
versets.phonetique: Thumma ijtabahu rabbuhu fataba AAalayhi wahada
versets.francais: Puis son Seigneur l'élut, lui accorda Son pardon et le guida.
versets.anglais: Then his Lord chose him and turned to him in forgiveness and guided [him]

versets.arabe: قَالَ اهْبِطَا مِنْهَا جَمِيعًا بَعْضُكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّ فَإِمَّا يَأْتِيَنَّكُم مِّنِّي هُدًى
versets.phonetique: Qala ihbita minha jameeAAan baAAdukum libaAAdin AAaduwwun fa-imma ya'tiyannakum minnee hudan
versets.francais: Il dit: "Descendez-en tous les deux; les uns aux autres vous serez ennemis. Si jamais vous vient de Ma part une guidance,"
versets.anglais: [Allah] said, "Descend from Paradise - all, [your descendants] being enemies to one another. And if there should come to you guidance from Me - then whoever follows My guidance will neither go astray [in the world] nor suffer [in the Hereafter]

versets.arabe: وَمَنْ أَعْرَضَ عَن ذِكْرِي فَإِنَّ لَهُ مَعِيشَةً ضَنكًا وَنَحْشُرُهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ أَعْمَىٰ
versets.phonetique: Waman aAArada AAan thikree fa-inna lahu maAAeeshatan danka wanahshuruhu yawma alqiyamati aAAma
versets.francais: "Mais quiconque se détourne de Mon rappel aura une existence difficile, et Nous le rassemblerons aveugle au Jour de la Résurrection."
versets.anglais: And whoever turns away from My remembrance - indeed, he will have a depressed life, and We will gather him on the Day of Resurrection blind

versets.arabe: قَالَ رَبِّ لِمَ حَشَرْتَنِي أَعْمَىٰ وَقَدْ كُنتُ بَصِيرًا
versets.phonetique: Qala rabbi lima hashartanee aAAma waqad kuntu baseeran
versets.francais: Il dira: "Seigneur, pourquoi m'as-Tu rassemblé aveugle, alors que j'étais voyant?"
versets.anglais: He will say, "My Lord, why have you raised me blind while I was [once] seeing

versets.arabe: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ أَتَتْكَ آيَاتُنَا فَنَسِيتَهَا وَكَذَٰلِكَ الْيَوْمَ تُنسَىٰ
versets.phonetique: Qala kathalika atatka ayatuna fanaseetaha wakathalika alyawma tunsa
versets.francais: Il dira: "Ainsi en est-il: Nos signes t'étaient venus et tu les avais oubliés. Ainsi aujourd'hui tu seras oublié."
versets.anglais: [Allah] will say, "Thus did Our signs come to you, and you forgot them; and thus will you this Day be forgotten

versets.arabe: وَكَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِي مَنْ أَسْرَفَ وَلَمْ يُؤْمِن بِآيَاتِ رَبِّهِ وَلَعَذَابُ الْآخِرَةِ أَشَدُّ وَأَبْقَىٰ
versets.phonetique: Wakathalika najzee man asrafa walam yu'min bi-ayati rabbihi walaAAathabu al-akhirati ashaddu waabqa
versets.francais: Ainsi rétribuons-Nous celui qui a été excessif et qui n'a pas cru aux signes de son Seigneur. Le châtiment de l'au-delà est certes plus rigoureux et plus durable.
versets.anglais: And thus do We recompense he who transgressed and did not believe in the signs of his Lord. And the punishment of the Hereafter is more severe and more enduring

versets.arabe: أَفَلَمْ يَهْدِ لَهُمْ كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّنَ الْقُرُونِ يَمْشُونَ فِي مَسَاكِنِهِمْ
versets.phonetique: Afalam yahdi lahum kam ahlakna qablahum mina alqurooni yamshoona fee masakinihim
versets.francais: N'ont-ils pas été guidés par le nombre de générations que Nous avons anéanties avant eux, dont ils parcourent les demeures?
versets.anglais: Then, has it not become clear to them how many generations We destroyed before them as they walk among their dwellings? Indeed in that are signs for those of intelligence

versets.arabe: وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِن رَّبِّكَ لَكَانَ لِزَامًا وَأَجَلٌ مُّسَمًّى
versets.phonetique: Walawla kalimatun sabaqat min rabbika lakana lizaman waajulun musamma
versets.francais: Et n'était la parole qui a précédé de la part de ton Seigneur et un terme fixé, cela aurait été inévitable.
versets.anglais: And if not for a word that preceded from your Lord, punishment would have been an obligation [due immediately], and [if not for] a specified term [decreed]

versets.arabe: فَاصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ غُرُوبِهَا
versets.phonetique: Faisbir AAala ma yaqooloona wasabbih bihamdi rabbika qabla tuloo'i alshshamsi waqabla ghuroobiha
versets.francais: Supporte donc patiemment ce qu'ils disent, et glorifie les louanges de ton Seigneur avant le lever du soleil et avant son coucher.
versets.anglais: So be patient over what they say and exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting; and during periods of the night [exalt Him] and at the ends of the day, that you may be satisfied

versets.arabe: وَلَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيْنَيْكَ إِلَىٰ مَا مَتَّعْنَا بِهِ أَزْوَاجًا مِّنْهُمْ زَهْرَةَ الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا
versets.phonetique: Wala tamuddanna AAaynayka ila ma mattaAAna bihi azwajan minhum zahrata alhayati alddunya
versets.francais: Et n'étends pas tes regards vers ce dont Nous avons pourvu certains groupes parmi eux, la splendeur de la vie d'ici-bas.
versets.anglais: And do not extend your eyes toward that by which We have given enjoyment to [some] categories of them, [its being but] the splendor of worldly life by which We test them. And the provision of your Lord is better and more enduring

versets.arabe: وَأْمُرْ أَهْلَكَ بِالصَّلَاةِ وَاصْطَبِرْ عَلَيْهَا لَا نَسْأَلُكَ رِزْقًا نَّحْنُ نَرْزُقُكَ وَالْعَاقِبَةُ لِلتَّقْوَىٰ
versets.phonetique: Wa'mur ahlaka bialssalati waistabir AAalayha la nas'aluka rizqan nahnu narzuquka waalAAaqibatu lilttaqwa
versets.francais: Ordonne à ta famille la Salat et sois-y assidu. Nous ne te demandons pas de subsistance; c'est Nous qui te donnons la subsistance. L'heureuse fin est pour la piété.
versets.anglais: And enjoin prayer upon your family [and people] and be steadfast therein. We ask you not for provision; We provide for you, and the [best] outcome is for [those of] righteousness

versets.arabe: وَقَالُوا لَوْلَا يَأْتِينَا بِآيَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّهِ أَوَلَمْ تَأْتِهِم بَيِّنَةُ مَا فِي الصُّحُفِ الْأُولَىٰ
versets.phonetique: Waqaloo lawla ya'teena bi-ayatin min rabbihi awalam ta'tihim bayyinatu ma fee alssuhuf al-oola
versets.francais: Ils dirent: "Que ne nous apporte-t-il un signe de la part de son Seigneur?" La preuve ne leur est-elle pas venue dans les pages premières?
versets.anglais: And they say, "Why does he not bring us a sign from his Lord?" Has there not come to them evidence of what was in the former scriptures

versets.arabe: وَلَوْ أَنَّا أَهْلَكْنَاهُم بِعَذَابٍ مِّن قَبْلِهِ لَقَالُوا رَبَّنَا لَوْلَا أَرْسَلْتَ إِلَيْنَا رَسُولًا فَنَتَّبِعَ آيَاتِكَ
versets.phonetique: Walaw anna ahlaknahum biAAathabin min qablihi laqaloo rabbana lawla arsalta ilayna rasoolan fanattabiAAa ayatika
versets.francais: Et si Nous les avions anéantis par un châtiment avant cela, ils auraient dit: "Seigneur, que n'as-Tu envoyé vers nous un messager pour que nous suivions Tes signes?"
versets.anglais: And if We had destroyed them with a punishment before him, they would have said, "Our Lord, why did You not send to us a messenger so we could have followed Your verses before we were humiliated and disgraced

versets.arabe: قُلْ كُلٌّ مُّتَرَبِّصٌ فَتَرَبَّصُوا فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ أَصْحَابُ الصِّرَاطِ السَّوِيِّ وَمَنِ اهْتَدَىٰ
versets.phonetique: Qul kullun mutarabbisun fatarabbasoo fasataAAlamoona man as-habu alssirati alssawiyyi wamani ihtada
versets.francais: Dis: "Chacun est dans l'attente. Attendez donc! Vous saurez bientôt qui sont les gens du droit sentier et qui est bien guidé."
versets.anglais: Say, "Each [of us] is waiting; so wait. For you will know who are the companions of the sound path and who is guided

versets.arabe: اقْتَرَبَ لِلنَّاسِ حِسَابُهُمْ وَهُمْ فِي غَفْلَةٍ مُّعْرِضُونَ
versets.phonetique: Iqtaraba lin-nâsi hisâbuhum wa hum fî ghaflatim mu'ridûn
versets.francais: Le moment du compte rendu des hommes s'approche, tandis qu'ils sont dans l'insouciance et se détournent.
versets.anglais: [The time of] their account has approached for the people, while they are in heedlessness turning away

versets.arabe: مَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن ذِكْرٍ مِّن رَّبِّهِم مُّحْدَثٍ إِلَّا اسْتَمَعُوهُ وَهُمْ يَلْعَبُونَ
versets.phonetique: Mâ ya'tîhim min thikrin mir-rabbihim muhdathin illastama'ûhu wa hum yal'abûn
versets.francais: Il ne leur vient aucun rappel nouveau de leur Seigneur sans qu'ils l'écoutent en jouant.
versets.anglais: No mention comes to them anew from their Lord except that they listen to it while they are at play

versets.arabe: لَاهِيَةً قُلُوبُهُمْ وَأَسَرُّوا النَّجْوَى الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا
versets.phonetique: Lâhiyatan qulûbuhum wa asarrun-najwal-lathîna dhalamû
versets.francais: Leurs cœurs sont distraits. Ceux qui sont injustes tiennent des conciliabules secrets.
versets.anglais: With their hearts distracted. And those who do wrong conceal their private conversation, [saying], "Is this [Prophet] except a human being like you? So would you approach magic while you are aware [of it]

versets.arabe: قَالَ رَبِّي يَعْلَمُ الْقَوْلَ فِي السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
versets.phonetique: Qâla rabbî ya'lamul-qawla fis-samâ'i wal-ardhi wa huwas-samî'ul-'alîm
versets.francais: Il dit: mon Seigneur connaît toute parole dans le ciel et sur la terre. Il est l'Audient l'Omniscient.
versets.anglais: The Prophet said, "My Lord knows whatever is said throughout the heaven and earth, and He is the Hearing, the Knowing

versets.arabe: بَلْ قَالُوا أَضْغَاثُ أَحْلَامٍ بَلِ افْتَرَاهُ بَلْ هُوَ شَاعِرٌ
versets.phonetique: Bal qâlû adghâthu ahlâmin baliftarâhu bal huwa shâ'ir
versets.francais: Ils ont dit: des rêves confus! Ou bien il l'a inventé! Ou bien c'est un poète!
versets.anglais: But they say, "[The revelation is but] a mixture of false dreams; rather, he has invented it; rather, he is a poet. So let him bring us a sign just as the previous [messengers] were sent [with miracles]

versets.arabe: مَا آمَنَتْ قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَاهَا أَفَهُمْ يُؤْمِنُونَ
versets.phonetique: Mâ âmanat qablahum min qaryatin ahlaknâhâ afahum yu'minûn
versets.francais: Aucune cité que Nous avons détruite avant eux n'a cru. Ceux-ci croiraient-ils donc?
versets.anglais: Not a [single] city which We destroyed believed before them, so will they believe

versets.arabe: وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ إِلَّا رِجَالًا نُّوحِي إِلَيْهِمْ فَاسْأَلُوا أَهْلَ الذِّكْرِ
versets.phonetique: Wa mâ arsalnâ qablaka illâ rijâlan nûhî ilayhim fas'alû ahladh-thikr
versets.francais: Nous n'avons envoyé avant toi que des hommes à qui Nous révélions. Interrogez les gens du Rappel.
versets.anglais: And We sent not before you, [O Muhammad], except men to whom We revealed [the message], so ask the people of the message if you do not know

versets.arabe: وَمَا جَعَلْنَاهُمْ جَسَدًا لَّا يَأْكُلُونَ الطَّعَامَ وَمَا كَانُوا خَالِدِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa mâ ja'alnâhum jasadan lâ ya'kulûnat-ta'âma wa mâ kânû khâlidîn
versets.francais: Nous ne leur avons pas donné un corps qui se passe de nourriture, et ils n'étaient pas immortels.
versets.anglais: And We did not make the prophets forms not eating food, nor were they immortal [on earth]

versets.arabe: ثُمَّ صَدَقْنَاهُمُ الْوَعْدَ فَأَنجَيْنَاهُمْ وَمَن نَّشَاءُ
versets.phonetique: Thumma sadaqnâhumul-wa'da fa'anjaynahum wa man nashâ'
versets.francais: Puis Nous avons accompli Notre promesse envers eux. Nous les avons sauvés ainsi que ceux que Nous voulions.
versets.anglais: Then We fulfilled for them the promise, and We saved them and whom We willed and destroyed the transgressors

versets.arabe: لَقَدْ أَنزَلْنَا إِلَيْكُمْ كِتَابًا فِيهِ ذِكْرُكُمْ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Laqad anzalnâ ilaykum kitâban fîhi thikrukum afalâ ta'qilûn
versets.francais: Nous vous avons certes fait descendre un Livre dans lequel il y a votre rappel. Ne raisonnez-vous pas?
versets.anglais: We have certainly sent down to you a Book in which is your mention. Then will you not reason

versets.arabe: وَكَمْ قَصَمْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ كَانَتْ ظَالِمَةً وَأَنشَأْنَا بَعْدَهَا قَوْمًا آخَرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa kam qasammâ min qaryatin kânat dhâlimatan wa ansha'nâ ba'dahâ qawman âkharîn
versets.francais: Combien de cités injustes avons-Nous brisées et créé après elles d'autres peuples!
versets.anglais: And how many a city which was unjust have We shattered and produced after it another people

versets.arabe: فَلَمَّا أَحَسُّوا بَأْسَنَا إِذَا هُم مِّنْهَا يَرْكُضُونَ
versets.phonetique: Falammâ ahassû ba'sanâ ithâ hum minhâ yarkudhûn
versets.francais: Quand ils sentirent Notre rigueur, voilà qu'ils s'enfuyaient.
versets.anglais: And when its inhabitants perceived Our punishment, at once they fled from it

versets.arabe: لَا تَرْكُضُوا وَارْجِعُوا إِلَىٰ مَا أُتْرِفْتُمْ فِيهِ وَمَسَاكِنِكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Lâ tarkudhû warji'û ilâ mâ utriftum fîhi wa masâkinikum
versets.francais: Ne fuyez pas! Retournez dans vos délices et vos demeures.
versets.anglais: [Some angels said], "Do not flee but return to where you were given luxury and to your homes - perhaps you will be questioned

versets.arabe: قَالُوا يَا وَيْلَنَا إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَالِمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qâlû yâ waylanâ innâ kunnâ dhâlimîn
versets.francais: Ils dirent: malheur à nous! Nous étions vraiment injustes.
versets.anglais: They said, "O woe to us! Indeed, we were wrongdoers

versets.arabe: فَمَا زَالَتْ تِلْكَ دَعْوَاهُمْ حَتَّىٰ جَعَلْنَاهُمْ حَصِيدًا خَامِدِينَ
versets.phonetique: Famâ zâlat tilka da'wâhum hattâ ja'alnâhum hasîdan khâmidîn
versets.francais: C'est ce qu'ils continuèrent à dire jusqu'à ce que Nous les rendions comme une moisson fauchée, éteints.
versets.anglais: And that declaration of theirs did not cease until We made them [as] a harvest [mowed down], extinguished [like a fire]

versets.arabe: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا السَّمَاءَ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَاعِبِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa mâ khalaqnas-samâ'a wal-ardha wa mâ baynahumâ lâ'ibîn
versets.francais: Nous n'avons pas créé le ciel et la terre et ce qui est entre eux en jouant.
versets.anglais: And We did not create the heaven and earth and that between them in play

versets.arabe: لَوْ أَرَدْنَا أَن نَّتَّخِذَ لَهْوًا لَّاتَّخَذْنَاهُ مِن لَّدُنَّا
versets.phonetique: Law aradnâ an nattakhitha lahwan lattakhathnâhu min ladunnâ
versets.francais: Si Nous avions voulu prendre un divertissement, Nous l'aurions pris de Nous-mêmes.
versets.anglais: Had We intended to take a diversion, We could have taken it from [what is] with Us - if [indeed] We were to do so

versets.arabe: بَلْ نَقْذِفُ بِالْحَقِّ عَلَى الْبَاطِلِ فَيَدْمَغُهُ فَإِذَا هُوَ زَاهِقٌ
versets.phonetique: Bal naqthibu bil-haqqi 'alal-bâtili fayadmaghuhu fa'ithâ huwa zâhiq
versets.francais: Mais Nous lançons la vérité contre le faux et elle l'écrase. Le voilà qui disparaît.
versets.anglais: Rather, We dash the truth upon falsehood, and it destroys it, and thereupon it departs. And for you is destruction from that which you describe

versets.arabe: وَلَهُ مَن فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَنْ عِندَهُ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ عَنْ عِبَادَتِهِ
versets.phonetique: Wa lahû man fis-samâwâti wal-ardhi wa man 'indahu lâ yastakbirûna 'an 'ibâdatih
versets.francais: À Lui appartient quiconque est dans les cieux et sur la terre. Ceux qui sont auprès de Lui ne s'enorgueillissent pas de son adoration.
versets.anglais: To Him belongs whoever is in the heavens and the earth. And those near Him are not prevented by arrogance from His worship, nor do they tire

versets.arabe: يُسَبِّحُونَ اللَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ لَا يَفْتُرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Yusabbihûnal-layla wan-nahâra lâ yaftarûn
versets.francais: Ils Le glorifient nuit et jour sans se lasser.
versets.anglais: They exalt [Him] night and day [and] do not slacken

versets.arabe: أَمِ اتَّخَذُوا آلِهَةً مِّنَ الْأَرْضِ هُمْ يُنشِرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Amittakhadhû âlihatam minal-ardhi hum yunshirûn
versets.francais: Ont-ils pris de la terre des divinités qui peuvent ressusciter?
versets.anglais: Or have men taken for themselves gods from the earth who resurrect [the dead]

versets.arabe: لَوْ كَانَ فِيهِمَا آلِهَةٌ إِلَّا اللَّهُ لَفَسَدَتَا
versets.phonetique: Law kâna fîhumâ âlihatun illallâhu lafasadatâ
versets.francais: S'il y avait en eux des divinités autres qu'Allah, ils se corrompraient certes.
versets.anglais: Had there been within the heavens and earth gods besides Allah, they both would have been ruined. So exalted is Allah, Lord of the Throne, above what they describe

versets.arabe: لَا يُسْأَلُ عَمَّا يَفْعَلُ وَهُمْ يُسْأَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Lâ yus'alu 'ammâ yaf'alu wa hum yus'alûn
versets.francais: Il n'est pas interrogé sur ce qu'Il fait, mais eux seront interrogés.
versets.anglais: He is not questioned about what He does, but they will be questioned

versets.arabe: أَمِ اتَّخَذُوا مِن دُونِهِ آلِهَةً قُلْ هَاتُوا بُرْهَانَكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Amittakhadhû min dûnihî âlihatan qul hâtû burhânakum
versets.francais: Ont-ils pris en dehors de Lui des divinités? Dis: apportez votre preuve.
versets.anglais: Or have they taken gods besides Him? Say, [O Muhammad], "Produce your proof. This [Qur'an] is the message for those with me and the message of those before me." But most of them do not know the truth, so they are turning away

versets.arabe: وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا نُوحِي إِلَيْهِ أَنَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنَا
versets.phonetique: Wa mâ arsalnâ min qablika mir-rasûlin illâ nûhî ilayhi annahu lâ ilâha illâ ana
versets.francais: Nous n'avons envoyé aucun messager avant toi sans lui révéler qu'il n'y a de divinité que Moi.
versets.anglais: And We sent not before you any messenger except that We revealed to him that, "There is no deity except Me, so worship Me

versets.arabe: وَقَالُوا اتَّخَذَ الرَّحْمَٰنُ وَلَدًا سُبْحَانَهُ بَلْ عِبَادٌ مُّكْرَمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa qâlûttakhathar-rahmânu waladân subhânahu bal 'ibâdun mukramûn
versets.francais: Ils dirent: Le Tout Miséricordieux S'est attribué un enfant. Gloire à Lui! Ce sont plutôt des serviteurs honorés.
versets.anglais: And they say, "The Most Merciful has taken a son." Exalted is He! Rather, they are [but] honored servants

versets.arabe: لَا يَسْبِقُونَهُ بِالْقَوْلِ وَهُم بِأَمْرِهِ يَعْمَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Lâ yasbiqûnahu bil-qawli wa hum bi'amrihî ya'malûn
versets.francais: Ils ne prennent pas la parole avant Lui et agissent selon Ses ordres.
versets.anglais: They cannot precede Him in word, and they act by His command

versets.arabe: يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلَا يَشْفَعُونَ إِلَّا لِمَنِ ارْتَضَىٰ
versets.phonetique: Ya'lamu mâ bayna aydîhim wa mâ khalfahum wa lâ yashfa'ûna illâ limanirtadhâ
versets.francais: Il sait ce qui est devant eux et ce qui est derrière eux. Ils n'intercèdent qu'en faveur de celui qu'Il agrée.
versets.anglais: He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they cannot intercede except on behalf of one whom He approves. And they, from fear of Him, are apprehensive

versets.arabe: وَمَن يَقُلْ مِنْهُمْ إِنِّي إِلَٰهٌ مِّن دُونِهِ فَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِيهِ جَهَنَّمَ
versets.phonetique: Wa man yaqul minhum innî ilâhun min dûnihî fathâlika najzîhi jahannama
versets.francais: Celui d'entre eux qui dirait: je suis une divinité en dehors de Lui, Nous le rétribuerions par la Géhenne.
versets.anglais: And whoever of them should say, "Indeed, I am a god besides Him"- that one We would recompense with Hell. Thus do We recompense the wrongdoers

versets.arabe: أَوَلَمْ يَرَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا أَنَّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ كَانَتَا رَتْقًا فَفَتَقْنَاهُمَا
versets.phonetique: Awa lam yaral-lathîna kafarû annas-samâwâti wal-ardha kânatâ ratqan fafataqnâhumâ
versets.francais: Les mécréants n'ont-ils pas vu que les cieux et la terre formaient une masse compacte? Nous les avons séparés.
versets.anglais: Have those who disbelieved not considered that the heavens and the earth were a joined entity, and We separated them and made from water every living thing? Then will they not believe

versets.arabe: وَجَعَلْنَا فِي الْأَرْضِ رَوَاسِيَ أَن تَمِيدَ بِهِمْ
versets.phonetique: Wa ja'alnâ fil-ardhi rawâsiya an tamîda bihim
versets.francais: Nous avons placé dans la terre des montagnes fermes pour qu'elle ne s'agite pas avec eux.
versets.anglais: And We placed within the earth firmly set mountains, lest it should shift with them, and We made therein [mountain] passes [as] roads that they might be guided

versets.arabe: وَجَعَلْنَا السَّمَاءَ سَقْفًا مَّحْفُوظًا وَهُمْ عَنْ آيَاتِهَا مُعْرِضُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa ja'alnas-samâ'a saqfan mahfûzhan wa hum 'an âyâtihâ mu'ridûn
versets.francais: Nous avons fait du ciel un toit bien gardé. Et pourtant, ils se détournent de ses signes.
versets.anglais: And We made the sky a protected ceiling, but they, from its signs, are turning away

versets.arabe: وَهُوَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ اللَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ وَالشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ
versets.phonetique: Wa huwal-lathî khalaqal-layla wan-nahâra wash-shamsa wal-qamar
versets.francais: C'est Lui qui a créé la nuit et le jour, le soleil et la lune.
versets.anglais: And it is He who created the night and the day and the sun and the moon; all [heavenly bodies] in an orbit are swimming

versets.arabe: وَمَا جَعَلْنَا لِبَشَرٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ الْخُلْدَ أَفَإِن مِّتَّ فَهُمُ الْخَالِدُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa mâ ja'alnâ libasharim min qablikal-khulda afa'in mitta fahumul-khâlidûn
versets.francais: Nous n'avons accordé l'immortalité à aucun être humain avant toi. Si tu mourais, seraient-ils immortels?
versets.anglais: And We did not grant to any man before you eternity [on earth]; so if you die - would they be eternal

versets.arabe: كُلُّ نَفْسٍ ذَائِقَةُ الْمَوْتِ وَنَبْلُوكُم بِالشَّرِّ وَالْخَيْرِ فِتْنَةً
versets.phonetique: Kullu nafsin thâ'iqatul-mawti wa nablûkum bish-sharri wal-khayri fitnah
versets.francais: Toute âme goûtera la mort. Nous vous éprouvons par le mal et le bien, comme tentation.
versets.anglais: Every soul will taste death. And We test you with evil and with good as trial; and to Us you will be returned

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا رَآكَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا إِن يَتَّخِذُونَكَ إِلَّا هُزُوًا
versets.phonetique: Wa ithâ ra'âkal-lathîna kafarû in yattakhithûnaka illâ huzuwâ
versets.francais: Quand les mécréants te voient, ils ne font que se moquer de toi.
versets.anglais: And when those who disbelieve see you, [O Muhammad], they take you not except in ridicule, [saying], "Is this the one who insults your gods?" And they are, at the mention of the Most Merciful, disbelievers

versets.arabe: خُلِقَ الْإِنسَانُ مِنْ عَجَلٍ سَأُرِيكُمْ آيَاتِي فَلَا تَسْتَعْجِلُونِ
versets.phonetique: Khuliqal-insânu min 'ajalin sa'urîkum âyâtî falâ tasta'jilûn
versets.francais: L'homme a été créé de précipitation. Je vous montrerai Mes signes; ne vous pressez donc pas.
versets.anglais: Man was created of haste. I will show you My signs, so do not impatiently urge Me

versets.arabe: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا الْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَادِقِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa yaqûlûna matâ hâthal-wa'du in kuntum sâdiqîn
versets.francais: Ils disent: quand se réalisera cette promesse si vous dites vrai?
versets.anglais: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful

versets.arabe: لَوْ يَعْلَمُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا حِينَ لَا يَكُفُّونَ عَن وُجُوهِهِمُ النَّارَ
versets.phonetique: Law ya'lamul-lathîna kafarû hîna lâ yakuffûna 'an wujûhihimun-nâr
versets.francais: Si les mécréants savaient le moment où ils ne pourront pas éloigner le feu de leurs visages.
versets.anglais: If those who disbelieved but knew the time when they will not avert the Fire from their faces or from their backs and they will not be aided

versets.arabe: بَلْ تَأْتِيهِم بَغْتَةً فَتَبْهَتُهُمْ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ رَدَّهَا
versets.phonetique: Bal ta'tîhim baghtatan fatabhathuhum falâ yastatî'ûna raddahâ
versets.francais: Elle viendra à eux à l'improviste et les atterrera. Ils ne pourront pas la repousser.
versets.anglais: Rather, it will come to them unexpectedly and bewilder them, and they will not be able to repel it, nor will they be reprieved

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدِ اسْتُهْزِئَ بِرُسُلٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ فَحَاقَ بِالَّذِينَ سَخِرُوا مِنْهُم
versets.phonetique: Wa laqadistuhzi'a birusulin min qablika fahâqa billathîna sakhiru minhum
versets.francais: Des messagers avant toi ont été tournés en dérision. Ceux qui se moquaient d'eux furent entourés par ce dont ils se moquaient.
versets.anglais: And already were messengers ridiculed before you, but those who mocked them were enveloped by what they used to ridicule

versets.arabe: قُلْ مَن يَكْلَؤُكُم بِاللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ مِنَ الرَّحْمَٰنِ
versets.phonetique: Qul man yakla'ukum bil-layli wan-nahâri minar-rahmân
versets.francais: Dis: qui vous garde de nuit et de jour contre le Tout Miséricordieux?
versets.anglais: Say, "Who can protect you at night or by day from the Most Merciful?" But they are, from the remembrance of their Lord, turning away

versets.arabe: أَمْ لَهُمْ آلِهَةٌ تَمْنَعُهُم مِّن دُونِنَا لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَ أَنفُسِهِمْ
versets.phonetique: Am lahum âlihatun tamna'uhum min dûninâ lâ yastatî'ûna nasra anfusihim
versets.francais: Ont-ils des divinités pour les protéger en dehors de Nous? Elles ne peuvent même pas se secourir elles-mêmes.
versets.anglais: Or do they have gods to defend them other than Us? They are unable [even] to help themselves, nor can they be protected from Us

versets.arabe: بَلْ مَتَّعْنَا هَٰؤُلَاءِ وَآبَاءَهُمْ حَتَّىٰ طَالَ عَلَيْهِمُ الْعُمُرُ
versets.phonetique: Bal matta'nâ hâ'ulâ'i wa âbâ'ahum hattâ tâla 'alayhimul-'umur
versets.francais: Nous avons laissé jouir ceux-ci et leurs pères jusqu'à ce que la vie leur parût longue.
versets.anglais: But, [on the contrary], We have provided good things for these [disbelievers] and their fathers until life was prolonged for them. Then do they not see that We set upon the land, reducing it from its borders? So it is they who will overcome

versets.arabe: قُلْ إِنَّمَا أُنذِرُكُم بِالْوَحْيِ وَلَا يَسْمَعُ الصُّمُّ الدُّعَاءَ
versets.phonetique: Qul innamâ unthirukum bil-wahyi wa lâ yasma'us-summud-du'â'
versets.francais: Dis: je vous avertis seulement par la Révélation. Mais les sourds n'entendent pas l'appel.
versets.anglais: Say, "I only warn you by revelation." But the deaf do not hear the call when they are warned

versets.arabe: وَلَئِن مَّسَّتْهُمْ نَفْحَةٌ مِّنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّكَ لَيَقُولُنَّ يَا وَيْلَنَا
versets.phonetique: Wa la'in massathum nafhatun min 'athâbi rabbika layaqûlunna yâ waylanâ
versets.francais: Si un souffle du châtiment de ton Seigneur les touchait, ils diraient sûrement: malheur à nous!
versets.anglais: And if [as much as] a whiff of the punishment of your Lord should touch them, they would surely say, "O woe to us! Indeed, we have been wrongdoers

versets.arabe: وَنَضَعُ الْمَوَازِينَ الْقِسْطَ لِيَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ
versets.phonetique: Wa nadha'ul-mawâzînal-qista liyawmil-qiyâmah
versets.francais: Nous placerons les balances exactes pour le Jour de la Résurrection.
versets.anglais: And We place the scales of justice for the Day of Resurrection, so no soul will be treated unjustly at all. And if there is [even] the weight of a mustard seed, We will bring it forth. And sufficient are We as accountant

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَهَارُونَ الْفُرْقَانَ وَضِيَاءً وَذِكْرًا لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa laqad âtaynâ mûsâ wa hârûnal-furqâna wa dhiyâ'an wa thikran lil-muttaqîn
versets.francais: Nous avons donné à Moïse et Aaron le Discernement, une lumière et un rappel pour les pieux.
versets.anglais: And We had already given Moses and Aaron the criterion and a light and a reminder for the righteous

versets.arabe: الَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُم بِالْغَيْبِ وَهُم مِّنَ السَّاعَةِ مُشْفِقُونَ
versets.phonetique: Allathîna yakhshawna rabbahum bil-ghaybi wa hum minas-sâ'ati mushfiqûn
versets.francais: Ceux qui craignent leur Seigneur en secret et qui redoutent l'Heure.
versets.anglais: Who fear their Lord unseen, while they are of the Hour apprehensive

versets.arabe: وَهَٰذَا ذِكْرٌ مُّبَارَكٌ أَنزَلْنَاهُ أَفَأَنتُمْ لَهُ مُنكِرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa hâthâ thikrun mubârakun anzalnâhu afa'antum lahû munkirûn
versets.francais: Et ceci est un rappel béni que Nous avons fait descendre. Le nierez-vous donc?
versets.anglais: And this [Qur'an] is a blessed message which We have sent down. Then are you with it unacquainted

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ رُشْدَهُ مِن قَبْلُ وَكُنَّا بِهِ عَالِمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa laqad âtaynâ ibrâhîma rushdahu min qablu wa kunnâ bihî 'âlimîn
versets.francais: Nous avions donné auparavant à Abraham sa droiture, et Nous le connaissions bien.
versets.anglais: And We had certainly given Abraham his sound judgement before, and We were of him well-Knowing

versets.arabe: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِ مَا هَٰذِهِ التَّمَاثِيلُ الَّتِي أَنتُمْ لَهَا عَاكِفُونَ
versets.phonetique: Ith qâla li'abîhi wa qawmihî mâ hâthihit-tamâthîlul-latî antum lahâ 'âkifûn
versets.francais: Quand il dit à son père et à son peuple: que sont ces statues auxquelles vous vous consacrez?
versets.anglais: When he said to his father and his people, "What are these statues to which you are devoted

versets.arabe: قَالُوا وَجَدْنَا آبَاءَنَا لَهَا عَابِدِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qâlû wajadnâ âbâ'anâ lahâ 'âbidîn
versets.francais: Ils dirent: nous avons trouvé nos pères les adorant.
versets.anglais: They said, "We found our fathers worshippers of them

versets.arabe: قَالَ لَقَدْ كُنتُمْ أَنتُمْ وَآبَاؤُكُمْ فِي ضَلَالٍ مُّبِينٍ
versets.phonetique: Qâla laqad kuntum antum wa âbâ'ukum fî dalâlim mubîn
versets.francais: Il dit: vous et vos pères étiez dans un égarement évident.
versets.anglais: He said, "You were certainly, you and your fathers, in manifest error

versets.arabe: قَالُوا أَجِئْتَنَا بِالْحَقِّ أَمْ أَنتَ مِنَ اللَّاعِبِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qâlû aji'tanâ bil-haqqi am anta minal-lâ'ibîn
versets.francais: Ils dirent: es-tu venu à nous avec la vérité ou es-tu de ceux qui plaisantent?
versets.anglais: They said, "Have you come to us with truth, or are you of those who jest

versets.arabe: قَالَ بَل رَّبُّكُمْ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ الَّذِي فَطَرَهُنَّ
versets.phonetique: Qâla bal rabbukum rabbus-samâwâti wal-ardhill-lathî fatarahunna
versets.francais: Il dit: mais non, votre Seigneur est le Seigneur des cieux et de la terre qui les a créés.
versets.anglais: He said, "[No], rather, your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth who created them, and I, to that, am of those who testify

versets.arabe: وَتَاللَّهِ لَأَكِيدَنَّ أَصْنَامَكُم بَعْدَ أَن تُوَلُّوا مُدْبِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa tallâhi la'akîdanna asnâmakum ba'da an tuwallû mudbirîn
versets.francais: Par Allah, je m'occuperai de vos idoles après que vous vous serez éloignés.
versets.anglais: And [I swear] by Allah, I will surely plan against your idols after you have turned and gone away

versets.arabe: فَجَعَلَهُمْ جُذَاذًا إِلَّا كَبِيرًا لَّهُمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ إِلَيْهِ يَرْجِعُونَ
versets.phonetique: Faja'alahum jutháthân illâ kabîran lahum la'allahum ilayhi yarji'ûn
versets.francais: Il les réduisit en morceaux, sauf la plus grande d'entre elles, pour qu'ils reviennent la consulter.
versets.anglais: So he made them into fragments, except a large one among them, that they might return to it [and question]

versets.arabe: قَالُوا مَن فَعَلَ هَٰذَا بِآلِهَتِنَا إِنَّهُ لَمِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qâlû man fa'ala hâthâ bi'âlihatinâ innahû laminadh-dhâlimîn
versets.francais: Ils dirent: qui a fait cela à nos divinités? C'est vraiment un injuste.
versets.anglais: They said, "Who has done this to our gods? Indeed, he is of the wrongdoers

versets.arabe: قَالُوا سَمِعْنَا فَتًى يَذْكُرُهُمْ يُقَالُ لَهُ إِبْرَاهِيمُ
versets.phonetique: Qâlû sami'nâ fatâ yathkuruhum yuqâlu lahû ibrâhîm
versets.francais: Ils dirent: nous avons entendu un jeune homme en parler, il s'appelle Abraham.
versets.anglais: They said, "We heard a young man mention them who is called Abraham

versets.arabe: قَالُوا فَأْتُوا بِهِ عَلَىٰ أَعْيُنِ النَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَشْهَدُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qâlû fa'tû bihî 'alâ a'yunin-nâsi la'allahum yashadûn
versets.francais: Ils dirent: amenez-le devant les gens pour qu'ils témoignent.
versets.anglais: They said, "Then bring him before the eyes of the people that they may testify

versets.arabe: قَالُوا أَأَنتَ فَعَلْتَ هَٰذَا بِآلِهَتِنَا يَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ
versets.phonetique: Qâlû a'anta fa'alta hâthâ bi'âlihatinâ yâ ibrâhîm
versets.francais: Ils dirent: est-ce toi qui as fait cela à nos divinités, ô Abraham?
versets.anglais: They said, "Have you done this to our gods, O Abraham

versets.arabe: قَالَ بَلْ فَعَلَهُ كَبِيرُهُمْ هَٰذَا فَاسْأَلُوهُمْ إِن كَانُوا يَنطِقُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qâla bal fa'alahu kabîruhum hâthâ fas'alûhum in kânû yantiqûn
versets.francais: Il dit: c'est plutôt leur grande idole qui a fait cela. Interrogez-les donc s'ils peuvent parler.
versets.anglais: He said, "Rather, this - the largest of them - did it, so ask them, if they should [be able to] speak

versets.arabe: فَرَجَعُوا إِلَىٰ أَنفُسِهِمْ فَقَالُوا إِنَّكُمْ أَنتُمُ الظَّالِمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Faraja'û ilâ anfusihim faqâlû innakum antumudh-dhâlimûn
versets.francais: Ils se retournèrent vers eux-mêmes et dirent: c'est vous qui êtes les injustes.
versets.anglais: So they returned to [blaming] themselves and said [to each other], "Indeed, you are the wrongdoers

versets.arabe: ثُمَّ نُكِسُوا عَلَىٰ رُءُوسِهِمْ لَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ مَا هَٰؤُلَاءِ يَنطِقُونَ
versets.phonetique: Thumma nukisû 'alâ ru'ûsihim laqad 'alimta mâ hâ'ulâ'i yantiqûn
versets.francais: Puis ils baissèrent la tête: tu sais bien que celles-ci ne parlent pas.
versets.anglais: Then they reversed themselves, [saying], "You have already known that these do not speak

versets.arabe: قَالَ أَفَتَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُكُمْ شَيْئًا وَلَا يَضُرُّكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Qâla afata'budûna min dûnillâhi mâ lâ yanfa'ukum shay'an wa lâ yadhurrukum
versets.francais: Il dit: adorez-vous donc en dehors d'Allah ce qui ne peut vous profiter ni vous nuire en rien?
versets.anglais: He said, "Then do you worship instead of Allah that which does not benefit you at all or harm you

versets.arabe: أُفٍّ لَّكُمْ وَلِمَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Uffin lakum wa limâ ta'budûna min dûnillâh afalâ ta'qilûn
versets.francais: Fi pour vous et pour ce que vous adorez en dehors d'Allah! Ne raisonnez-vous donc pas?
versets.anglais: Uff to you and to what you worship instead of Allah. Then will you not use reason

versets.arabe: قَالُوا حَرِّقُوهُ وَانصُرُوا آلِهَتَكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ فَاعِلِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qâlû harriqûhu wansurû âlihatakum in kuntum fâ'ilîn
versets.francais: Ils dirent: brûlez-le et secourez vos divinités, si vous devez agir.
versets.anglais: They said, "Burn him and support your gods - if you are to act

versets.arabe: قُلْنَا يَا نَارُ كُونِي بَرْدًا وَسَلَامًا عَلَىٰ إِبْرَاهِيمَ
versets.phonetique: Qulnâ yâ nâru kûnî bardan wa salâman 'alâ ibrâhîm
versets.francais: Nous dîmes: Ô feu, sois fraîcheur et sécurité pour Abraham.
versets.anglais: Allah said, "O fire, be coolness and safety upon Abraham

versets.arabe: وَأَرَادُوا بِهِ كَيْدًا فَجَعَلْنَاهُمُ الْأَخْسَرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa arâdû bihî kaydan faja'alnâhumul-akhsarîn
versets.francais: Ils voulurent lui tendre un piège mais Nous les rendîmes les plus grands perdants.
versets.anglais: And they intended for him harm, but We made them the greatest losers

versets.arabe: وَنَجَّيْنَاهُ وَلُوطًا إِلَى الْأَرْضِ الَّتِي بَارَكْنَا فِيهَا لِلْعَالَمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa najjaynâhu wa lûtan ilal-ardhill-latî bâraknâ fîhâ lil'âlamîn
versets.francais: Nous le sauvâmes ainsi que Lot vers la terre que Nous avons bénie pour les mondes.
versets.anglais: And We delivered him and Lot to the land which We had blessed for the worlds

versets.arabe: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُ إِسْحَاقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ نَافِلَةً وَكُلًّا جَعَلْنَا صَالِحِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa wahabnâ lahû ishâqa wa ya'qûba nâfilatan wa kullan ja'alnâ sâlihîn
versets.francais: Nous lui avons accordé Isaac et, en plus, Jacob. Nous avons rendu chacun d'eux vertueux.
versets.anglais: And We gave him Isaac and Jacob in addition, and all [of them] We made righteous

versets.arabe: وَجَعَلْنَاهُمْ أَئِمَّةً يَهْدُونَ بِأَمْرِنَا وَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْهِمْ فِعْلَ الْخَيْرَاتِ
versets.phonetique: Wa ja'alnâhum a'immatam yahdûna bi'amrinâ wa awhaynâ ilayhim fi'lal-khayrât
versets.francais: Nous en avons fait des imams qui guidaient selon Notre ordre. Nous leur avons révélé de faire le bien.
versets.anglais: And We made them leaders guiding by Our command. And We inspired to them the doing of good deeds, establishment of prayer, and giving of zakah; and they were worshippers of Us

versets.arabe: وَلُوطًا آتَيْنَاهُ حُكْمًا وَعِلْمًا وَنَجَّيْنَاهُ مِنَ الْقَرْيَةِ الَّتِي كَانَت تَّعْمَلُ الْخَبَائِثَ
versets.phonetique: Wa lûtan âtaynâhu hukman wa 'ilman wa najjaynâhu minal-qaryatillatî kânat ta'malul-khabâ'ith
versets.francais: À Lot Nous avons accordé sagesse et science. Nous l'avons sauvé de la cité qui pratiquait les abominations.
versets.anglais: And to Lot We gave judgement and knowledge, and We saved him from the city that was committing wicked deeds. Indeed, they were a people of evil, defiantly disobedient

versets.arabe: وَأَدْخَلْنَاهُ فِي رَحْمَتِنَا إِنَّهُ مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa adkhalnâhu fî rahmatinâ innahû minas-sâlihîn
versets.francais: Nous l'avons fait entrer dans Notre miséricorde. Il était des vertueux.
versets.anglais: And We admitted him into Our mercy. Indeed, he was of the righteous

versets.arabe: وَنُوحًا إِذْ نَادَىٰ مِن قَبْلُ فَاسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُ
versets.phonetique: Wa nûhan ith nâdâ min qablu fastajbnâ lahû
versets.francais: Et Noé quand il Nous invoqua auparavant. Nous exauçâmes sa prière.
versets.anglais: And [mention] Noah, when he called [to Allah] before [that time], so We responded to him and saved him and his family from the great flood

versets.arabe: وَنَصَرْنَاهُ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا بِآيَاتِنَا
versets.phonetique: Wa nasarnâhu minal-qawmillathîna kaththabû bi'âyâtinâ
versets.francais: Nous l'avons secouru contre le peuple qui avait traité de mensonges Nos signes.
versets.anglais: And We saved him from the people who denied Our signs. Indeed, they were a people of evil, so We drowned them, all together

versets.arabe: وَدَاوُودَ وَسُلَيْمَانَ إِذْ يَحْكُمَانِ فِي الْحَرْثِ
versets.phonetique: Wa dâwûda wa sulaymâna ith yahkumâni fil-harth
versets.francais: Et David et Salomon quand ils jugeaient au sujet du champ.
versets.anglais: And [mention] David and Solomon, when they judged concerning the field - when the sheep of a people overran it [at night], and We were witness to their judgement

versets.arabe: فَفَهَّمْنَاهَا سُلَيْمَانَ وَكُلًّا آتَيْنَا حُكْمًا وَعِلْمًا
versets.phonetique: Fafahhamnâhâ sulaymâna wa kullan âtaynâ hukman wa 'ilmâ
versets.francais: Nous avons fait comprendre cela à Salomon. À chacun d'eux Nous avons accordé sagesse et science.
versets.anglais: And We gave understanding of the case to Solomon, and to each [of them] We gave judgement and knowledge. And We subjected the mountains to exalt [Us], along with David and [also] the birds. And We were doing [that]

versets.arabe: وَعَلَّمْنَاهُ صَنْعَةَ لَبُوسٍ لَّكُمْ لِتُحْصِنَكُم مِّن بَأْسِكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Wa 'allamnâhu san'ata labûsin lakum lituhsinakum min ba'sikum
versets.francais: Nous lui avons appris la fabrication de cottes de mailles pour vous protéger dans vos combats.
versets.anglais: And We taught him the fashioning of coats of armor to protect you from your [enemy in] battle. So will you then be grateful

versets.arabe: وَلِسُلَيْمَانَ الرِّيحَ عَاصِفَةً تَجْرِي بِأَمْرِهِ إِلَى الْأَرْضِ الَّتِي بَارَكْنَا فِيهَا
versets.phonetique: Wa lisulaymânar-rîha 'âsifatan tajrî bi'amrihî ilal-ardhill-latî bâraknâ fîhâ
versets.francais: Et pour Salomon le vent violent courant selon son commandement vers la terre que Nous avons bénie.
versets.anglais: And to Solomon [We subjected] the wind, blowing forcefully, proceeding by his command toward the land which We had blessed. And We are ever, of all things, Knowing

versets.arabe: وَمِنَ الشَّيَاطِينِ مَن يَغُوصُونَ لَهُ وَيَعْمَلُونَ عَمَلًا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ
versets.phonetique: Wa minash-shayâtîni man yaghûsûna lahû wa ya'malûna 'amalan dûna thâlik
versets.francais: Et parmi les diables il y en avait qui plongeaient pour lui et faisaient d'autres travaux.
versets.anglais: And of the devils were those who dived for him and did work other than that. And We were of them a guardian

versets.arabe: وَأَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُ أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ الضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa ayyûba ith nâdâ rabbahu annî massaniyadh-dhurru wa anta arhamur-râhimîn
versets.francais: Et Job quand il invoqua son Seigneur: le malheur m'a touché et Tu es le plus Miséricordieux des miséricordieux.
versets.anglais: And [mention] Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, adversity has touched me, and you are the Most Merciful of the merciful

versets.arabe: فَاسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُ فَكَشَفْنَا مَا بِهِ مِن ضُرٍّ
versets.phonetique: Fastajbnâ lahû fakashafnâ mâ bihî min dhurr
versets.francais: Nous l'avons exaucé et avons écarté le mal qui l'affectait.
versets.anglais: So We responded to him and removed what afflicted him of adversity. And We gave him [back] his family and the like thereof with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for the worshippers [of Allah]

versets.arabe: وَإِسْمَاعِيلَ وَإِدْرِيسَ وَذَا الْكِفْلِ كُلٌّ مِّنَ الصَّابِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa ismâ'îla wa idrîsa wa thal-kifli kullun minas-sâbirîn
versets.francais: Et Ismaël, Idris et Dhul-Kifl, tous étaient des gens endurants.
versets.anglais: And [mention] Ishmael and Idrees and Dhul-Kifl; all were of the patient

versets.arabe: وَأَدْخَلْنَاهُمْ فِي رَحْمَتِنَا إِنَّهُم مِّنَ الصَّالِحِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa adkhalnâhum fî rahmatinâ innahum minas-sâlihîn
versets.francais: Nous les avons fait entrer dans Notre miséricorde. Ils étaient des vertueux.
versets.anglais: And We admitted them into Our mercy. Indeed, they were of the righteous

versets.arabe: وَذَا النُّونِ إِذ ذَّهَبَ مُغَاضِبًا فَظَنَّ أَن لَّن نَّقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ
versets.phonetique: Wa than-nûni ith thahaba mughâdhiban fadhanna an lan naqdira 'alayh
versets.francais: Et Dhul-Nun qui s'en alla irrité et pensa que Nous n'avions aucun pouvoir sur lui.
versets.anglais: And [mention] the man of the fish, when he went off in anger and thought that We would not decree [anything] upon him. And he called out within the darknesses, "There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers

versets.arabe: فَاسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُ وَنَجَّيْنَاهُ مِنَ الْغَمِّ وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُنجِي الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Fastajbnâ lahû wa najjaynâhu minal-ghammi wa kathâlika nunjil-mu'minîn
versets.francais: Nous l'avons exaucé et délivré du chagrin. C'est ainsi que Nous sauvons les croyants.
versets.anglais: So We responded to him and saved him from the distress. And thus do We save the believers

versets.arabe: وَزَكَرِيَّا إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُ رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِي فَرْدًا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الْوَارِثِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa zakariyyâ ith nâdâ rabbahu rabbi lâ tatharni fardan wa anta khayrul-wârithîn
versets.francais: Et Zacharie quand il invoqua son Seigneur: Seigneur, ne me laisse pas seul, Tu es le meilleur des héritiers.
versets.anglais: And [mention] Zechariah, when he called to his Lord, "My Lord, do not leave me alone [with no heir], while you are the best of inheritors

versets.arabe: فَاسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُ وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُ يَحْيَىٰ وَأَصْلَحْنَا لَهُ زَوْجَهُ
versets.phonetique: Fastajbnâ lahû wa wahabnâ lahû yahyâ wa aslâhnâ lahû zawjahu
versets.francais: Nous l'avons exaucé, lui avons accordé Yahya et guéri sa femme.
versets.anglais: So We responded to him, and We gave to him John, and amended for him his wife. Indeed, they used to hasten to good deeds and supplicate Us in hope and fear, and they were to Us humbly submissive

versets.arabe: وَالَّتِي أَحْصَنَتْ فَرْجَهَا فَنَفَخْنَا فِيهَا مِن رُّوحِنَا
versets.phonetique: Wallatî ahsanat farjahâ fanafakhnâ fîhâ min rûhinâ
versets.francais: Et celle qui a préservé sa chasteté. Nous avons insufflé en elle de Notre souffle.
versets.anglais: And [mention] the one who guarded her chastity, so We blew into her [garment] through Our angel [Gabriel], and We made her and her son a sign for the worlds

versets.arabe: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِ أُمَّتُكُمْ أُمَّةً وَاحِدَةً وَأَنَا رَبُّكُمْ فَاعْبُدُونِ
versets.phonetique: Inna hâthihî ummatukum ummataw wâhidatan wa ana rabbukum fa'budûn
versets.francais: Votre communauté est bien une communauté unique et Je suis votre Seigneur, adorez-Moi donc.
versets.anglais: Indeed this, your religion, is one religion, and I am your Lord, so worship Me

versets.arabe: وَتَقَطَّعُوا أَمْرَهُم بَيْنَهُمْ كُلٌّ إِلَيْنَا رَاجِعُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa taqatta'û amrahum baynahum kullun ilaynâ râji'ûn
versets.francais: Mais ils ont fragmenté leurs affaires entre eux. Ils reviendront tous vers Nous.
versets.anglais: And [yet] they divided their affair among themselves, [but] all to Us will return

versets.arabe: فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِنَ الصَّالِحَاتِ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَلَا كُفْرَانَ لِسَعْيِهِ
versets.phonetique: Faman ya'mal minas-sâlihâti wa huwa mu'minun falâ kufrâna lisa'yih
versets.francais: Quiconque fait de bonnes œuvres tout en étant croyant, son effort ne sera pas ignoré.
versets.anglais: So whoever does righteous deeds while he is a believer - no denial will there be for his effort, and indeed We, of it, are recorders

versets.arabe: وَحَرَامٌ عَلَىٰ قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَاهَا أَنَّهُمْ لَا يَرْجِعُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa harâmun 'alâ qaryatin ahlaknâhâ annahum lâ yarji'ûn
versets.francais: Il est interdit à une cité que Nous avons détruite de ne pas retourner.
versets.anglais: And there is prohibition upon [the people of] a city which We have destroyed that they will [ever] return

versets.arabe: حَتَّىٰ إِذَا فُتِحَتْ يَأْجُوجُ وَمَأْجُوجُ وَهُم مِّن كُلِّ حَدَبٍ يَنسِلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Hattâ ithâ futihat ya'jûju wa ma'jûju wa hum min kulli hadabin yansilûn
versets.francais: Jusqu'à ce que Gog et Magog soient libérés et qu'ils se répandent de toutes les hauteurs.
versets.anglais: Until when [the dam of] Gog and Magog has been opened and they, from every elevation, descend

versets.arabe: وَاقْتَرَبَ الْوَعْدُ الْحَقُّ فَإِذَا هِيَ شَاخِصَةٌ أَبْصَارُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا
versets.phonetique: Waqtarabal-wa'dul-haqqu fa'ithâ hiya shâkhisatun absârul-lathîna kafarû
versets.francais: La promesse vraie s'approche. Voilà que les regards des mécréants restent fixes.
versets.anglais: And [when] the true promise has approached; then suddenly the eyes of those who disbelieved will be staring [in horror, while they say], "O woe to us; we had been unmindful of this; rather, we were wrongdoers

versets.arabe: إِنَّكُمْ وَمَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ حَصَبُ جَهَنَّمَ
versets.phonetique: Innakum wa mâ ta'budûna min dûnillâhi hasabu jahannama
versets.francais: Vous et ce que vous adoriez en dehors d'Allah êtes le combustible de la Géhenne.
versets.anglais: Indeed, you [disbelievers] and what you worship other than Allah are the firewood of Hell. You will be coming to [enter] it

versets.arabe: لَوْ كَانَ هَٰؤُلَاءِ آلِهَةً مَّا وَرَدُوهَا وَكُلٌّ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ
versets.phonetique: Law kâna hâ'ulâ'i âlihatan mâ waradûhâ wa kullun fîhâ khâlidûn
versets.francais: Si ceux-là avaient été de vraies divinités, ils n'y seraient pas entrés. Tous y demeureront éternellement.
versets.anglais: Had these [false deities] been [actual] gods, they would not have come to it, but all are eternal therein

versets.arabe: لَهُمْ فِيهَا زَفِيرٌ وَهُمْ فِيهَا لَا يَسْمَعُونَ
versets.phonetique: Lahum fîhâ zafîrun wa hum fîhâ lâ yasma'ûn
versets.francais: Ils y pousseront des rugissements et ils n'y entendront rien.
versets.anglais: For them therein is heavy sighing, and they therein will not hear

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ سَبَقَتْ لَهُم مِّنَّا الْحُسْنَىٰ أُولَٰئِكَ عَنْهَا مُبْعَدُونَ
versets.phonetique: Innal-lathîna sabaqat lahum minnal-husnâ ulâ'ika 'anhâ mub'adûn
versets.francais: Ceux qui auront eu de Notre part la plus belle récompense seront tenus loin d'elle.
versets.anglais: Indeed, those for whom the best [reward] has preceded from Us - they are from it far removed

versets.arabe: لَا يَسْمَعُونَ حَسِيسَهَا وَهُمْ فِي مَا اشْتَهَتْ أَنفُسُهُمْ خَالِدُونَ
versets.phonetique: Lâ yasma'ûna hasîsahâ wa hum fî mash-tahat anfusuhum khâlidûn
versets.francais: Ils n'entendront pas son bruissement et ils demeureront éternellement dans ce que leurs âmes désirent.
versets.anglais: They will not hear its sound, while they are, in that which their souls desire, abiding eternally

versets.arabe: لَا يَحْزُنُهُمُ الْفَزَعُ الْأَكْبَرُ وَتَتَلَقَّاهُمُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ
versets.phonetique: Lâ yahzunuhumul-faza'ul-akbaru wa tatalaqqâhumul-malâ'ikah
versets.francais: La grande frayeur ne les attristera pas et les anges les accueilleront.
versets.anglais: They will not be grieved by the greatest terror, and the angels will meet them, [saying], "This is your Day which you have been promised

versets.arabe: يَوْمَ نَطْوِي السَّمَاءَ كَطَيِّ السِّجِلِّ لِلْكُتُبِ
versets.phonetique: Yawma natwiys-samâ'a katayis-sijilli lilkutub
versets.francais: Le jour où Nous enroulerons le ciel comme on enroule un registre de papyrus.
versets.anglais: The Day when We will fold the heaven like the folding of a [written] sheet for the records. As We began the first creation, We will repeat it. [That is] a promise binding upon Us. Indeed, We will do it

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ كَتَبْنَا فِي الزَّبُورِ مِن بَعْدِ الذِّكْرِ أَنَّ الْأَرْضَ يَرِثُهَا عِبَادِيَ الصَّالِحُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa laqad katabnâ fiz-zabûri mim ba'adith-thikri annal-ardha yarithuhâ 'ibâdiyas-sâlihûn
versets.francais: Nous avons écrit dans les Psaumes après le Rappel que la terre sera héritée par Mes serviteurs vertueux.
versets.anglais: And We have already written in the book [of Psalms] after the [previous] mention that the land [of Paradise] is inherited by My righteous servants

versets.arabe: إِنَّ فِي هَٰذَا لَبَلَاغًا لِّقَوْمٍ عَابِدِينَ
versets.phonetique: Inna fî hâthâ labalâghan liqawmin 'âbidîn
versets.francais: Certes en cela il y a un message suffisant pour un peuple qui adore.
versets.anglais: Indeed, in this [Qur'an] is notification for a worshipping people

versets.arabe: وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ إِلَّا رَحْمَةً لِّلْعَالَمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa mâ arsalnâka illâ rahmatan lil'âlamîn
versets.francais: Nous ne t'avons envoyé qu'en tant que miséricorde pour les mondes.
versets.anglais: And We have not sent you, [O Muhammad], except as a mercy to the worlds

versets.arabe: قُلْ إِنَّمَا يُوحَىٰ إِلَيَّ أَنَّمَا إِلَٰهُكُمْ إِلَٰهٌ وَاحِدٌ فَهَلْ أَنتُم مُّسْلِمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qul innamâ yûhâ ilayya annamâ ilâhukum ilâhun wâhidun fahal antum muslimûn
versets.francais: Dis: il m'est révélé que votre Dieu est un Dieu unique. Êtes-vous donc soumis?
versets.anglais: Say, "It is only revealed to me that your god is but one God; so will you be Muslims [in submission to Him]

versets.arabe: فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا فَقُلْ آذَنتُكُمْ عَلَىٰ سَوَاءٍ
versets.phonetique: Fa'in tawallawfaqul âthantukum 'alâ sawâ'
versets.francais: S'ils se détournent, dis: je vous ai prévenus équitablement.
versets.anglais: But if they turn away, then say, "I have announced to [all of] you equally. And I know not whether near or far is that which you are promised

versets.arabe: وَإِنْ أَدْرِي لَعَلَّهُ فِتْنَةٌ لَّكُمْ وَمَتَاعٌ إِلَىٰ حِينٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa in adrî la'allahu fitnatun lakum wa matâ'un ilâ hîn
versets.francais: Je ne sais pas si cela est peut-être une épreuve pour vous et une jouissance pour un temps.
versets.anglais: Indeed, He knows what is declared of speech, and He knows what you conceal

versets.arabe: قَالَ رَبِّ احْكُم بِالْحَقِّ وَرَبُّنَا الرَّحْمَٰنُ الْمُسْتَعَانُ عَلَىٰ مَا تَصِفُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qâla rabbih-kum bil-haqqi wa rabbunar-rahmânul-musta'ânu 'alâ mâ tasifûn
versets.francais: Il dit: Seigneur, juge en toute vérité. Notre Seigneur le Tout Miséricordieux est Celui dont on implore l'aide.
versets.anglais: And I know not; perhaps it is a trial for you and enjoyment for a time

versets.arabe: قُل رَّبِّ احْكُم بِالْحَقِّ وَرَبُّنَا الرَّحْمَٰنُ الْمُسْتَعَانُ عَلَىٰ مَا تَصِفُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qur-rabbih-kum bil-haqqi wa rabbunar-rahmânul-musta'ânu 'alâ mâ tasifûn
versets.francais: Dis: Seigneur, juge en toute vérité. Notre Seigneur le Tout Miséricordieux est Celui dont on implore l'aide contre ce que vous décrivez.
versets.anglais: [The Prophet] has said, "My Lord, judge [between us] in truth. And our Lord is the Most Merciful, the one whose help is sought against that which you describe

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اتَّقُوا رَبَّكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ زَلْزَلَةَ السَّاعَةِ شَيْءٌ عَظِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuhan-nasu ittaqu rabbakum inna zalzalatas-sa'ati shay'un 'azim
versets.francais: Ô hommes, craignez votre Seigneur ! Le séisme de l'Heure est une chose énorme.
versets.anglais: O mankind, fear your Lord. Indeed, the convulsion of the [final] Hour is a terrible thing

versets.arabe: يَوْمَ تَرَوْنَهَا تَذْهَلُ كُلُّ مُرْضِعَةٍ عَمَّا أَرْضَعَتْ وَتَضَعُ كُلُّ ذَاتِ حَمْلٍ حَمْلَهَا وَتَرَى النَّاسَ سُكَارَىٰ وَمَا هُم بِسُكَارَىٰ وَلَٰكِنَّ عَذَابَ اللَّهِ شَدِيدٌ
versets.phonetique: Yawma tarawnahaa tadhalu kullu murd'iatin 'amma ard'at wa tada'u kullu dhati hamlin hamlaha wa taran-nasa sukara wa ma hum bisukara wa lakinna 'adhaba-llahi shadid
versets.francais: Le jour où vous la verrez, toute femme qui allaite oubliera son nourrisson, toute femme enceinte avortera, et tu verras les gens comme ivres, alors qu'ils ne le sont pas. Mais le châtiment d'Allah est sévère.
versets.anglais: On the Day you see it every nursing mother will be distracted from that [child] she was nursing, and every pregnant woman will abort her pregnancy, and you will see the people [appearing] intoxicated while they are not intoxicated; but the punishment of Allah is severe

versets.arabe: وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَن يُجَادِلُ فِي اللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ وَيَتَّبِعُ كُلَّ شَيْطَانٍ مَّرِيدٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa minan-nasi may yujadilu fillahi bighayri 'ilmiw wa yattabi'u kulla shaytanin marid
versets.francais: Parmi les hommes, il en est qui dispute d'Allah sans savoir et qui suit tout diable rebelle.
versets.anglais: And of the people is he who disputes about Allah without knowledge and follows every rebellious devil

versets.arabe: كُتِبَ عَلَيْهِ أَنَّهُ مَن تَوَلَّاهُ فَأَنَّهُ يُضِلُّهُ وَيَهْدِيهِ إِلَىٰ عَذَابِ السَّعِيرِ
versets.phonetique: Kutiba 'alayhi annahu man tawallahu fa'annahu yudilluhu wa yahdihi ila 'adhabis-sa'ir
versets.francais: Il a été décrété que quiconque le prend pour allié, il l'égare et le guide vers le châtiment du brasier.
versets.anglais: It has been decreed for every devil that whoever turns to him - he will misguide him and will lead him to the punishment of the Blaze

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِن كُنتُمْ فِي رَيْبٍ مِّنَ الْبَعْثِ فَإِنَّا خَلَقْنَاكُم مِّن تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ ثُمَّ مِنْ عَلَقَةٍ ثُمَّ مِن مُّضْغَةٍ مُّخَلَّقَةٍ وَغَيْرِ مُخَلَّقَةٍ لِّنُبَيِّنَ لَكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuhan-nasu in kuntum fi raybin minal-ba'thi fa'inna khalaqnakum min turabin thumma min nutfatin thumma min 'alaqatin thumma mim mudghatin mukhallaqatiw wa ghayri mukhallaqatil linubayyina lakum
versets.francais: Ô hommes, si vous avez un doute sur la Résurrection, rappelez-vous que Nous vous avons créés de terre, puis d'une goutte de sperme, puis d'une adhérence, puis d'un morceau de chair formé ou non formé, afin de vous montrer Notre puissance.
versets.anglais: O People, if you should be in doubt about the Resurrection, then [consider that] indeed, We created you from dust, then from a sperm-drop, then from a clinging clot, and then from a lump of flesh, formed and unformed - that We may show you. And We settle in the wombs whom We will for a specified term, then We bring you out as a child, and then [We develop you] that you may reach your [time of] maturity. And among you is he who is taken in [early] death, and among you is he who is returned to the most decrepit [old] age so that he knows, after [once having] knowledge, nothing. And you see the earth barren, but when We send down upon it rain, it quivers and swells and grows [something] of every beautiful kind

versets.arabe: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْحَقُّ وَأَنَّهُ يُحْيِي الْمَوْتَىٰ وَأَنَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
versets.phonetique: Dhalika bi'annallaha huwal-haqqu wa annahu yuhyil-mawta wa annahu 'ala kulli shay'in qadir
versets.francais: Cela parce qu'Allah est la Vérité, qu'Il redonne vie aux morts et qu'Il est Omnipotent.
versets.anglais: That is because Allah is the Truth and because He gives life to the dead and because He is over all things competent

versets.arabe: وَأَنَّ السَّاعَةَ آتِيَةٌ لَّا رَيْبَ فِيهَا وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ يَبْعَثُ مَن فِي الْقُبُورِ
versets.phonetique: Wa annas-sa'ata atiyatun la rayba fiha wa annallaha yab'athu man fil-qubur
versets.francais: Et que l'Heure arrive sans aucun doute, et qu'Allah ressuscitera ceux qui sont dans les tombeaux.
versets.anglais: And [that they may know] that the Hour is coming - no doubt about it - and that Allah will resurrect those in the graves

versets.arabe: وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَن يُجَادِلُ فِي اللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ وَلَا هُدًى وَلَا كِتَابٍ مُّنِيرٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa minan-nasi may yujadilu fillahi bighayri 'ilmiw wa la hudaw wa la kitabim munir
versets.francais: Parmi les hommes, il en est qui dispute d'Allah sans savoir, sans guide et sans Livre lumineux.
versets.anglais: And of the people is he who disputes about Allah without knowledge or guidance or an enlightening book [from Him]

versets.arabe: ثَانِيَ عِطْفِهِ لِيُضِلَّ عَن سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ۖ لَهُ فِي الدُّنْيَا خِزْيٌ ۖ وَنُذِيقُهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ عَذَابَ الْحَرِيقِ
versets.phonetique: Thaniya 'itfihi liyudilla 'an sabilillahi lahu fid-dunya khizyuw wa nudhiquhu yawmal-qiyamati 'adhabal-hariq
versets.francais: Tournant le dos avec orgueil pour égarer du chemin d'Allah. Il aura la honte en ce monde et Nous lui ferons goûter le châtiment du feu au Jour de la Résurrection.
versets.anglais: Twisting his neck [in arrogance] to mislead [people] from the way of Allah. For him in the world is disgrace, and We will make him taste on the Day of Resurrection the punishment of the Burning Fire [while it is said]

versets.arabe: ذَٰلِكَ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاكَ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ لَيْسَ بِظَلَّامٍ لِّلْعَبِيدِ
versets.phonetique: Dhalika bima qaddamat yadaka wa annallaha laysa bidhallamin lil-'abid
versets.francais: Cela pour ce que tes mains ont accompli, et parce qu'Allah n'est pas injuste envers Ses serviteurs.
versets.anglais: That is for what your hands have put forth and because Allah is not ever unjust to [His] servants

versets.arabe: وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَن يَعْبُدُ اللَّهَ عَلَىٰ حَرْفٍ ۖ فَإِنْ أَصَابَهُ خَيْرٌ اطْمَأَنَّ بِهِ ۖ وَإِنْ أَصَابَتْهُ فِتْنَةٌ انقَلَبَ عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِ خَسِرَ الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةَ
versets.phonetique: Wa minan-nasi may ya'budullaha 'ala harfin fa'in asabahu khayruntt-maa'nna bihi wa in asabathu fitnatunq-qalaba 'ala wajhihi khasirad-dunya wal-akhirah
versets.francais: Parmi les hommes, il en est qui adore Allah sans conviction. S'il lui arrive un bien, il en est satisfait. Mais si une épreuve le touche, il retourne à son incroyance, perdant ainsi ce monde et l'au-delà.
versets.anglais: And of the people is he who worships Allah on an edge. If he is touched by good, he is reassured by it; but if he is struck by trial, he turns on his face [to the other direction]. He has lost [this] world and the Hereafter. That is what is the manifest loss

versets.arabe: يَدْعُو مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ مَا لَا يَضُرُّهُ وَمَا لَا يَنفَعُهُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ الضَّلَالُ الْبَعِيدُ
versets.phonetique: Yad'u min dunillahi ma la yadurruhu wa ma la yanfa'uh dhalika huwadd-dalalul-ba'id
versets.francais: Il invoque en dehors d'Allah ce qui ne peut ni lui nuire ni lui profiter. C'est là l'égarement lointain.
versets.anglais: He invokes instead of Allah that which neither harms him nor benefits him. That is what is the extreme error

versets.arabe: يَدْعُو لَمَن ضَرُّهُ أَقْرَبُ مِن نَّفْعِهِ ۚ لَبِئْسَ الْمَوْلَىٰ وَلَبِئْسَ الْعَشِيرُ
versets.phonetique: Yad'u laman darruhu aqrabu min naf'ihi labi'sal-mawla wa labi'sal-'ashir
versets.francais: Il invoque celui dont le mal est plus proche que le bien. Quel mauvais patron et quel mauvais associé !
versets.anglais: He invokes one whose harm is closer than his benefit - how wretched the protector and how wretched the associate

versets.arabe: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُدْخِلُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ
versets.phonetique: Innallaha yudkhilulladhina amanu wa amilussalihati jannatin tajri min tahtihal-anhar
versets.francais: Allah fait entrer ceux qui croient et font de bonnes œuvres dans des Jardins sous lesquels coulent les ruisseaux.
versets.anglais: Indeed, Allah will admit those who believe and do righteous deeds to gardens beneath which rivers flow. Indeed, Allah does what He intends

versets.arabe: مَن كَانَ يَظُنُّ أَن لَّن يَنصُرَهُ اللَّهُ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ فَلْيَمْدُدْ بِسَبَبٍ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ ثُمَّ لْيَقْطَعْ فَلْيَنظُرْ هَلْ يُذْهِبَنَّ كَيْدُهُ مَا يَغِيظُ
versets.phonetique: Man kana yadhunnu al-lay yansurahu-llahu fid-dunya wal-akhirati falyamdud bisababin ilas-sama'i thumma liyaqta' falyandhur hal yudhibanna kayduhu ma yaghidh
versets.francais: Quiconque pense qu'Allah ne l'aidera pas dans ce monde et dans l'au-delà, qu'il tende une corde jusqu'au plafond, puis qu'il se pende et qu'il voie si sa ruse peut faire disparaître ce qui l'irrite.
versets.anglais: Whoever should think that Allah will not support [Prophet Muhammad] in this world and the Hereafter - let him extend a rope to the ceiling, then cut off [his breath], and let him see: will his effort remove that which enrages [him]

versets.arabe: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَنزَلْنَاهُ آيَاتٍ بَيِّنَاتٍ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ يَهْدِي مَن يُرِيدُ
versets.phonetique: Wa kadhalika anzalnahu ayatin bayyinatiw wa annallaha yahdi man yurid
versets.francais: C'est ainsi que Nous l'avons révélé : des versets clairs, et qu'Allah guide qui Il veut.
versets.anglais: And thus have We sent the Qur'an down as verses of clear evidence and because Allah guides whom He intends

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَالَّذِينَ هَادُوا وَالصَّابِئِينَ وَالنَّصَارَىٰ وَالْمَجُوسَ وَالَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوا إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَفْصِلُ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ
versets.phonetique: Innal-ladhina amanu walladhina hadu was-sabi'ina wan-nasara wal-majusa walladhina ashraku innallaha yafsilu baynahum yawmal-qiyamah
versets.francais: Ceux qui ont cru, les Juifs, les Sabéens, les Chrétiens, les Mages et les polythéistes, Allah tranchera entre eux au Jour de la Résurrection.
versets.anglais: Indeed, those who have believed and those who were Jews and the Sabeans and the Christians and the Magians and those who associated with Allah - Allah will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed Allah is, over all things, Witness

versets.arabe: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ يَسْجُدُ لَهُ مَن فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَن فِي الْأَرْضِ وَالشَّمْسُ وَالْقَمَرُ وَالنُّجُومُ وَالْجِبَالُ وَالشَّجَرُ وَالدَّوَابُّ وَكَثِيرٌ مِّنَ النَّاسِ
versets.phonetique: Alam tara annallaha yasjudu lahu man fis-samawati wa man fil-ardi wash-shamsu wal-qamaru wan-nujumu wal-jibalu wash-shajaru wad-dawabbu wa kathirum minan-nas
versets.francais: N'as-tu pas vu que c'est à Allah que se prosternent ceux qui sont dans les cieux et ceux qui sont sur la terre, le soleil, la lune, les étoiles, les montagnes, les arbres, les bêtes et beaucoup d'hommes ?
versets.anglais: Do you not see that to Allah prostrates whoever is in the heavens and whoever is on the earth and the sun, the moon, the stars, the mountains, the trees, the moving creatures and many of the people? But upon many the punishment has been justified. And he whom Allah humiliates - for him there is no bestower of honor. Indeed, Allah does what He wills

versets.arabe: هَٰذَانِ خَصْمَانِ اخْتَصَمُوا فِي رَبِّهِمْ ۖ فَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا قُطِّعَتْ لَهُمْ ثِيَابٌ مِّن نَّارٍ
versets.phonetique: Hadhani khamsani-khtasamu fi rabbihim falladhina kafaru quttti'at lahum thiyabum min nar
versets.francais: Voilà deux adversaires qui se disputent à propos de leur Seigneur. Pour les mécréants, on taillera des vêtements de feu.
versets.anglais: These are two adversaries who have disputed over their Lord. But those who disbelieved will have cut out for them garments of fire. Poured upon their heads will be scalding water

versets.arabe: يُصَبُّ مِن فَوْقِ رُءُوسِهِمُ الْحَمِيمُ
versets.phonetique: Yusabbu min fawqi ru'usihimul-hamim
versets.francais: On versera sur leurs têtes de l'eau bouillante.
versets.anglais: By which is melted that within their bellies and [their] skins

versets.arabe: يُصْهَرُ بِهِ مَا فِي بُطُونِهِمْ وَالْجُلُودُ
versets.phonetique: Yusharu bihi ma fi butunihim wal-julud
versets.francais: Par laquelle fondront ce qui est dans leurs ventres ainsi que les peaux.
versets.anglais: And for [striking] them are maces of iron

versets.arabe: وَلَهُم مَّقَامِعُ مِنْ حَدِيدٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa lahum maqami'u min hadid
versets.francais: Et pour eux, des maillets de fer.
versets.anglais: Every time they want to get out of Hellfire from anguish, they will be returned to it, and [it will be said], "Taste the punishment of the Burning Fire

versets.arabe: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُدْخِلُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ يُحَلَّوْنَ فِيهَا مِنْ أَسَاوِرَ مِن ذَهَبٍ وَلُؤْلُؤًا ۖ وَلِبَاسُهُمْ فِيهَا حَرِيرٌ
versets.phonetique: Innallaha yudkhilulladhina amanu wa amilussalihati jannatin tajri min tahtihal-anharu yuhallawna fiha min asawira min dhahabiw wa lu'lu'aw wa libasuhum fiha harir
versets.francais: Allah fait entrer ceux qui croient et font de bonnes œuvres dans des jardins sous lesquels coulent les ruisseaux. Ils y seront parés de bracelets d'or et de perles, et leurs vêtements y seront de soie.
versets.anglais: Indeed, Allah will admit those who believe and do righteous deeds to gardens beneath which rivers flow. They will be adorned therein with bracelets of gold and pearl, and their garments therein will be silk

versets.arabe: وَهُدُوا إِلَى الطَّيِّبِ مِنَ الْقَوْلِ وَهُدُوا إِلَىٰ صِرَاطِ الْحَمِيدِ
versets.phonetique: Wa hudu ilat-tayyibi minal-qawli wa hudu ila siratal-hamid
versets.francais: Ils ont été guidés vers la bonne parole et vers le chemin du Très-Loué.
versets.anglais: And they had been guided [in worldly life] to good speech, and they were guided to the path of the Praiseworthy

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَيَصُدُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَالْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ الَّذِي جَعَلْنَاهُ لِلنَّاسِ سَوَاءً الْعَاكِفُ فِيهِ وَالْبَادِ
versets.phonetique: Innal-ladhina kafaru wa yasudduna 'an sabilillahi wal-masjidil-haramil-ladhee ja'alnahu lin-nasi sawa'anil-'akifu fihi wal-bad
versets.francais: Ceux qui ont mécru et qui obstruent le chemin d'Allah et de la Mosquée sacrée que Nous avons établie pour tous les hommes - tant l'habitant que le voyageur.
