versets.anglais: Indeed, those who have disbelieved and avert [people] from the way of Allah and [from] al-Masjid al-Haram, which We made for the people - equal are the resident therein and one from outside; and [also] whoever intends [a deed] therein of deviation [in religion] or wrongdoing - We will make him taste of a painful punishment

versets.arabe: وَإِذْ بَوَّأْنَا لِإِبْرَاهِيمَ مَكَانَ الْبَيْتِ أَن لَّا تُشْرِكْ بِي شَيْئًا وَطَهِّرْ بَيْتِيَ لِلطَّائِفِينَ وَالْقَائِمِينَ وَالرُّكَّعِ السُّجُودِ
versets.phonetique: Wa idh bawwa'na li'ibrahima makanal-bayti al-la tushrik bi shay'aw wa tahhir baytiya lit-ta'ifina wal-qa'imina war-rukka'is-sujud
versets.francais: Quand Nous avons indiqué à Abraham l'emplacement de la Maison en lui disant : "Ne M'associe rien et purifie Ma Maison pour ceux qui tournent autour, qui se tiennent debout et qui s'inclinent et se prosternent."
versets.anglais: And [mention, O Muhammad], when We designated for Abraham the site of the House, [saying], "Do not associate anything with Me and purify My House for those who perform Tawaf and those who stand [in prayer] and those who bow and prostrate

versets.arabe: وَأَذِّن فِي النَّاسِ بِالْحَجِّ يَأْتُوكَ رِجَالًا وَعَلَىٰ كُلِّ ضَامِرٍ يَأْتِينَ مِن كُلِّ فَجٍّ عَمِيقٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa adhdhin fin-nasi bil-hajji ya'tuka rijalan wa 'ala kulli damirin ya'tina min kulli fajjin 'amiq
versets.francais: Et proclame parmi les hommes le pèlerinage. Ils viendront à toi à pied et sur toutes sortes de montures efflanquées, de tous les horizons lointains.
versets.anglais: And proclaim to the people the Hajj [pilgrimage]; they will come to you on foot and on every lean camel; they will come from every distant pass

versets.arabe: لِيَشْهَدُوا مَنَافِعَ لَهُمْ وَيَذْكُرُوا اسْمَ اللَّهِ فِي أَيَّامٍ مَّعْلُومَاتٍ عَلَىٰ مَا رَزَقَهُم مِّن بَهِيمَةِ الْأَنْعَامِ
versets.phonetique: Liyashhadu manafi'a lahum wa yadhkurusmal-lahi fi ayyamim ma'lumatin 'ala ma razaqahum mim bahimatil-an'am
versets.francais: Pour être témoins des bienfaits qui leur sont accordés et pour prononcer le nom d'Allah aux jours déterminés sur les bêtes de troupeau qu'Il leur a attribuées.
versets.anglais: That they may witness benefits for themselves and mention the name of Allah on known days over what He has provided for them of [sacrificial] animals. So eat of them and feed the miserable and poor

versets.arabe: ثُمَّ لْيَقْضُوا تَفَثَهُمْ وَلْيُوفُوا نُذُورَهُمْ وَلْيَطَّوَّفُوا بِالْبَيْتِ الْعَتِيقِ
versets.phonetique: Thumma-lyadhu tafathahum wal-yufu nudhurahumm wal-yattawwafu bil-baytil-'atiq
versets.francais: Puis qu'ils mettent fin à leur état d'ihram, qu'ils accomplissent leurs vœux et tournent autour de l'Antique Maison.
versets.anglais: Then let them end their untidiness and fulfill their vows and perform Tawaf around the ancient House

versets.arabe: ذَٰلِكَ وَمَن يُعَظِّمْ حُرُمَاتِ اللَّهِ فَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَّهُ عِندَ رَبِّهِ
versets.phonetique: Dhalika wa may yu'adhdhim hurumatillahi fahuwa khayrul lahu 'inda rabbih
versets.francais: Voilà ! Quiconque respecte les choses sacrées d'Allah, c'est ce qui vaut mieux pour lui auprès de son Seigneur.
versets.anglais: That [has been commanded], and whoever honors the sacred ordinances of Allah - it is best for him in the sight of his Lord. And permitted to you are the grazing livestock, except what is recited to you. So avoid the uncleanliness of idols and avoid false statement

versets.arabe: حُنَفَاءَ لِلَّهِ غَيْرَ مُشْرِكِينَ بِهِ ۚ وَمَن يُشْرِكْ بِاللَّهِ فَكَأَنَّمَا خَرَّ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ فَتَخْطَفُهُ الطَّيْرُ أَوْ تَهْوِي بِهِ الرِّيحُ فِي مَكَانٍ سَحِيقٍ
versets.phonetique: Hunafa'a lillahi ghayra mushrikina bihi wa may yushrik billahi faka'annama kharra minas-sama'i fatakhtafuhut-tayru aw tahwi bihi-r-rihu fi makanin sahiq
versets.francais: En étant purement dévoués à Allah, sans Lui associer quoi que ce soit. Quiconque associe à Allah, c'est comme s'il tombait du ciel et que des oiseaux le déchiquetaient ou que le vent l'emportait dans un lieu lointain.
versets.anglais: Inclining [only] to Allah, not associating [anything] with Him. And he who associates with Allah - it is as though he had fallen from the sky and was snatched by the birds or the wind carried him down into a remote place

versets.arabe: ذَٰلِكَ وَمَن يُعَظِّمْ شَعَائِرَ اللَّهِ فَإِنَّهَا مِن تَقْوَى الْقُلُوبِ
versets.phonetique: Dhalika wa may yu'adhdhim sha'a'irallahi fa'innaha min taqwal-qulub
versets.francais: Voilà ! Quiconque vénère les symboles d'Allah, c'est là preuve de la piété des cœurs.
versets.anglais: That [is so]. And whoever honors the symbols of Allah - indeed, it is from the piety of hearts

versets.arabe: لَكُمْ فِيهَا مَنَافِعُ إِلَىٰ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ثُمَّ مَحِلُّهَا إِلَى الْبَيْتِ الْعَتِيقِ
versets.phonetique: Lakum fiha manafi'u ila ajalim musammaw thumma mahilluha ilal-baytil-'atiq
versets.francais: Vous en tirez des profits jusqu'à un terme fixé, puis le lieu pour les y amener est l'Antique Maison.
versets.anglais: For you the animals marked for sacrifice are benefits for a specified term; then their place of sacrifice is at the ancient House

versets.arabe: وَلِكُلِّ أُمَّةٍ جَعَلْنَا مَنسَكًا لِّيَذْكُرُوا اسْمَ اللَّهِ عَلَىٰ مَا رَزَقَهُم مِّن بَهِيمَةِ الْأَنْعَامِ
versets.phonetique: Wa likulli ummatin ja'alna mansakan liyadhkurusmallahi 'ala ma razaqahum mim bahimatil-an'am
versets.francais: Pour chaque communauté Nous avons institué un rite sacrificiel afin qu'ils prononcent le nom d'Allah sur les bêtes de troupeau qu'Il leur a attribuées.
versets.anglais: And for all religion We have appointed a rite [of sacrifice] that they may mention the name of Allah over what He has provided for them of [sacrificial] animals. For your god is one God, so to Him submit. And, [O Muhammad], give good tidings to the humble [before their Lord]

versets.arabe: الَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِرَ اللَّهُ وَجِلَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ وَالصَّابِرِينَ عَلَىٰ مَا أَصَابَهُمْ وَالْمُقِيمِي الصَّلَاةِ وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَاهُمْ يُنفِقُونَ
versets.phonetique: Alladhina idha dhukir-allahu wajilat qulubuhum was-sabirina 'ala ma asabahum wal-muqimis-salati wa mimma razaqnahum yunfiqun
versets.francais: Ceux dont les cœurs frémissent quand on mentionne Allah, qui sont patients dans les épreuves, qui accomplissent la prière et dépensent de ce que Nous leur avons attribué.
versets.anglais: Who, when Allah is mentioned, their hearts are fearful, and [to] the patient over what has afflicted them, and the establishers of prayer and those who spend from what We have provided them

versets.arabe: وَالْبُدْنَ جَعَلْنَاهَا لَكُم مِّن شَعَائِرِ اللَّهِ لَكُمْ فِيهَا خَيْرٌ ۖ فَاذْكُرُوا اسْمَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهَا صَوَافَّ
versets.phonetique: Wal-budna ja'alnaha lakum min sha'a'irillahi lakum fiha khayrun fadhkurusmallaha 'alayha sawwaf
versets.francais: Les chameaux sacrificiels, Nous en avons fait pour vous des symboles d'Allah. Il y a un bien pour vous en cela. Prononcez le nom d'Allah sur eux quand ils sont rangés.
versets.anglais: And the camels and cattle We have appointed for you as among the symbols of Allah; for you therein is good. So mention the name of Allah upon them when lined up [for sacrifice]; and when they are [lifeless] on their sides, then eat from them and feed the needy and the beggar. Thus have We subjected them to you that you may be grateful

versets.arabe: لَن يَنَالَ اللَّهَ لُحُومُهَا وَلَا دِمَاؤُهَا وَلَٰكِن يَنَالُهُ التَّقْوَىٰ مِنكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Lay yanalalaha luhumuha wa la dima'uha wa lakin yanaluhu-t-taqwa minkum
versets.francais: Ni leur viande ni leur sang n'atteindront Allah. C'est votre piété qui L'atteindra.
versets.anglais: Their meat will not reach Allah, nor will their blood, but what reaches Him is piety from you. Thus have We subjected them to you that you may glorify Allah for that [to] which He has guided you; and give good tidings to the doers of good

versets.arabe: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُدَافِعُ عَنِ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا ۗ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ خَوَّانٍ كَفُورٍ
versets.phonetique: Innallaha yudafi'u 'anil-ladhina amanu innallaha la yuhibbu kulla khawwanin kafur
versets.francais: Allah défend ceux qui ont cru. Allah n'aime pas tout traître ingrat.
versets.anglais: Indeed, Allah defends those who have believed. Indeed, Allah does not like everyone treacherous and ungrateful

versets.arabe: أُذِنَ لِلَّذِينَ يُقَاتَلُونَ بِأَنَّهُمْ ظُلِمُوا ۚ وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلَىٰ نَصْرِهِمْ لَقَدِيرٌ
versets.phonetique: Udhina lilladhina yuqataluna bi'annahum dhulimu wa innallaha 'ala nasrihim laqadir
versets.francais: Permission est donnée à ceux qui sont combattus, parce qu'ils ont été lésés - et Allah est certes Capable de les secourir.
versets.anglais: Permission [to fight] has been given to those who are being fought, because they were wronged. And indeed, Allah is competent to give them victory

versets.arabe: الَّذِينَ أُخْرِجُوا مِن دِيَارِهِم بِغَيْرِ حَقٍّ إِلَّا أَن يَقُولُوا رَبُّنَا اللَّهُ
versets.phonetique: Alladhina ukhriju min diyarihim bighayri haqqin illa ay yaqulu rabbunallah
versets.francais: Ceux qui ont été expulsés de leurs demeures sans aucun droit, simplement parce qu'ils disaient : "Notre Seigneur, c'est Allah."
versets.anglais: [They are] those who have been evicted from their homes without right - only because they say, "Our Lord is Allah." And were it not that Allah checks the people, some by means of others, there would have been demolished monasteries, churches, synagogues, and mosques in which the name of Allah is much mentioned. And Allah will surely support those who support Him. Indeed, Allah is Powerful and Exalted in Might

versets.arabe: الَّذِينَ إِن مَّكَّنَّاهُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ أَقَامُوا الصَّلَاةَ وَآتَوُا الزَّكَاةَ وَأَمَرُوا بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَنَهَوْا عَنِ الْمُنكَرِ ۗ وَلِلَّهِ عَاقِبَةُ الْأُمُورِ
versets.phonetique: Alladhina im makkannahum fil-ardi aqamus-salata wa atawuz-zakata wa amaru bil-ma'rufi wa nahaw 'anil-munkar wa lillahi 'aqibatul-umur
versets.francais: Ceux qui, si Nous les établissons sur la terre, accomplissent la prière, acquittent la zakat, ordonnent le convenable et interdisent le blâmable. C'est à Allah qu'appartient l'issue des affaires.
versets.anglais: [And they are] those who, if We give them authority in the land, establish prayer and give zakah and enjoin what is right and forbid what is wrong. And to Allah belongs the outcome of [all] matters

versets.arabe: وَإِن يُكَذِّبُوكَ فَقَدْ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَعَادٌ وَثَمُودُ
versets.phonetique: Wa iy yukadhdhibuka faqad kadhdhabat qablahum qawmu nuhiw wa 'aduw wa thamud
versets.francais: S'ils te traitent de menteur, déjà le peuple de Noé, les Aad et les Thamoud t'avaient précédé.
versets.anglais: And if they deny you, [O Muhammad] - so, before them, did the people of Noah and 'Aad and Thamud deny [their prophets]

versets.arabe: وَقَوْمُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَقَوْمُ لُوطٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa qawmu ibrahima wa qawmu lut
versets.francais: Et le peuple d'Abraham et le peuple de Lot,
versets.anglais: And the people of Abraham and the people of Lot

versets.arabe: وَأَصْحَابُ مَدْيَنَ ۖ وَكُذِّبَ مُوسَىٰ فَأَمْلَيْتُ لِلْكَافِرِينَ ثُمَّ أَخَذْتُهُمْ ۖ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ
versets.phonetique: Wa as-habu madyana wa kudhdhiba musa fa'amlay-tu lil-kafirna thumma akhadhtuhum fakayfa kana nakir
versets.francais: Et les gens de Madiane. Et Moïse fut traité de menteur. J'ai accordé un délai aux mécréants, puis Je les ai saisis. Et quelle fut Ma réprobation !
versets.anglais: And the inhabitants of Madyan. And Moses was denied, so I prolonged enjoyment for the disbelievers; then I seized them, and how [terrible] was My reproach

versets.arabe: فَكَأَيِّن مِّن قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَاهَا وَهِيَ ظَالِمَةٌ فَهِيَ خَاوِيَةٌ عَلَىٰ عُرُوشِهَا وَبِئْرٍ مُّعَطَّلَةٍ وَقَصْرٍ مَّشِيدٍ
versets.phonetique: Faka'ayyin min qaryatin ahlaknaha wa hiya dhalimatun fahiya khawiyatun 'ala 'urushiha wa bi'rim mu'attalatiw wa qasrim mashid
versets.francais: Combien de cités avons-Nous détruites alors qu'elles étaient injustes : elles gisent en ruines sur leurs toits, et combien de puits abandonnés et de palais élevés !
versets.anglais: And how many a city did We destroy while it was committing wrong - so it is [now] fallen into ruin - and [how many] an abandoned well and [how many] a lofty palace

versets.arabe: أَفَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَتَكُونَ لَهُمْ قُلُوبٌ يَعْقِلُونَ بِهَا أَوْ آذَانٌ يَسْمَعُونَ بِهَا ۖ فَإِنَّهَا لَا تَعْمَى الْأَبْصَارُ وَلَٰكِن تَعْمَى الْقُلُوبُ الَّتِي فِي الصُّدُورِ
versets.phonetique: Afalam yasiru fil-ardi fatakuna lahum qulubuy ya'qiluna biha aw adhanuy yasma'una biha fa'innaha la ta'mal-absaru wa lakin ta'mal-qulubu-llati fis-sudur
versets.francais: N'ont-ils pas parcouru la terre pour avoir des cœurs avec lesquels comprendre ou des oreilles avec lesquelles entendre ? Ce ne sont pas les yeux qui sont aveugles, mais ce sont les cœurs dans les poitrines qui sont aveugles.
versets.anglais: So have they not traveled through the earth and have hearts by which to reason and ears by which to hear? For indeed, it is not eyes that are blinded, but blinded are the hearts which are within the breasts

versets.arabe: وَيَسْتَعْجِلُونَكَ بِالْعَذَابِ وَلَن يُخْلِفَ اللَّهُ وَعْدَهُ ۚ وَإِنَّ يَوْمًا عِندَ رَبِّكَ كَأَلْفِ سَنَةٍ مِّمَّا تَعُدُّونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa yasta'jilunaka bil-'adhabi wa lay yukhlifulahu wa'dahu wa inna yawman 'inda rabbika ka'alfi sanatim mimma ta'uddun
versets.francais: Ils te demandent de hâter le châtiment. Mais Allah ne manquera pas à Sa promesse. Un jour auprès de ton Seigneur est comme mille ans de ce que vous comptez.
versets.anglais: And they urge you to hasten the punishment. But Allah will never fail in His promise. And indeed, a day with your Lord is like a thousand years of those which you count

versets.arabe: وَكَأَيِّن مِّن قَرْيَةٍ أَمْلَيْتُ لَهَا وَهِيَ ظَالِمَةٌ ثُمَّ أَخَذْتُهَا وَإِلَيَّ الْمَصِيرُ
versets.phonetique: Wa ka'ayyin min qaryatin amlay-tu laha wa hiya dhalimatun thumma akhadhtuhaa wa ilayyal-masir
versets.francais: Combien de cités injustes ai-Je laissées en sursis avant de les saisir ! Et c'est vers Moi que se fera le retour.
versets.anglais: And for how many a city did I prolong enjoyment while it was committing wrong. Then I seized it, and to Me is the [final] destination

versets.arabe: قُلْ يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِنَّمَا أَنَا لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
versets.phonetique: Qul ya ayyuhan-nasu innama ana lakum nadhirum mubin
versets.francais: Dis : "Ô hommes, je ne suis pour vous qu'un avertisseur explicite."
versets.anglais: Say, "O people, I am only to you a clear warner

versets.arabe: فَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَرِزْقٌ كَرِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Falladhina amanu wa amilussalihati lahum maghfiratuw wa rizqun karim
versets.francais: Ceux qui croient et font de bonnes œuvres auront pardon et généreuse attribution.
versets.anglais: And those who have believed and done righteous deeds - for them is forgiveness and noble provision

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ سَعَوْا فِي آيَاتِنَا مُعَاجِزِينَ أُولَٰئِكَ أَصْحَابُ الْجَحِيمِ
versets.phonetique: Walladhina sa'aw fi ayatina mu'ajizina ula'ika as-habul-jahim
versets.francais: Ceux qui s'efforcent de réduire à néant Nos versets, ceux-là sont les gens de l'Enfer.
versets.anglais: But the ones who strove against Our verses, [seeking] to cause failure - those are the companions of Hellfire

versets.arabe: وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رَّسُولٍ وَلَا نَبِيٍّ إِلَّا إِذَا تَمَنَّىٰ أَلْقَى الشَّيْطَانُ فِي أُمْنِيَّتِهِ فَيَنسَخُ اللَّهُ مَا يُلْقِي الشَّيْطَانُ ثُمَّ يُحْكِمُ اللَّهُ آيَاتِهِ
versets.phonetique: Wa ma arsalna min qablika mir-rasuliw wa la nabiyyin illa idha tamanna alqash-shaytanu fi umniyyatihi fayansakhu-llahu ma yulqish-shaytanu thumma yuhkimullahu ayatih
versets.francais: Nous n'avons envoyé avant toi ni messager ni prophète sans que le Diable ne vînt jeter quelque chose dans sa récitation. Mais Allah efface ce que le Diable insinue, puis Allah raffermit Ses versets.
versets.anglais: And We did not send before you any messenger or prophet except that when he spoke [or recited], Satan threw into it [some misunderstanding]. But Allah abolishes that which Satan throws in; then Allah makes precise His verses. And Allah is Knowing and Wise

versets.arabe: لِيَجْعَلَ مَا يُلْقِي الشَّيْطَانُ فِتْنَةً لِّلَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ وَالْقَاسِيَةِ قُلُوبُهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Liyaj'ala ma yulqish-shaytanu fitnatal lilladhina fi qulubihim maraduw wal-qasiyati qulubuhum
versets.francais: Afin de faire de ce que le Diable insinue une tentation pour ceux dont les cœurs sont malades et pour ceux dont les cœurs sont endurcis.
versets.anglais: [That is] so He may make what Satan throws in a trial for those within whose hearts is disease and those hard of heart. And indeed, the wrongdoers are in extreme dissension

versets.arabe: وَلِيَعْلَمَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْعِلْمَ أَنَّهُ الْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكَ فَيُؤْمِنُوا بِهِ فَتُخْبِتَ لَهُ قُلُوبُهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Wa liya'lamalladhina utul-'ilma annahu-l-haqqu mir-rabbika fayu'minu bihi fatukbita lahu qulubuhum
versets.francais: Et afin que ceux à qui le savoir a été donné sachent que c'est la vérité venant de ton Seigneur, y croient et que leurs cœurs s'y soumettent humblement.
versets.anglais: And so those who were given knowledge may know that it is the truth from your Lord and [therefore] believe in it, and their hearts humbly submit to it. And indeed is Allah the Guide of those who have believed to a straight path

versets.arabe: وَلَا يَزَالُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا فِي مِرْيَةٍ مِّنْهُ حَتَّىٰ تَأْتِيَهُمُ السَّاعَةُ بَغْتَةً أَوْ يَأْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَقِيمٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa la yazalulladhina kafaru fi miryatim minhu hatta ta'tiyahumus-sa'atu baghtatan aw ya'tiyahum 'adhabu yawmin 'aqim
versets.francais: Ceux qui ont mécru ne cesseront pas d'être dans le doute jusqu'à ce que l'Heure les surprenne à l'improviste ou que leur vienne le châtiment d'un Jour stérile.
versets.anglais: But those who disbelieve will not cease to be in doubt of it until the Hour comes upon them unexpectedly or there comes to them the punishment of a barren Day

versets.arabe: الْمُلْكُ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلَّهِ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ فَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ فِي جَنَّاتِ النَّعِيمِ
versets.phonetique: Al-mulku yawma'idhil lillahi yahkumu baynahum falladhina amanu wa amilussalihati fi jannatun-na'im
versets.francais: En ce jour, la royauté appartiendra à Allah. Il jugera entre eux. Ceux qui auront cru et fait de bonnes œuvres seront dans les jardins du bonheur.
versets.anglais: [All] sovereignty that Day is for Allah; He will judge between them. So they who believed and did righteous deeds will be in the Gardens of Pleasure

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَكَذَّبُوا بِآيَاتِنَا فَأُولَٰئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مُّهِينٌ
versets.phonetique: Walladhina kafaru wa kadhdhabu bi'ayatina fa'ula'ika lahum 'adhabum muhin
versets.francais: Et ceux qui ont mécru et traité Nos versets de mensonges auront un châtiment avilissant.
versets.anglais: And they who disbelieved and denied Our signs - for those there will be a humiliating punishment

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ هَاجَرُوا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ثُمَّ قُتِلُوا أَوْ مَاتُوا لَيَرْزُقَنَّهُمُ اللَّهُ رِزْقًا حَسَنًا
versets.phonetique: Walladhina hajaru fi sabilillahi thumma qutilu aw matu layarzuqannahumullahu rizqan hasana
versets.francais: Ceux qui ont émigré dans le chemin d'Allah puis ont été tués ou sont morts, Allah leur accordera certes une belle attribution.
versets.anglais: And those who emigrated for the cause of Allah and then were killed or died - Allah will surely provide for them a good provision. And indeed, it is Allah who is the best of providers

versets.arabe: لَيُدْخِلَنَّهُم مُّدْخَلًا يَرْضَوْنَهُ ۗ وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَعَلِيمٌ حَلِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Layadkhilannnahum mudkhalan yardawnah wa innallaha la'alimun halim
versets.francais: Il les fera entrer dans une entrée qu'ils agréeront. Allah est certes Omniscient et Indulgent.
versets.anglais: He will surely cause them to enter an entrance with which they will be pleased, and indeed, Allah is Knowing and Forbearing

versets.arabe: ذَٰلِكَ وَمَنْ عَاقَبَ بِمِثْلِ مَا عُوقِبَ بِهِ ثُمَّ بُغِيَ عَلَيْهِ لَيَنصُرَنَّهُ اللَّهُ
versets.phonetique: Dhalika wa man 'aqaba bimithli ma 'uqiba bihi thumma bughiya 'alayhi layansurannahullah
versets.francais: Voilà ! Quiconque répond à une agression de façon semblable à ce qu'il a subi, puis est de nouveau attaqué, Allah le secourra certes.
versets.anglais: That [is so]. And whoever responds [to injustice] with the equivalent of that with which he was harmed and then is tyrannized - Allah will surely aid him. Indeed, Allah is Pardoning and Forgiving

versets.arabe: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ اللَّهَ يُولِجُ اللَّيْلَ فِي النَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ النَّهَارَ فِي اللَّيْلِ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ بَصِيرٌ
versets.phonetique: Dhalika bi'annallaha yuliju-l-layla fin-nahari wa yuliju-n-nahara fil-layl wa annallaha sami'un basir
versets.francais: Cela parce qu'Allah fait pénétrer la nuit dans le jour et fait pénétrer le jour dans la nuit et qu'Allah est Audient et Voyant.
versets.anglais: That is because Allah causes the night to enter the day and causes the day to enter the night and because Allah is Hearing and Seeing

versets.arabe: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْحَقُّ وَأَنَّ مَا يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِ هُوَ الْبَاطِلُ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْكَبِيرُ
versets.phonetique: Dhalika bi'annallaha huwal-haqqu wa anna ma yad'una min dunihi huwal-batilu wa annallaha huwal-'aliyyul-kabir
versets.francais: Cela parce qu'Allah est la Vérité et que ce qu'ils invoquent en dehors de Lui est le Faux, et qu'Allah est le Très-Haut, le Très-Grand.
versets.anglais: That is because Allah is the Truth, and that which they call upon other than Him is falsehood, and because Allah is the Most High, the Grand

versets.arabe: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ أَنزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَتُصْبِحُ الْأَرْضُ مُخْضَرَّةً ۗ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَطِيفٌ خَبِيرٌ
versets.phonetique: Alam tara annallaha anzala minas-sama'i ma'an fatusbihul-ardu mukhddarrah innallaha latifun khabir
versets.francais: N'as-tu pas vu qu'Allah a fait descendre de l'eau du ciel et que la terre devient verdoyante ? Allah est certes Bienveillant et Bien-Informé.
versets.anglais: Do you not see that Allah has sent down rain from the sky and the earth becomes green? Indeed, Allah is Subtle and Acquainted

versets.arabe: لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۗ وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَهُوَ الْغَنِيُّ الْحَمِيدُ
versets.phonetique: Lahu ma fis-samawati wa ma fil-ard wa innallaha lahuwal-ghaniyyul-hamid
versets.francais: À Lui appartient ce qui est dans les cieux et ce qui est sur la terre. Allah est vraiment le Riche, le Très-Loué.
versets.anglais: To Him belongs what is in the heavens and what is on the earth. And indeed, Allah is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy

versets.arabe: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ سَخَّرَ لَكُم مَّا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَالْفُلْكَ تَجْرِي فِي الْبَحْرِ بِأَمْرِهِ
versets.phonetique: Alam tara annallaha sakhkhara lakum ma fil-ardi wal-fulka tajri fil-bahri bi'amrihi
versets.francais: N'as-tu pas vu qu'Allah vous a assujetti ce qui est sur la terre et les nefs qui voguent sur la mer par Son commandement ?
versets.anglais: Do you not see that Allah has subjected to you whatever is on the earth and the ships which run through the sea by His command? And He restrains the sky from falling upon the earth, unless by His permission. Indeed Allah, to the people, is Kind and Merciful

versets.arabe: وَهُوَ الَّذِي أَحْيَاكُمْ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمْ ثُمَّ يُحْيِيكُمْ ۗ إِنَّ الْإِنسَانَ لَكَفُورٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa huwal-ladhee ahyakum thumma yumitukum thumma yuhyikum innal-insana lakafur
versets.francais: C'est Lui qui vous a donné la vie, puis Il vous fera mourir, puis Il vous refera vivre. L'homme est vraiment très ingrat.
versets.anglais: And He is the one who gave you life; then He causes you to die and then will [again] give you life. Indeed, mankind is ungrateful

versets.arabe: لِّكُلِّ أُمَّةٍ جَعَلْنَا مَنسَكًا هُمْ نَاسِكُوهُ ۖ فَلَا يُنَازِعُنَّكَ فِي الْأَمْرِ ۚ وَادْعُ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ۖ إِنَّكَ لَعَلَىٰ هُدًى مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
versets.phonetique: Likulli ummatin ja'alna mansakan hum nasikuh fala yunazi'unnaka fil-amri wad'u ila rabbika innaka la'ala hudam mustaqim
versets.francais: À chaque communauté Nous avons assigné un rite qu'elle pratique. Qu'ils ne te disputent donc pas la question. Et invite à ton Seigneur. Tu es certes sur un droit chemin.
versets.anglais: For every religion We have appointed rites which they perform. So, [O Muhammad], let the disbelievers not contend with you over the matter but invite them to your Lord. Indeed, you are upon straight guidance

versets.arabe: وَإِن جَادَلُوكَ فَقُلِ اللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa in jadiluka faqulillahu a'lamu bima ta'malun
versets.francais: S'ils te disputent, dis : "Allah connaît mieux ce que vous faites."
versets.anglais: And if they dispute with you, then say, "Allah is most knowing of what you do

versets.arabe: اللَّهُ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَكُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فِيمَا كُنتُمْ فِيهِ تَخْتَلِفُونَ
versets.phonetique: Allahu yahkumu baynakum yawmal-qiyamati fima kuntum fihi takhtakilifun
versets.francais: Allah jugera entre vous au Jour de la Résurrection sur ce en quoi vous divergiez.
versets.anglais: Allah will judge between you on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which you used to differ

versets.arabe: أَلَمْ تَعْلَمْ أَنَّ اللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۗ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ فِي كِتَابٍ ۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى اللَّهِ يَسِيرٌ
versets.phonetique: Alam ta'lam annallaha ya'lamu ma fis-sama'i wal-ard inna dhalika fi kitab inna dhalika 'alallahi yasir
versets.francais: Ne sais-tu pas qu'Allah connaît ce qui est dans le ciel et sur la terre ? Tout cela est dans un Livre. Cela est facile pour Allah.
versets.anglais: Do you not know that Allah knows what is in the heaven and earth? Indeed, that is in a Record. Indeed that, for Allah, is easy

versets.arabe: وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ مَا لَمْ يُنَزِّلْ بِهِ سُلْطَانًا وَمَا لَيْسَ لَهُم بِهِ عِلْمٌ ۗ وَمَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ مِن نَّصِيرٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa ya'buduna min dunillahi ma lam yunazzil bihi sultanaw wa ma laysa lahum bihi 'ilm wa ma lidh-dhalimina min nasir
versets.francais: Ils adorent en dehors d'Allah ce sur quoi Il n'a fait descendre aucune preuve et ce dont ils n'ont aucune science. Les injustes n'auront aucun secours.
versets.anglais: And they worship besides Allah that for which He has not sent down authority and that of which they have no knowledge. And there will not be for the wrongdoers any helper

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ آيَاتُنَا بَيِّنَاتٍ تَعْرِفُ فِي وُجُوهِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا الْمُنكَرَ ۖ يَكَادُونَ يَسْطُونَ بِالَّذِينَ يَتْلُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ آيَاتِنَا
versets.phonetique: Wa idha tutla 'alayhim ayatuna bayyinatin ta'rifu fi wujuhil-ladhina kafarulI munkar yakaduna yastuna bil-ladhina yatluna 'alayhim ayatina
versets.francais: Quand Nos versets clairs leur sont récités, tu reconnais sur les visages des mécréants le refus. Ils sont sur le point de se jeter sur ceux qui leur récitent Nos versets.
versets.anglais: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, you recognize in the faces of those who disbelieve disapproval. They are almost on the verge of assaulting those who recite to them Our verses. Say, "Then shall I inform you of [what is] worse than that? [It is] the Fire which Allah has promised those who disbelieve, and wretched is the destination

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ ضُرِبَ مَثَلٌ فَاسْتَمِعُوا لَهُ ۚ إِنَّ الَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ لَن يَخْلُقُوا ذُبَابًا وَلَوِ اجْتَمَعُوا لَهُ
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuhan-nasu duriba mathalun fastami'u lahu innal-ladhina tad'una min dunillahi lay yakhluqu dhubabaw wa lawij-tama'u lah
versets.francais: Ô hommes, un exemple est cité, écoutez-le. Ceux que vous invoquez en dehors d'Allah ne sauraient créer une mouche, même s'ils se coalisaient pour cela.
versets.anglais: O people, an example is presented, so listen to it. Indeed, those you invoke besides Allah will never create [as much as] a fly, even if they gathered together for that purpose. And if the fly should steal away from them a [tiny] thing, they could not recover it from him. Weak are the pursuer and pursued

versets.arabe: مَا قَدَرُوا اللَّهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهِ ۗ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَقَوِيٌّ عَزِيزٌ
versets.phonetique: Ma qadarullaha haqqa qadrih innallaha laqawiyyun 'aziz
versets.francais: Ils n'ont pas estimé Allah à Sa juste valeur. Allah est certes Fort et Puissant.
versets.anglais: They have not appraised Allah with true appraisal. Indeed, Allah is Powerful and Exalted in Might

versets.arabe: اللَّهُ يَصْطَفِي مِنَ الْمَلَائِكَةِ رُسُلًا وَمِنَ النَّاسِ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ بَصِيرٌ
versets.phonetique: Allahu yastafi minal-mala'ikati rusulaw wa minan-nas innallaha sami'un basir
versets.francais: Allah choisit des messagers parmi les anges et parmi les hommes. Allah est Audient et Voyant.
versets.anglais: Allah chooses from the angels messengers and from the people. Indeed, Allah is Hearing and Seeing

versets.arabe: يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۗ وَإِلَى اللَّهِ تُرْجَعُ الْأُمُورُ
versets.phonetique: Ya'lamu ma bayna aydihim wa ma khalfahum wa ilallahi turja'ul-umur
versets.francais: Il connaît ce qui est devant eux et ce qui est derrière eux. C'est vers Allah que les affaires retournent.
versets.anglais: He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them. And to Allah will be returned [all] matters

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا ارْكَعُوا وَاسْجُدُوا وَاعْبُدُوا رَبَّكُمْ وَافْعَلُوا الْخَيْرَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuhal-ladhina amanu irka'u wasjudu wa'budu rabbakum waf'alul-khayra la'allakum tuflihun
versets.francais: Ô les croyants ! Inclinez-vous, prosternez-vous, adorez votre Seigneur et faites le bien. Peut-être réussirez-vous.
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, bow and prostrate and worship your Lord and do good - that you may succeed

versets.arabe: وَجَاهِدُوا فِي اللَّهِ حَقَّ جِهَادِهِ ۚ هُوَ اجْتَبَاكُمْ وَمَا جَعَلَ عَلَيْكُمْ فِي الدِّينِ مِنْ حَرَجٍ ۚ مِّلَّةَ أَبِيكُمْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ
versets.phonetique: Wa jahidu fillahi haqqa jihadihi huwa-jtabakum wa ma ja'ala 'alaykum fid-dini min haraji millata abikum ibrahim
versets.francais: Et combattez pour Allah comme il se doit. C'est Lui qui vous a élus. Il n'a pas établi de contrainte pour vous dans la religion : la religion de votre père Ibrahim.
versets.anglais: And strive for Allah with the striving due to Him. He has chosen you and has not placed upon you in the religion any difficulty. [It is] the religion of your father, Abraham. Allah named you "Muslims" before [in former scriptures] and in this [revelation] that the Messenger may be a witness over you and you may be witnesses over the people. So establish prayer and give zakah and hold fast to Allah. He is your protector; and excellent is the protector, and excellent is the helper

versets.arabe: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qad aflaḥa l-mu'minūn
versets.francais: Certes, les croyants ont réussi,
versets.anglais: Certainly will the believers have succeeded

versets.arabe: الَّذِينَ هُمْ فِي صَلَاتِهِمْ خَاشِعُونَ
versets.phonetique: Alladhīna hum fī ṣalātihim khāshi'ūn
versets.francais: ceux qui sont humbles dans leur prière,
versets.anglais: They who are during their prayer humbly submissive

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ عَنِ اللَّغْوِ مُعْرِضُونَ
versets.phonetique: Walladhīna hum 'ani l-laghwi mu'riḍūn
versets.francais: qui s'écartent du vain langage,
versets.anglais: And they who turn away from ill speech

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ لِلزَّكَاةِ فَاعِلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Walladhīna hum liz-zakāti fā'ilūn
versets.francais: qui s'acquittent de la Zakat,
versets.anglais: And they who are observant of zakah

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ لِفُرُوجِهِمْ حَافِظُونَ
versets.phonetique: Walladhīna hum lifurūjihim ḥāfiẓūn
versets.francais: qui préservent leur chasteté,
versets.anglais: And they who guard their private parts

versets.arabe: إِلَّا عَلَىٰ أَزْوَاجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ
versets.phonetique: Illā 'alā azwājihim aw mā malakat aymānuhum fa'innahum ghayru malūmīn
versets.francais: sauf envers leurs épouses ou ce que leurs mains droites possèdent — en cela ils ne sont pas blâmables —
versets.anglais: Except from their wives or those their right hands possess, for indeed, they will not be blamed

versets.arabe: فَمَنِ ابْتَغَىٰ وَرَاءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُولَٰئِكَ هُمُ الْعَادُونَ
versets.phonetique: Famani btaghā warā'a dhālika fa'ulā'ika humu l-'ādūn
versets.francais: mais ceux qui cherchent au-delà, ce sont eux les transgresseurs —
versets.anglais: But whoever seeks beyond that, then those are the transgressors

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ لِأَمَانَاتِهِمْ وَعَهْدِهِمْ رَاعُونَ
versets.phonetique: Walladhīna hum li'amānātihim wa'ahdihim rā'ūn
versets.francais: qui veillent sur leurs dépôts et leurs engagements,
versets.anglais: And they who are to their trusts and their promises attentive

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَوَاتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ
versets.phonetique: Walladhīna hum 'alā ṣalawātihim yuḥāfiẓūn
versets.francais: qui observent régulièrement leurs prières.
versets.anglais: And they who carefully maintain their prayers

versets.arabe: أُولَٰئِكَ هُمُ الْوَارِثُونَ
versets.phonetique: Ulā'ika humu l-wārithūn
versets.francais: Ce sont eux les héritiers,
versets.anglais: Those are the inheritors

versets.arabe: الَّذِينَ يَرِثُونَ الْفِرْدَوْسَ هُمْ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ
versets.phonetique: Alladhīna yarithūna l-firdawsa hum fīhā khālidūn
versets.francais: qui hériteront le Paradis, où ils demeureront éternellement.
versets.anglais: Who will inherit al-Firdaus. They will abide therein eternally

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْإِنسَانَ مِن سُلَالَةٍ مِّن طِينٍ
versets.phonetique: Walaqad khalaqnā l-insāna min sulālatin min ṭīn
versets.francais: Nous avons certes créé l'homme d'un extrait d'argile,
versets.anglais: And certainly did We create man from an extract of clay

versets.arabe: ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَاهُ نُطْفَةً فِي قَرَارٍ مَّكِينٍ
versets.phonetique: Thumma ja'alnāhu nuṭfatan fī qarārin makīn
versets.francais: puis Nous en avons fait une goutte de sperme dans un endroit sûr,
versets.anglais: Then We placed him as a sperm-drop in a firm lodging

versets.arabe: ثُمَّ خَلَقْنَا النُّطْفَةَ عَلَقَةً فَخَلَقْنَا الْعَلَقَةَ مُضْغَةً فَخَلَقْنَا الْمُضْغَةَ عِظَامًا فَكَسَوْنَا الْعِظَامَ لَحْمًا ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَاهُ خَلْقًا آخَرَ ۚ فَتَبَارَكَ اللَّهُ أَحْسَنُ الْخَالِقِينَ
versets.phonetique: Thumma khalaqnā n-nuṭfata 'alaqatan fakhalaqnā l-'alaqata muḍghatan fakhalaqnā l-muḍghata 'iẓāman fakasawnā l-'iẓāma laḥman thumma ansha'nāhu khalqan ākhar, fatābāraka llāhu aḥsanu l-khāliqīn
versets.francais: puis Nous avons transformé la goutte en adhérence, et l'adhérence en embryon, et l'embryon en os, et Nous avons revêtu les os de chair. Ensuite Nous en avons fait une toute autre création. Béni soit Allah, le meilleur des créateurs!
versets.anglais: Then We made the sperm-drop into a clinging clot, and We made the clot into a lump [of flesh], and We made [from] the lump, bones, and We covered the bones with flesh; then We developed him into another creation. So blessed is Allah, the best of creators

versets.arabe: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ لَمَيِّتُونَ
versets.phonetique: Thumma innakum ba'da dhālika lamayyitūn
versets.francais: Ensuite vous mourrez certes après cela,
versets.anglais: Then indeed, after that you are to die

versets.arabe: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ تُبْعَثُونَ
versets.phonetique: Thumma innakum yawma l-qiyāmati tub'athūn
versets.francais: puis vous serez ressuscités au Jour de la Résurrection.
versets.anglais: Then indeed you, on the Day of Resurrection, will be resurrected

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا فَوْقَكُمْ سَبْعَ طَرَائِقَ وَمَا كُنَّا عَنِ الْخَلْقِ غَافِلِينَ
versets.phonetique: Walaqad khalaqnā fawqakum sab'a ṭarā'iqa wamā kunnā 'ani l-khalqi ghāfilīn
versets.francais: Et certes, Nous avons créé au-dessus de vous sept voies; et Nous ne sommes pas inattentifs à la création.
versets.anglais: And We have created above you seven layered heavens, and never have We been of [Our] creation unaware

versets.arabe: وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً بِقَدَرٍ فَأَسْكَنَّاهُ فِي الْأَرْضِ ۖ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰ ذَهَابٍ بِهِ لَقَادِرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa'anzalnā mina s-samā'i mā'an biqadarin fa'askannāhu fī l-arḍi wa'innā 'alā dhahābin bihi laqādirūn
versets.francais: Et Nous faisons descendre du ciel de l'eau selon une mesure. Et Nous la faisons séjourner dans la terre. Et Nous sommes certes capables de la faire disparaître.
versets.anglais: And We have sent down rain from the sky in a measured amount and settled it in the earth. And indeed, We are Able to take it away

versets.arabe: فَأَنشَأْنَا لَكُم بِهِ جَنَّاتٍ مِّن نَّخِيلٍ وَأَعْنَابٍ لَّكُمْ فِيهَا فَوَاكِهُ كَثِيرَةٌ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Fa'ansha'nā lakum bihi jannātin min nakhīlin wa'a'nābin lakum fīhā fawākihu kathīratun waminhā ta'kulūn
versets.francais: Puis Nous avons créé pour vous, grâce à elle, des jardins de palmiers et de vignes, où il y a pour vous beaucoup de fruits, et dont vous mangez,
versets.anglais: And We brought forth for you thereby gardens of palm trees and grapevines in which for you are abundant fruits and from which you eat

versets.arabe: وَشَجَرَةً تَخْرُجُ مِن طُورِ سَيْنَاءَ تَنبُتُ بِالدُّهْنِ وَصِبْغٍ لِّلْآكِلِينَ
versets.phonetique: Washajratan takhruju min ṭūri saynā'a tanbutu bid-duhni waṣibghin lil-ākilīn
versets.francais: et un arbre qui pousse sur le mont Sinaï, qui donne de l'huile et de l'assaisonnement à ceux qui mangent.
versets.anglais: And [We brought forth] a tree issuing from Mount Sinai which produces oil and food for those who eat

versets.arabe: وَإِنَّ لَكُمْ فِي الْأَنْعَامِ لَعِبْرَةً ۖ نُّسْقِيكُم مِّمَّا فِي بُطُونِهَا وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَنَافِعُ كَثِيرَةٌ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa'inna lakum fī l-an'āmi la'ibratun nusqīkum mimmā fī buṭūnihā walakum fīhā manāfi'u kathīratun waminhā ta'kulūn
versets.francais: Il y a aussi une leçon pour vous dans les bestiaux. Nous vous abreuvons de ce qui est dans leurs ventres, et vous en tirez de nombreux avantages, et vous les mangez;
versets.anglais: And indeed, for you in livestock is a lesson. We give you drink from that which is in their bellies, and for you in them are numerous benefits, and from them you eat

versets.arabe: وَعَلَيْهَا وَعَلَى الْفُلْكِ تُحْمَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa'alayhā wa'alā l-fulki tuḥmalūn
versets.francais: et sur eux et sur les bateaux vous êtes transportés.
versets.anglais: And upon them and on ships you are carried

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِ فَقَالَ يَا قَوْمِ اعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَٰهٍ غَيْرُهُ ۖ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
versets.phonetique: Walaqad arsalnā nūḥan ilā qawmihi faqāla yā qawmi 'budū llāha mā lakum min ilāhin ghayruhu afalā tattaqūn
versets.francais: Et Nous avons certes envoyé Noé à son peuple. Il dit: «Ô mon peuple, adorez Allah; vous n'avez pas d'autre divinité que Lui. Ne craignez-vous pas?»
versets.anglais: And We had certainly sent Noah to his people, and he said, "O my people, worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him; then will you not fear Him

versets.arabe: فَقَالَ الْمَلَأُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِن قَوْمِهِ مَا هَٰذَا إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ يُرِيدُ أَن يَتَفَضَّلَ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ وَلَوْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ لَأَنزَلَ مَلَائِكَةً مَّا سَمِعْنَا بِهَٰذَا فِي آبَائِنَا الْأَوَّلِينَ
versets.phonetique: Faqāla l-mala'u lladhīna kafarū min qawmihi mā hādhā illā basharun mithlukum yurīdu an yataFaḍḍala 'alaykum walaw shā'a llāhu la'anzala malā'ikatan mā sami'nā bidhā fī ābā'inā l-awwalīn
versets.francais: Les notables de son peuple qui ne croyaient pas dirent: «Ce n'est qu'un homme comme vous qui veut se montrer supérieur à vous. Si Allah avait voulu, Il aurait fait descendre des anges. Nous n'avons pas entendu pareille chose chez nos ancêtres.»
versets.anglais: But the eminent among those who disbelieved from his people said, "This is not but a man like yourselves who wishes to take precedence over you; and if Allah had willed [to send a messenger], He would have sent down angels. We have not heard of this among our forefathers

versets.arabe: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا رَجُلٌ بِهِ جِنَّةٌ فَتَرَبَّصُوا بِهِ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
versets.phonetique: In huwa illā rajulun bihi jinnatun fatarabbaṣū bihi ḥattā ḥīn
versets.francais: Ce n'est qu'un homme atteint de folie, attendez donc avec lui jusqu'à un certain temps.
versets.anglais: He is not but a man possessed with madness, so wait concerning him for a time

versets.arabe: قَالَ رَبِّ انصُرْنِي بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ
versets.phonetique: Qāla rabbi nṣurnī bimā kadhdhabūn
versets.francais: Il dit: «Seigneur, secours-moi, parce qu'ils m'accusent de mensonge.»
versets.anglais: [Noah] said, "My Lord, support me because they have denied me

versets.arabe: فَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْهِ أَنِ اصْنَعِ الْفُلْكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا وَوَحْيِنَا فَإِذَا جَاءَ أَمْرُنَا وَفَارَ التَّنُّورُ فَاسْلُكْ فِيهَا مِن كُلٍّ زَوْجَيْنِ اثْنَيْنِ وَأَهْلَكَ إِلَّا مَن سَبَقَ عَلَيْهِ الْقَوْلُ مِنْهُمْ ۖ وَلَا تُخَاطِبْنِي فِي الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا ۖ إِنَّهُم مُّغْرَقُونَ
versets.phonetique: Fa'awḥaynā ilayhi ani ṣna'i l-fulka bi'a'yuninā wawaḥyinā fa'idhā jā'a amrunā wafāra t-tannūru fasluk fīhā min kullin zawjayni thnayny wa'ahlaka illā man sabaqa 'alayhi l-qawlu minhum walā tukhāṭibnī fī lladhīna ẓalamū innahum mughraqūn
versets.francais: Alors Nous lui révélâmes: «Construis l'arche sous Nos yeux et selon Notre révélation. Puis quand Notre ordre viendra et que le four se mettra à bouillonner, introduis dans l'arche un couple de chaque espèce, ainsi que ta famille — sauf ceux dont la sentence a déjà été prononcée. Et ne M'implore pas en faveur des injustes: ils vont être noyés.»
versets.anglais: So We inspired to him, "Construct the ship under Our observation, and Our inspiration, and when Our command comes and the oven overflows, put into the ship from each [creature] two mates and your family, except those for whom the decree [of destruction] has proceeded. And do not address Me concerning those who have wronged; indeed, they are to be drowned

versets.arabe: فَإِذَا اسْتَوَيْتَ أَنتَ وَمَن مَّعَكَ عَلَى الْفُلْكِ فَقُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي نَجَّانَا مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Fa'idhā stawyta anta waman ma'aka 'alā l-fulki faquli l-ḥamdu lillāhi lladhī najjānā mina l-qawmi ẓ-ẓālimīn
versets.francais: Quand tu seras installé, toi et ceux qui sont avec toi dans l'arche, dis: «Louange à Allah qui nous a sauvés des gens injustes.»
versets.anglais: And when you have boarded the ship, you and those with you, then say, 'Praise to Allah who has saved us from the wrongdoing people

versets.arabe: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَنزِلْنِي مُنزَلًا مُّبَارَكًا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الْمُنزِلِينَ
versets.phonetique: Waqul rabbi anzilnī munzalan mubārakan wa'anta khayru l-munzilīn
versets.francais: Et dis: «Seigneur, fais-moi débarquer dans un endroit béni, car Tu es le meilleur pour faire débarquer.»
versets.anglais: And say, 'My Lord, let me land at a blessed landing place, and You are the best to accommodate [us]

versets.arabe: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَاتٍ وَإِن كُنَّا لَمُبْتَلِينَ
versets.phonetique: Inna fī dhālika la'āyātin wa'in kunnā lamubtalīn
versets.francais: Il y a là certes des signes. Et Nous mettons vraiment à l'épreuve.
versets.anglais: Indeed in that are signs, and indeed, We are ever testing [Our servants]

versets.arabe: ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَا مِن بَعْدِهِمْ قَرْنًا آخَرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Thumma ansha'nā min ba'dihim qarnan ākharīn
versets.francais: Ensuite Nous avons fait naître, après eux, d'autres générations.
versets.anglais: Then We produced after them a generation of others

versets.arabe: فَأَرْسَلْنَا فِيهِمْ رَسُولًا مِّنْهُمْ أَنِ اعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَٰهٍ غَيْرُهُ ۖ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
versets.phonetique: Fa'arsalnā fīhim rasūlan minhum ani 'budū llāha mā lakum min ilāhin ghayruhu afalā tattaqūn
versets.francais: Et Nous leur avons envoyé un messager de chez eux: «Adorez Allah; vous n'avez pas d'autre divinité que Lui. Ne craignez-vous pas?»
versets.anglais: And We sent among them a messenger from themselves, [saying], "Worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him; then will you not fear Him

versets.arabe: وَقَالَ الْمَلَأُ مِن قَوْمِهِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَكَذَّبُوا بِلِقَاءِ الْآخِرَةِ وَأَتْرَفْنَاهُمْ فِي الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا مَا هَٰذَا إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ يَأْكُلُ مِمَّا تَأْكُلُونَ مِنْهُ وَيَشْرَبُ مِمَّا تَشْرَبُونَ
versets.phonetique: Waqāla l-mala'u min qawmihi lladhīna kafarū wakadhdhabū biliqā'i l-ākhirati wa'atrafnāhum fī l-ḥayāti d-dunyā mā hādhā illā basharun mithlukum ya'kulu mimmā ta'kulūna minhu wayashrabu mimmā tashrabūn
versets.francais: Et les notables de son peuple, qui ne croyaient pas et traitaient de mensonge la rencontre avec l'au-delà, et auxquels Nous avions accordé le bien-être dans la vie d'ici-bas, dirent: «Ce n'est qu'un homme comme vous, qui mange de ce que vous mangez et boit de ce que vous buvez.»
versets.anglais: And the eminent among his people who disbelieved and denied the meeting of the Hereafter while We had given them luxury in the worldly life said, "This is not but a man like yourselves. He eats of that from which you eat and drinks of what you drink

versets.arabe: وَلَئِنْ أَطَعْتُم بَشَرًا مِّثْلَكُمْ إِنَّكُمْ إِذًا لَّخَاسِرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wala'in aṭa'tum basharan mithlakum innakum idhan lakhāsirūn
versets.francais: Si vous obéissez à un homme comme vous, vous serez certes des perdants.
versets.anglais: And if you should obey a man like yourselves, indeed, you would then be losers

versets.arabe: أَيَعِدُكُمْ أَنَّكُمْ إِذَا مِتُّمْ وَكُنتُمْ تُرَابًا وَعِظَامًا أَنَّكُم مُّخْرَجُونَ
versets.phonetique: Aya'idukum annakum idhā mittum wakuntum turāban wa'iẓāman annakum mukhrajūn
versets.francais: Vous promet-il que lorsque vous serez morts et serez devenus poussière et ossements, vous sortirez [de vos tombes]?
versets.anglais: Does he promise you that when you have died and become dust and bones that you will be brought forth [once more]

versets.arabe: هَيْهَاتَ هَيْهَاتَ لِمَا تُوعَدُونَ
versets.phonetique: Hayhāta hayhāta limā tū'adūn
versets.francais: Loin, très loin, est ce qu'on vous promet!
versets.anglais: How far, how far, is that which you are promised

versets.arabe: إِنْ هِيَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا الدُّنْيَا نَمُوتُ وَنَحْيَا وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَبْعُوثِينَ
versets.phonetique: In hiya illā ḥayātunā d-dunyā namūtu wanaḥyā wamā naḥnu bimab'ūthīn
versets.francais: Il n'y a que notre vie d'ici-bas: nous mourons et nous vivons, et nous ne serons pas ressuscités.
versets.anglais: Life is not but our worldly life - we die and live, but we will not be resurrected

versets.arabe: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا رَجُلٌ افْتَرَىٰ عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا وَمَا نَحْنُ لَهُ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: In huwa illā rajulun iftarā 'alā llāhi kadhiban wamā naḥnu lahū bimu'minīn
versets.francais: Ce n'est qu'un homme qui forge des mensonges sur Allah, et nous ne croyons pas en lui.
versets.anglais: He is not but a man who has invented a lie about Allah, and we will not believe him

versets.arabe: قَالَ رَبِّ انصُرْنِي بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ
versets.phonetique: Qāla rabbi nṣurnī bimā kadhdhabūn
versets.francais: Il dit: «Seigneur, secours-moi parce qu'ils m'accusent de mensonge.»
versets.anglais: He said, "My Lord, support me because they have denied me

versets.arabe: قَالَ عَمَّا قَلِيلٍ لَّيُصْبِحُنَّ نَادِمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qāla 'ammā qalīlin layuṣbiḥunna nādimīn
versets.francais: Il dit: «Avant peu, ils regretteront certes.»
versets.anglais: [Allah] said, "After a little, they will surely become regretful

versets.arabe: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ الصَّيْحَةُ بِالْحَقِّ فَجَعَلْنَاهُمْ غُثَاءً ۚ فَبُعْدًا لِّلْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Fa'akhadhat-humu ṣ-ṣayḥatu bil-ḥaqqi faja'alnāhum ghuthā'an fabu'dan lil-qawmi ẓ-ẓālimīn
versets.francais: Alors le Cri s'empara d'eux selon la vérité, et Nous les réduisîmes en déchets. Loin [de la miséricorde divine], les gens injustes!
versets.anglais: So the shriek seized them in truth, and We made them as [plant] stubble. Then away with the wrongdoing people

versets.arabe: ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَا مِن بَعْدِهِمْ قُرُونًا آخَرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Thumma ansha'nā min ba'dihim qurūnan ākharīn
versets.francais: Ensuite Nous avons fait naître d'autres générations après eux.
versets.anglais: Then We produced after them other generations

versets.arabe: مَا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَأْخِرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Mā tasbiqu min ummatin ajalahā wamā yasta'khirūn
versets.francais: Nulle communauté ne peut devancer son terme fixé, ni le retarder.
versets.anglais: No nation will precede its time [of termination], nor will they remain [thereafter]

versets.arabe: ثُمَّ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلَنَا تَتْرَا ۚ كُلَّ مَا جَاءَ أُمَّةً رَّسُولُهَا كَذَّبُوهُ ۚ فَأَتْبَعْنَا بَعْضَهُم بَعْضًا وَجَعَلْنَاهُمْ أَحَادِيثَ ۚ فَبُعْدًا لِّقَوْمٍ لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ
versets.phonetique: Thumma arsalnā rusulanā tatrā kulla mā jā'a ummatan rasūluhā kadhdhabūhu fa'atba'nā ba'ḍahum ba'ḍan waja'alnāhum aḥādītha fabu'dan liqawmin lā yu'minūn
versets.francais: Ensuite Nous avons envoyé Nos messagers successivement. Chaque fois qu'un messager venait à sa communauté, ils le traitaient de menteur. Nous les avons fait se succéder, et Nous en avons fait des récits. Loin [de la grâce divine] les gens qui ne croient pas!
versets.anglais: Then We sent Our messengers in succession. Every time there came to a nation its messenger, they denied him, so We made them follow one another [to destruction], and We made them narrations. So away with a people who do not believe

versets.arabe: ثُمَّ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَأَخَاهُ هَارُونَ بِآيَاتِنَا وَسُلْطَانٍ مُّبِينٍ
versets.phonetique: Thumma arsalnā mūsā wa'akhāhu hārūna bi'āyātinā wasulṭānin mubīn
versets.francais: Ensuite Nous avons envoyé Moïse et son frère Aaron avec Nos signes et une autorité évidente,
versets.anglais: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our signs and a clear authority

versets.arabe: إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَئِهِ فَاسْتَكْبَرُوا وَكَانُوا قَوْمًا عَالِينَ
versets.phonetique: Ilā fir'awna wamala'ihi fastakbarū wakānū qawman 'ālīn
versets.francais: vers Pharaon et ses notables. Mais ils s'enorgueillirent et étaient des gens très arrogants.
versets.anglais: To Pharaoh and his establishment, but they were arrogant and were a haughty people

versets.arabe: فَقَالُوا أَنُؤْمِنُ لِبَشَرَيْنِ مِثْلِنَا وَقَوْمُهُمَا لَنَا عَابِدُونَ
versets.phonetique: Faqālū anu'minu libasharayni mithlunā waqawmuhumā lanā 'ābidūn
versets.francais: Ils dirent: «Allons-nous croire à deux hommes comme nous, alors que leur peuple nous est asservi?»
versets.anglais: They said, "Should we believe two men like ourselves while their people are for us in servitude

versets.arabe: فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَكَانُوا مِنَ الْمُهْلَكِينَ
versets.phonetique: Fakadhdhabūhumā fakānū mina l-muhlikīn
versets.francais: Ils les traitèrent tous deux de menteurs et furent donc de ceux qui furent anéantis.
versets.anglais: So they denied them and were of those destroyed

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا مُوسَى الْكِتَابَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ
versets.phonetique: Walaqad ātaynā mūsā l-kitāba la'allahum yahtadūn
versets.francais: Et certes, Nous avons donné le Livre à Moïse, afin qu'ils se guident.
versets.anglais: And We certainly gave Moses the Scripture that perhaps they would be guided

versets.arabe: وَجَعَلْنَا ابْنَ مَرْيَمَ وَأُمَّهُ آيَةً وَآوَيْنَاهُمَا إِلَىٰ رَبْوَةٍ ذَاتِ قَرَارٍ وَمَعِينٍ
versets.phonetique: Waja'alnā bna maryama wa'ummahu āyatan wa'āwaynāhumā ilā rabwatin dhāti qarārin wama'īn
versets.francais: Et Nous avons fait du fils de Marie et de sa mère un signe, et Nous les avons abrités tous deux sur une hauteur paisible avec eau courante.
versets.anglais: And We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign and sheltered them within a high ground having level [areas] and flowing water

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الرُّسُلُ كُلُوا مِنَ الطَّيِّبَاتِ وَاعْمَلُوا صَالِحًا ۖ إِنِّي بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ عَلِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Yā ayyuhā r-rusulu kulū mina ṭ-ṭayyibāti wa'malū ṣāliḥan innī bimā ta'malūna 'alīm
versets.francais: «Ô Messagers! Mangez des bonnes choses et faites le bien. Certes Je connais ce que vous faites.»
versets.anglais: [Allah said], "O messengers, eat from the good foods and work righteousness. Indeed, I, of what you do, am Knowing

versets.arabe: وَإِنَّ هَٰذِهِ أُمَّتُكُمْ أُمَّةً وَاحِدَةً وَأَنَا رَبُّكُمْ فَاتَّقُونِ
versets.phonetique: Wa'inna hādhihi ummatukum ummatan wāḥidatan wa'anā rabbukum fattaqūn
versets.francais: Et certes cette communauté est votre communauté, une seule communauté, et Je suis votre Seigneur, craignez-Moi donc.
versets.anglais: And indeed this, your religion, is one religion, and I am your Lord, so fear Me

versets.arabe: فَتَقَطَّعُوا أَمْرَهُم بَيْنَهُمْ زُبُرًا ۖ كُلُّ حِزْبٍ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ فَرِحُونَ
versets.phonetique: Fataqaṭṭa'ū amrahum baynahum zuburan kullu ḥizbin bimā ladayhim fariḥūn
versets.francais: Mais ils se sont divisés dans leur affaire en partis, chaque groupe se réjouissant de ce qu'il a.
versets.anglais: But the people divided their religion among them into sects - each faction, in what it has, rejoicing

versets.arabe: فَذَرْهُمْ فِي غَمْرَتِهِمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
versets.phonetique: Fadhar-hum fī ghamratihim ḥattā ḥīn
versets.francais: Laisse-les donc dans leur égarement jusqu'à un certain temps.
versets.anglais: So leave them in their confusion for a time

versets.arabe: أَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّمَا نُمِدُّهُم بِهِ مِن مَّالٍ وَبَنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Ayaḥsabūna annamā numidduhum bihi min mālin wabānīn
versets.francais: Pensent-ils que ce dont Nous les pourvoyons, richesses et enfants,
versets.anglais: Do they think that what We extend to them of wealth and children

versets.arabe: نُسَارِعُ لَهُمْ فِي الْخَيْرَاتِ ۚ بَل لَّا يَشْعُرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Nusāri'u lahum fī l-khayrāti bal lā yash'urūn
versets.francais: Nous nous empressons à leur donner du bien? Non, mais ils ne comprennent pas.
versets.anglais: Is [because] We hasten for them good things? Rather, they do not perceive

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ هُم مِّنْ خَشْيَةِ رَبِّهِم مُّشْفِقُونَ
versets.phonetique: Inna lladhīna hum min khashyati rabbihim mushfiqūn
versets.francais: Ceux qui, par crainte de leur Seigneur, sont craintifs,
versets.anglais: Indeed, they who are apprehensive from fear of their Lord

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ هُم بِآيَاتِ رَبِّهِمْ يُؤْمِنُونَ
versets.phonetique: Walladhīna hum bi'āyāti rabbihim yu'minūn
versets.francais: qui croient aux signes de leur Seigneur,
versets.anglais: And they who believe in the signs of their Lord

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ هُم بِرَبِّهِمْ لَا يُشْرِكُونَ
versets.phonetique: Walladhīna hum birabbihim lā yushrikūn
versets.francais: qui n'associent rien à leur Seigneur,
versets.anglais: And they who do not associate anything with their Lord

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ يُؤْتُونَ مَا آتَوا وَّقُلُوبُهُمْ وَجِلَةٌ أَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ رَاجِعُونَ
versets.phonetique: Walladhīna yu'tūna mā ātaw waqulūbuhum wajilatun annahum ilā rabbihim rāji'ūn
versets.francais: et qui donnent ce qu'ils donnent, le coeur plein de crainte, parce qu'ils vont retourner vers leur Seigneur:
versets.anglais: And they who give what they give while their hearts are fearful because they will be returning to their Lord

versets.arabe: أُولَٰئِكَ يُسَارِعُونَ فِي الْخَيْرَاتِ وَهُمْ لَهَا سَابِقُونَ
versets.phonetique: Ulā'ika yusāri'ūna fī l-khayrāti wahum lahā sābiqūn
versets.francais: voilà ceux qui s'empressent vers les bonnes oeuvres, et c'est eux qui y seront les premiers.
versets.anglais: It is those who hasten to good deeds, and they outstrip [others] therein

versets.arabe: وَلَا نُكَلِّفُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ۖ وَلَدَيْنَا كِتَابٌ يَنطِقُ بِالْحَقِّ ۚ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Walā nukallifu nafsan illā wus'ahā waladaynā kitābun yanṭiqu bil-ḥaqqi wahum lā yuẓlamūn
versets.francais: Et Nous n'imposons à personne que selon sa capacité. Et Nous avons un registre qui dit la vérité. Et ils ne seront pas lésés.
versets.anglais: And We charge no soul except [with that within] its capacity, and with Us is a record which speaks with truth; and they will not be wronged

versets.arabe: بَلْ قُلُوبُهُمْ فِي غَمْرَةٍ مِّنْ هَٰذَا وَلَهُمْ أَعْمَالٌ مِّن دُونِ ذَٰلِكَ هُمْ لَهَا عَامِلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Bal qulūbuhum fī ghamratin min hādhā walahum a'mālun min dūni dhālika hum lahā 'āmilūn
versets.francais: Mais leurs coeurs sont dans un aveuglement vis-à-vis de cela. Et en plus, ils font d'autres œuvres qu'ils commettent encore.
versets.anglais: But their hearts are covered with confusion over this, and they have [evil] deeds besides disbelief which they are doing

versets.arabe: حَتَّىٰ إِذَا أَخَذْنَا مُتْرَفِيهِم بِالْعَذَابِ إِذَا هُمْ يَجْأَرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Ḥattā idhā akhadhnā mutrafīhim bil-'adhābi idhā hum yaj'arūn
versets.francais: Jusqu'au moment où Nous aurons saisi leurs nantis par le châtiment, et aussitôt ils crieront.
versets.anglais: Until when We seize their affluent ones with punishment, at once they are crying [to Allah] for help

versets.arabe: لَا تَجْأَرُوا الْيَوْمَ ۖ إِنَّكُم مِّنَّا لَا تُنصَرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Lā taj'arū l-yawma innakum minnā lā tunṣarūn
versets.francais: «Ne criez pas aujourd'hui; vous ne serez pas secourus par Nous.»
versets.anglais: Do not cry out today. Indeed, by Us you will not be helped

versets.arabe: قَدْ كَانَتْ آيَاتِي تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَكُنتُمْ عَلَىٰ أَعْقَابِكُمْ تَنكِصُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qad kānat āyātī tutlā 'alaykum fakuntum 'alā a'qābikum tankiṣūn
versets.francais: Mes versets vous étaient lus, et vous reculiez sur vos talons,
versets.anglais: My verses had already been recited to you, but you were turning back on your heels

versets.arabe: مُسْتَكْبِرِينَ بِهِ سَامِرًا تَهْجُرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Mustakbirīna bihi sāmiran tahjurūn
versets.francais: vous en enorgueillissant, et le soir vous l'abandonniez.
versets.anglais: In arrogance regarding it, conversing by night, speaking evil

versets.arabe: أَفَلَمْ يَدَّبَّرُوا الْقَوْلَ أَمْ جَاءَهُم مَّا لَمْ يَأْتِ آبَاءَهُمُ الْأَوَّلِينَ
versets.phonetique: Afalam yaddabbarū l-qawla am jā'ahum mā lam ya'ti ābā'ahumu l-awwalīn
versets.francais: N'ont-ils donc pas médité la parole [du Coran]? Ou bien leur est-il venu quelque chose qui n'est pas venu à leurs ancêtres?
versets.anglais: Then have they not reflected over the Qur'an, or has there come to them that which had not come to their forefathers

versets.arabe: أَمْ لَمْ يَعْرِفُوا رَسُولَهُمْ فَهُمْ لَهُ مُنكِرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Am lam ya'rifū rasūlahum fahum lahū munkirūn
versets.francais: Ou bien n'ont-ils pas reconnu leur messager et le renient-ils?
versets.anglais: Or did they not know their Messenger, so they are toward him disacknowledging

versets.arabe: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ بِهِ جِنَّةٌ ۚ بَلْ جَاءَهُم بِالْحَقِّ وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ لِلْحَقِّ كَارِهُونَ
versets.phonetique: Am yaqūlūna bihi jinnatun bal jā'ahum bil-ḥaqqi wa'aktharuhum lil-ḥaqqi kārihūn
versets.francais: Ou bien disent-ils qu'il est possédé? Non, il leur est venu avec la vérité, et la plupart d'eux détestent la vérité.
versets.anglais: Or do they say, "In him is madness?" Rather, he brought them the truth, but most of them, to the truth, are averse

versets.arabe: وَلَوِ اتَّبَعَ الْحَقُّ أَهْوَاءَهُمْ لَفَسَدَتِ السَّمَاوَاتُ وَالْأَرْضُ وَمَن فِيهِنَّ ۚ بَلْ أَتَيْنَاهُم بِذِكْرِهِمْ فَهُمْ عَن ذِكْرِهِم مُّعْرِضُونَ
versets.phonetique: Walaw ittaba'a l-ḥaqqu ahwā'ahum lafasadati s-samāwātu wal-arḍu waman fīhinna bal ataynāhum bidhikrihim fahum 'an dhikrihim mu'riḍūn
versets.francais: Si la vérité suivait leurs passions, les cieux, la terre et tout ce qu'ils contiennent seraient corrompus. Nous leur avons plutôt apporté leur rappel, mais ils s'en détournent.
versets.anglais: But if the Truth had followed their inclinations, the heavens and the earth and whoever is in them would have been ruined. Rather, We have brought them their message, but they, from their message, are turning away

versets.arabe: أَمْ تَسْأَلُهُمْ خَرْجًا فَخَرَاجُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌ ۖ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ الرَّازِقِينَ
versets.phonetique: Am tas'aluhum kharjan fakharāju rabbika khayrun wahuwa khayru r-rāziqīn
versets.francais: Ou bien leur demandes-tu une rétribution? Mais la rétribution de ton Seigneur est meilleure, et Il est le meilleur des pourvoyeurs.
versets.anglais: Or do you, [O Muhammad], ask them for payment? But the reward of your Lord is best, and He is the best of providers

versets.arabe: وَإِنَّكَ لَتَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa'innaka latad'ūhum ilā ṣirāṭin mustaqīm
versets.francais: Et certes, tu les invites vers un droit chemin.
versets.anglais: And indeed, you invite them to a straight path

versets.arabe: وَإِنَّ الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْآخِرَةِ عَنِ الصِّرَاطِ لَنَاكِبُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa'inna lladhīna lā yu'minūna bil-ākhirati 'ani ṣ-ṣirāṭi lanākibūn
versets.francais: Et certes, ceux qui ne croient pas en l'au-delà s'écartent du droit chemin.
versets.anglais: But indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter are deviating from the path

versets.arabe: وَلَوْ رَحِمْنَاهُمْ وَكَشَفْنَا مَا بِهِم مِّن ضُرٍّ لَّلَجُّوا فِي طُغْيَانِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
versets.phonetique: Walaw raḥimnāhum wakashafnā mā bihim min ḍurrin lalajiū fī ṭughyānihim ya'mahūn
versets.francais: Même si Nous leur accordions miséricorde et dissipions leurs maux, ils persisteraient dans leur transgression à s'égarer.
versets.anglais: And even if We gave them mercy and removed what was upon them of affliction, they would persist in their transgression, wandering blindly

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ أَخَذْنَاهُم بِالْعَذَابِ فَمَا اسْتَكَانُوا لِرَبِّهِمْ وَمَا يَتَضَرَّعُونَ
versets.phonetique: Walaqad akhadhnāhum bil-'adhābi famā stakānū lirabbihim wamā yataḍarra'ūn
versets.francais: Certes Nous les avons déjà saisis par le châtiment, mais ils ne se sont pas humiliés devant leur Seigneur, et ils ne supplièrent pas,
versets.anglais: And We had gripped them with suffering [as a warning], but they did not yield to their Lord, nor did they humbly supplicate, [and will continue thus]

versets.arabe: حَتَّىٰ إِذَا فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِم بَابًا ذَا عَذَابٍ شَدِيدٍ إِذَا هُمْ فِيهِ مُبْلِسُونَ
versets.phonetique: Ḥattā idhā ftaḥnā 'alayhim bāban dhā 'adhābin shadīdin idhā hum fīhi mublisūn
versets.francais: jusqu'au moment où Nous ouvrirons sur eux une porte de sévère châtiment; les voilà désespérés.
versets.anglais: Until when We have opened before them a door of severe punishment, immediately they will be therein in despair

versets.arabe: وَهُوَ الَّذِي أَنشَأَ لَكُمُ السَّمْعَ وَالْأَبْصَارَ وَالْأَفْئِدَةَ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wahuwa lladhī ansha'a lakumu s-sam'a wal-abṣāra wal-af'idata qalīlan mā tashkurūn
versets.francais: C'est Lui qui vous a créé l'ouïe, les yeux et les coeurs. Vous êtes peu reconnaissants!
versets.anglais: And it is He who produced for you hearing and vision and hearts; little are you grateful

versets.arabe: وَهُوَ الَّذِي ذَرَأَكُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wahuwa lladhī dhara'akum fī l-arḍi wa'ilayhi tuḥsharūn
versets.francais: C'est Lui qui vous a répandus sur la terre, et c'est vers Lui que vous serez rassemblés.
versets.anglais: And it is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered

versets.arabe: وَهُوَ الَّذِي يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَلَهُ اخْتِلَافُ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ ۚ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wahuwa lladhī yuḥyī wayumītu walahu khtilāfu l-layli wan-nahāri afalā ta'qilūn
versets.francais: C'est Lui qui donne la vie et la mort; et à Lui appartient l'alternance de la nuit et du jour. Ne raisonnez-vous donc pas?
versets.anglais: And it is He who gives life and causes death, and His is the alternation of the night and the day. Then will you not reason

versets.arabe: بَلْ قَالُوا مِثْلَ مَا قَالَ الْأَوَّلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Bal qālū mithla mā qāla l-awwalūn
versets.francais: Mais non, ils ont dit comme ce qu'ont dit les anciens:
versets.anglais: Rather, they say like what the former peoples said

versets.arabe: قَالُوا أَإِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَامًا أَإِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qālū a'idhā mitnā wakunnā turāban wa'iẓāman a'innā lamab'ūthūn
versets.francais: «Quand nous serons morts et que nous serons poussière et ossements, allons-nous être ressuscités?»
versets.anglais: They said, "When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected

versets.arabe: لَقَدْ وُعِدْنَا نَحْنُ وَآبَاؤُنَا هَٰذَا مِن قَبْلُ إِنْ هَٰذَا إِلَّا أَسَاطِيرُ الْأَوَّلِينَ
versets.phonetique: Laqad wu'idnā naḥnu wa'ābā'unā hādhā min qablu in hādhā illā asāṭīru l-awwalīn
versets.francais: «Certes, on nous a déjà promis cela, ainsi qu'à nos ancêtres. Ce ne sont que des fables des anciens.»
versets.anglais: We have been promised this, we and our forefathers, before; this is not but legends of the former peoples

versets.arabe: قُل لِّمَنِ الْأَرْضُ وَمَن فِيهَا إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qul limani l-arḍu waman fīhā in kuntum ta'lamūn
versets.francais: Dis: «A qui appartient la terre et ceux qui s'y trouvent, si vous savez?»
versets.anglais: Say, [O Muhammad], "To whom belongs the earth and whoever is in it, if you should know

versets.arabe: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ ۚ قُلْ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Sayaqūlūna lillāhi qul afalā tadhakkarūn
versets.francais: Ils diront: «A Allah.» Dis: «Ne vous rappelez-vous donc pas?»
versets.anglais: They will say, "To Allah." Say, "Then will you not remember

versets.arabe: قُلْ مَن رَّبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
versets.phonetique: Qul man rabbu s-samāwāti s-sab'i warabbu l-'arshi l-'aẓīm
versets.francais: Dis: «Qui est le Seigneur des sept cieux et le Seigneur du Trône immense?»
versets.anglais: Say, "Who is Lord of the seven heavens and Lord of the Great Throne

versets.arabe: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ ۚ قُلْ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
versets.phonetique: Sayaqūlūna lillāhi qul afalā tattaqūn
versets.francais: Ils diront: «A Allah.» Dis: «Ne craignez-vous donc pas?»
versets.anglais: They will say, "[They belong] to Allah." Say, "Then will you not fear Him

versets.arabe: قُلْ مَن بِيَدِهِ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَهُوَ يُجِيرُ وَلَا يُجَارُ عَلَيْهِ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qul man biyadihi malakūtu kulli shay'in wahuwa yujīru walā yujāru 'alayhi in kuntum ta'lamūn
versets.francais: Dis: «Qui tient dans Sa main la royauté absolue sur toute chose, et Lui protège sans être protégé contre Lui, si vous savez?»
versets.anglais: Say, "In whose hand is the realm of all things - and He protects while none can protect against Him - if you should know

versets.arabe: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ ۚ قُلْ فَأَنَّىٰ تُسْحَرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Sayaqūlūna lillāhi qul fa'annā tusḥarūn
versets.francais: Ils diront: «A Allah.» Dis: «Comment donc vous laissez-vous ensorceler?»
versets.anglais: They will say, "[All belongs] to Allah." Say, "Then how are you deluded

versets.arabe: بَلْ أَتَيْنَاهُم بِالْحَقِّ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكَاذِبُونَ
versets.phonetique: Bal ataynāhum bil-ḥaqqi wa'innahum lakādhibūn
versets.francais: Nous leur avons plutôt apporté la vérité, et ils sont certes menteurs.
versets.anglais: Rather, We have brought them the truth, and indeed they are liars

versets.arabe: مَا اتَّخَذَ اللَّهُ مِن وَلَدٍ وَمَا كَانَ مَعَهُ مِنْ إِلَٰهٍ ۚ إِذًا لَّذَهَبَ كُلُّ إِلَٰهٍ بِمَا خَلَقَ وَلَعَلَا بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ ۚ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
versets.phonetique: Mā ttakhadha llāhu min waladin wamā kāna ma'ahu min ilāhin idhan ladhahaba kullu ilāhin bimā khalaqa wala'alā ba'ḍuhum 'alā ba'ḍin subḥāna llāhi 'ammā yaṣifūn
versets.francais: Allah n'a pas pris d'enfant, et il n'y a pas d'autre divinité avec Lui. Sinon, chaque dieu aurait emmené ce qu'il a créé, et certains auraient dominé les autres. Gloire à Allah! Il est au-dessus de tout ce qu'ils Lui attribuent!
versets.anglais: Allah has not taken any son, nor has there ever been with Him any deity. [If there had been], then each deity would have taken what it created, and some of them would have sought to overcome others. Exalted is Allah above what they describe [concerning Him]

versets.arabe: عَالِمِ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ فَتَعَالَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
versets.phonetique: 'Ālimi l-ghaybi wash-shahādati fata'ālā 'ammā yushrikūn
versets.francais: Connaisseur de l'invisible et du visible! Qu'Il est au-dessus de tout ce qu'ils Lui associent!
versets.anglais: [He is] Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, so high is He above what they associate [with Him]

versets.arabe: قُل رَّبِّ إِمَّا تُرِيَنِّي مَا يُوعَدُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qul rabbi immā turiyannī mā yū'adūn
versets.francais: Dis: «Seigneur, si Tu me montres ce dont ils sont menacés,»
versets.anglais: Say, [O Muhammad], "My Lord, if You should show me that which they are promised

versets.arabe: رَبِّ فَلَا تَجْعَلْنِي فِي الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Rabbi falā taj'alnī fī l-qawmi ẓ-ẓālimīn
versets.francais: «Seigneur, ne me place pas alors parmi les gens injustes.»
versets.anglais: My Lord, then do not place me among the wrongdoing people

versets.arabe: وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰ أَن نُّرِيَكَ مَا نَعِدُهُمْ لَقَادِرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa'innā 'alā an nuriyaka mā na'iduhum laqādirūn
versets.francais: Et certes, Nous sommes capable de te faire voir ce dont Nous les menaçons.
versets.anglais: And indeed, We are able to show you what We have promised them

versets.arabe: ادْفَعْ بِالَّتِي هِيَ أَحْسَنُ السَّيِّئَةَ ۚ نَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَصِفُونَ
versets.phonetique: Idfa' billati hiya aḥsanu s-sayyi'ata naḥnu a'lamu bimā yaṣifūn
versets.francais: Repousse le mal par ce qui est meilleur. Nous savons mieux ce qu'ils décrivent.
versets.anglais: Repel, by [means of] what is best, [their] evil. We are most knowing of what they describe

versets.arabe: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِينِ
versets.phonetique: Waqul rabbi a'ūdhu bika min hamazāti sh-shayāṭīn
versets.francais: Et dis: «Seigneur, je cherche protection auprès de Toi contre les incitations des diables,»
versets.anglais: And say, "My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the incitements of the devils

versets.arabe: وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ رَبِّ أَن يَحْضُرُونِ
versets.phonetique: Wa'a'ūdhu bika rabbi an yaḥḍurūn
versets.francais: «et je cherche protection auprès de Toi, Seigneur, pour qu'ils ne me soient pas présents.»
versets.anglais: And I seek refuge in You, my Lord, lest they be present with me

versets.arabe: حَتَّىٰ إِذَا جَاءَ أَحَدَهُمُ الْمَوْتُ قَالَ رَبِّ ارْجِعُونِ
versets.phonetique: Ḥattā idhā jā'a aḥadahumu l-mawtu qāla rabbi rji'ūn
versets.francais: Jusqu'au moment où la mort vient à l'un d'eux, il dit: «Seigneur, fais-moi retourner,»
versets.anglais: [For such is the state of the disbelievers], until, when death comes to one of them, he says, "My Lord, send me back

versets.arabe: لَعَلِّي أَعْمَلُ صَالِحًا فِيمَا تَرَكْتُ ۚ كَلَّا ۚ إِنَّهَا كَلِمَةٌ هُوَ قَائِلُهَا ۖ وَمِن وَرَائِهِم بَرْزَخٌ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
versets.phonetique: La'allī a'malu ṣāliḥan fīmā taraktu kallā innahā kalimatun huwa qā'iluhā wamin warā'ihim barzakhun ilā yawmi yub'athūn
versets.francais: «afin que je fasse du bien dans ce que j'ai laissé.» Non! Ce n'est qu'une parole qu'il dit. Et derrière eux il y a un barzakh jusqu'au Jour où ils seront ressuscités.
versets.anglais: That I might do righteousness in that which I left behind." No! It is only a word he is saying; and behind them is a barrier until the Day they are resurrected

versets.arabe: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِي الصُّورِ فَلَا أَنسَابَ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَلَا يَتَسَاءَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Fa'idhā nufikha fī ṣ-ṣūri falā ansāba baynahum yawma'idhin walā yatasā'alūn
versets.francais: Puis quand on soufflera dans la Trompe, ce jour-là il n'y aura plus de liens de parenté entre eux, et ils ne s'interrogeront pas mutuellement.
versets.anglais: So when the Horn is blown, no relationship will there be among them that Day, nor will they ask about one another

versets.arabe: فَمَن ثَقُلَتْ مَوَازِينُهُ فَأُولَٰئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ
versets.phonetique: Faman thaqulat mawāzīnuhu fa'ulā'ika humu l-mufliḥūn
versets.francais: Ceux dont la balance sera lourde, voilà les bienheureux.
versets.anglais: And those whose scales are heavy [with good deeds] - it is they who are the successful

versets.arabe: وَمَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَازِينُهُ فَأُولَٰئِكَ الَّذِينَ خَسِرُوا أَنفُسَهُمْ فِي جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدُونَ
versets.phonetique: Waman khaffat mawāzīnuhu fa'ulā'ika lladhīna khasirū anfusahum fī jahannama khālidūn
versets.francais: Et ceux dont la balance sera légère, voilà ceux qui auront perdu leurs âmes; dans l'Enfer, ils y demeureront éternellement.
versets.anglais: But those whose scales are light - those are the ones who have lost their souls, [being] in Hell, abiding eternally

versets.arabe: تَلْفَحُ وُجُوهَهُمُ النَّارُ وَهُمْ فِيهَا كَالِحُونَ
versets.phonetique: Talfaḥu wujūhahumu n-nāru wahum fīhā kāliḥūn
versets.francais: Le feu brûlera leurs visages et ils y grimaçeront.
versets.anglais: The Fire will sear their faces, and they therein will have taut smiles

versets.arabe: أَلَمْ تَكُنْ آيَاتِي تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَكُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
versets.phonetique: Alam takun āyātī tutlā 'alaykum fakuntum bihā tukadhdhibūn
versets.francais: «Mes versets ne vous étaient-ils pas lus et vous les traitiez de mensonges?»
versets.anglais: [It will be said]. "Were not My verses recited to you and you used to deny them

versets.arabe: قَالُوا رَبَّنَا غَلَبَتْ عَلَيْنَا شِقْوَتُنَا وَكُنَّا قَوْمًا ضَالِّينَ
versets.phonetique: Qālū rabbanā ghalabat 'alaynā shiqwatunā wakunnā qawman ḍāllīn
versets.francais: Ils diront: «Seigneur, notre malheur nous a dominés et nous étions des gens égarés.»
versets.anglais: They will say, "Our Lord, our wretchedness overcame us, and we were a people astray

versets.arabe: رَبَّنَا أَخْرِجْنَا مِنْهَا فَإِنْ عُدْنَا فَإِنَّا ظَالِمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Rabbanā akhrijunā minhā fa'in 'udnā fa'innā ẓālimūn
versets.francais: «Seigneur, fais-nous sortir d'ici. Et si nous recommençons, nous serons vraiment injustes.»
versets.anglais: Our Lord, remove us from it, and if we were to return [to evil], we would indeed be wrongdoers

versets.arabe: قَالَ اخْسَئُوا فِيهَا وَلَا تُكَلِّمُونِ
versets.phonetique: Qāla khsa'ū fīhā walā tukalimūn
versets.francais: Il dira: «Restez-y ignominieusement, et ne M'adressez plus la parole.»
versets.anglais: He will say, "Remain despised therein and do not speak to Me

versets.arabe: إِنَّهُ كَانَ فَرِيقٌ مِّنْ عِبَادِي يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا آمَنَّا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Innahū kāna farīqun min 'ibādī yaqūlūna rabbanā āmannā faghfir lanā warḥamnā wa'anta khayru r-rāḥimīn
versets.francais: Il y avait certes un groupe parmi Mes serviteurs qui disaient: «Seigneur, nous avons cru; pardonne-nous et fais-nous miséricorde, Tu es le meilleur des Miséricordieux.»
versets.anglais: Indeed, there was a party of My servants who said, 'Our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us and have mercy upon us, and You are the best of the merciful

versets.arabe: فَاتَّخَذْتُمُوهُمْ سِخْرِيًّا حَتَّىٰ أَنسَوْكُمْ ذِكْرِي وَكُنتُم مِّنْهُمْ تَضْحَكُونَ
versets.phonetique: Fattakhadhtumūhum sikhriyyan ḥattā ansawkum dhikrī wakuntum minhum taḍḥakūn
versets.francais: Mais vous les avez pris en moquerie, jusqu'à ce qu'ils vous aient fait oublier Mon rappel. Et vous vous moquiez d'eux.
versets.anglais: But you took them in mockery to the point that they made you forget My remembrance, and you used to laugh at them

versets.arabe: إِنِّي جَزَيْتُهُمُ الْيَوْمَ بِمَا صَبَرُوا أَنَّهُمُ الْفَائِزُونَ
versets.phonetique: Innī jazaytuhumy l-yawma bimā ṣabarū annahumu l-fā'izūn
versets.francais: «Certes, aujourd'hui Je les ai récompensés pour leur patience; ils sont bien les triomphants.»
versets.anglais: Indeed, I have rewarded them this Day for their patient endurance - that they are the attainers [of success]

versets.arabe: قَالَ كَمْ لَبِثْتُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ عَدَدَ سِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qāla kam labithtum fī l-arḍi 'adada sinīn
versets.francais: Il dira: «Combien d'années avez-vous demeuré sur la terre?»
versets.anglais: [Allah] will say, "How long did you remain on earth in number of years

versets.arabe: قَالُوا لَبِثْنَا يَوْمًا أَوْ بَعْضَ يَوْمٍ فَاسْأَلِ الْعَادِّينَ
versets.phonetique: Qālū labithnā yawman aw ba'ḍa yawmin fas'ali l-'āddīn
versets.francais: Ils diront: «Nous avons demeuré un jour ou partie d'un jour; interroge les dénombreurs.»
versets.anglais: They will say, "We remained a day or part of a day; ask those who enumerate

versets.arabe: قَالَ إِن لَّبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا ۖ لَّوْ أَنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qāla in labithtum illā qalīlan law annakum kuntum ta'lamūn
versets.francais: Il dira: «Vous n'y avez demeuré que peu de temps, si seulement vous saviez.»
versets.anglais: He will say, "You stayed not but a little - if only you had known

versets.arabe: أَفَحَسِبْتُمْ أَنَّمَا خَلَقْنَاكُمْ عَبَثًا وَأَنَّكُمْ إِلَيْنَا لَا تُرْجَعُونَ
versets.phonetique: Afaḥasibtum annamā khalaqnākum 'abathan wa'annakum ilaynā lā turja'ūn
versets.francais: Pensiez-vous que Nous vous avions créés sans but et que vous ne seriez pas ramenés vers Nous?
versets.anglais: Then did you think that We created you uselessly and that to Us you would not be returned

versets.arabe: فَتَعَالَى اللَّهُ الْمَلِكُ الْحَقُّ ۖ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ
versets.phonetique: Fata'ālā llāhu l-maliku l-ḥaqqu lā ilāha illā huwa rabbu l-'arshi l-karīm
versets.francais: Qu'Allah soit exalté, le Roi, la Vérité! Il n'y a pas de divinité en dehors de Lui, le Seigneur du Trône noble.
versets.anglais: So exalted is Allah, the Sovereign, the Truth; there is no deity except Him, Lord of the Noble Throne

versets.arabe: وَمَن يَدْعُ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا آخَرَ لَا بُرْهَانَ لَهُ بِهِ فَإِنَّمَا حِسَابُهُ عِندَ رَبِّهِ ۚ إِنَّهُ لَا يُفْلِحُ الْكَافِرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Waman yad'u ma'a llāhi ilāhan ākhara lā burhāna lahū bihi fa'innamā ḥisābuhu 'inda rabbihi innahu lā yufliḥu l-kāfirūn
versets.francais: Quiconque invoque, en dehors d'Allah, une autre divinité dont il n'a aucune preuve, son compte ne sera réglé qu'auprès de son Seigneur. Les mécréants ne réussiront certes pas.
versets.anglais: And whoever invokes besides Allah another deity for which he has no proof - then his account is only with his Lord. Indeed, the disbelievers will not succeed

versets.arabe: وَقُل رَّبِّ اغْفِرْ وَارْحَمْ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Waqul rabbi ghfir warḥam wa'anta khayru r-rāḥimīn
versets.francais: Et dis: «Seigneur, pardonne et fais miséricorde; Tu es le meilleur des Miséricordieux.»
versets.anglais: And, [O Muhammad], say, "My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of the merciful

versets.arabe: سُورَةٌ أَنزَلْنَاهَا وَفَرَضْنَاهَا وَأَنزَلْنَا فِيهَا آيَاتٍ بَيِّنَاتٍ لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Suratun anzalnaha wa faradnaha wa anzalna fiha ayatin bayyinatin la'allakum tadhakkarun
