versets.francais: C'est une sourate que Nous avons révélée et rendue obligatoire ; Nous y avons fait descendre des versets clairs, afin que vous vous souveniez.
versets.anglais: [This is] a surah which We have sent down and made [that within it] obligatory and revealed therein verses of clear evidence that you might remember

versets.arabe: الزَّانِيَةُ وَالزَّانِي فَاجْلِدُوا كُلَّ وَاحِدٍ مِّنْهُمَا مِائَةَ جَلْدَةٍ ۖ وَلَا تَأْخُذْكُم بِهِمَا رَأْفَةٌ فِي دِينِ اللَّهِ
versets.phonetique: Az-zaniyatu waz-zani fajlidu kulla wahidim minhuma mi'ata jaldatiw wa la ta'khudhkum bihima ra'fatun fi dinillah
versets.francais: La fornicatrice et le fornicateur, fouettez-les chacun cent coups. Et ne soyez pas pris de pitié pour eux dans l'application de la loi d'Allah.
versets.anglais: The [unmarried] woman or [unmarried] man found guilty of sexual intercourse - lash each one of them with a hundred lashes, and do not be taken by pity for them in the religion of Allah, if you should believe in Allah and the Last Day. And let a group of the believers witness their punishment

versets.arabe: الزَّانِي لَا يَنكِحُ إِلَّا زَانِيَةً أَوْ مُشْرِكَةً وَالزَّانِيَةُ لَا يَنكِحُهَا إِلَّا زَانٍ أَوْ مُشْرِكٌ ۚ وَحُرِّمَ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Az-zani la yankihu illa zaniyatan aw mushrikataw waz-zaniyatu la yankihuha illa zanin aw mushrik wa hurrima dhalika 'alal-mu'minin
versets.francais: Le fornicateur n'épouse qu'une fornicatrice ou une associatrice, et la fornicatrice n'est épousée que par un fornicateur ou un associateur. Cela est interdit aux croyants.
versets.anglais: The fornicator does not marry except a [female] fornicator or polytheist, and none marries her except a fornicator or a polytheist, and that has been made unlawful to the believers

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ يَرْمُونَ الْمُحْصَنَاتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَأْتُوا بِأَرْبَعَةِ شُهَدَاءَ فَاجْلِدُوهُمْ ثَمَانِينَ جَلْدَةً وَلَا تَقْبَلُوا لَهُمْ شَهَادَةً أَبَدًا
versets.phonetique: Walladhina yarmulnalmuhsanati thumma lam ya'tu bi'arba'ati shuhadaa fajliduhum thamanina jaldataw wa la taqbalu lahum shahadatan abada
versets.francais: Ceux qui lancent des accusations contre des femmes chastes sans produire quatre témoins, fouettez-les de quatre-vingts coups et ne recevez plus jamais leur témoignage.
versets.anglais: And those who accuse chaste women and then do not produce four witnesses - lash them with eighty lashes and do not accept from them testimony ever after. And those are the defiantly disobedient

versets.arabe: إِلَّا الَّذِينَ تَابُوا مِن بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ وَأَصْلَحُوا فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Illal-ladhina tabu mim ba'di dhalika wa aslaahu fa'innallaha ghafururrahim
versets.francais: Sauf ceux qui se repentent après cela et se corrigent : Allah est certes Pardonneur et Miséricordieux.
versets.anglais: Except for those who repent thereafter and reform, for indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ يَرْمُونَ أَزْوَاجَهُمْ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُمْ شُهَدَاءُ إِلَّا أَنفُسُهُمْ فَشَهَادَةُ أَحَدِهِمْ أَرْبَعُ شَهَادَاتٍ بِاللَّهِ
versets.phonetique: Walladhina yarmuna azwajahum wa lam yakun lahum shuhada'u illa anfusuhum fashahadatu ahadihim arba'u shahadatin billah
versets.francais: Ceux qui accusent leurs épouses sans avoir d'autres témoins qu'eux-mêmes, le témoignage de l'un d'eux consistera en quatre attestations par Allah.
versets.anglais: And those who accuse their wives [of adultery] and have no witnesses except themselves - then the witness of one of them [shall be] four testimonies [swearing] by Allah that indeed, he is of the truthful

versets.arabe: وَالْخَامِسَةُ أَنَّ لَعْنَتَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ إِن كَانَ مِنَ الْكَاذِبِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wal-khamisatu anna la'natallahi 'alayhi in kana minal-kadhibin
versets.francais: Et la cinquième attestation que la malédiction d'Allah soit sur lui s'il est du nombre des menteurs.
versets.anglais: And the fifth [oath will be] that the curse of Allah be upon him if he should be among the liars

versets.arabe: وَيَدْرَأُ عَنْهَا الْعَذَابَ أَن تَشْهَدَ أَرْبَعَ شَهَادَاتٍ بِاللَّهِ ۙ إِنَّهُ لَمِنَ الْكَاذِبِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa yadra'u 'anhal-'adhaba an tashhada arba'a shahadatin billahi innahu laminal-kadhibin
versets.francais: Et le châtiment sera écarté de la femme si elle atteste quatre fois par Allah qu'il est du nombre des menteurs.
versets.anglais: But it will prevent punishment from her if she gives four testimonies [swearing] by Allah that indeed, he is of the liars

versets.arabe: وَالْخَامِسَةَ أَنَّ غَضَبَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهَا إِن كَانَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wal-khamisata anna ghadaballahi 'alayha in kana minas-sadiqin
versets.francais: Et la cinquième attestation que la colère d'Allah soit sur elle s'il est du nombre des véridiques.
versets.anglais: And the fifth [oath will be] that the wrath of Allah be upon her if he was of the truthful

versets.arabe: وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ تَوَّابٌ حَكِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa lawla fadlullahi 'alaykum wa rahmatuhu wa annallaha tawwabun hakim
versets.francais: Sans la grâce d'Allah sur vous et Sa miséricorde, et qu'Allah est Celui qui accepte le repentir, le Sage...
versets.anglais: And if not for the favor of Allah upon you and His mercy... and because Allah is Accepting of repentance and Wise

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ جَاءُوا بِالْإِفْكِ عُصْبَةٌ مِّنكُمْ ۚ لَا تَحْسَبُوهُ شَرًّا لَّكُم ۖ بَلْ هُوَ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Innal-ladhina ja'u bil-ifki 'usbatun minkum la tahsabuhu sharral lakum bal huwa khayrul lakum
versets.francais: Ceux qui ont colporté le mensonge sont un groupe parmi vous. Ne considérez pas cela comme un mal pour vous, au contraire c'est un bien pour vous.
versets.anglais: Indeed, those who came with falsehood are a group among you. Do not think it bad for you; rather it is good for you. For every person among them is what [punishment] he has earned from the sin, and he who took upon himself the greater portion thereof - for him is a great punishment

versets.arabe: لَّوْلَا إِذْ سَمِعْتُمُوهُ ظَنَّ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتُ بِأَنفُسِهِمْ خَيْرًا وَقَالُوا هَٰذَا إِفْكٌ مُّبِينٌ
versets.phonetique: Lawla idh sami'tumuhu dhannal-mu'minuna wal-mu'minatu bi'anfusihim khayraw wa qalu hadha ifkum mubin
versets.francais: Pourquoi, lorsque vous l'avez entendu, les croyants et les croyantes n'ont-ils pas pensé du bien d'eux-mêmes et dit : "C'est là un mensonge évident !"
versets.anglais: Why, when you heard it, did not the believing men and believing women think good of one another and say, "This is an obvious falsehood

versets.arabe: لَّوْلَا جَاءُوا عَلَيْهِ بِأَرْبَعَةِ شُهَدَاءَ ۚ فَإِذْ لَمْ يَأْتُوا بِالشُّهَدَاءِ فَأُولَٰئِكَ عِندَ اللَّهِ هُمُ الْكَاذِبُونَ
versets.phonetique: Lawla ja'u 'alayhi bi'arba'ati shuhadaa fa'idh lam ya'tu bish-shuhada'i fa'ula'ika 'indallahi humul-kadhibun
versets.francais: Pourquoi n'ont-ils pas produit quatre témoins ? Puisqu'ils n'ont pas apporté de témoins, ce sont eux qui sont les menteurs auprès d'Allah.
versets.anglais: Why did they [who slandered] not produce for it four witnesses? And when they do not produce the witnesses, then it is they, in the sight of Allah, who are the liars

versets.arabe: وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ لَمَسَّكُمْ فِي مَا أَفَضْتُمْ فِيهِ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa lawla fadlullahi 'alaykum wa rahmatuhu fid-dunya wal-akhirati lamassakum fima afadtum fihi 'adhabun 'azim
versets.francais: Sans la grâce d'Allah sur vous et Sa miséricorde dans ce monde et dans l'au-delà, un grave châtiment vous aurait atteint pour ce en quoi vous vous êtes répandus.
versets.anglais: And if it had not been for the favor of Allah upon you and His mercy in this world and the Hereafter, you would have been touched for that [lie] in which you were involved by a great punishment

versets.arabe: إِذْ تَلَقَّوْنَهُ بِأَلْسِنَتِكُمْ وَتَقُولُونَ بِأَفْوَاهِكُم مَّا لَيْسَ لَكُم بِهِ عِلْمٌ وَتَحْسَبُونَهُ هَيِّنًا وَهُوَ عِندَ اللَّهِ عَظِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Idh talaqqawnahu bi'alsinatikum wa taquluna bi'afwahikum ma laysa lakum bihi 'ilmuw wa tahsabunahu hayyinaw wa huwa 'indallahi 'azim
versets.francais: Quand vous le colportiez de bouche en bouche et disiez de vos bouches ce dont vous n'aviez aucune science, le considérant comme une chose légère alors qu'il est énorme auprès d'Allah.
versets.anglais: When you received it with your tongues and said with your mouths that of which you had no knowledge and thought it was insignificant while it was, in the sight of Allah, tremendous

versets.arabe: وَلَوْلَا إِذْ سَمِعْتُمُوهُ قُلْتُمْ مَّا يَكُونُ لَنَا أَن نَّتَكَلَّمَ بِهَٰذَا سُبْحَانَكَ هَٰذَا بُهْتَانٌ عَظِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa lawla idh sami'tumuhu qultum ma yakunu lana an natakallama bihadha subhanaaka hadha buhtanun 'azim
versets.francais: Et pourquoi, lorsque vous l'avez entendu, n'avez-vous pas dit : "Il ne nous appartient pas de dire cela. Gloire à Toi ! C'est là une énorme calomnie !"
versets.anglais: And why, when you heard it, did you not say, "It is not for us to speak of this. Exalted are You, [O Allah]; this is a great slander

versets.arabe: يَعِظُكُمُ اللَّهُ أَن تَعُودُوا لِمِثْلِهِ أَبَدًا إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Ya'idhukumullahu an ta'udu limithlihi abadan in kuntum mu'minin
versets.francais: Allah vous exhorte à ne plus jamais recommencer pareille chose, si vous êtes croyants.
versets.anglais: Allah warns you against returning to the likes of this [conduct], ever, if you should be believers

versets.arabe: وَيُبَيِّنُ اللَّهُ لَكُمُ الْآيَاتِ ۚ وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa yubayyinullahu lakumul-ayat wallahu 'alimun hakim
versets.francais: Et Allah vous explique les versets. Allah est Omniscient et Sage.
versets.anglais: And Allah makes clear to you the verses, and Allah is Knowing and Wise

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُحِبُّونَ أَن تَشِيعَ الْفَاحِشَةُ فِي الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ
versets.phonetique: Innal-ladhina yuhibbuna an tashiy'al-fahishatu fil-ladhina amanu lahum 'adhabun alimun fid-dunya wal-akhirah
versets.francais: Ceux qui aiment que le scandale se répande parmi les croyants auront un châtiment douloureux dans ce monde et dans l'au-delà.
versets.anglais: Indeed, those who like that immorality should be spread [or publicized] among those who have believed will have a painful punishment in this world and the Hereafter. And Allah knows and you do not know

versets.arabe: وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ رَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa lawla fadlullahi 'alaykum wa rahmatuhu wa annallaha ra'ufur-rahim
versets.francais: Sans la grâce d'Allah sur vous et Sa miséricorde, et qu'Allah est Compatissant et Miséricordieux...
versets.anglais: And if it had not been for the favor of Allah upon you and His mercy... and because Allah is Kind and Merciful

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تَتَّبِعُوا خُطُوَاتِ الشَّيْطَانِ ۚ وَمَن يَتَّبِعْ خُطُوَاتِ الشَّيْطَانِ فَإِنَّهُ يَأْمُرُ بِالْفَحْشَاءِ وَالْمُنكَرِ
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuhal-ladhina amanu la tattabi'u khutuwatish-shaytani wa may-yattabi'kkhutuwa tish-shaytani fa'innahu ya'muru bil-fahsha'i wal-munkar
versets.francais: Ô les croyants ! Ne suivez pas les pas du Diable. Quiconque suit les pas du Diable, c'est qu'il ordonne la turpitude et le blâmable.
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, do not follow the footsteps of Satan. And whoever follows the footsteps of Satan - indeed, he enjoins immorality and wrongdoing. And if not for the favor of Allah upon you and His mercy, not one of you would have been pure, ever, but Allah purifies whom He wills, and Allah is Hearing and Knowing

versets.arabe: وَلَا يَأْتَلِ أُولُو الْفَضْلِ مِنكُمْ وَالسَّعَةِ أَن يُؤْتُوا أُولِي الْقُرْبَىٰ وَالْمَسَاكِينَ وَالْمُهَاجِرِينَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ
versets.phonetique: Wa la ya'tali ulul-fadli minkum was-sa'ati ay yu'tu ulil-qurba wal-masakina wal-muhajirina fi sabilillah
versets.francais: Que les gens de mérite et d'aisance parmi vous ne jurent pas de ne plus donner aux proches parents, aux pauvres et à ceux qui ont émigré dans le chemin d'Allah.
versets.anglais: And let not those of virtue among you and wealth swear not to give [aid] to their relatives and the needy and the emigrants for the cause of Allah, and let them pardon and overlook. Would you not like that Allah should forgive you? And Allah is Forgiving and Merciful

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَرْمُونَ الْمُحْصَنَاتِ الْغَافِلَاتِ الْمُؤْمِنَاتِ لُعِنُوا فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Innal-ladhina yarmulnalmuhsanatil-ghafilatal-mu'minati lu'inu fid-dunya wal-akhirati wa lahum 'adhabun 'azim
versets.francais: Ceux qui lancent des accusations contre des femmes chastes, innocentes et croyantes sont maudits dans ce monde et dans l'au-delà et ils auront un grave châtiment.
versets.anglais: Indeed, those who [falsely] accuse chaste, unaware and believing women are cursed in this world and the Hereafter; and they will have a great punishment

versets.arabe: يَوْمَ تَشْهَدُ عَلَيْهِمْ أَلْسِنَتُهُمْ وَأَيْدِيهِمْ وَأَرْجُلُهُم بِمَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Yawma tashhadu 'alayhim alsinatuhum wa aydihim wa arjuluhum bima kanu ya'malun
versets.francais: Le Jour où leurs langues, leurs mains et leurs pieds témoigneront contre eux de ce qu'ils faisaient.
versets.anglais: On a Day when their tongues, their hands and their feet will bear witness against them as to what they used to do

versets.arabe: يَوْمَئِذٍ يُوَفِّيهِمُ اللَّهُ دِينَهُمُ الْحَقَّ وَيَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْحَقُّ الْمُبِينُ
versets.phonetique: Yawma'idhin yuwaffihimullahu dinahumul-haqqa wa ya'lamuna annallaha huwal-haqqul-mubin
versets.francais: Ce Jour-là, Allah leur rendra en totalité leur juste dû, et ils sauront qu'Allah est la Vérité manifeste.
versets.anglais: That Day, Allah will pay them in full their deserved recompense, and they will know that it is Allah who is the perfect in justice

versets.arabe: الْخَبِيثَاتُ لِلْخَبِيثِينَ وَالْخَبِيثُونَ لِلْخَبِيثَاتِ ۖ وَالطَّيِّبَاتُ لِلطَّيِّبِينَ وَالطَّيِّبُونَ لِلطَّيِّبَاتِ
versets.phonetique: Al-khabitihatu lil-khabithina wal-khabithuna lil-khabitihati wat-tayyibatu lil-tayyibina wat-tayyibuna lit-tayyibat
versets.francais: Les femmes impures sont pour les hommes impurs, et les hommes impurs pour les femmes impures. Les femmes pures sont pour les hommes purs, et les hommes purs pour les femmes pures.
versets.anglais: Evil words are for evil men, and evil men are [subjected] to evil words. And good words are for good men, and good men are [an object] of good words. Those [good people] are declared innocent of what the slanderers say. For them is forgiveness and noble provision

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تَدْخُلُوا بُيُوتًا غَيْرَ بُيُوتِكُمْ حَتَّىٰ تَسْتَأْنِسُوا وَتُسَلِّمُوا عَلَىٰ أَهْلِهَا
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuhal-ladhina amanu la tadkhulu buyutan ghayra buyutikum hatta tasta'nisu wa tusallmu 'ala ahliha
versets.francais: Ô les croyants ! N'entrez pas dans des maisons autres que les vôtres avant de demander la permission et de saluer leurs habitants.
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, do not enter houses other than your own houses until you ascertain welcome and greet their inhabitants. That is best for you; perhaps you will be reminded

versets.arabe: فَإِن لَّمْ تَجِدُوا فِيهَا أَحَدًا فَلَا تَدْخُلُوهَا حَتَّىٰ يُؤْذَنَ لَكُمْ ۖ وَإِن قِيلَ لَكُمُ ارْجِعُوا فَارْجِعُوا هُوَ أَزْكَىٰ لَكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Fa'in lam tajidu fiha ahadan fala tadkhuluha hatta yu'dhana lakum wa in qila lakumurji'u farji'u huwa azka lakum
versets.francais: Si vous n'y trouvez personne, n'y entrez pas jusqu'à ce qu'on vous y autorise. Et si on vous dit : "Retournez", retournez. C'est plus pur pour vous.
versets.anglais: And if you do not find anyone therein, do not enter them until permission has been given you. And if it is said to you, "Go back," then go back; it is purer for you. And Allah is Knowing of what you do

versets.arabe: لَّيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ أَن تَدْخُلُوا بُيُوتًا غَيْرَ مَسْكُونَةٍ فِيهَا مَتَاعٌ لَّكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Laysa 'alaykum junahun an tadkhulu buyutan ghayra maskunatin fiha mata'ul lakum
versets.francais: Il n'y a pas de faute pour vous à entrer dans des maisons non habitées où se trouvent vos effets.
versets.anglais: There is no blame upon you for entering houses not inhabited in which there is convenience for you. And Allah knows what you reveal and what you conceal

versets.arabe: قُل لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَغُضُّوا مِنْ أَبْصَارِهِمْ وَيَحْفَظُوا فُرُوجَهُمْ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ أَزْكَىٰ لَهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Qul lil-mu'minina yaghudddu min absarihim wa yahfadhu furujahum dhalika azka lahum
versets.francais: Dis aux croyants de baisser leurs regards et de garder leur chasteté. C'est plus pur pour eux.
versets.anglais: Tell the believing men to reduce [some] of their vision and guard their private parts. That is purer for them. Indeed, Allah is Acquainted with what they do

versets.arabe: وَقُل لِّلْمُؤْمِنَاتِ يَغْضُضْنَ مِنْ أَبْصَارِهِنَّ وَيَحْفَظْنَ فُرُوجَهُنَّ وَلَا يُبْدِينَ زِينَتَهُنَّ إِلَّا مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا
versets.phonetique: Wa qul lil-mu'minati yaghdudna min absarihinna wa yahfadhna furujahunna wa la yubdina zinatahunna illa ma dhahara minha
versets.francais: Et dis aux croyantes de baisser leurs regards, de garder leur chasteté, et de ne montrer de leurs atours que ce qui en paraît.
versets.anglais: And tell the believing women to reduce [some] of their vision and guard their private parts and not expose their adornment except that which [necessarily] appears thereof and to wrap [a portion of] their headcovers over their chests and not expose their adornment except to their husbands, their fathers, their husbands' fathers, their sons, their husbands' sons, their brothers, their brothers' sons, their sisters' sons, their women, that which their right hands possess, or those male attendants having no physical desire, or children who are not yet aware of the private aspects of women. And let them not stamp their feet to make known what they conceal of their adornment. And turn to Allah in repentance, all of you, O believers, that you might succeed

versets.arabe: وَأَنكِحُوا الْأَيَامَىٰ مِنكُمْ وَالصَّالِحِينَ مِنْ عِبَادِكُمْ وَإِمَائِكُمْ ۚ إِن يَكُونُوا فُقَرَاءَ يُغْنِهِمُ اللَّهُ مِن فَضْلِهِ
versets.phonetique: Wa ankihul-ayama minkum was-salihina min 'ibadikum wa ima'ikum in yakunu fuqara'a yughnihumullahu min fadlih
versets.francais: Mariez les célibataires d'entre vous et les gens de bien parmi vos serviteurs et vos servantes. S'ils sont pauvres, Allah les enrichira de Sa grâce.
versets.anglais: And marry the unmarried among you and the righteous among your male slaves and female slaves. If they should be poor, Allah will enrich them from His bounty, and Allah is all-Encompassing and Knowing

versets.arabe: وَلْيَسْتَعْفِفِ الَّذِينَ لَا يَجِدُونَ نِكَاحًا حَتَّىٰ يُغْنِيَهُمُ اللَّهُ مِن فَضْلِهِ
versets.phonetique: Walyasta'fifil-ladhina la yajiduna nikahan hatta yughnihumullahu min fadlih
versets.francais: Que ceux qui ne trouvent pas de quoi se marier s'abstiennent jusqu'à ce qu'Allah les enrichisse de Sa grâce.
versets.anglais: But let them who find not [the means for] marriage abstain [from sexual relations] until Allah enriches them from His bounty. And those who seek a contract [for eventual emancipation] from among whom your right hands possess - then make a contract with them if you know there is within them goodness and give them from the wealth of Allah which He has given you. And do not compel your slave girls to prostitution, if they desire chastity, to seek [thereby] the temporary interests of worldly life. And if someone should compel them, then indeed, Allah is [to them], after their compulsion, Forgiving and Merciful

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ أَنزَلْنَا إِلَيْكُمْ آيَاتٍ مُّبَيِّنَاتٍ وَمَثَلًا مِّنَ الَّذِينَ خَلَوْا مِن قَبْلِكُمْ وَمَوْعِظَةً لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa laqad anzalna ilaykum ayatim mubayyinatiw wa mathalm minal-ladhina khalaw min qablikum wa maw'idhatal lil-muttaqin
versets.francais: Nous avons certes fait descendre vers vous des versets explicatifs, des exemples tirés de ceux qui ont vécu avant vous et une exhortation pour les pieux.
versets.anglais: And We have certainly sent down to you distinct verses and examples from those who passed on before you and an admonition for those who fear Allah

versets.arabe: اللَّهُ نُورُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۚ مَثَلُ نُورِهِ كَمِشْكَاةٍ فِيهَا مِصْبَاحٌ ۖ الْمِصْبَاحُ فِي زُجَاجَةٍ ۖ الزُّجَاجَةُ كَأَنَّهَا كَوْكَبٌ دُرِّيٌّ
versets.phonetique: Allahu nurus-samawati wal-ard mathalu nurihi kamishkatin fiha misbahul misbahu fi zujajah az-zujajatu ka'annaha kawkabun durriyyun
versets.francais: Allah est la Lumière des cieux et de la terre. Sa lumière est comparable à une niche où se trouve une lampe ; la lampe est dans un verre, le verre est comme un astre brillant.
versets.anglais: Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth. The example of His light is like a niche within which is a lamp, the lamp is within glass, the glass as if it were a pearly [white] star lit from [the oil of] a blessed olive tree, neither of the east nor of the west, whose oil would almost glow even if untouched by fire. Light upon light. Allah guides to His light whom He wills. And Allah presents examples for the people, and Allah is Knowing of all things

versets.arabe: فِي بُيُوتٍ أَذِنَ اللَّهُ أَن تُرْفَعَ وَيُذْكَرَ فِيهَا اسْمُهُ يُسَبِّحُ لَهُ فِيهَا بِالْغُدُوِّ وَالْآصَالِ
versets.phonetique: Fi buyutin adhinallaahu an turfa'a wa yudhkara fihasmuhu yusabbihu lahu fiha bil-ghuduwwi wal-asal
versets.francais: Dans des maisons qu'Allah a permis d'élever et où Son nom est mentionné. On y célèbre Sa gloire matin et soir.
versets.anglais: [Such niches are] in mosques which Allah has ordered to be raised and that His name be mentioned therein; exalting Him within them in the morning and the evenings

versets.arabe: رِجَالٌ لَّا تُلْهِيهِمْ تِجَارَةٌ وَلَا بَيْعٌ عَن ذِكْرِ اللَّهِ وَإِقَامِ الصَّلَاةِ وَإِيتَاءِ الزَّكَاةِ
versets.phonetique: Rija lul la tulhihim tijaratuw wa la bay'un 'an dhikrillahi wa iqamis-salati wa ita'iz-zakah
versets.francais: Des hommes que ni le commerce ni la vente ne distraient du rappel d'Allah, de l'accomplissement de la prière et de l'acquittement de la zakat.
versets.anglais: [Are] men whom neither commerce nor sale distracts from the remembrance of Allah and performance of prayer and giving of zakah. They fear a Day in which the hearts and eyes will [fearfully] turn about

versets.arabe: لِيَجْزِيَهُمُ اللَّهُ أَحْسَنَ مَا عَمِلُوا وَيَزِيدَهُم مِّن فَضْلِهِ ۗ وَاللَّهُ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَشَاءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
versets.phonetique: Liyajziyahumullahu ahsana ma 'amilu wa yazidahum min fadlih wallahu yarzuqu may yasha'u bighayri hisab
versets.francais: Afin qu'Allah les récompense de la meilleure de leurs actions et leur en donne davantage de Sa grâce. Allah pourvoit à qui Il veut sans compter.
versets.anglais: That Allah may reward them [according to] the best of what they did and increase them from His bounty. And Allah gives provision to whom He wills without account

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا أَعْمَالُهُمْ كَسَرَابٍ بِقِيعَةٍ يَحْسَبُهُ الظَّمْآنُ مَاءً حَتَّىٰ إِذَا جَاءَهُ لَمْ يَجِدْهُ شَيْئًا
versets.phonetique: Walladhina kafaru a'maluhum kasarabin biqiy'atin yahsabuhu-ddhama'anu ma'an hatta idha ja'ahu lam yajidhu shay'a
versets.francais: Les œuvres des mécréants sont comme un mirage dans une plaine désertique : l'assoiffé le prend pour de l'eau, mais quand il y arrive il ne trouve rien.
versets.anglais: But those who disbelieved - their deeds are like a mirage in a lowland which a thirsty one thinks is water until, when he comes to it, he finds it is nothing but finds Allah before Him, and He will pay him in full his due; and Allah is swift in account

versets.arabe: أَوْ كَظُلُمَاتٍ فِي بَحْرٍ لُّجِّيٍّ يَغْشَاهُ مَوْجٌ مِّن فَوْقِهِ مَوْجٌ مِّن فَوْقِهِ سَحَابٌ ۚ ظُلُمَاتٌ بَعْضُهَا فَوْقَ بَعْضٍ
versets.phonetique: Aw kadhulumatin fi bahril lujjiyyin yaghshahu mawjum min fawqihi mawjum min fawqihi sahabun dhulumatun ba'duha fawqa ba'd
versets.francais: Ou comme des ténèbres dans une mer profonde, recouvertes de vagues, au-dessus desquelles il y a des vagues, au-dessus desquelles il y a des nuages. Des ténèbres les unes au-dessus des autres.
versets.anglais: Or [they are] like darknesses within an unfathomable sea which is covered by waves, upon which are waves, over which are clouds - darknesses, some of them upon others. When one puts out his hand [therein], he can hardly see it. And he to whom Allah has not granted light - for him there is no light

versets.arabe: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ يُسَبِّحُ لَهُ مَن فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَالطَّيْرُ صَافَّاتٍ ۖ كُلٌّ قَدْ عَلِمَ صَلَاتَهُ وَتَسْبِيحَهُ
versets.phonetique: Alam tara annallaha yusabbihu lahu man fis-samawati wal-ardi wat-tayru saffatin kullun qad 'alima salatahu wa tasbihah
versets.francais: N'as-tu pas vu que tout ce qui est dans les cieux et sur la terre glorifie Allah, ainsi que les oiseaux aux ailes déployées ? Chacun connaît sa prière et sa glorification.
versets.anglais: Do you not see that Allah is exalted by whomever is within the heavens and the earth and [by] the birds with wings spread [in flight]? Each [of them] has known his [means of] prayer and exalting [Him], and Allah is Knowing of what they do

versets.arabe: وَلِلَّهِ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۖ وَإِلَى اللَّهِ الْمَصِيرُ
versets.phonetique: Wa lillahi mulkus-samawati wal-ard wa ilallahil-masir
versets.francais: A Allah appartient la royauté des cieux et de la terre, et c'est vers Allah que se fera le retour.
versets.anglais: And to Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth, and to Allah is the destination

versets.arabe: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ يُزْجِي سَحَابًا ثُمَّ يُؤَلِّفُ بَيْنَهُ ثُمَّ يَجْعَلُهُ رُكَامًا فَتَرَى الْوَدْقَ يَخْرُجُ مِنْ خِلَالِهِ
versets.phonetique: Alam tara annallaha yuzji sahabaan thumma yu'allifu baynahu thumma yaj'aluhu rukaman fatara-l-wadqa yakhruju min khilalih
versets.francais: N'as-tu pas vu qu'Allah pousse les nuages, puis les assemble et les entasse ? Tu vois alors la pluie sortir de leur sein.
versets.anglais: Do you not see that Allah drives clouds? Then He brings them together, then He makes them into a mass, and you see the rain emerge from within it. And He sends down from the sky, mountains [of clouds] within which is hail, and He strikes with it whom He wills and averts it from whom He wills. The flash of its lightening almost takes away the eyesight

versets.arabe: يُقَلِّبُ اللَّهُ اللَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ ۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةً لِّأُولِي الْأَبْصَارِ
versets.phonetique: Yuqallibullahul-layla wan-nahar inna fi dhalika la'ibratal li'ulil-absar
versets.francais: Allah fait alterner la nuit et le jour. Il y a là une leçon pour ceux qui ont de la perspicacité.
versets.anglais: Allah alternates the night and the day. Indeed in that is a lesson for those who have vision

versets.arabe: وَاللَّهُ خَلَقَ كُلَّ دَابَّةٍ مِّن مَّاءٍ ۖ فَمِنْهُم مَّن يَمْشِي عَلَىٰ بَطْنِهِ وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَمْشِي عَلَىٰ رِجْلَيْنِ وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَمْشِي عَلَىٰ أَرْبَعٍ
versets.phonetique: Wallahu khalaqa kulla dabbatin mim ma'in faminhum may yamshi 'ala batnihi wa minhum may yamshi 'ala rijlayni wa minhum may yamshi 'ala arba'
versets.francais: Allah a créé tout animal à partir de l'eau. Parmi eux, certains marchent sur le ventre, d'autres sur deux pattes, d'autres sur quatre.
versets.anglais: Allah has created every [living] creature from water. And of them are those that move on their bellies, and of them are those that walk on two legs, and of them are those that walk on four. Allah creates what He wills. Indeed, Allah is over all things competent

versets.arabe: لَّقَدْ أَنزَلْنَا آيَاتٍ مُّبَيِّنَاتٍ ۚ وَاللَّهُ يَهْدِي مَن يَشَاءُ إِلَىٰ صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
versets.phonetique: Laqad anzalna ayatim mubayyinat wallahu yahdi may yasha'u ila siratin mustaqim
versets.francais: Nous avons fait descendre des versets explicatifs. Allah guide qui Il veut vers un droit chemin.
versets.anglais: We have certainly sent down distinct verses. And Allah guides whom He wills to a straight path

versets.arabe: وَيَقُولُونَ آمَنَّا بِاللَّهِ وَبِالرَّسُولِ وَأَطَعْنَا ثُمَّ يَتَوَلَّىٰ فَرِيقٌ مِّنْهُم مِّن بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ
versets.phonetique: Wa yaquluna amanna billahi wa bir-rasuli wa ata'na thumma yatawalla fariqum minhum mim ba'di dhalik
versets.francais: Ils disent : "Nous croyons en Allah et au Messager et nous obéissons." Puis un groupe d'entre eux se détourne après cela.
versets.anglais: But the hypocrites say, "We have believed in Allah and in the Messenger, and we obey"; then a party of them turns away after that. And those are not believers

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا دُعُوا إِلَى اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ لِيَحْكُمَ بَيْنَهُمْ إِذَا فَرِيقٌ مِّنْهُم مُّعْرِضُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa idha du'u ilallahi wa rasulihi liyahkuma baynahum idha fariqum minhum mu'ridun
versets.francais: Quand on les appelle vers Allah et Son messager pour qu'il juge entre eux, voilà qu'un groupe d'entre eux se détourne.
versets.anglais: And when they are called to [the words of] Allah and His Messenger to judge between them, at once a party of them turns aside [in refusal]

versets.arabe: وَإِن يَكُن لَّهُمُ الْحَقُّ يَأْتُوا إِلَيْهِ مُذْعِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa iy yakun lahumul-haqqu ya'tu ilayhi mudh'inin
versets.francais: Mais si le droit est de leur côté, ils viennent à lui avec empressement.
versets.anglais: But if the right is theirs, they come to him in prompt obedience

versets.arabe: أَفِي قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ أَمِ ارْتَابُوا أَمْ يَخَافُونَ أَن يَحِيفَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَرَسُولُهُ
versets.phonetique: Afi qulubihim maradun amir-tabu am yakhafuna ay yahifallahu 'alayhim wa rasuluh
versets.francais: Y a-t-il une maladie dans leurs cœurs ? Ou doutent-ils ? Ou craignent-ils qu'Allah et Son messager leur soient injustes ?
versets.anglais: Is there disease in their hearts? Or have they doubted? Or do they fear that Allah will be unjust to them, or His Messenger? Rather, it is they who are the wrongdoers

versets.arabe: إِنَّمَا كَانَ قَوْلَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ إِذَا دُعُوا إِلَى اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ لِيَحْكُمَ بَيْنَهُمْ أَن يَقُولُوا سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا
versets.phonetique: Innama kana qawlal-mu'minina idha du'u ilallahi wa rasulihi liyahkuma baynahum an yaqulu sami'na wa ata'na
versets.francais: La seule parole des croyants quand on les appelle vers Allah et Son messager pour qu'il juge entre eux, c'est de dire : "Nous avons entendu et nous obéissons."
versets.anglais: The only statement of the [true] believers when they are called to Allah and His Messenger to judge between them is that they say, "We hear and we obey." And those are the successful

versets.arabe: وَمَن يُطِعِ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَيَخْشَ اللَّهَ وَيَتَّقْهِ فَأُولَٰئِكَ هُمُ الْفَائِزُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa may yuti'illaha wa rasulahu wa yakhshallaha wa yattaqhi fa'ula'ika humul-fa'izun
versets.francais: Quiconque obéit à Allah et à Son messager, craint Allah et Le redoute, ceux-là sont les victorieux.
versets.anglais: And whoever obeys Allah and His Messenger and fears Allah and is conscious of Him - it is those who are the attainers

versets.arabe: وَأَقْسَمُوا بِاللَّهِ جَهْدَ أَيْمَانِهِمْ لَئِنْ أَمَرْتَهُمْ لَيَخْرُجُنَّ ۖ قُل لَّا تُقْسِمُوا ۖ طَاعَةٌ مَّعْرُوفَةٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa aqsamu billahi jahda aymanihim la'in amartahum layakhrujunna qul la tuqsimu ta'atun ma'rufah
versets.francais: Ils jurent par Allah de leurs serments les plus solennels que si tu leur commandes, ils sortiront sûrement. Dis : "Ne jurez pas. L'obéissance convenable suffit."
versets.anglais: And they swear by Allah their strongest oaths that if you ordered them, they would go forth [in Allah 's cause]. Say, "Do not swear. [Such] obedience is known. Indeed, Allah is Acquainted with that which you do

versets.arabe: قُلْ أَطِيعُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُوا الرَّسُولَ ۖ فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا فَإِنَّمَا عَلَيْهِ مَا حُمِّلَ وَعَلَيْكُم مَّا حُمِّلْتُمْ
versets.phonetique: Qul ati'ullaha wa ati'ur-rasul fa'in tawallaw fa'innama 'alayhi ma hummila wa 'alaykum ma hummiltum
versets.francais: Dis : "Obéissez à Allah et obéissez au Messager." S'ils se détournent, il n'est responsable que de ce dont il a été chargé et vous l'êtes de ce dont vous avez été chargés.
versets.anglais: Say, "Obey Allah and obey the Messenger; but if you turn away - then upon him is only that [duty] with which he has been charged, and upon you is that with which you have been charged. And if you obey him, you will be [rightly] guided. And there is not upon the Messenger except the [responsibility for] clear notification

versets.arabe: وَعَدَ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا مِنكُمْ وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَيَسْتَخْلِفَنَّهُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ كَمَا اسْتَخْلَفَ الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ
versets.phonetique: Wa'adallahulladhina amanu minkum wa amilussalihati layastakhlifannahum fil-ardi kamastak-khalafal-ladhina min qablihim
versets.francais: Allah a promis à ceux d'entre vous qui croient et font de bonnes œuvres de les établir sur la terre comme Il a établi ceux qui étaient avant eux.
versets.anglais: Allah has promised those who have believed among you and done righteous deeds that He will surely grant them succession [to authority] upon the earth just as He granted it to those before them and that He will surely establish for them [therein] their religion which He has preferred for them and that He will surely substitute for them, after their fear, security, [for] they worship Me, not associating anything with Me. But whoever disbelieves after that - then those are the defiantly disobedient

versets.arabe: وَلَيُمَكِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ دِينَهُمُ الَّذِي ارْتَضَىٰ لَهُمْ وَلَيُبَدِّلَنَّهُم مِّن بَعْدِ خَوْفِهِمْ أَمْنًا
versets.phonetique: Wa layumakkiannna lahum dinahumulladhir-tada lahum wa layu-baddilannahum mim ba'di khawfihim amna
versets.francais: Et d'affermir pour eux leur religion qu'Il a agréée pour eux et de leur substituer la sécurité à leur crainte.
versets.anglais: And establish prayer and give zakah and obey the Messenger - that you may receive mercy

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَكَذَّبُوا بِآيَاتِنَا فَأُولَٰئِكَ هُمُ الْفَاسِقُونَ
versets.phonetique: Walladhina kafaru wa kadhdhabu bi'ayatina fa'ula'ika humul-fasiqun
versets.francais: Ceux qui ont mécru et traité Nos versets de mensonges, ceux-là sont les pervers.
versets.anglais: Never think that the disbelievers are causing failure [to Allah] upon the earth. Their refuge will be the Fire - and how wretched the destination

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لِيَسْتَأْذِنكُمُ الَّذِينَ مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُكُمْ وَالَّذِينَ لَمْ يَبْلُغُوا الْحُلُمَ مِنكُمْ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuhal-ladhina amanu lyasta'dhinkumul-ladhina malakat aymanukum walladhina lam yablughul-huluma minkum thalatha marrat
versets.francais: Ô les croyants ! Que ceux que vous possédez et ceux d'entre vous qui n'ont pas encore atteint la puberté vous demandent permission à trois moments.
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, let those whom your right hands possess and those who have not [yet] reached puberty among you ask permission of you [before entering] at three times: before the dawn prayer and when you put aside your clothing [for rest] at noon and after the night prayer. [These are] three times of privacy for you. There is no blame upon you nor upon them beyond these [periods], for they continually circulate among you - some of you, among others. Thus does Allah make clear to you the verses; and Allah is Knowing and Wise

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا بَلَغَ الْأَطْفَالُ مِنكُمُ الْحُلُمَ فَلْيَسْتَأْذِنُوا كَمَا اسْتَأْذَنَ الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ
versets.phonetique: Wa idha balaghattfaluminkumul huluma falyasta'dhinu kamas-ta'dhanal-ladhina min qablihim
versets.francais: Quand les enfants parmi vous ont atteint la puberté, qu'ils demandent permission comme leurs aînés l'ont fait.
versets.anglais: And when the children among you reach puberty, let them ask permission [at all times] as those before them have done. Thus does Allah make clear to you His verses; and Allah is Knowing and Wise

versets.arabe: وَالْقَوَاعِدُ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ اللَّاتِي لَا يَرْجُونَ نِكَاحًا فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهِنَّ جُنَاحٌ أَن يَضَعْنَ ثِيَابَهُنَّ غَيْرَ مُتَبَرِّجَاتٍ بِزِينَةٍ
versets.phonetique: Wal-qawa'idu minan-nisa'illatee la yarjuna nikahan falaysa 'alayhinna junahun ay yada'na thiyabahunna ghayra mutabarrijatin bizinatih
versets.francais: Les femmes âgées qui n'espèrent plus se marier ne commettent pas de faute en ôtant leurs vêtements de dessus, à condition de ne pas faire étalage de leurs atours.
versets.anglais: And women of post-menstrual age who have no desire for marriage - there is no blame upon them for putting aside their outer garments [but] not displaying adornment. But to modestly refrain [from that] is better for them. And Allah is Hearing and Knowing

versets.arabe: لَّيْسَ عَلَى الْأَعْمَىٰ حَرَجٌ وَلَا عَلَى الْأَعْرَجِ حَرَجٌ وَلَا عَلَى الْمَرِيضِ حَرَجٌ وَلَا عَلَىٰ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَن تَأْكُلُوا مِن بُيُوتِكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Laysa 'alal-a'ma harajuw wa la 'alal-a'raji harajuw wa la 'alal-maridi harajuw wa la 'ala anfusikum an ta'kulu mim buyutikum
versets.francais: Nul grief sur l'aveugle, nul grief sur le boiteux, nul grief sur le malade, ni sur vous-mêmes de manger dans vos propres maisons.
versets.anglais: There is not upon the blind [any] constraint nor upon the lame constraint nor upon the ill constraint nor upon yourselves when you eat from your [own] houses or the houses of your fathers or the houses of your mothers or the houses of your brothers or the houses of your sisters or the houses of your father's brothers or the houses of your father's sisters or the houses of your mother's brothers or the houses of your mother's sisters or [from houses] whose keys you possess or [from the house] of your friend. There is no blame upon you whether you eat together or separately. But when you enter houses, give greetings of peace upon each other - a greeting from Allah, blessed and good. Thus does Allah make clear to you the verses [of ordinance] that you may understand

versets.arabe: إِنَّمَا الْمُؤْمِنُونَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَإِذَا كَانُوا مَعَهُ عَلَىٰ أَمْرٍ جَامِعٍ لَّمْ يَذْهَبُوا حَتَّىٰ يَسْتَأْذِنُوهُ
versets.phonetique: Innamal-mu'minunal-ladhina amanu billahi wa rasulihi wa idha kanu ma'ahu 'ala amrin jami'il lam yadhabu hatta yasta'dhinuh
versets.francais: Les vrais croyants sont ceux qui croient en Allah et en Son messager et qui, quand ils sont avec lui pour une affaire commune, ne s'en vont pas sans lui demander permission.
versets.anglais: The believers are only those who believe in Allah and His Messenger and, when they are [meeting] with him for a matter of common interest, do not depart until they have asked his permission. Indeed, those who ask your permission, [O Muhammad] - those are the ones who believe in Allah and His Messenger. So when they ask your permission for something of their affairs, then give permission to whom you will among them and ask forgiveness for them of Allah. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful

versets.arabe: لَّا تَجْعَلُوا دُعَاءَ الرَّسُولِ بَيْنَكُمْ كَدُعَاءِ بَعْضِكُم بَعْضًا ۚ قَدْ يَعْلَمُ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ يَتَسَلَّلُونَ مِنكُمْ لِوَاذًا
versets.phonetique: La taj'alu du'a'ar-rasuli baynakum kadu'a'i ba'dikum ba'da qad ya'lamullahulladhina yataSalaluna minkum liwadha
versets.francais: Ne traitez pas l'appel du Messager entre vous comme vous vous appelez les uns les autres. Allah connaît certes ceux d'entre vous qui s'esquivent discrètement.
versets.anglais: Do not make [your] calling of the Messenger among yourselves as the call of one of you to another. Already Allah knows those of you who slip away, concealed by others. So let those beware who dissent from the Prophet's order, lest fitnah strike them or a painful punishment

versets.arabe: أَلَا إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۖ قَدْ يَعْلَمُ مَا أَنتُمْ عَلَيْهِ
versets.phonetique: Ala inna lillahi ma fis-samawati wal-ard qad ya'lamu ma antum 'alayh
versets.francais: À Allah appartient certes ce qui est dans les cieux et sur la terre. Il connaît parfaitement votre état.
versets.anglais: Unquestionably, to Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and earth. Already He knows that upon which you [stand] and [knows] the Day when they will be returned to Him and He will inform them of what they have done. And Allah is Knowing of all things

versets.arabe: تَبَارَكَ الَّذِي نَزَّلَ الْفُرْقَانَ عَلَىٰ عَبْدِهِ لِيَكُونَ لِلْعَالَمِينَ نَذِيرًا
versets.phonetique: Tabarakal-ladhee nazzalal-furqana 'ala 'abdihi liakuna lil-'alamina nadhira
versets.francais: Béni soit Celui qui a révélé le Discernement à Son serviteur pour être un avertisseur pour les mondes.
versets.anglais: Blessed is He who sent down the Criterion upon His Servant that he may be to the worlds a warner

versets.arabe: الَّذِي لَهُ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَلَمْ يَتَّخِذْ وَلَدًا وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ شَرِيكٌ فِي الْمُلْكِ
versets.phonetique: Alladhee lahu mulkus-samawati wal-ardi wa lam yattakhidh waladaw wa lam yakun lahu sharikun fil-mulk
versets.francais: À qui appartient la royauté des cieux et de la terre. Il n'a pas pris d'enfant et n'a pas d'associé dans la royauté.
versets.anglais: He to whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and who has not taken a son and has not had a partner in dominion and has created each thing and determined it with [precise] determination

versets.arabe: وَاتَّخَذُوا مِن دُونِهِ آلِهَةً لَّا يَخْلُقُونَ شَيْئًا وَهُمْ يُخْلَقُونَ وَلَا يَمْلِكُونَ لِأَنفُسِهِمْ ضَرًّا وَلَا نَفْعًا
versets.phonetique: Wattakhadhu min dunihi alihatal la yakhluquna shay'aw wa hum yukhlaquna wa la yamlikuna li'anfusihim darraw wa la naf'a
versets.francais: Ils ont pris en dehors de Lui des divinités qui ne créent rien et qui sont elles-mêmes créées, et qui ne possèdent pour elles-mêmes ni mal ni bien.
versets.anglais: But they have taken besides Him gods which create nothing, while they are created, and possess not for themselves any harm or benefit and possess not [power to cause] death or life or resurrection

versets.arabe: وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا إِنْ هَٰذَا إِلَّا إِفْكٌ افْتَرَاهُ وَأَعَانَهُ عَلَيْهِ قَوْمٌ آخَرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa qalal-ladhina kafaru in hadha illa ifkunif-taraahu wa a'anahu 'alayhi qawmun akharun
versets.francais: Les mécréants ont dit : "Ce n'est là qu'un mensonge qu'il a inventé avec l'aide d'autres gens."
versets.anglais: And those who disbelieve say, "This [Qur'an] is not except a falsehood he invented, and another people assisted him in it." But they have committed an injustice and a lie

versets.arabe: وَقَالُوا أَسَاطِيرُ الْأَوَّلِينَ اكْتَتَبَهَا فَهِيَ تُمْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا
versets.phonetique: Wa qalu asatirul-awwaliniktatabaha fahiya tumla 'alayhi bukrataw wa asila
versets.francais: Ils ont dit : "Ce sont des contes des anciens qu'il a fait transcrire et qui lui sont dictés matin et soir."
versets.anglais: And they say, "Legends of the former peoples which he has written down, and they are dictated to him morning and afternoon

versets.arabe: قُلْ أَنزَلَهُ الَّذِي يَعْلَمُ السِّرَّ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۚ إِنَّهُ كَانَ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا
versets.phonetique: Qul anzalahulladhee ya'lamus-sirra fis-samawati wal-ard innahu kana ghafururrahim
versets.francais: Dis : "C'est Celui qui connaît le secret des cieux et de la terre qui l'a révélé. Il est certes Pardonneur et Miséricordieux."
versets.anglais: Say, [O Muhammad], "It has been revealed by He who knows [every] secret within the heavens and the earth. Indeed, He is ever Forgiving and Merciful

versets.arabe: وَقَالُوا مَالِ هَٰذَا الرَّسُولِ يَأْكُلُ الطَّعَامَ وَيَمْشِي فِي الْأَسْوَاقِ ۙ لَوْلَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مَلَكٌ فَيَكُونَ مَعَهُ نَذِيرًا
versets.phonetique: Wa qalu malihad-dar-rasuli ya'kulut-ta'ama wa yamshi fil-aswaqi lawla unzila ilayhi malakun fayakuna ma'ahu nadhira
versets.francais: Ils ont dit : "Qu'a donc ce messager à manger de la nourriture et à aller dans les marchés ? Que n'a-t-on fait descendre vers lui un ange pour être avec lui un avertisseur ?"
versets.anglais: And they say, "What is this messenger that eats food and walks in the markets? Why was there not sent down to him an angel so he would be with him a warner

versets.arabe: أَوْ يُلْقَىٰ إِلَيْهِ كَنزٌ أَوْ تَكُونُ لَهُ جَنَّةٌ يَأْكُلُ مِنْهَا ۚ وَقَالَ الظَّالِمُونَ إِن تَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا رَجُلًا مَّسْحُورًا
versets.phonetique: Aw yulqa ilayhi kanzun aw takunu lahu jannatuy ya'kulu minha wa qalad-dhalimuna in tattabi'una illa rajulam mashura
versets.francais: "Ou qu'on lui ait jeté un trésor, ou qu'il ait un jardin dont il mange." Les injustes ont dit : "Vous ne suivez qu'un homme ensorcelé."
versets.anglais: Or [why is not] a treasure presented to him [from heaven], or does he [not] have a garden from which he eats?" And the wrongdoers say, "You follow not but a man affected by magic

versets.arabe: انظُرْ كَيْفَ ضَرَبُوا لَكَ الْأَمْثَالَ فَضَلُّوا فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ سَبِيلًا
versets.phonetique: Undhur kayfa darabu lakal-amthala fadallu fala yastati'una sabila
versets.francais: Regarde comme ils ont forgé des exemples à ton sujet. Ils se sont égarés et ne peuvent trouver un chemin.
versets.anglais: Look how they strike for you comparisons; but they have strayed, so they cannot [find] a way

versets.arabe: تَبَارَكَ الَّذِي إِن شَاءَ جَعَلَ لَكَ خَيْرًا مِّن ذَٰلِكَ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ وَيَجْعَل لَّكَ قُصُورًا
versets.phonetique: Tabarakal-ladhee in sha'a ja'ala laka khayram min dhalika jannatin tajri min tahtihal-anharu wa yaj'al laka qusura
versets.francais: Béni soit Celui qui, s'Il le voulait, te donnerait mieux que cela : des jardins sous lesquels coulent les ruisseaux, et Il te ferait des palais.
versets.anglais: Blessed is He who, if He willed, could have made for you [something] better than that - gardens beneath which rivers flow - and could make for you palaces

versets.arabe: بَلْ كَذَّبُوا بِالسَّاعَةِ ۖ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لِمَن كَذَّبَ بِالسَّاعَةِ سَعِيرًا
versets.phonetique: Bal kadhdhabu bis-sa'ati wa a'tadna liman kadhdhaba bis-sa'ati sa'ira
versets.francais: Non, ils traitent de mensonge l'Heure. Nous avons préparé un brasier pour ceux qui traitent l'Heure de mensonge.
versets.anglais: But they have denied the Hour, and We have prepared for those who deny the Hour a Blaze

versets.arabe: إِذَا رَأَتْهُم مِّن مَّكَانٍ بَعِيدٍ سَمِعُوا لَهَا تَغَيُّظًا وَزَفِيرًا
versets.phonetique: Idha ra'athum mim makanin ba'idin sami'u laha taghayyudhan wa zafira
versets.francais: Quand il les verra de loin, ils entendront sa fureur et ses mugissements.
versets.anglais: When the Hellfire sees them from a distant place, they will hear its fury and roaring

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا أُلْقُوا مِنْهَا مَكَانًا ضَيِّقًا مُّقَرَّنِينَ دَعَوْا هُنَالِكَ ثُبُورًا
versets.phonetique: Wa idha ulqu minha makanand-dayyiqam muqarranina da'aw hunalika thubbura
versets.francais: Et quand on les y jettera dans un endroit étroit, enchaînés, ils appelleront là la destruction.
versets.anglais: And when they are thrown into a narrow place therein bound in chains, they will cry out thereupon for destruction

versets.arabe: لَّا تَدْعُوا الْيَوْمَ ثُبُورًا وَاحِدًا وَادْعُوا ثُبُورًا كَثِيرًا
versets.phonetique: La tad'ul-yawma thubura wahidaw wad'u thubura kathira
versets.francais: "N'appelez pas aujourd'hui une seule destruction mais appelez beaucoup de destructions !"
versets.anglais: [They will be told], "Do not cry this Day for one destruction but cry for much destruction

versets.arabe: قُلْ أَذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ أَمْ جَنَّةُ الْخُلْدِ الَّتِي وُعِدَ الْمُتَّقُونَ ۚ كَانَتْ لَهُمْ جَزَاءً وَمَصِيرًا
versets.phonetique: Qul adhalika khayrun am jannatul-khuldillatee wu'idal-muttaqun kanat lahum jaza'aw wa masira
versets.francais: Dis : "Est-ce cela qui est meilleur ou le Paradis d'éternité qui a été promis aux pieux ?" Il sera pour eux une récompense et un retour.
versets.anglais: Say, "Is that better or the Garden of Eternity which is promised to the righteous? It will be for them a reward and destination

versets.arabe: لَّهُمْ فِيهَا مَا يَشَاءُونَ خَالِدِينَ ۚ كَانَ عَلَىٰ رَبِّكَ وَعْدًا مَّسْئُولًا
versets.phonetique: Lahum fiha ma yasha'una khalidin kana 'ala rabbika wa'dam mas'ula
versets.francais: Ils y auront ce qu'ils désirent et ils y demeureront éternellement. C'est une promesse que ton Seigneur doit tenir.
versets.anglais: For them therein is whatever they wish, [while] abiding eternally. It is ever upon your Lord a promise [worthy to be] requested

versets.arabe: وَيَوْمَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ وَمَا يَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ فَيَقُولُ أَأَنتُمْ أَضْلَلْتُمْ عِبَادِي هَٰؤُلَاءِ أَمْ هُمْ ضَلُّوا السَّبِيلَ
versets.phonetique: Wa yawma yahshuruhum wa ma ya'buduna min dunillahi fayaqulu a'antum adlaltum 'ibadi ha'ula'i am hum dallus-sabil
versets.francais: Le Jour où Il les rassemblera ainsi que ceux qu'ils adoraient en dehors d'Allah, Il dira : "Est-ce vous qui avez égaré Mes serviteurs que voilà, ou se sont-ils eux-mêmes égarés ?"
versets.anglais: And [mention] the Day He will gather them and that which they worship besides Allah and will say, "Did you mislead these, My servants, or did they [themselves] stray from the way

versets.arabe: قَالُوا سُبْحَانَكَ مَا كَانَ يَنبَغِي لَنَا أَن نَّتَّخِذَ مِن دُونِكَ مِنْ أَوْلِيَاءَ
versets.phonetique: Qalu subhanaka ma kana yambaghi lana an nattakhidha min dunika min awliya'
versets.francais: Ils diront : "Gloire à Toi ! Il ne nous appartenait pas de prendre d'autres patrons que Toi."
versets.anglais: They will say, "Exalted are You! It was not for us to take besides You any allies. But You provided comforts for them and their fathers until they forgot the message and became a people ruined

versets.arabe: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوكُم بِمَا تَقُولُونَ فَمَا تَسْتَطِيعُونَ صَرْفًا وَلَا نَصْرًا
versets.phonetique: Faqad kadhdhabukum bima taquluna fama tastati'una sarfaw wa la nasra
versets.francais: Ils vous ont donc démentis dans ce que vous disiez. Vous ne pouvez ni détourner le châtiment ni vous secourir.
versets.anglais: So they will deny you, [disbelievers], in what you say, and you cannot avert [punishment] or [find] help. And whoever commits injustice among you - We will make him taste a great punishment

versets.arabe: وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ مِنَ الْمُرْسَلِينَ إِلَّا إِنَّهُمْ لَيَأْكُلُونَ الطَّعَامَ وَيَمْشُونَ فِي الْأَسْوَاقِ
versets.phonetique: Wa ma arsalna qablaka minal-mursalina illa innahum laya'kulut-ta'ama wa yamshuna fil-aswaq
versets.francais: Nous n'avons envoyé avant toi que des messagers qui mangeaient de la nourriture et marchaient dans les marchés.
versets.anglais: And We did not send before you, [O Muhammad], any of the messengers except that they ate food and walked in the markets. And We have made some of you [people] as trial for others - will you have patience? And ever is your Lord, Seeing

versets.arabe: وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ لَا يَرْجُونَ لِقَاءَنَا لَوْلَا أُنزِلَ عَلَيْنَا الْمَلَائِكَةُ أَوْ نَرَىٰ رَبَّنَا
versets.phonetique: Wa qalal-ladhina la yarjuna liqa'ana lawla unzila 'alayna-l-mala'ikatu aw nara rabbana
versets.francais: Ceux qui n'espèrent pas Notre rencontre ont dit : "Que ne fait-on descendre sur nous des anges ou ne voyons-nous pas notre Seigneur ?"
versets.anglais: And those who do not expect the meeting with Us say, "Why were not angels sent down to us, or [why] do we [not] see our Lord?" They have certainly become arrogant within themselves and [become] insolent with great insolence

versets.arabe: يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَ الْمَلَائِكَةَ لَا بُشْرَىٰ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُجْرِمِينَ وَيَقُولُونَ حِجْرًا مَّحْجُورًا
versets.phonetique: Yawma yarawnal-mala'ikata la bushra yawma'idhil lil-mujrimiina wa yaquluna hijram mahjura
versets.francais: Le Jour où ils verront les anges, pas de bonne nouvelle ce jour-là pour les criminels. Ils diront : "Une barrière infranchissable !"
versets.anglais: The day they see the angels - no good tidings will there be that day for the criminals, and [the angels] will say, "Prevented and inaccessible

versets.arabe: وَقَدِمْنَا إِلَىٰ مَا عَمِلُوا مِنْ عَمَلٍ فَجَعَلْنَاهُ هَبَاءً مَّنثُورًا
versets.phonetique: Wa qadimna ila ma 'amilu min 'amalin faja'alnahu haba'am manthura
versets.francais: Nous Nous tournerons vers les œuvres qu'ils auront accomplies et Nous les réduirons en poussière dispersée.
versets.anglais: And We will regard what they have done of deeds and make them as dust dispersed

versets.arabe: أَصْحَابُ الْجَنَّةِ يَوْمَئِذٍ خَيْرٌ مُّسْتَقَرًّا وَأَحْسَنُ مَقِيلًا
versets.phonetique: As-habul-jannati yawma'idhin khayrum mustaqarraw wa ahsanu maqila
versets.francais: Les habitants du Paradis, ce jour-là, auront la meilleure demeure et le plus beau séjour.
versets.anglais: The companions of Paradise, that Day, are [in] a better settlement and better resting place

versets.arabe: وَيَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ السَّمَاءُ بِالْغَمَامِ وَنُزِّلَ الْمَلَائِكَةُ تَنزِيلًا
versets.phonetique: Wa yawma tashaqqaqus-sama'u bil-ghamamiwa nuzzilal-mala'ikatu tanzila
versets.francais: Le Jour où le ciel se fendra avec les nuages et où les anges seront envoyés en rangs serrés.
versets.anglais: And [mention] the Day when the heaven will split open with [emerging] clouds, and the angels will be sent down in successive descent

versets.arabe: الْمُلْكُ يَوْمَئِذٍ الْحَقُّ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ ۚ وَكَانَ يَوْمًا عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ عَسِيرًا
versets.phonetique: Al-mulku yawma'idhinil-haqqul lir-rahman wa kana yawman 'alal-kafirna 'asira
versets.francais: La vraie royauté en ce Jour-là appartiendra au Tout Miséricordieux. Ce sera un Jour difficile pour les mécréants.
versets.anglais: True sovereignty, that Day, is for the Most Merciful. And it will be upon the disbelievers a difficult Day

versets.arabe: وَيَوْمَ يَعَضُّ الظَّالِمُ عَلَىٰ يَدَيْهِ يَقُولُ يَا لَيْتَنِي اتَّخَذْتُ مَعَ الرَّسُولِ سَبِيلًا
versets.phonetique: Wa yawma ya'addhud-dhalamu 'ala yadayhi yaqulu ya laytani-t-takhadhtu ma'ar-rasuli sabila
versets.francais: Le Jour où l'injuste se mordra les mains en disant : "Que n'ai-je suivi le chemin avec le Messager !"
versets.anglais: And the Day the wrongdoer will bite on his hands [in regret] he will say, "Oh, I wish I had taken with the Messenger a way

versets.arabe: يَا وَيْلَتَىٰ لَيْتَنِي لَمْ أَتَّخِذْ فُلَانًا خَلِيلًا
versets.phonetique: Ya waylata laytani lam attakhidh fulanan khalila
versets.francais: "Malheur à moi ! Que n'ai-je pas pris un tel pour ami !"
versets.anglais: Oh, woe to me! I wish I had not taken that one as a friend

versets.arabe: لَّقَدْ أَضَلَّنِي عَنِ الذِّكْرِ بَعْدَ إِذْ جَاءَنِي ۗ وَكَانَ الشَّيْطَانُ لِلْإِنسَانِ خَذُولًا
versets.phonetique: Laqad adallani 'anidh-dhikri ba'da idh ja'ani wa kanash-shaytanu lil-insani khadhula
versets.francais: "Il m'a vraiment égaré loin du Rappel après qu'il me fut venu." Le Diable est un abandonniste pour l'homme.
versets.anglais: He led me away from the remembrance after it had come to me. And ever is Satan, to man, a deserter

versets.arabe: وَقَالَ الرَّسُولُ يَا رَبِّ إِنَّ قَوْمِي اتَّخَذُوا هَٰذَا الْقُرْآنَ مَهْجُورًا
versets.phonetique: Wa qalar-rasulu ya rabbi inna qawmi-t-takhadhu hadhal-qur'ana mahjura
versets.francais: Le Messager a dit : "Seigneur, mon peuple a délaissé ce Coran."
versets.anglais: And the Messenger has said, "O my Lord, indeed my people have taken this Qur'an as [a thing] abandoned

versets.arabe: وَكَذَٰلِكَ جَعَلْنَا لِكُلِّ نَبِيٍّ عَدُوًّا مِّنَ الْمُجْرِمِينَ ۗ وَكَفَىٰ بِرَبِّكَ هَادِيًا وَنَصِيرًا
versets.phonetique: Wa kadhalika ja'alna likulli nabiyyin 'aduwwam minal-mujrimin wa kafa birabbika hadiaw wa nasira
versets.francais: C'est ainsi que Nous avons assigné à chaque prophète des ennemis parmi les criminels. Ton Seigneur suffit comme Guide et Soutien.
versets.anglais: And thus have We made for every prophet an enemy from among the criminals. But sufficient is your Lord as a guide and a helper

versets.arabe: وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ الْقُرْآنُ جُمْلَةً وَاحِدَةً ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ لِنُثَبِّتَ بِهِ فُؤَادَكَ ۖ وَرَتَّلْنَاهُ تَرْتِيلًا
versets.phonetique: Wa qalal-ladhina kafaru lawla nuzzila 'alayhil-qur'anu jumlatan wahidah kadhalika linuthabbita bihi fu'adaka wa rattalnahu tartila
versets.francais: Les mécréants ont dit : "Que n'a-t-on fait descendre le Coran en une seule fois ?" C'est ainsi pour affermir ton cœur, et Nous te l'avons récité de façon posée.
versets.anglais: And those who disbelieve say, "Why was the Qur'an not revealed to him all at once?" Thus [it is] that We may strengthen thereby your heart. And We have spaced it distinctly

versets.arabe: وَلَا يَأْتُونَكَ بِمَثَلٍ إِلَّا جِئْنَاكَ بِالْحَقِّ وَأَحْسَنَ تَفْسِيرًا
versets.phonetique: Wa la ya'tunaka bimathalin illa ji'naka bil-haqqi wa ahsana tafsira
versets.francais: Ils ne t'apportent aucun exemple sans que Nous t'apportions la vérité et la meilleure explication.
versets.anglais: And they do not come to you with an argument except that We bring you the truth and the best explanation

versets.arabe: الَّذِينَ يُحْشَرُونَ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ أُولَٰئِكَ شَرٌّ مَّكَانًا وَأَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا
versets.phonetique: Alladhina yuhsharuna 'ala wujuhihim ila jahannama ula'ika sharrum makanaw wa adallu sabila
versets.francais: Ceux qui seront rassemblés la face contre terre vers l'Enfer, ceux-là sont dans la pire situation et le plus égaré du chemin.
versets.anglais: The ones who are gathered on their faces to Hell - those are the worst in position and farthest astray in [their] way

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا مُوسَى الْكِتَابَ وَجَعَلْنَا مَعَهُ أَخَاهُ هَارُونَ وَزِيرًا
versets.phonetique: Wa laqad atayna musakl-kitaba wa ja'alna ma'ahu akhahu haruna wazira
versets.francais: Nous avons certes donné à Moïse le Livre et adjoint son frère Aaron comme assistant.
versets.anglais: And We had certainly given Moses the Scripture and appointed with him his brother Aaron as an assistant

versets.arabe: فَقُلْنَا اذْهَبَا إِلَى الْقَوْمِ الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا بِآيَاتِنَا فَدَمَّرْنَاهُمْ تَدْمِيرًا
versets.phonetique: Faqulnadh-haba ilal-qawmilladhina kadhdhabu bi'ayatina fadammarna hum tadmira
versets.francais: Nous leur avons dit : "Allez vers le peuple qui a traité Nos signes de mensonges." Nous les avons alors totalement détruits.
versets.anglais: And We said, "Go both of you to the people who have denied Our signs." Then We destroyed them with [complete] destruction

versets.arabe: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ لَّمَّا كَذَّبُوا الرُّسُلَ أَغْرَقْنَاهُمْ وَجَعَلْنَاهُمْ لِلنَّاسِ آيَةً
versets.phonetique: Wa qawma nuhin lamma kadhdhabur-rusula aghraqnahum wa ja'alnahum lin-nasi ayah
versets.francais: Et le peuple de Noé, quand il a traité de menteurs les messagers, Nous l'avons noyé et en avons fait un signe pour les hommes.
versets.anglais: And the people of Noah - when they denied the messengers, We drowned them, and We made them for mankind a sign. And We have prepared for the wrongdoers a painful punishment

versets.arabe: وَعَادًا وَثَمُودَ وَأَصْحَابَ الرَّسِّ وَقُرُونًا بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ كَثِيرًا
versets.phonetique: Wa 'adaw wa thamuda wa as-habar-rassi wa quruna bayna dhalika kathira
versets.francais: Et les Aad et les Thamoud et les gens d'Ar-Rass et de nombreuses générations entre tout cela.
versets.anglais: And [We destroyed] 'Aad and Thamud and the companions of the well and many generations between them

versets.arabe: وَكُلًّا ضَرَبْنَا لَهُ الْأَمْثَالَ ۖ وَكُلًّا تَبَّرْنَا تَتْبِيرًا
versets.phonetique: Wa kullan darabna lahul-amthala wa kullan tabbarna tatbira
versets.francais: Nous leur avons cité des exemples pour chacun, et Nous les avons tous anéantis.
versets.anglais: And for each We presented examples [as warnings], and each We destroyed with [total] destruction

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ أَتَوْا عَلَى الْقَرْيَةِ الَّتِي أُمْطِرَتْ مَطَرَ السَّوْءِ ۚ أَفَلَمْ يَكُونُوا يَرَوْنَهَا
versets.phonetique: Wa laqad ataw 'alal-qaryatillatee umtirat matara as-saw'i afalam yakunu yarawnahaa
versets.francais: Ils ont certes passé devant la cité sur laquelle tomba la pluie funeste. Ne l'ont-ils donc pas vue ?
versets.anglais: And they have already come upon the town which was showered with a rain of evil. So have they not seen it? But they are not expecting resurrection

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا رَأَوْكَ إِن يَتَّخِذُونَكَ إِلَّا هُزُوًا أَهَٰذَا الَّذِي بَعَثَ اللَّهُ رَسُولًا
versets.phonetique: Wa idha ra'awka iy yattakhidunaka illa huzuwan a-hadhalladhee ba'atha-llahu rasula
versets.francais: Quand ils te voient, ils ne font que se moquer de toi : "Est-ce là celui qu'Allah a envoyé comme messager ?"
versets.anglais: And when they see you, [O Muhammad], they take you not except in ridicule, [saying], "Is this the one whom Allah has sent as a messenger

versets.arabe: إِن كَادَ لَيُضِلُّنَا عَنْ آلِهَتِنَا لَوْلَا أَن صَبَرْنَا عَلَيْهَا ۗ وَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ حِينَ يَرَوْنَ الْعَذَابَ
versets.phonetique: In kada layudilluna 'an alihatina lawla an sabarna 'alayha wa sawfa ya'lamuna hina yarawnal-'adhab
versets.francais: "Il a failli nous détourner de nos divinités si nous n'avions pas été persévérants envers elles." Ils sauront quand ils verront le châtiment.
versets.anglais: He almost would have misled us from our gods had we not been steadfast in [worship of] them." But they are going to know, when they see the punishment, who is farthest astray in [his] way

versets.arabe: أَرَأَيْتَ مَنِ اتَّخَذَ إِلَٰهَهُ هَوَاهُ أَفَأَنتَ تَكُونُ عَلَيْهِ وَكِيلًا
versets.phonetique: Ara'ayta manit-takhadha ilahahu hawahu afa'anta takunu 'alayhi wakila
versets.francais: N'as-tu pas vu celui qui a pris sa passion pour divinité ? Serais-tu donc son garant ?
versets.anglais: Have you seen the one who takes as his god his own desire? Then would you be responsible for him

versets.arabe: أَمْ تَحْسَبُ أَنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ يَسْمَعُونَ أَوْ يَعْقِلُونَ ۚ إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا كَالْأَنْعَامِ ۖ بَلْ هُمْ أَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا
versets.phonetique: Am tahsabu anna aktharahum yasma'una aw ya'qiluna in hum illa kal-an'ami bal hum adallu sabila
versets.francais: Penses-tu que la plupart d'entre eux entendent ou raisonnent ? Ils ne sont que comme des bestiaux. Ils sont même plus égarés que le chemin.
versets.anglais: Or do you think that most of them hear or reason? They are not except like livestock. Rather, they are [even] more astray in [their] way

versets.arabe: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَيْفَ مَدَّ الظِّلَّ وَلَوْ شَاءَ لَجَعَلَهُ سَاكِنًا ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَا الشَّمْسَ عَلَيْهِ دَلِيلًا
versets.phonetique: Alam tara ila rabbika kayfa maddadh-dhilla wa law sha'a laja'alahu sakinan thumma ja'alnash-shamsa 'alayhi dalila
versets.francais: N'as-tu pas vu comment ton Seigneur a étendu l'ombre ? S'Il avait voulu, Il l'aurait rendue fixe. Puis Nous avons fait du soleil son indicateur.
versets.anglais: Have you not considered your Lord - how He extends the shadow, and if He willed, He could have made it stationary? Then We made the sun for it an indication

versets.arabe: ثُمَّ قَبَضْنَاهُ إِلَيْنَا قَبْضًا يَسِيرًا
versets.phonetique: Thumma qabadnahu ilayna qabdan yasira
versets.francais: Puis Nous la ramenons à Nous progressivement.
versets.anglais: Then We hold it in hand for a brief grasp

versets.arabe: وَهُوَ الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ اللَّيْلَ لِبَاسًا وَالنَّوْمَ سُبَاتًا وَجَعَلَ النَّهَارَ نُشُورًا
versets.phonetique: Wa huwal-ladhee ja'ala lakumul-layla libasan wan-nawma subataw wa ja'alahan-nahara nushura
versets.francais: C'est Lui qui vous a fait de la nuit un vêtement, du sommeil un repos et du jour un lever.
versets.anglais: And it is He who has made the night for you as clothing and sleep [a means for] rest and has made the day a resurrection

versets.arabe: وَهُوَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلَ الرِّيَاحَ بُشْرًا بَيْنَ يَدَيْ رَحْمَتِهِ ۚ وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً طَهُورًا
versets.phonetique: Wa huwal-ladhee arsar-riyaha bushran bayna yaday rahmatih wa anzalna minas-sama'i ma'an tahura
versets.francais: C'est Lui qui envoie les vents en annonce avant Sa miséricorde. Nous faisons descendre du ciel une eau pure.
versets.anglais: And it is He who sends the winds as good tidings before His mercy, and We send down from the sky pure water

versets.arabe: لِّنُحْيِيَ بِهِ بَلْدَةً مَّيْتًا وَنُسْقِيَهُ مِمَّا خَلَقْنَا أَنْعَامًا وَأَنَاسِيَّ كَثِيرًا
versets.phonetique: Linuhyiya bihi baldatam maytaw wa nusqiyahu mimma khalaqna an'amaw wa anasiyya kathira
versets.francais: Pour redonner vie à une contrée morte et abreuver de ce que Nous avons créé : nombreux bestiaux et hommes.
versets.anglais: That We may bring to life thereby a dead land and give it as drink to those We created of numerous livestock and men

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ صَرَّفْنَاهُ بَيْنَهُمْ لِيَذَّكَّرُوا فَأَبَىٰ أَكْثَرُ النَّاسِ إِلَّا كُفُورًا
versets.phonetique: Wa laqad sarrafnahu baynahum liyadhdhakkaru fa'aba aktharun-nasi illa kufura
versets.francais: Nous l'avons diversifié parmi eux pour qu'ils se souviennent. Mais la plupart des hommes ne font que nier.
versets.anglais: And We have certainly distributed it among them that they might be reminded, but most of the people refuse except disbelief

versets.arabe: وَلَوْ شِئْنَا لَبَعَثْنَا فِي كُلِّ قَرْيَةٍ نَّذِيرًا
versets.phonetique: Wa law shi'na laba'athna fi kulli qaryatin nadhira
versets.francais: Si Nous voulions, Nous enverrions dans chaque cité un avertisseur.
versets.anglais: And if We had willed, We could have sent into every city a warner

versets.arabe: فَلَا تُطِعِ الْكَافِرِينَ وَجَاهِدْهُم بِهِ جِهَادًا كَبِيرًا
versets.phonetique: Fala tuti'il-kafirna wa jahid hum bihi jihadan kabira
versets.francais: N'obéis donc pas aux mécréants et combats-les avec cela d'un grand effort.
versets.anglais: So do not obey the disbelievers, and strive against them with the Qur'an a great striving

versets.arabe: وَهُوَ الَّذِي مَرَجَ الْبَحْرَيْنِ هَٰذَا عَذْبٌ فُرَاتٌ وَهَٰذَا مِلْحٌ أُجَاجٌ وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخًا وَحِجْرًا مَّحْجُورًا
versets.phonetique: Wa huwal-ladhee marajal-bahrayni hadha 'adhbun furatuw wa hadha milhun ujajuw wa ja'ala baynahuma barzakhaw wa hijram mahjura
versets.francais: C'est Lui qui a mis en contact les deux mers : l'une douce et désaltérante, l'autre salée et amère. Il a placé entre elles une barrière et une séparation infranchissable.
versets.anglais: And it is He who has released [simultaneously] the two seas, one fresh and sweet and one salty and bitter, and He placed between them a barrier and prohibiting partition

versets.arabe: وَهُوَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ مِنَ الْمَاءِ بَشَرًا فَجَعَلَهُ نَسَبًا وَصِهْرًا ۗ وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ قَدِيرًا
versets.phonetique: Wa huwal-ladhee khalaqa minal-ma'i basharan faja'alahu nasabaw wa sihra wa kana rabbuka qadira
versets.francais: C'est Lui qui a créé de l'eau un être humain qu'Il a doté de liens de consanguinité et d'alliance. Ton Seigneur est Omnipotent.
versets.anglais: And it is He who has created from water a human being and made him [a relative by] lineage and marriage. And ever is your Lord competent [concerning creation]

versets.arabe: وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُهُمْ وَلَا يَضُرُّهُمْ ۗ وَكَانَ الْكَافِرُ عَلَىٰ رَبِّهِ ظَهِيرًا
versets.phonetique: Wa ya'buduna min dunillahi ma la yanfa'uhum wa la yadurruhum wa kanal-kafiru 'ala rabbihi dhahira
versets.francais: Ils adorent en dehors d'Allah ce qui ne peut ni leur profiter ni leur nuire. Le mécréant est toujours un opposant à son Seigneur.
versets.anglais: But they worship rather than Allah that which does not benefit them or harm them, and the disbeliever is ever, against his Lord, an assistant [to Satan]

versets.arabe: وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرًا وَنَذِيرًا
versets.phonetique: Wa ma arsalnaka illa mubashshiraw wa nadhira
versets.francais: Nous ne t'avons envoyé qu'en annonciateur et en avertisseur.
versets.anglais: And We have not sent you, [O Muhammad], except as a bringer of good tidings and a warner

versets.arabe: قُلْ مَا أَسْأَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِلَّا مَن شَاءَ أَن يَتَّخِذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِ سَبِيلًا
versets.phonetique: Qul ma as'alukum 'alayhi min ajrin illa man sha'a ay yattakhidha ila rabbihi sabila
versets.francais: Dis : "Je ne vous demande pour cela aucun salaire, sauf que celui qui veut prenne le chemin vers son Seigneur."
versets.anglais: Say, "I do not ask of you for it any payment - only that whoever wills might take to his Lord a way

versets.arabe: وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى الْحَيِّ الَّذِي لَا يَمُوتُ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِهِ ۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِهِ بِذُنُوبِ عِبَادِهِ خَبِيرًا
versets.phonetique: Wa tawakkal 'alal-hayyilladhee la yamutu wa sabbih bihamdih wa kafa bihi bidhunubi 'ibadihi khabira
versets.francais: Mets ta confiance au Vivant qui ne meurt jamais, et glorifie-Le en Le louant. Il suffit qu'Il soit bien informé des péchés de Ses serviteurs.
versets.anglais: And rely upon the Ever-Living who does not die, and exalt [Allah] with His praise. And sufficient is He to be, with the sins of His servants, Acquainted

versets.arabe: الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ اسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى الْعَرْشِ
versets.phonetique: Alladhee khalaqas-samawati wal-arda wa ma baynahuma fi sittati ayyamin thummastawwa 'alal-'arsh
versets.francais: Celui qui a créé les cieux et la terre et ce qui est entre eux en six jours, puis S'est établi sur le Trône.
versets.anglais: He who created the heavens and the earth and what is between them in six days and then established Himself above the Throne - the Most Merciful, so ask about Him one well informed

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ اسْجُدُوا لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ قَالُوا وَمَا الرَّحْمَٰنُ أَنَسْجُدُ لِمَا تَأْمُرُنَا وَزَادَهُمْ نُفُورًا
versets.phonetique: Wa idha qila lahumus-judu lir-rahmani qalu wa mar-rahmanu anasjudu lima ta'murunawa zadahum nufura
versets.francais: Quand on leur dit : "Prosternez-vous devant le Tout Miséricordieux", ils disent : "Et qui est le Tout Miséricordieux ? Nous prosternerons-nous à ce que tu nous commandes ?" Et cela augmente leur aversion.
versets.anglais: And when it is said to them, "Prostrate to the Most Merciful," they say, "And what is the Most Merciful? Should we prostrate to that which you order us?" And it increases them in aversion

versets.arabe: تَبَارَكَ الَّذِي جَعَلَ فِي السَّمَاءِ بُرُوجًا وَجَعَلَ فِيهَا سِرَاجًا وَقَمَرًا مُّنِيرًا
versets.phonetique: Tabarakal-ladhee ja'ala fis-sama'i burujaw wa ja'ala fiha sirajaw wa qamaram munira
versets.francais: Béni soit Celui qui a mis dans le ciel des constellations et y a mis une lampe et une lune lumineuse.
versets.anglais: Blessed is He who has placed in the sky great stars and placed therein a [burning] lamp and luminous moon

versets.arabe: وَهُوَ الَّذِي جَعَلَ اللَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ خِلْفَةً لِّمَنْ أَرَادَ أَن يَذَّكَّرَ أَوْ أَرَادَ شُكُورًا
versets.phonetique: Wa huwal-ladhee ja'alal-layla wan-nahara khilfatal liman arada ay yadhdhakkara aw arada shukura
versets.francais: C'est Lui qui a fait alterner la nuit et le jour pour celui qui veut se souvenir ou être reconnaissant.
versets.anglais: And it is He who has made the night and the day in succession for whoever desires to remember or desires gratitude

versets.arabe: وَعِبَادُ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الَّذِينَ يَمْشُونَ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ هَوْنًا وَإِذَا خَاطَبَهُمُ الْجَاهِلُونَ قَالُوا سَلَامًا
versets.phonetique: Wa 'ibadur-rahmanilladhina yamshuna 'alal-ardi hawnan wa idha khatabahumuljahiluna qalu salama
versets.francais: Les serviteurs du Tout Miséricordieux sont ceux qui marchent humblement sur la terre et qui, lorsque les ignorants leur adressent la parole, disent : "Paix !"
versets.anglais: And the servants of the Most Merciful are those who walk upon the earth easily, and when the ignorant address them [harshly], they say [words of] peace

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ يَبِيتُونَ لِرَبِّهِمْ سُجَّدًا وَقِيَامًا
versets.phonetique: Walladhina yabituna lirabbihim sujjadaw wa qiyama
versets.francais: Et ceux qui passent la nuit prosternés et debout pour leur Seigneur.
versets.anglais: And those who spend [part of] the night to their Lord prostrating and standing [in prayer]

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا اصْرِفْ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًا
versets.phonetique: Walladhina yaquluna rabbanas-rif 'anna 'adhaba jahannama inna 'adhabaha kana ghrama
versets.francais: Et ceux qui disent : "Seigneur, détourne de nous le châtiment de l'Enfer, car son châtiment est une perdition."
versets.anglais: And those who say, "Our Lord, avert from us the punishment of Hell. Indeed, its punishment is ever adhering

versets.arabe: إِنَّهَا سَاءَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَمُقَامًا
versets.phonetique: Innaha sa'at mustaqarraw wa muqama
versets.francais: "C'est vraiment le pire séjour et la pire demeure."
versets.anglais: Indeed, it is evil as a settlement and residence

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ إِذَا أَنفَقُوا لَمْ يُسْرِفُوا وَلَمْ يَقْتُرُوا وَكَانَ بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ قَوَامًا
versets.phonetique: Walladhina idha anfaqu lam yusrifu wa lam yaqturu wa kana bayna dhalika qawama
versets.francais: Et ceux qui, quand ils dépensent, ne gaspillent pas et ne lésinent pas, et gardent un juste milieu.
versets.anglais: And [they are] those who, when they spend, do so not excessively or sparingly but are ever, between that, [justly] moderate

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ لَا يَدْعُونَ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا آخَرَ وَلَا يَقْتُلُونَ النَّفْسَ الَّتِي حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ إِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ وَلَا يَزْنُونَ
versets.phonetique: Walladhina la yad'una ma'allahi ilahan akhara wa la yaqtulunna-n-nafsallatee harramallahu illa bil-haqqi wa la yaznum
versets.francais: Et ceux qui n'invoquent pas d'autre divinité avec Allah, ne tuent pas la personne qu'Allah a défendu de tuer sauf pour juste raison, et ne forniquent pas.
versets.anglais: And those who do not invoke with Allah another deity or kill the soul which Allah has forbidden [to be killed], except by right, and do not commit unlawful sexual intercourse. And whoever should do that will meet a penalty

versets.arabe: وَمَن يَفْعَلْ ذَٰلِكَ يَلْقَ أَثَامًا
versets.phonetique: Wa may yaf'al dhalika yalqa athama
versets.francais: Quiconque fait cela sera puni.
versets.anglais: Multiplied for him is the punishment on the Day of Resurrection, and he will abide therein humiliated

versets.arabe: إِلَّا مَن تَابَ وَآمَنَ وَعَمِلَ عَمَلًا صَالِحًا فَأُولَٰئِكَ يُبَدِّلُ اللَّهُ سَيِّئَاتِهِمْ حَسَنَاتٍ
versets.phonetique: Illa man taba wa amana wa 'amila 'amalan salihan fa'ula'ika yubaddilullahu sayyi'atihim hasanat
versets.francais: Sauf ceux qui se repentent, croient et font une bonne œuvre. Allah changera leurs mauvaises actions en bonnes.
versets.anglais: Except for those who repent, believe and do righteous work. For them Allah will replace their evil deeds with good. And ever is Allah Forgiving and Merciful

versets.arabe: وَمَن تَابَ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَإِنَّهُ يَتُوبُ إِلَى اللَّهِ مَتَابًا
versets.phonetique: Wa man taba wa 'amila salihan fa'innahu yatubu ilallahi mataba
versets.francais: Quiconque se repent et fait le bien se tourne vraiment vers Allah avec repentir.
versets.anglais: And he who repents and does righteousness does indeed turn to Allah with [accepted] repentance

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ لَا يَشْهَدُونَ الزُّورَ وَإِذَا مَرُّوا بِاللَّغْوِ مَرُّوا كِرَامًا
versets.phonetique: Walladhina la yashhadunaz-zura wa idha marru bil-laghwi marru kirama
versets.francais: Et ceux qui ne témoignent pas faussement et qui, s'ils passent près des futilités, passent avec dignité.
versets.anglais: And [they are] those who do not testify to falsehood, and when they pass near ill speech, they pass by with dignity

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِّرُوا بِآيَاتِ رَبِّهِمْ لَمْ يَخِرُّوا عَلَيْهَا صُمًّا وَعُمْيَانًا
versets.phonetique: Walladhina idha dhukkiruu bi'ayati rabbihim lam yakhirru 'alayha summan wa 'umyana
versets.francais: Et ceux qui, quand on leur rappelle les versets de leur Seigneur, ne s'y soumettent pas comme s'ils étaient sourds et aveugles.
versets.anglais: And those who, when reminded of the verses of their Lord, do not fall upon them deaf and blind

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
versets.phonetique: Walladhina yaquluna rabbana hab lana min azwajina wa dhurriyyatina qurrata a'yunin waj'alna lil-muttaqina imama
versets.francais: Et ceux qui disent : "Seigneur, accorde-nous, de nos épouses et de nos descendants, la joie des yeux et fais de nous un modèle pour les pieux."
versets.anglais: And those who say, "Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us an example for the righteous

versets.arabe: أُولَٰئِكَ يُجْزَوْنَ الْغُرْفَةَ بِمَا صَبَرُوا وَيُلَقَّوْنَ فِيهَا تَحِيَّةً وَسَلَامًا
versets.phonetique: Ula'ika yujzawnal-ghurfata bima sabaru wa yulaqqawna fiha tahiyyataw wa salama
versets.francais: Ceux-là seront récompensés par la chambre haute pour leur patience, et ils y seront accueillis par des salutations et des salams.
versets.anglais: Those will be awarded the Chamber for what they patiently endured, and they will be received therein with greetings and [words of] peace

versets.arabe: خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ حَسُنَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَمُقَامًا
versets.phonetique: Khalidina fiha hasunat mustaqarraw wa muqama
versets.francais: Ils y demeureront éternellement. Quelle belle demeure et quel beau séjour !
versets.anglais: Abiding eternally therein. Good is the settlement and residence

versets.arabe: قُلْ مَا يَعْبَأُ بِكُمْ رَبِّي لَوْلَا دُعَاؤُكُمْ ۖ فَقَدْ كَذَّبْتُمْ فَسَوْفَ يَكُونُ لِزَامًا
versets.phonetique: Qul ma ya'ba'u bikum rabbi lawla du'a'ukum faqad kadhdhabtum fasawfa yakunu lizama
versets.francais: Dis : "Mon Seigneur ne Se soucie pas de vous si vous ne L'invoquez pas. Vous avez certes démenti, et ce sera inévitable."
versets.anglais: Say, "What would my Lord care for you if not for your supplication?" For you [disbelievers] have denied, so your denial is going to be adherent

versets.arabe: طسم
versets.phonetique: Ta Seen Meem
versets.francais: Ta, Seen, Mim.
versets.anglais: Ta, Seen, Meem

versets.arabe: تِلْكَ آيَاتُ الْكِتَابِ الْمُبِينِ
versets.phonetique: Tilka ayatu al-kitabi al-mubin
versets.francais: Voilà les versets du Livre explicite.
versets.anglais: These are the verses of the clear Book

versets.arabe: لَعَلَّكَ بَاخِعٌ نَّفْسَكَ أَلَّا يَكُونُوا مُؤْمِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: La'allaka baki'un nafsaka alla yakunu mu'minin
versets.francais: Peut-être te consumes-tu parce qu'ils ne croient pas.
versets.anglais: Perhaps, [O Muhammad], you would kill yourself with grief that they will not be believers

versets.arabe: إِن نَّشَأْ نُنَزِّلْ عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ السَّمَاءِ آيَةً
versets.phonetique: In nasha' nunazzil 'alayhim minas-sama'i ayah
versets.francais: Si Nous voulions, Nous ferions descendre du ciel sur eux un signe.
versets.anglais: If We willed, We could send down to them from the sky a sign for which their necks would remain humbled

versets.arabe: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن ذِكْرٍ مِّنَ الرَّحْمَٰنِ مُحْدَثٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا عَنْهُ مُعْرِضِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa-ma ya'tihim min dhikrin minar-rahmani muhdathin illa kanu 'anhu mu'ridin
versets.francais: Il ne leur vient aucun nouveau rappel du Tout Miséricordieux sans qu'ils s'en détournent.
