versets.anglais: And no revelation comes to them anew from the Most Merciful except that they turn away from it

versets.arabe: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوا فَسَيَأْتِيهِمْ أَنبَاءُ مَا كَانُوا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِئُونَ
versets.phonetique: Faqad kadhdhabu fasaya'tihim anba'u ma kanu bihi yastahzi'un
versets.francais: Ils ont donc traité de mensonge. Viendront bientôt à eux les nouvelles de ce dont ils se moquaient.
versets.anglais: For they have already denied, but there will come to them the news of that which they used to ridicule

versets.arabe: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا إِلَى الْأَرْضِ كَمْ أَنبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍ كَرِيمٍ
versets.phonetique: Awa lam yaraw ilal-ardi kam anbatnafihamin kulli zawjin karim
versets.francais: N'ont-ils pas regardé la terre: combien Nous y avons fait pousser de toutes sortes de couples généreux?
versets.anglais: Did they not look at the earth - how much We have produced therein from every noble kind

versets.arabe: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Inna fi dhalika la-ayatan wa-ma kana aktharuhum mu'minin
versets.francais: Il y a là un signe. Mais la plupart d'entre eux ne croient pas.
versets.anglais: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers

versets.arabe: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ
versets.phonetique: Wa-inna rabbaka lahuwal-'azizur-rahim
versets.francais: Ton Seigneur est certes le Puissant, le Miséricordieux.
versets.anglais: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful

versets.arabe: وَإِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبُّكَ مُوسَىٰ أَنِ ائْتِ الْقَوْمَ الظَّالِمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa-idh nada rabbuka musa ani'ti al-qawma az-zalimin
versets.francais: Quand ton Seigneur appela Moïse: "Va vers le peuple injuste."
versets.anglais: And [mention] when your Lord called Moses, [saying], "Go to the wrongdoing people

versets.arabe: قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ أَلَا يَتَّقُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qawma fir'awna ala yattaqun
versets.francais: Le peuple de Pharaon. Ne craindront-ils pas?
versets.anglais: The people of Pharaoh. Will they not fear Allah

versets.arabe: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّي أَخَافُ أَن يُكَذِّبُونِ
versets.phonetique: Qala rabbi inni akhafu an yukadhdhibun
versets.francais: Il dit: "Seigneur, je crains qu'ils ne me traitent de menteur."
versets.anglais: He said, "My Lord, indeed I fear that they will deny me

versets.arabe: وَيَضِيقُ صَدْرِي وَلَا يَنطَلِقُ لِسَانِي
versets.phonetique: Wa-yadiq sadri wa-la yantaliq lisani
versets.francais: Ma poitrine se resserre et ma langue ne se délie pas.
versets.anglais: And that my breast will tighten and my tongue will not be fluent, so send for Aaron

versets.arabe: وَلَهُمْ عَلَيَّ ذَنبٌ فَأَخَافُ أَن يَقْتُلُونِ
versets.phonetique: Wa-lahum 'alayya dhanbun fa-akhafu an yaqtulun
versets.francais: Et ils ont sur moi un crime, et je crains qu'ils me tuent.
versets.anglais: And they have upon me a [claim due to] sin, so I fear that they will kill me

versets.arabe: قَالَ كَلَّا فَاذْهَبَا بِآيَاتِنَا إِنَّا مَعَكُم مُّسْتَمِعُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qala kalla fadhdhaba bi-ayatina inna ma'akum mustami'un
versets.francais: Il dit: "Non! Allez tous deux avec Nos signes. Nous sommes avec vous à écouter."
versets.anglais: [Allah] said, "No. Go both of you with Our signs; indeed, We are with you, listening

versets.arabe: فَأْتِيَا فِرْعَوْنَ فَقُولَا إِنَّا رَسُولُ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Fa'tiya fir'awna faqula inna rasulu rabb al-'alamin
versets.francais: Allez donc trouver Pharaon et dites: "Nous sommes le messager du Seigneur des mondes."
versets.anglais: Go to Pharaoh and say, 'We are the messengers of the Lord of the worlds

versets.arabe: أَنْ أَرْسِلْ مَعَنَا بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ
versets.phonetique: An arsil ma'ana bani isra'il
versets.francais: Laisse partir avec nous les fils d'Israël.
versets.anglais: [Commanded to say], "Send with us the Children of Israel

versets.arabe: قَالَ أَلَمْ نُرَبِّكَ فِينَا وَلِيدًا وَلَبِثْتَ فِينَا مِنْ عُمُرِكَ سِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qala alam nurabbika fina walidan wa-labithta fina min 'umurika sinin
versets.francais: Il dit: "Ne t'avons-nous pas élevé parmi nous dès l'enfance, et tu as passé des années de ta vie avec nous?"
versets.anglais: [Pharaoh] said, "Did we not raise you among us as a child, and you remained among us for years of your life

versets.arabe: وَفَعَلْتَ فَعْلَتَكَ الَّتِي فَعَلْتَ وَأَنتَ مِنَ الْكَافِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa-fa'alta fa'lataka allati fa'alta wa-anta minal-kafirin
versets.francais: Et tu as commis ton acte que tu as commis et tu es des ingrats.
versets.anglais: And [then] you did your deed which you did, and you were of the ungrateful

versets.arabe: قَالَ فَعَلْتُهَا إِذًا وَأَنَا مِنَ الضَّالِّينَ
versets.phonetique: Qala fa'altuha idhan wa-ana minad-dallin
versets.francais: Il dit: "Je l'ai fait alors que j'étais parmi les égarés."
versets.anglais: [Moses] said, "I did it, then, while I was of those astray

versets.arabe: فَفَرَرْتُ مِنكُمْ لَمَّا خِفْتُكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Fafarartu minkum lamma khiftukum
versets.francais: Je me suis enfui de vous parce que j'avais peur de vous.
versets.anglais: So I fled from you when I feared you. Then my Lord granted me wisdom and prophethood and appointed me [as one] of the messengers

versets.arabe: وَتِلْكَ نِعْمَةٌ تَمُنُّهَا عَلَيَّ أَنْ عَبَّدتَّ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ
versets.phonetique: Wa-tilka ni'matun tamunnuha 'alayya an 'abbadta bani isra'il
versets.francais: Et c'est là un bienfait dont tu me fais don que d'avoir réduit en esclavage les fils d'Israël?
versets.anglais: And is this a favor of which you remind me - that you have enslaved the Children of Israel

versets.arabe: قَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَا رَبُّ الْعَالَمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qala fir'awnu wa-ma rabb al-'alamin
versets.francais: Pharaon dit: "Qu'est-ce que le Seigneur des mondes?"
versets.anglais: Said Pharaoh, "And what is the Lord of the worlds

versets.arabe: قَالَ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا
versets.phonetique: Qala rabbu as-samawati wal-ardi wa-ma baynahuma
versets.francais: Il dit: "Le Seigneur des cieux et de la terre et de ce qui est entre eux deux."
versets.anglais: [Moses] said, "The Lord of the heavens and earth and that between them, if you should be convinced

versets.arabe: قَالَ لِمَنْ حَوْلَهُ أَلَا تَسْتَمِعُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qala liman hawlahu ala tastami'un
versets.francais: Il dit à ceux qui l'entouraient: "N'entendez-vous pas?"
versets.anglais: [Pharaoh] said to those around him, "Do you not hear

versets.arabe: قَالَ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ آبَائِكُمُ الْأَوَّلِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qala rabbukum wa-rabbu aba'ikumu al-awwalin
versets.francais: Il dit: "Votre Seigneur et le Seigneur de vos ancêtres."
versets.anglais: [Moses] said, "Your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers

versets.arabe: قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَكُمُ الَّذِي أُرْسِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ لَمَجْنُونٌ
versets.phonetique: Qala inna rasulakumu alladhi ursila ilaykum lamajnun
versets.francais: Il dit: "Votre messager qui vous a été envoyé est certes fou."
versets.anglais: [Pharaoh] said, "Indeed, your 'messenger' who has been sent to you is mad

versets.arabe: قَالَ رَبُّ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا
versets.phonetique: Qala rabbu al-mashriqi wal-maghribi wa-ma baynahuma
versets.francais: Il dit: "Le Seigneur de l'Orient et de l'Occident et de ce qui est entre eux deux."
versets.anglais: [Moses] said, "Lord of the east and the west and that between them, if you were to reason

versets.arabe: قَالَ لَئِنِ اتَّخَذْتَ إِلَٰهًا غَيْرِي لَأَجْعَلَنَّكَ مِنَ الْمَسْجُونِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qala la'ini ttakhadhta ilahan ghayri la-aj'alannaka minal-masjunin
versets.francais: Il dit: "Si tu prends un autre dieu que moi, je te mettrai sûrement en prison."
versets.anglais: [Pharaoh] said, "If you take a god other than me, I will surely place you among those imprisoned

versets.arabe: قَالَ أَوَلَوْ جِئْتُكَ بِشَيْءٍ مُّبِينٍ
versets.phonetique: Qala awa law ji'tuka bishayin mubin
versets.francais: Il dit: "Et si je t'apporte quelque chose de probant?"
versets.anglais: [Moses] said, "Even if I brought you proof manifest

versets.arabe: قَالَ فَأْتِ بِهِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qala fa'ti bihi in kunta minas-sadiqin
versets.francais: Il dit: "Apporte-le si tu es parmi les véridiques."
versets.anglais: [Pharaoh] said, "Then bring it, if you should be of the truthful

versets.arabe: فَأَلْقَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ ثُعْبَانٌ مُّبِينٌ
versets.phonetique: Fa-alqa 'asahu fa-idha hiya thu'banun mubin
versets.francais: Il jeta son bâton et voilà qu'il devint un serpent évident.
versets.anglais: So [Moses] threw his staff, and suddenly it was a serpent manifest

versets.arabe: وَنَزَعَ يَدَهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ بَيْضَاءُ لِلنَّاظِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa-naza'a yadahu fa-idha hiya bayda'u lin-nazhirin
versets.francais: Et il retira sa main et voilà qu'elle était blanche pour les regardeurs.
versets.anglais: And he drew out his hand; thereupon it was white for the observers

versets.arabe: قَالَ لِلْمَلَإِ حَوْلَهُ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَسَاحِرٌ عَلِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Qala lil-mala'i hawlahu inna hadha lasahirun 'alim
versets.francais: Il dit aux notables qui l'entouraient: "C'est là un magicien savant."
versets.anglais: [Pharaoh] said to the eminent ones around him, "Indeed, this is a learned magician

versets.arabe: يُرِيدُ أَن يُخْرِجَكُم مِّنْ أَرْضِكُم بِسِحْرِهِ
versets.phonetique: Yuridu an yukhrijkum min ardikum bisihrih
versets.francais: Il veut vous expulser de votre pays par sa magie.
versets.anglais: He wants to drive you out of your land by his magic, so what do you advise

versets.arabe: قَالُوا أَرْجِهْ وَأَخَاهُ وَابْعَثْ فِي الْمَدَائِنِ حَاشِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qalu arjih wa-akhahu wab'ath fil-mada'ini hashirin
versets.francais: Ils dirent: "Reporte son affaire et celle de son frère, et envoie dans les villes des rassembleurs."
versets.anglais: They said, "Postpone [the matter of] him and his brother and send among the cities gatherers

versets.arabe: يَأْتُوكَ بِكُلِّ سَحَّارٍ عَلِيمٍ
versets.phonetique: Ya'tuka bikulli sahharin 'alim
versets.francais: Ils t'amèneront tout grand magicien.
versets.anglais: Who will bring you every learned, skilled magician

versets.arabe: فَجُمِعَ السَّحَرَةُ لِمِيقَاتِ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
versets.phonetique: Fajumi'a as-saharatu limiqati yawmin ma'lum
versets.francais: Les magiciens furent rassemblés au rendez-vous d'un jour bien connu.
versets.anglais: So the magicians were assembled for the appointment of a well-known day

versets.arabe: وَقِيلَ لِلنَّاسِ هَلْ أَنتُم مُّجْتَمِعُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa-qila lin-nasi hal antum mujtami'un
versets.francais: Et l'on dit aux gens: "Vous allez vous rassembler?"
versets.anglais: And it was said to the people, "Will you congregate

versets.arabe: لَعَلَّنَا نَتَّبِعُ السَّحَرَةَ إِن كَانُوا هُمُ الْغَالِبِينَ
versets.phonetique: La'allana nattabi'u as-saharata in kanu humul-ghalibina
versets.francais: "Peut-être suivrons-nous les magiciens s'ils sont les vainqueurs."
versets.anglais: That we might follow the magicians if they are the predominant

versets.arabe: فَلَمَّا جَاءَ السَّحَرَةُ قَالُوا لِفِرْعَوْنَ أَئِنَّ لَنَا لَأَجْرًا
versets.phonetique: Falamma ja'a as-saharatu qalu lifir'awna a'inna lana la-ajran
versets.francais: Quand les magiciens vinrent, ils dirent à Pharaon: "Aurons-nous une récompense?"
versets.anglais: And when the magicians arrived, they said to Pharaoh, "Is there indeed for us a reward if we are the predominant

versets.arabe: قَالَ نَعَمْ وَإِنَّكُمْ إِذًا لَّمِنَ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qala na'am wa-innakum idhan laminal-muqarrabin
versets.francais: Il dit: "Oui, et vous serez parmi les proches."
versets.anglais: He said, "Yes, and indeed, you will then be of those near [to me]

versets.arabe: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰ أَلْقُوا مَا أَنتُم مُّلْقُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qala lahum musa alqu ma antum mulqun
versets.francais: Moïse leur dit: "Jetez ce que vous allez jeter."
versets.anglais: Moses said to them, "Throw whatever you will throw

versets.arabe: فَأَلْقَوْا حِبَالَهُمْ وَعِصِيَّهُمْ وَقَالُوا بِعِزَّةِ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّا لَنَحْنُ الْغَالِبُونَ
versets.phonetique: Fa-alqaw hibalahum wa-'isiyyahum wa-qalu bi'izzati fir'awna inna lanahnu al-ghalibun
versets.francais: Ils jetèrent leurs cordes et leurs bâtons et dirent: "Par la gloire de Pharaon, c'est nous qui serons les vainqueurs."
versets.anglais: So they threw their ropes and their staffs and said, "By the might of Pharaoh, indeed it is we who are predominant

versets.arabe: فَأَلْقَىٰ مُوسَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ تَلْقَفُ مَا يَأْفِكُونَ
versets.phonetique: Fa-alqa musa 'asahu fa-idha hiya talqafu ma ya'fikun
versets.francais: Moïse jeta son bâton qui engloutit ce qu'ils falsifiaient.
versets.anglais: Then Moses threw his staff, and at once it devoured what they falsified

versets.arabe: فَأُلْقِيَ السَّحَرَةُ سَاجِدِينَ
versets.phonetique: Fa-ulqiya as-saharatu sajidina
versets.francais: Et les magiciens se prosternèrent.
versets.anglais: So the magicians fell down in prostration [to Allah]

versets.arabe: قَالُوا آمَنَّا بِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qalu amanna biRabbi al-'alamin
versets.francais: Ils dirent: "Nous croyons au Seigneur des mondes."
versets.anglais: They said, "We have believed in the Lord of the worlds

versets.arabe: رَبِّ مُوسَىٰ وَهَارُونَ
versets.phonetique: Rabbi musa wa-harun
versets.francais: Le Seigneur de Moïse et d'Aaron.
versets.anglais: The Lord of Moses and Aaron

versets.arabe: قَالَ آمَنتُمْ لَهُ قَبْلَ أَنْ آذَنَ لَكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Qala amantum lahu qabla an adhana lakum
versets.francais: Il dit: "Vous avez cru en lui avant que je vous en donne la permission."
versets.anglais: [Pharaoh] said, "You believed Moses before I gave you permission. Indeed, he is your leader who has taught you magic, but you are going to know. I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will surely crucify you all

versets.arabe: قَالُوا لَا ضَيْرَ إِنَّا إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا مُنقَلِبُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qalu la dayra inna ila rabbina munqalibun
versets.francais: Ils dirent: "Peu importe. Nous retournerons à notre Seigneur."
versets.anglais: They said, "No harm. Indeed, to our Lord we will return

versets.arabe: إِنَّا نَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لَنَا رَبُّنَا خَطَايَانَا أَن كُنَّا أَوَّلَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Inna natma'u an yaghfira lana rabbuna khatayana an kunna awwala al-mu'minin
versets.francais: Nous espérons que notre Seigneur nous pardonnera nos péchés, car nous sommes les premiers croyants.
versets.anglais: Indeed, we aspire that our Lord will forgive us our sins because we were the first of the believers

versets.arabe: وَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِي إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa awhayna ila Musa an asri bi'ibadi innakum muttaba'un
versets.francais: Et Nous révélâmes à Moïse: "Pars la nuit avec Mes serviteurs, car vous allez être poursuivis."
versets.anglais: And We inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants; indeed, you will be pursued

versets.arabe: فَأَرْسَلَ فِرْعَوْنُ فِي الْمَدَائِنِ حَاشِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Fa arsala Fir'awnu fi al-mada'ini hashirin
versets.francais: Alors Pharaon envoya dans les villes des rassembleurs
versets.anglais: Then Pharaoh sent among the cities gatherers

versets.arabe: إِنَّ هَٰؤُلَاءِ لَشِرْذِمَةٌ قَلِيلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Inna ha'ula'i lashirdhimatun qalilun
versets.francais: disant: "Ces gens-là ne forment qu'une petite bande
versets.anglais: [And said], "Indeed, those are but a small band

versets.arabe: وَإِنَّهُمْ لَنَا لَغَائِظُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa innahum lana lagha'idhun
versets.francais: et ils nous ont mis en rage.
versets.anglais: And indeed, they are enraging us

versets.arabe: وَإِنَّا لَجَمِيعٌ حَاذِرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa inna lajami'un hadhirun
versets.francais: Et nous sommes tous sur nos gardes."
versets.anglais: And indeed, we are a cautious society

versets.arabe: فَأَخْرَجْنَاهُم مِّن جَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
versets.phonetique: Fa akhrajnahum min jannatin wa 'uyun
versets.francais: Alors Nous les fîmes sortir de jardins et de sources,
versets.anglais: So We removed them from gardens and springs

versets.arabe: وَكُنُوزٍ وَمَقَامٍ كَرِيمٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa kunuzin wa maqamin karim
versets.francais: de trésors et d'une demeure honorable.
versets.anglais: And treasures and honorable station

versets.arabe: كَذَٰلِكَ وَأَوْرَثْنَاهَا بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ
versets.phonetique: Kadhalika wa awrathnahaa bani Isra'il
versets.francais: Ainsi en fut-il. Et Nous en fîmes hériter les enfants d'Israël.
versets.anglais: Thus. And We caused to inherit it the Children of Israel

versets.arabe: فَأَتْبَعُوهُم مُّشْرِقِينَ
versets.phonetique: Fa atba'uhum mushri qin
versets.francais: Et (les Égyptiens) les poursuivirent au lever du soleil.
versets.anglais: So they pursued them at sunrise

versets.arabe: فَلَمَّا تَرَاءَى الْجَمْعَانِ قَالَ أَصْحَابُ مُوسَىٰ إِنَّا لَمُدْرَكُونَ
versets.phonetique: Falamma tara'a al-jam'ani qala as-habu Musa inna lamudrakun
versets.francais: Et quand les deux groupes se virent, les compagnons de Moïse dirent: "Nous allons certainement être rattrapés!"
versets.anglais: And when the two companies saw one another, the companions of Moses said, "Indeed, we are to be overtaken

versets.arabe: قَالَ كَلَّا ۖ إِنَّ مَعِيَ رَبِّي سَيَهْدِينِ
versets.phonetique: Qala kalla inna ma'iya rabbi sayahdini
versets.francais: Il dit: "Certes non! Mon Seigneur est avec moi et Il me guidera."
versets.anglais: [Moses] said, "No! Indeed, with me is my Lord; He will guide me

versets.arabe: فَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ أَنِ اضْرِب بِّعَصَاكَ الْبَحْرَ ۖ فَانفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرْقٍ كَالطَّوْدِ الْعَظِيمِ
versets.phonetique: Fa awhayna ila Musa ani adrib bi'asaka al-bahr fanfalaqa fa kana kullu firqin kattawdi al-'adhim
versets.francais: Alors Nous révélâmes à Moïse: "Frappe la mer de ton bâton." Et elle se fendit, et chaque partie était comme une énorme montagne.
versets.anglais: Then We inspired to Moses, "Strike with your staff the sea," and it parted, and each portion was like a great towering mountain

versets.arabe: وَأَزْلَفْنَا ثَمَّ الْآخَرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa azlafna thamma al-akharin
versets.francais: Et Nous y fîmes approcher les autres.
versets.anglais: And We advanced thereto the pursuers

versets.arabe: وَأَنجَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَمَن مَّعَهُ أَجْمَعِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa anjayna Musa wa man ma'ahu ajma'in
versets.francais: Et Nous sauvâmes Moïse et tous ceux qui étaient avec lui.
versets.anglais: And We saved Moses and those with him, all together

versets.arabe: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا الْآخَرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Thumma aghraqna al-akharin
versets.francais: Puis Nous noyâmes les autres.
versets.anglais: Then We drowned the others

versets.arabe: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Inna fi dhalika la'ayatan wa ma kana aktharuhum mu'minin
versets.francais: Il y a vraiment là un signe. Mais la plupart d'entre eux ne croient pas.
versets.anglais: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers

versets.arabe: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ
versets.phonetique: Wa inna rabbaka lahuwa al-'azizu ar-rahim
versets.francais: Et certes, ton Seigneur est le Puissant, le Miséricordieux.
versets.anglais: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful

versets.arabe: وَاتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ
versets.phonetique: Watlu 'alayhim naba'a Ibrahim
versets.francais: Et récite-leur l'histoire d'Abraham.
versets.anglais: And recite to them the news of Abraham

versets.arabe: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ
versets.phonetique: Idh qala li'abihi wa qawmihi ma ta'budun
versets.francais: Quand il dit à son père et à son peuple: "Qu'adorez-vous?"
versets.anglais: When he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship

versets.arabe: قَالُوا نَعْبُدُ أَصْنَامًا فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عَاكِفِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qalu na'budu asnaman fanazallu laha 'akifin
versets.francais: Ils dirent: "Nous adorons des idoles, et nous leur restons assidûment dévoués."
versets.anglais: They said, "We worship idols and remain to them devoted

versets.arabe: قَالَ هَلْ يَسْمَعُونَكُمْ إِذْ تَدْعُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qala hal yasma'unakum idh tad'un
versets.francais: Il dit: "Vous entendent-elles quand vous les appelez?
versets.anglais: He said, "Do they hear you when you supplicate

versets.arabe: أَوْ يَنفَعُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَضُرُّونَ
versets.phonetique: Aw yanfa'unakum aw yadurruna
versets.francais: Vous font-elles du bien ou du mal?"
versets.anglais: Or do they benefit you, or do they harm

versets.arabe: قَالُوا بَلْ وَجَدْنَا آبَاءَنَا كَذَٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qalu bal wajadna aba'ana kadhalika yaf'alun
versets.francais: Ils dirent: "Mais nous avons trouvé nos ancêtres faisant ainsi."
versets.anglais: They said, "But we found our fathers doing thus

versets.arabe: قَالَ أَفَرَأَيْتُم مَّا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qala afara'aytum ma kuntum ta'budun
versets.francais: Il dit: "Avez-vous réfléchi à ce que vous adorez,
versets.anglais: He said, "Then do you see what you have been worshipping

versets.arabe: أَنتُمْ وَآبَاؤُكُمُ الْأَقْدَمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Antum wa aba'ukumu al-aqdamun
versets.francais: vous et vos ancêtres de jadis?
versets.anglais: You and your ancient forefathers

versets.arabe: فَإِنَّهُمْ عَدُوٌّ لِّي إِلَّا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Fa innahum 'aduwwun li illa rabba al-'alamin
versets.francais: Ils me sont ennemis, à l'exception du Seigneur des mondes,
versets.anglais: Indeed, they are enemies to me, except the Lord of the worlds

versets.arabe: الَّذِي خَلَقَنِي فَهُوَ يَهْدِينِ
versets.phonetique: Alladhi khalaqani fahuwa yahdini
versets.francais: qui m'a créé et c'est Lui qui me guide,
versets.anglais: Who created me, and He [it is who] guides me

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِي هُوَ يُطْعِمُنِي وَيَسْقِينِ
versets.phonetique: Wa alladhi huwa yut'imuni wa yasqin
versets.francais: qui me nourrit et me désaltère,
versets.anglais: And it is He who feeds me and gives me drink

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا مَرِضْتُ فَهُوَ يَشْفِينِ
versets.phonetique: Wa idha maridtu fahuwa yashfin
versets.francais: et quand je suis malade, c'est Lui qui me guérit,
versets.anglais: And when I am ill, it is He who cures me

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِي يُمِيتُنِي ثُمَّ يُحْيِينِ
versets.phonetique: Wa alladhi yumituni thumma yuhyin
versets.francais: qui me fera mourir puis me fera revivre,
versets.anglais: And who will cause me to die and then bring me to life

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِي أَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لِي خَطِيئَتِي يَوْمَ الدِّينِ
versets.phonetique: Wa alladhi atma'u an yaghfira li khati'ati yawma ad-din
versets.francais: et dont j'espère qu'Il me pardonnera ma faute au Jour de la Rétribution."
versets.anglais: And who I aspire that He will forgive me my sin on the Day of Recompense

versets.arabe: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي حُكْمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالصَّالِحِينَ
versets.phonetique: Rabbi hab li hukman wa alhiqni bis-salihin
versets.francais: "Seigneur, donne-moi sagesse et joints-moi aux vertueux,
versets.anglais: [And he said], "My Lord, grant me authority and join me with the righteous

versets.arabe: وَاجْعَل لِّي لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ فِي الْآخِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa ij'al li lisana sidqin fi al-akhirin
versets.francais: et fais que je sois honorablement mentionné par les générations futures,
versets.anglais: And grant me a reputation of honor among later generations

versets.arabe: وَاجْعَلْنِي مِن وَرَثَةِ جَنَّةِ النَّعِيمِ
versets.phonetique: Wa ij'alni min warathati jannati an-na'im
versets.francais: et fais de moi un des héritiers du Jardin de délices,
versets.anglais: And place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Pleasure

versets.arabe: وَاغْفِرْ لِأَبِي إِنَّهُ كَانَ مِنَ الضَّالِّينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa aghfir li'abi innahu kana mina ad-dallin
versets.francais: et pardonne à mon père car il est du nombre des égarés,
versets.anglais: And forgive my father. Indeed, he has been of those astray

versets.arabe: وَلَا تُخْزِنِي يَوْمَ يُبْعَثُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa la tukhzini yawma yub'athun
versets.francais: et ne me couvre pas de honte le Jour où ils seront ressuscités,
versets.anglais: And do not disgrace me on the Day they are [all] resurrected

versets.arabe: يَوْمَ لَا يَنفَعُ مَالٌ وَلَا بَنُونَ
versets.phonetique: Yawma la yanfa'u malun wa la banun
versets.francais: le Jour où ni les biens ni les enfants ne seront d'aucune utilité,
versets.anglais: The Day when there will not benefit [anyone] wealth or children

versets.arabe: إِلَّا مَنْ أَتَى اللَّهَ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ
versets.phonetique: Illa man ata Allaha biqalbin salim
versets.francais: sauf celui qui vient à Allah avec un cœur sain."
versets.anglais: But only one who comes to Allah with a sound heart

versets.arabe: وَأُزْلِفَتِ الْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa uzlifati al-jannatu lil-muttaqin
versets.francais: Le Paradis sera rapproché des pieux,
versets.anglais: And Paradise will be brought near [that Day] to the righteous

versets.arabe: وَبُرِّزَتِ الْجَحِيمُ لِلْغَاوِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa burrizati al-jahimu lil-ghawin
versets.francais: et la Fournaise sera exposée aux égarés.
versets.anglais: And Hellfire will be brought forth for the deviators

versets.arabe: وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa qila lahum ayna ma kuntum ta'budun
versets.francais: Et on leur dira: "Où sont ceux que vous adoriez
versets.anglais: And it will be said to them, "Where are those you used to worship

versets.arabe: مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ هَلْ يَنصُرُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَنتَصِرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Min duni Allahi hal yansuruna am aw yantasirun
versets.francais: en dehors d'Allah? Vous aident-ils ou s'aident-ils eux-mêmes?"
versets.anglais: Other than Allah? Can they help you or help themselves

versets.arabe: فَكُبْكِبُوا فِيهَا هُمْ وَالْغَاوُونَ
versets.phonetique: Fakubkibu fiha hum wa al-ghawun
versets.francais: Alors on les précipitera dedans, eux et les égarés,
versets.anglais: So they will be overturned into Hellfire, they and the deviators

versets.arabe: وَجُنُودُ إِبْلِيسَ أَجْمَعُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa junudu Iblisa ajma'un
versets.francais: ainsi que les armées d'Iblis, tous ensemble.
versets.anglais: And the soldiers of Iblees, all together

versets.arabe: قَالُوا وَهُمْ فِيهَا يَخْتَصِمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qalu wa hum fiha yakhtasimun
versets.francais: Ils diront, tout en se querellant là-dedans:
versets.anglais: They will say while they dispute therein

versets.arabe: تَاللَّهِ إِن كُنَّا لَفِي ضَلَالٍ مُّبِينٍ
versets.phonetique: Tallahi in kunna lafi dalalin mubin
versets.francais: "Par Allah! Nous étions vraiment dans un égarement manifeste,
versets.anglais: By Allah, we were indeed in manifest error

versets.arabe: إِذْ نُسَوِّيكُم بِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Idh nusawwikum birabba al-'alamin
versets.francais: quand nous vous placions sur le même rang que le Seigneur des mondes.
versets.anglais: When we equated you with the Lord of the worlds

versets.arabe: وَمَا أَضَلَّنَا إِلَّا الْمُجْرِمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa ma adallana illa al-mujrimun
versets.francais: Ce sont les criminels qui nous ont égarés.
versets.anglais: And no one misguided us except the criminals

versets.arabe: فَمَا لَنَا مِن شَافِعِينَ
versets.phonetique: Fama lana min shafi'in
versets.francais: Nous n'avons donc aucun intercesseur,
versets.anglais: So now we have no intercessors

versets.arabe: وَلَا صَدِيقٍ حَمِيمٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa la sadiqin hamim
versets.francais: ni d'ami intime.
versets.anglais: And not a devoted friend

versets.arabe: فَلَوْ أَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةً فَنَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Falaw anna lana karratan fanakuna mina al-mu'minin
versets.francais: Si seulement nous pouvions avoir une autre chance, nous serions parmi les croyants!"
versets.anglais: Then if we only had a return [to the world] and could be of the believers

versets.arabe: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Inna fi dhalika la'ayatan wa ma kana aktharuhum mu'minin
versets.francais: Il y a vraiment là un signe. Mais la plupart d'entre eux ne croient pas.
versets.anglais: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers

versets.arabe: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ
versets.phonetique: Wa inna rabbaka lahuwa al-'azizu ar-rahim
versets.francais: Et certes, ton Seigneur est le Puissant, le Miséricordieux.
versets.anglais: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful

versets.arabe: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ الْمُرْسَلِينَ
versets.phonetique: Kadhdhaba qawmu Nuh al-mursalin
versets.francais: Le peuple de Noé traita les messagers de menteurs.
versets.anglais: The people of Noah denied the messengers

versets.arabe: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ نُوحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
versets.phonetique: Idh qala lahum akhu hum Nuh ala tattaqun
versets.francais: Quand leur frère Noé leur dit: "N'allez-vous pas craindre (Allah)?
versets.anglais: When their brother Noah said to them, "Will you not fear Allah

versets.arabe: إِنِّي لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
versets.phonetique: Inni lakum rasulun amin
versets.francais: Je suis pour vous un messager digne de confiance.
versets.anglais: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger

versets.arabe: فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
versets.phonetique: Fattaqu Allaha wa ati'un
versets.francais: Craignez Allah donc, et obéissez-moi.
versets.anglais: So fear Allah and obey me

versets.arabe: وَمَا أَسْأَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa ma as'alukum 'alayhi min ajrin in ajriya illa 'ala rabbi al-'alamin
versets.francais: Je ne vous demande pas de salaire pour cela. Mon salaire n'incombe qu'au Seigneur des mondes.
versets.anglais: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds

versets.arabe: فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
versets.phonetique: Fattaqu Allaha wa ati'un
versets.francais: Craignez Allah donc, et obéissez-moi."
versets.anglais: So fear Allah and obey me

versets.arabe: قَالُوا أَنُؤْمِنُ لَكَ وَاتَّبَعَكَ الْأَرْذَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qalu anu'minu laka wattaba'aka al-ardhalun
versets.francais: Ils dirent: "Allons-nous te croire alors que ce sont les plus vils qui te suivent?"
versets.anglais: They said, "Should we believe you while you are followed by the lowest [class of people]

versets.arabe: قَالَ وَمَا عِلْمِي بِمَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qala wa ma 'ilmi bima kanu ya'malun
versets.francais: Il dit: "Je ne sais pas ce qu'ils faisaient.
versets.anglais: He said, "And what is my knowledge of what they used to do

versets.arabe: إِنْ حِسَابُهُمْ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّي ۖ لَوْ تَشْعُرُونَ
versets.phonetique: In hisabuhum illa 'ala rabbi law tash'urun
versets.francais: Leur compte n'incombe qu'à mon Seigneur, si seulement vous le saviez!
versets.anglais: Their account is only upon my Lord, if you [could] perceive

versets.arabe: وَمَا أَنَا بِطَارِدِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa ma ana bitaridi al-mu'minin
versets.francais: Je ne suis pas là pour chasser les croyants.
versets.anglais: And I am not one to drive away the believers

versets.arabe: إِنْ أَنَا إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
versets.phonetique: In ana illa nadhirun mubin
versets.francais: Je ne suis qu'un avertisseur explicite."
versets.anglais: I am only a clear warner

versets.arabe: قَالُوا لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَا نُوحُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْمَرْجُومِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qalu la'in lam tantahi ya Nuh latakununna mina al-marjumin
versets.francais: Ils dirent: "Si tu ne cesses pas, ô Noé, tu seras certainement lapidé!"
versets.anglais: They said, "If you do not desist, O Noah, you will surely be of those who are stoned

versets.arabe: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ قَوْمِي كَذَّبُونِ
versets.phonetique: Qala rabbi inna qawmi kadhdhabhuni
versets.francais: Il dit: "Seigneur, mon peuple m'a traité de menteur.
versets.anglais: He said, "My Lord, indeed my people have denied me

versets.arabe: فَافْتَحْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُمْ فَتْحًا وَنَجِّنِي وَمَن مَّعِيَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Fattah bayni wa baynahum fathan wa najjini wa man ma'iya mina al-mu'minin
versets.francais: Prononce alors entre moi et eux un jugement et sauve-moi ainsi que les croyants avec moi."
versets.anglais: Then judge between me and them with decisive judgement and save me and those with me of the believers

versets.arabe: فَأَنجَيْنَاهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُ فِي الْفُلْكِ الْمَشْحُونِ
versets.phonetique: Fa anjaynahu wa man ma'ahu fi al-fulki al-mashhhun
versets.francais: Alors Nous le sauvâmes, lui et ceux qui étaient avec lui, dans l'arche chargée.
versets.anglais: So We saved him and those with him in the laden ship

versets.arabe: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا بَعْدُ الْبَاقِينَ
versets.phonetique: Thumma aghraqna ba'du al-baqin
versets.francais: Puis Nous noyâmes après cela les autres.
versets.anglais: Then We drowned thereafter the remaining ones

versets.arabe: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Inna fi dhalika la'ayatan wa ma kana aktharuhum mu'minin
versets.francais: Il y a vraiment là un signe. Mais la plupart d'entre eux ne croient pas.
versets.anglais: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers

versets.arabe: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ
versets.phonetique: Wa inna rabbaka lahuwa al-'azizu ar-rahim
versets.francais: Et certes, ton Seigneur est le Puissant, le Miséricordieux.
versets.anglais: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful

versets.arabe: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ الْمُرْسَلِينَ
versets.phonetique: Kadhdhaba 'Adun al-mursalin
versets.francais: 'Aad traita les messagers de menteurs.
versets.anglais: Aad denied the messengers

versets.arabe: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ هُودٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
versets.phonetique: Idh qala lahum akhu hum Hud ala tattaqun
versets.francais: Quand leur frère Hûd leur dit: "N'allez-vous pas craindre (Allah)?
versets.anglais: When their brother Hud said to them, "Will you not fear Allah

versets.arabe: إِنِّي لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
versets.phonetique: Inni lakum rasulun amin
versets.francais: Je suis pour vous un messager digne de confiance.
versets.anglais: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger

versets.arabe: فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
versets.phonetique: Fattaqu Allaha wa ati'un
versets.francais: Craignez Allah donc, et obéissez-moi.
versets.anglais: So fear Allah and obey me

versets.arabe: وَمَا أَسْأَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa ma as'alukum 'alayhi min ajrin in ajriya illa 'ala rabbi al-'alamin
versets.francais: Je ne vous demande pas de salaire pour cela. Mon salaire n'incombe qu'au Seigneur des mondes.
versets.anglais: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds

versets.arabe: أَتَبْنُونَ بِكُلِّ رِيعٍ آيَةً تَعْبَثُونَ
versets.phonetique: Atabna bilkulli ri'in ayatan ta'bathun
versets.francais: Érigez-vous sur chaque hauteur un monument pour vous divertir?
versets.anglais: Do you construct on every elevation a sign, amusing yourselves

versets.arabe: وَتَتَّخِذُونَ مَصَانِعَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَخْلُدُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa tattakhidhuna masa ni'a la'allakum takhludun
versets.francais: Et prenez-vous des châteaux comme si vous deviez être immortels?
versets.anglais: And take for yourselves palaces and fortresses that you might abide eternally

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا بَطَشْتُم بَطَشْتُمْ جَبَّارِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa idha batashtum batashtum jabbarin
versets.francais: Et quand vous frappez, vous frappez en tyrans.
versets.anglais: And when you strike, you strike as tyrants

versets.arabe: فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
versets.phonetique: Fattaqu Allaha wa ati'un
versets.francais: Craignez Allah donc, et obéissez-moi.
versets.anglais: So fear Allah and obey me

versets.arabe: وَاتَّقُوا الَّذِي أَمَدَّكُم بِمَا تَعْلَمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wattaqu alladhi amaddakum bima ta'lamun
versets.francais: Et craignez Celui qui vous a accordé ce que vous savez:
versets.anglais: And fear He who provided you with that which you know

versets.arabe: أَمَدَّكُم بِأَنْعَامٍ وَبَنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Amaddakum bi'an'amin wa banin
versets.francais: Il vous a dotés de troupeaux et d'enfants,
versets.anglais: Provided you with grazing livestock and children

versets.arabe: وَجَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa jannatin wa 'uyun
versets.francais: de jardins et de sources.
versets.anglais: And gardens and springs

versets.arabe: إِنِّي أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
versets.phonetique: Inni akhafu 'alaykum 'adhaba yawmin 'adhim
versets.francais: Je crains pour vous le châtiment d'un jour terrible."
versets.anglais: Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a terrible day

versets.arabe: قَالُوا سَوَاءٌ عَلَيْنَا أَوَعَظْتَ أَمْ لَمْ تَكُن مِّنَ الْوَاعِظِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qalu sawa'un 'alayna awa'adhta am lam takun mina al-wa'idhin
versets.francais: Ils dirent: "C'est égal pour nous, que tu nous prêches ou que tu ne le fasses pas.
versets.anglais: They said, "It is all the same to us whether you advise or are not of the advisors

versets.arabe: إِنْ هَٰذَا إِلَّا خُلُقُ الْأَوَّلِينَ
versets.phonetique: In hadha illa khuluqu al-awwalin
versets.francais: Tout cela n'est que coutume des anciens.
versets.anglais: This is not but the custom of the former peoples

versets.arabe: وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa ma nahnu bimu'adhdhabin
versets.francais: Nous ne serons pas châtiés."
versets.anglais: And we are not to be punished

versets.arabe: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَهْلَكْنَاهُمْ ۗ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Fakadhdhabahu fa ahlaknahu inna fi dhalika la'ayatan wa ma kana aktharuhum mu'minin
versets.francais: Ils le traitèrent de menteur. Nous les détruisîmes alors. Il y a vraiment là un signe. Mais la plupart d'entre eux ne croient pas.
versets.anglais: And they denied him, so We destroyed them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers

versets.arabe: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ
versets.phonetique: Wa inna rabbaka lahuwa al-'azizu ar-rahim
versets.francais: Et certes, ton Seigneur est le Puissant, le Miséricordieux.
versets.anglais: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful

versets.arabe: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ الْمُرْسَلِينَ
versets.phonetique: Kadhdhaba Thamud al-mursalin
versets.francais: Thamûd traita les messagers de menteurs.
versets.anglais: Thamud denied the messengers

versets.arabe: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ صَالِحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
versets.phonetique: Idh qala lahum akhu hum Salih ala tattaqun
versets.francais: Quand leur frère Sâlih leur dit: "N'allez-vous pas craindre (Allah)?
versets.anglais: When their brother Salih said to them, "Will you not fear Allah

versets.arabe: إِنِّي لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
versets.phonetique: Inni lakum rasulun amin
versets.francais: Je suis pour vous un messager digne de confiance.
versets.anglais: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger

versets.arabe: فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
versets.phonetique: Fattaqu Allaha wa ati'un
versets.francais: Craignez Allah donc, et obéissez-moi.
versets.anglais: So fear Allah and obey me

versets.arabe: وَمَا أَسْأَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa ma as'alukum 'alayhi min ajrin in ajriya illa 'ala rabbi al-'alamin
versets.francais: Je ne vous demande pas de salaire pour cela. Mon salaire n'incombe qu'au Seigneur des mondes.
versets.anglais: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds

versets.arabe: أَتُتْرَكُونَ فِي مَا هَاهُنَا آمِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Atatrukuna fi ma hahuna aminin
versets.francais: Serez-vous laissés en sécurité dans ce que voici:
versets.anglais: Will you be left in what is here, secure [from death]

versets.arabe: فِي جَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
versets.phonetique: Fi jannatin wa 'uyun
versets.francais: jardins et sources,
versets.anglais: Within gardens and springs

versets.arabe: وَزُرُوعٍ وَنَخْلٍ طَلْعُهَا هَضِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa zuru'in wa nakhlin tal'uha hadim
versets.francais: cultures et palmiers aux régimes tendres,
versets.anglais: And fields of crops and palm trees with softened fruit

versets.arabe: وَتَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ الْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا فَارِهِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa tanhituna mina al-jibali buyutan farihin
versets.francais: et vous taillez habilement dans les montagnes des maisons?
versets.anglais: And you carve out of the mountains, homes, with skill

versets.arabe: فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
versets.phonetique: Fattaqu Allaha wa ati'un
versets.francais: Craignez Allah donc, et obéissez-moi.
versets.anglais: So fear Allah and obey me

versets.arabe: وَلَا تُطِيعُوا أَمْرَ الْمُسْرِفِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa la tuti'u amra al-musrifin
versets.francais: Et n'obéissez pas aux ordres des outranciers,
versets.anglais: And do not obey the order of the transgressors

versets.arabe: الَّذِينَ يُفْسِدُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُونَ
versets.phonetique: Alladhina yufsiduna fi al-ardi wa la yuslihun
versets.francais: qui sèment la corruption sur la terre sans jamais faire le bien."
versets.anglais: Who cause corruption in the land and do not amend

versets.arabe: قَالُوا إِنَّمَا أَنتَ مِنَ الْمُسَحَّرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qalu innama anta mina al-musahharin
versets.francais: Ils dirent: "Tu n'es qu'un ensorcelé.
versets.anglais: They said, "You are only of those affected by magic

versets.arabe: مَا أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا فَأْتِ بِآيَةٍ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ
versets.phonetique: Ma anta illa basharun mithluna fa'ti bi'ayatin in kunta mina as-sadiqin
versets.francais: Tu n'es qu'un être humain comme nous. Apporte donc un signe si tu es du nombre des véridiques."
versets.anglais: You are but a man like ourselves, so bring a sign, if you should be of the truthful

versets.arabe: قَالَ هَٰذِهِ نَاقَةٌ لَّهَا شِرْبٌ وَلَكُمْ شِرْبُ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
versets.phonetique: Qala hadhihi naqatun laha shirbun wa lakum shirbu yawmin ma'lum
versets.francais: Il dit: "Voici une chamelle. Elle a droit à son abreuvement et vous avez droit au vôtre, un jour déterminé.
versets.anglais: He said, "This is a she-camel. For her is a [time of] drink, and for you is a [time of] drink, [each] on a known day

versets.arabe: وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوءٍ فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa la tamassuha bisu'in faya'khudhakum 'adhaba yawmin 'adhim
versets.francais: Ne la touchez pas méchamment, sinon le châtiment d'un jour terrible vous atteindra."
versets.anglais: And do not touch her with harm, lest you be seized by the punishment of a terrible day

versets.arabe: فَعَقَرُوهَا فَأَصْبَحُوا نَادِمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Fa'aqaruha fa asbahu nadimin
versets.francais: Ils l'égorgèrent et se retrouvèrent pleins de remords.
versets.anglais: But they hamstrung her and so became regretful

versets.arabe: فَأَخَذَهُمُ الْعَذَابُ ۗ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Fa akhadhahum al-'adhab inna fi dhalika la'ayatan wa ma kana aktharuhum mu'minin
versets.francais: Le châtiment les frappa alors. Il y a vraiment là un signe. Mais la plupart d'entre eux ne croient pas.
versets.anglais: And the punishment seized them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers

versets.arabe: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ
versets.phonetique: Wa inna rabbaka lahuwa al-'azizu ar-rahim
versets.francais: Et certes, ton Seigneur est le Puissant, le Miséricordieux.
versets.anglais: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful

versets.arabe: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍ الْمُرْسَلِينَ
versets.phonetique: Kadhdhaba qawmu Lut al-mursalin
versets.francais: Le peuple de Loth traita les messagers de menteurs.
versets.anglais: The people of Lot denied the messengers

versets.arabe: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ لُوطٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
versets.phonetique: Idh qala lahum akhu hum Lut ala tattaqun
versets.francais: Quand leur frère Loth leur dit: "N'allez-vous pas craindre (Allah)?
versets.anglais: When their brother Lot said to them, "Will you not fear Allah

versets.arabe: إِنِّي لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
versets.phonetique: Inni lakum rasulun amin
versets.francais: Je suis pour vous un messager digne de confiance.
versets.anglais: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger

versets.arabe: فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
versets.phonetique: Fattaqu Allaha wa ati'un
versets.francais: Craignez Allah donc, et obéissez-moi.
versets.anglais: So fear Allah and obey me

versets.arabe: وَمَا أَسْأَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa ma as'alukum 'alayhi min ajrin in ajriya illa 'ala rabbi al-'alamin
versets.francais: Je ne vous demande pas de salaire pour cela. Mon salaire n'incombe qu'au Seigneur des mondes.
versets.anglais: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds

versets.arabe: أَتَأْتُونَ الذُّكْرَانَ مِنَ الْعَالَمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Ata'tuna adh-dhukrana mina al-'alamin
versets.francais: Vous approchez-vous des mâles parmi toutes les créatures,
versets.anglais: Do you approach males among the worlds

versets.arabe: وَتَذَرُونَ مَا خَلَقَ لَكُمْ رَبُّكُم مِّنْ أَزْوَاجِكُم ۚ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌ عَادُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa tadharuna ma khalaqa lakum rabbukum min azwajikum bal antum qawmun 'adun
versets.francais: en délaissant ce que votre Seigneur a créé pour vous de vos épouses? Vous êtes vraiment des gens qui transgressent les limites."
versets.anglais: And leave what your Lord has created for you as mates? But you are a people transgressing

versets.arabe: قَالُوا لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَا لُوطُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْمُخْرَجِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qalu la'in lam tantahi ya Lut latakununna mina al-makhrajin
versets.francais: Ils dirent: "Si tu ne cesses pas, ô Loth, tu seras du nombre des expulsés!"
versets.anglais: They said, "If you do not desist, O Lot, you will surely be of those evicted

versets.arabe: قَالَ إِنِّي لِعَمَلِكُم مِّنَ الْقَالِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qala inni li'amalikum mina al-qalin
versets.francais: Il dit: "Je suis vraiment de ceux qui abhorrent votre action.
versets.anglais: He said, "Indeed, I am, toward your deed, of those who detest [it]

versets.arabe: رَبِّ نَجِّنِي وَأَهْلِي مِمَّا يَعْمَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Rabbi najjini wa ahli mimma ya'malun
versets.francais: Seigneur, sauve-moi et ma famille de ce qu'ils font."
versets.anglais: My Lord, save me and my family from [the consequence of] what they do

versets.arabe: فَنَجَّيْنَاهُ وَأَهْلَهُ أَجْمَعِينَ
versets.phonetique: Fanajjaynahu wa ahlahu ajma'in
versets.francais: Nous le sauvâmes donc, lui et tous les siens,
versets.anglais: So We saved him and his family, all

versets.arabe: إِلَّا عَجُوزًا فِي الْغَابِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Illa 'ajuzan fi al-ghabirin
versets.francais: sauf une vieille femme qui fut du nombre de ceux qui restèrent en arrière.
versets.anglais: Except an old woman among those who remained behind

versets.arabe: ثُمَّ دَمَّرْنَا الْآخَرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Thumma dammarna al-akharin
versets.francais: Puis Nous anéantîmes les autres.
versets.anglais: Then We destroyed the others

versets.arabe: وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّطَرًا ۖ فَسَاءَ مَطَرُ الْمُنذَرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa amtarna 'alayhim mataran fasa'a mataru al-mundharin
versets.francais: Et Nous fîmes pleuvoir sur eux une pluie. Quelle mauvaise pluie pour ceux qui avaient été avertis!
versets.anglais: And We rained upon them a rain [of stones], and evil was the rain of those who were warned

versets.arabe: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Inna fi dhalika la'ayatan wa ma kana aktharuhum mu'minin
versets.francais: Il y a vraiment là un signe. Mais la plupart d'entre eux ne croient pas.
versets.anglais: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers

versets.arabe: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ
versets.phonetique: Wa inna rabbaka lahuwa al-'azizu ar-rahim
versets.francais: Et certes, ton Seigneur est le Puissant, le Miséricordieux.
versets.anglais: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful

versets.arabe: كَذَّبَ أَصْحَابُ الْأَيْكَةِ الْمُرْسَلِينَ
versets.phonetique: Kadhdhaba as-habu al-aykati al-mursalin
versets.francais: Les gens de la Forêt traitèrent les messagers de menteurs.
versets.anglais: The companions of the thicket denied the messengers

versets.arabe: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ شُعَيْبٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
versets.phonetique: Idh qala lahum Shu'aybun ala tattaqun
versets.francais: Quand Shu'ayb leur dit: "N'allez-vous pas craindre (Allah)?
versets.anglais: When Shu'ayb said to them, "Will you not fear Allah

versets.arabe: إِنِّي لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
versets.phonetique: Inni lakum rasulun amin
versets.francais: Je suis pour vous un messager digne de confiance.
versets.anglais: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger

versets.arabe: فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
versets.phonetique: Fattaqu Allaha wa ati'un
versets.francais: Craignez Allah donc, et obéissez-moi.
versets.anglais: So fear Allah and obey me

versets.arabe: وَمَا أَسْأَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa ma as'alukum 'alayhi min ajrin in ajriya illa 'ala rabbi al-'alamin
versets.francais: Je ne vous demande pas de salaire pour cela. Mon salaire n'incombe qu'au Seigneur des mondes.
versets.anglais: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds

versets.arabe: أَوْفُوا الْكَيْلَ وَلَا تَكُونُوا مِنَ الْمُخْسِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Awfu al-kayla wa la takunu mina al-mukhsirin
versets.francais: Donnez la pleine mesure et ne soyez pas de ceux qui causent des pertes.
versets.anglais: Give full measure and do not be of those who cause loss

versets.arabe: وَزِنُوا بِالْقِسْطَاسِ الْمُسْتَقِيمِ
versets.phonetique: Wa zinu bilqistasi al-mustaqim
versets.francais: Pesez avec une balance exacte.
versets.anglais: And weigh with an even balance

versets.arabe: وَلَا تَبْخَسُوا النَّاسَ أَشْيَاءَهُمْ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا فِي الْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa la tabkhasu an-nasa ashya'ahum wa la ta'thaw fi al-ardi mufsidun
versets.francais: Ne lésez pas les gens sur leurs biens et ne semez pas la corruption sur la terre.
versets.anglais: And do not deprive people of their due and do not commit abuse on earth, spreading corruption

versets.arabe: وَاتَّقُوا الَّذِي خَلَقَكُمْ وَالْجِبِلَّةَ الْأَوَّلِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wattaqu alladhi khalaqakum wa al-jibillata al-awwalin
versets.francais: Et craignez Celui qui vous a créés, vous et les générations anciennes."
versets.anglais: And fear He who created you and the former creation

versets.arabe: قَالُوا إِنَّمَا أَنتَ مِنَ الْمُسَحَّرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qalu innama anta mina al-musahharin
versets.francais: Ils dirent: "Tu n'es qu'un ensorcelé.
versets.anglais: They said, "You are only of those affected by magic

versets.arabe: وَمَا أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا وَإِن نَّظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ الْكَاذِبِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa ma anta illa basharun mithluna wa in nathunnuka lamina al-kadhibin
versets.francais: Tu n'es qu'un être humain comme nous, et nous te croyons certainement du nombre des menteurs.
versets.anglais: You are but a man like ourselves, and indeed, we think you are among the liars

versets.arabe: فَأَسْقِطْ عَلَيْنَا كِسَفًا مِّنَ السَّمَاءِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ
versets.phonetique: Fa asqit 'alayna kisafan mina as-sama'i in kunta mina as-sadiqin
versets.francais: Fais donc tomber sur nous des morceaux du ciel si tu es du nombre des véridiques."
versets.anglais: So cause to fall upon us fragments of the sky, if you should be of the truthful

versets.arabe: قَالَ رَبِّي أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qala rabbi a'lamu bima ta'malun
versets.francais: Il dit: "Mon Seigneur connaît mieux ce que vous faites."
versets.anglais: He said, "My Lord is most knowing of what you do

versets.arabe: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمِ الظُّلَّةِ ۚ إِنَّهُ كَانَ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
versets.phonetique: Fakadhdhabahu fa akhadhahum 'adhab yawmi adh-dhullati innahu kana 'adhaba yawmin 'adhim
versets.francais: Ils le traitèrent de menteur, et le châtiment du Jour de l'Ombre les saisit. C'était le châtiment d'un jour terrible.
versets.anglais: And they denied him, so the punishment of the day of the black cloud seized them. Indeed, it was the punishment of a terrible day

versets.arabe: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Inna fi dhalika la'ayatan wa ma kana aktharuhum mu'minin
versets.francais: Il y a vraiment là un signe. Mais la plupart d'entre eux ne croient pas.
versets.anglais: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers

versets.arabe: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ
versets.phonetique: Wa inna rabbaka lahuwa al-'azizu ar-rahim
versets.francais: Et certes, ton Seigneur est le Puissant, le Miséricordieux.
versets.anglais: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful

versets.arabe: وَإِنَّهُ لَتَنزِيلُ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa innahu latanzilu rabbi al-'alamin
versets.francais: Et certes, ceci est une révélation du Seigneur des mondes.
versets.anglais: And indeed, the Qur'an is the revelation of the Lord of the worlds

versets.arabe: نَزَلَ بِهِ الرُّوحُ الْأَمِينُ
versets.phonetique: Nazala bihi ar-ruhu al-amin
versets.francais: L'Esprit fidèle est descendu avec lui (le Coran)
versets.anglais: The Trustworthy Spirit has brought it down

versets.arabe: عَلَىٰ قَلْبِكَ لِتَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُنذِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: 'Ala qalbika litakuna mina al-mundhirin
versets.francais: sur ton cœur, afin que tu sois du nombre des avertisseurs,
versets.anglais: Upon your heart, [O Muhammad] - that you may be of the warners

versets.arabe: بِلِسَانٍ عَرَبِيٍّ مُّبِينٍ
versets.phonetique: Bilisanin 'arabiyyin mubin
versets.francais: en une langue arabe claire.
versets.anglais: In a clear Arabic language

versets.arabe: وَإِنَّهُ لَفِي زُبُرِ الْأَوَّلِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa innahu lafi zuburi al-awwalin
versets.francais: Et certes, il est mentionné dans les Écritures des Anciens.
versets.anglais: And indeed, it is [mentioned] in the scriptures of former peoples

versets.arabe: أَوَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُمْ آيَةً أَن يَعْلَمَهُ عُلَمَاءُ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ
versets.phonetique: Awa lam yakun lahum ayatan an ya'lamahu 'ulama'u bani Isra'il
versets.francais: N'est-ce pas là un signe pour eux que les savants des enfants d'Israël le connaissent?
versets.anglais: And has it not been a sign to them that it is recognized by the scholars of the Children of Israel

versets.arabe: وَلَوْ نَزَّلْنَاهُ عَلَىٰ بَعْضِ الْأَعْجَمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa law nazzalnahu 'ala ba'di al-a'jamin
versets.francais: Si Nous l'avions révélé à quelqu'un d'une autre nation que les Arabes,
versets.anglais: And even if We had revealed it to one among the foreigners

versets.arabe: فَقَرَأَهُ عَلَيْهِم مَّا كَانُوا بِهِ مُؤْمِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Faqa ra'ahu 'alayhim ma kanu bihi mu'minin
versets.francais: et qu'il le leur eût récité, ils n'y auraient pas cru.
versets.anglais: And he had recited it to them [perfectly], they would [still] not have been believers in it

versets.arabe: كَذَٰلِكَ سَلَكْنَاهُ فِي قُلُوبِ الْمُجْرِمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Kadhalika salak nahu fi qulubi al-mujrimin
versets.francais: Ainsi l'avons-Nous introduit dans les cœurs des criminels.
versets.anglais: Thus have We inserted disbelief into the hearts of the criminals

versets.arabe: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِ حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُا الْعَذَابَ الْأَلِيمَ
versets.phonetique: La yu'minuna bihi hatta yaraw al-'adhaba al-alim
versets.francais: Ils n'y croiront pas jusqu'à ce qu'ils voient le douloureux châtiment.
versets.anglais: They will not believe in it until they see the painful punishment

versets.arabe: فَيَأْتِيَهُم بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Faya'tiyahum baghtatan wa hum la yash'urun
versets.francais: Il leur viendra à l'improviste sans qu'ils s'en aperçoivent.
versets.anglais: And it will come to them suddenly while they perceive [it] not

versets.arabe: فَيَقُولُوا هَلْ نَحْنُ مُنظَرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Fayaqulu hal nahnu munzarun
versets.francais: Ils diront alors: "Avons-nous un délai de grâce?"
versets.anglais: And they will say, "May we be reprieved

versets.arabe: أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Afabi'adhabina yasta'jilun
versets.francais: Est-ce donc Notre châtiment qu'ils cherchent à hâter?
versets.anglais: So for Our punishment are they impatient

versets.arabe: أَفَرَأَيْتَ إِن مَّتَّعْنَاهُمْ سِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Afara'ayta in matta'nahum sinin
versets.francais: Vois-tu? Si Nous leur accordons la jouissance pendant des années,
versets.anglais: Then have you considered if We gave them enjoyment for years

versets.arabe: ثُمَّ جَاءَهُم مَّا كَانُوا يُوعَدُونَ
versets.phonetique: Thumma ja'ahum ma kanu yu'adun
versets.francais: puis que vient les atteindre ce qui leur était promis,
versets.anglais: And then there came to them that which they were promised

versets.arabe: مَا أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا يُمَتَّعُونَ
versets.phonetique: Ma aghna 'anhum ma kanu yumatta'un
versets.francais: à quoi leur aura servi ce dont ils jouissaient?
versets.anglais: They would not be availed by the enjoyment with which they were provided

versets.arabe: وَمَا أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا لَهَا مُنذِرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa ma ahlaknaa min qaryatin illa laha mundhirun
versets.francais: Nous n'avons jamais anéanti aucune cité sans qu'elle ait eu des avertisseurs
versets.anglais: And We did not destroy any city except that it had warners

versets.arabe: ذِكْرَىٰ وَمَا كُنَّا ظَالِمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Dhikra wa ma kunna zalimin
versets.francais: pour la rappeler à l'ordre. Et Nous ne sommes jamais injustes.
versets.anglais: As a reminder; and never have We been unjust

versets.arabe: وَمَا تَنَزَّلَتْ بِهِ الشَّيَاطِينُ
versets.phonetique: Wa ma tanazzalat bihi ash-shayatin
versets.francais: Et ce ne sont pas les diables qui sont descendus avec (le Coran).
versets.anglais: And the devils have not brought the revelation down

versets.arabe: وَمَا يَنبَغِي لَهُمْ وَمَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa ma yanbaghi lahum wa ma yastati'un
versets.francais: Cela ne leur convient pas et ils n'en sont pas capables.
versets.anglais: It is not allowable for them, nor would they be able

versets.arabe: إِنَّهُمْ عَنِ السَّمْعِ لَمَعْزُولُونَ
versets.phonetique: Innahum 'ani as-sam'i lama'zulun
versets.francais: Car ils sont tenus à l'écart de toute écoute (céleste).
versets.anglais: Indeed they, from [its] hearing, are removed

versets.arabe: فَلَا تَدْعُ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا آخَرَ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُعَذَّبِينَ
versets.phonetique: Fala tad'u ma'a Allahi ilahan akhara fatakuna mina al-mu'adhdhabin
versets.francais: N'invoque donc pas d'autre divinité avec Allah, sinon tu seras du nombre des châtiés.
versets.anglais: So do not invoke with Allah another deity and [thus] be among the punished

versets.arabe: وَأَنذِرْ عَشِيرَتَكَ الْأَقْرَبِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa andhir 'ashirataka al-aqrabin
versets.francais: Et avertis tes proches parents,
versets.anglais: And warn, [O Muhammad], your closest kindred

versets.arabe: وَاخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِمَنِ اتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa ikhfid janahaka liman ittaba'aka mina al-mu'minin
versets.francais: et abaisse ton aile (par bonté) envers ceux des croyants qui te suivent.
versets.anglais: And lower your wing to those who follow you of the believers

versets.arabe: فَإِنْ عَصَوْكَ فَقُلْ إِنِّي بَرِيءٌ مِّمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Fa in 'asaw ka faqul inni bari'un mimma ta'malun
versets.francais: Et s'ils te désobéissent, dis: "Je suis innocent de ce que vous faites."
versets.anglais: And if they disobey you, then say, "Indeed, I am disassociated from what you are doing

versets.arabe: وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى الْعَزِيزِ الرَّحِيمِ
versets.phonetique: Wa tawakkal 'ala al-'azizi ar-rahim
versets.francais: Et place ta confiance en le Puissant, le Miséricordieux,
versets.anglais: And rely upon the Exalted in Might, the Merciful

versets.arabe: الَّذِي يَرَاكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
versets.phonetique: Alladhi yaraka hina taqum
versets.francais: qui te voit quand tu te lèves (pour la prière),
versets.anglais: Who sees you when you arise

versets.arabe: وَتَقَلُّبَكَ فِي السَّاجِدِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa taqallubaka fi as-sajidin
versets.francais: et (voit) tes mouvements parmi ceux qui se prosternent.
versets.anglais: And your movement among those who prostrate

versets.arabe: إِنَّهُ هُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
versets.phonetique: Innahu huwa as-sami'u al-'alim
versets.francais: C'est Lui, l'Audient, l'Omniscient.
versets.anglais: Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing

versets.arabe: هَلْ أُنَبِّئُكُمْ عَلَىٰ مَن تَنَزَّلُ الشَّيَاطِينُ
versets.phonetique: Hal unabbi'ukum 'ala man tanazzalu ash-shayatin
versets.francais: Vous indiquerai-je sur qui les diables descendent?
versets.anglais: Shall I inform you upon whom the devils descend

versets.arabe: تَنَزَّلُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ أَفَّاكٍ أَثِيمٍ
versets.phonetique: Tanazzalu 'ala kulli affakin athim
versets.francais: Ils descendent sur tout grand menteur et pécheur,
versets.anglais: They descend upon every sinful liar

versets.arabe: يُلْقُونَ السَّمْعَ وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ كَاذِبُونَ
versets.phonetique: Yulquna as-sam'a wa aktharuhum kadhibun
versets.francais: qui prêtent l'oreille. Et la plupart d'eux sont des menteurs.
versets.anglais: They pass on what is heard, and most of them are liars

versets.arabe: وَالشُّعَرَاءُ يَتَّبِعُهُمُ الْغَاوُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wash-shu'ara'u yattabi'uhumu al-ghawun
versets.francais: Et ce sont les égarés qui suivent les poètes.
versets.anglais: And the poets - [only] the deviators follow them

versets.arabe: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّهُمْ فِي كُلِّ وَادٍ يَهِيمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Alam tara annahum fi kulli wadin yahimun
versets.francais: Ne vois-tu pas qu'ils errent dans chaque vallée
versets.anglais: Do you not see that in every valley they roam

versets.arabe: وَأَنَّهُمْ يَقُولُونَ مَا لَا يَفْعَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa annahum yaquluna ma la yaf'alun
versets.francais: et qu'ils disent ce qu'ils ne font pas?
versets.anglais: And that they say what they do not do

versets.arabe: إِلَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَذَكَرُوا اللَّهَ كَثِيرًا وَانتَصَرُوا مِن بَعْدِ مَا ظُلِمُوا ۗ وَسَيَعْلَمُ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا أَيَّ مُنقَلَبٍ يَنقَلِبُونَ
versets.phonetique: Illa alladhina amanu wa 'amilu as-salihati wa dhakaru Allaha kathiran wantasaru min ba'di ma dhullimu wa saya'lamu alladhina dhalamu ayya munqalabin yanqalibun
versets.francais: Sauf ceux qui ont cru, fait de bonnes œuvres, invoqué Allah beaucoup, et qui se sont défendus après avoir été lésés. Les injustes sauront bientôt par quel retournement ils seront retournés.
versets.anglais: Except those [poets] who believe and do righteous deeds and remember Allah often and defend [the Muslims] after they were wronged. And those who have wronged are going to know to what [kind of] return they will be returned

versets.arabe: طس تلك آيات القرآن وكتاب مبين
versets.phonetique: Taa-Seen tilka ayat al-qur'an wa kitab mubin
versets.francais: Ta-Seen. Ce sont là les versets du Coran et d'un Livre explicite.
versets.anglais: Ta, Seen. These are the verses of the Qur'an and a clear Book

versets.arabe: هدى وبشرى للمؤمنين
versets.phonetique: Huda wa bushra lil-mu'minin
versets.francais: Une guidance et une bonne nouvelle pour les croyants,
versets.anglais: As guidance and good tidings for the believers

versets.arabe: الذين يقيمون الصلاة ويؤتون الزكاة وهم بالآخرة هم يوقنون
versets.phonetique: Alladhina yuqimun as-salah wa yu'tun az-zakah wa hum bi-al-akhirah hum yawqinun
versets.francais: qui accomplissent la Salat, qui s'acquittent de la Zakah et qui croient à l'au-delà.
versets.anglais: Who establish prayer and give zakah, and of the Hereafter they are certain [in faith]

versets.arabe: إن الذين لا يؤمنون بالآخرة زينا لهم أعمالهم فهم يعمهون
versets.phonetique: Inna alladhina la yu'minun bi-al-akhirah zayyana laha um a'malahum fa-hum ya'mahun
versets.francais: Quant à ceux qui ne croient pas à l'au-delà, Nous avons embelli pour eux leurs œuvres, de sorte qu'ils y sont plongés dans la confusion.
versets.anglais: Indeed, for those who do not believe in the Hereafter, We have made pleasing to them their deeds, so they wander blindly

versets.arabe: أولئك الذين لهم عذاب أليم وهم في الآخرة هم الأخسرون
versets.phonetique: Ula'ika alladhina lahum adhab alim wa hum fi al-akhirah hum al-akhsarun
versets.francais: C'est pour eux qu'il y a un châtiment douloureux et ce sont eux qui seront les plus grands perdants dans l'au-delà.
versets.anglais: Those are the ones for whom there will be the worst of punishment, and in the Hereafter they are the greatest losers

versets.arabe: وإنك لتلقى القرآن من لدن حكيم عليم
versets.phonetique: Wa innaka latalaqa al-qur'an min ladun hakim alim
versets.francais: Et c'est de la part d'Un Sage et Omniscient que tu reçois le Coran.
versets.anglais: And indeed, [O Muhammad], you receive the Qur'an from one Wise and Knowing

versets.arabe: إذ قال موسى لأهله إني آنست نارا سآتيكم منها بخبر أو آتيكم بشهاب قبس لعلكم تصطلون
versets.phonetique: Idh qala Musa li-ahlihi inni anast naran sa'atiakum minha bikhabar aw atiakum bishhab qabus la'allakum tastalun
versets.francais: Quand Moïse dit à sa famille: 'J'ai aperçu un feu. Je vais vous en apporter des nouvelles, ou je vous apporterai un tison enflammé afin que vous puissiez vous chauffer.'
versets.anglais: [Mention] when Moses said to his family, "Indeed, I have perceived a fire. I will bring you from there information or will bring you a burning torch that you may warm yourselves

versets.arabe: فلما جاءها نودي أن بورك من في النار ومن حولها ومن سبحان الله رب العالمين
versets.phonetique: Fa-lamma ja'aha nudi an barika man fi an-nar wa man hawlaha wa subhan Allah rabb al-'alamin
versets.francais: Mais quand il y arriva, on l'appela: 'Que soit béni quiconque est dans ce feu et quiconque l'entoure! Et Gloire à Allah, Seigneur de l'Univers!'
versets.anglais: But when he came to it, he was called, "Blessed is whoever is at the fire and whoever is around it. And exalted is Allah, Lord of the worlds

versets.arabe: يا موسى إنه أنا الله العزيز الحكيم
versets.phonetique: Ya Musa innahu ana Allah al-'aziz al-hakim
versets.francais: Ô Moïse! C'est Moi, Allah, le Puissant, le Sage.
versets.anglais: O Moses, indeed it is I - Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Wise

versets.arabe: وألق عصاك فلما رآها تهتز كأنها جان ولى مدبرا ولم يعقب يا موسى لا تخف إني لا يخاف لدي المرسلون
versets.phonetique: Wa alq aasak fa-lamma ra'aha tahtaz ka'anha jan walla mudbiran wa lam ya'aqib ya Musa la takhaf inni la yakhaf ladayya al-mursilun
versets.francais: Jette ton bâton!' Quand il le vit s'agiter comme un serpent, il recula sans revenir. 'Ô Moïse! Ne crains pas. Auprès de Moi, les Messagers ne craignent point.
versets.anglais: And [he was told], "Throw down your staff." But when he saw it writhing as if it were a snake, he turned in flight and did not return. [Allah said], "O Moses, fear not. Indeed, in My presence the messengers do not fear

versets.arabe: إلا من ظلم ثم بدل حسنا بعد سوء فإني غفور رحيم
versets.phonetique: Illa man dhalam thumma baddala husnan ba'da su' fa-inni ghafur rahim
versets.francais: Seul celui qui a commis une injustice, puis a changé le mal en bien. Car je suis Pardonneur et Miséricordieux.
versets.anglais: Otherwise, he who wrongs, then substitutes good after evil - indeed, I am Forgiving and Merciful

versets.arabe: وأدخل يدك في جيبك تخرج بيضاء من غير سوء في تسع آيات إلى فرعون وقومه إنهم كانوا قوما فاسقين
versets.phonetique: Wa adkhil yadak fi jaybik takhraj bayda' min ghayri su' fi tisa' ayat ila fir'awn wa qawmihi innahum kanu qawman fasiqin
versets.francais: Mets ta main dans ton sein; elle en sortira blanche sans souffrir d'aucun mal. Ce sera au nombre des neuf signes pour Pharaon et son peuple. Car ce peuple est un peuple de pervers.'
versets.anglais: And put your hand into the opening of your garment [at the breast]; it will come out white without disease. [These are] among the nine signs [you will take] to Pharaoh and his people. Indeed, they have been a people defiantly disobedient

versets.arabe: فلما جاءتهم آياتنا مبصرة قالوا هذا سحر مبين
versets.phonetique: Fa-lamma ja'athum ayatuna mubasirah qalu hadha sihr mubin
versets.francais: Quand Nos signes évidents leur vinrent, ils dirent: 'Ceci est une magie évidente.'
versets.anglais: But when there came to them Our visible signs, they said, "This is obvious magic

versets.arabe: وجحدوا بها واستيقنتها أنفسهم ظلما وعلوا فانظر كيف كان عاقبة المفسدين
versets.phonetique: Wa jahadhu biha wa-stayqanat-ha anfusuhum dhulman wa 'uluwwan fa-andhur kayf kan 'aqibat al-mufsiddin
versets.francais: Ils les reniaient par orgueil et par injustice, bien que leurs âmes en fussent convaincues. Regardez comment a été la fin de ceux qui sèment la corruption.
versets.anglais: And they rejected them, while their [inner] selves were convinced thereof, out of injustice and haughtiness. So see how was the end of the corrupters

versets.arabe: ولقد آتينا داود وسليمان علما وقالا الحمد لله الذي فضلنا على كثير من عباده المؤمنين
versets.phonetique: Wa laqad ataina Dawud wa Sulayman ilman wa qala al-hamdu lil-lah alladhee faddalana alaa kathir min ibadih al-mu'minin
versets.francais: Et Nous avons donné à David et à Salomon un savoir et ils dirent: 'Louange à Allah qui nous a favorisés par rapport à beaucoup de Ses serviteurs croyants.'
versets.anglais: And We had certainly given to David and Solomon knowledge, and they said, "Praise [is due] to Allah, who has favored us over many of His believing servants

versets.arabe: ووَرِث سليمان داود وقال يا أيها الناس علمنا منطق الطير وأوتينا من كل شيء إن هذا لهو الفضل المبين
versets.phonetique: Wa warith Sulayman Dawud wa qala ya ayyuha an-nas 'allimna mantaq at-tayr wa utina min kulli shay'in inna hadha lahu al-fadl al-mubin
versets.francais: Et Salomon hérita de David. Il dit: 'Ô hommes! On nous a enseigné le langage des oiseaux et on nous a donné de toutes choses. C'est là certes une grâce manifeste.'
versets.anglais: And Solomon inherited David. He said, "O people, we have been taught the language of birds, and we have been given from all things. Indeed, this is evident bounty

versets.arabe: وحشر لسليمان جنوده من الجن والإنس والطير فهم يوزعون
versets.phonetique: Wa hashar li-Sulayman junudu-hu min al-jinn wa al-ins wa at-tayr fa-hum yuwza'un
versets.francais: Et pour Salomon, Nous mîmes en revue son armée de djinns, d'hommes et d'oiseaux, et ils étaient maintenus dans l'ordre.
versets.anglais: And gathered for Solomon were his soldiers of the jinn and men and birds, and they were [marching] in rows

versets.arabe: حتى إذا أتوا على وادي النمل قالت نملة يا أيها النمل ادخلوا مساكنكم لا يحطمنكم سليمان وجنوده وهم لا يشعرون
versets.phonetique: Hatta idha atu alaa wadi an-naml qalat namla ya ayyuha al-naml udkhlu maskinakum la yahtimankum Sulayman wa junudu-hu wa hum la yash'urun
versets.francais: Quand ils arrivèrent à la Vallée des Fourmis, une fourmi dit: 'Ô fourmis! Entrez dans vos demeures, de peur que Salomon et ses armées ne vous écrasent sans s'en apercevoir.'
versets.anglais: Until, when they came upon the valley of the ants, an ant said, "O ants, enter your dwellings that you not be crushed by Solomon and his soldiers while they perceive not

versets.arabe: فتبسم ضاحكا من قولها وقال رب أوزعني أن أشكر نعمتك التي أنعمت علي وعلى والديّ وأن أعمل صالحا ترضاه وأدخلني برحمتك في عبادك الصالحين
versets.phonetique: Fa-tabassamada ahikan min qawliha wa qala rabbi awzi'ni an ashkur ni'mataka allatee an'amt alayya wa alaa wa lidayya wa an a'mal salihan tardahu wa adkhilni birahmatika fi ibadaka as-saliheen
versets.francais: Il sourit en riant de sa parole et dit: 'Seigneur! Permets-moi de rendre grâces pour le bienfait dont Tu m'as comblé ainsi que mes père et mère, et de faire une bonne œuvre que Tu approuves. Et admets-moi, par Ta miséricorde, parmi Tes serviteurs vertueux.'
versets.anglais: So [Solomon] smiled, amused at her speech, and said, "My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to do righteousness of which You approve. And admit me by Your mercy into [the ranks of] Your righteous servants

versets.arabe: وتفقد الطير فقال ما لي لا أرى الهدهد أم كان من الغائبين
versets.phonetique: Wa tafaqqad at-tayr fa-qala ma li la ara al-hudhud am kan min al-gha'ibin
versets.francais: Et il passa en revue les oiseaux et dit: 'Pourquoi ne vois-je pas la Huppe? Sera-t-elle parmi les absents?
versets.anglais: And he took attendance of the birds and said, "Why do I not see the hoopoe - or is he among the absent

versets.arabe: لأعذبنه عذابا شديدا أو لأذبحنه أو ليأتيني بسلطان
versets.phonetique: La-a'adhdhiba-nhu 'adhaba shadida aw la-adhabba-nhu aw li-ya'tiya-ni bi-sultan
versets.francais: Je le châtierai d'un châtiment rigoureux ou je l'égorgerai, à moins qu'il ne m'apporte une excuse.'
versets.anglais: I will surely punish him with a severe punishment or slaughter him unless he brings me clear authorization

versets.arabe: فمكث غير بعيد فقال أحطت بما لم تحط به وجئتك من سبأ بنبأ يقين
versets.phonetique: Fa-makatha ghayra ba'id fa-qala ahatu bimah lam tahut bih wa ji'tuka min saba' bi-naba' yaqin
versets.francais: Mais il ne tarda pas longtemps et dit: 'J'ai appris ce que tu ne savais pas. Je te rapporte de Sabée une nouvelle certaine.
versets.anglais: But the hoopoe stayed not long and said, "I have encompassed [in knowledge] that which you have not encompassed, and I have come to you from Sheba with certain news

versets.arabe: إني وجدت امرأة تملكهم وأوتيت من كل شيء ولها عرش عظيم
versets.phonetique: Inni wajadtu imra'ah tamliku-hum wa utiyat min kulli shay'in wa laha 'arsh 'adhim
versets.francais: J'ai trouvé une femme qui règne sur eux, et elle a reçu de toute chose. Et elle a un trône magnifique.
versets.anglais: Indeed, I found [there] a woman ruling them, and she has been given of all things, and she has a great throne

versets.arabe: وجدتها وقومها يسجدون للشمس من دون الله وزين لهم الشيطان أعمالهم فصدهم عن السبيل فهم لا يهتدون
versets.phonetique: Wajadtuha wa qawmaha yasjudun li-ash-shams min dun Allah wa zayyana lahum ash-shaytan a'malahum fa-sadahum an as-sabil fa-hum la yahtadun
versets.francais: Je les ai trouvés, elle et son peuple, se prosternant devant le soleil au lieu d'Allah. Et le Diable a embelli leurs œuvres et les a détournés du Chemin; de sorte qu'ils ne sont pas guidés.
versets.anglais: I found her and her people prostrating to the sun instead of Allah, and Satan has made their deeds pleasing to them and averted them from [His] way, so they are not guided

versets.arabe: ألا يسجدوا لله الذي يخرج الخبء في السماوات والأرض ويعلم ما تخفون وما تعلنون
versets.phonetique: Alla yasjudu lil-lah alladhee yukhraj al-khib' fi as-samawat wa al-ardh wa ya'lam ma takhfun wa ma tu'linun
versets.francais: Ils ne se prosternent pas devant Allah, qui fait sortir ce qui est caché dans les cieux et la terre et qui sait ce que vous cachez et ce que vous divulguez.
versets.anglais: [And] so they do not prostrate to Allah, who brings forth what is hidden within the heavens and the earth and knows what you conceal and what you declare

versets.arabe: الله لا إله إلا هو رب العرش العظيم
versets.phonetique: Allah la ilaha illa huwa rabb al-'arsh al-'adhim
versets.francais: Allah! Il n'y a d'autre divinité que Lui, le Seigneur du Trône immense.
versets.anglais: Allah - there is no deity except Him, Lord of the Great Throne

versets.arabe: قال سنظر أصدقت أم كنت من الكاذبين
versets.phonetique: Qala sa-nandhar asadaqta am kunt min al-kadhihin
versets.francais: Salomon dit: 'Nous allons vérifier si tu dis la vérité ou si tu es du nombre des menteurs.
versets.anglais: [Solomon] said, "We will see whether you were truthful or were of the liars

versets.arabe: اذهب بكتابي هذا فألقه إليهم ثم تول عنهم فانظر ماذا يرجعون
versets.phonetique: Adhhab bi-kitabi hadha fa-alqih ilayhi-m thumma tawwal anhu-m fa-andhur madha yarji'un
versets.francais: Va avec cette lettre de moi et jette-la vers eux; puis retire-toi d'auprès d'eux et vois ce qu'ils répondent.'
versets.anglais: Take this letter of mine and deliver it to them. Then leave them and see what [answer] they will return

versets.arabe: قالت يا أيها الملأ إني ألقي إلي كتاب كريم
versets.phonetique: Qalat ya ayyuha al-mala inni ulqi ilayya kitab karim
versets.francais: Elle dit: 'Ô Conseil! Une lettre noble m'a été jetée.'
versets.anglais: She said, "O eminent ones, indeed, to me has been delivered a noble letter

versets.arabe: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ألا تعلوا علي وأتوني مسلمين
versets.phonetique: Bismillah ar-rahman ar-rahim alla ta'lu alayya wa atiun muslimin
versets.francais: 'Elle est au nom d'Allah le Miséricordieux. Qu'au nom du Seigneur vous soyez, 'adorateurs soumis!'
versets.anglais: Indeed, it is from Solomon, and indeed, it reads: 'In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful

versets.arabe: قالت يا أيها الملأ أفتوني في أمري ما كنت قاطعة أمرا حتى تشهدون
versets.phonetique: Qalat ya ayyuha al-mala aftuni fi amri ma kunt qati'ah amran hatta tashhadu
versets.francais: Elle dit: 'Ô Conseil! Conseillez-moi dans cette affaire. Je ne trancherai aucune affaire sans votre présence.'
versets.anglais: Be not haughty with me but come to me in submission [as Muslims]

versets.arabe: قالوا نحن أولو قوة وأولو بأس شديد والأمر إليك فانظري ماذا تأمرين
versets.phonetique: Qalu nahnu ulu quwwah wa ulu ba's shadid wa al-amr ilayk fa-andhuri madha ta'murin
versets.francais: Ils dirent: 'Nous sommes gens de force et gens de grande puissance. L'ordre est à toi; vois donc ce que tu commanderas.'
versets.anglais: She said, "O eminent ones, advise me in my affair. I would not decide a matter until you witness [for] me

versets.arabe: قالت إن الملوك إذا دخلوا قرية أفسدوها وجعلوا أعزة أهلها أذلة وكذلك يفعلون
versets.phonetique: Qalat inn al-muluk idha dakhalu qaryah afsad-ha wa ja'alu a'izzat ahlih adhillah wa kadhalika yaf'alun
versets.francais: Elle dit: 'Quand les rois font leur entrée dans une cité, ils la mettent en ruine et réduisent ses habitants à l'abaissement. C'est ainsi qu'ils agissent.
versets.anglais: They said, "We are men of strength and of great military might, but the command is yours, so see what you will command

versets.arabe: وإني مرسلة إليهم بهدية فناظرة بم يرجع المرسلون
versets.phonetique: Wa inni mursalah ilayhi-m bi-hadiyyah fa-nadhirah bim yarji'a al-mursilun
versets.francais: Je vais leur envoyer un présent et voir avec quoi les messagers reviendront.'
versets.anglais: She said, "Indeed kings - when they enter a city, they ruin it and render the honored of its people humbled. And thus do they do

versets.arabe: فلما جاء سليمان قال أتمدون في الآل أعملتم شتى أم تعملون نفسا واحدة قال الذي عنده علم من الكتاب أنا آتيك بعرشها قبل أن يأتيك طائفة من جنودك
versets.phonetique: Fa-lamma ja'a Sulayman qala atmuddun fi al-al a'maltum shatta am ta'malun nafsan wahidah qala alladhee indah 'ilm min al-kitab ana atikal bi-'arshih qabl an ya'tika ta'ifah min junudik
