versets.anglais: Those upon whom the word will have come into effect will say, "Our Lord, these are the ones we led to error. We led them to error just as we were in error. We declare our disassociation [from them] to You. They did not used to worship us

versets.arabe: وَقِيلَ ادْعُوا شُرَكَاءَكُمْ فَدَعَوْهُمْ فَلَمْ يَسْتَجِيبُوا لَهُمْ وَرَأَوُا الْعَذَابَ ۚ لَوْ أَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا يَهْتَدُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa qîlad'û shurakâ'akum fada'awhum falam yastajîbû lahum wa ra'awul-'adhâb, law annahum kânû yahtadûn
versets.francais: Et on leur dira: "Appelez vos associés." Ils les appelleront, mais ils ne leur répondront pas. Ils verront le châtiment. Ah! S'ils avaient été bien guidés!
versets.anglais: And it will be said, "Invoke your 'partners' " and they will invoke them; but they will not respond to them, and they will see the punishment. If only they had followed guidance

versets.arabe: وَيَوْمَ يُنَادِيهِمْ فَيَقُولُ مَاذَا أَجَبْتُمُ الْمُرْسَلِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa yawma yunâdîhim fayaqûlu mâdhâ ajabtumul-mursalîn
versets.francais: Et le jour où Il les appellera et dira: "Qu'avez-vous répondu aux envoyés?"
versets.anglais: And [mention] the Day He will call them and say, "What did you answer the messengers

versets.arabe: فَعَمِيَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ الْأَنبَاءُ يَوْمَئِذٍ فَهُمْ لَا يَتَسَاءَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Fa'amiyat 'alayhimul-anbâ'u yawma'idhin fahum lâ yatasâ'alûn
versets.francais: Les nouvelles leur seront obscures ce jour-là, et ils ne pourront se consulter.
versets.anglais: But the information will be unapparent to them that Day, so they will not [be able to] ask one another

versets.arabe: فَأَمَّا مَن تَابَ وَآمَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَعَسَىٰ أَن يَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُفْلِحِينَ
versets.phonetique: Fa ammâ man tâba wa âmana wa 'amila sâlihan fa'asâ an yakûna minal-muflihîn
versets.francais: Quant à celui qui se repent, croit et accomplit de bonnes œuvres, peut-être sera-t-il du nombre des bienheureux.
versets.anglais: But as for one who had repented, believed, and done righteousness, it is promised by Allah that he will be among the successful

versets.arabe: وَرَبُّكَ يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَاءُ وَيَخْتَارُ ۗ مَا كَانَ لَهُمُ الْخِيَرَةُ ۚ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَتَعَالَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa rabbuka yakhluqu mâ yashâ'u wa yakhtâr, mâ kâna lahumul-khiyara, subhânAllâhi wa ta'âlâ 'ammâ yushrikûn
versets.francais: Et ton Seigneur crée ce qu'Il veut et choisit; ils n'ont pas le choix. Gloire à Allah! Il est au-dessus de ce qu'ils Lui associent!
versets.anglais: And your Lord creates what He wills and chooses; not for them was the choice. Exalted is Allah and high above what they associate with Him

versets.arabe: وَرَبُّكَ يَعْلَمُ مَا تُكِنُّ صُدُورُهُمْ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa rabbuka ya'lamu mâ tukinnu sudûruhum wa mâ yu'linûn
versets.francais: Et ton Seigneur sait ce que leurs poitrines cachent et ce qu'ils annoncent.
versets.anglais: And your Lord knows what their breasts conceal and what they declare

versets.arabe: وَهُوَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ لَهُ الْحَمْدُ فِي الْأُولَىٰ وَالْآخِرَةِ ۖ وَلَهُ الْحُكْمُ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa huwAllâhu lâ ilâha illâ huwa, lahul-hamdu fil-ûlâ wal-âkhirati wa lahul-hukmu wa ilayhi turja'ûn
versets.francais: C'est Lui Allah, il n'y a de dieu que Lui. À Lui la louange dans la vie présente et dans la dernière. À Lui le jugement et c'est vers Lui que vous serez ramenés.
versets.anglais: And He is Allah; there is no deity except Him. To Him is [due all] praise in the first [life] and the Hereafter. And His is the [final] decision, and to Him you will be returned

versets.arabe: قُلْ أَرَأَيْتُمْ إِن جَعَلَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْكُمُ اللَّيْلَ سَرْمَدًا إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ مَنْ إِلَٰهٌ غَيْرُ اللَّهِ يَأْتِيكُم بِضِيَاءٍ ۖ أَفَلَا تَسْمَعُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qul ara'aytum in ja'alAllâhu 'alaykumul-layla sarmadan ilâ yawmil-qiyâmati man ilâhun ghayruAllâhi ya'tîkum bidhiyâ'in, afalâ tasma'ûn
versets.francais: Dis: "Voyez-vous: si Allah vous imposait la nuit, sans interruption, jusqu'au Jour de la Résurrection, quel autre dieu qu'Allah vous apporterait de la lumière? N'entendez-vous pas?"
versets.anglais: Say, "Have you considered: if Allah should make for you the night continuous until the Day of Resurrection, what deity other than Allah could bring you light? Then will you not hear

versets.arabe: قُلْ أَرَأَيْتُمْ إِن جَعَلَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْكُمُ النَّهَارَ سَرْمَدًا إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ مَنْ إِلَٰهٌ غَيْرُ اللَّهِ يَأْتِيكُم بِلَيْلٍ تَسْكُنُونَ فِيهِ ۖ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qul ara'aytum in ja'alAllâhu 'alaykumun-nahâra sarmadan ilâ yawmil-qiyâmati man ilâhun ghayruAllâhi ya'tîkum bilaylin taskunûna fîhi, afalâ tubsirûn
versets.francais: Dis: "Voyez-vous: si Allah vous imposait le jour, sans interruption, jusqu'au Jour de la Résurrection, quel autre dieu qu'Allah vous apporterait une nuit pour vous y reposer? Ne voyez-vous pas?"
versets.anglais: Say, "Have you considered: if Allah should make for you the day continuous until the Day of Resurrection, what deity other than Allah could bring you a night in which you may rest? Then will you not see

versets.arabe: وَمِن رَّحْمَتِهِ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ اللَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ لِتَسْكُنُوا فِيهِ وَلِتَبْتَغُوا مِن فَضْلِهِ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa min rahmatihî ja'ala lakumul-layla wan-nahâra litaskunû fîhi wa litabtaghû min fadhlihî wa la'allakum tashkurûn
versets.francais: Par Sa miséricorde, Il vous a accordé la nuit et le jour pour que vous vous y reposiez, et que vous recherchiez de Sa grâce, et afin que vous soyez reconnaissants.
versets.anglais: And out of His mercy He made for you the night and the day that you may rest therein and [by day] seek from His bounty and [that] perhaps you will be grateful

versets.arabe: وَيَوْمَ يُنَادِيهِمْ فَيَقُولُ أَيْنَ شُرَكَائِيَ الَّذِينَ كُنتُمْ تَزْعُمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa yawma yunâdîhim fayaqûlu ayna shurakâ'iyalladhîna kuntum taz'umûn
versets.francais: Et le jour où Il les appellera et dira: "Où sont Mes associés que vous prétendiez?"
versets.anglais: And [warn of] the Day He will call them and say, "Where are my 'partners' which you used to claim

versets.arabe: وَنَزَعْنَا مِن كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ شَهِيدًا فَقُلْنَا هَاتُوا بُرْهَانَكُمْ فَعَلِمُوا أَنَّ الْحَقَّ لِلَّهِ وَضَلَّ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا يَفْتَرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa naza'nâ min kulli ummatin shahîdan faqulnâ hâtû burhânakum fa'alimû annal-haqqa lillâhi wa dhalla 'anhum mâ kânû yaftarûn
versets.francais: Nous tirerons de chaque communauté un témoin et dirons: "Apportez votre preuve." Ils sauront alors que la vérité appartient à Allah, et ce qu'ils inventaient les aura abandonnés.
versets.anglais: And We will extract from every nation a witness and say, "Produce your proof," and they will know that the truth belongs to Allah, and lost from them is that which they used to invent

versets.arabe: إِنَّ قَارُونَ كَانَ مِن قَوْمِ مُوسَىٰ فَبَغَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ۖ وَآتَيْنَاهُ مِنَ الْكُنُوزِ مَا إِنَّ مَفَاتِحَهُ لَتَنُوءُ بِالْعُصْبَةِ أُولِي الْقُوَّةِ ۖ إِذْ قَالَ لَهُ قَوْمُهُ لَا تَفْرَحْ ۖ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ الْفَرِحِينَ
versets.phonetique: Inna Qârûna kâna min qawmi Mûsâ fabagha 'alayhim, wa âtaynâhu minal-kunûzi mâ inna mafâtihahu latanû'u bil-'usbati ulil-quwwati, idh qâla lahu qawmuhu lâ tafrah, innAllâha lâ yuhibbul-farihîn
versets.francais: Coré était du peuple de Moïse, et il les opprima. Nous lui avions donné des trésors dont les clés auraient pesé lourd à un groupe d'hommes vigoureux. Quand son peuple lui dit: "Ne te réjouis pas, car Allah n'aime pas les exultants."
versets.anglais: Indeed, Qarun was from the people of Moses, but he tyrannized them. And We gave him of treasures whose keys would burden a band of strong men; thereupon his people said to him, "Do not exult. Indeed, Allah does not like the exultant

versets.arabe: وَابْتَغِ فِيمَا آتَاكَ اللَّهُ الدَّارَ الْآخِرَةَ ۖ وَلَا تَنسَ نَصِيبَكَ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا ۖ وَأَحْسِن كَمَا أَحْسَنَ اللَّهُ إِلَيْكَ ۖ وَلَا تَبْغِ الْفَسَادَ فِي الْأَرْضِ ۖ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ الْمُفْسِدِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wabtaghi fîmâ âtâkAllâhud-dâral-âkhirata wa lâ tansa nasîbaka minad-dunyâ wa ahsin kamâ ahsanAllâhu ilayka wa lâ tabghil-fasâda fil-ardi, innAllâha lâ yuhibbul-mufsidîn
versets.francais: Cherche, dans ce qu'Allah t'a donné, la demeure de l'au-delà. N'oublie pas ta part de cette vie. Fais du bien comme Allah t'a fait du bien. Et ne recherche pas la corruption sur terre. Car Allah n'aime pas les fauteurs de corruption.
versets.anglais: But seek, through that which Allah has given you, the home of the Hereafter; and [yet], do not forget your share of the world. And do good as Allah has done good to you. And desire not corruption in the land. Indeed, Allah does not like corrupters

versets.arabe: قَالَ إِنَّمَا أُوتِيتُهُ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ عِندِي ۚ أَوَلَمْ يَعْلَمْ أَنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ أَهْلَكَ مِن قَبْلِهِ مِنَ الْقُرُونِ مَنْ هُوَ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُ قُوَّةً وَأَكْثَرُ جَمْعًا ۚ وَلَا يُسْأَلُ عَن ذُنُوبِهِمُ الْمُجْرِمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qâla innamâ ûtîtuhu 'alâ 'ilmin 'indî, awa lam ya'lam annAllâha qad ahlaka min qablihi minal-qurûni man huwa ashaddu minhu quwwatan wa aktharu jam'â, wa lâ yus'alu 'an dhunûbihimul-mujrimûn
versets.francais: Il dit: "C'est par une science que j'ai, que ceci m'a été accordé." Ne savait-il pas qu'Allah avait anéanti avant lui des générations plus fortes que lui et ayant plus amassé? Les criminels n'auront pas à rendre compte de leurs péchés.
versets.anglais: He said, "I was only given it because of knowledge I have." Did he not know that Allah had destroyed before him of generations those who were greater than him in power and greater in accumulation [of wealth]? But the criminals, about their sins, will not be asked

versets.arabe: فَخَرَجَ عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِ فِي زِينَتِهِ ۖ قَالَ الَّذِينَ يُرِيدُونَ الْحَيَاةَ الدُّنْيَا يَا لَيْتَ لَنَا مِثْلَ مَا أُوتِيَ قَارُونُ إِنَّهُ لَذُو حَظٍّ عَظِيمٍ
versets.phonetique: Fakharaja 'alâ qawmihi fî zînatih, qâlal-ladhîna yurîdûnal-hayâtad-dunyâ yâ layta lanâ mithla mâ ûtiya Qârûnu innahu ladhû hazzin 'azîm
versets.francais: Il sortit vers son peuple avec tout son faste. Ceux qui désiraient la vie présente dirent: "Ah! Si seulement nous avions ce qu'on a donné à Coré! Il a vraiment une grande chance!"
versets.anglais: So he came out before his people in his adornment. Those who desired the worldly life said, "Oh, would that we had like what was given to Qarun. Indeed, he is one of great fortune

versets.arabe: وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْعِلْمَ وَيْلَكُمْ ثَوَابُ اللَّهِ خَيْرٌ لِّمَنْ آمَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا وَلَا يُلَقَّاهَا إِلَّا الصَّابِرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa qâlal-ladhîna ûtul-'ilma waylakum thawâbullâhi khayrun liman âmana wa 'amila sâlihan wa lâ yulaqqâhâ illas-sâbirûn
versets.francais: Et ceux à qui la science avait été donnée dirent: "Malheur à vous! La récompense d'Allah est meilleure pour celui qui croit et fait le bien. Mais seuls les endurants l'obtiendront."
versets.anglais: But those who had been given knowledge said, "Woe to you! The reward of Allah is better for he who believes and does righteousness. And none are granted it except the patient

versets.arabe: فَخَسَفْنَا بِهِ وَبِدَارِهِ الْأَرْضَ فَمَا كَانَ لَهُ مِن فِئَةٍ يَنصُرُونَهُ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُنتَصِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Fakhasafnâ bihi wa bidârihil-arda famâ kâna lahu min fi'atin yansuranahu min dûnAllâhi wa mâ kâna minal-muntasirîn
versets.francais: Alors Nous le fîmes engloutir, lui et sa maison, par la terre. Il n'avait aucun groupe pour le défendre contre Allah. Il ne pouvait pas se défendre lui-même.
versets.anglais: And We caused the earth to swallow him and his home. And there was for him no company to aid him other than Allah, nor was he of those who [could] defend themselves

versets.arabe: وَأَصْبَحَ الَّذِينَ تَمَنَّوْا مَكَانَهُ بِالْأَمْسِ يَقُولُونَ وَيْكَأَنَّ اللَّهَ يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ وَيَقْدِرُ ۖ لَوْلَا أَن مَّنَّ اللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا لَخَسَفَ بِنَا ۖ وَيْكَأَنَّهُ لَا يُفْلِحُ الْكَافِرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa asbahal-ladhîna tamannaw makânahu bil-amsi yaqûlûna wayka'annAllâha yabsuturrrizqa liman yashâ'u min 'ibâdihi wa yaqdiru, lawlâ an mannAllâhu 'alaynâ lakhasafa binâ, wayka'annahu lâ yufhilul-kâfirûn
versets.francais: Et ceux qui avaient désiré sa place la veille se mirent à dire: "Ah! Vraiment c'est Allah qui étend la subsistance à qui Il veut de Ses serviteurs, ou la restreint. Si Allah ne nous avait pas gratifiés, Il nous aurait engloutis. Ah! Vraiment les ingrats ne réussissent point."
versets.anglais: And those who had wished for his position the previous day began to say, "Oh, how Allah extends provision to whom He wills of His servants and restricts it! If not that Allah had conferred favor on us, He would have caused it to swallow us. Oh, how the disbelievers do not succeed

versets.arabe: تِلْكَ الدَّارُ الْآخِرَةُ نَجْعَلُهَا لِلَّذِينَ لَا يُرِيدُونَ عُلُوًّا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فَسَادًا ۚ وَالْعَاقِبَةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
versets.phonetique: Tilkad-dârul-âkhiratu naj'aluhâ lil-ladhîna lâ yurîdûna 'uluwwan fil-ardi wa lâ fasâdâ, wal-'âqibatu lil-muttaqîn
versets.francais: Cette demeure de l'au-delà, Nous la réservons à ceux qui ne cherchent ni à s'élever sur la terre ni à y semer la corruption. L'heureuse fin est aux pieux.
versets.anglais: That home of the Hereafter We assign to those who do not desire exaltedness upon the earth or corruption. And the [best] outcome is for the righteous

versets.arabe: مَن جَاءَ بِالْحَسَنَةِ فَلَهُ خَيْرٌ مِّنْهَا ۖ وَمَن جَاءَ بِالسَّيِّئَةِ فَلَا يُجْزَى الَّذِينَ عَمِلُوا السَّيِّئَاتِ إِلَّا مَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Man jâ'a bil-hasanati falahu khayrun minhâ, wa man jâ'a bis-sayyi'ati falâ yujzal-ladhîna 'amiluss-sayyi'âti illâ mâ kânû ya'malûn
versets.francais: Quiconque viendra avec une bonne action obtiendra mieux qu'elle. Quiconque viendra avec une mauvaise action, ceux qui ont commis de mauvaises actions ne seront rétribués que selon ce qu'ils avaient fait.
versets.anglais: Whoever comes [on the Day of Judgement] with a good deed will have better than it; and whoever comes with an evil deed - then those who did evil deeds will not be recompensed except [as much as] what they used to do

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الَّذِي فَرَضَ عَلَيْكَ الْقُرْآنَ لَرَادُّكَ إِلَىٰ مَعَادٍ ۚ قُل رَّبِّي أَعْلَمُ مَن جَاءَ بِالْهُدَىٰ وَمَنْ هُوَ فِي ضَلَالٍ مُّبِينٍ
versets.phonetique: Innal-ladhî faradha 'alaykal-Qur'âna larâdduka ilâ ma'âd, qul rabbî a'lamu man jâ'a bil-hudâ wa man huwa fî dalâlin mubîn
versets.francais: Celui qui t'a imposé le Coran te ramènera certainement au lieu de retour. Dis: "Mon Seigneur sait mieux qui apporte la guidée et qui est dans un égarement manifeste."
versets.anglais: Indeed, [O Muhammad], He who imposed upon you the Qur'an will take you back to a place of return. Say, "My Lord is most knowing of who brings guidance and who is in clear error

versets.arabe: وَمَا كُنتَ تَرْجُو أَن يُلْقَىٰ إِلَيْكَ الْكِتَابُ إِلَّا رَحْمَةً مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۖ فَلَا تَكُونَنَّ ظَهِيرًا لِّلْكَافِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa mâ kunta tarjû an yulqâ ilaykak-kitâbu illâ rahmatan min rabbika, falâ takûnanna zahîran lil-kâfirîn
versets.francais: Tu n'espérais pas que le Livre te soit révélé; c'est uniquement une miséricorde de ton Seigneur. Ne sois donc jamais un soutien pour les mécréants.
versets.anglais: And you were not expecting that the Book would be conveyed to you, but [it is] a mercy from your Lord. So do not be an assistant to the disbelievers

versets.arabe: وَلَا يَصُدُّنَّكَ عَنْ آيَاتِ اللَّهِ بَعْدَ إِذْ أُنزِلَتْ إِلَيْكَ ۖ وَادْعُ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ۖ وَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa lâ yasuddunnaka 'an âyâtillâhi ba'da idh unzilat ilayk, wad'u ilâ rabbika wa lâ takûnanna minal-mushrikîn
versets.francais: Et qu'on ne te détourne point des versets d'Allah après qu'ils t'ont été révélés. Appelle à ton Seigneur et ne sois pas du nombre des associateurs.
versets.anglais: And never let them avert you from the verses of Allah after they have been revealed to you. And invite [people] to your Lord. And never be of those who associate others with Allah

versets.arabe: وَلَا تَدْعُ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا آخَرَ ۘ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ كُلُّ شَيْءٍ هَالِكٌ إِلَّا وَجْهَهُ ۚ لَهُ الْحُكْمُ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa lâ tad'u ma'AllâhI ilâhan âkhara, lâ ilâha illâ huw, kullu shay'in hâlikun illâ wajhah, lahul-hukmu wa ilayhi turja'ûn
versets.francais: N'invoque pas une autre divinité avec Allah. Point de dieu que Lui! Tout périt sauf Sa Face. À Lui le jugement. Et c'est vers Lui que vous serez ramenés.
versets.anglais: And do not invoke with Allah another deity. There is no deity except Him. Everything will be destroyed except His Face. His is the judgement, and to Him you will be returned

versets.arabe: الم
versets.phonetique: Alif-Lâm-Mîm
versets.francais: Alif, Lâm, Mîm.
versets.anglais: Alif, Lam, Meem

versets.arabe: أَحَسِبَ النَّاسُ أَن يُتْرَكُوا أَن يَقُولُوا آمَنَّا وَهُمْ لَا يُفْتَنُونَ
versets.phonetique: Ahasiban-nâsu an yutraku an yaqûlû âmannâ wa hum lâ yuftanûn
versets.francais: Les gens pensent-ils qu'on les laissera dire "Nous croyons" sans les éprouver?
versets.anglais: Do the people think that they will be left to say, "We believe" and they will not be tried

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۖ فَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ صَدَقُوا وَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ الْكَاذِبِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa laqad fatannal-ladhîna min qablihim, falaya'lamannAllâhul-ladhîna sadaqû wa laya'lamannal-kâdhibîn
versets.francais: Nous avons certes éprouvé ceux d'avant eux. Allah saura certainement ceux qui disent la vérité et Il saura certainement les menteurs.
versets.anglais: But We have certainly tried those before them, and Allah will surely make evident those who are truthful, and He will surely make evident the liars

versets.arabe: أَمْ حَسِبَ الَّذِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ السَّيِّئَاتِ أَن يَسْبِقُونَا ۚ سَاءَ مَا يَحْكُمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Am hasibal-ladhîna ya'malûnas-sayyi'âti an yasbiqûnâ, sâ'a mâ yahkumûn
versets.francais: Ou bien ceux qui commettent le mal pensent-ils pouvoir Nous devancer? Comme ils jugent mal!
versets.anglais: Or do those who do evil deeds think they can outrun Us? Evil is what they judge

versets.arabe: مَن كَانَ يَرْجُو لِقَاءَ اللَّهِ فَإِنَّ أَجَلَ اللَّهِ لَآتٍ ۚ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
versets.phonetique: Man kâna yarjû liqâ'Allâhi fa'inna ajalAllâhi la'ât, wa huwas-samî'ul-'alîm
versets.francais: Quiconque espère la rencontre d'Allah... le terme fixé par Allah viendra. Il est l'Audient, l'Omniscient.
versets.anglais: Whoever should hope for the meeting with Allah - indeed, the term decreed by Allah is coming. And He is the Hearing, the Knowing

versets.arabe: وَمَن جَاهَدَ فَإِنَّمَا يُجَاهِدُ لِنَفْسِهِ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَغَنِيٌّ عَنِ الْعَالَمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa man jâhada fa'innamâ yujâhidu linafsih, innAllâha laghanniyyun 'anil-'âlamîn
versets.francais: Et quiconque lutte, ne lutte que pour lui-même. Allah Se passe vraiment des mondes.
versets.anglais: And whoever strives only strives for [the benefit of] himself. Indeed, Allah is free from need of the worlds

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَنُكَفِّرَنَّ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّئَاتِهِمْ وَلَنَجْزِيَنَّهُمْ أَحْسَنَ الَّذِي كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Walladhîna âmanû wa 'amiluss-sâlihâti lanukaffiranna 'anhum sayyi'âtihim wa lanajziyannahum ahsanal-ladhî kânû ya'malûn
versets.francais: Ceux qui ont cru et accompli de bonnes œuvres, Nous effacerons certainement leurs méfaits et Nous les récompenserons certainement du mieux de ce qu'ils faisaient.
versets.anglais: And those who believe and do righteous deeds - We will surely remove from them their misdeeds and will surely reward them according to the best of what they used to do

versets.arabe: وَوَصَّيْنَا الْإِنسَانَ بِوَالِدَيْهِ حُسْنًا ۖ وَإِن جَاهَدَاكَ لِتُشْرِكَ بِي مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِ عِلْمٌ فَلَا تُطِعْهُمَا ۚ إِلَيَّ مَرْجِعُكُمْ فَأُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa wassaynal-insâna biwâlidayhi husnâ, wa in jâhadâka litushrika bî mâ laysa laka bihi 'ilmun falâ tuti'humâ, ilayya marji'ukum faunabi'ukum bimâ kuntum ta'malûn
versets.francais: Nous avons enjoint à l'homme la bonté envers ses père et mère. Mais s'ils te forcent à M'associer ce dont tu n'as aucune connaissance, ne leur obéis pas. C'est vers Moi que vous retournerez et Je vous informerai de ce que vous faisiez.
versets.anglais: And We have enjoined upon man goodness to parents. But if they endeavor to make you associate with Me that of which you have no knowledge, do not obey them. To Me is your return, and I will inform you about what you used to do

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَنُدْخِلَنَّهُمْ فِي الصَّالِحِينَ
versets.phonetique: Walladhîna âmanû wa 'amiluss-sâlihâti lanudkhilannahum fis-sâlihîn
versets.francais: Ceux qui ont cru et accompli de bonnes œuvres, Nous les ferons certainement entrer parmi les gens de bien.
versets.anglais: And those who believe and do righteous deeds - We will surely admit them among the righteous [into Paradise]

versets.arabe: وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَن يَقُولُ آمَنَّا بِاللَّهِ فَإِذَا أُوذِيَ فِي اللَّهِ جَعَلَ فِتْنَةَ النَّاسِ كَعَذَابِ اللَّهِ
versets.phonetique: Wa minan-nâsi man yaqûlu âmannâ billâhi fa idhâ ûdhiya fillâhi ja'ala fitnatak-nâsi ka'adhâbillâh
versets.francais: Parmi les gens il en est qui disent: "Nous croyons en Allah"; puis quand ils sont éprouvés à cause d'Allah, ils considèrent la persécution des hommes comme un châtiment d'Allah.
versets.anglais: And of the people are some who say, "We believe in Allah," but when one [of them] is harmed for [the cause of] Allah, they consider the trial of the people as [if it were] the punishment of Allah. But if victory comes from your Lord, they say, "Indeed, We were with you." Is not Allah most knowing of what is within the breasts of all creatures

versets.arabe: وَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ الْمُنَافِقِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa laya'lamannAllâhul-ladhîna âmanû wa laya'lamannal-munâfiqîn
versets.francais: Allah saura certes ceux qui ont cru, et Il saura certes les hypocrites.
versets.anglais: And Allah will surely make evident those who believe, and He will surely make evident the hypocrites

versets.arabe: وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لِلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اتَّبِعُوا سَبِيلَنَا وَلْنَحْمِلْ خَطَايَاكُمْ وَمَا هُم بِحَامِلِينَ مِنْ خَطَايَاهُم مِّن شَيْءٍ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ لَكَاذِبُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa qâlal-ladhîna kafarû lil-ladhîna âmanuttabi'û sabîlanâ walnahl khataâyâkum wa mâ hum bihâmilîna min khatâyâhum min shay'in, innahum lakâdhibûn
versets.francais: Et les mécréants dirent aux croyants: "Suivez notre voie et nous porterons vos fautes." Ils ne porteront rien de leurs fautes. Ce sont vraiment des menteurs.
versets.anglais: And those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Follow our way, and we will carry your sins." But they will not carry anything of their sins. Indeed, they are liars

versets.arabe: وَلَيَحْمِلُنَّ أَثْقَالَهُمْ وَأَثْقَالًا مَّعَ أَثْقَالِهِمْ ۖ وَلَيُسْأَلُنَّ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ عَمَّا كَانُوا يَفْتَرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa layahmilunn atqâlahum wa athqâlan ma'a athqâlihim, wa layus'alunna yawmal-qiyâmati 'ammâ kânû yaftarûn
versets.francais: Ils porteront certes leurs propres fardeaux et des fardeaux en plus de leurs fardeaux. Et au Jour de la Résurrection ils seront interrogés sur ce qu'ils inventaient.
versets.anglais: But they will surely carry their [own] burdens and [other] burdens along with their burdens, and they will surely be questioned on the Day of Resurrection about what they used to invent

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِ فَلَبِثَ فِيهِمْ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ إِلَّا خَمْسِينَ عَامًا فَأَخَذَهُمُ الطُّوفَانُ وَهُمْ ظَالِمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa laqad arsalnâ Nûhan ilâ qawmihi falabitha fîhim alfa sanatin illâ khamsîna 'âman fa'akhadhahumut-tûfânu wa hum zâlimûn
versets.francais: Nous avons certes envoyé Noé vers son peuple. Il demeura parmi eux mille ans moins cinquante. Le déluge les emporta alors qu'ils étaient injustes.
versets.anglais: And We certainly sent Noah to his people, and he remained among them a thousand years minus fifty years, and the flood seized them while they were wrongdoers

versets.arabe: فَأَنجَيْنَاهُ وَأَصْحَابَ السَّفِينَةِ وَجَعَلْنَاهَا آيَةً لِّلْعَالَمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Fa'anjaynâhu wa ashâbas-safînati wa ja'alnâhâ âyatan lil'âlamîn
versets.francais: Nous le sauvâmes lui et les gens de l'arche, et fîmes de celle-ci un signe pour les mondes.
versets.anglais: But We saved him and the companions of the ship, and We made it a sign for the worlds

versets.arabe: وَإِبْرَاهِيمَ إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِ اعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ وَاتَّقُوهُ ۖ ذَٰلِكُمْ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa Ibrâhîma idh qâla liqawmihi 'budullâha wattaqûh, dhâlikum khayrun lakum in kuntum ta'lamûn
versets.francais: Et Abraham quand il dit à son peuple: "Adorez Allah et craignez-Le. C'est meilleur pour vous si vous saviez."
versets.anglais: And [We sent] Abraham, when he said to his people, "Worship Allah and fear Him. That is best for you, if you should know

versets.arabe: إِنَّمَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ أَوْثَانًا وَتَخْلُقُونَ إِفْكًا ۚ إِنَّ الَّذِينَ تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ لَكُمْ رِزْقًا فَابْتَغُوا عِندَ اللَّهِ الرِّزْقَ وَاعْبُدُوهُ وَاشْكُرُوا لَهُ ۖ إِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
versets.phonetique: Innamâ ta'budûna min dûnillâhi awthânan wa takhluqûna ifkâ, innal-ladhîna ta'budûna min dûnillâhi lâ yamlikûna lakum rizqan fabtaghû 'indAllâhir-rizqa wa'budûhu washkurû lah, ilayhi turja'ûn
versets.francais: Vous n'adorez en dehors d'Allah que des idoles, et vous forgez des mensonges. Ceux que vous adorez en dehors d'Allah ne détiennent aucune subsistance pour vous. Cherchez donc auprès d'Allah la subsistance, adorez-Le et soyez-Lui reconnaissants. C'est vers Lui que vous retournerez.
versets.anglais: You only worship, besides Allah, idols, and you produce a falsehood. Indeed, those you worship besides Allah do not possess for you [the power of] provision. So seek from Allah provision and worship Him and be grateful to Him. To Him you will be returned

versets.arabe: وَإِن تُكَذِّبُوا فَقَدْ كَذَّبَ أُمَمٌ مِّن قَبْلِكُمْ ۖ وَمَا عَلَى الرَّسُولِ إِلَّا الْبَلَاغُ الْمُبِينُ
versets.phonetique: Wa in tukadhdhibû faqad kadhdhaba umumun min qablikum, wa mâ 'alar-rasûli illal-balâghul-mubîn
versets.francais: Si vous démentez, des peuples avant vous ont déjà démenti. Le Messager n'a pour mission que la transmission explicite.
versets.anglais: And if you [people] deny [the message] - already nations before you have denied. And there is not upon the Messenger except [the duty of] clear notification

versets.arabe: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا كَيْفَ يُبْدِئُ اللَّهُ الْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُ ۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى اللَّهِ يَسِيرٌ
versets.phonetique: Awa lam yaraw kayfa yubdi'ullâhul-khalqa thumma yu'îduh, inna dhâlika 'alAllâhi yasîr
versets.francais: N'ont-ils pas vu comment Allah commence la création, puis la refait? Cela est aisé pour Allah.
versets.anglais: Have they not considered how Allah begins creation and then repeats it? Indeed that, for Allah, is easy

versets.arabe: قُلْ سِيرُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَانظُرُوا كَيْفَ بَدَأَ الْخَلْقَ ۚ ثُمَّ اللَّهُ يُنشِئُ النَّشْأَةَ الْآخِرَةَ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
versets.phonetique: Qul sîrû fil-ardi fanzurû kayfa bada'al-khalqa, thummAllâhu yunshi'un-nash'atal-âkhirata, innAllâha 'alâ kulli shay'in qadîr
versets.francais: Dis: "Parcourez la terre et observez comment Il a commencé la création. Ensuite Allah renouvellera la création finale. Allah est certes Omnipotent."
versets.anglais: Say, [O Muhammad], "Travel through the land and observe how He began creation. Then Allah will produce the final creation. Indeed Allah, over all things, is competent

versets.arabe: يُعَذِّبُ مَن يَشَاءُ وَيَرْحَمُ مَن يَشَاءُ ۖ وَإِلَيْهِ تُقْلَبُونَ
versets.phonetique: Yu'adhdhibu man yashâ'u wa yarhamun man yashâ'u, wa ilayhi tuqlabûn
versets.francais: Il châtie qui Il veut et fait miséricorde à qui Il veut. Et c'est vers Lui que vous serez ramenés.
versets.anglais: He punishes whom He wills and has mercy upon whom He wills, and to Him you will be returned

versets.arabe: وَمَا أَنتُم بِمُعْجِزِينَ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ ۖ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِ اللَّهِ مِن وَلِيٍّ وَلَا نَصِيرٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa mâ antum bimú'jizîna fil-ardi wa lâ fis-samâ'i wa mâ lakum min dûnillâhi min waliyyin wa lâ nasîr
versets.francais: Vous ne pouvez réduire Allah à l'impuissance ni sur terre ni dans le ciel. Vous n'avez en dehors d'Allah ni protecteur ni secoureur.
versets.anglais: And you will not cause failure [to Allah] upon the earth or in the heaven. And you have not other than Allah any protector or any helper

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا بِآيَاتِ اللَّهِ وَلِقَائِهِ أُولَٰئِكَ يَئِسُوا مِن رَّحْمَتِي وَأُولَٰئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Walladhîna kafarû bi'âyâtillâhi wa liqâ'ihi ulâ'ika ya'isû min rahmatî wa ulâ'ika lahum 'adhâbun alîm
versets.francais: Ceux qui ne croient pas aux signes d'Allah et à la rencontre avec Lui, ceux-là désespèrent de Ma miséricorde, et ceux-là auront un châtiment douloureux.
versets.anglais: And the ones who disbelieve in the signs of Allah and the meeting with Him - those have despaired of My mercy, and they will have a painful punishment

versets.arabe: فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوْمِهِ إِلَّا أَن قَالُوا اقْتُلُوهُ أَوْ حَرِّقُوهُ فَأَنجَاهُ اللَّهُ مِنَ النَّارِ ۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَاتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ
versets.phonetique: Famâ kâna jawâba qawmihi illâ an qâlûqtulûhu aw harriqûhu fa'anjâhullâhu minan-nâri, inna fî dhâlika la'âyâtin liqawmin yu'minûn
versets.francais: La réponse de son peuple ne fut que de dire: "Tuez-le ou brûlez-le!" Mais Allah le sauva du feu. Il y a là vraiment des signes pour des gens qui croient.
versets.anglais: And the answer of Abraham's people was not but that they said, "Kill him or burn him," but Allah saved him from the fire. Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe

versets.arabe: وَقَالَ إِنَّمَا اتَّخَذْتُم مِّن دُونِ اللَّهِ أَوْثَانًا مَّوَدَّةَ بَيْنِكُمْ فِي الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا ۖ ثُمَّ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ يَكْفُرُ بَعْضُكُم بِبَعْضٍ وَيَلْعَنُ بَعْضُكُم بَعْضًا وَمَأْوَاكُمُ النَّارُ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن نَّاصِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa qâla innamattakhadhtum min dûnillâhi awthânan mawaddata baynikum fil-hayâtid-dunyâ, thumma yawmal-qiyâmati yakfuru ba'dhukum biba'dhin wa yal'anu ba'dhukum ba'dhan wa ma'wâkumun-nâru wa mâ lakum min nâsirîn
versets.francais: Et il dit: "Vous n'avez pris, en dehors d'Allah, que des idoles, par affection entre vous dans la vie présente. Puis au Jour de la Résurrection, vous vous renierez mutuellement et vous vous maudirez les uns les autres. Votre refuge sera le Feu. Vous n'aurez aucun secoureur."
versets.anglais: And [Abraham] said, "You have only taken, other than Allah, idols as [a bond of] affection among you in worldly life. Then on the Day of Resurrection you will deny one another and curse one another, and your refuge will be the Fire, and you will not have any helpers

versets.arabe: فَآمَنَ لَهُ لُوطٌ ۘ وَقَالَ إِنِّي مُهَاجِرٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّي ۖ إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ
versets.phonetique: Fa'âmana lahû Lût, wa qâla innî muhâjirun ilâ rabbî, innahu huwal-'azîzul-hakîm
versets.francais: Loth crut en lui. Et il dit: "Je fais l'émigration vers mon Seigneur. C'est Lui le Puissant, le Sage."
versets.anglais: And Lot believed him. [Abraham] said, "Indeed, I will emigrate to [the service of] my Lord. Indeed, He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise

versets.arabe: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُ إِسْحَاقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ وَجَعَلْنَا فِي ذُرِّيَّتِهِ النُّبُوَّةَ وَالْكِتَابَ وَآتَيْنَاهُ أَجْرَهُ فِي الدُّنْيَا ۖ وَإِنَّهُ فِي الْآخِرَةِ لَمِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa wahabnâ lahû Ishâqa wa Ya'qûba wa ja'alnâ fî dhurriyyatihinnubuwwata wal-kitâba wa âtaynâhu ajrahu fid-dunyâ, wa innahu fil-âkhirati laminas-sâlihîn
versets.francais: Et Nous lui accordâmes Isaac et Jacob, et plaçâmes dans sa descendance la prophétie et le Livre. Nous lui donnâmes sa récompense ici-bas; et dans l'au-delà, il sera certes parmi les gens de bien.
versets.anglais: And We gave to Him Isaac and Jacob and placed in his descendants prophethood and scripture. And We gave him his reward in this world, and indeed, he is in the Hereafter among the righteous

versets.arabe: وَلُوطًا إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِ إِنَّكُمْ لَتَأْتُونَ الْفَاحِشَةَ مَا سَبَقَكُم بِهَا مِنْ أَحَدٍ مِّنَ الْعَالَمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa Lûtan idh qâla liqawmihi innakum lata'tûnal-fâhishata mâ sabaqakum bihâ min ahadin minal-'âlamîn
versets.francais: Et Loth quand il dit à son peuple: "Vous commettez vraiment la turpitude qu'aucun être au monde n'a commise avant vous."
versets.anglais: And [mention] Lot, when he said to his people, "Indeed, you commit such immorality as no one has preceded you with from among the worlds

versets.arabe: أَئِنَّكُمْ لَتَأْتُونَ الرِّجَالَ وَتَقْطَعُونَ السَّبِيلَ وَتَأْتُونَ فِي نَادِيكُمُ الْمُنكَرَ ۖ فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوْمِهِ إِلَّا أَن قَالُوا ائْتِنَا بِعَذَابِ اللَّهِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ
versets.phonetique: A'innakum lata'tûnar-rijâla wa taqta'ûnas-sabîla wa ta'tûna fî nâdîkumul-munkar, famâ kâna jawâba qawmihi illâ an qâlûtu'nâ bi'adhâbillâhi in kunta minas-sâdiqîn
versets.francais: Est-ce que vous vous approchez vraiment des hommes, coupez la route et commettez l'acte répréhensible dans vos assemblées? La réponse de son peuple ne fut que de dire: "Apporte-nous le châtiment d'Allah si tu es du nombre des véridiques."
versets.anglais: Indeed, you approach men and obstruct the road and commit in your meetings [every] evil." And the answer of his people was not but they said, "Bring us the punishment of Allah, if you should be of the truthful

versets.arabe: قَالَ رَبِّ انصُرْنِي عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْمُفْسِدِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qâla rabbinsurnî 'alal-qawmil-mufsidîn
versets.francais: Il dit: "Seigneur, donne-moi la victoire contre le peuple corrupteur."
versets.anglais: He said, "My Lord, support me against the corrupting people

versets.arabe: وَلَمَّا جَاءَتْ رُسُلُنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ بِالْبُشْرَىٰ قَالُوا إِنَّا مُهْلِكُو أَهْلِ هَٰذِهِ الْقَرْيَةِ ۖ إِنَّ أَهْلَهَا كَانُوا ظَالِمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa lammâ jâ'at rusulunâ Ibrâhîma bil-bushrâ qâlû innâ muhlikû ahli hâdhihil-qaryati, inna ahla hâ kânû zâlimîn
versets.francais: Lorsque Nos envoyés vinrent apporter la bonne nouvelle à Abraham, ils dirent: "Nous allons détruire les habitants de cette cité. Ses habitants sont vraiment des injustes."
versets.anglais: And when Our messengers came to Abraham with the good tidings, they said, "Indeed, we will destroy the people of that Lot's city. Indeed, its people have been wrongdoers

versets.arabe: قَالَ إِنَّ فِيهَا لُوطًا ۚ قَالُوا نَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن فِيهَا ۖ لَنُنَجِّيَنَّهُ وَأَهْلَهُ إِلَّا امْرَأَتَهُ كَانَتْ مِنَ الْغَابِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qâla inna fîhâ Lûtan, qâlû nahnu a'lamu biman fîhâ, lanunajjiyannahû wa ahlahu illâmra'atahu kânat minal-ghâbirîn
versets.francais: Il dit: "Loth s'y trouve." Ils dirent: "Nous savons fort bien qui s'y trouve. Nous le sauverons certes lui et sa famille, sauf sa femme qui sera du nombre de ceux qui resteront."
versets.anglais: [Abraham] said, "Indeed, within it is Lot." They said, "We are more knowing of who is within it. We will surely save him and his family, except his wife. She is to be of those who remain behind

versets.arabe: وَلَمَّا أَن جَاءَتْ رُسُلُنَا لُوطًا سِيءَ بِهِمْ وَضَاقَ بِهِمْ ذَرْعًا وَقَالُوا لَا تَخَفْ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ ۖ إِنَّا مُنَجُّوكَ وَأَهْلَكَ إِلَّا امْرَأَتَكَ كَانَتْ مِنَ الْغَابِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa lammâ an jâ'at rusulunâ Lûtan sî'a bihim wa dhâqa bihim dhar'an wa qâlû lâ takhaf wa lâ tahzan, innâ munajjûka wa ahlaka illâmra'ataka kânat minal-ghâbirîn
versets.francais: Lorsque Nos envoyés arrivèrent chez Loth, il fut affligé à cause d'eux et se sentit impuissant à les protéger. Ils dirent: "N'aie pas peur et ne t'afflige pas. Nous te sauverons toi et ta famille, sauf ta femme qui sera du nombre de ceux qui resteront."
versets.anglais: And when Our messengers came to Lot, he was distressed for them and felt for them great discomfort. They said, "Fear not, nor grieve. Indeed, we will save you and your family, except your wife; she is to be of those who remain behind

versets.arabe: إِنَّا مُنزِلُونَ عَلَىٰ أَهْلِ هَٰذِهِ الْقَرْيَةِ رِجْزًا مِّنَ السَّمَاءِ بِمَا كَانُوا يَفْسُقُونَ
versets.phonetique: Innâ munzilûna 'alâ ahli hâdhihil-qaryati rijzan minas-samâ'i bimâ kânû yafsuqûn
versets.francais: Nous allons faire descendre sur les habitants de cette cité un châtiment venu du ciel, à cause de leur perversité.
versets.anglais: Indeed, we will bring down on the people of this city punishment from the sky because they have been defiantly disobedient

versets.arabe: وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَا مِنْهَا آيَةً بَيِّنَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa laqad taraknâ minhâ âyatan bayyinatan liqawmin ya'qilûn
versets.francais: Nous en avons certes laissé un signe évident pour des gens qui raisonnent.
versets.anglais: And We have certainly left of it a sign as clear evidence for a people who use reason

versets.arabe: وَإِلَىٰ مَدْيَنَ أَخَاهُمْ شُعَيْبًا فَقَالَ يَا قَوْمِ اعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ وَارْجُوا الْيَوْمَ الْآخِرَ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا فِي الْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa ilâ Madyana akhâhum Shu'ayban faqâla yâ qawmi'budullâha warjul-yawmal-âkhira wa lâ ta'thaw fil-ardi mufsidîn
versets.francais: Et vers Madyan, leur frère Chuayb. Il dit: "Ô mon peuple, adorez Allah et espérez le Jour Dernier. Ne semez pas la corruption sur la terre."
versets.anglais: And to Madyan [We sent] their brother Shu'ayb, and he said, "O my people, worship Allah and expect the Last Day and do not commit abuse on the earth, spreading corruption

versets.arabe: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ الرَّجْفَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا فِي دَارِهِمْ جَاثِمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Fakadhdhabûhu fa'akhadhathumur-rajfatu fa'asbahû fî dârihim jâthimîn
versets.francais: Ils le démentèrent et le tremblement de terre les saisit. Ils se retrouvèrent gisant dans leurs demeures.
versets.anglais: But they denied him, so the earthquake seized them, and they became within their home [corpses] fallen prone

versets.arabe: وَعَادًا وَثَمُودَ وَقَد تَّبَيَّنَ لَكُم مِّن مَّسَاكِنِهِمْ ۖ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الشَّيْطَانُ أَعْمَالَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ السَّبِيلِ وَكَانُوا مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa 'âdan wa thamûda wa qad tabayyana lakum min masâkinihim, wa zayyana lahumush-shaytânu a'mâlahum fasaddahum 'anis-sabîli wa kânû mustabsirîn
versets.francais: Et les 'Âd et les Thamûd - leurs demeures vous les ont montrés clairement. Le Diable leur a embelli leurs œuvres et les a détournés du droit chemin, alors qu'ils étaient perspicaces.
versets.anglais: And [We destroyed] 'Aad and Thamud, and it has become clear to you from their [ruined] dwellings. And Satan had made pleasing to them their deeds and averted them from the path, and they were endowed with perception

versets.arabe: وَقَارُونَ وَفِرْعَوْنَ وَهَامَانَ ۖ وَلَقَدْ جَاءَهُم مُّوسَىٰ بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ فَاسْتَكْبَرُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَمَا كَانُوا سَابِقِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa Qârûna wa Fir'awna wa Hâmân, wa laqad jâ'ahum Mûsâ bil-bayyinâti fastakbarû fil-ardi wa mâ kânû sâbiqîn
versets.francais: Et Coré, Pharaon et Haman. Moïse leur avait apporté les preuves et ils s'enorgueillirent sur terre, sans pouvoir Nous devancer.
versets.anglais: And [We destroyed] Qarun and Pharaoh and Haman. And Moses had already come to them with clear evidences, and they were arrogant in the land, but they were not outrunners [of Our punishment]

versets.arabe: فَكُلًّا أَخَذْنَا بِذَنبِهِ ۖ فَمِنْهُم مَّنْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِ حَاصِبًا وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ أَخَذَتْهُ الصَّيْحَةُ وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ خَسَفْنَا بِهِ الْأَرْضَ وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ أَغْرَقْنَا ۚ وَمَا كَانَ اللَّهُ لِيَظْلِمَهُمْ وَلَٰكِن كَانُوا أَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Fakullan akhadhnâ bidhanbihi, faminhum man arsalnâ 'alayhi hâsiban wa minhum man akhadhat-hus-sayhatu wa minhum man khasafnâ bihil-arda wa minhum man aghraqnâ, wa mâ kânAllâhu liyazlimahum wa lâkin kânû anfusahum yazlimûn
versets.francais: Nous saisîmes chacun selon son péché: contre certains Nous avons envoyé une tornade de pierres; d'autres furent surpris par le Cri; d'autres encore Nous fîmes engloutir par la terre; d'autres Nous noyâmes. Allah n'était pas injuste envers eux, mais c'est eux-mêmes qui étaient injustes.
versets.anglais: So each We seized for his sin; and among them were those upon whom We sent a storm of stones, and among them were those who were seized by the blast [from the sky], and among them were those whom We caused the earth to swallow, and among them were those whom We drowned. And Allah would not have wronged them, but it was they who were wronging themselves

versets.arabe: مَثَلُ الَّذِينَ اتَّخَذُوا مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ أَوْلِيَاءَ كَمَثَلِ الْعَنكَبُوتِ اتَّخَذَتْ بَيْتًا ۖ وَإِنَّ أَوْهَنَ الْبُيُوتِ لَبَيْتُ الْعَنكَبُوتِ ۖ لَوْ كَانُوا يَعْلَمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Mathalul-ladhînat-takhadhû min dûnillâhi awliyâ'a kamathalil-'ankabûtit-takhadhat baytan, wa inna awhanal-buyûti labaytu l-'ankabût, law kânû ya'lamûn
versets.francais: Ceux qui prennent des protecteurs en dehors d'Allah ressemblent à l'araignée qui se construit une demeure. La plus fragile des demeures est certes la demeure de l'araignée. S'ils savaient!
versets.anglais: The example of those who take allies other than Allah is like that of the spider who takes a home. And indeed, the weakest of homes is the home of the spider, if they only knew

versets.arabe: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِ مِن شَيْءٍ ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ
versets.phonetique: InnAllâha ya'lamu mâ yad'ûna min dûnihi min shay'in, wa huwal-'azîzul-hakîm
versets.francais: Allah sait bien ce qu'ils invoquent en dehors de Lui. Il est le Puissant, le Sage.
versets.anglais: Indeed, Allah knows whatever thing they call upon other than Him. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise

versets.arabe: وَتِلْكَ الْأَمْثَالُ نَضْرِبُهَا لِلنَّاسِ ۖ وَمَا يَعْقِلُهَا إِلَّا الْعَالِمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa tilkal-amthâlu nadhribuhâ lin-nâsi wa mâ ya'qiluhâ illal-'âlimûn
versets.francais: Ces paraboles, Nous les citons pour les gens. Mais seuls les savants les comprennent.
versets.anglais: And these examples We present to the people, but none will understand them except those of knowledge

versets.arabe: خَلَقَ اللَّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ بِالْحَقِّ ۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: KhalaqAllâhus-samâwâti wal-arda bil-haqq, inna fî dhâlika la'âyatan lil-mu'minîn
versets.francais: Allah a créé les cieux et la terre en toute vérité. Il y a là certes un signe pour les croyants.
versets.anglais: Allah created the heavens and the earth in truth. Indeed in that is a sign for the believers

versets.arabe: اتْلُ مَا أُوحِيَ إِلَيْكَ مِنَ الْكِتَابِ وَأَقِمِ الصَّلَاةَ ۖ إِنَّ الصَّلَاةَ تَنْهَىٰ عَنِ الْفَحْشَاءِ وَالْمُنكَرِ ۗ وَلَذِكْرُ اللَّهِ أَكْبَرُ ۗ وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تَصْنَعُونَ
versets.phonetique: Utlu mâ ûhiya ilayka minal-kitâbi wa aqimis-salâta, innas-salâta tanhâ 'anil-fahshâ'i wal-munkar, wa ladhikrullâhi akbar, wallâhu ya'lamu mâ tasna'ûn
versets.francais: Récite ce qui t'a été révélé du Livre et accomplis la Salât. La Salât préserve de la turpitude et du blâmable. Le rappel d'Allah est certes ce qu'il y a de plus grand. Allah sait ce que vous faites.
versets.anglais: Recite, [O Muhammad], what has been revealed to you of the Book and establish prayer. Indeed, prayer prohibits immorality and wrongdoing, and the remembrance of Allah is greater. And Allah knows that which you do

versets.arabe: وَلَا تُجَادِلُوا أَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ إِلَّا بِالَّتِي هِيَ أَحْسَنُ إِلَّا الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا مِنْهُمْ ۖ وَقُولُوا آمَنَّا بِالَّذِي أُنزِلَ إِلَيْنَا وَأُنزِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ وَإِلَٰهُنَا وَإِلَٰهُكُمْ وَاحِدٌ وَنَحْنُ لَهُ مُسْلِمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa lâ tujâdilû ahlal-kitâbi illâ billatî hiya ahsanu illal-ladhîna zalamû minhum wa qûlû âmannâ bil-ladhî unzila ilaynâ wa unzila ilaykum wa ilâhunâ wa ilâhukum wâhidun wa nahnu lahu muslimûn
versets.francais: Ne disputez avec les gens du Livre que de la meilleure façon, sauf avec ceux d'entre eux qui sont injustes. Et dites: "Nous croyons en ce qu'on a fait descendre vers nous et en ce qu'on a fait descendre vers vous. Notre Dieu et votre Dieu sont le même. Et nous Lui sommes soumis."
versets.anglais: And do not argue with the People of the Scripture except in a way that is best, except for those who commit injustice among them, and say, "We believe in that which has been revealed to us and revealed to you. And our God and your God is one; and we are Muslims [in submission] to Him

versets.arabe: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَنزَلْنَا إِلَيْكَ الْكِتَابَ ۚ فَالَّذِينَ آتَيْنَاهُمُ الْكِتَابَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِ ۖ وَمِنْ هَٰؤُلَاءِ مَن يُؤْمِنُ بِهِ ۚ وَمَا يَجْحَدُ بِآيَاتِنَا إِلَّا الْكَافِرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa kadhâlika anzalnâ ilaykal-kitâba, falladhîna âtaynâhumul-kitâba yu'minûna bihi wa min hâ'ulâ'i man yu'minu bih, wa mâ yajhadu bi'âyâtinâ illal-kâfirûn
versets.francais: C'est ainsi que Nous t'avons révélé le Livre. Ceux à qui Nous avons donné le Livre croient en lui. Parmi ceux-ci, il en est qui y croient aussi. Seuls les mécréants nient Nos signes.
versets.anglais: And thus We have sent down to you the Qur'an. And those to whom We [previously] gave the Scripture believe in it. And among these [people of Makkah] are those who believe in it. And none reject Our verses except the disbelievers

versets.arabe: وَمَا كُنتَ تَتْلُو مِن قَبْلِهِ مِن كِتَابٍ وَلَا تَخُطُّهُ بِيَمِينِكَ ۖ إِذًا لَّارْتَابَ الْمُبْطِلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa mâ kunta tatlu min qablihi min kitâbin wa lâ takhuttahu biyamînika, idhal-lartâbal-mubtilûn
versets.francais: Tu ne lisais, avant lui, aucun livre et tu n'en traçais rien de ta main droite. Autrement, ceux qui s'attachent au faux auraient certainement douté.
versets.anglais: And you did not recite before it any scripture, nor did you inscribe one with your right hand. Otherwise the falsifiers would have had [cause for] doubt

versets.arabe: بَلْ هُوَ آيَاتٌ بَيِّنَاتٌ فِي صُدُورِ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْعِلْمَ ۚ وَمَا يَجْحَدُ بِآيَاتِنَا إِلَّا الظَّالِمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Bal huwa âyâtun bayyinâtun fî sudûril-ladhîna ûtul-'ilm, wa mâ yajhadu bi'âyâtinâ illaz-zâlimûn
versets.francais: Mais ce sont des signes évidents dans les poitrines de ceux qui ont reçu la science. Seuls les injustes nient Nos signes.
versets.anglais: Rather, the Qur'an is distinct verses [preserved] within the breasts of those who have been given knowledge. And none reject Our verses except the wrongdoers

versets.arabe: وَقَالُوا لَوْلَا أُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ آيَاتٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِ ۖ قُلْ إِنَّمَا الْآيَاتُ عِندَ اللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَا أَنَا نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa qâlû lawlâ unzila 'alayhi âyâtun min rabbih, qul innamal-âyâtu 'indAllâhi wa innamâ ana nadhîrun mubîn
versets.francais: Et ils dirent: "Pourquoi des signes ne lui ont-ils pas été envoyés de son Seigneur?" Dis: "Les signes ne dépendent que d'Allah. Je ne suis qu'un avertisseur explicite."
versets.anglais: But they say, "Why are not signs sent down to him from his Lord?" Say, "The signs are only with Allah, and I am only a clear warner

versets.arabe: أَوَلَمْ يَكْفِهِمْ أَنَّا أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ الْكِتَابَ يُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَرَحْمَةً وَذِكْرَىٰ لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ
versets.phonetique: Awa lam yakfihim annâ anzalnâ 'alaykal-kitâba yutlâ 'alayhim, inna fî dhâlika larahmatan wa dhikrâ liqawmin yu'minûn
versets.francais: Ne leur suffit-il pas que Nous t'ayons révélé le Livre qu'on leur récite? Il y a là certes une miséricorde et un rappel pour des gens qui croient.
versets.anglais: And is it not sufficient for them that We revealed to you the Book which is recited to them? Indeed in that is a mercy and reminder for a people who believe

versets.arabe: قُلْ كَفَىٰ بِاللَّهِ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكُمْ شَهِيدًا ۖ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۗ وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا بِالْبَاطِلِ وَكَفَرُوا بِاللَّهِ أُولَٰئِكَ هُمُ الْخَاسِرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qul kafâ billâhi baynî wa baynakum shahîdan, ya'lamu mâ fis-samâwâti wal-ardi, walladhîna âmanû bil-bâtili wa kafarû billâhi ulâ'ika humul-khâsirûn
versets.francais: Dis: "Allah me suffit comme témoin entre vous et moi. Il sait ce qui est dans les cieux et la terre. Ceux qui croient au faux et ne croient pas en Allah, ceux-là sont les perdants."
versets.anglais: Say, "Sufficient is Allah between me and you as Witness. He knows what is in the heavens and earth. And they who have believed in falsehood and disbelieved in Allah - it is those who are the losers

versets.arabe: وَيَسْتَعْجِلُونَكَ بِالْعَذَابِ ۚ وَلَوْلَا أَجَلٌ مُّسَمًّى لَّجَاءَهُمُ الْعَذَابُ وَلَيَأْتِيَنَّهُم بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa yasta'jilûnaka bil-'adhâb, wa lawlâ ajalun musamman lajâ'ahumul-'adhâbu wa laya'tiyannahum baghtatan wa hum lâ yash'urûn
versets.francais: Ils te demandent d'accélérer le châtiment. Si un terme déterminé n'avait pas existé, le châtiment leur serait venu. Il leur viendra, tout à coup, sans qu'ils s'en aperçoivent.
versets.anglais: And they urge you to hasten the punishment. And if not for [the decree of] a specified term, punishment would have reached them. But it will surely come to them suddenly while they perceive not

versets.arabe: يَسْتَعْجِلُونَكَ بِالْعَذَابِ ۚ وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمُحِيطَةٌ بِالْكَافِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Yasta'jilûnaka bil-'adhâb, wa inna jahannama lamuhîtatun bil-kâfirîn
versets.francais: Ils te pressent d'accélérer le châtiment. La Géhenne va certes cerner les mécréants.
versets.anglais: They urge you to hasten the punishment. And indeed, Hell will be encompassing of the disbelievers

versets.arabe: يَوْمَ يَغْشَاهُمُ الْعَذَابُ مِن فَوْقِهِمْ وَمِن تَحْتِ أَرْجُلِهِمْ وَيَقُولُ ذُوقُوا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Yawma yaghshâhumul-'adhâbu min fawqihim wa min tahti arjulihim wa yaqûlu dhûqû mâ kuntum ta'malûn
versets.francais: Le jour où le châtiment les couvrira par-dessus et par-dessous leurs pieds, et Il dira: "Goûtez ce que vous faisiez."
versets.anglais: On the Day the punishment will cover them from above them and from below their feet and it is said, "Taste [the result of] what you used to do

versets.arabe: يَا عِبَادِيَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِنَّ أَرْضِي وَاسِعَةٌ فَإِيَّايَ فَاعْبُدُونِ
versets.phonetique: Yâ 'ibâdiyal-ladhîna âmanû inna ardî wâsi'atun fa'iyyâya fa'budûn
versets.francais: Ô Mes serviteurs qui croyez, Ma terre est vaste. Adorez-Moi donc.
versets.anglais: O My servants who have believed, indeed My earth is spacious, so worship only Me

versets.arabe: كُلُّ نَفْسٍ ذَائِقَةُ الْمَوْتِ ۖ ثُمَّ إِلَيْنَا تُرْجَعُونَ
versets.phonetique: Kullu nafsin dhâ'iqatul-mawt, thumma ilaynâ turja'ûn
versets.francais: Toute âme goûtera la mort. Puis c'est vers Nous que vous serez ramenés.
versets.anglais: Every soul will taste death. Then to Us will you be returned

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَنُبَوِّئَنَّهُم مِّنَ الْجَنَّةِ غُرَفًا تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ نِعْمَ أَجْرُ الْعَامِلِينَ
versets.phonetique: Walladhîna âmanû wa 'amiluss-sâlihâti lanubawwi'annahum minal-jannati ghurafan tajrî min tahtihâl-anhâru khâlidîna fîhâ, ni'ma ajrul-'âmilîn
versets.francais: Ceux qui ont cru et accompli de bonnes œuvres, Nous les logerons certes dans des chambres du Paradis sous lesquelles coulent des ruisseaux, pour y demeurer éternellement. Quelle belle récompense pour ceux qui œuvrent!
versets.anglais: And those who have believed and done righteous deeds - We will surely assign to them of Paradise [elevated] chambers beneath which rivers flow, wherein they abide eternally. Excellent is the reward of the [righteous] workers

versets.arabe: الَّذِينَ صَبَرُوا وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Alladhîna sabarû wa 'alâ rabbihim yatawakkalûn
versets.francais: Ceux qui ont enduré et qui font confiance à leur Seigneur.
versets.anglais: Who have been patient and upon their Lord rely

versets.arabe: وَكَأَيِّن مِّن دَابَّةٍ لَّا تَحْمِلُ رِزْقَهَا اللَّهُ يَرْزُقُهَا وَإِيَّاكُمْ ۚ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
versets.phonetique: Wa ka'ayyin min dâbbatin lâ tahmilu rizqahâ, Allâhu yarzuquhâ wa iyyâkum, wa huwas-samî'ul-'alîm
versets.francais: Que d'êtres vivants ne portent pas leur subsistance! C'est Allah qui les nourrit ainsi que vous. Il est l'Audient, l'Omniscient.
versets.anglais: And how many a creature carries not its [own] provision. Allah provides for it and for you. And He is the Hearing, the Knowing

versets.arabe: وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَسَخَّرَ الشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ لَيَقُولُنَّ اللَّهُ ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ يُؤْفَكُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa la'in sa'altahum man khalaqas-samâwâti wal-arda wa sakhkharash-shamsa wal-qamara layaqûlunnAllâh, fa'annâ yu'fakûn
versets.francais: Si tu leur demandes qui a créé les cieux et la terre et assujetti le soleil et la lune, ils diront certainement "Allah". Comment donc se détournent-ils?
versets.anglais: If you asked them, "Who created the heavens and earth and subjected the sun and the moon?" they would surely say, "Allah." Then how are they deluded

versets.arabe: اللَّهُ يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ وَيَقْدِرُ لَهُ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Allâhu yabsutur-rizqa liman yashâ'u min 'ibâdihi wa yaqdiru lahu, innAllâha bikulli shay'in 'alîm
versets.francais: Allah étend la subsistance à qui Il veut parmi Ses serviteurs, et la restreint. Allah est certes Omniscient.
versets.anglais: Allah extends provision for whom He wills of His servants and restricts for him. Indeed Allah is, of all things, Knowing

versets.arabe: وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّن نَّزَّلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَأَحْيَا بِهِ الْأَرْضَ مِن بَعْدِ مَوْتِهَا لَيَقُولُنَّ اللَّهُ ۚ قُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ۚ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa la'in sa'altahum man nazzala minas-samâ'i mâ'an fa'ahyâ bihil-arda min ba'di mawtihâ layaqûlunnAllâh, qulil-hamdu lillâh, bal aktharuhum lâ ya'qilûn
versets.francais: Si tu leur demandes qui a fait descendre du ciel une eau et avec laquelle Il a redonné vie à la terre après sa mort, ils diront certainement "Allah". Dis: "Louange à Allah!" Mais la plupart d'eux ne raisonnent pas.
versets.anglais: And if you asked them, "Who sends down rain from the sky and gives life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness?" they would surely say " Allah." Say, "Praise to Allah "; but most of them do not reason

versets.arabe: وَمَا هَٰذِهِ الْحَيَاةُ الدُّنْيَا إِلَّا لَهْوٌ وَلَعِبٌ ۚ وَإِنَّ الدَّارَ الْآخِرَةَ لَهِيَ الْحَيَوَانُ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا يَعْلَمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa mâ hâdhihil-hayâtud-dunyâ illâ lahwun wa la'ib, wa innad-dâral-âkhirata lahiyal-hayawân, law kânû ya'lamûn
versets.francais: La vie présente n'est que jeu et amusement. La demeure de l'au-delà est certes la vraie vie. S'ils savaient!
versets.anglais: And this worldly life is not but diversion and amusement. And indeed, the home of the Hereafter - that is the [eternal] life, if only they knew

versets.arabe: فَإِذَا رَكِبُوا فِي الْفُلْكِ دَعَوُا اللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ فَلَمَّا نَجَّاهُمْ إِلَى الْبَرِّ إِذَا هُمْ يُشْرِكُونَ
versets.phonetique: Fa idhâ rakibû fil-fulki da'awullâha mukhlisîna lahud-dîna falammâ najjâhum ilal-barri idhâ hum yushrikûn
versets.francais: Quand ils montent en barque, ils invoquent Allah en Lui vouant un culte sincère. Puis quand Il les sauve en les ramenant à terre, les voilà qui Lui donnent des associés.
versets.anglais: And when they board a ship, they supplicate Allah, sincere to Him in religion. But when He delivers them to the land, at once they associate others with Him

versets.arabe: لِيَكْفُرُوا بِمَا آتَيْنَاهُمْ وَلِيَتَمَتَّعُوا ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Liyakfurû bimâ âtaynâhum wa liyatamatta'û, fasawfa ya'lamûn
versets.francais: Afin qu'ils soient ingrats envers ce que Nous leur avons accordé et qu'ils profitent. Ils sauront bientôt.
versets.anglais: So that they will deny what We have granted them, and they will enjoy themselves. But they are going to know

versets.arabe: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا أَنَّا جَعَلْنَا حَرَمًا آمِنًا وَيُتَخَطَّفُ النَّاسُ مِنْ حَوْلِهِمْ ۚ أَفَبِالْبَاطِلِ يُؤْمِنُونَ وَبِنِعْمَةِ اللَّهِ يَكْفُرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Awa lam yaraw annâ ja'alnâ haraman âminan wa yutakhattafun-nâsu min hawlihim, afabil-bâtili yu'minûna wa bini'matillâhi yakfurûn
versets.francais: N'ont-ils pas vu que Nous avons établi un sanctuaire sûr, alors que les gens sont enlevés autour d'eux? Croient-ils donc au faux et sont-ils ingrats envers les bienfaits d'Allah?
versets.anglais: Have they not seen that We made [Makkah] a safe sanctuary, while people are being taken away all around them? Then in falsehood do they believe, and in the favor of Allah they disbelieve

versets.arabe: وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ افْتَرَىٰ عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا أَوْ كَذَّبَ بِالْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَاءَهُ ۚ أَلَيْسَ فِي جَهَنَّمَ مَثْوًى لِّلْكَافِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa man azlamu mimmaniftarâ 'alAllâhi kadhiban aw kadhdhaba bil-haqqi lammâ jâ'ah, alaysa fî jahannama mathwan lil-kâfirîn
versets.francais: Qui est plus injuste que celui qui forge un mensonge contre Allah, ou dément la vérité quand elle lui vient? N'y a-t-il pas dans la Géhenne une demeure pour les mécréants?
versets.anglais: And who is more unjust than one who invents a lie about Allah or denies the truth when it has come to him? Is there not in Hell a [sufficient] residence for the disbelievers

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ جَاهَدُوا فِينَا لَنَهْدِيَنَّهُمْ سُبُلَنَا ۚ وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَمَعَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Walladhîna jâhadû fînâ lanahdiyannahum subulanâ, wa innAllâha lama'al-muhsinîn
versets.francais: Ceux qui luttent pour Nous, Nous les guiderons certes sur Nos sentiers. Allah est certes avec les bienfaisants.
versets.anglais: And those who strive for Us - We will surely guide them to Our ways. And indeed, Allah is with the doers of good

versets.arabe: الم
versets.phonetique: Alif Lâm Mîm
versets.francais: Alif Lâm Mîm
versets.anglais: Alif, Lam, Meem

versets.arabe: غُلِبَتِ الرُّومُ
versets.phonetique: Ghulibat-ur-Rûm
versets.francais: Les Romains ont été vaincus
versets.anglais: The Byzantines have been defeated

versets.arabe: فِي أَدْنَى الْأَرْضِ وَهُم مِّن بَعْدِ غَلَبِهِمْ سَيَغْلِبُونَ
versets.phonetique: Fî adnâ-l-ardi wa hum min ba'di ghalibi-him sayaghlibûn
versets.francais: Dans le pays proche, mais après leur défaite ils vaincront
versets.anglais: In the nearest land. But they, after their defeat, will overcome

versets.arabe: فِي بِضْعِ سِنِينَ لِلَّهِ الْأَمْرُ مِن قَبْلُ وَمِن بَعْدُ وَيَوْمَئِذٍ يَفْرَحُ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ
versets.phonetique: Fî bid' sinîn, li-l-lâh-ul-amr min qabl wa min ba'd, wa yawma'idhin yafrah-ul-mu'minûn
versets.francais: En quelques années. À Allah appartient le commandement avant et après. Et ce jour-là, les croyants se réjouiront
versets.anglais: Within three to nine years. To Allah belongs the command before and after. And that day the believers will rejoice

versets.arabe: بِنَصْرِ اللَّهِ يَنصُرُ مَن يَشَاءُ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ
versets.phonetique: Bi-nasr-al-lâh, yanur man yashâ'u wa huwa-l-'azîz-ur-rahîm
versets.francais: C'est par le secours d'Allah qu'Il secourt qui Il veut. Et c'est Lui le Puissant, le Miséricordieux
versets.anglais: In the victory of Allah. He gives victory to whom He wills, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful

versets.arabe: وَعْدَ اللَّهِ لَا يُخْلِفُ اللَّهُ وَعْدَهُ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa'da-l-lâh, lâ yukhlifu-l-lâh wa'dahu wa lâkin akthara-n-nâs lâ ya'lamûn
versets.francais: Promesse d'Allah. Allah ne manque pas à Sa promesse. Mais la plupart des gens ne savent pas
versets.anglais: [It is] the promise of Allah. Allah does not fail in His promise, but most of the people do not know

versets.arabe: يَعْلَمُونَ ظَاهِرًا مِّنَ الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا وَهُمْ عَنِ الْآخِرَةِ هُمْ غَافِلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Ya'lamûn zâhir min-al-hayâ-ud-dunyâ wa hum 'an-il-âkhirah hum ghâfilûn
versets.francais: Ils connaissent un aspect apparent de la vie d'ici-bas, mais de l'Au-delà ils sont négligents
versets.anglais: They know what is apparent of the worldly life, but they, of the Hereafter, are unaware

versets.arabe: أَوَ لَمْ يَتَفَكَّرُوا فِي أَنفُسِهِم مَّا خَلَقَ اللَّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا إِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ وَأَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى
versets.phonetique: Aw lam yatafakkarû fî anfusihim mâ khalaqa-l-lâhu-s-samâwâti wa-l-ardi wa mâ baynahuma illâ bi-l-haq wa ajalin musammân
versets.francais: Ne réfléchissent-ils pas en eux-mêmes? Allah n'a créé les cieux et la terre et ce qui existe entre eux que pour une juste raison et pour un terme fixé
versets.anglais: Do they not contemplate within themselves? Allah has not created the heavens and the earth and what is between them except in truth and for a specified term. And indeed, many of the people, in [the matter of] the meeting with their Lord, are disbelievers

versets.arabe: وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًا مِّنَ النَّاسِ بِلِقَاءِ رَبِّهِمْ لَكَافِرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa inna kathîran min-an-nâs bi-liqâ'i rabbihim lakâfirûn
versets.francais: Et une grande partie des gens renie la rencontre de leur Seigneur
versets.anglais: Have they not traveled through the earth and observed how was the end of those before them? They were greater than them in power, and they plowed the earth and built it up more than they have built it up, and their messengers came to them with clear evidences. And Allah would not ever have wronged them, but they were wronging themselves

versets.arabe: أَوَ لَمْ يَسِيرُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَيَنظُرُوا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ
versets.phonetique: Aw lam yasîrû fi-l-ardi fayanzuru kayfa kân 'âqibat-al-ladhîn min qabli-him
versets.francais: N'ont-ils pas voyagé sur terre et observé comment a été la fin de ceux d'avant eux?
versets.anglais: Then the end of those who did evil was the worst [consequence] because they denied the signs of Allah and used to ridicule them

versets.arabe: كَانُوا أَشَدَّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةً وَأَثَارُوا الْأَرْضَ وَعَمَرُوهَا أَكْثَرَ مِمَّا عَمَرُوهَا
versets.phonetique: Kânû ashadda min-hum quwwa wa athârû-l-ardi wa 'amarûhâ akthara mimma 'amarûhâ
versets.francais: Ils étaient plus forts qu'eux, avaient cultigé la terre et l'avaient plus développée qu'eux
versets.anglais: Allah begins creation; then He will repeat it; then to Him you will be returned

versets.arabe: وَجَاءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُم بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ فَمَا كَانَ اللَّهُ لِيَظْلِمَهُمْ وَلَٰكِن كَانُوا أَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa jâ'at-hum rusuluhum bi-l-bayyinât, famâ kân-al-lâhu li yazlimahum wa lâkin kânû anfusahum yazlimûn
versets.francais: Et leurs Messagers vinrent à eux avec des preuves claires. Ce n'est pas Allah qui les opprimait, mais c'est eux-mêmes qui s'opprimaient
versets.anglais: And the Day the Hour appears the criminals will be in despair

versets.arabe: ثُمَّ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِينَ أَسَاءُوا السُّوأَىٰ أَن كَذَّبُوا بِآيَاتِ اللَّهِ وَكَانُوا بِهَا يَسْتَهْزِئُونَ
versets.phonetique: Thumma kân 'âqibat-al-ladhîn asâû-s-sû'â an kadhdhab û bi-âyât-al-lâh wa kânû bihâ yastahzi'ûn
versets.francais: Puis la fin de ceux qui ont commis le mal fut mauvaise parce qu'ils traitaient Nos signes de mensonges et s'en moquaient
versets.anglais: And there will not be for them among their [alleged] partners any intercessors, and they will [then] be disbelievers in their partners

versets.arabe: اللَّهُ يَبْدَأُ الْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُ ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
versets.phonetique: Al-lâhu yabda'u-l-khalq thumma yu'îduh thumma ilayhi turja'ûn
versets.francais: Allah commence la création, puis Il la réitère, puis vers Lui vous serez ramenés
versets.anglais: And the Day the Hour appears - that Day they will become separated

versets.arabe: وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ يُبْلِسُ الْمُجْرِمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa yawm taqûm-us-sâ'ah yublisu-l-mujrimûn
versets.francais: Et le jour où l'Heure se lèvera, les criminels seront dans le désespoir
versets.anglais: And as for those who had believed and done righteous deeds, they will be in a garden [of Paradise], delighted

versets.arabe: وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُم مِّن شُرَكَائِهِمْ شُفَعَاءُ وَكَانُوا بِشُرَكَائِهِمْ كَافِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa lam yakun lahum min sharukâ'i-him shufcâ'u wa kânû bi-sharukâ'i-him kâfirîn
versets.francais: Et leurs associés n'auront pas d'intercesseurs pour eux, et ils renieront leurs associés
versets.anglais: But as for those who disbelieved and denied Our verses and the meeting of the Hereafter, those will be brought into the punishment [to remain]

versets.arabe: وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَتَفَرَّقُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa yawm taqûm-us-sâ'ah yawma'idhin yatafarraqûn
versets.francais: Et le jour où l'Heure se lèvera, ce jour-là ils se sépareront
versets.anglais: So exalted is Allah when you reach the evening and when you reach the morning

versets.arabe: فَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ فَهُمْ فِي رَوْضَةٍ يُحْبَرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Fa ammâ alladhîn âmanû wa 'amilû-s-sâlihât fa hum fî rawda yahburûn
versets.francais: Quant à ceux qui ont cru et fait de bonnes œuvres, ils seront dans un verger, où ils jouiront
versets.anglais: And to Him is [due all] praise throughout the heavens and the earth. And [exalted is He] at night and when you are at noon

versets.arabe: وَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَكَذَّبُوا بِآيَاتِنَا وَلِقَاءِ الْآخِرَةِ فَأُولَٰئِكَ فِي الْعَذَابِ مُحْضَرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa ammâ alladhîn kafarû wa kadhdhab û bi-âyâtinâ wa liqâ'i-l-âkhirah fa ulâ'ika fi-l-'adhâb muhdarûn
versets.francais: Quant à ceux qui ont mécru et traité Nos signes de mensonges et la rencontre de l'Au-delà de mensonges, ceux-là seront livrés au châtiment
versets.anglais: He brings the living out of the dead and brings the dead out of the living and brings to life the earth after its lifelessness. And thus will you be brought out

versets.arabe: فَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ حِينَ تُمْسُونَ وَحِينَ تُصْبِحُونَ
versets.phonetique: Fasubhân-al-lâh hîn tumsûn wa hîn tusbihûn
versets.francais: Gloire à Allah le soir et le matin
versets.anglais: And of His signs is that He created you from dust; then, suddenly you were human beings dispersing [throughout the earth]

versets.arabe: وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَعَشِيًّا وَحِينَ تُظْهِرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa lahu-l-hamd fi-s-samâwât wa-l-ardi wa 'ashiyyan wa hîn tudzharûn
versets.francais: Et à Lui la louange dans les cieux et sur la terre. Et l'après-midi et quand vous êtes à midi
versets.anglais: And of His signs is that He created for you from yourselves mates that you may find tranquillity in them; and He placed between you affection and mercy. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought

versets.arabe: يُخْرِجُ الْحَيَّ مِنَ الْمَيِّتِ وَيُخْرِجُ الْمَيِّتَ مِنَ الْحَيِّ وَيُحْيِي الْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا وَكَذَٰلِكَ تُخْرَجُونَ
versets.phonetique: Yukhraj-ul-hayya min-al-mayyit wa yukhraj-al-mayyit min-al-hayy wa yuhyî-l-ardi ba'da mawti-hâ wa kadhâlika tukhrajûn
versets.francais: Il tire le vivant du mort et le mort du vivant, et Il vivifie la terre après sa mort. C'est ainsi que vous sortirez
versets.anglais: And of His signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth and the diversity of your languages and your colors. Indeed in that are signs for those of knowledge

versets.arabe: وَمِنْ آيَاتِهِ أَنْ خَلَقَكُم مِّن تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ إِذَا أَنتُم بَشَرٌ تَنتَشِرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa min âyâ-ti-hi an khalaqakum min turâb thumma idhâ antum bashar tantashirûn
versets.francais: Et parmi Ses signes: Il vous a créés de poussière, puis vous voilà devenant des hommes qui se dispersent
versets.anglais: And of His signs is your sleep by night and day and your seeking of His bounty. Indeed in that are signs for a people who listen

versets.arabe: وَمِنْ آيَاتِهِ أَنْ خَلَقَ لَكُم مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَزْوَاجًا لِّتَسْكُنُوا إِلَيْهَا وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَكُم مَّوَدَّةً وَرَحْمَةً
versets.phonetique: Wa min âyâ-ti-hi an khalaqa lakum min anfusikum azwâjan li-taskunû ilayhâ wa ja'ala baynakum mawwada wa rahmah
versets.francais: Et parmi Ses signes: Il a créé pour vous, de vous-mêmes, des épouses pour que vous trouviez la tranquillité auprès d'elles, et Il a mis entre vous de l'affection et de la miséricorde
versets.anglais: And of His signs is [that] He shows you the lightning [causing] fear and aspiration, and He sends down rain from the sky by which He brings to life the earth after its lifelessness. Indeed in that are signs for a people who use reason

versets.arabe: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَاتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Inna fî dhâlika la-âyât li-qawm yatafakkarûn
versets.francais: Il y a là des signes pour un peuple qui réfléchit
versets.anglais: And of His signs is that the heaven and earth remain by His command. Then when He calls you with a [single] call from the earth, immediately you will come forth

versets.arabe: وَمِنْ آيَاتِهِ خَلْقُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَاخْتِلَافُ أَلْسِنَتِكُمْ وَأَلْوَانِكُمْ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَاتٍ لِّلْعَالِمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa min âyâ-ti-hi khalq-us-samâwâti wa-l-ardi wa khtilâf alsinatikum wa alwânikum inna fî dhâlika la-âyât li-l-'âlamîn
versets.francais: Et parmi Ses signes: la création des cieux et de la terre, et la diversité de vos langues et de vos couleurs. Il y a là des signes pour les savants
versets.anglais: And to Him belongs whoever is in the heavens and earth. All are to Him devoutly obedient

versets.arabe: وَمِنْ آيَاتِهِ مَنَامُكُم بِاللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ وَابْتِغَاؤُكُم مِّن فَضْلِهِ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَاتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَسْمَعُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa min âyâ-ti-hi manâmukum bi-l-layli wa-n-nahâr wa-btigha'ukum min fadli-hi, inna fî dhâlika la-âyât li-qawm yasma'ûn
versets.francais: Et parmi Ses signes: votre sommeil la nuit et le jour, et votre recherche de Sa grâce. Il y a là des signes pour un peuple qui entend
versets.anglais: And it is He who begins creation; then He repeats it, and that is [even] easier for Him. To Him belongs the highest attribute in the heavens and earth. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise

versets.arabe: وَمِنْ آيَاتِهِ يُرِيكُمُ الْبَرْقَ خَوْفًا وَطَمَعًا وَيُنَزِّلُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَيُحْيِي بِهِ الْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا
versets.phonetique: Wa min âyâ-ti-hi yurîkum-ul-barq khawfan wa tama'an wa yunazzil min-us-samâ'i mâ'an fa yuhyî bi-hi-l-ardi ba'da mawti-hâ
versets.francais: Et parmi Ses signes: Il vous montre l'éclair, avec crainte et espérance, et Il fait descendre du ciel l'eau qui vivifie la terre après sa mort
versets.anglais: He presents to you an example from yourselves. Do you have among those whom your right hands possess any partners in what We have provided for you so that you are equal therein [and] would fear them as your fear of one another [within a partnership]? Thus do We detail the verses for a people who use reason

versets.arabe: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَاتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Inna fî dhâlika la-âyât li-qawm ya'qilûn
versets.francais: Il y a là des signes pour un peuple qui raisonne
versets.anglais: But those who wrong follow their [own] desires without knowledge. Then who can guide one whom Allah has sent astray? And for them there are no helpers

versets.arabe: وَمِنْ آيَاتِهِ أَن تَقُومَ السَّمَاءُ وَالْأَرْضُ بِأَمْرِهِ ثُمَّ إِذَا دَعَاكُمْ دَعْوَةً مِّنَ الْأَرْضِ إِذَا أَنتُمْ تَخْرُجُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa min âyâ-ti-hi an taqûm-us-samâu wa-l-ard bi-amri-hi thumma idhâ da'âkum da'wa min-al-ardi idhâ antum takhrujûn
versets.francais: Et parmi Ses signes: le ciel et la terre se maintiennent à Son ordre. Ensuite quand Il vous appelera d'un appel de la terre, voilà que vous sortirez
versets.anglais: So direct your face toward the religion, inclining to truth. [Adhere to] the fitrah of Allah upon which He has created [all] people. No change should there be in the creation of Allah. That is the correct religion, but most of the people do not know

versets.arabe: وَلَهُ مَن فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ كُلٌّ لَّهُ قَانِتُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa lahu man fi-s-samâwât wa-l-ardi kullun lahu qânitûn
versets.francais: Et à Lui appartient tout ce qui est dans les cieux et sur la terre. Tous lui sont obéissants
versets.anglais: [Adhere to it], turning in repentance to Him, and fear Him and establish prayer and do not be of those who associate others with Allah

versets.arabe: وَهُوَ الَّذِي يَبْدَأُ الْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُ وَهُوَ أَهْوَنُ عَلَيْهِ وَلَهُ الْمَثَلُ الْأَعْلَىٰ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ
versets.phonetique: Wa huwa alladhî yabda'u-l-khalq thumma yu'îdu-h wa huwa ahwan 'alayh wa lahu-l-mathal-ul-a'lâ fi-s-samâwât wa-l-ardi wa huwa-l-'azîz-ul-hakîm
versets.francais: Et c'est Lui qui commence la création puis la réitère. Cela Lui est facile. Et à Lui l'exemple le plus sublime dans les cieux et sur la terre. Et c'est Lui le Puissant, le Sage
versets.anglais: [Or] of those who have divided their religion and become sects, every faction rejoicing in what it has

versets.arabe: ضَرَبَ لَكُم مَّثَلًا مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ هَل لَّكُم مِّن مَّا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُكُم مِّن شُرَكَاءَ فِي مَا رَزَقْنَاكُمْ فَأَنتُمْ فِيهِ سَوَاءٌ تَخَافُونَهُمْ كَخِيفَتِكُمْ أَنفُسَكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Daraba lakum mathalan min anfusikum hal lakum mim mâ malakat aymânukum min sharukâ'a fî mâ razaqnâkum fa antum fîhi sawâun takkhâfûnahum ka khîfatikum anfusikum
versets.francais: Il vous donne un exemple tiré de vous-mêmes. Avez-vous, de ce que possèdent vos mains droites, des associés pour partager avec vous ce que Nous vous avons attribué, de sorte que vous en soyez égaux et que vous les craigniez comme vous vous craignez vous-mêmes?
versets.anglais: And when adversity touches the people, they call upon their Lord, turning in repentance to Him. Then when He lets them taste mercy from Him, at once a party of them associate others with their Lord

versets.arabe: كَذَٰلِكَ نُفَصِّلُ الْآيَاتِ لِقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Kadhâlika nufassil-ul-âyât li-qawm ya'qilûn
versets.francais: C'est ainsi que Nous exposons les versets pour un peuple qui raisonne
versets.anglais: So that they will deny what We have granted them. Then enjoy yourselves, for you are going to know

versets.arabe: بَلِ اتَّبَعَ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا أَهْوَاءَهُم بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ فَمَن يَهْدِي مَن أَضَلَّ اللَّهُ وَمَا لَهُم مِّن نَاصِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Bali-t-taba'a alladhîn zalamû ahwâ'ahum bi ghayri 'ilm fa man yahdî man adalal-lâhu wa mâ lahum min nâsirîn
versets.francais: Mais ceux qui ont commis l'injustice ont suivi leurs propres passions sans science. Qui peut alors mettre sur le droit chemin celui qu'Allah égare? Et il n'y a pour eux aucun secoureur
versets.anglais: Or have We sent down to them an authority, and it speaks of what they were associating with Him

versets.arabe: فَأَقِمْ وَجْهَكَ لِلدِّينِ حَنِيفًا فِطْرَةَ اللَّهِ الَّتِي فَطَرَ النَّاسَ عَلَيْهَا لَا تَبْدِيلَ لِخَلْقِ اللَّهِ ذَٰلِكَ الدِّينُ الْقَيِّمُ
versets.phonetique: Fa aqim wajhaka li-d-dîn hanîfan fitr-at-al-lâh allatî fatara-n-nâs 'alayhâ lâ tabdîl li khalq-al-lâh dhâlika-d-dîn-ul-qayyim
versets.francais: Dirige donc ton intention vers la Religion, exclusivement. La nature que Allah a originellement donnée aux hommes est son intention. Pas de modification à la création d'Allah. C'est cela la Religion de droit
versets.anglais: And when We let the people taste mercy, they rejoice therein, but if evil afflicts them for what their hands have put forth, immediately they despair

versets.arabe: وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa lâkin akthara-n-nâs lâ ya'lamûn
versets.francais: Mais la plupart des gens ne savent pas
versets.anglais: Do they not see that Allah extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it]? Indeed, in that are signs for a people who believe

versets.arabe: مُنِيبِينَ إِلَيْهِ وَاتَّقُوهُ وَأَقِيمُوا الصَّلَاةَ وَلَا تَكُونُوا مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ
versets.phonetique: Munîbîn ilayh wa-t-taqûh wa aqîmu-s-salâh wa lâ takûnû min-al-mushrikîn
versets.francais: Se tournant vers Lui, craignez-Le, accomplissez la Salat et ne soyez pas du nombre des associateurs
versets.anglais: So give the relative his right, as well as the needy and the traveler. That is best for those who desire the countenance of Allah, and it is they who will be the successful

versets.arabe: مِنَ الَّذِينَ فَرَّقُوا دِينَهُمْ وَكَانُوا شِيَعًا كُلُّ حِزْبٍ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ فَرِحُونَ
versets.phonetique: Min alladhîn faraqû dînahum wa kânû shiya'an kullu hizb bi mâ ladayhum farihûn
versets.francais: De ceux qui ont divisé leur Religion et se sont fragmentés en sectes, chaque groupe se réjouissant de ce qu'il détient
versets.anglais: And whatever you give for interest to increase within the wealth of people will not increase with Allah. But what you give in zakah, desiring the countenance of Allah - those are the multipliers

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا مَسَّ النَّاسَ ضُرٌّ دَعَوْا رَبَّهُم مُّنِيبِينَ إِلَيْهِ ثُمَّ إِذَا أَذَاقَهُم مِّنْهُ رَحْمَةً إِذَا فَرِيقٌ مِّنْهُم بِرَبِّهِمْ يُشْرِكُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa idhâ massa-n-nâs durr, da'aw rabbahum munîbîn ilayh, thumma idhâ adhâqahum minhu rahmah idhâ farîq min-hum bi rabbihim yushrikûn
versets.francais: Et quand un malheur atteint les gens, ils invoquent leur Seigneur en se tournant vers Lui. Puis, quand Il leur fait goûter une miséricorde de sa part, voilà qu'un groupe d'entre eux associent d'autres divinités à leur Seigneur
versets.anglais: Allah is the one who created you, then provided for you, then will cause you to die, and then will give you life. Are there any of your "partners" who does anything of that? Exalted is He and high above what they associate with Him

versets.arabe: لِيَكْفُرُوا بِمَا آتَيْنَاهُمْ فَتَمَتَّعُوا فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Li yakfurû bi mâ âtaynâhum fa tamatta'û fa sawfa ta'lamûn
versets.francais: Pour qu'ils renient ce que Nous leur avons attribué. Alors, jouissez! Mais vous saurez bientôt
versets.anglais: Corruption has appeared throughout the land and sea by [reason of] what the hands of people have earned so He may let them taste part of [the consequence of] what they have done that perhaps they will return [to righteousness]

versets.arabe: أَمْ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَانًا فَهُوَ يَتَكَلَّمُ بِمَا كَانُوا بِهِ يُشْرِكُونَ
versets.phonetique: Am anzalnâ 'alayhim sultânan fa huwa yatakallam bi mâ kânû bi-hi yushrikûn
versets.francais: Avons-Nous fait descendre sur eux un pouvoir qui parle en faveur de ce qu'ils associent?
versets.anglais: Say, [O Muhammad], "Travel through the land and observe how was the end of those before. Most of them were associators [of others with Allah]

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا أَذَقْنَا النَّاسَ رَحْمَةً فَرِحُوا بِهَا وَإِن تُصِبْهُمْ سَيِّئَةٌ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ إِذَا هُمْ يَقْنَطُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa idhâ adhaqnâ-n-nâs rahmah farihû bi hâ, wa in tusbhum sayyia bi mâ qaddamat aydîhim idhâ hum yaqnaTûn
versets.francais: Et quand Nous goûtons aux hommes une miséricorde, ils s'en réjouissent. Mais si un malheur les touche pour ce qu'ils ont commis, les voilà désespérés
