versets.anglais: So direct your face toward the correct religion before a Day comes from Allah of which there is no repelling. That Day, they will be divided

versets.arabe: أَوَ لَمْ يَرَوْا أَنَّ اللَّهَ يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَاءُ وَيَقْدِرُ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَاتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ
versets.phonetique: Aw lam yaraw anna-l-lâh yabsut-ur-rizq li-man yashâ'u wa yaqdir inna fî dhâlika la-âyât li-qawm yu'minûn
versets.francais: Ne voient-ils pas qu'Allah élargit la subsistance à qui Il veut et la restreint? Il y a là des signes pour un peuple qui croit
versets.anglais: Whoever disbelieves - upon him is [the consequence of] his disbelief. And whoever does righteousness - they are for themselves preparing

versets.arabe: فَآتِ ذَا الْقُرْبَىٰ حَقَّهُ وَالْمِسْكِينَ وَابْنَ السَّبِيلِ ذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ لِّلَّذِينَ يُرِيدُونَ وَجْهَ اللَّهِ وَأُولَٰئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ
versets.phonetique: Fa âti dhâ-l-qurbâ haqqahu wa-l-miskîn wa-bna-s-sabîl, dhâlika khayrun li-l-ladhîn yurîdûn wajh-al-lâh wa ulâ'ika hum-ul-muflihûn
versets.francais: Alors, donne au proche parent ses droits, ainsi qu'au pauvre et au voyageur. C'est mieux pour ceux qui recherchent la Face d'Allah. Et ce sont eux qui réussissent
versets.anglais: That He may reward those who have believed and done righteous deeds out of His bounty. Indeed, He does not like the disbelievers

versets.arabe: وَمَا آتَيْتُم مِّن رِّبًا لِّيَرْبُوَ فِي أَمْوَالِ النَّاسِ فَلَا يَرْبُو عِندَ اللَّهِ وَمَا آتَيْتُم مِّن زَكَاةٍ تُرِيدُونَ وَجْهَ اللَّهِ فَأُولَٰئِكَ هُمُ الْمُضْعِفُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa mâ âtaytum min ribbân li-yarbû fî amwâl-an-nâs fa lâ yarbû 'ind-al-lâh wa mâ âtaytum min zakâh turîdûn wajh-al-lâh fa ulâ'ika hum-al-mudh'ifûn
versets.francais: Et ce que vous donnez comme intérêt pour augmenter vos richesses aux dépens d'autrui ne les augmente pas auprès d'Allah. Mais ce que vous donnez comme Zakat, en désirant la Face d'Allah, ceux-là verront leur récompense multipliée
versets.anglais: And of His signs is that He sends the winds as bringers of good tidings and to let you taste His mercy and so the ships may sail at His command and so you may seek of His bounty, and perhaps you will be grateful

versets.arabe: اللَّهُ الَّذِي خَلَقَكُمْ ثُمَّ رَزَقَكُمْ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمْ ثُمَّ يُحْيِيكُمْ هَلْ مِن شُرَكَائِكُم مَّن يَفْعَلُ مِن ذَٰلِكُم مِّن شَيْءٍ سُبْحَانَهُ وَتَعَالَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
versets.phonetique: Al-lâhu alladhî khalaqakum thumma razaqakum thumma yumîtukum thumma yuhyîkum hal min sharukâ'ikum man yaf'al min dhâlikum min shay', subhânahu wa ta'âlâ 'ammâ yushrikûn
versets.francais: Allah est Celui qui vous a créés, puis vous a attribué une subsistance, puis vous fera mourir, puis vous ressuscitera. Y a-t-il parmi vos associés celui qui fasse quelque chose de ces choses? Gloire à Lui! Et que soit exalté bien au-dessus de ce qu'ils associent
versets.anglais: And We have already sent messengers before you to their peoples, and they came to them with clear evidences; then We took retribution from those who committed crimes, and incumbent upon Us was support of the believers

versets.arabe: ظَهَرَ الْفَسَادُ فِي الْبَرِّ وَالْبَحْرِ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ أَيْدِي النَّاسِ لِيُذِيقَهُم بَعْضَ الَّذِي عَمِلُوا لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
versets.phonetique: Zahar-al-fasâd fi-l-barr wa-l-bahr bi-mâ kasabat aydî-n-nâs li yudhîqahum ba'da alladhî 'amilû la'allahum yarji'ûn
versets.francais: La corruption est apparue sur la terre et dans la mer à cause de ce que les mains des gens ont acquis, pour leur faire goûter une partie de ce qu'ils ont commis, afin peut-être qu'ils reviennent
versets.anglais: It is Allah who sends the winds, and they stir the clouds and spread them in the sky however He wills, and He makes them fragments so you see the rain emerge from within them. And when He causes it to fall upon whom He wills of His servants, immediately they rejoice

versets.arabe: قُلْ سِيرُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَانظُرُوا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلُ كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ مُشْرِكِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qul sîrû fi-l-ardi fanzurû kayfa kân 'âqibat-al-ladhîn min qabl kân aktharu-hum mushrikîn
versets.francais: Dis: "Parcourez la terre et voyez comment a été la fin de ceux d'avant. La plupart d'entre eux étaient des associateurs"
versets.anglais: Although they were, before it was sent down upon them - before that, in despair

versets.arabe: فَأَقِمْ وَجْهَكَ لِلدِّينِ الْقَيِّمِ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَ يَوْمٌ لَّا مَرَدَّ لَهُ مِنَ اللَّهِ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَصِدُّونَ
versets.phonetique: Fa aqim wajhaka li-d-dîn-al-qayyim min qabl an ya'tiya yawm lâ maradda lahu min-al-lâh yawma'idhin yasiddûn
versets.francais: Dirige donc ton intention vers la Religion de droit, avant qu'un jour ne vienne d'Allah dont il n'y aura nul retour. Ce jour-là, ils se diviseront
versets.anglais: So observe the effects of the mercy of Allah - how He gives life to the earth after its lifelessness. Indeed, that [same one] will give life to the dead, and He is over all things competent

versets.arabe: مَن كَفَرَ فَعَلَيْهِ كُفْرُهُ وَمَن عَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَلِأَنفُسِهِمْ يَمْهَدُونَ
versets.phonetique: Man kafara fa 'alayh kufru-h wa man 'amila sâlihan fa li anfusi-him yamhadûn
versets.francais: Celui qui mécroit, son mécreance retombera sur lui. Et celui qui fait de bonnes œuvres prépare pour lui-même
versets.anglais: But if We should send a [bad] wind and they saw [their crops] turned yellow, they would remain thereafter disbelievers

versets.arabe: لِيَجْزِيَ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ مِن فَضْلِهِ إِنَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ الْكَافِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Li yajziya-l-lâhu alladhîn âmanû wa 'amilû-s-sâlihât min fadli-hi innahu lâ yuhiû-l-kâfirîn
versets.francais: Afin qu'Allah récompense ceux qui ont cru et ont fait de bonnes œuvres de Sa grâce. Il n'aime pas les mécréants
versets.anglais: So indeed, you will not make the dead hear, nor will you make the deaf hear the call when they turn their backs, retreating

versets.arabe: وَمِنْ آيَاتِهِ أَن يُرْسِلَ الرِّيَاحَ مُبَشِّرَاتٍ وَلِيُذِيقَكُم مِّن رَّحْمَتِهِ وَلِتَجْرِيَ الْفُلْكُ بِأَمْرِهِ وَلِتَبْتَغُوا مِن فَضْلِهِ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa min âyâ-ti-hi an yursil-ar-riyâh mubashshirât wa li yudhîqakum min rahmati-hi wa li tajriya-l-fulk bi-amri-hi wa li-tabtagû min fadli-hi wa la'allakum tashkurûn
versets.francais: Et parmi Ses signes: Il envoie les vents porteurs de bonnes nouvelles et pour vous faire goûter de Sa miséricorde, pour que les navires naviguent par Son ordre et pour que vous cherchiez de Sa grâce. Peut-être serez-vous reconnaissants
versets.anglais: And you cannot guide the blind away from their error. You will only make hear those who believe in Our verses so they are Muslims [in submission to Allah]

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ رُسُلًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِمْ فَجَاءُوهُم بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ فَانتَقَمْنَا مِنَ الَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا وَكَانَ حَقًّا عَلَيْنَا نَصْرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa laqad arsalnâ min qablika rusul ilâ qawmi-him fa jâ'ûhum bi-l-bayyinât fa-ntaqamnâ min alladhîn ajramû wa kân haqqan 'alaynâ nasr-ul-mu'minîn
versets.francais: Et Nous avons envoyé avant toi des Messagers à leurs peuples respectifs. Ils vinrent à eux avec des preuves évidentes. Nous tirâmes vengeance de ceux qui commettaient le crime, et il était pour Nous un devoir de secourir les croyants
versets.anglais: Allah is the one who created you from weakness, then made after weakness strength, then made after strength weakness and white hair. He creates what He wills, and He is the Knowing, the Competent

versets.arabe: اللَّهُ الَّذِي أَنزَلَ الْكِتَابَ بِالْحَقِّ وَالْمِيزَانَ وَمَا يَعْلَمُ إِن السَّاعَةُ آتِيَةٌ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَمَن يَقُلْ إِنِّي أَنزِلْتُ عَلَيَّ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ إِن تَتَّقُونَ
versets.phonetique: Al-lâhu alladhî anzal-al-kitâb bi-l-haq wa-l-mîzân wa mâ ya'lam in-us-sâ'ah âti'ah illâ-l-lâh wa man yaqul innî unzilat 'alayya min-al-'ilm in-ittaqûn
versets.francais: Allah est Celui qui a fait descendre le Livre en vérité et la Balance. Et qui sait, peut-être que l'Heure est proche? Ceux qui n'y croient pas en demandent l'accélération, tandis que ceux qui y croient en ont peur et savent que c'est la vérité
versets.anglais: And the Day the Hour appears the criminals will swear they had remained but an hour. Thus they were deluded

versets.arabe: إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَطِيفٌ بِعِبَادِهِ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَشَاءُ وَهُوَ الْقَوِيُّ الْعَزِيزُ
versets.phonetique: Inna-l-lâh latîf bi 'ibâdi-hi yarzuq man yashâ'u wa huwa-l-qawiyy-ul-'azîz
versets.francais: Allah est plein de délicatesse envers Ses serviteurs. Il pourvoit au subsistance de qui Il veut. Et c'est Lui le Puissant, le Très Fort
versets.anglais: But those who were given knowledge and faith will say, "You remained the extent of Allah 's decree until the Day of Resurrection, and this is the Day of Resurrection, but you did not used to know

versets.arabe: مَن كَانَ يُرِيدُ حَرْثَ الْآخِرَةِ نَزِدْ لَهُ فِي حَرْثِهِ وَمَن كَانَ يُرِيدُ حَرْثَ الدُّنْيَا نُؤْتِهِ مِنْهَا وَمَا لَهُ فِي الْآخِرَةِ مِن نَصِيبٍ
versets.phonetique: Man kân yurîd harth-al-âkhirah nazidd lahu fî harthi-h wa man kân yurîd harth-ad-dunyâ nu'ti-hi min-hâ wa mâ lahu fi-l-âkhirah min nasîb
versets.francais: Celui qui désire la moisson de l'Au-delà, Nous en augmentons la récolte. Et celui qui désire la moisson d'ici-bas, Nous lui en donnons quelque chose, mais il n'aura point de part dans l'Au-delà
versets.anglais: So that Day, their excuse will not benefit those who wronged, nor will they be asked to appease [Allah]

versets.arabe: أَمْ لَهُمْ شُرَكَاءُ شَرَعُوا لَهُم مِّنَ الدِّينِ مَا لَمْ يَأْذَن بِهِ اللَّهُ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةُ الْفَصْلِ لَقُضِيَ بَيْنَهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Am lahum sharukâ'u shara'û lahum min-ad-dîn mâ lam ya'dhan bi-h al-lâh wa lawlâ kalimat-ul-fasl laqudia baynahum
versets.francais: Ont-ils des associés qui leur auraient prescrit une religion qu'Allah n'a pas permise? Et n'eût été la parole définitive, on aurait déjà jugé entre eux
versets.anglais: And We have certainly presented to the people in this Qur'an from every [kind of] example. But, [O Muhammad], if you should bring them a sign, the disbelievers will surely say, "You [believers] are but falsifiers

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الظَّالِمِينَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Inna-z-zâlimîn lahum 'adhâb alîm
versets.francais: Les injustes auront certes un châtiment douloureux
versets.anglais: Thus does Allah seal the hearts of those who do not know

versets.arabe: تَرَىٰ الظَّالِمِينَ مُشْفِقِينَ مِمَّا كَسَبُوا وَهُوَ وَاقِعٌ بِهِمْ وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ فِي رَوْضَاتِ الْجَنَّاتِ لَهُمْ مَّا يَشَاءُونَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَضْلُ الْكَبِيرُ
versets.phonetique: Tarâ-z-zâlimîn mushfiqîn mimmâ kasabû wa huwa wâqi' bi-him wa alladhîn âmanû wa 'amilû-s-sâlihât fî rawdât-al-jannât lahum mâ yashâûn 'inda rabbi-him, dhâlika huwa-l-fadl-ul-kabîr
versets.francais: Tu vois les injustes effrayés à cause de ce qu'ils ont gagné, car ce châtiment est inévitable. Et ceux qui ont cru et fait de bonnes œuvres seront dans les jardins du Paradis, où ils auront tout ce qu'ils désireront auprès de leur Seigneur. Cela est la grâce immense
versets.anglais: So be patient. Indeed, the promise of Allah is truth. And let them not disquiet you who are not certain [in faith]

sourates.signification: Le nom d'un sage dont la sagesse est célèbre

versets.arabe: الم
versets.phonetique: Alif Lam Mim
versets.francais: Alif. Lam. Mim.
versets.anglais: Alif, Lam, Meem

versets.arabe: تِلْكَ آيَاتُ الْكِتَابِ الْحَكِيمِ
versets.phonetique: Tilka ayatu al-kitabi al-hakimi
versets.francais: Voilà les versets du Livre plein de sagesse,
versets.anglais: These are verses of the wise Book

versets.arabe: هُدًى وَرَحْمَةً لِلْمُحْسِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Hudan wa rahmatan lil-muhsinina
versets.francais: Guidance et miséricorde pour les bienfaiteurs,
versets.anglais: As guidance and mercy for the doers of good

versets.arabe: الَّذِينَ يُقِيمُونَ الصَّلَاةَ وَيُؤْتُونَ الزَّكَاةَ وَهُمْ بِالْآخِرَةِ هُمْ يُوقِنُونَ
versets.phonetique: Al-ladhina yuqimuna al-salata wa yu'tuna al-zakat wa hum bi-al-akhirati hum yuqinun
versets.francais: Ceux qui observent la Salat, acquittent la Zakat et ont la certitude de l'au-delà.
versets.anglais: Who establish prayer and give zakah, and they, of the Hereafter, are certain [in faith]

versets.arabe: أُولَئِكَ عَلَىٰ هُدًى مِنْ رَبِّهِمْ ۖ وَأُولَئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ
versets.phonetique: Ula'ika 'ala hudan min rabbihim wa ula'ika humu al-muflihtun
versets.francais: Ceux-ci sont sur la bonne voie de leur Seigneur, et ce sont eux qui réussissent.
versets.anglais: Those are on [right] guidance from their Lord, and it is those who are the successful

versets.arabe: وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَنْ يَشْتَرِي لَهْوَ الْحَدِيثِ لِيُضِلَّ عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ وَيَتَّخِذَهَا هُزُوًا ۚ أُولَئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مُهِينٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa mina al-nasi man yashtari lahwa al-hadith liyudzilla 'an sabil Allah bighayri 'ilm wa yattakhidhaha huzuwan ula'ika lahum 'adhab muheen
versets.francais: Et parmi les hommes, il en est qui achètent les paroles divertissantes pour égarer sur le sentier d'Allah, sans science, et qui prennent ce sentier en raillerie. Ceux-là auront un châtiment humiliant.
versets.anglais: And of the people is he who buys the amusement of speech to mislead [others] from the way of Allah without knowledge and who takes it in ridicule. Those will have a humiliating punishment

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ آيَاتُنَا وَلَّىٰ مُسْتَكْبِرًا كَأَنْ لَمْ يَسْمَعْهَا كَأَنَّ فِي أُذُنَيْهِ وَقْرًا ۖ فَبَشِّرْهُ بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa idha tutla 'alayhi ayatuna walla mustakbiran ka'an lam yasma'ha ka'anna fi udhunayhi waqr fa bashshirhu bi-'adhab alim
versets.francais: Et quand Nos versets lui sont récités, il s'en détourne par orgueil, comme s'il ne les avait point entendus, comme s'il y avait une surdité dans ses oreilles. Annonce-lui donc un châtiment douloureux.
versets.anglais: And when our verses are recited to him, he turns away arrogantly as if he had not heard them, as if there was in his ears deafness. So give him tidings of a painful punishment

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّاتُ النَّعِيمِ
versets.phonetique: Inna al-ladhina amanu wa 'amilu al-salihat lahum jannat al-na'im
versets.francais: Ceux qui croient et font les bonnes œuvres auront les Jardins de délices,
versets.anglais: Indeed, those who believe and do righteous deeds - for them are the Gardens of Pleasure

versets.arabe: خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا ۖ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقًّا ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ
versets.phonetique: Khalidina fihā wa'd Allah haqqan wa huwa al-'aziz al-hakim
versets.francais: Éternellement. C'est une promesse d'Allah en toute vérité. Et c'est Lui le Puissant, le Sage.
versets.anglais: Wherein they abide eternally; [it is] the promise of Allah [which is] truth. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise

versets.arabe: خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ بِغَيْرِ عَمَدٍ تَرَوْنَهَا وَأَلْقَىٰ فِي الْأَرْضِ رَوَاسِيَ أَنْ تَمِيدَ بِكُمْ وَبَثَّ فِيهَا مِنْ كُلِّ دَابَّةٍ ۚ وَأَنْزَلْنَا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَأَنْبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِنْ كُلِّ زَوْجٍ كَرِيمٍ
versets.phonetique: Khalaqa al-samawati bighayri 'amad tarawnahā wa alqā fi al-ard rawāsi an tamid bikum wa baththa fihā min kulli dābbah wa anzalna mina al-samā' mā' fa anbatna fihā min kulli zawj karim
versets.francais: Il a créé les cieux sans piliers que vous puissiez voir, et a implanté des montagnes fermes dans la terre pour qu'elle ne s'ébranle pas avec vous, et y a dispersé toutes sortes de bêtes. Et du ciel, Nous avons fait descendre de l'eau par laquelle Nous faisons croître des couples de plantes de toute espèce.
versets.anglais: He created the heavens without pillars that you see and has cast into the earth firmly set mountains, lest it should shift with you, and dispersed therein from every creature. And We sent down rain from the sky and made grow therein [plants] of every noble kind

versets.arabe: هَٰذَا خَلْقُ اللَّهِ فَأَرُونِي مَاذَا خَلَقَ الَّذِينَ مِنْ دُونِهِ ۚ بَلِ الظَّالِمُونَ فِي ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ
versets.phonetique: Hādhā khalq Allah fa āruni mādhā khalaqa al-ladhina min dūnih bal al-dhālimun fi dzalāl mubin
versets.francais: Telle est la création d'Allah. Montrez-moi donc ce qu'ont créé ceux qui sont en dehors de Lui ! Non, les injustes sont dans un égarement manifeste.
versets.anglais: This is the creation of Allah. So show Me what those other than Him have created. Rather, the wrongdoers are in clear error

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا لُقْمَانَ الْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ اشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَنْ يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِ ۚ وَمَنْ كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ غَنِيٌّ حَمِيدٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa laqad ataynā Luqmān al-hikmah an ashkur lillāh wa man yashkur fa innamā yashkur linafsihi wa man kafara fa inna Allah ghani hamid
versets.francais: Et Nous avons certes donné à Luqman la sagesse en disant : « Sois reconnaissant envers Allah ». Quiconque est reconnaissant l'est pour lui-même ; et quiconque ingrat... Allah n'a nul besoin et Il est Digne de louange.
versets.anglais: And We had certainly given Luqman wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allah." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allah is Free of need and Praiseworthy

versets.arabe: وَإِذْ قَالَ لُقْمَانُ لِابْنِهِ وَهُوَ يَعِظُهُ يَا بُنَيَّ لَا تُشْرِكْ بِاللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّ الشِّرْكَ لَظُلْمٌ عَظِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa idh qāla Luqmān li-ibnihi wa huwa ya'ithu yā bunayya lā tushrik billāh inna al-shirk ladhulm 'adhim
versets.francais: Et quand Luqman dit à son fils, tout en l'exhortant : « Ô mon fils, ne donne pas d'associés à Allah, car l'association à Allah est vraiment une injustice énorme ».
versets.anglais: And [mention, O Muhammad], when Luqman said to his son while he was instructing him, "O my son, do not associate [anything] with Allah. Indeed, association [with him] is great injustice

versets.arabe: وَبِالْوَالِدَيْنِ إِحْسَانًا ۖ وَإِنْ جَاهَدَاكَ عَلَىٰ أَنْ تُشْرِكَ بِي مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِ عِلْمٌ فَلَا تُطِعْهُمَا ۖ وَصَاحِبْهُمَا فِي الدُّنْيَا مَعْرُوفًا ۖ وَاتَّبِعْ سَبِيلَ مَنْ أَنَابَ إِلَيَّ ۚ ثُمَّ إِلَيَّ مَرْجِعُكُمْ فَأُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa bi-al-wālidayn ihsānan wa in jāhadāka 'alā an tushrik bi mā laysa laka bihi 'ilm falā tuṭi'humā wa sāhibhuma fi al-dunyā ma'rufan wa ittabi' sabīl man anāba ilayya thumma ilayya marji'ukum fa unabbu'ukum bimā kuntum ta'malun
versets.francais: Et sois bienfaisant envers tes père et mère. S'ils te pressent de m'associer ce dont tu n'as aucune connaissance, alors ne les obéis pas. Reste avec eux honorablement dans ce monde. Suis le chemin de celui qui s'est tourné vers Moi. Puis c'est vers Moi que sera votre retour, et alors Je vous informerai de ce que vous faisiez.
versets.anglais: And We have enjoined upon man [care] for his parents. His mother carried him, [increasing her] in weakness upon weakness, and his weaning is in two years. Be grateful to Me and to your parents; to Me is the [final] destination

versets.arabe: يَا بُنَيَّ إِنَّهَا إِنْ تَكُ مِثْقَالَ حَبَّةٍ مِنْ خَرْدَلٍ فَتَكُنْ فِي صَخْرَةٍ أَوْ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ أَوْ فِي الْأَرْضِ يَأْتِ بِهَا اللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَطِيفٌ خَبِيرٌ
versets.phonetique: Yā bunayya innahā in taku mithqāl habbah min khardal fatakun fi sakhra aw fi al-samāwāt aw fi al-ard ya'ti bihā Allah inna Allah latīf khabīr
versets.francais: Ô mon fils, eût-ce le poids d'un grain de moutarde, fût-ce dans un rocher, ou dans les cieux ou dans la terre, Allah l'apporterait. Allah est Subtil et Bien Informé.
versets.anglais: But if they endeavor to make you associate with Me that of which you have no knowledge, do not obey them but accompany them in [this] world with appropriate kindness and follow the way of those who turn back to Me [in repentance]. Then to Me will be your return, and I will inform you about what you used to do

versets.arabe: يَا بُنَيَّ أَقِمِ الصَّلَاةَ وَأْمُرْ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَانْهَ عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ وَاصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا أَصَابَكَ ۖ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ مِنْ عَزْمِ الْأُمُورِ
versets.phonetique: Yā bunayya aqimi al-salāt wa'mur bi-al-ma'rūf wa anha 'ani al-munkar wa asbir 'alā mā asābak inna dhālik min 'azm al-umur
versets.francais: Ô mon fils, accomplis la Salat, commande le bien, interdis le mal et endure patiemment ce qui t'atteint. Telle est la résolution à prendre dans toute entreprise !
versets.anglais: [And Luqman said], "O my son, indeed if wrong should be the weight of a mustard seed and should be within a rock or [anywhere] in the heavens or in the earth, Allah will bring it forth. Indeed, Allah is Subtle and Acquainted

versets.arabe: وَلَا تُصَعِّرْ خَدَّكَ لِلنَّاسِ وَلَا تَمْشِ فِي الْأَرْضِ مَرَحًا ۖ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ مُخْتَالٍ فَخُورٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa lā tuṣa''ir khaddak li-al-nās wa lā tamshi fi al-ard marah inna Allah lā yuhibbu kulla mukhṭāl fakhūr
versets.francais: Ne détourne pas ton visage des hommes, et ne foule pas la terre avec orgueil : Allah n'aime pas les présomptueux pleins de gloriole.
versets.anglais: O my son, establish prayer, enjoin what is right, forbid what is wrong, and be patient over what befalls you. Indeed, [all] that is of the matters [requiring] determination

versets.arabe: وَاقْصِدْ فِي مَشْيِكَ وَاغْضُضْ مِنْ صَوْتِكَ ۚ إِنَّ أَنْكَرَ الْأَصْوَاتِ لَصَوْتُ الْحَمِيرِ
versets.phonetique: Wa aqsid fi mashyika wa aghdud min sawṭik inna ankar al-aswāt lasawt al-hamīr
versets.francais: Sois modéré dans ta démarche et baisse ta voix. La voix la plus désagréable est celle de l'âne.
versets.anglais: And do not turn your cheek [in contempt] toward people and do not walk through the earth exultantly. Indeed, Allah does not like everyone self-deluded and boastful

versets.arabe: أَلَمْ تَرَوْا أَنَّ اللَّهَ سَخَّرَ لَكُمْ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَأَسْبَغَ عَلَيْكُمْ نِعَمَهُ ظَاهِرَةً وَبَاطِنَةً ۗ وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَنْ يُجَادِلُ فِي اللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ وَلَا هُدًى وَلَا كِتَابٍ مُنِيرٍ
versets.phonetique: Alam taraw anna Allah sakhkhara lakum mā fi al-samāwāt wa mā fi al-ard wa asbagha 'alaykum ni'amahu dhāhirah wa bāṭinah wa mina al-nās man yujādil fi Allah bighayri 'ilm wa lā hudan wa lā kitāb munīr
versets.francais: N'avez-vous pas vu qu'Allah a mis à votre service ce qui est dans les cieux et ce qui est dans la terre, et qu'Il vous a comblés de Ses bienfaits apparents et cachés ? Et parmi les hommes, il en est qui disputent sur Allah sans science, sans guidance et sans Livre lumineux.
versets.anglais: And be moderate in your pace and lower your voice; indeed, the most disagreeable of sounds is the voice of donkeys

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ اتَّبِعُوا مَا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ قَالُوا بَلْ نَتَّبِعُ مَا وَجَدْنَا عَلَيْهِ آبَاءَنَا ۚ أَوَلَوْ كَانَ الشَّيْطَانُ يَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ عَذَابِ السَّعِيرِ
versets.phonetique: Wa idhā qīla lahum ittabi'u mā anzala Allah qālū bal nattabi' mā wajadnā 'alayhi ābā'anā aw wa law kāna al-shaytān yad'uhum ilā 'adhāb al-sa'īr
versets.francais: Et quand on leur dit : « Suivez ce qu'Allah a fait descendre », ils disent : « Non, nous suivons ce sur quoi nous avons trouvé nos ancêtres ». Quoi ! Même si Satan les appelait au châtiment du Feu ?
versets.anglais: Do you not see that Allah has made subject to you whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth and amply bestowed upon you His favors, [both] apparent and unapparent? But of the people is he who disputes about Allah without knowledge or guidance or an enlightening Book [from Him]

versets.arabe: وَمَنْ يُسْلِمْ وَجْهَهُ إِلَىٰ اللَّهِ وَهُوَ مُحْسِنٌ فَقَدِ اسْتَمْسَكَ بِالْعُرْوَةِ الْوُثْقَىٰ ۗ وَإِلَىٰ اللَّهِ عَاقِبَةُ الْأُمُورِ
versets.phonetique: Wa man yuslim wajhahu ilā Allah wa huwa muhsin faqad istamsak bi-al-'urwah al-wuthqā wa ilā Allah 'āqibat al-umur
versets.francais: Quiconque soumet son visage à Allah, tandis qu'il est bienfaiteur, s'est vraiment saisi de l'anse la plus solide. Et c'est à Allah que revient la fin de toute affaire.
versets.anglais: And when it is said to them, "Follow what Allah has revealed," they say, "Rather, we will follow that upon which we found our fathers." Even if Satan was inviting them to the punishment of the Blaze

versets.arabe: وَمَنْ كَفَرَ فَلَا يَحْزُنْكَ كُفْرُهُ ۚ إِلَيْنَا مَرْجِعُهُمْ فَنُنَبِّئُهُمْ بِمَا عَمِلُوا ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ
versets.phonetique: Wa man kafara falā yahzunka kufruhu ilaynā marji'uhum faninabbu'uhum bimā 'amilū inna Allah 'alīm bidhāt al-sudūr
versets.francais: Et celui qui ne croit pas, que sa mécréance ne te chagrine point. C'est vers Nous que sera leur retour, et Nous les informerons de ce qu'ils ont fait. Allah connaît certes le secret des poitrines.
versets.anglais: And whoever submits his face to Allah while he is a doer of good - then he has grasped the most trustworthy handhold. And to Allah will be the outcome of [all] matters

versets.arabe: نُمَتِّعُهُمْ قَلِيلًا ثُمَّ نَضْطَرُّهُمْ إِلَىٰ عَذَابٍ غَلِيظٍ
versets.phonetique: Numattu'uhum qalīlan thumma nadtaruhum ilā 'adhāb ghalīdh
versets.francais: Nous les accordons une courte jouissance, puis Nous les contraignons à un châtiment rigoureux.
versets.anglais: And whoever has disbelieved - let not his disbelief grieve you. To Us is their return, and We will inform them of what they did. Indeed, Allah is Knowing of that within the breasts

versets.arabe: وَلَئِنْ سَأَلْتَهُمْ مَنْ خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ اللَّهُ ۚ قُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ۚ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa la'in sa'altahum man khalaqa al-samāwāt wa al-ard layaqūlunna Allah qul al-hamdu lillāh bal aktharuhum lā ya'lamūn
versets.francais: Et si tu les interroges : « Qui a créé les cieux et la terre ? » Ils diront certes : « Allah ». Dis : « Louange à Allah ! » Mais la plupart d'entre eux ne savent pas.
versets.anglais: We grant them enjoyment for a little; then We will force them to a massive punishment

versets.arabe: لِلَّهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْغَنِيُّ الْحَمِيدُ
versets.phonetique: Lillāh mā fi al-samāwāt wa al-ard inna Allah huwa al-ghaniyy al-hamīd
versets.francais: À Allah appartient tout ce qui est dans les cieux et sur la terre. Allah est Riche et Digne de louange.
versets.anglais: And if you asked them, "Who created the heavens and earth?" they would surely say, "Allah." Say, "[All] praise is [due] to Allah "; but most of them do not know

versets.arabe: وَلَوْ أَنَّ مَا فِي الْأَرْضِ مِنْ شَجَرَةٍ أَقْلَامٌ وَالْبَحْرُ يَمُدُّهُ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ سَبْعَةُ أَبْحُرٍ مَا نَفِدَتْ كَلِمَاتُ اللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa law anna mā fi al-ard min shajarah aqlām wa al-bahr yamudduh min ba'dihi saba'atu abhur mā nafida kalimāt Allah inna Allah 'azīz hakīm
versets.francais: Si tous les arbres de la terre se transformaient en plumes, et si l'océan était rempli d'encre, et si sept autres océans s'y ajoutaient, les paroles d'Allah ne s'épuiseraient pas. Allah est Puissant et Sage.
versets.anglais: To Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and earth. Indeed, Allah is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy

versets.arabe: مَا خَلْقُكُمْ وَلَا بَعْثُكُمْ إِلَّا كَنَفْسٍ وَاحِدَةٍ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ بَصِيرٌ
versets.phonetique: Mā khalqukum wa lā ba'thukum illā kanafsin wāhidah inna Allah samī' basīr
versets.francais: Votre création et votre résurrection ne sont qu'une seule âme. Allah est Celui qui entend tout et voit tout.
versets.anglais: And if whatever trees upon the earth were pens and the sea [was ink], replenished thereafter by seven [more] seas, the words of Allah would not be exhausted. Indeed, Allah is Exalted in Might and Wise

versets.arabe: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ يُولِجُ اللَّيْلَ فِي النَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ النَّهَارَ فِي اللَّيْلِ وَسَخَّرَ الشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ كُلٌّ يَجْرِي إِلَىٰ أَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ
versets.phonetique: Alam tara anna Allah yūlig al-layl fi al-nahār wa yūlig al-nahār fi al-layl wa sakhkhara al-shams wa al-qamar kullun tajrī ilā ajal musammā wa anna Allah bimā ta'malun khabīr
versets.francais: N'as-tu pas vu qu'Allah fait pénétrer la nuit dans le jour et pénétrer le jour dans la nuit, et qu'Il a assujetti le soleil et la lune, chacun poursuivant sa course jusqu'à un terme fixé, et qu'Allah est bien informé de ce que vous faites ?
versets.anglais: Your creation and your resurrection will not be but as that of a single soul. Indeed, Allah is Hearing and Seeing

versets.arabe: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْحَقُّ وَأَنَّ مَا يَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِهِ الْبَاطِلُ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْكَبِيرُ
versets.phonetique: Dhālik bi-anna Allah huwa al-haqq wa anna mā yad'ūn min dūnihi al-bāṭil wa anna Allah huwa al-'aliyy al-kabīr
versets.francais: C'est parce qu'Allah est la Vérité, et que ce qu'on invoque en dehors de Lui est le faux, et qu'Allah est le Très Haut, le Grand.
versets.anglais: Do you not see that Allah causes the night to enter the day and causes the day to enter the night and has subjected the sun and the moon, each running [its course] for a specified term, and that Allah, with whatever you do, is Acquainted

versets.arabe: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ الْفُلْكَ تَجْرِي فِي الْبَحْرِ بِنِعْمَةِ اللَّهِ لِيُرِيَكُمْ مِنْ آيَاتِهِ ۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَاتٍ لِكُلِّ صَبَّارٍ شَكُورٍ
versets.phonetique: Alam tara anna al-fulk tajrī fi al-bahr bi-ni'mat Allah liyuriyakum min āyātihi inna fi dhālik la-āyāt li-kulli sabbār shakūr
versets.francais: N'as-tu pas vu que les navires voguent sur la mer par le bienfait d'Allah, afin de vous montrer de Ses signes ? Il y a en cela des signes pour quiconque est très patient et très reconnaissant.
versets.anglais: That is because Allah is the Truth, and that what they call upon other than Him is falsehood, and because Allah is the Most High, the Grand

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا غَشِيَتْهُمْ مَوْجَةٌ كَالظُّلَلِ دَعَوُا اللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ فَلَمَّا نَجَّاهُمْ إِلَىٰ الْبَرِّ فَمِنْهُمْ مُقْتَصِدٌ ۚ وَمَا يَجْحَدُ بِآيَاتِنَا إِلَّا كُلُّ خَتَّارٍ كَفُورٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa idhā ghashiyathum mawjah ka-al-dhulal da'aw Allah mukhliṣīn lahu al-dīn fa lammā najjāhum ilā al-barr fa minhummuqtasid wa mā yajhad bi-āyātinā illā kull khattār kafūr
versets.francais: Et quand une vague les couvre comme des ombres, ils invoquent Allah, Lui vouant sincèrement leur culte. Puis quand Il les a sauvés vers la terre ferme, il en est parmi eux qui tiennent le juste milieu. Mais nul ne renie Nos signes, sauf tout traître infidèle.
versets.anglais: Do you not see that ships sail through the sea by the favor of Allah that He may show you of His signs? Indeed in that are signs for everyone patient and grateful

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اتَّقُوا رَبَّكُمْ وَاخْشَوْا يَوْمًا لَا يَجْزِي وَالِدٌ عَنْ وَلَدِهِ وَلَا مَوْلُودٌ هُوَ جَازٍ عَنْ وَالِدِهِ شَيْئًا ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عِنْدَهُ عِلْمُ السَّاعَةِ وَيُنَزِّلُ الْغَيْثَ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا فِي الْأَرْحَامِ ۚ وَمَا تَدْرِي نَفْسٌ مَاذَا تَكْسِبُ غَدًا ۚ وَمَا تَدْرِي نَفْسٌ بِأَيِّ أَرْضٍ تَمُوتُ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ خَبِيرٌ
versets.phonetique: Yā ayyuhā al-nās ittaqū rabbakum wa khshaw yawman lā yajzī wālidun 'an walidihi wa lā mawlūd huwa jāzin 'an wālidhihi shay'an inna Allah 'indahu 'ilm al-sā'ah wa yunazzil al-ghayth wa ya'lam mā fi al-arhām wa mā tadrī nafs mādhā taksibu ghadan wa mā tadrī nafs bi-ayy ardh tamūt inna Allah 'alīm khabīr
versets.francais: Ô vous les gens ! Craignez votre Seigneur et redoutez un jour où nul père ne pourra compenser pour son fils, ni nul fils ne pourra compenser pour son père, en quoi que ce soit. La promesse d'Allah est vérité. Que la vie présente ne vous abuse point ; que le Séducteur ne vous séduise point au sujet d'Allah.
versets.anglais: And when waves come over them like canopies, they supplicate Allah, sincere to Him in religion. But when He delivers them to the land, there are [some] of them who are moderate [in faith]. And none rejects Our signs except everyone treacherous and ungrateful

versets.arabe: إِنَّ اللَّهَ عِنْدَهُ عِلْمُ السَّاعَةِ وَيُنَزِّلُ الْغَيْثَ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا فِي الْأَرْحَامِ ۚ وَمَا تَدْرِي نَفْسٌ مَاذَا تَكْسِبُ غَدًا ۚ وَمَا تَدْرِي نَفْسٌ بِأَيِّ أَرْضٍ تَمُوتُ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ خَبِيرٌ
versets.phonetique: Inna Allah 'indahu 'ilm al-sā'ah wa yunazzil al-ghayth wa ya'lam mā fi al-arhām wa mā tadrī nafs mādhā taksibu ghadan wa mā tadrī nafs bi-ayy ardh tamūt inna Allah 'alīm khabīr
versets.francais: Certes, c'est auprès d'Allah qu'est la connaissance de l'Heure. C'est Lui qui fait descendre la pluie, et Il sait ce qui est dans les matrices. Aucune âme ne sait ce qu'elle acquerra demain, et aucune âme ne sait en quelle terre elle mourra. Allah est certes Omniscient et Bien Informé.
versets.anglais: O mankind, fear your Lord and fear a Day when no father will avail his son, nor will a son avail his father at all. Indeed, the promise of Allah is truth, so let not the worldly life delude you and be not deceived about Allah by the Deceiver

versets.arabe: إِنَّ اللَّهَ عِنْدَهُ عِلْمُ السَّاعَةِ وَيُنَزِّلُ الْغَيْثَ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا فِي الْأَرْحَامِ ۚ وَمَا تَدْرِي نَفْسٌ مَاذَا تَكْسِبُ غَدًا ۚ وَمَا تَدْرِي نَفْسٌ بِأَيِّ أَرْضٍ تَمُوتُ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ خَبِيرٌ
versets.phonetique: Inna Allah 'indahu 'ilm al-sā'ah wa yunazzil al-ghayth wa ya'lam mā fi al-arhām wa mā tadrī nafs mādhā taksibu ghadan wa mā tadrī nafs bi-ayy ardh tamūt inna Allah 'alīm khabīr
versets.francais: Certes, c'est auprès d'Allah qu'est la connaissance de l'Heure. C'est Lui qui fait descendre la pluie, et Il sait ce qui est dans les matrices. Aucune âme ne sait ce qu'elle acquerra demain, et aucune âme ne sait en quelle terre elle mourra. Allah est certes Omniscient et Bien Informé.
versets.anglais: Indeed, Allah [alone] has knowledge of the Hour and sends down the rain and knows what is in the wombs. And no soul perceives what it will earn tomorrow, and no soul perceives in what land it will die. Indeed, Allah is Knowing and Acquainted

versets.arabe: الم
versets.phonetique: Alif-Lam-Mim
versets.francais: Alif, Lam, Mim
versets.anglais: Alif, Lam, Meem

versets.arabe: تَنزِيلُ الْكِتَابِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ مِن رَّبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Tanzilu l-kitabi la rayba fihi min rabbi l-alamin
versets.francais: La révélation du Livre, sans aucun doute, vient du Seigneur des mondes
versets.anglais: [This is] the revelation of the Book about which there is no doubt from the Lord of the worlds

versets.arabe: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ افْتَرَاهُ بَلْ هُوَ الْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكَ لِتُنذِرَ قَوْمًا مَّا أَتَاهُم مِّن نَّذِيرٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ
versets.phonetique: Am yaquluna ftarahu bal huwa l-haqqu min rabbika litundhira qawman ma atahum min nadhirin min qablika la-allahum yahtadun
versets.francais: Disent-ils qu-il l-a inventé ? Non, c-est la vérité venant de ton Seigneur pour avertir un peuple à qui nul avertisseur n-était venu avant toi
versets.anglais: Or do they say, "He invented it"? Rather, it is the truth from your Lord, [O Muhammad], that you may warn a people to whom no warner has come before you [so] perhaps they will be guided

versets.arabe: اللَّهُ الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ اسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى الْعَرْشِ
versets.phonetique: Allahu lladhi khalaqa s-samawati wa l-arda wa ma baynahuma fi sittati ayyamin thumma stawa ala l-arsh
versets.francais: Allah est Celui qui a créé les cieux, la terre et ce qui est entre eux en six jours, puis Il S-est établi sur le Trône
versets.anglais: It is Allah who created the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them in six days; then He established Himself above the Throne. You have not besides Him any protector or any intercessor; so will you not be reminded

versets.arabe: يُدَبِّرُ الْأَمْرَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ إِلَى الْأَرْضِ ثُمَّ يَعْرُجُ إِلَيْهِ فِي يَوْمٍ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ مِّمَّا تَعُدُّونَ
versets.phonetique: Yudabbiru l-amra mina s-sama-i ila l-ardi thumma ya-ruju ilayhi fi yawmin kana miqdharuhu alfa sanatin mimma ta-uddun
versets.francais: Il dirige l-ordre du ciel vers la terre, puis il remonte vers Lui en un jour dont la durée est de mille ans selon votre compte
versets.anglais: He arranges [each] matter from the heaven to the earth; then it will ascend to Him in a Day, the extent of which is a thousand years of those which you count

versets.arabe: ذَٰلِكَ عَالِمُ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ
versets.phonetique: Dhalika alimu l-ghaybi wa sh-shahadati l-azizu r-rahim
versets.francais: C-est Lui le Connaisseur de l-invisible et du visible, le Puissant, le Très Miséricordieux
versets.anglais: That is the Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Exalted in Might, the Merciful

versets.arabe: الَّذِي أَحْسَنَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ خَلَقَهُ وَبَدَأَ خَلْقَ الْإِنسَانِ مِن طِينٍ
versets.phonetique: Alladhi ahsana kulla shay-in khalaqahu wa bada-a khalqa l-insani min tin
versets.francais: Celui qui a fait de tout ce qu-Il a créé quelque chose d-excellent, et qui a commencé la création de l-homme à partir de l-argile
versets.anglais: Who perfected everything which He created and began the creation of man from clay

versets.arabe: ثُمَّ جَعَلَ نَسْلَهُ مِن سُلَالَةٍ مِّن مَّاءٍ مَّهِينٍ
versets.phonetique: Thumma ja-ala naslahu min sulalatin min ma-in mahin
versets.francais: Puis Il a fait sa descendance d-un extrait d-une eau vile
versets.anglais: Then He made his posterity out of the extract of a liquid disdained

versets.arabe: ثُمَّ سَوَّاهُ وَنَفَخَ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِهِ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ السَّمْعَ وَالْأَبْصَارَ وَالْأَفْئِدَةَ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Thumma sawwahu wa nafakha fihi min ruhihi wa ja-ala lakumu s-sam-a wa l-absara wa l-af-idata qalilan ma tashkurun
versets.francais: Puis Il l-a modélé et lui a insufflé de Son esprit. Il vous a donné l-ouïe, les yeux et les coeurs. Mais vous êtes peu reconnaissants
versets.anglais: Then He proportioned him and breathed into him from His [created] soul and made for you hearing and vision and hearts; little are you grateful

versets.arabe: وَقَالُوا أَئِذَا ضَلَلْنَا فِي الْأَرْضِ أَئِنَّا لَفِي خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ بَلْ هُم بِلِقَاءِ رَبِّهِمْ كَافِرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa qalu a-idha dhalalna fi l-ardi a-inna lafi khalqin jadid bal hum biliqa-i rabbihim kafirun
versets.francais: Et ils disent : Quand nous aurons disparu dans la terre, serons-nous dans une nouvelle création ? Non, ils ne croient pas à la rencontre de leur Seigneur
versets.anglais: And they say, "When we are lost within the earth, will we indeed be [recreated] in a new creation?" Rather, they are, in [the matter of] the meeting with their Lord, disbelievers

versets.arabe: قُلْ يَتَوَفَّاكُم مَّلَكُ الْمَوْتِ الَّذِي وُكِّلَ بِكُمْ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمْ تُرْجَعُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qul yatawaffakum malaku l-mawti lladhi wukkila bikum thumma ila rabbikum turja-un
versets.francais: Dis : L-ange de la mort qui est chargé de vous vous recueillera, puis vous serez ramenés vers votre Seigneur
versets.anglais: Say, "The angel of death will take you who has been entrusted with you. Then to your Lord you will be returned

versets.arabe: وَلَوْ تَرَىٰ إِذِ الْمُجْرِمُونَ نَاكِسُو رُءُوسِهِمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ رَبَّنَا أَبْصَرْنَا وَسَمِعْنَا فَارْجِعْنَا نَعْمَلْ صَالِحًا إِنَّا مُوقِنُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa law tara idhi l-mujrimuna nakisu ru-usihim inda rabbihim rabbana absarna wa sami-na farji-na na-mal salihan inna muqinun
versets.francais: Si tu voyais les coupables baisser la tête devant leur Seigneur en disant : Seigneur, nous avons vu et entendu. Fais-nous revenir pour que nous fassions de bonnes oeuvres, car nous sommes convaincus
versets.anglais: If you could but see when the criminals are hanging their heads before their Lord, [saying], "Our Lord, we have seen and heard, so return us [to the world]; we will work righteousness. Indeed, we are [now] certain

versets.arabe: وَلَوْ شِئْنَا لَآتَيْنَا كُلَّ نَفْسٍ هُدَاهَا وَلَٰكِنْ حَقَّ الْقَوْلُ مِنِّي لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa law shi-na la-atayna kulla nafsin hudaha wa lakin haqqa l-qawlu minni la-amla-anna jahannama mina l-jinnati wa n-nasi ajma-in
versets.francais: Si Nous l-avions voulu, Nous aurions donné à chaque âme sa guidée. Mais la parole de Ma part est vraie : Je remplirai l-Enfer de djinns et d-hommes tous ensemble
versets.anglais: And if We had willed, We could have given every soul its guidance, but the word from Me will come into effect [that] "I will surely fill Hell with jinn and people all together

versets.arabe: فَذُوقُوا بِمَا نَسِيتُمْ لِقَاءَ يَوْمِكُمْ هَٰذَا إِنَّا نَسِينَاكُمْ وَذُوقُوا عَذَابَ الْخُلْدِ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Fadhuwqu bima nasitum liqa-a yawmikum hadha inna nasinakum wa dhuwqu adhaba l-khuldi bima kuntum ta-malun
versets.francais: Goûtez donc à cause de l-oubli de ce jour. Nous vous avons aussi oubliés. Goûtez le châtiment éternel pour ce que vous faisiez
versets.anglais: So taste [punishment] because you forgot the meeting of this, your Day; indeed, We have [accordingly] forgotten you. And taste the punishment of eternity for what you used to do

versets.arabe: إِنَّمَا يُؤْمِنُ بِآيَاتِنَا الَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِّرُوا بِهَا خَرُّوا سُجَّدًا وَسَبَّحُوا بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ وَهُمْ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Innama yu-minu bi-ayatina lladhina idha dhukkiru biha kharru sujjadan wa sabbahu bihamdi rabbihim wa hum la yastakbirun
versets.francais: Seuls croient en Nos signes ceux qui, lorsqu-on les leur rappelle, se prosternent et glorifient leur Seigneur avec louange sans s-enorgueillir
versets.anglais: Only those believe in Our verses who, when they are reminded by them, fall down in prostration and exalt [Allah] with praise of their Lord, and they are not arrogant

versets.arabe: تَتَجَافَىٰ جُنُوبُهُمْ عَنِ الْمَضَاجِعِ يَدْعُونَ رَبَّهُمْ خَوْفًا وَطَمَعًا وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَاهُمْ يُنفِقُونَ
versets.phonetique: Tatajafa junubuhum ani l-madaji-i yad-una rabbahum khawfan wa tama-an wa mimma razaqnahum yunfiqun
versets.francais: Leurs flancs se soulèvent des couches pour invoquer leur Seigneur avec crainte et espoir, et ils dépensent de ce que Nous leur avons accordé
versets.anglais: They arise from [their] beds; they supplicate their Lord in fear and aspiration, and from what We have provided them, they spend

versets.arabe: فَلَا تَعْلَمُ نَفْسٌ مَّا أُخْفِيَ لَهُم مِّن قُرَّةِ أَعْيُنٍ جَزَاءً بِمَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Fala ta-lamu nafsun ma ukhfiya lahum min qurrati a-yunin jaza-an bima kanu ya-malun
versets.francais: Nulle âme ne sait ce qui leur est réservé comme joie des yeux, en récompense de ce qu-ils oeuvrent
versets.anglais: And no soul knows what has been hidden for them of comfort for eyes as reward for what they used to do

versets.arabe: أَفَمَن كَانَ مُؤْمِنًا كَمَن كَانَ فَاسِقًا لَّا يَسْتَوُونَ
versets.phonetique: Afaman kana mu-minan kaman kana fasiqan la yastawun
versets.francais: Le croyant est-il donc comme le pervers ? Ils ne sont pas égaux
versets.anglais: Then is one who was a believer like one who was defiantly disobedient? They are not equal

versets.arabe: أَمَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ فَلَهُمْ جَنَّاتُ الْمَأْوَىٰ نُزُلًا بِمَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Amma lladhina amanu wa amilu s-salihati falahum jannatu l-ma-wa nuzulan bima kanu ya-malun
versets.francais: Ceux qui ont cru et accompli les bonnes oeuvres auront les jardins du refuge comme demeure, en récompense de ce qu-ils faisaient
versets.anglais: As for those who believed and did righteous deeds, for them will be the Gardens of Refuge as accommodation for what they used to do

versets.arabe: وَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ فَسَقُوا فَمَأْوَاهُمُ النَّارُ كُلَّمَا أَرَادُوا أَن يَخْرُجُوا مِنْهَا أُعِيدُوا فِيهَا
versets.phonetique: Wa amma lladhina fasaqu fama-wahumu n-naru kullama aradu an yakhruju minha u-idu fiha
versets.francais: Quant aux pervers, leur refuge sera le Feu. Chaque fois qu-ils voudront en sortir, ils y seront ramenés
versets.anglais: But as for those who defiantly disobeyed, their refuge is the Fire. Every time they wish to emerge from it, they will be returned to it while it is said to them, "Taste the punishment of the Fire which you used to deny

versets.arabe: وَلَنُذِيقَنَّهُم مِّنَ الْعَذَابِ الْأَدْنَىٰ دُونَ الْعَذَابِ الْأَكْبَرِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa lanudhhiqannahum mina l-adhabi l-adna duna l-adhabi l-akbari la-allahum yarji-un
versets.francais: Nous leur ferons goûter le châtiment proche avant le grand châtiment, afin qu-ils reviennent
versets.anglais: And we will surely let them taste the nearer punishment short of the greater punishment that perhaps they will repent

versets.arabe: وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّن ذُكِّرَ بِآيَاتِ رَبِّهِ ثُمَّ أَعْرَضَ عَنْهَا إِنَّا مِنَ الْمُجْرِمِينَ مُنتَقِمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa man azlamu mimman dukkira bi-ayati rabbihi thumma a-rada anha inna mina l-mujrimina muntaqimun
versets.francais: Qui est plus injuste que celui à qui on rappelle les signes de son Seigneur et qui s-en détourne ? Nous nous vengeons des criminels
versets.anglais: And who is more unjust than one who is reminded of the verses of his Lord; then he turns away from them? Indeed We, from the criminals, will take retribution

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا مُوسَى الْكِتَابَ فَلَا تَكُن فِي مِرْيَةٍ مِّن لِّقَائِهِ وَجَعَلْنَاهُ هُدًى لِّبَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ
versets.phonetique: Wa laqad atayna musa l-kitaba fala takun fi miryatin min liqa-ihi wa ja-alnahu hudan libani isra-il
versets.francais: Nous avons donné à Moïse le Livre. Ne sois pas dans le doute quant à sa rencontre. Et Nous en avons fait une guidée pour les Enfants d-Israël
versets.anglais: And We certainly gave Moses the Scripture, so do not be in doubt over his meeting. And we made the Torah guidance for the Children of Israel

versets.arabe: وَجَعَلْنَا مِنْهُمْ أَئِمَّةً يَهْدُونَ بِأَمْرِنَا لَمَّا صَبَرُوا وَكَانُوا بِآيَاتِنَا يُوقِنُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa ja-alna minhum a-immatan yahduna bi-amrina lamma sabaru wa kanu bi-ayatina yuqinun
versets.francais: Nous avons désigné parmi eux des dirigeants qui guident selon Notre ordre, parce qu-ils étaient patients et convaincus de Nos signes
versets.anglais: And We made from among them leaders guiding by Our command when they were patient and [when] they were certain of Our signs

versets.arabe: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَفْصِلُ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فِيمَا كَانُوا فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ
versets.phonetique: Inna rabbaka huwa yafṣilu baynahum yawma l-qiyamati fima kanu fihi yakhtalifun
versets.francais: C-est ton Seigneur qui tranchera entre eux au Jour de la Résurrection sur ce en quoi ils divergeaient
versets.anglais: Indeed, your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ

versets.arabe: أَوَلَمْ يَهْدِ لَهُمْ كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّنَ الْقُرُونِ يَمْشُونَ فِي مَسَاكِنِهِمْ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَاتٍ أَفَلَا يَسْمَعُونَ
versets.phonetique: Awa lam yahdi lahum kam ahlaknna min qablihim mina l-quruni yamshuna fi masakinihim inna fi dhalika la-ayatin afala yasma-un
versets.francais: N-est-ce pas un guide pour eux de voir combien de générations Nous avons détruites avant eux et dans les demeures desquelles ils marchent ? Il y a là des signes. N-écoutent-ils pas
versets.anglais: Has it not become clear to them how many generations We destroyed before them, [as] they walk among their dwellings? Indeed in that are signs; then do they not hear

versets.arabe: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا أَنَّا نَسُوقُ الْمَاءَ إِلَى الْأَرْضِ الْجُرُزِ فَنُخْرِجُ بِهِ زَرْعًا تَأْكُلُ مِنْهُ أَنْعَامُهُمْ وَأَنفُسُهُمْ أَفَلَا يُبْصِرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Awa lam yaraw anna nasuqu l-ma-a ila l-ardi l-jurzi fanukhriju bihi zar-an ta-kulu minhu an-amuhum wa anfusuhum afala yubsirun
versets.francais: N-ont-ils pas vu que Nous conduisons l-eau vers la terre desséchée et en faisons sortir une végétation dont mangent leurs troupeaux et eux-mêmes ? Ne voient-ils pas
versets.anglais: Have they not seen that We drive the water [in clouds] to barren land and bring forth thereby crops from which their livestock eat and [they] themselves? Then do they not see

versets.arabe: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا الْفَتْحُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَادِقِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa yaquluna mata hadha l-fathu in kuntum sadiqin
versets.francais: Ils disent : Quand viendra cette décision si vous êtes véridiques
versets.anglais: And they say, "When will be this conquest, if you should be truthful

versets.arabe: قُلْ يَوْمَ الْفَتْحِ لَا يَنفَعُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا إِيمَانُهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنظَرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qul yawma l-fathi la yanfa-u lladhina kafaru imanuhum wa la hum yunzarun
versets.francais: Dis : Au jour de la décision, la foi des mécréants ne leur sera d-aucune utilité et ils n-auront aucun délai
versets.anglais: Say, [O Muhammad], "On the Day of Conquest the belief of those who had disbelieved will not benefit them, nor will they be reprieved

versets.arabe: فَأَعْرِضْ عَنْهُمْ وَانتَظِرْ إِنَّهُم مُّنتَظِرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Fa-a-rid anhum wa ntazir innahum muntazirun
versets.francais: Détourne-toi d-eux et attends. Ils attendent aussi
versets.anglais: So turn away from them and wait. Indeed, they are waiting

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ اتَّقِ اللَّهَ وَلَا تُطِعِ الْكَافِرِينَ وَالْمُنَافِقِينَ ۗ إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا
versets.phonetique: Yaa ayyuhan-nabiyyut-taqillaaha wa laa tuti'il-kaafireena wal-munaafiqeen, innallaaha kaana 'aleeman hakeemaa
versets.francais: Ô Prophète ! Crains Allah et n'obéis pas aux mécréants et aux hypocrites. Allah est certes Omniscient et Sage
versets.anglais: O Prophet, fear Allah and do not obey the disbelievers and the hypocrites. Indeed, Allah is ever Knowing and Wise

versets.arabe: وَاتَّبِعْ مَا يُوحَىٰ إِلَيْكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرًا
versets.phonetique: Wattabi' maa yoohaa ilayka mir-rabbik, innallaaha kaana bimaa ta'maloona khabeera
versets.francais: Et suis ce qui t'est révélé de la part de ton Seigneur. Allah est certes Bien Informé de ce que vous faites
versets.anglais: And follow that which is revealed to you from your Lord. Indeed Allah is ever, with what you do, Acquainted

versets.arabe: وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ ۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِاللَّهِ وَكِيلًا
versets.phonetique: Wa tawakkal 'alallaah, wa kafaa billaahi wakeelaa
versets.francais: Et place ta confiance en Allah. Allah suffit comme Protecteur
versets.anglais: And rely upon Allah; and sufficient is Allah as Disposer of affairs

versets.arabe: مَّا جَعَلَ اللَّهُ لِرَجُلٍ مِّن قَلْبَيْنِ فِي جَوْفِهِ
versets.phonetique: Maa ja'alallaahu lirajulim-min qalbayni fee jawfih
versets.francais: Allah n'a pas mis deux cœurs à l'intérieur d'un homme
versets.anglais: Allah has not made for a man two hearts in his interior. And He has not made your wives whom you declare unlawful your mothers. And he has not made your adopted sons your [true] sons. That is [merely] your saying by your mouths, but Allah says the truth, and He guides to the [right] way

versets.arabe: ادْعُوهُمْ لِآبَائِهِمْ هُوَ أَقْسَطُ عِندَ اللَّهِ
versets.phonetique: Ud'oohum li-aabaa'ihim huwa aqsatu 'indallaah
versets.francais: Appelez-les du nom de leurs pères, c'est plus juste auprès d'Allah
versets.anglais: Call them by [the names of] their fathers; it is more just in the sight of Allah. But if you do not know their fathers - then they are [still] your brothers in religion and those entrusted to you. And there is no blame upon you for that in which you have erred but [only for] what your hearts intended. And ever is Allah Forgiving and Merciful

versets.arabe: النَّبِيُّ أَوْلَىٰ بِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ مِنْ أَنفُسِهِمْ ۖ وَأَزْوَاجُهُ أُمَّهَاتُهُمْ
versets.phonetique: An-nabiyyu awlaa bil-mu'mineena min anfusihim, wa azwaajuhoo ummahaatuhum
versets.francais: Le Prophète a plus de droits sur les croyants qu'ils n'en ont sur eux-mêmes, et ses épouses sont leurs mères
versets.anglais: The Prophet is more worthy of the believers than themselves, and his wives are [in the position of] their mothers. And those of [blood] relationship are more entitled [to inheritance] in the decree of Allah than the [other] believers and the emigrants, except that you may do to your close associates a kindness [through bequest]. That was in the Book inscribed

versets.arabe: وَإِذْ أَخَذْنَا مِنَ النَّبِيِّينَ مِيثَاقَهُمْ وَمِنكَ وَمِن نُّوحٍ وَإِبْرَاهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ وَعِيسَى ابْنِ مَرْيَمَ
versets.phonetique: Wa idh akhadhnaa minan-nabiyyeena meethaaqahum wa minka wa min noohin wa ibraaheema wa moosaa wa 'eesabni maryam
versets.francais: Et [rappelle] quand Nous prîmes des prophètes leur engagement solennel — de toi, de Noé, d'Abraham, de Moïse et de Jésus fils de Marie
versets.anglais: And [mention, O Muhammad], when We took from the prophets their covenant and from you and from Noah and Abraham and Moses and Jesus, the son of Mary; and We took from them a solemn covenant

versets.arabe: لِيَسْأَلَ الصَّادِقِينَ عَن صِدْقِهِمْ ۚ وَأَعَدَّ لِلْكَافِرِينَ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا
versets.phonetique: Liyasalassdiqeena 'an sidqihim, wa a'adda lil-kaafireena 'adhaaban aleemaa
versets.francais: Pour interroger les véridiques sur leur véracité. Et Il a préparé pour les mécréants un douloureux châtiment
versets.anglais: That He may question the truthful about their truth. And He has prepared for the disbelievers a painful punishment

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اذْكُرُوا نِعْمَةَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ إِذْ جَاءَتْكُمْ جُنُودٌ
versets.phonetique: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanudh-kuroo ni'matallaahi 'alaykum idh jaa'atkum junood
versets.francais: Ô croyants ! Rappelez-vous le bienfait d'Allah sur vous quand des armées sont venues contre vous
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, remember the favor of Allah upon you when armies came to [attack] you and We sent upon them a wind and armies [of angels] you did not see. And ever is Allah, of what you do, Seeing

versets.arabe: إِذْ جَاءُوكُم مِّن فَوْقِكُمْ وَمِنْ أَسْفَلَ مِنكُمْ وَإِذْ زَاغَتِ الْأَبْصَارُ وَبَلَغَتِ الْقُلُوبُ الْحَنَاجِرَ
versets.phonetique: Idh jaa'ookum min fawqikum wa min asfala minkum wa idh zaaghatil-absaaru wa balaghatil-quloobul-hanaajir
versets.francais: Quand ils vous vinrent par dessus et par dessous, quand les regards se troublèrent et les cœurs montèrent aux gorges
versets.anglais: [Remember] when they came at you from above you and from below you, and when eyes shifted [in fear], and hearts reached the throats and you assumed about Allah [various] assumptions

versets.arabe: هُنَالِكَ ابْتُلِيَ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ وَزُلْزِلُوا زِلْزَالًا شَدِيدًا
versets.phonetique: Hunaalika-btuliyal-mu'minoona wa zulziloo zilzaalan shadeedaa
versets.francais: Là, les croyants furent mis à l'épreuve et secoués d'une violente secousse
versets.anglais: There the believers were tested and shaken with a severe shaking

versets.arabe: وَإِذْ يَقُولُ الْمُنَافِقُونَ وَالَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ مَّا وَعَدَنَا اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ إِلَّا غُرُورًا
versets.phonetique: Wa idh yaqoolul-munaafiqoona walladheena fee quloobihim maradun maa wa'adanallaahu wa rasooluhoo illaa ghurooraa
versets.francais: Et quand les hypocrites et ceux qui ont la maladie au cœur disaient : "Allah et Son messager ne nous ont promis que tromperie"
versets.anglais: And [remember] when the hypocrites and those in whose hearts is disease said, "Allah and His Messenger did not promise us except delusion

versets.arabe: وَإِذْ قَالَت طَّائِفَةٌ مِّنْهُمْ يَا أَهْلَ يَثْرِبَ لَا مُقَامَ لَكُمْ فَارْجِعُوا
versets.phonetique: Wa idh qaalat taa'ifatum-minhum yaa ahla yathriba laa muqaama lakum farji'oo
versets.francais: Et quand une faction d'entre eux dit : "Ô gens de Yathrib, vous ne pouvez pas tenir ! Revenez !"
versets.anglais: And when a faction of them said, "O people of Yathrib, there is no stability for you [here], so return [home]." And a party of them asked permission of the Prophet, saying, "Indeed, our houses are unprotected," while they were not exposed. They did not intend except to flee

versets.arabe: وَلَوْ دُخِلَتْ عَلَيْهِم مِّنْ أَقْطَارِهَا ثُمَّ سُئِلُوا الْفِتْنَةَ لَآتَوْهَا
versets.phonetique: Wa law dukhilat 'alayhim min aqtaarihaa thumma su'ilul-fitnata la-aatawha
versets.francais: Si on avait pénétré contre eux de toutes parts et qu'on leur eût demandé de renier leur foi, ils l'auraient fait
versets.anglais: And if they had been entered upon from all its [surrounding] regions and fitnah had been demanded of them, they would have done it and not hesitated over it except briefly

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ كَانُوا عَاهَدُوا اللَّهَ مِن قَبْلُ لَا يُوَلُّونَ الْأَدْبَارَ
versets.phonetique: Wa laqad kaanoo 'aahadullaaha min qablu laa yuwalloonad-dubur
versets.francais: Pourtant ils avaient conclu avec Allah un pacte de ne pas tourner le dos
versets.anglais: And they had already promised Allah before not to turn their backs and flee. And ever is the promise to Allah [that about which one will be] questioned

versets.arabe: قُل لَّن يَنفَعَكُمُ الْفِرَارُ إِن فَرَرْتُم مِّنَ الْمَوْتِ أَوِ الْقَتْلِ
versets.phonetique: Qul lan yanfa'akumul-firaaru in farartum minal-mawti awil-qatl
versets.francais: Dis : "La fuite ne vous profitera pas si vous fuyez devant la mort ou le meurtre"
versets.anglais: Say, [O Muhammad], "Never will fleeing benefit you if you should flee from death or killing; and then [if you did], you would not be given enjoyment [of life] except for a little

versets.arabe: قُلْ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَعْصِمُكُم مِّنَ اللَّهِ إِن أَرَادَ بِكُمْ سُوءًا أَوْ أَرَادَ بِكُمْ رَحْمَةً
versets.phonetique: Qul man dhal-ladhee ya'simukum minallaaahi in araada bikum soo'an aw araada bikum rahmah
versets.francais: Dis : "Qui vous protégera d'Allah s'Il vous veut du mal ou vous veut Sa miséricorde ?"
versets.anglais: Say, "Who is it that can protect you from Allah if He intends for you an ill or intends for you a mercy?" And they will not find for themselves besides Allah any protector or any helper

versets.arabe: قَدْ يَعْلَمُ اللَّهُ الْمُعَوِّقِينَ مِنكُمْ وَالْقَائِلِينَ لِإِخْوَانِهِمْ هَلُمَّ إِلَيْنَا
versets.phonetique: Qad ya'lamullaahul-mu'awwiqeena minkum wal-qaa'ileena li-ikhwaanihim hallumma ilaynaa
versets.francais: Allah connaît ceux d'entre vous qui découragent les autres et qui disent à leurs frères : "Venez à nous !"
versets.anglais: Already Allah knows the hinderers among you and those [hypocrites] who say to their brothers, "Come to us," and do not go to battle, except for a few

versets.arabe: أَشِحَّةً عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ فَإِذَا جَاءَ الْخَوْفُ رَأَيْتَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَيْكَ تَدُورُ أَعْيُنُهُمْ كَالَّذِي يُغْشَىٰ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الْمَوْتِ
versets.phonetique: Ashihhatan 'alaykum, fa-idha jaa'al-khawfu ra'aytahum yanzuroona ilayka tadooru a'yunuhum kal-ladhee yughshaa 'alayhi minal-mawt
versets.francais: Ils sont avares envers vous. Quand la peur vient, tu les vois regarder vers toi, leurs yeux roulant comme celui qui est saisi par la mort
versets.anglais: Indisposed toward you. And when fear comes, you see them looking at you, their eyes revolving like one being overcome by death. But when fear departs, they lash you with sharp tongues, indisposed toward [any] good. Those have not believed, so Allah has rendered their deeds worthless, and ever is that, for Allah, easy

versets.arabe: يَحْسَبُونَ الْأَحْزَابَ لَمْ يَذْهَبُوا ۖ وَإِن يَأْتِ الْأَحْزَابُ يَوَدُّوا لَوْ أَنَّهُم بَادُونَ فِي الْأَعْرَابِ
versets.phonetique: Yahsabooonal-ahzaaba lam yadh-haboo, wa in ya'til-ahzaabu yawaddoo law annahum baadoona fil-a'raab
versets.francais: Ils croient que les coalisés ne sont pas partis. Et si les coalisés revenaient, ils voudraient être dans le désert parmi les Bédouins
versets.anglais: They think the companies have not [yet] withdrawn. And if the companies should come [again], they would wish they were in the desert among the bedouins, inquiring [from afar] about your news. And if they should be among you, they would not fight except for a little

versets.arabe: لَّقَدْ كَانَ لَكُمْ فِي رَسُولِ اللَّهِ أُسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ
versets.phonetique: Laqad kaana lakum fee rasoolillaahi uswatun hasanah
versets.francais: Vous avez certes dans le Messager d'Allah un excellent modèle
versets.anglais: There has certainly been for you in the Messenger of Allah an excellent pattern for anyone whose hope is in Allah and the Last Day and [who] remembers Allah often

versets.arabe: وَلَمَّا رَأَى الْمُؤْمِنُونَ الْأَحْزَابَ قَالُوا هَٰذَا مَا وَعَدَنَا اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ وَصَدَقَ اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
versets.phonetique: Wa lammaa ra'al-mu'minooonal-ahzaaba qaaloo hadhaa maa wa'adanaallaahu wa rasooluhoo wa sadaqallaahu wa rasooluh
versets.francais: Quand les croyants virent les coalisés, ils dirent : "C'est ce qu'Allah et Son messager nous ont promis, et Allah et Son messager ont dit vrai"
versets.anglais: And when the believers saw the companies, they said, "This is what Allah and His Messenger had promised us, and Allah and His Messenger spoke the truth." And it increased them only in faith and acceptance

versets.arabe: مِّنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ رِجَالٌ صَدَقُوا مَا عَاهَدُوا اللَّهَ عَلَيْهِ
versets.phonetique: Minal-mu'mineena rijaalun sadaqoo maa 'aahadul-laaha 'alayh
versets.francais: Parmi les croyants se trouvent des hommes qui ont tenu leur pacte avec Allah
versets.anglais: Among the believers are men true to what they promised Allah. Among them is he who has fulfilled his vow [to the death], and among them is he who awaits [his chance]. And they did not alter [the terms of their commitment] by any alteration

versets.arabe: لِيَجْزِيَ اللَّهُ الصَّادِقِينَ بِصِدْقِهِمْ وَيُعَذِّبَ الْمُنَافِقِينَ إِن شَاءَ أَوْ يَتُوبَ عَلَيْهِمْ
versets.phonetique: Liyajziyallaahus-saadiqeena bisidqihim wa yu'adhdhibal-munaafiqeena in shaa'a aw yatooba 'alayhim
versets.francais: Pour qu'Allah récompense les véridiques pour leur véracité, et châtie les hypocrites s'Il veut, ou accepte leur repentir
versets.anglais: That Allah may reward the truthful for their truth and punish the hypocrites if He wills or accept their repentance. Indeed, Allah is ever Forgiving and Merciful

versets.arabe: وَرَدَّ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا بِغَيْظِهِمْ لَمْ يَنَالُوا خَيْرًا
versets.phonetique: Wa raddal-laahul-ladheena kafaroo bighayzihim lam yanaaloo khayraa
versets.francais: Et Allah a repoussé les mécréants avec leur rage, sans qu'ils aient rien obtenu de bon
versets.anglais: And Allah repelled those who disbelieved, in their rage, not having obtained any good. And sufficient was Allah for the believers in battle, and ever is Allah Powerful and Exalted in Might

versets.arabe: وَأَنزَلَ الَّذِينَ ظَاهَرُوهُم مِّنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ مِن صَيَاصِيهِمْ
versets.phonetique: Wa anzalal-ladheena zaaharoo hum min ahlil-kitaabi min sayaaseehim
versets.francais: Et Il fit descendre de leurs forteresses ceux des gens du Livre qui les avaient aidés
versets.anglais: And He brought down those who supported them among the People of the Scripture from their fortresses and cast terror into their hearts [so that] a party you killed, and you took captive a party

versets.arabe: وَأَوْرَثَكُمْ أَرْضَهُمْ وَدِيَارَهُمْ وَأَمْوَالَهُمْ وَأَرْضًا لَّمْ تَطَئُوهَا
versets.phonetique: Wa awrathakoum ardahum wa diyaarahum wa amwaalahum wa ardan lam tataoohaa
versets.francais: Et Il vous a donné en héritage leur terre, leurs demeures, leurs biens et une terre que vous n'aviez pas encore foulée
versets.anglais: And He caused you to inherit their land and their homes and their properties and a land which you have not trodden. And ever is Allah, over all things, competent

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ قُل لِّأَزْوَاجِكَ إِن كُنتُنَّ تُرِدْنَ الْحَيَاةَ الدُّنْيَا وَزِينَتَهَا
versets.phonetique: Yaa ayyuhan-nabiyyu qul li-azwaajika in kuntunna turidnal-hayaatad-dunyaa wa zeenaatahaa
versets.francais: Ô Prophète ! Dis à tes épouses : "Si vous désirez la vie présente et ses atours..."
versets.anglais: O Prophet, say to your wives, "If you should desire the worldly life and its adornment, then come, I will provide for you and give you a gracious release

versets.arabe: وَإِن كُنتُنَّ تُرِدْنَ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَالدَّارَ الْآخِرَةَ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ أَعَدَّ لِلْمُحْسِنَاتِ مِنكُنَّ أَجْرًا عَظِيمًا
versets.phonetique: Wa in kuntunna turidnallaaha wa rasoolahu wad-daarul-aakhirata fa-innallaaha a'adda lil-muhsinaati minkunna ajran 'azeemaa
versets.francais: Mais si vous voulez Allah, Son messager et la demeure de l'au-delà, Allah a préparé pour les bonnes d'entre vous une immense récompense
versets.anglais: But if you should desire Allah and His Messenger and the home of the Hereafter - then indeed, Allah has prepared for the doers of good among you a great reward

versets.arabe: يَا نِسَاءَ النَّبِيِّ مَن يَأْتِ مِنكُنَّ بِفَاحِشَةٍ مُّبَيِّنَةٍ يُضَاعَفْ لَهَا الْعَذَابُ ضِعْفَيْنِ
versets.phonetique: Yaa nisaa'an-nabiyyi man ya'ti minkunna bifaahishatin mubayyinatin yuda'af lahal-'adhabu di'fayn
versets.francais: Ô femmes du Prophète ! Celle d'entre vous qui commet une turpitude avérée, son châtiment sera doublé au double
versets.anglais: O wives of the Prophet, whoever of you should commit a clear immorality - for her the punishment would be doubled two fold, and ever is that, for Allah, easy

versets.arabe: وَمَن يَقْنُتْ مِنكُنَّ لِلَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَتَعْمَلْ صَالِحًا نُّؤْتِهَا أَجْرَهَا مَرَّتَيْنِ
versets.phonetique: Wa man yaqnut minkunna lillaahi wa rasoolihee wa ta'mal saalihan nu'tihaa ajrahaa marratayni
versets.francais: Et celle d'entre vous qui obéit à Allah et à Son messager et fait le bien, Nous lui donnerons sa récompense deux fois
versets.anglais: And whoever of you devoutly obeys Allah and His Messenger and does righteousness - We will give her her reward twice; and We have prepared for her a noble provision

versets.arabe: يَا نِسَاءَ النَّبِيِّ لَسْتُنَّ كَأَحَدٍ مِّنَ النِّسَاءِ ۚ إِنِ اتَّقَيْتُنَّ
versets.phonetique: Yaa nisaa'an-nabiyyi lastunna ka-ahadin minan-nisaa'i init-taqaytunna
versets.francais: Ô femmes du Prophète ! Vous n'êtes comme aucune autre femme, si vous êtes pieuses
versets.anglais: O wives of the Prophet, you are not like anyone among women. If you fear Allah, then do not be soft in speech [to men], lest he in whose heart is disease should covet, but speak with appropriate speech

versets.arabe: وَقَرْنَ فِي بُيُوتِكُنَّ وَلَا تَبَرَّجْنَ تَبَرُّجَ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ الْأُولَىٰ
versets.phonetique: Wa qarna fee buyootikunna wa laa tabarrajna tabarrujaljaahiliyyatil-oolaa
versets.francais: Et restez dans vos maisons et ne vous exhibez pas comme s'exhibaient les femmes de la Jâhiliyya passée
versets.anglais: And abide in your houses and do not display yourselves as [was] the display of the former times of ignorance. And establish prayer and give zakah and obey Allah and His Messenger. Allah intends only to remove from you the impurity [of sin], O people of the [Prophet's] household, and to purify you with [extensive] purification

versets.arabe: وَاذْكُرْنَ مَا يُتْلَىٰ فِي بُيُوتِكُنَّ مِنْ آيَاتِ اللَّهِ وَالْحِكْمَةِ
versets.phonetique: Wadhkurna maa yutlaa fee buyootikunna min aayaatillaahi wal-hikmah
versets.francais: Et rappelez-vous ce qui est récité dans vos demeures des versets d'Allah et de la sagesse
versets.anglais: And remember what is recited in your houses of the verses of Allah and wisdom. Indeed, Allah is ever Subtle and Acquainted [with all things]

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الْمُسْلِمِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمَاتِ وَالْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ
versets.phonetique: Innal-muslimeena wal-muslimaati wal-mu'mineena wal-mu'minaat
versets.francais: Certes, les musulmans et les musulmanes, les croyants et les croyantes...
versets.anglais: Indeed, the Muslim men and Muslim women, the believing men and believing women, the obedient men and obedient women, the truthful men and truthful women, the patient men and patient women, the humble men and humble women, the charitable men and charitable women, the fasting men and fasting women, the men who guard their private parts and the women who do so, and the men who remember Allah often and the women who do so - for them Allah has prepared forgiveness and a great reward

versets.arabe: وَمَا كَانَ لِمُؤْمِنٍ وَلَا مُؤْمِنَةٍ إِذَا قَضَى اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَمْرًا أَن يَكُونَ لَهُمُ الْخِيَرَةُ مِنْ أَمْرِهِمْ
versets.phonetique: Wa maa kaana limu'minin wa laa mu'minatin idhaa qadaallaahu wa rasooluhoo amran an yakoona lahumul-khiyaratu min amrihim
versets.francais: Il n'appartient pas à un croyant ou à une croyante, une fois qu'Allah et Son messager ont décidé d'une chose, d'avoir encore le choix
versets.anglais: It is not for a believing man or a believing woman, when Allah and His Messenger have decided a matter, that they should [thereafter] have any choice about their affair. And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger has certainly strayed into clear error

versets.arabe: وَإِذْ تَقُولُ لِلَّذِي أَنْعَمَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَمْسِكْ عَلَيْكَ زَوْجَكَ وَاتَّقِ اللَّهَ
versets.phonetique: Wa idh taqoolu lilladhee an'amallaahu 'alayhi wa an'amta 'alayhi amsik 'alayka zawjaka wattaqillaah
versets.francais: Et quand tu disais à celui qu'Allah a comblé de bienfaits et que tu as toi-même comblé de bienfaits : "Garde ton épouse et crains Allah"
versets.anglais: And [remember, O Muhammad], when you said to the one on whom Allah bestowed favor and you bestowed favor, "Keep your wife and fear Allah," while you concealed within yourself that which Allah is to disclose. And you feared the people, while Allah has more right that you fear Him. So when Zayd had no longer any need for her, We married her to you in order that there not be upon the believers any discomfort concerning the wives of their adopted sons when they no longer have need of them. And ever is the command of Allah accomplished

versets.arabe: مَّا كَانَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ مِنْ حَرَجٍ فِيمَا فَرَضَ اللَّهُ لَهُ
versets.phonetique: Maa kaana 'alan-nabiyyi min harajin feemaa faradal-laahu lah
versets.francais: Le Prophète n'est pas en faute pour ce qu'Allah lui a prescrit
versets.anglais: There is not to be upon the Prophet any discomfort concerning that which Allah has imposed upon him. [This is] the established way of Allah with those [prophets] who have passed on before. And ever is the command of Allah a destiny decreed

versets.arabe: الَّذِينَ يُبَلِّغُونَ رِسَالَاتِ اللَّهِ وَيَخْشَوْنَهُ وَلَا يَخْشَوْنَ أَحَدًا إِلَّا اللَّهَ
versets.phonetique: Alladheena yuballighoona risaalaatillaahi wa yakhshawnahoo wa laa yakhshawna ahadan illallaah
versets.francais: Ceux qui transmettent les messages d'Allah, Le craignent et ne craignent personne d'autre qu'Allah
versets.anglais: [Allah praises] those who convey the messages of Allah and fear Him and do not fear anyone but Allah. And sufficient is Allah as Accountant

versets.arabe: مَّا كَانَ مُحَمَّدٌ أَبَا أَحَدٍ مِّن رِّجَالِكُمْ وَلَٰكِن رَّسُولَ اللَّهِ وَخَاتَمَ النَّبِيِّينَ
versets.phonetique: Maa kaana muhammadun abaa ahadin min rijaalikum wa laakin rasoolallaahi wa khaataman-nabiyyeen
versets.francais: Muhammad n'est pas le père d'un seul de vos hommes, mais le Messager d'Allah et le Sceau des prophètes
versets.anglais: Muhammad is not the father of [any] one of your men, but [he is] the Messenger of Allah and last of the prophets. And ever is Allah, of all things, Knowing

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اذْكُرُوا اللَّهَ ذِكْرًا كَثِيرًا
versets.phonetique: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanudh-kurullaaha dhikran katheeraa
versets.francais: Ô croyants ! Invoquez Allah fréquemment
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, remember Allah with much remembrance

versets.arabe: وَسَبِّحُوهُ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا
versets.phonetique: Wa sabbihoohu bukratan wa aseelaa
versets.francais: Et glorifiez-Le matin et soir
versets.anglais: And exalt Him morning and afternoon

versets.arabe: هُوَ الَّذِي يُصَلِّي عَلَيْكُمْ وَمَلَائِكَتُهُ لِيُخْرِجَكُم مِّنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النُّورِ
versets.phonetique: Huwal-ladhee yusallee 'alaykum wa malaa'ikatuhoo liyukhrijakum minaz-zulumaati ilan-noor
versets.francais: C'est Lui qui vous bénit, ainsi que Ses anges, pour vous faire sortir des ténèbres vers la lumière
versets.anglais: It is He who confers blessing upon you, and His angels [ask Him to do so] that He may bring you out from darknesses into the light. And ever is He, to the believers, Merciful

versets.arabe: تَحِيَّتُهُمْ يَوْمَ يَلْقَوْنَهُ سَلَامٌ ۚ وَأَعَدَّ لَهُمْ أَجْرًا كَرِيمًا
versets.phonetique: Tahiyyatuhum yawma yalqawnahoo salaam, wa a'adda lahum ajran kareemaa
versets.francais: Leur salut le Jour où ils Le rencontreront sera : "Paix !" Et Il leur a préparé une généreuse récompense
versets.anglais: Their greeting the Day they meet Him will be, "Peace." And He has prepared for them a noble reward

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ شَاهِدًا وَمُبَشِّرًا وَنَذِيرًا
versets.phonetique: Yaa ayyuhan-nabiyyu innaa arsalnaaka shaahidan wa mubashshiran wa nadheeraa
versets.francais: Ô Prophète ! Nous t'avons envoyé comme témoin, annonciateur et avertisseur
versets.anglais: O Prophet, indeed We have sent you as a witness and a bringer of good tidings and a warner

versets.arabe: وَدَاعِيًا إِلَى اللَّهِ بِإِذْنِهِ وَسِرَاجًا مُّنِيرًا
versets.phonetique: Wa daa'iyan ilallaahi bi-idhnihi wa siraajan muneeraa
versets.francais: Appelant à Allah par Sa permission et comme un flambeau lumineux
versets.anglais: And one who invites to Allah, by His permission, and an illuminating lamp

versets.arabe: وَبَشِّرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ بِأَنَّ لَهُم مِّنَ اللَّهِ فَضْلًا كَبِيرًا
versets.phonetique: Wa bashshiril-mu'mineena bi-anna lahum minallaahi fadlan kabeeraa
versets.francais: Et annonce aux croyants qu'ils auront d'Allah une grande grâce
versets.anglais: And give good tidings to the believers that they will have from Allah great bounty

versets.arabe: وَلَا تُطِعِ الْكَافِرِينَ وَالْمُنَافِقِينَ وَدَعْ أَذَاهُمْ وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ
versets.phonetique: Wa laa tuti'il-kaafireena wal-munaafiqeena wa da' adhaahum wa tawakkal 'alallaah
versets.francais: N'obéis pas aux mécréants et aux hypocrites, ignore leur tort et place ta confiance en Allah
versets.anglais: And do not obey the disbelievers and the hypocrites but do not harm them, and rely upon Allah. And sufficient is Allah as Disposer of affairs

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِذَا نَكَحْتُمُ الْمُؤْمِنَاتِ ثُمَّ طَلَّقْتُمُوهُنَّ مِن قَبْلِ أَن تَمَسُّوهُنَّ
versets.phonetique: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo idhaa nakahtumul-mu'minaati thumma tallaqtumoohunna min qabli an tamassoohunna
versets.francais: Ô croyants ! Quand vous épousez des croyantes puis que vous les répudiez avant de les avoir touchées
versets.anglais: O You who have believed, when you marry believing women and then divorce them before you have touched them, then there is not for you any waiting period to count concerning them. So provide for them and give them a gracious release

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ إِنَّا أَحْلَلْنَا لَكَ أَزْوَاجَكَ اللَّاتِي آتَيْتَ أُجُورَهُنَّ
versets.phonetique: Yaa ayyuhan-nabiyyu innaa ahlalnaa laka azwaajakal-laateee aatayta ujoorahunna
versets.francais: Ô Prophète ! Nous t'avons rendu licites tes épouses à qui tu as donné leurs dots
versets.anglais: O Prophet, indeed We have made lawful to you your wives to whom you have given their due compensation and those your right hand possesses from what Allah has returned to you [of captives] and the daughters of your paternal uncles and the daughters of your paternal aunts and the daughters of your maternal uncles and the daughters of your maternal aunts who emigrated with you and a believing woman if she gives herself to the Prophet [and] if the Prophet wishes to marry her, [this is] only for you, excluding the [other] believers. We certainly know what We have made obligatory upon them concerning their wives and those their right hands possess, [but this is for you] in order that there will be upon you no discomfort. And ever is Allah Forgiving and Merciful

versets.arabe: تُرْجِي مَن تَشَاءُ مِنْهُنَّ وَتُؤْوِي إِلَيْكَ مَن تَشَاءُ
versets.phonetique: Turjee man tashaa'u minhunna wa tu'wee ilayka man tashaa'
versets.francais: Tu peux remettre à plus tard celle que tu veux parmi elles et recevoir celle que tu veux
versets.anglais: You, [O Muhammad], may put aside whom you will of them or take to yourself whom you will. And any that you desire of those [wives] from whom you had [temporarily] separated - there is no blame upon you [in returning her]. That is more suitable that they should be content and not grieve and that they should be satisfied with what you have given them - all of them. And Allah knows what is in your hearts. And ever is Allah Knowing and Forbearing

versets.arabe: لَّا يَحِلُّ لَكَ النِّسَاءُ مِن بَعْدُ وَلَا أَن تَبَدَّلَ بِهِنَّ مِنْ أَزْوَاجٍ
versets.phonetique: Laa yahillu lakan-nisaa'u min ba'du wa laa an tabaddala bihinna min azwaaj
versets.francais: Il ne t'est plus permis d'autres femmes après cela ni de les échanger contre d'autres épouses
versets.anglais: Not lawful to you, [O Muhammad], are [any additional] women after [this], nor [is it] for you to exchange them for [other] wives, even if their beauty were to please you, except what your right hand possesses. And ever is Allah, over all things, an Observer

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تَدْخُلُوا بُيُوتَ النَّبِيِّ إِلَّا أَن يُؤْذَنَ لَكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa tadkhuloo buyootan-nabiyyi illaa an yu'dhana lakum
versets.francais: Ô croyants ! N'entrez pas dans les maisons du Prophète à moins qu'on ne vous y invite
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, do not enter the houses of the Prophet except when you are permitted for a meal, without awaiting its readiness. But when you are invited, then enter; and when you have eaten, disperse without seeking to remain for conversation. Indeed, that [behavior] was troubling the Prophet, and he is shy of [dismissing] you. But Allah is not shy of the truth. And when you ask [his wives] for something, ask them from behind a partition. That is purer for your hearts and their hearts. And it is not [conceivable or lawful] for you to harm the Messenger of Allah or to marry his wives after him, ever. Indeed, that would be in the sight of Allah an enormity

versets.arabe: إِن تُبْدُوا شَيْئًا أَوْ تُخْفُوهُ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمًا
versets.phonetique: In tubdoo shay'an aw tukhfoohu fa-innallaaha kaana bikulli shay'in 'aleemaa
versets.francais: Que vous divulguiez quelque chose ou le cachiez, Allah est certes Omniscient
versets.anglais: Whether you reveal a thing or conceal it, indeed Allah is ever, of all things, Knowing

versets.arabe: لَّا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْهِنَّ فِي آبَائِهِنَّ وَلَا أَبْنَائِهِنَّ وَلَا إِخْوَانِهِنَّ
versets.phonetique: Laa junaaha 'alayhinna fee aabaa'ihinna wa laa abnaaa'ihinna wa laa ikhwaanihinn
versets.francais: Il n'y a pas de faute pour elles [à se montrer] devant leurs pères, leurs fils et leurs frères
versets.anglais: There is no blame upon women concerning their fathers or their sons or their brothers or their brothers' sons or their sisters' sons or their women or those their right hands possess. And fear Allah. Indeed Allah is ever, over all things, Witness

versets.arabe: إِنَّ اللَّهَ وَمَلَائِكَتَهُ يُصَلُّونَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ ۚ يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا صَلُّوا عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمُوا تَسْلِيمًا
