versets.arabe: قَالُوا مَا أَنتُمْ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا وَمَا أَنزَلَ الرَّحْمَٰنُ مِن شَيْءٍ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا تَكْذِبُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qalu ma antum illa basharun mithluna wa ma anzala r-rahmanu min shay-in in antum illa takdhibun
versets.francais: Ils dirent : Vous n-êtes que des humains comme nous. Le Tout Miséricordieux n-a rien fait descendre. Vous ne faites que mentir
versets.anglais: They said, "You are not but human beings like us, and the Most Merciful has not revealed a thing. You are only telling lies

versets.arabe: قَالُوا رَبُّنَا يَعْلَمُ إِنَّا إِلَيْكُمْ لَمُرْسَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qalu rabbuna ya-lamu inna ilaykum lamursalun
versets.francais: Ils dirent : Notre Seigneur sait que nous vous sommes vraiment envoyés
versets.anglais: They said, "Our Lord knows that we are messengers to you

versets.arabe: وَمَا عَلَيْنَا إِلَّا الْبَلَاغُ الْمُبِينُ
versets.phonetique: Wa ma alayna illa l-balaghu l-mubin
versets.francais: Et nous n-avons pour mission que de vous transmettre clairement le message
versets.anglais: And we are not responsible except for clear notification

versets.arabe: قَالُوا إِنَّا تَطَيَّرْنَا بِكُمْ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهُوا لَنَرْجُمَنَّكُمْ وَلَيَمَسَّنَّكُم مِّنَّا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Qalu inna tatayarna bikum la-in lam tantahu lanarjumannakum wa layamassannakum minna adhabun alim
versets.francais: Ils dirent : Nous voyons en vous un mauvais présage. Si vous ne cessez pas, nous vous lapiderons et un châtiment douloureux vous atteindra de notre part
versets.anglais: They said, "Indeed, we consider you a bad omen. If you do not desist, we will surely stone you, and there will surely touch you, from us, a painful punishment

versets.arabe: قَالُوا طَائِرُكُم مَّعَكُمْ أَئِن ذُكِّرْتُم بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌ مُّسْرِفُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qalu ta-irukum ma-akum a-in dhukkirtum bal antum qawmun musrifun
versets.francais: Ils dirent : Votre présage est en vous-mêmes. N-est-ce pas parce qu-on vous a rappelé à l-ordre ? Vous êtes plutôt un peuple outrancier
versets.anglais: They said, "Your omen is with yourselves. Is it because you were reminded? Rather, you are a transgressing people

versets.arabe: وَجَاءَ مِنْ أَقْصَى الْمَدِينَةِ رَجُلٌ يَسْعَىٰ قَالَ يَا قَوْمِ اتَّبِعُوا الْمُرْسَلِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa ja-a min aqsa l-madinati rajulun yas-a qala ya qawmi ttabi-u l-mursalin
versets.francais: Et il vint du bout de la ville un homme en courant. Il dit : O mon peuple, suivez les messagers
versets.anglais: And there came from the farthest end of the city a man, running. He said, "O my people, follow the messengers

versets.arabe: اتَّبِعُوا مَن لَّا يَسْأَلُكُمْ أَجْرًا وَهُم مُّهْتَدُونَ
versets.phonetique: Ittabi-u man la yas-alukum ajran wa hum muhtadun
versets.francais: Suivez ceux qui ne vous demandent aucune rétribution et qui sont bien guidés
versets.anglais: Follow those who do not ask of you [any] payment, and they are [rightly] guided

versets.arabe: وَمَا لِيَ لَا أَعْبُدُ الَّذِي فَطَرَنِي وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa ma liya la a-budu lladhi fatarani wa ilayhi turja-un
versets.francais: Pourquoi ne adorerais-je pas Celui qui m-a créé et vers qui vous serez ramenés
versets.anglais: And why should I not worship He who created me and to whom you will be returned

versets.arabe: أَأَتَّخِذُ مِن دُونِهِ آلِهَةً إِن يُرِدْنِ الرَّحْمَٰنُ بِضُرٍّ لَّا تُغْنِ عَنِّي شَفَاعَتُهُمْ شَيْئًا وَلَا يُنقِذُونِ
versets.phonetique: A-attakhidhu min dunihi alihatan in yuridni r-rahmanu bidurrin la tughni anni shafa-atuhum shay-an wa la yunqidhun
versets.francais: Prendrais-je en dehors de Lui des divinités ? Si le Tout Miséricordieux me voulait du mal, leur intercession ne me servirait à rien et ils ne me sauveraient pas
versets.anglais: Should I take other than Him [false] deities [while], if the Most Merciful intends for me some adversity, their intercession will not avail me at all, nor can they save me

versets.arabe: إِنِّي إِذًا لَّفِي ضَلَالٍ مُّبِينٍ
versets.phonetique: Inni idhan lafi dalalin mubin
versets.francais: Je serais alors dans un égarement manifeste
versets.anglais: Indeed, I would then be in manifest error

versets.arabe: إِنِّي آمَنتُ بِرَبِّكُمْ فَاسْمَعُونِ
versets.phonetique: Inni amantu birabbikum fasma-un
versets.francais: Je crois en votre Seigneur. Écoutez-moi donc
versets.anglais: Indeed, I have believed in your Lord, so listen to me

versets.arabe: قِيلَ ادْخُلِ الْجَنَّةَ قَالَ يَا لَيْتَ قَوْمِي يَعْلَمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qila dkhuli l-jannata qala ya layta qawmi ya-lamun
versets.francais: Il lui fut dit : Entre au Paradis. Il dit : Si seulement mon peuple savait
versets.anglais: It was said, "Enter Paradise." He said, "I wish my people could know

versets.arabe: بِمَا غَفَرَ لِي رَبِّي وَجَعَلَنِي مِنَ الْمُكْرَمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Bima ghafara li rabbi wa ja-alani mina l-mukramin
versets.francais: Ce que mon Seigneur m-a pardonné et qu-Il m-a mis au rang des honorés
versets.anglais: Of how my Lord has forgiven me and placed me among the honored

versets.arabe: وَمَا أَنزَلْنَا عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِ مِن بَعْدِهِ مِن جُندٍ مِّنَ السَّمَاءِ وَمَا كُنَّا مُنزِلِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa ma anzalna ala qawmihi min ba-dihi min jundin mina s-sama-i wa ma kunna munzilin
versets.francais: Et Nous n-avons fait descendre sur son peuple après lui aucune armée venue du ciel, et Nous n-avions pas à en faire descendre
versets.anglais: And We did not send down upon his people after him any soldiers from the heaven, nor would We have done so

versets.arabe: إِن كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَاحِدَةً فَإِذَا هُمْ خَامِدُونَ
versets.phonetique: In kanat illa sayhatan wahidatan fa-idha hum khamidun
versets.francais: Ce ne fut qu-un seul cri, et les voilà éteints
versets.anglais: It was not but one shout, and immediately they were extinguished

versets.arabe: يَا حَسْرَةً عَلَى الْعِبَادِ مَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِئُونَ
versets.phonetique: Ya hasratan ala l-ibadi ma ya-tihim min rasulin illa kanu bihi yastahzi-un
versets.francais: Quel malheur pour les serviteurs ! Il ne leur vient pas de messager sans qu-ils se moquent de lui
versets.anglais: How regretful for the servants. There did not come to them any messenger except that they used to ridicule him

versets.arabe: أَلَمْ يَرَوْا كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّنَ الْقُرُونِ أَنَّهُمْ إِلَيْهِمْ لَا يَرْجِعُونَ
versets.phonetique: Alam yaraw kam ahlaknna qablahum mina l-quruni annahum ilayhim la yarji-un
versets.francais: N-ont-ils pas vu combien de générations Nous avons anéanties avant eux, et qu-ils ne retournent pas vers elles
versets.anglais: Have they not considered how many generations We destroyed before them - that they to them will not return

versets.arabe: وَإِن كُلٌّ لَّمَّا جَمِيعٌ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa in kullun lamma jami-un ladayna muhdarun
versets.francais: Et ils seront tous réunis devant Nous
versets.anglais: And indeed, all of them will yet be brought present before Us

versets.arabe: وَآيَةٌ لَّهُمُ الْأَرْضُ الْمَيْتَةُ أَحْيَيْنَاهَا وَأَخْرَجْنَا مِنْهَا حَبًّا فَمِنْهُ يَأْكُلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa ayatun lahumu l-ardu l-maytatu ahyaynahha wa akhrajna minha habban faminhu ya-kulun
versets.francais: La terre morte est un signe pour eux : Nous la revivifions et Nous en faisons sortir des grains dont ils se nourrissent
versets.anglais: And a sign for them is the dead earth. We have brought it to life and brought forth from it grain, and from it they eat

versets.arabe: وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا جَنَّاتٍ مِّن نَّخِيلٍ وَأَعْنَابٍ وَفَجَّرْنَا فِيهَا مِنَ الْعُيُونِ
versets.phonetique: Wa ja-alna fiha jannatin min nakhilin wa a-nabin wa fajjarna fiha mina l-uyun
versets.francais: Et Nous y avons mis des jardins de palmiers et de vignes, et Nous y avons fait jaillir des sources
versets.anglais: And We placed therein gardens of palm trees and grapevines and caused to burst forth therefrom some springs

versets.arabe: لِيَأْكُلُوا مِن ثَمَرِهِ وَمَا عَمِلَتْهُ أَيْدِيهِمْ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Liya-kulu min thamarihi wa ma amilathu aydihim afala yashkurun
versets.francais: Afin qu-ils mangent de ses fruits, sans que leurs mains les aient fabriqués. Ne seront-ils pas reconnaissants
versets.anglais: That they may eat of His fruit. And their hands have not produced it, so will they not be grateful

versets.arabe: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ الْأَزْوَاجَ كُلَّهَا مِمَّا تُنبِتُ الْأَرْضُ وَمِنْ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَمِمَّا لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Subhana lladhi khalaqa l-azwaja kullaha mimma tunbitu l-ardu wa min anfusihim wa mimma la ya-lamun
versets.francais: Gloire à Celui qui a créé toutes les espèces de ce que la terre fait pousser, et d-eux-mêmes, et de ce qu-ils ne connaissent pas
versets.anglais: Exalted is He who created all pairs - from what the earth grows and from themselves and from that which they do not know

versets.arabe: وَآيَةٌ لَّهُمُ اللَّيْلُ نَسْلَخُ مِنْهُ النَّهَارَ فَإِذَا هُم مُّظْلِمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa ayatun lahumu l-laylu naslakhu minhu n-nahara fa-idha hum mudhlimun
versets.francais: La nuit est un signe pour eux : Nous en retirons le jour, et les voilà plongés dans l-obscurité
versets.anglais: And a sign for them is the night. We remove from it [the light of] day, so they are [left] in darkness

versets.arabe: وَالشَّمْسُ تَجْرِي لِمُسْتَقَرٍّ لَّهَا ذَٰلِكَ تَقْدِيرُ الْعَزِيزِ الْعَلِيمِ
versets.phonetique: Wa sh-shamsu tajri limustaqarrin laha dhalika taqdiru l-azizi l-alim
versets.francais: Et le soleil court vers son lieu de repos. C-est là la détermination du Puissant, du Savant
versets.anglais: And the sun runs [on course] toward its stopping point. That is the determination of the Exalted in Might, the Knowing

versets.arabe: وَالْقَمَرَ قَدَّرْنَاهُ مَنَازِلَ حَتَّىٰ عَادَ كَالْعُرْجُونِ الْقَدِيمِ
versets.phonetique: Wa l-qamara qaddarnahu manazila hatta ada kal-urjuni l-qadim
versets.francais: Et la lune, Nous lui avons assigné des phases jusqu-à ce qu-elle redevienne comme une vieille branche de palmier
versets.anglais: And the moon - We have determined for it phases, until it returns [appearing] like the old date stalk

versets.arabe: لَا الشَّمْسُ يَنبَغِي لَهَا أَن تُدْرِكَ الْقَمَرَ وَلَا اللَّيْلُ سَابِقُ النَّهَارِ وَكُلٌّ فِي فَلَكٍ يَسْبَحُونَ
versets.phonetique: La sh-shamsu yanbaghhi laha an tudrika l-qamara wa la l-laylu sabiqu n-nahari wa kullun fi falakin yasbahun
versets.francais: Le soleil ne peut atteindre la lune, ni la nuit devancer le jour. Et chacun vogue dans une orbite
versets.anglais: It is not allowable for the sun to reach the moon, nor does the night overtake the day, but each, in an orbit, is swimming

versets.arabe: وَآيَةٌ لَّهُمْ أَنَّا حَمَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ فِي الْفُلْكِ الْمَشْحُونِ
versets.phonetique: Wa ayatun lahum anna hamalna dhurriyyatahum fi l-fulki l-mashhun
versets.francais: Et c-est un signe pour eux que Nous avons porté leur descendance dans le vaisseau chargé
versets.anglais: And a sign for them is that We carried their forefathers in a laden ship

versets.arabe: وَخَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّن مِّثْلِهِ مَا يَرْكَبُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa khalaqna lahum min mithlihi ma yarkabun
versets.francais: Et Nous avons créé pour eux de semblables à bord desquels ils montent
versets.anglais: And We created for them from the likes of it that which they ride

versets.arabe: وَإِن نَّشَأْ نُغْرِقْهُمْ فَلَا صَرِيخَ لَهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنقَذُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa in nasha-a nughríqhum fala sarikhha lahum wa la hum yunqadhun
versets.francais: Si Nous le voulions, Nous les noierions : personne ne viendrait à leur secours et ils ne seraient pas sauvés
versets.anglais: And if We should will, We could drown them; then no one responding to a cry would there be for them, nor would they be saved

versets.arabe: إِلَّا رَحْمَةً مِّنَّا وَمَتَاعًا إِلَىٰ حِينٍ
versets.phonetique: Illa rahmatan minna wa mata-an ila hin
versets.francais: Sauf par une miséricorde de Notre part et une jouissance jusqu-à un certain temps
versets.anglais: Except as a mercy from Us and provision for a time

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ اتَّقُوا مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَمَا خَلْفَكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa idha qila lahumu ttaqu ma bayna aydikum wa ma khalfakum la-allakum turhamun
versets.francais: Et quand on leur dit : Craignez ce qui est devant vous et derrière vous, afin qu-on vous fasse miséricorde
versets.anglais: But when it is said to them, "Beware of what is before you and what is behind you; perhaps you will receive mercy

versets.arabe: وَمَا تَأْتِيهِم مِّنْ آيَةٍ مِّنْ آيَاتِ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَّا كَانُوا عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa ma ta-tihim min ayatin min ayati rabbihim illa kanu anha mu-ridhin
versets.francais: Il ne vient aucun signe parmi les signes de leur Seigneur sans qu-ils s-en détournent
versets.anglais: And no sign comes to them from the signs of their Lord except that they are from it turning away

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ أَنفِقُوا مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ اللَّهُ قَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لِلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا أَنُطْعِمُ مَن لَّوْ يَشَاءُ اللَّهُ أَطْعَمَهُ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَالٍ مُّبِينٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa idha qila lahum anfiqu mimma razaqakumu l-lahu qala lladhina kafaru lilladhina amanu anut-imu man law yasha-u l-lahu at-amahu in antum illa fi dalalin mubin
versets.francais: Quand on leur dit : Dépensez de ce qu-Allah vous a accordé, les mécréants disent aux croyants : Allons-nous nourrir celui qu-Allah aurait pu nourrir s-Il l-avait voulu ? Vous n-êtes que dans un égarement manifeste
versets.anglais: And when it is said to them, "Spend from that which Allah has provided for you," those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Should we feed one whom, if Allah had willed, He would have fed? You are not but in clear error

versets.arabe: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا الْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَادِقِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa yaquluna mata hadha l-wa-du in kuntum sadiqin
versets.francais: Et ils disent : Quand sera réalisée cette promesse, si vous êtes véridiques
versets.anglais: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful

versets.arabe: مَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَاحِدَةً تَأْخُذُهُمْ وَهُمْ يَخِصِّمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Ma yanzuruna illa sayhatan wahidatan ta-khudhuhum wa hum yakhissimun
versets.francais: Ils n-attendent qu-un seul cri qui les saisira alors qu-ils sont en train de disputer
versets.anglais: They do not await except one blast which will seize them while they are disputing

versets.arabe: فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ تَوْصِيَةً وَلَا إِلَىٰ أَهْلِهِمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
versets.phonetique: Fala yastati-una tawsiyatan wa la ila ahlihim yarji-un
versets.francais: Ils ne pourront alors faire aucun testament et ils ne pourront pas retourner vers leurs familles
versets.anglais: And they will not be able [to give] any instruction, nor to their people can they return

versets.arabe: وَنُفِخَ فِي الصُّورِ فَإِذَا هُم مِّنَ الْأَجْدَاثِ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَنسِلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa nufikha fi s-suri fa-idha hum mina l-ajdathi ila rabbihim yansilun
versets.francais: Et l-on soufflera dans la Trompe, et les voilà qui, de leurs tombes, s-achemineront vers leur Seigneur
versets.anglais: And the Horn will be blown; and at once from the graves to their Lord they will hasten

versets.arabe: قَالُوا يَا وَيْلَنَا مَن بَعَثَنَا مِن مَّرْقَدِنَا هَٰذَا مَا وَعَدَ الرَّحْمَٰنُ وَصَدَقَ الْمُرْسَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qalu ya waylana man ba-athana min marqadina hadha ma wa-ada r-rahmanu wa sadaqa l-mursalun
versets.francais: Ils diront : Malheur à nous ! Qui nous a ressuscités de notre lieu de repos ? C-est ce que le Tout Miséricordieux avait promis et les messagers avaient dit vrai
versets.anglais: They will say, "O woe to us! Who has raised us up from our sleeping place?" [The reply will be], "This is what the Most Merciful had promised, and the messengers told the truth

versets.arabe: إِن كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَاحِدَةً فَإِذَا هُمْ جَمِيعٌ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ
versets.phonetique: In kanat illa sayhatan wahidatan fa-idha hum jami-un ladayna muhdarun
versets.francais: Ce ne sera qu-un seul cri, et les voilà tous réunis devant Nous
versets.anglais: It will not be but one blast, and at once they are all brought present before Us

versets.arabe: فَالْيَوْمَ لَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌ شَيْئًا وَلَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Fal-yawma la tuzlamu nafsun shay-an wa la tujzawna illa ma kuntum ta-malun
versets.francais: Aujourd-hui, nul ne sera lésé d-aucune manière, et vous ne serez rétribués que selon vos actes
versets.anglais: So today no soul will be wronged at all, and you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do

versets.arabe: إِنَّ أَصْحَابَ الْجَنَّةِ الْيَوْمَ فِي شُغُلٍ فَاكِهُونَ
versets.phonetique: Inna ashaba l-jannati l-yawma fi shughulin fakihun
versets.francais: Les gens du Paradis sont aujourd-hui dans une joyeuse occupation
versets.anglais: Indeed the companions of Paradise, that Day, will be amused in [joyful] occupation

versets.arabe: هُمْ وَأَزْوَاجُهُمْ فِي ظِلَالٍ عَلَى الْأَرَائِكِ مُتَّكِئُونَ
versets.phonetique: Hum wa azwajuhum fi dhilalin ala l-ara-iki muttaki-un
versets.francais: Eux et leurs épouses sont à l-ombre, accoudés sur des divans
versets.anglais: They and their spouses - in shade, reclining on adorned couches

versets.arabe: لَهُمْ فِيهَا فَاكِهَةٌ وَلَهُم مَّا يَدَّعُونَ
versets.phonetique: Lahum fiha fakihatun wa lahum ma yadda-un
versets.francais: Il y a là pour eux des fruits, et tout ce qu-ils désirent
versets.anglais: For them therein is fruit, and for them is whatever they request [or wish]

versets.arabe: سَلَامٌ قَوْلًا مِّن رَّبٍّ رَّحِيمٍ
versets.phonetique: Salamun qawlan min rabbin rahim
versets.francais: Paix ! telle est la parole d-un Seigneur Très Miséricordieux
versets.anglais: [And] "Peace," a word from a Merciful Lord

versets.arabe: وَامْتَازُوا الْيَوْمَ أَيُّهَا الْمُجْرِمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa mtazu l-yawma ayyuha l-mujrimun
versets.francais: Et ce jour-là : Écartez-vous, ô criminels
versets.anglais: [Then He will say], "But stand apart today, you criminals

versets.arabe: أَلَمْ أَعْهَدْ إِلَيْكُمْ يَا بَنِي آدَمَ أَن لَّا تَعْبُدُوا الشَّيْطَانَ إِنَّهُ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِينٌ
versets.phonetique: Alam a-had ilaykum ya bani adama an la ta-budu sh-shaytana innahu lakum aduwwun mubin
versets.francais: Ne vous avais-Je pas enjoint, ô fils d-Adam, de ne pas adorer le Diable qui est pour vous un ennemi déclaré
versets.anglais: Did I not enjoin upon you, O children of Adam, that you not worship Satan - [for] indeed, he is to you a clear enemy

versets.arabe: وَأَنِ اعْبُدُونِي هَٰذَا صِرَاطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa ani buduni hadha siratun mustaqim
versets.francais: Et d-adorer Moi ? C-est là le chemin droit
versets.anglais: And that you worship [only] Me? This is a straight path

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ أَضَلَّ مِنكُمْ جِبِلًّا كَثِيرًا أَفَلَمْ تَكُونُوا تَعْقِلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa laqad adalla minkum jibillan kathiran afalam takunu ta-qilun
versets.francais: Il a égaré parmi vous une multitude. N-aviez-vous donc pas de raison
versets.anglais: And he had already led astray from among you much of creation, so did you not use reason

versets.arabe: هَٰذِهِ جَهَنَّمُ الَّتِي كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ
versets.phonetique: Hadhihi jahannamu llati kuntum tu-adun
versets.francais: Voici l-Enfer qu-on vous promettait
versets.anglais: This is the Hellfire which you were promised

versets.arabe: اصْلَوْهَا الْيَوْمَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Islaw-ha l-yawma bima kuntum takfurun
versets.francais: Brûlez-y aujourd-hui pour avoir mécru
versets.anglais: [Enter to] burn therein today for what you used to deny

versets.arabe: الْيَوْمَ نَخْتِمُ عَلَىٰ أَفْوَاهِهِمْ وَتُكَلِّمُنَا أَيْدِيهِمْ وَتَشْهَدُ أَرْجُلُهُم بِمَا كَانُوا يَكْسِبُونَ
versets.phonetique: Al-yawma nakhtimu ala afwahihim wa tukallimuna aydihim wa tashhadu arjuluhum bima kanu yaksibun
versets.francais: Aujourd-hui Nous scellons leurs bouches. Leurs mains Nous parleront et leurs pieds témoigneront de ce qu-ils auront acquis
versets.anglais: That Day, We will seal over their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us, and their feet will testify about what they used to earn

versets.arabe: وَلَوْ نَشَاءُ لَطَمَسْنَا عَلَىٰ أَعْيُنِهِمْ فَاسْتَبَقُوا الصِّرَاطَ فَأَنَّىٰ يُبْصِرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa law nasha-u latamasna ala a-yunihim fastabaqus-sirata fa-anna yubsirun
versets.francais: Si Nous le voulions, Nous effacerions leurs yeux et ils courraient vers le chemin sans pouvoir voir
versets.anglais: And if We willed, We could have obliterated their eyes, and they would race to [find] the path, and how could they see

versets.arabe: وَلَوْ نَشَاءُ لَمَسَخْنَاهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِهِمْ فَمَا اسْتَطَاعُوا مُضِيًّا وَلَا يَرْجِعُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa law nasha-u lamasakhnahum ala makanatihim fama stata-u mudiyyan wa la yarji-un
versets.francais: Si Nous le voulions, Nous les transformerions sur place et ils ne pourraient ni avancer ni revenir
versets.anglais: And if We willed, We could have deformed them, [paralyzing them] in their places so they would not be able to proceed, nor could they return

versets.arabe: وَمَن نُّعَمِّرْهُ نُنَكِّسْهُ فِي الْخَلْقِ أَفَلَا يَعْقِلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa man nu-ammirhu nunakkishu fi l-khalqi afala ya-qilun
versets.francais: Celui que Nous faisons vieillir, Nous lui faisons décliner ses forces. Ne raisonneront-ils pas
versets.anglais: And he to whom We grant long life We reverse in creation; so will they not understand

versets.arabe: وَمَا عَلَّمْنَاهُ الشِّعْرَ وَمَا يَنبَغِي لَهُ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ وَقُرْآنٌ مُّبِينٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa ma allamnahu sh-shi-ra wa ma yanbaghhi lahu in huwa illa dhikrun wa quranun mubin
versets.francais: Nous ne lui avons pas appris la poésie, cela ne lui convient pas. Ce n-est qu-un Rappel et une Lecture claire
versets.anglais: And We did not give Prophet Muhammad, knowledge of poetry, nor is it befitting for him. It is not but a message and a clear Qur'an

versets.arabe: لِيُنذِرَ مَن كَانَ حَيًّا وَيَحِقَّ الْقَوْلُ عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Liyundhira man kana hayyan wa yahiqqa l-qawlu ala l-kafirin
versets.francais: Pour avertir celui qui est vivant, et que la parole soit avérée contre les mécréants
versets.anglais: To warn whoever is alive and justify the word against the disbelievers

versets.arabe: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا أَنَّا خَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّمَّا عَمِلَتْ أَيْدِينَا أَنْعَامًا فَهُمْ لَهَا مَالِكُونَ
versets.phonetique: Awa lam yaraw anna khalaqna lahum mimma amilat aydina an-aman fahum laha malikun
versets.francais: N-ont-ils pas vu que Nous avons créé pour eux, de ce que Nos mains ont fait, des bestiaux dont ils sont maîtres
versets.anglais: Do they not see that We have created for them from what Our hands have made, grazing livestock, and [then] they are their owners

versets.arabe: وَذَلَّلْنَاهَا لَهُمْ فَمِنْهَا رَكُوبُهُمْ وَمِنْهَا يَأْكُلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa dhallalnaha lahum faminaha rakubuhum wa minha ya-kulun
versets.francais: Et Nous les leur avons soumis : certains leur servent de montures et d-autres ils se nourrissent
versets.anglais: And We have tamed them for them, so some of them they ride, and some of them they eat

versets.arabe: وَلَهُمْ فِيهَا مَنَافِعُ وَمَشَارِبُ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa lahum fiha manafi-u wa masharib afala yashkurun
versets.francais: Et ils en tirent d-autres avantages et des boissons. Ne seront-ils pas reconnaissants
versets.anglais: And for them therein are [other] benefits and drinks, so will they not be grateful

versets.arabe: وَاتَّخَذُوا مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ آلِهَةً لَّعَلَّهُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa ttakhadhu min duni l-lahi alihatan la-allahum yunsarun
versets.francais: Et ils ont pris en dehors d-Allah des divinités, espérant être secourus
versets.anglais: But they have taken besides Allah [false] deities that perhaps they would be helped

versets.arabe: لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُمْ جُندٌ مُّحْضَرُونَ
versets.phonetique: La yastati-una nasrahum wa hum lahum jundun muhdarun
versets.francais: Ces divinités ne peuvent les secourir, alors qu-eux seront une armée à leur disposition
versets.anglais: They are not able to help them, and they [themselves] are for them soldiers in attendance

versets.arabe: فَلَا يَحْزُنكَ قَوْلُهُمْ إِنَّا نَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ
versets.phonetique: Fala yahzunka qawluhum inna na-lamu ma yusirruna wa ma yu-linun
versets.francais: Que leurs paroles ne t-attristent pas. Nous savons ce qu-ils cachent et ce qu-ils déclarent
versets.anglais: So let not their speech grieve you. Indeed, We know what they conceal and what they declare

versets.arabe: أَوَلَمْ يَرَ الْإِنسَانُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَاهُ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٌ مُّبِينٌ
versets.phonetique: Awa lam yara l-insanu anna khalaqnahu min nutfatin fa-idha huwa khasimun mubin
versets.francais: L-homme n-a-t-il pas vu que Nous l-avons créé d-une goutte de sperme ? Et le voilà qui conteste ouvertement
versets.anglais: Does man not consider that We created him from a [mere] sperm-drop - then at once he is a clear adversary

versets.arabe: وَضَرَبَ لَنَا مَثَلًا وَنَسِيَ خَلْقَهُ قَالَ مَن يُحْيِي الْعِظَامَ وَهِيَ رَمِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa daraba lana mathalan wa nasiya khalqahu qala man yuhyi l-ithama wa hiya ramim
versets.francais: Il Nous propose des comparaisons, et oublie sa propre création. Il dit : Qui donc redonnera vie aux ossements réduits en poussière
versets.anglais: And he presents for Us an example and forgets his [own] creation. He says, "Who will give life to bones while they are disintegrated

versets.arabe: قُلْ يُحْيِيهَا الَّذِي أَنشَأَهَا أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلْقٍ عَلِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Qul yuhyiha lladhi ansha-aha awwala marratin wa huwa bikulli khalqin alim
versets.francais: Dis : Celui qui les a créés la première fois les ranimera. Il est le Connaisseur de toute création
versets.anglais: Say, "He will give them life who produced them the first time; and He is, of all creation, Knowing

versets.arabe: الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ الشَّجَرِ الْأَخْضَرِ نَارًا فَإِذَا أَنتُم مِّنْهُ تُوقِدُونَ
versets.phonetique: Alladhi ja-ala lakum mina sh-shajari l-akhdhri naran fa-idha antum minhu tuqidun
versets.francais: Celui qui a tiré pour vous du feu du bois vert, et voilà que vous l-allumez
versets.anglais: [It is] He who made for you from the green tree, fire, and then from it you ignite

versets.arabe: أَوَلَيْسَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ بِقَادِرٍ عَلَىٰ أَن يَخْلُقَ مِثْلَهُمْ بَلَىٰ وَهُوَ الْخَلَّاقُ الْعَلِيمُ
versets.phonetique: Awa laysa lladhi khalaqa s-samawati wa l-arda biqadirin ala an yakhluqa mithlahum bala wa huwa l-khallaqul-alim
versets.francais: Celui qui a créé les cieux et la terre n-est-Il pas capable de créer leurs pareils ? Mais oui ! Il est le grand Créateur, l-Omniscient
versets.anglais: Is not He who created the heavens and the earth Able to create the likes of them? Yes, [it is so]; and He is the Knowing Creator

versets.arabe: إِنَّمَا أَمْرُهُ إِذَا أَرَادَ شَيْئًا أَن يَقُولَ لَهُ كُن فَيَكُونُ
versets.phonetique: Innama amruhu idha arada shay-an an yaqula lahu kun fayakun
versets.francais: Lorsqu-Il veut une chose, Son commandement consiste à dire : Sois, et c-est
versets.anglais: His command is only when He intends a thing that He says to it, "Be," and it is

versets.arabe: فَسُبْحَانَ الَّذِي بِيَدِهِ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
versets.phonetique: Fasub-hana lladhi biyadihi malakutu kulli shay-in wa ilayhi turja-un
versets.francais: Gloire à Celui en la main de Qui est la royauté de toute chose. Et c-est vers Lui que vous serez ramenés
versets.anglais: So exalted is He in whose hand is the realm of all things, and to Him you will be returned

sourates.signification: Ceux qui se mettent en rangs

versets.arabe: وَالصَّافَّاتِ صَفًّا
versets.phonetique: Was-sâffâti saffâ
versets.francais: Par ceux qui se mettent en rangs serrés,
versets.anglais: By those [angels] lined up in rows

versets.arabe: فَالزَّاجِرَاتِ زَجْرًا
versets.phonetique: Faz-zâjirâti zajrâ
versets.francais: et par ceux qui repoussent avec force,
versets.anglais: And those who drive [the clouds]

versets.arabe: فَالتَّالِيَاتِ ذِكْرًا
versets.phonetique: Fat-tâliyâti dhikrâ
versets.francais: et par ceux qui récitent le Rappel,
versets.anglais: And those who recite the message

versets.arabe: إِنَّ إِلَٰهَكُمْ لَوَاحِدٌ
versets.phonetique: Inna ilâhakum lawâhid
versets.francais: votre Dieu est certes Un,
versets.anglais: Indeed, your God is One

versets.arabe: رَّبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَرَبُّ الْمَشَارِقِ
versets.phonetique: Rabbus-samâwâti wal-ardi wa mâ baynahumâ wa rabbul-mashâriq
versets.francais: le Seigneur des cieux et de la terre et de ce qui est entre eux, et le Seigneur des Levants.
versets.anglais: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them and Lord of the sunrises

versets.arabe: إِنَّا زَيَّنَّا السَّمَاءَ الدُّنْيَا بِزِينَةٍ الْكَوَاكِبِ
versets.phonetique: Innâ zayyannâs-samâ'ad-dunyâ bizînatil-kawâkib
versets.francais: Nous avons orné le ciel le plus proche de l'ornement des étoiles,
versets.anglais: Indeed, We have adorned the nearest heaven with an adornment of stars

versets.arabe: وَحِفْظًا مِّن كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ مَّارِدٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa hifzan min kulli shaytânin mârid
versets.francais: et pour le garder contre tout diable rebelle.
versets.anglais: And as protection against every rebellious devil

versets.arabe: لَّا يَسَّمَّعُونَ إِلَى الْمَلَإِ الْأَعْلَىٰ وَيُقْذَفُونَ مِن كُلِّ جَانِبٍ
versets.phonetique: Lâ yassamma'ûna ilal-mala'il-a'lâ wa yuqdhafûna min kulli jânib
versets.francais: Ils ne peuvent écouter l'Assemblée Suprême; ils sont lancés de tous côtés,
versets.anglais: [So] they may not listen to the exalted assembly [of angels] and are pelted from every side

versets.arabe: دُحُورًا ۖ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ وَاصِبٌ
versets.phonetique: Duhûran wa lahum 'adhâbun wâsib
versets.francais: repoussés. Il y a pour eux un châtiment permanent.
versets.anglais: Repelled; and for them is a constant punishment

versets.arabe: إِلَّا مَنْ خَطِفَ الْخَطْفَةَ فَأَتْبَعَهُ شِهَابٌ ثَاقِبٌ
versets.phonetique: Illâ man khatifal-khatfata fa'atba'ahu shihâbun thâqib
versets.francais: Sauf celui qui dérobe furtivement quelque chose; une flamme perçante le poursuit alors.
versets.anglais: Except one who snatches [some words] by theft, but they are pursued by a burning flame, piercing [in brightness]

versets.arabe: فَاسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَهُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَم مَّنْ خَلَقْنَا ۚ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَاهُم مِّن طِينٍ لَّازِبٍ
versets.phonetique: Fastaftihim ahum ashaddu khalqan am man khalaqnâ, innâ khalaqnâhum min tînin lâzib
versets.francais: Demande-leur: sont-ils plus difficiles à créer que ce que Nous avons créé? Nous les avons créés d'une argile collante.
versets.anglais: Then inquire of them, [O Muhammad], "Are they a stronger [or more difficult] creation or those [others] We have created?" Indeed, We created men from sticky clay

versets.arabe: بَلْ عَجِبْتَ وَيَسْخَرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Bal 'ajibta wa yaskharûn
versets.francais: Tu t'en étonnes, mais eux se moquent.
versets.anglais: But you wonder, while they mock

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا ذُكِّرُوا لَا يَذْكُرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa idhâ dhukkrû lâ yadhkurûn
versets.francais: Et quand on les exhorte, ils ne se laissent pas exhorter.
versets.anglais: And when they are reminded, they remember not

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا رَأَوْا آيَةً يَسْتَسْخِرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa idhâ ra'aw âyatan yastaskhirûn
versets.francais: Et quand ils voient un signe, ils se moquent.
versets.anglais: And when they see a sign, they ridicule

versets.arabe: وَقَالُوا إِنْ هَٰذَا إِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa qâlû in hâdhâ illâ sihrun mubîn
versets.francais: Et ils disent: "Ce n'est là qu'une sorcellerie manifeste."
versets.anglais: And say, "This is not but obvious magic

versets.arabe: أَئِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَامًا أَئِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ
versets.phonetique: A'idhâ mitnâ wa kunnâ turâban wa 'izâman a'innâ lamab'ûthûn
versets.francais: "Quand nous serons morts et serons devenus poussière et ossements, serons-nous vraiment ressuscités?"
versets.anglais: When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected

versets.arabe: أَوَآبَاؤُنَا الْأَوَّلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Awa âbâ'unal-awwalûn
versets.francais: "Et aussi nos ancêtres premiers?"
versets.anglais: And our forefathers [as well]

versets.arabe: قُلْ نَعَمْ وَأَنتُمْ دَاخِرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qul na'am wa antum dâkhirûn
versets.francais: Dis: "Oui, et vous serez humiliés."
versets.anglais: Say, "Yes, and you will be [rendered] contemptible

versets.arabe: فَإِنَّمَا هِيَ زَجْرَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ فَإِذَا هُمْ يَنظُرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Fa innamâ hiya zajratun wâhidatun fa'idhâ hum yanzurûn
versets.francais: Ce ne sera qu'un seul cri, et les voilà qui regarderont.
versets.anglais: It will be only one shout, and at once they will be observing

versets.arabe: وَقَالُوا يَا وَيْلَنَا هَٰذَا يَوْمُ الدِّينِ
versets.phonetique: Wa qâlû yâ waylanâ hâdhâ yawmud-dîn
versets.francais: Ils diront: "Malheur à nous! C'est le Jour de la rétribution."
versets.anglais: They will say, "O woe to us! This is the Day of Recompense

versets.arabe: هَٰذَا يَوْمُ الْفَصْلِ الَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِ تُكَذِّبُونَ
versets.phonetique: Hâdhâ yawmul-faslil-ladhî kuntum bihi tukadhdhibûn
versets.francais: "C'est le Jour de la séparation que vous traitiez de mensonge."
versets.anglais: [They will be told], "This is the Day of Judgement which you used to deny

versets.arabe: احْشُرُوا الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا وَأَزْوَاجَهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوا يَعْبُدُونَ
versets.phonetique: Uhshurulladhîna zalamû wa azwâjahum wa mâ kânû ya'budûn
versets.francais: "Rassemblez les injustes, leurs semblables et ce qu'ils adoraient,
versets.anglais: [The angels will be ordered], "Gather those who committed wrong, their kinds, and what they used to worship

versets.arabe: مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ فَاهْدُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَاطِ الْجَحِيمِ
versets.phonetique: Min dûnillâhi fahdûhum ilâ sirâtil-jahîm
versets.francais: en dehors d'Allah, et guidez-les vers le chemin de l'Enfer.
versets.anglais: Other than Allah, and guide them to the path of Hellfire

versets.arabe: وَقِفُوهُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُم مَّسْئُولُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa qifûhum innahum mas'ûlûn
versets.francais: Et arrêtez-les, car ils seront interrogés."
versets.anglais: And stop them; indeed, they are to be questioned

versets.arabe: مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَنَاصَرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Mâ lakum lâ tanâsarûn
versets.francais: "Qu'avez-vous? Pourquoi ne vous entraidez-vous pas?"
versets.anglais: [They will be asked], "What is [wrong] with you? Why do you not help each other

versets.arabe: بَلْ هُمُ الْيَوْمَ مُسْتَسْلِمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Bal humul-yawma mustaslimûn
versets.francais: Bien au contraire, ce jour-là ils se soumettent.
versets.anglais: But they, that Day, are in surrender

versets.arabe: وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَسَاءَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa aqbala ba'dhuhum 'alâ ba'dhin yatasâ'alûn
versets.francais: Ils se retournent les uns vers les autres en s'interrogeant.
versets.anglais: And they will approach one another blaming each other

versets.arabe: قَالُوا إِنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ تَأْتُونَنَا عَنِ الْيَمِينِ
versets.phonetique: Qâlû innakum kuntum ta'tûnanâ 'anil-yamîn
versets.francais: Ils disent: "C'est vous qui veniez à nous par la droite."
versets.anglais: They will say, "Indeed, you used to come at us from the right

versets.arabe: قَالُوا بَل لَّمْ تَكُونُوا مُؤْمِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qâlû bal lam takûnû mu'minîn
versets.francais: Ils répondent: "Mais non, c'est vous qui n'étiez pas croyants."
versets.anglais: The oppressors will say, "Rather, you [yourselves] were not believers

versets.arabe: وَمَا كَانَ لَنَا عَلَيْكُم مِّن سُلْطَانٍ ۖ بَلْ كُنتُمْ قَوْمًا طَاغِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa mâ kâna lanâ 'alaykum min sultânin bal kuntum qawman tâghîn
versets.francais: "Nous n'avions aucun pouvoir sur vous. Mais vous étiez un peuple rebelle."
versets.anglais: And we had over you no authority, but you were a transgressing people

versets.arabe: فَحَقَّ عَلَيْنَا قَوْلُ رَبِّنَا ۖ إِنَّا لَذَائِقُونَ
versets.phonetique: Fahaqqa 'alaynâ qawlu rabbinâ, innâ ladhâ'iqûn
versets.francais: "La parole de notre Seigneur s'est donc réalisée contre nous. Nous allons vraiment goûter."
versets.anglais: So the word of our Lord has come into effect upon us; indeed, we will taste [punishment]

versets.arabe: فَأَغْوَيْنَاكُمْ إِنَّا كُنَّا غَاوِينَ
versets.phonetique: Fa'aghwaynâkum innâ kunnâ ghâwîn
versets.francais: "Nous vous avons égarés. Nous étions nous-mêmes égarés."
versets.anglais: And we led you to deviation; indeed, we were deviators

versets.arabe: فَإِنَّهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ فِي الْعَذَابِ مُشْتَرِكُونَ
versets.phonetique: Fa innahum yawma'idhin fil-'adhâbi mushtarikûn
versets.francais: Ce jour-là, ils partageront tous le châtiment.
versets.anglais: So indeed they, that Day, will be sharing in the punishment

versets.arabe: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِالْمُجْرِمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Innâ kadhâlika naf'alu bil-mujrimîn
versets.francais: C'est ainsi que Nous traitons les criminels.
versets.anglais: Indeed, that is how We deal with the criminals

versets.arabe: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا إِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Innahum kânû idhâ qîla lahum lâ ilâha illAllâhu yastakbirûn
versets.francais: Car quand on leur disait: "Point de dieu qu'Allah", ils s'enorgueillissaient,
versets.anglais: Indeed they, when it was said to them, "There is no deity but Allah," were arrogant

versets.arabe: وَيَقُولُونَ أَئِنَّا لَتَارِكُو آلِهَتِنَا لِشَاعِرٍ مَّجْنُونٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa yaqûlûna a'innâ latârikû âlihatinâ lishâ'irin majnûn
versets.francais: et disaient: "Allons-nous abandonner nos dieux pour un poète fou?"
versets.anglais: And were saying, "Are we to leave our gods for a mad poet

versets.arabe: بَلْ جَاءَ بِالْحَقِّ وَصَدَّقَ الْمُرْسَلِينَ
versets.phonetique: Bal jâ'a bil-haqqi wa saddaqal-mursalîn
versets.francais: Mais non, il est venu avec la vérité et confirme les envoyés.
versets.anglais: Rather, the Prophet has come with the truth and confirmed the [previous] messengers

versets.arabe: إِنَّكُمْ لَذَائِقُو الْعَذَابِ الْأَلِيمِ
versets.phonetique: Innakum ladhâ'iqul-'adhâbil-alîm
versets.francais: Vous goûterez vraiment le châtiment douloureux.
versets.anglais: Indeed, you [disbelievers] will be tasters of the painful punishment

versets.arabe: وَمَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa mâ tujzawna illâ mâ kuntum ta'malûn
versets.francais: Vous ne serez rétribués que selon ce que vous faisiez.
versets.anglais: And you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do

versets.arabe: إِلَّا عِبَادَ اللَّهِ الْمُخْلَصِينَ
versets.phonetique: Illâ 'ibâdAllâhil-mukhlasîn
versets.francais: Sauf les serviteurs sincères d'Allah.
versets.anglais: But not the chosen servants of Allah

versets.arabe: أُولَٰئِكَ لَهُمْ رِزْقٌ مَّعْلُومٌ
versets.phonetique: Ulâ'ika lahum rizqun ma'lûm
versets.francais: Pour ceux-là, il y a une subsistance assignée:
versets.anglais: Those will have a provision determined

versets.arabe: فَوَاكِهُ ۖ وَهُم مُّكْرَمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Fawâkihu wa hum mukramûn
versets.francais: des fruits, et ils seront comblés d'honneurs
versets.anglais: Fruits; and they will be honored

versets.arabe: فِي جَنَّاتِ النَّعِيمِ
versets.phonetique: Fî jannâtin-na'îm
versets.francais: dans les jardins du bonheur,
versets.anglais: In gardens of pleasure

versets.arabe: عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مُّتَقَابِلِينَ
versets.phonetique: 'Alâ sururin mutaqâbilîn
versets.francais: sur des lits se faisant face.
versets.anglais: On thrones facing one another

versets.arabe: يُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِكَأْسٍ مِّن مَّعِينٍ
versets.phonetique: Yutâfu 'alayhim bika'sin min ma'în
versets.francais: On fera circuler autour d'eux une coupe d'une source vive,
versets.anglais: There will be circulated among them a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring

versets.arabe: بَيْضَاءَ لَذَّةٍ لِّلشَّارِبِينَ
versets.phonetique: Baydha'a ladhdhatin lish-shâribîn
versets.francais: blanche, délicieuse à boire,
versets.anglais: White and delicious to the drinkers

versets.arabe: لَا فِيهَا غَوْلٌ وَلَا هُمْ عَنْهَا يُنزَفُونَ
versets.phonetique: Lâ fîhâ ghawlun wa lâ hum 'anhâ yunzafûn
versets.francais: sans ivresse et sans qu'ils en soient enivrés.
versets.anglais: No bad effect is there in it, nor from it will they be intoxicated

versets.arabe: وَعِندَهُمْ قَاصِرَاتُ الطَّرْفِ عِينٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa 'indahum qâsirâtut-tarfi 'în
versets.francais: Auprès d'eux seront des jeunes filles au regard chaste, aux grands yeux,
versets.anglais: And with them will be women limiting [their] glances, with large, [beautiful] eyes

versets.arabe: كَأَنَّهُنَّ بَيْضٌ مَّكْنُونٌ
versets.phonetique: Ka'annahunna baydun maknûn
versets.francais: semblables à des œufs bien gardés.
versets.anglais: As if they were [delicate] eggs, well-protected

versets.arabe: فَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَسَاءَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Fa'aqbala ba'dhuhum 'alâ ba'dhin yatasâ'alûn
versets.francais: Ils se retourneront les uns vers les autres en s'interrogeant.
versets.anglais: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other

versets.arabe: قَالَ قَائِلٌ مِّنْهُمْ إِنِّي كَانَ لِي قَرِينٌ
versets.phonetique: Qâla qâ'ilun minhum innî kâna lî qarîn
versets.francais: L'un d'eux dira: "J'avais un compagnon,
versets.anglais: A speaker among them will say, "Indeed, I had a companion [on earth]

versets.arabe: يَقُولُ أَئِنَّكَ لَمِنَ الْمُصَدِّقِينَ
versets.phonetique: Yaqûlu a'innaka laminal-musaddiqîn
versets.francais: qui me disait: 'Es-tu vraiment de ceux qui croient?'
versets.anglais: Who would say, 'Are you indeed of those who believe

versets.arabe: أَئِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَامًا أَئِنَّا لَمَدِينُونَ
versets.phonetique: A'idhâ mitnâ wa kunnâ turâban wa 'izâman a'innâ lamedînûn
versets.francais: 'Quand nous serons morts et serons devenus poussière et ossements, serons-nous vraiment jugés?'"
versets.anglais: That when we have died and become dust and bones, we will indeed be recompensed

versets.arabe: قَالَ هَلْ أَنتُم مُّطَّلِعُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qâla hal antum muttali'ûn
versets.francais: Il dira: "Voulez-vous regarder?"
versets.anglais: He will say, "Would you [care to] look

versets.arabe: فَاطَّلَعَ فَرَآهُ فِي سَوَاءِ الْجَحِيمِ
versets.phonetique: Fattala'a fara'âhu fî sawâ'il-jahîm
versets.francais: Il regarde et le voit au milieu de l'Enfer.
versets.anglais: And he will look and see him in the midst of the Hellfire

versets.arabe: قَالَ تَاللَّهِ إِن كِدتَّ لَتُرْدِينِ
versets.phonetique: Qâla tallâhi in kidta laturdîn
versets.francais: Il dit: "Par Allah, tu as failli me perdre!
versets.anglais: He will say, "By Allah, you almost ruined me

versets.arabe: وَلَوْلَا نِعْمَةُ رَبِّي لَكُنتُ مِنَ الْمُحْضَرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa lawlâ ni'matu rabbî lakuntu minal-muhdharîn
versets.francais: Sans la grâce de mon Seigneur, j'aurais été du nombre des comparants."
versets.anglais: If not for the favor of my Lord, I would have been of those brought in [to Hell]

versets.arabe: أَفَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَيِّتِينَ
versets.phonetique: Afamâ nahnu bîmayyitîn
versets.francais: "Ne mourrons-nous donc pas,
versets.anglais: Then, are we not to die

versets.arabe: إِلَّا مَوْتَتَنَا الْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
versets.phonetique: Illâ mawtatanal-ûlâ wa mâ nahnu bimu'adhdhabîn
versets.francais: sauf notre première mort, et ne serons pas châtiés?"
versets.anglais: Except for our first death, and we will not be punished

versets.arabe: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ
versets.phonetique: Inna hâdhâ lahuwal-fawzul-'azîm
versets.francais: C'est là vraiment le grand succès!
versets.anglais: Indeed, this is the great attainment

versets.arabe: لِمِثْلِ هَٰذَا فَلْيَعْمَلِ الْعَامِلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Limithli hâdhâ falya'malil-'âmilûn
versets.francais: Pour quelque chose de semblable, que les travailleurs travaillent!
versets.anglais: For the like of this let the workers [on earth] work

versets.arabe: أَذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ نُّزُلًا أَمْ شَجَرَةُ الزَّقُّومِ
versets.phonetique: Adhâlika khayrun nuzulan am shajaratuz-zaqqûm
versets.francais: Est-ce là une meilleure hospitalité ou l'arbre de Zaqqûm?
versets.anglais: Is Paradise a better accommodation or the tree of zaqqum

versets.arabe: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَاهَا فِتْنَةً لِّلظَّالِمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Innâ ja'alnâhâ fitnatan liz-zâlimîn
versets.francais: Nous en avons fait un châtiment pour les injustes.
versets.anglais: Indeed, We have made it a torment for the wrongdoers

versets.arabe: إِنَّهَا شَجَرَةٌ تَخْرُجُ فِي أَصْلِ الْجَحِيمِ
versets.phonetique: Innahâ shajaratun takhruju fî aslil-jahîm
versets.francais: C'est un arbre qui pousse au fond de l'Enfer,
versets.anglais: Indeed, it is a tree issuing from the bottom of the Hellfire

versets.arabe: طَلْعُهَا كَأَنَّهُ رُءُوسُ الشَّيَاطِينِ
versets.phonetique: Tal'uhâ ka'annahu ru'ûsush-shayâtîn
versets.francais: dont les régimes sont comme des têtes de diables.
versets.anglais: Its emerging fruit as if it was heads of the devils

versets.arabe: فَإِنَّهُمْ لَآكِلُونَ مِنْهَا فَمَالِئُونَ مِنْهَا الْبُطُونَ
versets.phonetique: Fa innahum la'âkilûna minhâ famâli'ûna minhal-butûn
versets.francais: Ils en mangeront et s'en rempliront le ventre.
versets.anglais: And indeed, they will eat from it and fill with it their bellies

versets.arabe: ثُمَّ إِنَّ لَهُمْ عَلَيْهَا لَشَوْبًا مِّنْ حَمِيمٍ
versets.phonetique: Thumma inna lahum 'alayhâ lashawban min hamîm
versets.francais: Puis ils auront par-dessus un mélange d'eau bouillante,
versets.anglais: Then indeed, they will have after it a mixture of scalding water

versets.arabe: ثُمَّ إِنَّ مَرْجِعَهُمْ لَإِلَى الْجَحِيمِ
versets.phonetique: Thumma inna marji'ahum la'ilal-jahîm
versets.francais: puis leur retour sera bien vers l'Enfer.
versets.anglais: Then indeed, their return will be to the Hellfire

versets.arabe: إِنَّهُمْ أَلْفَوْا آبَاءَهُمْ ضَالِّينَ
versets.phonetique: Innahum alfaw âbâ'ahum dhâllîn
versets.francais: Ils ont trouvé leurs pères égarés,
versets.anglais: Indeed they found their fathers astray

versets.arabe: فَهُمْ عَلَىٰ آثَارِهِمْ يُهْرَعُونَ
versets.phonetique: Fahum 'alâ âthârihim yuhra'ûn
versets.francais: et ils se précipitent sur leurs traces.
versets.anglais: So they hastened [to follow] in their footsteps

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ ضَلَّ قَبْلَهُمْ أَكْثَرُ الْأَوَّلِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa laqad dhalla qablahum aktharal-awwalîn
versets.francais: Avant eux, la plupart des anciens s'étaient égarés.
versets.anglais: And there had already strayed before them most of the former peoples

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا فِيهِم مُّنذِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa laqad arsalnâ fîhim mundhirîn
versets.francais: Nous avions envoyé parmi eux des avertisseurs.
versets.anglais: And We had already sent among them warners

versets.arabe: فَانظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُنذَرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Fanzur kayfa kâna 'âqibatul-mundhharîn
versets.francais: Vois comment a été la fin de ceux qui avaient été avertis,
versets.anglais: Then look how was the end of those who were warned

versets.arabe: إِلَّا عِبَادَ اللَّهِ الْمُخْلَصِينَ
versets.phonetique: Illâ 'ibâdAllâhil-mukhlasîn
versets.francais: sauf les serviteurs sincères d'Allah.
versets.anglais: But not the chosen servants of Allah

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ نَادَانَا نُوحٌ فَلَنِعْمَ الْمُجِيبُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa laqad nâdânâ Nûhun falani'mal-mujîbûn
versets.francais: Noé Nous avait invoqués; et Nous sommes le meilleur des exauceurs.
versets.anglais: And Noah had certainly called Us, and [We are] the best of responders

versets.arabe: وَنَجَّيْنَاهُ وَأَهْلَهُ مِنَ الْكَرْبِ الْعَظِيمِ
versets.phonetique: Wa najjaynâhu wa ahlahu minal-karbil-'azîm
versets.francais: Nous le sauvâmes lui et sa famille de la grande détresse.
versets.anglais: And We saved him and his family from the great affliction

versets.arabe: وَجَعَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُ هُمُ الْبَاقِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa ja'alnâ dhurriyyatahu humul-bâqîn
versets.francais: Et Nous fîmes de sa descendance les survivants.
versets.anglais: And We made his descendants those remaining [on the earth]

versets.arabe: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِي الْآخِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa taraknâ 'alayhi fil-âkhirîn
versets.francais: Nous perpétuâmes son renom parmi les générations futures.
versets.anglais: And left for him [favorable mention] among later generations

versets.arabe: سَلَامٌ عَلَىٰ نُوحٍ فِي الْعَالَمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Salâmun 'alâ Nûhin fil-'âlamîn
versets.francais: Paix sur Noé parmi tous les mondes!
versets.anglais: Peace upon Noah among the worlds

versets.arabe: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Innâ kadhâlika najzil-muhsinîn
versets.francais: C'est ainsi que Nous récompensons les bienfaisants.
versets.anglais: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good

versets.arabe: إِنَّهُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Innahu min 'ibâdinil-mu'minîn
versets.francais: Il est vraiment du nombre de Nos serviteurs croyants.
versets.anglais: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants

versets.arabe: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا الْآخَرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Thumma aghraqnal-âkharîn
versets.francais: Puis Nous noyâmes les autres.
versets.anglais: Then We drowned the disbelievers

versets.arabe: وَإِنَّ مِن شِيعَتِهِ لَإِبْرَاهِيمَ
versets.phonetique: Wa inna min shî'atihi la Ibrâhîm
versets.francais: Abraham était aussi de ses partisans.
versets.anglais: And indeed, among his kind was Abraham

versets.arabe: إِذْ جَاءَ رَبَّهُ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ
versets.phonetique: Idh jâ'a rabbahu biqalbin salîm
versets.francais: Quand il vint à son Seigneur avec un cœur sain,
versets.anglais: When he came to his Lord with a sound heart

versets.arabe: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِ مَاذَا تَعْبُدُونَ
versets.phonetique: Idh qâla li'abîhi wa qawmihi mâdhâ ta'budûn
versets.francais: quand il dit à son père et à son peuple: "Qu'adorez-vous?
versets.anglais: [And] when he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship

versets.arabe: أَئِفْكًا آلِهَةً دُونَ اللَّهِ تُرِيدُونَ
versets.phonetique: A'ifkan âlihatan dûnAllâhi turîdûn
versets.francais: Est-ce un mensonge? Des divinités en dehors d'Allah, voulez-vous?"
versets.anglais: Is it falsehood [as] gods other than Allah you desire

versets.arabe: فَمَا ظَنُّكُم بِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Famâ zannukum birabbil-'âlamîn
versets.francais: "Que pensez-vous donc du Seigneur des mondes?"
versets.anglais: Then what is your thought about the Lord of the worlds

versets.arabe: فَنَظَرَ نَظْرَةً فِي النُّجُومِ
versets.phonetique: Fanazara nazratan fin-nujûm
versets.francais: Il jeta un regard vers les étoiles,
versets.anglais: And he cast a look at the stars

versets.arabe: فَقَالَ إِنِّي سَقِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Faqâla innî saqîm
versets.francais: puis dit: "Je suis malade."
versets.anglais: And said, "Indeed, I am [about to be] ill

versets.arabe: فَتَوَلَّوْا عَنْهُ مُدْبِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Fatawallau 'anhu mudbirîn
versets.francais: Ils lui tournèrent le dos et s'en allèrent.
versets.anglais: So they turned away from him, departing

versets.arabe: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰ آلِهَتِهِمْ فَقَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Farâgha ilâ âlihatihim faqâla alâ ta'kulûn
versets.francais: Il se glissa vers leurs dieux et dit: "Ne mangez-vous pas?
versets.anglais: Then he turned to their gods and said, "Do you not eat

versets.arabe: مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَنطِقُونَ
versets.phonetique: Mâ lakum lâ tantiqûn
versets.francais: Qu'avez-vous? Vous ne parlez pas?"
versets.anglais: What is [wrong] with you that you do not speak

versets.arabe: فَرَاغَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضَرْبًا بِالْيَمِينِ
versets.phonetique: Farâgha 'alayhim dharban bil-yamîn
versets.francais: Il se jeta sur eux en les frappant de la main droite.
versets.anglais: And he turned upon them a blow with [his] right hand

versets.arabe: فَأَقْبَلُوا إِلَيْهِ يَزِفُّونَ
versets.phonetique: Fa'aqbalû ilayhi yazziffûn
versets.francais: Ils accoururent vers lui en hâte.
versets.anglais: Then the people came toward him, hastening

versets.arabe: قَالَ أَتَعْبُدُونَ مَا تَنْحِتُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qâla ata'budûna mâ tanhitûn
versets.francais: Il dit: "Adorez-vous ce que vous sculptez,
versets.anglais: He said, "Do you worship that which you [yourselves] carve

versets.arabe: وَاللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمْ وَمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: WAllâhu khalaqakum wa mâ ta'malûn
versets.francais: alors qu'Allah vous a créés, vous et ce que vous faites?"
versets.anglais: While Allah created you and that which you do

versets.arabe: قَالُوا ابْنُوا لَهُ بُنْيَانًا فَأَلْقُوهُ فِي الْجَحِيمِ
versets.phonetique: Qâlûbnû lahu bunyânan fa'alqûhu fil-jahîm
versets.francais: Ils dirent: "Construisez pour lui un bâtiment et jetez-le dans l'Enfer."
versets.anglais: They said, "Construct for him a furnace and throw him into the burning fire

versets.arabe: فَأَرَادُوا بِهِ كَيْدًا فَجَعَلْنَاهُمُ الْأَسْفَلِينَ
versets.phonetique: Fa arâdû bihi kaydan faja'alnâhumul-asfalîn
versets.francais: Ils voulurent lui tendre un piège, mais Nous les rendîmes les plus bas.
versets.anglais: And they intended for him a plan, but We made them the most debased

versets.arabe: وَقَالَ إِنِّي ذَاهِبٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّي سَيَهْدِينِ
versets.phonetique: Wa qâla innî dhâhibun ilâ rabbî sayahdîn
versets.francais: Il dit: "Je vais vers mon Seigneur; Il me guidera."
versets.anglais: And [then] he said, "Indeed, I will go to [where I am ordered by] my Lord; He will guide me

versets.arabe: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ
versets.phonetique: Rabbi hab lî minas-sâlihîn
versets.francais: "Seigneur, accorde-moi un enfant vertueux."
versets.anglais: My Lord, grant me [a child] from among the righteous

versets.arabe: فَبَشَّرْنَاهُ بِغُلَامٍ حَلِيمٍ
versets.phonetique: Fabashsarnâhu bighulâmin halîm
versets.francais: Nous lui annonçâmes la bonne nouvelle d'un garçon longanime.
versets.anglais: So We gave him good tidings of a forbearing boy

versets.arabe: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ السَّعْيَ قَالَ يَا بُنَيَّ إِنِّي أَرَىٰ فِي الْمَنَامِ أَنِّي أَذْبَحُكَ فَانظُرْ مَاذَا تَرَىٰ ۚ قَالَ يَا أَبَتِ افْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ ۖ سَتَجِدُنِي إِن شَاءَ اللَّهُ مِنَ الصَّابِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Falammâ balagha ma'ahus-sa'ya qâla yâ bunayya innî arâ fil-manâmi annî adhbahuka fanzur mâdhâ tarâ, qâla yâ abatif'al mâ tu'maru satajidunî inshâ'allâhu minas-sâbirîn
versets.francais: Quand il fut en âge de l'accompagner, il dit: "Ô mon fils, je me vois en songe en train de t'immoler. Vois ce que tu en penses." Il dit: "Ô mon père, fais ce qu'on t'ordonne. Tu me trouveras, si Allah veut, du nombre des endurants."
versets.anglais: And when he reached with him [the age of] exertion, he said, "O my son, indeed I have seen in a dream that I [must] sacrifice you, so see what you think." He said, "O my father, do as you are commanded. You will find me, if Allah wills, of the steadfast

versets.arabe: فَلَمَّا أَسْلَمَا وَتَلَّهُ لِلْجَبِينِ
versets.phonetique: Falammâ aslamâ wa tallahu lil-jabîn
versets.francais: Quand ils se furent tous deux soumis et qu'il l'eut renversé sur le front,
versets.anglais: And when they had both submitted and he put him down upon his forehead

versets.arabe: وَنَادَيْنَاهُ أَن يَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ
versets.phonetique: Wa nâdaynâhu an yâ Ibrâhîm
versets.francais: Nous l'appelâmes: "Ô Abraham!
versets.anglais: We called to him, "O Abraham

versets.arabe: قَدْ صَدَّقْتَ الرُّؤْيَا ۚ إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qad saddaqtar-ru'yâ, innâ kadhâlika najzil-muhsinîn
versets.francais: Tu as réalisé le songe." C'est ainsi que Nous récompensons les bienfaisants.
versets.anglais: You have fulfilled the vision." Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good

versets.arabe: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ الْبَلَاءُ الْمُبِينُ
versets.phonetique: Inna hâdhâ lahuwal-balâ'ul-mubîn
versets.francais: C'était là vraiment l'épreuve manifeste.
versets.anglais: Indeed, this was the clear trial

versets.arabe: وَفَدَيْنَاهُ بِذِبْحٍ عَظِيمٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa fadaynâhu bidhib-hin 'azîm
versets.francais: Nous le rachetâmes avec un sacrifice solennel.
versets.anglais: And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice

versets.arabe: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِي الْآخِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa taraknâ 'alayhi fil-âkhirîn
versets.francais: Nous perpétuâmes son renom dans la postérité.
versets.anglais: And We left for him [favorable mention] among later generations

versets.arabe: سَلَامٌ عَلَىٰ إِبْرَاهِيمَ
versets.phonetique: Salâmun 'alâ Ibrâhîm
versets.francais: Paix sur Abraham!
versets.anglais: Peace upon Abraham

versets.arabe: كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Kadhâlika najzil-muhsinîn
versets.francais: C'est ainsi que Nous récompensons les bienfaisants.
versets.anglais: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good

versets.arabe: إِنَّهُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Innahu min 'ibâdinil-mu'minîn
versets.francais: Il est vraiment du nombre de Nos serviteurs croyants.
versets.anglais: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants

versets.arabe: وَبَشَّرْنَاهُ بِإِسْحَاقَ نَبِيًّا مِّنَ الصَّالِحِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa bashsarnâhu bi Ishâqa nabiyyan minas-sâlihîn
versets.francais: Nous lui annonçâmes la bonne nouvelle d'Isaac, prophète parmi les gens de bien.
versets.anglais: And We gave him good tidings of Isaac, a prophet from among the righteous

versets.arabe: وَبَارَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَىٰ إِسْحَاقَ ۚ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا مُحْسِنٌ وَظَالِمٌ لِّنَفْسِهِ مُبِينٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa bâraknâ 'alayhi wa 'alâ Ishâq, wa min dhurriyyatihimâ muhsinun wa zâlimun linafsihî mubîn
versets.francais: Nous les bénîmes, lui et Isaac. Parmi leurs descendants, il y en a qui font le bien, et d'autres qui se font ouvertement du tort.
versets.anglais: And We blessed him and Isaac. But among their descendants is the doer of good and the clearly unjust to himself

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ مَنَنَّا عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَارُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa laqad manannâ 'alâ Mûsâ wa Hârûn
versets.francais: Nous avons accordé Notre grâce à Moïse et Aaron.
versets.anglais: And We did certainly confer favor upon Moses and Aaron

versets.arabe: وَنَجَّيْنَاهُمَا وَقَوْمَهُمَا مِنَ الْكَرْبِ الْعَظِيمِ
versets.phonetique: Wa najjaynâhumâ wa qawmahumâ minal-karbil-'azîm
versets.francais: Et Nous les sauvâmes, eux et leur peuple, de la grande détresse.
versets.anglais: And We saved them and their people from the great affliction

versets.arabe: وَنَصَرْنَاهُمْ فَكَانُوا هُمُ الْغَالِبِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa nasarnâhum fakânû humul-ghâlibîn
versets.francais: Nous leur donnâmes la victoire et ils furent les vainqueurs.
versets.anglais: And We supported them so it was they who overcame

versets.arabe: وَآتَيْنَاهُمَا الْكِتَابَ الْمُسْتَبِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa âtaynâhumal-kitâbal-mustabîn
versets.francais: Nous leur donnâmes le Livre explicite.
versets.anglais: And We gave them the explicit Scripture

versets.arabe: وَهَدَيْنَاهُمَا الصِّرَاطَ الْمُسْتَقِيمَ
versets.phonetique: Wa hadaynâhumas-sirâtal-mustaqîm
versets.francais: Nous les guidâmes sur le droit chemin.
versets.anglais: And We guided them on the straight path

versets.arabe: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِمَا فِي الْآخِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa taraknâ 'alayhimâ fil-âkhirîn
versets.francais: Et Nous perpétuâmes leur renom dans la postérité.
versets.anglais: And We left for them [favorable mention] among later generations

versets.arabe: سَلَامٌ عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَارُونَ
versets.phonetique: Salâmun 'alâ Mûsâ wa Hârûn
versets.francais: Paix sur Moïse et Aaron!
versets.anglais: Peace upon Moses and Aaron

versets.arabe: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Innâ kadhâlika najzil-muhsinîn
versets.francais: C'est ainsi que Nous récompensons les bienfaisants.
versets.anglais: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good

versets.arabe: إِنَّهُمَا مِنْ عِبَادِنَا الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Innahumâ min 'ibâdinil-mu'minîn
versets.francais: Ils sont vraiment du nombre de Nos serviteurs croyants.
versets.anglais: Indeed, they were of Our believing servants

versets.arabe: وَإِنَّ إِلْيَاسَ لَمِنَ الْمُرْسَلِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa inna Ilyâsa laminal-mursalîn
versets.francais: Élie est certes du nombre des envoyés.
versets.anglais: And indeed, Elias was from among the messengers

versets.arabe: إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
versets.phonetique: Idh qâla liqawmihi alâ tattaqûn
versets.francais: Quand il dit à son peuple: "Ne craignez-vous pas Allah?
versets.anglais: When he said to his people, "Will you not fear Allah

versets.arabe: أَتَدْعُونَ بَعْلًا وَتَذَرُونَ أَحْسَنَ الْخَالِقِينَ
versets.phonetique: Atad'ûna Ba'lan wa tadharûna ahsanal-khâliqîn
versets.francais: Invoquez-vous Ba'l et abandonnez-vous le meilleur des créateurs,
versets.anglais: Do you call upon Ba'l and leave the best of creators

versets.arabe: اللَّهَ رَبَّكُمْ وَرَبَّ آبَائِكُمُ الْأَوَّلِينَ
versets.phonetique: Allâha rabbakum wa rabba âbâ'ikumul-awwalîn
versets.francais: Allah, votre Seigneur et le Seigneur de vos premiers ancêtres?"
versets.anglais: Allah, your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers

versets.arabe: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَإِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Fakadhdhabûhu fa innahum lamuhdarûn
versets.francais: Ils le démentèrent; ils seront donc comparants,
versets.anglais: And they denied him, so indeed, they will be brought [for punishment]

versets.arabe: إِلَّا عِبَادَ اللَّهِ الْمُخْلَصِينَ
versets.phonetique: Illâ 'ibâdAllâhil-mukhlasîn
versets.francais: sauf les serviteurs sincères d'Allah.
versets.anglais: Except the chosen servants of Allah

versets.arabe: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِي الْآخِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa taraknâ 'alayhi fil-âkhirîn
versets.francais: Nous perpétuâmes son renom dans la postérité.
versets.anglais: And We left for him [favorable mention] among later generations

versets.arabe: سَلَامٌ عَلَىٰ إِلْ يَاسِينَ
versets.phonetique: Salâmun 'alâ Il Yâsîn
versets.francais: Paix sur Il-Yâsîn!
versets.anglais: Peace upon Elias

versets.arabe: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Innâ kadhâlika najzil-muhsinîn
versets.francais: C'est ainsi que Nous récompensons les bienfaisants.
versets.anglais: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good

versets.arabe: إِنَّهُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Innahu min 'ibâdinil-mu'minîn
versets.francais: Il est vraiment du nombre de Nos serviteurs croyants.
versets.anglais: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants

versets.arabe: وَإِنَّ لُوطًا لَّمِنَ الْمُرْسَلِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa inna Lûtan laminal-mursalîn
versets.francais: Loth est certes du nombre des envoyés.
versets.anglais: And indeed, Lot was among the messengers

versets.arabe: إِذْ نَجَّيْنَاهُ وَأَهْلَهُ أَجْمَعِينَ
versets.phonetique: Idh najjaynâhu wa ahlahu ajma'în
versets.francais: Quand Nous le sauvâmes lui et toute sa famille,
versets.anglais: [So mention] when We saved him and his family, all

versets.arabe: إِلَّا عَجُوزًا فِي الْغَابِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Illâ 'ajûzan fil-ghâbirîn
versets.francais: sauf une vieille femme qui fut du nombre de ceux qui restèrent.
versets.anglais: Except his wife among those who remained [with the evildoers]

versets.arabe: ثُمَّ دَمَّرْنَا الْآخَرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Thumma dammarnâl-âkharîn
versets.francais: Puis Nous anéantîmes les autres.
versets.anglais: Then We destroyed the others

versets.arabe: وَإِنَّكُمْ لَتَمُرُّونَ عَلَيْهِم مُّصْبِحِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa innakum latamurrûna 'alayhim musbihîn
versets.francais: Vous passez le matin devant leurs ruines,
versets.anglais: And indeed, you pass by them in the morning

versets.arabe: وَبِاللَّيْلِ ۗ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa bil-layl, afalâ ta'qilûn
versets.francais: et la nuit aussi. Ne raisonnez-vous pas?
versets.anglais: And at night. Then will you not use reason

versets.arabe: وَإِنَّ يُونُسَ لَمِنَ الْمُرْسَلِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa inna Yûnusa laminal-mursalîn
versets.francais: Jonas est certes du nombre des envoyés.
versets.anglais: And indeed, Jonah was among the messengers

versets.arabe: إِذْ أَبَقَ إِلَى الْفُلْكِ الْمَشْحُونِ
versets.phonetique: Idh abaqa ilal-fulkil-mashhûn
versets.francais: Quand il s'enfuit vers le bateau chargé.
versets.anglais: [Mention] when he ran away to the laden ship

versets.arabe: فَسَاهَمَ فَكَانَ مِنَ الْمُدْحَضِينَ
versets.phonetique: Fasâhama fakâna minal-mudhadîn
versets.francais: Il tira au sort et fut du nombre des perdants.
versets.anglais: And he drew lots and was among the losers

versets.arabe: فَالْتَقَمَهُ الْحُوتُ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Faltaqamahhûtu wa huwa mulîm
versets.francais: Le grand poisson l'avala alors qu'il était blâmable.
versets.anglais: Then the fish swallowed him, while he was blameworthy

versets.arabe: فَلَوْلَا أَنَّهُ كَانَ مِنَ الْمُسَبِّحِينَ
versets.phonetique: Falawlâ annahu kâna minal-musabbihîn
versets.francais: S'il n'avait pas été du nombre de ceux qui glorifient Allah,
versets.anglais: And had he not been of those who exalt Allah

versets.arabe: لَلَبِثَ فِي بَطْنِهِ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
versets.phonetique: Lalabitha fî batnihi ilâ yawmi yub'athûn
versets.francais: il serait resté dans son ventre jusqu'au Jour de la Résurrection.
versets.anglais: He would have remained inside its belly until the Day they are resurrected

versets.arabe: فَنَبَذْنَاهُ بِالْعَرَاءِ وَهُوَ سَقِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Fanabadhnâhu bil-'arâ'i wa huwa saqîm
versets.francais: Nous le jetâmes sur un rivage nu et il était malade.
versets.anglais: But We threw him onto the open shore while he was ill

versets.arabe: وَأَنبَتْنَا عَلَيْهِ شَجَرَةً مِّن يَقْطِينٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa anbatnâ 'alayhi shajaratan min yaqtîn
versets.francais: Nous fîmes pousser au-dessus de lui un arbre de courge.
versets.anglais: And We caused to grow over him a gourd vine

versets.arabe: وَأَرْسَلْنَاهُ إِلَىٰ مِائَةِ أَلْفٍ أَوْ يَزِيدُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa arsalnâhu ilâ mi'ati alfin aw yazîdûn
versets.francais: Et Nous l'envoyâmes vers cent mille ou plus.
versets.anglais: And We sent him to [his people of] a hundred thousand or more

versets.arabe: فَآمَنُوا فَمَتَّعْنَاهُمْ إِلَىٰ حِينٍ
versets.phonetique: Fa âmanû famatta'nâhum ilâ hîn
versets.francais: Ils crurent et Nous leur accordâmes la jouissance pour un temps.
versets.anglais: And they believed, so We gave them enjoyment [of life] for a time

versets.arabe: فَاسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَلِرَبِّكَ الْبَنَاتُ وَلَهُمُ الْبَنُونَ
versets.phonetique: Fastaftihim alirabbika l-banâtu wa lahumul-banûn
versets.francais: Demande-leur: "Les filles sont-elles pour ton Seigneur, et les fils pour eux?"
versets.anglais: So inquire of them, [O Muhammad], "Does your Lord have daughters while they have sons

versets.arabe: أَمْ خَلَقْنَا الْمَلَائِكَةَ إِنَاثًا وَهُمْ شَاهِدُونَ
versets.phonetique: Am khalaqnal-malâ'ikata inâthan wa hum shâhidûn
versets.francais: Avons-Nous créé les anges de sexe féminin alors qu'ils étaient témoins?
versets.anglais: Or did We create the angels as females while they were witnesses

versets.arabe: أَلَا إِنَّهُم مِّنْ إِفْكِهِمْ لَيَقُولُونَ
versets.phonetique: Alâ innahum min ifkihim layaqûlûn
versets.francais: N'est-ce pas que c'est de leur calomnie qu'ils disent:
versets.anglais: Unquestionably, it is out of their [invented] falsehood that they say

versets.arabe: وَلَدَ اللَّهُ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكَاذِبُونَ
versets.phonetique: Walad Allâhu wa innahum lakâdhibûn
versets.francais: "Allah a engendré!" Ils sont vraiment des menteurs.
versets.anglais: Allah has begotten," and indeed, they are liars

versets.arabe: أَصْطَفَى الْبَنَاتِ عَلَى الْبَنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Astafal-banâti 'alal-banîn
versets.francais: "A-t-Il préféré les filles aux fils?"
versets.anglais: Has He chosen daughters over sons

versets.arabe: مَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Mâ lakum kayfa tahkumûn
versets.francais: Qu'avez-vous? Comment jugez-vous?
versets.anglais: What is [wrong] with you? How do you make judgement

versets.arabe: أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Afalâ tadhakkarûn
versets.francais: Ne vous souvenez-vous pas?
versets.anglais: Then will you not be reminded

versets.arabe: أَمْ لَكُمْ سُلْطَانٌ مُّبِينٌ
versets.phonetique: Am lakum sultânun mubîn
versets.francais: Ou avez-vous une preuve manifeste?
versets.anglais: Or do you have a clear authority

versets.arabe: فَأْتُوا بِكِتَابِكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَادِقِينَ
versets.phonetique: Fa'tû bikitâbikum in kuntum sâdiqîn
versets.francais: Apportez votre livre, si vous êtes véridiques!
versets.anglais: Then produce your scripture, if you should be truthful

versets.arabe: وَجَعَلُوا بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ الْجِنَّةِ نَسَبًا ۚ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمَتِ الْجِنَّةُ إِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa ja'alû baynahû wa baynal-jinnati nasabâ, wa laqad 'alimatil-jinnatu innahum lamuhdarûn
versets.francais: Ils ont établi une parenté entre Lui et les djinns. Les djinns savent bien qu'ils seront comparants.
versets.anglais: And they have claimed between Him and the jinn a lineage, but the jinn have already known that they [who made such claims] will be brought to [punishment]

versets.arabe: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
versets.phonetique: SubhânAllâhi 'ammâ yasifûn
versets.francais: Gloire à Allah! Il est au-dessus de ce qu'ils Lui attribuent,
versets.anglais: Exalted is Allah above what they describe

versets.arabe: إِلَّا عِبَادَ اللَّهِ الْمُخْلَصِينَ
versets.phonetique: Illâ 'ibâdAllâhil-mukhlasîn
versets.francais: sauf les serviteurs sincères d'Allah.
versets.anglais: Except the chosen servants of Allah [who do not share in that sin]

versets.arabe: فَإِنَّكُمْ وَمَا تَعْبُدُونَ
versets.phonetique: Fa innakum wa mâ ta'budûn
versets.francais: Vous et ce que vous adorez,
versets.anglais: So indeed, you [disbelievers] and whatever you worship

versets.arabe: مَا أَنتُمْ عَلَيْهِ بِفَاتِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Mâ antum 'alayhi bifâtinîn
versets.francais: vous ne pouvez séduire personne contre Lui,
versets.anglais: You cannot tempt [anyone] away from Him

versets.arabe: إِلَّا مَنْ هُوَ صَالِ الْجَحِيمِ
versets.phonetique: Illâ man huwa sâlil-jahîm
versets.francais: sauf celui qui est destiné à brûler dans l'Enfer.
versets.anglais: Except he who is to [enter and] burn in the Hellfire

versets.arabe: وَمَا مِنَّا إِلَّا لَهُ مَقَامٌ مَّعْلُومٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa mâ minnâ illâ lahu maqâmun ma'lûm
versets.francais: Il n'est personne parmi nous qui n'ait une place connue.
versets.anglais: [The angels say], "There is not among us any except that he has a known position

versets.arabe: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ الصَّافُّونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa innâ lanahnus-sâffûn
versets.francais: Et certes nous sommes ceux qui se rangent en rangs,
versets.anglais: And indeed, we are those who line up [for prayer]

versets.arabe: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ الْمُسَبِّحُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa innâ lanahnum-musabbihûn
versets.francais: et certes nous sommes ceux qui glorifient Allah.
versets.anglais: And indeed, we are those who exalt Allah

versets.arabe: وَإِن كَانُوا لَيَقُولُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa in kânû layaqûlûn
versets.francais: Ils disaient certes:
versets.anglais: And indeed, the disbelievers used to say

versets.arabe: لَوْ أَنَّ عِندَنَا ذِكْرًا مِّنَ الْأَوَّلِينَ
versets.phonetique: Law anna 'indanâ dhikran minal-awwalîn
versets.francais: "Si nous avions eu un rappel des Anciens,
versets.anglais: If we had a message from [those of] the former peoples

versets.arabe: لَكُنَّا عِبَادَ اللَّهِ الْمُخْلَصِينَ
versets.phonetique: Lakunnâ 'ibâdAllâhil-mukhlasîn
versets.francais: nous aurions été certes du nombre des serviteurs sincères d'Allah."
versets.anglais: We would have been the chosen servants of Allah

versets.arabe: فَكَفَرُوا بِهِ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Fakafarû bih, fasawfa ya'lamûn
versets.francais: Ils l'ont renié; ils sauront bientôt.
versets.anglais: But they disbelieved in it, so they are going to know

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ سَبَقَتْ كَلِمَتُنَا لِعِبَادِنَا الْمُرْسَلِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa laqad sabaqat kalimatunâ li'ibâdinil-mursalîn
versets.francais: Notre parole a déjà été donnée à Nos serviteurs les envoyés:
versets.anglais: And Our word has already preceded for Our servants, the messengers

versets.arabe: إِنَّهُمْ لَهُمُ الْمَنصُورُونَ
versets.phonetique: Innahum lahumul-mansûrûn
versets.francais: qu'ils auront certes la victoire,
versets.anglais: [That] indeed, they would be those given victory

versets.arabe: وَإِنَّ جُندَنَا لَهُمُ الْغَالِبُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa inna jundanâ lahumul-ghâlibûn
versets.francais: et que Notre armée sera certes victorieuse.
versets.anglais: And [that] indeed, Our soldiers will be those who overcome

versets.arabe: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
versets.phonetique: Fatawalla 'anhum hattâ hîn
versets.francais: Détourne-toi d'eux pour un temps,
versets.anglais: So, [O Muhammad], leave them for a time

versets.arabe: وَأَبْصِرْهُمْ فَسَوْفَ يُبْصِرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa absir hum fasawfa yubsirûn
versets.francais: et observe-les; ils verront bientôt.
versets.anglais: And see [what will befall] them, for they are going to see

versets.arabe: أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Afabi'adhâbinâ yasta'jilûn
versets.francais: Veulent-ils hâter Notre châtiment?
versets.anglais: Then for Our punishment are they impatient

versets.arabe: فَإِذَا نَزَلَ بِسَاحَتِهِمْ فَسَاءَ صَبَاحُ الْمُنذَرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Fa idhâ nazala bisâhatihim fasâ'a sabâhul-mundhharîn
versets.francais: Quand il descendra dans leur cour, comme il sera mauvais le matin de ceux qui auront été avertis!
versets.anglais: But when it descends in their territory, then evil is the morning of those who were warned

versets.arabe: وَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa tawalla 'anhum hattâ hîn
versets.francais: Détourne-toi d'eux pour un temps,
versets.anglais: And leave them for a time

versets.arabe: وَأَبْصِرْ فَسَوْفَ يُبْصِرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa absir fasawfa yubsirûn
versets.francais: et observe; ils verront bientôt.
versets.anglais: And see, for they are going to see

versets.arabe: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ الْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
versets.phonetique: SubhânaRabbika rabbil-'izzati 'ammâ yasifûn
versets.francais: Gloire à ton Seigneur, le Seigneur de la Puissance! Il est au-dessus de ce qu'ils Lui attribuent.
versets.anglais: Exalted is your Lord, the Lord of might, above what they describe

versets.arabe: وَسَلَامٌ عَلَى الْمُرْسَلِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa salâmun 'alal-mursalîn
versets.francais: Et paix sur les envoyés!
versets.anglais: And peace upon the messengers

versets.arabe: وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Walhamdu lillâhi rabbil-'âlamîn
versets.francais: Et louange à Allah, Seigneur des mondes!
versets.anglais: And praise to Allah, Lord of the worlds

versets.arabe: ص ۚ وَالْقُرْآنِ ذِي الذِّكْرِ
versets.phonetique: Sad. Wal-qur'ani dhil-dhikr
versets.francais: Sad. Par le Coran, plein de rappel.
versets.anglais: Sad. By the Qur'an containing reminder

versets.arabe: بَلِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا فِي عِزَّةٍ وَشِقَاقٍ
versets.phonetique: Balil-ladhina kafaru fi 'izzatiw wa shiqaq
versets.francais: Mais ceux qui ont mécru sont dans l'arrogance et la dissension.
versets.anglais: But those who disbelieve are in pride and dissension

versets.arabe: كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن قَرْنٍ فَنَادَوا وَّلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٍ
versets.phonetique: Kam ahlakna min qablihim min qarnin fanadaw wa lata hina manas
versets.francais: Combien de générations avant eux avons-Nous détruites ! Elles ont appelé au secours, mais ce n'était plus le moment d'échapper.
versets.anglais: How many a generation have We destroyed before them, and they [then] called out; but it was not a time for escape

versets.arabe: وَعَجِبُوا أَن جَاءَهُم مُّنذِرٌ مِّنْهُمْ ۖ وَقَالَ الْكَافِرُونَ هَٰذَا سَاحِرٌ كَذَّابٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa 'ajibu an ja'ahum mundhirum minhum wa qalal-kafiruna hadha sahirun kadhdhab
versets.francais: Ils s'étonnent qu'un avertisseur venu d'entre eux leur soit venu. Les mécréants ont dit : "C'est un magicien, un grand menteur."
versets.anglais: And they wonder that there has come to them a warner from among themselves. And the disbelievers say, "This is a magician and a liar

versets.arabe: أَجَعَلَ الْآلِهَةَ إِلَٰهًا وَاحِدًا ۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَيْءٌ عُجَابٌ
versets.phonetique: Aja'alal-alihata ilahan wahida inna hadha lashay'un 'ujab
versets.francais: A-t-il fait des divinités un Dieu unique ? C'est là vraiment quelque chose d'étrange !
versets.anglais: Has he made the gods [only] one God? Indeed, this is a curious thing

versets.arabe: وَانطَلَقَ الْمَلَأُ مِنْهُمْ أَنِ امْشُوا وَاصْبِرُوا عَلَىٰ آلِهَتِكُمْ ۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَيْءٌ يُرَادُ
versets.phonetique: Wantalaqal-mala'u minhum anim-shu wasbiruu 'ala alihatikum inna hadha lashay'un yurad
versets.francais: Les notables d'entre eux s'en allèrent en disant : "Partez et tenez ferme dans votre culte des divinités. C'est là certainement une chose voulue."
versets.anglais: And the eminent among them went forth, [saying], "Continue, and be patient over [the defense of] your gods. Indeed, this is a thing intended

versets.arabe: مَا سَمِعْنَا بِهَٰذَا فِي الْمِلَّةِ الْآخِرَةِ إِنْ هَٰذَا إِلَّا اخْتِلَاقٌ
versets.phonetique: Ma sami'na bihadha fil-millatil-akhirati in hadha illakh-tilaq
versets.francais: Nous n'avons pas entendu parler de cela dans la dernière religion. Ce n'est qu'une invention.
versets.anglais: We have not heard of this in the latest religion. This is not but a fabrication

versets.arabe: أَأُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ الذِّكْرُ مِن بَيْنِنَا ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِي شَكٍّ مِّن ذِكْرِي ۖ بَل لَّمَّا يَذُوقُوا عَذَابِ
versets.phonetique: A'unzila 'alayhidh-dhikru mim bayninaa bal hum fi shakkim min dhikri bal lamma yadhuqu 'adhab
versets.francais: Est-ce lui, parmi nous, qui a reçu le Rappel ? Mais ils sont dans le doute sur Mon rappel. Mais ils n'ont pas encore goûté Mon châtiment.
versets.anglais: Has the message been revealed to him out of [all of] us?" Rather, they are in doubt about My message. Rather, they have not yet tasted My punishment

versets.arabe: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَائِنُ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّكَ الْعَزِيزِ الْوَهَّابِ
versets.phonetique: Am 'indahum khaza'inu rahmati rabbikal-'azizil-wahhab
versets.francais: Ont-ils en leur possession les trésors de la miséricorde de ton Seigneur, le Tout-Puissant, le Grand Donateur ?
versets.anglais: Or do they have the depositories of the mercy of your Lord, the Exalted in Might, the Bestower

versets.arabe: أَمْ لَهُم مُّلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ۖ فَلْيَرْتَقُوا فِي الْأَسْبَابِ
versets.phonetique: Am lahum mulkus-samawati wal-ardi wa ma baynahuma falyartaqu fil-asbab
versets.francais: Ont-ils la souveraineté des cieux et de la terre et de ce qui est entre eux ? Qu'ils montent alors par les moyens !
versets.anglais: Or is theirs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and what is between them? Then let them ascend through [any] ways of access

versets.arabe: جُندٌ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهْزُومٌ مِّنَ الْأَحْزَابِ
versets.phonetique: Jundum ma hunalika mahzumum minal-ahzab
versets.francais: Une armée de coalisés sera vaincue sur place.
versets.anglais: [They are but] soldiers [who will be] defeated there among the companies [of disbelievers]

versets.arabe: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَعَادٌ وَفِرْعَوْنُ ذُو الْأَوْتَادِ
versets.phonetique: Kadhdhabat qablahum qawmu nuhiw wa 'aduw wa fir'awnu dhul-awtad
