versets.francais: Avant eux, le peuple de Noé, les Aad et Pharaon le maître des piques ont démenti.
versets.anglais: The people of Noah denied before them, and [the tribe of] 'Aad and Pharaoh, the owner of stakes

versets.arabe: وَثَمُودُ وَقَوْمُ لُوطٍ وَأَصْحَابُ الْأَيْكَةِ ۚ أُولَٰئِكَ الْأَحْزَابُ
versets.phonetique: Wa thamudu wa qawmu lutiw wa as-habul-aykah ula'ikal-ahzab
versets.francais: Et les Thamoud, le peuple de Lot et les gens d'Al-Aykah. Ce sont là les coalisés.
versets.anglais: And [the tribe of] Thamud and the people of Lot and the companions of the thicket. Those are the companies

versets.arabe: إِن كُلٌّ إِلَّا كَذَّبَ الرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ
versets.phonetique: In kullun illa kadhdhabar-rusula fahaqqa 'iqab
versets.francais: Chacun d'eux n'a fait que traiter les messagers de menteurs, et Ma punition s'est avérée méritée.
versets.anglais: Each of them denied the messengers, so My penalty was justified

versets.arabe: وَمَا يَنظُرُ هَٰؤُلَاءِ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَاحِدَةً مَّا لَهَا مِن فَوَاقٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa ma yanthuru ha'ula'i illa sayhatan wahidatam ma laha min fawaq
versets.francais: Ces gens-ci n'attendent qu'un seul cri, qui n'aura pas de trêve.
versets.anglais: And these [disbelievers] await not but one blast [of the Horn]; for it there will be no delay

versets.arabe: وَقَالُوا رَبَّنَا عَجِّل لَّنَا قِطَّنَا قَبْلَ يَوْمِ الْحِسَابِ
versets.phonetique: Wa qalu rabbana 'ajjil lana qittana qabla yawmil-hisab
versets.francais: Ils ont dit : "Notre Seigneur, hâte pour nous notre part avant le Jour du Jugement."
versets.anglais: And they say, "Our Lord, hasten for us our share [of the punishment] before the Day of Account

versets.arabe: اصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَاذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا دَاوُودَ ذَا الْأَيْدِ ۖ إِنَّهُ أَوَّابٌ
versets.phonetique: Isbir 'ala ma yaquluna wadhkur 'abdana dawuda dhal-ayd innahu awwab
versets.francais: Supporte ce qu'ils disent et rappelle-toi Notre serviteur David, le fort, car il était très repentant.
versets.anglais: Be patient over what they say and remember Our servant, David, the possessor of strength; indeed, he was one who repeatedly turned back [to Allah]

versets.arabe: إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا الْجِبَالَ مَعَهُ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِالْعَشِيِّ وَالْإِشْرَاقِ
versets.phonetique: Inna sakhkharnaljibala ma'ahu yusabbihna bil-'ashiyyi wal-ishraq
versets.francais: Nous avions assujetti les montagnes à glorifier avec lui au soir et au lever du soleil.
versets.anglais: Indeed, We subjected the mountains [to praise] with him, exalting [Allah] in the [late] afternoon and [after] sunrise

versets.arabe: وَالطَّيْرَ مَحْشُورَةً ۖ كُلٌّ لَّهُ أَوَّابٌ
versets.phonetique: Wat-tayra mahshurah kullul lahu awwab
versets.francais: Et les oiseaux rassemblés, tous se tournaient vers lui avec repentir.
versets.anglais: And the birds were assembled, all with him repeating [praises]

versets.arabe: وَشَدَدْنَا مُلْكَهُ وَآتَيْنَاهُ الْحِكْمَةَ وَفَصْلَ الْخِطَابِ
versets.phonetique: Wa shadadna mulkahu wa ataynahl-hikmata wa faslal-khitab
versets.francais: Nous avons raffermi son royaume et lui avons donné la sagesse et la faculté de bien juger.
versets.anglais: And We strengthened his kingdom and gave him wisdom and discernment in speech

versets.arabe: وَهَلْ أَتَاكَ نَبَأُ الْخَصْمِ إِذْ تَسَوَّرُوا الْمِحْرَابَ
versets.phonetique: Wa hal ataka naba'ul-khasmi idh tasawwaral-mihrab
versets.francais: T'est-il parvenu la nouvelle des deux adversaires quand ils escaladèrent le mur du sanctuaire ?
versets.anglais: And has there come to you the news of the adversaries, when they climbed over the wall of [his] prayer chamber

versets.arabe: إِذْ دَخَلُوا عَلَىٰ دَاوُودَ فَفَزِعَ مِنْهُمْ ۖ قَالُوا لَا تَخَفْ ۖ خَصْمَانِ بَغَىٰ بَعْضُنَا عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ فَاحْكُم بَيْنَنَا بِالْحَقِّ وَلَا تُشْطِطْ وَاهْدِنَا إِلَىٰ سَوَاءِ الصِّرَاطِ
versets.phonetique: Idh dakhalu 'ala dawuda fafazi'a minhum qalu la takhaf khasmani bagha ba'duna 'ala ba'din fahkum baynana bil-haqqi wa la tushtitwahdinaa ila sawa'is-sirat
versets.francais: Quand ils entrèrent chez David, il eut peur d'eux. Ils dirent : "Ne crains pas ! Nous sommes deux adversaires dont l'un a lésé l'autre. Juge entre nous en toute équité, ne sois pas injuste, et guide-nous vers le droit chemin."
versets.anglais: When they entered upon David and he was alarmed by them? They said, "Fear not. [We are] two adversaries, one of whom has wronged the other, so judge between us with truth and do not exceed [it] and guide us to the sound path

versets.arabe: إِنَّ هَٰذَا أَخِي لَهُ تِسْعٌ وَتِسْعُونَ نَعْجَةً وَلِيَ نَعْجَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ فَقَالَ أَكْفِلْنِيهَا وَعَزَّنِي فِي الْخِطَابِ
versets.phonetique: Inna hadha akhi lahu tis'uw wa tis'una na'jataw wa liya na'jatuw wahidatun faqala akfilniha wa 'azzani fil-khitab
versets.francais: Celui-ci est mon frère : il possède quatre-vingt-dix-neuf brebis, et moi je n'en possède qu'une seule. Il me dit : "Confie-la moi", et il a été dur avec moi dans la discussion.
versets.anglais: Indeed this, my brother, has ninety-nine ewes, and I have one ewe; so he said, 'Entrust her to me,' and he overpowered me in speech

versets.arabe: قَالَ لَقَدْ ظَلَمَكَ بِسُؤَالِ نَعْجَتِكَ إِلَىٰ نِعَاجِهِ ۖ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًا مِّنَ الْخُلَطَاءِ لَيَبْغِي بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ إِلَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَقَلِيلٌ مَّا هُمْ ۗ وَظَنَّ دَاوُودُ أَنَّمَا فَتَنَّاهُ فَاسْتَغْفَرَ رَبَّهُ وَخَرَّ رَاكِعًا وَأَنَابَ
versets.phonetique: Qala laqad dhalamaka bisu'ali na'jatika ila ni'ajihi wa inna kathiram minal-khulata'i layabghi ba'duhum 'ala ba'din illal-ladhina amanu wa 'amilus-salihati wa qalilum ma hum wa dhanna dawudu annama fatannahu fastagfhara rabbahu wa kharra raki'aw wa anab
versets.francais: Il dit : "Certes, il t'a lésé en demandant à joindre ta brebis aux siennes. Beaucoup d'associés sont injustes les uns envers les autres, sauf ceux qui croient et font les bonnes œuvres - et ceux-là sont peu nombreux." Et David pensa que Nous l'avions mis à l'épreuve ; alors il implora le pardon de son Seigneur, s'inclina et se repentit.
versets.anglais: [David] said, "He has certainly wronged you in demanding your ewe [in addition] to his ewes. And indeed, many associates oppress one another, except for those who believe and do righteous deeds - and few are they." And David became certain that We had tried him, and he asked forgiveness of his Lord and fell down bowing [in prostration] and turned in repentance [to Allah]

versets.arabe: فَغَفَرْنَا لَهُ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَهُ عِندَنَا لَزُلْفَىٰ وَحُسْنَ مَآبٍ
versets.phonetique: Faghafarna lahu dhalik wa inna lahu 'indana lazulfa wa husna ma'ab
versets.francais: Nous lui pardonnâmes cela, et il a vraiment auprès de Nous une place rapprochée et un beau retour.
versets.anglais: So We forgave him that; and indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return

versets.arabe: يَا دَاوُودُ إِنَّا جَعَلْنَاكَ خَلِيفَةً فِي الْأَرْضِ فَاحْكُم بَيْنَ النَّاسِ بِالْحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعِ الْهَوَىٰ فَيُضِلَّكَ عَن سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَضِلُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ بِمَا نَسُوا يَوْمَ الْحِسَابِ
versets.phonetique: Ya dawudu inna ja'alnaka khalifatan fil-ardi fahkum baynan-nasi bil-haqqi wa la tattabi'il-hawa fayudillaka 'an sabilillah innal-ladhina yadilluna 'an sabilillahi lahum 'adhabun shadidun bima nasu yawmal-hisab
versets.francais: Ô David, Nous t'avons établi vicaire sur la terre. Juge donc parmi les hommes en toute équité et ne suis pas la passion, car elle t'égarerait du chemin d'Allah. Ceux qui s'égarent du chemin d'Allah auront un dur châtiment pour avoir oublié le Jour du Jugement.
versets.anglais: [We said], "O David, indeed We have made you a successor upon the earth, so judge between the people in truth and do not follow [your own] desire, as it will lead you astray from the way of Allah." Indeed, those who go astray from the way of Allah will have a severe punishment for having forgotten the Day of Account

versets.arabe: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا السَّمَاءَ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا بَاطِلًا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ظَنُّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا ۚ فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِنَ النَّارِ
versets.phonetique: Wa ma khalaqnas-sama'a wal-arda wa ma baynahuma batila dhalika dhannul-ladhina kafaru fawaylul lilladhina kafaru minan-nar
versets.francais: Nous n'avons pas créé en vain le ciel et la terre et ce qui est entre eux. C'est là l'opinion de ceux qui ont mécru. Malheur donc aux mécréants à cause du Feu !
versets.anglais: And We did not create the heaven and the earth and that between them aimlessly. That is the assumption of those who disbelieve, so woe to those who disbelieve from the Fire

versets.arabe: أَمْ نَجْعَلُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ كَالْمُفْسِدِينَ فِي الْأَرْضِ أَمْ نَجْعَلُ الْمُتَّقِينَ كَالْفُجَّارِ
versets.phonetique: Am naj'alul-ladhina amanu wa 'amilus-salihati kal-mufsidina fil-ardi am naj'alul-muttaqina kal-fujjar
versets.francais: Allons-Nous traiter de la même façon ceux qui croient et font de bonnes œuvres et les semeurs de corruption sur terre ? Ou allons-Nous traiter de la même façon les pieux et les pervers ?
versets.anglais: Or should we treat those who believe and do righteous deeds like corrupters in the land? Or should We treat those who fear Allah like the wicked

versets.arabe: كِتَابٌ أَنزَلْنَاهُ إِلَيْكَ مُبَارَكٌ لِّيَدَّبَّرُوا آيَاتِهِ وَلِيَتَذَكَّرَ أُولُو الْأَلْبَابِ
versets.phonetique: Kitabun anzalnahu ilayka mubarakul liyaddabbaru ayatihi wa lyatadhakkara ulul-albab
versets.francais: C'est un Livre béni que Nous t'avons révélé, afin qu'ils méditent ses versets, et que les doués d'intelligence se souviennent.
versets.anglais: [This is] a blessed Book which We have revealed to you, [O Muhammad], that they might reflect upon its verses and that those of understanding would be reminded

versets.arabe: وَوَهَبْنَا لِدَاوُودَ سُلَيْمَانَ ۚ نِعْمَ الْعَبْدُ ۖ إِنَّهُ أَوَّابٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa wahabna lidawuda sulayman ni'mal-'abdu innahu awwab
versets.francais: Nous avons accordé à David Salomon, quel excellent serviteur ! Il était vraiment très repentant.
versets.anglais: And to David We gave Solomon. An excellent servant, indeed he was one repeatedly turning back [to Allah]

versets.arabe: إِذْ عُرِضَ عَلَيْهِ بِالْعَشِيِّ الصَّافِنَاتُ الْجِيَادُ
versets.phonetique: Idh 'urida 'alayhi bil-'ashiyyis-safinatul-jiyad
versets.francais: Quand un soir, on lui présenta des coursiers racés se tenant sur trois jambes.
versets.anglais: [Mention] when there were exhibited before him in the afternoon the poised [standing] racehorses

versets.arabe: فَقَالَ إِنِّي أَحْبَبْتُ حُبَّ الْخَيْرِ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّي حَتَّىٰ تَوَارَتْ بِالْحِجَابِ
versets.phonetique: Faqala inni ahbabtu hubbal-khayri 'an dhikri rabbi hatta tawarat bil-hijab
versets.francais: Il dit : "J'ai préféré l'amour des biens terrestres au rappel de mon Seigneur", jusqu'à ce que le soleil se cachât derrière le voile.
versets.anglais: And he said, "Indeed, I gave preference to the love of good [things] over the remembrance of my Lord until the sun disappeared into the curtain [of darkness]

versets.arabe: رُدُّوهَا عَلَيَّ ۖ فَطَفِقَ مَسْحًا بِالسُّوقِ وَالْأَعْنَاقِ
versets.phonetique: Rudduha 'alayya fatafiqqa mashan bis-suqi wal-a'naq
versets.francais: "Ramenez-les moi !" Et il se mit à leur caresser les jarrets et les cous.
versets.anglais: [He said], "Return them to me," and set about striking [their] legs and necks

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا سُلَيْمَانَ وَأَلْقَيْنَا عَلَىٰ كُرْسِيِّهِ جَسَدًا ثُمَّ أَنَابَ
versets.phonetique: Wa laqad fatanna sulaymana wa alqayna 'ala kursiyyihi jasadan thumma anab
versets.francais: Nous avons éprouvé Salomon et placé sur son trône un corps, puis il se repentit.
versets.anglais: And We certainly tried Solomon and placed on his throne a body; then he returned

versets.arabe: قَالَ رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَهَبْ لِي مُلْكًا لَّا يَنبَغِي لِأَحَدٍ مِّن بَعْدِي ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْوَهَّابُ
versets.phonetique: Qala rabbighfir li wa hab li mulkal la yambaghi li'ahadin mim ba'di innaka antal-wahhab
versets.francais: Il dit : "Seigneur, pardonne-moi et accorde-moi un royaume qui n'appartiendra à personne après moi. Tu es vraiment le Grand Donateur."
versets.anglais: He said, "My Lord, forgive me and grant me a kingdom such as will not belong to anyone after me. Indeed, You are the Bestower

versets.arabe: فَسَخَّرْنَا لَهُ الرِّيحَ تَجْرِي بِأَمْرِهِ رُخَاءً حَيْثُ أَصَابَ
versets.phonetique: Fasakhkharna lahur-riha tajri bi'amrihi rukhaa'an haythu asab
versets.francais: Nous lui avons alors assujetti le vent soufflant avec douceur selon son ordre partout où il voulait aller.
versets.anglais: So We subjected to him the wind blowing by his command, gently, wherever he directed

versets.arabe: وَالشَّيَاطِينَ كُلَّ بَنَّاءٍ وَغَوَّاصٍ
versets.phonetique: Wash-shayatina kulla bannaa'iw wa ghawwas
versets.francais: Et (Nous lui avons assujetti) les démons, tous bâtisseurs et plongeurs.
versets.anglais: And [also] the devils [of jinn] - every builder and diver

versets.arabe: وَآخَرِينَ مُقَرَّنِينَ فِي الْأَصْفَادِ
versets.phonetique: Wa akharina muqarranina fil-asfad
versets.francais: Et d'autres enchaînés ensemble.
versets.anglais: And others bound together in shackles

versets.arabe: هَٰذَا عَطَاؤُنَا فَامْنُنْ أَوْ أَمْسِكْ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
versets.phonetique: Hadha 'ata'una famnun aw amsik bighayri hisab
versets.francais: "Voici Notre don : accorde-en ou retiens-en, sans compte à rendre."
versets.anglais: [We said], "This is Our gift, so grant or withhold without account

versets.arabe: وَإِنَّ لَهُ عِندَنَا لَزُلْفَىٰ وَحُسْنَ مَآبٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa inna lahu 'indana lazulfa wa husna ma'ab
versets.francais: Il aura vraiment auprès de Nous une place rapprochée et un beau retour.
versets.anglais: And indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return

versets.arabe: وَاذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا أَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُ أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ الضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wadhkur 'abdana ayyuba idh nada rabbahu anni massaniyad-durru wa anta arhamur-rahimin
versets.francais: Et rappelle Notre serviteur Job, quand il appela son Seigneur : "L'adversité m'a touché, et Tu es le plus Miséricordieux des miséricordieux."
versets.anglais: And remember Our servant Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, Satan has touched me with hardship and torment

versets.arabe: فَاسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُ فَكَشَفْنَا مَا بِهِ مِن ضُرٍّ ۖ وَآتَيْنَاهُ أَهْلَهُ وَمِثْلَهُم مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةً مِّنْ عِندِنَا وَذِكْرَىٰ لِلْعَابِدِينَ
versets.phonetique: Fastajabna lahu fakashafna ma bihi min durriw wa ataynahu ahlahu wa mithlahum ma'ahum rahmatam min 'indina wa dhikra lil-'abidin
versets.francais: Nous lui répondîmes et enlevâmes le mal dont il souffrait. Nous lui rendîmes sa famille et autant encore, par miséricorde de Notre part et comme rappel pour les adorateurs.
versets.anglais: [So he was told], "Strike [the ground] with your foot; this is a [spring for] a cool bath and drink

versets.arabe: وَخُذْ بِيَدِكَ ضِغْثًا فَاضْرِب بِّهِ وَلَا تَحْنَثْ ۗ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَاهُ صَابِرًا ۚ نِّعْمَ الْعَبْدُ ۖ إِنَّهُ أَوَّابٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa khudh biyadika dhighthan fadrib bihi wa la tahnathu inna wajadnahu sabiran ni'mal-'abdu innahu awwab
versets.francais: "Prends en main une botte d'herbes et frappe avec cela, et ne viole pas ton serment." Nous l'avons trouvé endurant. Quel excellent serviteur ! Il était très repentant.
versets.anglais: And We granted him his family and a like [number] with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for those of understanding

versets.arabe: وَاذْكُرْ عِبَادَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَإِسْحَاقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ أُولِي الْأَيْدِي وَالْأَبْصَارِ
versets.phonetique: Wadhkur 'ibadana ibrahima wa is-haqa wa ya'quba ulil-aydi wal-absar
versets.francais: Et rappelle Nos serviteurs Abraham, Isaac et Jacob, hommes de force et de clairvoyance.
versets.anglais: [We said], "And take in your hand a bunch [of grass] and strike with it and do not break your oath." Indeed, We found him patient, an excellent servant. Indeed, he was one repeatedly turning back [to Allah]

versets.arabe: إِنَّا أَخْلَصْنَاهُم بِخَالِصَةٍ ذِكْرَى الدَّارِ
versets.phonetique: Inna akhlasnahum bikhalisatin dhikrad-dar
versets.francais: Nous les avons vraiment choisis pour une qualité exclusive : le rappel de la demeure dernière.
versets.anglais: And remember Our servants, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob - those of strength and [religious] vision

versets.arabe: وَإِنَّهُمْ عِندَنَا لَمِنَ الْمُصْطَفَيْنَ الْأَخْيَارِ
versets.phonetique: Wa innahum 'indana laminal-mustafayal-akhyar
versets.francais: Ils sont vraiment auprès de Nous parmi les élus, les meilleurs.
versets.anglais: Indeed, We chose them for an exclusive quality: remembrance of the home [of the Hereafter]

versets.arabe: وَاذْكُرْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ وَالْيَسَعَ وَذَا الْكِفْلِ ۖ وَكُلٌّ مِّنَ الْأَخْيَارِ
versets.phonetique: Wadhkur isma'ila wal-yasa'a wa dhal-kifl wa kullum minal-akhyar
versets.francais: Et rappelle Ismaël, Al-Yasa' et Dhul-Kifl. Ils sont tous parmi les meilleurs.
versets.anglais: And indeed they are, to Us, among the chosen and outstanding

versets.arabe: هَٰذَا ذِكْرٌ ۚ وَإِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ لَحُسْنَ مَآبٍ
versets.phonetique: Hadha dhikr wa inna lil-muttaqina lahusna ma'ab
versets.francais: Voilà le rappel. Les pieux auront vraiment un beau retour :
versets.anglais: And remember Ishmael, Elisha and Dhul-Kifl, and all are among the outstanding

versets.arabe: جَنَّاتِ عَدْنٍ مُّفَتَّحَةً لَّهُمُ الْأَبْوَابُ
versets.phonetique: Jannati 'adnim mufattahatal lahumul-abwab
versets.francais: Des jardins d'éternité, dont les portes leur seront ouvertes.
versets.anglais: This is a reminder. And indeed, for the righteous is a good place of return

versets.arabe: مُتَّكِئِينَ فِيهَا يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِفَاكِهَةٍ كَثِيرَةٍ وَشَرَابٍ
versets.phonetique: Muttaki'ina fiha yad'una fiha bifakihatin kathiratiw wa sharab
versets.francais: Où ils seront accoudés, demandant de nombreux fruits et boissons.
versets.anglais: Gardens of perpetual residence, whose doors will be opened to them

versets.arabe: وَعِندَهُمْ قَاصِرَاتُ الطَّرْفِ أَتْرَابٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa 'indahum qasiratut-tarfi atrab
versets.francais: Et auprès d'eux des épouses au regard modeste, d'égal âge.
versets.anglais: Reclining within them, they will call therein for abundant fruit and drink

versets.arabe: هَٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِيَوْمِ الْحِسَابِ
versets.phonetique: Hadha ma tu'aduna li yawmil-hisab
versets.francais: Voilà ce qui vous est promis pour le Jour du Jugement.
versets.anglais: And with them will be women limiting [their] glances and of equal age

versets.arabe: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَرِزْقُنَا مَا لَهُ مِن نَّفَادٍ
versets.phonetique: Inna hadha larizquna ma lahu min nafad
versets.francais: C'est là Notre attribution inépuisable.
versets.anglais: This is what you, [the righteous], are promised for the Day of Account

versets.arabe: هَٰذَا ۚ وَإِنَّ لِلطَّاغِينَ لَشَرَّ مَآبٍ
versets.phonetique: Hadha wa inna lit-taghina lasharra ma'ab
versets.francais: Voilà. Et les transgresseurs auront vraiment le pire retour :
versets.anglais: Indeed, this is Our provision; for it there is no depletion

versets.arabe: جَهَنَّمَ يَصْلَوْنَهَا فَبِئْسَ الْمِهَادُ
versets.phonetique: Jahannama yaslaw naha fabi'sal-mihad
versets.francais: L'Enfer où ils brûleront. Quelle mauvaise couche !
versets.anglais: This [is so]. But indeed, for the transgressors is an evil place of return

versets.arabe: هَٰذَا فَلْيَذُوقُوهُ حَمِيمٌ وَغَسَّاقٌ
versets.phonetique: Hadha falyad huquhu hamimuw wa ghassaq
versets.francais: Voilà ! Qu'ils en goûtent donc : de l'eau bouillante et du pus.
versets.anglais: Hell, which they will [enter to] burn, and wretched is the resting place

versets.arabe: وَآخَرُ مِن شَكْلِهِ أَزْوَاجٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa akharu min shaklihi azwaj
versets.francais: Et d'autres tourments de même espèce, par paires.
versets.anglais: This - so let them taste it - is scalding water and [foul] purulence

versets.arabe: هَٰذَا فَوْجٌ مُّقْتَحِمٌ مَّعَكُمْ ۖ لَا مَرْحَبًا بِهِمْ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ صَالُو النَّارِ
versets.phonetique: Hadha fawjum muqtahimum ma'akum la marhaban bihim innahum salun-nar
versets.francais: "Voilà une troupe qui se précipite avec vous. Point de bienvenue pour eux ! Ils vont brûler dans le Feu."
versets.anglais: And other [punishments] of its type [in various] kinds

versets.arabe: قَالُوا بَلْ أَنتُمْ لَا مَرْحَبًا بِكُمْ ۖ أَنتُمْ قَدَّمْتُمُوهُ لَنَا ۖ فَبِئْسَ الْقَرَارُ
versets.phonetique: Qalu bal antum la marhaban bikum antum qaddamtumuhu lana fabi'sal-qarar
versets.francais: Ils dirent : "Non, c'est plutôt vous, point de bienvenue pour vous ! C'est vous qui nous l'avez préparé. Quelle mauvaise demeure !"
versets.anglais: [Its inhabitants will say], "This is a company bursting in with you. No welcome for them. Indeed, they will burn in the Fire

versets.arabe: قَالُوا رَبَّنَا مَن قَدَّمَ لَنَا هَٰذَا فَزِدْهُ عَذَابًا ضِعْفًا فِي النَّارِ
versets.phonetique: Qalu rabbana man qaddama lana hadha fazidhu 'adhaban di'fan fin-nar
versets.francais: Ils dirent : "Seigneur, celui qui nous a préparé cela, augmente-lui le châtiment double dans le Feu."
versets.anglais: They will say, "Nor you! No welcome for you. You, [our leaders], brought this upon us, and wretched is the settlement

versets.arabe: وَقَالُوا مَا لَنَا لَا نَرَىٰ رِجَالًا كُنَّا نَعُدُّهُم مِّنَ الْأَشْرَارِ
versets.phonetique: Wa qalu ma lana la nara rijalan kunna na'udduhum minal-ashrar
versets.francais: Et ils dirent : "Pourquoi ne voyons-nous pas des hommes que nous comptions parmi les méchants ?
versets.anglais: They will say, "Our Lord, whoever brought this upon us - increase for him double punishment in the Fire

versets.arabe: أَتَّخَذْنَاهُمْ سِخْرِيًّا أَمْ زَاغَتْ عَنْهُمُ الْأَبْصَارُ
versets.phonetique: Attakhadh nahum sikhriyan am zaghat 'anhumul-absar
versets.francais: Les avions-nous pris en dérision, ou bien nos regards les ont-ils manqués ?"
versets.anglais: And they will say, "Why do we not see men whom we used to count among the worst

versets.arabe: إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَحَقٌّ تَخَاصُمُ أَهْلِ النَّارِ
versets.phonetique: Inna dhalika lahaqqunn takhashumu ahlin-nar
versets.francais: Il est bien vrai que c'est là la querelle des gens du Feu.
versets.anglais: Is it [because] we took them in ridicule, or has [our] vision turned away from them

versets.arabe: قُلْ إِنَّمَا أَنَا مُنذِرٌ ۖ وَمَا مِنْ إِلَٰهٍ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْوَاحِدُ الْقَهَّارُ
versets.phonetique: Qul innama ana mundhiraw wa ma min ilahin illallahul-wahidul-qahhar
versets.francais: Dis : "Je ne suis qu'un avertisseur. Il n'y a de dieu qu'Allah, l'Unique, le Dominateur suprême."
versets.anglais: Indeed, that is truth - the quarreling of the people of the Fire

versets.arabe: رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا الْعَزِيزُ الْغَفَّارُ
versets.phonetique: Rabbus-samawati wal-ardi wa ma baynahumal-'azizul-ghaffar
versets.francais: Seigneur des cieux et de la terre et de ce qui est entre eux, le Tout-Puissant, le Très Pardonneur.
versets.anglais: Say, [O Muhammad], "I am only a warner, and there is not any deity except Allah, the One, the Prevailing

versets.arabe: قُلْ هُوَ نَبَأٌ عَظِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Qul huwa naba'un 'azim
versets.francais: Dis : "C'est une nouvelle importante.
versets.anglais: Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver

versets.arabe: أَنتُمْ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضُونَ
versets.phonetique: Antum 'anhu mu'ridun
versets.francais: Dont vous vous détournez."
versets.anglais: Say, "It is great news

versets.arabe: مَا كَانَ لِيَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ بِالْمَلَإِ الْأَعْلَىٰ إِذْ يَخْتَصِمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Ma kana liya min 'ilmim bil-mala'il-a'la idh yakhtasimun
versets.francais: Je n'avais aucune connaissance de l'Assemblée céleste suprême quand ils discutaient.
versets.anglais: From which you turn away

versets.arabe: إِن يُوحَىٰ إِلَيَّ إِلَّا أَنَّمَا أَنَا نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
versets.phonetique: In yuha ilayya illa annama ana nadhirum mubin
versets.francais: Il ne m'est révélé que ceci : je suis un avertisseur explicite.
versets.anglais: I had no knowledge of the exalted assembly [of angels] when they were disputing [the creation of Adam]

versets.arabe: إِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَائِكَةِ إِنِّي خَالِقٌ بَشَرًا مِّن طِينٍ
versets.phonetique: Idh qala rabbuka lil-mala'ikati inni khaliqum basharam min tin
versets.francais: Quand ton Seigneur dit aux anges : "Je vais créer un homme d'argile.
versets.anglais: It has not been revealed to me except that I am a clear warner

versets.arabe: فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِي فَقَعُوا لَهُ سَاجِدِينَ
versets.phonetique: Fa'idha sawwaytuhu wa nafakhtu fihi mir-ruhi faqa'u lahu sajidin
versets.francais: Quand Je l'aurai bien formé et y aurai insufflé de Mon esprit, prosternez-vous devant lui."
versets.anglais: [So mention] when your Lord said to the angels, "Indeed, I am going to create a human being from clay

versets.arabe: فَسَجَدَ الْمَلَائِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ
versets.phonetique: Fasajadal-mala'ikatu kulluhum ajma'un
versets.francais: Les anges se prosternèrent tous ensemble.
versets.anglais: So when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul, then fall down to him in prostration

versets.arabe: إِلَّا إِبْلِيسَ اسْتَكْبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ الْكَافِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Illa iblisa istakbara wa kana minal-kafirin
versets.francais: Sauf Iblis qui s'enfla d'orgueil et fut au nombre des mécréants.
versets.anglais: So the angels prostrated - all of them entirely

versets.arabe: قَالَ يَا إِبْلِيسُ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَن تَسْجُدَ لِمَا خَلَقْتُ بِيَدَيَّ ۖ أَسْتَكْبَرْتَ أَمْ كُنتَ مِنَ الْعَالِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qala ya iblisu ma mana'aka an tasjuda lima khalaqtu biyadayy astakbarta am kunta minal-'alin
versets.francais: Il dit : "Ô Iblis, qu'est-ce qui t'a empêché de te prosterner devant ce que J'ai créé de Mes deux mains ? T'es-tu enflé d'orgueil ou es-tu du nombre des hautains ?"
versets.anglais: Except Iblees; he was arrogant and became among the disbelievers

versets.arabe: قَالَ أَنَا خَيْرٌ مِّنْهُ ۖ خَلَقْتَنِي مِن نَّارٍ وَخَلَقْتَهُ مِن طِينٍ
versets.phonetique: Qala ana khayrum minhu khalaqtani min nariw wa khalaqtahu min tin
versets.francais: Il dit : "Je suis meilleur que lui : Tu m'as créé de feu, alors que Tu l'as créé d'argile."
versets.anglais: [Allah] said, "O Iblees, what prevented you from prostrating to that which I created with My hands? Were you arrogant [then], or were you [already] among the haughty

versets.arabe: قَالَ فَاخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Qala fakhruj minha fa'innaka rajim
versets.francais: Il dit : "Sors d'ici, tu es un réprouvé.
versets.anglais: He said, "I am better than him. You created me from fire and created him from clay

versets.arabe: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ لَعْنَتِي إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ الدِّينِ
versets.phonetique: Wa inna 'alayka la'nati ila yawmid-din
versets.francais: Et sur toi sera Ma malédiction jusqu'au Jour du Jugement."
versets.anglais: [Allah] said, "Then get out of Paradise, for indeed, you are expelled

versets.arabe: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرْنِي إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qala rabbi fa'anzhirni ila yawmi yub'athun
versets.francais: Il dit : "Seigneur, accorde-moi un délai jusqu'au Jour où ils seront ressuscités."
versets.anglais: And indeed, upon you is My curse until the Day of Recompense

versets.arabe: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ الْمُنظَرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qala fa'innaka minal-mundharin
versets.francais: Il dit : "Tu es parmi ceux à qui un délai est accordé,
versets.anglais: He said, "My Lord, then reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected

versets.arabe: إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ الْوَقْتِ الْمَعْلُومِ
versets.phonetique: Ila yawmil-waqtil-ma'lum
versets.francais: Jusqu'au Jour du Temps connu."
versets.anglais: [Allah] said, "So indeed, you are of those reprieved

versets.arabe: قَالَ فَبِعِزَّتِكَ لَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qala fabi'izzatika la'ughwiyannahum ajma'in
versets.francais: Il dit : "Par Ta puissance, je les égarerai tous,
versets.anglais: Until the Day of the time well-known

versets.arabe: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ الْمُخْلَصِينَ
versets.phonetique: Illa 'ibadaka minhumul-mukhlashin
versets.francais: Sauf Tes serviteurs sincèrement dévoués parmi eux."
versets.anglais: [Iblees] said, "By your might, I will surely mislead them all

versets.arabe: قَالَ فَالْحَقُّ وَالْحَقَّ أَقُولُ
versets.phonetique: Qala fal-haqqu wal-haqqa aqul
versets.francais: Il dit : "La vérité - et Je dis la vérité -
versets.anglais: Except, among them, Your chosen servants

versets.arabe: لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنكَ وَمِمَّن تَبِعَكَ مِنْهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
versets.phonetique: La'amla'anna jahannama minka wa mimman tabi'aka minhum ajma'in
versets.francais: Je remplirai l'Enfer de toi et de tous ceux d'entre eux qui te suivront."
versets.anglais: [Allah] said, "The truth [is My oath], and the truth I say

versets.arabe: قُلْ مَا أَسْأَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ وَمَا أَنَا مِنَ الْمُتَكَلِّفِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qul ma as'alukum 'alayhi min ajriw wa ma ana minal-mutakallafin
versets.francais: Dis : "Je ne vous demande aucun salaire pour cela, et je ne suis pas du nombre des imposteurs.
versets.anglais: [That] I will surely fill Hell with you and those of them that follow you all together

versets.arabe: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَالَمِينَ
versets.phonetique: In huwa illa dhikrul lil-'alamin
versets.francais: Ce n'est là qu'un rappel pour les mondes.
versets.anglais: Say, [O Muhammad], "I do not ask you for the Qur'an any payment, and I am not of the pretentious

versets.arabe: وَلَتَعْلَمُنَّ نَبَأَهُ بَعْدَ حِينٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa lata'lamunna naba'ahu ba'da hin
versets.francais: Et vous en saurez la nouvelle après un certain temps."
versets.anglais: It is but a reminder to the worlds

versets.arabe: تَنزِيلُ الْكِتَابِ مِنَ اللَّهِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَكِيمِ
versets.phonetique: Tanzeelul-kitaabi minallahil-azeezhil-hakeem
versets.francais: La révélation du Livre émane d'Allah le Puissant, le Sage
versets.anglais: The revelation of the Qur'an is from Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Wise

versets.arabe: إِنَّا أَنزَلْنَا إِلَيْكَ الْكِتَابَ بِالْحَقِّ فَاعْبُدِ اللَّهَ مُخْلِصًا لَّهُ الدِّينَ
versets.phonetique: Innaa anzalnaa ilaykal-kitaaba bil-haqqi fa'budillaaha mukhlisan lahud-deen
versets.francais: Nous t'avons révélé le Livre en toute vérité. Adore donc Allah en Lui vouant un culte exclusif
versets.anglais: Indeed, We have sent down to you the Book, [O Muhammad], in truth. So worship Allah, [being] sincere to Him in religion

versets.arabe: أَلَا لِلَّهِ الدِّينُ الْخَالِصُ
versets.phonetique: Alaa lillaahid-deenul-khaaalis
versets.francais: N'est-ce pas à Allah qu'appartient le culte pur ?
versets.anglais: Unquestionably, for Allah is the pure religion. And those who take protectors besides Him [say], "We only worship them that they may bring us nearer to Allah in position." Indeed, Allah will judge between them concerning that over which they differ. Indeed, Allah does not guide he who is a liar and [confirmed] disbeliever

versets.arabe: لَوْ أَرَادَ اللَّهُ أَن يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدًا لَّاصْطَفَىٰ مِمَّا يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَاءُ
versets.phonetique: Law araadallaahu an yattakhidha waladan lastafaa mimmaa yakhluqu maa yashaa
versets.francais: Si Allah avait voulu Se choisir un fils, Il aurait choisi ce qu'Il voulait parmi Ses créatures
versets.anglais: If Allah had intended to take a son, He could have chosen from what He creates whatever He willed. Exalted is He; He is Allah, the One, the Prevailing

versets.arabe: خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ بِالْحَقِّ
versets.phonetique: Khalaqas-samaawaati wal-arda bil-haqq
versets.francais: Il a créé les cieux et la terre en toute vérité
versets.anglais: He created the heavens and earth in truth. He wraps the night over the day and wraps the day over the night and has subjected the sun and the moon, each running [its course] for a specified term. Unquestionably, He is the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver

versets.arabe: خَلَقَكُم مِّن نَّفْسٍ وَاحِدَةٍ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنْهَا زَوْجَهَا
versets.phonetique: Khalaqakum min nafsin waahidatin thumma ja'ala minhaa zawjahaa
versets.francais: Il vous a créés d'une seule âme, puis Il en a tiré son épouse
versets.anglais: He created you from one soul. Then He made from it its mate, and He produced for you from the grazing livestock eight mates. He creates you in the wombs of your mothers, creation after creation, within three darknesses. That is Allah, your Lord; to Him belongs dominion. There is no deity except Him, so how are you averted

versets.arabe: إِن تَكْفُرُوا فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ غَنِيٌّ عَنكُمْ
versets.phonetique: In takfuroo fa-innallaaha ghanniyyun ankum
versets.francais: Si vous mécroissez, Allah Se passe de vous
versets.anglais: If you disbelieve - indeed, Allah is Free from need of you. And He does not approve for His servants disbelief. And if you are grateful, He approves it for you; and no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another. Then to your Lord is your return, and He will inform you about what you used to do. Indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا مَسَّ الْإِنسَانَ ضُرٌّ دَعَا رَبَّهُ مُنِيبًا إِلَيْهِ
versets.phonetique: Wa idhaa massal-insaana durrun da'aa rabbahoo muneeban ilayh
versets.francais: Quand un malheur touche l'homme, il implore son Seigneur en se tournant vers Lui
versets.anglais: And when adversity touches man, he calls upon his Lord, turning to Him [alone]; then when He bestows on him a favor from Himself, he forgets Him whom he called upon before, and he attributes to Allah equals to mislead [people] from His way. Say, "Enjoy your disbelief for a little; indeed, you are of the companions of the Fire

versets.arabe: أَمَّنْ هُوَ قَانِتٌ آنَاءَ اللَّيْلِ سَاجِدًا وَقَائِمًا
versets.phonetique: Amman huwa qaanitun aanaa'al-layli saajidan wa qaa'iman
versets.francais: Est-il comparable à celui qui accomplit ses dévotions pendant les heures de la nuit ?
versets.anglais: Is one who is devoutly obedient during periods of the night, prostrating and standing [in prayer], fearing the Hereafter and hoping for the mercy of his Lord, [like one who does not]? Say, "Are those who know equal to those who do not know?" Only they will remember [who are] people of understanding

versets.arabe: قُلْ يَا عِبَادِ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اتَّقُوا رَبَّكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Qul yaa 'ibaadil-ladheena aamanut-taqoo rabbakum
versets.francais: Dis : "Ô Mes serviteurs qui avez cru, craignez votre Seigneur"
versets.anglais: Say, "O My servants who have believed, fear your Lord. For those who do good in this world is good, and the earth of Allah is spacious. Indeed, the patient will be given their reward without account

versets.arabe: قُلْ إِنِّي أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَعْبُدَ اللَّهَ مُخْلِصًا لَّهُ الدِّينَ
versets.phonetique: Qul innee umirtu an a'budallaha mukhlisan lahud-deen
versets.francais: Dis : "Il m'a été ordonné d'adorer Allah en Lui vouant un culte exclusif"
versets.anglais: Say, [O Muhammad], "Indeed, I have been commanded to worship Allah, [being] sincere to Him in religion

versets.arabe: وَأُمِرْتُ لِأَنْ أَكُونَ أَوَّلَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa umirtu li-an akoona awwalal-muslimeen
versets.francais: Et il m'a été ordonné d'être le premier des Musulmans
versets.anglais: And I have been commanded to be the first [among you] of the Muslims

versets.arabe: قُلْ إِنِّي أَخَافُ إِنْ عَصَيْتُ رَبِّي عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
versets.phonetique: Qul innee akhafu in asaytu rabbee adhaaba yawmin azeem
versets.francais: Dis : "Je crains, si je désobéis à mon Seigneur, le châtiment d'un jour terrible"
versets.anglais: Say, "Indeed I fear, if I should disobey my Lord, the punishment of a tremendous Day

versets.arabe: قُلِ اللَّهَ أَعْبُدُ مُخْلِصًا لَّهُ دِينِي
versets.phonetique: Qulillaaha a'budu mukhlisan lahoo deeni
versets.francais: Dis : "C'est Allah que j'adore en Lui vouant mon culte exclusif"
versets.anglais: Say, "Allah [alone] do I worship, sincere to Him in my religion

versets.arabe: فَاعْبُدُوا مَا شِئْتُم مِّن دُونِهِ
versets.phonetique: Fa'budoo maa shi'tum min doonih
versets.francais: Adorez donc, en dehors de Lui, ce que vous voulez
versets.anglais: So worship what you will besides Him." Say, "Indeed, the losers are the ones who will lose themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection. Unquestionably, that is the manifest loss

versets.arabe: لَهُم مِّن فَوْقِهِمْ ظُلَلٌ مِّنَ النَّارِ وَمِن تَحْتِهِمْ ظُلَلٌ
versets.phonetique: Lahum min fawqihim zulalem minan-naari wa min tahtihim zulal
versets.francais: Ils auront au-dessus d'eux des couches de Feu et au-dessous d'eux des couches
versets.anglais: They will have canopies of fire above them and below them, canopies. By that Allah threatens His servants. O My servants, then fear Me

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ اجْتَنَبُوا الطَّاغُوتَ أَن يَعْبُدُوهَا وَأَنَابُوا إِلَى اللَّهِ لَهُمُ الْبُشْرَىٰ
versets.phonetique: Walladheena-jtanabut-taagoota an ya'budoohaa wa anaaboo ilallaahi lahumul-bushraa
versets.francais: Et ceux qui se sont éloignés des faux dieux et se sont tournés vers Allah, à eux la bonne nouvelle
versets.anglais: But those who have avoided Taghut, lest they worship it, and turned back to Allah - for them are good tidings. So give good tidings to My servants

versets.arabe: الَّذِينَ يَسْتَمِعُونَ الْقَوْلَ فَيَتَّبِعُونَ أَحْسَنَهُ
versets.phonetique: Alladheena yastami'oonal-qawla fayattabi'oona ahsanah
versets.francais: Ceux qui écoutent la parole et suivent ce qu'il y a de meilleur
versets.anglais: Who listen to speech and follow the best of it. Those are the ones Allah has guided, and those are people of understanding

versets.arabe: أَفَمَنْ حَقَّ عَلَيْهِ كَلِمَةُ الْعَذَابِ
versets.phonetique: Afaman haqqa alayhi kalimatul-adhaab
versets.francais: Celui contre qui la parole du châtiment s'est réalisée...
versets.anglais: Then, is one who has deserved the decree of punishment [to be guided]? Then, can you save one who is in the Fire

versets.arabe: لَٰكِنِ الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا رَبَّهُمْ لَهُمْ غُرَفٌ مِّن فَوْقِهَا غُرَفٌ
versets.phonetique: Laakinil-ladheena-ttaqaw rabbahum lahum ghurafum min fawqihaa ghuraf
versets.francais: Mais ceux qui ont craint leur Seigneur auront des chambres et au-dessus d'elles d'autres chambres
versets.anglais: But those who have feared their Lord - for them are chambers, above them chambers built high, beneath which rivers flow. [This is] the promise of Allah. Allah does not fail in [His] promise

versets.arabe: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ أَنزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَسَلَكَهُ يَنَابِيعَ فِي الْأَرْضِ
versets.phonetique: Alam tara annallaaha anzala minas-samaa'i maa'an fasalakahoo yanaabee'a fil-ard
versets.francais: N'as-tu pas vu qu'Allah fait descendre du ciel de l'eau et la fait circuler en sources dans la terre ?
versets.anglais: Do you not see that Allah sends down rain from the sky and makes it flow as springs [and rivers] in the earth; then He produces thereby crops of varying colors; then they dry and you see them turned yellow; then He makes them [scattered] debris. Indeed in that is a reminder for those of understanding

versets.arabe: أَفَمَن شَرَحَ اللَّهُ صَدْرَهُ لِلْإِسْلَامِ فَهُوَ عَلَىٰ نُورٍ مِّن رَّبِّهِ
versets.phonetique: Afaman sharahahllaahu sadrahu lil-islaami fa-huwa alaa noorim-mir-rabbih
versets.francais: Celui dont Allah a ouvert la poitrine à l'Islam et qui se trouve dans une lumière venant de son Seigneur...
versets.anglais: So is one whose breast Allah has expanded to [accept] Islam and he is upon a light from his Lord [like one whose heart rejects it]? Then woe to those whose hearts are hardened against the remembrance of Allah. Those are in manifest error

versets.arabe: اللَّهُ نَزَّلَ أَحْسَنَ الْحَدِيثِ كِتَابًا مُّتَشَابِهًا مَّثَانِيَ
versets.phonetique: Allaahu nazzala ahsanal-hadeeth kitaabam mutashaabihan mathaaniya
versets.francais: Allah a fait descendre le plus beau des récits : un Livre dont les parties se ressemblent et se répètent
versets.anglais: Allah has sent down the best statement: a consistent Book wherein is reiteration. The skins shiver therefrom of those who fear their Lord; then their skins and their hearts relax at the remembrance of Allah. That is the guidance of Allah by which He guides whom He wills. And one whom Allah leaves astray - for him there is no guide

versets.arabe: أَفَمَن يَتَّقِي بِوَجْهِهِ سُوءَ الْعَذَابِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ
versets.phonetique: Afaman yattaqee biwajhihee soo'al-adhaabi yawmal-qiyaamah
versets.francais: Celui qui le Jour de la Résurrection doit se protéger le visage du mauvais châtiment...
versets.anglais: Then is he who will shield with his face the worst of the punishment on the Day of Resurrection [like one secure from it]? And it will be said to the wrongdoers, "Taste what you used to earn

versets.arabe: كَذَّبَ الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَأَتَاهُمُ الْعَذَابُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Kadhdhabal-ladheena min qablihim fa-ataahumu-l-adhabu min haythu laa yash'uroon
versets.francais: Ceux qui étaient avant eux ont traité [leurs prophètes] de menteurs et le châtiment les a atteints à l'improviste
versets.anglais: Those before them denied, and punishment came upon them from where they did not perceive

versets.arabe: فَأَذَاقَهُمُ اللَّهُ الْخِزْيَ فِي الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا
versets.phonetique: Fa-adhaqahumul-laahul-khizya fil-hayaatid-dunyaa
versets.francais: Allah leur a donc fait goûter l'humiliation dans la vie présente
versets.anglais: So Allah made them taste disgrace in worldly life. But the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ ضَرَبْنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِي هَٰذَا الْقُرْآنِ مِن كُلِّ مَثَلٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa laqad darabnaa lin-naasi fee haadhal-qur'aani min kulli mathal
versets.francais: Nous avons certes proposé aux hommes dans ce Coran toutes sortes d'exemples
versets.anglais: And We have certainly presented for the people in this Qur'an from every [kind of] example - that they might remember

versets.arabe: قُرْآنًا عَرَبِيًّا غَيْرَ ذِي عِوَجٍ لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qur'aanan arabiyyan ghayra dhee iwajin la'allahum yattaqoon
versets.francais: Un Coran en arabe sans aucune ambiguïté, afin qu'ils soient pieux
versets.anglais: [It is] an Arabic Qur'an, without any deviance that they might become righteous

versets.arabe: ضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلًا رَّجُلًا فِيهِ شُرَكَاءُ مُتَشَاكِسُونَ وَرَجُلًا سَلَمًا لِّرَجُلٍ
versets.phonetique: Daraballaahu mathalan rajulan feehi shurakaa'u mutashaakisoon wa rajulan salaman li-rajul
versets.francais: Allah propose en exemple un homme appartenant à plusieurs associés qui se querellent, et un homme appartenant entièrement à un seul homme
versets.anglais: Allah presents an example: a slave owned by quarreling partners and another belonging exclusively to one man - are they equal in comparison? Praise be to Allah! But most of them do not know

versets.arabe: إِنَّكَ مَيِّتٌ وَإِنَّهُم مَّيِّتُونَ
versets.phonetique: Innaka mayyitun wa innahum mayyitoon
versets.francais: Tu mourras certes et ils mourront aussi
versets.anglais: Indeed, you are to die, and indeed, they are to die

versets.arabe: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ عِندَ رَبِّكُمْ تَخْتَصِمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Thumma innakum yawmal-qiyaamati inda rabbikum takhtasimoon
versets.francais: Puis le Jour de la Résurrection vous vous disputerez devant votre Seigneur
versets.anglais: Then indeed you, on the Day of Resurrection, before your Lord, will dispute

versets.arabe: فَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّن كَذَبَ عَلَى اللَّهِ وَكَذَّبَ بِالصِّدْقِ
versets.phonetique: Faman azlamu mimman kadhaba alallahi wa kadhdhaba bis-sidq
versets.francais: Qui est plus injuste que celui qui ment sur Allah et traite de mensonge la vérité ?
versets.anglais: So who is more unjust than one who lies about Allah and denies the truth when it has come to him? Is there not in Hell a residence for the disbelievers

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِي جَاءَ بِالصِّدْقِ وَصَدَّقَ بِهِ أُولَٰئِكَ هُمُ الْمُتَّقُونَ
versets.phonetique: Walladhee jaa'a bis-sidqi wa saddaqa bihi ulaa'ika humul-muttaqoon
versets.francais: Et celui qui apporte la vérité et celui qui y croit, ce sont eux les pieux
versets.anglais: And the one who has brought the truth and [they who] believed in it - those are the righteous

versets.arabe: لَهُم مَّا يَشَاءُونَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ ذَٰلِكَ جَزَاءُ الْمُحْسِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Lahum maa yashaaoona inda rabbihim, dhaalika jazaa'ul-muhsineen
versets.francais: Ils auront auprès de leur Seigneur ce qu'ils voudront. Telle est la récompense des bienfaisants
versets.anglais: They will have whatever they desire with their Lord. That is the reward of the doers of good

versets.arabe: لِيُكَفِّرَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ أَسْوَأَ الَّذِي عَمِلُوا
versets.phonetique: Liyukaffirallaahu anhum aswa'al-ladhee amiloo
versets.francais: Pour qu'Allah leur efface les pires de leurs actions
versets.anglais: That Allah may remove from them the worst of what they did and reward them their due for the best of what they used to do

versets.arabe: أَلَيْسَ اللَّهُ بِكَافٍ عَبْدَهُ
versets.phonetique: Alaysal-laahu bikaafin abdah
versets.francais: Allah ne suffit-Il pas à Son serviteur ?
versets.anglais: Is not Allah sufficient for His Servant [Prophet Muhammad]? And [yet], they threaten you with those [they worship] other than Him. And whoever Allah leaves astray - for him there is no guide

versets.arabe: وَمَن يَهْدِ اللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُ مِن مُّضِلٍّ
versets.phonetique: Wa man yahdillaahu famaa lahoo min mudill
versets.francais: Celui qu'Allah guide, nul ne peut l'égarer
versets.anglais: And whoever Allah guides - for him there is no misleader. Is not Allah Exalted in Might and Owner of Retribution

versets.arabe: وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ اللَّهُ
versets.phonetique: Wa la'in sa'altahum man khalaqas-samaawaati wal-arda layaqoolunnallaah
versets.francais: Si tu leur demandes qui a créé les cieux et la terre, ils diront certes : "Allah"
versets.anglais: And if you asked them, "Who created the heavens and the earth?" they would surely say, "Allah." Say, "Then have you considered what you invoke besides Allah? If Allah intended me harm, are they removers of His harm; or if He intended me mercy, are they withholders of His mercy?" Say, "Sufficient for me is Allah; upon Him [alone] rely the [wise] reliers

versets.arabe: قُلْ يَا قَوْمِ اعْمَلُوا عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِكُمْ إِنِّي عَامِلٌ
versets.phonetique: Qul yaa qawmi'maloo alaa makanatikum innee aamil
versets.francais: Dis : "Ô mon peuple ! Agissez selon votre état, j'agis moi aussi"
versets.anglais: Say, "O my people, work according to your position, [for] indeed, I am working; and you are going to know

versets.arabe: فَمَنْ يَأْتِيهِ عَذَابٌ يُخْزِيهِ
versets.phonetique: Faman ya'teehi adhaabun yukhzeeh
versets.francais: À qui viendra un châtiment qui l'humiliera ?
versets.anglais: To whom will come a torment disgracing him and on whom will descend an enduring punishment

versets.arabe: إِنَّا أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ الْكِتَابَ لِلنَّاسِ بِالْحَقِّ
versets.phonetique: Innaa anzalnaa alaykal-kitaaba lin-naasi bil-haqq
versets.francais: Nous t'avons révélé le Livre pour les hommes en toute vérité
versets.anglais: Indeed, We sent down to you the Book for the people in truth. So whoever is guided - it is for [the benefit of] his soul; and whoever goes astray only goes astray to its detriment. And you are not a manager over them

versets.arabe: اللَّهُ يَتَوَفَّى الْأَنفُسَ حِينَ مَوْتِهَا
versets.phonetique: Allaahu yatawaffal-anfusa heena mawtihaa
versets.francais: Allah retient les âmes au moment de leur mort
versets.anglais: Allah takes the souls at the time of their death, and those that do not die [He takes] during their sleep. Then He keeps those for which He has decreed death and releases the others for a specified term. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought

versets.arabe: أَمِ اتَّخَذُوا مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ شُفَعَاءَ
versets.phonetique: Amit-takhadhoo min doonillaahi shufa'aa
versets.francais: Ont-ils pris des intercesseurs en dehors d'Allah ?
versets.anglais: Or have they taken other than Allah as intercessors? Say, "Even though they do not possess [power over] anything, nor do they reason

versets.arabe: قُل لِّلَّهِ الشَّفَاعَةُ جَمِيعًا
versets.phonetique: Qul lillaahish-shafaa'atu jamee'aa
versets.francais: Dis : "L'intercession appartient entièrement à Allah"
versets.anglais: Say, "To Allah belongs [the right to allow] intercession entirely. To Him belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. Then to Him you will be returned

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا ذُكِرَ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ اشْمَأَزَّتْ قُلُوبُ الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْآخِرَةِ
versets.phonetique: Wa idhaa dhukiral-laahu wahdahush-ma'azzat quloobul-ladheena laa yu'minoona bil-aakhirah
versets.francais: Quand on mentionne Allah seul, les cœurs de ceux qui ne croient pas en l'au-delà se soulèvent de dégoût
versets.anglais: And when Allah is mentioned alone, the hearts of those who do not believe in the Hereafter shrink with aversion, but when those [worshipped] other than Him are mentioned, immediately they rejoice

versets.arabe: قُلِ اللَّهُمَّ فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ
versets.phonetique: Qulil-laahumma faatirassamaawaati wal-ard
versets.francais: Dis : "Ô Allah, Créateur des cieux et de la terre"
versets.anglais: Say, "O Allah, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, You will judge between your servants concerning that over which they used to differ

versets.arabe: وَلَوْ أَنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا مَا فِي الْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا لَافْتَدَوْا بِهِ
versets.phonetique: Wa law anna lilladheena zalamoo maa fil-ardi jamee'an laftadaw bih
versets.francais: Si les injustes possédaient tout ce qui est sur la terre, ils l'offriraient pour se racheter
versets.anglais: And if those who did wrong had all that is in the earth entirely and the like of it with it, they would [attempt to] ransom themselves thereby from the worst of the punishment on the Day of Resurrection. And there will appear to them from Allah that which they had not taken into account

versets.arabe: وَبَدَا لَهُمْ سَيِّئَاتُ مَا كَسَبُوا
versets.phonetique: Wa badaa lahum sayyi'aatu maa kasaboo
versets.francais: Le mal de ce qu'ils ont acquis leur apparaîtra
versets.anglais: And there will appear to them the evils they had earned, and they will be enveloped by what they used to ridicule

versets.arabe: فَإِذَا مَسَّ الْإِنسَانَ ضُرٌّ دَعَانَا
versets.phonetique: Fa-idha massal-insaana durrun da'aanaa
versets.francais: Quand un malheur touche l'homme, il Nous invoque
versets.anglais: And when adversity touches man, he calls upon Us; then when We bestow on him a favor from Us, he says, "I have only been given it because of [my] knowledge." Rather, it is a trial, but most of them do not know

versets.arabe: قَدْ قَالَهَا الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَمَا أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا يَكْسِبُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qad qaalahaal-ladheena min qablihim famaa aghnaa anhum maa kaanoo yaksiboon
versets.francais: Ceux qui étaient avant eux l'ont dit aussi. Ce qu'ils acquéraient ne leur a servi à rien
versets.anglais: Those before them had already said it, but they were not availed by what they used to earn

versets.arabe: فَأَصَابَهُمْ سَيِّئَاتُ مَا كَسَبُوا
versets.phonetique: Fa-asaabahum sayyi'aatu maa kasaboo
versets.francais: Les méfaits de ce qu'ils avaient acquis les ont atteints
versets.anglais: And the evil consequences of what they earned struck them. And those who have wronged of these [people] will be afflicted by the evil consequences of what they earned; and they will not cause failure

versets.arabe: أَوَلَمْ يَعْلَمُوا أَنَّ اللَّهَ يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَاءُ وَيَقْدِرُ
versets.phonetique: Awa lam ya'lamoo annallaaha yabsutur-rizqa liman yashaa'u wa yaqdir
versets.francais: Ne savent-ils pas qu'Allah accroît Ses dons pour qui Il veut et les restreint ?
versets.anglais: Do they not know that Allah extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it]? Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe

versets.arabe: قُلْ يَا عِبَادِيَ الَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوا عَلَىٰ أَنفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوا مِن رَّحْمَةِ اللَّهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعًا
versets.phonetique: Qul yaa ibaadiyal-ladheena asrafoo alaa anfusihim laa taqnatoo mir-rahmatillaah, innallaaha yaghfirudh-dhunooba jamee'aa
versets.francais: Dis : "Ô Mes serviteurs qui avez commis des excès, ne désespérez pas de la miséricorde d'Allah. Allah pardonne tous les péchés"
versets.anglais: Say, "O My servants who have transgressed against themselves [by sinning], do not despair of the mercy of Allah. Indeed, Allah forgives all sins. Indeed, it is He who is the Forgiving, the Merciful

versets.arabe: وَأَنِيبُوا إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمْ وَأَسْلِمُوا لَهُ
versets.phonetique: Wa aneeboo ilaa rabbikum wa aslimoo lah
versets.francais: Et revenez vers votre Seigneur et soumettez-vous à Lui
versets.anglais: And return [in repentance] to your Lord and submit to Him before the punishment comes upon you; then you will not be helped

versets.arabe: وَاتَّبِعُوا أَحْسَنَ مَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكُم مِّن رَّبِّكُم
versets.phonetique: Wattabi'oo ahsana maaa unzila ilaykum mir-rabbikum
versets.francais: Et suivez ce qu'il y a de meilleur dans ce qui vous a été révélé de votre Seigneur
versets.anglais: And follow the best of what was revealed to you from your Lord before the punishment comes upon you suddenly while you do not perceive

versets.arabe: أَن تَقُولَ نَفْسٌ يَا حَسْرَتَىٰ عَلَىٰ مَا فَرَّطتُ فِي جَنبِ اللَّهِ
versets.phonetique: An taqoola nafsun yaa hasrataa alaa maa farratutu fee jambillaah
versets.francais: De peur qu'une âme ne dise : "Quel regret d'avoir négligé mon devoir envers Allah"
versets.anglais: Lest a soul should say, "Oh [how great is] my regret over what I neglected in regard to Allah and that I was among the mockers

versets.arabe: أَوْ تَقُولَ لَوْ أَنَّ اللَّهَ هَدَانِي لَكُنتُ مِنَ الْمُتَّقِينَ
versets.phonetique: Aw taqoola law annallaaha hadaanee lakuntu minal-muttaqeen
versets.francais: Ou qu'elle dise : "Si Allah m'avait guidé, j'aurais certes été du nombre des pieux"
versets.anglais: Or [lest] it say, "If only Allah had guided me, I would have been among the righteous

versets.arabe: أَوْ تَقُولَ حِينَ تَرَى الْعَذَابَ لَوْ أَنَّ لِي كَرَّةً
versets.phonetique: Aw taqoola heena taral-adhaaba law anna lee karrah
versets.francais: Ou qu'elle dise en voyant le châtiment : "Si seulement j'avais une seconde chance"
versets.anglais: Or [lest] it say when it sees the punishment, "If only I had another turn so I could be among the doers of good

versets.arabe: بَلَىٰ قَدْ جَاءَتْكَ آيَاتِي فَكَذَّبْتَ بِهَا وَاسْتَكْبَرْتَ
versets.phonetique: Balaa qad jaa'atka aayaatee fakadhdhabta bihaa wastakbart
versets.francais: Si fait ! Mes versets t'étaient venus, mais tu les as traités de mensonges et tu t'es montré arrogant
versets.anglais: But yes, there had come to you My verses, but you denied them and were arrogant, and you were among the disbelievers

versets.arabe: وَيَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ تَرَى الَّذِينَ كَذَبُوا عَلَى اللَّهِ وُجُوهُهُم مُّسْوَدَّةٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa yawmal-qiyaamati taral-ladheena kadhaboo alallahi wujoohuhum muswaddah
versets.francais: Le Jour de la Résurrection, tu verras ceux qui ont menti sur Allah avec leurs visages noircis
versets.anglais: And on the Day of Resurrection you will see those who lied about Allah [with] their faces blackened. Is there not in Hell a residence for the arrogant

versets.arabe: وَيُنَجِّي اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا بِمَفَازَتِهِمْ
versets.phonetique: Wa yunajjillaahul-ladheena-ttaqaw bimafaazatihim
versets.francais: Et Allah sauvera les pieux grâce à leurs succès
versets.anglais: And Allah will save those who feared Him by their attainment; no evil will touch them, nor will they grieve

versets.arabe: اللَّهُ خَالِقُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَكِيلٌ
versets.phonetique: Allaahu khaaliqukkulli shay'in wa huwa alaa kulli shay'in wakeel
versets.francais: Allah est le Créateur de toute chose et Il est le Garant de toute chose
versets.anglais: Allah is the Creator of all things, and He is, over all things, Disposer of affairs

versets.arabe: لَهُ مَقَالِيدُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ
versets.phonetique: Lahoo maqaaleedus-samaawaati wal-ard
versets.francais: À Lui appartiennent les clés des cieux et de la terre
versets.anglais: To Him belong the keys of the heavens and the earth. And they who disbelieve in the verses of Allah - it is those who are the losers

versets.arabe: قُلْ أَفَغَيْرَ اللَّهِ تَأْمُرُونِّي أَعْبُدُ
versets.phonetique: Qul afaghayrallaahi ta'muroonneee a'bud
versets.francais: Dis : "M'ordonnez-vous d'adorer autre qu'Allah ?"
versets.anglais: Say, [O Muhammad], "Is it other than Allah that you order me to worship, O ignorant ones

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ أُوحِيَ إِلَيْكَ لَئِنْ أَشْرَكْتَ لَيَحْبَطَنَّ عَمَلُكَ
versets.phonetique: Wa laqad oohiya ilayka la'in ashrakta layahbatanna amaluk
versets.francais: Il t'a été révélé : "Si tu associes [quoi que ce soit à Allah], ton œuvre sera anéantie"
versets.anglais: And it was already revealed to you and to those before you that if you should associate [anything] with Allah, your work would surely become worthless, and you would surely be among the losers

versets.arabe: بَلِ اللَّهَ فَاعْبُدْ وَكُن مِّنَ الشَّاكِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Balillaaha fa'bud wa kum minash-shaakireen
versets.francais: Adore plutôt Allah et sois du nombre des reconnaissants
versets.anglais: Rather, worship [only] Allah and be among the grateful

versets.arabe: وَمَا قَدَرُوا اللَّهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهِ وَالْأَرْضُ جَمِيعًا قَبْضَتُهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ
versets.phonetique: Wa maa qadarullaaha haqqa qadrihee wal-ardu jamee'an qabdatuhu yawmal-qiyaamah
versets.francais: Ils n'ont pas accordé à Allah la valeur qui Lui est due. Le Jour de la Résurrection, la terre sera entièrement dans Sa poigne
versets.anglais: They have not appraised Allah with true appraisal, while the earth entirely will be [within] His grip on the Day of Resurrection, and the heavens will be folded in His right hand. Exalted is He and high above what they associate with Him

versets.arabe: وَنُفِخَ فِي الصُّورِ فَصَعِقَ مَن فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَن فِي الْأَرْضِ
versets.phonetique: Wa nufikha fis-soori fasa'iqa man fis-samaawaati wa man fil-ard
versets.francais: La Trompe sera soufflée et tous ceux qui sont dans les cieux et sur la terre s'effondreront
versets.anglais: And the Horn will be blown, and whoever is in the heavens and whoever is on the earth will fall dead except whom Allah wills. Then it will be blown again, and at once they will be standing, looking on

versets.arabe: وَأَشْرَقَتِ الْأَرْضُ بِنُورِ رَبِّهَا وَوُضِعَ الْكِتَابُ
versets.phonetique: Wa ashraqatil-ardu binoori rabbihaa wa wudi'al-kitaab
versets.francais: La terre resplendira de la lumière de son Seigneur et le Registre sera posé
versets.anglais: And the earth will shine with the light of its Lord, and the record [of deeds] will be placed, and the prophets and the witnesses will be brought, and it will be judged between them in truth, and they will not be wronged

versets.arabe: وَوُفِّيَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّا عَمِلَتْ
versets.phonetique: Wa wuffiyat kullu nafsim maa amilat
versets.francais: Chaque âme sera rétribuée selon ses actes
versets.anglais: And every soul will be fully compensated [for] what it did; and He is most knowing of what they do

versets.arabe: وَسِيقَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ زُمَرًا
versets.phonetique: Wa seeqal-ladheena kafaroo ilaa jahannama zumaraa
versets.francais: Les mécréants seront conduits en groupes vers la Géhenne
versets.anglais: And those who disbelieved will be driven to Hell in groups until, when they reach it, its gates are opened and its keepers will say, "Did there not come to you messengers from yourselves, reciting to you the verses of your Lord and warning you of the meeting of this Day of yours?" They will say, "Yes, but the word of punishment has come into effect upon the disbelievers

versets.arabe: قِيلَ ادْخُلُوا أَبْوَابَ جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا
versets.phonetique: Qeelad-khuloo abwaaba jahannama khaalideena feehaa
versets.francais: On leur dira : "Entrez par les portes de la Géhenne pour y demeurer éternellement"
versets.anglais: [To them] it will be said, "Enter the gates of Hell to abide eternally therein, and wretched is the residence of the arrogant

versets.arabe: وَسِيقَ الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا رَبَّهُمْ إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ زُمَرًا
versets.phonetique: Wa seeqal-ladheena-ttaqaw rabbahum ilal-jannati zumaraa
versets.francais: Et les pieux seront conduits en groupes vers le Paradis
versets.anglais: But those who feared their Lord will be driven to Paradise in groups until, when they reach it while its gates have been opened and its keepers say, "Peace be upon you; you have become pure; so enter it to abide eternally therein," [they will enter]

versets.arabe: وَقَالُوا الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي صَدَقَنَا وَعْدَهُ
versets.phonetique: Wa qaalul-hamdu lillaahil-ladhee sadaqanaa wa'dah
versets.francais: Ils diront : "Louange à Allah qui a tenu Sa promesse envers nous"
versets.anglais: And they will say, "Praise to Allah, who has fulfilled for us His promise and made us inherit the earth [so] we may settle in Paradise wherever we will. And excellent is the reward of [righteous] workers

versets.arabe: وَتَرَى الْمَلَائِكَةَ حَافِّينَ مِنْ حَوْلِ الْعَرْشِ يُسَبِّحُونَ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ
versets.phonetique: Wa taral-malaa'ikata haaffeena min hawlil-arshi yusabbihoona bihamdi rabbihim
versets.francais: Et tu verras les anges faisant cercle autour du Trône, célébrant les louanges de leur Seigneur
versets.anglais: And you will see the angels surrounding the Throne, exalting [Allah] with praise of their Lord. And it will be judged between them in truth, and it will be said, "[All] praise to Allah, Lord of the worlds

versets.arabe: حم
versets.phonetique: Ha Mim
versets.francais: Ha. Mim.
versets.anglais: Ha, Meem

versets.arabe: تَنزِيلُ الْكِتَابِ مِنَ اللَّهِ الْعَزِيزِ الْعَلِيمِ
versets.phonetique: Tanzilul-kitabi minallahil-'azizil-'alim
versets.francais: La révélation du Livre émanant d'Allah, le Tout-Puissant, l'Omniscient.
versets.anglais: The revelation of the Book is from Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Knowing

versets.arabe: غَافِرِ الذَّنبِ وَقَابِلِ التَّوْبِ شَدِيدِ الْعِقَابِ ذِي الطَّوْلِ ۖ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ إِلَيْهِ الْمَصِيرُ
versets.phonetique: Ghafirith-dhanbi wa qabilit-tawbi shadidil-'iqabi dhit-tawl la ilaha illa huwa ilayhil-masir
versets.francais: Qui pardonne le péché, qui accepte le repentir, qui est sévère dans le châtiment et plein de munificence. Point de divinité que Lui. Vers Lui est le retour.
versets.anglais: The forgiver of sin, acceptor of repentance, severe in punishment, owner of abundance. There is no deity except Him; to Him is the destination

versets.arabe: مَا يُجَادِلُ فِي آيَاتِ اللَّهِ إِلَّا الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا فَلَا يَغْرُرْكَ تَقَلُّبُهُمْ فِي الْبِلَادِ
versets.phonetique: Ma yujadilu fi ayatillahi illal-ladhina kafaru fala yaghurrka taqallubuhum fil-bilad
versets.francais: Seuls ceux qui ont mécru disputent à propos des versets d'Allah. Que leur allée et venue dans les pays ne te séduise donc pas.
versets.anglais: No one disputes concerning the signs of Allah except those who disbelieve, so be not deceived by their [uninhibited] movement throughout the land

versets.arabe: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَالْأَحْزَابُ مِن بَعْدِهِمْ ۖ وَهَمَّتْ كُلُّ أُمَّةٍ بِرَسُولِهِمْ لِيَأْخُذُوهُ ۖ وَجَادَلُوا بِالْبَاطِلِ لِيُدْحِضُوا بِهِ الْحَقَّ فَأَخَذْتُهُمْ ۖ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عِقَابِ
versets.phonetique: Kadhdhabat qablahum qawmu nuhin wal-ahzabu mim ba'dihim wa hammat kullu ummatin birasulihim liya'khudhuh wa jadalu bil-batili liyudhidu bihil-haqqa fa'akhadhtuhu fakayfa kana 'iqab
versets.francais: Avant eux, le peuple de Noé et les coalisés après eux ont démenti. Chaque communauté a comploté contre son messager pour le saisir et ils ont disputé avec le faux pour réfuter avec lui le vrai. Alors Je les ai saisis. Et quel a été Mon châtiment !
versets.anglais: The people of Noah denied before them and the [disbelieving] factions after them, and every nation intended [a plot] for their messenger to seize him, and they disputed by [using] falsehood to [attempt to] invalidate thereby the truth. So I seized them, and how [terrible] was My penalty

versets.arabe: وَكَذَٰلِكَ حَقَّتْ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ عَلَى الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا أَنَّهُمْ أَصْحَابُ النَّارِ
versets.phonetique: Wa kadhalika haqqat kalimatu rabbika 'alal-ladhina kafaru annahum as-habun-nar
versets.francais: C'est ainsi que la parole de ton Seigneur s'est avérée méritée contre ceux qui ont mécru qu'ils seront les gens du Feu.
versets.anglais: And thus has the word of your Lord come into effect upon those who disbelieved that they are companions of the Fire

versets.arabe: الَّذِينَ يَحْمِلُونَ الْعَرْشَ وَمَنْ حَوْلَهُ يُسَبِّحُونَ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ وَيُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِ وَيَسْتَغْفِرُونَ لِلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا رَبَّنَا وَسِعْتَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ رَّحْمَةً وَعِلْمًا فَاغْفِرْ لِلَّذِينَ تَابُوا وَاتَّبَعُوا سَبِيلَكَ وَقِهِمْ عَذَابَ الْجَحِيمِ
versets.phonetique: Alladhina yahmilul-'arsha wa man hawlahu yusabbihuna bihamdi rabbihim wa yu'minuna bihi wa yastaghfiruna lil-ladhina amanu rabbana wasi'ta kulla shay'ir rahmataw wa 'ilman faghfir lil-ladhina tabu wattaba'u sabilaka wa qihim 'adhaba jahim
versets.francais: Ceux qui portent le Trône et ceux qui l'entourent glorifient leur Seigneur en Le louant, croient en Lui et demandent pardon pour ceux qui ont cru : "Seigneur, Tu embrasses toute chose par Ta miséricorde et Ta science. Pardonne donc à ceux qui se sont repentis et qui ont suivi Ton chemin, et préserve-les du châtiment de l'Enfer."
versets.anglais: Those [angels] who carry the Throne and those around it exalt [Allah] with praise of their Lord and believe in Him and ask forgiveness for those who have believed, [saying], "Our Lord, You have encompassed all things in mercy and knowledge, so forgive those who have repented and followed Your way and protect them from the punishment of Hellfire

versets.arabe: رَبَّنَا وَأَدْخِلْهُمْ جَنَّاتِ عَدْنٍ الَّتِي وَعَدتَّهُمْ وَمَن صَلَحَ مِنْ آبَائِهِمْ وَأَزْوَاجِهِمْ وَذُرِّيَّاتِهِمْ ۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ
versets.phonetique: Rabbana wa adkhilhum jannati 'adninillatee wa'adttahum wa man salaha min aba'ihim wa azwajihim wa dhurriyyatihim innaka antal-'azizul-hakim
versets.francais: "Seigneur, fais-les entrer dans les jardins d'éternité que Tu leur as promis, ainsi qu'à leurs parents, leurs épouses et leurs descendants qui auront été vertueux. Tu es le Tout-Puissant, le Sage."
versets.anglais: Our Lord, and admit them to gardens of perpetual residence which You have promised them and whoever was righteous among their fathers, their spouses and their offspring. Indeed, it is You who is the Exalted in Might, the Wise

versets.arabe: وَقِهِمُ السَّيِّئَاتِ ۚ وَمَن تَقِ السَّيِّئَاتِ يَوْمَئِذٍ فَقَدْ رَحِمْتَهُ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ
versets.phonetique: Wa qihimus-sayyi'at wa man taqis-sayyi'ati yawma'idhin faqad rahimtahu wa dhalika huwal-fawzul-'azim
versets.francais: "Et préserve-les des mauvaises actions. Et celui que Tu préserveras des mauvaises actions en ce jour, Tu lui auras fait miséricorde. C'est là le suprême succès."
versets.anglais: And protect them from the evil consequences [of their deeds]. And he whom You protect from evil consequences that Day - You will have given him mercy. And that is the great attainment

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا يُنَادَوْنَ لَمَقْتُ اللَّهِ أَكْبَرُ مِن مَّقْتِكُمْ أَنفُسَكُمْ إِذْ تُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى الْإِيمَانِ فَتَكْفُرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Innal-ladhina kafaru yunadawna lamaqtullahi akbaru mim maqtikum anfusakum idh tud'awna ilal-imani fatakfurun
versets.francais: Ceux qui ont mécru seront interpellés : "La répugnance d'Allah envers vous est plus grande que votre répugnance envers vous-mêmes, puisque vous étiez appelés à la foi et vous mécriez."
versets.anglais: Indeed, those who disbelieve will be addressed, "The hatred of Allah for you was [even] greater than your hatred of yourselves [this Day in Hell] when you were invited to faith, but you refused

versets.arabe: قَالُوا رَبَّنَا أَمَتَّنَا اثْنَتَيْنِ وَأَحْيَيْتَنَا اثْنَتَيْنِ فَاعْتَرَفْنَا بِذُنُوبِنَا فَهَلْ إِلَىٰ خُرُوجٍ مِّن سَبِيلٍ
versets.phonetique: Qalu rabbana amattanaththnatayni wa ahyaytanathnatayn fa'tarafna bidhunubina fahal ila khurujim min sabil
versets.francais: Ils diront : "Seigneur, Tu nous as fait mourir deux fois et Tu nous as fait vivre deux fois. Nous avouons nos péchés. Y a-t-il un moyen de sortir ?"
versets.anglais: They will say, "Our Lord, You made us lifeless twice and gave us life twice, and we have confessed our sins. So is there to an exit any way

versets.arabe: ذَٰلِكُم بِأَنَّهُ إِذَا دُعِيَ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ كَفَرْتُمْ ۖ وَإِن يُشْرَكْ بِهِ تُؤْمِنُوا ۚ فَالْحُكْمُ لِلَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْكَبِيرِ
versets.phonetique: Dhalikum bi'annahu idha du'iyallahu wahdahu kafartum wa in yushrak bihi tu'minu fal-hukmu lillahil-'aliyyil-kabir
versets.francais: Cela, parce que quand Allah seul était invoqué, vous mécriez, et si on Lui associait quelque chose, vous croyiez. Le jugement appartient à Allah, le Très-Haut, le Très-Grand.
versets.anglais: [They will be told], "That is because, when Allah was called upon alone, you disbelieved; but if others were associated with Him, you believed. So the judgement is with Allah, the Most High, the Grand

versets.arabe: هُوَ الَّذِي يُرِيكُمْ آيَاتِهِ وَيُنَزِّلُ لَكُم مِّنَ السَّمَاءِ رِزْقًا ۚ وَمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ إِلَّا مَن يُنِيبُ
versets.phonetique: Huwal-ladhee yureekum ayatihi wa yunazzilu lakum minas-sama'i rizqa wa ma yatadhakkaru illa man yunib
versets.francais: C'est Lui qui vous montre Ses signes et qui fait descendre pour vous du ciel une subsistance. Seul se souvient, celui qui se repent.
versets.anglais: It is He who shows you His signs and sends down to you from the sky, provision. But none will remember except he who turns back [in repentance]

versets.arabe: فَادْعُوا اللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الْكَافِرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Fad'ullaha mukhlisina lahud-dina wa law karihal-kafirun
versets.francais: Invoquez donc Allah en Lui vouant un culte sincère, même si les mécréants le détestent.
versets.anglais: So invoke Allah, [being] sincere to Him in religion, although the disbelievers dislike it

versets.arabe: رَفِيعُ الدَّرَجَاتِ ذُو الْعَرْشِ يُلْقِي الرُّوحَ مِنْ أَمْرِهِ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ لِيُنذِرَ يَوْمَ التَّلَاقِ
versets.phonetique: Rafi'ud-darajati dhul-'arshi yulqir-ruha min amrihi 'ala may yasha'u min 'ibadihi liyundhira yawmat-talaq
versets.francais: Lui qui élève les degrés, le Maître du Trône : Il envoie l'Esprit par Son commandement à qui Il veut parmi Ses serviteurs pour qu'il avertisse du Jour de la Rencontre.
versets.anglais: [He is] the Exalted above [all] degrees, Owner of the Throne; He places the inspiration of His command upon whom He wills of His servants to warn of the Day of Meeting

versets.arabe: يَوْمَ هُم بَارِزُونَ ۖ لَا يَخْفَىٰ عَلَى اللَّهِ مِنْهُمْ شَيْءٌ ۚ لِّمَنِ الْمُلْكُ الْيَوْمَ ۖ لِلَّهِ الْوَاحِدِ الْقَهَّارِ
versets.phonetique: Yawma hum barizun la yakhfa 'alallahi minhum shay'ul limanil-mulkul-yawm lillahil-wahidil-qahhar
versets.francais: Le Jour où ils seront tous exposés - rien d'eux n'est caché à Allah. "A qui appartient la royauté aujourd'hui ? A Allah, l'Unique, le Dominateur suprême !"
versets.anglais: The Day they come forth nothing concerning them will be concealed from Allah. To whom belongs [all] sovereignty this Day? To Allah, the One, the Prevailing

versets.arabe: الْيَوْمَ تُجْزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ ۚ لَا ظُلْمَ الْيَوْمَ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَرِيعُ الْحِسَابِ
versets.phonetique: Al-yawma tujza kullu nafsin bima kasabat la dhulmal-yawm innallaha sari'ul-hisab
versets.francais: Aujourd'hui, chaque âme sera rétribuée selon ce qu'elle a acquis. Pas d'injustice aujourd'hui ! Allah est prompt dans le règlement des comptes.
versets.anglais: This Day every soul will be recompensed for what it earned. No injustice today! Indeed, Allah is swift in account

versets.arabe: وَأَنذِرْهُمْ يَوْمَ الْآزِفَةِ إِذِ الْقُلُوبُ لَدَى الْحَنَاجِرِ كَاظِمِينَ ۚ مَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ مِنْ حَمِيمٍ وَلَا شَفِيعٍ يُطَاعُ
versets.phonetique: Wa andhirhum yawmal-azifati idhil-qulubu ladal-hanajiri kadhimin ma lidh-dhalimina min hamimin wa la shafi'iy yuta'
versets.francais: Avertis-les du Jour proche, quand les cœurs remonteront aux gorges, pleins d'angoisse. Les injustes n'auront ni ami intime ni intercesseur obéi.
versets.anglais: And warn them, [O Muhammad], of the Approaching Day, when hearts are at the throats, filled [with distress]. For the wrongdoers there will be no devoted friend and no intercessor [who is] obeyed

versets.arabe: يَعْلَمُ خَائِنَةَ الْأَعْيُنِ وَمَا تُخْفِي الصُّدُورُ
versets.phonetique: Ya'lamu kha'inatal-a'yuni wa ma tukhfis-sudur
versets.francais: Il connaît la trahison des regards et ce que les poitrines cachent.
versets.anglais: He knows that which deceives the eyes and what the breasts conceal

versets.arabe: وَاللَّهُ يَقْضِي بِالْحَقِّ ۖ وَالَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِ لَا يَقْضُونَ بِشَيْءٍ ۗ إِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْبَصِيرُ
versets.phonetique: Wallahu yaqdee bil-haqq walladhina yad'una min dunihi la yaqduna bishay'in innallaha huwas-sami'ul-basir
versets.francais: Allah juge en toute vérité, tandis que ceux qu'ils invoquent en dehors de Lui ne peuvent rien juger. Allah est vraiment l'Audient, le Voyant.
versets.anglais: And Allah judges with truth, while those they invoke besides Him judge not with anything. Indeed, Allah - He is the Hearing, the Seeing

versets.arabe: أَوَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَيَنظُرُوا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِينَ كَانُوا مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ كَانُوا هُمْ أَشَدَّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةً وَآثَارًا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَأَخَذَهُمُ اللَّهُ بِذُنُوبِهِمْ وَمَا كَانَ لَهُم مِّنَ اللَّهِ مِن وَاقٍ
versets.phonetique: Awa lam yasiru fil-ardi fayanduru kayfa kana 'aqibatulladhina kanu min qablihim kanu hum ashadda minhum quwwatan wa atharan fil-ardi fa'akhadhahumullahu bidhunubihim wa ma kana lahum minallahi miw waq
versets.francais: N'ont-ils pas parcouru la terre pour voir ce qu'il en a été de ceux qui vivaient avant eux ? Ils étaient plus forts qu'eux en puissance et ils ont laissé plus de traces sur la terre. Mais Allah les a saisis à cause de leurs péchés, et ils n'ont trouvé aucun protecteur contre Allah.
versets.anglais: Have they not traveled through the land and observed how was the end of those who were before them? They were greater than them in strength and in impression on the land, but Allah seized them for their sins. And they had not from Allah any protector

versets.arabe: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَانَت تَّأْتِيهِمْ رُسُلُهُم بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ فَكَفَرُوا فَأَخَذَهُمُ اللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُ قَوِيٌّ شَدِيدُ الْعِقَابِ
versets.phonetique: Dhalika bi'annahum kanat ta'tihim rusuluhum bil-bayyinati fakafaru fa'akhadhahumullahu innahu qawiyyun shadidil-'iqab
versets.francais: Cela parce que leurs messagers leur venaient avec des preuves évidentes et ils mécroyaient. Allah les a donc saisis. Il est Fort, sévère dans le châtiment.
versets.anglais: That was because their messengers were coming to them with clear proofs, but they disbelieved, so Allah seized them. Indeed, He is Powerful and severe in punishment

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ بِآيَاتِنَا وَسُلْطَانٍ مُّبِينٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa laqad arsalna musa bi'ayatina wa sultanim mubin
versets.francais: Nous avons envoyé Moïse avec Nos signes et une autorité manifeste,
versets.anglais: And We did certainly send Moses with Our signs and a clear authority

versets.arabe: إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَهَامَانَ وَقَارُونَ فَقَالُوا سَاحِرٌ كَذَّابٌ
versets.phonetique: Ila fir'awna wa hamana wa qaruna faqalu sahirun kadhdhab
versets.francais: Vers Pharaon, Haman et Coré. Mais ils dirent : "Magicien, grand menteur !"
versets.anglais: To Pharaoh, Haman and Qarun; but they said, "[He is] a magician and a liar

versets.arabe: فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُم بِالْحَقِّ مِنْ عِندِنَا قَالُوا اقْتُلُوا أَبْنَاءَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا مَعَهُ وَاسْتَحْيُوا نِسَاءَهُمْ ۚ وَمَا كَيْدُ الْكَافِرِينَ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَالٍ
versets.phonetique: Falamma ja'ahum bil-haqqi min 'indina qalulqtulu abna'al-ladhina amanu ma'ahu wastahyu nisa'ahum wa ma kaydul-kafirna illa fi dalal
versets.francais: Lorsqu'il leur vint avec la vérité venant de Nous, ils dirent : "Tuez les fils de ceux qui ont cru avec lui et laissez vivre leurs femmes." Mais la ruse des mécréants n'est que dans l'égarement.
versets.anglais: And when he brought them the truth from Us, they said, "Kill the sons of those who have believed with him and keep their women alive." But the plan of the disbelievers is not except in error

versets.arabe: وَقَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ ذَرُونِي أَقْتُلْ مُوسَىٰ وَلْيَدْعُ رَبَّهُ ۖ إِنِّي أَخَافُ أَن يُبَدِّلَ دِينَكُمْ أَوْ أَن يُظْهِرَ فِي الْأَرْضِ الْفَسَادَ
versets.phonetique: Wa qala fir'awnu dharuni aqtul musa walyad'u rabbahu inni akhafu ay-yubaddila dinakum aw ay-yudhira fil-ardil-fasad
versets.francais: Pharaon dit : "Laissez-moi tuer Moïse, et qu'il appelle son Seigneur ! Je crains qu'il ne change votre religion ou qu'il ne répande la corruption sur la terre."
versets.anglais: And Pharaoh said, "Let me kill Moses and let him call upon his Lord. Indeed, I fear that he will change your religion or that he will cause corruption in the land

versets.arabe: وَقَالَ مُوسَىٰ إِنِّي عُذْتُ بِرَبِّي وَرَبِّكُم مِّن كُلِّ مُتَكَبِّرٍ لَّا يُؤْمِنُ بِيَوْمِ الْحِسَابِ
versets.phonetique: Wa qala musa inni 'udhtu birabby wa rabbikum min kulli mutakabbirin la yu'minu biyawmil-hisab
versets.francais: Moïse dit : "Je me suis réfugié auprès de mon Seigneur et de votre Seigneur contre tout orgueilleux qui ne croit pas au Jour du Jugement."
versets.anglais: But Moses said, "Indeed, I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord from every arrogant one who does not believe in the Day of Account

versets.arabe: وَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مُّؤْمِنٌ مِّنْ آلِ فِرْعَوْنَ يَكْتُمُ إِيمَانَهُ أَتَقْتُلُونَ رَجُلًا أَن يَقُولَ رَبِّيَ اللَّهُ وَقَدْ جَاءَكُم بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ مِن رَّبِّكُمْ ۖ وَإِن يَكُ كَاذِبًا فَعَلَيْهِ كَذِبُهُ ۖ وَإِن يَكُ صَادِقًا يُصِبْكُم بَعْضُ الَّذِي يَعِدُكُمْ ۖ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِي مَنْ هُوَ مُسْرِفٌ كَذَّابٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa qala rajulum mu'minun min ali fir'awna yaktumu imanahu ataqtuluna rajulan ay yaqula rabbiyallahu wa qad ja'akum bil-bayyinati mir rabbikum wa iy yaku kadhibun fa'alayhi kadhibuhu wa iy yaku sadiqay yusibkum ba'dulldhhi ya'idukum innallaha la yahdi man huwa musrifun kadhdhab
versets.francais: Un homme croyant de la famille de Pharaon, qui cachait sa foi, dit : "Allez-vous tuer un homme parce qu'il dit : Mon Seigneur c'est Allah ? Il vous est pourtant venu des preuves de votre Seigneur. S'il est menteur, son mensonge lui appartient. Mais s'il est véridique, une partie de ce dont il vous menace vous atteindra. Allah ne guide pas celui qui transgresse et qui ment."
versets.anglais: And a believing man from the family of Pharaoh who concealed his faith said, "Do you kill a man [merely] because he says, 'My Lord is Allah' while he has brought you clear proofs from your Lord? And if he should be lying, then upon him is [the consequence of] his lie; but if he should be truthful, there will strike you some of what he promises you. Indeed, Allah does not guide one who is a transgressor and a liar
