versets.arabe: يَا قَوْمِ لَكُمُ الْمُلْكُ الْيَوْمَ ظَاهِرِينَ فِي الْأَرْضِ فَمَن يَنصُرُنَا مِن بَأْسِ اللَّهِ إِن جَاءَنَا ۚ قَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ مَا أُرِيكُمْ إِلَّا مَا أَرَىٰ وَمَا أَهْدِيكُمْ إِلَّا سَبِيلَ الرَّشَادِ
versets.phonetique: Ya qawmi lakumul-mulkul-yawma dhahirina fil-ardi faman yansurunna min ba'sillahi in ja'ana qala fir'awnu ma urikum illa ma ara wa ma ahdikum illa sabilar-rashad
versets.francais: "Ô mon peuple, à vous la royauté aujourd'hui, maîtres sur la terre. Mais qui nous secourra contre le châtiment d'Allah s'il nous venait ?" Pharaon dit : "Je ne vous fais voir que ce que je vois moi-même, et je ne vous guide que vers le chemin de la droiture."
versets.anglais: O my people, sovereignty is yours today, [your being] dominant in the land. But who would protect us from the punishment of Allah if it came to us?" Pharaoh said, "I do not show you except what I see, and I do not guide you except to the way of right conduct

versets.arabe: وَقَالَ الَّذِي آمَنَ يَا قَوْمِ إِنِّي أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُم مِّثْلَ يَوْمِ الْأَحْزَابِ
versets.phonetique: Wa qalal-ladhee amana ya qawmi inni akhafu 'alaykum mithla yawmil-ahzab
versets.francais: Celui qui avait cru dit : "Ô mon peuple, je crains pour vous quelque chose de semblable à ce qui s'abattit sur les coalisés.
versets.anglais: And he who believed said, "O my people, indeed I fear for you [a fate] like the day of the companies

versets.arabe: مِثْلَ دَأْبِ قَوْمِ نُوحٍ وَعَادٍ وَثَمُودَ وَالَّذِينَ مِن بَعْدِهِمْ ۚ وَمَا اللَّهُ يُرِيدُ ظُلْمًا لِّلْعِبَادِ
versets.phonetique: Mithla da'bi qawmi nuhin wa 'adiw wa thamuuda wallladhina mim ba'dihim wa mallahu yuridu dhulmallil-'ibad
versets.francais: Le sort du peuple de Noé, des Aad, des Thamoud et de ceux qui vécurent après eux. Allah ne veut pas d'injustice pour Ses serviteurs.
versets.anglais: Like the custom of the people of Noah and of 'Aad and Thamud and those after them. And Allah wants no injustice for [His] servants

versets.arabe: وَيَا قَوْمِ إِنِّي أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَوْمَ التَّنَادِ
versets.phonetique: Wa ya qawmi inni akhafu 'alaykum yawmat-tanad
versets.francais: "Ô mon peuple, je crains pour vous le Jour du mutuel appel,
versets.anglais: And O my people, indeed I fear for you the Day of Calling

versets.arabe: يَوْمَ تُوَلُّونَ مُدْبِرِينَ مَا لَكُم مِّنَ اللَّهِ مِنْ عَاصِمٍ ۗ وَمَن يُضْلِلِ اللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُ مِنْ هَادٍ
versets.phonetique: Yawma tuwalluna mudbirina ma lakum minallahi min 'asim wa may-yudlilillahu fama lahu min had
versets.francais: Le Jour où vous fuirez en vous retournant - vous n'aurez aucun protecteur contre Allah. Celui qu'Allah égare n'a pas de guide."
versets.anglais: The Day you will turn your backs fleeing; there is not for you from Allah any protector. And whoever Allah leaves astray - there is not for him any guide

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ جَاءَكُمْ يُوسُفُ مِن قَبْلُ بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ فَمَا زِلْتُمْ فِي شَكٍّ مِّمَّا جَاءَكُم بِهِ ۖ حَتَّىٰ إِذَا هَلَكَ قُلْتُمْ لَن يَبْعَثَ اللَّهُ مِن بَعْدِهِ رَسُولًا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ اللَّهُ مَنْ هُوَ مُسْرِفٌ مُّرْتَابٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa laqad ja'akum yusufu min qablu bil-bayyinati fama ziltum fi shakkimm mimma ja'akum bihi hatta idha halaka qultum lay yab'athallahu mim ba'dihi rasulaa kadhalika yudillullahu man huwa musrifum murtab
versets.francais: Joseph vous était venu auparavant avec des preuves évidentes. Vous n'avez pas cessé de douter de ce qu'il vous avait apporté. Jusqu'à ce qu'il mourut, vous dites : "Allah n'enverra plus de messager après lui." C'est ainsi qu'Allah égare celui qui transgresse et qui doute.
versets.anglais: And Joseph had already come to you before with clear proofs, but you remained in doubt of that which he brought to you, until when he died, you said, 'Never will Allah send a messenger after him.' Thus does Allah leave astray he who is a transgressor and skeptic

versets.arabe: الَّذِينَ يُجَادِلُونَ فِي آيَاتِ اللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ سُلْطَانٍ أَتَاهُمْ ۖ كَبُرَ مَقْتًا عِندَ اللَّهِ وَعِندَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يَطْبَعُ اللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ قَلْبِ مُتَكَبِّرٍ جَبَّارٍ
versets.phonetique: Alladhina yujadiluna fi ayatillahi bighayri sultanin ataahum kabura maqtan 'indallahi wa 'indal-ladhina amanu kadhalika yatba'ullahu 'ala kulli qalbi mutakabbirin jabbar
versets.francais: Ceux qui disputent des versets d'Allah sans aucune preuve qui leur soit venue - cela est fort exécrable aux yeux d'Allah et aux yeux des croyants. C'est ainsi qu'Allah scelle le cœur de tout orgueilleux tyran.
versets.anglais: Those who dispute concerning the signs of Allah without an authority having come to them - great is hatred [of them] in the sight of Allah and in the sight of those who have believed. Thus does Allah seal over every heart [belonging to] an arrogant tyrant

versets.arabe: وَقَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ يَا هَامَانُ ابْنِ لِي صَرْحًا لَّعَلِّي أَبْلُغُ الْأَسْبَابَ
versets.phonetique: Wa qala fir'awnu ya hamanu ibni li sarhal la'alli ablughul-asbab
versets.francais: Pharaon dit : "Ô Haman, construis-moi une tour afin que j'atteigne les voies,
versets.anglais: And Pharaoh said, "O Haman, construct for me a tower that I might reach the ways

versets.arabe: أَسْبَابَ السَّمَاوَاتِ فَأَطَّلِعَ إِلَىٰ إِلَٰهِ مُوسَىٰ وَإِنِّي لَأَظُنُّهُ كَاذِبًا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ زُيِّنَ لِفِرْعَوْنَ سُوءُ عَمَلِهِ وَصُدَّ عَنِ السَّبِيلِ ۚ وَمَا كَيْدُ فِرْعَوْنَ إِلَّا فِي تَبَابٍ
versets.phonetique: Asbabus-samawati fatta'lia ila ilahi musa wa inni la'adhunnuhu kadhiba wa kadhalika zuyyina lifir'awna su'u 'amalihi wa sudda 'anis-sabili wa ma kaydu fir'awna illa fi tabab
versets.francais: Les voies des cieux, et que je puisse apercevoir le Dieu de Moïse. Je pense vraiment qu'il est menteur." C'est ainsi que la mauvaise action de Pharaon lui fut enjolivée et qu'il fut détourné de la bonne voie. La ruse de Pharaon ne lui mena qu'à la ruine.
versets.anglais: The ways into the heavens - so that I may look at the deity of Moses; but indeed, I think he is a liar." And thus was made attractive to Pharaoh the evil of his deed, and he was averted from the [right] way. And the plan of Pharaoh was not except in ruin

versets.arabe: وَقَالَ الَّذِي آمَنَ يَا قَوْمِ اتَّبِعُونِ أَهْدِكُمْ سَبِيلَ الرَّشَادِ
versets.phonetique: Wa qalal-ladhee amana ya qawmi attabi'uni ahdikum sabilar-rashad
versets.francais: Celui qui avait cru dit : "Ô mon peuple, suivez-moi, je vous guiderai vers le droit chemin.
versets.anglais: And he who believed said, "O my people, follow me, I will guide you to the way of right conduct

versets.arabe: يَا قَوْمِ إِنَّمَا هَٰذِهِ الْحَيَاةُ الدُّنْيَا مَتَاعٌ وَإِنَّ الْآخِرَةَ هِيَ دَارُ الْقَرَارِ
versets.phonetique: Ya qawmi innaama hadhihil-hayatud-dunya mata'uw wa innal-akhirata hiya darul-qarar
versets.francais: "Ô mon peuple, cette vie d'ici-bas n'est que jouissance passagère. L'au-delà est certes la demeure stable.
versets.anglais: O my people, this worldly life is only [temporary] enjoyment, and indeed, the Hereafter - that is the home of [permanent] settlement

versets.arabe: مَنْ عَمِلَ سَيِّئَةً فَلَا يُجْزَىٰ إِلَّا مِثْلَهَا ۖ وَمَنْ عَمِلَ صَالِحًا مِّن ذَكَرٍ أَوْ أُنثَىٰ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَأُولَٰئِكَ يَدْخُلُونَ الْجَنَّةَ يُرْزَقُونَ فِيهَا بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
versets.phonetique: Man 'amila sayyi'atan fala yujza illa mithlaha wa man 'amila salihan min dhakarin aw untha wa huwa mu'minun fa'ula'ika yadkhulujal-jannata yurzaquna fiha bighayri hisab
versets.francais: Quiconque fait une mauvaise action ne sera rétribué qu'à son équivalent. Et quiconque fait du bien, mâle ou femelle, étant croyant, ceux-là entreront au Paradis où ils seront pourvus sans compter.
versets.anglais: Whoever does an evil deed will not be recompensed except by the like thereof; but whoever does righteousness, whether male or female, while he is a believer - those will enter Paradise, being given provision therein without account

versets.arabe: وَيَا قَوْمِ مَا لِي أَدْعُوكُمْ إِلَى النَّجَاةِ وَتَدْعُونَنِي إِلَى النَّارِ
versets.phonetique: Wa ya qawmi ma li ad'ukum ilan-najati wa tad'unani ilan-nar
versets.francais: "Ô mon peuple, comment se fait-il que je vous appelle au salut alors que vous m'appelez au Feu ?
versets.anglais: And O my people, how is it that I invite you to salvation while you invite me to the Fire

versets.arabe: تَدْعُونَنِي لِأَكْفُرَ بِاللَّهِ وَأُشْرِكَ بِهِ مَا لَيْسَ لِي بِهِ عِلْمٌ وَأَنَا أَدْعُوكُمْ إِلَى الْعَزِيزِ الْغَفَّارِ
versets.phonetique: Tad'unani li'akfura billahi wa ushrika bihi ma laysa li bihi 'ilmuw wa ana ad'ukum ilal-'azizil-ghaffar
versets.francais: "Vous m'appelez à mécroître en Allah et à Lui associer ce dont je n'ai aucune connaissance, alors que je vous appelle vers le Tout-Puissant, le Très Pardonneur.
versets.anglais: You invite me to disbelieve in Allah and associate with Him that of which I have no knowledge, and I invite you to the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver

versets.arabe: لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّمَا تَدْعُونَنِي إِلَيْهِ لَيْسَ لَهُ دَعْوَةٌ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَلَا فِي الْآخِرَةِ وَأَنَّ مَرَدَّنَا إِلَى اللَّهِ وَأَنَّ الْمُسْرِفِينَ هُمْ أَصْحَابُ النَّارِ
versets.phonetique: La jarama annama tad'unani ilayhi laysa lahu da'watun fid-dunya wa la fil-akhirati wa anna maraddana ilallahi wa annal-musrifina hum as-habun-nar
versets.francais: Il est évident que ce vers quoi vous m'appelez ne mérite aucune invocation ni dans ce monde ni dans l'au-delà, que notre retour est vers Allah, et que les transgresseurs seront les gens du Feu.
versets.anglais: Assuredly, that to which you invite me has no [response to a] supplication in this world or in the Hereafter; and indeed, our return is to Allah, and indeed, the transgressors will be companions of the Fire

versets.arabe: فَسَتَذْكُرُونَ مَا أَقُولُ لَكُمْ ۚ وَأُفَوِّضُ أَمْرِي إِلَى اللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بَصِيرٌ بِالْعِبَادِ
versets.phonetique: Fasatadhkuruna ma aqulu lakum wa ufawwidu amri ilallahi innallaha basirun bil-'ibad
versets.francais: "Vous vous souviendrez de ce que je vous dis. Je confie mon affaire à Allah. Allah voit bien les serviteurs."
versets.anglais: And you will remember what I [now] say to you, and I entrust my affair to Allah. Indeed, Allah is Seeing of [His] servants

versets.arabe: فَوَقَاهُ اللَّهُ سَيِّئَاتِ مَا مَكَرُوا ۖ وَحَاقَ بِآلِ فِرْعَوْنَ سُوءُ الْعَذَابِ
versets.phonetique: Fawaqahullahu sayyi'ati ma makaru wa haqa bi'ali fir'awna su'ul-'adhab
versets.francais: Allah le préserva des maux de leurs complots et le pire châtiment enveloppa la famille de Pharaon.
versets.anglais: So Allah protected him from the evils they plotted, and the people of Pharaoh were enveloped by the worst of punishment

versets.arabe: النَّارُ يُعْرَضُونَ عَلَيْهَا غُدُوًّا وَعَشِيًّا ۖ وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ أَدْخِلُوا آلَ فِرْعَوْنَ أَشَدَّ الْعَذَابِ
versets.phonetique: An-naru yu'raduna 'alayha ghuduwwaw wa 'ashiyya wa yawma taqumus-sa'atu adkhilu ala fir'awna ashadddal-'adhab
versets.francais: Le Feu auquel ils sont exposés matin et soir. Et le Jour où l'Heure s'établira : "Faites entrer la famille de Pharaon dans le plus dur des châtiments."
versets.anglais: The Fire, they are exposed to it morning and evening. And the Day the Hour appears [it will be said], "Make the people of Pharaoh enter the severest punishment

versets.arabe: وَإِذْ يَتَحَاجُّونَ فِي النَّارِ فَيَقُولُ الضُّعَفَاءُ لِلَّذِينَ اسْتَكْبَرُوا إِنَّا كُنَّا لَكُمْ تَبَعًا فَهَلْ أَنتُم مُّغْنُونَ عَنَّا نَصِيبًا مِّنَ النَّارِ
versets.phonetique: Wa idh yatahajjuna fin-nari fayaqulud-du'afa'u lil-ladhinas-takbaru inna kunna lakum taba'an fahal antum mughnuna 'anna nasibam minan-nar
versets.francais: Et quand ils se disputeront dans le Feu, les faibles diront aux orgueilleux : "Nous vous suivions. Pouvez-vous nous décharger d'une partie du Feu ?"
versets.anglais: And [mention] when they will argue within the Fire, and the weak will say to those who had been arrogant, "Indeed, we were [only] your followers, so will you relieve us of a share of the Fire

versets.arabe: قَالَ الَّذِينَ اسْتَكْبَرُوا إِنَّا كُلٌّ فِيهَا إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ حَكَمَ بَيْنَ الْعِبَادِ
versets.phonetique: Qalal-ladhinas-takbaru inna kullun fiha innallaha qad hakama baynal-'ibad
versets.francais: Les orgueilleux diront : "Nous y sommes tous. Allah a déjà jugé entre les serviteurs."
versets.anglais: Those who had been arrogant will say, "Indeed, all [of us] are in it. Indeed, Allah has judged between the servants

versets.arabe: وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ فِي النَّارِ لِخَزَنَةِ جَهَنَّمَ ادْعُوا رَبَّكُمْ يُخَفِّفْ عَنَّا يَوْمًا مِّنَ الْعَذَابِ
versets.phonetique: Wa qalal-ladhina fin-nari likhazanati jahannama ud'u rabbakum yukhaffif 'anna yawmam minal-'adhab
versets.francais: Ceux qui sont dans le Feu diront aux gardiens de l'Enfer : "Implorez votre Seigneur pour qu'Il allège notre châtiment d'un seul jour."
versets.anglais: And those in the Fire will say to the keepers of Hell, "Supplicate your Lord to lighten for us a day from the punishment

versets.arabe: قَالُوا أَوَلَمْ تَكُ تَأْتِيكُمْ رُسُلُكُم بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ ۖ قَالُوا بَلَىٰ ۚ قَالُوا فَادْعُوا ۗ وَمَا دُعَاءُ الْكَافِرِينَ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَالٍ
versets.phonetique: Qalu awa lam taku ta'tikum rusulukum bil-bayyinati qalu bala qalu fad'u wa ma du'a'ul-kafirana illa fi dalal
versets.francais: Ils diront : "Vos messagers ne vous venaient-ils pas avec des preuves évidentes ?" Ils diront : "Si." Ils diront : "Alors, invoquez vous-mêmes." Mais l'invocation des mécréants ne sert à rien.
versets.anglais: They will say, "Did there not come to you your messengers with clear proofs?" They will say, "Yes." They will reply, "Then supplicate [yourselves], but the supplication of the disbelievers is not except in error

versets.arabe: إِنَّا لَنَنصُرُ رُسُلَنَا وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا فِي الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا وَيَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْأَشْهَادُ
versets.phonetique: Inna lanansuru ruslana walladhina amanu fil-hayatid-dunya wa yawma yaqumul-ashhad
versets.francais: Nous secourons certes Nos messagers et ceux qui ont cru, dans la vie d'ici-bas et le Jour où les témoins se lèveront.
versets.anglais: Indeed, We will support Our messengers and those who believe during the life of this world and on the Day when the witnesses will stand

versets.arabe: يَوْمَ لَا يَنفَعُ الظَّالِمِينَ مَعْذِرَتُهُمْ ۖ وَلَهُمُ اللَّعْنَةُ وَلَهُمْ سُوءُ الدَّارِ
versets.phonetique: Yawma la yanfa'udh-dhalimina ma'dhiratuhum wa lahumul-la'natu wa lahum su'ud-dar
versets.francais: Le Jour où les injustes ne profiteront pas de leurs excuses. A eux la malédiction et à eux la mauvaise demeure.
versets.anglais: The Day their excuse will not benefit the wrongdoers, and they will have the curse, and they will have the worst home

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا مُوسَى الْهُدَىٰ وَأَوْرَثْنَا بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ الْكِتَابَ
versets.phonetique: Wa laqad atayna musal-huda wa awarathna bani isra'ilal-kitab
versets.francais: Nous avons donné à Moïse la guidance et Nous avons fait hériter les Enfants d'Israël du Livre,
versets.anglais: And We had certainly given Moses guidance, and We caused the Children of Israel to inherit the Scripture

versets.arabe: هُدًى وَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُولِي الْأَلْبَابِ
versets.phonetique: Hudaw wa dhikra li'ulil-albab
versets.francais: Guide et rappel pour les doués d'intelligence.
versets.anglais: As guidance and a reminder for those of understanding

versets.arabe: فَاصْبِرْ إِنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّ وَاسْتَغْفِرْ لِذَنبِكَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ بِالْعَشِيِّ وَالْإِبْكَارِ
versets.phonetique: Fasbir inna wa'dallahi haqquw wastagfhir lidhanbika wa sabbih bihamdi rabbika bil-'ashiyyi wal-ibkar
versets.francais: Sois donc patient. La promesse d'Allah est vraiment vérité. Implore le pardon de ton péché et glorifie ton Seigneur en Le louant le soir et le matin.
versets.anglais: So be patient, [O Muhammad]. Indeed, the promise of Allah is truth. And ask forgiveness for your sin and exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord in the evening and the morning

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُجَادِلُونَ فِي آيَاتِ اللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ سُلْطَانٍ أَتَاهُمْ ۙ إِن فِي صُدُورِهِمْ إِلَّا كِبْرٌ مَّا هُم بِبَالِغِيهِ ۚ فَاسْتَعِذْ بِاللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّهُ هُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْبَصِيرُ
versets.phonetique: Innal-ladhina yujadiluna fi ayatillahi bighayri sultanin ataahum in fi sudurihim illa kibrum ma hum bibalighi fasta'idh billahi innahu huwas-sami'ul-basir
versets.francais: Ceux qui disputent des versets d'Allah sans aucune preuve qui leur soit venue n'ont dans leurs poitrines qu'un orgueil qu'ils n'arriveront jamais à satisfaire. Cherche refuge auprès d'Allah. C'est Lui l'Audient, le Voyant.
versets.anglais: Indeed, those who dispute concerning the signs of Allah without [any] authority having come to them - there is not within their breasts except pride, [the extent of] which they cannot reach. So seek refuge in Allah. Indeed, it is He who is the Hearing, the Seeing

versets.arabe: لَخَلْقُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ أَكْبَرُ مِنْ خَلْقِ النَّاسِ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Lakhalqus-samawati wal-ardi akbaru min khalqin-nasi wa lakinna aktharan-nasi la ya'lamun
versets.francais: La création des cieux et de la terre est certes plus grande que la création des hommes. Mais la plupart des hommes ne savent pas.
versets.anglais: The creation of the heavens and earth is greater than the creation of mankind, but most of the people do not know

versets.arabe: وَمَا يَسْتَوِي الْأَعْمَىٰ وَالْبَصِيرُ وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَلَا الْمُسِيءُ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَتَذَكَّرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa ma yastawil-a'ma wal-basiru walladhina amanu wa amilusalihaati wa lal-musi' qalilam ma tatadhakkarun
versets.francais: L'aveugle et le clairvoyant ne sont pas égaux, ni ceux qui croient et font de bonnes œuvres et le malfaiteur. Vous vous souvenez si peu !
versets.anglais: And not equal are the blind and the seeing, nor are those who believe and do righteous deeds and the evildoer. Little do you remember

versets.arabe: إِنَّ السَّاعَةَ لَآتِيَةٌ لَّا رَيْبَ فِيهَا وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
versets.phonetique: Innas-sa'ata la'atiyatun la rayba fiha wa lakinna aktharan-nasi la yu'minun
versets.francais: L'Heure viendra sûrement - il n'y a pas de doute là-dessus - mais la plupart des hommes ne croient pas.
versets.anglais: Indeed, the Hour is coming - no doubt about it - but most of the people do not believe

versets.arabe: وَقَالَ رَبُّكُمُ ادْعُونِي أَسْتَجِبْ لَكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ عَنْ عِبَادَتِي سَيَدْخُلُونَ جَهَنَّمَ دَاخِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa qala rabbukumud'uni astajib lakum innal-ladhina yastakbiruna 'an 'ibadati sayadkhuluna jahannama dakhirin
versets.francais: Votre Seigneur a dit : "Appelez-Moi, Je vous répondrai." Ceux qui, par orgueil, se refusent à M'adorer entreront en Enfer, humiliés.
versets.anglais: And your Lord says, "Call upon Me; I will respond to you." Indeed, those who disdain My worship will enter Hell [rendered] contemptible

versets.arabe: اللَّهُ الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ اللَّيْلَ لِتَسْكُنُوا فِيهِ وَالنَّهَارَ مُبْصِرًا ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَذُو فَضْلٍ عَلَى النَّاسِ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَشْكُرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Allahulladhee ja'ala lakumul-layla litasukunu feehi wan-nahara mubsiraa innaallaha ladhuu fadlin 'alan-naasi wa laakinna aktharan-nasi la yashkurun
versets.francais: C'est Allah qui vous a fait la nuit pour vous y reposer et le jour pour voir clair. Allah est vraiment plein de grâce envers les hommes, mais la plupart des hommes ne sont pas reconnaissants.
versets.anglais: It is Allah who made for you the night that you may rest therein and the day giving sight. Indeed, Allah is full of bounty to the people, but most of the people are not grateful

versets.arabe: ذَٰلِكُمُ اللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ خَالِقُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ لَّا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ تُؤْفَكُونَ
versets.phonetique: Dhalikumullahu rabbukum khaliqqu kulli shay'in la ilaha illa huwa fa'anna tu'fakun
versets.francais: Tel est Allah votre Seigneur, Créateur de toute chose. Point de divinité que Lui. Où allez-vous donc ?
versets.anglais: That is Allah, your Lord, Creator of all things; there is no deity except Him, so how are you deluded

versets.arabe: كَذَٰلِكَ يُؤْفَكُ الَّذِينَ كَانُوا بِآيَاتِ اللَّهِ يَجْحَدُونَ
versets.phonetique: Kadhalika yu'fakulladhina kanu bi'ayatillahi yajhadun
versets.francais: C'est ainsi qu'on détourne ceux qui niaient les versets d'Allah.
versets.anglais: Thus were those [before you] deluded who were rejecting the signs of Allah

versets.arabe: اللَّهُ الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْأَرْضَ قَرَارًا وَالسَّمَاءَ بِنَاءً وَصَوَّرَكُمْ فَأَحْسَنَ صُوَرَكُمْ وَرَزَقَكُم مِّنَ الطَّيِّبَاتِ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ اللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ ۖ فَتَبَارَكَ اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَالَمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Allahulladhee ja'ala lakumul-arda qararan was-sama'a bina'aw wa sawwarakum fa'ahsana suwarakum wa razaqakum minat-tayyibat dhalikumullahu rabbukum fatabarakallahu rabbul-'alamin
versets.francais: C'est Allah qui vous a fait la terre pour séjour et le ciel comme édifice et qui vous a formés et a bien formé vos formes, et vous a pourvus de bonnes choses. Tel est Allah votre Seigneur. Béni soit Allah, Seigneur de l'univers.
versets.anglais: It is Allah who made for you the earth a place of settlement and the sky a ceiling and formed you and perfected your forms and provided you with good things. That is Allah, your Lord; then blessed is Allah, Lord of the worlds

versets.arabe: هُوَ الْحَيُّ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَادْعُوهُ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ ۗ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Huwal-hayyu la ilaha illa huwa fad'uhu mukhlisina lahud-din alhamdu lillahi rabbil-'alamin
versets.francais: Il est le Vivant. Point de divinité que Lui. Invoquez-Le en Lui vouant un culte sincère. Louange à Allah, Seigneur de l'univers.
versets.anglais: He is the Ever-Living; there is no deity except Him, so call upon Him, [being] sincere to Him in religion. [All] praise is [due] to Allah, Lord of the worlds

versets.arabe: قُلْ إِنِّي نُهِيتُ أَنْ أَعْبُدَ الَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ لَمَّا جَاءَنِيَ الْبَيِّنَاتُ مِن رَّبِّي وَأُمِرْتُ أَنْ أُسْلِمَ لِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qul inni nuhitu an a'budal-ladhina tad'una min dunillahi lamma ja'aaniyal-bayyinatu mir-rabbi wa umirtu an uslima li-rabbil-'alamin
versets.francais: Dis : "Il m'a été interdit d'adorer ceux que vous invoquez en dehors d'Allah puisque les preuves évidentes me sont venues de mon Seigneur. Et il m'a été ordonné de me soumettre au Seigneur de l'univers."
versets.anglais: Say, [O Muhammad], "Indeed, I have been forbidden to worship those you call upon besides Allah once the clear proofs have come to me from my Lord, and I have been commanded to submit to the Lord of the worlds

versets.arabe: هُوَ الَّذِي خَلَقَكُم مِّن تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ ثُمَّ مِنْ عَلَقَةٍ ثُمَّ يُخْرِجُكُمْ طِفْلًا ثُمَّ لِتَبْلُغُوا أَشُدَّكُمْ ثُمَّ لِتَكُونُوا شُيُوخًا ۚ وَمِنكُم مَّن يُتَوَفَّىٰ مِن قَبْلُ ۖ وَلِتَبْلُغُوا أَجَلًا مُّسَمًّى وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Huwal-ladhee khalaqakum min turabin thumma min nutfatin thumma min 'alaqatin thumma yukhrijukum tiflan thumma litablughu ashaddakum thumma litakunu shuyukha wa minkum man yutawaffa min qablu wa litablughu ajalam musammaw wa la'allakum ta'qilun
versets.francais: C'est Lui qui vous a créés de terre, puis d'une goutte de sperme, puis d'une adhérence, puis Il vous fait sortir enfant. Puis vous atteignez votre maturité, puis vous devenez vieillards - bien qu'il y en ait parmi vous qui meurent avant - pour atteindre un terme fixé, afin que vous raisonniez.
versets.anglais: It is He who created you from dust, then from a sperm-drop, then from a clinging clot; then He brings you out as a child; then [He develops you] that you reach your [time of] maturity, then [further] that you become elders. And among you is he who is taken in death before [that], so that you reach a specified term; and perhaps you will use reason

versets.arabe: هُوَ الَّذِي يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ ۖ فَإِذَا قَضَىٰ أَمْرًا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُ كُن فَيَكُونُ
versets.phonetique: Huwal-ladhee yuhyi wa yumit fa'idha qada amran fa'innama yaqulu lahu kun fayakun
versets.francais: C'est Lui qui donne la vie et la mort. Quand Il décide une chose, Il dit seulement : "Sois", et elle est.
versets.anglais: He it is who gives life and causes death; and when He decrees a matter, He but says to it, "Be," and it is

versets.arabe: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى الَّذِينَ يُجَادِلُونَ فِي آيَاتِ اللَّهِ أَنَّىٰ يُصْرَفُونَ
versets.phonetique: Alam tara ilal-ladhina yujadiluna fi ayatillahi anna yusrafun
versets.francais: N'as-tu pas vu ceux qui disputent des versets d'Allah ? Où sont-ils donc détournés ?
versets.anglais: Do you not consider those who dispute concerning the signs of Allah - how are they averted

versets.arabe: الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا بِالْكِتَابِ وَبِمَا أَرْسَلْنَا بِهِ رُسُلَنَا ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Alladhina kadhdhabu bil-kitabi wa bima arsalna bihi ruslana fasawfa ya'lamun
versets.francais: Ceux qui traitent le Livre de mensonge, et ce avec quoi Nous avons envoyé Nos messagers - ils sauront,
versets.anglais: Those who deny the Book and that with which We sent Our messengers - they are going to know

versets.arabe: إِذِ الْأَغْلَالُ فِي أَعْنَاقِهِمْ وَالسَّلَاسِلُ يُسْحَبُونَ
versets.phonetique: Idhil-aghlalu fi a'naqihim was-salasilu yushabun
versets.francais: Quand les carcans seront à leurs cous et les chaînes - ils seront traînés,
versets.anglais: When the shackles are around their necks and the chains; they will be dragged

versets.arabe: فِي الْحَمِيمِ ثُمَّ فِي النَّارِ يُسْجَرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Fil-hamimi thumma fin-nari yusjarun
versets.francais: Dans l'eau bouillante, puis ils brûleront dans le Feu.
versets.anglais: In boiling water; then in the Fire they will be filled [with flame]

versets.arabe: ثُمَّ قِيلَ لَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تُشْرِكُونَ
versets.phonetique: Thumma qila lahum ayna ma kuntum tushrikun
versets.francais: Puis on leur dit : "Où sont ceux que vous associiez
versets.anglais: Then it will be said to them, "Where is that which you used to associate [with Him in worship]

versets.arabe: مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ ۖ قَالُوا ضَلُّوا عَنَّا بَل لَّمْ نَكُن نَّدْعُو مِن قَبْلُ شَيْئًا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ اللَّهُ الْكَافِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Min dunillahi qalu dallu 'anna bal lam nakun nad'u min qablu shay'a kadhalika yudillullahul-kafirin
versets.francais: En dehors d'Allah ?" Ils dirent : "Ils se sont éloignés de nous. Non, nous n'invoquions rien auparavant." C'est ainsi qu'Allah égare les mécréants.
versets.anglais: Other than Allah?" They will say, "They have departed from us; rather, we did not used to invoke previously anything." Thus does Allah put astray the disbelievers

versets.arabe: ذَٰلِكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَفْرَحُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ الْحَقِّ وَبِمَا كُنتُمْ تَمْرَحُونَ
versets.phonetique: Dhalikum bima kuntum tafrahuna fil-ardi bighayril-haqqi wa bima kuntum tamrahun
versets.francais: "Cela, parce que vous vous réjouissiez sans raison sur la terre et parce que vous vous vantiez."
versets.anglais: [The angels will say], "That was because you used to exult upon the earth without right and you used to behave insolently

versets.arabe: ادْخُلُوا أَبْوَابَ جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا ۖ فَبِئْسَ مَثْوَى الْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Udkhulu abwaba jahannama khalidina fiha fabi'sa mathwal-mutakabbirin
versets.francais: "Entrez par les portes de l'Enfer pour y demeurer éternellement. Quelle mauvaise demeure pour les orgueilleux !"
versets.anglais: Enter the gates of Hell to abide eternally therein, and wretched is the residence of the arrogant

versets.arabe: فَاصْبِرْ إِنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّ ۚ فَإِمَّا نُرِيَنَّكَ بَعْضَ الَّذِي نَعِدُهُمْ أَوْ نَتَوَفَّيَنَّكَ فَإِلَيْنَا يُرْجَعُونَ
versets.phonetique: Fasbir inna wa'dallahi haqqun fa'imma nuriyannnaka ba'dalldhee na'iduhum aw natawaffayannaka fa'ilayna yurja'un
versets.francais: Sois donc patient. La promesse d'Allah est vérité. Que Nous te fassions voir une partie de ce dont Nous les menaçons, ou que Nous te fassions mourir, c'est vers Nous qu'ils seront ramenés.
versets.anglais: So be patient, [O Muhammad]; indeed, the promise of Allah is truth. And whether We show you some of what We have promised them or We take you in death, it is to Us they will be returned

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلًا مِّن قَبْلِكَ مِنْهُم مَّن قَصَصْنَا عَلَيْكَ وَمِنْهُم مَّن لَّمْ نَقْصُصْ عَلَيْكَ ۗ وَمَا كَانَ لِرَسُولٍ أَن يَأْتِيَ بِآيَةٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ ۚ فَإِذَا جَاءَ أَمْرُ اللَّهِ قُضِيَ بِالْحَقِّ وَخَسِرَ هُنَالِكَ الْمُبْطِلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa laqad arsalna rusulan min qablika minhum man qasasna 'alayka wa minhum man lam naqsus 'alayk wa ma kana lirasulini ay ya'tiya bi'ayatin illa bi'idhnillahi fa'idha ja'a amrullahi qudiya bil-haqqi wa khasira hunalikal-mubtilun
versets.francais: Nous avons certes envoyé des messagers avant toi. Il en est dont Nous t'avons raconté l'histoire et il en est dont Nous ne t'avons pas raconté l'histoire. Aucun messager ne pouvait apporter un signe qu'avec la permission d'Allah. Quand l'ordre d'Allah vient, tout est décidé en toute vérité et les tenants du faux seront perdants.
versets.anglais: And We have already sent messengers before you. Among them are those [whose stories] We have related to you, and among them are those [whose stories] We have not related to you. And it was not for any messenger to bring a sign [or verse] except by permission of Allah. So when the command of Allah comes, it will be concluded in truth, and the falsifiers will thereupon lose [all]

versets.arabe: اللَّهُ الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْأَنْعَامَ لِتَرْكَبُوا مِنْهَا وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Allahulladhee ja'ala lakumul-an'ama litarkahu minha wa minha ta'kulun
versets.francais: C'est Allah qui vous a fait les bestiaux pour que vous en montiez certains et d'autres vous en nourrissez.
versets.anglais: It is Allah who made for you the grazing animals upon which you ride, and some of them you eat

versets.arabe: وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَنَافِعُ وَلِتَبْلُغُوا عَلَيْهَا حَاجَةً فِي صُدُورِكُمْ وَعَلَيْهَا وَعَلَى الْفُلْكِ تُحْمَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa lakum fiha manafi'u wa litablughu 'alayha hajatan fi sudurikum wa 'alayha wa 'alal-fulki tuhmbalun
versets.francais: Vous en tirez des profits divers et pour atteindre sur eux un besoin qui est dans vos poitrines. Sur eux et sur les nefs vous êtes transportés.
versets.anglais: And for you therein are [other] benefits and that you may realize upon them a need which is in your breasts; and upon them and upon ships you are carried

versets.arabe: وَيُرِيكُمْ آيَاتِهِ فَأَيَّ آيَاتِ اللَّهِ تُنكِرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa yurikum ayatihi fa'ayya ayatillahi tunkirun
versets.francais: Et Il vous montre Ses signes. Lequel des signes d'Allah reniez-vous donc ?
versets.anglais: And He shows you His signs. So which of the signs of Allah do you deny

versets.arabe: أَفَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَيَنظُرُوا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ كَانُوا أَكْثَرَ مِنْهُمْ وَأَشَدَّ قُوَّةً وَآثَارًا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَمَا أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا يَكْسِبُونَ
versets.phonetique: Afalam yasiru fil-ardi fayanduru kayfa kana 'aqibatulladhina min qablihim kanu akthara minhum wa ashadda quwwatan wa atharan fil-ardi fama aghna 'anhum ma kanu yaksibun
versets.francais: N'ont-ils pas parcouru la terre pour voir ce qu'il en a été de ceux qui vivaient avant eux ? Ils étaient plus nombreux qu'eux et plus puissants en forces et en réalisations sur la terre. Ce qu'ils avaient acquis ne leur servit à rien.
versets.anglais: Have they not traveled through the land and observed how was the end of those before them? They were more numerous than themselves and greater in strength and in impression on the land, but they were not availed by what they used to earn

versets.arabe: فَلَمَّا جَاءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُم بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ فَرِحُوا بِمَا عِندَهُم مِّنَ الْعِلْمِ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُوا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِئُونَ
versets.phonetique: Falamma ja'athum rusuluhum bil-bayyinati farahu bima 'indahum minal-'ilmi wa haqa bihim ma kanu bihi yastahzi'un
versets.francais: Quand leurs messagers leur vinrent avec les preuves évidentes, ils se réjouirent de ce qu'ils avaient comme science et ce dont ils se moquaient les enveloppa.
versets.anglais: And when their messengers came to them with clear proofs, they [merely] rejoiced in what they had of knowledge, but they were enveloped by what they used to ridicule

versets.arabe: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْا بَأْسَنَا قَالُوا آمَنَّا بِاللَّهِ وَحْدَهُ وَكَفَرْنَا بِمَا كُنَّا بِهِ مُشْرِكِينَ
versets.phonetique: Falamma ra'aw ba'sana qalu amanna billahi wahdahu wa kafarna bima kunna bihi mushrikin
versets.francais: Quand ils virent Notre rigueur ils dirent : "Nous croyons en Allah seul et nous mécroissons en ce à quoi nous L'associions."
versets.anglais: And when they saw Our punishment, they said," We believe in Allah alone and disbelieve in that which we used to associate with Him

versets.arabe: فَلَمْ يَكُ يَنفَعُهُمْ إِيمَانُهُمْ لَمَّا رَأَوْا بَأْسَنَا ۖ سُنَّتَ اللَّهِ الَّتِي قَدْ خَلَتْ فِي عِبَادِهِ ۖ وَخَسِرَ هُنَالِكَ الْكَافِرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Falam yaku yanfa'uhum imanuhum lamma ra'aw ba'sana sunnatallaahillatee qad khalat fi 'ibadihi wa khasira hunalikal-kafirun
versets.francais: Leur foi ne leur fut d'aucune utilité quand ils virent Notre rigueur. Telle est la loi d'Allah qui a prévalu parmi Ses serviteurs. Les mécréants furent alors perdants.
versets.anglais: But never did their faith benefit them once they saw Our punishment. [It is] the established way of Allah which has preceded among His servants. And the disbelievers thereupon lost [all]

versets.arabe: حم
versets.phonetique: Ha mim
versets.francais: Ha Mim.
versets.anglais: Ha, Meem

versets.arabe: تنزيل من الرحمن الرحيم
versets.phonetique: Tanzilun min ar-rahmani ar-rahim
versets.francais: Révélation du Miséricordieux, du Compatissant.
versets.anglais: [This is] a revelation from the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful

versets.arabe: كتاب فصلت آياته قرآنا عربيا لقوم يعلمون
versets.phonetique: Kitabun fussilat ayatuhu qur'anan 'arabiyyan liqawmin ya'lamun
versets.francais: Un Livre dont les versets ont été exposés en détail, un Coran en langue arabe, pour ceux qui savent.
versets.anglais: A Book whose verses have been detailed, an Arabic Qur'an for a people who know

versets.arabe: بشيرا ونذيرا فأعرض أكثرهم فهم لا يسمعون
versets.phonetique: Bashhiran wa nadhiran fa a'rada aktharu hum fahum la yasma'un
versets.francais: Annonciateur de bonne nouvelle et avertisseur. Mais la plupart d'entre eux se détournent : ils n'écoutent pas.
versets.anglais: As a giver of good tidings and a warner; but most of them turn away, so they do not hear

versets.arabe: وقالوا قلوبنا في أكنة من ما تدعونا إليه وفي آذاننا وقر ومن بيننا وبينك حجاب فاعمل إننا عاملون
versets.phonetique: Wa qalu qulubu na fi akinnatin mimma tad'una na ilayhi wa fi adhnina waqrun wa min bayni na wa bayni ka hijabun fa'mal inna na amillun
versets.francais: Ils disent : « Nos cœurs sont fermés à ce que tu nous invites, il y a une lourdeur dans nos oreilles, et entre toi et nous, il y a un voile. Agis donc ; nous aussi nous agissons ».
versets.anglais: And they say, "Our hearts are within coverings from that to which you invite us, and in our ears is deafness, and between us and you is a partition, so work; indeed, we are working

versets.arabe: قل إنما أنا بشر مثلكم يوحى إلي أنما إلهكم إله واحد فاستقيموا إليه واستغفروه وويل للمشركين
versets.phonetique: Qul innama ana basharun mithlukum yuha ilayya innama ilahukum ilahun wahidun fastaqimuu ilayhi wastaghfiru hu wa wayilun li al-mushrikin
versets.francais: Dis : « Je ne suis qu'un homme comme vous. Il m'a été révélé que votre Dieu est un Dieu Unique. Tendez donc directement vers Lui et demandez-Lui pardon. Et malheur aux associationnistes,
versets.anglais: Say, O [Muhammad], "I am only a man like you to whom it has been revealed that your god is but one God; so take a straight course to Him and seek His forgiveness." And woe to those who associate others with Allah

versets.arabe: الذين لا يؤتون الزكاة وهم بالآخرة هم كافرون
versets.phonetique: Alladhina la yu'tun az-zakata wa hum bi al-akhirati hum kafrun
versets.francais: ceux qui ne font pas l'aumône obligatoire et qui nient l'au-delà ».
versets.anglais: Those who do not give zakah, and in the Hereafter they are disbelievers

versets.arabe: إن الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات لهم أجر غير منقطع
versets.phonetique: Inna alladhina amanu wa 'amilu as-salihati lahum ajrun ghayru munqati'in
versets.francais: Ceux qui ont cru et agi avec droiture, auront une récompense sans fin.
versets.anglais: Indeed, those who believe and do righteous deeds - for them is a reward uninterrupted

versets.arabe: قل أئنكم لتكفرون بالذي خلق الأرض في يومين وتجعلون له أندادا ذلك رب العالمين
versets.phonetique: Qul a'innakum latakfurun bi alladhí khalaqa al-arda fi yawmayn wa taj'alun lahu andada dhalika rabbul 'alamin
versets.francais: Dis : « Niez-vous celui qui a créé la terre en deux jours, et lui donnez-vous des égaux ? C'est le Seigneur de l'univers ».
versets.anglais: Say, "Do you indeed disbelieve in He who created the earth in two days and attribute to Him equals? That is the Lord of the worlds

versets.arabe: وجعل فيها رواسي من فوقها وبارك فيها وقدر فيها أقواتها في أربعة أيام سواء للسائلين
versets.phonetique: Wa ja'ala fiha rawasi min fawqiha wa baraka fiha wa qaddara fiha aqwataha fi arba'ati ayyamin sawaan li as-sa'ilin
versets.francais: Il y a établi des montagnes de dehors, Il l'a bénie, et Il a mesuré dans celle-ci ses ressources alimentaires en quatre jours ; de façon égale pour ceux qui interrogent.
versets.anglais: And He placed on the earth firmly set mountains over its surface, and He blessed it and determined therein its [creatures'] sustenance in four days without distinction - for [the information] of those who ask

versets.arabe: ثم استوى إلى السماء وهي دخان فقال لها وللأرض ائتيا طوعا أو كرها قالتا أتينا طائعين
versets.phonetique: Thumma istawa ila as-sama'i wa hiya dukhanu faqala laha wa li al-ardi i'tiya taw'an aw karhan qalata atayna ta'i'in
versets.francais: Puis Il s'est tourné vers le ciel, qui était encore fumée. Il dit à celui-ci et à la terre : « Venez docilement ou de mauvaise grâce ». Tous deux dirent : « Nous venons obéissants ».
versets.anglais: Then He directed Himself to the heaven while it was smoke and said to it and to the earth, "Come [into being], willingly or by compulsion." They said, "We have come willingly

versets.arabe: فقضاهن سبع سماوات في يومين وأوحى في كل سماء أمرها وزينا السماء الدنيا بمصابيح وحفظا ذلك تقدير العزيز العليم
versets.phonetique: Faqadaahun saba'a samawatin fi yawmayn wa awha fi kulli sama'in amraha wa zayyana as-sama'a ad-dunya bi masabih wa hifza dhalika taqdiru al-'azizia al-'alim
versets.francais: Il en a formé sept cieux en deux jours. Il a assigné à chaque ciel sa fonction. Et nous avons embelli le ciel inférieur avec des lampes, et une protection. Tel est l'ordre établi par le Puissant et l'Omniscient.
versets.anglais: And He completed them as seven heavens within two days and inspired in each heaven its command. And We adorned the nearest heaven with lamps and as protection. That is the determination of the Exalted in Might, the Knowing

versets.arabe: فإن أعرضوا فقل أنذرتكم صاعقة مثل صاعقة عاد وثمود
versets.phonetique: Fa in a'radu faqul andhartukum sa'iqatun mithl sa'iqat 'adin wa thamud
versets.francais: Si l'on vous refuse, dis : « Je vous avertis d'une foudre pareille à celle qui frappa 'Ad et Thamud ».
versets.anglais: But if they turn away, then say, "I have warned you of a thunderbolt like the thunderbolt [that struck] 'Aad and Thamud

versets.arabe: إذ جاءتهم الرسل من بين أيديهم ومن خلفهم ألا تعبدوا إلا الله قالوا لو شاء ربنا لأنزل ملائكة فإنا بما أرسلتم به كافرون
versets.phonetique: Idh ja'at hum ar-rusulu min bayna aydihim wa min khalfihim alla ta'budu illa allah qalu law sha'a rabbuna la anzala mala'ika fa inna bima arsaltu bihi kafrun
versets.francais: Quand les Messagers vinrent à eux, venant de devant eux et de derrière eux, [disant :] « N'adorez qu'Allah »; ils dirent : « Si notre Seigneur avait voulu, Il aurait envoyé des Anges. Nous rejetons donc ce avec lequel vous avez été envoyés ».
versets.anglais: [That occurred] when the messengers had come to them before them and after them, [saying], "Worship not except Allah." They said, "If our Lord had willed, He would have sent down the angels, so indeed we, in that with which you have been sent, are disbelievers

versets.arabe: أما عاد فاستكبروا في الأرض بغير الحق وقالوا من أشد منا قوة أولم يروا أن الله الذي خلقهم هو أشد منهم قوة وكانوا بآياتنا يجحدون
versets.phonetique: Amma 'adun fastakbaru fi al-ardi bighayri al-haqqi wa qalu man ashaddu minna quwwatan alam yaraw anna allah alladhi khalaqahum huwa ashaddu minhum quwwatan wa kanu bi ayatina yajhadun
versets.francais: Quant à 'Ad, ils s'enorgueillirent sur la terre sans aucun droit et dirent : « Qui est plus fort que nous ? » Ne voyaient-ils pas qu'Allah, qui les avait créés, était plus fort qu'eux ? Et ils niaient Nos versets.
versets.anglais: As for 'Aad, they were arrogant upon the earth without right and said, "Who is greater than us in strength?" Did they not consider that Allah who created them was greater than them in strength? But they were rejecting Our signs

versets.arabe: فأرسلنا عليهم ريحا صرصرا في أيام نحسات لنذيقهم عذاب الخزي في الحياة الدنيا ولعذاب الآخرة أخزى وهم لا ينصرون
versets.phonetique: Fa arsalna 'alayhim rihan sarsaran fi ayyamin nahsatin linudhiqahum 'adhaba al-khizyi fi al-hayati ad-dunya wa la'adhaba al-akhirati akhza wa hum la yansarun
versets.francais: Nous envoyâmes contre eux un vent terrible et des jours malheureux, afin de leur faire goûter le châtiment de l'humiliation dans la vie présente. Mais le châtiment de l'au-delà sera plus ignominieux encore, et personne ne les secoura.
versets.anglais: So We sent upon them a screaming wind during days of misfortune to make them taste the punishment of disgrace in the worldly life; but the punishment of the Hereafter is more disgracing, and they will not be helped

versets.arabe: وأما ثمود فهديناهم فاستحبوا العمى على الهدى فأخذتهم صاعقة العذاب الهون بما كانوا يكسبون
versets.phonetique: Wa amma thamud fahadaynahum fastahabbu al-'ama 'ala al-huda fa akhad hathu m sa'iqatu al-'adhabi al-hun bima kanu yaksbun
versets.francais: Et Thamud, Nous les avions guidés, mais ils ont préféré l'aveuglement à la bonne direction. C'est pourquoi ils ont été frappés par la foudre du châtiment avilissant, pour ce qu'ils avaient commis.
versets.anglais: And as for Thamud, We guided them, but they preferred blindness over guidance, so the thunderbolt of humiliating punishment seized them for what they used to earn

versets.arabe: وأنجينا الذين آمنوا وكانوا يتقون
versets.phonetique: Wa anja­yna alladhina amanu wa kanu yattaqun
versets.francais: Nous sauvâmes ceux qui avaient cru et qui craignaient Allah.
versets.anglais: And We saved those who believed and used to fear Allah

versets.arabe: ويوم يحشر أعداء الله إلى النار فهم يوزعون
versets.phonetique: Wa yawma yahsuru a'da'u allahi ila an-nari fahum yuza'un
versets.francais: Et le jour où les ennemis d'Allah seront rassemblés au Feu et placés en rangs,
versets.anglais: And [mention, O Muhammad], the Day when the enemies of Allah will be gathered to the Fire while they are [driven] assembled in rows

versets.arabe: حتى إذا ما جاؤوها شهد عليهم سمعهم وأبصارهم وجلودهم بما كانوا يعملون
versets.phonetique: Hatta idha ma ja'uha shahida 'alayhim sam'u hum wa absaru hum wa ju luduhum bima kanu ya'malun
versets.francais: Jusqu'à quand ils y seront, leurs oreilles, leurs yeux et leurs peaux témoigneront contre eux de ce qu'ils faisaient.
versets.anglais: Until, when they reach it, their hearing and their eyes and their skins will testify against them of what they used to do

versets.arabe: وقالوا لجلودهم لم شهدتم علينا قالت أنطقنا الله الذي أنطق كل شيء وهو خلقكم أول مرة وإليه ترجعون
versets.phonetique: Wa qalu li juludi hum lima shahidtum 'alayna qalat antaqana allah alladhi antaqa kulla shay'in wa huwa khalaqakum awwala marratin wa ilayhi turji'un
versets.francais: Et ils diront à leurs peaux : « Pourquoi avez-vous témoigné contre nous ? » Elles répondront : « Allah nous a donné la parole, Lui qui donne la parole à toute chose. C'est Lui qui vous a créés la première fois, et c'est vers Lui que vous retournerez ».
versets.anglais: And they will say to their skins, "Why have you testified against us?" They will say, "We were made to speak by Allah, who has made everything speak; and He created you the first time, and to Him you are returned

versets.arabe: وما كنتم تستترون أن يشهد عليكم سمعكم ولا أبصاركم ولا جلودكم ولكن ظننتم أن الله لا يعلم كثيرا مما تعملون
versets.phonetique: Wa ma kuntum tastattirun an yashhada 'alaykum sam'ukum wa la absarukum wa la juludukum wa lakin zhannatum anna allah la ya'lamu kathiran mimma ta'malun
versets.francais: Vous ne pensiez pas vous cacher de sorte que vos oreilles, vos yeux et vos peaux ne témoignent pas contre vous. Mais vous pensiez qu'Allah ne savait pas une bonne partie de ce que vous faisiez.
versets.anglais: And you were not covering yourselves, lest your hearing testify against you or your sight or your skins, but you assumed that Allah does not know much of what you do

versets.arabe: وذلكم ظنكم الذي ظننتم بربكم أرداكم فأصبحتم من الخاسرين
versets.phonetique: Wa dhalikami zhannukum alladhi zhanantum bi rabbikum ardakum fa asbahatum min al-khasirain
versets.francais: Telle est l'opinion que vous aviez de votre Seigneur. Elle vous a perdus, et vous vous êtes trouvés être parmi les perdants.
versets.anglais: And that was your assumption which you assumed about your Lord. It has brought you to ruin, and you have become among the losers

versets.arabe: فإن يصبروا فالنار مثوى لهم وإن يستعتبوا فما هم من المعتبين
versets.phonetique: Fa in yasbiru fa an-naru matha walhum wa in yasta'tibu fama hum min al-mu'tabin
versets.francais: S'ils endurent, le Feu sera leur demeure. S'ils demandent à se faire pardonner, on n'acceptera pas leur demande.
versets.anglais: So [even] if they are patient, the Fire is a residence for them; and if they ask to appease [Allah], they will not be of those who are allowed to appease

versets.arabe: وقيضنا لهم قرناء فزينوا لهم ما بين أيديهم وما خلفهم وحق عليهم القول في أمم قد خلت من قبلهم من الجن والإنس إنهم كانوا خاسرين
versets.phonetique: Wa qayyad na lahum qarina fa zayyan u lahum ma bayna aydi him wa ma khalfahum wa haqqat 'alayhim al-qawlu fi umamin qad khalat min qablihim min al-jinni wa al-insi innahum kanu khasi­rin
versets.francais: Nous avons destiné pour eux des compagnons qui ont embelli à leurs yeux ce qui était devant eux et ce qui était derrière eux. La parole s'est réalisée contre eux, comme elle s'était réalisée avant eux, tant chez les djinns que chez les humains. Ils étaient perdants.
versets.anglais: And We appointed for them companions who made attractive to them what was before them and what was behind them [of sin], and the word has come into effect upon them among nations which had passed on before them of jinn and men. Indeed, they [all] were losers

versets.arabe: والذين كفروا قالوا لا تسمعوا لهذا القرآن والغوا فيه لعلكم تغلبون
versets.phonetique: Wa alladhina kafaru qalu la tasma'u li hadha al-qur'ani wa alghaw fihi la'allakum taghlebun
versets.francais: Ceux qui ont mécru disaient : « N'écoutez pas ce Coran, et faites du bruit pendant qu'on le récite, afin que vous soyez vainqueurs ».
versets.anglais: And those who disbelieve say, "Do not listen to this Qur'an and speak noisily during [the recitation of] it that perhaps you will overcome

versets.arabe: فسوف نذيق الذين كفروا عذابا شديدا ونجزيهم أسوأ الذي كانوا يعملون
versets.phonetique: Fasawfa nudhiqu alladhina kafaru 'adhaban shadidan wa najzihi m aswa al-ladhi kanu ya'malun
versets.francais: Nous ferons bientôt goûter aux mécréants un châtiment terrible. Nous les rétribuerons du pire de ce qu'ils faisaient.
versets.anglais: But We will surely cause those who disbelieve to taste a severe punishment, and We will surely recompense them for the worst of what they had been doing

versets.arabe: ذلك جزاء أعداء الله النار لهم فيها دار الخلود جزاء بما كانوا بآياتنا يجحدون
versets.phonetique: Dhalika jaza'u a'da'i allah an-naru lahum fiha daru al-khulud jaza'an bima kanu bi ayatina yajhadun
versets.francais: Telle est la rétribution des ennemis d'Allah : le Feu. C'est là leur demeure éternelle, en récompense de ce qu'ils reniaient Nos versets.
versets.anglais: That is the recompense of the enemies of Allah - the Fire. For them therein is the home of eternity as recompense for what they, of Our verses, were rejecting

versets.arabe: والذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات سنجعل لهم جنات تجري من تحتها الأنهار
versets.phonetique: Wa alladhina amanu wa 'amilu as-salihati sanaj'alu lahum janatin tajri min tahtiha al-anhar
versets.francais: Et ceux qui ont cru et agi avec droiture, Nous les admettrons dans des jardins sous lesquels coulent les fleuves.
versets.anglais: And those who disbelieved will [then] say, "Our Lord, show us those who misled us of the jinn and men [so] we may put them under our feet that they will be among the lowest

versets.arabe: فيها دعواهم سبحانك اللهم وتحيتهم فيها سلام وآخر دعواهم أن الحمد لله رب العالمين
versets.phonetique: Fiha da'wa hum subhanak allahumma wa tahiyyatahu m fiha assalam wa akhiru da'wa hum an al-hamdu lillahi rabbi al-'alamin
versets.francais: Leur invocation y sera : « Gloire à Toi, ô Allah ! » Et leur salutation y sera : « Paix ! » et le terme de leur invocation sera : « Louange à Allah, Seigneur de l'univers ».
versets.anglais: Indeed, those who have said, "Our Lord is Allah " and then remained on a right course - the angels will descend upon them, [saying], "Do not fear and do not grieve but receive good tidings of Paradise, which you were promised

versets.arabe: ولو يعجل الله للناس الشر استعجالهم بالخير لقضي إليهم أجلهم فنذر الذين لا يرجون لقاءنا في طغيانهم يعمهون
versets.phonetique: Wa law yu'ajjilu allah li an-nasi ash-sharra istija'alahum bi al-khayri laquda bi ilayhi m ajla hum fa nadharu alladhina la yarjun liqa'ana fi tughyani him ya'mahun
versets.francais: Si Allah hâtait vers les hommes le mal comme ils hâtent le bien, leur terme leur aurait déjà été fixé. Mais Nous laissons ceux qui n'espèrent point Notre rencontre, errer dans leur transgression.
versets.anglais: We [angels] were your allies in worldly life and [are so] in the Hereafter. And you will have therein whatever your souls desire, and you will have therein whatever you request [or wish]

versets.arabe: وإذا أصاب الإنسان ضر دعانا لجنبه أو قاعدا أو قائما فلما كشفنا عنه ضره مر كأن لم يدعنا إلى ضر مس ه كذلك زين للمسرفين ما كانوا يعملون
versets.phonetique: Wa idha asaba al-insana darrun da'ana li junubihi aw qa'idan aw qa'iman falamma kashafna 'anhu darruhu marra ka an lam yad'una ila darrin masahu kadalika zuyyin li al-musrifina ma kanu ya'malun
versets.francais: Et quand le mal touche un homme, il Nous invoque en se couchant, ou en étant assis, ou en étant debout. Mais dès que Nous le libérons de son mal, il passe outre, comme s'il ne Nous avait pas invokés pour le mal qui l'avait touché. C'est ainsi que les actes des prodigues leur ont été embellies.
versets.anglais: As accommodation from a [Lord who is] Forgiving and Merciful

versets.arabe: وأرسلنا إلى أربع مدائن ملكا بالسوء فاستغاثوا بنا قال أن جاء نصري بل كانوا يومئذ يلعبون
versets.phonetique: Wa arsalna ila arba'i madain malikan bi as-saw'i faistaghatu bina qala an ja'a nasri bal kanu yawma idhin yal'abun
versets.francais: Nous envoyâmes auprès de quatre villes un messager avec le châtiment : ils implorèrent Notre aide, [mais Nous dîmes :] « Le secours ne viendra pas [d'où ils attendent]. N'étaient-ils pas des joueurs ? »
versets.anglais: And who is better in speech than one who invites to Allah and does righteousness and says, "Indeed, I am of the Muslims

versets.arabe: وإذا أصابتهم آية قالوا لن نؤمن حتى نؤتى مثل ما أوتي رسل الله الله أعلم حيث يجعل رسالته سيصيب الذين أجرموا صغار عند الله وعذاب شديد بما كانوا يمكرون
versets.phonetique: Wa idha asabat hum ayatun qalu lan nu'mina hatta nu'ta mithla ma utiya rusuli allah allahu a'lamu haythu yaj'alu risalatahu sayusibu alladhina ajramu sugharun 'inda allah wa 'adhab shadid bima kanu yamakarun
versets.francais: Et quand un signe leur vient, ils disent : « Nous ne croirons que si on nous donne quelque chose de semblable à ce qui a été donné aux Messagers d'Allah ! » Allah sait mieux où placer Sa mission. Les criminels seront frappés d'avilissement auprès d'Allah et d'un dur châtiment pour les machinations qu'ils ourrdissaient.
versets.anglais: And not equal are the good deed and the bad. Repel [evil] by that [deed] which is better; and thereupon the one whom between you and him is enmity [will become] as though he was a devoted friend

versets.arabe: فلما جاءتهم رسالتنا أفكانوا يستبشرون بل أصابهم ما كانوا به يستهزئون
versets.phonetique: Falamma ja'at hum risalatuna afakanu yastabshirun bal asabahum ma kanu bihi yastahzi'un
versets.francais: Quand donc Notre message leur vint, se réjouirent-ils ? Non, au contraire, il les frappa de ce dont ils se moquaient.
versets.anglais: But none is granted it except those who are patient, and none is granted it except one having a great portion [of good]

versets.arabe: ألم يروا أنا خلقنا لهم مما عملت أيدينا أنعاما فهم لها مالكون
versets.phonetique: Alam yaraw anna khalaqna lahum mimma 'amilat aydiyna an'aman fahum laha malikin
versets.francais: Ne voient-ils pas qu'en ce qui concerne le bétail que Nos mains ont créé pour eux, Nous en avons fait leurs propriétés ? »
versets.anglais: And if there comes to you from Satan an evil suggestion, then seek refuge in Allah. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing

versets.arabe: وذللناها لهم فمنها ركوبهم ومنها يأكلون
versets.phonetique: Wa dhallalna ha lahum famin ha rakubu hum wa min ha ya'kulun
versets.francais: Et Nous les avons soumis à leur service. Les uns servent à les transporter, les autres à les nourrir.
versets.anglais: And of His signs are the night and day and the sun and moon. Do not prostrate to the sun or to the moon, but prostate to Allah, who created them, if it should be Him that you worship

versets.arabe: ولهم فيها منافع ومشارب أفلا يشكرون
versets.phonetique: Wa lahum fiha mana­fi'u wa mashrib afala yashakarun
versets.francais: Et ils en tirent profit et des boissons. Ne seraient-ils pas reconnaissants ? »
versets.anglais: But if they are arrogant - then those who are near your Lord exalt Him by night and by day, and they do not become weary

versets.arabe: واتخذوا من دون الله آلهة لعلهم ينصرون
versets.phonetique: Wa ittakhadu min duni allah alihatan la'allahum yunsa­run
versets.francais: Et ils se sont donné, en dehors d'Allah, d'autres divinités pour qu'elles les secourent.
versets.anglais: And of His signs is that you see the earth stilled, but when We send down upon it rain, it quivers and grows. Indeed, He who has given it life is the Giver of Life to the dead. Indeed, He is over all things competent

versets.arabe: لا يستطيعون نصرهم وهم لهم جند محضرون
versets.phonetique: La yastati'un nasra hum wa hum lahum jundu muhdaran
versets.francais: Elles n'ont pas le pouvoir de les secourir. Au contraire, elles comparaîtront comme soldats rangés contre eux.
versets.anglais: Indeed, those who inject deviation into Our verses are not concealed from Us. So, is he who is cast into the Fire better or he who comes secure on the Day of Resurrection? Do whatever you will; indeed, He is Seeing of what you do

versets.arabe: فلا يحزنك قولهم إنا نعلم ما يسرون وما يعلنون
versets.phonetique: Fala yahzunka qawlu hum inna na'lamu ma yasirrun wa ma yu'linun
versets.francais: Que leurs propos ne t'affligent point. Nous savons ce qu'ils cachent et ce qu'ils déclarent.
versets.anglais: Indeed, those who disbelieve in the message after it has come to them... And indeed, it is a mighty Book

versets.arabe: أولم ير الإنسان أنا خلقناه من نطفة فإذا هو خصيم مبين
versets.phonetique: Awalam yara al-insanu anna khalaqna hu min nutfatin fa idha huwa khasm mubin
versets.francais: L'homme ne voit-il pas que Nous l'avons créé d'une goutte de sperme ? Et le voilà un adversaire déclaré !
versets.anglais: Falsehood cannot approach it from before it or from behind it; [it is] a revelation from a [Lord who is] Wise and Praiseworthy

versets.arabe: وضرب لنا مثلا ونسي خلقه قال من يحيي العظام وهي رميم
versets.phonetique: Wa daraba lana mathalan wa nasiya khalqahu qala man yuhyi al-'izama wa hiya ramim
versets.francais: Et il nous propose un exemple et oublie sa création. Il dit : « Qui redonnera la vie aux os quand ils seront pourris ? »
versets.anglais: Nothing is said to you, [O Muhammad], except what was already said to the messengers before you. Indeed, your Lord is a possessor of forgiveness and a possessor of painful penalty

versets.arabe: قل يحييها الذي أنشأها أول مرة وهو بكل خلق عليم
versets.phonetique: Qul yuhyi ­ha alladhí anha'aha awwala marratin wa huwa bi kulli khalqin 'alim
versets.francais: Dis : « Celui qui les a créés la première fois les redonnera à la vie. Il connaît bien toute création ».
versets.anglais: And if We had made it a non-Arabic Qur'an, they would have said, "Why are its verses not explained in detail [in our language]? Is it a foreign [recitation] and an Arab [messenger]?" Say, "It is, for those who believe, a guidance and cure." And those who do not believe - in their ears is deafness, and it is upon them blindness. Those are being called from a distant place

versets.arabe: الذي جعل لكم من الشجر الأخضر نارا فإذا أنتم منه توقدون
versets.phonetique: Alladhí ja'ala lakum min ash-shajar al-akhdar naran fa idha antum minh tuwaqqidun
versets.francais: Celui qui a fait pour vous du bois vert du feu, et voilà que vous en tirez du feu !
versets.anglais: And We had already given Moses the Scripture, but it came under disagreement. And if not for a word that preceded from your Lord, it would have been concluded between them. And indeed they are, concerning the Qur'an, in disquieting doubt

versets.arabe: أوليس الذي خلق السماوات والأرض بقادر على أن يخلق مثلهم بلى وهو الخلاق العليم
versets.phonetique: Awalisat alladhí khalaqa as-samawati wa al-arda biqadir 'ala an yakhluqa mithlahum bala wa huwa al-khallaq al-'alim
versets.francais: Celui qui a créé les cieux et la terre n'est-Il pas capable de créer leur semblables ? Si, de reste ! Il est le Créateur par excellence, l'Omniscient.
versets.anglais: Whoever does righteousness - it is for his [own] soul; and whoever does evil [does so] against it. And your Lord is not ever unjust to [His] servants

versets.arabe: إنما أمره إذا أراد شيئا أن يقول له كن فيكون
versets.phonetique: Innama amru hu idha arada shay'an an yaqula lahu kun fayakun
versets.francais: Son Commandement, quand Il veut une chose, est seulement de dire : « Sois ! » et elle est.
versets.anglais: To him [alone] is attributed knowledge of the Hour. And fruits emerge not from their coverings nor does a female conceive or give birth except with His knowledge. And the Day He will call to them, "Where are My 'partners'?" they will say, "We announce to You that there is [no longer] among us any witness [to that]

versets.arabe: فسبحان الذي بيده ملكوت كل شيء وإليه ترجعون
versets.phonetique: Fasubhana alladhí biyadihi malakut kulli shay'in wa ilayhi turja'un
versets.francais: Gloire à Celui entre les mains de qui est la domination de toute chose ! Et c'est vers Lui que vous serez ramenés.
versets.anglais: And lost from them will be those they were invoking before, and they will be certain that they have no place of escape

versets.arabe: ألم تر أن الله سخر لكم ما في السماوات وما في الأرض وأسبغ عليكم نعمه ظاهرة وباطنة
versets.phonetique: Alam tara anna allah sakhkhara lakum ma fi as-samawati wa ma fi al-ardi wa asbagha 'alaykum ni'amahu zahiratun wa batinah
versets.francais: N'as-tu pas vu qu'Allah a soumis à votre service tout ce qui est dans les cieux et sur la terre, et comblé sur vous Ses bienfaits apparents et cachés ? »
versets.anglais: Man is not weary of supplication for good [things], but if evil touches him, he is hopeless and despairing

versets.arabe: ومن الناس من يجادل في الله بغير علم ولا هدى ولا كتاب منير
versets.phonetique: Wa min an-nasi man yujadilu fi allah bighayri 'ilmin wa la hudan wa la kitab munir
versets.francais: Parmi les hommes, il y en a qui disputent au sujet d'Allah, sans science, sans guidance, et sans Livre qui apporte la lumière.
versets.anglais: And if We let him taste mercy from Us after an adversity which has touched him, he will surely say, "This is [due] to me, and I do not think the Hour will occur; and [even] if I should be returned to my Lord, indeed, for me there will be with Him the best." But We will surely inform those who disbelieved about what they did, and We will surely make them taste a massive punishment

versets.arabe: وإذا قيل لهم اتبعوا ما أنزل الله قالوا بل نتبع ما وجدنا عليه آباءنا أولو كان آباؤهم لا يعقلون شيئا ولا يهتدون
versets.phonetique: Wa idha qila lahum ittabi'u ma anzala allah qalu bal nattabi'u ma wajadna 'alayhi aba'una awalauw kana aba'uhum la ya'qilun shay'an wa la yahtadun
versets.francais: Et quand on leur dit : « Suivez ce qu'Allah a révélé », ils disent : « Non, nous suivons plutôt les traces que nous avons trouvées empreintes par nos ancêtres ». Quoi ! Même si les ancêtres ne comprenaient rien et n'étaient pas guidés ? »
versets.anglais: And when We bestow favor upon man, he turns away and distances himself; but when evil touches him, then he is full of extensive supplication

versets.arabe: ومثل الذين كفروا كمثل الذي ينعق بما لا يسمع إلا دعاء ونداء صم بكم عمي فهم لا يعقلون
versets.phonetique: Wa mathalu alladhina kafaru kamathali alladhí yan'aqu bima la yasma'u illa da'a'an wa nida'an summun bukmun 'umyun fahum la ya'qilun
versets.francais: La ressemblance de ceux qui ont mécru, c'est comme celle du troupeau qui entend l'appel du berger sans comprendre que des sons et des cris. Sourds, muets, aveugles, ils n'ont pas d'intelligence.
versets.anglais: Say, "Have you considered: if the Qur'an is from Allah and you disbelieved in it, who would be more astray than one who is in extreme dissension

versets.arabe: يا أيها الذين آمنوا كلوا من طيبات ما رزقناكم واشكروا لله إن كنتم إياه تعبدون
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuha alladhina amanu kulu min tayyibati ma razaqna kum wa shakarun lillahi in kuntum iyyahu ta'badun
versets.francais: Ô les croyants ! Mangez des biens licites que Nous vous avons attribués. Et soyez reconnaissants envers Allah, si vous L'adorez.
versets.anglais: We will show them Our signs in the horizons and within themselves until it becomes clear to them that it is the truth. But is it not sufficient concerning your Lord that He is, over all things, a Witness

versets.arabe: إنما حرم عليكم الميتة والدم ولحم الخنزير وما أهل لغيره فمن اضطر غير باغ ولا عاد فإن الله غفور رحيم
versets.phonetique: Innama harrama 'alaykum al-mayta wa ad-dama wa lahma al-khinzir wa ma uhilla lighayrihi faman idtarra ghayra baghun wa la 'adin fa inn allah ghafur rahim
versets.francais: Il vous a seulement interdit la bête trouvée morte, le sang, la chair de porc, et ce sur quoi on a invoqué un autre qu'Allah. Mais quiconque est contraint sans intention de pécher, ni de transgression, pour lui, Allah est Pardonneur et Miséricordieux.
versets.anglais: Unquestionably, they are in doubt about the meeting with their Lord. Unquestionably He is, of all things, encompassing

versets.arabe: حم
versets.phonetique: Hā Mīm
versets.francais: Hā, Mīm.
versets.anglais: Ha, Meem

versets.arabe: عسق
versets.phonetique: 'Ayn Sīn Qāf
versets.francais: 'Ayn, Sīn, Qāf.
versets.anglais: Ayn, Seen, Qaf

versets.arabe: كَذَٰلِكَ يُوحِي إِلَيْكَ وَإِلَى الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ اللَّهُ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ
versets.phonetique: Kadhālik yuwhī ilayka wa-ilā-alladhīn min qablik-Allāhu-al-'azīzu-al-hakīm
versets.francais: C'est ainsi qu'Allah, le Puissant et le Sage, te révèle, comme Il a révélé à ceux qui t'ont précédé.
versets.anglais: Thus has He revealed to you, [O Muhammad], and to those before you - Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Wise

versets.arabe: لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ
versets.phonetique: Lahu mā fi-as-samāwāti wa-mā fi-al-ardi wa-huwa-al-'alīyу-al-'azīm
versets.francais: À Lui appartient tout ce qui est dans les cieux et sur la terre, et Il est le Très-Haut, l'Infiniment Grand.
versets.anglais: To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth, and He is the Most High, the Most Great

versets.arabe: تَكَادُ السَّمَاوَاتُ يَتَفَطَّرْنَ مِنْ فَوْقِهِنَّ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ يُسَبِّحُونَ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ وَيَسْتَغْفِرُونَ لِمَنْ فِي الْأَرْضِ
versets.phonetique: Takādu-as-samāwātu yatafattarnа min fawqihinna wa-al-malā'ikatu yusabbihūn bi-hamdi rabbihim wa-yastaghfirūn liman fi-al-ardi
versets.francais: Peu s'en faut que les cieux ne se déchirent d'en haut, tandis que les anges célèbrent les louanges de leur Seigneur et implorent le pardon pour ceux qui sont sur la terre.
versets.anglais: The heavens almost break from above them, and the angels exalt [Allah] with praise of their Lord and ask forgiveness for those on earth. Unquestionably, it is Allah who is the Forgiving, the Merciful

versets.arabe: أَلَا إِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
versets.phonetique: Alā inna-Allāh huwa-al-ghafūru-ar-rahīm
versets.francais: Certes, Allah est le Pardonneur, le Très-Miséricordieux.
versets.anglais: And those who take as allies other than Him - Allah is [yet] Guardian over them; and you, [O Muhammad], are not over them a manager

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ اتَّخَذُوا مِنْ دُونِهِ أَوْلِيَاءَ اللَّهُ حَفِيظٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَمَا أَنْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ بِوَكِيلٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa-alladhīn-ittakhadhū min dūnihi awliyā'a-Allāh hafīzun 'alayhim wa-mā anta 'alayhim biwakal
versets.francais: Et ceux qui se prennent d'autres alliés que Lui... Allah est Celui qui les surveille, et tu n'es point responsable de leurs affaires.
versets.anglais: And thus We have revealed to you an Arabic Qur'an that you may warn the Mother of Cities [Makkah] and those around it and warn of the Day of Assembly, about which there is no doubt. A party will be in Paradise and a party in the Blaze

versets.arabe: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ قُرْآنًا عَرَبِيًّا لِتُنْذِرَ أُمَّ الْقُرَىٰ وَمَنْ حَوْلَهَا
versets.phonetique: Wa-kadhālik awhay nā ilayka qur'ānan 'arabīyyan litu ndhira umma-al-qurā wa-man hawlaha
versets.francais: Et c'est ainsi que Nous t'avons révélé un Coran en arabe, afin que tu avertisses la Mère des cités (La Mecque) et ceux autour d'elle,
versets.anglais: And if Allah willed, He could have made them [of] one religion, but He admits whom He wills into His mercy. And the wrongdoers have not any protector or helper

versets.arabe: وَتُنْذِرَ يَوْمَ الْجَمْعِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ فَرِيقٌ فِي الْجَنَّةِ وَفَرِيقٌ فِي السَّعِيرِ
versets.phonetique: Wa-tundhir yawma-al-jama'i lā rayba fīhi farīqun fi-al-jannati wa-farīqun fi-as-sa'īr
versets.francais: et pour avertir du jour du Rassemblement - il n'y a point de doute à son sujet - un groupe au Paradis et un groupe en l'Enfer.
versets.anglais: Or have they taken protectors [or allies] besides him? But Allah - He is the Protector, and He gives life to the dead, and He is over all things competent

versets.arabe: وَلَوْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ لَجَعَلَهُمْ أُمَّةً وَاحِدَةً
versets.phonetique: Wa-law shā'a-Allāhu laja'alahum ummatan wāhidah
versets.francais: Et si Allah l'avait voulu, Il aurait fait d'eux une seule communauté;
versets.anglais: And in anything over which you disagree - its ruling is [to be referred] to Allah. [Say], "That is Allah, my Lord; upon Him I have relied, and to Him I turn back

versets.arabe: وَلَٰكِنْ يُدْخِلُ مَنْ يَشَاءُ فِي رَحْمَتِهِ
versets.phonetique: Wa-lākin yudkhilu man yashā'u fi rahmatih
versets.francais: mais Il fait entrer dans Sa miséricorde qui Il veut.
versets.anglais: [He is] Creator of the heavens and the earth. He has made for you from yourselves, mates, and among the cattle, mates; He multiplies you thereby. There is nothing like unto Him, and He is the Hearing, the Seeing

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا مَا لَهُمْ مِنْ وَلِيٍّ وَلَا نَاصِرٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa-alladhīn zhalamū mā lahum min walīyun wa-lā nāsir
versets.francais: Et ceux qui ont commis des injustices n'ont point de protecteur ni de secoureur.
versets.anglais: To Him belong the keys of the heavens and the earth. He extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it]. Indeed He is, of all things, Knowing

versets.arabe: أَمِ اتَّخَذُوا مِنْ دُونِهِ أَوْلِيَاءَ فَاللَّهُ هُوَ الْوَلِيُّ وَهُوَ يُحْيِي الْمَوْتَىٰ
versets.phonetique: Am ittakhadhū min dūnihi awliyā'a fa-Allāhu huwa-al-walīyу wa-huwa yuhyī-al-mawtā
versets.francais: Ou se sont-ils pris d'autres alliés que Lui? Mais Allah est le Seul Allié, et c'est Lui qui ressuscite les morts.
versets.anglais: He has ordained for you of religion what He enjoined upon Noah and that which We have revealed to you, [O Muhammad], and what We enjoined upon Abraham and Moses and Jesus - to establish the religion and not be divided therein. Difficult for those who associate others with Allah is that to which you invite them. Allah chooses for Himself whom He wills and guides to Himself whoever turns back [to Him]

versets.arabe: وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa-huwa 'alā kulli shay'in qadīr
versets.francais: Et c'est Lui qui a le pouvoir sur toute chose.
versets.anglais: And they did not become divided until after knowledge had come to them - out of jealous animosity between themselves. And if not for a word that preceded from your Lord [postponing the penalty] until a specified time, it would have been concluded between them. And indeed, those who were granted inheritance of the Scripture after them are, concerning it, in disquieting doubt

versets.arabe: فَمَا اخْتَلَفْتُمْ فِيهِ مِنْ شَيْءٍ فَحُكْمُهُ إِلَى اللَّهِ
versets.phonetique: Fa-mā-ikh taliftu m fīhi min shay'in fa-hukmuh u ilā-Allāh
versets.francais: En tout ce en quoi vous divergez, le jugement en revient à Allah.
versets.anglais: So to that [religion of Allah] invite, [O Muhammad], and remain on a right course as you are commanded and do not follow their inclinations but say, "I have believed in what Allah has revealed of the Qur'an, and I have been commanded to do justice among you. Allah is our Lord and your Lord. For us are our deeds, and for you your deeds. There is no [need for] argument between us and you. Allah will bring us together, and to Him is the [final] destination

versets.arabe: ذَٰلِكُمُ اللَّهُ رَبِّي عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَإِلَيْهِ أُنِيبُ
versets.phonetique: Dhālikum-Allāh rabbī 'alayhi tawakkaltu wa-ilayhi unīb
versets.francais: Voilà Allah, mon Seigneur. Je m'en remets à Lui, et je me repens auprès de Lui.
versets.anglais: And those who argue concerning Allah after He has been responded to - their argument is invalid with their Lord, and upon them is [His] wrath, and for them is a severe punishment

versets.arabe: فَاطِرُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ جَعَلَ لَكُمْ مِنْ أَنْفُسِكُمْ أَزْوَاجًا وَمِنَ الْأَنْعَامِ أَزْوَاجًا
versets.phonetique: Fātiru-as-samāwāti wa-al-ardi ja'ala lakum min anfusikum azwājan wa-min-al-an'āmi azwāja
versets.francais: Le Créateur des cieux et de la terre. Il vous a créé de vous-mêmes des épouses, et des bestiaux par couples.
versets.anglais: It is Allah who has sent down the Book in truth and [also] the balance. And what will make you perceive? Perhaps the Hour is near

versets.arabe: يَذِرُّكُمْ فِيهِ لَيْسَ كَمِثْلِهِ شَيْءٌ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْبَصِيرُ
versets.phonetique: Yadhirru kum fīh lays a kamithlih shay'un wa-huwa-as-samī'u-al-basīr
versets.francais: Il n'y a rien qui Lui soit semblable, et c'est Lui l'Audient, le Clairvoyant.
versets.anglais: Those who do not believe in it are impatient for it, but those who believe are fearful of it and know that it is the truth. Unquestionably, those who dispute concerning the Hour are in extreme error

versets.arabe: لَهُ مَقَالِيدُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ وَيَقْدِرُ
versets.phonetique: Lahu maqālīdu-as-samāwāti wa-al-ardi yasbut u-ar-rizy aq liman yashā'u wa-yaqdiru
versets.francais: À Lui appartiennent les clés des cieux et de la terre. Il dispense le sustenance à qui Il veut et la restreint (à qui Il veut).
versets.anglais: Allah is Subtle with His servants; He gives provisions to whom He wills. And He is the Powerful, the Exalted in Might

versets.arabe: وَشَرَعَ لَكُمْ مِنَ الدِّينِ مَا وَصَّىٰ بِهِ نُوحًا وَالَّذِي أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ وَمَا وَصَّيْنَا بِهِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ وَعِيسَىٰ
versets.phonetique: Wa-shara'a lakum min-ad-dīn mā wassā bihi nūhan wa-alladhī awhay nā ilayka wa-mā wassaynā bihi ibrāhīm wa-mūsā wa-'īsā
versets.francais: Il vous a prescrit la religion qu'Il avait déjà prescrite à Noé, celle que Nous t'avons révélée, celle qu'Il avait prescrite à Abraham, à Moïse et à Jésus:
versets.anglais: Whoever desires the harvest of the Hereafter - We increase for him in his harvest. And whoever desires the harvest of this world - We give him thereof, but there is not for him in the Hereafter any share

versets.arabe: أَنْ أَقِيمُوا الدِّينَ وَلَا تَتَفَرَّقُوا فِيهِ
versets.phonetique: An aqīmū-ad-dīn wa-lā tatafarraqū fīh
versets.francais: "Pratiquez la religion, et ne vous en divisez pas."
versets.anglais: Or have they other deities who have ordained for them a religion to which Allah has not consented? But if not for the decisive word, it would have been concluded between them. And indeed, the wrongdoers will have a painful punishment

versets.arabe: كَبُرَ عَلَى الْمُشْرِكِينَ مَا تَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَيْهِ
versets.phonetique: Kabura 'alā-al-mushrikīn mā tad'ūhum ilayh
versets.francais: Ce à quoi tu les appelles est difficile aux Associateurs.
versets.anglais: You will see the wrongdoers fearful of what they have earned, and it will [certainly] befall them. And those who have believed and done righteous deeds will be in lush regions of the gardens [in Paradise] having whatever they will in the presence of their Lord. That is what is the great bounty

versets.arabe: اللَّهُ يَجْتَبِي إِلَيْهِ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَيَهْدِي إِلَيْهِ مَنْ يُنِيبُ
versets.phonetique: Allāhu yajtabī ilayh man yashā'u wa-yahdi ilayh man yunīb
versets.francais: Allah attire à Lui celui qu'Il veut, et guide vers Lui celui qui se repent.
versets.anglais: It is that of which Allah gives good tidings to His servants who believe and do righteous deeds. Say, [O Muhammad], "I do not ask you for this message any payment [but] only good will through kinship." And whoever commits a good deed - We will increase for him good therein. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Appreciative

versets.arabe: وَمَا تَفَرَّقُوا إِلَّا مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا جَاءَهُمُ الْعِلْمُ بَغْيًا بَيْنَهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Wa-mā tafarraqū illā min ba'di mā jā'ahum-al-'ilm baghyan baynahum
versets.francais: Et ils ne se sont divisés que par inimité mutuelle, après que le savoir leur soit venu.
versets.anglais: Or do they say, "He has invented about Allah a lie"? But if Allah willed, He could seal over your heart. And Allah eliminates falsehood and establishes the truth by His words. Indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts

versets.arabe: وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِنْ رَبِّكَ إِلَىٰ أَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى لَقُضِيَ بَيْنَهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Wa-lawlā kalimatun sabaqat min rabbik ilā ajalin musammā laqudiya baynahum
versets.francais: Et sans une parole précédente émanant de ton Seigneur jusqu'à un terme fixé, elle eût été prononcée entre eux.
versets.anglais: And it is He who accepts repentance from his servants and pardons misdeeds, and He knows what you do

versets.arabe: وَإِنَّ الَّذِينَ أُورِثُوا الْكِتَابَ مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ لَفِي شَكٍّ مِنْهُ مُرِيبٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa-inna-alladhīn ūrithu-al-kitāb min ba'dihim lafī shakkin minhu murīb
versets.francais: Et ceux qui ont hérité de l'Écriture après eux sont en doute au sujet d'celui-ci, un doute inquiétant.
versets.anglais: And He answers [the supplication of] those who have believed and done righteous deeds and increases [for] them from His bounty. But the disbelievers will have a severe punishment

versets.arabe: فَلِذَٰلِكَ فَادْعُ وَاسْتَقِمْ كَمَا أُمِرْتَ
versets.phonetique: Fa-lidhālik fad'u wa-staqim kamā umirt
versets.francais: Appelle donc (les hommes) à cela, et sois constant comme il te l'a été ordonné.
versets.anglais: And if Allah had extended [excessively] provision for His servants, they would have committed tyranny throughout the earth. But He sends [it] down in an amount which He wills. Indeed He is, of His servants, Acquainted and Seeing

versets.arabe: وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ أَهْوَاءَهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Wa-lā tattabi' ahwā'ahum
versets.francais: Et ne suis pas les passions qu'ils suivent.
versets.anglais: And it is He who sends down the rain after they had despaired and spreads His mercy. And He is the Protector, the Praiseworthy

versets.arabe: وَقُلْ آمَنْتُ بِمَا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ مِنْ كِتَابٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa-qul āmantu bimā anzala-Allāhu min kitāb
versets.francais: Et dis: "J'ai cru en ce qu'Allah a révélé comme Livre.
versets.anglais: And of his signs is the creation of the heavens and earth and what He has dispersed throughout them of creatures. And He, for gathering them when He wills, is competent

versets.arabe: وَأُمِرْتُ لِأَعْدِلَ بَيْنَكُمُ اللَّهُ رَبُّنَا وَرَبُّكُمْ لَنَا أَعْمَالُنَا وَلَكُمْ أَعْمَالُكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Wa-umirt u li-a'dila bayнakum-Allāhu rabbu nā wa-rabbukum lanā a'mālu nā wa-lakum a'mālu kum
versets.francais: Et il m'a été ordonné de faire justice entre vous. Allah est notre Seigneur et votre Seigneur. A nous nos œuvres, à vous vos œuvres.
versets.anglais: And whatever strikes you of disaster - it is for what your hands have earned; but He pardons much

versets.arabe: لَا حُجَّةَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكُمُ اللَّهُ يَجْمَعُ بَيْنَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ الْمَصِيرُ
versets.phonetique: Lā hujjata baynanā wa-baynakum-Allāhu yajma'u baynanā wa-ilayh-al-masīr
versets.francais: Point de débat entre nous et vous. Allah nous rassemblera, et c'est vers Lui le retour."
versets.anglais: And you will not cause failure [to Allah] upon the earth. And you have not besides Allah any protector or helper

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ يُحَاجُّونَ فِي اللَّهِ مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا اسْتُجِيبَ لَهُ
versets.phonetique: Wa-alladhīn yuhājjūn fi-Allāh min ba'di mā-ustuji bā lahu
versets.francais: Et ceux qui argumentent au sujet d'Allah après qu'on Lui a répondu,
versets.anglais: And of His signs are the ships in the sea, like mountains

versets.arabe: حُجَّتُهُمْ دَاحِضَةٌ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ وَعَلَيْهِمْ غَضَبٌ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ
versets.phonetique: Hujjatu hum dāhidatun 'inda rabbihim wa-'alayhim ghadaб u wa-lahum 'adhābun shadīd
versets.francais: leur argument auprès de leur Seigneur n'a aucune valeur. Il y a sur eux une colère, et ils subiront un châtiment terrible.
versets.anglais: If He willed, He could still the wind, and they would remain motionless on its surface. Indeed in that are signs for everyone patient and grateful

versets.arabe: اللَّهُ الَّذِي أَنْزَلَ الْكِتَابَ بِالْحَقِّ وَالْمِيزَانَ
versets.phonetique: Allāhu-alladhī anzala-al-kitāb bi-al-haqq wa-al-mīzān
versets.francais: Allah est Celui qui a révélé le Livre avec la Vérité et la balance.
versets.anglais: Or He could destroy them for what they earned; but He pardons much

versets.arabe: وَمَا يَدْرِي نَفْسٌ مَاذَا تَكْسِبُ غَدًا وَمَا تَدْرِي نَفْسٌ بِأَيِّ أَرْضٍ تَمُوتُ
