versets.phonetique: Wa-mā yadrī nafsun mādhā taksibu ghadā wa-mā tadrī nafsun bi-ayyī ardin tamūt
versets.francais: Nul ne sait ce qu'il acquerra demain, et nul ne sait en quelle terre il mourra.
versets.anglais: And [that is so] those who dispute concerning Our signs may know that for them there is no place of escape

versets.arabe: إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ خَبِيرٌ
versets.phonetique: Inna-Allāh 'alīmun khabīr
versets.francais: Allah, certes, est Savant et bien Informé.
versets.anglais: So whatever thing you have been given - it is but [for] enjoyment of the worldly life. But what is with Allah is better and more lasting for those who have believed and upon their Lord rely

versets.arabe: آمِنُوا بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَأَنْفِقُوا مِمَّا جَعَلَكُمْ مُسْتَخْلَفِينَ فِيهِ
versets.phonetique: Āminū bi-Allāh wa-rasūlihi wa-anfiqū mimmā ja'alakum mustakh lafīn fīh
versets.francais: Croyez en Allah et en Son Messager, et dépensez de ce qu'Il vous a légué comme intendants.
versets.anglais: And those who avoid the major sins and immoralities, and when they are angry, they forgive

versets.arabe: فَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا مِنْكُمْ وَأَنْفَقُوا لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ كَبِيرٌ
versets.phonetique: Fa-alladhīn āmanū minkum wa-anfaqū lahum ajrun kabīr
versets.francais: Ceux d'entre vous qui auront cru et dépensé auront une grande récompense.
versets.anglais: And those who have responded to their lord and established prayer and whose affair is [determined by] consultation among themselves, and from what We have provided them, they spend

versets.arabe: وَمَا لَكُمْ لَا تُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللَّهِ
versets.phonetique: Wa-mā lakum lā tu'minūn bi-Allāh
versets.francais: Pourquoi ne croyez-vous pas en Allah,
versets.anglais: And those who, when tyranny strikes them, they defend themselves

versets.arabe: وَالرَّسُولُ يَدْعُوكُمْ لِتُؤْمِنُوا بِرَبِّكُمْ وَقَدْ أَخَذَ مِيثَاقَكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Wa-ar-rasūlu yad'ūkum litu'minū birab bikum wa-qad akhadha mīthāqakum
versets.francais: alors que le Messager vous appelle à croire en votre Seigneur, et qu'Il a pris de vous une promesse?
versets.anglais: And the retribution for an evil act is an evil one like it, but whoever pardons and makes reconciliation - his reward is [due] from Allah. Indeed, He does not like wrongdoers

versets.arabe: إِنْ تَتُوبُوا يَكُنْ خَيْرًا لَكُمْ
versets.phonetique: In tatūbū yakun khayran lakum
versets.francais: Si vous vous repentez, ce sera mieux pour vous.
versets.anglais: And whoever avenges himself after having been wronged - those have not upon them any cause [for blame]

versets.arabe: وَإِنْ تَتَوَلَّوْا فَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّكُمْ لَسْتُمْ بِمُعْجِزِي اللَّهِ
versets.phonetique: Wa-in tatawallā fa-'alamū annakum lastum bi-mu'jizī-Allāh
versets.francais: Et si vous vous détournez, sachez que vous ne pouvez aucunement échapper à Allah.
versets.anglais: The cause is only against the ones who wrong the people and tyrannize upon the earth without right. Those will have a painful punishment

versets.arabe: وَبَشِّرِ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ أَنَّ لَهُمْ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ
versets.phonetique: Wa-bashshir-alladhīn āmanū wa-'amilū-as-sālihāt anna lahum jannātun tajrī min tah tihā-al-anhār
versets.francais: Et annonce une bonne nouvelle à ceux qui ont cru et accompli des œuvres pie, qu'ils auront des jardins sous lesquels coulent les fleuves.
versets.anglais: And whoever is patient and forgives - indeed, that is of the matters [requiring] determination

versets.arabe: كُلَّمَا رُزِقُوا مِنْهَا مِنْ ثَمَرَةٍ رِزْقًا قَالُوا هَٰذَا الَّذِي رُزِقْنَا مِنْ قَبْلُ
versets.phonetique: Kullama ruziqū minha min thamarah rizy aqan qālū hādhā-alladhī ruziqnā min qabl
versets.francais: Toutes les fois qu'on leur donnera un fruit de ces jardins en provision, ils diront: "C'est là ce qu'on nous donnait auparavant".
versets.anglais: And he whom Allah sends astray - for him there is no protector beyond Him. And you will see the wrongdoers, when they see the punishment, saying, "Is there for return [to the former world] any way

versets.arabe: وَأُتُوا بِهِ مُتَشَابِهًا وَلَهُمْ فِيهَا أَزْوَاجٌ مُطَهَّرَةٌ وَهُمْ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa-utū bihi mutashābihan wa-lahum fīhā azwājun mutahhаratun wa-hum fīhā khālidūn
versets.francais: On les leur présentera en ressemblance; ils auront là des épouses purifiées, et ils y demeureront éternellement.
versets.anglais: And you will see them being exposed to the Fire, humbled from humiliation, looking from [behind] a covert glance. And those who had believed will say, "Indeed, the [true] losers are the ones who lost themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection. Unquestionably, the wrongdoers are in an enduring punishment

versets.arabe: إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَسْتَحْيِي أَنْ يَضْرِبَ مَثَلًا مَا بَعُوضَةً فَمَا فَوْقَهَا
versets.phonetique: Inna-Allāh lā yastahyī an yadrib mathalan mā ba'ūdatah fa-mā fawqahā
versets.francais: Allah n'hésite pas à donner une parabole: moustique ou quelque chose au-dessus.
versets.anglais: And there will not be for them any allies to aid them other than Allah. And whoever Allah sends astray - for him there is no way

versets.arabe: فَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا فَيَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّهُ الْحَقُّ مِنْ رَبِّهِمْ
versets.phonetique: Fa-ammā-alladhīn āmanū fa-ya'lamūn annahu-al-haqqu min rabbihim
versets.francais: Quant à ceux qui ont cru, ils savent que c'est la Vérité venant de leur Seigneur.
versets.anglais: Respond to your Lord before a Day comes from Allah of which there is no repelling. No refuge will you have that day, nor for you will there be any denial

versets.arabe: وَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا فَيَقُولُونَ مَاذَا أَرَادَ اللَّهُ بِهَٰذَا مَثَلًا
versets.phonetique: Wa-ammā-alladhīn kafarū fa-yaqūlūn mādhā arāda-Allāhu bi-hādhā mathalan
versets.francais: Mais ceux qui ont mécru diront: "Que veut dire Allah par cette parabole?"
versets.anglais: But if they turn away - then We have not sent you, [O Muhammad], over them as a guardian; upon you is only [the duty of] notification. And indeed, when We let man taste mercy from us, he rejoices in it; but if evil afflicts him for what his hands have put forth, then indeed, man is ungrateful

versets.arabe: يُضِلُّ بِهِ كَثِيرًا وَيَهْدِي بِهِ كَثِيرًا
versets.phonetique: Yudillu bihi kathīran wa-yahdi bihi kathīra
versets.francais: Il égare beaucoup de gens par elle et en guide beaucoup par elle.
versets.anglais: To Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth; He creates what he wills. He gives to whom He wills female [children], and He gives to whom He wills males

versets.arabe: وَمَا يُضِلُّ بِهِ إِلَّا الْفَاسِقِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa-mā yudillu bihi illā-al-fāsiqīn
versets.francais: Il n'égare par elle que les pervers.
versets.anglais: Or He makes them [both] males and females, and He renders whom He wills barren. Indeed, He is Knowing and Competent

versets.arabe: الَّذِينَ يَنْقُضُونَ عَهْدَ اللَّهِ مِنْ بَعْدِ مِيثَاقِهِ وَيَقْطَعُونَ مَا أَمَرَ اللَّهُ بِهِ أَنْ يُوصَلَ
versets.phonetique: Alladhīn yanqud ūn 'ahda-Allāh min ba'di mīthāqihi wa-yaqta'ūn mā amara-Allāhu bihi an yūsal
versets.francais: Ceux qui violent le pacte d'Allah après l'avoir conclu, et rompent ce qu'Allah a ordonné d'unir,
versets.anglais: And it is not for any human being that Allah should speak to him except by revelation or from behind a partition or that He sends a messenger to reveal, by His permission, what He wills. Indeed, He is Most High and Wise

versets.arabe: وَيُفْسِدُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ
versets.phonetique: Wa-yufsidūn fi-al-ardi
versets.francais: et qui sèment le désordre sur la terre;
versets.anglais: And thus We have revealed to you an inspiration of Our command. You did not know what is the Book or [what is] faith, but We have made it a light by which We guide whom We will of Our servants. And indeed, [O Muhammad], you guide to a straight path

versets.arabe: أُولَٰئِكَ لَهُمُ اللَّعْنَةُ وَلَهُمْ سُوءُ الدَّارِ
versets.phonetique: Ulā'ika lahum-al-la'natu wa-lahum sū'u-ad-dār
versets.francais: Ceux-là ont la malédiction et auront une mauvaise demeure.
versets.anglais: The path of Allah, to whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Unquestionably, to Allah do [all] matters evolve

versets.arabe: حم
versets.phonetique: Ha Mim
versets.francais: Ha. Mim.
versets.anglais: Ha, Meem

versets.arabe: وَالْكِتَابِ الْمُبِينِ
versets.phonetique: Wal-kitabil-mubin
versets.francais: Par le Livre explicite !
versets.anglais: By the clear Book

versets.arabe: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَاهُ قُرْآنًا عَرَبِيًّا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Inna ja'alnahu qur'anan 'arabiyyal la'allakum ta'qilun
versets.francais: Nous en avons fait un Coran en arabe afin que vous raisonniez.
versets.anglais: Indeed, We have made it an Arabic Qur'an that you might understand

versets.arabe: وَإِنَّهُ فِي أُمِّ الْكِتَابِ لَدَيْنَا لَعَلِيٌّ حَكِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa innahu fi umml-kitabi ladayna la'aliyyun hakim
versets.francais: Il est dans l'Écrit-Mère, auprès de Nous, vraiment sublime et plein de sagesse.
versets.anglais: And indeed it is, in the Mother of the Book with Us, exalted and full of wisdom

versets.arabe: أَفَنَضْرِبُ عَنكُمُ الذِّكْرَ صَفْحًا أَن كُنتُمْ قَوْمًا مُّسْرِفِينَ
versets.phonetique: Afanadribu 'ankumudh-dhikra safhan an kuntum qawmam musrifin
versets.francais: Allons-Nous vous épargner le Rappel parce que vous êtes un peuple excessif ?
versets.anglais: Then should We turn the message away, disregarding you, because you are a transgressing people

versets.arabe: وَكَمْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن نَّبِيٍّ فِي الْأَوَّلِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa kam arsalna min nabiyyin fil-awwalin
versets.francais: Combien avons-Nous envoyé de prophètes chez les anciens !
versets.anglais: And how many a prophet We sent among the former peoples

versets.arabe: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن نَّبِيٍّ إِلَّا كَانُوا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِئُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa ma ya'tihim min nabiyyin illa kanu bihi yastahzi'un
versets.francais: Nul prophète ne leur venait sans qu'ils se moquassent de lui.
versets.anglais: But there would not come to them a prophet except that they used to ridicule him

versets.arabe: فَأَهْلَكْنَا أَشَدَّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًا وَمَضَىٰ مَثَلُ الْأَوَّلِينَ
versets.phonetique: Fa'ahlakna ashadda minhum batshaa wa mada mathalul-awwalin
versets.francais: Nous avons détruit des gens plus puissants qu'eux et l'exemple des anciens est passé.
versets.anglais: And We destroyed greater than them in [striking] power, and the example of the former peoples has preceded

versets.arabe: وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ خَلَقَهُنَّ الْعَزِيزُ الْعَلِيمُ
versets.phonetique: Wa la'in sa'altahum man khalaqas-samawati wal-arda layaqulunna khalaqahunal-'azizul-'alim
versets.francais: Si tu leur demandais qui a créé les cieux et la terre, ils diraient sûrement : "C'est le Tout-Puissant, l'Omniscient qui les a créés."
versets.anglais: And if you should ask them, "Who has created the heavens and the earth?" they would surely say, "They were created by the Exalted in Might, the Knowing

versets.arabe: الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْأَرْضَ مَهْدًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمْ فِيهَا سُبُلًا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُونَ
versets.phonetique: Alladhee ja'ala lakumul-arda mahdaw wa ja'ala lakum fiha subulan la'allakum tahtadun
versets.francais: Lui qui a fait pour vous de la terre un berceau et vous a tracé des sentiers afin que vous vous guidiez.
versets.anglais: [The one] who has made for you the earth a bed and made for you upon it roads that you might be guided

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِي نَزَّلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً بِقَدَرٍ فَأَنشَرْنَا بِهِ بَلْدَةً مَّيْتًا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ تُخْرَجُونَ
versets.phonetique: Walladhee nazzala minas-sama'i ma'am biqadarin fa'ansharna bihi baldatam mayta kadhalika tukhrajun
versets.francais: Et Lui qui a fait descendre du ciel l'eau en mesure, et par laquelle Nous avons redonné vie à une contrée morte. Ainsi vous serez ressuscités.
versets.anglais: And who sends down rain from the sky in measured amounts, and We revive thereby a dead land - thus will you be brought forth

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِي خَلَقَ الْأَزْوَاجَ كُلَّهَا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ الْفُلْكِ وَالْأَنْعَامِ مَا تَرْكَبُونَ
versets.phonetique: Walladhee khalaqal-azwaja kullaha wa ja'ala lakum minal-fulki wal-an'ami ma tarkabun
versets.francais: Et Lui qui a créé toutes les paires et a mis à votre disposition les nefs et les bestiaux que vous enfourchez.
versets.anglais: And who created the species, all of them, and has made for you of ships and animals those which you mount

versets.arabe: لِتَسْتَوُوا عَلَىٰ ظُهُورِهِ ثُمَّ تَذْكُرُوا نِعْمَةَ رَبِّكُمْ إِذَا اسْتَوَيْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ وَتَقُولُوا سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Litastawu 'ala dhuhurihit thumma tadhkaru ni'mata rabbikum idhas-tawaytum 'alayhi wa taqulu subhanal-ladhee sakhkhara lana hadha wa ma kunna lahu muqrinin
versets.francais: Pour que vous vous y installiez sur leurs dos, puis que vous vous rappeliez le bienfait de votre Seigneur quand vous vous y êtes installés et que vous disiez : "Gloire à Celui qui nous a assujetti cela, nous n'aurions pu le faire nous-mêmes.",
versets.anglais: That you may settle yourselves upon their backs and then remember the favor of your Lord when you have settled upon them and say. "Exalted is He who has subjected this to us, and we could not have [otherwise] subdued it

versets.arabe: وَإِنَّا إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa inna ila rabbina lamunqalibun
versets.francais: "Et nous retournerons certes vers notre Seigneur."
versets.anglais: And indeed we, to our Lord, will [surely] return

versets.arabe: وَجَعَلُوا لَهُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ جُزْءًا ۚ إِنَّ الْإِنسَانَ لَكَفُورٌ مُّبِينٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa ja'alu lahu min 'ibadihi juz'a innal-insana lakafurum mubin
versets.francais: Ils Lui ont attribué une partie de Ses serviteurs. L'homme est vraiment un ingrat manifeste.
versets.anglais: But they have attributed to Him from His servants a portion. Indeed, man is clearly ungrateful

versets.arabe: أَمِ اتَّخَذَ مِمَّا يَخْلُقُ بَنَاتٍ وَأَصْفَاكُم بِالْبَنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Amit-takhadha mimma yakhluqu banatij wa asfakum bil-banin
versets.francais: A-t-Il pris, parmi ce qu'Il crée, des filles, et vous a-t-Il distingués en vous donnant des fils ?
versets.anglais: Or has He taken, out of what He has created, daughters and chosen you for [having] sons

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا بُشِّرَ أَحَدُهُم بِمَا ضَرَبَ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ مَثَلًا ظَلَّ وَجْهُهُ مُسْوَدًّا وَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa idha bushshira ahaduhum bima daraba lir-rahmani mathalan dhalla wajhuhu muswaddaw wa huwa kadhim
versets.francais: Quand l'un d'eux apprend la naissance de ce qu'il attribue au Tout Miséricordieux, son visage devient noir et il étouffe de chagrin.
versets.anglais: And when one of them is given good tidings of that which he attributes to the Most Merciful in comparison, his face becomes dark, and he suppresses grief

versets.arabe: أَوَمَن يُنَشَّأُ فِي الْحِلْيَةِ وَهُوَ فِي الْخِصَامِ غَيْرُ مُبِينٍ
versets.phonetique: Awa man yunasha'u fil-hilyati wa huwa fil-khisami ghayru mubin
versets.francais: Quoi ! Celui qui est élevé dans les ornements et qui dans la dispute ne sait pas argumenter clairement ?
versets.anglais: So is one brought up in ornaments while being during conflict unevident [attributed to Allah]

versets.arabe: وَجَعَلُوا الْمَلَائِكَةَ الَّذِينَ هُمْ عِبَادُ الرَّحْمَٰنِ إِنَاثًا ۚ أَشَهِدُوا خَلْقَهُمْ ۚ سَتُكْتَبُ شَهَادَتُهُمْ وَيُسْأَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa ja'alul-mala'ikatalladhina hum 'ibaadur-rahmani inatha ashhadu khalqahum satuktatbu shahadatuhum wa yus'alun
versets.francais: Ils ont fait des anges, qui sont les serviteurs du Tout Miséricordieux, des femelles. Ont-ils assisté à leur création ? Leur témoignage sera consigné et on les interrogera.
versets.anglais: And they have made the angels, who are servants of the Most Merciful, females. Did they witness their creation? Their testimony will be recorded, and they will be questioned

versets.arabe: وَقَالُوا لَوْ شَاءَ الرَّحْمَٰنُ مَا عَبَدْنَاهُمْ ۗ مَّا لَهُم بِذَٰلِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ ۖ إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَخْرُصُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa qalu law sha'ar-rahmanu ma 'abadnahum ma lahum bidhalika min 'ilmin in hum illa yakhrusun
versets.francais: Ils ont dit : "Si le Tout Miséricordieux l'avait voulu, nous ne les aurions pas adorés." Ils n'ont là-dessus aucune science ; ils ne font que supposer.
versets.anglais: And they said, "If the Most Merciful had willed, we would not have worshipped them." They have of that no knowledge. They are not but falsifying

versets.arabe: أَمْ آتَيْنَاهُمْ كِتَابًا مِّن قَبْلِهِ فَهُم بِهِ مُسْتَمْسِكُونَ
versets.phonetique: Am ataynamhum kitabam min qablihi fahum bihi mustamsikun
versets.francais: Ou bien leur avons-Nous donné un livre avant lui auquel ils s'accrochent ?
versets.anglais: Or have We given them a book before the Qur'an to which they are adhering

versets.arabe: بَلْ قَالُوا إِنَّا وَجَدْنَا آبَاءَنَا عَلَىٰ أُمَّةٍ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰ آثَارِهِم مُّهْتَدُونَ
versets.phonetique: Bal qalu inna wajadna aba'ana 'ala ummatiw wa inna 'ala atharihim muhtadun
versets.francais: Non ! Ils dirent : "Nous avons trouvé nos pères dans cette pratique et nous suivons leurs traces."
versets.anglais: Rather, they say, "Indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we are in their footsteps [rightly] guided

versets.arabe: وَكَذَٰلِكَ مَا أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ فِي قَرْيَةٍ مِّن نَّذِيرٍ إِلَّا قَالَ مُتْرَفُوهَا إِنَّا وَجَدْنَا آبَاءَنَا عَلَىٰ أُمَّةٍ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰ آثَارِهِم مُّقْتَدُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa kadhalika ma arsalna min qablika fi qaryatim min nadhirin illa qala mutrafuha inna wajadna aba'ana 'ala ummatiw wa inna 'ala atharihim muqtadun
versets.francais: C'est ainsi que chaque fois que Nous envoyions avant toi un avertisseur dans une cité, les gens aisés de celle-ci disaient : "Nous avons trouvé nos pères dans cette pratique et nous suivons leurs traces."
versets.anglais: And similarly, We did not send before you any warner into a city except that its affluent said, "Indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we are, in their footsteps, following

versets.arabe: قَالَ أَوَلَوْ جِئْتُكُم بِأَهْدَىٰ مِمَّا وَجَدتُّمْ عَلَيْهِ آبَاءَكُمْ ۖ قَالُوا إِنَّا بِمَا أُرْسِلْتُم بِهِ كَافِرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qala awa law ji'tukum bi'ahda mimma wajadttum 'alayhi aba'akum qalu inna bima ursiltum bihi kafirun
versets.francais: Il dit : "Même si je vous apportais mieux que ce que vous avez trouvé chez vos pères ?" Ils dirent : "Nous mécroissons en ce dont vous êtes envoyés."
versets.anglais: [Each warner] said, "Even if I brought you better guidance than that [religion] upon which you found your fathers?" They said, "Indeed we, in that with which you were sent, are disbelievers

versets.arabe: فَانتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ ۖ فَانظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُكَذِّبِينَ
versets.phonetique: Fantasaqmna minhum fandhur kayfa kana 'aqibatal-mukadhdhibin
versets.francais: Nous nous sommes vengés d'eux. Observe ce qu'il est advenu de ceux qui ont démenti.
versets.anglais: So we took retribution from them; then see how was the end of the deniers

versets.arabe: وَإِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِ إِنَّنِي بَرَاءٌ مِّمَّا تَعْبُدُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa idh qala ibrahimu li'abihi wa qawmihi innani bara'um mimma ta'budun
versets.francais: Quand Abraham dit à son père et à son peuple : "Je me dissocie de ce que vous adorez,
versets.anglais: And [mention, O Muhammad], when Abraham said to his father and his people, "Indeed, I am disassociated from that which you worship

versets.arabe: إِلَّا الَّذِي فَطَرَنِي فَإِنَّهُ سَيَهْدِينِ
versets.phonetique: Illal-ladhee fatarani fa'innahu sayahdini
versets.francais: "Sauf Celui qui m'a créé - Il me guidera certes."
versets.anglais: Except for He who created me; and indeed, He will guide me

versets.arabe: وَجَعَلَهَا كَلِمَةً بَاقِيَةً فِي عَقِبِهِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa ja'alaha kalimatan baqiyatan fi 'aqibihi la'allahum yarji'un
versets.francais: Il en fit une parole qui devait persister parmi sa descendance afin qu'ils reviennent.
versets.anglais: And he made it a word remaining among his descendants that they might return [to it]

versets.arabe: بَلْ مَتَّعْتُ هَٰؤُلَاءِ وَآبَاءَهُمْ حَتَّىٰ جَاءَهُمُ الْحَقُّ وَرَسُولٌ مُّبِينٌ
versets.phonetique: Bal matta'tu ha'ula'i wa aba'ahum hatta ja'ahumul-haqqu wa rasulum mubin
versets.francais: Non, J'ai donné à jouir à ceux-là et à leurs pères jusqu'à ce que leur vienne la Vérité et un messager explicite.
versets.anglais: However, I gave enjoyment to these [people of Makkah] and their fathers until there came to them the truth and a clear Messenger

versets.arabe: وَلَمَّا جَاءَهُمُ الْحَقُّ قَالُوا هَٰذَا سِحْرٌ وَإِنَّا بِهِ كَافِرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa lamma ja'ahumul-haqqu qalu hadha sihiur wa inna bihi kafirun
versets.francais: Quand la Vérité leur vint, ils dirent : "C'est de la magie, et nous y mécroissons."
versets.anglais: But when the truth came to them, they said, "This is magic, and indeed we are, concerning it, disbelievers

versets.arabe: وَقَالُوا لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ هَٰذَا الْقُرْآنُ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٍ مِّنَ الْقَرْيَتَيْنِ عَظِيمٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa qalu lawla nuzzila hadhal-qur'anu 'ala rajulim minal-qaryatayni 'azim
versets.francais: Ils dirent : "Que n'a-t-on révélé ce Coran à un homme important de l'une des deux villes ?"
versets.anglais: And they said, "Why was this Qur'an not sent down upon a great man from [one of] the two cities

versets.arabe: أَهُمْ يَقْسِمُونَ رَحْمَتَ رَبِّكَ ۚ نَحْنُ قَسَمْنَا بَيْنَهُم مَّعِيشَتَهُمْ فِي الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا ۚ وَرَفَعْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ فَوْقَ بَعْضٍ دَرَجَاتٍ لِّيَتَّخِذَ بَعْضُهُم بَعْضًا سُخْرِيًّا ۗ وَرَحْمَتُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌ مِّمَّا يَجْمَعُونَ
versets.phonetique: Ahum yaqsimuna rahmata rabbik nahnu qasamba baynahum ma'ishatahum fil-hayatid-dunya wa rafa'na ba'dahum fawqa ba'din darajatin liyattakhidha ba'duhum ba'dan sukhriyya wa rahmatu rabbika khayrum mimma yajma'un
versets.francais: Est-ce eux qui distribuent la miséricorde de ton Seigneur ? C'est Nous qui distribuons entre eux leur subsistance dans la vie d'ici-bas et qui élevons les uns au-dessus des autres en degrés afin que les uns prennent les autres à leur service. La miséricorde de ton Seigneur vaut mieux que ce qu'ils amassent.
versets.anglais: Do they distribute the mercy of your Lord? It is We who have apportioned among them their livelihood in the life of this world and have raised some of them above others in degrees [of rank] that they may make use of one another for service. But the mercy of your Lord is better than whatever they accumulate

versets.arabe: وَلَوْلَا أَن يَكُونَ النَّاسُ أُمَّةً وَاحِدَةً لَّجَعَلْنَا لِمَن يَكْفُرُ بِالرَّحْمَٰنِ لِبُيُوتِهِمْ سُقُفًا مِّن فِضَّةٍ وَمَعَارِجَ عَلَيْهَا يَظْهَرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa lawla ay yakuunan-naasu ummataw wahidatal laja'alna liman yakfuru bir-rahmani libyutihim suqufam min fiddatiw wa ma'arija 'alayha yadh-harun
versets.francais: N'était la crainte que les hommes ne forment qu'une seule communauté, Nous aurions donné aux mécréants en le Tout Miséricordieux, des toits en argent pour leurs maisons et des escaliers pour y monter.
versets.anglais: And if it were not that the people would become one community [of disbelievers], We would have made for those who disbelieve in the Most Merciful - for their houses - ceilings and stairways of silver upon which to mount

versets.arabe: وَلِبُيُوتِهِمْ أَبْوَابًا وَسُرُرًا عَلَيْهَا يَتَّكِئُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa libyutihim abwabaw wa sururan 'alayha yattaki'un
versets.francais: Et des portes pour leurs maisons et des divans sur lesquels ils s'accouderaient.
versets.anglais: And for their houses - doors and couches [of silver] upon which to recline

versets.arabe: وَزُخْرُفًا ۚ وَإِن كُلُّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمَّا مَتَاعُ الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا ۚ وَالْآخِرَةُ عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa zukhrufaa wa in kullu dhalika lamma mata'ul-hayatid-dunya wal-akhiratu 'inda rabbika lil-muttaqin
versets.francais: Et des ornements d'or. Tout cela ne serait que jouissance de la vie d'ici-bas. Et l'au-delà, auprès de ton Seigneur, est pour les pieux.
versets.anglais: And gold ornament. But all that is not but the enjoyment of worldly life. And the Hereafter with your Lord is for the righteous

versets.arabe: وَمَن يَعْشُ عَن ذِكْرِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ نُقَيِّضْ لَهُ شَيْطَانًا فَهُوَ لَهُ قَرِينٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa may ya'shu 'an dhikrir-rahmani nuqayyid lahu shaytanan fahuw lahu qarin
versets.francais: Quiconque s'aveugle sur le rappel du Tout Miséricordieux, Nous lui adjoignons un démon qui devient son compagnon.
versets.anglais: And whoever is blinded from remembrance of the Most Merciful - We appoint for him a devil, and he is to him a companion

versets.arabe: وَإِنَّهُمْ لَيَصُدُّونَهُمْ عَنِ السَّبِيلِ وَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّهُم مُّهْتَدُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa innahum layasuddunnahum 'anis-sabili wa yahsabuna annahum muhtadun
versets.francais: Ils les détournent du chemin tandis qu'ils s'imaginent être bien guidés.
versets.anglais: And indeed, the devils avert them from the way [of guidance] while they think that they are [rightly] guided

versets.arabe: حَتَّىٰ إِذَا جَاءَنَا قَالَ يَا لَيْتَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكَ بُعْدَ الْمَشْرِقَيْنِ فَبِئْسَ الْقَرِينُ
versets.phonetique: Hatta idha ja'ana qala ya layta bayni wa baynaka bu'dal-mashriqqayni fabi'sal-qarin
versets.francais: Jusqu'à ce qu'il nous vienne et dise : "Que n'y avait-il entre moi et toi la distance des deux orients ! Quel mauvais compagnon !"
versets.anglais: Until, when he comes to Us [at Judgement], he says [to his companion], "Oh, I wish there was between me and you the distance between the east and west - how wretched a companion

versets.arabe: وَلَن يَنفَعَكُمُ الْيَوْمَ إِذ ظَّلَمْتُمْ أَنَّكُمْ فِي الْعَذَابِ مُشْتَرِكُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa lay yanfa'akumul-yawma idh dhalamtum annakum fil-'adhabi mushtarikun
versets.francais: Aujourd'hui, puisque vous avez été injustes, cela ne vous profitera pas que vous partagerez le châtiment.
versets.anglais: And never will it benefit you that Day, when you have wronged, that you are [all] sharing in the punishment

versets.arabe: أَفَأَنتَ تُسْمِعُ الصُّمَّ أَوْ تَهْدِي الْعُمْيَ وَمَن كَانَ فِي ضَلَالٍ مُّبِينٍ
versets.phonetique: Afa'anta tusmi'us-summa aw tahdi 'umya wa man kana fi dalalim mubin
versets.francais: Peux-tu faire entendre les sourds ou guider les aveugles et ceux qui sont dans un égarement manifeste ?
versets.anglais: Then will you make the deaf hear, [O Muhammad], or guide the blind or he who is in clear error

versets.arabe: فَإِمَّا نَذْهَبَنَّ بِكَ فَإِنَّا مِنْهُم مُّنتَقِمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Fa'imma nadhhabanna bika fa'inna minhum muntaqimun
versets.francais: Soit Nous t'emportons, Nous Nous vengerons d'eux,
versets.anglais: And whether [or not] We take you away [in death], indeed, We will take retribution upon them

versets.arabe: أَوْ نُرِيَنَّكَ الَّذِي وَعَدْنَاهُمْ فَإِنَّا عَلَيْهِم مُّقْتَدِرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Aw nuriyannakal-ladhee wa'adnahum fa'inna 'alayhim muqtadirun
versets.francais: Soit Nous te faisons voir ce dont Nous les avons menacés - Nous avons plein pouvoir sur eux.
versets.anglais: Or whether [or not] We show you that which We have promised them, indeed, We are Perfect in Ability

versets.arabe: فَاسْتَمْسِكْ بِالَّذِي أُوحِيَ إِلَيْكَ ۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
versets.phonetique: Fastamsik billadhee uhiya ilayka innaka 'ala siratim mustaqim
versets.francais: Accroche-toi donc à ce qui t'a été révélé, car tu es sur un droit chemin.
versets.anglais: So adhere to that which is revealed to you. Indeed, you are on a straight path

versets.arabe: وَإِنَّهُ لَذِكْرٌ لَّكَ وَلِقَوْمِكَ ۖ وَسَوْفَ تُسْأَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa innahu ladhikrul laka wa liqawmik wa sawfa tus'alun
versets.francais: C'est un rappel pour toi et pour ton peuple. Et vous serez interrogés.
versets.anglais: And indeed, it is a remembrance for you and your people, and you [all] are going to be questioned

versets.arabe: وَاسْأَلْ مَنْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رُّسُلِنَا أَجَعَلْنَا مِن دُونِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ آلِهَةً يُعْبَدُونَ
versets.phonetique: Was'al man arsalna min qablika mir ruslina aja'alna min dunir-rahmani alihatay yu'badun
versets.francais: Et interroge ceux que Nous avons envoyés avant toi parmi Nos messagers : avons-Nous établi en dehors du Tout Miséricordieux des divinités à adorer ?
versets.anglais: And ask those We sent before you of Our messengers; have We made besides the Most Merciful deities to be worshipped

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ بِآيَاتِنَا إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَئِهِ فَقَالَ إِنِّي رَسُولُ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa laqad arsalna musa bi'ayatina ila fir'awna wa mala'ihi faqala inni rasulur-rabbil-'alamin
versets.francais: Nous avons envoyé Moïse avec Nos signes à Pharaon et à ses notables. Il dit : "Je suis le messager du Seigneur de l'univers."
versets.anglais: And certainly did We send Moses with Our signs to Pharaoh and his establishment, and he said, "Indeed, I am the messenger of the Lord of the worlds

versets.arabe: فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُم بِآيَاتِنَا إِذَا هُم مِّنْهَا يَضْحَكُونَ
versets.phonetique: Falamma ja'ahum bi'ayatina idha hum minha yadhakun
versets.francais: Quand il leur vint avec Nos signes, ils s'en moquèrent aussitôt.
versets.anglais: But when he brought them Our signs, at once they laughed at them

versets.arabe: وَمَا نُرِيهِم مِّنْ آيَةٍ إِلَّا هِيَ أَكْبَرُ مِنْ أُخْتِهَا ۖ وَأَخَذْنَاهُم بِالْعَذَابِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa ma nurihim min ayatin illa hiya akbaru min ukhtiiha wa akhadh nahum bil-'adhabi la'allahum yarji'un
versets.francais: Nous ne leur montrions aucun signe sans qu'il fût plus grand que le signe précédent. Nous les avons saisis par le châtiment afin qu'ils reviennent.
versets.anglais: And We showed them not a sign except that it was greater than its sister, and We seized them with affliction that perhaps they might return [to faith]

versets.arabe: وَقَالُوا يَا أَيُّهَ السَّاحِرُ ادْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ بِمَا عَهِدَ عِندَكَ إِنَّنَا لَمُهْتَدُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa qalu ya ayyuhas-sahiru ud'u lana rabbaka bima 'ahida 'indaka innana lamuhtadun
versets.francais: Ils dirent : "Ô magicien, invoque pour nous ton Seigneur au nom de ce qu'Il a conclu avec toi, nous serons certes bien guidés."
versets.anglais: And they said [to Moses], "O magician, invoke for us your Lord by what He has promised you. Indeed, we will be guided

versets.arabe: فَلَمَّا كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُمُ الْعَذَابَ إِذَا هُمْ يَنكُثُونَ
versets.phonetique: Falamma kashafna 'anhumul-'adhaba idha hum yankuthun
versets.francais: Mais quand Nous enlevâmes d'eux le châtiment, ils violèrent aussitôt leur promesse.
versets.anglais: But when We removed from them the affliction, at once they broke their word

versets.arabe: وَنَادَىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ فِي قَوْمِهِ قَالَ يَا قَوْمِ أَلَيْسَ لِي مُلْكُ مِصْرَ وَهَٰذِهِ الْأَنْهَارُ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِي ۖ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa nada fir'awnu fi qawmihi qala ya qawmi alaysa li mulku misra wa hadhihil-anharu tajri min tahti afala tubsirun
versets.francais: Pharaon proclama parmi son peuple : "Ô mon peuple, le royaume d'Égypte ne m'appartient-il pas, et ces fleuves qui coulent à mes pieds ? Ne voyez-vous pas ?"
versets.anglais: And Pharaoh called out among his people; he said, "O my people, does not the kingdom of Egypt belong to me, and these rivers flowing beneath me; then do you not see

versets.arabe: أَمْ أَنَا خَيْرٌ مِّنْ هَٰذَا الَّذِي هُوَ مَهِينٌ وَلَا يَكَادُ يُبِينُ
versets.phonetique: Am ana khayrum min hadhal-ladhee huwa mahinuw wa la yakadu yubin
versets.francais: "Ne suis-je pas meilleur que cet homme méprisable qui ne sait presque pas s'exprimer clairement ?
versets.anglais: Or am I [not] better than this one who is insignificant and hardly makes himself clear

versets.arabe: فَلَوْلَا أُلْقِيَ عَلَيْهِ أَسَاوِرَةٌ مِّن ذَهَبٍ أَوْ جَاءَ مَعَهُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ مُقْتَرِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Falawla ulqiya 'alayhi asawiratam min dhahabin aw ja'a ma'ahul-mala'ikatu muqtarin
versets.francais: "Que ne lui a-t-on mis des bracelets d'or, ou que les anges ne l'ont-ils accompagné ?"
versets.anglais: Then why have there not been placed upon him bracelets of gold or come with him the angels in conjunction

versets.arabe: فَاسْتَخَفَّ قَوْمَهُ فَأَطَاعُوهُ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا قَوْمًا فَاسِقِينَ
versets.phonetique: Fastakhaffa qawmahu fa'ata'uh innahum kanu qawman fasiqin
versets.francais: Il rendit son peuple frivole et ils lui obéirent. C'était vraiment un peuple pervers.
versets.anglais: So he bluffed his people, and they obeyed him. Indeed, they were [themselves] a people defiantly disobedient [of Allah]

versets.arabe: فَلَمَّا آسَفُونَا انتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ فَأَغْرَقْنَاهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
versets.phonetique: Falamma asafuna antaqamna minhum fa'aghraqnahum ajma'in
versets.francais: Quand ils Nous eurent irrité, Nous Nous vengeâmes d'eux et les noyâmes tous.
versets.anglais: And when they angered Us, We took retribution from them and drowned them all

versets.arabe: فَجَعَلْنَاهُمْ سَلَفًا وَمَثَلًا لِّلْآخِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Faja'alnahum salafaw wa mathalal lil-akhirin
versets.francais: Nous en fîmes des précédents et un exemple pour les suivants.
versets.anglais: And We made them a precedent and an example for the later peoples

versets.arabe: وَلَمَّا ضُرِبَ ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ مَثَلًا إِذَا قَوْمُكَ مِنْهُ يَصِدُّونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa lamma duriba bnu maryama mathalan idha qawmuka minhu yasiddun
versets.francais: Quand le fils de Marie fut cité en exemple, voilà que ton peuple poussa des clameurs.
versets.anglais: And when the son of Mary was presented as an example, immediately your people laughed aloud

versets.arabe: وَقَالُوا أَآلِهَتُنَا خَيْرٌ أَمْ هُوَ ۚ مَا ضَرَبُوهُ لَكَ إِلَّا جَدَلًا ۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ خَصِمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa qalu a'alihatuna khayrun am huw ma darabuhu laka illa jadalaa bal hum qawmun khasimun
versets.francais: Ils dirent : "Nos divinités sont-elles meilleures que lui ?" Ils ne te l'ont cité qu'à titre de discussion. Ils ne sont, en fait, que chicaneurs.
versets.anglais: And they said, "Are your gods better, or is he?" They did not present the comparison except for [mere] argument. But, [in fact], they are a people prone to dispute

versets.arabe: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا عَبْدٌ أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَجَعَلْنَاهُ مَثَلًا لِّبَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ
versets.phonetique: In huwa illa 'abdun an'amna 'alayhi wa ja'alnahu mathalan libani isra'il
versets.francais: Il n'est qu'un serviteur que Nous avons comblé de bienfaits et que Nous avons donné en exemple aux Enfants d'Israël.
versets.anglais: Jesus was not but a servant upon whom We bestowed favor, and We made him an example for the Children of Israel

versets.arabe: وَلَوْ نَشَاءُ لَجَعَلْنَا مِنكُم مَّلَائِكَةً فِي الْأَرْضِ يَخْلُفُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa law nasha'u laja'alna minkum mala'ikatan fil-ardi yakhlufun
versets.francais: Si Nous voulions, Nous aurions mis à votre place des anges sur terre pour vous succéder.
versets.anglais: And if We willed, We could have made [instead] of you angels succeeding [one another] on the earth

versets.arabe: وَإِنَّهُ لَعِلْمٌ لِّلسَّاعَةِ فَلَا تَمْتَرُنَّ بِهَا وَاتَّبِعُونِ ۚ هَٰذَا صِرَاطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa innahu la'ilmul lis-sa'ati fala tamtarunnna biha wattabi'uni hadha siratun mustaqim
versets.francais: Il est un signe annonciateur de l'Heure. N'en doutez point et suivez-moi. Voilà le droit chemin.
versets.anglais: And indeed, Jesus will be [a sign for] knowledge of the Hour, so be not in doubt of it, and follow Me. This is a straight path

versets.arabe: وَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكُمُ الشَّيْطَانُ ۖ إِنَّهُ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِينٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa la yasuddannakumush-shaytanu innahu lakum 'aduwwum mubin
versets.francais: Que le Diable ne vous détourne pas. C'est pour vous un ennemi déclaré.
versets.anglais: And never let Satan avert you. Indeed, he is to you a clear enemy

versets.arabe: وَلَمَّا جَاءَ عِيسَىٰ بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ قَالَ قَدْ جِئْتُكُم بِالْحِكْمَةِ وَلِأُبَيِّنَ لَكُم بَعْضَ الَّذِي تَخْتَلِفُونَ فِيهِ ۖ فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
versets.phonetique: Wa lamma ja'a 'isa bil-bayyinati qala qad ji'tukum bil-hikmati wa li'ubayyina lakum ba'dalldhee takhtalilfuna fihi fattaqullaha wa ati'un
versets.francais: Quand Jésus vint avec les preuves évidentes, il dit : "Je suis venu à vous avec la sagesse, et pour vous expliquer une partie de ce sur quoi vous divergez. Craignez Allah et obéissez-moi.
versets.anglais: And when Jesus brought clear proofs, he said, "I have come to you with wisdom and to make clear to you some of that over which you differ, so fear Allah and obey me

versets.arabe: إِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ رَبِّي وَرَبُّكُمْ فَاعْبُدُوهُ ۚ هَٰذَا صِرَاطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Innallaha huwa rabbi wa rabbukum fa'buduhu hadha siratun mustaqim
versets.francais: "Allah est mon Seigneur et votre Seigneur. Adorez-Le donc ! Voilà le droit chemin."
versets.anglais: Indeed, Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. This is a straight path

versets.arabe: فَاخْتَلَفَ الْأَحْزَابُ مِن بَيْنِهِمْ ۖ فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمٍ أَلِيمٍ
versets.phonetique: Fakhtalafal-ahzabu mim baynihim fawaylul lilladhina dhalamu min 'adhabi yawmin alim
versets.francais: Les factions se mirent alors à diverger entre eux. Malheur donc à ceux qui ont été injustes, à cause du châtiment d'un jour douloureux.
versets.anglais: But the denominations from among them differed [and separated], so woe to those who have wronged from the punishment of a painful Day

versets.arabe: هَلْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا السَّاعَةَ أَن تَأْتِيَهُم بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Hal yanduruna illas-sa'ata an ta'tiyahum baghtatan wa hum la yash'urun
versets.francais: N'attendent-ils que l'Heure qui leur viendra à l'improviste sans qu'ils s'en doutent ?
versets.anglais: Are they waiting except for the Hour to come upon them suddenly while they perceive not

versets.arabe: الْأَخِلَّاءُ يَوْمَئِذٍ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّ إِلَّا الْمُتَّقِينَ
versets.phonetique: Al-akhilla'u yawma'idhin ba'duhum liba'din 'aduwwun illal-muttaqin
versets.francais: Les amis intimes, ce Jour-là, seront des ennemis les uns pour les autres, sauf les pieux.
versets.anglais: Close friends, that Day, will be enemies to each other, except for the righteous

versets.arabe: يَا عِبَادِ لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْكُمُ الْيَوْمَ وَلَا أَنتُمْ تَحْزَنُونَ
versets.phonetique: Ya 'ibadi la khawfun 'alaykumul-yawma wa la antum tahzanun
versets.francais: "Ô Mes serviteurs, pas de crainte pour vous aujourd'hui et vous ne serez pas attristés.
versets.anglais: [To whom Allah will say], "O My servants, no fear will there be concerning you this Day, nor will you grieve

versets.arabe: الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا بِآيَاتِنَا وَكَانُوا مُسْلِمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Alladhina amanu bi'ayatina wa kanu muslimin
versets.francais: Vous qui avez cru en Nos versets et qui étiez soumis.
versets.anglais: [You] who believed in Our verses and were Muslims

versets.arabe: ادْخُلُوا الْجَنَّةَ أَنتُمْ وَأَزْوَاجُكُمْ تُحْبَرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Udkhulul-jannata antum wa azwajukum tuhbarun
versets.francais: "Entrez au Paradis, vous et vos épouses, dans la joie."
versets.anglais: Enter Paradise, you and your kinds, delighted

versets.arabe: يُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِصِحَافٍ مِّن ذَهَبٍ وَأَكْوَابٍ ۖ وَفِيهَا مَا تَشْتَهِيهِ الْأَنفُسُ وَتَلَذُّ الْأَعْيُنُ ۖ وَأَنتُمْ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ
versets.phonetique: Yutafu 'alayhim bisihafim min dhahabiw wa akwab wa fiha ma tashtahihi-l-anfusu wa taladhdhu-l-a'yun wa antum fiha khalidun
versets.francais: On fera circuler parmi eux des plats et des coupes d'or. Il y aura là ce que les âmes désirent et ce qui réjouit les yeux. Vous y demeurerez éternellement.
versets.anglais: Circulated among them will be plates and vessels of gold. And therein is whatever the souls desire and [what] delights the eyes, and you will abide therein eternally

versets.arabe: وَتِلْكَ الْجَنَّةُ الَّتِي أُورِثْتُمُوهَا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa tilkal-jannatul-lati urithtumuhaa bima kuntum ta'malun
versets.francais: "Voilà le Paradis en héritage que vous avez eu pour ce que vous faisiez."
versets.anglais: And that is Paradise which you are made to inherit for what you used to do

versets.arabe: لَكُمْ فِيهَا فَاكِهَةٌ كَثِيرَةٌ مِّنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Lakum fiha fakihatun kathiratun minha ta'kulun
versets.francais: "Vous y avez en abondance des fruits dont vous vous nourrissez."
versets.anglais: For you therein is much fruit from which you will eat

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الْمُجْرِمِينَ فِي عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدُونَ
versets.phonetique: Innal-mujrimina fi 'adhabi jahannama khalidun
versets.francais: Les criminels demeureront éternellement dans le châtiment de l'Enfer.
versets.anglais: Indeed, the criminals will be in the punishment of Hell, abiding eternally

versets.arabe: لَا يُفَتَّرُ عَنْهُمْ وَهُمْ فِيهِ مُبْلِسُونَ
versets.phonetique: La yufatttaru 'anhum wa hum fihi mublisun
versets.francais: Il ne leur sera pas allégé et ils seront désespérés.
versets.anglais: It will not be allowed to subside for them, and they, therein, are in despair

versets.arabe: وَمَا ظَلَمْنَاهُمْ وَلَٰكِن كَانُوا هُمُ الظَّالِمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa ma dhalamnahum wa lakin kanu humudh-dhalimin
versets.francais: Nous ne leur avons pas été injustes, mais c'est eux qui étaient les injustes.
versets.anglais: And We did not wrong them, but it was they who were the wrongdoers

versets.arabe: وَنَادَوْا يَا مَالِكُ لِيَقْضِ عَلَيْنَا رَبُّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّكُم مَّاكِثُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa nadaw ya maliku liyaqdi 'alayna rabbuk qala innakum makithun
versets.francais: Ils appelèrent : "Ô Malik, que ton Seigneur nous donne la mort !" Il dit : "Vous y resterez."
versets.anglais: And they will call, "O Malik, let your Lord put an end to us!" He will say, "Indeed, you will remain

versets.arabe: لَقَدْ جِئْنَاكُم بِالْحَقِّ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَكُمْ لِلْحَقِّ كَارِهُونَ
versets.phonetique: Laqad ji'nakum bil-haqqi wa lakinna aktharakum lil-haqqi karihun
versets.francais: Nous vous avons certes apporté la Vérité, mais la plupart d'entre vous avez de l'aversion pour la Vérité.
versets.anglais: We had certainly brought you the truth, but most of you, to the truth, were averse

versets.arabe: أَمْ أَبْرَمُوا أَمْرًا فَإِنَّا مُبْرِمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Am abramu amran fa'inna mubrimun
versets.francais: Ont-ils décidé une affaire ? Nous aussi Nous décidons.
versets.anglais: Or have they devised [some] affair? But indeed, We are devising [a plan]

versets.arabe: أَمْ يَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّا لَا نَسْمَعُ سِرَّهُمْ وَنَجْوَاهُمْ ۚ بَلَىٰ وَرُسُلُنَا لَدَيْهِمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
versets.phonetique: Am yahsabuna anna la nasma'u sirrahum wa najwahum bala wa rusuluna ladayhim yaktubun
versets.francais: Pensent-ils que Nous n'entendons pas leurs secrets et leurs conciliabules ? Mais si ! Et Nos envoyés auprès d'eux notent tout.
versets.anglais: Or do they think that We hear not their secrets and their private conversations? Yes, [We do], and Our messengers are with them recording

versets.arabe: قُلْ إِن كَانَ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ وَلَدٌ فَأَنَا أَوَّلُ الْعَابِدِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qul in kana lir-rahmani waladun fa'ana awwalul-'abidin
versets.francais: Dis : "Si le Tout Miséricordieux avait un fils, je serais le premier à l'adorer."
versets.anglais: Say, [O Muhammad], "If the Most Merciful had a son, then I would be the first of [his] worshippers

versets.arabe: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ رَبِّ الْعَرْشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
versets.phonetique: Subhana rabbis-samawati wal-ardi rabbil-'arshi 'amma yasifun
versets.francais: Gloire au Seigneur des cieux et de la terre, Seigneur du Trône, bien au-dessus de ce qu'ils décrivent.
versets.anglais: Exalted is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Lord of the Throne, above what they describe

versets.arabe: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوا وَيَلْعَبُوا حَتَّىٰ يُلَاقُوا يَوْمَهُمُ الَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ
versets.phonetique: Fadhar hum yakhudhu wa yal'abu hatta yulaquu yawmahumul-ladhee yu'adun
versets.francais: Laisse-les donc se livrer à leurs vains discours et jouer jusqu'à ce qu'ils rencontrent leur Jour qui leur a été promis.
versets.anglais: So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised

versets.arabe: وَهُوَ الَّذِي فِي السَّمَاءِ إِلَٰهٌ وَفِي الْأَرْضِ إِلَٰهٌ ۚ وَهُوَ الْحَكِيمُ الْعَلِيمُ
versets.phonetique: Wa huwal-ladhee fis-sama'i ilahuw wa fil-ardi ilah wa huwal-hakimul-'alim
versets.francais: C'est Lui qui est Dieu au ciel et Dieu sur la terre. Il est le Sage, l'Omniscient.
versets.anglais: And it is Allah who is [the only] deity in the heaven, and on the earth [the only] deity. And He is the Wise, the Knowing

versets.arabe: وَتَبَارَكَ الَّذِي لَهُ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَعِندَهُ عِلْمُ السَّاعَةِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa tabarakal-ladhee lahu mulkus-samawati wal-ardi wa ma baynahuma wa 'indahu 'ilmus-sa'ati wa ilayhi turja'un
versets.francais: Béni soit Celui à qui appartient la royauté des cieux et de la terre et de ce qui est entre eux. Il a la science de l'Heure et c'est vers Lui que vous serez ramenés.
versets.anglais: And blessed is He to whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them and with whom is knowledge of the Hour and to whom you will be returned

versets.arabe: وَلَا يَمْلِكُ الَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِ الشَّفَاعَةَ إِلَّا مَن شَهِدَ بِالْحَقِّ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa la yamliku alladhina yad'una min dunihi-sh-shafa'ata illa man shahida bil-haqqi wa hum ya'lamun
versets.francais: Ceux qu'ils invoquent en dehors de Lui n'ont aucun pouvoir d'intercession, sauf celui qui a témoigné de la vérité en toute connaissance.
versets.anglais: And those they invoke besides Him do not possess [power of] intercession; but only those who testify to the truth [can benefit], and they know

versets.arabe: وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَهُمْ لَيَقُولُنَّ اللَّهُ ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ يُؤْفَكُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa la'in sa'altahum man khalaqahum layaqulunna allahu fa'anna yu'fakun
versets.francais: Si tu leur demandes qui les a créés, ils diront sûrement : "Allah." Où sont-ils donc détournés ?
versets.anglais: And if you asked them who created them, they would surely say, "Allah." So how are they deluded

versets.arabe: وَقِيلِهِ يَا رَبِّ إِنَّ هَٰؤُلَاءِ قَوْمٌ لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa qilihee ya rabbi inna ha'ula'i qawmul la yu'minun
versets.francais: Il dit : "Seigneur, ce sont des gens qui ne croient pas."
versets.anglais: And [Allah acknowledges] his saying, "O my Lord, indeed these are a people who do not believe

versets.arabe: فَاصْفَحْ عَنْهُمْ وَقُلْ سَلَامٌ ۚ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Fasafah 'anhum wa qul salam fasawfa ya'lamun
versets.francais: "Détourne-toi d'eux et dis : Paix ! Ils sauront bientôt."
versets.anglais: So turn aside from them and say, "Peace." But they are going to know

versets.arabe: حم
versets.phonetique: Hâ Mîm
versets.francais: Hâ Mîm
versets.anglais: Ha, Meem

versets.arabe: وَالْكِتَابِ الْمُبِينِ
versets.phonetique: Wa-l-kitâbi-l-mubîn
versets.francais: Par le Livre explicite
versets.anglais: By the clear Book

versets.arabe: إِنَّا أَنزَلْنَاهُ فِي لَيْلَةٍ مُّبَارَكَةٍ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Innâ anzalnâhu fî laylatin mubârakah, innâ kunnâ mundhirîn
versets.francais: Nous l'avons fait descendre une nuit bénie. Nous sommes Celui qui avertit
versets.anglais: Indeed, We sent it down during a blessed night. Indeed, We were to warn [mankind]

versets.arabe: فِيهَا يُفْرَقُ كُلُّ أَمْرٍ حَكِيمٍ
versets.phonetique: Fîhâ yufraq kullu amrin hakîm
versets.francais: Dans cette nuit, toute affaire pleine de sagesse est décidée
versets.anglais: On that night is made distinct every precise matter

versets.arabe: أَمْرًا مِّنْ عِندِنَا إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرْسِلِينَ
versets.phonetique: Amran min 'indina, innâ kunnâ mursilîn
versets.francais: C'est un ordre de Notre part. Nous envoyons toujours
versets.anglais: [Every] matter [proceeding] from Us. Indeed, We were to send [a messenger]

versets.arabe: رَحْمَةً مِّن رَّبِّكَ إِنَّهُ هُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
versets.phonetique: Rahma min rabbika, innahu huwa-s-samî'u-l-'alîm
versets.francais: Une miséricorde de la part de ton Seigneur. Il est Celui qui entend et qui sait
versets.anglais: As mercy from your Lord. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing

versets.arabe: رَبِّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Rabbi-s-samâwâti wa-l-ardi wa mâ baynahuma, in kuntum muqinîn
versets.francais: Seigneur des cieux et de la terre et de ce qui est entre les deux, si vous en êtes certains
versets.anglais: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them, if you would be certain

versets.arabe: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ آبَائِكُمُ الْأَوَّلِينَ
versets.phonetique: Lâ ilâha illâ huwa yuhyî wa yumît, rabbukum wa rabb âbâikum-ul-awwalîn
versets.francais: Il n'y a de dieu que Lui. Il fait vivre et mourir. Votre Seigneur et le Seigneur de vos ancêtres
versets.anglais: There is no deity except Him; He gives life and causes death. [He is] your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers

versets.arabe: بَلْ هُمْ فِي شَكٍّ يَلْعَبُونَ
versets.phonetique: Bal hum fî shakkin yal'abûn
versets.francais: Non! Ils sont dans le doute et ils plaisantent
versets.anglais: But they are in doubt, amusing themselves

versets.arabe: فَارْقُبْ يَوْمَ تَأْتِي السَّمَاءُ بِدُخَانٍ مُّبِينٍ
versets.phonetique: Farqub yawma ta'tî-s-samâu bi dukhanin mubîn
versets.francais: Sois donc attentif, le jour où le ciel apportera une fumée visible
versets.anglais: Then watch for the Day when the sky will bring a visible smoke

versets.arabe: يَغْشَى النَّاسَ هَذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Yaghshâ-n-nâs, hâdhâ 'adhâbun alîm
versets.francais: qui enveloppera les gens. Ceci est un châtiment douloureux
versets.anglais: Covering the people; this is a painful torment

versets.arabe: رَبَّنَا اكْشِفْ عَنَّا الْعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤْمِنُونَ
versets.phonetique: Rabbanâ-kshif 'annâ-l-'adhâb, innâ mu'minûn
versets.francais: Ô notre Seigneur! Écarte de nous le châtiment. Nous avons la foi
versets.anglais: [They will say], "Our Lord, remove from us the torment; indeed, we are believers

versets.arabe: أَنَّى لَهُمُ الذِّكْرَى وَقَدْ جَاءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ مُّبِينٌ
versets.phonetique: Annâ lahumu-dh-dhikrâ wa qad jâ'ahum rasûlun mubîn
versets.francais: Comment pourraient-ils se rappeler alors qu'un Messager évident est venu à eux
versets.anglais: How will there be for them a reminder [at that time]? And there had come to them a clear Messenger

versets.arabe: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوْا عَنْهُ وَقَالُوا مُعَلَّمٌ مَّجْنُونٌ
versets.phonetique: Thumma tawallaw 'anhu wa qâlû mu'allam majnûn
versets.francais: Puis ils s'en détournèrent en disant: "Un homme enseigné par d'autres, qui a perdu la raison"
versets.anglais: Then they turned away from him and said, "[He was] taught [and is] a madman

versets.arabe: إِنَّا كَاشِفُو الْعَذَابِ قَلِيلًا إِنَّكُمْ عَائِدُونَ
versets.phonetique: Innâ kâshifû-l-'adhâbi qalîlan, innakum 'âidûn
versets.francais: Nous allons écarter le châtiment un peu. Mais vous allez revenir
versets.anglais: Indeed, We will remove the torment for a little. Indeed, you [disbelievers] will return [to disbelief]

versets.arabe: يَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ الْبَطْشَةَ الْكُبْرَىٰ إِنَّا مُنتَقِمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Yawma nabtishu-l-batshata-l-kubrâ, innâ muntaqimûn
versets.francais: Le jour où Nous vous frapperons d'un grand châtiment, Nous serons Celui qui se venge
versets.anglais: The Day We will strike with the greatest assault, indeed, We will take retribution

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَجَاءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ كَرِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa laqad fatannâ qablahum qawma fir'awn wa jâ'ahum rasûlun karîm
versets.francais: Avant eux, Nous avons éprouvé le peuple de Pharaon, et un Messager noble vint à eux
versets.anglais: And We had already tried before them the people of Pharaoh, and there came to them a noble messenger

versets.arabe: أَن أَدُّوا إِلَيَّ عِبَادَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
versets.phonetique: An addû ilayya 'ibâda-l-lâh, innî lakum rasûlun amîn
versets.francais: "Livrez-moi les serviteurs d'Allah. Je suis pour vous un Messager digne de confiance"
versets.anglais: [Saying], "Render to me the servants of Allah. Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger

versets.arabe: وَأَن لَّا تَعْلُوا عَلَى اللَّهِ إِنِّي آتِيكُم بِسُلْطَانٍ مُّبِينٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa an lâ ta'lû 'alâ-l-lâh, innî âtîkum bi-sultânin mubîn
versets.francais: "Et de ne pas vous élever contre Allah. Je viens à vous avec une preuve évidente"
versets.anglais: And [saying], "Be not haughty with Allah. Indeed, I have come to you with clear authority

versets.arabe: وَإِنِّي عُذْتُ بِرَبِّي وَرَبِّكُمْ أَن تَرْجُمُونِ
versets.phonetique: Wa innî 'udhtu bi rabbî wa rabbikum an tarjumûn
versets.francais: "Et je me réfugie auprès de mon Seigneur et du vôtre pour que vous ne me lapidiez pas"
versets.anglais: And indeed, I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord, lest you stone me

versets.arabe: وَإِن لَّمْ تُؤْمِنُوا لِي فَاعْتَزِلُونِ
versets.phonetique: Wa in lam tu'minû lî fa'tazilûn
versets.francais: "Et si vous ne me croyez pas, alors écartez-vous de moi"
versets.anglais: But if you do not believe me, then leave me alone

versets.arabe: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُ أَنَّ هَؤُلَاءِ قَوْمٌ مُّجْرِمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Fada'â rabbahu anna hâ'ulâ'i qawmun mujrimûn
versets.francais: Il invoqua son Seigneur: "Ceux-ci sont un peuple criminel"
versets.anglais: And [finally] he called to his Lord that these were a criminal people

versets.arabe: فَأَسْرِ بِعِبَادِي لَيْلًا إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
versets.phonetique: Fa asri bi 'ibâdî laylân, innakum muttaba'ûn
versets.francais: "Mène donc mes serviteurs la nuit. Vous serez poursuivis"
versets.anglais: [Allah said], "Then set out with My servants by night. Indeed, you are to be pursued

versets.arabe: وَاتْرُكْ الْبَحْرَ إِذَا انفَلَقَ كُلُّ فِرْقَةٍ كَالطَّوْدِ الْعَظِيمِ
versets.phonetique: Wa-truk-al-bahr, idhâ infalaqa kullu firqah ka-t-tawdi-l-'azîm
versets.francais: "Et laisse la mer tranquille. Chaque vague s'écarte comme une montagne énorme"
versets.anglais: And leave the sea in stillness. Indeed, they are an army to be drowned

versets.arabe: إِنَّ فِرْعَوْنَ وَجُنُودَهُ كَانُوا عَالِينَ
versets.phonetique: Inna fir'awn wa junûdahu kânû 'âlîn
versets.francais: Pharaon et ses soldats étaient vraiment hautains
versets.anglais: How much they left behind of gardens and springs

versets.arabe: فَأَغْرَقْنَاهُمْ فِي الْيَمِّ فَلَا تَأْسَ عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Fa aghraqqnâhum fi-l-yamm, falâ ta's 'alâ-l-qawmi-z-zâlimîn
versets.francais: Et Nous les avons noyés dans la mer. Ne t'afflige donc pas sur le peuple injuste
versets.anglais: And crops and noble sites

versets.arabe: وَأَوْرَثْنَاهَا قَوْمًا آخَرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa awrathnahâ qawman âkharîn
versets.francais: Et Nous l'avons donnée en héritage à un autre peuple
versets.anglais: And comfort wherein they were amused

versets.arabe: وَمَا بَكَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّمَاءُ وَالْأَرْضُ وَمَا كَانُوا مُنظَرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa mâ bakat 'alayhim-us-samâu wa-l-ard, wa mâ kânû munzarîn
versets.francais: Et ni le ciel ni la terre ne pleurèrent sur eux, et ils n'eurent pas de délai
versets.anglais: Thus. And We caused to inherit it another people

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ نَجَّيْنَا بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ مِنَ الْعَذَابِ الْمُهِينِ
versets.phonetique: Wa laqad najjaynâ banî isrâ'îl min-al-'adhâbi-l-muhîn
versets.francais: Et Nous avons sauvé les Enfants d'Israël du châtiment humiliant
versets.anglais: And the heaven and earth wept not for them, nor were they reprieved

versets.arabe: مِن فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُ كَانَ عَالِيًا مِّنَ الْمُسْرِفِينَ
versets.phonetique: Min fir'awn, innahu kân 'âliyan min-al-musrifîn
versets.francais: De Pharaon. Il était vraiment parmi les hautains excessifs
versets.anglais: And We certainly saved the Children of Israel from the humiliating torment

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدِ اخْتَرْنَاهُمْ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ عَلَى الْعَالَمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa laqadi-khtaranâhum 'alâ 'ilm 'alâ-l-'âlamîn
versets.francais: Et Nous les avons choisis avec connaissance, sur tous les univers
versets.anglais: From Pharaoh. Indeed, he was a haughty one among the transgressors

versets.arabe: وَآتَيْنَاهُم مِّنَ الْآيَاتِ مَا فِيهِ بَلَاءٌ مُّبِينٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa âtaynâhum min-al-âyâti mâ fîhi balâun mubîn
versets.francais: Et Nous leur donnâmes des signes dans lesquels il y a une épreuve manifeste
versets.anglais: And We certainly chose them by knowledge over [all] the worlds

versets.arabe: إِنَّ هَؤُلَاءِ لَيَقُولُونَ
versets.phonetique: Inna hâ'ulâ'i layqûlûn
versets.francais: Ceux-ci disent vraiment
versets.anglais: And We gave them of signs that in which there was a clear trial

versets.arabe: إِن هِيَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا الدُّنْيَا نَمُوتُ وَنَحْيَا وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَبْعُوثِينَ
versets.phonetique: In hiya illâ hayâtunâ-d-dunyâ namût wa nahyâ, wa mâ nahnu bi-mab'ûthîn
versets.francais: "Ce n'est que notre vie d'ici-bas; nous mourons et nous vivons, et nous ne serons pas ressuscités"
versets.anglais: Indeed, these [disbelievers] are saying

versets.arabe: لَوْ تَعْلَمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Law ta'lamûn
versets.francais: Si seulement vous saviez!
versets.anglais: There is not but our first death, and we will not be resurrected

versets.arabe: إِن كُلُّ نَفْسٍ لَّمَّا عَلَيْهَا حَافِظٌ
versets.phonetique: In kull nafs lammâ 'alayhâ hâfiz
versets.francais: Chaque âme sait déjà ce qu'elle a avancé et ce qu'elle a remis
versets.anglais: Then bring [back] our forefathers, if you should be truthful

versets.arabe: فَلَا أُقْسِمُ بِالْخُنَّسِ
versets.phonetique: Falâ uqsimu bi-l-khunnas
versets.francais: Non! Je jure par les étoiles qui disparaissent
versets.anglais: Are they better or the people of Tubba' and those before them? We destroyed them, [for] indeed, they were criminals

versets.arabe: الْجَوَارِ الْكُنَّسِ
versets.phonetique: Al-jawâri-l-kunnas
versets.francais: Qui circulent et se cachent
versets.anglais: And We did not create the heavens and earth and that between them in play

versets.arabe: وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا عَسْعَسَ
versets.phonetique: Wa-l-layli idhâ 'asas
versets.francais: Et par la nuit quand elle s'épaissit
versets.anglais: We did not create them except in truth, but most of them do not know

versets.arabe: وَالصُّبْحِ إِذَا تَنَفَّسَ
versets.phonetique: Wa-s-subhi idhâ tanaffas
versets.francais: Et par l'aube quand elle respire
versets.anglais: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is the appointed time for them all

versets.arabe: إِنَّهُ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍ كَرِيمٍ
versets.phonetique: Innahu laqawl rasûl karîm
versets.francais: Ceci est vraiment la parole d'un Messager noble
versets.anglais: The Day when no relation will avail a relation at all, nor will they be helped

versets.arabe: ذِي قُوَّةٍ عِندَ ذِي الْعَرْشِ مَكِينٍ
versets.phonetique: Dhî quwwa 'inda dhî-l-'arsh makîn
versets.francais: Doué d'une grande force, auprès du Maître du Trône, établi
versets.anglais: Except those [believers] on whom Allah has mercy. Indeed, He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful

versets.arabe: مُطَاعٍ ثَمَّ أَمِينٍ
versets.phonetique: Mutâ' thamma amîn
versets.francais: Obéi, et de plus, digne de confiance
versets.anglais: Indeed, the tree of zaqqum

versets.arabe: وَمَا صَاحِبُكُم بِمَجْنُونٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa mâ sâhibukum bi-majnûn
versets.francais: Et votre compagnon n'est pas un possédé
versets.anglais: Is food for the sinful

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ رَآهُ بِالْأُفُقِ الْمُبِينِ
versets.phonetique: Wa laqad râahu bi-l-ufuq-al-mubîn
versets.francais: Et il l'a vu à l'horizon clair
versets.anglais: Like murky oil, it boils within bellies

versets.arabe: وَمَا هُوَ عَلَى الْغَيْبِ بِضَنِينٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa mâ huwa 'alâ-l-ghayb bi-danîn
versets.francais: Et il n'est pas avare de la science de l'Invisible
versets.anglais: Like the boiling of scalding water

versets.arabe: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَيْطَانٍ رَجِيمٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa mâ huwa bi-qawl shaytân rajîm
versets.francais: Et ce n'est pas la parole d'un diable maudit
versets.anglais: [It will be commanded], "Seize him and drag him into the midst of the Hellfire

versets.arabe: فَأَيْنَ تَذْهَبُونَ
versets.phonetique: Fa ayna tadhhabûn
versets.francais: Où donc allez-vous?
versets.anglais: Then pour over his head from the torment of scalding water

versets.arabe: إِن هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَالَمِينَ
versets.phonetique: In huwa illâ dhikr li-l-'âlamîn
versets.francais: Ce n'est qu'un Rappel pour les univers
versets.anglais: [It will be said], "Taste! Indeed, you are the honored, the noble

versets.arabe: لِمَن شَاءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَسْتَقِيمَ
versets.phonetique: Li man shâ'a minkum an yastaqîm
versets.francais: Pour celui d'entre vous qui veut suivre le droit chemin
versets.anglais: Indeed, this is what you used to dispute

versets.arabe: وَمَا تَشَاءُونَ إِلَّا أَن يَشَاءَ اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَالَمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa mâ tashâûn illâ an yashâ'a-l-lâhu rabb-al-'âlamîn
versets.francais: Et vous ne pouvez vouloir que si Allah le veut, Lui, le Seigneur de l'univers
versets.anglais: Indeed, the righteous will be in a secure place

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّاتُ النَّعِيمِ
versets.phonetique: Inna alladhîna âmanû wa 'amilû-s-sâlihât lahum jannâtu-n-na'îm
versets.francais: Ceux qui croient et font de bonnes œuvres auront des jardins de délices
versets.anglais: Within gardens and springs

versets.arabe: فِي رَوْضَةٍ يَحْبِرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Fî rawda yahburûn
versets.francais: Dans un verger, où ils jouiront
versets.anglais: Wearing [garments of] fine silk and brocade, facing each other

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَكَذَّبُوا بِآيَاتِنَا أُولَٰئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مُّهِينٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa alladhîna kafarû wa kadhdhab û bi-âyâtinâ, ulâ'ika lahum 'adhâb muhîn
versets.francais: Et ceux qui ont mécru et traité Nos signes de mensonges, ceux-là auront un châtiment humiliant
versets.anglais: Thus. And We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes

versets.arabe: وَلَا تَحْسَبَنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مُعْجِزِينَ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَمَأْوَاهُمُ النَّارُ وَلَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيرُ
versets.phonetique: Wa lâ tahsabanna alladhîna kafarû mu'jizîn fi-l-ardi wa ma'wâhumu-n-nâr, wa labis-al-masîr
versets.francais: Et ne pense pas que ceux qui ont mécru puissent nous échapper sur la terre. Leur refuge sera le Feu. Et c'est vraiment un mauvais retour
versets.anglais: They will call therein for every [kind of] fruit - safe and secure

versets.arabe: هَٰذَا بَيَانٌ لِّلنَّاسِ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةٌ لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ
versets.phonetique: Hâdhâ bayânun li-n-nâs wa hudân wa rahmah li-qawm yu'minûn
versets.francais: Ceci est une clarification pour les gens, un guidage et une miséricorde pour un peuple qui croit
versets.anglais: They will not taste death therein except the first death, and He will have protected them from the punishment of Hellfire

versets.arabe: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَأْمُرُ بِالْعَدْلِ وَالْإِحْسَانِ وَإِيتَاءِ ذِي الْقُرْبَىٰ وَيَنْهَىٰ عَنِ الْفَحْشَاءِ وَالْمُنكَرِ وَالْبَغْيِ
versets.phonetique: Inna-l-lâha ya'muru bi-l-'adl wa-l-ihsân wa îtâ'i dhî-l-qurbâ wa yanhâ 'an-al-fahshâ'i wa-l-munkar wa-l-baghî
versets.francais: Allah ordonne la justice, la bienfaisance et l'assistance aux proches, et Il interdit la turpitude, l'acte répréhensible et l'oppression
versets.anglais: As bounty from your Lord. That is what is the great attainment

versets.arabe: يَعِظُكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Ya'izukum la'allakum tadhakkarûn
versets.francais: Il vous le rappelle afin que vous vous souveniez
versets.anglais: And indeed, We have eased the Qur'an in your tongue that they might be reminded

versets.arabe: وَأَوْفُوا بِعَهْدِ اللَّهِ إِذَا عَاهَدتُّمْ وَلَا تَنقُضُوا الْأَيْمَانَ بَعْدَ تَوْكِيدِهَا وَقَدْ جَعَلْتُمُ اللَّهَ عَلَيْكُمْ كَفِيلًا إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa awfû bi 'ahd-al-lâh idhâ 'âhattum, wa lâ tanqudu-l-aymân ba'da tawkîdihâ wa qad ja'altum-al-lâha 'alaykum kafîl, inna-l-lâha ya'lam mâ taf'alûn
versets.francais: Et accomplissez le pacte d'Allah quand vous l'avez conclu, et ne violez pas les serments après en avoir confirmé la validité, ayant pris Allah pour garant sur vous. Allah sait certes tout ce que vous faites
versets.anglais: So watch, [O Muhammad]; indeed, they are watching [for your end]

versets.arabe: حم
versets.phonetique: Ha Mim
versets.francais: Ha. Mim.
versets.anglais: Ha, Meem

versets.arabe: تَنْزِيلُ الْكِتَابِ مِنَ اللَّهِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَكِيمِ
versets.phonetique: Tanzīl al-kitāb min Allah al-'azīz al-hakīm
versets.francais: La révélation du Livre vient d'Allah, le Puissant, le Sage.
versets.anglais: The revelation of the Book is from Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Wise

versets.arabe: إِنَّ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ لَآيَاتٍ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Inna fi al-samāwāt wa al-ard la-āyāt li-al-mu'minīn
versets.francais: Il y a certes dans les cieux et la terre des signes pour les croyants.
versets.anglais: Indeed, within the heavens and earth are signs for the believers

versets.arabe: وَفِي خَلْقِكُمْ وَمَا يَبُثُّ مِنْ دَابَّةٍ آيَاتٌ لِقَوْمٍ يُوقِنُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa fi khalqikum wa mā yabuthth min dābbah āyāt li-qawm yuqinūn
versets.francais: Et dans la création de vous-mêmes et dans la dispersion de tout animal, il y a des signes pour des gens qui ont la certitude.
versets.anglais: And in the creation of yourselves and what He disperses of moving creatures are signs for people who are certain [in faith]

versets.arabe: وَاخْتِلَافُ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ وَمَا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مِنْ رِزْقٍ فَأَحْيَا بِهِ الْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا وَتَصْرِيفُ الرِّيَاحِ آيَاتٌ لِقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa ikhtilāf al-layl wa al-nahār wa mā anzala Allah min al-samā'i min rizq fa ahyā bihī al-ard ba'd mawtihā wa tasrīf al-riyāh āyāt li-qawm ya'qilūn
versets.francais: Et l'alternance de la nuit et du jour, et ce qu'Allah fait descendre du ciel comme provision pour vivifier la terre après sa mort, et la direction des vents, ce sont là des signes pour des gens qui comprennent.
versets.anglais: And [in] the alternation of night and day and [in] what Allah sends down from the sky of provision and gives life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness and [in His] directing of the winds are signs for a people who reason

versets.arabe: تِلْكَ آيَاتُ اللَّهِ نَتْلُوهَا عَلَيْكَ بِالْحَقِّ ۖ فَبِأَيِّ حَدِيثٍ بَعْدَ اللَّهِ وَآيَاتِهِ يُؤْمِنُونَ
versets.phonetique: Tilka āyāt Allah natlūhā 'alayk bi-al-haqq fa bi-ayy hadīth ba'd Allah wa āyātihi yu'minūn
versets.francais: Voilà les signes d'Allah que Nous te récitions en toute vérité. En quel discours après Allah et Ses signes croiront-ils donc ?
versets.anglais: These are the verses of Allah which We recite to you in truth. Then in what statement after Allah and His verses will they believe

versets.arabe: وَيْلٌ لِكُلِّ أَفَّاكٍ أَثِيمٍ
versets.phonetique: Waylun li-kulli affāk athīm
versets.francais: Malheur à chaque menteur pécheur.
versets.anglais: Woe to every sinful liar

versets.arabe: يَسْمَعُ آيَاتِ اللَّهِ تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ يُصِرُّ مُسْتَكْبِرًا كَأَنْ لَمْ يَسْمَعْهَا ۖ فَبَشِّرْهُ بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
versets.phonetique: Yasma'u āyāt Allah tutlā 'alayh thumma yusirr mustakbiran ka'an lam yasma'hā fa bashshirhu bi-'adhāb alīm
versets.francais: Il entend les signes d'Allah qu'on lui récite, puis il s'obstine avec orgueil, comme s'il ne les avait point entendus. Annonce-lui donc un châtiment douloureux.
versets.anglais: Who hears the verses of Allah recited to him, then persists arrogantly as if he had not heard them. So give him tidings of a painful punishment

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا عَلِمَ مِنْ آيَاتِنَا شَيْئًا اتَّخَذَهَا هُزُوًا ۚ أُولَئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مُهِينٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa idhā 'alima min āyātinā shay'an ittakhadha huzuwan ula'ika lahum 'adhāb muhīn
versets.francais: Et quand il apprend quelque chose de Nos signes, il la tourne en dérision. Ceux-là auront un châtiment humiliant.
versets.anglais: And when he knows anything of Our verses, he takes them in ridicule. Those will have a humiliating punishment

versets.arabe: مِنْ وَرَائِهِمْ جَهَنَّمُ ۖ وَلَا يُغْنِي عَنْهُمْ مَا كَسَبُوا شَيْئًا وَلَا مَا اتَّخَذُوا مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ أَوْلِيَاءَ ۖ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Min warā'ihim jahannam wa lā yughni 'anhum mā kasabū shay'an wa lā mā ittakhadhu min dūn Allah awliyā'a wa lahum 'adhāb 'adhīm
versets.francais: Derrière eux il y a l'Enfer, et ce qu'ils ont acquis ne leur servira à rien, ni ceux qu'ils ont pris comme alliés en dehors d'Allah. Et ils auront un châtiment énorme.
versets.anglais: Before them is Hell, and what they had earned will not avail them at all nor what they had taken besides Allah as allies. And they will have a great punishment

versets.arabe: هَٰذَا هُدًى ۖ وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا بِآيَاتِ رَبِّهِمْ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مِنْ رِجْزٍ أَلِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Hādhā hudan wa al-ladhina kafarū bi-āyāt rabbihim lahum 'adhāb min rijz alīm
versets.francais: Ceci est une guidance. Quant à ceux qui rejettent les signes de leur Seigneur, il y aura pour eux un châtiment pénible de supplice.
versets.anglais: This [Qur'an] is guidance. And those who have disbelieved in the verses of their Lord will have a painful punishment of foul nature

versets.arabe: اللَّهُ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَكُمُ الْبَحْرَ لِتَجْرِيَ الْفُلْكُ فِيهِ بِأَمْرِهِ وَلِتَبْتَغُوا مِنْ فَضْلِهِ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Allah al-ladhī sakhkhara lakum al-bahr li-tajrī al-fulk fīh bi-amrih wa li-tabtagh min fadhlih wa la'allakum tashkurūn
versets.francais: Allah est Celui qui vous a assujetti la mer afin que les navires la sillonnent par Son commandement, et que vous cherchiez de Son Bounty. Peut-être serez-vous reconnaissants.
versets.anglais: It is Allah who subjected to you the sea so that ships may sail upon it by His command and that you may seek of His bounty; and perhaps you will be grateful

versets.arabe: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمْ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا مِنْهُ ۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَاتٍ لِقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa sakhkhara lakum mā fi al-samāwāt wa mā fi al-ard jamī'an minhu inna fi dhālik la-āyāt li-qawm yatafakkarūn
versets.francais: Et Il vous a assujetti tout ce qui est dans les cieux et sur la terre, tout venant de Lui. Il y a là certes des signes pour des gens qui réfléchissent.
versets.anglais: And He has subjected to you whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth - all from Him. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought

versets.arabe: قُلْ لِلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا يَغْفِرُونَ لِلَّذِينَ لَا يَرْجُونَ أَيَّامَ اللَّهِ لِيَجْزِيَ قَوْمًا بِمَا كَانُوا يَكْسِبُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qul li-al-ladhina āmanū yaghfirūn li-al-ladhina lā yarjūn ayyām Allah li-yajziya qawman bimā kānū yaksibūn
versets.francais: Dis à ceux qui ont cru de pardonner à ceux qui n'espèrent pas les jours d'Allah, afin que Lui rétribue un peuple selon ce qu'il gagnait.
versets.anglais: Say, [O Muhammad], to those who have believed that they [should] forgive those who expect not the days of Allah so that He may recompense a people for what they used to earn

versets.arabe: مَنْ عَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَلِنَفْسِهِ ۖ وَمَنْ أَسَاءَ فَعَلَيْهَا ۚ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمْ تُرْجَعُونَ
versets.phonetique: Man 'amila sāliḥan fa li-nafsihi wa man asā'a fa 'alayh thumma ilā rabbikum turja'ūn
versets.francais: Quiconque fait une bonne œuvre c'est pour lui-même, et quiconque fait le mal, c'est contre lui-même. Ensuite c'est vers votre Seigneur que vous serez ramenés.
versets.anglais: Whoever does a good deed - it is for himself; and whoever does evil - it is against the self. Then to your Lord you will be returned

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ الْكِتَابَ وَالْحُكْمَ وَالنُّبُوَّةَ وَرَزَقْنَاهُمْ مِنَ الطَّيِّبَاتِ وَفَضَّلْنَاهُمْ عَلَىٰ الْعَالَمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa laqad ātaynā banī Isrā'īl al-kitāb wa al-hikm wa al-nubuwwah wa razaqnāhum min al-tayyibāt wa faddalnāhum 'alā al-'ālamīn
versets.francais: Et Nous avons certes donné aux Enfants d'Israël l'Écriture, la sagacité et la prophétie, leur avons accordé de bonnes choses, et les avons élevés au-dessus de toutes les nations.
versets.anglais: And We did certainly give the Children of Israel the Scripture and judgement and prophethood, and We provided them with good things and preferred them over the worlds

versets.arabe: وَآتَاهُمْ بَيِّنَاتٍ مِنَ الْأَمْرِ ۚ فَمَا اخْتَلَفُوا إِلَّا مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا جَاءَهُمُ الْعِلْمُ بَغْيًا بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقْضِي بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فِيمَا كَانُوا فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa ātāhum bayyināt min al-amr fa mā ikhtarafu illā min ba'd mā jā'ahum al-'ilm baghyan baynahum inna rabbak yaqdī baynahum yawm al-qiyāmah fīmā kānū fīh yakhtalifūn
versets.francais: Et Nous leur avons donné des preuves explicites de l'ordre divin. Ils ne se sont divisés que par suite de rivalité, après que le savoir leur était venu. Certes, ton Seigneur décidera entre eux au Jour de la Résurrection sur ce en quoi ils divergeaient.
versets.anglais: And We gave them clear proofs of the matter [of religion]. And they did not differ except after knowledge had come to them - out of jealous animosity between themselves. Indeed, your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ

versets.arabe: ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَاكَ عَلَىٰ شَرِيعَةٍ مِنَ الْأَمْرِ فَاتَّبِعْهَا وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ أَهْوَاءَ الَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Thumma ja'alnāka 'alā sharī'ah min al-amr fattabi'hā wa lā tattabi' ahwā'ā al-ladhina lā ya'lamūn
versets.francais: Ensuite, Nous t'avons mis sur le Chemin de l'Ordre. Suis-le donc, et ne suis pas les désirs de ceux qui ne savent pas.
versets.anglais: Then We put you, [O Muhammad], on an ordained way concerning the matter [of religion]; so follow it and do not follow the inclinations of those who do not know

versets.arabe: إِنَّهُمْ لَنْ يُغْنُوا عَنْكَ مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا ۚ وَإِنَّ الظَّالِمِينَ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلِيَاءُ بَعْضٍ ۖ وَاللَّهُ وَلِيُّ الْمُتَّقِينَ
versets.phonetique: Innahum lan yughnu 'anak min Allah shay'an wa inna al-dhālimīn ba'duhum awliyā'ā ba'd wa Allah waliyy al-muttaqīn
versets.francais: Car ils ne te seront d'aucune utilité contre Allah. Les injustes sont alliés les uns des autres ; tandis qu'Allah est l'Allié des pieux.
versets.anglais: Indeed, they will never avail you against Allah at all. And indeed, the wrongdoers are allies of one another; but Allah is the protector of the righteous

versets.arabe: هَٰذَا بَصَائِرُ لِلنَّاسِ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةٌ لِقَوْمٍ يُوقِنُونَ
versets.phonetique: Hādhā basā'ir li-al-nās wa hudan wa rahmah li-qawm yuqinūn
versets.francais: Ceci est des éclairages pour les hommes, et une guidance et une miséricorde pour des gens qui ont la certitude.
versets.anglais: This [Qur'an] is enlightenment for mankind and guidance and mercy for a people who are certain [in faith]

versets.arabe: أَمْ حَسِبَ الَّذِينَ اجْتَرَحُوا السَّيِّئَاتِ أَنْ نَجْعَلَهُمْ كَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ سَوَاءً مَحْيَاهُمْ وَمَمَاتُهُمْ ۚ سَاءَ مَا يَحْكُمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Am hasiba al-ladhina jtarahū al-sayyiāt an naja'alahum ka-al-ladhina āmanū wa 'amilū al-sāliḥāt sawā'ā mahyāhum wa mamātuhum sā'a mā yaḥkumūn
versets.francais: Ceux qui ont commis le mal pensent-ils que Nous les traiterons comme ceux qui ont cru et fait les bonnes œuvres, pareillement en vie et en mort ? Quel mauvais jugement ils font !
versets.anglais: Or do those who commit evils think We will make them like those who have believed and done righteous deeds - [make them] equal in their life and their death? Evil is that which they judge

versets.arabe: وَخَلَقَ اللَّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ بِالْحَقِّ وَلِتُجْزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa khalaqa Allah al-samāwāt wa al-ard bi-al-haqq wa li-tujzā kull nafs bimā kasabat wa hum lā yudhlmūn
versets.francais: Allah a créé les cieux et la terre en toute justice. Chaque âme goûte à ce qu'elle s'est acquis, et il ne leur sera point fait d'injustice.
versets.anglais: And Allah created the heavens and earth in truth and so that every soul may be recompensed for what it has earned, and they will not be wronged

versets.arabe: أَفَرَأَيْتَ مَنِ اتَّخَذَ إِلَٰهَهُ هَوَاهُ وَأَضَلَّهُ اللَّهُ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ وَخَتَمَ عَلَىٰ سَمْعِهِ وَقَلْبِهِ وَجَعَلَ عَلَىٰ بَصَرِهِ غِشَاوَةً ۚ فَمَنْ يَهْدِيهِ مِنْ بَعْدِ اللَّهِ ۚ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Afarayta man ittakhadha ilāhahu hawāh wa adallahu Allah 'alā 'ilm wa khatama 'alā sam'ih wa qalbih wa ja'ala 'alā basarih ghishāwah fa man yahdīh min ba'd Allah a falā tadhakkarūn
versets.francais: As-tu vu celui qui a pris sa passion pour divinité ? Allah l'a égaré sciemment, a scellé son ouïe et son cœur, et a mis un voile sur sa vue. Qui donc le guidera après Allah ? Ne vous rappelez-vous pas ?
versets.anglais: Have you seen he who has taken as his god his [own] desire, and Allah has sent him astray due to knowledge and has set a seal upon his hearing and his heart and put over his vision a veil? So who will guide him after Allah? Then will you not be reminded

versets.arabe: وَقَالُوا مَا هِيَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا الدُّنْيَا نَمُوتُ وَنَحْيَا وَمَا يُهْلِكُنَا إِلَّا الدَّهْرُ ۚ وَمَا لَهُمْ بِذَٰلِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ ۖ إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَخْرُصُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa qālū mā hiya illā hayātunā al-dunyā namūt wa nahyā wa mā yuhlikuna illā al-dahr wa mā lahum bidhālik min 'ilm in hum illā yakhrusun
versets.francais: Et ils disent : « Il n'y a que notre vie présente ; nous mourons et nous vivons, et seul le temps nous anéantit ». Ils n'en ont aucune connaissance : ce ne sont que des conjectures.
versets.anglais: And they say, "There is not but our worldly life; we die and live, and nothing destroys us except time." And they have of that no knowledge; they are only assuming

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ آيَاتُنَا بَيِّنَاتٍ مَا كَانَ حُجَّتُهُمْ إِلَّا أَنْ قَالُوا ائْتُوا بِآبَائِنَا إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa idhā tutlā 'alayhim āyātunā bayyināt mā kāna hujjatuhum illā an qālū i'tū bi-ābā'inā in kuntum sādiqīn
versets.francais: Et quand Nos versets manifestes leur sont récités, leur seul argument est de dire : « Apportez nos ancêtres, si vous dites la vérité ».
versets.anglais: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, their argument is only that they say, "Bring [back] our forefathers, if you should be truthful

versets.arabe: قُلِ اللَّهُ يُحْيِيكُمْ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمْ ثُمَّ يَجْمَعُكُمْ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qul Allah yuhyīkum thumma yumītukum thumma yajma'ukum ilā yawm al-qiyāmah lā rayb fīh wa lākinnal akthar al-nās lā ya'lamūn
versets.francais: Dis : « Allah vous fait vivre, puis vous fait mourir, puis vous rassemblera au Jour de la Résurrection sans doute. Mais la plupart des gens ne savent pas ».
versets.anglais: Say, "Allah causes you to live, then causes you to die; then He will assemble you for the Day of Resurrection, about which there is no doubt, but most of the people do not know
