versets.arabe: وَلِلَّهِ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۚ وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَخْسَرُ الْمُبْطِلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa lillāh mulk al-samāwāt wa al-ard wa yawm taqūm al-sā'ah yawma'idh yakhsaru al-mubtilūn
versets.francais: Et à Allah appartient la royauté des cieux et de la terre. Et le jour où l'Heure se lèvera, ce jour-là les gens du mensonge seront perdants.
versets.anglais: And to Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And the Day the Hour appears - that Day the falsifiers will lose

versets.arabe: وَتَرَىٰ كُلَّ أُمَّةٍ جَاثِيَةً ۚ كُلُّ أُمَّةٍ تُدْعَىٰ إِلَىٰ كِتَابِهَا ۚ الْيَوْمَ تُجْزَوْنَ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa tarā kull ummah jāthiyah kull ummah tud'ā ilā kitābihā al-yawm tujzawn bimā kuntum ta'malūn
versets.francais: Et tu verras chaque nation s'agenouillant. Chaque nation sera appelée à (lire) son Livre. Aujourd'hui vous serez rétribués selon ce que vous faisiez.
versets.anglais: And you will see every nation kneeling [from fear]. Every nation will be called to its record [and told], "Today you will be recompensed for what you used to do

versets.arabe: هَٰذَا كِتَابُنَا يَنْطِقُ عَلَيْكُمْ بِالْحَقِّ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا نَسْتَنْسِخُ مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Hādhā kitābunā yantiq 'alaykum bi-al-haqq innā kunnā nastansakhu mā kuntum ta'malūn
versets.francais: Voici notre Livre qui parle contre vous avec vérité. Nous enregistrions ce que vous faisiez.
versets.anglais: This, Our record, speaks about you in truth. Indeed, We were having transcribed whatever you used to do

versets.arabe: فَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ فَيُدْخِلُهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ فِي رَحْمَتِهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْمُبِينُ
versets.phonetique: Fa ammā al-ladhina āmanū wa 'amilū al-sāliḥāt fa yudkhiluhum rabbuhum fī raḥmatihi dhālik huwa al-fawz al-mubīn
versets.francais: Quant à ceux qui ont cru et fait les bonnes œuvres, leur Seigneur les fera entrer dans Sa miséricorde. C'est là le succès manifeste.
versets.anglais: So as for those who believed and did righteous deeds, their Lord will admit them into His mercy. That is what is the clear attainment

versets.arabe: وَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا أَفَلَمْ تَكُنْ آيَاتِي تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَاسْتَكْبَرْتُمْ وَكُنْتُمْ قَوْمًا مُجْرِمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa ammā al-ladhina kafarū a falam takun āyātī tutlā 'alaykum fa istakbartum wa kuntum qawman mujrimīn
versets.francais: Et quant à ceux qui ont mécru : « Mes versets ne vous ont-ils pas été récités ? Mais vous avez été pleins d'orgueil et vous étiez un peuple criminel ».
versets.anglais: But as for those who disbelieved, [it will be said], "Were not Our verses recited to you, but you were arrogant and became a people of criminals

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا قِيلَ إِنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّ وَالسَّاعَةُ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهَا قُلْتُمْ مَا نَدْرِي مَا السَّاعَةُ إِنْ نَظُنُّ إِلَّا ظَنًّا وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُسْتَيْقِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa idhā qīla inna wa'd Allah haqq wa al-sā'ah lā rayb fīhā qultum mā nadrī mā al-sā'ah in ndhunnu illā dhanna wa mā nahnu bimustayyaqinīn
versets.francais: Et quand on vous disait : « La promesse d'Allah est vérité et l'Heure ne fait l'objet d'aucun doute », vous disiez : « Nous ne savons pas ce qu'est l'Heure. Nous n'avons que des conjectures et nous ne sommes pas convaincus ».
versets.anglais: And when it was said, 'Indeed, the promise of Allah is truth and the Hour [is coming] - no doubt about it,' you said, 'We know not what is the Hour. We assume only assumption, and we are not convinced

versets.arabe: وَبَدَا لَهُمْ سَيِّئَاتُ مَا عَمِلُوا وَحَاقَ بِهِمْ مَا كَانُوا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِئُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa badā lahum sayyiāt mā 'amilū wa hāq bihim mā kānū bihī yastahzi'ūn
versets.francais: Et le mal de ce qu'ils ont fait leur apparaîtra, et le tourment qu'ils raillaient les enveloppera.
versets.anglais: And the evil consequences of what they did will appear to them, and they will be enveloped by what they used to ridicule

versets.arabe: وَقِيلَ الْيَوْمَ نَنْسَاكُمْ كَمَا نَسِيتُمْ لِقَاءَ يَوْمِكُمْ هَٰذَا وَمَأْوَاكُمُ النَّارُ وَمَا لَكُمْ مِنْ نَاصِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa qīla al-yawm nansākum kamā nasītum liqā'ā yawmikum hādhā wa ma'wākum al-nār wa mā lakum min nāsirīn
versets.francais: Et il sera dit : « Aujourd'hui Nous vous oublions, comme vous avez oublié la rencontre de ce vôtre jour. Et votre refuge est le Feu, et vous n'aurez pas de secoureurs ».
versets.anglais: And it will be said, "Today We will forget you as you forgot the meeting of this Day of yours, and your refuge is the Fire, and for you there are no helpers

versets.arabe: ذَٰلِكُمْ بِأَنَّكُمُ اتَّخَذْتُمْ آيَاتِ اللَّهِ هُزُوًا وَغَرَّتْكُمُ الْحَيَاةُ الدُّنْيَا ۚ فَالْيَوْمَ لَا يُخْرَجُونَ مِنْهَا وَلَا هُمْ يُسْتَعْتَبُونَ
versets.phonetique: Dhālikum bi-annakum ittakhadhtum āyāt Allah huzuwan wa gharratakum al-hayāh al-dunyā fa-al-yawm lā yukhrajūn minhā wa lā hum yusta'tabūn
versets.francais: C'est parce que vous aviez pris les signes d'Allah en dérision et que la vie présente vous a trompés. C'est pourquoi aujourd'hui ils n'en sortiront point et on n'acceptera pas leur repentir.
versets.anglais: That is because you took the verses of Allah in ridicule, and worldly life deluded you." So that Day they will not be removed from it, nor will they be asked to appease [Allah]

versets.arabe: فَلِلَّهِ الْحَمْدُ رَبِّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَرَبِّ الْأَرْضِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Fa lillāh al-hamdu rabb al-samāwāt wa rabb al-ard rabb al-'ālamīn
versets.francais: À Allah soit la louange, Seigneur des cieux et Seigneur de la terre, Seigneur de l'Univers.
versets.anglais: Then, to Allah belongs [all] praise - Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, Lord of the worlds

versets.arabe: وَلَهُ الْكِبْرِيَاءُ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ
versets.phonetique: Wa lahu al-kibriyā'u fi al-samāwāt wa al-ard wa huwa al-'azīz al-hakīm
versets.francais: Et à Lui la grandeur dans les cieux et sur la terre. Et c'est Lui le Puissant, le Sage.
versets.anglais: And to Him belongs [all] grandeur within the heavens and the earth, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise

sourates.signification: Les dunes de sable ou Les vallées sinueuses

versets.arabe: حم
versets.phonetique: Ha Mim
versets.francais: Ha. Mim.
versets.anglais: Ha, Meem

versets.arabe: تَنْزِيلُ الْكِتَابِ مِنَ اللَّهِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَكِيمِ
versets.phonetique: Tanzīl al-kitāb min Allah al-'azīz al-hakīm
versets.francais: La révélation du Livre vient d'Allah, le Puissant, le Sage.
versets.anglais: The revelation of the Book is from Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Wise

versets.arabe: مَا خَلَقْنَا السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا إِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ وَأَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى ۚ وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا عَمَّا أُنْذِرُوا مُعْرِضُونَ
versets.phonetique: Mā khalaqnā al-samāwāt wa al-ard wa mā baynahum illā bi-al-haqq wa ajal musammā wa al-ladhina kafarū 'ammā undhirū mu'ridūn
versets.francais: Nous n'avons créé les cieux et la terre et ce qui est entre eux que pour la Vérité et pour un terme fixé. Cependant, ceux qui ont mécru se détournent de l'avertissement qu'on leur donne.
versets.anglais: We did not create the heavens and earth and what is between them except in truth and [for] a specified term. But those who disbelieve, from that of which they are warned, are turning away

versets.arabe: قُلْ أَرَأَيْتُمْ مَا تَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ أَرُونِي مَاذَا خَلَقُوا مِنَ الْأَرْضِ أَمْ لَهُمْ شِرْكٌ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ ۖ ائْتُونِي بِكِتَابٍ مِنْ قَبْلِ هَٰذَا أَوْ أَثَارَةٍ مِنْ عِلْمٍ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qul ara'aytum mā tad'ūn min dūn Allah arūni mādhā khalaqū min al-ard am lahum shirk fi al-samāwāt a'tūni bi-kitāb min qabl hādhā aw āthārah min 'ilm in kuntum sādiqīn
versets.francais: Dis : « Avez-vous considéré ce que vous invoquez en dehors d'Allah ? Montrez-moi ce qu'ils ont créé de la terre, ou ont-ils une part dans les cieux ? Apportez-moi un écrit antérieur à ceci, ou quelque vestige de connaissance, si vous êtes véridiques ».
versets.anglais: Say, [O Muhammad], "Have you considered that which you invoke besides Allah? Show me what they have created of the earth; or did they have partnership in [creation of] the heavens? Bring me a scripture [revealed] before this or a [remaining] trace of knowledge, if you should be truthful

versets.arabe: وَمَنْ أَضَلُّ مِمَّنْ يَدْعُو مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ مَنْ لَا يَسْتَجِيبُ لَهُ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ وَهُمْ عَنْ دُعَائِهِمْ غَافِلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa man adall mimman yad'u min dūn Allah man lā yastajīb lahu ilā yawm al-qiyāmah wa hum 'an du'ā'ihim ghāfilūn
versets.francais: Et qui est plus égaré que celui qui invoque, en dehors d'Allah, celui qui ne peut lui répondre jusqu'au Jour de la Résurrection, et qui ignore son invocation ?
versets.anglais: And who is more astray than he who invokes besides Allah those who will not respond to him until the Day of Resurrection, and they, of their invocation, are unaware

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا حُشِرَ النَّاسُ كَانُوا لَهُمْ أَعْدَاءً وَكَانُوا بِعِبَادَتِهِمْ كَافِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa idhā hushir al-nās kānū lahum a'dā'an wa kānū bi-'ibādatihim kāfirīn
versets.francais: Et quand les hommes seront rassemblés, ils seront pour eux des ennemis et renieront leur culte.
versets.anglais: And when the people are gathered [that Day], they [who were invoked] will be enemies to them, and they will be deniers of their worship

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ آيَاتُنَا بَيِّنَاتٍ قَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لِلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ هَٰذَا سِحْرٌ مُبِينٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa idhā tutlā 'alayhim āyātunā bayyināt qāla al-ladhina kafarū li-al-haqq lammā jā'ahum hādhā sihr mubīn
versets.francais: Et quand Nos versets évidents leur sont récités, ceux qui ont mécru disent de la Vérité quand elle leur vient : « Ceci est une magie manifeste ».
versets.anglais: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, those who disbelieve say of the truth when it has come to them, "This is obvious magic

versets.arabe: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ افْتَرَاهُ ۚ قُلْ إِنِ افْتَرَيْتُهُ فَلَا تَمْلِكُونَ لِي مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا ۚ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تُفِيضُونَ فِيهِ ۚ كَفَىٰ بِهِ شَهِيدًا بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكُمْ ۖ وَهُوَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
versets.phonetique: Am yaqūlun iftarāh qul ini iftaraytuh falā tamlukūn lī min Allah shay'an huwa a'lam bimā tufīdūn fīh kafā bihī shahīdan baynī wa baynikum wa huwa al-ghafūr al-rahīm
versets.francais: Ou ils disent : « Il l'a forgé ». Dis : « Si je l'ai forgé, vous ne pouvez rien pour moi contre Allah. Il sait fort bien ce dans lequel vous vous jetez. Il Me suffit comme témoin entre moi et vous. Et c'est Lui le Pardonneur, le Miséricordieux ».
versets.anglais: Or do they say, "He has invented it?" Say, "If I have invented it, you will not possess for me [the power of protection] from Allah at all. He is most knowing of that in which you are involved. Sufficient is He as Witness between me and you, and He is the Forgiving the Merciful

versets.arabe: قُلْ مَا كُنْتُ بِدْعًا مِنَ الرُّسُلِ وَمَا أَدْرِي مَا يُفْعَلُ بِي وَلَا بِكُمْ ۖ إِنْ أَتَّبِعُ إِلَّا مَا يُوحَىٰ إِلَيَّ وَمَا أَنَا إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ مُبِينٌ
versets.phonetique: Qul mā kuntu bid'an min al-rusul wa mā adrī mā yufa'al bī wa lā bikum in attabi' illā mā yūhā ilayya wa mā anā illā nadhīr mubīn
versets.francais: Dis : « Je ne suis pas novateur parmi les messagers, et je ne sais pas ce qui sera fait de moi ni de vous. Je ne fais que suivre ce qui m'est révélé, et je ne suis que l'avertisseur déclaré ».
versets.anglais: Say, "I am not something original among the messengers, nor do I know what will be done with me or with you. I only follow that which is revealed to me, and I am not but a clear warner

versets.arabe: قُلْ أَرَأَيْتُمْ إِنْ كَانَ مِنْ عِنْدِ اللَّهِ وَكَفَرْتُمْ بِهِ وَشَهِدَ شَاهِدٌ مِنْ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ عَلَىٰ مِثْلِهِ فَآمَنَ وَاسْتَكْبَرْتُمْ ۖ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ الظَّالِمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qul ara'aytum in kāna min 'ind Allah wa kafartem bihī wa shahida shahid min banī Isrā'īl 'alā mithlih fa āman wa istakbartum inna Allah lā yahdī al-qawm al-dhālimīn
versets.francais: Dis : « Avez-vous vu ? Si ce Coran venait d'Allah et que vous l'aviez rejeté, alors qu'un témoin parmi les Enfants d'Israël aurait attesté son semblable et aurait cru tandis que vous seriez pleins d'orgueil ? Certes, Allah ne guide pas les gens injustes ».
versets.anglais: Say, "Have you considered: if the Qur'an was from Allah, and you disbelieved in it while a witness from the Children of Israel has testified to something similar and believed while you were arrogant...?" Indeed, Allah does not guide the wrongdoing people

versets.arabe: وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لِلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَوْ كَانَ خَيْرًا مَا سَبَقُونَا إِلَيْهِ ۚ وَإِذْ لَمْ يَهْتَدُوا بِهِ فَسَيَقُولُونَ هَٰذَا إِفْكٌ قَدِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa qāla al-ladhina kafarū li-al-ladhina āmanū law kāna khayran mā sabaqūnā ilayh wa idh lam yahtadū bihī fa sayaqūlūn hādhā ifk qadīm
versets.francais: Et ceux qui ont mécru disent à ceux qui ont cru : « Si c'était une bonne affaire, ils n'auraient pas devancés vers elle ». Et puisqu'ils ne se laissent pas guider par lui, ils diront : « Voici un ancien mensonge ».
versets.anglais: And those who disbelieve say of those who believe, "If it had [truly] been good, they would not have preceded us to it." And when they are not guided by it, they will say, "This is an ancient falsehood

versets.arabe: وَمِنْ قَبْلِهِ كِتَابُ مُوسَىٰ إِمَامًا وَرَحْمَةً ۚ وَهَٰذَا كِتَابٌ مُصَدِّقٌ لِسَانًا عَرَبِيًّا لِيُنْذِرَ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا وَبُشْرَىٰ لِلْمُحْسِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa min qablih kitāb Mūsā imāman wa rahmah wa hādhā kitāb musaddiq lisānan 'arabiyyān liyundhir al-ladhina dhalamū wa bushrā li-al-muhsinīn
versets.francais: Et avant lui, le Livre de Moïse, guide et miséricorde. Et ceci est un Livre le confirmant en langue arabe, pour avertir ceux qui ont commis l'injustice et comme bonne nouvelle pour les bienfaiteurs.
versets.anglais: And before it was the scripture of Moses to lead and as a mercy. And this is a confirming Book in an Arabic tongue to warn those who have wronged and as good tidings to the doers of good

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ قَالُوا رَبُّنَا اللَّهُ ثُمَّ اسْتَقَامُوا فَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
versets.phonetique: Inna al-ladhina qālū rabbunā Allah thumma istaqāmū falā khawf 'alayhim wa lā hum yahzanūn
versets.francais: Ceux qui disent : « Notre Seigneur est Allah », puis demeurent dans la droiture, il n'y aura nulle crainte pour eux, et ils ne seront point affligés.
versets.anglais: Indeed, those who have said, "Our Lord is Allah," and then remained on a right course - there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve

versets.arabe: أُولَئِكَ أَصْحَابُ الْجَنَّةِ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا جَزَاءً بِمَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Ula'ika ashāb al-jannah khālidīn fīhā jazā'an bimā kānū ya'malūn
versets.francais: Ceux-là sont les occupants du Paradis, qui y demeureront éternellement, récompense de ce qu'ils faisaient.
versets.anglais: Those are the companions of Paradise, abiding eternally therein as reward for what they used to do

versets.arabe: وَوَصَّيْنَا الْإِنْسَانَ بِوَالِدَيْهِ إِحْسَانًا ۖ حَمَلَتْهُ أُمُّهُ كُرْهًا وَوَضَعَتْهُ كُرْهًا ۖ وَحَمْلُهُ وَفِصَالُهُ ثَلَاثُونَ شَهْرًا ۚ حَتَّىٰ إِذَا بَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُ وَبَلَغَ أَرْبَعِينَ سَنَةً قَالَ رَبِّ أَوْزِعْ نِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ وَأَصْلِحْ لِي فِي ذُرِّيَّتِي ۖ إِنِّي تُبْتُ إِلَيْكَ وَإِنِّي مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa wasayynā al-insān bi-wālidayh ihsānan hamalaṯhu ummuh kurhan wa wadha'aṯhu kurhan wa hamluhu wa fisāluhu thulāthūn shahran hattā idhā balaghā ashuddahu wa balaghā arba'īn sanah qāla rabbi awzi' ni an ashkur ni'mataka al-latī ana'amṯ alayya wa 'alā wālidayya wa an a'mal sāliḥan tardāh wa aslih lī fī dhurriyyatī innī tubtu ilayk wa innī min al-muslimīn
versets.francais: Et Nous avons enjoint à l'homme de bien traiter ses père et mère. Sa mère l'a porté dans la peine et elle l'a enfanté dans la peine. Et la gestation et l'allaitement durent trente mois. Quand il a atteint son plein développement et qu'il a quarante ans, il dit : « Seigneur, fais-moi reconnaître le bienfait dont Tu m'as comblé ainsi que mes père et mère, et fais que j'accomplisse une œuvre salutaire qui T'agrée. Et fais-moi entrer par Ta miséricorde dans Tes serviteurs vertueux ».
versets.anglais: And We have enjoined upon man, to his parents, good treatment. His mother carried him with hardship and gave birth to him with hardship, and his gestation and weaning [period] is thirty months. [He grows] until, when he reaches maturity and reaches [the age of] forty years, he says, "My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to work righteousness of which You will approve and make righteous for me my offspring. Indeed, I have repented to You, and indeed, I am of the Muslims

versets.arabe: أُولَئِكَ الَّذِينَ نَتَقَبَّلُ عَنْهُمْ أَحْسَنَ مَا عَمِلُوا وَنَتَجَاوَزُ عَنْ سَيِّئَاتِهِمْ فِي أَصْحَابِ الْجَنَّةِ ۖ وَعْدَ الصِّدْقِ الَّذِي كَانُوا يُوعَدُونَ
versets.phonetique: Ula'ika al-ladhina nataqabbalu 'anhum ahsan mā 'amilū wa natajāwazu 'an sayyiāthim fī ashāb al-jannah wa'd al-sidq al-ladhī kānū yū'adūn
versets.francais: Ce sont ceux dont Nous acceptons les meilleures œuvres et dont Nous pardonnons les méfaits, parmi les occupants du Paradis. C'est une promesse véridique qui leur a été faite.
versets.anglais: Those are the ones from whom We will accept the best of what they did and overlook their misdeeds, [their being] among the companions of Paradise. [That is] the promise of truth which they had been promised

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِي قَالَ لِوَالِدَيْهِ أُفٍّ لَكُمَا أَتِعِدَانِ أَنْ أُخْرَجَ وَقَدْ خَلَتِ الْقُرُونُ مِنْ قَبْلِي ۖ وَهُمَا يَسْتَغِيثَانِ اللَّهَ وَيْلَكَ آمِنْ ۖ إِنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّ ۖ فَيَقُولُ مَا هَٰذَا إِلَّا أَسَاطِيرُ الْأَوَّلِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa al-ladhī qāla li-wālidayh uff lakumā ati'idāni an ukhraja wa qad khalat al-qurūn min qablī wa humā yastaghīthān Allah waylaka āmin inna wa'd Allah haqq fa yaqūl mā hādhā illā asātīr al-awwalīn
versets.francais: Et celui qui dit à ses père et mère : « Pouah ! Me promettez-vous que je ressusciterai, alors que tant de générations ont déjà disparu avant moi ? » Et ceux-ci implorent Allah en disant : « Malheur à toi ! Crois. La promesse d'Allah est vérité ». Mais il dit : « Ce ne sont là que des contes des anciens ».
versets.anglais: But one who says to his parents, "Uff to you; do you promise me that I will be brought forth [from the earth] when generations before me have already passed on [into oblivion]?" while they call to Allah for help [and to their son], "Woe to you! Believe! Indeed, the promise of Allah is truth." But he says, "This is not but legends of the former people

versets.arabe: أُولَئِكَ الَّذِينَ حَقَّ عَلَيْهِمُ الْقَوْلُ فِي أُمَمٍ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنْسِ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا خَاسِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Ula'ika al-ladhina haqqa 'alayhim al-qawl fī umam qad khalat min qablihim min al-jinn wa al-ins innahum kānū khāsirīn
versets.francais: Ce sont ceux pour lesquels s'est réalisée la parole parmi les communautés de Djinn et d'hommes qui ont passé avant eux. Ils sont réellement des perdants.
versets.anglais: Those are the ones upon whom the word has come into effect, [who will be] among nations which had passed on before them of jinn and men. Indeed, they [all] were losers

versets.arabe: وَلِكُلٍّ دَرَجَاتٌ مِمَّا عَمِلُوا ۖ وَلِيُوَفِّيَهُمْ أَعْمَالَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa li-kullin darajāt mimmā 'amilū wa liyuwaffiyahum a'mālaham wa hum lā yudhlmūn
versets.francais: Pour chacun il y a des degrés selon ce qu'il a fait, afin que Lui rétribue complètement leurs œuvres, et il ne leur sera fait aucune injustice.
versets.anglais: And for all there are degrees [of reward and punishment] for what they have done, and [it is] so that He may fully compensate them for their deeds, and they will not be wronged

versets.arabe: وَيَوْمَ يُعْرَضُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا عَلَىٰ النَّارِ أَذْهَبْتُمْ طَيِّبَاتِكُمْ فِي حَيَاتِكُمُ الدُّنْيَا وَاسْتَمْتَعْتُمْ بِهَا فَالْيَوْمَ تُجْزَوْنَ عَذَابَ الْهُونِ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَسْتَكْبِرُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ الْحَقِّ وَبِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَفْسِقُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa yawm yu'rad al-ladhina kafarū 'alā al-nār adhhabtum ṭayyibātikum fī hayātikum al-dunyā wa istamta'tum bihā fa-al-yawm tujzawn 'adhāb al-hūn bimā kuntum tastakbirūn fi al-ard bighayri al-haqq wa bimā kuntum tafsiqūn
versets.francais: Et le jour où seront présentés au Feu ceux qui ont mécru : « Vous avez dissipé vos bonnes choses dans votre vie d'ici-bas et vous en avez jouies. Aujourd'hui donc vous serez rétribués par le châtiment humiliant pour avoir été pleins d'orgueil sur terre sans droit et pour avoir commis la débauche ».
versets.anglais: And the Day those who disbelieved are exposed to the Fire [it will be said], "You exhausted your pleasures during your worldly life and enjoyed them, so this Day you will be awarded the punishment of [extreme] humiliation because you were arrogant upon the earth without right and because you were defiantly disobedient

versets.arabe: وَاذْكُرْ أَخَا عَادٍ إِذْ أَنْذَرَ قَوْمَهُ بِالْأَحْقَافِ وَقَدْ خَلَتِ النُّذُرُ مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِ أَلَّا تَعْبُدُوا إِلَّا اللَّهَ ۖ إِنِّي أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa dhkur akhā 'ād idh andhara qawmahu bi-al-ahqāf wa qad khalat al-ndhur min bayn yadayh wa min khalfih allā ta'badū illā Allah innī akhāfu 'alaykum 'adhāb yawm 'adhīm
versets.francais: Et mentionne le frère de 'Ad, quand il avertit son peuple aux Ahqaf. Des avertisseurs avaient passé avant lui et après lui disant : « N'adorez qu'Allah ». Je crains pour vous le châtiment d'un jour terrible ».
versets.anglais: And mention, [O Muhammad], the brother of 'Aad, when he warned his people in the [region of] al-Ahqaf - and warners had already passed on before him and after him - [saying], "Do not worship except Allah. Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a terrible day

versets.arabe: قَالُوا أَجِئْتَنَا لِتَحْرِفَنَا عَنْ آلِهَتِنَا فَأْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَا إِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qālū aij'tanā litahrifanā 'an ālihatinā fa'tinā bimā ta'idunā in kunta min al-sādiqīn
versets.francais: Ils dirent : « Es-tu venu pour nous détourner de nos divinités ? Apporte-nous donc ce avec lequel tu nous menaces, si tu dis la vérité ».
versets.anglais: They said, "Have you come to delude us away from our gods? Then bring us what you promise us, if you should be of the truthful

versets.arabe: قَالَ إِنَّمَا الْعِلْمُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ وَأُبَلِّغُكُمْ مَا أُرْسِلْتُ بِهِ وَلَٰكِنِّي أَرَاكُمْ قَوْمًا تَجْهَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qāla innamā al-'ilm 'ind Allah wa ubllighuekum mā ursiltu bihī wa lākinni arākum qawman tajhalūn
versets.francais: Il dit : « La connaissance n'est qu'auprès d'Allah. Je vous communique le message avec lequel j'ai été envoyé ; mais je vois que vous êtes un peuple ignorant ».
versets.anglais: He said, "Knowledge [of its time] is only with Allah, and I convey to you that with which I was sent; but I see you [to be] a people behaving ignorantly

versets.arabe: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ عَارِضًا مُسْتَقْبِلَ أَوْدِيَتِهِمْ قَالُوا هَٰذَا عَارِضٌ مُمْطِرُنَا ۚ بَلْ هُوَ مَا اسْتَعْجَلْتُمْ بِهِ رِيحٌ فِيهَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Fa lammā ra'aw hā 'āridhan mustaqbal awdiyatihim qālū hādhā 'ārid mumtiruna bal huwa mā ista'jaltum bihī rīh fīhā 'adhāb alīm
versets.francais: Puis, quand ils virent un nuage s'avancer vers leurs vallées, ils dirent : « Voilà un nuage qui nous apportera la pluie ». Mais non, c'est au contraire ce que vous aviez demandé hâtivement : un vent contenant un châtiment douloureux.
versets.anglais: And when they saw it as a cloud approaching their valleys, they said, "This is a cloud bringing us rain!" Rather, it is that for which you were impatient: a wind, within it a painful punishment

versets.arabe: يُدَمِّرُ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ بِأَمْرِ رَبِّهِ فَأَصْبَحُوا لَا يُرَىٰ إِلَّا مَسَاكِنُهُمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْقَوْمَ الْمُجْرِمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Yudammiru kulla shay'in bi-amr rabbih fa asbahu lā yurā illā masākinuhum kadhālik najzī al-qawm al-mujrimīn
versets.francais: Il détruit toute chose sur le commandement de son Seigneur. Et au matin, il ne restait visible que leurs demeures. C'est ainsi que Nous rétribuons les gens criminels.
versets.anglais: Destroying everything by command of its Lord. And they became so that nothing was seen [of them] except their dwellings. Thus do We recompense the criminal people

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ مَكَّنَّاهُمْ فِيمَا إِنْ مَكَّنَّاكُمْ فِيهِ وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُمْ سَمْعًا وَأَبْصَارًا وَأَفْئِدَةً فَمَا أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُمْ سَمْعُهُمْ وَلَا أَبْصَارُهُمْ وَلَا أَفْئِدَتُهُمْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ إِذْ كَانُوا يَجْحَدُونَ بِآيَاتِ اللَّهِ وَحَاقَ بِهِمْ مَا كَانُوا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِئُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa laqad makkannāhum fīmā in makkannākum fīh wa ja'alnā lahum sam'an wa absāran wa af'idah fa mā aghnā 'anhum sam'uhum wa lā absāruhum wa lā af'idatuhum min shay'in idh kānū yajhadūn bi-āyāt Allah wa hāq bihim mā kānū bihī yastahzi'ūn
versets.francais: Nous les avions établis avec une puissance que Nous ne vous avons pas donnée et Nous leur avions donné l'ouïe, la vue et les cœurs. Mais l'ouïe, la vue et les cœurs ne leur ont servi à rien, puisqu'ils reniaient les signes d'Allah, et ce dont ils se moquaient les a cernés.
versets.anglais: And We had certainly established them in such as We have not established you, and We made for them hearing and vision and hearts. But their hearing and vision and hearts availed them not from anything [of the punishment] when they were [continually] rejecting the signs of Allah; and they were enveloped by what they used to ridicule

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَا مَا حَوْلَكُمْ مِنَ الْقُرَىٰ وَصَرَّفْنَا الْآيَاتِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa laqad ahlakna mā hawlakum min al-qurā wa sarraffnā al-āyāt la'allahum yarji'ūn
versets.francais: Et Nous avons détruit les cités qui étaient autour de vous et Nous avons varié les signes afin qu'ils se repentent.
versets.anglais: And We have already destroyed what surrounds you of [those] cities, and We have diversified the signs [or verses] that perhaps they might return [from disbelief]

versets.arabe: فَلَوْلَا نَصَرَهُمُ الَّذِينَ اتَّخَذُوا مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ قُرْبَانًا آلِهَةً ۖ بَلْ ضَلُّوا عَنْهُمْ ۖ وَذَٰلِكَ إِفْكُهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوا يَفْتَرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Fa lawlā nasarahum al-ladhīn attakhadhu min dūn Allah qurbānan ālihatun bal dallū 'anhum wa dhālik ifkuhum wa mā kānū iftarūn
versets.francais: Pourquoi donc ceux qu'ils avaient pris, en dehors d'Allah, comme divinités d'intercession ne les ont-ils pas secourus ? Au contraire, ils les ont abandonnés. Telle est leur mensonge et ce qu'ils inventaient.
versets.anglais: Then why did those they took besides Allah as deities by which to approach [Him] not aid them? But they had strayed from them. And that was their falsehood and what they were inventing

versets.arabe: وَإِذْ صَرَفْنَا إِلَيْكَ نَفَرًا مِنَ الْجِنِّ يَسْتَمِعُونَ الْقُرْآنَ فَلَمَّا حَضَرُوهُ قَالُوا أَنْصِتُوا ۖ فَلَمَّا قُضِيَ وَلَّوْا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِمْ مُنْذِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa idh sarafnā ilayk nafaran min al-jinn yastamiūn al-qur'ān fa lammā hadru qālū ansitū fa lammā qudziya wa llawwu ilā qawmihim mundhirīn
versets.francais: Et quand Nous t'envoyâmes un groupe de Djinn, qui écoutaient le Coran. Quand ils l'eurent entendu, ils dirent : « Faites silence ! ». Puis quand la lecture fut achevée, ils retournèrent vers leur peuple en avertisseurs.
versets.anglais: And [mention, O Muhammad], when We directed to you a few of the jinn, listening to the Qur'an. And when they attended it, they said, "Listen quietly." And when it was concluded, they went back to their people as warners

versets.arabe: قَالُوا يَا قَوْمَنَا إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا كِتَابًا أُنْزِلَ مِنْ بَعْدِ مُوسَىٰ مُصَدِّقًا لِمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ يَهْدِي إِلَىٰ الْحَقِّ وَإِلَىٰ طَرِيقٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ
versets.phonetique: Qālū yā qawmanā innā sami'nā kitāban unzil min ba'd Mūsā musaddiqan limā bayn yadayh yahdī ilā al-haqq wa ilā tarīq mustaqīm
versets.francais: Ils dirent : « Ô notre peuple ! Nous avons entendu un Livre descendu après Moïse, confirmant ce qui l'a précédé, guidant vers la Vérité et vers un sentier droit ».
versets.anglais: They said, "O our people, indeed we have heard a [recited] Book revealed after Moses confirming what was before it which guides to the truth and to a straight path

versets.arabe: يَا قَوْمَنَا أَجِيبُوا دَاعِيَ اللَّهِ وَآمِنُوا بِهِ يَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ مِنْ ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُجِرْكُمْ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
versets.phonetique: Yā qawmanā ajībū dāī'ī Allah wa āminū bihī yaghfir lakum min dhunūbikum wa yujirkum min 'adhāb alīm
versets.francais: Ô notre peuple ! Répondez à l'appelant d'Allah et croyez en lui. Allah vous pardonnera vos péchés et vous protègera d'un châtiment douloureux.
versets.anglais: O our people, respond to the Messenger of Allah and believe in him; Allah will forgive for you your sins and protect you from a painful punishment

versets.arabe: وَمَنْ لَا يُجِبْ دَاعِيَ اللَّهِ فَلَيْسَ بِمُعْجِزٍ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَيْسَ لَهُ مِنْ دُونِهِ أَوْلِيَاءُ ۖ أُولَئِكَ فِي ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa man lā yujib dāī'ī Allah fa laysa bimu'jiz fi al-ard wa laysa lahu min dūnihī awliyā'u ula'ika fi dzalāl mubīn
versets.francais: Et celui qui ne répond pas à l'appelant d'Allah ne peut pas L'échapper sur terre, et en dehors de Lui, il n'a pas de protecteurs. Ceux-ci sont dans un égarement manifeste.
versets.anglais: But he who does not respond to the Caller of Allah will not cause failure [to Him] upon earth, and he will not have besides Him any protectors. Those are in manifest error

versets.arabe: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا أَنَّ اللَّهَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَلَمْ يَعْيَ بِخَلْقِهِنَّ بِقَادِرٍ عَلَىٰ أَنْ يُحْيِيَ الْمَوْتَىٰ ۚ بَلَىٰ إِنَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
versets.phonetique: Aw lam yaraw anna Allah al-ladhī khalaqa al-samāwāt wa al-ard wa lam ya'ī bi-khalqihinn biqādir 'alā an yuhyī al-mawṯā balā innahu 'alā kulli shay'in qadīr
versets.francais: N'ont-ils pas vu qu'Allah qui a créé les cieux et la terre, sans se fatiguer à leur création, est capable de ramener à la vie les morts ? Oui, certes il est capable de tout.
versets.anglais: Do they not see that Allah, who created the heavens and earth and did not fail in their creation, is able to give life to the dead? Yes. Indeed, He is over all things competent

versets.arabe: وَيَوْمَ يُعْرَضُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا عَلَىٰ النَّارِ أَلَيْسَ هَٰذَا بِالْحَقِّ ۖ قَالُوا بَلَىٰ وَرَبِّنَا ۖ قَالَ فَذُوقُوا الْعَذَابَ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa yawm yu'rad al-ladhina kafarū 'alā al-nār a laysa hādhā bi-al-haqq qālū balā wa rabbinā qāla fadhūqu al-'adhāb bimā kuntum takfurūn
versets.francais: Et le jour où seront présentés au Feu ceux qui ont mécru, ils se diront : « N'est-ce point la vérité ? » Ils diront : « Oui, par notre Seigneur ! » Il dira : « Goûtez donc le châtiment pour votre mécréance ».
versets.anglais: And the Day those who disbelieved are exposed to the Fire [it will be said], "Is this not the truth?" They will say, "Yes, by our Lord." He will say, "Then taste the punishment because you used to disbelieve

versets.arabe: فَاصْبِرْ كَمَا صَبَرَ أُولُو الْعَزْمِ مِنَ الرُّسُلِ وَلَا تَسْتَعْجِلْ لَهُمْ ۚ كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَ مَا يُوعَدُونَ لَمْ يَلْبَثُوا إِلَّا سَاعَةً مِنْ نَهَارٍ ۚ بَلَاغٌ ۚ فَهَلْ يُهْلَكُ إِلَّا الْقَوْمُ الْفَاسِقُونَ
versets.phonetique: Fa asbir kamā sabara ulu al-'azm min al-rusul wa lā tasta'jil lahum ka'annahum yawm yarawna mā yū'adūn lam yalbathū illā sā'ah min nahār balāgh fa hal yuhlik illā al-qawm al-fāsiqūn
versets.francais: Sois patient donc, comme ont été patients ceux doués de fermeté d'entre les messagers. Ne cherche pas à hâter pour eux le châtiment. Le jour où ils verront ce qui leur a été promis, ils croiront que ils ne sont restés qu'une heure du jour. C'est là une prédication suffisante. Seuls les gens pervers seront-ils anéantis ?
versets.anglais: So be patient, [O Muhammad], as were those of determination among the messengers and do not be impatient for them. It will be - on the Day they see that which they are promised - as though they had not remained [in the world] except an hour of a day. [This is] notification. And will [any] be destroyed except the defiantly disobedient people

versets.arabe: الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَصَدُّوا عَن سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ أَضَلَّ أَعْمَالَهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Alladhina kafarou wa saddu an sabili-llahi adalla a'malahum
versets.francais: Ceux qui ont mécru et obstrué le chemin d'Allah, Il les égarera en les privant de voir ses bonnes oeuvres.
versets.anglais: Those who disbelieve and avert [people] from the way of Allah - He will waste their deeds

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَآمَنُوا بِمَا نُزِّلَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَهُوَ الْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّهِمْ ۚ كَفَّرَ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّئَاتِهِمْ وَأَصْلَحَ بَالَهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Wa-alladhina amanu wa amilu as-salihati wa amanu bima nuzzila ala Muhammadin wa huwa al-haqqu min rabbihim, kaffara anhum sayyiatihim wa aslaha balahum
versets.francais: Et ceux qui ont cru, accompli les bonnes oeuvres et cru à ce qui a été révélé à Muhammad - et c'est la vérité venant de leur Seigneur - Il leur efface leurs mauvaises oeuvres et améliore leur condition.
versets.anglais: And those who believe and do righteous deeds and believe in what has been sent down upon Muhammad - and it is the truth from their Lord - He will remove from them their misdeeds and amend their condition

versets.arabe: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا اتَّبَعُوا الْبَاطِلَ وَأَنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اتَّبَعُوا الْحَقَّ مِن رَّبِّهِمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يَضْرِبُ اللَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ أَمْثَالَهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Dhalika bi-anna alladhina kafarou ittaba'u al-batil wa anna alladhina amanu ittaba'u al-haqqa min rabbihim, kadhalika yadribu-llahu li-n-nasi amthalahum
versets.francais: Cela est parce que ceux qui ont mécru ont suivi le faux tandis que ceux qui ont cru ont suivi la vérité de leur Seigneur. C'est ainsi qu'Allah cite les exemples pour les gens.
versets.anglais: That is because those who disbelieve follow falsehood, and those who believe follow the truth from their Lord. Thus does Allah present to the people their comparisons

versets.arabe: فَإِذَا لَقِيتُمُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا فَضَرْبَ الرِّقَابِ حَتَّىٰ إِذَا أَثْخَنتُمُوهُمْ فَشُدُّوا الْوَثَاقَ فَإِمَّا مَنًّا بَعْدُ وَإِمَّا فِدَاءً حَتَّىٰ تَضَعَ الْحَرْبُ أَوْزَارَهَا ۚ
versets.phonetique: Fa-idha laqitumu alladhina kafarou fa-darba ar-riqab hatta idha athkhan tumuhum fashuddu al-wathaq fa-imma mannan ba'du wa imma fida'an hatta tadaa'a al-harbu awzarahaa
versets.francais: Quand vous rencontrez les mécréants, frappez-les au cou. Puis, quand vous les avez domptés, serrez les entraves. Ensuite, c'est soit la libération gratuite, soit la rançon, jusqu'à ce que la guerre abandonne ses fardeau.
versets.anglais: So when you meet those who disbelieve [in battle], strike [their] necks until, when you have inflicted slaughter upon them, then secure their bonds, and either [confer] favor afterwards or ransom [them] until the war lays down its burdens. That [is the command]. And if Allah had willed, He could have taken vengeance upon them [Himself], but [He ordered armed struggle] to test some of you by means of others. And those who are killed in the cause of Allah - never will He waste their deeds

versets.arabe: ذَٰلِكَ وَلَوْ يَشَاءُ اللَّهُ لَانتَصَرَ مِنْهُمْ وَلَٰكِن لِّيَبْلُوَ بَعْضَكُم بِبَعْضٍ ۗ وَالَّذِينَ قُتِلُوا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَلَن يُضِلَّ أَعْمَالَهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Dhalika wa law yasha'u-llahu lantasara minhum wa lakin li-yabluwah ba'dakum bi-ba'd, wa-alladhina qutilu fi sabili-llahi fa-lan yudilla a'malahum
versets.francais: Tel est l'ordre. Et si Allah le voulait, Il se vengerait Lui-même d'eux, mais Il veut vous éprouver les uns par les autres. Et ceux qui sont tués dans le chemin d'Allah, Il ne rendra jamais vaines leurs oeuvres.
versets.anglais: He will guide them and amend their condition

versets.arabe: سَيَهْدِيهِمْ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Sa-yahdihim wa yuslih balahum
versets.francais: Il les guidera et améliorera leur condition.
versets.anglais: And admit them to Paradise, which He has made known to them

versets.arabe: وَيُدْخِلُهُمُ الْجَنَّةَ عَرَّفَهَا لَهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Wa yudkhiluhum al-jannata arrafaha lahum
versets.francais: Et Il les fera entrer au Paradis qu'Il leur aura fait connaître.
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, if you support Allah, He will support you and plant firmly your feet

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِن تَنصُرُوا اللَّهَ يَنصُرْكُمْ وَيُثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuha alladhina amanu in tansuru-llaha yansarkum wa yuthabbit aqdamakum
versets.francais: Ô vous qui avez cru! Si vous secourez Allah, Il vous secourra et affermira vos pas.
versets.anglais: But those who disbelieve - for them is misery, and He will waste their deeds

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا فَتَعْسًا لَّهُمْ وَأَضَلَّ أَعْمَالَهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Wa-alladhina kafarou fa-ta'san lahum wa adalla a'malahum
versets.francais: Et quant à ceux qui ont mécru, le malheur soit sur eux, et Il rend leurs oeuvres vaines.
versets.anglais: That is because they disliked what Allah revealed, so He rendered worthless their deeds

versets.arabe: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَرِهُوا مَا أَنزَلَ اللَّهُ فَأَحْبَطَ أَعْمَالَهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Dhalika bi-annahum karihu ma anzala-llahu fa-ahbata a'malahum
versets.francais: C'est parce qu'ils ont détesté ce qu'Allah a révélé et leurs actions ont été annulées.
versets.anglais: Have they not traveled through the land and seen how was the end of those before them? Allah destroyed [everything] over them, and for the disbelievers is something comparable

versets.arabe: أَفَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَيَنظُرُوا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ دَمَّرَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ ۖ وَلِلْكَافِرِينَ أَمْثَالُهَا
versets.phonetique: Afa-lam yasiru fi al-ardi fa-yanzhuru kayfa kana aqibatu alladhina min qablihim, dammara-llahu alayhim wa li-l-kafirin amthaluhaa
versets.francais: N'ont-ils pas parcouru la terre et vu comment a été la fin de ceux qui les ont précédés? Allah les a anéantis, et pour les mécréants il y a pareil.
versets.anglais: That is because Allah is the protector of those who have believed and because the disbelievers have no protector

versets.arabe: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ اللَّهَ مَوْلَى الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَأَنَّ الْكَافِرِينَ لَا مَوْلَىٰ لَهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Dhalika bi-anna-llaha mawla alladhina amanu wa anna al-kafirin la mawla lahum
versets.francais: Cela est parce qu'Allah est le protecteur de ceux qui ont cru, tandis que les mécréants n'ont pas de protecteur.
versets.anglais: Indeed, Allah will admit those who have believed and done righteous deeds to gardens beneath which rivers flow, but those who disbelieve enjoy themselves and eat as grazing livestock eat, and the Fire will be a residence for them

versets.arabe: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُدْخِلُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ ۖ وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا يَتَمَتَّعُونَ وَيَأْكُلُونَ كَمَا تَأْكُلُ الْأَنْعَامُ وَالنَّارُ مَثْوًى لَّهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Inna-llaha yudkhil alladhina amanu wa amilu as-salihati jannatin tajri min tahtiha al-anharu wa-alladhina kafarou yatamatta'un wa ya'kulun kama ta'kul al-an'amu wa n-naru mathwan lahum
versets.francais: Allah fait entrer ceux qui ont cru et accompli les bonnes oeuvres dans des Jardins sous lesquels coulent les fleuves. Et ceux qui ont mécru jouissent et mangent comme mangent les bestiaux, et le feu sera leur demeure.
versets.anglais: And how many a city was stronger than your city [Makkah] which drove you out? We destroyed them; and there was no helper for them

versets.arabe: وَكَأَيِّن مِّن قَرْيَةٍ هِيَ أَشَدُّ قُوَّةً مِّن قَرْيَتِكَ الَّتِي أَخْرَجَتْكَ ۖ أَهْلَكْنَاهُمْ فَلَا نَاصِرَ لَهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Wa ka-ayyin min qaryatin hiya ashaddu quwwatan min qaryatik alladhia akhrajat ka ahlaknnahum fa-la nasir lahum
versets.francais: Combien de cités y a-t-il qui avaient une puissance bien plus grande que celle de ta cité qui t'a expulsé! Nous les avons anéantis et il n'y avait pour eux aucun secoureur.
versets.anglais: So is he who is on clear evidence from his Lord like him to whom the evil of his work has been made attractive and they follow their [own] desires

versets.arabe: أَفَمَن كَانَ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّهِ كَمَن زُيِّنَ لَهُ سُوءُ عَمَلِهِ وَاتَّبَعُوا أَهْوَاءَهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Afa-man kana ala bayyinatin min rabbihi kaman zuyyina lahu su'u amalih wa-ittaba'u ahwa'ahum
versets.francais: Est-ce que celui qui s'appuie sur une preuve évidente de son Seigneur est comme celui pour qui ses mauvaises actions ont été embellies, et qui suivent leurs passions?
versets.anglais: Is the description of Paradise, which the righteous are promised, wherein are rivers of water unaltered, rivers of milk the taste of which never changes, rivers of wine delicious to those who drink, and rivers of purified honey, in which they will have from all [kinds of] fruits and forgiveness from their Lord, like [that of] those who abide eternally in the Fire and are given to drink scalding water that will sever their intestines

versets.arabe: مَثَلُ الْجَنَّةِ الَّتِي وُعِدَ الْمُتَّقُونَ ۖ فِيهَا أَنْهَارٌ مِّن مَّاءٍ غَيْرِ آسِنٍ وَأَنْهَارٌ مِّن لَّبَنٍ لَّمْ يَتَغَيَّرْ طَعْمُهُ وَأَنْهَارٌ مِّن خَمْرٍ لَّذَّةٍ لِّلشَّارِبِينَ وَأَنْهَارٌ مِّن عَسَلٍ مُّصَفًّى ۖ
versets.phonetique: Mathalu al-jannati alladhia wu'ida al-muttaqun, fihaa anhru min ma'in ghayri asin wa anharu min labanin lam yataghayar ta'muh wa anharu min khamrin ladhdha li-sh-sharbin wa anharu min asalin musfan
versets.francais: Voici la description du Paradis qui a été promis aux pieux: il y a en lui des fleuves d'eau non saumâtre, des fleuves de lait au goût inchangé, des fleuves de vin délicieux à boire, des fleuves de miel purifié.
versets.anglais: And among them, [O Muhammad], are those who listen to you, until when they depart from you, they say to those who were given knowledge, "What has he said just now?" Those are the ones of whom Allah has sealed over their hearts and who have followed their [own] desires

versets.arabe: وَلَهُمْ فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ الثَّمَرَاتِ وَمَغْفِرَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ ۖ كَمَنْ هُوَ خَالِدٌ فِي النَّارِ وَسُقُوا مَاءً حَمِيمًا فَقَطَّعَ أَمْعَاءَهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Wa lahum fihaa min kulli ath-thmarait wa maghfirah min rabbihin kaman huwa khalidun fi an-nari wa suquu ma'an hamiman fa-qatta'a am'a'ahum
versets.francais: Et ils y auront tous les fruits et le pardon de la part de leur Seigneur. Est-ce comme celui qui demeurera éternellement au feu et à qui on aura donné à boire une eau bouillante qui déchirera ses intestins?
versets.anglais: And those who are guided - He increases them in guidance and gives them their righteousness

versets.arabe: وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَسْتَمِعُ إِلَيْكَ ۖ حَتَّىٰ إِذَا خَرَجُوا مِنْ عِندِكَ قَالُوا لِلَّذِينَ آتَاهُمُ اللَّهُ الْعِلْمَ مَاذَا قَالَ آنِفًا ۚ أُولَٰئِكَ الَّذِينَ طَبَعَ اللَّهُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ وَاتَّبَعُوا أَهْوَاءَهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Wa minhum man yastami'u ilayk hatta idha khajaru min indik qalu li-lladhina atahum-llahu al-ilm madha qala anifan, ula'ik alladhina taba'a-llahu ala qulubihim wa-ittaba'u ahwa'ahum
versets.francais: Il y a parmi eux ceux qui t'écoutent. Mais dès qu'ils sortent de chez toi, ils disent à ceux à qui Allah a donné le savoir: "Qu'a-t-il dit à l'instant?" Ceux-là sont ceux qu'Allah a marqué d'un sceau sur le cœur et qui suivent leurs passions.
versets.anglais: Then do they await except that the Hour should come upon them unexpectedly? But already there have come [some of] its indications. Then what good to them, when it has come, will be their remembrance

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ اهْتَدَوْا زَادَهُمْ هُدًى وَآتَاهُمْ تَقْوَاهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Wa-alladhina ihtadaw zadahum hudan wa atahum taqwahum
versets.francais: Et ceux qui se sont guidés, Il augmente leur guidée et leur donne leur piété.
versets.anglais: So know, [O Muhammad], that there is no deity except Allah and ask forgiveness for your sin and for the believing men and believing women. And Allah knows of your movement and your resting place

versets.arabe: فَهَلْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا السَّاعَةَ أَن تَأْتِيَهُم بَغْتَةً ۖ فَقَدْ جَاءَ أَشْرَاطُهَا ۚ فَأَنَّىٰ لَهُمْ إِذَا جَاءَتْهُمْ ذِكْرَاهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Fa-hal yanzhurun illa as-sa'ata an ta'tiyahum baghtatan, fa-qad ja'a ashratuhaa fa-anna lahum idha ja'athum dhikrahum
versets.francais: Attendent-ils que l'Heure les surprenne soudainement? Or ses signes sont déjà venus. Et comment pourront-ils être avertis quand elle leur viendra?
versets.anglais: Those who believe say, "Why has a surah not been sent down? But when a precise surah is revealed and fighting is mentioned therein, you see those in whose hearts is hypocrisy looking at you with a look of one overcome by death. And more appropriate for them [would have been]

versets.arabe: فَاعْلَمْ أَنَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَاسْتَغْفِرْ لِذَنبِكَ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ ۗ وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مُتَقَلَّبَكُمْ وَمَثْوَاكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Fa-'lam annahu la ilaha illallahu wa-staghfir li-dhanbik wa li-l-mu'minin wa-l-mu'minat, wa-llahu ya'lamu muataqallabakum wa mathwakum
versets.francais: Sache donc qu'il n'y a de divinité qu'Allah, implore le pardon pour ton péché ainsi que pour les croyants et les croyantes. Allah connaît vos mouvements et votre demeure.
versets.anglais: Obedience and good words. And when the matter [of fighting] was determined, if they had been true to Allah, it would have been better for them

versets.arabe: وَيَقُولُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَوْلَا نُزِّلَتْ سُورَةٌ ۖ فَإِذَا أُنزِلَتْ سُورَةٌ مُّحْكَمَةٌ وَذُكِرَ فِيهَا الْقِتَالُ ۙ رَأَيْتَ الَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَيْكَ نَظَرَ الْمَغْشِيِّ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الْمَوْتِ ۖ
versets.phonetique: Wa yaqul alladhina amanu law la nuzzilat surat fa-idha unzilat suratun muhkamah wa dhukira fiha al-qital ra'ayta alladhina fi qulubihim maradun yanzhurun ilayka nazara al-magshiyy alayh mina al-mawt
versets.francais: Et ceux qui ont cru disent: "Pourquoi une sourate n'a-t-elle pas été révélée?" Mais quand une sourate précise est révélée et que la bataille y est mentionnée, tu vois ceux qui ont une maladie au cœur te regarder du regard de celui que saisit l'agonie de la mort.
versets.anglais: So would you perhaps, if you turned away, cause corruption on earth and sever your [ties of] relationship

versets.arabe: فَأَوْلَىٰ لَهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Fa-awla lahum
versets.francais: Et il eût été mieux pour eux
versets.anglais: Those [who do so] are the ones that Allah has cursed, so He deafened them and blinded their vision

versets.arabe: طَاعَةٌ وَقَوْلٌ مَّعْرُوفٌ ۚ فَإِذَا عَزَمَ الْأَمْرُ فَلَوْ صَدَقُوا اللَّهَ لَكَانَ خَيْرًا لَّهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Taa'ah wa qawl ma'ruf, fa-idha 'azama al-amru fa-law sadaqu-llaha la kana khayran lahum
versets.francais: L'obéissance et la parole honnête. Puis, quand l'affaire est décidée, s'ils avaient été véridiques envers Allah, ce eût été meilleur pour eux.
versets.anglais: Then do they not reflect upon the Qur'an, or are there locks upon [their] hearts

versets.arabe: فَهَلْ عَسَيْتُمْ إِن تَوَلَّيْتُمْ أَن تُفْسِدُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَتُقَطِّعُوا أَرْحَامَكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Fa-hal 'asaytum in tawallaytu an tufsidu fi al-ardi wa tuqatti'u arhamakum
versets.francais: Si vous vous détourniez, ne semeriez-vous pas la corruption sur la terre et ne rompriez-vous pas vos liens de parenté?
versets.anglais: Indeed, those who reverted back [to disbelief] after guidance had become clear to them - Satan enticed them and prolonged hope for them

versets.arabe: أُولَٰئِكَ الَّذِينَ لَعَنَهُمُ اللَّهُ فَأَصَمَّهُمْ وَأَعْمَىٰ أَبْصَارَهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Ula'ik alladhina la'anahum-llahu fa-asamahum wa a'ma absarahum
versets.francais: Ceux-là, Allah les a maudits, les a rendus sourds et les a aveuglés.
versets.anglais: That is because they said to those who disliked what Allah sent down, "We will obey you in part of the matter." And Allah knows what they conceal

versets.arabe: أَفَلَا يَتَدَبَّرُونَ الْقُرْآنَ أَمْ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبٍ أَقْفَالُهَا
versets.phonetique: Afa-la yatadabbarun al-qur'an am ala qulub aqlaluhaa
versets.francais: Ne méditent-ils pas sur le Coran? Ou y a-t-il des cadenas sur leurs cœurs?
versets.anglais: Then how [will it be] when the angels take them in death, striking their faces and their backs

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ ارْتَدُّوا عَلَىٰ أَدْبَارِهِم مِّن بَعْدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الْهُدَى ۙ الشَّيْطَانُ سَوَّلَ لَهُمْ وَأَمْلَىٰ لَهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Inna alladhina irtaddu ala adbarim min ba'di ma tabayyana lahum al-huda ash-shaitan sawwala lahum wa amlaa lahum
versets.francais: Ceux qui ont apostasié après que le droit chemin leur soit devenu clair, c'est le Diable qui les a séduits et their a inspiré l'espoir.
versets.anglais: That is because they followed what angered Allah and disliked [what earns] His pleasure, so He rendered worthless their deeds

versets.arabe: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَالُوا لِلَّذِينَ كَرِهُوا مَا نَزَّلَ اللَّهُ سَنُطِيعُكُمْ فِي بَعْضِ الْأَمْرِ ۖ وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ إِسْرَارَهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Dhalika bi-annahum qalu li-lladhina karihu ma nazzala-llahu sanutiukum fi ba'di al-amr wa-llahu ya'lamu isrrarahum
versets.francais: Cela est parce qu'ils ont dit à ceux qui détestaient ce qu'Allah a révélé: "Nous vous obéirons en partie." Allah connaît leur secret.
versets.anglais: Or do those in whose hearts is disease think that Allah would never expose their [feelings of] hatred

versets.arabe: فَكَيْفَ إِذَا تَوَفَّتْهُمُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ يَضْرِبُونَ وُجُوهَهُمْ وَأَدْبَارَهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Fa-kayf idha tawaffathum al-malaikah yadribun wujuhahum wa adbarahum
versets.francais: Comment sera-ce alors, quand les Anges viendront les enlever, frappant leurs faces et leurs dos?
versets.anglais: And if We willed, We could show them to you, and you would know them by their mark; but you will surely know them by the tone of [their] speech. And Allah knows your deeds

versets.arabe: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمُ اتَّبَعُوا مَا أَسْخَطَ اللَّهَ وَكَرِهُوا رِضْوَانَهُ فَأَحْبَطَ أَعْمَالَهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Dhalika bi-annahum ittaba'u ma askhata-llaha wa karihu ridwanahu fa-ahbata a'malahum
versets.francais: Cela est parce qu'ils ont suivi ce qui déplaît à Allah et détestaient Son agrément; aussi a-t-Il annulé leurs oeuvres.
versets.anglais: And We will surely test you until We make evident those who strive among you [for the cause of Allah] and the patient, and We will test your affairs

versets.arabe: أَمْ حَسِبَ الَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ أَن لَّن يُخْرِجَ اللَّهُ أَضْغَانَهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Am hasiba alladhina fi qulubihim maradun an lan yukhraj-llahu adghannahum
versets.francais: Pensez-vous que ceux qui ont une maladie au cœur, Allah ne fera pas connaître leur rancune?
versets.anglais: Indeed, those who disbelieved and averted [people] from the path of Allah and opposed the Messenger after guidance had become clear to them - never will they harm Allah at all, and He will render worthless their deeds

versets.arabe: وَلَوْ نَشَاءُ لَأَرَيْنَاكَهُمْ فَلَعَرَفْتَهُم بِسِيمَاهُمْ ۚ وَلَتَعْرِفَنَّهُمْ فِي لَحْنِ الْقَوْلِ ۚ وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ أَعْمَالَكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Wa law nasha'u la-ara'yanakaahum fa-la'araftahum bi-simaahum wa la-ta'rifanna-hum fi lahni al-qawl wa-llahu ya'lamu a'malakum
versets.francais: Et si Nous voulions, Nous te les montrerions et tu les reconnaîtrais à leurs marques. Et certes tu les reconnaîtras à la manière dont ils parlent. Allah connaît vos oeuvres.
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, obey Allah and obey the Messenger and do not invalidate your deeds

versets.arabe: وَلَنَبْلُوَنَّكُمْ حَتَّىٰ نَعْلَمَ الْمُجَاهِدِينَ مِنكُمْ وَالصَّابِرِينَ وَنَبْلُوَ أَخْبَارَكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Wa la-nabluwannakum hatta na'lama al-mujahidin minkum wa as-sabirin wa nablu akhbarakum
versets.francais: Et Nous vous éprouverons jusqu'à ce que Nous connaissions ceux d'entre vous qui luttent et ceux qui endurent, et Nous saurons si vous dites la vérité.
versets.anglais: Indeed, those who disbelieved and averted [people] from the path of Allah and then died while they were disbelievers - never will Allah forgive them

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَصَدُّوا عَن سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَشَاقُّوا الرَّسُولَ مِن بَعْدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الْهُدَى لَن يَضُرُّوا اللَّهَ شَيْئًا وَسَيُحْبِطُ أَعْمَالَهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Inna alladhina kafarou wa saddu an sabili-llahi wa shaqqu ar-rasul min ba'di ma tabayyana lahum al-huda lan yadurru-llaha shay'an wa sa-yuhbit a'malahum
versets.francais: Ceux qui ont mécru et obstrué le chemin d'Allah et ont contredit le Messager, après que le droit chemin leur ait été clairement montré, ne peuvent nuire à Allah en rien. Et Il annulera leurs oeuvres.
versets.anglais: So do not weaken and call for peace while you are superior; and Allah is with you and will never deprive you of [the reward of] your deeds

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا أَطِيعُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُوا الرَّسُولَ وَلَا تُبْطِلُوا أَعْمَالَكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuha alladhina amanu atiu-llaha wa atiu ar-rasul wa la tubstilu a'malakum
versets.francais: Ô vous qui avez cru! Obéissez à Allah et au Messager, et ne rendez pas vaines vos oeuvres.
versets.anglais: [This] worldly life is only amusement and diversion. And if you believe and fear Allah, He will give you your rewards and not ask you for your properties

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَصَدُّوا عَن سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ثُمَّ مَاتُوا وَهُمْ كُفَّارٌ فَلَن يَغْفِرَ اللَّهُ لَهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Inna alladhina kafarou wa saddu an sabili-llahi thumma matu wa hum kuffar fa-lan yaghfir-llahu lahum
versets.francais: Ceux qui ont mécru et obstrué le chemin d'Allah, puis sont morts tandis qu'ils étaient mécréants, Allah ne leur pardonnera jamais.
versets.anglais: If He should ask you for them and press you, you would withhold, and He would expose your unwillingness

versets.arabe: فَلَا تَهِنُوا وَتَدْعُوا إِلَى السَّلْمِ وَأَنتُمُ الْأَعْلَوْنَ وَاللَّهُ مَعَكُمْ وَلَن يَتِرَكُمْ أَعْمَالَكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Fa-la tahinu wa tad'u ila as-salam wa antum al-a'lawn wa-llahu ma'akum wa lan yatirakum a'malakum
versets.francais: Ne faiblissez donc pas et n'appelez pas à la paix alors que vous êtes les plus forts, et Allah est avec vous. Il ne vous frustrera point du fruit de vos oeuvres.
versets.anglais: Here you are - those invited to spend in the cause of Allah - but among you are those who withhold [out of greed]. And whoever withholds only withholds [benefit] from himself; and Allah is the Free of need, while you are the needy. And if you turn away, He will replace you with another people; then they will not be the likes of you

versets.arabe: إِنَّا فَتَحْنَا لَكَ فَتْحًا مُّبِينًا
versets.phonetique: Inna fatahna laka fathan mubina
versets.francais: Nous t-avons accordé une victoire éclatante
versets.anglais: Indeed, We have given you, [O Muhammad], a clear conquest

versets.arabe: لِّيَغْفِرَ لَكَ اللَّهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِن ذَنبِكَ وَمَا تَأَخَّرَ وَيُتِمَّ نِعْمَتَهُ عَلَيْكَ وَيَهْدِيَكَ صِرَاطًا مُّسْتَقِيمًا
versets.phonetique: Liyaghfira laka l-lahu ma taqaddama min dhanbika wa ma ta-akhkhara wa yutimma ni-matahu alayka wa yahdiyaka siratan mustaqima
versets.francais: Afin qu-Allah te pardonne tes péchés passés et futurs, qu-Il complète Sa grâce sur toi et te guide sur un chemin droit
versets.anglais: That Allah may forgive for you what preceded of your sin and what will follow and complete His favor upon you and guide you to a straight path

versets.arabe: وَيَنصُرَكَ اللَّهُ نَصْرًا عَزِيزًا
versets.phonetique: Wa yanṣuraka l-lahu nasran aziza
versets.francais: Et qu-Allah te donne une aide puissante
versets.anglais: And [that] Allah may aid you with a mighty victory

versets.arabe: هُوَ الَّذِي أَنزَلَ السَّكِينَةَ فِي قُلُوبِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ لِيَزْدَادُوا إِيمَانًا مَّعَ إِيمَانِهِمْ
versets.phonetique: Huwa lladhi anzala s-sakinata fi qulubi l-mu-minina liyazdadu imanan ma-a imanihim
versets.francais: C-est Lui qui a fait descendre la quiétude dans les coeurs des croyants afin qu-ils augmentent en foi
versets.anglais: It is He who sent down tranquillity into the hearts of the believers that they would increase in faith along with their [present] faith. And to Allah belong the soldiers of the heavens and the earth, and ever is Allah Knowing and Wise

versets.arabe: لِّيُدْخِلَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا
versets.phonetique: Liyudkhila l-mu-minina wa l-mu-minati jannatin tajri min tahtiha l-anharu khalidina fiha
versets.francais: Pour faire entrer les croyants et les croyantes dans des jardins sous lesquels coulent des ruisseaux où ils demeureront éternellement
versets.anglais: [And] that He may admit the believing men and the believing women to gardens beneath which rivers flow to abide therein eternally and remove from them their misdeeds - and ever is that, in the sight of Allah, a great attainment

versets.arabe: وَيُعَذِّبَ الْمُنَافِقِينَ وَالْمُنَافِقَاتِ وَالْمُشْرِكِينَ وَالْمُشْرِكَاتِ الظَّانِّينَ بِاللَّهِ ظَنَّ السَّوْءِ
versets.phonetique: Wa yu-adhdhibha l-munafiqina wa l-munafiqati wa l-mushrikina wa l-mushrikati z-zannnina billahi zanna s-saw-
versets.francais: Et pour châtier les hypocrites et les hypocrites, les polythéistes et les polythéistes qui ont de mauvaises pensées à l-égard d-Allah
versets.anglais: And [that] He may punish the hypocrite men and hypocrite women, and the polytheist men and polytheist women - those who assume about Allah an assumption of evil nature. Upon them is a misfortune of evil nature; and Allah has become angry with them and has cursed them and prepared for them Hell, and evil it is as a destination

versets.arabe: وَلِلَّهِ جُنُودُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ عَزِيزًا حَكِيمًا
versets.phonetique: Wa lillahi junudu s-samawati wa l-ardi wa kana l-lahu azizzan hakima
versets.francais: À Allah appartiennent les armées des cieux et de la terre. Allah est Puissant et Sage
versets.anglais: And to Allah belong the soldiers of the heavens and the earth. And ever is Allah Exalted in Might and Wise

versets.arabe: إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ شَاهِدًا وَمُبَشِّرًا وَنَذِيرًا
versets.phonetique: Inna arsalnaka shahidan wa mubashshiran wa nadhira
versets.francais: Nous t-avons envoyé comme témoin, annonciateur et avertisseur
versets.anglais: Indeed, We have sent you as a witness and a bringer of good tidings and a warner

versets.arabe: لِّتُؤْمِنُوا بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَتُعَزِّرُوهُ وَتُوَقِّرُوهُ وَتُسَبِّحُوهُ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا
versets.phonetique: Litu-minu billahi wa rasulihi wa tu-azzirahu wa tuwaqqiruhu wa tusabbbihuhu bukratan wa asila
versets.francais: Afin que vous croyiez en Allah et en Son messager, que vous l-aidiez, l-honoriez et Le glorifiiez matin et soir
versets.anglais: That you [people] may believe in Allah and His Messenger and honor him and respect the Prophet and exalt Allah morning and afternoon

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُبَايِعُونَكَ إِنَّمَا يُبَايِعُونَ اللَّهَ يَدُ اللَّهِ فَوْقَ أَيْدِيهِمْ
versets.phonetique: Inna lladhina yubayy-unaka innama yubayy-una l-laha yadu l-lahi fawqa aydihim
versets.francais: Ceux qui te prêtent serment d-allégeance ne font que prêter serment à Allah. La main d-Allah est au-dessus de leurs mains
versets.anglais: Indeed, those who pledge allegiance to you, [O Muhammad] - they are actually pledging allegiance to Allah. The hand of Allah is over their hands. So he who breaks his word only breaks it to the detriment of himself. And he who fulfills that which he has promised Allah - He will give him a great reward

versets.arabe: سَيَقُولُ لَكَ الْمُخَلَّفُونَ مِنَ الْأَعْرَابِ شَغَلَتْنَا أَمْوَالُنَا وَأَهْلُونَا فَاسْتَغْفِرْ لَنَا
versets.phonetique: Sayaqulu laka l-mukhallifuna mina l-a-rabi shaghhalat-na amwaluna wa ahluna fastaghhfir lana
versets.francais: Les Bédouins retardataires te diront : Nos biens et nos familles nous ont occupés. Demande pardon pour nous
versets.anglais: Those who remained behind of the bedouins will say to you, "Our properties and our families occupied us, so ask forgiveness for us." They say with their tongues what is not within their hearts. Say, "Then who could prevent Allah at all if He intended for you harm or intended for you benefit? Rather, ever is Allah, with what you do, Acquainted

versets.arabe: بَلْ ظَنَنتُمْ أَن لَّن يَنقَلِبَ الرَّسُولُ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ إِلَىٰ أَهْلِيهِمْ أَبَدًا
versets.phonetique: Bal zanantum an llan yanqaliba r-rasulu wa l-mu-minuna ila ahlihim abada
versets.francais: Vous pensiez plutôt que le Prophète et les croyants ne retourneraient jamais vers leurs familles
versets.anglais: But you thought that the Messenger and the believers would never return to their families, ever, and that was made pleasing in your hearts. And you assumed an assumption of evil and became a people ruined

versets.arabe: وَمَن لَّمْ يُؤْمِن بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ فَإِنَّا أَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَافِرِينَ سَعِيرًا
versets.phonetique: Wa man lam yu-min billahi wa rasulihi fa-inna a-tadna lil-kafiryna sa-ira
versets.francais: Quant à celui qui ne croit pas en Allah et en Son messager, Nous avons préparé pour les mécréants une Fournaise
versets.anglais: And whoever has not believed in Allah and His Messenger - then indeed, We have prepared for the disbelievers a Blaze

versets.arabe: وَلِلَّهِ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ يَغْفِرُ لِمَن يَشَاءُ وَيُعَذِّبُ مَن يَشَاءُ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا
versets.phonetique: Wa lillahi mulku s-samawati wa l-ardi yaghfiru liman yasha-u wa yu-adhdhibhu man yasha-u wa kana l-lahu ghafuran rahima
versets.francais: À Allah appartient le royaume des cieux et de la terre. Il pardonne à qui Il veut et châtie qui Il veut. Allah est Pardonneur et Miséricordieux
versets.anglais: And to Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. He forgives whom He wills and punishes whom He wills. And ever is Allah Forgiving and Merciful

versets.arabe: سَيَقُولُ الْمُخَلَّفُونَ إِذَا انطَلَقْتُمْ إِلَىٰ مَغَانِمَ لِتَأْخُذُوهَا ذَرُونَا نَتَّبِعْكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Sayaqulu l-mukhallifuna idha ntalagtum ila maghaanima lita-khuduha dharuna nattabi-kum
versets.francais: Les retardataires diront quand vous partirez pour prendre les butins : Laissez-nous vous suivre
versets.anglais: Those who remained behind will say when you set out toward the war booty to take it, "Let us follow you." They wish to change the words of Allah. Say, "Never will you follow us. Thus did Allah say before." So they will say, "Rather, you envy us." But [in fact] they were not understanding except a little

versets.arabe: قُل لِّلْمُخَلَّفِينَ مِنَ الْأَعْرَابِ سَتُدْعَوْنَ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ أُولِي بَأْسٍ شَدِيدٍ تُقَاتِلُونَهُمْ أَوْ يُسْلِمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qul lil-mukhallifina mina l-a-rabi satudawna ila qawmin uli ba-sin shadid tuqatiluhum aw yuslamun
versets.francais: Dis aux Bédouins retardataires : Vous serez appelés contre un peuple doté d-une grande force guerrière, à les combattre ou à ce qu-ils se soumettent
versets.anglais: Say to those who remained behind of the bedouins, "You will be called to [face] a people of great military might; you may fight them, or they will submit. So if you obey, Allah will give you a good reward; but if you turn away as you turned away before, He will punish you with a painful punishment

versets.arabe: لَّيْسَ عَلَى الْأَعْمَىٰ حَرَجٌ وَلَا عَلَى الْأَعْرَجِ حَرَجٌ وَلَا عَلَى الْمَرِيضِ حَرَجٌ
versets.phonetique: Laysa ala l-a-ma harajun wa la ala l-a-raji harajun wa la ala l-maridi haraj
versets.francais: L-aveugle, le boiteux et le malade ne sont pas en faute
versets.anglais: There is not upon the blind any guilt or upon the lame any guilt or upon the ill any guilt [for remaining behind]. And whoever obeys Allah and His Messenger - He will admit him to gardens beneath which rivers flow; but whoever turns away - He will punish him with a painful punishment

versets.arabe: لَّقَدْ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ إِذْ يُبَايِعُونَكَ تَحْتَ الشَّجَرَةِ
versets.phonetique: Laqad radiya l-lahu ani l-mu-minina idh yubayyi-unaka tahta sh-shajara
versets.francais: Allah a été satisfait des croyants quand ils t-ont prêté serment sous l-arbre
versets.anglais: Certainly was Allah pleased with the believers when they pledged allegiance to you, [O Muhammad], under the tree, and He knew what was in their hearts, so He sent down tranquillity upon them and rewarded them with an imminent conquest

versets.arabe: وَمَغَانِمَ كَثِيرَةً يَأْخُذُونَهَا وَكَانَ اللَّهُ عَزِيزًا حَكِيمًا
versets.phonetique: Wa maghanima kathiratan ya-khudhunaha wa kana l-lahu azizzan hakima
versets.francais: Et un grand butin qu-ils prendront. Allah est Puissant et Sage
versets.anglais: And much war booty which they will take. And ever is Allah Exalted in Might and Wise

versets.arabe: وَعَدَكُمُ اللَّهُ مَغَانِمَ كَثِيرَةً تَأْخُذُونَهَا فَعَجَّلَ لَكُمْ هَٰذِهِ وَكَفَّ أَيْدِيَ النَّاسِ عَنكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Wa-adakumu l-lahu maghanima kathiratan ta-khudhunaha fa-ajjala lakum hadhihi wa kaffa aydi n-nasi ankum
versets.francais: Allah vous a promis un grand butin que vous prendrez. Il vous a accordé ceci en avant-goût et a retenu les mains des gens loin de vous
versets.anglais: Allah has promised you much booty that you will take [in the future] and has hastened for you this [victory] and withheld the hands of people from you - that it may be a sign for the believers and [that] He may guide you to a straight path

versets.arabe: وَأُخْرَىٰ لَمْ تَقْدِرُوا عَلَيْهَا قَدْ أَحَاطَ اللَّهُ بِهَا وَكَانَ اللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرًا
versets.phonetique: Wa ukhra lam taqdiru alayha qad ahata l-lahu biha wa kana l-lahu ala kulli shay-in qadira
versets.francais: Et d-autres encore que vous n-étiez pas en mesure de prendre. Allah les avait déjà cernées. Allah est Omnipotent
versets.anglais: And [He promises] other [victories] that you were [so far] unable to [realize] which Allah has already encompassed. And ever is Allah, over all things, competent

versets.arabe: وَلَوْ قَاتَلَكُمُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَوَلَّوُا الْأَدْبَارَ ثُمَّ لَا يَجِدُونَ وَلِيًّا وَلَا نَصِيرًا
versets.phonetique: Wa law qatalakumu lladhina kafaru lawallawu l-adbara thumma la yajiduna waliyyan wa la nasira
versets.francais: Si les mécréants vous avaient combattus, ils auraient tourné le dos, puis n-auraient trouvé ni protecteur ni secours
versets.anglais: And if those [Makkans] who disbelieve had fought you, they would have turned their backs [in flight]. Then they would not find a protector or a helper

versets.arabe: سُنَّةَ اللَّهِ الَّتِي قَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلُ وَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّةِ اللَّهِ تَبْدِيلًا
versets.phonetique: Sunnata l-lahi llati qad khalat min qablu wa lan tajida lisunnati l-lahi tabdila
versets.francais: C-est la règle d-Allah qui était en vigueur avant. Tu ne trouveras aucun changement dans la règle d-Allah
versets.anglais: [This is] the established way of Allah which has occurred before. And never will you find in the way of Allah any change

versets.arabe: وَهُوَ الَّذِي كَفَّ أَيْدِيَهُمْ عَنكُمْ وَأَيْدِيَكُمْ عَنْهُم بِبَطْنِ مَكَّةَ مِن بَعْدِ أَنْ أَظْفَرَكُمْ عَلَيْهِمْ
versets.phonetique: Wa huwa lladhi kaffa aydiyahum ankum wa aydiyakum anhum bibatni makkata min ba-di an azfarakum alayhim
versets.francais: C-est Lui qui a retenu leurs mains de vous et vos mains d-eux dans l-enceinte de La Mecque après vous avoir donné la victoire sur eux
versets.anglais: And it is He who withheld their hands from you and your hands from them within [the area of] Makkah after He caused you to overcome them. And ever is Allah of what you do, Seeing

versets.arabe: هُمُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَصَدُّوكُمْ عَنِ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ وَالْهَدْيَ مَعْكُوفًا أَن يَبْلُغَ مَحِلَّهُ
versets.phonetique: Humu lladhina kafaru wa sadddukum ani l-masjidi l-harami wa l-hadya ma-kufan an yablugha mahillahu
versets.francais: Ce sont eux qui ont mécru et vous ont empêchés d-accéder à la Mosquée Sacrée et ont retenu les offrandes d-atteindre leur lieu de sacrifice
versets.anglais: They are the ones who disbelieved and obstructed you from al-Masjid al-Haram while the offering was prevented from reaching its place of sacrifice. And if not for believing men and believing women whom you did not know - that you might trample them and there would befall you because of them dishonor without [your] knowledge - [you would have been permitted to enter Makkah]. [This was so] that Allah might admit to His mercy whom He willed. If they had been apart [from them], We would have punished those who disbelieved among them with painful punishment

versets.arabe: إِذْ جَعَلَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا فِي قُلُوبِهِمُ الْحَمِيَّةَ حَمِيَّةَ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ فَأَنزَلَ اللَّهُ سَكِينَتَهُ عَلَىٰ رَسُولِهِ وَعَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Idh ja-ala lladhina kafaru fi qulubihimu l-hamiyyata hamiyyata l-jahiliyyati fa-anzala l-lahu sakinatahu ala rasulihi wa ala l-mu-minin
versets.francais: Quand les mécréants mirent dans leurs coeurs l-orgueil, l-orgueil de l-ignorance, Allah fit descendre Sa quiétude sur Son messager et sur les croyants
versets.anglais: When those who disbelieved had put into their hearts chauvinism - the chauvinism of the time of ignorance. But Allah sent down His tranquillity upon His Messenger and upon the believers and imposed upon them the word of righteousness, and they were more deserving of it and worthy of it. And ever is Allah, of all things, Knowing

versets.arabe: لَّقَدْ صَدَقَ اللَّهُ رَسُولَهُ الرُّؤْيَا بِالْحَقِّ لَتَدْخُلُنَّ الْمَسْجِدَ الْحَرَامَ إِن شَاءَ اللَّهُ آمِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Laqad sadaqa l-lahu rasulahu r-ru-ya bil-haqqi latadkhulunna l-masjida l-harama in sha-a l-lahu aminin
versets.francais: Allah a tenu la promesse de Son messager dans la vision : Vous entrerez certainement dans la Mosquée Sacrée, si Allah veut, en sécurité
versets.anglais: Certainly has Allah showed to His Messenger the vision in truth. You will surely enter al-Masjid al-Haram, if Allah wills, in safety, with your heads shaved and [hair] shortened, not fearing [anyone]. He knew what you did not know and has arranged before that a conquest near [at hand]

versets.arabe: هُوَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلَ رَسُولَهُ بِالْهُدَىٰ وَدِينِ الْحَقِّ لِيُظْهِرَهُ عَلَى الدِّينِ كُلِّهِ وَكَفَىٰ بِاللَّهِ شَهِيدًا
versets.phonetique: Huwa lladhi arsala rasulahu bil-huda wa dini l-haqqi liyuzhirahu ala d-dini kullihi wa kafa billahi shahida
versets.francais: C-est Lui qui a envoyé Son messager avec la guidée et la religion de la vérité pour la faire prévaloir sur toute religion. Allah suffit comme témoin
versets.anglais: It is He who sent His Messenger with guidance and the religion of truth to manifest it over all religion. And sufficient is Allah as Witness

versets.arabe: مُّحَمَّدٌ رَّسُولُ اللَّهِ وَالَّذِينَ مَعَهُ أَشِدَّاءُ عَلَى الْكُفَّارِ رُحَمَاءُ بَيْنَهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Muhammadun rasulu l-lahi wa lladhina ma-ahu ashdda-u ala l-kuffari ruhama-u baynahum
versets.francais: Muhammad est le messager d-Allah. Ceux qui sont avec lui sont durs envers les mécréants et miséricordieux entre eux
versets.anglais: Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah; and those with him are forceful against the disbelievers, merciful among themselves. You see them bowing and prostrating [in prayer], seeking bounty from Allah and [His] pleasure. Their mark is on their faces from the trace of prostration. That is their description in the Torah. And their description in the Gospel is as a plant which produces its offshoots and strengthens them so they grow firm and stand upon their stalks, delighting the sowers - so that Allah may enrage by them the disbelievers. Allah has promised those who believe and do righteous deeds among them forgiveness and a great reward

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تُقَدِّمُوا بَيْنَ يَدَيِ اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuha lladhina amanu la tuqaddimu bayna yaday i l-lahi wa rasulihi wa ttaqu l-laha inna l-laha sami-un alim
versets.francais: O croyants ! Ne devancez pas Allah et Son messager. Craignez Allah. Allah est Audient et Omniscient
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, do not put [yourselves] before Allah and His Messenger but fear Allah. Indeed, Allah is Hearing and Knowing

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تَرْفَعُوا أَصْوَاتَكُمْ فَوْقَ صَوْتِ النَّبِيِّ وَلَا تَجْهَرُوا لَهُ بِالْقَوْلِ
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuha lladhina amanu la tarfa-u aswatakum fawqa sawti n-nabiyyi wa la tajharu lahu bil-qawl
versets.francais: O croyants ! N-élevez pas vos voix au-dessus de la voix du Prophète et ne lui parlez pas à haute voix
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, do not raise your voices above the voice of the Prophet or be loud to him in speech like the loudness of some of you to others, lest your deeds become worthless while you perceive not

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَغُضُّونَ أَصْوَاتَهُمْ عِندَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ أُولَٰئِكَ الَّذِينَ امْتَحَنَ اللَّهُ قُلُوبَهُمْ لِلتَّقْوَىٰ
versets.phonetique: Inna lladhina yaghudhduna aswatahum inda rasuli l-lahi ula-ika lladhina mtahana l-lahu qulubahum lit-taqwa
versets.francais: Ceux qui baissent leur voix auprès du messager d-Allah sont ceux dont Allah a éprouvé les coeurs pour la piété
versets.anglais: Indeed, those who lower their voices before the Messenger of Allah - they are the ones whose hearts Allah has tested for righteousness. For them is forgiveness and great reward

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُنَادُونَكَ مِن وَرَاءِ الْحُجُرَاتِ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Inna lladhina yunadunaka min wara-i l-hujurati aktharuhum la ya-qilun
versets.francais: Ceux qui t-appellent de derrière les appartements, la plupart d-entre eux ne raisonnent pas
versets.anglais: Indeed, those who call you, [O Muhammad], from behind the chambers - most of them do not use reason

versets.arabe: وَلَوْ أَنَّهُمْ صَبَرُوا حَتَّىٰ تَخْرُجَ إِلَيْهِمْ لَكَانَ خَيْرًا لَّهُمْ وَاللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa law annahum sabaru hatta takhruja ilayhim lakana khayran lahum wa l-lahu ghafurun rahim
versets.francais: S-ils avaient patienté jusqu-à ce que tu sortes vers eux, ce serait meilleur pour eux. Allah est Pardonneur et Miséricordieux
versets.anglais: And if they had been patient until you [could] come out to them, it would have been better for them. But Allah is Forgiving and Merciful

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِن جَاءَكُمْ فَاسِقٌ بِنَبَإٍ فَتَبَيَّنُوا
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuha lladhina amanu in ja-akum fasiqun bianaba-in fatabayyanu
versets.francais: O croyants ! Si un pervers vous apporte une nouvelle, vérifiez-la
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, if there comes to you a disobedient one with information, investigate, lest you harm a people out of ignorance and become, over what you have done, regretful

versets.arabe: وَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّ فِيكُمْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ لَوْ يُطِيعُكُمْ فِي كَثِيرٍ مِّنَ الْأَمْرِ لَعَنِتُّمْ
versets.phonetique: Wa-lamu anna fikum rasulal-lahi law yuti-ukum fi kathirin mina l-amri la-anittum
versets.francais: Sachez que le messager d-Allah est parmi vous. S-il vous obéissait en beaucoup d-affaires, vous seriez en difficulté
versets.anglais: And know that among you is the Messenger of Allah. If he were to obey you in much of the matter, you would be in difficulty, but Allah has endeared to you the faith and has made it pleasing in your hearts and has made hateful to you disbelief, defiance and disobedience. Those are the [rightly] guided

versets.arabe: فَضْلًا مِّنَ اللَّهِ وَنِعْمَةً وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Fadlan mina l-lahi wa ni-matan wa l-lahu alimun hakim
versets.francais: C-est une faveur et une grâce d-Allah. Allah est Omniscient et Sage
versets.anglais: [It is] as bounty from Allah and favor. And Allah is Knowing and Wise

versets.arabe: وَإِن طَائِفَتَانِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ اقْتَتَلُوا فَأَصْلِحُوا بَيْنَهُمَا
versets.phonetique: Wa in ta-ifatani mina l-mu-minina qqtatalu fa-asllihu baynahuma
versets.francais: Si deux groupes de croyants se combattent, réconciliez-les
versets.anglais: And if two factions among the believers should fight, then make settlement between the two. But if one of them oppresses the other, then fight against the one that oppresses until it returns to the ordinance of Allah. And if it returns, then make settlement between them in justice and act justly. Indeed, Allah loves those who act justly

versets.arabe: إِنَّمَا الْمُؤْمِنُونَ إِخْوَةٌ فَأَصْلِحُوا بَيْنَ أَخَوَيْكُمْ وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Innama l-mu-minuna ikhwatun fa-asllihu bayna akhawayakum wa ttaqu l-laha la-allakum turhamun
versets.francais: Les croyants ne sont que des frères. Réconciliez donc vos frères et craignez Allah. Peut-être vous fera-t-on miséricorde
versets.anglais: The believers are but brothers, so make settlement between your brothers. And fear Allah that you may receive mercy

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا يَسْخَرْ قَوْمٌ مِّن قَوْمٍ عَسَىٰ أَن يَكُونُوا خَيْرًا مِّنْهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuha lladhina amanu la yaskhar qawmun min qawmin asa an yakunu khayran minhum
versets.francais: O croyants ! Qu-un groupe ne se moque pas d-un autre groupe qui vaut peut-être mieux
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, let not a people ridicule [another] people; perhaps they may be better than them; nor let women ridicule [other] women; perhaps they may be better than them. And do not insult one another and do not call each other by [offensive] nicknames. Wretched is the name of disobedience after [one's] faith. And whoever does not repent - then it is those who are the wrongdoers

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اجْتَنِبُوا كَثِيرًا مِّنَ الظَّنِّ إِنَّ بَعْضَ الظَّنِّ إِثْمٌ وَلَا تَجَسَّسُوا وَلَا يَغْتَب بَّعْضُكُم بَعْضًا
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuha lladhina amanu jtanibu kathiran mina z-zanni inna ba-da z-zanni ithmun wa la tajassasu wa la yaghtab ba-dukum ba-da
versets.francais: O croyants ! Évitez beaucoup de soupçons car certains soupçons sont péchés. N-espionnez pas et ne médisez pas les uns des autres
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, avoid much [negative] assumption. Indeed, some assumption is sin. And do not spy or backbite each other. Would one of you like to eat the flesh of his brother when dead? You would detest it. And fear Allah; indeed, Allah is Accepting of repentance and Merciful

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَاكُم مِّن ذَكَرٍ وَأُنثَىٰ وَجَعَلْنَاكُمْ شُعُوبًا وَقَبَائِلَ لِتَعَارَفُوا إِنَّ أَكْرَمَكُمْ عِندَ اللَّهِ أَتْقَاكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuha n-nasu inna khalaqnakum min dhakarin wa untha wa ja-alnakum shu-uban wa qaba-ila lita-arafu inna akramakum inda l-lahi atqakum
