versets.phonetique: Inna arsalna 'alayhim sayhatan wahidatan fakanu ka hashim al-muhtadhir
versets.francais: Nous envoyâmes contre eux un seul cri, et ils furent comme l'herbe sèche d'une haie brisée.
versets.anglais: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning

versets.arabe: ولقد يسرنا القرآن للذكر فهل من مدكر
versets.phonetique: Wa laqad yasarna al-qur'ana li adh-dhikri fa hal min mudakkirr
versets.francais: Et Nous avons facilité le Coran pour l'admonition. Y a-t-il donc quelqu'un qui se souvienne ?
versets.anglais: Indeed, We sent upon them one blast from the sky, and they became like the dry twig fragments of an [animal] pen

versets.arabe: كذبت قوم لوط بالنذر
versets.phonetique: Kadhdhbat qawmu lut bi an-nudhur
versets.francais: Le peuple de Loth traita les avertissements de mensonge.
versets.anglais: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember

versets.arabe: إنا أرسلنا عليهم حاصبا إلا آل لوط نجيناهم بسحر
versets.phonetique: Inna arsalna 'alayhim hasiban illa ala lut najaynahum bi sahar
versets.francais: Nous envoyâmes contre eux un vent de sable abrasif, sauf la famille de Loth que nous sauvâmes à l'aube.
versets.anglais: The people of Lot denied the warning

versets.arabe: نعمة من عندنا كذلك نجزي من شكر
versets.phonetique: Ni'matan min 'indi na kadalika najzi man shakara
versets.francais: Par une grâce de Notre part. C'est ainsi que nous récompensons celui qui est reconnaissant.
versets.anglais: Indeed, We sent upon them a storm of stones, except the family of Lot - We saved them before dawn

versets.arabe: ولقد أنذرهم بطشتنا فتماروا بالنذر
versets.phonetique: Wa laqad andhara hum batshata na fatamaru bi an-nudhur
versets.francais: Et il les avait avertis de Notre châtiment, mais ils niaient les avertissements.
versets.anglais: As favor from us. Thus do We reward he who is grateful

versets.arabe: وراودوه عن ضيفه فطمسنا أعينهم فذوقوا عذابي ونذر
versets.phonetique: Wa raawdu hu 'an dayfihi fatamasna a'yunahum fadhaqqu 'adhabi wa nudhur
versets.francais: Et ils le pressaient au sujet de ses hôtes, alors Nous aveuglâmes leurs yeux. Goûtez donc Mon châtiment et Mes avertissements !
versets.anglais: And he had already warned them of Our assault, but they disputed the warning

versets.arabe: ولقد صبحهم بكرة عذاب مستقر
versets.phonetique: Wa laqad sabbahhum bakratan 'adhab mustaqir
versets.francais: Et dès le matin, un châtiment durable les saisit.
versets.anglais: And they had demanded from him his guests, but We obliterated their eyes, [saying], "Taste My punishment and warning

versets.arabe: فذوقوا عذابي ونذر
versets.phonetique: Fadhaqqu 'adhabi wa nudhur
versets.francais: Goûtez donc Mon châtiment et Mes avertissements !
versets.anglais: And there came upon them by morning an abiding punishment

versets.arabe: ولقد يسرنا القرآن للذكر فهل من مدكر
versets.phonetique: Wa laqad yasarna al-qur'ana li adh-dhikri fa hal min mudakkirr
versets.francais: Et Nous avons facilité le Coran pour l'admonition. Y a-t-il donc quelqu'un qui se souvienne ?
versets.anglais: So taste My punishment and warning

versets.arabe: ولقد جاء فرعون النذر
versets.phonetique: Wa laqad ja'a fir'awnu an-nudhur
versets.francais: Et déjà l'avertissement était venu à Pharaon.
versets.anglais: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember

versets.arabe: كذب بآياتنا فأخذناه أخذا وبيلا
versets.phonetique: Kadhdhaba bi ayatina fa akhadhna hu akhdhah wa bil
versets.francais: Il traita Nos signes de mensonge, alors Nous le saisîmes d'une prise terrible.
versets.anglais: And there certainly came to the people of Pharaoh warning

versets.arabe: أليس في جهنم مثوى للكافرين
versets.phonetique: Alaisa fi jahnam mathwa li al-kafirina
versets.francais: N'est-ce pas dans l'Enfer qu'il y a une demeure pour les mécréants ?
versets.anglais: They denied Our signs, all of them, so We seized them with a seizure of one Exalted in Might and Perfect in Ability

versets.arabe: وإن الظالمين في ضلال وسعر
versets.phonetique: Wa in adh-dhaliminaa fi dalalain wa su'ur
versets.francais: Et les injustes sont dans l'égarement et la folie.
versets.anglais: Are your disbelievers better than those [former ones], or have you immunity in the scripture

versets.arabe: ويوم يعرض الذين كفروا على النار أليس هذا بالحق قالوا بلى وربنا قال فذوقوا العذاب بما كنتم تكفرون
versets.phonetique: Wa yawma yu'radu alladhina kafaru 'ala an-nari alaisa hadha bi al-haqqi qalu bala wa rabbina qala fadhaqqu al-'adhaba bima kuntu takfirun
versets.francais: Et le jour où ceux qui ont mécru seront exposés au Feu, cela leur sera dit : « N'est-ce pas la Vérité ? » Ils diront : « Oui, par notre Seigneur ! » Il dira : « Goûtez donc le châtiment pour avoir mécru ».
versets.anglais: Or do they say, "We are an assembly supporting [each other]

versets.arabe: فاصبر كما صبر أولوا العزم من الرسل ولا تستعجل لهم كأنهم يوم يرون ما يوعدون لم يلبثوا إلا ساعة من نهار بلاغ فهل يهلك إلا القوم الفاسقون
versets.phonetique: Fasabir kama sabara uluul 'azmi min ar-rusuli wa la tasta'jil lahum ka'anna hum yawma yarawna ma yuu'adun lam yalbathu illa sa'atan min nahar balagh fa hal yahlaku illa al-qawmu al-fasiqun
versets.francais: Sois donc patient, comme l'ont été les Messagers doués de fermeté. Ne hâte point pour eux le châtiment. Le jour où ils verront ce qui leur est promis, il leur semblera qu'ils n'ont demeuré [sur terre] qu'une heure d'un jour. C'est là le message. Et n'y aura-t-il de perdus que les gens qui commettent des transgressions ?
versets.anglais: [Their] assembly will be defeated, and they will turn their backs [in retreat]

versets.arabe: ولقد يسرنا القرآن للذكر فهل من مدكر
versets.phonetique: Wa laqad yasarna al-qur'ana li adh-dhikri fa hal min mudakkirr
versets.francais: Et Nous avons facilité le Coran pour l'admonition. Y a-t-il donc quelqu'un qui se souvienne ?
versets.anglais: But the Hour is their appointment [for due punishment], and the Hour is more disastrous and more bitter

versets.arabe: وقد خلقنا السماوات والأرض وما بينهما في ستة أيام وما مسنا من لغوب
versets.phonetique: Wa qad khalaqna as-samawati wa al-arda wa ma baynahuma fi sittati ayyamin wa ma masana min lugub
versets.francais: Nous avons créé les cieux et la terre ainsi que ce qui se trouve entre eux en six jours, et la fatigue ne nous a point touchés.
versets.anglais: Indeed, the criminals are in error and madness

versets.arabe: فاصبر على ما يقولون وسبح بحمد ربك قبل طلوع الشمس وقبل غروبها
versets.phonetique: Fasabir 'ala ma yaqulun wa sabbih bihamdi rabbika qabla tuluu ash-shamsi wa qabla ghurubha
versets.francais: Sois donc patient devant ce qu'ils disent, et célèbre la louange de ton Seigneur avant le lever du soleil et avant son coucher.
versets.anglais: The Day they are dragged into the Fire on their faces [it will be said], "Taste the touch of Saqar

versets.arabe: ومن آناء الليل فسبح وأدبار السجود
versets.phonetique: Wa min anya al-layli fasabbih wa adbar as-sujud
versets.francais: Et une partie de la nuit, célèbre Sa louange, ainsi qu'après chaque prosternation.
versets.anglais: Indeed, all things We created with predestination

versets.arabe: واستمع يوم يناد المنادي من مكان قريب
versets.phonetique: Wa istami' yawma yunad al-munadi min makinin qarib
versets.francais: Et écoute le jour où le Crieur criera de tout près,
versets.anglais: And Our command is but one, like a glance of the eye

versets.arabe: يوم يخرجون من الأجداث سراعا كأنهم إلى نصب يوفضون
versets.phonetique: Yawma yakhrajun min al-ajdath sira'an ka'anna hum ila nasbin yufidu n
versets.francais: Le jour où ils sortiront des tombes en toute hâte, comme s'ils se précipitaient vers un but.
versets.anglais: And We have already destroyed your kinds, so is there any who will remember

versets.arabe: خاشعة أبصارهم يخرجون من الأجداث كأنهم جراد منتشر
versets.phonetique: Khashi'atun absaruhum yakhrajun min al-ajdath ka'anna hum jarad muntashir
versets.francais: Les regards abaissés, ils sortiront des tombes comme des sauterelles dispersées.
versets.anglais: And everything they did is in written records

versets.arabe: مهطعين إلى الداع يقول الكافرون هذا يوم عسر
versets.phonetique: Muhtati'in ila ad-da'i yaqulu al-kafiruna hadhà yawmu 'usr
versets.francais: Accourant vers l'Appelant, les mécréants diront : « Ceci est un jour difficile ».
versets.anglais: And every small and great [thing] is inscribed

versets.arabe: كم أهلكنا قبلهم من قرن فنادوا ولات حين مناص
versets.phonetique: Kam ahlakna qablahu m min qarni fanadu wa lat hina manas
versets.francais: Combien de générations avant eux avons-Nous détruites. Ils crièrent [pour obtenir du secours], mais ce n'était pas le moment du salut.
versets.anglais: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and rivers

versets.arabe: إن هذا تذكرة فمن شاء اتخذ إلى ربه سبيلا
versets.phonetique: Inna hadha tadhkiran faman sha'a ittakhadha ila rabbi hi sabila
versets.francais: Ceci est une admonition. Que quiconque veut emprunte vers son Seigneur un chemin.
versets.anglais: In a seat of honor near a Sovereign, Perfect in Ability

versets.arabe: الرَّحْمَٰنُ
versets.phonetique: Ar-rahmaan
versets.francais: Le Tout Miséricordieux
versets.anglais: The Most Merciful

versets.arabe: عَلَّمَ الْقُرْآنَ
versets.phonetique: 'Allamal-qur'aan
versets.francais: a enseigné le Coran
versets.anglais: Taught the Qur'an

versets.arabe: خَلَقَ الْإِنسَانَ
versets.phonetique: Khalaqal-insaan
versets.francais: Il a créé l'homme
versets.anglais: Created man

versets.arabe: عَلَّمَهُ الْبَيَانَ
versets.phonetique: 'Allamahul-bayaan
versets.francais: Il lui a appris la parole
versets.anglais: [And] taught him eloquence

versets.arabe: الشَّمْسُ وَالْقَمَرُ بِحُسْبَانٍ
versets.phonetique: Ash-shamsu wal-qamaru bihusban
versets.francais: Le soleil et la lune [suivent] un calcul précis
versets.anglais: The sun and the moon [move] by precise calculation

versets.arabe: وَالنَّجْمُ وَالشَّجَرُ يَسْجُدَانِ
versets.phonetique: Wan-najmu wash-shajaru yasjudaan
versets.francais: Et les plantes et les arbres se prosternent
versets.anglais: And the stars and trees prostrate

versets.arabe: وَالسَّمَاءَ رَفَعَهَا وَوَضَعَ الْمِيزَانَ
versets.phonetique: Wassama'a rafa'aha wa wada'al-meezaan
versets.francais: Et le ciel, Il l'a élevé et Il a établi la balance
versets.anglais: And the heaven He raised and imposed the balance

versets.arabe: أَلَّا تَطْغَوْا فِي الْمِيزَانِ
versets.phonetique: Allaa tatghaw fil-meezaan
versets.francais: afin que vous ne transgressiez pas la balance
versets.anglais: That you not transgress within the balance

versets.arabe: وَأَقِيمُوا الْوَزْنَ بِالْقِسْطِ وَلَا تُخْسِرُوا الْمِيزَانَ
versets.phonetique: Wa aqeemul-wazna bil-qisti wa laa tukhsirul-meezaan
versets.francais: Et acquittez-vous du pesage avec équité et ne lésez pas la balance
versets.anglais: And establish weight in justice and do not make deficient the balance

versets.arabe: وَالْأَرْضَ وَضَعَهَا لِلْأَنَامِ
versets.phonetique: Wal-arda wada'aha lil-anaam
versets.francais: Et la terre, Il l'a mise pour les créatures
versets.anglais: And the earth He laid [out] for the creatures

versets.arabe: فِيهَا فَاكِهَةٌ وَالنَّخْلُ ذَاتُ الْأَكْمَامِ
versets.phonetique: Feehaa faakihatun wan-nakhlu dhaatul-akmaam
versets.francais: Il y a des fruits et les palmiers aux spathes
versets.anglais: Therein is fruit and palm trees having sheaths [of dates]

versets.arabe: وَالْحَبُّ ذُو الْعَصْفِ وَالرَّيْحَانُ
versets.phonetique: Wal-habbu dhul-'asfi war-rayhaan
versets.francais: Et les grains dans leurs enveloppes et les plantes aromatiques
versets.anglais: And grain having husks and scented plants

versets.arabe: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
versets.phonetique: Fabi-ayyi aalaa'i rabbikumaa tukadhdhiban
versets.francais: Lequel donc des bienfaits de votre Seigneur nierez-vous ?
versets.anglais: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny

versets.arabe: خَلَقَ الْإِنسَانَ مِن صَلْصَالٍ كَالْفَخَّارِ
versets.phonetique: Khalaqal-insaana min salsaalin kal-fakhkhar
versets.francais: Il a créé l'homme d'une argile sèche comme la poterie
versets.anglais: He created man from clay like [that of] pottery

versets.arabe: وَخَلَقَ الْجَانَّ مِن مَّارِجٍ مِّن نَّارٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa khalaqal-jaanna mim-maarijim-min-naar
versets.francais: Et Il a créé le djinn d'une flamme de feu
versets.anglais: And He created the jinn from a smokeless flame of fire

versets.arabe: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
versets.phonetique: Fabi-ayyi aalaa'i rabbikumaa tukadhdhiban
versets.francais: Lequel donc des bienfaits de votre Seigneur nierez-vous ?
versets.anglais: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny

versets.arabe: رَبُّ الْمَشْرِقَيْنِ وَرَبُّ الْمَغْرِبَيْنِ
versets.phonetique: Rabbul-mashriqayni wa rabbul-maghribayan
versets.francais: Seigneur des deux Levants et Seigneur des deux Couchants
versets.anglais: [He is] Lord of the two sunrises and Lord of the two sunsets

versets.arabe: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
versets.phonetique: Fabi-ayyi aalaa'i rabbikumaa tukadhdhiban
versets.francais: Lequel donc des bienfaits de votre Seigneur nierez-vous ?
versets.anglais: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny

versets.arabe: مَرَجَ الْبَحْرَيْنِ يَلْتَقِيَانِ
versets.phonetique: Marajal-bahrayni yaltaqiyaan
versets.francais: Il a mis en contact les deux mers qui se rencontrent
versets.anglais: He released the two seas, meeting [side by side]

versets.arabe: بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخٌ لَّا يَبْغِيَانِ
versets.phonetique: Baynahumaa barzakhul-laa yabghiyaan
versets.francais: Entre elles est une barrière qu'elles ne franchissent pas
versets.anglais: Between them is a barrier [so] neither of them transgresses

versets.arabe: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
versets.phonetique: Fabi-ayyi aalaa'i rabbikumaa tukadhdhiban
versets.francais: Lequel donc des bienfaits de votre Seigneur nierez-vous ?
versets.anglais: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny

versets.arabe: يَخْرُجُ مِنْهُمَا اللُّؤْلُؤُ وَالْمَرْجَانُ
versets.phonetique: Yakhruju minhumal-lu'lu'u wal-marjaan
versets.francais: Il en sort des perles et du corail
versets.anglais: From both of them emerge pearl and coral

versets.arabe: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
versets.phonetique: Fabi-ayyi aalaa'i rabbikumaa tukadhdhiban
versets.francais: Lequel donc des bienfaits de votre Seigneur nierez-vous ?
versets.anglais: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny

versets.arabe: وَلَهُ الْجَوَارِ الْمُنشَآتُ فِي الْبَحْرِ كَالْأَعْلَامِ
versets.phonetique: Wa lahul-jawaril-munsha'aatu fil-bahri kal-a'laam
versets.francais: Et à Lui appartiennent les navires élevés sur la mer tels des montagnes
versets.anglais: And to Him belong the ships [with sails] elevated in the sea like mountains

versets.arabe: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
versets.phonetique: Fabi-ayyi aalaa'i rabbikumaa tukadhdhiban
versets.francais: Lequel donc des bienfaits de votre Seigneur nierez-vous ?
versets.anglais: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny

versets.arabe: كُلُّ مَنْ عَلَيْهَا فَانٍ
versets.phonetique: Kullu man 'alayhaa faan
versets.francais: Tout ce qui est sur elle est périssable
versets.anglais: Everyone upon the earth will perish

versets.arabe: وَيَبْقَىٰ وَجْهُ رَبِّكَ ذُو الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ
versets.phonetique: Wa yabqaa wajhu rabbika dhul-jalaali wal-ikraam
versets.francais: Et subsiste la Face de ton Seigneur, plein de Majesté et de Générosité
versets.anglais: And there will remain the Face of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor

versets.arabe: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
versets.phonetique: Fabi-ayyi aalaa'i rabbikumaa tukadhdhiban
versets.francais: Lequel donc des bienfaits de votre Seigneur nierez-vous ?
versets.anglais: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny

versets.arabe: يَسْأَلُهُ مَن فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۚ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ هُوَ فِي شَأْنٍ
versets.phonetique: Yas'aluhu man fis-samaawaati wal-ard, kulla yawmin huwa fee sha'n
versets.francais: Tout ce qui est dans les cieux et la terre Lui demande. Chaque jour Il est à l'œuvre
versets.anglais: Whoever is within the heavens and earth asks Him; every day He is bringing about a matter

versets.arabe: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
versets.phonetique: Fabi-ayyi aalaa'i rabbikumaa tukadhdhiban
versets.francais: Lequel donc des bienfaits de votre Seigneur nierez-vous ?
versets.anglais: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny

versets.arabe: سَنَفْرُغُ لَكُمْ أَيُّهَ الثَّقَلَانِ
versets.phonetique: Sanafraghu lakum ayyuhas-thaqalaan
versets.francais: Nous Nous occuperons de vous, ô vous les deux espèces !
versets.anglais: We will attend to you, O prominent beings

versets.arabe: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
versets.phonetique: Fabi-ayyi aalaa'i rabbikumaa tukadhdhiban
versets.francais: Lequel donc des bienfaits de votre Seigneur nierez-vous ?
versets.anglais: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny

versets.arabe: يَا مَعْشَرَ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنسِ إِنِ اسْتَطَعْتُمْ أَن تَنفُذُوا مِنْ أَقْطَارِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ فَانفُذُوا ۚ لَا تَنفُذُونَ إِلَّا بِسُلْطَانٍ
versets.phonetique: Yaa ma'sharal-jinni wal-insi inis-tata'tum an tanfudhoo min aqtaaris-samaawaati wal-ardi fanfudhoo, laa tanfudhoona illaa bisultaan
versets.francais: Ô assemblée des djinns et des hommes ! Si vous pouvez traverser les régions des cieux et de la terre, traversez ! Vous n'y passerez qu'avec une autorisation
versets.anglais: O company of jinn and mankind, if you are able to pass beyond the regions of the heavens and the earth, then pass. You will not pass except by authority [from Allah]

versets.arabe: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
versets.phonetique: Fabi-ayyi aalaa'i rabbikumaa tukadhdhiban
versets.francais: Lequel donc des bienfaits de votre Seigneur nierez-vous ?
versets.anglais: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny

versets.arabe: يُرْسَلُ عَلَيْكُمَا شُوَاظٌ مِّن نَّارٍ وَنُحَاسٌ فَلَا تَنتَصِرَانِ
versets.phonetique: Yursalu 'alaykumaa shuwaazum-min naariw-wa nuhaasun falaa tantasiraan
versets.francais: On enverra contre vous une flamme de feu et une fumée de cuivre, et vous ne pourrez pas vous défendre
versets.anglais: There will be sent upon you a flame of fire and smoke, and you will not defend yourselves

versets.arabe: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
versets.phonetique: Fabi-ayyi aalaa'i rabbikumaa tukadhdhiban
versets.francais: Lequel donc des bienfaits de votre Seigneur nierez-vous ?
versets.anglais: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny

versets.arabe: فَإِذَا انشَقَّتِ السَّمَاءُ فَكَانَتْ وَرْدَةً كَالدِّهَانِ
versets.phonetique: Fa-idhan-shaqqatis-samaa'u fakaanat wardatan kad-dihaan
versets.francais: Quand le ciel se fendra et sera rouge comme du cuir tanné
versets.anglais: And when the heaven is split open and becomes rose-colored like oil

versets.arabe: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
versets.phonetique: Fabi-ayyi aalaa'i rabbikumaa tukadhdhiban
versets.francais: Lequel donc des bienfaits de votre Seigneur nierez-vous ?
versets.anglais: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny

versets.arabe: فَيَوْمَئِذٍ لَّا يُسْأَلُ عَن ذَنبِهِ إِنسٌ وَلَا جَانٌّ
versets.phonetique: Fa-yawma'idhin laa yus'alu 'an dhambihee insun wa laa jaaann
versets.francais: Ce jour-là, il ne sera demandé à aucun homme ni aucun djinn compte de ses péchés
versets.anglais: Then on that Day none will be asked about his sin among men or jinn

versets.arabe: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
versets.phonetique: Fabi-ayyi aalaa'i rabbikumaa tukadhdhiban
versets.francais: Lequel donc des bienfaits de votre Seigneur nierez-vous ?
versets.anglais: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny

versets.arabe: يُعْرَفُ الْمُجْرِمُونَ بِسِيمَاهُمْ فَيُؤْخَذُ بِالنَّوَاصِي وَالْأَقْدَامِ
versets.phonetique: Yu'raful-mujrimoona biseemaahum fayu'khadhu bin-nawaasee wal-aqdaam
versets.francais: Les criminels seront reconnus à leurs traits, et on les saisira par les toupets et les pieds
versets.anglais: The criminals will be known by their marks, and they will be seized by the forelocks and the feet

versets.arabe: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
versets.phonetique: Fabi-ayyi aalaa'i rabbikumaa tukadhdhiban
versets.francais: Lequel donc des bienfaits de votre Seigneur nierez-vous ?
versets.anglais: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny

versets.arabe: هَٰذِهِ جَهَنَّمُ الَّتِي يُكَذِّبُ بِهَا الْمُجْرِمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Haadhihi jahannamu-llatee yukadhdhihu bihal-mujrimoon
versets.francais: Voilà la Géhenne que les criminels traitaient de mensonge
versets.anglais: This is Hell, which the criminals deny

versets.arabe: يَطُوفُونَ بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَ حَمِيمٍ آنٍ
versets.phonetique: Yatoofoona baynaha wa bayna hameemin aan
versets.francais: Ils iront et viendront entre elle et une eau bouillante
versets.anglais: They will go around between it and scalding water, heated [to the utmost degree]

versets.arabe: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
versets.phonetique: Fabi-ayyi aalaa'i rabbikumaa tukadhdhiban
versets.francais: Lequel donc des bienfaits de votre Seigneur nierez-vous ?
versets.anglais: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny

versets.arabe: وَلِمَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِ جَنَّتَانِ
versets.phonetique: Wa liman khaafa maqaama rabbihee jannataan
versets.francais: Pour celui qui a craint la station de son Seigneur, il y a deux jardins
versets.anglais: But for he who has feared the position of his Lord are two gardens

versets.arabe: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
versets.phonetique: Fabi-ayyi aalaa'i rabbikumaa tukadhdhiban
versets.francais: Lequel donc des bienfaits de votre Seigneur nierez-vous ?
versets.anglais: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny

versets.arabe: ذَوَاتَا أَفْنَانٍ
versets.phonetique: Dhawataaa afnaan
versets.francais: Tous deux aux multiples rameaux
versets.anglais: Having [spreading] branches

versets.arabe: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
versets.phonetique: Fabi-ayyi aalaa'i rabbikumaa tukadhdhiban
versets.francais: Lequel donc des bienfaits de votre Seigneur nierez-vous ?
versets.anglais: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny

versets.arabe: فِيهِمَا عَيْنَانِ تَجْرِيَانِ
versets.phonetique: Feehimaa 'aynaani tajriyaan
versets.francais: En eux deux coulent deux sources
versets.anglais: In both of them are two springs, flowing

versets.arabe: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
versets.phonetique: Fabi-ayyi aalaa'i rabbikumaa tukadhdhiban
versets.francais: Lequel donc des bienfaits de votre Seigneur nierez-vous ?
versets.anglais: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny

versets.arabe: فِيهِمَا مِن كُلِّ فَاكِهَةٍ زَوْجَانِ
versets.phonetique: Feehimaa min kulli faakihatin zawjaan
versets.francais: En eux deux, de chaque fruit il y a deux espèces
versets.anglais: In both of them are of every fruit, two kinds

versets.arabe: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
versets.phonetique: Fabi-ayyi aalaa'i rabbikumaa tukadhdhiban
versets.francais: Lequel donc des bienfaits de votre Seigneur nierez-vous ?
versets.anglais: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny

versets.arabe: مُتَّكِئِينَ عَلَىٰ فُرُشٍ بَطَائِنُهَا مِنْ إِسْتَبْرَقٍ ۚ وَجَنَى الْجَنَّتَيْنِ دَانٍ
versets.phonetique: Muttaki'eena 'alaa furushim bataaa'inuhaa min istabraq, wa janal-jannataini daan
versets.francais: Ils s'y appuieront sur des tapis dont la doublure est de brocart ; les fruits des deux jardins seront à portée de main
versets.anglais: [They are] reclining on beds whose linings are of silk brocade, and the fruit of the two gardens is hanging low

versets.arabe: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
versets.phonetique: Fabi-ayyi aalaa'i rabbikumaa tukadhdhiban
versets.francais: Lequel donc des bienfaits de votre Seigneur nierez-vous ?
versets.anglais: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny

versets.arabe: فِيهِنَّ قَاصِرَاتُ الطَّرْفِ لَمْ يَطْمِثْهُنَّ إِنسٌ قَبْلَهُمْ وَلَا جَانٌّ
versets.phonetique: Feehinna qaasiraatut-tarfi lam yatmithhunna insun qablahum wa laa jaaann
versets.francais: En elles [se trouvent] des [vierges] aux regards pudiques qu'aucun homme ni aucun djinn n'a touchées avant eux
versets.anglais: In them are women limiting [their] glances, untouched before them by man or jinni

versets.arabe: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
versets.phonetique: Fabi-ayyi aalaa'i rabbikumaa tukadhdhiban
versets.francais: Lequel donc des bienfaits de votre Seigneur nierez-vous ?
versets.anglais: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny

versets.arabe: كَأَنَّهُنَّ الْيَاقُوتُ وَالْمَرْجَانُ
versets.phonetique: Ka'annahunnal-yaaqootu wal-marjaan
versets.francais: Elles sont comme des rubis et du corail
versets.anglais: As if they were rubies and coral

versets.arabe: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
versets.phonetique: Fabi-ayyi aalaa'i rabbikumaa tukadhdhiban
versets.francais: Lequel donc des bienfaits de votre Seigneur nierez-vous ?
versets.anglais: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny

versets.arabe: هَلْ جَزَاءُ الْإِحْسَانِ إِلَّا الْإِحْسَانُ
versets.phonetique: Hal jazaa'ul-ihsaani illal-ihsaan
versets.francais: La récompense du bien n'est-elle pas le bien ?
versets.anglais: Is the reward for good [anything] but good

versets.arabe: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
versets.phonetique: Fabi-ayyi aalaa'i rabbikumaa tukadhdhiban
versets.francais: Lequel donc des bienfaits de votre Seigneur nierez-vous ?
versets.anglais: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny

versets.arabe: وَمِن دُونِهِمَا جَنَّتَانِ
versets.phonetique: Wa min doonihimaa jannataan
versets.francais: Et en dehors de ces deux, il y a encore deux jardins
versets.anglais: And below them both [in excellence] are two [other] gardens

versets.arabe: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
versets.phonetique: Fabi-ayyi aalaa'i rabbikumaa tukadhdhiban
versets.francais: Lequel donc des bienfaits de votre Seigneur nierez-vous ?
versets.anglais: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny

versets.arabe: مُدْهَامَّتَانِ
versets.phonetique: Mud-haammataan
versets.francais: D'un vert sombre
versets.anglais: Dark green [in color]

versets.arabe: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
versets.phonetique: Fabi-ayyi aalaa'i rabbikumaa tukadhdhiban
versets.francais: Lequel donc des bienfaits de votre Seigneur nierez-vous ?
versets.anglais: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny

versets.arabe: فِيهِمَا عَيْنَانِ نَضَّاخَتَانِ
versets.phonetique: Feehimaa 'aynaani naddaakhataan
versets.francais: En eux deux jaillissent deux sources
versets.anglais: In both of them are two springs, spouting

versets.arabe: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
versets.phonetique: Fabi-ayyi aalaa'i rabbikumaa tukadhdhiban
versets.francais: Lequel donc des bienfaits de votre Seigneur nierez-vous ?
versets.anglais: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny

versets.arabe: فِيهِمَا فَاكِهَةٌ وَنَخْلٌ وَرُمَّانٌ
versets.phonetique: Feehimaa faakihatun wa nakhlun wa rummaan
versets.francais: En eux deux il y a des fruits, des palmiers et des grenadiers
versets.anglais: In both of them are fruit and palm trees and pomegranates

versets.arabe: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
versets.phonetique: Fabi-ayyi aalaa'i rabbikumaa tukadhdhiban
versets.francais: Lequel donc des bienfaits de votre Seigneur nierez-vous ?
versets.anglais: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny

versets.arabe: فِيهِنَّ خَيْرَاتٌ حِسَانٌ
versets.phonetique: Feehinna khayraatun hisaan
versets.francais: En eux [se trouvent] des [épouses] bonnes et belles
versets.anglais: In them are good and beautiful women

versets.arabe: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
versets.phonetique: Fabi-ayyi aalaa'i rabbikumaa tukadhdhiban
versets.francais: Lequel donc des bienfaits de votre Seigneur nierez-vous ?
versets.anglais: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny

versets.arabe: حُورٌ مَّقْصُورَاتٌ فِي الْخِيَامِ
versets.phonetique: Hoorun maqsooraatun fil-khiyaam
versets.francais: Des houris retirées dans des tentes
versets.anglais: Fair ones reserved in pavilions

versets.arabe: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
versets.phonetique: Fabi-ayyi aalaa'i rabbikumaa tukadhdhiban
versets.francais: Lequel donc des bienfaits de votre Seigneur nierez-vous ?
versets.anglais: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny

versets.arabe: لَمْ يَطْمِثْهُنَّ إِنسٌ قَبْلَهُمْ وَلَا جَانٌّ
versets.phonetique: Lam yatmithhunna insun qablahum wa laa jaaann
versets.francais: Qu'aucun homme ni djinn n'a touchées avant eux
versets.anglais: Untouched before them by man or jinni

versets.arabe: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
versets.phonetique: Fabi-ayyi aalaa'i rabbikumaa tukadhdhiban
versets.francais: Lequel donc des bienfaits de votre Seigneur nierez-vous ?
versets.anglais: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny

versets.arabe: مُتَّكِئِينَ عَلَىٰ رَفْرَفٍ خُضْرٍ وَعَبْقَرِيٍّ حِسَانٍ
versets.phonetique: Muttaki'eena 'alaa rafrafin khudriw-wa 'abqariyyin hisaan
versets.francais: Appuyés sur des coussins verts et de beaux tapis
versets.anglais: Reclining on green cushions and beautiful fine carpets

versets.arabe: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
versets.phonetique: Fabi-ayyi aalaa'i rabbikumaa tukadhdhiban
versets.francais: Lequel donc des bienfaits de votre Seigneur nierez-vous ?
versets.anglais: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny

versets.arabe: تَبَارَكَ اسْمُ رَبِّكَ ذِي الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ
versets.phonetique: Tabaarakas-mu rabbika dhil-jalaali wal-ikraam
versets.francais: Béni soit le Nom de ton Seigneur, le Majestueux et le Très Généreux
versets.anglais: Blessed is the name of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor

versets.arabe: إذا وقعت الواقعة
versets.phonetique: Idha waqa'at al-waqiah
versets.francais: Quand l'Événement inéluctable aura lieu,
versets.anglais: When the Occurrence occurs

versets.arabe: ليس لوقعتها كاذبة
versets.phonetique: Laysa li-waqiah kadhbah
versets.francais: nul ne niera son occurrence.
versets.anglais: There is, at its occurrence, no denial

versets.arabe: خافضة رافعة
versets.phonetique: Khafidah rafi'ah
versets.francais: Elle abaissera [les uns] et élèvera [les autres].
versets.anglais: It will bring down [some] and raise up [others]

versets.arabe: إذا رجت الأرض رجا
versets.phonetique: Idha rujjat al-ardh rajjah
versets.francais: Quand la terre tremblera d'une secousse saccadée,
versets.anglais: When the earth is shaken with convulsion

versets.arabe: وبست الجبال بسا
versets.phonetique: Wa bussat al-jibal bassa
versets.francais: et les montagnes seront réduites en poussière,
versets.anglais: And the mountains are broken down, crumbling

versets.arabe: فكانت هباء منبثا
versets.phonetique: Fa-kanat haba'an munbaththa
versets.francais: et deviendront comme de la poussière dispersée,
versets.anglais: And become dust dispersing

versets.arabe: وكنتم أزواجا ثلاثة
versets.phonetique: Wa kuntum azwajan thallathah
versets.francais: et vous serez en trois groupes:
versets.anglais: And you become [of] three kinds

versets.arabe: فأصحاب الميمنة ما أصحاب الميمنة
versets.phonetique: Fa-ashab al-maymana ma ashab al-maymana
versets.francais: les gens de la droite - que sont les gens de la droite?
versets.anglais: Then the companions of the right - what are the companions of the right

versets.arabe: وأصحاب المشأمة ما أصحاب المشأمة
versets.phonetique: Wa ashab al-masha'ama ma ashab al-masha'ama
versets.francais: et les gens de la gauche - que sont les gens de la gauche?
versets.anglais: And the companions of the left - what are the companions of the left

versets.arabe: والسابقون السابقون
versets.phonetique: Wa as-sabiqun as-sabiqun
versets.francais: et les plus rapprochés - ce sont les plus rapprochés!
versets.anglais: And the forerunners, the forerunners

versets.arabe: أولئك المقربون
versets.phonetique: Ula'ika al-muqarrabun
versets.francais: Ce sont ceux qui seront les plus rapprochés
versets.anglais: Those are the ones brought near [to Allah]

versets.arabe: في جنات النعيم
versets.phonetique: Fi janati al-na'im
versets.francais: dans les Jardins de délices,
versets.anglais: In the Gardens of Pleasure

versets.arabe: ثلة من الأولين
versets.phonetique: Thulaah min al-awwalin
versets.francais: une multitude parmi les anciens
versets.anglais: A [large] company of the former peoples

versets.arabe: وقليل من الآخرين
versets.phonetique: Wa qalil min al-akhirin
versets.francais: et une petite multitude parmi les derniers.
versets.anglais: And a few of the later peoples

versets.arabe: على سرر موضونة
versets.phonetique: Alaa surur mawdhunah
versets.francais: sur des lits ornés,
versets.anglais: On thrones woven [with ornament]

versets.arabe: متكئين عليها متقابلين
versets.phonetique: Muttaki'in alayha mutaqabilin
versets.francais: face à face, allongés sur eux.
versets.anglais: Reclining on them, facing each other

versets.arabe: يطوف عليهم ولدان مخلدون
versets.phonetique: Yatuf alayhi-m wildanan mukhalladan
versets.francais: Des jeunes gens immortels circuleront parmi eux,
versets.anglais: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal

versets.arabe: بأكواب وأباريق وكأس من معين
versets.phonetique: Bi-akwab wa abariq wa ka's min ma'in
versets.francais: avec des coupes, des aiguières et un verre rempli d'une boisson délicieuse;
versets.anglais: With vessels, pitchers and a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring

versets.arabe: لا يصدعون عنها ولا ينزفون
versets.phonetique: La yasda'un anha wa la yunzifun
versets.francais: ils ne souffriront ni mal de tête ni ivresse;
versets.anglais: No headache will they have therefrom, nor will they be intoxicated

versets.arabe: وفاكهة مما يختارون
versets.phonetique: Wa fakihah mimma yakhtar-un
versets.francais: et des fruits au choix des habitants,
versets.anglais: And fruit of what they select

versets.arabe: ولحم طير مما يشتهون
versets.phonetique: Wa lahm tayr mimma yashtahun
versets.francais: et la chair de volaille qu'ils désireront.
versets.anglais: And the meat of fowl, from whatever they desire

versets.arabe: وحور عين
versets.phonetique: Wa hur 'ayn
versets.francais: Et [auprès d'eux seront] des houris aux yeux noirs,
versets.anglais: And [for them are] fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes

versets.arabe: كأمثال اللؤلؤ المكنون
versets.phonetique: Ka-amthal al-lu'lu' al-maknun
versets.francais: pareilles à des perles précieuses bien conservées.
versets.anglais: The likenesses of pearls well-protected

versets.arabe: جزاء بما كانوا يعملون
versets.phonetique: Jaza'an bi-ma kanu ya'malun
versets.francais: C'est une récompense pour ce qu'ils faisaient.
versets.anglais: As reward for what they used to do

versets.arabe: لا يسمعون فيها لغوا ولا تأثيما
versets.phonetique: La yasma'un fiha laghwan wa la ta'thiman
versets.francais: Ils n'y entendront ni vaine parole, ni appels au péché,
versets.anglais: They will not hear therein ill speech or commission of sin

versets.arabe: إلا قيلا سلاما سلاما
versets.phonetique: Illa qilan salaman salama
versets.francais: mais seulement le salut: 'Paix! Paix!'
versets.anglais: Only a saying: "Peace, peace

versets.arabe: وأصحاب اليمين ما أصحاب اليمين
versets.phonetique: Wa ashab al-yamayn ma ashab al-yamayn
versets.francais: Et les gens de la droite - qu'ils sont heureux, les gens de la droite!
versets.anglais: The companions of the right - what are the companions of the right

versets.arabe: في سدرة المنتهى
versets.phonetique: Fi sidrat al-muntaha
versets.francais: [Ils sont] au milieu de lotus sans épines,
versets.anglais: [They will be] among lote trees with thorns removed

versets.arabe: عند جنة المأوى
versets.phonetique: Inda jannat al-ma'wa
versets.francais: près d'un Jardin de refuge,
versets.anglais: And [banana] trees layered [with fruit]

versets.arabe: مع أصحاب الميمنة
versets.phonetique: Ma'a ashab al-maymana
versets.francais: parmi les gens de la droite.
versets.anglais: And shade extended

versets.arabe: ثلة من الأولين
versets.phonetique: Thulaah min al-awwalin
versets.francais: Une multitude parmi les anciens
versets.anglais: And water poured out

versets.arabe: وثلة من الآخرين
versets.phonetique: Wa thulaah min al-akhirin
versets.francais: et une multitude parmi les derniers.
versets.anglais: And fruit, abundant [and varied]

versets.arabe: وأصحاب الشمال ما أصحاب الشمال
versets.phonetique: Wa ashab ash-shimal ma ashab ash-shimal
versets.francais: Et les gens de la gauche - qu'ils sont malheureux, les gens de la gauche!
versets.anglais: Neither limited [to season] nor forbidden

versets.arabe: في سموم وحميم
versets.phonetique: Fi sumum wa hamim
versets.francais: [Ils seront] dans un vent brûlant et une eau bouillante,
versets.anglais: And [upon] beds raised high

versets.arabe: وظل من يقطين
versets.phonetique: Wa dhil min yaqtin
versets.francais: et l'ombre d'une fumée noire,
versets.anglais: Indeed, We have produced the women of Paradise in a [new] creation

versets.arabe: لا بارد ولا كريم
versets.phonetique: La barid wa la karim
versets.francais: ni froide ni agréable.
versets.anglais: And made them virgins

versets.arabe: إنهم كانوا قبل ذلك مترفين
versets.phonetique: Innahum kanu qabl dhalik mutrfin
versets.francais: Avant cela, ils jouissaient des délices,
versets.anglais: Devoted [to their husbands] and of equal age

versets.arabe: وكانوا يصرون على الحنث العظيم
versets.phonetique: Wa kanu yasirrun alaa al-hanath al-'adhim
versets.francais: et persistaient dans le grand péché.
versets.anglais: For the companions of the right [who are]

versets.arabe: وكانوا يقولون أئذا مت وكنت ترابا وعظاما أئنا لمبعوثون
versets.phonetique: Wa kanu yaqulun a-idha mit wa kuntu turaban wa adhaman a-inna lamabu'thun
versets.francais: Et ils disaient: 'Après notre mort, serons-nous ressuscités,
versets.anglais: A company of the former peoples

versets.arabe: أو آباؤنا الأولون
versets.phonetique: Aw aba'una al-awwalun
versets.francais: nous et nos ancêtres?'
versets.anglais: And a company of the later peoples

versets.arabe: قل إن الأولين والآخرين
versets.phonetique: Qul inn al-awwalin wa al-akhirin
versets.francais: Dis: 'Certes, les anciens et les derniers,
versets.anglais: And the companions of the left - what are the companions of the left

versets.arabe: لمجموعون إلى ميقات يوم معلوم
versets.phonetique: La-majmu'un ila miqat yawm ma'lum
versets.francais: seront rassemblés au Jour du Jugement fixé.'
versets.anglais: [They will be] in scorching fire and scalding water

versets.arabe: ثم إنكم أيها الضالون المكذبون
versets.phonetique: Thumma inna-kum ayyuha adh-dhalun al-mukadhdhbun
versets.francais: Ensuite, vous qui vous êtes égarés et aviez nié,
versets.anglais: And a shade of black smoke

versets.arabe: لآكلون من شجر من زقوم
versets.phonetique: La-aklun min shajar min zaqum
versets.francais: vous mangerez certainement de l'arbre de Zaqqum,
versets.anglais: Neither cool nor beneficial

versets.arabe: فمالئون منها البطون
versets.phonetique: Fa-maliun minha al-butun
versets.francais: vous en remplirez vos ventres,
versets.anglais: Indeed they were, before that, indulging in affluence

versets.arabe: وشاربون عليه من الحميم
versets.phonetique: Wa sharibun alayhi min al-hamim
versets.francais: puis vous boirez par-dessus une eau brûlante,
versets.anglais: And they used to persist in the great violation

versets.arabe: وشاربون شرب الهيم
versets.phonetique: Wa sharibun sharb al-him
versets.francais: et vous boirez comme les chameaux assoiffés.
versets.anglais: And they used to say, "When we die and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected

versets.arabe: هذا نزلهم يوم الدين
versets.phonetique: Hadha nuzuluhum yawm ad-din
versets.francais: Telle sera leur nourriture au Jour du Jugement.
versets.anglais: And our forefathers [as well]

versets.arabe: نحن خلقناكم فلولا تصدقون
versets.phonetique: Nahnu khalaqnakum fa-lawla tasaddiqun
versets.francais: Nous vous avons créés. Pourquoi ne le confirmez-vous donc pas?
versets.anglais: Say, [O Muhammad], "Indeed, the former and the later peoples

versets.arabe: أفرأيتم ما تمنون
versets.phonetique: Afara'aytum ma tamnun
versets.francais: Avez-vous vu ce que vous émetez,
versets.anglais: Are to be gathered together for the appointment of a known Day

versets.arabe: أأنتم تخلقونه أم نحن الخالقون
versets.phonetique: A-antum takhluqun-uh am nahnu al-khaliqun
versets.francais: le créez-vous ou le créons-Nous?
versets.anglais: Then indeed you, O those astray [who are] deniers

versets.arabe: نحن قدرنا بينكم الموت وما نحن بمسبوقين
versets.phonetique: Nahnu qaddarna baynaakum al-mawt wa ma nahnu bi-masbiqin
versets.francais: Nous avons décrété la mort parmi vous, et nul ne peut Nous devancer,
versets.anglais: Will be eating from trees of zaqqum

versets.arabe: على أن نبدل أمثالكم وننشئكم في ما لا تعلمون
versets.phonetique: Alaa an nubaddil amthalakum wa nunshi'akum fi ma la ta'lamun
versets.francais: ni que Nous soyons impuissants à vous remplacer par vos semblables, ni à vous ressusciter dans une forme que vous ne connaissez pas.
versets.anglais: And filling with it your bellies

versets.arabe: ولقد علمتم النشأة الأولى فلولا تذكرون
versets.phonetique: Wa laqad alimtum an-nasha'ah al-ula fa-lawla tadhkiarun
versets.francais: Vous avez certes connu la première création. Pourquoi ne vous rappelez-vous donc pas?
versets.anglais: And drinking on top of it from scalding water

versets.arabe: أفرأيتم ما تحرثون
versets.phonetique: Afara'aytum ma tahrutun
versets.francais: Avez-vous vu ce que vous semez?
versets.anglais: And will drink as the drinking of thirsty camels

versets.arabe: أأنتم تنبتونه أم نحن المنبتون
versets.phonetique: A-antum tunbitun-uh am nahnu al-munbitun
versets.francais: Est-ce vous qui le faites croître, ou est-ce Nous qui le faisons croître?
versets.anglais: That is their accommodation on the Day of Recompense

versets.arabe: لو نشاء لجعلناه حطاما فظلتم تفكهون
versets.phonetique: Law nasha' la-ja'alnah hutaman fa-dhallitum tafakahun
versets.francais: Si Nous voulions, Nous en ferions du foin desséché, et vous resteriez confus à le regarder,
versets.anglais: We have created you, so why do you not believe

versets.arabe: إنا لمغرمون
versets.phonetique: Inna lamaghrumun
versets.francais: en disant: 'Nous sommes endettés!
versets.anglais: Have you seen that which you emit

versets.arabe: بل نحن محرومون
versets.phonetique: Bal nahnu mahrumun
versets.francais: Non, nous sommes privés.'
versets.anglais: Is it you who creates it, or are We the Creator

versets.arabe: أفرأيتم الماء الذي تشربون
versets.phonetique: Afara'aytum al-ma'a alladhee tashabun
versets.francais: Avez-vous vu l'eau que vous buvez?
versets.anglais: We have decreed death among you, and We are not to be outdone

versets.arabe: أأنتم أنزلتموه من المزن أم نحن المنزلون
versets.phonetique: A-antum anzaltumuh min al-muzn am nahnu al-munzilun
versets.francais: Est-ce vous qui la faites descendre du nuage, ou est-ce Nous qui la faisons descendre?
versets.anglais: In that We will change your likenesses and produce you in that [form] which you do not know

versets.arabe: لو نشاء جعلناه أجاجا فلولا تشكرون
versets.phonetique: Law nasha' ja'alnah ujajan fa-lawla tashkarun
versets.francais: Si Nous voulions, Nous la rendrions salée. Pourquoi ne remercierez-vous donc pas?
versets.anglais: And you have already known the first creation, so will you not remember

versets.arabe: أفرأيتم النار التي تورون
versets.phonetique: Afara'aytum an-nar allatee tawarun
versets.francais: Avez-vous vu le feu que vous allumez?
versets.anglais: And have you seen that [seed] which you sow

versets.arabe: أأنتم أنشأتم شجرتها أم نحن المنشئون
versets.phonetique: A-antum ansha'tum shajarataha am nahnu al-munshi'un
versets.francais: Est-ce vous qui avez créé l'arbre qui le produit, ou est-ce Nous qui l'avons créé?
versets.anglais: Is it you who makes it grow, or are We the grower

versets.arabe: نحن جعلناها تذكرة ومتاعا للمقوين
versets.phonetique: Nahnu ja'alnah tadhkirah wa mata'an li-al-muqwin
versets.francais: Nous en avons fait un rappel et un profit pour les voyageurs.
versets.anglais: If We willed, We could make it [dry] debris, and you would remain in wonder

versets.arabe: فسبح باسم ربك العظيم
versets.phonetique: Fa-sabbih bi-ism rabbik al-'adhim
versets.francais: Glorifie donc le nom de ton Seigneur, le Grand.
versets.anglais: [Saying], "Indeed, we are [now] in debt

versets.arabe: فلا أقسم بمواقع النجوم
versets.phonetique: Fa-la aqsim bi-mawaqih an-nujum
versets.francais: Non! Je le jure par les positions des étoiles,
versets.anglais: Rather, we have been deprived

versets.arabe: وإنه لقسم لو تعلمون عظيم
versets.phonetique: Wa innah laqasam law ta'lamun 'adhim
versets.francais: et c'est certes un serment bien grand, si vous le saviez,
versets.anglais: And have you seen the water that you drink

versets.arabe: إنه لقرآن كريم
versets.phonetique: Innah la-qur'an karim
versets.francais: que c'est un Coran noble,
versets.anglais: Is it you who brought it down from the clouds, or is it We who bring it down

versets.arabe: في كتاب مكنون
versets.phonetique: Fi kitab maknun
versets.francais: conservé dans un Livre préservé
versets.anglais: If We willed, We could make it bitter, so why are you not grateful

versets.arabe: لا يمسه إلا المطهرون
versets.phonetique: La yamasuh illa al-mutahharun
versets.francais: que seuls les purifiés touchent.
versets.anglais: And have you seen the fire that you ignite

versets.arabe: تنزيل من رب العالمين
versets.phonetique: Tanzil min rabb al-'alamin
versets.francais: C'est une révélation du Seigneur de l'univers.
versets.anglais: Is it you who produced its tree, or are We the producer

versets.arabe: أفبهذا الحديث أنتم مدهنون
versets.phonetique: Af-bi-hadha al-hadith antum mudhnun
versets.francais: Allez-vous rejeter ce Récit?
versets.anglais: We have made it a reminder and provision for the travelers

versets.arabe: وتجعلون رزقكم أنكم تكذبون
versets.phonetique: Wa taj'alun rizqakum annakum tukadhdhbun
versets.francais: Et faire de votre part un gain en le traiter de mensonge?
versets.anglais: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great

versets.arabe: فلولا إذا بلغت الحلقوم
versets.phonetique: Fa-lawla idha balaghat al-hulqum
versets.francais: Pourquoi donc, lorsque l'âme atteindra la gorge,
versets.anglais: Then I swear by the setting of the stars

versets.arabe: وأنتم حينئذ تنظرون
versets.phonetique: Wa antum hina'idhin tandhirun
versets.francais: alors que vous regardez,
versets.anglais: And indeed, it is an oath - if you could know - [most] great

versets.arabe: ونحن أقرب إليه منكم ولكن لا تبصرون
versets.phonetique: Wa nahnu aqrab ilayhi minkum wa lakin la tubsirun
versets.francais: et que Nous, Nous sommes plus près de lui que vous, bien que vous ne nous voyiez pas,
versets.anglais: Indeed, it is a noble Qur'an

versets.arabe: فلولا إن كنتم غير مدينين
versets.phonetique: Fa-lawla in kuntum ghayra muddinin
versets.francais: pourquoi donc, si vous ne serez pas jugés,
versets.anglais: In a Register well-protected

versets.arabe: ترجعونها إن كنتم صادقين
versets.phonetique: Tarji'unaha in kuntum sadiqin
versets.francais: ne la ramèneriez-vous pas, si vous étiez véridiques?
versets.anglais: None touch it except the purified

versets.arabe: فأما إن كان من المقربين
versets.phonetique: Fa-amma in kan min al-muqarrabin
versets.francais: Et si le mourant était parmi les rapprochés,
versets.anglais: [It is] a revelation from the Lord of the worlds

versets.arabe: فروح وريحان وجنة نعيم
versets.phonetique: Fa-rauh wa rayhan wa jannat na'im
versets.francais: il y aura pour lui repos, aisance et Jardin de délices.
versets.anglais: Then is it to this statement that you are indifferent

versets.arabe: وأما إن كان من أصحاب اليمين
versets.phonetique: Wa amma in kan min ashab al-yamayn
versets.francais: Et si c'était l'un des gens de la droite,
versets.anglais: And make [the thanks for] your provision that you deny [the Provider]

versets.arabe: فسلام لك من أصحاب اليمين
versets.phonetique: Fa-salam laka min ashab al-yamayn
versets.francais: il y aura pour lui un salut du côté des gens de la droite.
versets.anglais: Then why, when the soul at death reaches the throat

versets.arabe: وأما إن كان من المكذبين الضالين
versets.phonetique: Wa amma in kan min al-mukadhdhbin adh-dhallin
versets.francais: Et si c'était l'un des négateurs, des égarés,
versets.anglais: And you are at that time looking on

versets.arabe: فنزل من حميم
versets.phonetique: Fa-nuzul min hamim
versets.francais: il y aura pour lui une réception avec de l'eau bouillante,
versets.anglais: And Our angels are nearer to him than you, but you do not see

versets.arabe: وتصلية جحيم
versets.phonetique: Wa tasiyyat jahim
versets.francais: et un châtiment dans le Feu.
versets.anglais: Then why do you not, if you are not to be recompensed

versets.arabe: إن هذا لهو حق اليقين
versets.phonetique: Inna hadha la-huwa haq al-yaqin
versets.francais: Ceci est certainement la vérité absolue.
versets.anglais: Bring it back, if you should be truthful

versets.arabe: فسبح باسم ربك العظيم
versets.phonetique: Fa-sabbih bi-ism rabbik al-'adhim
versets.francais: Glorifie donc le nom de ton Seigneur, le Grand.
versets.anglais: And if the deceased was of those brought near to Allah

versets.arabe: فلا أقسم بمواقع النجوم
versets.phonetique: Fa-la aqsim bi-mawaqih an-nujum
versets.francais: Je le jure par les positions des étoiles,
versets.anglais: Then [for him is] rest and bounty and a garden of pleasure

versets.arabe: وإنه لقسم لو تعلمون عظيم
versets.phonetique: Wa innah laqasam law ta'lamun 'adhim
versets.francais: et c'est un serment bien grand, si vous le saviez,
versets.anglais: And if he was of the companions of the right

versets.arabe: إنه لقرآن كريم
versets.phonetique: Innah la-qur'an karim
versets.francais: que c'est un Coran noble,
versets.anglais: Then [the angels will say], "Peace for you; [you are] from the companions of the right

versets.arabe: في كتاب مكنون
versets.phonetique: Fi kitab maknun
versets.francais: conservé dans un Livre préservé
versets.anglais: But if he was of the deniers [who were] astray

versets.arabe: لا يمسه إلا المطهرون
versets.phonetique: La yamasuh illa al-mutahharun
versets.francais: que seuls les purifiés touchent.
versets.anglais: Then [for him is] accommodation of scalding water

versets.arabe: تنزيل من رب العالمين
versets.phonetique: Tanzil min rabb al-'alamin
versets.francais: C'est une révélation du Seigneur de l'univers.
versets.anglais: And burning in Hellfire

versets.arabe: أفبهذا الحديث أنتم مدهنون
versets.phonetique: Af-bi-hadha al-hadith antum mudhnun
versets.francais: Allez-vous rejeter ce Récit?
versets.anglais: Indeed, this is the true certainty

versets.arabe: وتجعلون رزقكم أنكم تكذبون
versets.phonetique: Wa taj'alun rizqakum annakum tukadhdhbun
versets.francais: Et faire de votre part un gain en le traiter de mensonge?
versets.anglais: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great

versets.arabe: سَبَّحَ لِلَّهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ
versets.phonetique: Sabbaha lillahi ma fi s-samawati wa l-ardi wa huwa l-azizu l-hakim
versets.francais: Tout ce qui est dans les cieux et la terre glorifie Allah. Il est le Puissant, le Sage
versets.anglais: Whatever is in the heavens and earth exalts Allah, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise

versets.arabe: لَهُ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
versets.phonetique: Lahu mulku s-samawati wa l-ardi yuhyi wa yumitu wa huwa ala kulli shay-in qadir
versets.francais: À Lui appartient le royaume des cieux et de la terre. Il donne la vie et donne la mort. Il est Omnipotent
versets.anglais: His is the dominion of the heavens and earth. He gives life and causes death, and He is over all things competent

versets.arabe: هُوَ الْأَوَّلُ وَالْآخِرُ وَالظَّاهِرُ وَالْبَاطِنُ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Huwa l-awwalu wa l-akhiru wa z-zahiru wa l-batinu wa huwa bikulli shay-in alim
versets.francais: Il est le Premier et le Dernier, l-Apparent et le Caché. Il est Omniscient
versets.anglais: He is the First and the Last, the Ascendant and the Intimate, and He is, of all things, Knowing

versets.arabe: هُوَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ اسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى الْعَرْشِ يَعْلَمُ مَا يَلِجُ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَمَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا
versets.phonetique: Huwa lladhi khalaqa s-samawati wa l-arda fi sittati ayyamin thumma stawa ala l-arshi ya-lamu ma yaliju fi l-ardi wa ma yakhruju minha
versets.francais: Il est Celui qui a créé les cieux et la terre en six jours puis S-est établi sur le Trône. Il sait ce qui pénètre dans la terre et ce qui en sort
versets.anglais: It is He who created the heavens and earth in six days and then established Himself above the Throne. He knows what penetrates into the earth and what emerges from it and what descends from the heaven and what ascends therein; and He is with you wherever you are. And Allah, of what you do, is Seeing

versets.arabe: لَهُ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَإِلَى اللَّهِ تُرْجَعُ الْأُمُورُ
versets.phonetique: Lahu mulku s-samawati wa l-ardi wa ila l-lahi turja-u l-umur
versets.francais: À Lui appartient le royaume des cieux et de la terre, et c-est vers Allah que toutes choses retournent
versets.anglais: His is the dominion of the heavens and earth. And to Allah are returned [all] matters

versets.arabe: يُولِجُ اللَّيْلَ فِي النَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ النَّهَارَ فِي اللَّيْلِ وَهُوَ عَلِيمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ
versets.phonetique: Yuliju l-layla fi n-nahari wa yuliju n-nahara fi l-layli wa huwa alimun bidhati s-sudur
versets.francais: Il fait pénétrer la nuit dans le jour et le jour dans la nuit. Il connaît bien le contenu des poitrines
versets.anglais: He causes the night to enter the day and causes the day to enter the night, and he is Knowing of that within the breasts

versets.arabe: آمِنُوا بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَأَنفِقُوا مِمَّا جَعَلَكُم مُّسْتَخْلَفِينَ فِيهِ
versets.phonetique: Aminu billahi wa rasulihi wa anfiquu mimma ja-alakum mustakhlafina fih
versets.francais: Croyez en Allah et en Son messager et dépensez de ce dont Il vous a faits héritiers
versets.anglais: Believe in Allah and His Messenger and spend out of that in which He has made you successors. For those who have believed among you and spent, there will be a great reward

versets.arabe: وَمَا لَكُمْ لَا تُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللَّهِ وَالرَّسُولُ يَدْعُوكُمْ لِتُؤْمِنُوا بِرَبِّكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Wa ma lakum la tu-minuna billahi wa r-rasulu yad-ukum litu-minu birabbikum
versets.francais: Pourquoi ne croyez-vous pas en Allah alors que le messager vous invite à croire en votre Seigneur
versets.anglais: And why do you not believe in Allah while the Messenger invites you to believe in your Lord and He has taken your covenant, if you should [truly] be believers

versets.arabe: هُوَ الَّذِي يُنَزِّلُ عَلَىٰ عَبْدِهِ آيَاتٍ بَيِّنَاتٍ لِّيُخْرِجَكُم مِّنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النُّورِ
versets.phonetique: Huwa lladhi yunazzilu ala abdihi ayatin bayyinatin liyukhrijjakum mina z-zulumati ila n-nur
versets.francais: C-est Lui qui fait descendre sur Son serviteur des signes clairs pour vous faire sortir des ténèbres vers la lumière
versets.anglais: It is He who sends down upon His Servant [Muhammad] verses of clear evidence that He may bring you out from darknesses into the light. And indeed, Allah is to you Kind and Merciful

versets.arabe: وَمَا لَكُمْ أَلَّا تُنفِقُوا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَلِلَّهِ مِيرَاثُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ
versets.phonetique: Wa ma lakum alla tunfiqu fi sabili l-lahi wa lillahi mirathu s-samawati wa l-ard
versets.francais: Pourquoi ne dépensez-vous pas dans le chemin d-Allah ? À Allah appartient l-héritage des cieux et de la terre
versets.anglais: And why do you not spend in the cause of Allah while to Allah belongs the heritage of the heavens and the earth? Not equal among you are those who spent before the conquest [of Makkah] and fought [and those who did so after it]. Those are greater in degree than they who spent afterwards and fought. But to all Allah has promised the best [reward]. And Allah, with what you do, is Acquainted

versets.arabe: مَّن ذَا الَّذِي يُقْرِضُ اللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا فَيُضَاعِفَهُ لَهُ وَلَهُ أَجْرٌ كَرِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Man dha lladhi yuqridu l-laha qardan hasanan fayuda-ifahu lahu wa lahu ajrun karim
versets.francais: Qui est-ce qui prêtera à Allah un beau prêt pour qu-Il le lui multiplie ? Il aura une généreuse récompense
versets.anglais: Who is it that would loan Allah a goodly loan so He will multiply it for him and he will have a noble reward

versets.arabe: يَوْمَ تَرَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ يَسْعَىٰ نُورُهُم بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَبِأَيْمَانِهِم
versets.phonetique: Yawma tara l-mu-minina wa l-mu-minati yas-a nuruhum bayna aydihim wa bi-aymanihim
versets.francais: Le jour où tu verras les croyants et les croyantes, leur lumière courant devant eux et à leur droite
versets.anglais: On the Day you see the believing men and believing women, their light proceeding before them and on their right, [it will be said], "Your good tidings today are [of] gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein you will abide eternally." That is what is the great attainment

versets.arabe: يَوْمَ يَقُولُ الْمُنَافِقُونَ وَالْمُنَافِقَاتُ لِلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا انظُرُونَا نَقْتَبِسْ مِن نُّورِكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Yawma yaqulu l-munafiquna wa l-munafiqatu lilladhina amanu nzuruna naqtabis min nurikum
versets.francais: Le jour où les hypocrites diront aux croyants : Attendez-nous pour que nous prenions de votre lumière
versets.anglais: On the [same] Day the hypocrite men and hypocrite women will say to those who believed, "Wait for us that we may acquire some of your light." It will be said, "Go back behind you and seek light." And a wall will be placed between them with a door, its interior containing mercy, but on the outside of it is torment

versets.arabe: يُنَادُونَهُمْ أَلَمْ نَكُن مَّعَكُمْ قَالُوا بَلَىٰ وَلَٰكِنَّكُمْ فَتَنتُمْ أَنفُسَكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Yunaduhum alam nakun ma-akum qalu bala wa lakinnakum fatantum anfusakum
versets.francais: Ils les appelleront : N-étions-nous pas avec vous ? Ils diront : Si, mais vous vous êtes mis vous-mêmes à l-épreuve
versets.anglais: The hypocrites will call to the believers, "Were we not with you?" They will say, "Yes, but you afflicted yourselves and awaited [misfortune for us] and doubted, and wishful thinking deluded you until there came the command of Allah. And the Deceiver deceived you concerning Allah

versets.arabe: فَالْيَوْمَ لَا يُؤْخَذُ مِنكُمْ فِدْيَةٌ وَلَا مِنَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مَأْوَاكُمُ النَّارُ هِيَ مَوْلَاكُمْ وَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيرُ
versets.phonetique: Fal-yawma la yu-khadhu minkum fidyatun wa la mina lladhina kafaru ma-wakumu n-naru hiya mawlakum wa bi-sa l-masir
versets.francais: Aujourd-hui, on n-acceptera de vous aucune rançon, ni de ceux qui ont mécru. Votre refuge est le Feu. Quelle mauvaise destination
versets.anglais: So today no ransom will be taken from you or from those who disbelieved. Your refuge is the Fire. It is most worthy of you, and wretched is the destination

versets.arabe: أَلَمْ يَأْنِ لِلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا أَن تَخْشَعَ قُلُوبُهُمْ لِذِكْرِ اللَّهِ وَمَا نَزَلَ مِنَ الْحَقِّ
versets.phonetique: Alam ya-ni lilladhina amanu an takhsha-a qulubuhum lidhikri l-lahi wa ma nazzala mina l-haqq
versets.francais: N-est-il pas temps pour les croyants que leurs coeurs s-humilient au souvenir d-Allah et à la vérité qu-Il a fait descendre
versets.anglais: Has the time not come for those who have believed that their hearts should become humbly submissive at the remembrance of Allah and what has come down of the truth? And let them not be like those who were given the Scripture before, and a long period passed over them, so their hearts hardened; and many of them are defiantly disobedient

versets.arabe: اعْلَمُوا أَنَّ اللَّهَ يُحْيِي الْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا قَدْ بَيَّنَّا لَكُمُ الْآيَاتِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
versets.phonetique: I-lamu anna l-laha yuhyi l-arda ba-da mawtiha qad bayyanna lakumu l-ayati la-allakum ta-qilun
versets.francais: Sachez qu-Allah revivifie la terre après sa mort. Nous vous avons clairement expliqué les signes pour que vous raisonniez
versets.anglais: Know that Allah gives life to the earth after its lifelessness. We have made clear to you the signs; perhaps you will understand

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الْمُصَّدِّقِينَ وَالْمُصَّدِّقَاتِ وَأَقْرَضُوا اللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا يُضَاعَفُ لَهُمْ وَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ كَرِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Inna l-mussaddiqina wa l-mussaddiqati wa aqradu l-laha qardan hasanan yuda-afu lahum wa lahum ajrun karim
versets.francais: Les hommes et femmes qui font l-aumône et prêtent à Allah un beau prêt, cela leur sera multiplié et ils auront une généreuse récompense
versets.anglais: Indeed, the men who practice charity and the women who practice charity and [they who] have loaned Allah a goodly loan - it will be multiplied for them, and they will have a noble reward

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا بِاللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِ أُولَٰئِكَ هُمُ الصِّدِّيقُونَ وَالشُّهَدَاءُ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ
versets.phonetique: Wa lladhina amanu billahi wa rusulihi ula-ika humu s-siddiquna wa sh-shuhadau inda rabbihim
versets.francais: Ceux qui croient en Allah et en Ses messagers, ce sont eux les véridiques et les martyrs auprès de leur Seigneur
versets.anglais: And those who have believed in Allah and His messengers - those are [in the ranks of] the supporters of truth and the martyrs, with their Lord. For them is their reward and their light. But those who have disbelieved and denied Our verses - those are the companions of Hellfire

versets.arabe: اعْلَمُوا أَنَّمَا الْحَيَاةُ الدُّنْيَا لَعِبٌ وَلَهْوٌ وَزِينَةٌ وَتَفَاخُرٌ بَيْنَكُمْ وَتَكَاثُرٌ فِي الْأَمْوَالِ وَالْأَوْلَادِ
versets.phonetique: I-lamu annama l-hayatu d-dunya la-ibun wa lahwun wa zinatun wa tafakhurun baynakum wa takathrun fi l-amwali wa l-awlad
versets.francais: Sachez que la vie présente n-est que jeu, amusement, parure, vantardise entre vous et rivalité dans les richesses et les enfants
versets.anglais: Know that the life of this world is but amusement and diversion and adornment and boasting to one another and competition in increase of wealth and children - like the example of a rain whose [resulting] plant growth pleases the tillers; then it dries and you see it turned yellow; then it becomes [scattered] debris. And in the Hereafter is severe punishment and forgiveness from Allah and approval. And what is the worldly life except the enjoyment of delusion

versets.arabe: سَابِقُوا إِلَىٰ مَغْفِرَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ وَجَنَّةٍ عَرْضُهَا كَعَرْضِ السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ
versets.phonetique: Sabiqu ila maghfiratin min rabbikum wa jannatin arduha ka-ardi s-sama-i wa l-ard
versets.francais: Concourez vers un pardon de votre Seigneur et un Paradis aussi large que le ciel et la terre
versets.anglais: Race toward forgiveness from your Lord and a Garden whose width is like the width of the heavens and earth, prepared for those who believed in Allah and His messengers. That is the bounty of Allah which He gives to whom He wills, and Allah is the possessor of great bounty

versets.arabe: مَا أَصَابَ مِن مُّصِيبَةٍ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي أَنفُسِكُمْ إِلَّا فِي كِتَابٍ مِّن قَبْلِ أَن نَّبْرَأَهَا
versets.phonetique: Ma asaba min musibatin fi l-ardi wa la fi anfusikum illa fi kitabin min qabli an nabra-aha
versets.francais: Toute calamité qui survient sur la terre ou en vous-mêmes était déjà inscrite dans un Livre avant que Nous la créions
versets.anglais: No disaster strikes upon the earth or among yourselves except that it is in a register before We bring it into being - indeed that, for Allah, is easy

versets.arabe: لِّكَيْلَا تَأْسَوْا عَلَىٰ مَا فَاتَكُمْ وَلَا تَفْرَحُوا بِمَا آتَاكُمْ وَاللَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ مُخْتَالٍ فَخُورٍ
versets.phonetique: Likayla ta-saw ala ma fatakum wa la tafraahu bima atakum wa l-lahu la yuhibbu kulla mukhtalin fakhur
versets.francais: Afin que vous ne vous affligiez pas de ce qui vous échappe et ne vous réjouissiez pas outre mesure de ce qu-Il vous donne. Allah n-aime pas le vantard orgueilleux
versets.anglais: In order that you not despair over what has eluded you and not exult [in pride] over what He has given you. And Allah does not like everyone self-deluded and boastful

versets.arabe: الَّذِينَ يَبْخَلُونَ وَيَأْمُرُونَ النَّاسَ بِالْبُخْلِ وَمَن يَتَوَلَّ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْغَنِيُّ الْحَمِيدُ
versets.phonetique: Alladhina yabkhaluna wa ya-muruna n-nasa bil-bukhli wa man yatawalla fa-inna l-laha huwa l-ghaniyu l-hamid
versets.francais: Ceux qui sont avares et ordonnent aux gens d-être avares. Quiconque se détourne, Allah Se suffit à Lui-même et Il est Le Louable
versets.anglais: [Those] who are stingy and enjoin upon people stinginess. And whoever turns away - then indeed, Allah is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy

versets.arabe: لَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلَنَا بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ وَأَنزَلْنَا مَعَهُمُ الْكِتَابَ وَالْمِيزَانَ لِيَقُومَ النَّاسُ بِالْقِسْطِ وَأَنزَلْنَا الْحَدِيدَ
versets.phonetique: Laqad arsalna rusulana bil-bayyinati wa anzalna ma-ahumu l-kitaba wa l-mizana liyaquma n-nasu bil-qisti wa anzalna l-hadid
versets.francais: Nous avons envoyé Nos messagers avec des preuves claires et fait descendre avec eux le Livre et la Balance afin que les hommes pratiquent la justice. Et Nous avons fait descendre le fer
versets.anglais: We have already sent Our messengers with clear evidences and sent down with them the Scripture and the balance that the people may maintain [their affairs] in justice. And We sent down iron, wherein is great military might and benefits for the people, and so that Allah may make evident those who support Him and His messengers unseen. Indeed, Allah is Powerful and Exalted in Might

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا وَإِبْرَاهِيمَ وَجَعَلْنَا فِي ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا النُّبُوَّةَ وَالْكِتَابَ
versets.phonetique: Wa laqad arsalna nuhan wa ibrahima wa ja-alna fi dhurriyyatihima n-nubuwwata wa l-kitab
versets.francais: Nous avons envoyé Noé et Abraham et Nous avons établi dans leur descendance la prophétie et le Livre
versets.anglais: And We have already sent Noah and Abraham and placed in their descendants prophethood and scripture; and among them is he who is guided, but many of them are defiantly disobedient

versets.arabe: ثُمَّ قَفَّيْنَا عَلَىٰ آثَارِهِم بِرُسُلِنَا وَقَفَّيْنَا بِعِيسَى ابْنِ مَرْيَمَ وَآتَيْنَاهُ الْإِنجِيلَ
versets.phonetique: Thumma qaffayna ala atharihim birusulina wa qaffayna bi-isa bni maryama wa ataynahu l-injil
versets.francais: Puis Nous avons fait succéder à leur suite Nos messagers et avons fait suivre Jésus fils de Marie et lui avons donné l-Évangile
versets.anglais: Then We sent following their footsteps Our messengers and followed [them] with Jesus, the son of Mary, and gave him the Gospel. And We placed in the hearts of those who followed him compassion and mercy and monasticism, which they innovated; We did not prescribe it for them except [that they did so] seeking the approval of Allah. But they did not observe it with due observance. So We gave the ones who believed among them their reward, but many of them are defiantly disobedient

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَآمِنُوا بِرَسُولِهِ يُؤْتِكُمْ كِفْلَيْنِ مِن رَّحْمَتِهِ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ نُورًا تَمْشُونَ بِهِ
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuha lladhina amanu ttaqu l-laha wa aminu birasulhi yu-tikum kiflayni min rahmatihi wa yaj-al lakum nuran tamshuna bih
versets.francais: O croyants ! Craignez Allah et croyez en Son messager. Il vous accordera une double part de Sa miséricorde et vous donnera une lumière à laquelle vous marcherez
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, fear Allah and believe in His Messenger; He will [then] give you a double portion of His mercy and make for you a light by which you will walk and forgive you; and Allah is Forgiving and Merciful

versets.arabe: لِّئَلَّا يَعْلَمَ أَهْلُ الْكِتَابِ أَلَّا يَقْدِرُونَ عَلَىٰ شَيْءٍ مِّن فَضْلِ اللَّهِ وَأَنَّ الْفَضْلَ بِيَدِ اللَّهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَن يَشَاءُ
versets.phonetique: Li-alla ya-lama ahlu l-kitabi alla yaqdiruna ala shay-in min fadli l-lahi wa anna l-fadla biyaddi l-lahi yu-tihi man yasha-
versets.francais: Afin que les Gens du Livre sachent qu-ils n-ont aucun pouvoir sur la grâce d-Allah et que la grâce est entre les mains d-Allah, qu-Il accorde à qui Il veut
versets.anglais: [This is] so that the People of the Scripture may know that they are not able [to obtain] anything from the bounty of Allah and that [all] bounty is in the hand of Allah; He gives it to whom He wills. And Allah is the possessor of great bounty

versets.arabe: قَدْ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ قَوْلَ الَّتِي تُجَادِلُكَ فِي زَوْجِهَا وَتَشْتَكِي إِلَى اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ يَسْمَعُ تَحَاوُرَكُمَا
versets.phonetique: Qad sami-a l-lahu qawla llati tujadiluka fi zawjiha wa tashtaki ila l-lahi wa l-lahu yasma-u tahawurakuma
versets.francais: Allah a certes entendu les paroles de celle qui discutait avec toi au sujet de son mari et se plaignait à Allah. Allah entendait votre discussion
versets.anglais: Certainly has Allah heard the speech of the one who argues with you, [O Muhammad], concerning her husband and directs her complaint to Allah. And Allah hears your dialogue; indeed, Allah is Hearing and Seeing

versets.arabe: الَّذِينَ يُظَاهِرُونَ مِنكُم مِّن نِّسَائِهِم مَّا هُنَّ أُمَّهَاتِهِمْ إِنْ أُمَّهَاتُهُمْ إِلَّا اللَّائِي وَلَدْنَهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Alladhina yuzahiruna minkum min nisa-ihim ma hunna ummahatihim in ummahatuhum illa l-la-i waladnahum
versets.francais: Ceux d-entre vous qui répudient leurs femmes par zihar : elles ne sont pas leurs mères. Leurs mères ne sont que celles qui les ont enfantés
versets.anglais: Those who pronounce thihar among you [to separate] from their wives - they are not [consequently] their mothers. Their mothers are none but those who gave birth to them. And indeed, they are saying an objectionable statement and a falsehood. But indeed, Allah is Pardoning and Forgiving

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ يُظَاهِرُونَ مِن نِّسَائِهِمْ ثُمَّ يَعُودُونَ لِمَا قَالُوا فَتَحْرِيرُ رَقَبَةٍ مِّن قَبْلِ أَن يَتَمَاسَّا
versets.phonetique: Wa lladhina yuzahiruna min nisa-ihim thumma ya-uduna lima qalu fatariru raqabatin min qabli an yatamassa
versets.francais: Ceux qui répudient leurs femmes par zihar puis reviennent sur ce qu-ils ont dit doivent affranchir un esclave avant de se toucher
versets.anglais: And those who pronounce thihar from their wives and then [wish to] go back on what they said - then [there must be] the freeing of a slave before they touch one another. That is what you are admonished thereby; and Allah is Acquainted with what you do

versets.arabe: فَمَن لَّمْ يَجِدْ فَصِيَامُ شَهْرَيْنِ مُتَتَابِعَيْنِ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَتَمَاسَّا فَمَن لَّمْ يَسْتَطِعْ فَإِطْعَامُ سِتِّينَ مِسْكِينًا
versets.phonetique: Faman lam yajid fasiyamu shahrayni mutatabbi-ayni min qabli an yatamassa faman lam yastati- fa-it-amu sittina miskina
versets.francais: Celui qui n-en trouve pas jeûnera deux mois consécutifs avant de se toucher. Celui qui ne peut pas nourrira soixante pauvres
versets.anglais: And he who does not find [a slave] - then a fast for two months consecutively before they touch one another; and he who is unable - then the feeding of sixty poor persons. That is for you to believe [completely] in Allah and His Messenger; and those are the limits [set by] Allah. And for the disbelievers is a painful punishment

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُحَادُّونَ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ كُبِتُوا كَمَا كُبِتَ الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ
versets.phonetique: Inna lladhina yuhaddduna l-laha wa rasulahu kubitu kama kubita lladhina min qablihim
versets.francais: Ceux qui s-opposent à Allah et à Son messager seront humiliés comme l-ont été ceux d-avant eux
versets.anglais: Indeed, those who oppose Allah and His Messenger are abased as those before them were abased. And We have certainly sent down verses of clear evidence. And for the disbelievers is a humiliating punishment

versets.arabe: يَوْمَ يَبْعَثُهُمُ اللَّهُ جَمِيعًا فَيُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا عَمِلُوا أَحْصَاهُ اللَّهُ وَنَسُوهُ
versets.phonetique: Yawma yab-athuhumu l-lahu jami-an fayunabbiuhum bima amilu ahsahu l-lahu wa nasuh
versets.francais: Le jour où Allah les ressuscitera tous et les informera de ce qu-ils ont fait. Allah l-a comptabilisé alors qu-ils l-ont oublié
versets.anglais: On the Day when Allah will resurrect them all and inform them of what they did. Allah had enumerated it, while they forgot it; and Allah is, over all things, Witness

versets.arabe: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ مَا يَكُونُ مِن نَّجْوَىٰ ثَلَاثَةٍ إِلَّا هُوَ رَابِعُهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Alam tara anna l-laha ya-lamu ma fi s-samawati wa ma fi l-ardi ma yakunu min najwa thalathatin illa huwa rabi-uhum
versets.francais: N-as-tu pas vu qu-Allah sait ce qui est dans les cieux et la terre ? Jamais il n-y a de conversation secrète entre trois personnes sans qu-Il soit leur quatrième
versets.anglais: Have you not considered that Allah knows what is in the heavens and what is on the earth? There is in no private conversation three but that He is the fourth of them, nor are there five but that He is the sixth of them - and no less than that and no more except that He is with them [in knowledge] wherever they are. Then He will inform them of what they did, on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed Allah is, of all things, Knowing

versets.arabe: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى الَّذِينَ نُهُوا عَنِ النَّجْوَىٰ ثُمَّ يَعُودُونَ لِمَا نُهُوا عَنْهُ وَيَتَنَاجَوْنَ بِالْإِثْمِ وَالْعُدْوَانِ
versets.phonetique: Alam tara ila lladhina nuhu ani n-najwa thumma ya-uduna lima nuhu anhu wa yatanajawna bil-ithmi wa l-udwan
versets.francais: N-as-tu pas vu ceux à qui on a interdit les conciliabules secrets, puis qui y reviennent et se chuchotent péché et transgression
versets.anglais: Have you not considered those who were forbidden from private conversation, then they return to that which they were forbidden and converse among themselves about sin and aggression and disobedience to the Messenger? And when they come to you, they greet you with that [word] by which Allah does not greet you and say among themselves, "Why does Allah not punish us for what we say?" Sufficient for them is Hell, which they will [enter to] burn, and wretched is the destination

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِذَا تَنَاجَيْتُمْ فَلَا تَتَنَاجَوْا بِالْإِثْمِ وَالْعُدْوَانِ وَمَعْصِيَتِ الرَّسُولِ
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuha lladhina amanu idha tanajaytu fala tatanajaw bil-ithmi wa l-udwani wa ma-siyati r-rasul
versets.francais: O croyants ! Quand vous vous chuchotez des secrets, ne vous chuchotez pas péché, transgression et désobéissance au messager
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, when you converse privately, do not converse about sin and aggression and disobedience to the Messenger but converse about righteousness and piety. And fear Allah, to whom you will be gathered

versets.arabe: إِنَّمَا النَّجْوَىٰ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ لِيَحْزُنَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَلَيْسَ بِضَارِّهِمْ شَيْئًا إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ
versets.phonetique: Innama n-najwa mina sh-shaytani liyahzuna lladhina amanu wa laysa bidarrihim shay-an illa bi-idhni l-lah
versets.francais: Les conciliabules secrets viennent du diable pour attrister les croyants. Mais il ne peut leur nuire en rien sans la permission d-Allah
versets.anglais: Private conversation is only from Satan that he may grieve those who have believed, but he will not harm them at all except by permission of Allah. And upon Allah let the believers rely

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِذَا قِيلَ لَكُمْ تَفَسَّحُوا فِي الْمَجَالِسِ فَافْسَحُوا يَفْسَحِ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuha lladhina amanu idha qila lakum tafassahu fi l-majalist fafsahu yafsahi l-lahu lakum
versets.francais: O croyants ! Quand on vous dit de faire de la place dans les assemblées, faites-en. Allah vous fera de la place
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, when you are told, "Space yourselves" in assemblies, then make space; Allah will make space for you. And when you are told, "Arise," then arise; Allah will raise those who have believed among you and those who were given knowledge, by degrees. And Allah is Acquainted with what you do

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِذَا نَاجَيْتُمُ الرَّسُولَ فَقَدِّمُوا بَيْنَ يَدَيْ نَجْوَاكُمْ صَدَقَةً
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuha lladhina amanu idha najaytu r-rasula faqaddimu bayna yaday najwakum sadaqata
versets.francais: O croyants ! Quand vous voulez avoir un entretien privé avec le messager, faites précéder votre entretien d-une aumône
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, when you [wish to] privately consult the Messenger, present before your consultation a charity. That is better for you and purer. But if you find not [the means] - then indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful

versets.arabe: أَأَشْفَقْتُمْ أَن تُقَدِّمُوا بَيْنَ يَدَيْ نَجْوَاكُمْ صَدَقَاتٍ فَإِذْ لَمْ تَفْعَلُوا وَتَابَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْكُمْ فَأَقِيمُوا الصَّلَاةَ وَآتُوا الزَّكَاةَ
versets.phonetique: A-ashfaqtum an tuqaddimu bayna yaday najwakum sadaqatin fa-idh lam taf-alu wa taba l-lahu alaykum fa-aqimu s-salata wa atu z-zakat
versets.francais: Avez-vous craint de faire précéder votre entretien d-aumônes ? Puisque vous ne l-avez pas fait et qu-Allah vous a pardonné, accomplissez la prière et acquittez la zakat
versets.anglais: Have you feared to present before your consultation charities? Then when you do not and Allah has forgiven you, then [at least] establish prayer and give zakah and obey Allah and His Messenger. And Allah is Acquainted with what you do

versets.arabe: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى الَّذِينَ تَوَلَّوْا قَوْمًا غَضِبَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِم مَّا هُم مِّنكُمْ وَلَا مِنْهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Alam tara ila lladhina tawallow qawman ghadiba l-lahu alayhim ma hum minkum wa la minhum
versets.francais: N-as-tu pas vu ceux qui se sont alliés à un peuple contre lequel Allah est en colère ? Ils ne sont ni des vôtres ni des leurs
versets.anglais: Have you not considered those who make allies of a people with whom Allah has become angry? They are neither of you nor of them, and they swear to untruth while they know [they are lying]

versets.arabe: أَعَدَّ اللَّهُ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا شَدِيدًا إِنَّهُمْ سَاءَ مَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: A-adda l-lahu lahum adhaban shadida innahum sa-a ma kanu ya-malun
versets.francais: Allah leur a préparé un châtiment sévère. Comme est mauvais ce qu-ils faisaient
versets.anglais: Allah has prepared for them a severe punishment. Indeed, it was evil that they were doing

versets.arabe: اتَّخَذُوا أَيْمَانَهُمْ جُنَّةً فَصَدُّوا عَن سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مُّهِينٌ
versets.phonetique: Ttakhadhu aymanahum junnatan fasaddu an sabili l-lahi falahum adhabun muhin
versets.francais: Ils ont pris leurs serments comme bouclier et ont détourné du chemin d-Allah. Ils auront un châtiment humiliant
versets.anglais: They took their [false] oaths as a cover, so they averted [people] from the way of Allah, and for them is a humiliating punishment

versets.arabe: لَّن تُغْنِيَ عَنْهُمْ أَمْوَالُهُمْ وَلَا أَوْلَادُهُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا أُولَٰئِكَ أَصْحَابُ النَّارِ هُمْ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ
versets.phonetique: Lan tughniya anhum amwaluhum wa la awladuhum mina l-lahi shay-an ula-ika ashabu n-nari hum fiha khalidun
versets.francais: Leurs biens et leurs enfants ne leur seront d-aucune utilité contre Allah. Ce sont les gens du Feu où ils demeureront éternellement
