versets.anglais: Never will their wealth or their children avail them against Allah at all. Those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally

versets.arabe: يَوْمَ يَبْعَثُهُمُ اللَّهُ جَمِيعًا فَيَحْلِفُونَ لَهُ كَمَا يَحْلِفُونَ لَكُمْ وَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّهُمْ عَلَىٰ شَيْءٍ أَلَا إِنَّهُمْ هُمُ الْكَاذِبُونَ
versets.phonetique: Yawma yab-athuhumu l-lahu jami-an fayahlifuna lahu kama yahlifuna lakum wa yahsabuna annahum ala shay-in ala innahum humu l-kadhibun
versets.francais: Le jour où Allah les ressuscitera tous, ils lui jureront comme ils vous jurent et penseront être sur quelque chose. Ils sont certes des menteurs
versets.anglais: On the Day Allah will resurrect them all, and they will swear to Him as they swear to you and think that they are [standing] on something. Unquestionably, it is they who are the liars

versets.arabe: اسْتَحْوَذَ عَلَيْهِمُ الشَّيْطَانُ فَأَنسَاهُمْ ذِكْرَ اللَّهِ أُولَٰئِكَ حِزْبُ الشَّيْطَانِ أَلَا إِنَّ حِزْبَ الشَّيْطَانِ هُمُ الْخَاسِرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Stahwadha alayhimu sh-shaytanu fa-ansahum dhikra l-lahi ula-ika hizbu sh-shaytani ala inna hizba sh-shaytani humu l-khasirun
versets.francais: Le diable a pris possession d-eux et leur a fait oublier le souvenir d-Allah. Ce sont les partisans du diable. Sachez que les partisans du diable sont les perdants
versets.anglais: Satan has overcome them and made them forget the remembrance of Allah. Those are the party of Satan. Unquestionably, the party of Satan - they will be the losers

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُحَادُّونَ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ أُولَٰئِكَ فِي الْأَذَلِّينَ
versets.phonetique: Inna lladhina yuhaddduna l-laha wa rasulahu ula-ika fi l-adhallin
versets.francais: Ceux qui s-opposent à Allah et à Son messager sont parmi les plus humiliés
versets.anglais: Indeed, the ones who oppose Allah and His Messenger - those will be among the most humbled

versets.arabe: كَتَبَ اللَّهُ لَأَغْلِبَنَّ أَنَا وَرُسُلِي إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَوِيٌّ عَزِيزٌ
versets.phonetique: Kataba l-lahu la-aghlibanna ana wa rusuli inna l-laha qawiyyun aziz
versets.francais: Allah a décrété : C-est Moi et Mes messagers qui l-emporterons. Allah est Fort et Puissant
versets.anglais: Allah has written, "I will surely overcome, I and My messengers." Indeed, Allah is Powerful and Exalted in Might

versets.arabe: لَا تَجِدُ قَوْمًا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ يُوَادُّونَ مَنْ حَادَّ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَلَوْ كَانُوا آبَاءَهُمْ
versets.phonetique: La tajidu qawman yu-minuna billahi wa l-yawmi l-akhiri yuwadduna man hadda l-laha wa rasulahu wa law kanu aba-ahum
versets.francais: Tu ne trouveras pas de gens qui croient en Allah et au Jour dernier se liant d-amitié avec ceux qui s-opposent à Allah et à Son messager, même si ce sont leurs pères
versets.anglais: You will not find a people who believe in Allah and the Last Day having affection for those who oppose Allah and His Messenger, even if they were their fathers or their sons or their brothers or their kindred. Those - He has decreed within their hearts faith and supported them with spirit from Him. And We will admit them to gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein they abide eternally. Allah is pleased with them, and they are pleased with Him - those are the party of Allah. Unquestionably, the party of Allah - they are the successful

versets.arabe: سَبَّحَ لِلَّهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ
versets.phonetique: Sabbaha lillahi ma fi s-samawati wa ma fi l-ardi wa huwa l-azizu l-hakim
versets.francais: Tout ce qui est dans les cieux et tout ce qui est sur la terre glorifie Allah. Il est le Puissant, le Sage
versets.anglais: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth exalts Allah, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise

versets.arabe: هُوَ الَّذِي أَخْرَجَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ مِن دِيَارِهِمْ لِأَوَّلِ الْحَشْرِ
versets.phonetique: Huwa lladhi akhraja lladhina kafaru min ahli l-kitabi min diyarihim li-awwali l-hashr
versets.francais: C-est Lui qui a expulsé de leurs demeures, lors du premier rassemblement, les mécréants parmi les Gens du Livre
versets.anglais: It is He who expelled the ones who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture from their homes at the first gathering. You did not think they would leave, and they thought that their fortresses would protect them from Allah; but [the decree of] Allah came upon them from where they had not expected, and He cast terror into their hearts [so] they destroyed their houses by their [own] hands and the hands of the believers. So take warning, O people of vision

versets.arabe: وَلَوْلَا أَن كَتَبَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمُ الْجَلَاءَ لَعَذَّبَهُمْ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَلَهُمْ فِي الْآخِرَةِ عَذَابُ النَّارِ
versets.phonetique: Wa lawla an kataba l-lahu alayhimu l-jala-a la-adhdhabahum fi d-dunya wa lahum fi l-akhirati adhabu n-nar
versets.francais: Si Allah n-avait pas décrété pour eux l-exil, Il les aurait châtiés dans ce monde. Et dans l-au-delà, ils auront le châtiment du Feu
versets.anglais: And if not that Allah had decreed for them evacuation, He would have punished them in [this] world, and for them in the Hereafter is the punishment of the Fire

versets.arabe: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ شَاقُّوا اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَمَن يُشَاقِّ اللَّهَ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ شَدِيدُ الْعِقَابِ
versets.phonetique: Dhalika bi-annahum shaqqqu l-laha wa rasulahu wa man yushaqqi l-laha fa-inna l-laha shadidu l-iqab
versets.francais: Cela parce qu-ils ont combattu Allah et Son messager. Quiconque combat Allah, Allah est sévère dans le châtiment
versets.anglais: That is because they opposed Allah and His Messenger. And whoever opposes Allah - then indeed, Allah is severe in penalty

versets.arabe: مَا قَطَعْتُم مِّن لِّينَةٍ أَوْ تَرَكْتُمُوهَا قَائِمَةً عَلَىٰ أُصُولِهَا فَبِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ
versets.phonetique: Ma qata-tum min linatin aw taraktumuwha qa-imatan ala usultiha fabi-idhni l-lah
versets.francais: Les palmiers que vous avez abattus ou laissés debout sur leurs racines, c-était avec la permission d-Allah
versets.anglais: Whatever you have cut down of [their] palm trees or left standing on their trunks - it was by permission of Allah and so He would disgrace the defiantly disobedient

versets.arabe: وَمَا أَفَاءَ اللَّهُ عَلَىٰ رَسُولِهِ مِنْهُمْ فَمَا أَوْجَفْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ خَيْلٍ وَلَا رِكَابٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa ma afa-a l-lahu ala rasulihi minhum fama awjaftum alayhi min khaylin wa la rikab
versets.francais: Ce qu-Allah a accordé en butin à Son messager de leur part, vous n-avez fourni pour cela ni chevaux ni chameaux
versets.anglais: And what Allah restored [of property] to His Messenger from them - you did not spur for it [in an expedition] any horses or camels, but Allah gives His messengers power over whom He wills, and Allah is over all things competent

versets.arabe: مَّا أَفَاءَ اللَّهُ عَلَىٰ رَسُولِهِ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْقُرَىٰ فَلِلَّهِ وَلِلرَّسُولِ وَلِذِي الْقُرْبَىٰ وَالْيَتَامَىٰ وَالْمَسَاكِينِ وَابْنِ السَّبِيلِ
versets.phonetique: Ma afa-a l-lahu ala rasulihi min ahli l-qura falillahi wa lir-rasuli wa lidhil-qurba wa l-yatama wa l-masakini wa bni s-sabil
versets.francais: Ce qu-Allah accorde à Son messager comme butin des gens des cités appartient à Allah, au messager, aux proches parents, aux orphelins, aux pauvres et au voyageur
versets.anglais: And what Allah restored to His Messenger from the people of the towns - it is for Allah and for the Messenger and for [his] near relatives and orphans and the [stranded] traveler - so that it will not be a perpetual distribution among the rich from among you. And whatever the Messenger has given you - take; and what he has forbidden you - refrain from. And fear Allah; indeed, Allah is severe in penalty

versets.arabe: لِلْفُقَرَاءِ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ الَّذِينَ أُخْرِجُوا مِن دِيَارِهِمْ وَأَمْوَالِهِمْ يَبْتَغُونَ فَضْلًا مِّنَ اللَّهِ وَرِضْوَانًا
versets.phonetique: Lil-fuqara-i l-muhajirina lladhina ukhriju min diyarihim wa amwalihim yabtaghuna fadlan mina l-lahi wa ridwana
versets.francais: Pour les pauvres émigrés qui ont été chassés de leurs demeures et de leurs biens, cherchant une grâce d-Allah et Son agrément
versets.anglais: For the poor emigrants who were expelled from their homes and their properties, seeking bounty from Allah and [His] approval and supporting Allah and His Messenger, [there is also a share]. Those are the truthful

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ تَبَوَّءُوا الدَّارَ وَالْإِيمَانَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ يُحِبُّونَ مَنْ هَاجَرَ إِلَيْهِمْ
versets.phonetique: Wa lladhina tabawwa-u d-dara wa l-imana min qablihim yuhibbuna man hajara ilayhim
versets.francais: Et ceux qui ont adopté Médine comme demeure et ont embrassé la foi avant eux aiment ceux qui ont émigré vers eux
versets.anglais: And [also for] those who were settled in al-Madinah and [adopted] the faith before them. They love those who emigrated to them and find not any want in their breasts of what the emigrants were given but give [them] preference over themselves, even though they are in privation. And whoever is protected from the stinginess of his soul - it is those who will be the successful

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ جَاءُوا مِن بَعْدِهِمْ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلِإِخْوَانِنَا الَّذِينَ سَبَقُونَا بِالْإِيمَانِ
versets.phonetique: Wa lladhina ja-u min ba-dihim yaquluna rabbana ghfir lana wa li-ikhwanina lladhina sabaquna bil-iman
versets.francais: Ceux qui sont venus après eux disent : Seigneur, pardonne-nous ainsi qu-à nos frères qui nous ont précédés dans la foi
versets.anglais: And [there is a share for] those who came after them, saying, "Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith and put not in our hearts [any] resentment toward those who have believed. Our Lord, indeed You are Kind and Merciful

versets.arabe: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى الَّذِينَ نَافَقُوا يَقُولُونَ لِإِخْوَانِهِمُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ
versets.phonetique: Alam tara ila lladhina nafaqu yaquluna li-ikhwanihimu lladhina kafaru min ahli l-kitab
versets.francais: N-as-tu pas vu les hypocrites dire à leurs frères mécréants parmi les Gens du Livre
versets.anglais: Have you not considered those who practice hypocrisy, saying to their brothers who have disbelieved among the People of the Scripture, "If you are expelled, we will surely leave with you, and we will not obey, in regard to you, anyone - ever; and if you are fought, we will surely aid you." But Allah testifies that they are liars

versets.arabe: لَئِنْ أُخْرِجُوا لَا يَخْرُجُونَ مَعَهُمْ وَلَئِن قُوتِلُوا لَا يَنصُرُونَهُمْ وَلَئِن نَّصَرُوهُمْ لَيُوَلُّنَّ الْأَدْبَارَ
versets.phonetique: La-in ukhriju la yakhrujuna ma-ahum wa la-in qutilu la yansurunahum wa la-in nasaruhum layuwallunna l-adbar
versets.francais: S-ils sont expulsés, ils ne partiront pas avec eux. S-ils sont combattus, ils ne les secoureront pas. Et s-ils les secouraient, ils tourneraient le dos
versets.anglais: If they are expelled, they will not leave with them, and if they are fought, they will not aid them. And [even] if they should aid them, they will surely turn their backs; then [thereafter] they will not be aided

versets.arabe: لَأَنتُمْ أَشَدُّ رَهْبَةً فِي صُدُورِهِم مِّنَ اللَّهِ ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَوْمٌ لَّا يَفْقَهُونَ
versets.phonetique: La-antum ashaddu rahbatan fi suduirihim mina l-lahi dhalika bi-annahum qawmun la yafqahun
versets.francais: Vous êtes certes plus terrifiants dans leurs poitrines qu-Allah. C-est parce qu-ils sont un peuple qui ne comprend pas
versets.anglais: You [believers] are more fearful within their breasts than Allah. That is because they are a people who do not understand

versets.arabe: لَا يُقَاتِلُونَكُمْ جَمِيعًا إِلَّا فِي قُرًى مُّحَصَّنَةٍ أَوْ مِن وَرَاءِ جُدُرٍ بَأْسُهُم بَيْنَهُمْ شَدِيدٌ
versets.phonetique: La yuqatilunakum jami-an illa fi quran muhassanatin aw min wara-i judorin ba-suhum baynahum shadid
versets.francais: Ils ne vous combattront pas tous ensemble sauf dans des villes fortifiées ou derrière des murailles. Leur violence entre eux est grande
versets.anglais: They will not fight you all except within fortified cities or from behind walls. Their violence among themselves is severe. You think they are together, but their hearts are diverse. That is because they are a people who do not reason

versets.arabe: كَمَثَلِ الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ قَرِيبًا ذَاقُوا وَبَالَ أَمْرِهِمْ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Kamathali lladhina min qablihim qariban dhaqu wabala amrihim wa lahum adhabun alim
versets.francais: Comme ceux qui les ont précédés de peu : ils ont goûté le funeste résultat de leur conduite. Ils auront un châtiment douloureux
versets.anglais: [Theirs is] like the example of those shortly before them: they tasted the bad consequence of their affair, and they will have a painful punishment

versets.arabe: كَمَثَلِ الشَّيْطَانِ إِذْ قَالَ لِلْإِنسَانِ اكْفُرْ فَلَمَّا كَفَرَ قَالَ إِنِّي بَرِيءٌ مِّنكَ
versets.phonetique: Kamathali sh-shaytani idh qala lil-insani kfur falamma kafara qala inni bari-un minka
versets.francais: Comme le diable quand il dit à l-homme : Mécroie ! Et quand il a mécru, il dit : Je me désolidarise de toi
versets.anglais: [The hypocrites are] like the example of Satan when he says to man, "Disbelieve." But when he disbelieves, he says, "Indeed, I am disassociated from you. Indeed, I fear Allah, Lord of the worlds

versets.arabe: فَكَانَ عَاقِبَتَهُمَا أَنَّهُمَا فِي النَّارِ خَالِدَيْنِ فِيهَا وَذَٰلِكَ جَزَاءُ الظَّالِمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Fakana aqibatahuma annahuma fi n-nari khalidayni fiha wa dhalika jaza-u z-zalimin
versets.francais: Leur sort à tous deux sera d-être dans le Feu où ils demeureront éternellement. Telle est la rétribution des injustes
versets.anglais: So the outcome for both of them is that they will be in the Fire, abiding eternally therein. And that is the recompense of the wrong-doers

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَلْتَنظُرْ نَفْسٌ مَّا قَدَّمَتْ لِغَدٍ وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ خَبِيرٌ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuha lladhina amanu ttaqu l-laha waltanzur nafsun ma qaddamat lighadin wa ttaqu l-laha inna l-laha khabirun bima ta-malun
versets.francais: O croyants ! Craignez Allah et que chaque âme regarde ce qu-elle a préparé pour demain. Craignez Allah. Allah est Parfaitement Connaisseur de ce que vous faites
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, fear Allah. And let every soul look to what it has put forth for tomorrow - and fear Allah. Indeed, Allah is Acquainted with what you do

versets.arabe: وَلَا تَكُونُوا كَالَّذِينَ نَسُوا اللَّهَ فَأَنسَاهُمْ أَنفُسَهُمْ أُولَٰئِكَ هُمُ الْفَاسِقُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa la takunu kalladhina nasu l-laha fa-ansahum anfusahum ula-ika humu l-fasiqun
versets.francais: Ne soyez pas comme ceux qui ont oublié Allah et qu-Il a fait s-oublier eux-mêmes. Ce sont eux les pervers
versets.anglais: And be not like those who forgot Allah, so He made them forget themselves. Those are the defiantly disobedient

versets.arabe: لَا يَسْتَوِي أَصْحَابُ النَّارِ وَأَصْحَابُ الْجَنَّةِ أَصْحَابُ الْجَنَّةِ هُمُ الْفَائِزُونَ
versets.phonetique: La yastawi ashabu n-nari wa ashabu l-jannati ashabu l-jannati humu l-fa-izun
versets.francais: Les gens du Feu et les gens du Paradis ne sont pas égaux. Les gens du Paradis sont les vrais gagnants
versets.anglais: Not equal are the companions of the Fire and the companions of Paradise. The companions of Paradise - they are the attainers [of success]

versets.arabe: لَوْ أَنزَلْنَا هَٰذَا الْقُرْآنَ عَلَىٰ جَبَلٍ لَّرَأَيْتَهُ خَاشِعًا مُّتَصَدِّعًا مِّنْ خَشْيَةِ اللَّهِ
versets.phonetique: Law anzalna hadha l-qurana ala jabalin lara-aytahu khashi-an mutasaddi-an min khashyati l-lah
versets.francais: Si Nous avions fait descendre ce Coran sur une montagne, tu l-aurais vue s-humilier et se fendre par crainte d-Allah
versets.anglais: If We had sent down this Qur'an upon a mountain, you would have seen it humbled and coming apart from fear of Allah. And these examples We present to the people that perhaps they will give thought

versets.arabe: هُوَ اللَّهُ الَّذِي لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَالِمُ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ هُوَ الرَّحْمَٰنُ الرَّحِيمُ
versets.phonetique: Huwa l-lahu lladhi la ilaha illa huwa alimu l-ghaybi wa sh-shahadati huwa r-rahmanu r-rahim
versets.francais: C-est Lui Allah, en dehors de Qui il n-y a point de divinité, le Connaisseur de l-invisible et du visible. Il est le Tout Miséricordieux, le Très Miséricordieux
versets.anglais: He is Allah, other than whom there is no deity, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed. He is the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful

versets.arabe: هُوَ اللَّهُ الَّذِي لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْمَلِكُ الْقُدُّوسُ السَّلَامُ الْمُؤْمِنُ الْمُهَيْمِنُ الْعَزِيزُ الْجَبَّارُ الْمُتَكَبِّرُ
versets.phonetique: Huwa l-lahu lladhi la ilaha illa huwa l-maliku l-quddosu s-salamu l-mu-minu l-muhayminu l-azizu l-jabbaru l-mutakabbir
versets.francais: C-est Lui Allah, en dehors de Qui il n-y a point de divinité, le Souverain, le Très Saint, la Paix, le Fidèle, le Gardien, le Puissant, le Tout Puissant, le Majestueux
versets.anglais: He is Allah, other than whom there is no deity, the Sovereign, the Pure, the Perfection, the Bestower of Faith, the Overseer, the Exalted in Might, the Compeller, the Superior. Exalted is Allah above whatever they associate with Him

versets.arabe: هُوَ اللَّهُ الْخَالِقُ الْبَارِئُ الْمُصَوِّرُ لَهُ الْأَسْمَاءُ الْحُسْنَىٰ يُسَبِّحُ لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ
versets.phonetique: Huwa l-lahu l-khaliqul-bari-u l-musawwiru lahu l-asma-u l-husna yusabbihu lahu ma fi s-samawati wa l-ardi wa huwa l-azizu l-hakim
versets.francais: C-est Lui Allah, le Créateur, Celui qui donne la vie, le Formateur. À Lui les plus beaux noms. Tout ce qui est dans les cieux et la terre Le glorifie. Il est le Puissant, le Sage
versets.anglais: He is Allah, the Creator, the Inventor, the Fashioner; to Him belong the best names. Whatever is in the heavens and earth is exalting Him. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تَتَّخِذُوا عَدُوِّي وَعَدُوَّكُمْ أَوْلِيَاءَ تُلْقُونَ إِلَيْهِم بِالْمَوَدَّةِ
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuha lladhina amanu la tattakhidhu aduwwi wa aduwwakum awliya-a tulquna ilayhim bil-mawadda
versets.francais: O croyants ! Ne prenez pas Mes ennemis et vos ennemis pour alliés, en leur témoignant de l-affection
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, do not take My enemies and your enemies as allies, extending to them affection while they have disbelieved in what came to you of the truth, having driven out the Prophet and yourselves [only] because you believe in Allah, your Lord. If you have come out for jihad in My cause and seeking means to My approval, [take them not as friends]. You confide to them affection, but I am most knowing of what you have concealed and what you have declared. And whoever does it among you has certainly strayed from the soundness of the way

versets.arabe: إِن يَثْقَفُوكُمْ يَكُونُوا لَكُمْ أَعْدَاءً وَيَبْسُطُوا إِلَيْكُمْ أَيْدِيَهُمْ وَأَلْسِنَتَهُم بِالسُّوءِ
versets.phonetique: In yathqafukum yakunu lakum a-da-an wa yabsutu ilaykum aydiyahum wa alsinatahum bis-su-
versets.francais: S-ils vous saisissent, ils seront vos ennemis, étendront leurs mains et leurs langues contre vous pour vous faire du mal
versets.anglais: If they gain dominance over you, they would be to you as enemies and extend against you their hands and their tongues with evil, and they wish you would disbelieve

versets.arabe: لَن تَنفَعَكُمْ أَرْحَامُكُمْ وَلَا أَوْلَادُكُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ يَفْصِلُ بَيْنَكُمْ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
versets.phonetique: Lan tanfa-akum arhamukum wa la awladukum yawma l-qiyamati yafsilyu baynakum wa l-lahu bima ta-maluna basir
versets.francais: Au Jour de la Résurrection, ni vos liens familiaux ni vos enfants ne vous seront utiles. Il séparera entre vous. Allah voit ce que vous faites
versets.anglais: Never will your relatives or your children benefit you; the Day of Resurrection He will judge between you. And Allah, of what you do, is Seeing

versets.arabe: قَدْ كَانَتْ لَكُمْ أُسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ فِي إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَالَّذِينَ مَعَهُ إِذْ قَالُوا لِقَوْمِهِمْ إِنَّا بُرَآءُ مِنكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Qad kanat lakum uswatun hasanatun fi ibrahima wa lladhina ma-ahu idh qalu liqawmihim inna bura-a minkum
versets.francais: Vous avez eu un bel exemple en Abraham et ceux qui étaient avec lui quand ils dirent à leur peuple : Nous nous désolidarisons de vous
versets.anglais: There has already been for you an excellent pattern in Abraham and those with him, when they said to their people, "Indeed, we are disassociated from you and from whatever you worship other than Allah. We have denied you, and there has appeared between us and you animosity and hatred forever until you believe in Allah alone" except for the saying of Abraham to his father, "I will surely ask forgiveness for you, but I have not [power to do] for you anything against Allah. Our Lord, upon You we have relied, and to You we have returned, and to You is the destination

versets.arabe: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ
versets.phonetique: Rabbana la taj-alna fitnatan lilladhina kafaru wa ghfir lana rabbana innaka anta l-azizu l-hakim
versets.francais: Seigneur, ne fais pas de nous une épreuve pour les mécréants et pardonne-nous. Seigneur, Tu es le Puissant, le Sage
versets.anglais: Our Lord, make us not [objects of] torment for the disbelievers and forgive us, our Lord. Indeed, it is You who is the Exalted in Might, the Wise

versets.arabe: لَقَدْ كَانَ لَكُمْ فِيهِمْ أُسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ لِّمَن كَانَ يَرْجُو اللَّهَ وَالْيَوْمَ الْآخِرَ
versets.phonetique: Laqad kana lakum fihim uswatun hasanatun liman kana yarjuw l-laha wa l-yawma l-akhir
versets.francais: Vous avez certes en eux un bel exemple pour celui qui espère en Allah et au Jour dernier
versets.anglais: There has certainly been for you in them an excellent pattern for anyone whose hope is in Allah and the Last Day. And whoever turns away - then indeed, Allah is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy

versets.arabe: عَسَى اللَّهُ أَن يَجْعَلَ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَ الَّذِينَ عَادَيْتُم مِّنْهُم مَّوَدَّةً
versets.phonetique: Asa l-lahu an yaj-ala baynakum wa bayna lladhina adaytum minhum mawaddata
versets.francais: Peut-être Allah établira-t-Il entre vous et ceux d-entre eux que vous prenez pour ennemis une affection
versets.anglais: Perhaps Allah will put, between you and those to whom you have been enemies among them, affection. And Allah is competent, and Allah is Forgiving and Merciful

versets.arabe: لَّا يَنْهَاكُمُ اللَّهُ عَنِ الَّذِينَ لَمْ يُقَاتِلُوكُمْ فِي الدِّينِ وَلَمْ يُخْرِجُوكُم مِّن دِيَارِكُمْ أَن تَبَرُّوهُمْ وَتُقْسِطُوا إِلَيْهِمْ
versets.phonetique: La yanhakumu l-lahu ani lladhina lam yuqatilukum fi d-dini wa lam yukhrijukum min diyarikum an tabarruhum wa tuqsitu ilayhim
versets.francais: Allah ne vous interdit pas d-être bons et équitables envers ceux qui ne vous ont pas combattus pour la religion et ne vous ont pas expulsés de vos demeures
versets.anglais: Allah does not forbid you from those who do not fight you because of religion and do not expel you from your homes - from being righteous toward them and acting justly toward them. Indeed, Allah loves those who act justly

versets.arabe: إِنَّمَا يَنْهَاكُمُ اللَّهُ عَنِ الَّذِينَ قَاتَلُوكُمْ فِي الدِّينِ وَأَخْرَجُوكُم مِّن دِيَارِكُمْ وَظَاهَرُوا عَلَىٰ إِخْرَاجِكُمْ أَن تَوَلَّوْهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Innama yanhakumu l-lahu ani lladhina qatalukum fi d-dini wa akhrajukum min diyarikum wa zaharu ala ikhrajiikum an tawallawahum
versets.francais: Allah vous interdit seulement de vous allier avec ceux qui vous ont combattus pour la religion, vous ont expulsés de vos demeures et ont aidé à votre expulsion
versets.anglais: Allah only forbids you from those who fight you because of religion and expel you from your homes and aid in your expulsion - [forbids] that you make allies of them. And whoever makes allies of them, then it is those who are the wrongdoers

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِذَا جَاءَكُمُ الْمُؤْمِنَاتُ مُهَاجِرَاتٍ فَامْتَحِنُوهُنَّ اللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِإِيمَانِهِنَّ
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuha lladhina amanu idha ja-akumu l-mu-minatu muhajiratin famtahinuhunna l-lahu a-lamu bi-imanihinn
versets.francais: O croyants ! Quand des croyantes viennent à vous comme émigrées, éprouvez-les. Allah connaît mieux leur foi
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, when the believing women come to you as emigrants, examine them. Allah is most knowing as to their faith. And if you know them to be believers, then do not return them to the disbelievers; they are not lawful [wives] for them, nor are they lawful [husbands] for them. But give the disbelievers what they have spent. And there is no blame upon you if you marry them when you have given them their due compensation. And hold not to marriage bonds with disbelieving women, but ask for what you have spent and let them ask for what they have spent. That is the judgement of Allah; He judges between you. And Allah is Knowing and Wise

versets.arabe: وَإِن فَاتَكُمْ شَيْءٌ مِّنْ أَزْوَاجِكُمْ إِلَى الْكُفَّارِ فَعَاقَبْتُمْ فَآتُوا الَّذِينَ ذَهَبَتْ أَزْوَاجُهُم مِّثْلَ مَا أَنفَقُوا
versets.phonetique: Wa in fatakum shay-un min azwajikum ila l-kuffari fa-aqabtum fa-atu lladhina dhahabat azwajuhum mithla ma anfaqu
versets.francais: Si l-une de vos épouses passe chez les mécréants et que vous ayez à vous compenser, donnez à ceux dont les épouses sont parties l-équivalent de ce qu-ils ont dépensé
versets.anglais: And if you have lost any of your wives to the disbelievers and you subsequently obtain [something], then give those whose wives have gone the equivalent of what they had spent. And fear Allah, in whom you are believers

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ إِذَا جَاءَكَ الْمُؤْمِنَاتُ يُبَايِعْنَكَ عَلَىٰ أَن لَّا يُشْرِكْنَ بِاللَّهِ شَيْئًا
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuha n-nabiyyu idha ja-aka l-mu-minatu yubay-i-naka ala an la yushrikna billahi shay-an
versets.francais: O Prophète ! Quand les croyantes viennent te prêter serment de ne pas associer quoi que ce soit à Allah
versets.anglais: O Prophet, when the believing women come to you pledging to you that they will not associate anything with Allah, nor will they steal, nor will they commit unlawful sexual intercourse, nor will they kill their children, nor will they bring forth a slander they have invented between their arms and legs, nor will they disobey you in what is right - then accept their pledge and ask forgiveness for them of Allah. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تَتَوَلَّوْا قَوْمًا غَضِبَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ قَدْ يَئِسُوا مِنَ الْآخِرَةِ كَمَا يَئِسَ الْكُفَّارُ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ الْقُبُورِ
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuha lladhina amanu la tatawllaw qawman ghadiba l-lahu alayhim qad ya-isu mina l-akhirati kama ya-isa l-kuffaru min ashabi l-qubur
versets.francais: O croyants ! Ne prenez pas pour alliés un peuple contre lequel Allah est en colère. Ils ont désespéré de l-au-delà comme les mécréants désespèrent des gens des tombeaux
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, do not make allies of a people with whom Allah has become angry. They have despaired of [reward in] the Hereafter just as the disbelievers have despaired of [meeting] the inhabitants of the graves

versets.arabe: سَبَّحَ لِلَّهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ
versets.phonetique: Sabbaha lillahi ma fi s-samawati wa ma fi l-ardi wa huwa l-azizu l-hakim
versets.francais: Tout ce qui est dans les cieux et la terre glorifie Allah. Il est le Puissant, le Sage
versets.anglais: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth exalts Allah, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لِمَ تَقُولُونَ مَا لَا تَفْعَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuha lladhina amanu lima taquluna ma la taf-alun
versets.francais: O croyants ! Pourquoi dites-vous ce que vous ne faites pas
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, why do you say what you do not do

versets.arabe: كَبُرَ مَقْتًا عِندَ اللَّهِ أَن تَقُولُوا مَا لَا تَفْعَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Kabura maqtan inda l-lahi an taqulu ma la taf-alun
versets.francais: C-est une grande abomination auprès d-Allah que de dire ce que vous ne faites pas
versets.anglais: Great is hatred in the sight of Allah that you say what you do not do

versets.arabe: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الَّذِينَ يُقَاتِلُونَ فِي سَبِيلِهِ صَفًّا كَأَنَّهُم بُنْيَانٌ مَّرْصُوصٌ
versets.phonetique: Inna l-laha yuhibbu lladhina yuqatiluna fi sabilihi saffan ka-annahum bunyanun marsus
versets.francais: Allah aime ceux qui combattent dans Son chemin en rangs serrés, comme un édifice compact
versets.anglais: Indeed, Allah loves those who fight in His cause in a row as though they are a [single] structure joined firmly

versets.arabe: وَإِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِقَوْمِهِ يَا قَوْمِ لِمَ تُؤْذُونَنِي وَقَد تَّعْلَمُونَ أَنِّي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ إِلَيْكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Wa idh qala musa liqawmihi ya qawmi lima tu-dhunani wa qad ta-lamuna anni rasulu l-lahi ilaykum
versets.francais: Et quand Moïse dit à son peuple : O mon peuple, pourquoi me faites-vous du mal alors que vous savez que je suis le messager d-Allah vers vous
versets.anglais: And [mention, O Muhammad], when Moses said to his people, "O my people, why do you harm me while you certainly know that I am the messenger of Allah to you?" And when they deviated, Allah caused their hearts to deviate. And Allah does not guide the defiantly disobedient people

versets.arabe: وَإِذْ قَالَ عِيسَى ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ يَا بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ إِنِّي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ إِلَيْكُم مُّصَدِّقًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيَّ مِنَ التَّوْرَاةِ وَمُبَشِّرًا بِرَسُولٍ يَأْتِي مِن بَعْدِي اسْمُهُ أَحْمَدُ
versets.phonetique: Wa idh qala isa bnu maryama ya bani isra-ila inni rasulu l-lahi ilaykum musaddiqan lima bayna yadayya mina t-tawrati wa mubash-shiran birasullin ya-ti min ba-di smuhu ahmad
versets.francais: Et quand Jésus fils de Marie dit : O Enfants d-Israël, je suis le messager d-Allah vers vous, confirmant ce que j-ai sous la main de la Torah et annonçant un messager qui viendra après moi dont le nom sera Ahmad
versets.anglais: And [mention] when Jesus, the son of Mary, said, "O children of Israel, indeed I am the messenger of Allah to you confirming what came before me of the Torah and bringing good tidings of a messenger to come after me, whose name is Ahmad." But when he came to them with clear evidences, they said, "This is obvious magic

versets.arabe: وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ افْتَرَىٰ عَلَى اللَّهِ الْكَذِبَ وَهُوَ يُدْعَىٰ إِلَى الْإِسْلَامِ وَاللَّهُ لَا يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ الظَّالِمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa man azlamu mimmani ftara ala l-lahi l-kadhiba wa huwa yud-a ila l-islami wa l-lahu la yahdi l-qawma z-zalimin
versets.francais: Qui est plus injuste que celui qui invente un mensonge contre Allah alors qu-il est appelé à l-Islam ? Allah ne guide pas les gens injustes
versets.anglais: And who is more unjust than one who invents about Allah untruth while he is being invited to Islam. And Allah does not guide the wrongdoing people

versets.arabe: يُرِيدُونَ لِيُطْفِئُوا نُورَ اللَّهِ بِأَفْوَاهِهِمْ وَاللَّهُ مُتِمُّ نُورِهِ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الْكَافِرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Yuriduna liyutfi-u nura l-lahi bi-afwahihim wa l-lahu mutimmu nurihi wa law kariha l-kafirun
versets.francais: Ils veulent éteindre la lumière d-Allah avec leurs bouches. Mais Allah parachèvera Sa lumière même si les mécréants le détestent
versets.anglais: They want to extinguish the light of Allah with their mouths, but Allah will perfect His light, although the disbelievers dislike it

versets.arabe: هُوَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلَ رَسُولَهُ بِالْهُدَىٰ وَدِينِ الْحَقِّ لِيُظْهِرَهُ عَلَى الدِّينِ كُلِّهِ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الْمُشْرِكُونَ
versets.phonetique: Huwa lladhi arsala rasulahu bil-huda wa dini l-haqqi liyuzhirahu ala d-dini kullihi wa law kariha l-mushrikun
versets.francais: C-est Lui qui a envoyé Son messager avec la guidée et la religion de la vérité pour la faire prévaloir sur toute religion, même si les polythéistes le détestent
versets.anglais: It is He who sent His Messenger with guidance and the religion of truth to manifest it over all religion, although those who associate others with Allah dislike it

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا هَلْ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰ تِجَارَةٍ تُنجِيكُم مِّنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuha lladhina amanu hal adullukum ala tijaratin tunjikum min adhabin alim
versets.francais: O croyants ! Voulez-vous que je vous indique un commerce qui vous sauvera d-un châtiment douloureux
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, shall I guide you to a transaction that will save you from a painful punishment

versets.arabe: تُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَتُجَاهِدُونَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ بِأَمْوَالِكُمْ وَأَنفُسِكُمْ ذَٰلِكُمْ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Tu-minuna billahi wa rasulihi wa tujahiduna fi sabili l-lahi bi-amwalikum wa anfusikum dhalikum khayrun lakum in kuntum ta-lamun
versets.francais: Vous croyez en Allah et en Son messager et vous combattez dans le chemin d-Allah de vos biens et de vos personnes. C-est ce qui est meilleur pour vous, si vous saviez
versets.anglais: [It is that] you believe in Allah and His Messenger and strive in the cause of Allah with your wealth and your lives. That is best for you, if you should know

versets.arabe: يَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ذُنُوبَكُمْ وَيُدْخِلْكُمْ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ وَمَسَاكِنَ طَيِّبَةً فِي جَنَّاتِ عَدْنٍ ذَٰلِكَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ
versets.phonetique: Yaghfir lakum dhunubakum wa yudkhilkum jannatin tajri min tahtiha l-anharu wa masakina tayyibatan fi jannati adnin dhalika l-fawzu l-azim
versets.francais: Il vous pardonnera vos péchés et vous fera entrer dans des jardins sous lesquels coulent des ruisseaux, et de belles demeures dans les jardins d-Eden. C-est le grand succès
versets.anglais: He will forgive for you your sins and admit you to gardens beneath which rivers flow and pleasant dwellings in gardens of perpetual residence. That is the great attainment

versets.arabe: وَأُخْرَىٰ تُحِبُّونَهَا نَصْرٌ مِّنَ اللَّهِ وَفَتْحٌ قَرِيبٌ وَبَشِّرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa ukhra tuhibbunaha nasrun mina l-lahi wa fathun qaribun wa bashshiri l-mu-minin
versets.francais: Et une autre que vous aimez : un secours d-Allah et une victoire prochaine. Annonce la bonne nouvelle aux croyants
versets.anglais: And [you will obtain] another [favor] that you love - victory from Allah and an imminent conquest; and give good tidings to the believers

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا كُونُوا أَنصَارَ اللَّهِ كَمَا قَالَ عِيسَى ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ لِلْحَوَارِيِّينَ مَنْ أَنصَارِي إِلَى اللَّهِ
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuha lladhina amanu kunu ansara l-lahi kama qala isa bnu maryama lil-hawariyyina man ansari ila l-lah
versets.francais: O croyants ! Soyez les partisans d-Allah comme Jésus fils de Marie le dit aux Apôtres : Qui sont mes partisans pour Allah
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, be supporters of Allah, as when Jesus, the son of Mary, said to the disciples, "Who are my supporters for Allah?" The disciples said, "We are supporters of Allah." And a faction of the Children of Israel believed and a faction disbelieved. So We supported those who believed against their enemy, and they became dominant

versets.arabe: يُسَبِّحُ لِلَّهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ الْمَلِكِ الْقُدُّوسِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَكِيمِ
versets.phonetique: Yusabbihu lillahi ma fi s-samawati wa ma fi l-ardi l-maliki l-quddusi l-azizi l-hakim
versets.francais: Tout ce qui est dans les cieux et la terre glorifie Allah, le Souverain, le Pur, le Puissant, le Sage
versets.anglais: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth is exalting Allah, the Sovereign, the Pure, the Exalted in Might, the Wise

versets.arabe: هُوَ الَّذِي بَعَثَ فِي الْأُمِّيِّينَ رَسُولًا مِّنْهُمْ يَتْلُو عَلَيْهِمْ آيَاتِهِ وَيُزَكِّيهِمْ وَيُعَلِّمُهُمُ الْكِتَابَ وَالْحِكْمَةَ
versets.phonetique: Huwa lladhi ba-atha fi l-ummiyyina rasulan minhum yatlu alayhim ayatihi wa yuzakkihim wa yu-allimuhumu l-kitaba wa l-hikmata
versets.francais: C-est Lui qui a envoyé parmi les non-lettrés un messager de chez eux, qui leur récite Ses versets, les purifie et leur enseigne le Livre et la Sagesse
versets.anglais: It is He who has sent among the unlettered a Messenger from themselves reciting to them His verses and purifying them and teaching them the Book and wisdom - although they were before in clear error

versets.arabe: وَآخَرِينَ مِنْهُمْ لَمَّا يَلْحَقُوا بِهِمْ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ
versets.phonetique: Wa akharina minhum lamma yalhaqu bihim wa huwa l-azizu l-hakim
versets.francais: Et à d-autres parmi eux qui ne les ont pas encore rejoints. Il est le Puissant, le Sage
versets.anglais: And [to] others of them who have not yet joined them. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise

versets.arabe: ذَٰلِكَ فَضْلُ اللَّهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَن يَشَاءُ وَاللَّهُ ذُو الْفَضْلِ الْعَظِيمِ
versets.phonetique: Dhalika fadlu l-lahi yu-tihi man yasha-u wa l-lahu dhu l-fadli l-azim
versets.francais: C-est la grâce d-Allah qu-Il accorde à qui Il veut. Allah est le Détenteur de l-immense grâce
versets.anglais: That is the bounty of Allah, which He gives to whom He wills, and Allah is the possessor of great bounty

versets.arabe: مَثَلُ الَّذِينَ حُمِّلُوا التَّوْرَاةَ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَحْمِلُوهَا كَمَثَلِ الْحِمَارِ يَحْمِلُ أَسْفَارًا
versets.phonetique: Mathalu lladhina hummilu t-tawrata thumma lam yahmiluha kamathali l-himari yahmilu asfara
versets.francais: Ceux qui ont été chargés de la Torah puis ne l-ont pas appliquée ressemblent à un âne qui porte des livres
versets.anglais: The example of those who were entrusted with the Torah and then did not take it on is like that of a donkey who carries volumes [of books]. Wretched is the example of the people who deny the signs of Allah. And Allah does not guide the wrongdoing people

versets.arabe: قُلْ يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ هَادُوا إِن زَعَمْتُمْ أَنَّكُمْ أَوْلِيَاءُ لِلَّهِ مِن دُونِ النَّاسِ فَتَمَنَّوُا الْمَوْتَ إِن كُنتُمْ صَادِقِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qul ya ayyuha lladhina hadu in za-amtum annakum awliya-u lillahi min duni n-nasi fatamanna-wu l-mawta in kuntum sadiqin
versets.francais: Dis : Ô vous qui êtes juifs, si vous prétendez être les favoris d-Allah à l-exclusion des autres hommes, souhaitez donc la mort si vous êtes véridiques
versets.anglais: Say, "O you who are Jews, if you claim that you are allies of Allah, excluding the [other] people, then wish for death, if you should be truthful

versets.arabe: وَلَا يَتَمَنَّوْنَهُ أَبَدًا بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ بِالظَّالِمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa la yatamannawnahu abadan bima qaddamat aydihim wa l-lahu alimun bi z-zalimin
versets.francais: Mais jamais ils ne la souhaiteront à cause de ce que leurs mains ont accompli. Allah connaît parfaitement les injustes
versets.anglais: But they will not wish for it, ever, because of what their hands have put forth. And Allah is Knowing of the wrongdoers

versets.arabe: قُلْ إِنَّ الْمَوْتَ الَّذِي تَفِرُّونَ مِنْهُ فَإِنَّهُ مُلَاقِيكُمْ ثُمَّ تُرَدُّونَ إِلَىٰ عَالِمِ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ
versets.phonetique: Qul inna l-mawta lladhi tafiruna minhu fa-innahu mulaqikum thumma turaddduna ila alimi l-ghaybi wa sh-shahada
versets.francais: Dis : La mort que vous fuyez va certes vous rejoindre, puis vous serez ramenés vers Celui qui connaît l-invisible et le visible
versets.anglais: Say, "Indeed, the death from which you flee - indeed, it will meet you. Then you will be returned to the Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, and He will inform you about what you used to do

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِذَا نُودِيَ لِلصَّلَاةِ مِن يَوْمِ الْجُمُعَةِ فَاسْعَوْا إِلَىٰ ذِكْرِ اللَّهِ وَذَرُوا الْبَيْعَ
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuha lladhina amanu idha nudiya li s-salati min yawmi l-jumu-ati fas-aw ila dhikri l-lahi wa dharu l-bay-a
versets.francais: O croyants ! Quand l-appel à la prière est lancé le vendredi, empressez-vous vers le souvenir d-Allah et laissez le commerce
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, when [the adhan] is called for the prayer on the day of Jumu'ah [Friday], then proceed to the remembrance of Allah and leave trade. That is better for you, if you only knew

versets.arabe: فَإِذَا قُضِيَتِ الصَّلَاةُ فَانتَشِرُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَابْتَغُوا مِن فَضْلِ اللَّهِ وَاذْكُرُوا اللَّهَ كَثِيرًا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
versets.phonetique: Fa-idha qudiyati s-salatu fantashiru fi l-ardi wa btaghu min fadli l-lahi wa dhkuru l-laha kathiran la-allakum tuflihun
versets.francais: Lorsque la prière est accomplie, dispersez-vous sur terre, recherchez la grâce d-Allah et invoquez beaucoup Allah afin que vous réussissiez
versets.anglais: And when the prayer has been concluded, disperse within the land and seek from the bounty of Allah, and remember Allah often that you may succeed

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا رَأَوْا تِجَارَةً أَوْ لَهْوًا انفَضُّوا إِلَيْهَا وَتَرَكُوكَ قَائِمًا قُلْ مَا عِندَ اللَّهِ خَيْرٌ مِّنَ اللَّهْوِ وَمِنَ التِّجَارَةِ
versets.phonetique: Wa idha ra-aw tijaratan aw lahwan infaddddu ilayha wa tarakuka qa-iman qul ma inda l-lahi khayrun mina l-lahwi wa mina t-tijara
versets.francais: Quand ils voient un commerce ou un divertissement, ils s-y précipitent et te laissent debout. Dis : Ce qu-il y a auprès d-Allah est bien meilleur que le divertissement et le commerce
versets.anglais: But when they saw a transaction or a diversion, [O Muhammad], they rushed to it and left you standing. Say, "What is with Allah is better than diversion and than a transaction, and Allah is the best of providers

versets.arabe: إِذَا جَاءَكَ الْمُنَافِقُونَ قَالُوا نَشْهَدُ إِنَّكَ لَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ إِنَّكَ لَرَسُولُهُ وَاللَّهُ يَشْهَدُ إِنَّ الْمُنَافِقِينَ لَكَاذِبُونَ
versets.phonetique: Idha ja-aka l-munafiquna qalu nashhadu innaka la-rasulu l-lahi wa l-lahu ya-lamu innaka la-rasulahu wa l-lahu yashhadu inna l-munafiqina la-kadhibun
versets.francais: Quand les hypocrites viennent te voir, ils disent : Nous attestons que tu es certes le messager d-Allah. Allah sait que tu es Son messager et Allah atteste que les hypocrites sont des menteurs
versets.anglais: When the hypocrites come to you, [O Muhammad], they say, "We testify that you are the Messenger of Allah." And Allah knows that you are His Messenger, and Allah testifies that the hypocrites are liars

versets.arabe: اتَّخَذُوا أَيْمَانَهُمْ جُنَّةً فَصَدُّوا عَن سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ إِنَّهُمْ سَاءَ مَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Ttakhadhu aymanahum junnatan fasaddu an sabili l-lahi innahum sa-a ma kanu ya-malun
versets.francais: Ils ont pris leurs serments comme bouclier et ont détourné du chemin d-Allah. Comme est mauvais ce qu-ils faisaient
versets.anglais: They have taken their oaths as a cover, so they averted [people] from the way of Allah. Indeed, it was evil that they were doing

versets.arabe: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ آمَنُوا ثُمَّ كَفَرُوا فَطُبِعَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ فَهُمْ لَا يَفْقَهُونَ
versets.phonetique: Dhalika bi-annahum amanu thumma kafaru fatubi-a ala qulubihim fahum la yafqahun
versets.francais: C-est parce qu-ils ont cru puis mécru que leurs cœurs ont été scellés. Ils ne comprennent donc pas
versets.anglais: That is because they believed, and then they disbelieved; so their hearts were sealed over, and they do not understand

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ تُعْجِبُكَ أَجْسَامُهُمْ وَإِن يَقُولُوا تَسْمَعْ لِقَوْلِهِمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ خُشُبٌ مُّسَنَّدَةٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa idha ra-aytahum tu-jibuka ajsamuhum wa in yaqulu tasma-u li-qawlihim ka-annahum khushubun musannada
versets.francais: Quand tu les vois, leur physique t-émerveille, et s-ils parlent, tu écoutes leurs discours. Ils sont comme des poutres appuyées contre un mur
versets.anglais: And when you see them, their forms please you, and if they speak, you listen to their speech. [They are] as if they were pieces of wood propped up - they think that every shout is against them. They are the enemy, so beware of them. May Allah destroy them; how are they deluded

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَعَالَوْا يَسْتَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ لَوَّوْا رُءُوسَهُمْ وَرَأَيْتَهُمْ يَصُدُّونَ وَهُم مُّسْتَكْبِرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa idha qila lahum ta-alaw yastaghfir lakum rasulu l-lahi lawwaw ru-usahum wa ra-aytahum yasudduna wa hum mustakbirun
versets.francais: Quand on leur dit : Venez, le messager d-Allah implorera le pardon pour vous, ils tournent la tête et tu les vois se détourner avec arrogance
versets.anglais: And when it is said to them, "Come, the Messenger of Allah will ask forgiveness for you," they turn their heads aside and you see them evading while they are arrogant

versets.arabe: سَوَاءٌ عَلَيْهِمْ أَسْتَغْفَرْتَ لَهُمْ أَمْ لَمْ تَسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ لَن يَغْفِرَ اللَّهُ لَهُمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ الْفَاسِقِينَ
versets.phonetique: Sawa-un alayhim astaghfarta lahum am lam tastaghfir lahum lan yaghfira l-lahu lahum inna l-laha la yahdi l-qawma l-fasiqin
versets.francais: Que tu implores ou non le pardon pour eux, Allah ne leur pardonnera jamais. Allah ne guide pas les gens pervers
versets.anglais: It is all the same for them whether you ask forgiveness for them or do not ask forgiveness for them; never will Allah forgive them. Indeed, Allah does not guide the defiantly disobedient people

versets.arabe: هُمُ الَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ لَا تُنفِقُوا عَلَىٰ مَنْ عِندَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ حَتَّىٰ يَنفَضُّوا
versets.phonetique: Humu lladhina yaquluna la tunfiqu ala man inda rasuli l-lahi hatta yanfaddddu
versets.francais: Ce sont eux qui disent : Ne dépensez rien pour ceux qui sont auprès du messager d-Allah jusqu-à ce qu-ils se dispersent
versets.anglais: They are the ones who say, "Do not spend on those who are with the Messenger of Allah until they disband." And to Allah belongs the depositories of the heavens and the earth, but the hypocrites do not understand

versets.arabe: يَقُولُونَ لَئِن رَّجَعْنَا إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ لَيُخْرِجَنَّ الْأَعَزُّ مِنْهَا الْأَذَلَّ وَلِلَّهِ الْعِزَّةُ وَلِرَسُولِهِ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
versets.phonetique: Yaquluna la-in raja-na ila l-madinati la-yukhrijanna l-a-azzu minha l-adhalla wa lillahi l-izzatu wa li-rasulihi wa lil-mu-minin
versets.francais: Ils disent : Si nous retournons à Médine, le plus fort en chassera le plus faible. Or la puissance appartient à Allah, à Son messager et aux croyants
versets.anglais: They say, "If we return to al-Madinah, the more honored [for power] will surely expel therefrom the more humble." And to Allah belongs [all] honor, and to His Messenger, and to the believers, but the hypocrites do not know

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تُلْهِكُمْ أَمْوَالُكُمْ وَلَا أَوْلَادُكُمْ عَن ذِكْرِ اللَّهِ
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuha lladhina amanu la tulhikum amwalukum wa la awladukum an dhikri l-lah
versets.francais: O croyants ! Que vos biens et vos enfants ne vous distraient pas du souvenir d-Allah
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, let not your wealth and your children divert you from remembrance of Allah. And whoever does that - then those are the losers

versets.arabe: وَأَنفِقُوا مِن مَّا رَزَقْنَاكُم مِّن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَ أَحَدَكُمُ الْمَوْتُ فَيَقُولَ رَبِّ لَوْلَا أَخَّرْتَنِي إِلَىٰ أَجَلٍ قَرِيبٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa anfiqu mimma razaqnakum min qabli an ya-tiya ahadakumu l-mawtu fa-yaqula rabbi lawla akhkhartani ila ajalin qarib
versets.francais: Dépensez de ce que Nous vous avons accordé avant que la mort ne vienne à l-un de vous et qu-il dise : Seigneur, si Tu m-accordais un court délai
versets.anglais: And spend [in the way of Allah] from what We have provided you before death approaches one of you and he says, "My Lord, if only You would delay me for a brief term so I would give charity and be among the righteous

versets.arabe: وَلَن يُؤَخِّرَ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِذَا جَاءَ أَجَلُهَا وَاللَّهُ خَبِيرٌ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa lan yu-akhkhira l-lahu nafsan idha ja-a ajalaha wa l-lahu khabirun bima ta-malun
versets.francais: Allah n-accorde aucun délai à une âme quand son terme est arrivé. Allah est Parfaitement Connaisseur de ce que vous faites
versets.anglais: But never will Allah delay a soul when its time has come. And Allah is Acquainted with what you do

versets.arabe: يُسَبِّحُ لِلَّهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
versets.phonetique: Yusabbihu lillahi ma fi s-samawati wa ma fi l-ardi lahu l-mulku wa lahu l-hamdu wa huwa ala kulli shay-in qadir
versets.francais: Tout ce qui est dans les cieux et la terre glorifie Allah. À Lui la royauté, à Lui la louange. Il est Omnipotent
versets.anglais: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth is exalting Allah. To Him belongs dominion, and to Him belongs [all] praise, and He is over all things competent

versets.arabe: هُوَ الَّذِي خَلَقَكُمْ فَمِنكُمْ كَافِرٌ وَمِنكُم مُّؤْمِنٌ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
versets.phonetique: Huwa lladhi khalaqakum faminkum kafirun wa minkum mu-minun wa l-lahu bima ta-maluna basir
versets.francais: C-est Lui qui vous a créés : parmi vous il y a le mécréant et le croyant. Allah voit parfaitement ce que vous faites
versets.anglais: It is He who created you, and among you is the disbeliever, and among you is the believer. And Allah, of what you do, is Seeing

versets.arabe: خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ بِالْحَقِّ وَصَوَّرَكُمْ فَأَحْسَنَ صُوَرَكُمْ وَإِلَيْهِ الْمَصِيرُ
versets.phonetique: Khalaqa s-samawati wa l-arda bil-haqqi wa sawwarakum fa-ahsana suwarakum wa ilayhi l-masir
versets.francais: Il a créé les cieux et la terre en toute vérité, vous a formés et a parfait vos formes. C-est vers Lui que sera le retour
versets.anglais: He created the heavens and earth in truth and formed you and perfected your forms; and to Him is the [final] destination

versets.arabe: يَعْلَمُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تُسِرُّونَ وَمَا تُعْلِنُونَ وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ
versets.phonetique: Ya-lamu ma fi s-samawati wa l-ardi wa ya-lamu ma tusirrruna wa ma tu-linuna wa l-lahu alimun bi-dhati s-sudur
versets.francais: Il sait ce qui est dans les cieux et la terre, il sait ce que vous cachez et ce que vous divulguez. Allah connaît parfaitement le contenu des cœurs
versets.anglais: He knows what is within the heavens and earth and knows what you conceal and what you declare. And Allah is Knowing of that within the breasts

versets.arabe: أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ نَبَأُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِن قَبْلُ فَذَاقُوا وَبَالَ أَمْرِهِمْ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Alam ya-tikum naba-u lladhina kafaru min qablu fadhaaqu wabala amrihim wa lahum adhabun alim
versets.francais: Ne vous est-il pas parvenu la nouvelle de ceux qui ont mécru avant vous ? Ils ont goûté aux funestes conséquences de leurs actes et un douloureux châtiment les attend
versets.anglais: Has there not come to you the news of those who disbelieved before? So they tasted the bad consequence of their affair, and they will have a painful punishment

versets.arabe: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُ كَانَت تَّأْتِيهِمْ رُسُلُهُم بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ فَقَالُوا أَبَشَرٌ يَهْدُونَنَا فَكَفَرُوا وَتَوَلَّوا
versets.phonetique: Dhalika bi-annahu kanat ta-tihim rusuluhum bil-bayyinati faqalu a-basharun yahdunana fakafaru wa tawallow
versets.francais: C-est parce que leurs messagers venaient à eux avec des preuves claires et qu-ils disaient : Des humains vont-ils nous guider ? Ils ont mécru et se sont détournés
versets.anglais: That is because their messengers used to come to them with clear evidences, but they said, "Shall human beings guide us?" and disbelieved and turned away. And Allah dispensed [with them]; and Allah is Free of need and Praiseworthy

versets.arabe: زَعَمَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا أَن لَّن يُبْعَثُوا قُلْ بَلَىٰ وَرَبِّي لَتُبْعَثُنَّ ثُمَّ لَتُنَبَّؤُنَّ بِمَا عَمِلْتُمْ
versets.phonetique: Za-ama lladhina kafaru an lan yub-athu qul bala wa rabbi la-tub-athunna thumma la-tunabba-unna bima amiltum
versets.francais: Les mécréants prétendent qu-ils ne seront pas ressuscités. Dis : Si, par mon Seigneur ! Vous serez certes ressuscités, puis on vous informera de ce que vous avez fait
versets.anglais: Those who disbelieve have claimed that they will never be resurrected. Say, "Yes, by my Lord, you will surely be resurrected; then you will surely be informed of what you did. And that, for Allah, is easy

versets.arabe: فَآمِنُوا بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَالنُّورِ الَّذِي أَنزَلْنَا وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ
versets.phonetique: Fa-aminu billahi wa rasulihi wa n-nuri lladhi anzalna wa l-lahu bima ta-maluna khabir
versets.francais: Croyez donc en Allah, en Son messager et en la Lumière que Nous avons fait descendre. Allah est Parfaitement Connaisseur de ce que vous faites
versets.anglais: So believe in Allah and His Messenger and the Qur'an which We have sent down. And Allah is Acquainted with what you do

versets.arabe: يَوْمَ يَجْمَعُكُمْ لِيَوْمِ الْجَمْعِ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ التَّغَابُنِ وَمَن يُؤْمِن بِاللَّهِ وَيَعْمَلْ صَالِحًا يُكَفِّرْ عَنْهُ سَيِّئَاتِهِ
versets.phonetique: Yawma yajma-ukum li-yawmi l-jam-i dhalika yawmu t-taghabuni wa man yu-min billahi wa ya-mal salihan yukaffir anhu sayyi-atih
versets.francais: Le jour où Il vous rassemblera pour le Jour du Rassemblement : ce sera le Jour de la Dépossession mutuelle. Celui qui croit en Allah et fait le bien, Il effacera ses mauvaises actions
versets.anglais: The Day He will assemble you for the Day of Assembly - that is the Day of Deprivation. And whoever believes in Allah and does righteousness - He will remove from him his misdeeds and admit him to gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever. That is the great attainment

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَكَذَّبُوا بِآيَاتِنَا أُولَٰئِكَ أَصْحَابُ النَّارِ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا وَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيرُ
versets.phonetique: Wa lladhina kafaru wa kadhdhabu bi-ayatina ula-ika ashabu n-nari khalidina fiha wa bi-sa l-masir
versets.francais: Ceux qui ont mécru et traité de mensonges Nos signes, ce sont les gens du Feu où ils demeureront éternellement. Quelle mauvaise destination
versets.anglais: But the ones who disbelieved and denied Our verses - those are the companions of the Fire, abiding eternally therein; and wretched is the destination

versets.arabe: مَا أَصَابَ مِن مُّصِيبَةٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ وَمَن يُؤْمِن بِاللَّهِ يَهْدِ قَلْبَهُ وَاللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Ma asaba min musibatin illa bi-idhni l-lahi wa man yu-min billahi yahdi qalbahu wa l-lahu bikulli shay-in alim
versets.francais: Nulle épreuve ne survient qu-avec la permission d-Allah. Celui qui croit en Allah, Il guide son cœur. Allah est Omniscient
versets.anglais: No disaster strikes except by permission of Allah. And whoever believes in Allah - He will guide his heart. And Allah is Knowing of all things

versets.arabe: وَأَطِيعُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُوا الرَّسُولَ فَإِن تَوَلَّيْتُمْ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَىٰ رَسُولِنَا الْبَلَاغُ الْمُبِينُ
versets.phonetique: Wa ati-u l-laha wa ati-u r-rasula fa-in tawallaytum fa-innama ala rasulina l-balaghu l-mubin
versets.francais: Obéissez à Allah et obéissez au messager. Si vous vous détournez, la mission de Notre messager n-est que la transmission claire
versets.anglais: And obey Allah and obey the Messenger; but if you turn away - then upon Our Messenger is only [the duty of] clear notification

versets.arabe: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ وَعَلَى اللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ
versets.phonetique: L-lahu la ilaha illa huwa wa ala l-lahi falyatawakkali l-mu-minun
versets.francais: Allah ! Pas de divinité en dehors de Lui. C-est en Allah que les croyants doivent se fier
versets.anglais: Allah - there is no deity except Him. And upon Allah let the believers rely

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِنَّ مِنْ أَزْوَاجِكُمْ وَأَوْلَادِكُمْ عَدُوًّا لَّكُمْ فَاحْذَرُوهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuha lladhina amanu inna min azwajikum wa awladikum aduwwan lakum fahdharu-hum
versets.francais: O croyants ! Certains de vos épouses et de vos enfants sont vos ennemis. Méfiez-vous d-eux
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, indeed, among your wives and your children are enemies to you, so beware of them. But if you pardon and overlook and forgive - then indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful

versets.arabe: إِنَّمَا أَمْوَالُكُمْ وَأَوْلَادُكُمْ فِتْنَةٌ وَاللَّهُ عِندَهُ أَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Innama amwalukum wa awladukum fitnatun wa l-lahu indahu ajrun azim
versets.francais: Vos biens et vos enfants ne sont qu-une tentation. Auprès d-Allah il y a une immense récompense
versets.anglais: Your wealth and your children are but a trial, and Allah has with Him a great reward

versets.arabe: فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُمْ وَاسْمَعُوا وَأَطِيعُوا وَأَنفِقُوا خَيْرًا لِّأَنفُسِكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Fa-ttaqu l-laha ma stata-tum wa sma-u wa ati-u wa anfiqu khayran li-anfusikum
versets.francais: Craignez Allah autant que vous le pouvez, écoutez, obéissez et dépensez. Ce sera pour votre propre bien
versets.anglais: So fear Allah as much as you are able and listen and obey and spend [in the way of Allah]; it is better for your selves. And whoever is protected from the stinginess of his soul - it is those who will be the successful

versets.arabe: إِن تُقْرِضُوا اللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا يُضَاعِفْهُ لَكُمْ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ وَاللَّهُ شَكُورٌ حَلِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: In tuqridu l-laha qardan hasanan yuda-ifhu lakum wa yaghfir lakum wa l-lahu shakurun halim
versets.francais: Si vous faites à Allah un beau prêt, Il le multipliera pour vous et vous pardonnera. Allah est Reconnaissant et Indulgent
versets.anglais: If you loan Allah a goodly loan, He will multiply it for you and forgive you. And Allah is Most Appreciative and Forbearing

versets.arabe: عَالِمُ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ
versets.phonetique: Alimu l-ghaybi wa sh-shahadati l-azizu l-hakim
versets.francais: Connaisseur de l-invisible et du visible, le Puissant, le Sage
versets.anglais: Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Exalted in Might, the Wise

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ إِذَا طَلَّقْتُمُ النِّسَاءَ فَطَلِّقُوهُنَّ لِعِدَّتِهِنَّ وَأَحْصُوا الْعِدَّةَ وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ رَبَّكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuha n-nabiyyu idha tallaqtumu n-nisa-a fatalliqu-hunna li-iddatihinna wa ahsu l-iddata wa ttaqu l-laha rabbakum
versets.francais: O Prophète ! Quand vous répudiez des femmes, répudiez-les à l-entrée de leur période d-attente et calculez la période. Craignez Allah votre Seigneur
versets.anglais: O Prophet, when you [Muslims] divorce women, divorce them for [the commencement of] their waiting period and keep count of the waiting period, and fear Allah, your Lord. Do not turn them out of their [husbands'] houses, nor should they [themselves] leave [during that period] unless they are committing a clear immorality. And those are the limits [set by] Allah. And whoever transgresses the limits of Allah has certainly wronged himself. You know not; perhaps Allah will bring about after that a [different] matter

versets.arabe: فَإِذَا بَلَغْنَ أَجَلَهُنَّ فَأَمْسِكُوهُنَّ بِمَعْرُوفٍ أَوْ فَارِقُوهُنَّ بِمَعْرُوفٍ وَأَشْهِدُوا ذَوَيْ عَدْلٍ مِّنكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Fa-idha balaghna ajalahunna fa-amsikuhunna bi-ma-rufin aw fariquhunna bi-ma-rufin wa ash-hidu dhaway adlin minkum
versets.francais: Lorsqu-elles arrivent au terme de leur délai, retenez-les convenablement ou séparez-vous d-elles convenablement. Prenez deux témoins équitables parmi vous
versets.anglais: And when they have [nearly] fulfilled their term, either retain them according to acceptable terms or part with them according to acceptable terms. And bring to witness two just men from among you and establish the testimony for [the acceptance of] Allah. That is instructed to whoever should believe in Allah and the Last day. And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out

versets.arabe: وَيَرْزُقْهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَحْتَسِبُ وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بَالِغُ أَمْرِهِ
versets.phonetique: Wa yarzuqhu min haythu la yahtasib wa man yatawakkal ala l-lahi fahuwa hasbuhu inna l-laha balighu amrih
versets.francais: Et Il lui accordera Sa subsistance d-où il ne s-y attend pas. Celui qui se confie en Allah, Il lui suffira. Allah accomplit ce qu-Il a décrété
versets.anglais: And will provide for him from where he does not expect. And whoever relies upon Allah - then He is sufficient for him. Indeed, Allah will accomplish His purpose. Allah has already set for everything a [decreed] extent

versets.arabe: وَاللَّائِي يَئِسْنَ مِنَ الْمَحِيضِ مِن نِّسَائِكُمْ إِنِ ارْتَبْتُمْ فَعِدَّتُهُنَّ ثَلَاثَةُ أَشْهُرٍ وَاللَّائِي لَمْ يَحِضْنَ
versets.phonetique: Wa l-la-i ya-isna mina l-mahidi min nisa-ikum ini rtabtum fa-iddatuhunna thalathatu ashhurin wa l-la-i lam yahidn
versets.francais: Pour celles de vos femmes qui n-espèrent plus avoir leurs règles, si vous avez un doute, leur période d-attente est de trois mois, de même pour celles qui n-ont pas encore leurs règles
versets.anglais: And those who no longer expect menstruation among your women - if you doubt, then their period is three months, and [also for] those who have not menstruated. And for those who are pregnant, their term is until they give birth. And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him of his matter ease

versets.arabe: ذَٰلِكَ أَمْرُ اللَّهِ أَنزَلَهُ إِلَيْكُمْ وَمَن يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يُكَفِّرْ عَنْهُ سَيِّئَاتِهِ وَيُعْظِمْ لَهُ أَجْرًا
versets.phonetique: Dhalika amru l-lahi anzalahu ilaykum wa man yattaqi l-laha yukaffir anhu sayyi-atihi wa yu-zim lahu ajra
versets.francais: Tel est le commandement d-Allah qu-Il vous a révélé. Celui qui craint Allah, Il effacera ses mauvaises actions et lui accordera une grande récompense
versets.anglais: That is the command of Allah, which He has sent down to you; and whoever fears Allah - He will remove for him his misdeeds and make great for him his reward

versets.arabe: أَسْكِنُوهُنَّ مِنْ حَيْثُ سَكَنتُم مِّن وُجْدِكُمْ وَلَا تُضَارُّوهُنَّ لِتُضَيِّقُوا عَلَيْهِنَّ
versets.phonetique: Askinuhunna min haythu sakantum min wujdikum wa la tudarruhunna litudayyiqu alayhinn
versets.francais: Logez-les là où vous résidez, selon vos moyens, et ne leur faites pas de tort pour les mettre dans la gêne
versets.anglais: Lodge them [in a section] of where you dwell out of your means and do not harm them in order to oppress them. And if they should be pregnant, then spend on them until they give birth. And if they breastfeed for you, then give them their payment and confer among yourselves in the acceptable way; but if you are in discord, then there may breastfeed for the father another woman

versets.arabe: لِيُنفِقْ ذُو سَعَةٍ مِّن سَعَتِهِ وَمَن قُدِرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقُهُ فَلْيُنفِقْ مِمَّا آتَاهُ اللَّهُ لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا مَا آتَاهَا
versets.phonetique: Liyunfiq dhu sa-atin min sa-atihi wa man qudira alayhi rizquhu falyunfiq mimma atahu l-lahu la yukallifu l-lahu nafsan illa ma ataha
versets.francais: Que celui qui est dans l-aisance dépense selon ses moyens. Que celui dont les ressources sont limitées dépense de ce qu-Allah lui a accordé. Allah n-impose à personne que ce qu-Il lui a donné
versets.anglais: Let a man of wealth spend from his wealth, and he whose provision is restricted - let him spend from what Allah has given him. Allah does not charge a soul except [according to] what He has given it. Allah will bring about, after hardship, ease

versets.arabe: وَكَأَيِّن مِّن قَرْيَةٍ عَتَتْ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهَا وَرُسُلِهِ فَحَاسَبْنَاهَا حِسَابًا شَدِيدًا وَعَذَّبْنَاهَا عَذَابًا نُّكْرًا
versets.phonetique: Wa ka-ayyin min qaryatin atat an amri rabbiha wa rusulihi fahasabnahaa hisaban shadidan wa adhdhabnahaa adhabhan nukra
versets.francais: Que de cités se sont rebellées contre le commandement de leur Seigneur et de Ses messagers ! Nous leur avons demandé un compte sévère et les avons châtiées d-un châtiment terrible
versets.anglais: And how many a city was insolent toward the command of its Lord and His messengers, so We took it to severe account and punished it with a terrible punishment

versets.arabe: فَذَاقَتْ وَبَالَ أَمْرِهَا وَكَانَ عَاقِبَةُ أَمْرِهَا خُسْرًا
versets.phonetique: Fadhaaqat wabala amriha wa kana aqibatu amriha khusra
versets.francais: Elles ont goûté aux funestes conséquences de leurs actes et leur fin a été la perdition
versets.anglais: And it tasted the bad consequence of its affair, and the outcome of its affair was loss

versets.arabe: أَعَدَّ اللَّهُ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا شَدِيدًا فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ يَا أُولِي الْأَلْبَابِ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا
versets.phonetique: A-adda l-lahu lahum adhaban shadidan fa-ttaqu l-laha ya uli l-albabi lladhina amanu
versets.francais: Allah leur a préparé un châtiment sévère. Craignez Allah, ô vous qui êtes doués d-intelligence et qui croyez
versets.anglais: Allah has prepared for them a severe punishment; so fear Allah, O you of understanding who have believed. Allah has sent down to you the Qur'an

versets.arabe: رَّسُولًا يَتْلُو عَلَيْكُمْ آيَاتِ اللَّهِ مُبَيِّنَاتٍ لِّيُخْرِجَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ مِنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النُّورِ
versets.phonetique: Rasulan yatlu alaykum ayati l-lahi mubayyinatin li-yukhrija lladhina amanu wa amilu s-salihati mina z-zulumati ila n-nur
versets.francais: Un messager qui vous récite les versets clarificateurs d-Allah pour faire sortir ceux qui croient et font le bien des ténèbres vers la lumière
versets.anglais: [He sent] a Messenger [Muhammad] reciting to you the distinct verses of Allah that He may bring out those who believe and do righteous deeds from darknesses into the light. And whoever believes in Allah and does righteousness - He will admit him into gardens beneath which rivers flow to abide therein forever. Allah will have perfected for him a provision

versets.arabe: اللَّهُ الَّذِي خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَاوَاتٍ وَمِنَ الْأَرْضِ مِثْلَهُنَّ يَتَنَزَّلُ الْأَمْرُ بَيْنَهُنَّ
versets.phonetique: L-lahu lladhi khalaqa sab-a samawatin wa mina l-ardi mithlahunna yatanazzalu l-amru baynahunna
versets.francais: Allah est Celui qui a créé sept cieux et autant de terres. L-ordre descend à travers eux
versets.anglais: It is Allah who has created seven heavens and of the earth, the like of them. [His] command descends among them so you may know that Allah is over all things competent and that Allah has encompassed all things in knowledge

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ لِمَ تُحَرِّمُ مَا أَحَلَّ اللَّهُ لَكَ تَبْتَغِي مَرْضَاتَ أَزْوَاجِكَ وَاللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuha n-nabiyyu lima tuharrimu ma ahalla l-lahu laka tabtaghi mardaata azwajika wa l-lahu ghafurun rahim
versets.francais: O Prophète ! Pourquoi t-interdis-tu ce qu-Allah t-a rendu licite, cherchant à plaire à tes épouses ? Allah est Pardonneur et Miséricordieux
versets.anglais: O Prophet, why do you prohibit [yourself from] what Allah has made lawful for you, seeking the approval of your wives? And Allah is Forgiving and Merciful

versets.arabe: قَدْ فَرَضَ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ تَحِلَّةَ أَيْمَانِكُمْ وَاللَّهُ مَوْلَاكُمْ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيمُ الْحَكِيمُ
versets.phonetique: Qad farada l-lahu lakum tahillata aymanikum wa l-lahu mawlakum wa huwa l-alimu l-hakim
versets.francais: Allah vous a prescrit la manière de vous acquitter de vos serments. Allah est votre Maître, Il est l-Omniscient, le Sage
versets.anglais: Allah has already ordained for you [Muslims] the dissolution of your oaths. And Allah is your protector, and He is the Knowing, the Wise

versets.arabe: وَإِذْ أَسَرَّ النَّبِيُّ إِلَىٰ بَعْضِ أَزْوَاجِهِ حَدِيثًا فَلَمَّا نَبَّأَتْ بِهِ وَأَظْهَرَهُ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ
versets.phonetique: Wa idh asarra n-nabiyyu ila ba-di azwajihi hadithan falamma nabbaat bihi wa azhara l-lahu alayh
versets.francais: Lorsque le Prophète confia un secret à l-une de ses épouses et qu-elle le divulgua, Allah l-en informa
versets.anglais: And [remember] when the Prophet confided to one of his wives a statement; and when she informed [another] of it and Allah showed it to him, he made known part of it and ignored a part. And when he informed her about it, she said, "Who told you this?" He said, "I was informed by the Knowing, the Acquainted

versets.arabe: إِن تَتُوبَا إِلَى اللَّهِ فَقَدْ صَغَتْ قُلُوبُكُمَا وَإِن تَظَاهَرَا عَلَيْهِ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ مَوْلَاهُ وَجِبْرِيلُ
versets.phonetique: In tatuba ila l-lahi faqad saghat qulubukuma wa in tazahara alayhi fa-inna l-laha huwa mawlahu wa jibril
versets.francais: Si vous vous repentez toutes les deux à Allah, vos cœurs se sont certes inclinés. Mais si vous vous liguez contre lui, Allah est son Maître ainsi que Jibril
versets.anglais: If you two [wives] repent to Allah, [it is best], for your hearts have deviated. But if you cooperate against him - then indeed Allah is his protector, and Gabriel and the righteous of the believers and the angels, moreover, are [his] assistants

versets.arabe: عَسَىٰ رَبُّهُ إِن طَلَّقَكُنَّ أَن يُبْدِلَهُ أَزْوَاجًا خَيْرًا مِّنكُنَّ مُسْلِمَاتٍ مُّؤْمِنَاتٍ قَانِتَاتٍ تَائِبَاتٍ
versets.phonetique: Asa rabbuhu in tallaqakunna an yubdilahu azwajan khayran minkunna muslimatin mu-minatin qanitatin ta-ibatin
versets.francais: Si le Prophète vous répudie, son Seigneur lui donnera peut-être en échange de meilleures épouses que vous : soumises, croyantes, obéissantes, repentantes
versets.anglais: Perhaps his Lord, if he divorced you [all], would substitute for him wives better than you - submitting [to Allah], believing, devoutly obedient, repentant, worshipping, and traveling - [ones] previously married and virgins

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا قُوا أَنفُسَكُمْ وَأَهْلِيكُمْ نَارًا وَقُودُهَا النَّاسُ وَالْحِجَارَةُ
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuha lladhina amanu qu anfusakum wa ahlikum naran waquduha n-nasu wa l-hijara
versets.francais: O croyants ! Préservez-vous, vous et vos familles, d-un Feu dont le combustible sera les hommes et les pierres
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, protect yourselves and your families from a Fire whose fuel is people and stones, over which are [appointed] angels, harsh and severe; they do not disobey Allah in what He commands them but do what they are commanded

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَا تَعْتَذِرُوا الْيَوْمَ إِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuha lladhina kafaru la ta-tadhiru l-yawma innama tujzawna ma kuntum ta-malun
versets.francais: O mécréants ! Ne vous excusez pas aujourd-hui. Vous ne serez rétribués que pour ce que vous faisiez
versets.anglais: O you who have disbelieved, make no excuses that Day. You will only be recompensed for what you used to do

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا تُوبُوا إِلَى اللَّهِ تَوْبَةً نَّصُوحًا عَسَىٰ رَبُّكُمْ أَن يُكَفِّرَ عَنكُمْ سَيِّئَاتِكُمْ
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuha lladhina amanu tubu ila l-lahi tawbatan nasuha asa rabbukum an yukaffira ankum sayyi-atikum
versets.francais: O croyants ! Repentez-vous à Allah d-un repentir sincère. Peut-être votre Seigneur effacera-t-Il vos mauvaises actions
versets.anglais: O you who have believed, repent to Allah with sincere repentance. Perhaps your Lord will remove from you your misdeeds and admit you into gardens beneath which rivers flow [on] the Day when Allah will not disgrace the Prophet and those who believed with him. Their light will proceed before them and on their right; they will say, "Our Lord, perfect for us our light and forgive us. Indeed, You are over all things competent

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ جَاهِدِ الْكُفَّارَ وَالْمُنَافِقِينَ وَاغْلُظْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَمَأْوَاهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ وَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيرُ
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuha n-nabiyyu jahidi l-kuffara wa l-munafiqina wa ghuluz alayhim wa ma-wahum jahannamu wa bi-sa l-masir
versets.francais: O Prophète ! Combats les mécréants et les hypocrites et sois dur envers eux. Leur demeure sera la Géhenne, quelle mauvaise destination
versets.anglais: O Prophet, strive against the disbelievers and the hypocrites and be harsh upon them. And their refuge is Hell, and wretched is the destination

versets.arabe: ضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلًا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا امْرَأَتَ نُوحٍ وَامْرَأَتَ لُوطٍ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَالِحَيْنِ
versets.phonetique: Daraba l-lahu mathalan lilladhina kafaru mra-ata nuhin wa mra-ata lutin kanataa tahta abdayni min ibadina salihayn
versets.francais: Allah cite en exemple pour les mécréants la femme de Noé et la femme de Lot : elles étaient sous deux de Nos serviteurs vertueux
versets.anglais: Allah presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so those prophets did not avail them from Allah at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter

versets.arabe: وَضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلًا لِّلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا امْرَأَتَ فِرْعَوْنَ إِذْ قَالَتْ رَبِّ ابْنِ لِي عِندَكَ بَيْتًا فِي الْجَنَّةِ
versets.phonetique: Wa daraba l-lahu mathalan lilladhina amanu mra-ata fir-awna idh qalat rabbi bni li indaka baytan fi l-janna
versets.francais: Allah cite en exemple pour les croyants la femme de Pharaon quand elle dit : Seigneur, construis-moi une demeure auprès de Toi au Paradis
versets.anglais: And Allah presents an example of those who believed: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, "My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people

versets.arabe: وَمَرْيَمَ ابْنَتَ عِمْرَانَ الَّتِي أَحْصَنَتْ فَرْجَهَا فَنَفَخْنَا فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِنَا وَصَدَّقَتْ بِكَلِمَاتِ رَبِّهَا وَكُتُبِهِ
versets.phonetique: Wa maryama bnat imrana llati ahsanat farjaha fanafakhna fihi min ruhina wa saddaqat bi-kalimati rabbiha wa kutubihi
versets.francais: Et Marie, fille de Imran, qui avait gardé sa chasteté. Nous avons insufflé en elle de Notre Esprit. Elle a cru aux paroles de son Seigneur et à Ses Livres
versets.anglais: And [the example of] Mary, the daughter of 'Imran, who guarded her chastity, so We blew into [her garment] through Our angel, and she believed in the words of her Lord and His scriptures and was of the devoutly obedient

versets.arabe: تَبَارَكَ الَّذِي بِيَدِهِ الْمُلْكُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
versets.phonetique: Tabaraka lladhi biyadihi l-mulku wa huwa ala kulli shay-in qadir
versets.francais: Béni soit Celui en la main de Qui est la royauté. Et Il est Omnipotent
versets.anglais: Blessed is He in whose hand is dominion, and He is over all things competent

versets.arabe: الَّذِي خَلَقَ الْمَوْتَ وَالْحَيَاةَ لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ أَيُّكُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًا وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْغَفُورُ
versets.phonetique: Alladhi khalaqa l-mawta wa l-hayata liyabluwakum ayyukum ahsanu amalan wa huwa l-azizu l-ghafur
versets.francais: Celui qui a créé la mort et la vie afin de vous éprouver. Il est le Puissant, le Pardonneur
versets.anglais: [He] who created death and life to test you [as to] which of you is best in deed - and He is the Exalted in Might, the Forgiving

versets.arabe: الَّذِي خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَاوَاتٍ طِبَاقًا مَّا تَرَىٰ فِي خَلْقِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ مِن تَفَاوُتٍ فَارْجِعِ الْبَصَرَ هَلْ تَرَىٰ مِن فُطُورٍ
versets.phonetique: Alladhi khalaqa sab-a samawatin tibaqan ma tara fi khalqi r-rahmani min tafawutin farji-i l-basara hal tara min futur
versets.francais: Celui qui a créé sept cieux superposés. Tu ne vois aucune imperfection dans la création du Tout Miséricordieux. Tourne encore ton regard : y vois-tu des failles
versets.anglais: [And] who created seven heavens in layers. You do not see in the creation of the Most Merciful any inconsistency. So return [your] vision [to the sky]; do you see any breaks

versets.arabe: ثُمَّ ارْجِعِ الْبَصَرَ كَرَّتَيْنِ يَنقَلِبْ إِلَيْكَ الْبَصَرُ خَاسِئًا وَهُوَ حَسِيرٌ
versets.phonetique: Thumma rji-i l-basara karratayni yanqalib ilayka l-basaru khasi-an wa huwa hasir
versets.francais: Puis retourne deux fois le regard : il te reviendra humilié et épuisé
versets.anglais: Then return [your] vision twice again. [Your] vision will return to you humbled while it is fatigued

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ زَيَّنَّا السَّمَاءَ الدُّنْيَا بِمَصَابِيحَ وَجَعَلْنَاهَا رُجُومًا لِّلشَّيَاطِينِ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لَهُمْ عَذَابَ السَّعِيرِ
versets.phonetique: Wa laqad zayyanna s-sama-a d-dunya bimasabiha wa ja-alnaha rujuman lish-shayatini wa a-tadna lahum adhaba s-sa-ir
versets.francais: Nous avons orné le ciel du monde de lampes, et Nous en avons fait des projectiles contre les diables
versets.anglais: And We have certainly beautified the nearest heaven with stars and have made [from] them what is thrown at the devils and have prepared for them the punishment of the Blaze

versets.arabe: وَلِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا بِرَبِّهِمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيرُ
versets.phonetique: Wa lilladhina kafaru birabbihim adhabu jahannama wa bi-sa l-masir
versets.francais: Et pour ceux qui ont mécru en leur Seigneur, il y a le châtiment de l-Enfer. Quelle mauvaise destination
versets.anglais: And for those who disbelieved in their Lord is the punishment of Hell, and wretched is the destination

versets.arabe: إِذَا أُلْقُوا فِيهَا سَمِعُوا لَهَا شَهِيقًا وَهِيَ تَفُورُ
versets.phonetique: Idha ulqu fiha sami-u laha shahiqan wa hiya tafur
versets.francais: Quand ils y seront jetés, ils entendront son mugissement tandis qu-elle bouillonnera
versets.anglais: When they are thrown into it, they hear from it a [dreadful] inhaling while it boils up

versets.arabe: تَكَادُ تَمَيَّزُ مِنَ الْغَيْظِ كُلَّمَا أُلْقِيَ فِيهَا فَوْجٌ سَأَلَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَا أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ نَذِيرٌ
versets.phonetique: Takadu tamayyazu mina l-ghayzi kullama ulqiya fiha fawjun sa-alahum khazanatuha alam ya-tikum nadhir
versets.francais: Prête à éclater de rage. Chaque fois qu-un groupe y sera jeté, ses gardiens leur demanderont : Ne vous est-il pas venu un avertisseur
versets.anglais: It almost bursts with rage. Every time a company is thrown into it, its keepers ask them, "Did there not come to you a warner

versets.arabe: قَالُوا بَلَىٰ قَدْ جَاءَنَا نَذِيرٌ فَكَذَّبْنَا وَقُلْنَا مَا نَزَّلَ اللَّهُ مِن شَيْءٍ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَالٍ كَبِيرٍ
versets.phonetique: Qalu bala qad ja-ana nadhirun fakadhdhabnna wa qulna ma nazzala l-lahu min shay-in in antum illa fi dalalin kabir
versets.francais: Ils diront : Si, un avertisseur nous est bien venu, mais nous l-avons traité de menteur. Allah n-a rien fait descendre, vous n-êtes que dans un grand égarement
versets.anglais: They will say," Yes, a warner had come to us, but we denied and said, 'Allah has not sent down anything. You are not but in great error

versets.arabe: وَقَالُوا لَوْ كُنَّا نَسْمَعُ أَوْ نَعْقِلُ مَا كُنَّا فِي أَصْحَابِ السَّعِيرِ
versets.phonetique: Wa qalu law kunna nasma-u aw na-qilu ma kunna fi ashabi s-sa-ir
versets.francais: Et ils diront : Si seulement nous avions écouté ou raisonné, nous ne serions pas parmi les gens de la Fournaise
versets.anglais: And they will say, "If only we had been listening or reasoning, we would not be among the companions of the Blaze

versets.arabe: فَاعْتَرَفُوا بِذَنبِهِمْ فَسُحْقًا لِّأَصْحَابِ السَّعِيرِ
versets.phonetique: Fa-tarafu bidhanbihim fasuhqan li-ashabi s-sa-ir
versets.francais: Ainsi ils avoueront leur péché. Loin de la miséricorde, les gens de la Fournaise
