versets.anglais: And they will admit their sin, so [it is] alienation for the companions of the Blaze

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُم بِالْغَيْبِ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَأَجْرٌ كَبِيرٌ
versets.phonetique: Inna lladhina yakhshawna rabbahum bil-ghaybi lahum maghfiratun wa ajrun kabir
versets.francais: Ceux qui craignent leur Seigneur sans Le voir auront un pardon et une grande récompense
versets.anglais: Indeed, those who fear their Lord unseen will have forgiveness and great reward

versets.arabe: وَأَسِرُّوا قَوْلَكُمْ أَوِ اجْهَرُوا بِهِ إِنَّهُ عَلِيمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ
versets.phonetique: Wa asirru qawlakum awi jharu bihi innahu alimun bidhati s-sudur
versets.francais: Que vous cachiez vos paroles ou que vous les disiez à haute voix, Il connaît le contenu des poitrines
versets.anglais: And conceal your speech or publicize it; indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts

versets.arabe: أَلَا يَعْلَمُ مَنْ خَلَقَ وَهُوَ اللَّطِيفُ الْخَبِيرُ
versets.phonetique: Ala ya-lamu man khalaqa wa huwa l-latifu l-khabir
versets.francais: Comment ne saurait-Il pas ce qu-Il a créé ? C-est Lui le Subtil, le Parfaitement Connaisseur
versets.anglais: Does He who created not know, while He is the Subtle, the Acquainted

versets.arabe: هُوَ الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْأَرْضَ ذَلُولًا فَامْشُوا فِي مَنَاكِبِهَا وَكُلُوا مِن رِّزْقِهِ وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
versets.phonetique: Huwa lladhi ja-ala lakumu l-arda dhalulan famhu fi manakibiha wa kulu min rizqihi wa ilayhi n-nushur
versets.francais: C-est Lui qui vous a rendu la terre soumise : circulez dans ses contrées et mangez de Sa subsistance. C-est vers Lui que sera la Résurrection
versets.anglais: It is He who made the earth tame for you - so walk among its slopes and eat of His provision - and to Him is the resurrection

versets.arabe: أَأَمِنتُم مَّن فِي السَّمَاءِ أَن يَخْسِفَ بِكُمُ الْأَرْضَ فَإِذَا هِيَ تَمُورُ
versets.phonetique: A-amintum man fi s-sama-i an yakhsifa bikumu l-arda fa-idha hiya tamur
versets.francais: Êtes-vous à l-abri de Celui qui est dans le ciel, s-Il vous enfonçait en terre alors qu-elle se met à trembler
versets.anglais: Do you feel secure that He who [holds authority] in the heaven would not cause the earth to swallow you and suddenly it would sway

versets.arabe: أَمْ أَمِنتُم مَّن فِي السَّمَاءِ أَن يُرْسِلَ عَلَيْكُمْ حَاصِبًا فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ كَيْفَ نَذِيرِ
versets.phonetique: Am amintum man fi s-sama-i an yursila alaykum hasiban fasata-lamuna kayfa nadhir
versets.francais: Ou bien êtes-vous à l-abri de Celui qui est dans le ciel, s-Il envoyait contre vous un ouragan ? Vous saurez alors comment est Mon avertissement
versets.anglais: Or do you feel secure that He who [holds authority] in the heaven would not send against you a storm of stones? Then you would know how [severe] was My warning

versets.arabe: وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ
versets.phonetique: Wa laqad kadhdhaba lladhina min qablihim fakayfa kana nakir
versets.francais: Certes, ceux qui les ont précédés ont aussi démenti. Et comment fut Ma réprobation
versets.anglais: And already had those before them denied, and how [terrible] was My reproach

versets.arabe: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا إِلَى الطَّيْرِ فَوْقَهُمْ صَافَّاتٍ وَيَقْبِضْنَ مَا يُمْسِكُهُنَّ إِلَّا الرَّحْمَٰنُ إِنَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ بَصِيرٌ
versets.phonetique: Awa lam yaraw ila t-tayri fawqahum saffatin wa yaqbidna ma yumsikuhunna illa r-rahmanu innahu bikulli shay-in basir
versets.francais: N-ont-ils pas observé les oiseaux au-dessus d-eux déployant leurs ailes et les repliant ? Nul autre que le Tout Miséricordieux ne les retient
versets.anglais: Do they not see the birds above them with wings outspread and [sometimes] folded in? None holds them [aloft] except the Most Merciful. Indeed He is, of all things, Seeing

versets.arabe: أَمَّنْ هَٰذَا الَّذِي هُوَ جُندٌ لَّكُمْ يَنصُرُكُم مِّن دُونِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ إِنِ الْكَافِرُونَ إِلَّا فِي غُرُورٍ
versets.phonetique: Amman hadha lladhi huwa jundun lakum yansurukum min duni r-rahmani ini l-kafiruna illa fi ghurur
versets.francais: Quel est celui qui pourrait être une armée pour vous en dehors du Tout Miséricordieux ? Les mécréants ne sont que dans l-illusion
versets.anglais: Or who is it that could be an army for you to aid you other than the Most Merciful? The disbelievers are not but in delusion

versets.arabe: أَمَّنْ هَٰذَا الَّذِي يَرْزُقُكُمْ إِنْ أَمْسَكَ رِزْقَهُ بَل لَّجُّوا فِي عُتُوٍّ وَنُفُورٍ
versets.phonetique: Amman hadha lladhi yarzuqukum in amsaka rizqahu bal lajju fi utuwwin wa nufur
versets.francais: Quel est celui qui pourrait vous nourrir si Allah retenait Sa subsistance ? Non, ils s-obstinent dans l-arrogance
versets.anglais: Or who is it that could provide for you if He withheld His provision? But they have persisted in insolence and aversion

versets.arabe: أَفَمَن يَمْشِي مُكِبًّا عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِ أَهْدَىٰ أَمَّن يَمْشِي سَوِيًّا عَلَىٰ صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
versets.phonetique: Afaman yamshi mukibban ala wajhihi ahda amman yamshi sawiyyan ala siratin mustaqim
versets.francais: Celui qui marche la tête penchée vers le sol est-il mieux guidé que celui qui marche droit sur un chemin rectiligne
versets.anglais: Then is one who walks fallen on his face better guided or one who walks erect on a straight path

versets.arabe: قُلْ هُوَ الَّذِي أَنشَأَكُمْ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ السَّمْعَ وَالْأَبْصَارَ وَالْأَفْئِدَةَ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qul huwa lladhi ansha-akum wa ja-ala lakumu s-sam-a wa l-absara wa l-af-idata qalilan ma tashkurun
versets.francais: Dis : C-est Lui qui vous a créés et vous a donné l-ouïe, les yeux et les coeurs. Mais que vous êtes peu reconnaissants
versets.anglais: Say, "It is He who has produced you and made for you hearing and vision and hearts; little are you grateful

versets.arabe: قُلْ هُوَ الَّذِي ذَرَأَكُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qul huwa lladhi dhara-akum fi l-ardi wa ilayhi tuhsharun
versets.francais: Dis : C-est Lui qui vous a répandus sur la terre, et c-est vers Lui que vous serez rassemblés
versets.anglais: Say, "It is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered

versets.arabe: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا الْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَادِقِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa yaquluna mata hadha l-wa-du in kuntum sadiqin
versets.francais: Et ils disent : Quand sera réalisée cette promesse, si vous êtes véridiques
versets.anglais: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful

versets.arabe: قُلْ إِنَّمَا الْعِلْمُ عِندَ اللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَا أَنَا نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
versets.phonetique: Qul innama l-ilmu inda l-lahi wa innama ana nadhirun mubin
versets.francais: Dis : La connaissance n-appartient qu-à Allah. Je ne suis qu-un avertisseur explicite
versets.anglais: Say, "The knowledge is only with Allah, and I am only a clear warner

versets.arabe: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ زُلْفَةً سِيئَتْ وُجُوهُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَقِيلَ هَٰذَا الَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِ تَدَّعُونَ
versets.phonetique: Falamma ra-awhu zulfatan si-at wujuhu lladhina kafaru wa qila hadha lladhi kuntum bihi tadda-un
versets.francais: Puis quand ils le verront tout proche, les visages des mécréants se rembroniront. Et on leur dira : C-est cela que vous réclamiez
versets.anglais: But when they see it approaching, the faces of those who disbelieve will be distressed, and it will be said, "This is that for which you used to call

versets.arabe: قُلْ أَرَأَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَهْلَكَنِيَ اللَّهُ وَمَن مَّعِيَ أَوْ رَحِمَنَا فَمَن يُجِيرُ الْكَافِرِينَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
versets.phonetique: Qul ara-aytum in ahlakaniya l-lahu wa man ma-iya aw rahimana faman yujiru l-kafirana min adhabin alim
versets.francais: Dis : Qu-Allah me fasse mourir ainsi que ceux qui sont avec moi, ou qu-Il nous fasse miséricorde, qui donc protégera les mécréants d-un châtiment douloureux
versets.anglais: Say, [O Muhammad], "Have you considered: whether Allah should cause my death and those with me or have mercy upon us, who can protect the disbelievers from a painful punishment

versets.arabe: قُلْ هُوَ الرَّحْمَٰنُ آمَنَّا بِهِ وَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ فِي ضَلَالٍ مُّبِينٍ
versets.phonetique: Qul huwa r-rahmanu amanna bihi wa alayhi tawakkalna fasata-lamuna man huwa fi dalalin mubin
versets.francais: Dis : C-est le Tout Miséricordieux en qui nous croyons et en qui nous plaçons notre confiance. Vous saurez bientôt qui est dans un égarement manifeste
versets.anglais: Say, "He is the Most Merciful; we have believed in Him, and upon Him we have relied. And you will [come to] know who it is that is in clear error

versets.arabe: قُلْ أَرَأَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَصْبَحَ مَاؤُكُمْ غَوْرًا فَمَن يَأْتِيكُم بِمَاءٍ مَّعِينٍ
versets.phonetique: Qul ara-aytum in asbaha ma-ukum ghawran faman ya-tikum bima-in ma-in
versets.francais: Dis : Si votre eau s-enfonçait dans la terre, qui donc vous apporterait une eau de source
versets.anglais: Say, "Have you considered: if your water was to become sunken [into the earth], then who could bring you flowing water

versets.arabe: ن وَالْقَلَمِ وَمَا يَسْطُرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Nun wa l-qalami wa ma yasturun
versets.francais: Nun. Par le calame et ce qu-ils écrivent
versets.anglais: Nun. By the pen and what they inscribe

versets.arabe: مَا أَنتَ بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ بِمَجْنُونٍ
versets.phonetique: Ma anta bi-ni-mati rabbika bi-majnun
versets.francais: Tu n-es pas, grâce à la faveur de ton Seigneur, un insensé
versets.anglais: You are not, [O Muhammad], by the favor of your Lord, a madman

versets.arabe: وَإِنَّ لَكَ لَأَجْرًا غَيْرَ مَمْنُونٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa inna laka la-ajran ghayra mamnun
versets.francais: Tu auras une récompense sans fin
versets.anglais: And indeed, for you is a reward uninterrupted

versets.arabe: وَإِنَّكَ لَعَلَىٰ خُلُقٍ عَظِيمٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa innaka la-ala khuluqin azim
versets.francais: Tu es certes d-une moralité sublime
versets.anglais: And indeed, you are of a great moral character

versets.arabe: فَسَتُبْصِرُ وَيُبْصِرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Fasatubsiru wa yubsirun
versets.francais: Tu verras et ils verront
versets.anglais: So you will see and they will see

versets.arabe: بِأَييِّكُمُ الْمَفْتُونُ
versets.phonetique: Bi-ayyikumu l-maftun
versets.francais: Lequel d-entre vous est atteint de folie
versets.anglais: Which of you is the afflicted [by a devil]

versets.arabe: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِالْمُهْتَدِينَ
versets.phonetique: Inna rabbaka huwa a-lamu bi-man dalla an sabilihi wa huwa a-lamu bi l-muhtadin
versets.francais: Ton Seigneur sait mieux qui s-est égaré de Sa voie et Il connaît mieux les bien guidés
versets.anglais: Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who has gone astray from His way, and He is most knowing of the [rightly] guided

versets.arabe: فَلَا تُطِعِ الْمُكَذِّبِينَ
versets.phonetique: Fala tuti-i l-mukadhdhibın
versets.francais: N-obéis donc pas aux démenteurs
versets.anglais: Then do not obey the deniers

versets.arabe: وَدُّوا لَوْ تُدْهِنُ فَيُدْهِنُونَ
versets.phonetique: Waddu law tudhinu fayudhinun
versets.francais: Ils aimeraient que tu transiges pour qu-ils transigent
versets.anglais: They wish that you would soften [in your position], so they would soften [toward you]

versets.arabe: وَلَا تُطِعْ كُلَّ حَلَّافٍ مَّهِينٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa la tuti- kulla hallafin mahin
versets.francais: N-obéis pas à tout grand jureur méprisable
versets.anglais: And do not obey every worthless habitual swearer

versets.arabe: هَمَّازٍ مَّشَّاءٍ بِنَمِيمٍ
versets.phonetique: Hammazin masha-in bi-namim
versets.francais: Qui calomnie beaucoup et colporte les commérages
versets.anglais: [And] scorner, going about with malicious gossip

versets.arabe: مَّنَّاعٍ لِّلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
versets.phonetique: Manna-in lil-khayri mu-tadin athim
versets.francais: Qui entrave le bien, transgresseur et pécheur
versets.anglais: A preventer of good, transgressing and sinful

versets.arabe: عُتُلٍّ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ زَنِيمٍ
versets.phonetique: Utulli ba-da dhalika zanim
versets.francais: Grossier et par-dessus tout de naissance illégitime
versets.anglais: Cruel, moreover, and an illegitimate pretender

versets.arabe: أَن كَانَ ذَا مَالٍ وَبَنِينَ
versets.phonetique: An kana dha malin wa banın
versets.francais: Parce qu-il possède des biens et des enfants
versets.anglais: Because he is a possessor of wealth and children

versets.arabe: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ آيَاتُنَا قَالَ أَسَاطِيرُ الْأَوَّلِينَ
versets.phonetique: Idha tutla alayhi ayatuna qala asatiru l-awwalin
versets.francais: Quand Nos versets lui sont récités, il dit : Ce sont des légendes des anciens
versets.anglais: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples

versets.arabe: سَنَسِمُهُ عَلَى الْخُرْطُومِ
versets.phonetique: Sanasımuhu ala l-khurtum
versets.francais: Nous le marquerons sur le museau
versets.anglais: We will brand him upon the snout

versets.arabe: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَاهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَا أَصْحَابَ الْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
versets.phonetique: Inna balawnahum kama balawna ashaba l-jannati idh aqsamu la-yasrimunnaha musbihın
versets.francais: Nous les avons éprouvés comme Nous avons éprouvé les propriétaires du jardin quand ils jurèrent de le cueillir dès le matin
versets.anglais: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning

versets.arabe: وَلَا يَسْتَثْنُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa la yastathınun
versets.francais: Sans faire d-exception
versets.anglais: Without making exception

versets.arabe: فَطَافَ عَلَيْهَا طَائِفٌ مِّن رَّبِّكَ وَهُمْ نَائِمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Fatafa alayha ta-ifun min rabbika wa hum na-imun
versets.francais: Un fléau de ton Seigneur fit le tour du jardin tandis qu-ils dormaient
versets.anglais: So there came upon the garden an affliction from your Lord while they were asleep

versets.arabe: فَأَصْبَحَتْ كَالصَّرِيمِ
versets.phonetique: Fa-asbahаt ka s-sarim
versets.francais: Et au matin il était comme calciné
versets.anglais: And it became as though reaped

versets.arabe: فَتَنَادَوْا مُصْبِحِينَ
versets.phonetique: Fatanadaw musbihın
versets.francais: Le matin, ils s-appelèrent les uns les autres
versets.anglais: And they called one another at morning

versets.arabe: أَنِ اغْدُوا عَلَىٰ حَرْثِكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَارِمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Ani ghdu ala harthikum in kuntum sarimın
versets.francais: Partez tôt vers votre champ si vous voulez cueillir
versets.anglais: [Saying], "Go early to your crop if you would cut the fruit

versets.arabe: فَانطَلَقُوا وَهُمْ يَتَخَافَتُونَ
versets.phonetique: Fantalaqu wa hum yatakhafatun
versets.francais: Ils partirent en se chuchotant
versets.anglais: So they set out, while lowering their voices

versets.arabe: أَن لَّا يَدْخُلَنَّهَا الْيَوْمَ عَلَيْكُم مِّسْكِينٌ
versets.phonetique: An la yadkhulannaha l-yawma alaykum miskın
versets.francais: Qu-aucun pauvre n-entre aujourd-hui chez vous
versets.anglais: [Saying], "There will surely not enter it today upon you [any] poor person

versets.arabe: وَغَدَوْا عَلَىٰ حَرْدٍ قَادِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa ghadaw ala hardin qadirın
versets.francais: Ils partirent tôt déterminés à être avares
versets.anglais: And they went early in determination, [assuming themselves] able

versets.arabe: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهَا قَالُوا إِنَّا لَضَالُّونَ
versets.phonetique: Falamma ra-awha qalu inna la-dallun
versets.francais: Quand ils le virent, ils dirent : Nous nous sommes égarés
versets.anglais: But when they saw it, they said, "Indeed, we are lost

versets.arabe: بَلْ نَحْنُ مَحْرُومُونَ
versets.phonetique: Bal nahnu mahrumun
versets.francais: Bien plus, nous sommes privés
versets.anglais: Rather, we have been deprived

versets.arabe: قَالَ أَوْسَطُهُمْ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكُمْ لَوْلَا تُسَبِّحُونَ
versets.phonetique: Qala awsatuhum alam aqul lakum lawla tusabbihun
versets.francais: Le plus raisonnable d-entre eux dit : Ne vous avais-je pas dit de glorifier Allah
versets.anglais: The most moderate of them said, "Did I not say to you, 'Why do you not exalt [Allah]

versets.arabe: قَالُوا سُبْحَانَ رَبِّنَا إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَالِمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qalu subhana rabbına inna kunna zalimın
versets.francais: Ils dirent : Gloire à notre Seigneur ! Nous étions vraiment des injustes
versets.anglais: They said, "Exalted is our Lord! Indeed, we were wrongdoers

versets.arabe: فَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَلَاوَمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Fa-aqbala ba-duhum ala ba-din yatalawamun
versets.francais: Ils se retournèrent alors les uns vers les autres en se reprochant mutuellement
versets.anglais: Then they approached one another, blaming each other

versets.arabe: قَالُوا يَا وَيْلَنَا إِنَّا كُنَّا طَاغِينَ
versets.phonetique: Qalu ya waylana inna kunna taghın
versets.francais: Ils dirent : Malheur à nous ! Nous étions vraiment des rebelles
versets.anglais: They said, "O woe to us; indeed we were transgressors

versets.arabe: عَسَىٰ رَبُّنَا أَن يُبْدِلَنَا خَيْرًا مِّنْهَا إِنَّا إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا رَاغِبُونَ
versets.phonetique: Asa rabbuna an yubdalana khayran minha inna ila rabbina raghıbun
versets.francais: Peut-être notre Seigneur nous donnera-t-il en échange un meilleur. Nous nous tournons vers notre Seigneur
versets.anglais: Perhaps our Lord will substitute for us [one] better than it. Indeed, we are toward our Lord desirous

versets.arabe: كَذَٰلِكَ الْعَذَابُ وَلَعَذَابُ الْآخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ لَوْ كَانُوا يَعْلَمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Kadhalika l-adhab wa la-adhab l-akhirati akbar law kanu ya-lamun
versets.francais: Tel est le châtiment. Le châtiment de l-au-delà est certes plus grand, si seulement ils savaient
versets.anglais: Such is the punishment [of this world]. And the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew

versets.arabe: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّاتِ النَّعِيمِ
versets.phonetique: Inna lil-muttaqına inda rabbihim jannati n-na-im
versets.francais: Les pieux auront auprès de leur Seigneur les Jardins des délices
versets.anglais: Indeed, for the righteous with their Lord are the Gardens of Pleasure

versets.arabe: أَفَنَجْعَلُ الْمُسْلِمِينَ كَالْمُجْرِمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Afanaj-alu l-muslimına ka l-mujrimın
versets.francais: Allons-Nous traiter les soumis comme les criminels
versets.anglais: Then will We treat the Muslims like the criminals

versets.arabe: مَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Ma lakum kayfa tahkumun
versets.francais: Qu-avez-vous ? Comment jugez-vous
versets.anglais: What is [the matter] with you? How do you judge

versets.arabe: أَمْ لَكُمْ كِتَابٌ فِيهِ تَدْرُسُونَ
versets.phonetique: Am lakum kitabun fihi tadrusun
versets.francais: Avez-vous un Livre dans lequel vous étudiez
versets.anglais: Or do you have a scripture in which you learn

versets.arabe: إِنَّ لَكُمْ فِيهِ لَمَا تَخَيَّرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Inna lakum fihi lama takhayyarun
versets.francais: Que vous y trouverez ce que vous choisissez
versets.anglais: That indeed for you is whatever you choose

versets.arabe: أَمْ لَكُمْ أَيْمَانٌ عَلَيْنَا بَالِغَةٌ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ إِنَّ لَكُمْ لَمَا تَحْكُمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Am lakum aymanun alayna balighatun ila yawmi l-qiyamati inna lakum lama tahkumun
versets.francais: Ou avez-vous des serments sur Nous valables jusqu-au Jour de la Résurrection que vous aurez ce que vous décrétez
versets.anglais: Or do you have oaths [binding] upon Us, extending until the Day of Resurrection, that indeed for you is whatever you judge

versets.arabe: سَلْهُمْ أَيُّهُم بِذَٰلِكَ زَعِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Salhum ayyuhum bi-dhalika za-im
versets.francais: Demande-leur lequel d-entre eux en est garant
versets.anglais: Ask them which of them, for that [claim], is responsible

versets.arabe: أَمْ لَهُمْ شُرَكَاءُ فَلْيَأْتُوا بِشُرَكَائِهِمْ إِن كَانُوا صَادِقِينَ
versets.phonetique: Am lahum shuraka-u falyatu bi-shuraka-ihim in kanu sadiqın
versets.francais: Ou ont-ils des associés ? Qu-ils amènent donc leurs associés si ils sont véridiques
versets.anglais: Or do they have partners? Then let them bring their partners, if they should be truthful

versets.arabe: يَوْمَ يُكْشَفُ عَن سَاقٍ وَيُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى السُّجُودِ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ
versets.phonetique: Yawma yukshafu an saqin wa yud-awna ila s-sujudi fala yasratiun
versets.francais: Le jour où on découvrira la jambe et qu-on les invitera à se prosterner mais ils ne pourront pas
versets.anglais: The Day the shin will be uncovered and they are invited to prostration but the disbelievers will not be able

versets.arabe: خَاشِعَةً أَبْصَارُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ وَقَدْ كَانُوا يُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى السُّجُودِ وَهُمْ سَالِمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Khashi-atan absaruhum tarhaquhum dhillatun wa qad kanu yud-awna ila s-sujudi wa hum salimun
versets.francais: Les regards baissés, l-humiliation les couvrira. Ils étaient pourtant invités à la prosternation alors qu-ils étaient sains
versets.anglais: Their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. And they used to be invited to prostration while they were sound

versets.arabe: فَذَرْنِي وَمَن يُكَذِّبُ بِهَٰذَا الْحَدِيثِ سَنَسْتَدْرِجُهُم مِّنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Fadharni wa man yukadhdhibu bi-hadha l-hadıthi sanastadrijuhum min haythu la ya-lamun
versets.francais: Laisse-Moi avec celui qui dément ce discours. Nous les amènerons progressivement à leur perte sans qu-ils s-en rendent compte
versets.anglais: So leave Me, [O Muhammad], with [the matter of] whoever denies the Qur'an. We will progressively lead them [to punishment] from where they do not know

versets.arabe: وَأُمْلِي لَهُمْ إِنَّ كَيْدِي مَتِينٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa umli lahum inna kaydi matin
versets.francais: Je leur accorde un délai. Mon stratagème est solide
versets.anglais: And I will give them time. Indeed, My plan is firm

versets.arabe: أَمْ تَسْأَلُهُمْ أَجْرًا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍ مُّثْقَلُونَ
versets.phonetique: Am tas-aluhum ajran fahum min maghraMin muthqalun
versets.francais: Leur demandes-tu une rémunération qui les accablerait d-une dette
versets.anglais: Or do you ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down

versets.arabe: أَمْ عِندَهُمُ الْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
versets.phonetique: Am indahumu l-ghaybu fahum yaktubun
versets.francais: Ou ont-ils accès à l-invisible et l-écrivent-ils
versets.anglais: Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down

versets.arabe: فَاصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تَكُن كَصَاحِبِ الْحُوتِ إِذْ نَادَىٰ وَهُوَ مَكْظُومٌ
versets.phonetique: Fasbir li-hukmi rabbika wa la takun ka-sahibi l-huti idh nada wa huwa makzum
versets.francais: Sois patient face au jugement de ton Seigneur et ne sois pas comme le compagnon de la baleine qui appela alors qu-il était oppressé
versets.anglais: Then be patient for the decision of your Lord, [O Muhammad], and be not like the companion of the fish when he called out while he was distressed

versets.arabe: لَّوْلَا أَن تَدَارَكَهُ نِعْمَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِ لَنُبِذَ بِالْعَرَاءِ وَهُوَ مَذْمُومٌ
versets.phonetique: Lawla an tadarakahu ni-matun min rabbihi lanubidha bi l-ara-i wa huwa madhmum
versets.francais: Si une grâce de son Seigneur ne l-avait atteint, il aurait été jeté en plein désert dans un état de blâme
versets.anglais: If not that a favor from his Lord overtook him, he would have been thrown onto the naked shore while he was censured

versets.arabe: فَاجْتَبَاهُ رَبُّهُ فَجَعَلَهُ مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ
versets.phonetique: Fajtabahu rabbuhu faja-alahu mina s-salihın
versets.francais: Mais son Seigneur le choisit et le mit au nombre des vertueux
versets.anglais: And his Lord chose him and made him of the righteous

versets.arabe: وَإِن يَكَادُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَيُزْلِقُونَكَ بِأَبْصَارِهِمْ لَمَّا سَمِعُوا الذِّكْرَ
versets.phonetique: Wa in yakadu lladhına kafaru layuzliqunaka bi-absarihim lamma sami-u dh-dhikr
versets.francais: Les mécréants faillirent te foudroyer du regard quand ils entendirent le Coran
versets.anglais: And indeed, those who disbelieve would almost make you slip with their eyes when they hear the message, and they say, "Indeed, he is mad

versets.arabe: وَيَقُولُونَ إِنَّهُ لَمَجْنُونٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa yaquluna innahu la-majnun
versets.francais: Et ils disent : Il est vraiment fou
versets.anglais: But it is not except a reminder to the worlds

versets.arabe: الْحَاقَّةُ
versets.phonetique: Al-haqqah
versets.francais: La Réalité Inévitable
versets.anglais: The Inevitable Reality

versets.arabe: مَا الْحَاقَّةُ
versets.phonetique: Ma l-haqqah
versets.francais: Qu'est-ce que la Réalité Inévitable ?
versets.anglais: What is the Inevitable Reality

versets.arabe: وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا الْحَاقَّةُ
versets.phonetique: Wa ma adraka ma l-haqqah
versets.francais: Et qui te fera connaître ce qu'est la Réalité Inévitable ?
versets.anglais: And what can make you know what is the Inevitable Reality

versets.arabe: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ وَعَادٌ بِالْقَارِعَةِ
versets.phonetique: Kadhdhabat thamud wa adun bi-l-qari-ah
versets.francais: Thamoud et 'Aad ont démenti le Fracas
versets.anglais: Thamud and 'Aad denied the Striking Calamity

versets.arabe: فَأَمَّا ثَمُودُ فَأُهْلِكُوا بِالطَّاغِيَةِ
versets.phonetique: Fa-amma thamud fa-uhlik u bi-t-taghiyah
versets.francais: Quant à Thamoud, ils furent détruits par le Fracas excessif
versets.anglais: So as for Thamud, they were destroyed by the overpowering [blast]

versets.arabe: وَأَمَّا عَادٌ فَأُهْلِكُوا بِرِيحٍ صَرْصَرٍ عَاتِيَةٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa amma adun fa-uhlik u bi-rihin sarsarin atiyah
versets.francais: Et 'Aad furent détruits par un vent violent et déchaîné
versets.anglais: And as for 'Aad, they were destroyed by a screaming, violent wind

versets.arabe: سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَبْعَ لَيَالٍ وَثَمَانِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُومًا فَتَرَى الْقَوْمَ فِيهَا صَرْعَىٰ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ خَاوِيَةٍ
versets.phonetique: Sakhkhara-ha alayhim sab-a layalin wa thamaniyata ayyamin husumar-fata-ra l-qawma fiha sar-a ka-annahum ajazu nakhlin khawiyah
versets.francais: Il les soumit pendant sept nuits et huit jours consécutifs. Tu y aurais vu les gens gisant, comme des troncs de palmiers creusés
versets.anglais: Which Allah imposed upon them for seven nights and eight days in succession, so you would see the people therein fallen as if they were hollow trunks of palm trees

versets.arabe: فَهَلْ تَرَىٰ لَهُم مِّن بَاقِيَةٍ
versets.phonetique: Fa-hal tara lahum min baqiyah
versets.francais: En vois-tu encore un seul survivant ?
versets.anglais: Then do you see of them any remains

versets.arabe: وَجَاءَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَن قَبْلَهُ وَالْمُؤْتَفِكَاتُ بِالْخَاطِئَةِ
versets.phonetique: Wa ja-a fir-awnu wa man qablahu wa l-mu-tafikatu bi-l-khati-ah
versets.francais: Pharaon et ceux qui vinrent avant lui, et les cités renversées, commirent le péché
versets.anglais: And there came Pharaoh and those before him and the overturned cities with sin

versets.arabe: فَعَصَوْا رَسُولَ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَهُمْ أَخْذَةً رَّابِيَةً
versets.phonetique: Fa-asaw rasula rabbihim fa-akhadhahum akdhatan rabiyah
versets.francais: Ils désobéirent au messager de leur Seigneur, et Il les saisit d'une saisie sévère
versets.anglais: And they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with a seizure exceeding [in severity]

versets.arabe: إِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَا الْمَاءُ حَمَلْنَاكُمْ فِي الْجَارِيَةِ
versets.phonetique: Inna lamma tagha l-ma-u hamalnakum fi l-jariyah
versets.francais: Quand l'eau déborda, Nous vous avons portés dans le vaisseau qui voguait
versets.anglais: Indeed, when the water overflowed, We carried your ancestors in the sailing ship

versets.arabe: لِنَجْعَلَهَا لَكُمْ تَذْكِرَةً وَتَعِيَهَا أُذُنٌ وَاعِيَةٌ
versets.phonetique: Li-naj-alaha lakum tadhkiratan wa ta-iyaha udhunun wa-iyah
versets.francais: Pour en faire pour vous un rappel, et qu'une oreille attentive le retienne
versets.anglais: That We might make it for you a reminder and [that] a conscious ear would be conscious of it

versets.arabe: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِي الصُّورِ نَفْخَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ
versets.phonetique: Fa-idha nufikha fi s-suri nafkhatun wahidah
versets.francais: Quand on soufflera dans la Trompe un seul souffle
versets.anglais: Then when the Horn is blown with one blast

versets.arabe: وَحُمِلَتِ الْأَرْضُ وَالْجِبَالُ فَدُكَّتَا دَكَّةً وَاحِدَةً
versets.phonetique: Wa humilati l-ardu wa l-jibalu fa-dukketa dakkatan wahidah
versets.francais: Et que la terre et les montagnes seront soulevées et écrasées d'un seul coup
versets.anglais: And the earth and the mountains are lifted and leveled with one blow

versets.arabe: فَيَوْمَئِذٍ وَقَعَتِ الْوَاقِعَةُ
versets.phonetique: Fa-yawma-idhin waqa-ati l-waqi-ah
versets.francais: Ce jour-là, l'Événement aura lieu
versets.anglais: Then on that Day, the Resurrection will occur

versets.arabe: وَانشَقَّتِ السَّمَاءُ فَهِيَ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَاهِيَةٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa nshaqqati s-sama-u fa-hiya yawma-idhin wahiyah
versets.francais: Le ciel se fendra et sera ce jour-là très fragile
versets.anglais: And the heaven will split [open], for that Day it is infirm

versets.arabe: وَالْمَلَكُ عَلَىٰ أَرْجَائِهَا وَيَحْمِلُ عَرْشَ رَبِّكَ فَوْقَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ ثَمَانِيَةٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa l-malaku ala arja-iha wa yahmilu arsha rabbika fawqahum yawma-idhin thamaniyah
versets.francais: Les anges seront à ses bords. En ce jour, huit d'entre eux porteront le Trône de ton Seigneur au-dessus d'eux
versets.anglais: And the angels are at its edges. And there will bear the Throne of your Lord above them, that Day, eight [of them]

versets.arabe: يَوْمَئِذٍ تُعْرَضُونَ لَا تَخْفَىٰ مِنكُمْ خَافِيَةٌ
versets.phonetique: Yawma-idhin tu-raduna la takhfa minkum khafiyah
versets.francais: En ce jour, vous serez exhibés et aucun de vos secrets ne sera caché
versets.anglais: That Day, you will be exhibited [for judgement]; not hidden among you is anything concealed

versets.arabe: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِيَ كِتَابَهُ بِيَمِينِهِ فَيَقُولُ هَاؤُمُ اقْرَءُوا كِتَابِيَهْ
versets.phonetique: Fa-amma man utiya kitabahu bi-yaminih fa-yaqulu ha-umu qra-u kitabiyah
versets.francais: Quant à celui qui recevra son livre de la droite, il dira : Prenez, lisez mon livre !
versets.anglais: So as for he who is given his record in his right hand, he will say, "Here, read my record

versets.arabe: إِنِّي ظَنَنتُ أَنِّي مُلَاقٍ حِسَابِيَهْ
versets.phonetique: Inni zannantu anni mulaqin hisabiyah
versets.francais: J'étais sûr que j'allais rencontrer mon compte
versets.anglais: Indeed, I was certain that I would be meeting my account

versets.arabe: فَهُوَ فِي عِيشَةٍ رَّاضِيَةٍ
versets.phonetique: Fa-huwa fi ishatin radiyah
versets.francais: Il sera dans une vie agréable
versets.anglais: So he will be in a pleasant life

versets.arabe: فِي جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍ
versets.phonetique: Fi jannatin aliyah
versets.francais: Dans un Jardin élevé
versets.anglais: In an elevated garden

versets.arabe: قُطُوفُهَا دَانِيَةٌ
versets.phonetique: Qutufuha daniyah
versets.francais: Dont les fruits sont à portée de main
versets.anglais: Its [fruit] to be picked hanging near

versets.arabe: كُلُوا وَاشْرَبُوا هَنِيئًا بِمَا أَسْلَفْتُمْ فِي الْأَيَّامِ الْخَالِيَةِ
versets.phonetique: Kulu wa shrabu hani-an bi-ma aslaftum fi l-ayyami l-khaliyah
versets.francais: Mangez et buvez agréablement, pour ce que vous avez accompli dans les jours passés
versets.anglais: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you put forth in the days past

versets.arabe: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِيَ كِتَابَهُ بِشِمَالِهِ فَيَقُولُ يَا لَيْتَنِي لَمْ أُوتَ كِتَابِيَهْ
versets.phonetique: Wa amma man utiya kitabahu bi-shimalihi fa-yaqulu ya laytani lam uta kitabiyah
versets.francais: Quant à celui qui recevra son livre de la gauche, il dira : Hélas ! Si seulement on ne m'avait pas remis mon livre !
versets.anglais: But as for he who is given his record in his left hand, he will say, "Oh, I wish I had not been given my record

versets.arabe: وَلَمْ أَدْرِ مَا حِسَابِيَهْ
versets.phonetique: Wa lam adri ma hisabiyah
versets.francais: Et que je n'avais pas connu mon compte !
versets.anglais: And had not known what is my account

versets.arabe: يَا لَيْتَهَا كَانَتِ الْقَاضِيَةَ
versets.phonetique: Ya laytaha kanati l-qadiyah
versets.francais: Ah ! Si seulement c'était la mort définitive !
versets.anglais: I wish my death had been the decisive one

versets.arabe: مَا أَغْنَىٰ عَنِّي مَالِيَهْ
versets.phonetique: Ma aghna anni maliyah
versets.francais: Ma richesse ne m'a servi à rien !
versets.anglais: My wealth has not availed me

versets.arabe: هَلَكَ عَنِّي سُلْطَانِيَهْ
versets.phonetique: Halaka anni sultaniyah
versets.francais: Mon pouvoir s'est évanoui !
versets.anglais: Gone from me is my authority

versets.arabe: خُذُوهُ فَغُلُّوهُ
versets.phonetique: Khudhuh fa-ghulluh
versets.francais: Saisissez-le et enchaînez-le !
versets.anglais: [Allah will say], "Seize him and shackle him

versets.arabe: ثُمَّ الْجَحِيمَ صَلُّوهُ
versets.phonetique: Thumma l-jahima sallu-h
versets.francais: Puis faites-le brûler dans la Fournaise !
versets.anglais: Then into Hellfire drive him

versets.arabe: ثُمَّ فِي سِلْسِلَةٍ ذَرْعُهَا سَبْعُونَ ذِرَاعًا فَاسْلُكُوهُ
versets.phonetique: Thumma fi silsilatin dhar-uha sab-una dhira-an fa-slukuh
versets.francais: Puis dans une chaîne de soixante-dix coudées, passez-le !
versets.anglais: Then into a chain whose length is seventy cubits insert him

versets.arabe: إِنَّهُ كَانَ لَا يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ
versets.phonetique: Innahu kana la yu-minu bi-llahi l-adhim
versets.francais: Car il ne croyait pas en Allah le Très Grand
versets.anglais: Indeed, he did not used to believe in Allah, the Most Great

versets.arabe: وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ الْمِسْكِينِ
versets.phonetique: Wa la yahuddu ala ta-ami l-miskin
versets.francais: Et n'encourageait pas à nourrir le pauvre
versets.anglais: Nor did he encourage the feeding of the poor

versets.arabe: فَلَيْسَ لَهُ الْيَوْمَ هَاهُنَا حَمِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Fa-laysa lahu l-yawma ha-huna hamim
versets.francais: Il n'a donc aujourd'hui ici aucun ami proche
versets.anglais: So there is not for him here this Day any devoted friend

versets.arabe: وَلَا طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِنْ غِسْلِينٍ
versets.phonetique: Wa la ta-amun illa min ghislin
versets.francais: Ni aucune nourriture sauf le pus
versets.anglais: Nor any food except from the discharge of wounds

versets.arabe: لَّا يَأْكُلُهُ إِلَّا الْخَاطِئُونَ
versets.phonetique: La ya-kuluhu illa l-khati-un
versets.francais: Que les pécheurs ne mangent pas
versets.anglais: None will eat it except the sinners

versets.arabe: فَلَا أُقْسِمُ بِمَا تُبْصِرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Fa-la uqsimu bi-ma tubsirun
versets.francais: Je jure par ce que vous voyez
versets.anglais: So I swear by what you see

versets.arabe: وَمَا لَا تُبْصِرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa ma la tubsirun
versets.francais: Et par ce que vous ne voyez pas
versets.anglais: And what you do not see

versets.arabe: إِنَّهُ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍ كَرِيمٍ
versets.phonetique: Innahu la-qawlu rasulin karim
versets.francais: Que c'est la parole d'un noble messager
versets.anglais: [That] indeed, the Qur'an is the word of a noble Messenger

versets.arabe: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَاعِرٍ قَلِيلًا مَّا تُؤْمِنُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa ma huwa bi-qawli sha-irin qalilan ma tu-minun
versets.francais: Et non la parole d'un poète — que peu vous croyez !
versets.anglais: And it is not the word of a poet; little do you believe

versets.arabe: وَلَا بِقَوْلِ كَاهِنٍ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa la bi-qawli kahinin qalilan ma tadhakkarun
versets.francais: Ni la parole d'un devin — que peu vous vous rappelez !
versets.anglais: Nor the word of a soothsayer; little do you remember

versets.arabe: تَنزِيلٌ مِّن رَّبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
versets.phonetique: Tanzilun min rabbi l-alamin
versets.francais: Une révélation du Seigneur des mondes
versets.anglais: [It is] a revelation from the Lord of the worlds

versets.arabe: وَلَوْ تَقَوَّلَ عَلَيْنَا بَعْضَ الْأَقَاوِيلِ
versets.phonetique: Wa law taqawwala alayna ba-da l-aqawil
versets.francais: S'il avait inventé contre Nous quelques paroles
versets.anglais: And if Muhammad had made up about Us some [false] sayings

versets.arabe: لَأَخَذْنَا مِنْهُ بِالْيَمِينِ
versets.phonetique: La-akhadhna minhu bi-l-yamin
versets.francais: Nous lui aurions saisi la main droite
versets.anglais: We would have seized him by the right hand

versets.arabe: ثُمَّ لَقَطَعْنَا مِنْهُ الْوَتِينَ
versets.phonetique: Thumma laqata-na minhu l-watin
versets.francais: Puis Nous lui aurions tranché la veine du cœur
versets.anglais: Then We would have cut from him the aorta

versets.arabe: فَمَا مِنكُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ عَنْهُ حَاجِزِينَ
versets.phonetique: Fa-ma minkum min ahadin anhu hajizin
versets.francais: Et nul d'entre vous n'aurait pu Nous en empêcher
versets.anglais: And there is no one of you who could prevent [Us] from him

versets.arabe: وَإِنَّهُ لَتَذْكِرَةٌ لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa innahu la-tadhkiratun li-l-muttaqin
versets.francais: C'est un rappel pour les pieux
versets.anglais: And indeed, the Qur'an is a reminder for the righteous

versets.arabe: وَإِنَّا لَنَعْلَمُ أَنَّ مِنكُم مُّكَذِّبِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa inna la-na-lamu anna minkum mukadhdhibin
versets.francais: Et Nous savons qu'il y a parmi vous des démenteurs
versets.anglais: And indeed, We know that among you are deniers

versets.arabe: وَإِنَّهُ لَحَسْرَةٌ عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ
versets.phonetique: Wa innahu la-hasratun ala l-kafirin
versets.francais: Et c'est un regret pour les mécréants
versets.anglais: And indeed, it will be [a cause of] regret upon the disbelievers

versets.arabe: وَإِنَّهُ لَحَقُّ الْيَقِينِ
versets.phonetique: Wa innahu la-haqqu l-yaqin
versets.francais: Et c'est la pure vérité
versets.anglais: And indeed, it is the truth of certainty

versets.arabe: فَسَبِّحْ بِاسْمِ رَبِّكَ الْعَظِيمِ
versets.phonetique: Fa-sabbih bi-smi rabbika l-adhim
versets.francais: Glorifie le nom de ton Seigneur le Très Grand
versets.anglais: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great

versets.arabe: سَأَلَ سَائِلٌ بِعَذَابٍ وَاقِعٍ
versets.phonetique: Sa-ala sa-ilun bi-adhabin waqi-
versets.francais: Un demandeur a demandé un châtiment qui s-abattra
versets.anglais: A supplicant asked for a punishment bound to happen

versets.arabe: لِّلْكَافِرِينَ لَيْسَ لَهُ دَافِعٌ
versets.phonetique: Lil-kafirına laysa lahu dafi-
versets.francais: Sur les mécréants, contre lequel il n-y a pas de défense
versets.anglais: To the disbelievers; of it there is no preventer

versets.arabe: مِّنَ اللَّهِ ذِي الْمَعَارِجِ
versets.phonetique: Mina l-lahi dhi l-ma-arij
versets.francais: Venant d-Allah, Maître des voies d-ascension
versets.anglais: [It is] from Allah, owner of the ways of ascent

versets.arabe: تَعْرُجُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ وَالرُّوحُ إِلَيْهِ فِي يَوْمٍ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُ خَمْسِينَ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ
versets.phonetique: Ta-ruju l-mala-ikatu wa r-ruhu ilayhi fi yawmin kana miqdaruhu khamsına alfa sana
versets.francais: Les anges et l-Esprit montent vers Lui en un jour dont la durée est de cinquante mille ans
versets.anglais: The angels and the Spirit will ascend to Him during a Day the extent of which is fifty thousand years

versets.arabe: فَاصْبِرْ صَبْرًا جَمِيلًا
versets.phonetique: Fasbir sabran jamila
versets.francais: Sois donc patient d-une belle patience
versets.anglais: So be patient with gracious patience

versets.arabe: إِنَّهُمْ يَرَوْنَهُ بَعِيدًا
versets.phonetique: Innahum yarawnahuبعيدا ba-ida
versets.francais: Ils le voient lointain
versets.anglais: Indeed, they see it [as] distant

versets.arabe: وَنَرَاهُ قَرِيبًا
versets.phonetique: Wa naraahu qariba
versets.francais: Et Nous le voyons proche
versets.anglais: But We see it [as] near

versets.arabe: يَوْمَ تَكُونُ السَّمَاءُ كَالْمُهْلِ
versets.phonetique: Yawma takunu s-sama-u ka l-muhl
versets.francais: Le jour où le ciel sera comme du métal en fusion
versets.anglais: On the Day the sky will be like murky oil

versets.arabe: وَتَكُونُ الْجِبَالُ كَالْعِهْنِ
versets.phonetique: Wa takunu l-jibalu ka l-ihn
versets.francais: Et les montagnes comme de la laine
versets.anglais: And the mountains will be like wool

versets.arabe: وَلَا يَسْأَلُ حَمِيمٌ حَمِيمًا
versets.phonetique: Wa la yas-alu hamimun hamima
versets.francais: Aucun ami proche ne s-enquerra d-un ami proche
versets.anglais: And no friend will ask [anything of] a friend

versets.arabe: يُبَصَّرُونَهُمْ يَوَدُّ الْمُجْرِمُ لَوْ يَفْتَدِي مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمِئِذٍ بِبَنِيهِ
versets.phonetique: Yubassarunahum yawaddu l-mujrimu law yaftadi min adhabi yawma-idhin bibanıh
versets.francais: On se les montrera mutuellement. Le criminel voudrait se racheter du châtiment de ce jour en donnant ses fils
versets.anglais: They will be shown each other. The criminal will wish that he could be ransomed from the punishment of that Day by his children

versets.arabe: وَصَاحِبَتِهِ وَأَخِيهِ
versets.phonetique: Wa sahibatihi wa akhih
versets.francais: Et sa femme et son frère
versets.anglais: And his wife and his brother

versets.arabe: وَفَصِيلَتِهِ الَّتِي تُؤْوِيهِ
versets.phonetique: Wa fasilatıhi llatı tu-wıh
versets.francais: Et sa famille qui le protégeait
versets.anglais: And his nearest kindred who shelter him

versets.arabe: وَمَن فِي الْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ يُنجِيهِ
versets.phonetique: Wa man fi l-ardi jami-an thumma yunjıh
versets.francais: Et tous ceux qui sont sur terre, pourvu qu-il soit sauvé
versets.anglais: And whoever is on earth entirely [so] then it could save him

versets.arabe: كَلَّا إِنَّهَا لَظَىٰ
versets.phonetique: Kalla innaha laza
versets.francais: Certes non ! Ce sera la Flamme
versets.anglais: No! Indeed, it is the Flame [of Hell]

versets.arabe: نَزَّاعَةً لِّلشَّوَىٰ
versets.phonetique: Nazza-atan li sh-shawa
versets.francais: Qui arrachera le cuir chevelu
versets.anglais: A remover of exteriors

versets.arabe: تَدْعُو مَنْ أَدْبَرَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
versets.phonetique: Tad-u man adbara wa tawalla
versets.francais: Elle appellera celui qui a tourné le dos et s-est détourné
versets.anglais: It invites he who turned his back [on truth] and went away [from obedience]

versets.arabe: وَجَمَعَ فَأَوْعَىٰ
versets.phonetique: Wa jama-a fa-aw-a
versets.francais: Et qui a amassé puis thésaurisé
versets.anglais: And collected [wealth] and hoarded

versets.arabe: إِنَّ الْإِنسَانَ خُلِقَ هَلُوعًا
versets.phonetique: Inna l-insana khuliqa halu-a
versets.francais: L-homme a vraiment été créé impatient
versets.anglais: Indeed, mankind was created anxious

versets.arabe: إِذَا مَسَّهُ الشَّرُّ جَزُوعًا
versets.phonetique: Idha massahu sh-sharru jazu-a
versets.francais: Quand le mal le touche, il est anxieux
versets.anglais: When evil touches him, impatient

versets.arabe: وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ الْخَيْرُ مَنُوعًا
versets.phonetique: Wa idha massahu l-khayru manu-a
versets.francais: Et quand le bien le touche, il est avare
versets.anglais: And when good touches him, withholding [of it]

versets.arabe: إِلَّا الْمُصَلِّينَ
versets.phonetique: Illa l-musallin
versets.francais: Sauf ceux qui font la prière
versets.anglais: Except the observers of prayer

versets.arabe: الَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ دَائِمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Lladhina hum ala salatihim da-imun
versets.francais: Ceux qui sont assidus à leur prière
versets.anglais: Those who are constant in their prayer

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ فِي أَمْوَالِهِمْ حَقٌّ مَّعْلُومٌ
versets.phonetique: Wa lladhına fi amwalihim haqqun ma-lum
versets.francais: Et ceux dans les biens desquels il y a une part connue
versets.anglais: And those within whose wealth is a known right

versets.arabe: لِّلسَّائِلِ وَالْمَحْرُومِ
versets.phonetique: Li s-sa-ili wa l-mahrum
versets.francais: Pour le mendiant et le privé
versets.anglais: For the petitioner and the deprived

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ يُصَدِّقُونَ بِيَوْمِ الدِّينِ
versets.phonetique: Wa lladhına yusaddiquna bi-yawmi d-din
versets.francais: Et ceux qui croient au Jour du Jugement
versets.anglais: And those who believe in the Day of Recompense

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ هُم مِّنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّهِم مُّشْفِقُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa lladhına hum min adhabi rabbihim mushfiqun
versets.francais: Et ceux qui craignent le châtiment de leur Seigneur
versets.anglais: And those who are fearful of the punishment of their Lord

versets.arabe: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّهِمْ غَيْرُ مَأْمُونٍ
versets.phonetique: Inna adhaba rabbihim ghayru ma-mun
versets.francais: Car le châtiment de leur Seigneur n-est pas à l-abri
versets.anglais: Indeed, the punishment of their Lord is not that from which one is safe

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ لِفُرُوجِهِمْ حَافِظُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa lladhına hum li-furujihim hafizun
versets.francais: Et ceux qui gardent leur chasteté
versets.anglais: And those who guard their private parts

versets.arabe: إِلَّا عَلَىٰ أَزْوَاجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ
versets.phonetique: Illa ala azwajihim aw ma malakat aymanuhum fa-innahum ghayru malumın
versets.francais: Sauf avec leurs épouses ou leurs esclaves — car là ils ne sont pas blâmables
versets.anglais: Except from their wives or those their right hands possess, for indeed, they are not to be blamed

versets.arabe: فَمَنِ ابْتَغَىٰ وَرَاءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُولَٰئِكَ هُمُ الْعَادُونَ
versets.phonetique: Faman ibtagha wara-a dhalika fa-ula-ika humu l-adun
versets.francais: Ceux qui cherchent au-delà de cela, ce sont les transgresseurs
versets.anglais: But whoever seeks beyond that, then they are the transgressors

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ لِأَمَانَاتِهِمْ وَعَهْدِهِمْ رَاعُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa lladhına hum li-amanatihim wa ahdihim ra-un
versets.francais: Et ceux qui respectent leurs dépôts et leurs engagements
versets.anglais: And those who are to their trusts and promises attentive

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ هُم بِشَهَادَاتِهِمْ قَائِمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa lladhına hum bi-shahadatihim qa-imun
versets.francais: Et ceux qui tiennent leurs témoignages
versets.anglais: And those who are in their testimonies upright

versets.arabe: وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ
versets.phonetique: Wa lladhına hum ala salatihim yuhafizun
versets.francais: Et ceux qui observent scrupuleusement leur prière
versets.anglais: And those who [carefully] maintain their prayer

versets.arabe: أُولَٰئِكَ فِي جَنَّاتٍ مُّكْرَمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Ula-ika fi jannatin mukramun
versets.francais: Ceux-là seront dans des jardins, honorés
versets.anglais: They will be in gardens, honored

versets.arabe: فَمَالِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا قِبَلَكَ مُهْطِعِينَ
versets.phonetique: Famali lladhına kafaru qibalaka muhtı-ın
versets.francais: Qu-ont-ils donc ceux qui mécroient à courir vers toi
versets.anglais: So what is [the matter] with those who disbelieve, hastening [from] before you, [O Muhammad]

versets.arabe: عَنِ الْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ الشِّمَالِ عِزِينَ
versets.phonetique: Ani l-yamını wa ani sh-shimali izın
versets.francais: De droite et de gauche, par groupes
versets.anglais: [To sit] on [your] right and [your] left in separate groups

versets.arabe: أَيَطْمَعُ كُلُّ امْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُدْخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعِيمٍ
versets.phonetique: Ayatma-u kullu imri-in minhum an yudkhala jannata na-im
versets.francais: Chacun d-eux espère-t-il entrer dans le Jardin des délices
versets.anglais: Does every person among them aspire to enter a garden of pleasure

versets.arabe: كَلَّا إِنَّا خَلَقْنَاهُم مِّمَّا يَعْلَمُونَ
versets.phonetique: Kalla inna khalaqnahum mimma ya-lamun
versets.francais: Certes non ! Nous les avons créés de ce qu-ils savent
versets.anglais: No! Indeed, We have created them from that which they know

versets.arabe: فَلَا أُقْسِمُ بِرَبِّ الْمَشَارِقِ وَالْمَغَارِبِ إِنَّا لَقَادِرُونَ
versets.phonetique: Fala uqsimu bi-rabbi l-mashariqı wa l-magharibı inna la-qadırun
versets.francais: Non ! Je jure par le Seigneur des Orients et des Occidents que Nous sommes certes capables
versets.anglais: So I swear by the Lord of [all] risings and settings that indeed We are able

versets.arabe: عَلَىٰ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ خَيْرًا مِّنْهُمْ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ
versets.phonetique: Ala an nubaddila khayran minhum wa ma nahnu bi-masbukın
versets.francais: De les remplacer par de meilleurs qu-eux et nous ne sommes pas surpassés
versets.anglais: To replace them with better than them; and We are not to be outdone

versets.arabe: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوا وَيَلْعَبُوا حَتَّىٰ يُلَاقُوا يَوْمَهُمُ الَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ
versets.phonetique: Fadhar-hum yakhudhu wa yal-abu hatta yulaqu yawmahumu lladhi yu-adun
versets.francais: Laisse-les donc s-agiter et jouer jusqu-à ce qu-ils rencontrent leur jour qui leur est promis
versets.anglais: So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised

versets.arabe: يَوْمَ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ الْأَجْدَاثِ سِرَاعًا كَأَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ نُصُبٍ يُوفِضُونَ
versets.phonetique: Yawma yakhrujuna mina l-ajdathi sira-an ka-annahum ila nusubin yufidun
versets.francais: Le jour où ils sortiront des tombes en hâte, comme s-ils se précipitaient vers des idoles
versets.anglais: The Day they will emerge from the graves rapidly as if they were, toward an erected idol, hastening

versets.arabe: خَاشِعَةً أَبْصَارُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ ذَٰلِكَ الْيَوْمُ الَّذِي كَانُوا يُوعَدُونَ
versets.phonetique: Khashi-atan absaruhum tarhaquhum dhillatun dhalika l-yawmu lladhi kanu yu-adun
versets.francais: Les regards baissés, l-humiliation les couvrira. Voilà le jour qui leur était promis
versets.anglais: Their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. That is the Day which they had been promised

versets.arabe: إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِ أَنْ أَنذِرْ قَوْمَكَ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
versets.phonetique: Inna arsalna nuhan ila qawmihi an andhir qawmaka min qabli an ya-tiyahum adhabun alim
versets.francais: Nous avons envoyé Noé à son peuple : Avertis ton peuple avant qu-un douloureux châtiment ne leur vienne
versets.anglais: Indeed, We sent Noah to his people, [saying], "Warn your people before there comes to them a painful punishment

versets.arabe: قَالَ يَا قَوْمِ إِنِّي لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
versets.phonetique: Qala ya qawmi inni lakum nadhirun mubin
versets.francais: Il dit : Ô mon peuple ! Je suis pour vous un avertisseur explicite
versets.anglais: He said, "O my people, indeed I am to you a clear warner

versets.arabe: أَنِ اعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ وَاتَّقُوهُ وَأَطِيعُونِ
versets.phonetique: Ani buduu l-laha wa ttaquhu wa ati-un
versets.francais: Adorez Allah, craignez-Le et obéissez-moi
versets.anglais: [Saying], 'Worship Allah, fear Him and obey me

versets.arabe: يَغْفِرْ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُؤَخِّرْكُمْ إِلَىٰ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى إِنَّ أَجَلَ اللَّهِ إِذَا جَاءَ لَا يُؤَخَّرُ
versets.phonetique: Yaghfir lakum min dhunubikum wa yu-akhkhirkum ila ajalin musamman inna ajala l-lahi idha ja-a la yu-akhkhar
versets.francais: Il vous pardonnera vos péchés et vous accordera un délai jusqu-à un terme fixé. Le terme d-Allah, quand il arrive, ne peut être repoussé
versets.anglais: Allah will forgive you of your sins and delay you for a specified term. Indeed, the time [set by] Allah, when it comes, will not be delayed, if you only knew

versets.arabe: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّي دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِي لَيْلًا وَنَهَارًا
versets.phonetique: Qala rabbi inni da-awtu qawmi laylan wa nahara
versets.francais: Il dit : Seigneur, j-ai appelé mon peuple nuit et jour
versets.anglais: He said, "My Lord, indeed I invited my people [to truth] night and day

versets.arabe: فَلَمْ يَزِدْهُمْ دُعَائِي إِلَّا فِرَارًا
versets.phonetique: Falam yazid-hum du-a-i illa firara
versets.francais: Mais mon appel ne leur a fait qu-augmenter leur fuite
versets.anglais: But my invitation increased them not except in flight

versets.arabe: وَإِنِّي كُلَّمَا دَعَوْتُهُمْ لِتَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ جَعَلُوا أَصَابِعَهُمْ فِي آذَانِهِمْ وَاسْتَغْشَوْا ثِيَابَهُمْ
versets.phonetique: Wa inni kullama da-awtuhum litaghfira lahum ja-alu asabi-ahum fi adhanihim wa staghashu thiyabahum
versets.francais: Chaque fois que je les ai appelés pour que Tu leur pardonnes, ils ont mis leurs doigts dans leurs oreilles, se sont couverts de leurs vêtements
versets.anglais: And indeed, every time I invited them that You may forgive them, they put their fingers in their ears, covered themselves with their garments, persisted, and were arrogant with [great] arrogance

versets.arabe: ثُمَّ إِنِّي دَعَوْتُهُمْ جِهَارًا
versets.phonetique: Thumma inni da-awtuhum jihara
versets.francais: Puis je les ai appelés ouvertement
versets.anglais: Then I invited them publicly

versets.arabe: ثُمَّ إِنِّي أَعْلَنتُ لَهُمْ وَأَسْرَرْتُ لَهُمْ إِسْرَارًا
versets.phonetique: Thumma inni a-lantu lahum wa asrartu lahum israra
versets.francais: Puis je leur ai fait des annonces publiques et des confidences secrètes
versets.anglais: Then I announced to them and [also] confided to them secretly

versets.arabe: فَقُلْتُ اسْتَغْفِرُوا رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّهُ كَانَ غَفَّارًا
versets.phonetique: Faqultu staghfiru rabbakum innahu kana ghaffara
versets.francais: Et j-ai dit : Implorez le pardon de votre Seigneur. Il est certes Grand Pardonneur
versets.anglais: And said, 'Ask forgiveness of your Lord. Indeed, He is ever a Perpetual Forgiver

versets.arabe: يُرْسِلِ السَّمَاءَ عَلَيْكُم مِّدْرَارًا
versets.phonetique: Yursili s-sama-a alaykum midrara
versets.francais: Il vous enverra du ciel une pluie abondante
versets.anglais: He will send [rain from] the sky upon you in [continuing] showers

versets.arabe: وَيُمْدِدْكُم بِأَمْوَالٍ وَبَنِينَ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ جَنَّاتٍ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ أَنْهَارًا
versets.phonetique: Wa yumdidkum bi-amwalin wa banina wa yaj-al lakum jannatin wa yaj-al lakum anhara
versets.francais: Il vous accordera des biens et des enfants, vous fera des jardins et vous fera des rivières
versets.anglais: And give you increase in wealth and children and provide for you gardens and provide for you rivers

versets.arabe: مَّا لَكُمْ لَا تَرْجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَارًا
versets.phonetique: Ma lakum la tarjuna lillahi waqara
versets.francais: Qu-avez-vous à ne pas espérer en la grandeur d-Allah
versets.anglais: What is [the matter] with you that you do not attribute to Allah [due] grandeur

versets.arabe: وَقَدْ خَلَقَكُمْ أَطْوَارًا
versets.phonetique: Wa qad khalaqakum atwara
versets.francais: Alors qu-Il vous a créés en différentes étapes
versets.anglais: While He has created you in stages

versets.arabe: أَلَمْ تَرَوْا كَيْفَ خَلَقَ اللَّهُ سَبْعَ سَمَاوَاتٍ طِبَاقًا
versets.phonetique: Alam taraw kayfa khalaqa l-lahu sab-a samawatin tibaq
versets.francais: N-avez-vous pas vu comment Allah a créé sept cieux superposés
versets.anglais: Do you not consider how Allah has created seven heavens in layers

versets.arabe: وَجَعَلَ الْقَمَرَ فِيهِنَّ نُورًا وَجَعَلَ الشَّمْسَ سِرَاجًا
versets.phonetique: Wa ja-ala l-qamara fihinna nuran wa ja-ala sh-shamsa siraja
versets.francais: Et y a placé la lune comme lumière et le soleil comme lampe
versets.anglais: And made the moon therein a [reflected] light and made the sun a burning lamp

versets.arabe: وَاللَّهُ أَنبَتَكُم مِّنَ الْأَرْضِ نَبَاتًا
versets.phonetique: Wa l-lahu anbatakum mina l-ardi nabata
versets.francais: Allah vous a fait pousser de la terre comme une plante
versets.anglais: And Allah has caused you to grow from the earth a [progressive] growth

versets.arabe: ثُمَّ يُعِيدُكُمْ فِيهَا وَيُخْرِجُكُمْ إِخْرَاجًا
versets.phonetique: Thumma yu-idukum fiha wa yukhrijukum ikhraja
versets.francais: Puis Il vous y fera retourner et vous en fera sortir de nouveau
versets.anglais: Then He will return you into it and extract you [another] extraction

versets.arabe: وَاللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْأَرْضَ بِسَاطًا
versets.phonetique: Wa l-lahu ja-ala lakumu l-arda bisata
versets.francais: Allah a fait de la terre un tapis pour vous
versets.anglais: And Allah has made for you the earth an expanse

versets.arabe: لِتَسْلُكُوا مِنْهَا سُبُلًا فِجَاجًا
versets.phonetique: Litasluku minha subulan fijaja
versets.francais: Afin que vous empruntiez ses chemins spacieux
versets.anglais: That you may follow therein roads of passage

versets.arabe: قَالَ نُوحٌ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِي وَاتَّبَعُوا مَن لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُ وَوَلَدُهُ إِلَّا خَسَارًا
versets.phonetique: Qala nuhun rabbi innahum asawni wa ttaba-u man lam yazidhu maluhu wa waladuhu illa khasara
versets.francais: Noé dit : Seigneur, ils m-ont désobéi et ont suivi celui dont les richesses et les enfants n-ont fait qu-augmenter la perdition
versets.anglais: Noah said, "My Lord, indeed they have disobeyed me and followed him whose wealth and children will not increase him except in loss

versets.arabe: وَمَكَرُوا مَكْرًا كُبَّارًا
versets.phonetique: Wa makaru makran kubbara
versets.francais: Et ils ont ourdi un immense complot
versets.anglais: And they conspired an immense conspiracy

versets.arabe: وَقَالُوا لَا تَذَرُنَّ آلِهَتَكُمْ وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدًّا وَلَا سُوَاعًا وَلَا يَغُوثَ وَيَعُوقَ وَنَسْرًا
versets.phonetique: Wa qalu la tadharунна aليهatakum wa la tadharунна waddан wa la suwa-an wa la yaghуtha wa ya-uqa wa nasra
versets.francais: Et ils ont dit : N-abandonnez jamais vos divinités : ni Wadd, ni Suwa, ni Yaghuth, Ya-uq et Nasr
versets.anglais: And said, 'Never leave your gods and never leave Wadd or Suwa' or Yaghuth and Ya'uq and Nasr

versets.arabe: وَقَدْ أَضَلُّوا كَثِيرًا وَلَا تَزِدِ الظَّالِمِينَ إِلَّا ضَلَالًا
versets.phonetique: Wa qad adallu kathiran wa la tazidi z-zalimina illa dalala
versets.francais: Ils ont égaré beaucoup de monde. Ne fais qu-augmenter l-égarement des injustes
versets.anglais: And already they have misled many. And, [my Lord], do not increase the wrongdoers except in error

versets.arabe: مِّمَّا خَطِيئَاتِهِمْ أُغْرِقُوا فَأُدْخِلُوا نَارًا فَلَمْ يَجِدُوا لَهُم مِّن دُونِ اللَّهِ أَنصَارًا
versets.phonetique: Mimma khati-atihim ughriquu fa-udkhilu naran falam yajidu lahum min duni l-lahi ansara
versets.francais: À cause de leurs péchés ils ont été noyés et introduits dans le Feu. Ils n-ont trouvé pour eux aucun protecteur en dehors d-Allah
versets.anglais: Because of their sins they were drowned and put into the Fire, and they found not for themselves besides Allah [any] helpers

versets.arabe: وَقَالَ نُوحٌ رَّبِّ لَا تَذَرْ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ مِنَ الْكَافِرِينَ دَيَّارًا
versets.phonetique: Wa qala nuhun rabbi la tadhar ala l-ardi mina l-kafirина dayyara
versets.francais: Noé dit : Seigneur, ne laisse sur terre aucun habitant parmi les mécréants
versets.anglais: And Noah said, "My Lord, do not leave upon the earth from among the disbelievers an inhabitant

versets.arabe: إِنَّكَ إِن تَذَرْهُمْ يُضِلُّوا عِبَادَكَ وَلَا يَلِدُوا إِلَّا فَاجِرًا كَفَّارًا
versets.phonetique: Innaka in tadhar-hum yudillu ibadaka wa la yalidu illa fajiran kaffara
versets.francais: Si Tu les laisses, ils égareront Tes serviteurs et n-enfanteront que des dépravés mécréants
versets.anglais: Indeed, if You leave them, they will mislead Your servants and not beget except [every] wicked one and [confirmed] disbeliever

versets.arabe: رَّبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيْتِيَ مُؤْمِنًا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ
versets.phonetique: Rabbi ghfir li wa li-walidayya wa li-man dakhala baytiya mu-minan wa lil-mu-minina wa l-mu-minat
versets.francais: Seigneur, pardonne-moi, à mes parents, à quiconque entre dans ma maison en croyant, aux croyants et aux croyantes
versets.anglais: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house a believer and the believing men and believing women. And do not increase the wrongdoers except in destruction

versets.arabe: قُلْ أُوحِيَ إِلَيَّ أَنَّهُ اسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌ مِّنَ الْجِنِّ فَقَالُوا إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْآنًا عَجَبًا
versets.phonetique: Qul uhiya ilayya annahu stama-a nafarun mina l-jinni faqalu inna sami-na qur-anan ajaba
versets.francais: Dis : Il m-a été révélé qu-un groupe de djinns a écouté et dit : Nous avons entendu un Coran admirable
versets.anglais: Say, [O Muhammad], "It has been revealed to me that a group of the jinn listened and said, 'Indeed, we have heard an amazing Qur'an

versets.arabe: يَهْدِي إِلَى الرُّشْدِ فَآمَنَّا بِهِ وَلَن نُّشْرِكَ بِرَبِّنَا أَحَدًا
versets.phonetique: Yahdi ila r-rushdi fa-amanna bihi wa lan nushrika bi-rabbina ahada
versets.francais: Il guide vers la bonne voie. Nous y avons cru et nous n-associerons jamais personne à notre Seigneur
versets.anglais: It guides to the right course, and we have believed in it. And we will never associate with our Lord anyone

versets.arabe: وَأَنَّهُ تَعَالَىٰ جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا اتَّخَذَ صَاحِبَةً وَلَا وَلَدًا
versets.phonetique: Wa annahu ta-ala jaddu rabbina ma ttakhadha sahibatan wa la walada
versets.francais: La Majesté de notre Seigneur est exaltée. Il n-a pris ni compagne ni enfant
versets.anglais: And [it teaches] that exalted is the nobleness of our Lord; He has not taken a wife or a son

versets.arabe: وَأَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ سَفِيهُنَا عَلَى اللَّهِ شَطَطًا
versets.phonetique: Wa annahu kana yaqulu safihuna ala l-lahi shatata
versets.francais: Notre insensé disait des contre-vérités sur Allah
versets.anglais: And that our foolish one has been saying about Allah an excessive transgression

versets.arabe: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّا أَن لَّن تَقُولَ الْإِنسُ وَالْجِنُّ عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا
versets.phonetique: Wa anna zananna an lan taqula l-insu wa l-jinnu ala l-lahi kadhiba
versets.francais: Nous pensions que les humains et les djinns ne mentiraient jamais sur Allah
versets.anglais: And we had thought that mankind and the jinn would never speak about Allah a lie

versets.arabe: وَأَنَّهُ كَانَ رِجَالٌ مِّنَ الْإِنسِ يَعُوذُونَ بِرِجَالٍ مِّنَ الْجِنِّ فَزَادُوهُمْ رَهَقًا
versets.phonetique: Wa annahu kana rijalun mina l-insi ya-udhuna bi-rijanin mina l-jinni fazaduhum rahaqan
versets.francais: Des hommes parmi les humains cherchaient refuge auprès d-hommes parmi les djinns, ce qui ne faisait qu-augmenter leur égarement
versets.anglais: And there were men from mankind who sought refuge in men from the jinn, so they [only] increased them in burden

versets.arabe: وَأَنَّهُمْ ظَنُّوا كَمَا ظَنَنتُمْ أَن لَّن يَبْعَثَ اللَّهُ أَحَدًا
versets.phonetique: Wa annahum zannu kama zanantum an lan yab-atha l-lahu ahada
versets.francais: Et ils pensaient, comme vous pensiez, qu-Allah ne ressusciterait personne
versets.anglais: And they had thought, as you thought, that Allah would never send anyone [as a messenger]

versets.arabe: وَأَنَّا لَمَسْنَا السَّمَاءَ فَوَجَدْنَاهَا مُلِئَتْ حَرَسًا شَدِيدًا وَشُهُبًا
versets.phonetique: Wa anna lamassa s-sama-a fawajadnaha muli-at harasan shadidan wa shuhuba
versets.francais: Nous avons exploré le ciel et l-avons trouvé rempli de gardiens vigoureux et de météores
versets.anglais: And we have sought [to reach] the heaven but found it filled with powerful guards and burning flames

versets.arabe: وَأَنَّا كُنَّا نَقْعُدُ مِنْهَا مَقَاعِدَ لِلسَّمْعِ فَمَن يَسْتَمِعِ الْآنَ يَجِدْ لَهُ شِهَابًا رَّصَدًا
versets.phonetique: Wa anna kunna naq-udu minha maqa-ida li-s-sam-i faman yastami-i l-ana yajid lahu shihaban rasada
versets.francais: Nous occupions des postes d-écoute. Maintenant quiconque écoute trouve un météore en embuscade
versets.anglais: And we used to sit therein in positions for hearing, but whoever listens now will find a burning flame lying in wait for him

versets.arabe: وَأَنَّا لَا نَدْرِي أَشَرٌّ أُرِيدَ بِمَن فِي الْأَرْضِ أَمْ أَرَادَ بِهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ رَشَدًا
versets.phonetique: Wa anna la nadri a-sharrun urida bi-man fi l-ardi am arada bihim rabbuhum rashada
versets.francais: Nous ne savons pas si un malheur est voulu pour les habitants de la terre, ou si leur Seigneur veut pour eux un bienfait
versets.anglais: And we do not know [therefore] whether evil is intended for those on earth or whether their Lord intends for them a right course

versets.arabe: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا الصَّالِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ كُنَّا طَرَائِقَ قِدَدًا
versets.phonetique: Wa anna minna s-salihuna wa minna duna dhalika kunna tara-iqa qidada
versets.francais: Parmi nous certains sont vertueux et d-autres ne le sont pas. Nous étions de tendances diverses
versets.anglais: And among us are the righteous, and among us are [others] not so; we were [of] divided ways

versets.arabe: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّا أَن لَّن نُّعْجِزَ اللَّهَ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَن نُّعْجِزَهُ هَرَبًا
versets.phonetique: Wa anna zananna an lan nu-jiza l-laha fi l-ardi wa lan nu-jizahu haraba
versets.francais: Nous pensions que nous ne pourrions jamais réduire Allah à l-impuissance sur terre et nous ne pourrions pas Lui échapper par la fuite
versets.anglais: And we have become certain that we will never cause failure to Allah upon earth, nor can we escape Him by flight

versets.arabe: وَأَنَّا لَمَّا سَمِعْنَا الْهُدَىٰ آمَنَّا بِهِ فَمَن يُؤْمِن بِرَبِّهِ فَلَا يَخَافُ بَخْسًا وَلَا رَهَقًا
versets.phonetique: Wa anna lamma sami-na l-huda amanna bihi faman yu-min bi-rabbihi fala yakhаfu bakhsan wa la rahaqа
versets.francais: Lorsque nous avons entendu le guide nous y avons cru. Celui qui croit en son Seigneur ne craindra ni lésion ni injustice
versets.anglais: And when we heard the guidance, we believed in it. And whoever believes in his Lord will not fear deprivation or burden

versets.arabe: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا الْمُسْلِمُونَ وَمِنَّا الْقَاسِطُونَ فَمَنْ أَسْلَمَ فَأُولَٰئِكَ تَحَرَّوْا رَشَدًا
versets.phonetique: Wa anna minna l-muslimuna wa minna l-qasituna faman aslama fa-ula-ika taharraw rashada
versets.francais: Parmi nous certains sont soumis et d-autres sont injustes. Ceux qui se soumettent ont choisi la bonne voie
versets.anglais: And among us are Muslims [in submission to Allah], and among us are the unjust. And whoever has become Muslim - those have sought out the right course

versets.arabe: وَأَمَّا الْقَاسِطُونَ فَكَانُوا لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَبًا
versets.phonetique: Wa amma l-qasituna fakanu li-jahannama hataba
versets.francais: Quant aux injustes, ils seront du combustible pour la Géhenne
versets.anglais: But as for the unjust, they will be, for Hell, firewood

versets.arabe: وَأَلَّوِ اسْتَقَامُوا عَلَى الطَّرِيقَةِ لَأَسْقَيْنَاهُم مَّاءً غَدَقًا
versets.phonetique: Wa allow staqamu ala t-tariqqati la-asqaynahum ma-an ghadaqan
versets.francais: Si les gens s-étaient maintenus dans la droiture, Nous leur aurions accordé une eau abondante
versets.anglais: And [Allah revealed] that if they had remained straight on the way, We would have given them abundant provision

versets.arabe: لِّنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِيهِ وَمَن يُعْرِضْ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِ يَسْلُكْهُ عَذَابًا صَعَدًا
versets.phonetique: Li-naftиnahum fihi wa man yu-rid an dhikri rabbihi yaslukhu adhaban sa-ada
versets.francais: Pour les y éprouver. Celui qui se détourne du rappel de son Seigneur, Il le fera entrer dans un châtiment croissant
versets.anglais: So We might test them therein. And whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord He will put into arduous punishment

versets.arabe: وَأَنَّ الْمَسَاجِدَ لِلَّهِ فَلَا تَدْعُوا مَعَ اللَّهِ أَحَدًا
versets.phonetique: Wa anna l-masajida lillahi fala tadu-u ma-a l-lahi ahada
versets.francais: Les mosquées sont pour Allah, n-invoquez donc personne aux côtés d-Allah
versets.anglais: And [He revealed] that the masjids are for Allah, so do not invoke with Allah anyone

versets.arabe: وَأَنَّهُ لَمَّا قَامَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ يَدْعُوهُ كَادُوا يَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِ لِبَدًا
versets.phonetique: Wa annahu lamma qama abdu l-lahi yad-uhu kadu yakununa alayhi libada
versets.francais: Lorsque le serviteur d-Allah se leva pour L-invoquer, ils faillirent se ruer sur lui en masse
versets.anglais: And that when the Servant of Allah stood up supplicating Him, they almost became about him a compacted mass

versets.arabe: قُلْ إِنَّمَا أَدْعُو رَبِّي وَلَا أُشْرِكُ بِهِ أَحَدًا
versets.phonetique: Qul innama ad-u rabbi wa la ushrika bihi ahada
versets.francais: Dis : J-invoque seulement mon Seigneur et je ne Lui associe personne
versets.anglais: Say, [O Muhammad], "I only invoke my Lord and do not associate with Him anyone

versets.arabe: قُلْ إِنِّي لَا أَمْلِكُ لَكُمْ ضَرًّا وَلَا رَشَدًا
versets.phonetique: Qul inni la amliku lakum darran wa la rashada
versets.francais: Dis : Je ne maîtrise ni le tort ni le bienfait pour vous
versets.anglais: Say, "Indeed, I do not possess for you [the power of] harm or right direction

versets.arabe: قُلْ إِنِّي لَن يُجِيرَنِي مِنَ اللَّهِ أَحَدٌ وَلَنْ أَجِدَ مِن دُونِهِ مُلْتَحَدًا
versets.phonetique: Qul inni lan yujiranie mina l-lahi ahadun wa lan ajida min dunihi multahada
versets.francais: Dis : Personne ne me protègera d-Allah et je ne trouverai aucun refuge en dehors de Lui
versets.anglais: Say, "Indeed, there will never protect me from Allah anyone [if I should disobey], nor will I find in other than Him a refuge

versets.arabe: إِلَّا بَلَاغًا مِّنَ اللَّهِ وَرِسَالَاتِهِ وَمَن يَعْصِ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ فَإِنَّ لَهُ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا أَبَدًا
versets.phonetique: Illa balaghan mina l-lahi wa risalatihi wa man ya-si l-laha wa rasulahu fa-inna lahu nara jahannama khalidina fiha abada
versets.francais: Ma mission n-est que de transmettre de la part d-Allah et Ses messages. Celui qui désobéit à Allah et à Son messager, il aura le feu de la Géhenne pour y demeurer éternellement
versets.anglais: But [I have for you] only notification from Allah, and His messages." And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger - then indeed, for him is the fire of Hell; they will abide therein forever

versets.arabe: حَتَّىٰ إِذَا رَأَوْا مَا يُوعَدُونَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ أَضْعَفُ نَاصِرًا وَأَقَلُّ عَدَدًا
versets.phonetique: Hatta idha ra-aw ma yu-aduna fasaya-lamuna man ad-afu nasiran wa aqallu adada
versets.francais: Quand ils verront ce qui leur est promis, ils sauront qui est le plus faible en soutien et le moins nombreux
versets.anglais: [The disbelievers continue] until, when they see that which they are promised, then they will know who is weaker in helpers and less in number

versets.arabe: قُلْ إِنْ أَدْرِي أَقَرِيبٌ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ أَمْ يَجْعَلُ لَهُ رَبِّي أَمَدًا
versets.phonetique: Qul in adri aqaribun ma tu-aduna am yaj-alu lahu rabbi amada
versets.francais: Dis : Je ne sais pas si ce qui vous est promis est proche ou si mon Seigneur lui fixera un terme lointain
versets.anglais: Say, "I do not know if what you are promised is near or if my Lord will grant for it a [long] period

versets.arabe: عَالِمُ الْغَيْبِ فَلَا يُظْهِرُ عَلَىٰ غَيْبِهِ أَحَدًا
versets.phonetique: Alimu l-ghaybi fala yuzhiru ala ghaybihi ahada
versets.francais: Connaisseur de l-invisible, Il ne dévoile Son invisible à personne
versets.anglais: [He is] Knower of the unseen, and He does not disclose His [knowledge of the] unseen to anyone

versets.arabe: إِلَّا مَنِ ارْتَضَىٰ مِن رَّسُولٍ فَإِنَّهُ يَسْلُكُ مِن بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِ رَصَدًا
versets.phonetique: Illa mani rtada min rasulin fa-innahu yasluku min bayni yadayhi wa min khalfihi rasada
versets.francais: Sauf à celui qu-Il agrée comme messager. Il envoie alors des gardiens devant lui et derrière lui
versets.anglais: Except whom He has approved of messengers, and indeed, He sends before each messenger and behind him observers

versets.arabe: لِيَعْلَمَ أَن قَدْ أَبْلَغُوا رِسَالَاتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَأَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ وَأَحْصَىٰ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ عَدَدًا
versets.phonetique: Li-ya-lama an qad ablaghu risalati rabbihim wa ahata bima ladayhim wa ahsa kulla shay-in adada
versets.francais: Pour qu-Il sache qu-ils ont transmis les messages de leur Seigneur. Il embrasse tout ce qui est auprès d-eux et dénombre toute chose
versets.anglais: That he may know that they have conveyed the messages of their Lord; and He has encompassed whatever is with them and has enumerated all things in number

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الْمُزَّمِّلُ
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuha l-muzzammil
versets.francais: O toi qui t-enveloppes
versets.anglais: O you who wraps himself [in clothing]

versets.arabe: قُمِ اللَّيْلَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا
versets.phonetique: Qumi l-layla illa qalila
versets.francais: Lève-toi la nuit, sauf une petite partie
versets.anglais: Arise [to pray] the night, except for a little

versets.arabe: نِّصْفَهُ أَوِ انقُصْ مِنْهُ قَلِيلًا
versets.phonetique: Nisfahu awi nqus minhu qalila
versets.francais: Sa moitié, ou un peu moins
versets.anglais: Half of it - or subtract from it a little

versets.arabe: أَوْ زِدْ عَلَيْهِ وَرَتِّلِ الْقُرْآنَ تَرْتِيلًا
versets.phonetique: Aw zid alayhi wa rattili l-qur-ana tartila
versets.francais: Ou un peu plus. Et récite le Coran posément
versets.anglais: Or add to it, and recite the Qur'an with measured recitation

versets.arabe: إِنَّا سَنُلْقِي عَلَيْكَ قَوْلًا ثَقِيلًا
versets.phonetique: Inna sanalqi alayka qawlan thaqila
versets.francais: Nous allons te révéler une parole lourde de sens
versets.anglais: Indeed, We will cast upon you a heavy word

versets.arabe: إِنَّ نَاشِئَةَ اللَّيْلِ هِيَ أَشَدُّ وَطْئًا وَأَقْوَمُ قِيلًا
versets.phonetique: Inna nashi-ata l-layli hiya ashaddu wat-an wa aqwamu qila
versets.francais: Certes la prière de nuit est plus propice à la concentration et meilleure pour la parole
versets.anglais: Indeed, the hours of the night are more effective for concurrence [of heart and tongue] and more suitable for words

versets.arabe: إِنَّ لَكَ فِي النَّهَارِ سَبْحًا طَوِيلًا
versets.phonetique: Inna laka fi n-nahari sabhan tawila
versets.francais: Tu as le jour de nombreuses occupations
versets.anglais: Indeed, for you by day is prolonged occupation

versets.arabe: وَاذْكُرِ اسْمَ رَبِّكَ وَتَبَتَّلْ إِلَيْهِ تَبْتِيلًا
versets.phonetique: Wa dhkuri sma rabbika wa tabattal ilayhi tabtila
versets.francais: Invoque le nom de ton Seigneur et consacre-Lui un entier dévouement
versets.anglais: And remember the name of your Lord and devote yourself to Him with [complete] devotion

versets.arabe: رَّبُّ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَاتَّخِذْهُ وَكِيلًا
versets.phonetique: Rabbu l-mashriqi wa l-maghribi la ilaha illa huwa fattakhidhhu wakila
versets.francais: Le Seigneur de l-Orient et de l-Occident, pas de divinité en dehors de Lui. Prends-Le comme Protecteur
versets.anglais: [He is] the Lord of the East and the West; there is no deity except Him, so take Him as Disposer of [your] affairs

versets.arabe: وَاصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَاهْجُرْهُمْ هَجْرًا جَمِيلًا
versets.phonetique: Wa sbir ala ma yaquluna wa hjurhum hajran jamila
versets.francais: Sois patient face à ce qu-ils disent et éloigne-toi d-eux avec élégance
versets.anglais: And be patient over what they say and avoid them with gracious avoidance

versets.arabe: وَذَرْنِي وَالْمُكَذِّبِينَ أُولِي النَّعْمَةِ وَمَهِّلْهُمْ قَلِيلًا
versets.phonetique: Wa dhарни wa l-mukadhdhibina uli n-ni-mati wa mahhilhum qalila
versets.francais: Laisse-Moi avec ceux qui démentent et qui jouissent du bien-être. Accorde-leur un court délai
versets.anglais: And leave Me with [the matter of] the deniers, those of ease [in life], and allow them respite a little

versets.arabe: إِنَّ لَدَيْنَا أَنكَالًا وَجَحِيمًا
versets.phonetique: Inna ladayna ankalan wa jahima
versets.francais: Nous avons des entraves et un brasier
versets.anglais: Indeed, with Us [for them] are shackles and burning fire

versets.arabe: وَطَعَامًا ذَا غُصَّةٍ وَعَذَابًا أَلِيمًا
versets.phonetique: Wa ta-aman dha ghussatin wa adhaban alima
versets.francais: Et une nourriture qui s-étrangle et un châtiment douloureux
versets.anglais: And food that chokes and a painful punishment

versets.arabe: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ الْأَرْضُ وَالْجِبَالُ وَكَانَتِ الْجِبَالُ كَثِيبًا مَّهِيلًا
versets.phonetique: Yawma tarjufu l-ardu wa l-jibalu wa kanati l-jibalu kathiban mahila
versets.francais: Le jour où la terre et les montagnes trembleront et où les montagnes deviendront des dunes de sable mouvant
versets.anglais: On the Day the earth and the mountains will convulse and the mountains will become a heap of sand pouring down

versets.arabe: إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَا إِلَيْكُمْ رَسُولًا شَاهِدًا عَلَيْكُمْ كَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ رَسُولًا
versets.phonetique: Inna arsalna ilaykum rasulan shahidan alaykum kama arsalna ila fir-awna rasula
versets.francais: Nous vous avons envoyé un messager pour témoigner contre vous, comme Nous avions envoyé un messager à Pharaon
versets.anglais: Indeed, We have sent to you a Messenger as a witness upon you just as We sent to Pharaoh a messenger

versets.arabe: فَعَصَىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ الرَّسُولَ فَأَخَذْنَاهُ أَخْذًا وَبِيلًا
versets.phonetique: Fa-asa fir-awnu r-rasula fa-akhadhnaahu akhdan wabila
versets.francais: Pharaon a désobéi au messager et Nous l-avons saisi d-une saisie sévère
versets.anglais: But Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger, so We seized him with a ruinous seizure

versets.arabe: فَكَيْفَ تَتَّقُونَ إِن كَفَرْتُمْ يَوْمًا يَجْعَلُ الْوِلْدَانَ شِيبًا
versets.phonetique: Fakayfa tattaquna in kafartum yawman yaj-alu l-wildana shiba
versets.francais: Comment vous protègerez-vous, si vous mécroissez, d-un Jour qui fera blanchir les cheveux des enfants
versets.anglais: Then how can you fear, if you disbelieve, a Day that will make the children white- haired

versets.arabe: السَّمَاءُ مُنفَطِرٌ بِهِ كَانَ وَعْدُهُ مَفْعُولًا
versets.phonetique: As-sama-u munfatirun bihi kana wa-duhu maf-ula
versets.francais: Le ciel se fendra en ce jour. Sa promesse sera accomplie
versets.anglais: The heaven will break apart therefrom; ever is His promise fulfilled

versets.arabe: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِ تَذْكِرَةٌ فَمَن شَاءَ اتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِ سَبِيلًا
versets.phonetique: Inna hadhihi tadhkiratun faman sha-a ttakhadha ila rabbihi sabila
versets.francais: Ceci est un rappel. Que celui qui veut prenne un chemin vers son Seigneur
versets.anglais: Indeed, this is a reminder, so whoever wills may take to his Lord a way

versets.arabe: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ تَقُومُ أَدْنَىٰ مِن ثُلُثَيِ اللَّيْلِ وَنِصْفَهُ وَثُلُثَهُ وَطَائِفَةٌ مِّنَ الَّذِينَ مَعَكَ
versets.phonetique: Inna rabbaka ya-lamu annaka taqumu adna min thuluthay l-layli wa nisfahu wa thuluthahu wa ta-ifatun mina lladhina ma-ak
versets.francais: Ton Seigneur sait que tu passes en prière un peu moins des deux tiers de la nuit, ou la moitié, ou le tiers, avec un groupe de ceux qui sont avec toi
versets.anglais: Indeed, your Lord knows, [O Muhammad], that you stand [in prayer] almost two thirds of the night or half of it or a third of it, and [so do] a group of those with you. And Allah determines [the extent of] the night and the day. He has known that you [Muslims] will not be able to do it and has turned to you in forgiveness, so recite what is easy [for you] of the Qur'an. He has known that there will be among you those who are ill and others traveling throughout the land seeking [something] of the bounty of Allah and others fighting for the cause of Allah. So recite what is easy from it and establish prayer and give zakah and loan Allah a goodly loan. And whatever good you put forward for yourselves - you will find it with Allah. It is better and greater in reward. And seek forgiveness of Allah. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful

versets.arabe: يَا أَيُّهَا الْمُدَّثِّرُ
versets.phonetique: Ya ayyuha l-muddaththir
versets.francais: O toi qui te couvres !
versets.anglais: O you who covers himself [with a garment]

versets.arabe: قُمْ فَأَنذِرْ
versets.phonetique: Qum fa-andhir
versets.francais: Lève-toi et avertis !
versets.anglais: Arise and warn

versets.arabe: وَرَبَّكَ فَكَبِّرْ
versets.phonetique: Wa rabbaka fa-kabbir
versets.francais: Magnifie ton Seigneur !
versets.anglais: And your Lord glorify

versets.arabe: وَثِيَابَكَ فَطَهِّرْ
versets.phonetique: Wa thiyabaka fa-tahhir
versets.francais: Et purifie tes vêtements !
versets.anglais: And your clothing purify

versets.arabe: وَالرُّجْزَ فَاهْجُرْ
versets.phonetique: Wa r-rujza fa-hjur
versets.francais: Et fuis la souillure !
versets.anglais: And uncleanliness avoid
